source_text: 右肺下叶背段、右肺中叶、左肺上叶舌段多发结节大致同前，较大约6x5mm（IM36）
text_en: Multiple nodules in the right lower lobe (dorsal segment), right middle lobe, and left upper lobe (lingular segment) are essentially unchanged, the largest measuring approximately 6x5 mm (IM36).

source_text: 胸骨局限性高密度灶同前，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Localized high-density lesion in sternum unchanged from previous; no bone destruction seen in other scanned bones.

source_text: 右下肺胸膜下少许小片影较前相仿，双肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: The small patchy opacity subpleurally in the right lower lobe is similar to prior examination. No new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 余诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: The remaining bones show no signs of osseous destruction.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下小结节同前（IM18、42）
text_en: Subpleural small nodule in the right lung is unchanged from prior (IM18, 42)

source_text: 胸椎体高密度小结节及左第9肋局部骨质密度略增高同前（IM48）
text_en: Small high-density nodules in the thoracic vertebral bodies and slight focal increase in bone density in the left 9th rib, same as before (IM48).

source_text: 扫及甲状腺左叶低密度结节同前
text_en: Low-density nodule in the left thyroid lobe unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双侧胸膜不均匀结节样增厚伴部分结节样钙化同前
text_en: Bilateral pleural thickening is nodular and irregular, with partial nodular calcification, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺内索条小结节灶同前
text_en: The linear and nodular opacities in the right lung are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左锁骨上小淋巴结同前，纵隔多发淋巴结较前相仿，较大现约7x4mm（IM16）
text_en: Left supraclavicular small lymph node unchanged from prior. Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes similar to prior. The largest now measures approximately 7x4 mm (IM16)

source_text: 两肺多发小结节较前缩小，原较大约13*8mm，现较大约5mm（IM50）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are smaller than prior; the previously largest was about 13x8 mm, now about 5 mm (IM50).

source_text: 左肺多发磨玻璃结节同前
text_en: Multiple ground-glass nodules in the left lung unchanged from prior.

source_text: 食管旁小淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Paraesophageal small lymph node unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双侧锁骨上区淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Lymph nodes in the bilateral supraclavicular regions are stable compared to prior, all less than 10 mm.

source_text: 右肺中叶不规则片絮及索条影影、左肺上叶胸膜下肺大泡及右肺胸膜下小结节（IM51）大致同前，余肺野未见新发结节及斑片影
text_en: Irregular patchy and linear opacities in the right middle lobe, subpleural bulla in the left upper lobe, and a small subpleural nodule in the right lung (IM51) are essentially unchanged; remainder of the lung fields show no new nodules or patchy opacities

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，约6mm（IM36）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM36).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段软组织密度结节较前稍增大，实性密度区原约14x13mm，现约16x13mm（IMA21），轻度强化，仍可见分叶及胸膜凹陷
text_en: A soft-tissue density nodule in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe has slightly increased compared to prior, with the solid density area previously approximately 14x13 mm, now approximately 16x13 mm (IMA21), mild enhancement, and lobulation and pleural indentation still visible

source_text: 左肺底高密度小结节同前，直径约5mm（IM44），余肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Small high-density nodule at the left lung base unchanged from prior, approximately 5mm in diameter (IM44); no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remaining lung.

source_text: 双肺小结节灶同前，较大约8x6mm（IM52）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodule foci are stable compared to prior, largest approximately 8x6 mm (IM52)

source_text: 纵隔内淋巴结较前增大
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes enlarged compared to previous.

source_text: 右侧叶间裂新见多发小结节，较大约4mm（IM43）左侧胸膜略厚同前
text_en: Multiple new small nodules are seen along the right interlobar fissure, the largest measuring approximately 4 mm (IM43). The left pleura is slightly thickened, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸主动脉旁微小结节同前(图28)
text_en: A tiny nodule adjacent to the thoracic aorta in the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior (Figure 28).

source_text: 右后胸膜小结节大致同前（IM23）
text_en: The small pleural nodule in the right posterior aspect is essentially unchanged compared to prior (IM23).

source_text: 左胸壁皮下小结节灶同前，追查
text_en: Left chest wall subcutaneous small nodule stable, follow-up.

source_text: 左肺索条影、双肺下叶小结节同前（IM42、52），较大约4mm（IM42）
text_en: Left lung linear opacities and small nodules in both lower lobes unchanged from prior (IM42, 52), largest approximately 4 mm (IM42)

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段模糊结节灶同前（IMA45）
text_en: Left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment: hazy nodular focus unchanged from previous (IMA45).

source_text: 余双肺小结节较前大致相仿
text_en: Residual multiple small nodules in both lungs are approximately similar to prior

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，现约3mm（IM57）
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior, currently approximately 3 mm (IM57).

source_text: 左肺胸膜下结节影、右肺上叶前段浅淡结节同前
text_en: Left lung subpleural nodule shadow, right upper lobe anterior segment faint nodule unchanged

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃结节灶大致同前，约16x13mm（IM23），周围边界不清
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe posterior segment is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 16 x 13 mm (IM23), with indistinct margins.

source_text: 双肺少许陈旧灶同前（IM9、33、47），余肺未见新发结节及片絮影
text_en: Few chronic foci in both lungs are stable (IM9, 33, 47); the remainder of the lungs show no new nodules or fluffy opacities.

source_text: 右肺上叶结节大致同前，约8x6mm（IMA28），余两肺散在模糊结节影同前相仿，双肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: The nodule in the right upper lobe is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 8x6 mm (IMA28). The scattered hazy nodular opacities in the rest of the lungs are similar to prior studies. No new nodules or consolidations are seen in either lung.

source_text: 双肺少许小结节同前（Im42），未见新生结节及斑片影
text_en: Few small nodules in both lungs are stable (Im42); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺见软组织结节同前，约9mm(IM61)
text_en: On imaging, a soft tissue nodule measuring approximately 9 mm is seen in the left adrenal gland, unchanged from prior (IM61).

source_text: 扫及双侧肾上腺呈结节样增粗较前减轻，左侧原约14x11mm（IM59），现约8mm（IM58）
text_en: Nodular thickening of the bilateral adrenal glands has decreased compared to prior, left side previously approximately 14x11 mm (IM59), now approximately 8 mm (IM58)

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段、前段不规则厚壁空洞，尖段者较前增大，原约28x25cm（IM18），现约54x33cm(IM19)，腔内可见液平，空洞外壁多发斑片影
text_en: Irregular thick-walled cavity in the right upper lobe apical and anterior segments; the apical component increased in size, previously approximately 28x25 cm (IM18), now approximately 54x33 cm (IM19); air-fluid level visible within the cavity; multiple patchy opacities in the outer wall

source_text: 新见淋巴结
text_en: Newly seen lymph nodes

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺结节略增大，现约17x12mm（IM57），原约14x11mm（IM56）
text_en: Left adrenal nodule slightly enlarged, currently approximately 17x12 mm (IM57), previously approximately 14x11 mm (IM56).

source_text: 右肺索条及钙化影同前，右肺下叶可见小结节，大小约4mm（IM39），追查
text_en: Linear opacities and calcifications in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior; a small nodule is seen in the right lower lobe, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM39), and follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 双肺弥漫转移结节普遍较前增大，如较大灶原约9mm（IM17），现约10mm（IM16）
text_en: Diffusely distributed metastatic nodules in both lungs are generally larger than prior; for example, the largest lesion previously measured about 9 mm (IM17), now about 10 mm (IM16).

source_text: 双肺未见新发灶
text_en: No new foci seen in both lungs.

text_en: newly identified nodule

text_en: The mediastinal station 4R lymph node is unchanged (Fig. 17), and no enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the remaining mediastinum

source_text: 新增散在淋巴结
text_en: newly identified scattered lymph nodes

text_en: Cavitary mass in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is smaller than before, previously measuring approximately 4.3x3 cm (IM14), now approximately 3.6x2.6 cm (IM13), with thinner wall compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶微小结节影同前（IM17）
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule unchanged (IM17).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变同前，支气管断端未见占位
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lobe are unchanged; no mass at the bronchial stump

source_text: 右肺上叶钙化小结节同前
text_en: Calcified small nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段结节同前相仿，仍约9x7mm（IM28），上叶纵隔旁另一小结节灶同前，约7x6mm（IM17）
text_en: Nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, similar to prior, still approximately 9x7 mm (IM28); another small nodular focus adjacent to the mediastinum in the upper lobe, stable, approximately 7x6 mm (IM17)

source_text: 右下肺肿块大致同前，现约48x42mm（IM28），肿物与远端不张肺组织及胸腔积液分界不清
text_en: The mass in the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged, currently measuring approximately 48x42 mm (IM28). The lesion has indistinct margins with the distal atelectatic lung tissue and pleural effusion.

source_text: 纵隔散在淋巴结较前稍饱满，较大现约10x7mm（IM22），原约8x7mm（IM23）
text_en: Mediastinal scattered lymph nodes slightly enlarged compared to previous, largest now approximately 10x7 mm (IM22), previously approximately 8x7 mm (IM23).

source_text: 左肺下叶少许斑片索条影同前，未见结节灶
text_en: Few patchy and linear opacities in the left lower lobe unchanged from prior, no nodules seen

source_text: 右肺尖脊柱旁不规则类结节影同前，约8x2mm(IM11)，邻近胸膜增厚同前
text_en: The irregular nodular opacity adjacent to the spine in the right lung apex is unchanged, measuring approximately 8x2 mm (IM11). Adjacent pleural thickening is unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶下舌段增粗迂曲血管影同前（IMA42-46），余肺未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: The thickened and tortuous vascular shadow in the lower lingular segment of the left upper lobe remains unchanged (IMA42-46); no new nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺结节同前，考虑良性
text_en: Left pulmonary nodule unchanged from prior, considered benign.

source_text: 纵隔2R组局部心包上隐窝少量积液同前，约13x10mm（IM16），相邻的高密度小淋巴结同前，双侧锁骨上及腋窝平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Small amount of localized fluid in the supracardiac recess of mediastinal station 2R unchanged from previous, approximately 13x10 mm (IM16), adjacent small high-density lymph node unchanged from previous, no enlarged lymph nodes seen on non-contrast scan in bilateral supraclavicular and axillary regions.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃结节较前相仿，约12x10mm（IM20），右肺下叶微小磨玻璃密度灶同前（IM25）
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is similar to prior, approximately 12x10 mm (IM20). Tiny ground-glass opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM25).

source_text: 左上肺不规则索条灶，局部较前增大，倾向恶性，建议活检
text_en: Irregular linear opacity in the left upper lobe has increased locally compared to prior, favoring malignancy; biopsy is recommended.

source_text: 右肺中叶模糊小结节影同前， 约3mm（IM38）
text_en: Faint small nodular opacity in the right middle lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM38).

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门见发小淋巴结较前稍缩小，如隆突下淋巴结短径原约9mm，现约7mm（Im23）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right hilum are slightly reduced compared to prior, such as the subcarinal lymph node with a short axis of approximately 9 mm previously and now approximately 7 mm (Im23).

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结未见增大
text_en: No enlargement of mediastinal small lymph nodes observed.

source_text: 左锁骨上淋巴结较前略增大，现约11x6mm（IMA6），原约8x5mm，追查
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node slightly increased compared to previous, currently approximately 11x6 mm (IMA6), previously approximately 8x5 mm, requires follow-up.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Bilateral lung markings are unremarkable in course, and pulmonary lucency is uniform. No new nodules or consolidations are seen.

source_text: 扫及肝脏多发囊样低密度结节及高密度结节灶同前
text_en: Multiple cystic-like low-density and high-density nodular foci in the liver unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，约4mm（IM37），追查
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, approximately 4 mm (IM37), requires follow-up.

source_text: 右肺下叶支气管截断、肺门肿物同前，强化较前略减低，范围仍约28x25mm(IM30)，远端肺不张大致同前
text_en: Right lower lobe bronchial cutoff and hilar mass unchanged; enhancement is slightly decreased compared to prior. Size remains approximately 28x25 mm (IM30). Distal atelectasis is essentially unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，未见复发、转移征象
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no findings of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 两肺内索条小结节及索条影同前，右肺下叶内基底段小结节约4mm（IMA43）
text_en: Linear nodules and linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged; a small nodule in the medial basal segment of the right lower lobe measures about 4 mm (IMA43).

source_text: 右肺尖结节同前，约4mm（IM11）
text_en: Nodule in the right lung apex is unchanged, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM11).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段分叶状肿块较前增大，原约34x31mm（IM28），现约41x37mm（IM28），内部密度不均，局部支气管截断，内见少许空泡征
text_en: Lobulated mass in the right lower lobe posterior segment is larger than prior, previously approximately 34x31 mm (IM28), now approximately 41x37 mm (IM28), with heterogeneous internal density, localized bronchial truncation, and a few air bronchograms and bubble-like lucencies noted within.

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜结节样增厚同前
text_en: The nodular thickening of the left interlobar pleura is unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段支气管显影，局部软组织团块较前缩小、现局部以大片状改变为主同前，现较大截面约48*40mm(图19)，原约55x51mm（IM20）
text_en: Right upper lobe posterior segmental bronchus is patent; the local soft tissue mass has decreased in size compared to prior and is now predominantly characterized by a large patchy change, similar to before. The largest cross-section is now approximately 48x40 mm (Figure 19), previously about 55x51 mm (IM20).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段小结节较前略增大，原约3mm，现约4mm（IM23），左肺下叶外基底段胸膜下小结节同前（IM38）
text_en: Small nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe slightly increased in size, previously approximately 3 mm, now approximately 4 mm (IM23); small subpleural nodule in the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe, stable (IM38)

source_text: 平扫纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约11*8mm（IMA21）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest approximately 11x8 mm (image 21).

source_text: 余双肺胸膜下少许模糊小结节同前相仿（IM19、29、31等）
text_en: A few indistinct small subpleural nodules in both lungs are similar to prior (IM19, 29, 31, etc.).

text_en: No patchy opacities or new findings

text_en: Bilateral pulmonary micro-nodular opacities are stable compared to prior; largest is approximately 3 mm (IM38).

text_en: Part of the nodule in the right upper lobe is slightly smaller than before; the prior measurement of approximately 5x5 mm (IM21) is now about 4 mm (IM18).

source_text: 左锁骨上区多发小结节较前相仿，较大仍约8mm（IM9）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left supraclavicular region similar to previous, largest still approximately 8 mm (IM9).
Bilateral pulmonary small nodule shadows are stable compared to prior (IMA20, 23, 29, 30, 31, 32, 36, 43), less than 5 mm

source_text: 右肺下叶背段转移结节较前缩小，现约16*12mm(IM30)，原约17x15mm（IM29）
text_en: The metastatic nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, now approximately 16x12 mm (IM30), previously approximately 17x15 mm (IM29).

source_text: 右肺新发结节斑片，请结合临床抗炎治疗后复查
text_en: Newly observed nodule and patchy opacity in the right lung; recommend correlation with clinical findings and follow-up after anti-inflammatory treatment.

source_text: 右肺微小结节影同前（Im10、18、28），右肺钙化索条影同前
text_en: Right lung tiny nodular opacities unchanged (Im10, 18, 28); right lung calcified linear opacities unchanged

source_text: 纵隔2、5、7、8组多发肿大淋巴结较前缩小，较大原约31x20mm（IM31），现约29x16mm（IM30）
text_en: Mediastinal stations 2, 5, 7, and 8 multiple enlarged lymph nodes reduced compared to prior, larger one previously approximately 31x20 mm (IM31), now approximately 29x16 mm (IM30)

source_text: 右侧胸膜下见软组织密度结节略增大，似见轻度强化，原约17x13mm（IM50），现约23x22mm（IM46），右侧壁层胸膜另见强化结节，约25x9mm（IM49）
text_en: Right subpleural soft tissue density nodule is slightly larger and shows mild enhancement, previously measuring approximately 17x13 mm (IM50), now approximately 23x22 mm (IM46). Another enhancing nodule is seen in the right parietal pleura, measuring approximately 25x9 mm (IM49).

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，右肺上叶磨玻璃密度小结节及右肺门小淋巴结同前
text_en: Following right upper lobectomy, a small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe and a small lymph node at the right hilum are unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下小结节大致同前，建议追查
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural nodule approximately stable compared to prior, recommend follow-up

source_text: 纵隔内多发小淋巴结同前，较大约9mm（IMA14）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes, stable compared to prior. Largest approximately 9 mm (IMA14).

source_text: 食管癌疗后改变，较前明显缩小
text_en: Post-treatment for esophageal cancer, changes significantly decreased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 两肺索条影、左肺下叶索条小结节影同前，约3mm（IM39）
text_en: The linear opacities and the linear small nodules in the left lower lobe are unchanged, about 3 mm (IM39).

source_text: 右肺中叶术后，支气管断端未见异常肿块影，右肺索条影同前
text_en: Status post right middle lobectomy; no abnormal mass is seen at the bronchial stump. Linear opacities in the right lung are stable.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段陈旧微小结节同前（Im25），余肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Old micro-nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is stable (Im25); no new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lungs

source_text: 双肺小结节大小同前，仍约3mm、3mm、5mm（IM12、31、32）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are stable in size compared to prior, remaining approximately 3 mm, 3 mm, and 5 mm (IM12, 31, 32)

source_text: 右肺下叶背段小结节同前，追查
text_en: Small nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged; further follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结较前略增大，追查
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes have slightly increased in size compared to previous. Follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶沿支气管分布小结节较前略减少（IM51），余双肺未见新发增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Left lower lobe small nodules distributed along bronchi slightly decreased compared to previous (IM51), no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见占位，管壁周围少许软组织密度影同前
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy. No mass is seen at the bronchial stump. A small amount of soft tissue density around the wall is unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段结节影同前，约8x6mm（IM36）
text_en: Left lower lobe posterior segment nodule unchanged, approximately 8x6 mm (IM36).

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节影同前（IMA15、16、27）
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule same as before (IMA15, 16, 27).

source_text: 右肺中叶、左肺下叶结节较前增大，原约5mm（IM41），现约7mm（IM39）
text_en: Nodules in the right middle lobe and left lower lobe are larger than prior; previously approximately 5 mm (IM41), now approximately 7 mm (IM39)

source_text: 余肺未见新增结节灶及片絮影
text_en: The remainder of the lungs shows no new nodules or floccular opacities.

source_text: 胸9椎体密度不均及腰1椎体椎管前壁钙化灶同前，余胸壁诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: Inhomogeneous density of the T9 vertebral body and calcified focus on the anterior wall of the spinal canal at L1 vertebral body, unchanged from prior; no bone destruction seen in the remaining thoracic wall bones.

source_text: 胸7椎体高密度小结节同前，余扫及诸骨未见破坏征象
text_en: Dense small nodule in T7 vertebra, unchanged from previous; no bone destruction seen in other scanned bones.

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节同前，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: The small nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged and considered chronic.

source_text: 左肺上叶结节，同前相仿
text_en: Nodule in the left upper lobe, similar to previous.

source_text: 椎体新见高密度结节（IMA45），建议骨扫描
text_en: Newly seen high-density nodule in the vertebrae (IMA45), recommend bone scan.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结部分缩小，隆突下较大者原约17*14mm（IMA25），现约17*10mm（IM25），平扫部分显示不清
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes are reduced in size; the largest subcarinal was previously approximately 17*14mm (IMA25) and is now approximately 17*10mm (IM25); partially not visualized on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 右腋下淋巴结稍缩小，原约15x13mm，现约14x12mm（Im22）
text_en: Right axillary lymph node slightly decreased in size, previously measuring approximately 15x13 mm, now measuring approximately 14x12 mm (Im22).

source_text: 左肺叶间胸膜结节影同前，仍约8x4mm（IM37）
text_en: Left lung interlobar pleural nodule unchanged from prior, still approximately 8x4 mm (IM37).

source_text: 右肺、叶间胸膜小结节同前
text_en: Small nodules in the right lung and interlobar pleura unchanged.

source_text: 左肺散在磨玻璃结节同前
text_en: Scattered ground-glass nodules in the left lung unchanged from previous

source_text: 右侧胸膜增厚较前减轻且范围缩小，现较厚约9mm(图29)，原约13mm(图29)
text_en: Right pleural thickening is less than prior and the extent has decreased. The maximum thickness is now about 9 mm (Figure 29), previously about 13 mm (Figure 29).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结部分饱满同前，较大约10mm(IM21)
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes are full-appearing and unchanged from prior, largest approximately 10 mm (IM21).

source_text: 双侧肾上腺结节同前，追查
text_en: Bilateral adrenal nodules are unchanged; continued follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，约4mm（IMA49）
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 4 mm (IMA49).

source_text: 隆突下脂肪间隙密度增高，小结节影较前相仿，现约14x9mm（IM36），结合临床复查
text_en: Subcarinal fat plane increased density, small nodular shadow similar to prior, now approximately 14x9 mm (IM36), in conjunction with clinical follow-up.

source_text: 右上纵隔稍增大淋巴结同前（IM19），纵隔余组及肺门平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Slightly enlarged lymph node in the right upper mediastinum is unchanged (IM19); no enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the remaining mediastinal groups and hilar regions on non-contrast imaging.

source_text: 余双肺小结节同前，追查
text_en: Residual multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged; follow-up recommended

source_text: 纵隔及肺门多发淋巴结伴钙化同前
text_en: Multiple mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes with calcification unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺内未见新发结节
text_en: No new nodules are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 双肺新见多发小结节，较大约7*5mm(图20)，考虑转移
text_en: Newly noted multiple small nodules in both lungs, the largest measuring approximately 7x5 mm (Figure 20), considered metastatic.
Right lung small nodules unchanged (IM8, 19, 29, 36, 46)

source_text: 纵隔4、5、6、7、10组淋巴结较前相仿，较大约13x9mm（IM23）
text_en: Mediastinal stations 4, 5, 6, 7, and 10 lymph nodes similar to prior, largest approximately 13x9 mm (IM23).

source_text: 纵隔4R、4L、5、7区可见多发小淋巴结同前，短径小于10mm，双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R, 4L, 5, and 7 unchanged from previous, short axis diameter less than 10 mm, no enlarged lymph nodes seen in bilateral hilar, supraclavicular, or bilateral axillary regions

source_text: 新见多发簇状分布结节
text_en: Newly seen multiple nodules with clustered distribution

source_text: 双肺结节灶部分较前相仿，仍约6mm（IM42）
text_en: Some bilateral pulmonary nodules are similar to prior, still measuring approximately 6 mm (IM42).

source_text: 右肺上叶结节影同前相仿（IM25），追查
text_en: The nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior imaging (IM25); further investigation is recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶可见微小结节同前，＜5mm（IM13）
text_en: Micronodules in left upper lobe unchanged, less than 5 mm (IM13)

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大现仍约14x7mm（IM24）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest measures approximately 14x7 mm (IM24).

source_text: Findings document explicit comparative improvement language (e.g., 较前缩小/吸收).
text_en: Findings document explicit comparative improvement language (e.g., decreased in size or absorption compared to prior).

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段胸膜下不规则实性结节较前缩小，原约20x15mm，现约17x11mm（Im24），紧贴胸膜同前
text_en: The irregular solid nodule subpleurally in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 20x15 mm, now approximately 17x11 mm (Im24); remains in contact with the pleura as before.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前相仿（IM27）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is similar to prior (IM27).

source_text: 右肺中叶微小结节同前（IMA37）
text_en: Right middle lobe tiny nodule unchanged from prior (IMA37)

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，局部条片状不均匀软组织密度影较前缩小，其内伴致密金属影同前，现约62x21mm（IM20），原约88x37mm（IM22），随诊观察
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; the local ill-defined linear and patchy soft tissue density has decreased in size compared to prior, with stable dense metallic opacity within. Now approximately 62 x 21 mm (IM20), previously about 88 x 37 mm (IM22). Follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶原多发小结节较前缩小减少，较大者原约9x6mm，现呈索条状，约4x2mm（IM34），追查
text_en: Previously multiple small nodules in the right lower lobe are smaller and fewer; the largest was previously approximately 9 × 6 mm, now appears as a linear band, measuring approximately 4 × 2 mm (IM34); further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左侧斜裂微小结节同前（IM19），余双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Tiny nodule in the left oblique fissure is unchanged (IM19); otherwise, no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 胸骨前软组织小结节同前（IM15）
text_en: Small soft tissue nodule anterior to sternum, unchanged from previous (IM15)

source_text: 纵隔内多发小淋巴结同前，心包上隐窝少量液性密度同前（Im28）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes, stable compared to prior. Small amount of fluid density in the superior pericardial recess, stable compared to prior (Im28).

source_text: 纵隔多个淋巴结显示同前相仿，较大约12x10mm（IM23）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes similar to previous, the largest approximately 12x10 mm (IM23)

source_text: 右侧胸膜结节同前，左侧胸膜局限性增厚，双侧未见胸水征象
text_en: The right pleural nodule is unchanged from prior. There is localized thickening of the left pleura. No pleural effusion is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段可见不规则片状软组织密度影较前增大，原范围约33x16mm(IM18)，现约56x23mm（IM19），边缘可见毛刺和索条，实性成分增多，可见强化
text_en: An irregular patchy soft tissue density shadow in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment has increased in size compared to prior, from approximately 33 x 16 mm (IM18) to 56 x 23 mm (IM19). The margins show spiculation and strands, with increased solid component and enhancement.

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则形混杂磨玻璃密度小结节大致同前，边界不清，现仍约20x13mm（IMA15），内见小空泡
text_en: Irregular mixed ground-glass density nodule in the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior, with ill-defined margins, currently measuring approximately 20 x 13 mm (IMA15), containing a small air bubble.

source_text: 纵隔食管旁淋巴结同前相仿，约15x13mm（Im9），追查
text_en: The mediastinal paraesophageal lymph node is similar to previous, approximately 15x13mm (Im9), follow-up.

source_text: 右肺下叶微小结节同前，约2mm（IMA36）
text_en: Right lower lobe tiny nodule unchanged, approximately 2 mm (IMA36)

source_text: 右肺下叶背段胸膜下小结节同前，约7mm（Im32），边缘模糊，见索条影与胸膜牵拉
text_en: The small subpleural nodule in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 7 mm (Im32), with blurred margins and linear opacities associated with pleural retraction.

source_text: 食管癌疗后，食管胸中下段管壁不均匀增厚较前明显好转，原较厚处约24mm（IM40），现较厚处约6mm（IM29）
text_en: Post-treatment for esophageal cancer, irregular wall thickening in the mid to lower thoracic esophagus significantly improved compared to prior; previously thickest area approximately 24mm (IM40), currently thickest area approximately 6mm (IM29).

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，胸部平扫CT未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Left lower lobe postoperative, chest plain CT shows no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 纵隔及左肺门淋巴结同前，较大约11x6mm（IM27）
text_en: Mediastinal and left hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest approximately 11x6 mm (IM27)

source_text: 右肺清晰，双肺未见新发结节灶及实变影
text_en: Right lung is clear. No new nodules or consolidation are seen in either lung.

source_text: 右侧气管食管沟淋巴结略增大，原约13x11mm（IM8），现约15x12mm(IM7)
text_en: The lymph node in the right tracheoesophageal groove is slightly enlarged, previously measuring approximately 13 x 11 mm (IM8) and now approximately 15 x 12 mm (IM7).

source_text: 纵隔2、4、5、7组及右肺门多发淋巴结部分缩小，多数密度较高，部分见钙化灶，较大现约11x7mm（IM25），原约16x9mm（IM26）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal groups 2, 4, 5, 7 and right hilum are partially reduced in size; most have higher density, and some show calcified foci. The largest is currently approximately 11x7mm (IM25), previously approximately 16x9mm (IM26)

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节影同前
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶磨玻璃密度结节同前
text_en: A ground-glass opacity nodule in the left lower lobe is similar to previous.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门淋巴结同前，较大约11x10mm（IM14），锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal and bilateral hilar lymph nodes, unchanged from previous, the larger one approximately 11x10 mm (IM14). No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the supraclavicular regions or bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 纵隔多个高密度淋巴结同前，较大约10x8mm（IMA24），部分内含钙化
text_en: Multiple mediastinal high-density lymph nodes unchanged from previous, the largest approximately 10x8 mm (IMA24), some containing calcification

source_text: 右肺术后改变同前，支气管断端未见占位
text_en: Findings of prior right lung surgery are unchanged; no space-occupying lesion is seen at the bronchial stump.

source_text: 左锁骨上小淋巴结较前缩小
text_en: Left supraclavicular small lymph node decreased in size compared to prior

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，约13x9mm（IM35）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is unchanged, measuring approximately 13 x 9 mm (IM35).

source_text: 右肺上叶纵隔旁小结节影同前
text_en: Small nodule in the right upper lobe adjacent to the mediastinum is unchanged compared to prior

source_text: 扫及甲状腺右侧叶结节同前相仿
text_en: Nodule in the right thyroid lobe, similar to prior.

source_text: 双肺散在微结节同前，追查
text_en: Scattered micronodules in both lungs are unchanged, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺术后，右肺条片影大致同前(IM23)，缝合线旁软组织结节较前增大，原约14x10mm（IM25），现约17*10mm（IM24），追查
text_en: Postoperative right lung, linear and patchy opacities in the right lung generally unchanged (IM23); soft tissue nodule adjacent to the suture line has increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 14 x 10 mm (IM25), now approximately 17 x 10 mm (IM24); further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 两肺多发小斑片及小结节影同前（IM20、26、32、46、49），右肺索条及类结节影同前
text_en: Multiple small patchy opacities and small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM20, 26, 32, 46, 49); linear and nodular opacities in the right lung are unchanged.

source_text: 扫及多发骨质破坏灶，范围、密度大致同前
text_en: On scan, multiple osseous destruction foci, extent and density largely unchanged from prior

source_text: 双侧肺内小结节较前相仿
text_en: Small nodules in the bilateral lungs are similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下微小结节同前，约2mm（Im2）
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodule in the right lung is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 2 mm (Im2).

source_text: 贲门旁、胃小弯多发肿大淋巴结较前缩小，原较大约26x19mm（IM50），现约18*13mm（IMA53）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes adjacent to the cardia and along the lesser curvature of the stomach have decreased in size; the largest was previously approximately 26x19 mm (IM50) and is now approximately 18x13 mm (IMA53).

source_text: 双肺多发斑片、片结影，左肺大致同前，右肺病灶较前增多
text_en: Multiple patchy and nodular opacities in both lungs; the left lung is roughly unchanged, while the right lung shows an increase in lesions compared to prior.

source_text: 左膈抬高、纵膈略左移同前，纵隔4R组淋巴结区低密度区较前无变化，仍约17x11mm（IM21）
text_en: Left diaphragm elevation and slight left mediastinal shift unchanged from prior; low-density area in the 4R mediastinal lymph node group unchanged, measuring approximately 17x11 mm (IM21).

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前相仿，腔静脉后淋巴结仍约12x7mm（IM21），气管憩室同前
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes similar to prior, retrocaval lymph node still approximately 12x7 mm (IM21), tracheal diverticulum unchanged.

source_text: 右侧胸膜结节同前（IM45）
text_en: The right pleural nodule is unchanged from prior (IM45).

source_text: 纵隔2R组淋巴结同前，大小约8*6mm（IMA12），平扫密度较高
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal station 2R unchanged from previous, approximately 8x6 mm in size (IMA12), higher density on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 食管癌术后，胸胃与左主支气管、胸主动脉之间密度增高范围增大，考虑转移性病变，左主支气管受累
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer, increased density between the intrathoracic stomach and the left main bronchus and thoracic aorta, extent increased compared to prior, suggestive of metastatic lesion, left main bronchus involved.

source_text: 未见确切新发
text_en: No definite new lesions seen

source_text: T8椎体高密度结节同前
text_en: High-density nodule in T8 vertebral body unchanged

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结同前，约14x10mm（IM21)，余纵隔及肺门未见淋巴结肿大
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are stable, measuring approximately 14x10 mm (IM21). No lymphadenopathy is seen in the remaining mediastinal or hilar regions.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺低密度结节影同前
text_en: A low-density nodule is seen in the thyroid, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵膈小淋巴结同前，如7组淋巴结现仍约8x6mm（IM35）
text_en: Small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, such as station 7 lymph node still measuring approximately 8x6 mm (IM35)

source_text: 右肺及左肺含气肺组织内未见新发结节、斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen within the aerated lung parenchyma of the right and left lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段微小结节同前（IM21）
text_en: Tiny nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable (IM21)

source_text: 右后胸膜小结节大致同前（IM22）
text_en: The small pleural nodule in the right posterior aspect is essentially unchanged compared to prior (IM22).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段磨玻璃密度小结节同前，约6x5mm（IM24）
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable, approximately 6x5 mm (IM24)

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段小结节伴钙化灶同前，约7x5mm（IM6）
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment small nodule with calcification unchanged from previous, approximately 7x5 mm (IM6).

source_text: 左肺散在小结节同前（IM27、43）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the left lung unchanged from previous (IM27, 43)

source_text: 右锁骨上小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 食道癌术后改变，未见明显复发征象
text_en: Post esophageal cancer surgery changes; no obvious signs of recurrence.

source_text: 右锁骨上、纵隔及右肺门多个淋巴结缩小，隆突下较大者原约13x7mm（IM25），现约11x6mm（IM23）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region, mediastinum, and right hilum have decreased in size; the largest subcarinal lymph node previously measured approximately 13x7 mm (IM25), now approximately 11x6 mm (IM23).

source_text: 双肺浅淡磨玻璃结节影同前（Im19、28、29）
text_en: Faint ground-glass nodules in both lungs are unchanged (Im19, 28, 29).

source_text: 食管胸中下段管壁增厚减轻，较厚处原约16mm（IM39），现约10mm（IM36），管腔狭窄较前减轻，与胸主动脉之间脂肪间隙尚存
text_en: The wall thickening of the mid-to-lower thoracic esophagus is reduced, with the thickest portion previously measuring approximately 16 mm (IM39) and now approximately 10 mm (IM36). Luminal narrowing is improved compared to prior, and the fat plane between the esophagus and the thoracic aorta is preserved

source_text: 纵隔内散在小淋巴结显示同前，平扫密度较高
text_en: Scattered mediastinal small lymph nodes appear unchanged from prior, with higher density on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下可疑新增结节（IM28），追查
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural suspicious new nodule (IM28), recommend follow-up.

source_text: 扫及胸椎多发转移，密度较前增高，部分椎体缘骨质塌陷较前明显，结合临床及骨扫描检查
text_en: Multiple metastases in the thoracic vertebrae, density increased compared to prior, partial vertebral body margin collapse more pronounced than prior, in conjunction with clinical and bone scan findings.

source_text: 左侧甲状腺内低密度结节同前
text_en: Low-density nodule within the left thyroid unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔、锁骨上、腋下未见新发肿大淋巴结
text_en: No new enlarged lymph nodes seen in mediastinal, supraclavicular, or axillary regions.

source_text: 纵隔气管右侧旁淋巴结较前稍缩小，原约16x9mm（IM7），现约14x8mm（IM10）
text_en: The right paratracheal mediastinal lymph node is slightly smaller than before, previously approximately 16x9 mm (IM7), now approximately 14x8 mm (IM10)

source_text: 新发一实性小结节
text_en: Newly identified solid small nodule.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段磨玻璃结节灶同前，约9*6mm（IMA46），建议追查
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 9 x 6 mm (IMA46), recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段不规则肿块较前缩小，原约40mm（IM31），现约31x26mm（IM32），与肺门血管分界不清
text_en: The irregular mass in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, from approximately 40 mm (IM31) to approximately 31x26 mm (IM32), with indistinct demarcation from the hilar vessels.

source_text: 双肺下叶多发小结节大致同前（Im39、42、46、50），较大者仍约7x4mm（IM46）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the bilateral lower lobes are essentially unchanged compared to prior (Im39, 42, 46, 50); the largest remains approximately 7x4 mm (IM46).

source_text: 双肺散在胸膜下小结节较前相仿（IM13、21、38、53等）
text_en: Scattered subpleural small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior (IM13, 21, 38, 53, etc.).

source_text: 纵隔平扫小淋巴结同前，未见明显异常增大者
text_en: Mediastinal CT without contrast shows small lymph nodes unchanged, no obvious abnormal enlargement.

source_text: 新发多发结节
text_en: Newly developed multiple nodules

source_text: 左肺下叶索条影、两肺散在模糊小结节灶同前，较大约8*6mm（IMA20）
text_en: Left lower lobe linear opacities and scattered indistinct small nodular opacities in both lungs unchanged from prior; largest approximately 8x6 mm (IMA20).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变，胸部CT平扫未见复发转移征象
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; non-contrast chest CT shows no signs of recurrence or metastasis

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节影同前，约3mm（Im30）
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe, same as before, approximately 3mm (Image 30).

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜及双侧胸膜多发结节状增厚较前增大，右肺尖胸膜结节较前增大，如较厚现约13mm（IM12），原约8mm（IM15）
text_en: Multiple nodular thickenings of the right interlobar pleura and bilateral pleura are increased compared to prior. The pleural nodule at the right lung apex is enlarged, increasing from approximately 8 mm (IM15) to approximately 13 mm (IM12).

source_text: 右肺癌术后改变同前
text_en: Postoperative change from right lung cancer is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺上叶、右肺下叶结节同前，仍约2-3mm（IM8、24、28、37等）
text_en: Nodules in the upper lobes of both lungs and the right lower lobe are stable compared to prior, still approximately 2-3 mm (IM8, 24, 28, 37, etc.).

source_text: 右肺下叶钙化小结节同前
text_en: Calcified small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged.

source_text: 左锁骨上、余纵隔多发小淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region and remaining mediastinum unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔内及左侧锁骨上区淋巴结较前相仿
text_en: Lymph nodes within the mediastinum and left supraclavicular region are similar to previous.

source_text: 双侧胸膜及叶间胸膜较前增厚，右侧胸水较前稍多，考虑转移
text_en: Bilateral pleural thickening has increased compared to prior. Right-sided pleural effusion is slightly increased. Metastasis is considered.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段微结节同前
text_en: Micronodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable

source_text: 纵隔内4、5组淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4 and 5 are roughly unchanged from prior

source_text: 胸10椎体内低密度结节较前缩小，建议MRI或结合骨扫描
text_en: Low-density nodule within thoracic vertebra 10 has decreased in size compared to previous, recommend MRI or combined bone scan

source_text: 右肺上叶及下叶结节同前
text_en: The nodules in the right upper and lower lobes remain unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，术区条片影同前，未见新发肿块
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; the linear and patchy opacity in the surgical bed is unchanged; no new mass identified.

source_text: 骨质破坏
text_en: Bone destruction.

source_text: 两肺小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior; follow-up recommended

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段索条影同前，余肺未见明确结节灶
text_en: Linear opacity in the basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged; no definite nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右叶间胸膜约5mm小结节同前（IM41）
text_en: A small nodule measuring approximately 5 mm along the right interlobar pleura is stable compared to prior imaging (IM41).

source_text: 前纵隔结节影较前增大，追查
text_en: Nodular opacity in the anterior mediastinum has increased in size compared to prior, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔散在淋巴结较前相仿，较大约14x7mm（IM25）
text_en: Mediastinal scattered lymph nodes similar to previous, largest approximately 14x7 mm (IM25).

source_text: 右上肺胸膜下结节同前
text_en: Right upper lobe subpleural nodule unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔4L组及左肺门淋巴结大致同前，左肺门较大约11x5mm（IM32）
text_en: The mediastinal 4L group and left hilar lymph nodes are similar to prior; the left hilar lymph node measures approximately 11x5 mm (IM32).

source_text: 纵隔5组及右肺门淋巴结较强较前相仿，现较大仍约12mm（IM32）
text_en: Mediastinal station 5 and right hilar lymph nodes more prominent but similar to previous, largest still approximately 12 mm (IM32).

source_text: 肺内局限性索条影同前，未见明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: Focal linear opacities within the lung unchanged from previous, no obvious new nodules or consolidations

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段肿块较前增大，原约21x16mm（IM20），现约16x19mm（IM17），病变内见钙化灶同前，病变边缘模糊，多发索条影仍与胸膜及叶间胸膜分界不清
text_en: The mass in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment has increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 21x16 mm (IM20), now approximately 16x19 mm (IM17), with calcification within the lesion unchanged, ill-defined margins, and multiple linear opacities still indistinct from the pleura and interlobar pleura

source_text: 两肺散在模糊小结节灶大致同前
text_en: Scattered indistinct small nodular opacities in both lungs, largely unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右侧水平裂旁类结节灶及右肺中叶结节较前缩小，追查
text_en: Nodule-like focus adjacent to the right horizontal fissure and nodule in the right middle lobe are smaller than before; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 两肺少许点状结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: The punctate nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged from prior; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 两肺结节影同前，小于10mm，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Nodules in both lungs are stable, all less than 10 mm; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 右上肺陈旧灶同前（IMA26），双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Right upper lobe chronic changes unchanged (IMA26); no new nodules or patchy opacities in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺中间干支气管内侧肺韧带内软组织结节较前相仿，约20*8mm(IM31)
text_en: The soft-tissue nodule within the pulmonary ligament medial to the right intermediate bronchus is similar to prior, measuring approximately 20x8 mm (IM31).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段磨玻璃密度小结节大致同前，约7x6mm（IM12），右肺散在微小结节同前（IM28、37、50）
text_en: A ground-glass opacity small nodule in the left upper lobe anterior segment, approximately 7x6 mm, is essentially unchanged (IM12). Scattered tiny nodules in the right lung are unchanged (IM28, 37, 50).

source_text: 纵隔见数枚小淋巴结，较大原约10x7mm（IM25），现约12x8mm（IM26）
text_en: Several small lymph nodes in the mediastinum; the largest previously measured approximately 10x7mm (IM25), now approximately 12x8mm (IM26).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管残端少许软组织密度灶同前，未见结节及肿块
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, minimal soft tissue density at the bronchial stump unchanged from prior, no nodules or masses.

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段结节同前相仿，约11x10mm（IM23）
text_en: A nodule in the left upper lobe lingular segment is similar to previous, approximately 11x10 mm (IM23).

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、双锁骨上区及双腋下多发小淋巴结同前相仿
text_en: Mediastinal, bilateral hilar, bilateral supraclavicular, and bilateral axillary multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from previous.

source_text: 纵隔4R、5、7组淋巴结增大同前，部分并钙化，较大约17*11mm(图21)
text_en: Enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R, 5, and 7 are similar to previous, with some showing calcification; the largest measures approximately 17x11 mm (Figure 21)

source_text: 右锁骨上、纵隔及右肺门多发淋巴结，较前缩小，追查
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region, mediastinum, and right hilum are smaller than before; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 左肺尖小结节同前相仿，仍约3mm（IM8），余双肺未见新增结节和斑片影
text_en: Left apical segment: small nodule similar to previous, still approximately 3 mm (IM8), remainder of both lungs no new nodules or patchy opacities seen.

source_text: 右肺中叶肿物较前相仿，仍约21x17mm（IM32），右肺膨胀不全较前相仿、双下肺索条影同前
text_en: The right middle lobe mass is similar to prior, still measuring approximately 21 x 17 mm (IM32). Right lung atelectasis and bilateral lower lung fibrotic bands are similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺中上叶体积缩小，其内支气管扩张伴斑片及网状影同前，余肺野未见新发结节及片絮灶
text_en: Volume loss in the right middle and upper lobes with bronchiectasis and patchy and reticular opacities within is unchanged; no new nodules or fluffy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺上叶切除术后，支气管断端未见明确复发征象
text_en: After left upper lobe resection, no definite signs of recurrence at the bronchial stump.

source_text: 右肺上叶见少许索条及结节灶同前
text_en: A few linear bands and nodular opacities are seen in the right upper lobe, unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则形性结节缩小，原约16x14mm（IM25），现约11x10mm（IM25），软组织低密度
text_en: An irregular nodular lesion in the right upper lobe posterior segment has decreased in size, previously measuring approximately 16x14 mm (IM25), now measuring approximately 11x10 mm (IM25), with low soft-tissue density.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段结节灶较前相仿，约14x9mm（IM11、12），边缘仍见毛刺，且与邻近胸膜分界不清
text_en: Nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 14x9 mm (IM11, 12); spiculated margins persist and the lesion remains indistinct from the adjacent pleura

source_text: 右肺门区新见淋巴结约20x10mm（Im30），左肺门、双侧腋窝及锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Newly seen lymph node in the right hilar region measures approximately 20 x 10 mm (Im30); no enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the left hilum, bilateral axillae, or supraclavicular regions.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段不规则结节形态大小大致同前，约20x15mm（Im30），实性成分不均匀，边缘有磨玻璃密度成分及毛刺影、长索条
text_en: Irregular nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe is roughly unchanged in size, approximately 20x15mm (Im30); solid components are heterogeneous; margins show ground-glass components, spiculations, and long fibrous strands.

source_text: 两肺磨玻璃密度结节影及小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: The ground-glass density nodules and small nodules in both lungs are unchanged compared to prior; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔、左锁骨上及双腋下散在小淋巴结同前，短径仍小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal, left supraclavicular, and bilateral axillary scattered small lymph nodes unchanged from previous, short axis diameter still less than 10 mm.

source_text: 纵隔食管病变旁、胸主动脉后方、下段气管旁、隆突下、上腹部胃左动脉旁肿大淋巴结多数较前缩小，较大者原约28x12mm（IMA34），现约20x6mm（IM31），数量大于7
text_en: Enlarged lymph nodes in the mediastinum paraesophageal to the esophageal lesion, posterior to the thoracic aorta, paratracheal (lower segment), subcarinal, and left gastric artery region in the upper abdomen; most have decreased in size compared to previous, the largest previously approximately 28x12mm (IMA34), currently approximately 20x6mm (IM31), number greater than 7.

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影同前，余双肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged; the remainder of both lungs shows no new nodules or consolidation.

source_text: 纵隔4L组淋巴结同前，较大约15x9mm（IM24），平扫密度较高，倾向良性
text_en: Mediastinal station 4L lymph nodes unchanged, largest approximately 15x9 mm (IM24); non-contrast density elevated, favoring benign

source_text: 双肺下叶少许条片状影，余肺内未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Few linear and patchy opacities in both lower lobes; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右下肺局部胸膜下微结节同前，约4mm（IM18）
text_en: Focal subpleural micronodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM18).

source_text: 双肺未见新发结节和实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation shadows seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺少许索条影同前，上叶胸膜下不规则结节灶同前
text_en: A few linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged; an irregular subpleural nodule in the upper lobe is stable.

source_text: 双侧肺透光度减低，左肺上叶胸膜下小结节同前，仍约为5mm（IM42）
text_en: Decreased lung lucency bilaterally. A small subpleural nodule in the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior, still measuring approximately 5 mm (IM42).

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结较前相仿，大小约10x8mm(IM26)，平扫高密度影
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph node similar in size compared to prior, approximately 10x8 mm (IM26), high-density on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 右侧胸膜结节状增厚同前，左侧未见胸水征象
text_en: The nodular thickening of the right pleura is unchanged from prior. No pleural effusion is seen on the left.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，仍约9x7mm（IM14）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment, similar to prior, still approximately 9x7 mm (IM14).

source_text: 左肺下叶外基底段胸膜下小结节灶同前
text_en: Left lower lobe lateral basal segment subpleural nodule unchanged

source_text: 双肺多发微小结节同前（IM20、37），较大约4mm（IM37），双肺少许小钙化灶同前
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM20, 37); the largest is about 4 mm (IM37); a few small calcified foci in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔4L组淋巴结同前，较大约15x9mm（IM25），平扫密度仍较高
text_en: Mediastinal station 4L lymph nodes unchanged, largest approximately 15x9 mm (IM25); non-contrast density remains elevated

source_text: 隆突下及右肺门淋巴结较前增大，现较大约16*13mm(图30)，原约17*9mm(图33)
text_en: Subcarinal and right hilar lymph nodes increased compared to prior, currently approximately 16x13 mm (Figure 30), previously approximately 17x9 mm (Figure 33).

source_text: 扫及右乳头后方新发结节，约20x10mm（IM45），边界可
text_en: CT shows a newly developed nodule posterior to the right nipple, measuring approximately 20x10 mm (IM45) with well-defined margins.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段多发胸膜下索条结节同前，多数较为致密，少数密度略低，伴不规则长索条同前
text_en: Multiple subpleural linear and nodular opacities in the right lower lobe posterior segment are stable; most are relatively dense, with a few showing slightly lower density, accompanied by irregular long linear strands unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，双肺内见散在多发磨玻璃密度结节灶大致同前，较大于右肺上叶，仍约29x25mm（IM20、21），邻近斜裂胸膜局部凹陷，内部未见实性成分
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent; scattered multiple ground-glass nodules in both lungs are roughly unchanged from prior; the largest is in the right upper lobe, still measuring approximately 29x25 mm (IM20, 21), with local pleural indentation adjacent to the oblique fissure; no solid component is seen within.

source_text: 右肺门稍高密度淋巴结同前，仍约16x9mm（IM27）
text_en: Slightly increased density right hilar lymph node is stable compared to prior, still approximately 16x9 mm (IM27)

source_text: 纵隔6组淋巴结较前增大，转移
text_en: Mediastinal station 6 lymph nodes are enlarged compared to previous, metastasis

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后表现同前，胸部CT平扫未见新生占位
text_en: Postoperative appearance following right upper lobectomy is unchanged; non-contrast chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 左肺胸膜下小结节较前减小（IM30)
text_en: Left lung subpleural small nodule decreased compared to previous (IM30).

source_text: 纵隔2R组淋巴结同前，建议追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 2R lymph nodes unchanged from prior, recommend follow-up.

source_text: 左肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation in the left lung.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段结节较前增大，原约15x10mm（Im44），现约17x14mm（IM41），追查
text_en: The nodule in the basal segment of the right lower lobe has increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 15x10 mm (Im44), now approximately 17x14 mm (IM41); further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶3mm微结节同前（IM19）
text_en: A 3 mm tiny nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM19).

source_text: 部分结节较前略增大，现较大约10*7mm(图23)，原约8*7mm(图24)
text_en: Some nodules are slightly enlarged compared to previous; the larger one is now approximately 10x7mm (Figure 23), previously approximately 8x7mm (Figure 24).

source_text: 食管胸下段及腹段管壁不规则增厚较前减轻，较厚处原约21mm（IM45），现约13mm（IMA46）管腔狭窄
text_en: Irregular wall thickening of the lower thoracic and abdominal esophagus reduced compared to prior; previously thickest about 21 mm (IM45), now approximately 13 mm (IMA46), with luminal narrowing.

source_text: 左肺上叶见多发微小磨玻璃密度结节同前，较大约5mm（IM17）
text_en: Multiple tiny ground-glass opacity nodules in the left upper lobe are unchanged from prior, largest approximately 5mm (Image 17).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，如4L组者仍约15x10mm（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior, such as 4L station still approximately 15x10 mm (IM19)

source_text: 余肺野未见新增结节及实变影
text_en: The remainder of the lung fields shows no new nodules or consolidation.

source_text: 双肺小结节影同前，右下肺较大者仍约7*5mm（Im46）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodule shadows are stable compared to prior, the largest in the right lower lobe remains approximately 7x5 mm (Im46)

source_text: 考虑弥漫转移
text_en: Consider diffuse metastases.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见软组织增厚及异常强化，左肺下叶后基底段含点状钙化小结节同前，大小约6x5mm（IMA40），左肺上叶胸膜下及斜裂旁磨玻璃结节同前，余双肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no soft tissue thickening or abnormal enhancement is seen at the bronchial stump. A small nodule with punctate calcification in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is stable (approximately 6x5 mm, IMA40). Ground-glass nodules in the subpleural region and adjacent to the oblique fissure in the left upper lobe are unchanged. No new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶微结节同前，追查
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous, follow-up

source_text: 右侧膈上淋巴结同前，现约12x5mm（IM48）
text_en: The right diaphragmatic lymph node is unchanged from prior, currently measuring approximately 12 x 5 mm (IM48).

source_text: 胸11模糊稍高密度灶，请结合骨扫描，转移性待除外
text_en: T11 ill-defined slightly high-density focus; please correlate with bone scan, metastatic disease cannot be excluded.

source_text: 右肺下叶近肺门结节较前似相仿，平扫与肺血管分界不清，远端肺内模糊片影较前相仿，两肺内多发结节及模糊条片影较前相仿（IM17、23、30）
text_en: The nodule near the hilum of the right lower lobe appears similar to prior. On non-contrast imaging, it is indistinct from adjacent pulmonary vessels. The hazy patchy opacity in the distal lung parenchyma is similar to prior. Multiple nodules and hazy linear-patchy opacities in both lungs are similar to prior (IM17, 23, 30).

source_text: 余双肺多发小结节基本同前
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the remainder of both lungs are essentially unchanged.

source_text: 两肺内及胸膜下散在点状小结节灶同前，未见新发异常密度
text_en: Scattered punctate small nodules in both lungs and subpleural regions are unchanged from prior; no new abnormal densities are seen.

source_text: 左肺上叶2处结节较前增大
text_en: Two nodules in the left upper lobe are larger than previously.

source_text: 余纵隔多发小淋巴结大致同前
text_en: The remaining multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes are approximately unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶索条、两肺微小结节同前（IMA16、28、34、45）
text_en: The linear opacities in the right upper lobe and the tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged compared to prior (IMA16, 28, 34, 45).

source_text: 余肺野未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: The remainder of the lung fields shows no new nodules or consolidation.

source_text: 右肺下叶前基底段及后基底段胸膜下结节灶同前，大小分别约6*4mm（IMA49）、9*7mm（IM62）
text_en: Subpleural nodules in the anterior and posterior basal segments of the right lower lobe remain unchanged, measuring approximately 6 x 4 mm (IMA49) and 9 x 7 mm (IM62), respectively.

source_text: 纵隔4、6组淋巴结区见软组织密度灶同前，较大者约21*11mm（IM15），双侧锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal groups 4 and 6 lymph node regions show soft tissue density focus unchanged from previous, largest approximately 21x11 mm (IM15); no enlarged lymph nodes seen in bilateral supraclavicular regions.

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段与背段交界处磨玻璃密度结节同前，追查
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule at the junction of the outer basal and dorsal segments of the right lower lobe is unchanged from prior; follow-up required.

source_text: 腰1椎体骨质破坏，考虑转移
text_en: Bone destruction in the L1 vertebral body, considered metastatic.

source_text: 左肺下叶前内基底段磨玻璃结节同前，大小约5x5mm（IM30)，追查
text_en: Left lower lobe anterior-inferior basal segment ground-glass nodule same as prior, size approximately 5x5 mm (IM30), for follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔、左侧锁骨上区小淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal and left supraclavicular small lymph nodes unchanged from previous

source_text: 左肺斑片状透过度降低，左肺胸膜下小结节同前，约5mm（IM18）
text_en: Patchy opacity in the left lung, small subpleural nodules in the left lung unchanged from previous, approximately 5mm (image 18).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃密度小结节灶同前相仿，约5x6mm（IM33），建议继续随诊复查
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is similar to the prior study, measuring approximately 5x6 mm (IM33); continued follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔2R组淋巴结同前，约11mm（Im12）
text_en: Mediastinal station 2R lymph nodes unchanged from prior, approximately 11 mm (Im12).

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节同前
text_en: Small nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶、中叶及左肺下叶散在微小结节同前（IM24、31、39、47、48、50）
text_en: Scattered tiny nodules in the right upper and middle lobes and left lower lobe unchanged (IM24, 31, 39, 47, 48, 50).

source_text: 双肺纹理略增多，左肺上叶舌段结节同前相仿，约11x8mm（IM32），边缘不规则并可见毛刺，内部密度较前减低，局部支气管受牵拉可见扩张
text_en: Slightly increased bronchovascular markings in both lungs, the nodule in the lingular segment of the left upper lobe is similar to prior, approximately 11x8 mm (IM32), irregular margins with visible spiculation, internal density lower than before, local bronchial traction with visible dilation.

source_text: 右肺下叶及左肺微小结节同前，＜5mm
text_en: Tiny nodules in the right lower lobe and left lung are unchanged, <5 mm.

source_text: 左肱骨头结节状致密影同前，考虑骨岛（Im6），胸廓诸骨未见明确破坏征象
text_en: Nodular dense opacity in the left humeral head is unchanged, consistent with enostosis (Im6); no definite osseous destruction is seen in the bones of the thorax.

source_text: 未见确切复发
text_en: No definite recurrence seen

source_text: 右下肺背段及左上肺模糊结节灶大致同前
text_en: The indistinct nodular opacities in the right lower lobe and left upper lobe are essentially unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔、右侧锁骨上淋巴结同前
text_en: Lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right supraclavicular region are similar to prior.

source_text: 余双肺多发结节同前
text_en: Residual multiple nodules in both lungs are unchanged compared to prior

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段小结节影较前增大，现15*13mm（IM48）,原约12*11mm（IMA47）
text_en: A small nodule in the left lower lobe posterior basal segment has increased in size compared to previous, now measuring 15*13 mm (IM48), previously approximately 12*11 mm (IMA47).

source_text: 甲状腺左叶结节同前，结合相关检查
text_en: Left thyroid lobe nodule stable, correlate with relevant examinations.

source_text: 双肺多发索条影同前，右侧为著，未见新生结节或实变影
text_en: Multiple linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged, more prominent on the right; no new nodules or consolidations are seen.

source_text: 双肺弥漫转移结节明显减少缩小
text_en: Diffusely distributed metastatic nodules in both lungs are markedly decreased in number and smaller in size.

source_text: 左肺下叶癌复查，较前缩小
text_en: Left lower lobe cancer follow-up, decreased in size compared to prior

source_text: 双肺浅淡磨玻璃密度小结节灶同前（IM12、14、22、28），较大约10mm（IM12），其内未见明显实性成分
text_en: Faint ground-glass density small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM12, 14, 22, 28); the largest is approximately 10 mm (IM12), with no obvious solid component within.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段小结节同前，约13x12mm（IMA24）
text_en: The small nodule in the left upper lobe anterior segment is unchanged, measuring approximately 13x12 mm (IMA24).

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下见2mm小结节同前（IMA25）
text_en: A 2 mm subpleural nodule is seen in the right middle lobe, unchanged from prior (IMA25).

source_text: 左肺尖结节同前
text_en: Nodule at the left lung apex unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶点状结节影同前（IM50）
text_en: Left lower lobe punctate nodule unchanged from previous (IM50)

source_text: 左侧头臂静脉旁结节同前，追查
text_en: Nodule adjacent to the left brachiocephalic vein is unchanged compared to prior; continued follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 双肺多发小结节影同前相仿，均小于10mm
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior, all less than 10 mm.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结及右锁骨上区小淋巴结较前稍大，如原约15x13mm者，现约17x14mm（IM30），追查
text_en: The right hilar lymph node and small lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region are slightly larger than prior; for example, a node previously approximately 15 x 13 mm is now approximately 17 x 14 mm (IM30); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 新见类结节
text_en: newly identified nodule-like lesion

source_text: 右肺下叶背段小结节，较前稍缩小，追查
text_en: Small nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe, slightly smaller than prior; recommended for follow-up.

source_text: 甲状腺左叶结节大致同前
text_en: Left thyroid lobe nodule stable.

source_text: 左肺尖模糊小灶大致同前（IM14、17），余肺未见明确新发结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: Indistinct small focus at the left lung apex largely unchanged from prior (IM14, 17); no definite new nodules or patchy opacities in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺中叶内侧段纵隔胸膜旁结节较前略增大，实性成分增多，倾向恶性，建议临床进步一检查
text_en: Nodule adjacent to the mediastinal pleura in the medial segment of the right middle lobe is slightly larger than before with increased solid component, malignancy is favored; recommend further clinical evaluation.

source_text: 右肺尖见模糊小结节（IM14），下叶背段近叶间胸膜见硬结灶同前（IM25）
text_en: A faint small nodule is seen in the right lung apex (IM14). A sclerotic focus is seen near the interlobar pleura in the lower lobe posterior segment, unchanged from prior (IM25).

source_text: 纵隔内多发淋巴结部分同前，部分缩小，如原约16x11mm（IM22）者，现约12x8mm(IM25)，密度稍高
text_en: Some multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from previous, some reduced in size, for example, previously approximately 16x11 mm (IM22), currently approximately 12x8 mm (IM25), with slightly higher density

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜结节状增厚同前（IM32），左肺下叶散在少许片絮影同前
text_en: Nodular thickening of the left interlobar pleura is unchanged compared to prior (IM32); scattered faint patchy opacities in the left lower lobe are also unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结大致同前，较大约19x16mm（Im18）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior; largest approximately 19 × 16 mm (Im18).

source_text: 两肺多发模糊斑片、小结节影同前，倾向放疗后改变，随诊观察
text_en: Multiple ill-defined patchy opacities and small nodules in both lungs similar to prior, likely post-radiation changes; follow-up recommended

source_text: 甲状腺左侧叶多发低密度结节同前
text_en: Multiple low-density nodules in the left thyroid lobe, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔、左肺门可见多发淋巴结较前略缩小，平扫密度偏高，较大原约20x11mm，现为18*7mm（IM32）
text_en: Mediastinal and left hilar multiple lymph nodes are slightly reduced compared to prior; non-contrast scan shows increased density; largest previously measuring approximately 20x11 mm, now 18x7 mm (IM32).

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门见发小淋巴结较前相仿，如隆突下淋巴结短径现仍约7mm（Im24）
text_en: Small mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes are seen similar to previous, such as subcarinal lymph node with short axis still approximately 7mm (Im24).

source_text: 右肺下叶3mm微结节同前（IM18）
text_en: A 3 mm tiny nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM18).

source_text: 左侧腋窝淋巴结较前增大，现约25x18mm（IM14），原约21x14mm
text_en: The left axillary lymph node is larger than previously, now measuring approximately 25 x 18 mm (IM14), previously approximately 21 x 14 mm.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段毛刺结节大致同前，仍约10x9mm（IM38）
text_en: The spiculated nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged, still measuring approximately 10 x 9 mm (IM38).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，左肺上叶尖后段、左肺下叶外基底段陈旧小结节同前（Im18、48），肺内未见新生占位
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, old small nodules in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe and the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe similar to prior (IM18, 48), no new space-occupying lesions seen in the lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见异常软组织肿块，残留索条影同前
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no abnormal soft tissue mass is seen at the bronchial stump. Residual linear bands are unchanged.

source_text: 双肺各支气管分支通畅，肺内及叶间胸膜见散在小结节同前（IM22、30、38、45、46、61），较大约8x4mm（IM38）
text_en: Bronchial branches in both lungs are patent. Scattered small nodules in the lung parenchyma and interlobar pleura are stable compared to prior (IM22, 30, 38, 45, 46, 61), largest measuring approximately 8x4 mm (IM38).

source_text: 左肺底局限性膨胀不全、肺内局限性索条影大致同前，余肺内未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Localized atelectasis at the left lung base and localized linear opacities within the lung parenchyma largely unchanged from prior; no new nodules or consolidation in the remaining lung parenchyma.

source_text: 纵隔2、7、8组散在小淋巴结较前缩小，较大原约8mm，现约5mm（IM14）
text_en: Mediastinal stations 2, 7, and 8 scattered small lymph nodes reduced compared to prior, larger one previously approximately 8 mm, now approximately 5 mm (IM14)

source_text: 双肺另见多发小结节同前，较大约4mm（IM36）
text_en: Multiple additional small nodules in both lungs are stable, largest measuring approximately 4 mm (IM36).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段胸膜下可疑模糊磨玻璃样小结节同前（Im24）
text_en: A suspicious, ill-defined small ground-glass opacity nodule subpleurally in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe remains unchanged (Im24).

source_text: 右侧腋窝新见肿大淋巴结，约12*9mm(图17)，建议追查
text_en: A new enlarged lymph node is seen in the right axilla, measuring approximately 12 x 9 mm (Figure 17); follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结部分较前缩小，如原约11x10mm（IM17）者，现约9x7mm（IM16），双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见明显肿大淋巴结
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes have decreased in size compared to previous; for example, one previously measured approximately 11x10 mm (IM17) is now approximately 9x7 mm (IM16). No significantly enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular areas, or bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 双肺新见小结节（IM11、24），较大约3mm（IM24）
text_en: Newly noted small nodules in both lungs (IM11, 24), the largest measuring approximately 3 mm (IM24).

source_text: 余两肺多发小结节同前，未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the remainder of both lungs are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下微小结节同前，约4mm（IM27），双肺上叶索条影同前，余肺内透亮度均匀，未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural tiny nodule unchanged from prior, approximately 4 mm (IM27). Bilateral upper lobes linear opacities unchanged from prior. Remaining lung parenchyma demonstrates uniform radiolucency without new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上及腋窝多发淋巴结部分较前稍减小
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular areas, and axillae are partially slightly reduced in size compared to previous.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结较前增大，原约16x9mm（IM29），现约19x10mm（IM28）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph node enlarged compared to prior, previously approximately 16x9 mm (IM29), now approximately 19x10 mm (IM28).

source_text: 双肺未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺小结节同前（IM10、18、32、39、50），较大约6*4mm
text_en: Small nodules in the right lung are stable (IM10, 18, 32, 39, 50), largest measuring approximately 6 x 4 mm.

source_text: 纵隔2、4、5、7组多发淋巴结部分较前缩小，原约16x11mm（IM20）灶现约14x8mm（IM19）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal groups 2, 4, 5, 7 are partially reduced in size compared to previous; the largest was previously approximately 16x11mm (IM20) and is now approximately 14x8mm (IM19)

source_text: 余肺内未见明显新增结节灶
text_en: No obvious new nodules are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 未见新发肿大淋巴结
text_en: No new enlarged lymph nodes

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段及前段磨玻璃密度结节大致同前，边缘模糊，现分别仍约8x7mm、4x3mm（IM11、23）
text_en: Ground-glass density nodules in the right upper lobe apical and anterior segments essentially unchanged, margins blurred, currently still approximately 8x7 mm and 4x3 mm respectively (IM11, 23)

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结基本同前，现仍约13x7mm（IMA23）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes essentially unchanged, currently approximately 13x7 mm (IMA23).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段磨玻璃密度结节影同前，建议与术区片比较评价
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe unchanged from previous

source_text: 右侧水平裂胸膜小结节或片状轻度增厚同前（IM23、24）
text_en: Small pleural nodule or mild patchy thickening along the right horizontal fissure is stable (IM23, 24).

source_text: 纵隔、右侧锁骨上淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right supraclavicular region are roughly similar to prior.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜及胸膜下多发结节灶同前，较大者约12x9mm（IM42）
text_en: Multiple nodular lesions of the right interlobar pleura and subpleural regions are unchanged from prior; the largest measures approximately 12x9 mm (IM42).

source_text: 两肺内多发小结节部分较前缩小，左下肺原模糊小结节未见明显显示（IMA32）
text_en: Some of the multiple small nodules in both lungs are smaller than prior; the previously indistinct small nodule in the left lower lobe is no longer clearly visible (IMA32).

source_text: 气管隆突下可见肿大淋巴结，现约17x15mm（IM28），考虑转移
text_en: Subcarinal enlarged lymph node, currently approximately 17x15 mm (IM28), suspicious for metastasis.

source_text: 双肺胸膜下模糊小结节同前，追查
text_en: Subpleural indistinct small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 两肺下叶小斑片、小结节影同前
text_en: Small patchy and nodular opacities in both lower lobes are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肾上腺软组织小结节同前，约14x12mm（IM56）
text_en: Small soft tissue nodule in left adrenal gland unchanged, size approximately 14x12 mm (IM56).

source_text: 左下肺叶结节较前相仿，恶性不除外，结合临床或密切随访
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is similar to prior; malignancy cannot be excluded—correlation with clinical findings or close follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺左叶钙化结节同前
text_en: A calcified nodule in the left thyroid lobe is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右第5肋走行欠自然同前，余扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Right 5th rib with abnormal course unchanged; no osseous destruction seen in the remainder of the visualized thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，约3mm（IMA16）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IMA16).

source_text: 双肺纹理增多，双肺散在小结节大致同前，较大约4mm（IMA42）
text_en: Increased lung markings. Scattered small nodules in both lungs are approximately similar to prior. The largest is about 4 mm (IMA42).

source_text: 左上纵隔颈总动脉旁结节缩小，原约7x4mm现约5x4mm（IM10）
text_en: Nodule adjacent to the left common carotid artery in the upper mediastinum has decreased in size, previously measuring approximately 7x4 mm, now approximately 5x4 mm (IM10).

source_text: 右肺下叶切除术后表现同前，胸部CT扫描未见新生占位
text_en: Findings after right lower lobectomy are unchanged; chest CT scan shows no new mass.

source_text: 双肺散在小结节影同前，较大约7*5mm（IM22）
text_en: Scattered small nodule shadows in both lungs are unchanged, largest approximately 7x5 mm (IM22).

source_text: T1、12椎体可见骨质破坏，T12椎体轻度压缩变形，余扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Osseous destruction is seen in the T1 and T12 vertebral bodies, with mild compression deformity of T12; no osseous destruction is seen in the remainder of the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段气管旁结节较前略增大，原约18x15mm，现约20X18mm（IM33）
text_en: The paratracheal nodule in the right lower lobe dorsal segment is slightly larger than before, previously approximately 18x15 mm, now approximately 20x18 mm (IM33).

source_text: 双肺散在多发小结节数量及大小同前，边缘不规则，较大约5mm（IM37），部分见索条影与胸膜牵拉，建议继续追查
text_en: Number and size of scattered multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, with irregular margins, the largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM37); some show linear opacities with pleural tethering. Continued follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 双肺见散在网格状及索条状影大致同前，两肺未见新发结节影
text_en: Scattered reticular and linear opacities in both lungs are essentially unchanged from prior; no new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门、锁骨上淋巴结较前略增大
text_en: Lymph nodes in the mediastinum, right hilar region, and supraclavicular region are slightly increased compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶结节增大，原约12x10mm（IM21），现约15x13mm（IM21）
text_en: The nodule in the right upper lobe has increased in size, previously approximately 12x10 mm (IM21), now approximately 15x13 mm (IM21).

source_text: 左肺小钙化同前，右肺未见结节影
text_en: Left lung small calcification stable, right lung no nodules seen

source_text: 右锁骨上区淋巴结同前，约11x8mm（IM7）
text_en: Lymph node in the right supraclavicular region is stable compared to prior, measures approximately 11x8 mm (IM7).

source_text: 双侧锁骨上区及纵隔内多发小淋巴结，部分较前略饱满，如原约7x6mm(IM14)，现约9x8mm(IM15)
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the bilateral supraclavicular regions and mediastinum are stable, with some appearing slightly more prominent; for example, previously about 7x6 mm (IM14), now approximately 9x8 mm (IM15).

source_text: 左肺结节同前，仍约7mm（IM33）
text_en: Left lung nodule unchanged, still approximately 7mm (IM33).

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下微小结节同前，＜5mm（IM34）
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior, less than 5 mm (IM34).

source_text: 左肺多发钙化同前，余双肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Multiple calcifications in the left lung unchanged from prior, no new nodules or consolidation in the remaining bilateral lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节及斜裂胸膜结节大致同前，仍约3mm（IM28、34）
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe and the pleural nodule along the oblique fissure are stable compared to prior, remaining approximately 3 mm (IM28, 34)

source_text: 右肺下叶背段微小结节显示较前清楚，大小同前，仍约3mm（IM36）
text_en: Tiny nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is more clearly visualized than prior; size unchanged, still approximately 3 mm (IM36).

source_text: 左肺下叶术后改变，双肺未见新发占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left lower lobe; no new mass-like lesions are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 双肺散在多发小结节，不能除外转移，密切追查
text_en: Scattered multiple small nodules in both lungs; metastasis cannot be excluded. Close follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 双侧肺内小结节较前增大，考虑转移
text_en: Small nodules in the bilateral lungs are larger than prior; metastasis is considered.

source_text: 纵隔4R、5组可见多发小淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R and 5 are similar to previous

source_text: 余双肺内透亮度均匀，未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Lung parenchyma in the remainder of both lungs shows uniform lucency; no new nodules or consolidations are seen.

source_text: 双肺各叶段支气管通畅，右肺下叶胸膜下模糊小结节同前，约4mm（IM34）
text_en: Bronchial branches in all lobes and segments of both lungs are patent. A faint subpleural small nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM34).

source_text: 右肺门小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small right hilar lymph nodes are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔7组可见肿大淋巴结同前，仍约21*16mm(IM24)
text_en: Enlarged lymph nodes visible in mediastinal station 7, unchanged from previous, still approximately 21x16 mm (IM24).

source_text: p组见淋巴结同前，现约10*8mm（IM8）
text_en: Lymph nodes in p group present unchanged, currently approximately 10x8 mm (IM8)

source_text: 左肺下叶背段结节较前缩小，请结合临床情况
text_en: Left lower lobe posterior segment nodule decreased in size; clinical correlation advised.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约12mm（IMA24）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest measuring approximately 12 mm (IMA24).

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下见微小结节同前，约3mm（IM42）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural tiny nodule unchanged, approximately 3mm (IM42)

source_text: 纵隔4L组淋巴结较前缩小，现约10x7mm（IM27），原为14x9mm（IM25），双侧肺门及锁骨上平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal station 4L lymph nodes decreased in size compared to prior, currently approximately 10x7mm (image 27), previously 14x9mm (image 25), no enlarged lymph nodes seen in bilateral hilar and supraclavicular regions on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 右肺中叶局切术后，双肺微结节、双肺索条影同前
text_en: Following limited resection of the right middle lobe, bilateral pulmonary micro-nodules and bilateral pulmonary linear opacities are unchanged.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，左肺上叶索条及小结节，左肺上叶近斜裂磨玻璃密度模糊结节较前无明显变化，仍约5mm（IMA16）
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Linear opacities and small nodules are present in the left upper lobe. A poorly defined ground-glass opacity near the oblique fissure in the left upper lobe shows no significant change compared to prior, still measuring approximately 5 mm (IMA16).

source_text: 右肺胸膜下、两侧胸膜多发结节大致同前，较大仍约9mm（IM51)，边界清
text_en: Multiple subpleural nodules in the right lung and bilateral pleura are essentially unchanged; the largest remains approximately 9 mm (IM51), with well-defined margins.

source_text: 纵隔少量小淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal few small lymph nodes unchanged, all less than 10mm.

source_text: 左肺上叶2处结节较前增大，考虑转移可能大
text_en: Two nodules in the left upper lobe are larger than previously; metastasis is highly likely.

source_text: 双肺散在小结节同前，大者约7x6mm（IM44）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, largest approximately 7x6 mm (IM44).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段不规则实变灶同前相仿，恶性肿瘤与机化性肺炎仍需鉴别，请结合临床考虑
text_en: Irregular consolidation in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe is similar to prior; malignant tumor and organizing pneumonia still need to be differentiated; correlate clinically.

source_text: 双肺未见转移结节
text_en: No metastatic nodules are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段肿块较前缩小，范围原约36*31mm（IM31），现约29x27mm（IM31），密度减低，背段支气管通畅，包绕左下肺动脉
text_en: The mass in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, from approximately 36x31 mm (IM31) to 29x27 mm (IM31), with decreased density. The dorsal segment bronchus is patent, and the mass encircles the left lower pulmonary artery.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节较前稍增大，原约10x9mm，现约12x9mm（IM23）
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe has slightly increased in size, previously approximately 10 x 9 mm, now approximately 12 x 9 mm (Image 23).

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下磨玻璃结节同前，大小约9x7mm（IM29）
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural ground-glass nodule unchanged from prior, size approximately 9 x 7 mm (IM29).

source_text: 左肺上叶微小结节同前，＜5mm（图19）
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule unchanged, less than 5 mm (Figure 19).

source_text: 两肺新见微小结节性质待定，转移
text_en: New micro-nodules in both lungs, nature undetermined; metastasis cannot be excluded.

source_text: 右肺肿物均较前相仿
text_en: The right lung masses are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 胸9椎体模糊低密度灶，转移不除外，结合骨扫描
text_en: Ill-defined low-density focus in the T9 vertebral body, metastasis cannot be excluded; correlate with bone scan.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，仍约8x5mm（IM36）
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from prior, still approximately 8x5 mm (IM36).

source_text: 右锁骨上区淋巴结大致同前，约5mm（IM5
text_en: Lymph node in the right supraclavicular region is essentially unchanged compared to prior, measures approximately 5 mm (IM5).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，右肺上叶软组织密度结节较前增大，现约15*11mm(图14)，原约12x9mm（IM12)，余肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Lung parenchymal lucency is uniform. A soft-tissue density nodule in the right upper lobe has increased in size compared to prior, now measuring approximately 15x11 mm (Figure 14), previously 12x9 mm (IM12). No other nodules or consolidation are seen.

source_text: 甲状腺左叶见稍低密度结节同前（IM1），请结合超声检查
text_en: Left thyroid lobe slightly low-density nodule stable (IM1), correlate with ultrasound examination.

source_text: 沿右胸膜新见多发小结节，考虑胸膜转移可能大
text_en: Newly seen multiple small nodules along the right pleura, with consideration of possible pleural metastasis.

source_text: 右肺下叶近肺门结节，较前稍增大，原约19x13mm（IM30），现约23x15mm（IM31）（因平扫与肺血管分界不清，故测量范围包括相同层面结节及血管影），远端肺内模糊片影同前，余两肺内多发结节较前相仿
text_en: The nodule near the hilum of the right lower lobe is slightly larger than before, previously measuring about 19 x 13 mm (IM30), now approximately 23 x 15 mm (IM31). Due to indistinct margins from adjacent pulmonary vessels on non-contrast imaging, the measurement includes both the nodule and vascular shadows at the same level. The hazy patchy opacity in the distal lung remains unchanged. The multiple nodules in the rest of both lungs are similar to prior.

source_text: 肺内钙化结节及索条影同前
text_en: Intrapulmonary calcified nodules and linear strand shadows unchanged from previous.

source_text: 胸11椎体高密度结节、双侧肩胛骨边缘硬化伴骨质内多发低密度灶同前
text_en: T11 vertebral body high-density nodule, bilateral scapular marginal sclerosis with multiple low-density foci within bone, unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶结节影同前，大小约4mm（IM27），左肺下叶索条影同前
text_en: The nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM27). The linear opacity in the left lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior imaging.

source_text: 双肺多发小结节较前相仿，较大仍约5mm（IM42），追查
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior; the largest remains about 5 mm (IM42); further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺中叶微小结节同前
text_en: Micro-nodules in the right middle lobe are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺散在小结节较前相仿（IM20、22、29、36、48、51）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right lung are similar to prior (IM20, 22, 29, 36, 48, 51).

source_text: 甲状腺低密度小结节影同前
text_en: Thyroid low-density small nodular opacity unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺门见淋巴结增大同前，较大仍约16x9mm（IM29)，纵隔、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Left hilar enlarged lymph node unchanged from previous, larger still approximately 16x9 mm (IM29), no enlarged lymph nodes in mediastinum, supraclavicular regions, or bilateral axillae.
