source_text: 右肺索条影同前，左肺上叶新见模糊小结节(图29)
text_en: Fibrotic band in the right lung is stable compared to prior; a new faint small nodule is seen in the left upper lobe (Figure 29).

source_text: 右侧锁骨上、纵隔4R、7、10R组多发淋巴结，较前相仿，较大仍约20x10mm（IM20）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular and mediastinal stations 4R, 7, and 10R are similar to prior, with the largest still measuring approximately 20 x 10 mm (IM20).

source_text: 左肺门、纵隔多发淋巴结同前，转移不除外
text_en: Multiple left hilar and mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior; metastasis cannot be excluded.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结大致同前，较大4L组模糊密度区约17x15mm（IM20）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are largely unchanged from prior, with the larger ill-defined lymph node in station 4L measuring approximately 17x15 mm (IM20).

source_text: 双肺下叶新见少许索条影，未见新增结节
text_en: Newly noted few linear opacities in both lower lobes; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 左肺下叶软组织肿块较前呈不规则形态增大，原较大层面约2.7x1.8cm（Im46），现约3.0x2.8cm（IM43），其外侧肺内多发索条纠集同前，胸膜增厚较前明显，叶间胸膜可见细结节样，左侧少量胸水，考虑左肺癌进展，左侧胸膜转移
text_en: The soft tissue mass in the left lower lobe has irregularly increased in size compared to prior, previously measured approximately 2.7x1.8 cm (Im46), currently measures approximately 3.0x2.8 cm (IM43). Multiple linear opacities with traction in the adjacent lung parenchyma remain unchanged. Pleural thickening is more prominent than prior. Fine nodular opacities are visible along the interlobar pleura. Small left pleural effusion. Findings suggest progression of left lung cancer and left pleural metastasis.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are approximately stable compared to prior

source_text: 肺内未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: No new nodular lesions or patchy opacities within the lung.

source_text: 4R组小淋巴结同前，约12x8mm（IM23），平扫密度较高，考虑良性
text_en: Small lymph node in station 4R is unchanged, measuring about 12x8 mm (IM23); on non-contrast imaging, the density is relatively high, suggestive of benign etiology.

source_text: 纵隔4组淋巴结同前，短径仍约11mm（IM20）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal station 4 are stable compared to prior, with short axes still approximately 11 mm (IM20)

source_text: 右肺下叶背段条形结节大致同前，现约11x5mm(IM30)，追查
text_en: The linear nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged, currently measuring approximately 11 x 5 mm (IM30); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左侧斜裂胸膜见模糊小结节同前，仍约4mm（IM33）
text_en: A small indistinct nodule is seen along the left oblique fissure pleura, unchanged, still approximately 4 mm (IM33).

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结，原3p及4R小淋巴结较前缩小，如原约8x4mm（IM17）者，现约6x4mm（IM18）
text_en: No enlarged lymph nodes seen in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular regions, and bilateral axillary regions; previous small lymph nodes at stations 3p and 4R are smaller than before, for example, a node previously measuring approximately 8x4 mm (IM17) now measures approximately 6x4 mm (IM18).

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节同前（IM35）
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule stable compared to prior (IM35)

source_text: 纵隔及肺门多发小淋巴结同前，短径小于10mm（Im26）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes unchanged from prior, short axis less than 10mm (Im26).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段不规则混杂磨玻璃密度结节大致同前，仍约20x10mm（IM26），牵拉相邻的斜裂胸膜
text_en: The irregular mixed ground-glass opacity nodule in the apical segment of the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged, still measuring approximately 20x10 mm (IM26), and it is pulling on the adjacent oblique fissure pleura.

source_text: 左肺结节同前，倾向良性，随诊复查
text_en: Left pulmonary nodule unchanged from prior, favoring benign, follow-up examination.
Right lung small nodules unchanged (IM9, 19, 32, 39, 50)

source_text: 余肺多发小结节及磨玻璃密度结节灶同前相仿（IM22、24、25、39、57、62等）
text_en: Multiple small nodules and ground-glass nodules in the remaining lung are similar to prior (IM22, 24, 25, 39, 57, 62, etc.).

source_text: 双肺多发结节较前增大、部分缩小、部分同前，追查
text_en: Multiple nodules in both lungs have increased in size, some have decreased, and others are unchanged; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 右下肺索条结节灶同前，约8mm（IMA41）
text_en: The linear and nodular opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 8 mm (IMA41).

source_text: 右肺中叶肿物同前，仍约21x17mm（IM30），右肺膨胀不全、双下肺索条影同前
text_en: The lesion in the right middle lobe is unchanged, still measuring approximately 21 x 17 mm (IM30); right lung volume loss and reticular opacities in both lower lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右侧肋胸膜结节缩小，现约2mm（IM43），原约3mm（IM41），双侧未见胸水征象
text_en: Nodule in the right costal pleura has decreased in size, now approximately 2 mm (IM43), previously about 3 mm (IM41). No pleural effusion bilaterally.

source_text: 右肺下叶心包后方类圆形软组织密度结节较前增大，原约20x18mm（Im47），现约23x23mm（IM47），边缘模糊、索条影同前，恶性不除外，原发与转移待鉴别，请结合其它检查评价
text_en: Round soft tissue density nodule posterior to the pericardium in the right lower lobe has increased in size, previously approximately 20x18 mm (Im47), now approximately 23x23 mm (IM47). Margins remain blurred and associated linear opacities unchanged. Malignancy cannot be excluded; primary versus metastatic origin requires differentiation—correlate with other studies.

source_text: 部分肋骨高密度结节同前，结合临床
text_en: Partial high-density nodules in ribs unchanged, correlate with clinical findings.

source_text: 双肺上叶及下叶另新见多发磨玻璃密度结节 ，较大约6mm（Im46、49、58等）
text_en: Multiple new ground-glass density nodules are seen in the upper and lower lobes of both lungs; the largest is approximately 6 mm (IM46, 49, 58, etc.).

source_text: 右侧胸膜结节样增厚同前（IM43）
text_en: The nodular thickening of the right pleura is unchanged from prior (IM43).

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，现约13x10mm（IM32）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is stable compared to prior, currently measuring approximately 13 x 10 mm (IM32).

source_text: 纵隔2、4组小淋巴结同前，4R组仍约14x8mm（IM19）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2 and 4 are unchanged from previous; station 4R remains approximately 14x8 mm (IM19).

source_text: 左侧甲状腺低密度结节同前(图4)，请结合B超检查
text_en: A low-density nodule is seen in the left thyroid, unchanged (Figure 4); correlate with ultrasound findings.

source_text: 右肺中叶另可见不规则小结节，较前略饱满，现约4mm（IM38），原约3mm（Im38）
text_en: An additional irregular small nodule is seen in the right middle lobe, slightly more prominent than before, currently measuring approximately 4 mm (IM38), previously about 3 mm (Im38).

source_text: 双肺结节大致同前，追查
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary nodules are roughly stable. Further investigation is recommended.

source_text: 新发多发实性微小结节
text_en: Newly developed multiple solid tiny nodules

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段近膈肌上方扁平样结节影同前，大小约8x3mm（IM63）
text_en: A flat-appearing subpleural nodule superior to the diaphragm in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged from previous, size approximately 8x3 mm (IM63).

source_text: T6椎体右侧横突局限性高密度灶同前，余扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Focal high-density lesion in the right transverse process of T6 unchanged; no evidence of osseous destruction in the remainder of the visualized thoracic skeleton

source_text: 两肺索条影同前，左肺上叶舌段胸膜下类小结节灶此次未见
text_en: Linear opacities in both lungs are stable; a small subpleural nodule in the lingular segment of the left upper lobe is not seen on this exam.

source_text: 右肺多发小结节同前，随诊观察
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right lung are unchanged; observation with follow-up is advised.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结较前变化不明显，原约20x15mm，现约22x12mm（IM24）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes show no significant change compared to previous, previously approximately 20x15 mm, currently approximately 22x12 mm (IM24).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，左肺胸膜下多发不规则索条、结节影大致同前，部分仍呈磨玻璃密度（IM28、32）
text_en: Bilateral lung markings are unremarkable in course, and pulmonary lucency is uniform. Multiple irregular linear and nodular opacities subpleurally in the left lung are roughly stable, with some still showing ground-glass density (IM28, 32).

source_text: 右肺上叶模糊结节部分同前（IM22），部分显示不清
text_en: Part of the ill-defined nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior (IM22), while part is not clearly visualized.

source_text: 右肺下叶磨玻璃密度小结节同前，追查
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged; further follow-up is recommended

source_text: 左侧叶间裂扁平小结节同前，考虑良性
text_en: Flat small nodule in the left interlobar fissure is unchanged compared to prior; benign etiology is considered.

source_text: 右锁骨上淋巴结缩小，原约18*12mm，现约11*9mm（IM4）
text_en: Right supraclavicular lymph node has decreased in size, previously approximately 18x12 mm, now approximately 11x9 mm (IM4)

source_text: 纵隔平扫肿大淋巴结同前，较大约27x25mm（IMA18）
text_en: Non-contrast mediastinal CT demonstrates enlarged lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest measuring approximately 27x25 mm (IMA18).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端周围软组织影增厚，左侧纵隔旁、胸膜及胸膜下多发结节及肿块，较前缩小，如原约24x20mm，现约14x13mm（IM12）
text_en: Left upper lobe postoperative status with thickened soft tissue density surrounding the bronchial stump. Multiple nodules and masses in the left paramediastinal, pleural, and subpleural regions, decreased in size compared to prior (previously approximately 24x20 mm, currently approximately 14x13 mm) (IM12)

source_text: 右肺门肿大淋巴结较前增大，较大者原约23x15mm，现约27x19mm（IM27）
text_en: The enlarged right hilar lymph node is larger than prior; the largest was previously approximately 23 x 15 mm and is now approximately 27 x 19 mm (IM27).

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R、7组淋巴结同前，较大约11x10mm（IM17）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R, 4R, and 7 are unchanged from prior, with the largest measuring approximately 11x10 mm (Image 17).

source_text: 左肺上叶肿物切除术后，支气管断端稍增厚同前，未见异常密度灶
text_en: Postoperative status after left upper lobe mass resection, bronchial stump slightly thickened similar to previous, no abnormal density lesion seen.

source_text: 左侧斜裂胸膜小结节同前，约3mm（IM41），余双侧胸膜光滑，未见胸水征象
text_en: Small nodule along the left major fissure pleura is unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IM41); otherwise, bilateral pleura are smooth, and no signs of pleural effusion are seen.

source_text: 左上肺钙化及索条影同前，两下肺局限性索条小结节灶同前（IMA18、44）
text_en: Calcification and fibrotic bands in the left upper lobe are unchanged from prior. Localized fibrotic bands and small nodules in both lower lobes are unchanged from prior (IMA18, 44).

source_text: 右肺中叶团片状软组织结节形态相仿，纵膈窗见内部实性软组织成分增大，原约18x9mm（纵膈窗IM36)，现约22x11mm（纵膈窗IM37),边缘分叶状，远侧少量条索改变同前
text_en: The soft tissue nodule in the right middle lobe shows similar morphology; on the mediastinal window, the internal solid soft tissue component has increased in size from approximately 18x9 mm (mediastinal window IM36) to approximately 22x11 mm (mediastinal window IM37). The margin remains lobulated, and the small amount of distal linear fibrotic change is unchanged.

source_text: 未见新增结节及斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities

source_text: 其外侧圆形结节较前相仿，约8mm（IM20）
text_en: The round nodule lateral to it is similar to prior, measuring approximately 8 mm (IM20).

source_text: 双肺新增小结节，转移不除外，建议密切追查
text_en: Newly developed small nodules in both lungs. Metastasis cannot be excluded. Recommend close follow-up.

source_text: 余肺实质未见新发结节及异常实变影
text_en: The remaining lung parenchyma shows no new nodules or abnormal areas of consolidation.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段结节较前缩小，现仅可见钙化
text_en: Left lower lobe posterior segment nodule decreased in size, now only calcification visible.

source_text: 食道胸下段管壁不均匀增厚较前减轻，较厚部位原约15mm，现约12mm（IM39），外膜模糊，同胸主动脉接触面约90度，近端食管略扩张
text_en: Irregular wall thickening of the lower thoracic esophagus decreased compared to prior, with maximum thickness reduced from approximately 15 mm to 12 mm (IM39); outer wall blurred, interface with thoracic aorta approximately 90 degrees, proximal esophagus slightly dilated

source_text: 左肺癌术后，胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Post-left lung cancer surgery, no new space-occupying lesions in the chest.

source_text: 左上肺淡片结节同前（IM34）
text_en: Faint patchy nodule in the left upper lobe unchanged (IM34)

source_text: 胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏
text_en: No bone destruction seen in the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 双肺门及纵隔多发高密度淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Multiple high-density lymph nodes in the bilateral hila and mediastinum are unchanged from prior; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 双侧胸膜多发结节增厚伴部分钙化同前
text_en: Bilateral pleural multiple nodular thickening with partial calcification is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶新见结节，考虑转移
text_en: A new nodule in the left upper lobe; consider metastasis.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段不规则结节同前相仿，部分呈实性密度，部分呈磨玻璃密度，约34x18mm（IM19），形态不规则，边缘索条牵拉邻近胸膜同前，定期复查
text_en: An irregular nodule in the left lower lobe, apical segment, similar to prior, with partially solid and partially ground-glass density, measuring approximately 34x18 mm (IM19), irregular in shape, with marginal spiculation causing traction of the adjacent pleura, similar to prior.

source_text: 胃小弯多发淋巴结较前缩小
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes at the lesser curvature of the stomach have decreased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段小结节同前，结合临床追查
text_en: The small nodule in the outer basal segment of the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior; clinical follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门淋巴结缩小，现较大约12x7mm（IMA20），原约15x11mm
text_en: Mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes decreased in size, currently the largest approximately 12x7 mm (IMA20), previously approximately 15x11 mm.

source_text: 新见一结节
text_en: Newly seen nodule

source_text: 双肺实性微小结节同前
text_en: Multiple solid micronodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶多发磨玻璃密度结节同前（IM10、13、17），边界尚清，较大者仍约7mm（IM17）
text_en: Multiple ground-glass density nodules in the right upper lobe are stable compared to prior (IM10, 13, 17), with relatively well-defined margins; the largest remains approximately 7 mm (IM17).

source_text: 双肺散在小结节同前，较大仍约4mm（IM33）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, largest still about 4 mm (IM33).

source_text: 左腋下小淋巴结略大，原约7mm，现约9mm（IM24）
text_en: Left axillary small lymph node slightly enlarged, previously approximately 7 mm, currently approximately 9 mm (image 24).

source_text: 两肺上叶小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Small nodular opacities in both upper lobes are unchanged from prior. Follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，胸部CT未见新发占位
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, chest CT shows no new mass.

source_text: 纵隔3p组见小淋巴结同前，约7mm（IM13）
text_en: Mediastinal station 3p shows small lymph nodes unchanged from previous, approximately 7 mm (IM13).

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下新见模糊小结节，约5mm（IM42）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural newly identified hazy small nodule, approximately 5mm (Image 42)

source_text: 扫及腹腔干上方淋巴结同前（IM49），追查
text_en: CT shows lymph nodes above the celiac trunk unchanged from prior (IM49); follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶钙化灶同前，左肺上叶斜裂胸膜下3mm小结节同前（IM30）
text_en: Calcified focus in the left upper lobe stable; 3 mm subpleural nodule near the oblique fissure in the left upper lobe stable (IM30).

source_text: 右侧水平裂小结节同前，约5mm（IMA28）
text_en: Small nodule along the right horizontal fissure is stable, measuring approximately 5 mm (IMA28).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段多发模糊点片影及多发类圆形小结节较前减少、变淡（IM25）
text_en: Multiple ill-defined punctate and patchy opacities and multiple round small nodules in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe have decreased in number and become fainter compared to prior (IM25).

source_text: 右肺小结节部分较前相仿，个别病灶略饱满，追查
text_en: Some small nodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior; individual lesions appear slightly more prominent and require follow-up.

source_text: 左肺下叶斑片索条影较前变淡，小结节灶同前，约5mm（Im57）
text_en: Patchy linear opacities in the left lower lobe are less prominent than before, small nodule foci unchanged, approximately 5mm (Im57).

source_text: 左肺微结节同前
text_en: Left lung micronodule unchanged from previous.

source_text: 扫及双肾上腺结节同前相仿，分别约右侧18x16mm（IM56）、左侧11x11mm（IM54）
text_en: CT shows bilateral adrenal nodules similar to prior, with the right measuring approximately 18x16 mm (IM56) and the left approximately 11x11 mm (IM54).

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右肺中叶及左肺上叶少许索条灶同前，双肺未见结节
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. Minor linear opacities in the right middle lobe and left upper lobe lingular segment are stable. No nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 右肺尖磨玻璃密度结节大致同前
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right apex essentially unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔内及左侧锁骨上数枚小淋巴结大致同前，短径均小于10mm
text_en: Several small lymph nodes within the mediastinum and left supraclavicular region are essentially unchanged from previous, with short axes all less than 10 mm.

source_text: 左下胸膜轻度增厚及索条同前，余双肺未见新生结节影
text_en: Mild thickening and linear bands in the left lower pleura remain unchanged; no new nodules are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约12*6mm（IMA23）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest measuring approximately 12x6 mm (IMA23).

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段（IM48）微结节同前，大小约2-3mm
text_en: The micro-nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe (IM48) is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 2-3 mm.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度灶较前略增大，原约13x6mm，现约15*8mm（IMA17），两肺微小结节影部分同前如左肺上叶舌段结节仍约3mm（IMA35），部分增大，如右肺下叶前基底段结节原约6mm，现约9mm（IM38）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe slightly increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 13 x 6 mm, now approximately 15 x 8 mm (IMA17); some tiny nodules in both lungs unchanged from prior, such as the 3 mm nodule in the left upper lobe lingular segment (IMA35), while others increased in size, such as the nodule in the right lower lobe anterior basal segment previously approximately 6 mm, now approximately 9 mm (IM38).

source_text: 扫及胃小弯侧多发淋巴结较前缩小，如原较大约15x10mm（IM59），现约9x6mm（IM61）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes along the lesser curvature of the stomach reduced in size compared to prior, from approximately 15x10mm (IM59) to approximately 9x6mm (IM61).

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，局部软组织密度影较前缩小，现约21*15mm(图34)，原约21x18mm（IM34），左侧胸膜增厚较前减轻，左侧未见胸水征象
text_en: Left lower lobe postoperative, local soft tissue density shadow is reduced in size compared to previous, now approximately 21*15 mm (Figure 34), previously approximately 21x18 mm (IM34), left pleural thickening is improved compared to previous, no left pleural effusion seen.

source_text: 右肺散在钙化结节及索条影同前
text_en: Scattered calcified nodules and linear opacities in the right lung are similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段、左肺新见多发类圆形实性结节，约3-5mm（IM32、35、36），追查
text_en: Newly seen multiple round solid nodules in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe and the left lung, measuring approximately 3-5 mm (IM32, 35, 36); further evaluation is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔内多发高密度淋巴结较前增大，原较大约为14x8mm（Im31），现约19x8mm（IM28）
text_en: Multiple high-density mediastinal lymph nodes enlarged compared to previous, previously larger approximately 14x8 mm (Im31), currently approximately 19x8 mm (IM28)

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，断端周围软组织密度影及索条影范围同前，左肺上叶结节较前增大，原约7mm（IM14），现约9x7mm（IM15）
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, soft tissue density and linear opacities around the stump with extent stable compared to prior, left upper lobe nodule increased in size from approximately 7mm (IM14) to approximately 9x7mm (IM15).

source_text: 锁骨上、腋下淋巴结大致同前，较大现仍约10x5mm（IM13）
text_en: Supraclavicular and axillary lymph nodes essentially unchanged from previous, with the larger one currently still approximately 10x5 mm (IM13)

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结较前稍饱满，较大原约18x16mm，现约19x18mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph node is slightly enlarged compared to previous, larger previously approximately 18x16 mm, currently approximately 19x18 mm (Image 20).

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，局部小斑片索条钙化影较前相仿，支气管后方约17mm软组织结节状影大致同前(图35)，其后缘见条形致密钙化（IM36）
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lower lobe; small patchy linear and calcified opacities are stable compared to prior. A soft tissue nodular opacity measuring approximately 17 mm posterior to the bronchus is essentially unchanged (Fig. 35), with a linear dense calcification seen at its posterior margin (IM36).

source_text: 食管胸中下段环周增厚减轻，较厚处原约8mm（IM34），现约6mm（IM36），管腔略窄，与胸主动脉接触面小于90°
text_en: Circumferential thickening in the middle-lower thoracic esophagus has decreased. Current maximum thickness is approximately 6 mm (IM36), previously 8 mm (IM34). Lumen is slightly narrowed. Contact surface with the thoracic aorta is less than 90 degrees.

source_text: 双肺多发转移较前进展
text_en: Multiple metastatic nodules in both lungs have progressed compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结同前，仍约10x8mm（Im24）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are stable, measuring approximately 10x8 mm (Im24).

source_text: 右肺胸膜下微小结节同前(图31)
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior (Figure 31).

source_text: 余双下肺淡片影大致同前，未见新生结节或实变影
text_en: Faint patchy opacities in the remaining portions of both lower lungs are largely unchanged; no new nodules or consolidations are seen.

source_text: 胸12椎体上缘休谟结节形成同前（Im56），边缘见硬化边
text_en: T12 vertebral body superior margin Schmorl's node formation unchanged (Im56), with sclerotic margin.

source_text: 食管胸中下段管壁不均匀增厚减轻，较厚原约17mm（IM31），现约11mm（IM31），外膜模糊
text_en: Irregular wall thickening of the mid-to-lower thoracic esophagus reduced, thickest portion previously approximately 17mm (IM31), now approximately 11mm (IM31), serosa blurred.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段叶间胸膜下不规则结节较前略增大，现约27*20mm(图19)，原约25x15mm（IM19)，邻近周围索条及叶间胸膜凹陷同前
text_en: An irregular nodule subpleural to the interlobar pleura in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment is slightly larger compared to prior, now approximately 27 x 20 mm (Fig 19), previously 25 x 15 mm (IM19). Adjacent strands and interlobar pleural indentation are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶多发结节、钙化及索条同前，考虑结核纤维硬结灶，随访
text_en: Multiple nodules, calcifications, and linear opacities in the right upper lobe are unchanged; findings are consistent with fibrotic sequelae of prior tuberculosis; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔4-7组及双肺门数枚淋巴结同前，较大仍约17x8mm（IM33），部分密度稍高，内见点状钙化
text_en: Several mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4-7 and bilateral hilar lymph nodes are stable compared to prior, with the largest still measuring approximately 17 x 8 mm (IM33); some have slightly higher density with punctate calcifications.

source_text: 右下肺少许索条影同前，右肺下叶胸膜旁见模糊小结节，约为5mm（IM50）
text_en: Few fibrotic bands in the right lower lobe are stable compared to prior. A small indistinct nodule, approximately 5 mm, is seen adjacent to the pleura in the right lower lobe (IM50).

source_text: 扫及胸廓骨质未见转移征象
text_en: No metastatic signs seen in the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度灶同前，约13*6mm（IMA16），两肺微小结节影同前（IMA34、42）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe unchanged from prior, approximately 13 x 6 mm (IMA16); tiny nodules in both lungs unchanged from prior (IMA34, 42).

source_text: 纵隔、右锁骨上区、腋下未见新发肿大淋巴结
text_en: No new enlarged lymph nodes seen in the mediastinal, right supraclavicular, and axillary regions

source_text: 左肺下叶外基底段磨玻璃密度结节同前，仍约为7x6mm（IM45），边缘小索条影同前
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 7x6 mm (IM45), with stable small linear opacities at the margins.

source_text: 右肺小结节同前，约3mm（Im22）
text_en: Right lung small nodule unchanged, approximately 3 mm (Im22)

source_text: 右肺中叶多个微小结节大致同前
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in the right middle lobe are essentially unchanged.

source_text: 双下肺少许索条同前，余双肺未见新生结节及实变影
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the bilateral lower lungs are unchanged; no new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶微结节同前（Im33）
text_en: Right lower lobe micronodule stable compared to prior (Im33).

source_text: 双肺少许小结节同前（Im43），未见新生结节及斑片影
text_en: Few small nodules in both lungs are stable (Im43); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 纵隔4L组淋巴结较前相仿，现仍约15x11mm（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4L lymph nodes similar to prior, currently still approximately 15x11mm (image 21).

source_text: 右肺上叶贴胸膜处小结节同前
text_en: Small nodule adjacent to the pleura in the right upper lobe is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结较前增大，原约13x8mm，现约18x9mm（IM29），转移待排，建议密切追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph node enlarged compared to prior, previously approximately 13x8 mm, now approximately 18x9 mm (IM29), metastasis cannot be excluded, close follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4、5组及双腋区小淋巴结大致同前，较大仍约14x9mm（IM25），平扫密度较高
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R, 4, and 5, and small bilateral axillary lymph nodes are essentially unchanged from previous, with the largest still measuring approximately 14x9 mm (IM25), higher density on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 右侧纵隔胸膜多发结节影同前相仿，较大约11mm（IM39），左侧纵隔胸膜结节同前（IM50）
text_en: Multiple nodules in the right mediastinal pleura are similar to prior. The largest is approximately 11 mm (IM39). The left mediastinal pleural nodule is unchanged (IM50).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节同前，约9x6mm（IM20），下叶基底段胸膜下模糊小结节（IM34）
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 9 x 6 mm (IM20). The subpleural indistinct small nodule in the basal segment of the lower lobe (IM34) is noted.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段两处小结节较前略缩小，原分别约15x9mm、10x9mm，现约14x6mm、8x6mm（IM21），边缘毛糙同前
text_en: Two small nodules in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe are slightly decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 15x9 mm and 10x9 mm, now approximately 14x6 mm and 8x6 mm (IM21), with irregular margins stable.

source_text: 左侧斜裂少许胸膜小结节同前
text_en: A few small pleural nodules in the left oblique fissure are unchanged.

source_text: 双肺未见明显新发结节影
text_en: No obvious new nodules are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 甲状腺左侧叶见高强化结节同前，大小约15*10mm（IM7）
text_en: A hyperenhancing nodule is seen in the left thyroid lobe, unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 15 x 10 mm (image 7).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则软组织密度结节较前相仿，仍约20x15mm（Im17），密度不均，边缘仍与侧胸膜牵拉
text_en: The irregular soft-tissue density nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is similar to prior, still measuring approximately 20x15 mm (Im17). The density is heterogeneous, and the margin continues to show lateral pleural retraction.

source_text: 右肺中叶新见类结节影，约12mm（IM36），追查
text_en: A new nodular opacity is seen in the right middle lobe, measuring approximately 12 mm (IM36); follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结缩小，左锁骨上小淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes reduced in size; left supraclavicular small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, follow-up recommended

source_text: 右上肺术后，支气管残端少许软组织密度改变同前，未见肿块征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lung; slight soft tissue density change at the bronchial stump is unchanged; no mass-like findings are seen.

source_text: 纵隔5区淋巴结较前增大，较大原约9x5mm（IM22），现约16x9mm（IM19），反应性增生
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at station 5 have increased in size compared to prior, previously larger at approximately 9x5 mm (IM22), now approximately 16x9 mm (IM19), reactive hyperplasia.

source_text: 右肺多发粟粒样小结节较前增多，左侧胸膜局限性增厚并胸水，转移可能，进一步检查
text_en: Multiplemiliary small nodules in the right lung have increased compared to prior; left-sided pleural focal thickening with pleural effusion, metastasis possible; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 右叶间胸膜及右侧侧胸膜增厚同前，仍见小结节（IM38）
text_en: The thickening of the right interlobar pleura and right lateral pleura remains unchanged compared to prior imaging, with small nodules still present (IM38).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端软组织稍增厚较前相仿，局部未见结节及肿块，考虑术后改变
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, mild soft tissue thickening at the bronchial stump similar to prior, no nodules or masses locally, considered postoperative change.

source_text: 纵隔多枚淋巴结较前缩小，较大者现约15x7mm（IMA22），原约20x8mm（Im21）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes have decreased in size compared to previous; the largest is now approximately 15x7 mm (Image A22) and was previously approximately 20x8 mm (Image 21).

source_text: 纵隔隆突下片状积液同前，纵隔、肺门及锁骨上区平扫未见明显肿大淋巴结
text_en: Patchy fluid collection in subcarinal mediastinum unchanged from previous; no significantly enlarged lymph nodes seen in mediastinum, hilar, or supraclavicular regions on non-contrast scan

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区多发小淋巴结同前（IM8）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region are stable compared to prior (IM8).

source_text: 前纵隔脂肪密度增高同前，纵隔、肺门、锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Increased fat density in the anterior mediastinum is unchanged from prior. No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum, hila, or supraclavicular regions.

source_text: 右上肺及右肺中叶小结节部分同前（IM16、24），部分较前消失（IM31），双侧肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Some small nodules in the right upper lung and right middle lobe are unchanged (IM16, 24), while others have resolved (IM31); no new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: T1椎体低密度结节同前，追查
text_en: T1 vertebral body low-density nodule unchanged, follow-up recommended

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，右肺中叶支气管截断，肺组织不张较前减轻，局部结节影较前缩小，现约14*5mm(图28)，原约19*14mm（IMA27）
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; right middle lobe bronchial cutoff with atelectasis, which is improved compared to prior. The local nodule has decreased in size, now approximately 14 x 5 mm (Figure 28), previously about 19 x 14 mm (IMA27).

source_text: 纵隔2R小淋巴结较前增大，原约8mm（IM11），现约10mm（IM12），追查
text_en: Small lymph node at mediastinal station 2R increased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 8mm (IM11), currently approximately 10mm (IM12), for follow-up

source_text: 扫及左侧4、5肋骨折，余扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Fractures of the left 4th and 5th ribs are noted; no osseous destruction is identified in the remaining thoracic bones.

source_text: 两肺多发小结节多大致同前
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are mostly unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶切除术后，双肺多发小结节同前
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, multiple small nodules in both lungs unchanged.

source_text: 左肺门淋巴结较前缩小，原较大者约15x10mm（IM36），现约11x6mm（IM36）
text_en: Left hilar lymph nodes are decreased in size compared to previous; the largest was approximately 15x10mm (IM36), now approximately 11x6mm (IM36).

source_text: 两肺模糊小结节灶同前相仿（IM34等）
text_en: The hazy small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior (IM34, etc.).

source_text: 食管术后，吻合口壁增厚，吻合口旁肿大淋巴结大致同前，现约46*31mm(图8)，原约40x33mm（IM11）
text_en: Post-esophagectomy. Anastomotic wall thickening. Enlarged lymph node adjacent to the anastomosis stable compared to prior, currently approximately 46x31 mm (image 8), previously 40x33 mm (image 11).

source_text: 双肺磨玻璃结节、右肺中叶实性结节部分同前，部分显示不清，追查
text_en: Ground-glass nodules in both lungs and the solid nodule in the right middle lobe are partially similar to prior; some are not clearly visible. Follow up.

source_text: 左肺下叶3mm圆形小结节同前（IM37），追查
text_en: 3mm round small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (IM37), follow-up.

source_text: 未见结节新发
text_en: No new nodules seen

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右肺下叶背段胸膜下模糊结节同前（IM33），余双肺肺内透亮度均匀，未见结节或斑片影
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent; hazy subpleural nodule in the dorsal segment of the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior (IM33); the remainder of both lungs shows uniform lucency, with no nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 右肺肺尖胸膜下局限性磨玻璃密度结节灶大致同前（IM9、18），较大者约7mm（IM9）
text_en: The focal ground-glass opacity nodule subpleurally at the right lung apex is largely unchanged (IM9, 18); the larger one measures approximately 7 mm (IM9).

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后改变同前，胸部CT平扫未见新发占位
text_en: Postoperative changes following right upper lobectomy are unchanged; non-contrast chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则肿物明显增大，原约35*29mm(图20)，现约53x52mm（IM22），与纵隔胸膜关系密切
text_en: The irregular mass in the left upper lobe has significantly increased in size, from approximately 35x29 mm (Figure 20) to approximately 53x52 mm (IM22), and is closely related to the mediastinal pleura.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结饱满同前相仿，约19x13mm（IM24）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes enlarged similar to previous, approximately 19x13 mm (IM24).

source_text: 左肺下叶微小致密结节同前，2-3mm（IM47、49、56）
text_en: Left lower lobe small solid nodule unchanged, 2-3 mm (IM47, 49, 56).

source_text: 右上肺微结节同前（IM28），肺尖钙化灶
text_en: Micro-nodules in the right upper lung are unchanged (IM28); calcified foci at the lung apex.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，约14x11mm（IM25）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node unchanged, measuring approximately 14 x 11 mm (IM25)

source_text: 余双肺见多发2-4mm小结节同前，胸膜下分布为主
text_en: Multiple 2–4 mm small nodules in both lungs, predominantly subpleural, are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 余肺未见新增结节灶及斑片影
text_en: The remainder of the lungs shows no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4、7、10R组淋巴结同前相仿，较大约14x10mm（IM22、27）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R, 4, 7, and 10R are similar to previous, with the largest measuring approximately 14x10 mm (IM22, 27).

source_text: 两肺多发磨玻璃密度结节同前，较大约21*17mm（IMA13）
text_en: Multiple ground-glass nodules in both lungs similar to prior, largest measuring approximately 21x17 mm (IMA13)

source_text: 右肺中叶血管旁见模糊磨玻璃密度片絮影同前，约8x5mm（IM36），中叶胸膜下见一5mm小结节（IM39）同前
text_en: A hazy ground-glass opacity is seen adjacent to vessels in the right middle lobe, unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 8x5 mm (IM36). A 5-mm small nodule is seen subpleural in the middle lobe (IM39), unchanged.

source_text: 食道癌术后，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Post esophageal cancer surgery; no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 左肺术后改变，右肺多发小结节同前
text_en: Left lung postoperative change, multiple small nodules in right lung unchanged.

source_text: 双肺门淋巴结同前，较大约11x6mm（IM30）
text_en: Hilar lymph nodes are unchanged from prior, the largest measuring approximately 11x6 mm (IM30).

source_text: 双肺多发微小结节同前，左肺上叶索条影同前
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged; left upper lobe linear opacities are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔4-6组淋巴结部分缩小，较大者原约23x9mm（Im16），现约21x7mm（IM16）
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4-6 have decreased in size; the largest was previously approximately 23 x 9 mm (Im16) and is now approximately 21 x 7 mm (IM16).

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段类圆形结节同前，仍约3mm（IM43）
text_en: Round nodule in the left lower lobe basal segment unchanged from prior, still approximately 3 mm (IM43)

source_text: 右侧纵隔胸膜多发结节影同前，较大仍约11mm（IM41），左侧纵隔胸膜结节同前（IM50）
text_en: Multiple nodules in the right mediastinal pleura are unchanged. The largest remains approximately 11 mm (IM41). The left mediastinal pleural nodule is unchanged (IM50).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段类圆形磨玻璃密度小结节较前密度增高，原约5mm（薄层Im112），现约4mm（薄层Im242）
text_en: Round ground-glass opacity small nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, increased in density, previously approximately 5 mm (thin-slice Im112), now approximately 4 mm (thin-slice Im242)

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下陈旧灶同前（IMA16），余肺内未见新增结节灶及斑片影
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural old lesion unchanged (IMA16); no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remainder of the lung

source_text: 右肺下叶结节较前增大，现约16x9mm（IMA35），原约8x5mm，其下方另一枚结节现约6x5mm（IMA40），原约2x1mm
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe has increased in size compared to prior, now measuring approximately 16x9 mm (IMA35), previously about 8x5 mm. Another nodule inferior to it now measures approximately 6x5 mm (IMA40), previously about 2x1 mm.

source_text: L1椎体楔形变扁同前，胸椎多个椎体呈凹透镜形状同前，未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Wedge-shaped flattening of the L1 vertebral body is unchanged; multiple thoracic vertebral bodies show a biconcave lens shape, unchanged; no osseous destruction is evident.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见明显软组织密度肿块影，局部胸膜增厚同前（IM34-37）
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lower lobe; non-contrast scan shows no obvious soft tissue density mass at the bronchial stump. Local pleural thickening is stable (IM34-37).

source_text: 食管癌术后，胸胃左旁结节较前缩小，追查
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer, nodule adjacent to the left of the intrathoracic stomach decreased in size compared to prior, follow-up.

source_text: 左下肺小结节同前（IM49），右肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable (IM49); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the right lung.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端周围软组织结构紊乱同前，未见占位征象
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; disorganized soft tissue structures around the bronchial stump are unchanged. No mass is identified.

source_text: 左斜裂扁平结节同前，仍约6x3mm（IM37）
text_en: Flat nodule along the left oblique fissure is unchanged, still approximately 6x3 mm (IM37).

source_text: 左肺上叶病灶较前稍增大
text_en: Left upper lobe lesion has slightly increased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 右肺上下叶胸膜下多发模糊小结节同前，较大约3mm（IM36）
text_en: Multiple indistinct subpleural small nodules in the right upper and lower lobes unchanged; largest approximately 3 mm (IM36).

source_text: 左肺下叶新见索条结节影，结节约4mm（IM38）
text_en: A linear nodular shadow is newly seen in the left lower lobe, with the nodule measuring approximately 4 mm (IM38).

source_text: 双肺纹理增重，多发微结节同前
text_en: Increased lung markings. Multiple micro-nodules are similar to prior.

source_text: 两肺未见新增结节灶及斑片影
text_en: No new nodular lesions or patchy opacities are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 双肺及右侧叶间胸膜散在微结节同前，直径均小于2mm（如IM30、41）
text_en: Scattered micro-nodules in both lungs and right interlobar pleura are stable, all diameters less than 2 mm (e.g., IM30, 41).

source_text: 右肺中叶支气管不规则变窄、中断，楔状实变影范围较前相仿，约38x28mm（IMA31），其肿块边界不清
text_en: Irregular narrowing and interruption of the right middle lobe bronchus. The wedge-shaped area of consolidation is similar in extent to prior, measuring approximately 38 x 28 mm (IMA31). The mass has ill-defined margins.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃小结节同前，约为5mm（Im19）
text_en: The small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged, approximately 5 mm (Image 19).

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段胸膜下2mm微小结节同前（IM30）
text_en: A 2-mm subpleural micronodule in the left upper lobe lingular segment is similar to previous (IM30).

source_text: 右肺上叶索条影、左肺钙化灶同前，右肺浅淡微小结节影同前（IMA20、32）
text_en: Linear opacities in the right upper lobe and calcifications in the left lung are unchanged compared to prior; faint, tiny nodules in the right lung are also unchanged (IMA20, 32)

source_text: 左肺上叶、下叶小结节影同前（IMA30、45），较大约7mm（IM45）
text_en: Small nodules in the left upper and lower lobes are stable compared to prior (IMA30, 45); the largest is approximately 7 mm (IM45).

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门可见多发淋巴结大致同前，平扫肺门淋巴结显示欠清，仍约为13x11mm（IM27），双侧锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right hilar region are largely unchanged from previous. On non-contrast scan, hilar lymph nodes are poorly visualized but still approximately 13x11 mm (IM27). No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the bilateral supraclavicular or bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段模糊小片影显示不清，余肺内未见新发结节或斑片影
text_en: The indistinct small patchy opacity in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is no longer clearly visible; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen elsewhere in the lungs.

source_text: 余双肺未见新发结节
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no new nodules.

source_text: 右肺尖结节同前，约4mm（IM12）
text_en: Nodule in the right lung apex is unchanged, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM12).

source_text: 纵隔内4L组淋巴结较前相仿，仍约12x9mm（IMA23）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at station 4L, similar to previous; still approximately 12x9 mm (IMA23).

source_text: 前纵隔胸腺区密度稍高较前相仿，其内小结节大小同前（Im18、26）
text_en: Slightly increased density in the thymic region of the anterior mediastinum is similar to prior, with the internal small nodule unchanged in size (Im18, 26).

source_text: 扫及肝脏低密度结节同前相仿，部分呈实性密度
text_en: On scan, a low-density nodule in the liver is similar to prior, with some portions demonstrating solid density.

source_text: 纵隔、肺门淋巴结较前增大
text_en: Mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes enlarged compared to previous.

source_text: 食道胸中段管壁不均匀异常增厚较前减轻，较厚处原约18mm，现厚约11mm（IM27），外膜面尚清，与胸主动脉脂肪间隙存在
text_en: Irregular abnormal thickening of the mid-thoracic esophageal wall, reduced compared to previous; thickest portion previously approximately 18 mm, now approximately 11 mm (IM27); outer membrane surface clear; fat plane with thoracic aorta present.

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节较前略显缩小（Im13），边界较清
text_en: Right upper lobe small nodule slightly smaller than prior (Im13), with well-defined margins

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则形结节较前缩小，原约22*14mm，现约18*14mm（IM19）
text_en: The irregular nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 22x14 mm, now approximately 18x14 mm (IM19).

source_text: 纵隔平扫未见肿大淋巴结，右侧气管食管沟小淋巴结同前，仍约8x6mm（IMA16）
text_en: Non-contrast mediastinal CT shows no enlarged lymph nodes; small lymph nodes in the right tracheoesophageal groove unchanged from prior, still measuring approximately 8x6 mm (IMA16).

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门散在小淋巴结同前，不足8mm
text_en: Scattered small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right hilum are stable compared to prior, measuring less than 8 mm.

source_text: 余双肺及双侧胸膜多发小结节大致同前，较大者约8mm（IM29）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the remainder of both lungs and bilateral pleura are largely unchanged; the largest measures approximately 8 mm (IM29).

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节同前，仍约2mm(IM16)，追查
text_en: Small nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, still measures approximately 2 mm (IM16); further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 胸骨体部局限性致密结节灶同前，余扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Sternum body localized dense nodular focus unchanged, remaining scanned chest bones show no bone destruction signs.

source_text: 纵膈4、7组及双肺门多发肿大淋巴结同前，较大位于4R，约22x18mm（IM25）
text_en: Multiple enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4, 7, and bilateral hilar regions unchanged from previous, largest at station 4R, approximately 22x18 mm (IM25).

source_text: 右肺中叶支气管截断、远端肺不张，局部软组织密度肿块与不张肺分界不清大致同前，短径约60mm（Im29）
text_en: Right middle lobe bronchus is truncated, with distal atelectasis. The local soft tissue density mass and the collapsed lung remain indistinct in demarcation, largely unchanged. The short axis measures approximately 60 mm (Im29).

source_text: 右侧胸膜弥漫不规则增厚减轻，右侧胸腔胸水同前，考虑胸膜转移略好转
text_en: Diffuse irregular thickening of the right pleura is less than prior. Right pleural effusion is unchanged. Slight improvement in pleural metastasis is considered.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段不规则结节较前相仿，现仍约8x7mm（IM39），边缘长索条影同前
text_en: Left lung lower lobe posterior basal segment irregular nodule stable compared to prior, currently still approximately 8x7 mm (IM39), with unchanged linear streaks at the margin

source_text: 右肺下叶局部切除术后，支气管断端未见明确增厚及异常强化（IM30），右肺下叶可见条片状实变影，右肺上叶前段、左肺下叶前基底段胸膜下小结节同前（IM18、42）
text_en: Status post partial resection of the right lower lobe; no definite thickening or abnormal enhancement at the bronchial stump (IM30). A linear consolidation is seen in the right lower lobe. Small subpleural nodules in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe and the anterior basal segment of the left lower lobe are stable (IM18, 42)

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结大同前，较大约16x7mm（IM25）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes size unchanged, the largest approximately 16x7 mm (IM25).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变同前，右肺下叶微小结节影同前
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lobe are unchanged. The tiny nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺多发微小点灶结节大致同前（IM9、14、22、30、37）
text_en: Multiple tiny punctate nodules in both lungs are roughly unchanged (IM9, 14, 22, 30, 37).

source_text: 余左肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation are seen in the left lung.

source_text: 右水平裂胸膜下结节影同前，较大者仍约14x9mm（IM33）
text_en: Subpleural nodule along the right horizontal fissure unchanged, largest still approximately 14x9 mm (IM33).

source_text: 双肺小结节同前
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结部分增大，现约12mm者（IM14），原约8mm，双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes are enlarged; one is now approximately 12mm (IM14), previously approximately 8mm; no enlarged lymph nodes are seen on non-contrast scan in bilateral hilar, supraclavicular, and bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 左肺多发小结节大致同前（IM19、21、22、43）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left lung generally unchanged from prior (IM19, 21, 22, 43)

source_text: 右肺中叶小斑点斑片影同前，余肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Small punctate and patchy opacities in the right middle lobe are unchanged; no new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶结节影同前，仍约5mm（IM44、45），追查
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged, still approximately 5 mm (images 44 and 45), follow-up.

source_text: 双下肺少许条索、微结节同前，双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: A few linear strands and micro-nodules in both lower lungs are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 纵隔5、6组淋巴结同前相仿，现较大约仍18x6mm（IM15）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 5 and 6 are similar to prior, currently larger, still approximately 18x6 mm (IM15).

source_text: 右肺门及纵隔可疑肿大淋巴结，转移可能
text_en: Suspicious enlarged lymph nodes at the right hilum and mediastinum, metastasis is possible

source_text: 右肺下叶磨玻璃密度小结节影同前（IM25、30、37、53），小于10mm，边界模糊
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM25, 30, 37, 53), less than 10 mm in size, with indistinct margins

source_text: 纵隔内4、7组多发淋巴结同前，约为16x10mm（IM30）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4 and 7 are unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 16x10 mm (IM30)

source_text: 左肺下叶不规则结节小片灶呈片絮状，范围大致同前（IM45）
text_en: Left lower lobe irregular nodule with patchy fluffy appearance, size stable compared to previous (Image 45)

source_text: 左肺下叶前基底段结节同前
text_en: Left lower lobe anterior basal segment nodule same as prior.

source_text: 双肺未见新发结节或斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左上肺磨玻璃结节较前略增大，现约19*14mm(图15)，原约17*12mm（IM15）
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe is slightly increased in size compared to prior, now measuring approximately 19 x 14 mm (Figure 15), previously 17 x 12 mm (IM15).

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段胸膜下高密度小斑片索条影同前无变化（IMA15），余双肺清晰，未见新发结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: The subpleural high-density small patchy and linear opacity in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged from prior (IMA15). The remainder of both lungs is clear, with no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜结节，原约10x7mm（IM39），现约16x10mm（IM37）
text_en: Nodule in the left interlobar pleura, previously approximately 10x7 mm (IM39), now approximately 16x10 mm (IM37).

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结，部分较前缩小，如4R组原较大约18x12mm，现约15X9mm（Im22），追查
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes, some decreased in size compared to prior, for example, station 4R previously approximately 18x12 mm, now approximately 15x9 mm (Im22), follow-up recommended

source_text: 纵隔左移同前，纵隔、肺门、腋窝及锁骨上平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Leftward shift of the mediastinum unchanged, no enlarged lymph nodes in the mediastinum, hila, axillae, or supraclavicular regions on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上淋巴结同前，建议复查
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node unchanged, follow-up recommended

source_text: 双侧叶间胸膜下小结节影同前（IMA35、54），较大约5mm
text_en: Small nodules subpleurally in the bilateral interlobar fissures are unchanged (IMA35, 54), the largest measuring approximately 5 mm.

source_text: 两下肺局限性索条影同前，双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Focal linear opacities in both lower lungs are unchanged from prior. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 右肺中叶结节增大，符合转移
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe has increased in size, consistent with metastasis.

source_text: 右肺和左肺下叶可见散在磨玻璃密度结节影同前相仿（IM18、19、27、36、39、50），较大约6mm（IM18）
text_en: Scattered ground-glass opacity nodules are seen in the right lung and left lower lobe, similar to prior (IM18, 19, 27, 36, 39, 50), largest measuring approximately 6 mm (IM18).

source_text: 纵隔内多发淋巴结同前相仿，如约16x11mm（IM25），密度稍高
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes similar to previous, largest approximately 16x11 mm (IM25), with slightly increased density

source_text: 右肺中叶磨玻璃密度小结节同前
text_en: Small ground-glass density nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, less than 10mm.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见明显异常软组织密度增厚影，右肺下叶索条结节影同前，约6mm（IM40）
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; non-contrast scan shows no significant abnormal soft-tissue density thickening at the bronchial stump. Linear and nodular opacities in the right lower lobe are unchanged, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM40).

source_text: 纵隔5、7组高密度肿大淋巴结同前相仿，约20x17mm（Im25）
text_en: High-density enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 5 and 7 are similar to prior, approximately 20x17 mm (Im25).

source_text: 扫及胸10椎体高密度结节影同前
text_en: Scans show a hyperdense nodule in the T10 vertebra, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结略缩小，原约19x16mm（Im19），现约17x14mm（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph node is slightly decreased in size, previously approximately 19x16 mm (Image 19), currently approximately 17x14 mm (Image 19).

source_text: 右肺上叶模糊结节同前相仿，约5mm（IM28）
text_en: The ill-defined nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM28).

source_text: 纵隔4、7组及双肺门高密度淋巴结较前相仿，较大者约20x12mm（IM25），部分伴钙化
text_en: High-density mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4 and 7 and bilateral hilar lymph nodes are similar to prior, with the largest measuring approximately 20x12 mm (IM25), and some show calcification.

source_text: 纵隔4L、7组淋巴结略饱满，较大原约11x7mm（IM28），现约17x7mm（IM27），反应增生
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4L and 7 are slightly enlarged, with the larger one previously measuring approximately 11x7 mm (IM28) and now approximately 17x7 mm (IM27), consistent with reactive hyperplasia.

source_text: 右肺小结节及双侧胸膜局限性增厚较前相仿
text_en: Small nodules in the right lung and focal thickening of the bilateral pleura are similar to prior.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，随诊观察
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged, follow-up observation.

source_text: 左肺小结节影同前（IM50）
text_en: Left lung small nodule unchanged (IM50)

source_text: 右肺局部术后，右肺下叶基底段团块影缩小，原约30x22mm，现约23*19mm（Im43）
text_en: Status post localized surgery in the right lung. The mass in the basal segment of the right lower lobe has decreased in size, from approximately 30x22 mm to 23x19 mm (Im43).

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段小结节同前，大小约2mm（IM12）
text_en: Small nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged, approximately 2 mm (IM12).

source_text: 右肺下叶较大结节影消失，余肺多发结节同前
text_en: The larger nodule in the right lower lobe has disappeared. The multiple nodules in the remainder of the lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 双肺散在多发小结节数目及大小同前，较大约8mm（Im31）
text_en: Number and size of scattered multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, the largest measuring approximately 8 mm (Im31).

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节同前，约5mm（IM18）
text_en: Right upper lobe small nodule unchanged, approximately 5 mm (IM18)

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior, all less than 10 mm

source_text: 扫及胸骨柄、T2右侧附件、T3、11、12椎体多发骨转移灶范围大致同前，部分密度较前增高
text_en: CT scan shows multiple bone metastases in the manubrium of sternum, right accessory process of T2, T3, T11, and T12 vertebral bodies, extent stable compared to prior, with increased density in some areas.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段分叶状肿物较前增大，现约60x52mm（IM13），原为47x40mm（IM12），尖段支气管进入肿物后截断，肿物与胸膜顶、第一肋骨及右锁骨下动脉分界不清同前，肿块周边见不规则浅淡片絮影，考虑炎性病变，追查
text_en: Lobulated mass in the right upper lobe apical segment increased in size, now approximately 60x52 mm (IM13), previously 47x40 mm (IM12); bronchus enters the mass and then terminates, same as prior; poorly defined margins with pleural apex, first rib, and right subclavian artery; irregular faint patchy opacities around the mass, suggestive of inflammatory changes, recommend follow-up

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，4L组约13x9mm（IM21）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, with the 4L station measuring approximately 13x9 mm (IM21).

source_text: 双肺含气良好，透亮度基本均匀，未见肺内新发结节或斑片影
text_en: Both lungs are well aerated with essentially uniform lucency. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen within the lungs.

source_text: 右上肺磨玻璃片状影及左肺模糊小结节同前
text_en: Ground-glass opacity in the right upper lung and indistinct small nodules in the left lung are unchanged.

source_text: 双肺另可见多发胸膜下小结节同前，约2-4mm（Im38、47、55），形态不规则
text_en: Additional multiple subpleural small nodules in both lungs are stable, measuring approximately 2-4 mm (Im38, 47, 55), with irregular morphology.

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影、双肺模糊小结节同前(IM25、30)，双肺未见新增结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: The linear opacities in the right lower lobe and the indistinct small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM25, 30); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔及左锁骨上多发小淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and left supraclavicular region approximately unchanged from previous.

source_text: 新见散在多发类圆形小结节
text_en: Newly seen scattered multiple round small nodules

source_text: 右肺中叶切除术后，支气管断端软组织密度灶较前明显缩小，原约17x15mm（IM36），现约8x5mm（IM34），增强扫描未见明确强化
text_en: Postoperative status after right middle lobectomy. The soft tissue density focus at the bronchial stump has markedly decreased in size, from approximately 17x15 mm (IM36) previously to approximately 8x5 mm (IM34) currently. No definite enhancement is seen on contrast-enhanced scanning.

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段及右肺中叶内侧段淡斑片影及索条影同前相仿，余肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Faint patchy and linear opacities in the left upper lobe lingular segment and right middle lobe medial segment are unchanged from prior. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区小淋巴结同前，约为7mm（Im7）
text_en: Small lymph node in the left supraclavicular region is stable, measuring approximately 7 mm (Im7).

source_text: 纵隔内多发淋巴结同前相仿，如约16x11mm（IM22），密度稍高
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes similar to previous, largest approximately 16x11 mm (IM22), with slightly increased density

source_text: 纵隔2R,4R多发淋巴结同前，较大9x8mm（IM18)
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R and 4R unchanged from previous, largest 9x8 mm (IM18).

source_text: 部分较前增大，如原约3mm（IM17）者，现约7mm（IM13）
text_en: Partial increase in size, e.g., from approximately 3mm (IM17) to approximately 7mm (IM13).

source_text: 建议追查除外转移
text_en: Recommend further evaluation to rule out metastasis.

source_text: 左肺下叶结节影同前，仍约5mm（IM42、44），追查
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged, still approximately 5mm on images 42 and 44, follow-up.

source_text: 左肺上叶切除术后，右肺小结节同前
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, small nodule in right lung unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段胸膜下模糊小结节同前，仍小于3mm（IM24）
text_en: Ill-defined small subpleural nodule in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe, unchanged from prior, still less than 3 mm (IM24).

source_text: 双肺胸膜下多发微结节大部分同前，约3mm（IM17、41），右肺下叶背段小结节同前，约5x4mm（IM38）
text_en: Most of the multiple subpleural micro-nodules in both lungs are stable, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM17, 41); the small nodule in the right lower lobe dorsal segment remains unchanged, measuring approximately 5x4 mm (IM38).

source_text: 纵隔、扫及胃小弯淋巴结缩小，原较大约25x20mm，现较大约17*12mm（IM33）
text_en: Lymph nodes in the mediastinum and along the lesser curvature of the stomach have decreased in size, previously measuring approximately 25x20 mm, now approximately 17x12 mm (IM33)

source_text: 右侧胸膜增厚同前，右侧叶间胸膜见小结节影，约4mm（IM41）
text_en: Right pleural thickening is unchanged. A small nodule is seen in the right interlobar pleura, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM41).

source_text: 左肺散在小结节同前（IM11、57），小于5mm
text_en: Left lung scattered small nodules unchanged from previous (IM11, 57), less than 5 mm.

source_text: 右腋下小淋巴结同前，现仍约7mm（IM21），纵隔、双肺门及锁骨上未见淋巴结肿大
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the right axilla are unchanged from prior, currently still approximately 7 mm (IM21). No lymphadenopathy in the mediastinum, bilateral hila, or supraclavicular regions.

source_text: 纵隔4R及右侧腋窝小淋巴结同前，余纵膈未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Small lymph nodes in mediastinal station 4R and right axilla are unchanged from previous; no enlarged lymph nodes seen in the remaining mediastinum.

source_text: 余双肺未新见结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidations are seen in both lungs

source_text: 左肺上叶前段磨玻璃密度结节及右肺结节同前
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the left upper lobe anterior segment and nodules in the right lung are unchanged.

source_text: 胸廓骨质及软组织未见转移征象
text_en: No metastatic findings seen in the thoracic skeleton and soft tissues.

source_text: 双肺未见新增结节灶
text_en: No new nodules are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右肺上叶尖段小结节同前，约5mm（IM8）
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent; small nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM8).

source_text: 两肺多发小结节同前
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结缩小，原较大者约10x9mm（IM31），现约6mm（IM34），余纵隔、左肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见明显肿大淋巴结
text_en: Right hilar lymph node decreased in size; the largest was previously approximately 10x9 mm (IM31), now approximately 6 mm (IM34). No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum, left hilum, supraclavicular regions, or bilateral axillae.

source_text: 左肺钙化灶、左上叶胸膜下多发肺大泡、左肺下叶支气管轻度扩张同前相仿，左肺多发不规则微小结节影部分同前如（IM32），部分缩小（如IM55）
text_en: Left lung calcifications, multiple subpleural bullae in left upper lobe, and mild bronchiectasis in left lower lobe similar to previous; multiple irregular tiny nodules in left lung, some unchanged (e.g., IM32), some decreased (e.g., IM55).

source_text: 右肺尖胸膜微小结节较前相仿，其内上方新见一结节灶，转移不除外，建议密切追查
text_en: The tiny subpleural nodule in the right lung apex is similar to prior; a new nodule is now seen superior and internal to it. Metastasis cannot be excluded; close follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜结节样增厚同前（IMA43）
text_en: The nodular thickening of the left interlobar pleura is unchanged compared to prior (IMA43).

source_text: 右侧肾上腺结节灶同前，仍约17x14mm（IM58），追查
text_en: Nodular focus in the right adrenal gland is unchanged, still measuring approximately 17x14 mm (IM58). Follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双侧胸膜轻度增厚，左侧斜裂上小结节较前饱满，原约2mm（IM43），现约4mm（IM47）
text_en: Bilateral pleural mild thickening is present. A small nodule on the left oblique fissure is more prominent compared to prior, previously about 2 mm (IM43), now about 4 mm (IM47).

source_text: 右肺上叶新见一类结节影，约5mm（IM22），边缘见小片影，性质待定，密切追查
text_en: Newly seen nodular opacity in the right upper lobe, approximately 5 mm (IM22), with a small patchy opacity at the margin; indeterminate in nature; close follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔内腔静脉后方小淋巴结同前，大小约6x5mm（IM49）
text_en: Small lymph nodes posterior to the vena cava in the mediastinum, similar to previous, size approximately 6x5 mm (IM49).

source_text: 原约13x12mm者，现约25x20mm（Im38），内可见不规则空洞
text_en: Previously measured at 13x12 mm, now measures approximately 25x20 mm (Im38), with an irregular cavity visible within.

source_text: 余肺未见新增结节及斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 双肺多发磨玻璃微结节同前，追查
text_en: Multiple ground-glass micronodules in both lungs are unchanged; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 双侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前，＜5mm（IM34、38）
text_en: Micro-nodules in the bilateral interlobar fissures are unchanged, <5 mm (IM34, 38).

source_text: 左肺局限性索条影同前，两肺内i未见明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: Localized linear opacity in the left lung unchanged from prior; no obvious new nodules or consolidations within both lungs.

source_text: 未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则结节同前相仿，较大截面约32x14mm（IM15），其内见含气透亮影
text_en: Irregular nodule in the left upper lobe is similar to prior, with largest cross-section measuring approximately 32 x 14 mm (IM15), and an air-containing lucency is seen within.

source_text: 右肺上叶模糊结节较前饱满，原约5mm（IM22），现约8mm（IM24）
text_en: The ill-defined nodule in the right upper lobe appears more prominent than prior, previously measuring approximately 5 mm (IM22), now approximately 8 mm (IM24).

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，较大约12x10mm（IM20）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are stable compared to prior, largest measuring approximately 12x10 mm (IM20)

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下微小结节影同前（4-IMA61）
text_en: Subpleural tiny nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior (4-IMA61).

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下模糊小结节同前，大小约4mm（IM27）
text_en: Indistinct small subpleural nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM27).

source_text: 右侧前胸膜小结节同前，约7mm（IM34），余双侧胸膜光滑，右侧少量胸水减少，左侧未见胸水征象
text_en: Small pleural nodule in the right side is unchanged, measuring approximately 7 mm (IM34). The remainder of the pleura is smooth bilaterally. Right-sided small pleural effusion has decreased; no pleural effusion is seen on the left.

source_text: 双肺结节部分同前，右肺上叶约5mm（IM23），部分显示欠清，如左肺下叶小结节未见明确显示
text_en: Some bilateral pulmonary nodules are stable, such as a 5 mm nodule in the right upper lobe (IM23). Some are poorly visualized, such as a small nodule in the left lower lobe not clearly seen.

source_text: 左肺门见淋巴结显示，约10x8mm（IM16），较前相仿，追查
text_en: Left hilar lymph node visible, approximately 10x8 mm (IM16), similar to previous, follow-up.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段类结节灶大小同前，建议结合临床追查
text_en: The size of the nodule-like lesion in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment is unchanged from previous; clinical correlation recommended.

source_text: 纵隔7、8组小淋巴结同前，5-8mm
text_en: Small lymph nodes at mediastinal stations 7 and 8 unchanged from prior, 5-8 mm.

source_text: 左肺下叶不规则形结节同前（IM61）
text_en: Irregular nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from prior (IM61).

source_text: 左肺下叶术后改变，胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Left lower lobe postoperative change, no new space-occupying lesions seen in the chest.

source_text: 右肺中叶三角形类结节同前，约6x4mm（IM38），原右肺下叶小结节受遮挡未见明确显示（原IM41）
text_en: Triangular-like nodule in the right middle lobe unchanged, measuring approximately 6x4 mm (IM38); the prior small nodule in the right lower lobe is obscured and not clearly visible (prior IM41)

source_text: 左肺舌叶结节大致同前
text_en: Left lung lingula: nodule essentially unchanged

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节较前略显缩小，原约6x6mm(IM54)，现约5x5mm（IM54）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is slightly smaller than prior, previously measuring approximately 6x6 mm (IM54), now about 5x5 mm (IM54).

source_text: 纵隔内少许小淋巴结同前
text_en: A few mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，双肺小结节同前
text_en: Following right upper lobectomy, small nodules in the bilateral lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 左侧胸膜结节样增厚同前，双侧胸腔未见胸水
text_en: Left pleural nodular thickening is unchanged; no pleural effusion is seen in either hemithorax

source_text: 右肺下叶背段索条、结节灶同前，倾向陈旧灶
text_en: The linear and nodular opacities in the right lower lobe dorsal segment are unchanged and likely represent chronic findings.

source_text: 左侧较大约8x6mm（IM23），病灶内可见软组织密度成分同前
text_en: The larger lesion in the left lung measures approximately 8x6 mm (IM23), and soft tissue density components within the lesion are unchanged compared to prior imaging.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，支气管断端旁软组织影较前增大，现较大层面约24*23mm（IMA33），原约8mm（Im32）
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, soft tissue density adjacent to bronchial stump increased in size compared to prior; current largest dimension approximately 24 x 23 mm (IMA33), previously approximately 8 mm (Im32).

source_text: 双肺微小结节影同前（IM12、21、36等）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary micro-nodular opacities are stable compared to prior (IM12, 21, 36, etc.).

source_text: 纵隔4R区低密度结节影同前（IMA16）
text_en: A low-density nodule in mediastinal station 4R is unchanged from prior (IMA16).

source_text: 双侧胸膜小结节同前，部分伴钙化，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: Bilateral pleural small nodules are unchanged, some with calcification. Chronic changes are considered.

source_text: 食道胸中段管壁不均匀增厚较前减轻，现较厚部位约9mm（IM30），原约14mm（IMA29），外膜模糊，同胸主动脉接触面约90度，近端食管无扩张
text_en: Wall thickening of the mid-thoracic esophagus is reduced compared to prior, with the thickest portion decreasing from approximately 14 mm (IMA29) to 9 mm (IM30). The outer membrane is blurred, the contact surface with the thoracic aorta is approximately 90 degrees, and there is no proximal esophageal dilation.

source_text: 右肺下叶后基底段小片影较前范围缩小，原约14mm，现约7mm（IM56）
text_en: The small patchy opacity in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe has decreased in extent, previously measuring approximately 14 mm, now approximately 7 mm (IM56).

source_text: 左肺下叶钙化同前（IM48），余肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Calcification in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (IM48); no new nodules or consolidations in the remaining lung.

source_text: 双肺小结节灶同前相仿（IM30、34）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodule foci are similar to prior (IM30, 34)

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节略饱满，右肺下叶小结节同前，建议追查
text_en: The small nodule in the right middle lobe appears slightly more prominent; the small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged; further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结较前相仿，约16x10mm（IM25）
text_en: The right hilar lymph node is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 16 x 10 mm (IM25).

source_text: 甲状腺左叶见低密度结节同前（IM7）
text_en: Left thyroid lobe low-density nodule stable (IM7).

source_text: 右下肺前侧胸壁胸膜增厚及胸膜下结节影同前
text_en: Right lower lung anterior lateral chest wall pleural thickening and subpleural nodular opacities unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门散在钙化小淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal and bilateral hilar scattered calcified small lymph nodes, unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺索条及斑片影同前，两肺未见新发异常结节或实变影
text_en: Linear opacities and patchy opacities in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior; no new abnormal nodules or consolidations are seen in either lung.

source_text: 食管-胃吻合术后改变，胸部未见明确复发、转移征象
text_en: Post-esophagogastrectomy changes; no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 右肺中叶混杂磨玻璃密度结节同前，边界模糊不清，范围仍约1.6x1.2cm（Im36），其内少许实性密度，其外上模糊小片影同前（IM23）
text_en: Mixed ground-glass opacity nodule in the right middle lobe unchanged, with indistinct margins, still measuring approximately 1.6 x 1.2 cm (Im36), containing a small amount of solid density; the indistinct small patchy opacity in its upper-lateral aspect unchanged (IM23)

source_text: 右肺下叶结节相仿，约5mm（IM35）
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is similar in appearance, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM35).

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下浅淡结节同前相仿（IM19），余双肺未见新发结节或斑片影
text_en: Subpleural faint nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior (IM19); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶后段微小结节较前略明显(图37)，余肺多发小结节较前略缩小
text_en: The tiny nodule in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe is slightly more prominent than before (Figure 37); the remaining multiple small nodules in the lungs are slightly smaller than prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后，支气管断端软组织略增厚表现同前（Im29），未见增大或异常强化
text_en: Status post left lower lobectomy, soft tissue thickening at the bronchial stump unchanged from prior study (Image 29), no increase or abnormal enhancement seen.

source_text: 纵隔2L、4、5、8组多发淋巴结部分缩小，原较大者约24x12mm（IM38），现约19x9mm（IM40）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal groups 2L, 4, 5, and 8 with some decreased in size, previously largest approximately 24x12mm (IM38), now approximately 19x9mm (IM40).

source_text: 前纵隔小结节灶同前
text_en: Small nodule in the anterior mediastinum is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 两肺内胸膜下散在小结节灶同前（IMA18、29、43），约3mm，余肺未见异常密度区及结节灶
text_en: Scattered subpleural small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IMA18, 29, 43), approximately 3 mm; no abnormal density areas or nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段类圆形小结节大小同前，仍约7mm（Im13），边缘清晰、光滑
text_en: Small, round nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is stable in size, still approximately 7 mm (Im13), with clear and smooth margins.

source_text: 右肺索条影同前，余双肺未见新生结节灶
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lung is stable; no new nodules are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 左肺新见微小结节，追查
text_en: New tiny nodule in left lung, follow-up recommended

source_text: 纵隔4R区淋巴结较前相仿，约10x7mm（IM17）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are similar to previous, approximately 10x7 mm (IM17).

source_text: 右肺多发小结节同前，部分位于胸膜下，较大者仍约6mm（IM44）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right lung are unchanged, with some located subpleurally; the largest remains approximately 6 mm (IM44).

source_text: 隆突下淋巴结缩小几近消失，10L组淋巴结大小相仿，仍8x6mm（IM31)
text_en: Subcarinal lymph node decreased in size nearly disappeared, station 10L lymph node size similar to previous, still 8 × 6 mm (IM31)

source_text: 纵隔2-6组及双侧锁骨上淋巴结较前缩小，较大原约18x13mm（IM25），现约10x7mm（IM23）
text_en: Mediastinal stations 2-6 and bilateral supraclavicular lymph nodes are reduced compared to previous; the larger one was previously approximately 18x13mm (IM25) and is now approximately 10x7mm (IM23).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后改变，局部未见残余及复发征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left upper lobe; no residual or recurrent findings locally.

source_text: 扫及肝硬化较前相仿，肝内见强化结节影
text_en: On scan, hepatic cirrhosis is similar to prior; intrahepatic enhancing nodules are present.

source_text: 左上肺见模糊小结节影同前，约5mm（Im18），追查
text_en: Indistinct small nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged from prior, approximately 5 mm (Im18); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Right lung small nodule shadows are unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右上纵隔气管食管沟淋巴结较前增大，原约15x13mm（Im9），现约20x17mm（IM9），考虑转移，追查
text_en: Lymph node in the right upper mediastinal tracheoesophageal groove has increased in size compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 15x13 mm (Im9), now approximately 20x17 mm (IM9); metastasis is considered, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶、中叶及左肺下叶结节数目大小同前，较大仍约6mm（IM49)
text_en: Number and size of nodules in the right upper and middle lobes and left lower lobe unchanged; largest still approximately 6 mm (IM49).

source_text: 两肺小结节影同前（IM11、14、20、25、31），较大约3mm
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior (IM11, 14, 20, 25, 31), largest approximately 3 mm

source_text: 右肺中叶及下叶两处微小结节同前，良性可能，追查
text_en: Two tiny nodules in the right middle and lower lobes are unchanged. Benign etiology is likely. Follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔3P组小淋巴结较前相仿，约10x7mm（IM9）
text_en: Small lymph node in mediastinal station 3P is similar to previous, approximately 10x7 mm (IM9).

source_text: 纵隔少许小淋巴结同前，较大约8x7mm（IM24）
text_en: Mediastinal few small lymph nodes unchanged, largest approximately 8x7mm (IM24).

source_text: 隆突下肿大淋巴结同前
text_en: Enlarged subcarinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右上肺不规则索条影较前相仿，双肺小结节较前相仿（IM37、46、48、59、60）
text_en: Irregular linear opacity in the right upper lung is similar to prior; small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior (IM37, 46, 48, 59, 60).

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门见多发轻度肿大淋巴结同前，较大仍约23x11mm（Im27）
text_en: Multiple mildly enlarged lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right hilum are unchanged from prior, with the largest still measuring approximately 23x11 mm (Im27).

source_text: 右锁骨上淋巴结增大，现约15x10mm（IM7），原为13x7mm（IM6）
text_en: Right supraclavicular lymph node enlarged, now measuring approximately 15x10 mm (IM7), previously 13x7 mm (IM6)

source_text: 两肺浅淡点状结节影同前（IMA20、24）
text_en: The faint punctate nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IMA20, 24).

source_text: 两肺斑片索条影同前，两肺微小结节影部分较前饱满（IMA21）
text_en: Patchy and linear opacities in both lungs, unchanged from prior; some of the micro-nodules in both lungs appear more prominent than before (IMA21).

source_text: 两肺小结节影较前缩小
text_en: The small nodules in both lungs are smaller than prior.

source_text: 左下叶磨玻璃密度结节同前，仍约6mm(IM34)
text_en: Ground-glass density nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged, still measuring approximately 6 mm (IM34).

source_text: 右肺斑片索条灶远侧新见分叶状软组织结节，较大层面21*15mm（IM28-34）,考虑肿瘤复发
text_en: A new lobulated soft tissue nodule is seen distal to the patchy and linear opacities in the right lung, measuring 21 x 15 mm on the largest slice (IM28-34), consistent with tumor recurrence.

source_text: 另左肺下叶前内基底段侧胸膜下不规则结节灶较前明显缩小，原约6mm（IMA39），现约4mm（IM37）
text_en: Additionally, an irregular nodular focus subpleurally in the anterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is significantly smaller than before; previously approximately 6 mm (IMA39), now approximately 4 mm (IM37).

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged from previous

source_text: 甲状腺右叶结节大致同前，平扫边界不清
text_en: Right thyroid lobe nodule stable compared to prior, with ill-defined margins on non-contrast CT.

source_text: 食管术后改变同前，胸部CT扫描未见新发占位征象
text_en: Post-esophagectomy changes unchanged, chest CT scan shows no new mass lesion signs.

source_text: 右肺上叶结节较前增大，倾向转移
text_en: The nodule in the right upper lobe has increased in size, suggestive of metastasis.

source_text: 纵隔多个小淋巴结略增大，原较大约12*9mm(图22)，现约13x10mm（IM24）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes are slightly enlarged, previously measuring approximately 12x9 mm (Figure 22), currently measuring approximately 13x10 mm (IM24).

source_text: 两肺小结节影同前，较大约5mm（IM46）
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior, largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM46)

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺结节同前（IMA66），结合腹部评价
text_en: A nodule is noted in the left adrenal gland, stable compared to prior (IMA66). Correlate with abdominal evaluation.

source_text: 左全肺切除术后、少量胸水同前，胸部CT扫描未见新生占位
text_en: Status post left pneumonectomy; small amount of pleural effusion is stable compared to prior; chest CT scan shows no new mass.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后改变，胸部未见新增占位
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left upper lobe; no new mass lesions in the chest.

source_text: 原右肺上叶、左肺斑片影基本消失，双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: The previously noted patchy opacities in the right upper lobe and left lung have essentially disappeared. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺上叶、右肺下叶微小结节同前（IMA23、47、53）
text_en: Tiny nodules in the left upper lobe and right lower lobe are stable compared to prior (IMA23, 47, 53).

source_text: 右肺尖微结节同前（IM8）
text_en: Tiny nodule in the right lung apex is stable compared to prior (IM8).

source_text: 双肺散在网格状及索条影大致同前，左肺下叶片状影较前增多，两肺未见新发结节影
text_en: Scattered reticular and linear opacities in both lungs are largely unchanged. The patchy opacity in the left lower lobe has increased in extent compared to prior. No new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影、左下肺小结节（Im35）同前
text_en: The linear opacities in the right lower lobe and the small nodule in the left lower lung (Im35) are unchanged.

source_text: 胸部CT未见新发占位
text_en: Chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R小淋巴结较前缩小，原较大约8x6mm（IM19），现约6x4mm（Im16）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R and 4R are smaller compared to prior; previously largest approximately 8x6 mm (IM19), now approximately 6x4 mm (IM16).

source_text: 右肺斑点索条结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Punctate, linear, and nodular opacities in the right lung are unchanged from prior; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右下肺软组织肿块大致同前
text_en: Soft tissue mass in the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged.

source_text: 左锁骨上小淋巴结缩小，原较大者约10x6mm（IM8），现约6mm（IM7）
text_en: Left supraclavicular small lymph node decreased in size, the largest previously measured approximately 10x6 mm (IM8), now approximately 6 mm (IM7)

source_text: 左肺下叶膨胀不良，可见斑片索条影，右肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Left lower lobe atelectasis with patchy linear opacities; right lung shows no new nodules or patchy opacities

source_text: 纵隔肺门多发淋巴结，部分较前增大
text_en: Multiple mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes, some increased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 扫及右肾上腺见一低密度结节同前，约18x13mm（IMA62），仍密度较低，考虑腺瘤
text_en: On scan, right adrenal gland shows a low-density nodule unchanged from prior, approximately 18x13 mm (IMA62), still low density, suggestive of adenoma

source_text: 双肺散在少许小结节数量及大小同前，较大者仍约7mm（IM42）
text_en: Scattered few small nodules in both lungs, number and size unchanged, largest still about 7 mm (IM42).

source_text: 纵隔多个小淋巴结大致同前，均小于10mm（IM22）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes generally unchanged from prior, all less than 10 mm (IM22)

source_text: 纵膈4R、5组及7组淋巴结同前，较大约14*10mm（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R, 5, and 7 unchanged from previous, largest approximately 14x10 mm (IM21).

source_text: 右肺索条影同前，双肺未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: Fibrotic band in the right lung is stable compared to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔11R小淋巴结大致同前，约9*8mm(图27)，余纵膈未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: The small mediastinal lymph node at station 11R is essentially unchanged, approximately 9x8 mm (Figure 27), no enlarged lymph nodes seen in the remaining mediastinum.

source_text: 转移可能大
text_en: Probable metastasis.

source_text: 纵隔2-7组淋巴结同前，较大约18x11mm（IM26）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal groups 2-7 unchanged from prior, largest approximately 18x11mm (IM26).

source_text: 扫及肝脏占位、左肾上腺结节同前，结合腹部评价
text_en: On scan, a hepatic mass and a left adrenal nodule are unchanged from prior; correlate with abdominal evaluation.

source_text: 双肺浅淡磨玻璃结节影同前（Im16、25、28）
text_en: Faint ground-glass nodules in both lungs are unchanged (Im16, 25, 28).

source_text: 右肺上叶实变影、局部胸膜增厚同前，右肺上叶斑片索条钙化及小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Consolidation and focal pleural thickening in the right upper lobe are unchanged compared to prior. Patchy linear calcifications and small nodules in the right upper lobe are also unchanged. Follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜较前增厚，约13mm（IM29），不除外转移，左侧胸膜光滑，双侧未见胸水征象
text_en: The right interlobar pleura is thicker than prior, measuring approximately 13 mm (IM29), and metastasis cannot be excluded. The left pleura is smooth. No pleural effusion is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段可见类结节样磨玻璃密度影同前，大小约7x5mm（IM40）
text_en: A nodule-like ground-glass opacity is present in the left upper lobe lingular segment, unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 7 x 5 mm (IM40).

source_text: 右上肺片絮影及模糊结节同前，较大约5mm（IM22），右肺中叶小结节（IM39）同前相仿，双肺未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: Patchy opacities and indistinct nodules in the right upper lung are unchanged; the largest is approximately 5 mm (IM22). Small nodule in the right middle lobe (IM39) is similar to prior. No new nodules or consolidations are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺尖磨玻璃密度结节同前，约3mm（IMA12）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right apex unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IMA12).

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门多发肿大淋巴结同前，大部分密度较高，部分伴钙化同前，较大仍约19x13mm（IM21）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions unchanged from previous, most with high density, part with calcification unchanged, largest still approximately 19x13 mm (IM21).

source_text: 左锁骨上区见小淋巴结同前，约8x6mm（IM5）
text_en: Left supraclavicular small lymph node unchanged from prior, approximately 8 x 6 mm (IM5)

source_text: 右肺上叶后段模糊小结节灶同前，仍约4x3mm（IM21），双肺下叶索条影及右肺下叶钙化灶同前
text_en: Indistinct small nodular focus in the right upper lobe posterior segment, unchanged, still approximately 4x3 mm (IM21). The linear opacities in both lower lobes and the calcified focus in the right lower lobe are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺中叶结节较前略增大，较大现约6x5mm（Im39），原约5x4mm（Im35），现与相邻的小斑片灶融合，追查
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe is slightly larger than before, currently measuring approximately 6 x 5 mm (Im39), previously 5 x 4 mm (Im35); it is now fused with an adjacent small patchy opacity and requires follow-up.

source_text: 右肺下叶较大结节较前缩小，原较大约15x12mm（IM55），现约10*7mm(图49)
text_en: The larger nodule in the right lower lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 15 x 12 mm (IM55), now measuring approximately 10 x 7 mm (Figure 49).

source_text: 左肺下叶胸主动脉旁微小结节同前（IM32）
text_en: Tiny nodule adjacent to the thoracic aorta in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (IM32)

source_text: 双肺散在微结节同前，较大仍约5x3mm（IM29）
text_en: Scattered micronodules in both lungs are unchanged, largest still about 5x3 mm (IM29).

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结较前略饱满，现约12*8mm(图23)，原约10*7mm(图23)
