text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph node is slightly enlarged compared to previous, currently approximately 12x8 mm (Image 23), previously approximately 10x7 mm (Image 23).

source_text: 左肺上叶索条影同前，双肺未见新发结节
text_en: Left upper lobe linear opacity unchanged, no new nodules in both lungs.

source_text: 纵隔4R组见较高密度淋巴结同前，约17x10mm（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R higher density lymph node similar to previous, approximately 17x10 mm (IM19).

source_text: 甲状腺右侧低密度结节同前
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right thyroid lobe unchanged from prior.

source_text: 胸廓骨质未见转移征象
text_en: No metastatic findings seen in the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 两肺多发小结节灶大致同前（IM10、20、23、41），较大者仍约5*4mm（IMA10）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are roughly unchanged (IM10, 20, 23, 41); the largest remains about 5x4 mm (IMA10).

source_text: 食管癌术后改变同前，随诊观察
text_en: Postoperative changes from esophageal cancer are unchanged; follow-up observation.

source_text: 右肺新见多发小结节，高度可疑肺内转移
text_en: Newly observed multiple small nodules in the right lung; highly suspicious for intrapulmonary metastases.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门多发小淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺小结节同前相仿（IM16、26），双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Small nodules in the right lung are stable (IM16, 26); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔隆突下软组织条片影形态范围同前，余纵隔及锁骨上未见明显肿大淋巴结
text_en: Soft tissue streak in subcarinal mediastinum unchanged in morphology and size from previous; no significantly enlarged lymph nodes seen in remainder of mediastinum or supraclavicular regions

source_text: 扫及胸部诸骨未见新生骨质破坏灶
text_en: CT scan shows no evidence of new bone destruction lesions in the bones of the chest.

source_text: 余双肺纹理走行顺畅，未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Lung markings in the remainder of both lungs are smooth and unremarkable with no newly increased nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 纵隔1组、5组淋巴结较前缩小，原约5mm者，现约4mm（IM11），较大原约12x9mm（IM21）者，现约7x5mm（IM23），纵隔5组淋巴结与病变食管分界较前清晰
text_en: Mediastinal group 1 and 5 lymph nodes have decreased in size compared to prior; previously approximately 5 mm, now approximately 4 mm (IM11); the larger one previously approximately 12x9 mm (IM21), now approximately 7x5 mm (IM23). The boundary between mediastinal group 5 lymph nodes and the diseased esophagus is clearer compared to prior

source_text: 右肺多发索条影同前，双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Multiple linear opacities in the right lung are stable. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前相仿，较大约14x9mm（IM17），密度较高
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior, largest approximately 14x9 mm (IM17), with increased density

source_text: 右肺下叶背段小结节同前，约5mm（IM32），伴少量索条影
text_en: Small nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM32), associated with minimal reticular opacities.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜小结节同前（IM40）
text_en: Small nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior (IM40).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段含钙化结节同前，仍约16x15mm（IMA15）
text_en: A calcified nodule in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment is stable compared to prior, still measuring approximately 16 x 15 mm (IMA15).

source_text: 纵隔散在淋巴结较前相仿，较大仍约8x7mm（IM23）
text_en: Scattered mediastinal lymph nodes similar to previous, larger one still approximately 8x7 mm (IM23).

source_text: 贴左上纵隔旁见局限增厚软组织影较前缩小，厚度原约1cm（Se6Im19），现约6mm（IM22）
text_en: A localized thickened soft tissue shadow adjacent to the left upper mediastinum has decreased in size, with thickness previously approximately 1 cm (Se6Im19) and currently approximately 6 mm (IM22).

source_text: 纵隔、肺门多发淋巴结同前，较大约35*21mm（IMA36）
text_en: Mediastinal and hilar multiple lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest approximately 35x21 mm (IMA36).

source_text: 右上肺胸膜下结节较前相仿，约10x6mm（IM17），仍见胸膜牵拉改变同前
text_en: Right upper lobe subpleural nodule similar to prior, approximately 10x6 mm (IM17), with persistent pleural retraction unchanged.

source_text: 双肺下叶见散在索条影及钙化结节同前
text_en: Scattered linear opacities and calcified nodules in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，局部未见确切复发征象
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, no definite evidence of local recurrence.

source_text: 右肺上叶多发磨玻璃密度结节影较前略增大（IMA12、18、27），原较大约7mm，现较大约8x7mm（IM12），左肺磨玻璃密度灶同前（IM18、43）
text_en: Multiple ground-glass opacity nodules in the right upper lobe are slightly larger than before (IMA12, 18, 27); previously up to approximately 7 mm, now up to approximately 8x7 mm (IM12). Ground-glass opacities in the left lung are unchanged (IM18, 43).

source_text: 食管胸下段结节同前，仍考虑平滑肌瘤可能
text_en: Nodule in the lower thoracic esophagus unchanged from previous. Leiomyoma is still considered possible.

source_text: 隆突下、食管旁等处淋巴结同前
text_en: Subcarinal, paraesophageal, and other lymph nodes similar to prior.

source_text: 纵隔4组淋巴结略增大，原约13*7mm，现约15*12mm（IM24），内见脂肪密度，术后反应性增大可能，建议随诊复查
text_en: Mediastinal group 4 lymph nodes slightly enlarged, previously approximately 13x7 mm, currently approximately 15x12 mm (IM24), fat density seen within, possible reactive enlargement post-surgery, recommend follow-up

source_text: 双肺多发小结节同前，建议复查
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右上纵隔淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Lymph nodes in the right upper mediastinum are unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺多发索条影大致同前，余双肺未见新发结节或斑片影
text_en: Multiple linear opacities in the right lung are roughly stable. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 双肺多发实性密度结节同前，较大约7x5mm（IM17），大部分边缘清楚，部分与相邻肺内血管分界不清
text_en: Multiple solid-density nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior, largest measuring approximately 7x5 mm (IM17). Most have well-defined margins, while some are indistinct from adjacent intrapulmonary vessels.

source_text: 右肺门多发肿大淋巴结部分增大，原较大约18*13mm（IM34）现28x24mm（IM36)
text_en: Some of the multiple enlarged right hilar lymph nodes have increased in size; the largest was previously approximately 18x13 mm (IM34), now 28x24 mm (IM36).

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃结节较前增大，恶性不除外
text_en: Left upper lobe ground-glass nodule increased in size compared to prior, malignancy cannot be excluded

source_text: 右下肺模糊结节较前增多
text_en: The indistinct nodules in the right lower lobe have increased in number compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺浅淡小结节影同前，较大约4mm(IM46)
text_en: Faint small nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged; the largest is approximately 4 mm (IM46).

source_text: 右肺下叶高密度结节大致同前（IM40），建议追查
text_en: High-density nodule in the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged (IM40); follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 双肺多发转移结节较前增大，原较大者约10mm，现约15mm（IM47）
text_en: Multiple metastatic nodules in both lungs have increased in size; the largest was previously about 10 mm, now measures approximately 15 mm (IM47).

source_text: 左侧甲状腺内低密度小结节影同前（IMA7）
text_en: Small low-density nodule within the left thyroid unchanged (IMA7).

source_text: 胸12椎体类圆形结节样密度增高同前，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏
text_en: T12 vertebral body round or oval nodule-like density increase unchanged, the remaining scanned bones show no evidence of bone destruction.

source_text: 右上肺少许索条影较前变淡，余双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Minimal linear opacity in the right upper lung has become fainter compared to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 双肺内未见新发结节灶
text_en: No new nodules are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺少许索条、胸膜下结节灶同前
text_en: A few linear opacities and subpleural nodules in the right lung are unchanged.

source_text: T11椎体血管瘤同前，余诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Hemangioma in the T11 vertebral body is unchanged; no osseous destruction is seen in the remainder of the bones.

source_text: 食管术后，食管-胸胃吻合口尚通畅，吻合口左侧气管后方见软组织密度肿物，范围约37x26mm（IM17），与吻合口及气管膜部无分界，考虑转移
text_en: Post-esophagectomy, the esophagogastric anastomosis remains patent; a soft tissue mass measuring approximately 37x26 mm (IM17) is present posterior to the trachea on the left side of the anastomosis, with no clear demarcation from the anastomosis and tracheal membranous portion, suspicious for metastasis.

source_text: 左肺胸膜下及叶间胸膜微小结节大致同前，不足5mm（IM14、28），余肺未见新发结节影
text_en: Left lung subpleural and interlobar pleural tiny nodules unchanged from previous, less than 5mm (IM14, 28), no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remaining left lung.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段结节同前，定期复查
text_en: The nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior. Recommend regular follow-up.

source_text: 右肺模糊小结节影同前，较大约3mm（IM38）
text_en: Faint small nodular opacity in the right lung is stable compared to prior, the largest measuring approximately 3 mm (IM38).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大者约15x7mm（Im20），部分稍高密度淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged, the largest approximately 15x7 mm (IM20), with some lymph nodes showing slightly higher density unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔4组淋巴结同前，较大约10x10mm（IM23）
text_en: Mediastinal group 4 lymph nodes same as before, largest approximately 10x10 mm (IM23)

source_text: 右肺门及纵隔2-7组多发肿大淋巴结同前相仿，较大仍约28x12mm（IM28）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes at the right hilum and mediastinal stations 2-7 are similar to prior, the largest still measures approximately 28x12 mm (IM28)

source_text: 甲状腺左叶低密度结节同前（IM8）
text_en: Left thyroid lobe low-density nodule stable compared to prior (Image 8).

source_text: 纵隔4R及右肺门淋巴结同前，较大仍约12x11mm（IM11）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal station 4R and right hilar region are unchanged from previous, still approximately 12x11 mm (IM11).

source_text: 双肺结节同前相仿，右下肺门团块灶同前，约34x22mm（IM38），远端气管血管束增粗大致同前，病灶边缘多发斑片索条影大致同前
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary nodules are similar to prior. The lobulated mass at the right lower hilum is stable, measuring approximately 34x22 mm (IM38). Peribronchovascular thickening distally is stable. Multiple patchy and linear opacities at the margin of the lesion are stable.

source_text: 胸8、12椎体局限性硬化结节灶同前
text_en: Localized sclerotic nodule in T8 and T12 vertebrae, unchanged from previous.

source_text: 未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: No definite signs of recurrence or metastasis

source_text: 余双肺多发模糊小结节同前，较大仍约5mm（IM25）
text_en: Multiple indistinct small nodules in the remainder of both lungs are unchanged; the largest remains approximately 5 mm (IM25).

source_text: 双肺多发结节，较前增大、密度增高，现较大者如左肺上叶结节，现约12x10mm（IM23），原约9x5mm（IM25）
text_en: Multiple nodules in both lungs have increased in size and density; the largest is now in the left upper lobe, measuring approximately 12x10 mm (IM23), previously about 9x5 mm (IM25).

source_text: 左肺门肿块较前增大，累及左肺动脉，整体大小现约44x38mm（IM22），原约25x22mm（IMA25）
text_en: Left hilar mass increased compared to previous, involving left pulmonary artery, current size approximately 44x38 mm (IM22), previously approximately 25x22 mm (IMA25).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变同前，右肺下叶背段结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lobe are unchanged. The nodule in the dorsal segment of the right lower lobe is stable. Follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔7组及左侧锁骨上淋巴结缩小，现约10x6mm者(IM30)，原约10x8mm（IM29）
text_en: Lymph nodes at mediastinal station 7 and left supraclavicular decreased in size, now approximately 10x6 mm (IM30), previously approximately 10x8 mm (IM29).

source_text: 右肺下叶前基底段结节较前相仿，约7x5mm（IM52）
text_en: Nodule in the anterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 7 × 5 mm (IM52).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，建议继续随访复查
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is similar to the prior study; continued follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 双下肺散在小结节数目同前，部分结节较前稍增大，如左下肺较大结节原约13x9mm，现约13x11mm（IM46）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the bilateral lower lungs are unchanged in number; some are slightly larger than prior. The larger nodule in the left lower lung previously measured approximately 13x9 mm and now measures approximately 13x11 mm (IM46).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，两上肺可见多个浅淡磨玻璃模糊小结节及微小结节灶大致同前（IMA20、25、27、33、555），右肺上叶后段较大者仍约6mm（IMA25）
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, multiple faint ground-glass indistinct small nodules and micronodules in the upper lungs largely unchanged (IMA20, 25, 27, 33, 555), the largest in the right upper lobe posterior segment still approximately 6 mm (IMA25).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见软组织密度影增厚影，右肺索条及点状结节影同前（IMA27）
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no soft tissue density or thickening is seen at the bronchial stump. Linear opacities and punctate nodular opacities in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior (IMA27).

source_text: 纵隔多个小淋巴结大致同前，现较大约12x6mm（IM20）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes are essentially unchanged from previous, with the largest currently measuring approximately 12x6 mm (IM20).

source_text: 前纵隔胸腺区密度稍高较前相仿，其内小结节大小同前（Im21、28）
text_en: Slightly increased density in the thymic region of the anterior mediastinum is similar to prior, with the internal small nodule unchanged in size (Im21, 28).

source_text: 纵隔内多发小淋巴结同前，较大约9mm（IM13）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes, stable compared to prior. Largest approximately 9 mm (IM13).

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右肺下叶背段磨玻璃结节同前相仿，约8mm（IM31），边缘模糊，追查
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent; ground-glass nodule in the dorsal segment of the right lower lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 8 mm (IM31), with blurred margins; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双肺散在小结节及微小结节同前（IM15、19、28、35、41、51等），类圆形，边界清晰，较大者位于右肺上叶尖段（IM19）
text_en: Scattered small nodules and tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM15, 19, 28, 35, 41, 51, etc.), round in shape with well-defined margins. The largest is located in the apical segment of the right upper lobe (IM19).

source_text: 左侧第4侧肋内见结节状高密度灶同前（IM20），余扫及胸廓诸骨未见破坏征象
text_en: Nodular high-density focus within the left 4th lateral rib unchanged (IM20); no destruction seen in the remainder of the visualized bones.

source_text: 右肺散在小结节影较前相仿，较大仍约5mm（IMA48）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right lung are similar to prior, the largest still measuring approximately 5 mm (IMA48).

source_text: 双肺胸膜下多发微小结节同前，倾向良性，定期复查
text_en: Multiple subpleural micronodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior, likely benign; regular follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段支气管闭塞，局部可见不规则软组织肿物较前范围缩小，原约76*59mm，现约62x59mm(图32)，其内坏死物部分排出，可见不规则空洞，远端肺不张及片絮影较前缩小
text_en: Bronchial occlusion in the left lower lobe dorsal segment with a local irregular soft tissue mass decreased in size compared to previous (previously approximately 76x59 mm, now approximately 62x59 mm; Fig. 32), with partial evacuation of necrotic material and an irregular cavity visible; distal atelectasis and patchy opacities have also decreased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结大致同前（IM25）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes essentially unchanged from previous (IM25)

source_text: 食管癌术后，吻合口位于下胸部，吻合口未见明显增厚同前（IM36）
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer, anastomosis located in the lower chest, anastomotic wall without significant thickening, stable compared to prior (IM36).

source_text: 纵隔10R淋巴结同前，仍约17x11mm(IM31)
text_en: Right paratracheal (10R) mediastinal lymph node unchanged from prior, still measuring approximately 17x11 mm (IM31)

source_text: 扫及甲状腺右叶结节伴钙化同前
text_en: Imaging shows a nodule with calcification in the right lobe of the thyroid, unchanged.

source_text: 右肺内微小结节、点状钙化及索条影同前（IMA16、21），双肺内未见新发结节灶
text_en: Micro-nodules, punctate calcifications, and linear opacities in the right lung are stable compared to prior (IMA16, 21); no new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶新发多发实性微小结节，较大者约3mm，沿支气管血管束走行分布
text_en: New multiple small solid nodules in the left lower lobe, largest approximately 3mm, distributed along bronchovascular bundles.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃样结节大致同前，约20*18mm(图17)
text_en: Left upper lobe ground-glass nodule largely unchanged, approximately 20x18 mm (Fig. 17)

source_text: 左上胸膜结节样增厚较前同前，现约18x10mm（IM7），邻近肺内见少许类结节影（IM7-10）
text_en: Nodular pleural thickening in the left upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, currently measuring approximately 18x10 mm (IM7); a few small nodular opacities are seen in the adjacent lung parenchyma (IM7-10).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段结节较前相仿，考虑周围型腺癌可能大
text_en: The nodule in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe is similar to prior; peripheral adenocarcinoma is highly likely.

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节缩小，原约13x10mm(IM26)，现约9x7mm（IM27）
text_en: Right upper lobe small nodule decreased in size, previously approximately 13x10 mm (IM26), now approximately 9x7 mm (IM27)

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜下见小结节约3mm，同前（IM32）
text_en: A small subpleural nodule measuring approximately 3 mm is seen in the left interlobar pleura, stable compared to prior (IM32).

source_text: 右肺散在小结节大部分同前，如右肺上叶者，较大仍约4mm（IM19）
text_en: Most scattered small nodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior, such as the one in the right upper lobe, the largest remaining approximately 4 mm (IM19).

source_text: 左肺门淋巴结现约19mm（IMA34），原约12mm（IM32），倾向转移可能大，结合临床密切观察
text_en: Left hilar lymph node increased from approximately 12 mm (IM32) to 19 mm (IMA34), metastasis favored; close clinical observation is recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶模糊磨玻璃密度结节大致同前，约19x11mm（IM19）
text_en: Indistinct ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe, approximately stable, measuring approximately 19 x 11 mm (IM19).

source_text: 右肺上叶楔状切除+右肺下叶楔状切除术后改变，术区金属缝线周围片絮影范围较前缩小，右肺内未见新发结节灶
text_en: Status post wedge resection of the right upper lobe and right lower lobe. The patchy opacities surrounding the metallic suture material in the surgical bed have decreased in extent compared to prior. No new nodules are seen in the right lung.

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则形结节影、周围斑片索条小结节影同前
text_en: Irregular nodular opacity in the left upper lobe and surrounding small patchy, linear, and nodular opacities are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 双侧胸膜多发结节伴钙化、左肺下叶钙化灶同前
text_en: Bilateral pleural multiple nodules with calcification and left lower lobe calcification are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 余双肺清晰，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs is clear with no newly increased nodular foci or patchy opacities.

source_text: 左肺下叶内侧基底段浅淡模糊小结节同前，仍约2mm（Im46）
text_en: Left lower lobe medial basal segment faint indistinct small nodule stable compared to previous, still approximately 2mm (Image 46)

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，右上纵隔小淋巴结同前
text_en: Following right upper lobectomy, a small lymph node in the right superior mediastinum is unchanged.

source_text: 左肺小结节（IM19、22）部分同前、部分稍缩小，原约5mm，现约3mm（IM38）
text_en: Left lung small nodule (IM19, 22) partially stable, partially slightly decreased (from approximately 5mm to approximately 3mm on IM38)

source_text: 余双肺微结节大致同前，追查
text_en: Residual multiple micronodules in both lungs are approximately unchanged; follow-up recommended

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃密度结节大致同前大，现约37*34mm（IM16）
text_en: Ground-glass density nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is essentially unchanged in size, currently approximately 37 × 34 mm (IM16).

source_text: 隆突下淋巴结原约22*12mm者，现约15X10mm（IM24）
text_en: Subcarinal lymph node previously approximately 22 × 12 mm, now approximately 15 × 10 mm (IM24)

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节同前，右肺多发微结节同前
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged; multiple micronodules in the right lung are also unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节同前，约2mm（IM17），追查
text_en: The small nodule in the right upper lobe is stable, measuring approximately 2 mm (IM17); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节较前略缩小，密度减低，现8*6mm(图16)，原约12*8mm（IMA18）
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule slightly decreased in size compared to previous, decreased density, currently 8x6mm (Figure 16), previously approximately 12x8mm (IMA18).

source_text: 右侧胸膜结节样略厚同前
text_en: The slightly thickened nodular right pleura is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺术后，支气管断端平扫未见明显异常软组织密度肿块影，左肺下叶条片影同前（IMA35），左膈抬高同前，左侧未见胸水征象
text_en: Post left lung surgery, non-contrast imaging of the bronchial stump shows no obvious abnormal soft tissue density mass; left lower lobe linear and patchy opacities stable compared to prior (IMA35); left diaphragmatic elevation stable; no left pleural effusion.

source_text: 右肺中叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见明显肿块影，右肺斑片索条影较前增多，左肺下叶索条影同前，两肺小结节影同前（IMA25、27、33、36），较大约5mm
text_en: Status post right middle lobectomy; no obvious mass is seen at the bronchial stump on non-contrast imaging. Patchy and linear opacities in the right lung are increased compared to prior. Linear opacities in the left lower lobe are stable. Small nodules in both lungs are stable (IMA25, 27, 33, 36), largest measuring approximately 5 mm.

source_text: 扫及诸骨未见明确骨质破坏灶
text_en: CT shows no definite bone destruction lesions in the bones examined.

source_text: 左肺上叶占位较前明显增大
text_en: A mass in the left upper lobe is significantly increased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 右水平裂胸膜下结节同前，较大约14x9mm（IM30）
text_en: Subpleural nodule along the right horizontal fissure unchanged, largest measuring approximately 14x9 mm (IM30).

source_text: 纵隔2、4、5、7组及右肺门多发淋巴结部分缩小，多数密度较高，部分见钙化灶，较大原约16x13mm，现约16x9mm（IM26）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal groups 2, 4, 5, 7 and right hilum are partially reduced in size; most have higher density, and some show calcified foci. The largest was previously approximately 16x13mm and is now approximately 16x9mm (IM26)

source_text: 双肺纹理增重，右肺上叶后段数枚磨玻璃密度小结节同前，较大约6mm（IM26）
text_en: Increased lung markings. Several ground-glass opacity small nodules in the right upper lobe are similar to prior. The largest is about 6 mm (IM26).

source_text: 右肺中叶肿物同前，仍约21x17mm（IM31），右肺膨胀不全、双下肺索条影同前
text_en: The lesion in the right middle lobe is unchanged, still measuring approximately 21 x 17 mm (IM31); right lung volume loss and reticular opacities in both lower lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双腋区小淋巴结，较前缩小
text_en: Small lymph nodes in bilateral axillary regions, smaller than prior.

source_text: 上叶邻近右水平裂膜见一小结节影同前（IM33），约3mm
text_en: Small nodule adjacent to the right horizontal fissure in the upper lobe unchanged (IM33), approximately 3 mm

source_text: 右肺术后，支气管断端未见异常软组织密度，两肺未见新增结节及斑片
text_en: Post right lung surgery, no abnormal soft tissue density at the bronchial stump; no new nodules or patchy opacities in both lungs.

source_text: 纵隔散在高密度小淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal scattered small high-density lymph nodes unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶磨玻璃密度灶较前缩小，邻近结节同前
text_en: Ground-glass opacity focus in the right lower lobe is slightly smaller than prior; adjacent nodules are unchanged

source_text: 双肺少许微小结节影同前(IM27、30、32等)
text_en: Few tiny nodular opacities in both lungs are stable (IM27, 30, 32, etc.).

source_text: 双肺微结节同前（IM26、27、45），余肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary micro-nodules are stable compared to prior (IM26, 27, 45); no new nodules or consolidations in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔5组淋巴结同前，较大仍约15x10mm（IM29）
text_en: Mediastinal group 5 lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest still approximately 15x10 mm (Image 29)

source_text: 上腔静脉旁不规则软组织灶较前增大，原约27x13mm（IM19），现约29x16mm（IM20），右侧胸膜增厚同前，局部软组织结节较前缩小，原约14x8mm（IM30），现约13x6mm（IM30）
text_en: Irregular soft tissue focus adjacent to the superior vena cava increased in size, previously approximately 27x13 mm (IM19), now approximately 29x16 mm (IM20); right pleural thickening unchanged; local soft tissue nodule decreased in size, previously approximately 14x8 mm (IM30), now approximately 13x6 mm (IM30)

source_text: 双肺多发结节部分被掩盖，部分同前
text_en: Some of the multiple nodules in both lungs are obscured; others are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶磨玻璃密度结节同前，需密切追查
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior; close follow-up is required.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段软组织密度占位较前缩小，原约36x30mm，现约28x21mm（Im14），边缘多发毛刺
text_en: The soft tissue density mass in the apical segment of the right upper lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 36x30 mm, now approximately 28x21 mm (Im14), with multiple spiculations at the margin.

source_text: 左侧气管旁淋巴结同前，约11x8mm（IMA10），观察
text_en: The left paratracheal lymph node is unchanged, measuring approximately 11x8 mm (IMA10); continue observation.

source_text: 扫及肝脏占位大致同前，结合腹部检查
text_en: On scan, a hepatic mass is largely unchanged from prior; correlate with abdominal examination.

source_text: 右侧胸膜结节及双下肺结节较前相仿
text_en: The right pleural nodule and bilateral lower lung nodules are similar to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则形粗条状及结节状病变较前发展，范围增大，内部及周围新增多发斑点、片絮及不规则结节灶，内部见支气管扩张及少量点状钙化，原病灶内部结节表现出硬化改变，考虑结核
text_en: Irregular coarse linear and nodular lesion in the left upper lobe has progressed compared to prior, with increased extent; multiple new punctate, patchy, and irregular nodular opacities are seen within and around the lesion. Internal bronchiectasis and a small amount of punctate calcification are present. The internal nodule within the original lesion shows sclerotic change. Tuberculosis is considered.

source_text: 左肺下叶模糊结节大致同前
text_en: Left lower lobe hazy nodule essentially unchanged

source_text: 胸腰椎多发骨转移灶大致同前
text_en: Multiple bone metastases in the thoracolumbar spine largely unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段小结节同前，约2mm（IM27），邻近胸膜增厚
text_en: Small nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 2 mm (IM27), with adjacent pleural thickening.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下浅淡模糊小结节同前（IM48）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural faint hazy small nodule unchanged from previous (IM48).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段少许索条影同前，双肺气肿同前，双肺未见新生结节或片絮状病灶
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable; bilateral pulmonary emphysema, stable; no new nodules or patchy opacities in both lungs

source_text: 左肺下叶斑片索条及小结节影同前
text_en: Patchy linear opacities and small nodules in the left lower lobe are unchanged from previous.

source_text: 纵隔及膈上多发淋巴结缩小，原约22x13mm者现约15x6mm（IM23）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal and supra-diaphragmatic lymph nodes decreased in size; the one previously approximately 22x13 mm is now approximately 15x6 mm (IM23).

source_text: 余双肺散在磨玻璃密度结节及小片影同前，未见明确实性结节灶
text_en: Residual scattered ground-glass opacity nodules and small patchy opacities in both lungs are unchanged; no definite solid nodules are seen

source_text: 右肺下叶磨玻璃密度小结节同前（IM29），直径约3mm
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM29), measuring approximately 3 mm in diameter

source_text: 右肺上叶前段胸膜下实性-磨玻璃密度结节较前略增大，现约10x6mm（IM28），原为9x5mm（IM26），形态不规则、边缘模糊、局部与侧胸膜粘连同前
text_en: The subpleural solid–ground-glass density nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe has slightly increased in size, now measuring approximately 10x6 mm (IM28), previously 9x5 mm (IM26); the irregular shape, blurred margins, and local pleural adhesion remain unchanged.

source_text: 吻合口右侧旁淋巴结较前缩小，原约12x9mm（IM10），现约9x6mm（IM9），密度增高
text_en: Lymph node adjacent to the right side of the anastomosis decreased in size compared to prior (previously approximately 12x9 mm, IM10; currently approximately 9x6 mm, IM9), with increased density

source_text: 纵隔内及左侧锁骨上区淋巴结较前缩小
text_en: Lymph nodes within the mediastinum and left supraclavicular region are smaller compared to previous.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区小淋巴结较前相仿，约为4mm（IM 6）
text_en: Small lymph node in the left supraclavicular region is similar to prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM 6).

source_text: 右肺上叶类结节影同前（IM10）
text_en: Nodule-like opacity in the right upper lobe unchanged from prior (IM10).

source_text: 新增多发肿大淋巴结
text_en: newly identified multiple enlarged lymph nodes

source_text: 左侧胸膜增厚同前，右侧斜裂胸膜结节样增厚同前（IM30、36）
text_en: Left pleural thickening is stable compared to prior; nodular thickening of the right oblique fissure pleura is stable compared to prior (IM30, 36).

source_text: 下纵隔食管旁、上腹部胃左动脉旁多发肿大淋巴结较前增大，现较大约19*16mm(图57)，原约16x11mm（IMA58）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the lower mediastinal paraesophageal and upper abdominal left gastric artery regions increased in size compared to prior; currently largest approximately 19x16 mm (Figure 57), previously approximately 16x11 mm (IMA58)

source_text: 前纵隔胸腺区密度偏高，其内小结节同前（Im27）
text_en: Increased density in the thymic region of the anterior mediastinum, with a small nodule within it unchanged from prior (Im27).

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影同前，左侧叶间胸膜旁小结节同前，约为5mm（IM39）
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged; a small nodule adjacent to the left interlobar pleura is unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM39).

source_text: 右肺上叶小斑片结节影同前（IMA8、25），双肺索条影同前，两肺未见新增结节及实变影
text_en: Small patchy nodular opacities in the right upper lobe are unchanged (IMA8, 25). Linear bands in both lungs are unchanged. No new nodules or consolidations are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左乳内上象限一枚小结节同前，约7mm（Im25）
text_en: A small nodule in the upper inner quadrant of the left breast is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 7 mm (Im25).

source_text: 转移灶
text_en: Metastatic lesion.

source_text: 右肺多发结节较前增大，原较大於上叶前段，约22*15mm（IM20)，现约26*22mm(图20）周围不规则索条影较前模糊
text_en: Multiple nodules in the right lung are larger than before; the largest previously in the anterior segment of the upper lobe measured approximately 22 x 15 mm (IM20), now measures approximately 26 x 22 mm (Figure 20); surrounding irregular linear opacities are less distinct than before.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，仍约5mm（IM52）
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from prior, still approximately 5 mm (IM52).

source_text: 纵隔4、5、7组多发淋巴结同前，较大约21*6mm(图29)
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4, 5, and 7 are unchanged from previous, with the largest approximately 21x6 mm (Image 29).

source_text: 食道胸中段管壁局限性增厚较前稍减轻，较大外径现约30*15mm(IM42)，原约30x18mm（IM39），与胸主动脉接触面＜90°
text_en: Focal thickening of the mid-thoracic esophageal wall, slightly reduced compared to previous; larger outer diameter now approximately 30*15 mm (IM42), previously approximately 30x18 mm (IM39); contact surface with thoracic aorta less than 90 degrees.

source_text: 部分同前，如斜裂胸膜结节较大仍约3mm（IM35）
text_en: Some similar to prior, such as the larger pleural nodule along the oblique fissure still approximately 3 mm (image 35).

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺低密度结节同前（IM56），性质待定，请结合腹部检查
text_en: A low-density nodule in the left adrenal gland is unchanged from prior (Im56), nature indeterminate; correlation with abdominal examination is recommended.

source_text: 左侧肋骨术后改变，右侧第10后肋局限性高密度灶同前，余扫及胸部诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left ribs; focal hyperdensity in the right tenth posterior rib, unchanged from prior; no evidence of osseous destruction in the remainder of the visualized thoracic bones.

source_text: 左肺少许索条影同前相仿，余双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Left lung slight linear shadows stable, remaining lungs no new nodules or patchy opacities seen

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段实变影、局部胸膜增厚同前，右肺上叶斑片索条钙化及小结节影同前，较大约10x6mm（IM13）
text_en: Consolidation and localized pleural thickening in the apical segment of the right upper lobe are unchanged; patchy linear calcifications and small nodules in the right upper lobe are unchanged, largest approximately 10 × 6 mm (IM13).

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右肺尖少许索条斑片灶，右肺结节基本同前（IM17、18、24、34），左肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. Minor linear and patchy opacities are seen at the right lung apex. The right lung nodules are essentially unchanged (IM17, 18, 24, 34). No nodules or consolidation are seen in the left lung.

source_text: 左下叶见实性小结节同前，直径6mm（IM41），边界清楚，右肺上叶后段实性小结节同前，约4mm（IM29）
text_en: Small solid nodule in the left lower lobe is stable, measuring 6 mm in diameter (IM41), with well-defined margins. Small solid nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is stable, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM29).

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前（IM53、56），较大约4mm（IM56），内小空洞
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from prior (IM53, 56), larger dimension approximately 4 mm (IM56), with a small cavity.

source_text: 新见3mm大小结节
text_en: Newly seen 3mm nodule

source_text: 右锁骨上淋巴结较前略增大，原约9x7mm（IM7），现约12x9mm（IM5）
text_en: Right supraclavicular lymph node is slightly larger than prior, previously approximately 9x7 mm (IM7), now approximately 12x9 mm (IM5)

source_text: 双肺多发磨玻璃密度结节及小结节同前，密切随诊观察
text_en: Multiple ground-glass density nodules and small nodules in both lungs are unchanged; close follow-up observation recommended.

source_text: 甲状腺双侧叶结节同前
text_en: Nodule in bilateral thyroid lobes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶癌及右肺门淋巴结转移，均较前增大
text_en: Right upper lobe carcinoma and right hilar lymph node metastasis, both increased in size compared to prior

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结大致同前，约12x8mm（IMA23）
text_en: Mediastinal 4R lymph node stable, measuring approximately 12x8 mm (IMA23)

source_text: 双肺外带为主分布多发纯GGO灶同前相仿，稳定存在，较大约5mm（薄层169），双肺多发小实性结节同前
text_en: Multiple pure ground-glass opacities (GGOs) predominantly in the peripheral lung zones are stable compared to prior, persisting without change, largest measuring approximately 5 mm (thin-slice 169). Multiple small solid nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段胸膜下微结节同前，大小仍约3mm（IM42）
text_en: The subpleural tiny nodule in the left lower lobe basal segment remains unchanged, size still approximately 3 mm (IM42).

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结大致同前，约17x14mm（Im20）
text_en: Mediastinal 4R lymph node stable, measuring approximately 17x14 mm (Im20)

source_text: 双肺小结节显示较前清楚，大小同前（IM12、22、29）均小于10mm
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are more clearly visualized compared to prior, size stable (IM12, 22, 29), all less than 10 mm

source_text: 两肺微小结节同前（IM22），未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: The tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM22); no new nodules or consolidations are seen.

source_text: 右肺中心型肺癌，伴右侧中等量胸水，伴纵隔及锁骨上淋巴结转移，大致同前
text_en: Central lung cancer in the right lung, with moderate right-sided pleural effusion and metastatic lymphadenopathy in the mediastinum and supraclavicular region, findings are largely unchanged.

source_text: 左肺脊柱旁新见微小结节，约2mm（IM29）
text_en: A new tiny nodule adjacent to the spine in the left lung, approximately 2 mm (IM29)

source_text: 右肺上叶心缘旁结节较前增大，现约7mm(图25)，原约4mm(图23)，考虑转移可能大
text_en: Nodule adjacent to the cardiac border in the right upper lobe has increased in size, now approximately 7 mm (Figure 25), previously about 4 mm (Figure 23); metastasis is highly likely.

source_text: 平扫纵隔7组淋巴结较前缩小，现约11x6mm（IMA24），原约12*8mm（IM23）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes decreased in size compared to prior, now measuring approximately 11x6 mm on image A24, previously approximately 12x8 mm on image 23.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段及前段磨玻璃密度结节大致同前，边缘模糊，分别约8x7mm、4x3mm（IM10、22）
text_en: Ground-glass density nodules in the right upper lobe apical and anterior segments essentially unchanged, margins blurred, measuring approximately 8x7 mm and 4x3 mm respectively (IM10, 22)

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜小结节影同前，约4mm（IMA33），左侧胸膜稍增厚同前，双侧胸腔未见积液
text_en: Small nodular opacity of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (IMA33). Left pleural slight thickening is unchanged from prior. No pleural effusion is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 纵隔肿物术后，局部软组织灶较前缩小，追查
text_en: Postoperative for mediastinal mass, local soft tissue focus reduced in size compared to previous, follow-up.

source_text: 甲状腺双叶多发低密度结节大致同前
text_en: Multiple low-density nodules in bilateral thyroid lobes essentially unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右腋下淋巴结较前略增大，原约5x4mm，现约7x4mm（Im20）
text_en: Right axillary lymph node slightly increased in size compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 5x4 mm, now measuring approximately 7x4 mm (Im20).

source_text: 余肺未见新发结节及异常密度区
text_en: No new nodules or abnormal density areas are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 10R淋巴结较前相仿，约13x12mm（IM24）
text_en: 10R lymph node is similar to prior, measuring approximately 13x12 mm (IM24).

source_text: 纵隔及左肺门多发淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Multiple mediastinal and left hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous, follow-up

source_text: 纵隔、双侧锁骨上区及右膈上小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the mediastinum, bilateral supraclavicular regions, and right supradiaphragmatic region are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔4、5组少许小淋巴结同前，较大约9mm（IM17）
text_en: A few small lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 4 and 5 are stable compared to prior. The largest measures approximately 9 mm (Image 17).

source_text: 新见骨质破坏
text_en: newly identified bone destruction

source_text: 右肺尖磨玻璃密度小结节同前，约6mm（Im12）
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right apex unchanged, approximately 6 mm (Im12).

source_text: 双肺未见明确新发结节
text_en: No definite new nodules are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔多发肿大淋巴结较前增大，较大原约24x16mm（IM24），现约32x25mm（IM24）
text_en: Multiple enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes increased compared to prior; largest previously approximately 24x16 mm (IM24), now approximately 32x25 mm (IM24).

source_text: 纵隔4R、7、9组较高密度淋巴结大致同前，较大约15x9mm（IM26）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes with higher density at stations 4R, 7, and 9 are roughly similar to prior, with the largest approximately 15x9mm (IM26).

source_text: 右肺上叶微结节同前（IM21），双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Right upper lobe micro-nodule unchanged (IM21); no new nodules or patchy opacities in both lungs.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜及纵隔胸膜多发结节状增厚部分较前稍大，如原约4mm（IM26）者，现约6mm（IM26）
text_en: Some of the multiple nodular thickenings of the right interlobar pleura and mediastinal pleura are slightly larger than prior, such as one increasing from approximately 4 mm (IM26) to approximately 6 mm (IM26).

source_text: L及6组淋巴结增大，如较大现约18*15mm（IM22），倾向转移，追查
text_en: Enlarged lymph nodes in station L and 6, with the largest currently measuring approximately 18x15 mm (IM22), favoring metastasis; further investigation recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节相仿
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is similar to prior.

source_text: 左肺舌叶上舌段模糊小结节灶同前，仍约5mm（IM32）
text_en: The indistinct small nodule in the superior lingular segment of the left lung is unchanged, still approximately 5 mm (IM32)

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，倾向良性，随访
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from prior, likely benign, follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结较前相仿，现约16*8mm（IM25）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are similar to previous, currently approximately 16x8 mm (IM25).

source_text: 右锁骨上区显示欠清，可疑缩小，原约12x10mm（IM7），现约11x9mm（IM8），追查
text_en: Right supraclavicular region is poorly defined, possibly decreased in size; previously measured 12x10 mm (IM7), now approximately 11x9 mm (IM8); recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段脊柱旁磨玻璃密度灶较前增大，原约21x15mm，现约24x17mm（IM21），内部密度同前，建议密切追查以除外恶性占位
text_en: Paravertebral ground-glass density focus in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe has increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 21x15 mm, now approximately 24x17 mm (IM21); internal density is stable; close follow-up recommended to exclude malignant neoplasm

source_text: 右肺上叶模糊小结节同前，左肺下叶小结节
text_en: Indistinct small nodule in the right upper lobe, stable compared to prior. Small nodule in the left lower lobe.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，双肺散在索条结节，右上肺为著，部分伴钙化同前
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent; scattered linear and nodular opacities in both lungs, more prominent in the right upper lobe, some with calcification, are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 两肺门淋巴结大致同前，右肺门较大者原约16*13mm（IMA24），现约15*14mm（IMA25）
text_en: Hilar lymph nodes in both lungs are stable; the largest on the right side previously measured approximately 16x13 mm (IMA24), now measures approximately 15x14 mm (IMA25).

source_text: 右肺下叶小模糊结节（IM51）及钙化灶同前，双肺尖少许微小结节同前
text_en: Small indistinct nodule (IM51) and calcified focus in the right lower lobe are unchanged; a few tiny nodules in both lung apices are unchanged.

source_text: 左侧气管旁淋巴结同前，约12x8mm（IMA9），观察
text_en: The left paratracheal lymph node is unchanged, measuring approximately 12x8 mm (IMA9); continue observation.

source_text: 右上肺新发微结节（IM30），追查
text_en: New micro-nodule in the right upper lung (IM30); further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶肿块较前缩小，边缘仍可见毛刺及分叶，邻近胸膜牵拉同前，不均匀强化同前相仿，原约34x28mm（IM17），现约30x25mm（IM19）
text_en: The mass in the right upper lobe has decreased in size compared to prior imaging. Marginal spiculation and lobulation remain visible, and adjacent pleural retraction is unchanged. Heterogeneous enhancement is similar to prior studies; previously measuring approximately 34x28 mm (IM17), it now measures about 30x25 mm (IM19).

source_text: 两肺结节较前增大增多，较大约19x17mm（IM49）
text_en: Nodules in both lungs are increased in size and number compared to prior, the largest measuring approximately 19x17 mm (IM49).

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影同前，双肺未见新生结节或实变影，双肺文理走形结构正常
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged; no new nodules or consolidation are seen in either lung; pulmonary vascular markings appear normal in course and structure.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，左肺上叶见多发钙化灶，左下叶见索条影，右下叶见钙化灶，左肺上叶不规则磨玻璃密度结节同前，约7mm（IM19）
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Multiple calcified foci are seen in the left upper lobe. A linear opacity is present in the left lower lobe, and a calcified focus is seen in the right lower lobe. An irregular ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe remains stable, measuring approximately 7 mm (IM19).

source_text: 纵隔内多发小淋巴结同前，心包上隐窝少量液性密度同前（Im30）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes, stable compared to prior. Small amount of fluid density in the superior pericardial recess, stable compared to prior (Im30).

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后，肺间质性病变同前，胸部CT平扫未见占位征象
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, interstitial lung disease unchanged, non-contrast chest CT shows no mass lesion.

source_text: 右上纵隔内圆形淋巴结同前，较大者约9mm（Im12）
text_en: Round lymph nodes in the right upper mediastinum are unchanged from prior; the largest measures approximately 9 mm (Im12).

source_text: 纵隔2R、3P、4R及左侧锁骨上多发肿大淋巴结同前相仿，较大约12x10mm（IM7、19）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R, 3P, 4R, and left supraclavicular region similar to previous, largest approximately 12x10 mm (IM7, 19).

source_text: 纵隔内数枚小淋巴结同前相仿
text_en: Several small mediastinal lymph nodes similar to prior

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度影（IM20）、钙化结节及索条影同前
text_en: Ground-glass opacity (IM20), calcified nodule, and linear bands in the right upper lobe are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶钙化灶及两肺内局限性索条影大致同前，双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Calcified focus in the left lower lobe and focal linear opacities in both lungs essentially unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶结节同前，倾向良性，追查
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged and favored as benign; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段3mm小结节同前（IM14）
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment 3 mm small nodule unchanged (IM14).

source_text: 双肺未见新增灶
text_en: No new foci seen in both lungs.

source_text: 其余双肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前缩小，左肺门淋巴结因平扫无法评价
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are reduced in size compared to previous; left hilar lymph nodes cannot be evaluated due to non-contrast scan.

source_text: 右肺下叶斑点灶及结节、片絮灶大致同前，追查
text_en: Patchy opacities, nodules, and flecks in the right lower lobe are largely unchanged from prior, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 食管裂孔处及残胃周数枚淋巴结缩小，较大原约15x10mm（IM45），现约11x8mm（IM45），追查
text_en: Several lymph nodes at the esophageal hiatus and around the residual stomach decreased in size, largest previously approximately 15x10 mm (IM45), currently approximately 11x8 mm (IM45), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶索条影，余肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Left lower lobe linear opacity; no new nodules or consolidations seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下小磨玻璃结节同前，约5mm（IM34）
text_en: Small ground-glass nodule in the subpleural region of the right middle lobe is stable compared to prior, approximately 5 mm (IM34).

source_text: 前纵隔见类圆形小结节同前，约15x11mm（Im23）
text_en: A small, round nodule in the anterior mediastinum is unchanged from prior, approximately 15x11 mm (Im23).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，断端周围软组织密度影及索条影范围同前，左肺上叶结节较前增大，原约9x7mm（IM15），现约13x11mm（IM13）
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, soft tissue density and linear opacities around the stump with extent stable compared to prior, left upper lobe nodule increased in size from approximately 9x7mm (IM15) to approximately 13x11mm (IM13).

source_text: 右肺底结节灶同前，倾向良性，追查
text_en: Nodule in the right lung base is unchanged and is considered likely benign; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 余两肺结节较前增大，原左肺下叶基底段结节约6mm（IM46），现约10x10mm（IM49），倾向转移，追查
text_en: Nodules in the remainder of both lungs have increased in size; the nodule in the basal segment of the left lower lobe previously measured approximately 6 mm (IM46), and now measures approximately 10x10 mm (IM49); metastasis is favored; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺小结节影同前（IM12、39），右肺上叶索条影同前
text_en: Right lung small nodule shadows unchanged (IM12, 39); right upper lobe linear opacity unchanged.

source_text: 双侧胸膜及叶间胸膜结节样增厚较前增大，原约30x18mm（IM30），现约43x22mm（IM31），右侧胸水较前稍多
text_en: Bilateral pleural and interlobar septal nodular thickening has increased compared to prior, previously approximately 30x18 mm (IM30), now approximately 43x22 mm (IM31). Right-sided pleural effusion is slightly increased.

source_text: 双肺多发新发结节，考虑转移
text_en: Multiple new nodules in both lungs, metastasis considered likely.

source_text: 余肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or areas of consolidation are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃密度结节影同前，约15x12mm（IM27）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe posterior segment is unchanged, measuring approximately 15 x 12 mm (IM27).

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节同前，追查
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶近膈处小结节同前，仍约7mm（IM43）
text_en: The small nodule near the diaphragm in the right lower lobe is stable, still measuring approximately 7 mm (IM43).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段新增结节，形态不规则，边缘毛糙，大小约15x9mm（IM19）
text_en: Newly noted irregular nodule with ill-defined margins in left upper lobe apicoposterior segment, approximately 15x9 mm (IM19)

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，右肺上叶软组织密度结节同前，仍见分叶及毛刺，约12x9mm（IM12)，余肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Lung parenchymal lucency is uniform. A soft-tissue density nodule in the right upper lobe is stable, still showing lobulation and spiculation, measuring approximately 12x9 mm (IM12). No other nodules or consolidation are seen.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，未见新增肺内结节或斑片影
text_en: Bilateral lung markings are unremarkable in course, and pulmonary lucency is uniform. No new pulmonary nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，左肺门软组织影较前缩小，原约15x10mm(图25)，现约11x6mm(IM26)，周围可见金属夹包绕，考虑术后改变
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, left hilar soft tissue shadow decreased in size compared to prior, originally approximately 15x10 mm (Figure 25), now approximately 11x6 mm (Image 26), surrounded by metal clips, considered postoperative change.

source_text: 左肺类结节同前相仿
text_en: Left lung nodule-like lesion similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段微小结节同前（IM13、21）
text_en: Tiny nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable (IM13, 21)

source_text: 双肺弥漫转移结节同前
text_en: Diffusely distributed metastatic nodules in both lungs are stable.

source_text: 扫及T8椎体高密度结节同前（IM36）
text_en: High-density nodule in the T8 vertebral body, stable compared to prior (IM36).

source_text: 新见小淋巴结
text_en: Newly identified small lymph node

source_text: 左侧肾上腺转移缩小，追查
text_en: Left adrenal metastasis decreased in size; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺新见多发模糊结节影，约3mm（IM16、19）
text_en: Newly seen multiple indistinct nodules in the right lung, approximately 3 mm (IM16, 19).

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结大致同前，大小约11x8mm(IM24)
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes largely unchanged, size approximately 11x8 mm (IM24).

source_text: 纵隔2、7组及右肺门淋巴结同前，肺门淋巴结平扫显示不清
text_en: Mediastinal stations 2 and 7 and right hilar lymph nodes unchanged from prior, hilar lymph nodes not clearly visible on non-contrast CT

source_text: 左肺下叶新见小结节，约5mm（IM34），双肺散在多发磨玻璃密度及实性结节同前，如右肺中叶实性病灶仍约3mm（Im27）
text_en: New small nodule in the left lower lobe, approximately 5mm (IM34), with scattered multiple ground-glass opacities and solid nodules in both lungs unchanged from previous, such as the solid lesion in the right middle lobe still approximately 3mm (Im27).

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段近胸膜处模糊结节同前，约7x6mm（IM47）
text_en: The indistinct nodule near the pleura in the lateral basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 7 x 6 mm (IM47).

source_text: 左肺下叶背段见小结节同前，仍约4mm（IM37）
text_en: A small nodule in the left lower lobe dorsal segment is unchanged, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM37).

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，约5mm（IM37）
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM37).

source_text: 新发多个结节
text_en: Newly identified multiple nodules.

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门淋巴结并部分点状钙化同前
text_en: Mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes with partial punctate calcification unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺中叶肿物较前缩小，原约33x28mm（IMA26），现约22x14mm（IM31），右肺膨胀不全较前略减轻
text_en: The right middle lobe mass has decreased in size compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 33 x 28 mm (IMA26), now measuring approximately 22 x 14 mm (IM31). Atelectasis of the right lung is slightly improved compared to prior.

source_text: 无明显变化
text_en: no significant change

source_text: 另双肺多发胸膜下小结节同前
text_en: Additionally, multiple pleural-based small nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段分叶状肿块大致同前，仍约34x31mm（IM28），内部密度不均，含气支气管及空泡征表现同前
text_en: The lobulated mass in the apical segment of the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged, still measuring approximately 34x31 mm (IM28), with heterogeneous internal density; the appearance of air bronchograms and air bubble signs is unchanged.

source_text: 双肺散在小结节同前，倾向良性，复查
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, favoring benign, recheck.

source_text: 纵隔散在小淋巴结缩小，较大原约13x9mm（IM26），现约10x7mm（IM25），追查
text_en: Scattered small mediastinal lymph nodes decreased in size; larger one previously approximately 13x9 mm (IM26), now approximately 10x7 mm (IM25), follow-up.

source_text: 右腋区淋巴结变化不大，原约9x6mm，现约10x4mm（IM15），纵隔、左肺门、左腋窝及双锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Right axillary lymph nodes unchanged, previously measuring approximately 9x6 mm, now measuring approximately 10x4 mm (IM15); no enlarged lymph nodes seen in the mediastinum, left hilum, left axilla, or bilateral supraclavicular regions.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段模糊点状结节同前，约4mm（IM20）
text_en: Left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment: hazy punctate nodule unchanged from previous, approximately 4 mm (IM20).

source_text: 右肺上叶、下叶多发小结节同前，较大仍约4mm（IM23）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right upper and lower lobes unchanged; largest still approximately 4 mm (IM23).

source_text: 左侧锁骨上淋巴结较前略缩小，原约12x10mm（IM5），现约10x7mm（IM4）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node is slightly decreased in size compared to prior; previously approximately 12x10 mm (IM5), now approximately 10x7 mm (IM4).

source_text: 右下胸膜轻度增厚并肺内索条影同前，未见明确结节灶
text_en: Mild pleural thickening in the right lower region with intrapulmonary linear opacities unchanged. No definite nodules are seen.

source_text: 右锁骨上、纵隔多发淋巴结同前，较大约15mm（IM24）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region and mediastinum are similar to prior, the largest measuring approximately 15 mm (IM24).

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃结节同前，继续追查
text_en: Left upper lobe ground-glass nodule stable compared to prior, continue follow-up

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺低密度小结节同前，约10mm（IM61）
text_en: A low-density small nodule measuring approximately 10 mm is noted in the left adrenal gland, unchanged from prior (Im61).

source_text: 右肺小结节影同前（IM10、16、38），右肺上叶索条影同前
text_en: Right lung small nodule shadows unchanged (IM10, 16, 38); right upper lobe linear opacity unchanged.

source_text: 右肺尖见模糊小结节（IM17），下叶背段近叶间胸膜见硬结灶同前（IM28）
text_en: A faint small nodule is seen in the right lung apex (IM17). A sclerotic focus is seen near the interlobar pleura in the lower lobe posterior segment, unchanged from prior (IM28).

source_text: 未见新见
text_en: No new findings

source_text: 左肺上叶切除术后，支气管断端周围局限性软组织同前，未见结节及肿块
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, localized soft tissue around bronchial stump unchanged, no nodules or masses.

source_text: 左侧甲状腺低密度结节同前，请结合B超检查
text_en: Left thyroid low-density nodule unchanged; correlate with ultrasound examination.

source_text: 胸10、12椎体可见高密度结节同前（IM46、56），胸11、腰椎体左侧部见片状低密度影同前（IM52、63)
text_en: High-density nodules are visible in thoracic vertebrae 10 and 12, same as before (IM46, 56); patchy low-density shadow is seen in the left side of thoracic vertebra 11 and lumbar vertebrae, same as before (IM52, 63)

source_text: 双肺多发转移结节较前增大，原较大约5x4mm，现约8x6mm（IM18）
text_en: Multiple metastatic nodules in both lungs have increased in size; the largest was previously about 5x4 mm, now measures approximately 8x6 mm (IM18).

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下结节同前
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural nodule unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔2组淋巴结较前稍增大，如原约9x6mm，现约10x7mm（IM15），追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 2 lymph nodes slightly increased compared to previous, previously approximately 9x6 mm, currently approximately 10x7 mm (IM15), follow-up.

source_text: 甲状腺左叶结节同前，大小约12*8mm（IMA5）
text_en: Thyroid left lobe nodule same as prior, size approximately 12x8 mm (IMA5).

source_text: 余肺未见新发结节影
text_en: No new nodules are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 双肺轻度气肿大致同前，未见新生结节斑片影
text_en: Mild emphysema in both lungs is unchanged from prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶另一磨玻璃密度小结节同前，仍约5mm（IMA16）
text_en: Another small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is stable compared to prior, remaining approximately 5 mm (IMA16).

source_text: 纵隔内4、5、7、10组多发淋巴结同前相仿，较大约10x8mm（IM30）
text_en: Mediastinal multiple lymph nodes at stations 4, 5, 7, and 10, similar to previous; largest approximately 10x8 mm (IM30).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段浅淡小结节影同前，追查
text_en: Faint small nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment, unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺索条同前，未见肺内明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: Linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior; no significant new nodules or consolidations are seen within the lungs.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺结节同前
text_en: A thyroid nodule is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶内侧段及左肺下叶外基底段胸膜下结节同前（IM26、50、55）
text_en: The subpleural nodules in the medial segment of the right middle lobe and the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe are unchanged from prior (IM26, 50, 55).

source_text: 左肺点条灶同前相仿，未见新发结节
text_en: Left lung punctate and linear opacities similar to previous, no new nodules.

source_text: T9及T10椎体下终板结节样凹陷相仿，许莫氏结节可能，追查
text_en: Nodular indentation at the inferior endplates of T9 and T10 vertebral bodies similar to prior, suggestive of Schmorl's node; follow-up recommended

source_text: 右肺上叶后段及中叶胸膜下钙化灶及微小结节同前
text_en: Pleural-based calcifications and micro-nodules in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe and the middle lobe are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔5组淋巴结较前相仿，较大现约15x10mm（IM28）
text_en: Mediastinal group 5 lymph nodes similar to prior, largest currently approximately 15x10 mm (Image 28)

source_text: 腹腔淋巴结较前增大，考虑转移可能大
text_en: Abdominal lymph nodes are enlarged compared to previous, considered likely metastatic.

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段混杂磨玻璃密度结节范围较前略增大、密度减低，现约21*14mm(图37)，原约19x12mm（Im37），外周肺少许索条影同前
text_en: Mixed ground-glass opacity nodule in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe shows slight increase in size and decreased density compared to prior; currently measures approximately 21 x 14 mm (Figure 37), previously measured 19 x 12 mm (Im37). Minimal peripheral pulmonary linear opacities remain unchanged.

source_text: 两肺弥漫结节及散在片絮影大致同前
text_en: The diffuse nodules and scattered fluffy opacities in both lungs are largely unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶不规则小结节同前，约5mm（IM38）
text_en: Irregular small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM38).

source_text: 双腋下多发淋巴结大致同前，较大约2x1.2cm（Im10）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes at both axillae are generally unchanged from prior, the largest measuring approximately 2x1.2 cm (Im10).

source_text: 双锁骨上区淋巴结同前
text_en: Lymph nodes in bilateral supraclavicular regions are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结较前相仿，仍见钙化
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph node is similar to previous, with calcification still present.

source_text: 纵隔7组肿大淋巴结同前，较大仍约30*20mm(图27)
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 enlarged lymph nodes unchanged from previous, the largest still approximately 30 × 20 mm (Image 27)

source_text: 左肺下叶背段胸膜下索条小结节灶同前，约3mm（IM31）
text_en: A linear small subpleural nodule in the left lower lobe dorsal segment is unchanged, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM31).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段肿块影缩小，原约31x28mm（IM14），现约29x26mm（IM14）
text_en: The mass in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment has decreased in size from approximately 31x28 mm (IM14) to approximately 29x26 mm (IM14).

source_text: 左肺下叶胸主动脉旁小结节同前，约6x4mm（IM33）
text_en: A small nodule adjacent to the thoracic aorta in the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 6x4 mm (IM33).

source_text: 右肺胸膜下可新见一微小结节，直径约3mm（IM44），追查
text_en: A new tiny nodule is now visible in the right lung subpleural region, approximately 3 mm in diameter (IM44); recommend follow-up.

source_text: 左上肺结节同前
text_en: Nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 两肺多发结节大致同前，较大约7x5mm（IM33）
text_en: Multiple nodules in both lungs generally similar to prior, largest measuring approximately 7x5 mm (IM33)

source_text: 纵隔散在淋巴结同前，短径均不足10mm
text_en: Scattered mediastinal lymph nodes same as before, short axes all less than 10 mm.

source_text: 右肺上叶钙化、索条、小结节影、右肺下叶点状结节影同前（IMA19、42）
text_en: Calcification, linear opacities, and small nodules in the right upper lobe, and punctate nodules in the right lower lobe are unchanged (IMA19, 42).

source_text: 气管上段术后，管壁清晰，右侧壁软组织影略增厚较前明显，原约7mm（IM5），现约11mm（IMA6），局部复发
text_en: Postoperative status of upper trachea, tube wall clear, soft tissue shadow on right wall slightly thickened and more obvious than before, previously approximately 7mm (IM5), now approximately 11mm (IMA6), local recurrence.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前缩小，较大原约23x15mm（IM20），现约20x8mm（IM24）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are reduced in size compared to previous; the largest was previously approximately 23x15mm (IM20) and is now approximately 20x8mm (IM24).

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结大致同前，较大仍约12x10mm（IM38），纵隔余处、锁骨区、腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is essentially unchanged, with the largest still measuring approximately 12x10 mm (IM38); no enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the remainder of the mediastinum, supraclavicular region, or axillae.

source_text: 纵隔4R肿大淋巴结大致同前(图24)
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R enlarged lymph node approximately unchanged from prior (Figure 24).

source_text: 左下肺少许索条影大致同前，左肺下叶小结节同前相仿（IM31）
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the left lower lobe are essentially unchanged; a small nodule in the left lower lobe is similar to prior (IM31).

source_text: 右肺门小淋巴结较前增大，追随
text_en: Small right hilar lymph nodes have increased in size compared to prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺中叶近水平裂胸膜处一处纯磨玻璃密度结节较前稍增大，原约20x13mm，现约20x16mm（IMA30），边缘尚清，内见血管穿行，内部密度稍增高，其后方实性小结节同前，仍约7x6mm（IMA30），边缘光滑
text_en: A pure ground-glass opacity nodule near the horizontal fissure and pleura in the right middle lobe is slightly increased in size compared to prior (previously approximately 20x13 mm, now approximately 20x16 mm) (IMA30), with relatively well-defined margins, containing visible vascular passage and slightly increased internal density; a small solid nodule posteriorly remains unchanged, still measuring approximately 7x6 mm (IMA30), with smooth margins

source_text: 右肺中叶新见一枚结节，直径约5mm（IMA42），考虑转移不除外，密切追查
text_en: A new nodule is seen in the right middle lobe, measuring approximately 5 mm in diameter (IMA42); metastasis cannot be excluded; close follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 两肺小结节影同前（IMA13、14、33），右肺索条影同前
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior (IMA13, 14, 33); right lung reticular opacities similar to prior

source_text: 左下肺斑片渗出实变影大致同前，局部可疑结节较前缩小，现约6x4mm（IM32），原约8x4mm（IM33）
text_en: Patchy exudative consolidation in the left lower lobe is essentially unchanged; the focal suspicious nodule has decreased in size, now approximately 6x4 mm (IM32), previously approximately 8x4 mm (IM33).

source_text: 两肺未见新发结节影
text_en: No new nodules seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺中叶磨玻璃密度小结节影同前，约5mm（IM16），右肺小斑片索条影同前
text_en: Small ground-glass density nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM16). Small patchy linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔及双肺门多发肿大淋巴结部分较前缩小
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions partially decreased compared to previous

source_text: 右肺上叶新见肿块约46x37mm（Im22），上下径长度约78mm，延伸至包绕右上肺门支气管血管分支，周围小结节较多
text_en: Newly seen mass in the right upper lobe measuring approximately 46x37 mm (Im22), with a craniocaudal length of about 78 mm, extending to and encasing the right upper lobe bronchovascular branches; numerous surrounding small nodules are present.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段结节影缩小，原约15x12mm（IM32），现约10x7mm（IM32）
text_en: Left lower lobe posterior segment nodule decreased in size, previously approximately 15x12 mm (IM32), now approximately 10x7 mm (IM32).

source_text: 余肺未见新发斑片结节或实变影
text_en: No new patchy opacities, nodules, or areas of consolidation are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 新发实性结节
text_en: Newly developed solid nodule

source_text: 余肺野未见新增结节及片絮病灶
text_en: The remainder of the lung fields shows no new nodules or floccular opacities.

source_text: 未见明确新发破坏灶
text_en: No definite new osseous destruction

source_text: 右上肺陈旧灶同前（IMA24），双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Right upper lobe chronic changes unchanged (IMA24); no new nodules or patchy opacities in both lungs.

source_text: 其外侧圆形结节同前，约8mm（IM19）
text_en: The round nodule lateral to it is stable, measuring approximately 8 mm (IM19).

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结同前，约11x11mm(IM20)
text_en: The mediastinal station 4R lymph node is unchanged, approximately 11 x 11 mm (Image 20)

source_text: 右下肺及左上肺微小结节灶同前
text_en: Micro-nodules in the right lower lung and left upper lung unchanged.

source_text: 甲状腺左叶结节影同前
text_en: Left thyroid lobe nodule stable.

source_text: 右侧前胸壁皮下结节大致同前
text_en: Subcutaneous nodule in the right anterior chest wall is essentially unchanged.

source_text: 新见5mm大小模糊结节
text_en: Newly seen 5mm ill-defined nodule

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门多发淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous.

source_text: 左肺下叶多发类结节影同前（IMA24、34），较大仍约13x9mm
text_en: Multiple nodule-like opacities in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (IMA24, 34), the largest still approximately 13x9mm.

source_text: 未见残余及复发
text_en: No residual disease or recurrence seen

source_text: 左肺上叶前段实性结节较前缩小，密度减低，大小原约14x12mm（IM18），现约9x8mm（IM17），边界欠清，略呈分叶状
text_en: The solid nodule in the left upper lobe anterior segment is smaller than before with decreased density, measuring approximately 14x12 mm (IM18) previously and approximately 9x8 mm (IM17) currently, with ill-defined margins and slightly lobulated.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段小结节同前，约5mm（IM27），边缘光滑
text_en: A small nodule in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe, unchanged from previous, approximately 5 mm (IM27), with smooth margins.

source_text: 左下肺胸主动脉旁不规则肿物伴钙化较前增大，原约29x22mm（IM49），现约33x27mm（IM51）
text_en: The irregular mass with calcification adjacent to the descending aorta in the left lower lobe has increased in size, previously approximately 29x22 mm (IM49), now approximately 33x27 mm (IM51).

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门高密度淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal and bilateral hilar high-density lymph nodes, unchanged from previous.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结，右肺门区小淋巴结同前，约9x7mm（IM30）
