source_text: 前纵隔术后，局部软组织密度较前减轻，原厚约18mm（IM19），现约16mm(图22)
text_en: Status post anterior mediastinal surgery; local soft tissue density has decreased compared to prior, previously thick approximately 18 mm (IM19), now approximately 16 mm (Figure 22).

source_text: 纵隔4、7组及双侧锁骨上小淋巴结较前缩小
text_en: Small mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4 and 7 and bilateral supraclavicular lymph nodes have decreased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结同前，仍约10x5mm（IM24）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes unchanged from previous, still approximately 10x5 mm (IM24).

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段胸膜下微结节较前相仿，约4mm（IM39）
text_en: The subpleural tiny nodule in the left lower lobe basal segment is similar to prior, approximately 4 mm (IM39).

source_text: 气管右侧旁淋巴结较前相仿，原约10x10mm（IM13），现约12x8mm（IM9）
text_en: Right paratracheal lymph node similar to prior, previously approximately 10x10mm (IM13), now approximately 12x8mm (IM9)

source_text: 纵隔内腔静脉后方高密度线影旁异常密度灶较前相仿，范围原约16x13mm，现约17x10mm（IM22），考虑术后改变，追查
text_en: Abnormal density focus adjacent to a high-density linear shadow posterior to the vena cava in the mediastinum, similar to previous, previous extent approximately 16x13 mm, current extent approximately 17x10 mm (IM22), considered postoperative change, follow-up.

source_text: 右肺上叶水平裂下小结节影同前，约4mm（IM24）
text_en: The small nodular opacity below the horizontal fissure in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM24).

source_text: 前纵隔结节影较前增大，现约11x5mm（IMA20），原约7x4mm（Im21）
text_en: Nodular opacity in the anterior mediastinum has increased in size compared to prior, now measuring approximately 11x5 mm (IMA20), previously approximately 7x4 mm (Im21).

source_text: 双肺结节部分较前增大，性质待定，需密切追查
text_en: Some bilateral pulmonary nodules are larger than prior. Nature is indeterminate; close follow-up is required.

source_text: 气管右侧旁小淋巴结同前，约11*7mm（IM14）
text_en: Small right paratracheal lymph node unchanged, approximately 11x7 mm (IM14).

source_text: 食管术后改变同前，未见新生占位
text_en: Post-esophagectomy changes unchanged, no new mass lesion.

source_text: T9椎体骨破坏(图45)，考虑骨转移
text_en: Bone destruction in T9 vertebral body (Figure 45), consistent with metastasis

source_text: 左侧肾上腺结节较前相仿（IM54）
text_en: Left adrenal nodule similar to prior (IM54).

source_text: 左肺下叶空洞结节增大，空洞消失、密度变实，原约12x9mm，现约14x10mm（IM45）
text_en: The cavitary nodule in the left lower lobe has increased in size with resolution of the cavity and solidification of density, previously approximately 12x9 mm, now approximately 14x10 mm (IM45).

source_text: 纵隔10R淋巴结同前，约11*7mm(图26)
text_en: Right paratracheal (10R) mediastinal lymph node unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 11x7 mm (Figure 26)

source_text: 新见一类结节
text_en: Newly seen nodule-like lesion

source_text: 食管癌术后，吻合口纵隔瘘形成，局部积气较前稍减少
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer, mediastinal fistula at the anastomosis, localized air collection slightly decreased compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段新见两枚混合磨玻璃密度结节，建议抗炎治疗后复查，尚不除外恶性
text_en: Two new mixed ground-glass opacity nodules are seen in the left upper lobe lingular segment. Follow-up after anti-inflammatory treatment is recommended, as malignancy cannot be excluded.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜钙化结节同前
text_en: The calcified nodule along the right interlobar pleura is unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔多个小淋巴结同前相仿，平扫密度较高，较大约17x6mm（IM24）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes similar to prior, higher density on non-contrast scan, largest approximately 17x6 mm (IM24)

source_text: 纵隔及肺门多个淋巴结同前，较大约15x10mm(IM32)
text_en: Multiple mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest approximately 15x10mm (IM32).

source_text: 左肺上叶、左斜裂胸膜及右肺中叶微小结节同前（Im24、34、39、37、46），余肺未见新增结节
text_en: Tiny nodules in the left upper lobe, left oblique fissure pleura, and right middle lobe are unchanged (Im24, 34, 39, 37, 46); no new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 余肺内未见新见结节
text_en: No new nodules are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段微小结节同前，约2mm（IM27）
text_en: The tiny nodule in the left upper lobe anterior segment is unchanged, measuring approximately 2 mm (IM27).

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结大致同前，追查
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is essentially unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔4L淋巴结大致同前，现约13x10mm(IM23)，追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 4L lymph nodes are roughly unchanged from prior, now measuring approximately 13x10 mm (IM23), for follow-up.

source_text: 右肺中叶小钙化结节同前（IM35）
text_en: The small calcified nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged (IM35).

source_text: 纵隔、膈上淋巴结同前，较大约15x10mm（IM25）
text_en: Mediastinal and supra-diaphragmatic lymph nodes unchanged from prior; largest approximately 15x10 mm (IM25).

source_text: 腋窝小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small axillary lymph nodes unchanged from previous

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变同前，右肺索条小结节影同前
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lobe are unchanged. The linear opacities and small nodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺多发转移小结节较前缩小减少，原约7x5mm（IM27）者，现约4mm（IM27)
text_en: Multiple metastatic small nodules in both lungs have decreased in size and number; the one previously measuring approximately 7x5 mm (IM27) now measures about 4 mm (IM27).

source_text: 食管胸中下段管壁不均匀增厚较前减轻，较厚部原约14mm，现约11mm（IM30），强化较前减低
text_en: Irregular wall thickening of the mid-to-lower thoracic esophagus reduced compared to prior, thickest portion previously approximately 14mm, now approximately 11mm (IM30), enhancement decreased compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔4组淋巴结同前
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal station 4 are stable compared to prior

source_text: 纵隔内新发小淋巴结，追查
text_en: Newly noted small mediastinal lymph nodes; follow-up recommended.

source_text: T1椎体低密度结节同前，倾向血管瘤
text_en: T1 vertebral body low-density nodule unchanged, favoring hemangioma

source_text: 纵隔2、4、7组淋巴结同前，现较大仍约16x10mm（IMA19）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2, 4, and 7 are unchanged from previous; the largest remains approximately 16x10 mm (IMA19).

source_text: 左肺术后改变，纵隔淋巴结同前
text_en: Left lung postoperative change, mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged.

source_text: 其后方实性小结节同前
text_en: The small solid nodule posterior to it remains stable.

source_text: 纵隔4R、右肺门转移淋巴结增大，追查
text_en: Metastatic lymph nodes in mediastinal station 4R and the right hilum have increased in size; follow up.

source_text: 左胸术后改变，支气管断端未见异常增厚征象，左主支气管后方低密度影较前缩小，原约14x11mm（IM23），现约10x9mm（Im25）
text_en: Left chest postoperative change, no abnormal thickening at bronchial stump, low-density shadow posterior to left main bronchus decreased in size, previously approximately 14x11mm (IM23), now approximately 10x9mm (Im25).

source_text: 左肺下叶斑片索条影及小结节灶同前（Im57）
text_en: Patchy linear opacities and small nodule foci in the left lower lobe are unchanged from previous (Im57).

source_text: 甲状腺右叶低密度结节同前（IM4）
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right lobe of the thyroid gland unchanged from prior (IM4).

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，4R组较大者约16*10mm（IMA21）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, with the largest in the 4R station measuring approximately 16x10 mm (IMA21).

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段肿块较前缩小
text_en: The mass in the left lower lobe basal segment has decreased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 平扫纵隔小淋巴结部分略增大，如原约5x3mm（IM12），现约8x7mm（IM10）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows some small mediastinal lymph nodes slightly increased in size, for example, previously approximately 5x3 mm on image 12, now approximately 8x7 mm on image 10.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，右肺新发结节，追查
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged; a new nodule in the right lung is noted, requires follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结稍大同前，建议复查
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes slightly enlarged unchanged from prior, recommend follow-up

source_text: 右肺胸膜下多发小结节同前，追查
text_en: Multiple subpleural small nodules in the right lung are unchanged from prior; follow-up recommended

source_text: 双肺下叶胸膜下小斑片索条影及散在小结节同前
text_en: Subpleural small patchy linear opacities and scattered small nodules in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 左膈抬高、纵膈略左移同前，纵隔、双侧锁骨上及腋窝平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Left diaphragm elevation and slight left mediastinal shift unchanged from prior; no enlarged lymph nodes seen on non-contrast scans in the mediastinum, bilateral supraclavicular regions, or axillae.

source_text: 左侧新见多发胸膜下小结节，较大约5mm（IM17）
text_en: Newly seen multiple subpleural small nodules in the left lung, the largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM17).

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，较大约19x13mm(图27)
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are stable compared to prior, largest measuring approximately 19x13 mm (Figure 27)

source_text: 食管胸中段可见两处管壁环周增厚较前略减轻，较厚处分别原约14mm（IM27）、13mm（IM36），现约12mm（IM24）、10mm（IM33），局部浆膜面模糊，管腔明显狭窄，胸中段增厚管壁局部与主动脉脂肪间隙消失
text_en: Two areas of circumferential wall thickening in the mid-thoracic esophagus show slight reduction compared to prior, with the thickest portions previously measuring approximately 14 mm (IM27) and 13 mm (IM36), and now approximately 12 mm (IM24) and 10 mm (IM33). The local serosal surface is blurred, the lumen is significantly narrowed, and the fat plane between the thickened esophageal wall in the mid-thoracic segment and the aorta is absent

source_text: 左肺下叶背段、右肺上叶后段磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，仍约3mm、10x6mm、5x4mm（IM16、22、23），建议6月后追查
text_en: Left lower lobe dorsal segment and right upper lobe posterior segment ground-glass opacity nodules unchanged, still approximately 3 mm, 10x6 mm, and 5x4 mm (IM16, 22, 23); recommend follow-up in 6 months.

source_text: 右锁骨上淋巴结略显增大，原约10x8mm，现约13x8mm（IM6）
text_en: Right supraclavicular lymph node is slightly enlarged, previously approximately 10x8 mm, now approximately 13x8 mm (IM6)

source_text: 右肺上叶微小结节同前
text_en: Tiny nodules in the right upper lobe, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节较前缩小，追查
text_en: Right upper lobe small nodule decreased in size compared to prior, recommend follow-up

source_text: 左腋下淋巴结较前缩小
text_en: Left axillary lymph nodes decreased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 左锁骨上、气管左旁、纵隔2、5、7组多发小淋巴结同前，较大仍约14x8mm（IM22）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region, left paratracheal area, and mediastinal stations 2, 5, and 7 unchanged from prior; the largest remains approximately 14x8 mm (IM22).

source_text: 右侧纵隔胸膜结节较前增大，转移可能，追查
text_en: Nodule in the right mediastinal pleura is larger than before. Metastasis is possible. Follow-up recommended.

source_text: 两肺下叶索条影同前，两肺点状结节影同前（IMA25）
text_en: Linear opacities in both lower lobes are unchanged. Punctate nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged from prior (IMA25).

source_text: 右肺上叶多发钙化灶及中叶索条影同前，下叶胸膜旁模糊结节灶同前，约5mm（IM38）
text_en: Multiple calcifications in the right upper lobe and linear opacities in the middle lobe are unchanged. A hazy nodule adjacent to the pleura in the lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM38).

source_text: 左肺纹理清晰，双肺未见新发结节或片絮影
text_en: Left lung markings clear, no new nodules or patchy opacities in both lungs.

source_text: 右下胸膜结节样增厚同前
text_en: Nodular pleural thickening in the right lower region is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺中叶及下叶胸膜下不规则小结节灶较前相仿（IM27、30、47），较大约7mm（IM30）
text_en: Irregular subpleural small nodular foci in the right middle and lower lobes are similar to prior (IM27, 30, 47), with the largest measuring approximately 7 mm (IM30).

source_text: 淋巴结转移
text_en: Lymph node metastasis.

source_text: 右肺下叶结节同前，约6mm（IM55）
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM55).

source_text: 左肺小结节同前（IM19、40），追查
text_en: Small nodules in the left lung unchanged from prior (IM19, 40), follow-up.

source_text: 右下肺少许索条影同前，两肺未见新生结节灶
text_en: Few fibrotic bands in the right lower lobe are stable compared to prior; no new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下小结节同前，约6*6mm(图35)
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right middle lobe is stable, approximately 6x6 mm (Figure 35).

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，散在胸膜下模糊小斑片影及小结节影同前，余双肺未见新发结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. Scattered subpleural hazy small patchy opacities and small nodules are stable. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后改变同前，左肺硬结灶同前，左肺模糊小结节影，建议复查定性
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left upper lobe unchanged from previous, fibrotic focus in the left lung unchanged from previous, indistinct small nodule in the left lung, with recommendation for follow-up to characterize.

source_text: 左肺下叶斜裂旁4mm结节较前相仿（IM32）
text_en: 4mm nodule adjacent to the oblique fissure in the left lower lobe is similar to previous (IM32).

source_text: 右肺中叶结节较前缩小，原约8mm（IM46），现约4mm（IM44）
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe is smaller than before, previously approximately 8 mm (IM46), now approximately 4 mm (IM44).

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门淋巴结同前，较大约15mm（IM27），内伴钙化
text_en: Mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest approximately 15mm (IM27), with internal calcification.

source_text: 左锁骨上见8x5mm淋巴结表现同前（IM2)，纵膈及肺门未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node measuring 8x5 mm seen with unchanged appearance (IM2); no enlarged lymph nodes seen in mediastinum and hilar regions.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段结节较前缩小，现约9x7mm（IM32），原为20x15mm（IM33），边缘较前清晰
text_en: Left lower lobe posterior segment nodule decreased in size, now approximately 9x7 mm (IM32), previously 20x15 mm (IM33), margins clearer than prior.

source_text: 食道胸中下癌疗后，大致同前
text_en: Post-treatment for mid-to-lower thoracic esophageal cancer, findings are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右肺上叶尖段类圆形软组织密度结节同前，边缘光滑，密度较均匀，约9mm（IM13）
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent; round soft-tissue density nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is stable compared to prior, with smooth margins and relatively uniform density, measuring approximately 9 mm (IM13).

source_text: 左肺上叶、右肺下叶微小结节同前（IMA23、46、52）
text_en: Tiny nodules in the left upper lobe and right lower lobe are stable compared to prior (IMA23, 46, 52).

source_text: 纵隔散在淋巴结（IMA22）大致同前
text_en: Mediastinal scattered lymph nodes (IMA22) essentially unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶类结节影同前（IM12）
text_en: Nodule-like opacity in the right upper lobe unchanged from prior (IM12).

source_text: 纵隔内金属夹影同前，纵隔、肺门、腋窝及锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Metal clip shadow within the mediastinum same as before; no enlarged lymph nodes seen in the mediastinum, hilar, axillary, or supraclavicular regions

source_text: 肝脏低密度占位大致同前（IM50），边界模糊
text_en: Liver low-density mass largely unchanged from prior (IM50), ill-defined margins.

source_text: 左肺下叶前内基底段不规则软组织密度结节同前，约12x10mm（Im40），浅分叶，内未见确切钙化，周围未见明显索条牵拉
text_en: In the anterior-inferior basal segment of the left lower lobe, irregular soft tissue density nodule unchanged, approximately 12x10 mm (IM40), shallow lobulation, no definite calcification, no obvious traction bands.

source_text: 右肺上叶肺癌术后近端未见新发结节影，左肺下叶后基底段（IM45）胸膜下微结节影同前，大小仍约2-3mm
text_en: No new nodules are seen at the proximal site following right upper lobectomy. A subpleural micronodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe (IM45) remains unchanged, still measuring approximately 2-3 mm.

source_text: 左侧斜裂上少许小结节同前，较大约5mm（IM33）
text_en: A few small nodules in the left oblique fissure are unchanged, the largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM33).

source_text: 纵隔轻度左移、多发小淋巴结同前，较大者仍约13x8mm（IM21）
text_en: Mild leftward shift of the mediastinum; multiple small lymph nodes, same as before; the largest still approximately 13x8mm (IM21).

source_text: 右肺上叶及左肺下叶各见一小结节灶相仿，约3-4mm（IM20、44）
text_en: One small nodule is seen in the right upper lobe and another in the left lower lobe, similar to prior, measuring approximately 3–4 mm (IM20, 44).

source_text: 右肺中、下叶多发胸膜下结节大致同前，倾向良性，追查
text_en: Multiple subpleural nodules in the right middle and lower lobes are approximately unchanged; benign etiology is favored; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 胸廓入口气管右旁软组织增厚影较前缩小，与邻近血管及甲状腺及吻合口右后壁分界不清，原较大层面约61x45mm（IM11），现约42x28mm（IM11），局部层面气管受压狭窄程度较前减轻
text_en: Right paratracheal soft tissue thickening at the thoracic inlet is reduced in size compared to previous, ill-defined with adjacent vessels, thyroid, and right posterior wall of anastomosis. Previously measured approximately 61x45 mm (IM11), now approximately 42x28 mm (IM11). Local tracheal compression and narrowing are reduced compared to previous.

source_text: 双肺弥漫网条影基本同前，双肺模糊微小结节部分较前增大，如左肺下叶小结节现较大约4mm（IM32），原未见明确显示
text_en: Diffuse reticular opacities in both lungs are essentially stable. Some of the indistinct tiny nodules are larger than prior; for example, a small nodule in the left lower lobe now measures up to approximately 4 mm (IM32), not clearly demonstrated previously.

source_text: 纵隔见多发淋巴结增大，现约18x13mm（IM21），原约13x7mm（IM20）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in mediastinum, currently approximately 18x13mm (IM21), previously approximately 13x7mm (IM20).

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门小淋巴结较前相仿
text_en: Small mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes similar to previous.

source_text: 右肺下叶模糊小结节同前，仍约5mm（IMA42）
text_en: The ill-defined small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, still approximately 5 mm (IMA42).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结稍增大，现约13x7mm者（IM18），原约9x4mm
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are slightly enlarged, measuring approximately 13x7 mm (IM18) currently and 9x4 mm previously.

source_text: 右肺散在索条结节灶大致同前，右下肺较大者仍约6mm（IMA50）
text_en: Scattered linear and nodular opacities in the right lung are generally similar to prior; the largest in the right lower lobe remains approximately 6 mm (IMA50).

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节灶同前（Im56）
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe, same as before (Image 56).

source_text: 前纵隔软组织密度影大致同前，原约33x27mm（IM19），现约33x25mm（IM18）
text_en: Soft tissue density in the anterior mediastinum is essentially unchanged, previously approximately 33x27 mm (IM19), now approximately 33x25 mm (IM18).

source_text: 右肺门肿物较前增大，平扫与肺门血管分界不清，整体范围原约57*46mm(图41)，现约64x53mm（IM40），右肺中叶及下叶支气管受压变窄
text_en: Right hilar mass increased in size compared to prior; on non-contrast imaging, poorly demarcated from hilar vessels. Overall extent previously measured approximately 57x46 mm (Figure 41), now approximately 64x53 mm (IM40). The right middle and lower lobe bronchi are compressed and narrowed.

source_text: 气管前淋巴结同前，约6x4mm（IM15)
text_en: Pretracheal lymph nodes unchanged from previous, approximately 6x4mm (IM15).

source_text: 双肺转移粟粒结节减少
text_en: Pulmonary metastatic miliary nodules in both lungs are decreased in number.

source_text: 双肺散在小结节同前，较大仍约3mm（IM49）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, largest still about 3 mm (IM49).

source_text: 两肺微小结节影同前（IM23、29、37、41、56）
text_en: The tiny nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged (IM23, 29, 37, 41, 56).

source_text: 左下肺胸膜下微小结节同前，仍约2mm（IM49）
text_en: Subpleural micronodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged, still measuring approximately 2 mm (IM49).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃样结节同前，约6*5mm(图13)
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 6 x 5 mm (Figure 13).

source_text: 左下肺微小结节灶同前，小于2mm（IMA43、44）
text_en: A tiny nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged, measuring less than 2 mm (IMA43, 44).

source_text: 右心缘旁小结节同前，仍约8mm（IM37）
text_en: Small nodule adjacent to the right cardiac border is stable compared to prior, still approximately 8 mm (IM37).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度小结节同前
text_en: Small ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段胸膜下实性微结节同前，约3mm（IM39）
text_en: A subpleural solid micro-nodule in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM39).

text_en: The low-density soft tissue nodule in the anterior superior mediastinum is stable, measuring approximately 12x9 mm (IM14), well-defined, with CT value around 0 HU; benign etiology is considered, with thymic cyst being most likely.

source_text: 双肺稍低点状结节及点状钙化灶同前
text_en: Slightly low-attenuation punctate nodules and punctate calcifications in both lungs are similar to prior.

source_text: 扫及右侧肋骨高密度结节同前（IM39)，余胸廓诸骨未见明确破坏征象
text_en: CT shows a high-density nodule in the right rib, unchanged from previous (IM39); no definite bone destruction seen in the other thoracic bones.

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段模糊结节同前（IM44）
text_en: Indistinct nodule in the left lower lobe basal segment unchanged from prior (IM44)

source_text: 胸11椎体高密度小结节同前，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: High-density small nodule in T11 vertebra unchanged from prior; no bone destruction seen in other scanned bones.

source_text: 纵隔3A组淋巴结较前缩小，原约11x9mm（IM20），现约7x5mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal station 3A lymph nodes decreased compared to previous, previously approximately 11x9 mm (IM20), currently approximately 7x5 mm (IM20).

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段微小结节同前，约3mm（IM46、49），双肺未见新增结节及实变影
text_en: Tiny nodule in the basal segment of the right lower lobe stable compared to prior, approximately 3 mm (IM46, 49); no new nodules or consolidations seen in the lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶微小结节及索条影同前
text_en: Tiny nodules and linear opacities in the right upper lobe, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左下肺钙化灶同前，两肺未见新发结节影
text_en: Calcified focus in the left lower lobe is unchanged. No new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 双肺及叶间胸膜小结节同前，约5mm(IM30、33、39)
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs and interlobar pleura are stable, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM30, 33, 39).

text_en: newly identified mass

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结较前减少，较大仍约12x8mm（IM19）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes have decreased compared to prior, with the larger one remaining approximately 12x8 mm (IM19).

source_text: 右侧锁骨下结节影大小同前，约27x24mm（IMA5），增强扫描强化不明显，边界清楚，边缘光滑
text_en: The nodule in the right subclavian region is stable in size compared to prior, measuring approximately 27 x 24 mm (IMA5). It shows no significant enhancement on contrast-enhanced scanning, with a well-defined margin and smooth edge.

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节同前，约5mm（IM17）
text_en: Right upper lobe small nodule unchanged, approximately 5 mm (IM17)

source_text: 左肺上叶术后改变同前，未见复发、转移征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left upper lobe unchanged from previous, no evidence of recurrence or metastasis

source_text: 右肺上叶后段边界模糊磨玻璃密度灶同前，约17x16mm（IM23），中心仍见透光区，余双肺未见新发结节影
text_en: Ill-defined ground-glass density focus in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is stable, approximately 17x16 mm (IM23); a central lucency persists; no new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs

source_text: 右肺上叶楔状切除+右肺下叶楔状切除术后改变，术区金属缝线周围片絮影范围较前相仿，右肺内未见新发结节灶
text_en: Status post wedge resection of the right upper lobe and right lower lobe. The patchy opacities surrounding the metallic suture material in the surgical bed are similar in extent compared to prior. No new nodules are seen in the right lung.

source_text: 右胸膜转移伴胸水同前
text_en: Right pleural metastasis with pleural effusion, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下微结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: Right lung subpleural micronodule unchanged from prior, favoring benign etiology.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，右上叶尖段见纯磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，仍约13*10mm（IM12），大部分边界模糊
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, a pure ground-glass density nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe similar to prior, still approximately 13x10 mm (IM12), mostly ill-defined margins.

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结大致同前，短径小于10mm
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes essentially unchanged from previous, short axis less than 10mm

source_text: 右侧胸膜增厚，右侧纵隔胸膜结节较前增大，现约16x10mm（IM39），原约15*7mm（IM41）
text_en: Right pleural thickening is present. The right mediastinal pleural nodule is larger than prior, now measuring approximately 16x10 mm (IM39), previously 15x7 mm (IM41).

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，内见点状钙化灶
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, with punctate calcification foci.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段磨玻璃结节增大，现约13x8mm（IM14），原约10x7mm（IM11）
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment ground-glass opacity nodule increased, now approximately 13x8 mm (IM14), previously approximately 10x7 mm (IM11).

source_text: 余右肺多发磨玻璃结节同前
text_en: Multiple ground-glass nodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 余左肺磨玻璃样结节同前（IM28、38）
text_en: Ground-glass nodules in the left lung are stable compared to prior (IM28, 38).

source_text: 双锁骨上散在小淋巴结同前，3-5mm
text_en: Scattered small lymph nodes in bilateral supraclavicular regions are unchanged from prior, measuring 3–5 mm.

source_text: 余双肺未见新增结节灶
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no newly increased nodule foci.

source_text: 双肺下叶基底段小结节同前，追查
text_en: Small nodules in the basal segments of both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，左肺下叶背段见不规则结节较前缩小，原约10x8mm（IM29），现约6x4mm（IM30）
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. The irregular nodule in the left lower lobe posterior segment is smaller compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 10x8 mm (IM29), now approximately 6x4 mm (IM30).

source_text: 右肺下叶前基底段类结节灶同前相仿（IM38）
text_en: Nodular opacity in the anterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is similar to prior (IM38).

source_text: 右肺上叶索条及钙化点及中叶3mm结节(IM33）同前相仿，双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: The linear opacity and calcified foci in the right upper lobe, along with a 3 mm nodule in the middle lobe (IM33), are similar to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 右肺下叶近肺门结节同前，仍约19x15mm（IM27)，与右肺门血管及支气管分界不清，与右斜裂胸膜广基底粘连
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe near the hilum remains unchanged, still approximately 19x15 mm (IM27), with indistinct margins from the hilar vessels and bronchi, and broad-based adhesion to the right oblique fissure pleura.

source_text: 纵隔2R淋巴结同前，现约8x4mm（IMA15），较前不规则
text_en: Lymph node at mediastinal station 2R same as previous, currently approximately 8x4mm (IMA15), irregular compared to previous

source_text: 纵隔4、5组多发淋巴结同前，较大仍者约12x8mm（IM26），双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4 and 5 unchanged, largest still measuring approximately 12x8 mm (IM26), no enlarged lymph nodes seen in bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular areas, or bilateral axillae

source_text: 左肺内未见明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: No obvious new nodules or consolidation in the left lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段混合型磨玻璃密度病变范围较前略增大，现较大层面约51*36mm(图34)，原约51*30mm（IMA36）
text_en: Left lower lobe dorsal segment mixed ground-glass density lesion slightly increased in size compared to previous, currently approximately 51*36 mm on the largest slice (Figure 34), previously approximately 51*30 mm (IMA36)

source_text: 两肺索条、结节灶大致同前，较大约5x3mm（IM31、34）
text_en: The linear opacities and nodular lesions in both lungs are approximately unchanged; the largest is about 5x3 mm (IM31, 34).

source_text: 右肺索条影同前，余肺未见新增结节及斑片影
text_en: Fibrotic band in the right lung is stable compared to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左侧第3肋局部形态欠规则同前，余扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Local irregularity of the left 3rd rib unchanged; no evidence of osseous destruction in the remainder of the visualized thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，约11x9mm（IM26）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is unchanged, measuring approximately 11 x 9 mm (IM26).

source_text: 左锁骨上、纵隔2R、4、6、7组可见多发淋巴结，部分缩小，如较大者原约14x10mm，现约10x6mm（IM27），余淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes are seen in the left supraclavicular region, mediastinal stations 2R, 4, 6, and 7, with some decreased in size; for example, the largest previously measured approximately 14x10 mm is now approximately 10x6 mm (IM27), and the remaining lymph nodes are similar to previous.

source_text: 右侧前胸壁皮下结节大致同前，约7mm（IM26）
text_en: Subcutaneous nodule in the right anterior chest wall is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 7 mm (IM26).

source_text: 右锁骨上小淋巴结同前，纵隔及双腋下平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Right supraclavicular small lymph node unchanged; mediastinum and bilateral axillae show no enlarged lymph nodes on non-contrast imaging

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结增大，原约12x8mm（IM25），现约16x12mm（IM23）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes enlarged, previously approximately 12x8 mm (IM25), currently approximately 16x12 mm (IM23).

source_text: 扫及胸廓诸骨密度欠匀，未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Scans show uneven density in the bones of the thorax, with no signs of bone destruction.

source_text: 双肺未见新增结节及实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation shadows seen in both lungs.

source_text: 胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: No bone destruction lesions seen in the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 肺上叶后段近叶间裂处磨玻璃样结节同前，建议追查
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the posterior segment of the upper lobe near the interlobar fissure unchanged from prior, recommend follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结，原3p及4R小淋巴结较前缩小，如原约10x4mm（IM18）者，现约8x4mm（IM17）
text_en: No enlarged lymph nodes seen in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular regions, and bilateral axillary regions; previous small lymph nodes at stations 3p and 4R are smaller than before, for example, a node previously measuring approximately 10x4 mm (IM18) now measures approximately 8x4 mm (IM17).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段两个磨玻璃结节影同前，约为10x9mm（Im29）、2mm（IM30）
text_en: In the anterior segment of the left upper lobe, two ground-glass nodules are stable compared to previous, approximately 10x9 mm (Im29) and 2 mm (IM30).

source_text: 胃小弯侧可见肿大淋巴结较前缩小，原较大约26x21mm，现约 19*12mm（IM56）
text_en: Enlarged lymph nodes at the lesser curvature of the stomach have decreased in size compared to prior. The largest previously measured approximately 26x21mm, now approximately 19x12mm (IM56).

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段磨玻璃密度小结节同前，仍约5mm（IM48）
text_en: A small ground-glass opacity nodule in the left lower lobe posterior basal segment is the same as previous, still approximately 5 mm (IM48).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端见少许软组织密度同前，未见明确占位征象
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, minimal soft tissue density at the bronchial stump unchanged from prior, no definite mass-like lesions.

source_text: 右肺中叶贴水平裂下一约3mm浅淡微小结节同前（Im28）
text_en: A faint approximately 3 mm tiny nodule adjacent to the horizontal fissure in the right middle lobe, unchanged from prior (Im28)

source_text: 纵隔高密度淋巴结同前
text_en: The mediastinal high-attenuation lymph node is similar to previous.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，约8x6mm（IM33）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node unchanged, measuring approximately 8 x 6 mm (IM33)

source_text: 右肺上叶新见小结节显示，约2mm（IM20）
text_en: Newly seen small nodule in the right upper lobe, approximately 2 mm (IM20).

source_text: 右锁骨上区及纵隔内多组新见多发肿大淋巴结，较大者约25x22mm（Im23）
text_en: Newly noted multiple enlarged lymph nodes in multiple groups within the right supraclavicular region and mediastinum; the largest measures approximately 25x22 mm (Im23).

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段胸膜下稍高密度结节灶同前，仍约4mm（IM47）
text_en: A slightly increased density subpleural nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged from previous, still approximately 4 mm (IM47).

source_text: 纵隔5组淋巴结同前（IMA35）
text_en: Mediastinal station 5 lymph nodes unchanged from previous (IMA35).

source_text: 纵隔、双锁骨上区及双腋下多个小淋巴结，较前相仿，如原4R较大仍约6mm（IM24）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum, bilateral supraclavicular regions, and bilateral axillary regions are similar to prior, with the largest in station 4R still measuring approximately 6 mm (IM24).

source_text: 右侧心膈角处低密度结节影略饱满，原约12x11mm（IM47），现约16x12mm（IM49），追查
text_en: The low-density nodular opacity in the right cardiophrenic angle appears slightly more prominent, previously measuring approximately 12 x 11 mm (IM47) and now approximately 16 x 12 mm (IM49). Follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺斑片索条影基本消失，双肺未见新增结节灶及斑片影
text_en: Patchy and linear opacities in the right lung are nearly resolved; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 胸胃与左主支气管、胸主动脉之间纵隔脂肪间隙密度增高较前范围增大，较厚处原约10mm（IM22），现约15mm（IM23），累及左主支气管，管腔变窄
text_en: Increased density in the mediastinal fat space between the stomach and the left main bronchus and thoracic aorta, with increased extent compared to previous; thickest part previously approximately 10mm (IM22), now approximately 15mm (IM23); involving the left main bronchus with luminal narrowing.

source_text: 右肺下叶后基底段浅淡磨玻璃影消失，余肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: The faint ground-glass opacity in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe has disappeared; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段胸膜下稍高密度不规则结节较前相仿，短径仍约6mm(IM59)
text_en: A slightly increased density irregular subpleural nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is similar to previous, with a short axis still approximately 6 mm (IM59).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端周围可见少许软组织增厚，左下肺肺大泡同前，余肺未见新增结节及实变影
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, slight soft tissue thickening around the bronchial stump; left lower lobe bulla unchanged from prior; no new nodules or consolidations in the remaining lung.

source_text: 双肺多发结节大致同前，追查
text_en: Multiple nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约12x10mm（IMA17）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest measuring approximately 12x10 mm (IMA17).

source_text: 甲状腺左叶结节同前，请结合超声检查
text_en: Left thyroid lobe nodule stable, correlate with ultrasound examination.

source_text: 纵隔3A组淋巴结较前缩小，观察
text_en: Mediastinal station 3A lymph nodes decreased compared to previous, observation.

source_text: 双肺散在小结节同前相仿，追查
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior. Follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶GGO同前，请结合老片比较或密切追查除外恶性
text_en: The ground-glass opacity (GGO) in the left upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior imaging; correlation with old films or close follow-up is recommended to exclude malignancy.

source_text: 纵隔4-7组及双肺门淋巴结同前，较大仍约13x10mm（IM35）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4-7 and bilateral hilar lymph nodes are stable compared to prior, with the largest still measuring approximately 13 x 10 mm (IM35).

source_text: 右肺中叶及胸膜下小结节同前（Im23、32、33）
text_en: Small nodules in the right middle lobe and subpleural region are unchanged compared to prior (Im23, 32, 33).

source_text: 左肺上叶实性结节同前，追查
text_en: Left upper lobe solid nodule stable compared to prior, follow-up recommended

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，双肺胸膜下多发小结节较前相仿，较大仍约6mm(IM51)
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Lung parenchymal lucency is uniform. Multiple subpleural small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior, the largest still measuring approximately 6 mm (IM51).

source_text: 左下叶背段软组织肿块缩小，原约64*60mm（IM28），现46x44mm（IM30)，增强扫描仍呈不均匀强化，左下叶背段支气管截断状同前
text_en: The soft tissue mass in the left lower lobe dorsal segment has decreased in size, previously approximately 64 x 60 mm (IM28), now 46 x 44 mm (IM30); it still shows heterogeneous enhancement on contrast-enhanced scanning. The truncated appearance of the left lower lobe dorsal segmental bronchus remains unchanged.

source_text: 胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: No bone destruction findings seen in the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 两肺上叶多发磨玻璃样结节及小结节较前相仿，较大现约24x17mm(IM15)，中央见少许略高密度
text_en: Multiple ground-glass nodules and small nodules in both upper lobes are similar to prior. The largest now measures approximately 24x17 mm (IM15), with a small area of slightly higher density centrally.

source_text: 肺门小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small hilar lymph nodes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis

source_text: 右肺术后同前，未见新生占位
text_en: Status post right lung surgery is stable; no new mass is seen.

source_text: 双侧腋窝淋巴结同前
text_en: Lymph nodes in bilateral axillae are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段陈旧微小结节同前（Im26），余肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Old micro-nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is stable (Im26); no new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lungs

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右上肺磨玻璃结节同前，建议追查
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the right upper lung is unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左乳下象限肿块影较前稍增大，建议进一步详查
text_en: The mass in the lower quadrant of the left breast is slightly larger than before; further detailed evaluation is recommended.

source_text: 左侧斜裂胸膜小结节显示较前清楚，大小同前（IM17）
text_en: Small nodule along the left major fissure pleura is more clearly visualized than prior, but size remains unchanged (IM17).

source_text: 新增结节
text_en: newly identified nodule

source_text: 纵隔4、6、7、10组多发淋巴结增大同前，较大仍约20x10mm（IM29)
text_en: Mediastinal groups 4, 6, 7, and 10 show multiple enlarged lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest still approximately 20x10 mm (IM29).

source_text: 右肺下叶见索条影，左侧胸膜下微小结节同前（IM42）
text_en: Linear opacities are seen in the right lower lobe. Tiny subpleural nodules in the left lung are unchanged compared to prior (IM42).

source_text: 右肺中间干支气管内侧肺韧带内软组织结节较前缩小，原约20x14mm（IM28），现约20*8mm(图31)
text_en: The soft-tissue nodule within the pulmonary ligament medial to the right intermediate bronchus has decreased in size, previously measuring approximately 20x14 mm (IM28), now approximately 20x8 mm (Figure 31).

source_text: 胃小弯多发增大淋巴结，转移不除外，追查
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes at the lesser curvature of the stomach, metastasis cannot be excluded. Further investigation recommended.

source_text: 右上肺不规则磨玻璃密度病灶较前略增大，不除外恶性，追查
text_en: Irregular ground-glass opacity in the right upper lung has slightly increased in size compared to prior; malignancy cannot be excluded, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶新见小片状模糊影(图31)，未见明确新发灶
text_en: Newly seen small patchy hazy opacity in the right lower lobe (Fig. 31); no definite new lesion identified.

source_text: 纵隔内4、5、7、10组多发淋巴结同前相仿，较大约10x8mm（IM29）
text_en: Mediastinal multiple lymph nodes at stations 4, 5, 7, and 10, similar to previous; largest approximately 10x8 mm (IM29).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结部分饱满同前，较大约10mm(IM19)
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes are full-appearing and unchanged from prior, largest approximately 10 mm (IM19).

source_text: 左侧胸膜增厚同前，右侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前（IM37）
text_en: Left pleural thickening is unchanged. Tiny nodules in the right interlobar pleura are unchanged (IM37).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端周围软组织略增厚同前，未见明确占位征象
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; mild thickening of soft tissue around the bronchial stump is unchanged. No definite mass is seen.

source_text: 双肺胸膜下多发小结节灶影同前
text_en: Multiple small subpleural nodular opacities in both lungs are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺多发索条影同前，余肺内未见明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: Multiple linear opacities in the right lung are stable. No significant new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后改变同前，胸部CT平扫未见新生占位
text_en: Post-left lower lobectomy changes are unchanged, and no new mass is seen on non-contrast chest CT.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: The nodule-like opacity in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment is unchanged from previous; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结同前，约18x10mm（IMA28）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes unchanged from prior, approximately 18x10 mm (IMA28).

source_text: 扫及骨质未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Scanned bones show no evidence of osseous destruction.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，双肺散在磨玻璃结节大致同前，较大约9mm（IM30）
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent; scattered ground-glass nodules in both lungs are roughly unchanged from prior; the largest is approximately 9 mm (IM30).

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门多发高密度淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple high-density lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺斑点索条及结节影（IMA48）、左肺下叶小斑片钙化影同前
text_en: Punctate, linear, and nodular opacities in the right lung (IMA48) and small calcified patchy opacities in the left lower lobe are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 余双肺未见新发肺内结节或实变影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no new pulmonary nodules or consolidation shadows.

source_text: 双肺散在少许模糊小结节同前（IM22、31、36、41）
text_en: Scattered few indistinct small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM22, 31, 36, 41).

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段4mm结节同前（IM11），余双肺未见新生结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: 4 mm nodule in the right upper lobe apical segment unchanged (IM11); remainder of both lungs show no new nodules or fluffy opacities

source_text: 两肺未见新增异常密度灶
text_en: No new abnormal density foci seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段胸膜下浅淡小结节同前，考虑良性
text_en: A subpleural faint small nodule in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged, considered benign.

source_text: 左锁骨上及纵隔多发淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Left supraclavicular and mediastinal multiple lymph nodes roughly unchanged from prior

source_text: 右肺胸膜/叶间胸膜下微结节较前略缩小（IM23、27），均小于5mm
text_en: The subpleural and interlobar pleural micronodules in the right lung are slightly smaller compared to prior (IM23, 27), all measuring less than 5 mm.

source_text: 右肺散在小结节影较前相仿（IM24、31、39、49）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right lung are similar to prior (IM24, 31, 39, 49).

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，约4mm（IM52），余肺内未见明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior, approximately 4 mm (IM52); no obvious new nodules or consolidation are seen within the lungs.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺右侧叶低密度结节同前相仿
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right thyroid lobe, similar to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节影同前
text_en: Nodule with ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 甲状腺右侧叶上极结节、左侧叶钙化灶同前
text_en: Nodule in the upper pole of the right thyroid lobe and calcified focus in the left thyroid lobe unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段小结节影较前减小
text_en: Small nodular opacity in the basal segment of the right lower lobe has decreased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺局部术后，右肺下叶基底段团块影缩小，原范围约4x2cm，现约30*22mm（Im41）
text_en: Status post localized surgery in the right lung. The mass in the basal segment of the right lower lobe has decreased in size, from approximately 4x2 cm to 30x22 mm (Im41).

source_text: 平扫纵隔淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes on non-contrast CT are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶后基底模糊结节同前，仍约6x5mm（IMA50），密度较低，倾向良性，建议随诊复查
text_en: An indistinct nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged, still approximately 6x5 mm (IMA50), with low density, likely benign; follow-up is suggested.

source_text: 胸12椎体边缘线状低密度影同前，扫及余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: T12 vertebral body shows a linear low-density shadow at the margin, stable compared to prior. No bone destruction identified in the remaining thoracic bones.

source_text: 少许微小结节同前
text_en: A few tiny nodules are unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃样灶同前（Im12），右肺散在微小结节同前（Im29等）
text_en: Left upper lobe ground-glass opacity focus unchanged from previous (image 12), scattered small nodules in the right lung unchanged from previous (image 29, etc.).

source_text: 左肺下叶斜裂旁结节同前，追查
text_en: Nodule adjacent to the oblique fissure in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous, follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔内散在淋巴结同前，较大现仍约21x7mm（IM24），内见脂肪密度
text_en: Scattered mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, with the larger one still approximately 21x7mm (IM24), containing fat density

source_text: 右肺胸膜旁结节同前，仍约4mm（IM10），未见新发结节及异常密度区
text_en: The nodule adjacent to the right pleura remains unchanged, still measuring about 4 mm (IM10); no new nodules or abnormal density areas are seen.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下小结节影同前（IMA18、45）
text_en: Subpleural nodule in the right lung is stable compared to prior (IMA18, 45).

source_text: 右肺胸膜下小结节同前（IM20、46）
text_en: Subpleural small nodule in the right lung is unchanged from prior (IM20, 46)

source_text: 扫及腹部小结节同前，请结合腹部检查
text_en: CT shows small nodules in the abdomen unchanged from prior; correlate with abdominal examination.

source_text: 双肺少许索条影同前，未见新生结节灶
text_en: Few linear opacities in both lungs are stable; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 右肺下叶点状结节（IM41）本次扫描未见显示，左肺索条影同前，双肺未见新发结节灶或斑片影
text_en: The punctate nodule in the right lower lobe (IM41) is not visible on this scan; the linear opacity in the left lung is unchanged. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 平扫纵隔淋巴结同前，较大现仍约13x7mm（IM22）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes on non-contrast CT are stable compared to prior, with the largest measuring approximately 13x7 mm (IM22).

source_text: 余胸壁诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: The remaining thoracic bones show no osseous destruction.

source_text: 甲状腺双侧结节同前，请结合超声检查
text_en: Bilateral thyroid nodules unchanged from prior; please correlate with ultrasound findings.

source_text: 右肺中叶及胸膜下小结节同前，约5mm（IM31)及6x4mm（IM32）
text_en: Small nodules in the right middle lobe and subpleural region are unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM31) and 6x4 mm (IM32).

source_text: 胸部CT扫描未见新发占位征象
text_en: Chest CT scan shows no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 右气管食管沟淋巴结较前缩小，原约9*6mm（IM11），现约6*4mm（IMA9）
text_en: Right tracheoesophageal groove lymph node decreased in size compared to prior; previously measured 9x6 mm (IM11), now measures approximately 6x4 mm (IMA9).

source_text: 左肺舌叶多发小结节同前，较大仍约5mm（IM38）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the lingula of the left lung are unchanged, the largest still approximately 5 mm (IM38)

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，支气管残端未见新发肿块
text_en: Following right upper lobectomy, no new mass is seen at the bronchial remnant.

source_text: 前纵隔软组织密度影、两肺浅淡小结节影同前
text_en: Soft tissue density in the anterior mediastinum and faint small nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 余肺野肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: The remainder of the lung fields shows normal bronchovascular markings and uniform lucency, with no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 双肺未见新增结节及斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右侧第6后肋结节状高密度影同前（IMA25），追查，余扫及胸廓诸骨未见明确破坏征象
text_en: Nodular high-density focus in the right 6th posterior rib is unchanged (IMA25). Follow-up recommended. No definite evidence of destructive changes in the other bones of the thorax.

source_text: 纵隔多个小淋巴结影同前，平扫密度较高，较大约17*6mm（IM25），良性可能，建议密切随诊
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged from previous, with higher density on non-contrast scan, the largest measuring approximately 17x6 mm (IM25), benign possibility, recommend close follow-up.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段、右肺下叶基底段类圆形浅淡密度结节同前（IM17、34）
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment and right lower lobe basal segment roundish faint density nodules unchanged (IM17, 34).

source_text: 纵隔5、6组多发淋巴结较前略缩小，较大现约8mm（IM22），原约10mm（IM22）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 5 and 6 slightly decreased in size compared to previous, largest now approximately 8 mm (IM22), previously approximately 10 mm (IM22).

source_text: 扫描所及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: Scanned bones show no osseous destruction focus.

source_text: 左侧第五后肋骨折、胸椎多发低密度灶同前，考虑转移，胸8椎体病灶周围硬化较前明显
text_en: Fracture of the left fifth posterior rib and multiple low-density foci in the thoracic vertebrae, unchanged from prior and considered metastatic; sclerosis surrounding the T8 vertebral lesion is more prominent than prior.

source_text: 甲状腺右侧叶低强化结节同前
text_en: Hypoenhancing nodule in the right thyroid lobe unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段混杂磨玻璃密度结节（IM15）及左肺下叶背段实性小结节（IM38、40、49）大致同前
text_en: Mixed ground-glass density nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe (IM15) and a small solid nodule in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe (IM38, 40, 49) are essentially unchanged.

source_text: 升主动脉旁小淋巴结较前相仿
text_en: The small lymph node adjacent to the ascending aorta is similar to prior.

source_text: 左肺术后，左下肺局部软组织较前增多（IM44)，现大小约26x11mm，考虑局部复发可能大
text_en: Post left lung surgery, increased soft tissue density in the left lower lobe compared to prior (IM44), currently measuring approximately 26x11 mm, considered likely local recurrence.

source_text: 左肺上叶微小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule unchanged from prior, recommend follow-up

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端壁略增厚同前（IMA26），右肺条片影消失，右肺小斑片索条及小结节影同前
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy. Slight wall thickening at the bronchial stump is unchanged (IMA26). Linear and patchy opacities in the right lung have resolved. Small patchy linear opacities and small nodules in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔内见小淋巴结（Im21）及钙化同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes (IM21) and calcification in the mediastinum, similar to previous.

source_text: 右肺及右侧叶间胸膜下小结节灶同前
text_en: The small nodular opacities in the right lung and along the right interlobar pleura are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 新发多发大小不等结节
text_en: Newly developed multiple nodules of varying sizes

source_text: 左肺下叶外基底段胸膜下小结节同前，大小仍约4mm（IM44）
text_en: Left lower lobe lateral basal segment subpleural small nodule unchanged, size still approximately 4mm (IM44)

source_text: 右肺中叶癌术后，支气管断端未见异常增厚，右肺上叶索条同前，右肺上、下叶多发局灶性磨玻璃影较前大致相仿（IM14,25,34），现右下叶背段约11mm（IM24）,仍以磨玻璃成分为主，追查
text_en: Postoperative change from right middle lobe carcinoma; no abnormal thickening seen at the bronchial stump. Linear opacities in the right upper lobe are unchanged. Multiple focal ground-glass opacities in the right upper and lower lobes are largely similar to prior (IM14,25,34). Currently, a lesion in the right lower lobe dorsal segment measures approximately 11 mm (IM24) and remains predominantly ground-glass in composition; further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段边界清晰致密小结节同前，约5mm（IM16、23）
text_en: A well-defined dense small nodule in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe is unchanged from prior, approximately 5 mm (IM16, 23)

source_text: 其内侧右肺门区软组织影较前增大，平扫与血管区分不清，短径原约2.2cm，现约2.6cm（Im26）
text_en: The soft tissue density in the right hilar region medial to it has increased in size compared to prior, and is indistinguishable from vessels on non-contrast imaging; short axis was previously approximately 2.2 cm, now approximately 2.6 cm (Im26).

source_text: 右肺散在多发磨玻璃密度同前相仿，未见新发结节
text_en: Scattered multifocal ground-glass opacities in the right lung are similar to prior; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 双肺下叶小结节灶同前（IM33、44）
text_en: Small nodular foci in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior (IM33, 44).

source_text: 左后下纵隔胸主动脉旁软组织结节同前，大小约20x14mm（IM53）
text_en: Left posterior inferior mediastinal paraaortic soft tissue nodule unchanged, size approximately 20x14 mm (IM53).

source_text: 左上肺可见局限性索条影同前，右肺尖胸膜下可见索条结节灶同前，大小约5mm（IMA7）
text_en: A localized linear opacity in the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior; a linear nodular focus subpleural in the right lung apex is also stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (IMA7).

source_text: 两肺小斑片索条影、两肺微小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Small patchy and reticular opacities and tiny nodules in both lungs similar to prior; follow-up recommended

source_text: 气管、双侧支气管通畅，双肺散在小结节大致同前，较大约4mm（IM66），结节边缘光滑，未见小毛刺影
text_en: Trachea and bilateral bronchi patent, scattered small nodules in both lungs largely unchanged, approximately 4mm in size (IM66), smooth nodule margins, no spiculations.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段微小结节同前，约3mm（IM46），双肺未见新增结节及实变影
text_en: Tiny nodule in the basal segment of the right lower lobe stable compared to prior, approximately 3 mm (IM46); no new nodules or consolidations seen in the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔右侧气管食管沟小淋巴结大致同前，较大约5mm（IM11），追查
text_en: Small lymph node in the right tracheoesophageal groove of the mediastinum, stable compared to prior examination, largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM11), recommended for follow-up.

source_text: 左肺下叶占位消融治疗后，局部团片状实变区较前收缩，范围原约48x36mm，现约43x30mm（IM26）
text_en: After ablation therapy for the mass in the left lower lobe, the local patchy consolidation area has contracted compared to previous, original size approximately 48x36 mm, now approximately 43x30 mm (IM26)

source_text: 左肺上叶切除术后吧，胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, no new space-occupying lesions in the chest.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下小结节同前，约5mm（IM41）
text_en: The subpleural small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, approximately 5 mm (IM41)

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节同前
text_en: Small nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，肺内透亮度均匀，双肺少量小结节影基本同前，如左肺下叶结节仍约5x4mm（IM38），边界模糊
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. Lung lucency is uniform. A few small nodules are essentially unchanged, such as the nodule in the left lower lobe, still measuring approximately 5x4 mm (IM38), with indistinct margins.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段磨玻璃结节灶同前，大小约8x7mm（IM18），边界清
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment ground-glass opacity nodule unchanged, size approximately 8x7 mm (IM18), well-defined margins.

source_text: 双肺未见新发结节及实变
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶软组织肿块较前增大，原较大层面约48x36mm，现约62x42mm（IM45），其外侧肺内多发索条增粗
text_en: The soft tissue mass in the left lower lobe has increased in size compared to prior, previously measured approximately 48x36 mm, currently measures approximately 62x42 mm (IM45). Multiple thickened linear opacities in the adjacent lung parenchyma.

source_text: 左肺多发微小结节较前增大，原约2mm（IM41），现约5mm（IM42），并见新发多个结节，较大约2mm（IM51）
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in the left lung have increased in size compared to prior (previously approximately 2 mm [IM41], now approximately 5 mm [IM42]), and new multiple nodules are present, the largest approximately 2 mm (IM51)

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后，支气管断端未见异常软组织影(IM29)，余肺内未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Status post left lower lobectomy, no abnormal soft tissue shadow at the bronchial stump (Image 29), with no new nodules or consolidation in the remaining lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段术后，支气管断端未见增厚软组织密度影，左肺下叶基底段见结节影同前（IMA47），边缘见粗条状影，边缘见高密度影
text_en: Postoperative status in the left lower lobe dorsal segment; no thickened soft tissue density at the bronchial stump, with a nodular opacity in the left lower lobe basal segment unchanged from previous (IMA47), showing coarse linear opacities at the margin and high-density shadow at the margin.

source_text: 右肺下叶微小结节影同前（IM44）
text_en: Right lower lobe tiny nodular opacity unchanged (IM44)

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段结节大致同前，约12mm（IM30），周围边界部分欠清楚
text_en: A nodule in the left upper lobe lingular segment is roughly similar to previous, approximately 12 mm (IM30), with partially indistinct margins.

source_text: 胸壁诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: No evidence of bone destruction in the chest wall bones.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节较前相仿，仍约10x9mm（IM27）
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe remains similar in size compared to prior, still approximately 10 x 9 mm (Image 27).

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，未见异常增大者
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, no abnormal enlargement seen.

source_text: 左肺尖小结节，仍约6mm（IM15），倾向转移，追查
text_en: Small nodule at the left lung apex, still approximately 6 mm (IM15), favored as metastasis, under investigation.

source_text: 肝S1结节同前
text_en: Nodule in liver segment S1 unchanged.

source_text: 右侧水平裂叶间胸膜小结节同前，仍约4mm（IMA33），余双侧胸膜光滑，未见胸水征象
text_en: Small pleural nodule along the right horizontal fissure is stable, still measuring approximately 4 mm (IMA33). The remainder of the bilateral pleura are smooth, with no signs of pleural effusion.

source_text: 右肺上叶小钙化灶同前，余肺未见新生结节
text_en: Right upper lobe small calcified focus unchanged; remainder of lungs show no new nodules

source_text: 双肺小结节同前相仿，小于5mm（IM20、23、43），未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior, all less than 5 mm (IM20, 23, 43); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 余肺未见新发病变
text_en: No new abnormalities are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 右侧胸膜结节缩小，原约5mm（IM43），现约3mm（IM42）
text_en: The right pleural nodule has decreased in size, previously approximately 5 mm (IM43), now approximately 3 mm (IM42).

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后，支气管断端未见新发软组织密度占位征象
text_en: Status post left lower lobectomy, no new soft tissue density space-occupying lesions at the bronchial stump.

source_text: 两肺胸膜下散在小结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: Scattered small subpleural nodules in both lungs are stable, likely benign.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段肿块较前相仿，较大层面约21x16mm（IM20），内见钙化灶，边界不清

text_en: Nodular change is noted in the left adrenal gland confluence area, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶癌大致同前
text_en: Right upper lobe carcinoma, largely unchanged.

text_en: Focal small nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged (IM17).

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结部分同前,部分较前饱满
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes: some unchanged, some appear more prominent compared to previous.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端术后改变同前，右肺多发索条影同前，双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; postoperative changes at the bronchial stump are stable. Multiple linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下结节较前相仿，仍约8mm（Im13），右肺下叶条状结节同前（IM32）
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural nodule similar to previous, still approximately 8mm (Im13); right lower lobe linear nodule unchanged (IM32)

text_en: The tiny nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged (IMA23, 24).

text_en: No osseous destruction foci are seen in the imaged bones.

text_en: Tiny nodules and calcified small nodules in the right lower lobe are stable, approximately 2 mm (IM42)

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节灶同前，约18*15mm（IMA15），左肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节密度稍增高，范围略增大，原约22*15mm（IMA26）及19*15mm（IMA 27），现约24*16mm（IMA25）及23*16mm（IMA26），建议临床追查
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged, approximately 18x15 mm (IMA15); ground-glass opacity nodules in the left upper lobe show slightly increased density and slight increase in size, previously approximately 22x15 mm (IMA26) and 19x15 mm (IMA27), now approximately 24x16 mm (IMA25) and 23x16 mm (IMA26); clinical follow-up is recommended

source_text: 右侧胸膜见15x8mm大小结节（IM22)，转移不除外，追查
text_en: A 15 x 8 mm nodule is seen in the right pleura (IM22); metastasis cannot be excluded; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺索条影、右肺胸膜下多发小结节同前，较大仍约6mm（IM39）
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lung and multiple small subpleural nodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior study (IM39); the largest remains approximately 6 mm.

text_en: Leftward shift of the mediastinum unchanged, cystic low-density area adjacent to the main pulmonary artery in the mediastinum roughly unchanged, previously approximately 40x16mm (IM26), now approximately 44x12mm (IM27), considered benign, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结大致同前，追查
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are largely unchanged from prior; follow-up recommended.

text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no new space-occupying lesions.

text_en: Several lymph nodes are seen in mediastinal stations 2R, 5, and 7, which are similar to prior, with the largest still measuring approximately 9x6 mm (IM27)

text_en: Multiple nodules and masses in the left pleura and subpleural region are larger than prior; for example, previously approximately 31x22 mm, now approximately 41x24 mm (IM30).

text_en: A small flat nodule is seen along the left oblique fissure pleura, unchanged, measuring approximately 5x2 mm (IM30).

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，约11mm（IM35）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 11 mm (IM35).

text_en: Scattered linear opacities are present in the right lung. A faint small nodule in the right lower lobe remains stable, still measuring approximately 5 mm (IM41).

text_en: Mediastinal stations 4, 5, 7, and 10 lymph nodes similar to prior, approximately 13x9 mm (IM23).

text_en: The small subpleural nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior (IM16).

text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 5-6 unchanged, largest approximately 14x8 mm (IM22); left supraclavicular lymph node unchanged, approximately 10 mm (IM6); no enlarged lymph nodes seen in bilateral hilar, right supraclavicular, or bilateral axillary regions.

text_en: Nodules and patchy opacities in the right middle and lower lobes are larger compared to prior; metastasis is considered.

text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, largest short axis approximately 10 mm (IM11).

text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, favoring benign.

text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged; mild thickening of the right pleura is noted; further follow-up is recommended.

text_en: The nodule in the lateral basal segment of the right lower lobe is smaller compared to prior imaging.

text_en: Scattered small nodules in the bilateral lower lungs are unchanged in number; some are larger than prior. The nodule in the left lower lung now measures approximately 17x15 mm (IM45), previously measuring 13x11 mm (IM46).

text_en: A 3 mm tiny nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM23).

text_en: New multifocal small nodules are seen in the remaining lung. The largest measures approximately 5 mm (IM26).

text_en: In the junctional region of the middle-lower thoracic esophagus, wall thickening has worsened compared to prior. Current maximum transverse diameter of the wall is approximately 53x31 mm (IM32), previously 42x30 mm. There is marked heterogeneous enhancement and luminal narrowing.

text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Multiple calcified nodules are seen in the lungs, unchanged from prior, most prominent in the left upper lobe.

text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes decreased in size compared to previous, currently approximately 12x10 mm (Figure 24), previously approximately 18x15 mm (IM25).

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段小结节大小及密度大致同前
text_en: The small nodule in the basal segment of the left lower lobe shows stable size and density compared to prior.

text_en: CT shows increased bone density in the L1 vertebral body; further evaluation is recommended to exclude metastasis.

text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph node enlarged compared to prior, follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔、左侧锁骨上淋巴结同前，较大约14x8mm（IM28）
text_en: Mediastinal and left supraclavicular lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest approximately 14x8 mm (IM28)

source_text: 右肺类结节影同前（IMA28）
text_en: Nodular shadow in the right lung is unchanged compared to prior (IMA28).

text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged, still measuring approximately 21x13 mm (IM28).

text_en: Enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 5-6 increased in size, previously largest approximately 21x19 mm (IM19), now approximately 30x23 mm (IM20).

text_en: Faint small nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior, still measuring approximately 5x3 mm (IM30).

text_en: Chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesions.

text_en: Mediastinal stations 4-5 lymph nodes unchanged from previous, the larger one approximately 21x7 mm (IM16).

text_en: Left upper lobe nodule unchanged, approximately 3 mm (Image 11), no new nodules or patchy opacities in both lungs.

text_en: The linear opacities and the small nodules in the left lung are unchanged, about 3 mm (IM40).
