source_text: 右上肺和左下肺结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: Nodules in the right upper lung and left lower lung are unchanged, favoring benign etiology.

source_text: 左肺微小结节同前
text_en: Tiny nodule in the left lung unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段胸膜下模糊小结节同前（IM26）
text_en: Ill-defined small subpleural nodule in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe, unchanged from prior (IM26).

source_text: 左肺上叶切除术后，支气管断端未见复发征象
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, no evidence of recurrence at bronchial stump.

source_text: 左肺门结节大致同前，仍约19x10mm(IM30 纵隔窗)，病灶远端见条索影，其旁多发结节同前，较大仍约15x12mm（IM27）
text_en: Left hilar nodule is similar to previous, still approximately 19x10mm (IM30 mediastinal window); distal to the lesion, linear opacities are seen, and multiple adjacent nodules are similar to previous, the largest still approximately 15x12mm (IM27).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段肿块较前相仿，较大层面约21x18mm（IM19），内见钙化灶，边界不清
text_en: The mass in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment is similar to prior, with a maximum dimension of approximately 21x18 mm (IM19), containing a calcification, and ill-defined margins

source_text: 纵隔4组多发小淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in mediastinal station 4 are stable compared to prior

source_text: 右肺下叶不规则小结节同前，约5mm（IM37）
text_en: Irregular small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM37).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段切除术后，支气管断端周围及缝线旁见软组织影，与增大淋巴结及邻近血管影分界不清，较前变扁长，大致范围原约44x24mm（纵隔窗IM41），相应层面现约46x19mm（IM38）
text_en: Postoperative status following resection of the right lower lobe posterior segment; soft tissue density is seen around the bronchial stump and suture site, indistinct from enlarged lymph nodes and adjacent vascular structures, now more flattened and elongated; approximate size previously 44x24 mm (mediastinal window, IM41), currently 46x19 mm at corresponding level (IM38).

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则结节同前相仿，较大截面约27x18mm（IM15），内部见不规则空洞
text_en: Irregular nodule in the left upper lobe is similar to prior, with largest cross-section measuring approximately 27 x 18 mm (IM15), and an irregular cavity is seen within.

source_text: 右下肺少许索条影及左肺小结节同前无变化（IM26、30）
text_en: Few fibrotic bands in the right lower lobe and a small nodule in the left lung are unchanged compared to prior (IM26, 30).

source_text: 左肺下叶斑片状影增大，呈结节状，转移不能除外，请结合临床明确
text_en: Patchy shadow in the left lower lobe increased in size, nodular in appearance, metastasis cannot be excluded; clinical correlation necessary for clarification

source_text: 右肺条索影、双肺模糊小结节同前相仿
text_en: Linear opacities in the right lung and hazy small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior.

source_text: 纵膈及左侧锁骨上淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal and left supraclavicular lymph nodes unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺上叶索条伴钙化结节影同前，约10x7mm(IM15)
text_en: The linear opacity with calcified nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 10x7 mm (IM15).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段磨玻璃密度结节同前，建议追查
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the left upper lobe anterior segment is unchanged. Follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右上肺尖多个高密度结节同前，右肺上叶后段卵圆形结节灶同前，约9x7mm（IM21）
text_en: Multiple high-density nodules in the right upper lung apex are unchanged; oval nodular focus in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 9x7 mm (IM21).

source_text: 左肺下叶背段胸膜下小结节灶基本同前，大小约8x6mm（IM33）
text_en: A subpleural small nodule focus in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 8x6 mm (IM33).

source_text: 右侧胸膜下微小结节较前无明显变化
text_en: Subpleural micronodules in the right lung are without significant change compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺间质纤维化大致同前，左肺下叶片状影同前，两肺未见新发结节影
text_en: Pulmonary interstitial fibrosis is generally unchanged from prior; a patchy opacity in the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior; no new nodules are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺结节同前，余肺未见新生结节灶
text_en: Right lung nodule unchanged; no new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下小结节同前（IM19、44）
text_en: Subpleural small nodule in the right lung is unchanged from prior (IM19, 44)

source_text: 右肺中叶微小结节及索条影同前，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: Micro-nodules and linear opacities in the right middle lobe are unchanged, likely representing old/chronic changes.

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结较前相仿，4R组仍约8mm（IMA21），密切观察
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes are similar to prior; 4R group remains approximately 8 mm (IMA21), close observation.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上及腋窝未见新发肿大淋巴结
text_en: No new enlarged lymph nodes seen in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular areas, and axillae.

source_text: 前纵隔椭圆形结节同前，约17x11mm（IM36），内见钙化
text_en: Oval nodule in the anterior mediastinum is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 17x11 mm (IM36), with calcification present.

source_text: 左肺下叶微小结节同前，约3mm（IM27）
text_en: Left lower lobe small nodule unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IM27).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见异常软组织密度肿块影，右肺索条影同前，右肺下叶斑片索条状影同前（IM45）
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no abnormal soft tissue density mass is seen at the bronchial stump. Linear opacities in the right lung are stable. Patchy and linear opacities in the right lower lobe are stable compared to prior (IM45).

source_text: 左肺尖小结节较前增大，原约6x5mm（IM15），现约7x6mm（IM13）
text_en: Left apical segment: small nodule increased compared to previous, previously approximately 6x5 mm (IM15), now approximately 7x6 mm (IM13).

source_text: 锁骨上区及双腋下平扫未见新发明显肿大淋巴结
text_en: No new significantly enlarged lymph nodes seen in the supraclavicular region and bilateral axillae on non-contrast scan

source_text: 余肺多发不张实变范围较前相仿，右上肺微小结节同前（IM18），余双肺未见明确新发结节
text_en: The extent of multifocal atelectasis and consolidation in the remaining lung is similar to prior. The tiny nodule in the right upper lobe is stable (IM18). No definite new nodules are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 纵隔散在淋巴结同前，3-8mm
text_en: Scattered mediastinal lymph nodes same as before, 3-8 mm.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前，仍约4mm（Im28）
text_en: Tiny nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior, still measuring approximately 4 mm (Im28).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结大致同前，较大仍约15x10mm（IM27)
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior; largest approximately 15 × 10 mm (IM27).

source_text: 纵隔多个淋巴结大致同前，较大仍约10x7mm（IM19）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes essentially unchanged from previous, the largest still approximately 10x7 mm (IM19)

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见新发软组织密度占位
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, no new soft tissue density mass at the bronchial stump

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后，双肺微小点灶同前考虑陈旧灶，未见新生占位
text_en: Post-left lower lobectomy, bilateral pulmonary micronodules unchanged from prior are considered old lesions, and no new mass is seen.

source_text: 双肺数枚小结节同前，右肺下叶背段小结节仍约7*4mm（IM30），右肺下叶后基底段小结节仍约3mm（IM40）
text_en: Several small nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior. The nodule in the right lower lobe, dorsal segment, measures approximately 7x4 mm (IM30). The nodule in the right lower lobe, posterior basal segment, measures approximately 3 mm (IM40).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃样结节大致同前，约7*6mm(图23)
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 7 x 6 mm (Figure 23).

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段多发微小结节同前，聚集分布（IM44），左肺下叶后基底段新见一处钙化灶（IMA51）
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in the left lung lower lobe posterior basal segment unchanged from prior with clustered distribution (IM44); a newly noted calcified focus in the left lung lower lobe posterior basal segment (IMA51)

source_text: 左肺小结节同前（IM35、36），余双未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Small nodules in the left lung unchanged from prior (IM35, 36), no new nodules or consolidation in the remaining bilateral lungs.

source_text: 散在微小结节同前（Im28）
text_en: Scattered tiny nodules unchanged (Im28).

source_text: 纵隔4R、7组及右肺门淋巴结较前相仿，较大仍约11mm（IM17）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 4R and 7 and the right hilum are similar to prior, with the largest remaining approximately 11 mm (IM17).

source_text: 左侧胸膜增厚较前稍明显，未见胸水，胸膜转移待排，密切追查
text_en: Left pleural thickening is slightly more prominent than prior; no pleural effusion is seen. Pleural metastasis cannot be excluded; close follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右侧胸膜略增厚较前明显且范围增大，现较厚约13mm(图29)，原约7mm(图25)
text_en: The right pleural thickening is now more pronounced and increased in extent compared to prior, measuring up to approximately 13 mm (Figure 29), previously about 7 mm (Figure 25).

source_text: 左下肺磨玻璃密度影同前，右下肺微结节同前，观察
text_en: Ground-glass opacity in the left lower lobe is unchanged; tiny nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged; observation recommended.

source_text: 双肺小点状结节影同前（IM12、17、24、31）
text_en: Multiple small punctate nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged (IM12, 17, 24, 31).

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门及右侧锁骨上区小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, and right supraclavicular region unchanged from previous.

source_text: 双肺术后改变同前，胸部CT未见新增占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the lungs are unchanged; chest CT shows no new mass lesion.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节同前
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged.

source_text: 左下肺门区占位较前略大，远端肺不张增大
text_en: The mass in the left lower hilum is slightly larger than before. The distal atelectasis has increased.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段胸膜下实性-磨玻璃密度结节较前无明显变化，大小约9x5mm（IM26），形态不规则，边缘模糊，局部与侧胸膜粘连改变同前相仿
text_en: The subpleural solid–ground-glass density nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe shows no significant change compared to prior, measuring approximately 9x5 mm (IM26); it has an irregular shape, blurred margins, and local adhesion to the lateral pleura, similar to prior findings.

source_text: 食管癌术后较前相仿，吻合口壁未见增厚及结节
text_en: Postoperative esophageal cancer similar to prior; anastomotic wall shows no thickening or nodules.

source_text: 右上肺不规则磨玻璃密度病灶较前略增大，进一步检查或密切观察
text_en: Irregular ground-glass opacity in the right upper lung has slightly increased in size compared to prior; further evaluation or close observation is recommended.

source_text: 胸部CT平扫所见大致同前，未见新生占位
text_en: Findings on chest CT scan roughly unchanged from prior. No new mass lesions seen.

source_text: 左肺下叶结节增大，考虑转移
text_en: Left lower lobe nodule increased in size; consider metastasis.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结及淋巴结钙化同前
text_en: The mediastinal lymph nodes and lymph node calcifications are unchanged

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度小结节同前相仿，病灶微小，建议常规1年1次CT随诊5年
text_en: Small ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior; the lesion is minimal. Recommend routine CT follow-up annually for 5 years.

source_text: 甲状腺左叶低密度结节大致同前
text_en: Left thyroid lobe low-density nodule stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段可见一浅淡磨玻璃密度结节同前，约3mm（IM18）
text_en: A faint ground-glass density nodule is visible in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe, stable compared to prior, approximately 3 mm (IM18).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段结节较前略饱满，原短径约13mm（IM18），现约15mm（IM19），周围不规则索条同前
text_en: The nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe appears slightly more prominent; the previous short diameter was approximately 13 mm (IM18), now approximately 15 mm (IM19); the surrounding irregular linear opacities remain unchanged.

source_text: 右上肺纵隔旁片状影范围较前增大（IMA13），余肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: The extent of the patchy opacity adjacent to the mediastinum in the right upper lung is larger than prior (IMA13); no new nodules are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 左侧腋窝淋巴结增大，现约21*14mm(图15)，原约15*13mm(图14)，转移
text_en: Left axillary lymph node enlargement, currently approximately 21 x 14 mm (Figure 15), previously approximately 15 x 13 mm (Figure 14), suggestive of metastasis

source_text: 右肺索条影同前，左肺下叶胸膜下浅淡模糊小结节同前（IM48），左肺少许索条影同前，余肺未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: Fibrotic band in the right lung is stable compared to prior; the faint, indistinct small subpleural nodule in the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior (IM48); minimal fibrotic bands in the left lung are stable; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔平扫小淋巴结影同前相仿
text_en: Non-contrast mediastinal CT demonstrates small lymph nodes unchanged and similar to prior findings.

source_text: 左肺未见新发结节斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities in the left lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段磨玻璃密度小结节同前（IM50）
text_en: A small ground-glass opacity nodule in the left lower lobe posterior basal segment is the same as previous (IM50).

source_text: 右侧第四肋骨术后改变同前，邻近胸膜增厚较前明显，现约8mm(图16)，原约6mm(图18)
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right 4th rib are unchanged. Adjacent pleural thickening is more prominent than before, now approximately 8 mm (Figure 16), previously about 6 mm (Figure 18).

source_text: 两肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidations seen in both lungs.

source_text: 后下纵隔分叶状肿物大小同前
text_en: Lobulated mass in the posterior inferior mediastinum, size unchanged from prior

source_text: 右肺中叶斑片影同前，倾向良性纤维化病灶，追查
text_en: Patchy opacity in the right middle lobe unchanged compared to prior; favors benign fibrotic lesion; recommend follow-up

source_text: 纵隔散在小淋巴结大致同前，较大约8x7mm（IM23）
text_en: Scattered small mediastinal lymph nodes roughly unchanged from prior; the larger node measures approximately 8x7 mm (station IM23).

source_text: 左锁骨上、余纵膈多发小淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region and remaining mediastinum unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段结节影较前略增大
text_en: Left lower lobe basal segment nodule opacity slightly increased compared to previous.

source_text: 右肺散在模糊小结节较前减少，部分呈树丫状改变同前
text_en: Scattered hazy small nodules in the right lung are decreased in number compared to prior; some show tree-in-bud pattern, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左侧肾上腺结节大致同前，仍约22x16mm（IMA62）
text_en: Left adrenal nodule remains stable, measuring approximately 22x16 mm (IMA62).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段胸膜下微小结节同前，小于2mm（IM23）
text_en: The subpleural micro-nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe remains unchanged, measuring less than 2 mm (IM23).

source_text: 右肺上叶贴水平裂处结节同前，约6x5mm（IM28）
text_en: Nodule adjacent to the horizontal fissure in the right upper lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 6x5 mm (IM28).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节灶治疗后，范围较前略小，现约21x17mm（IM15），原约24x16mm（IM15），密度增高，邻近胸膜下新见斑片影
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is slightly smaller post-treatment, now approximately 21x17 mm (IM15), previously approximately 24x16 mm (IM15), with increased density; new patchy opacity is seen subpleurally adjacent to the nodule

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段结节略增大，原约9x4mm（IM21），现约10x6mm（IM22），前段支气管血管束旁小结节较前增大，原约3mm（IM26），现约7mm（IM26）
text_en: The nodule in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment has slightly increased in size from approximately 9x4 mm (IM21) to approximately 10x6 mm (IM22). The small nodule adjacent to the bronchovascular bundle in the anterior segment has increased from approximately 3 mm (IM26) to approximately 7 mm (IM26).

source_text: 右腋下淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Right axillary lymph nodes are unchanged compared to prior, follow-up recommended

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见占位征象，左肺复张可，条索影同前
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, no space-occupying lesion at bronchial stump; left lung re-expansion satisfactory; linear opacities unchanged from prior.

source_text: 两肺点状小结节大致同前，约4mm（IM15、18、25）
text_en: The punctate small nodules in both lungs are approximately unchanged, about 4 mm (IM15, 18, 25).

source_text: 双肺内未见新发病灶
text_en: No new lesions are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，肺内透亮度均匀，未见新发结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. Lung lucency is uniform. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，右肺中叶支气管截断，肺组织不张，局部结节影较前增大，现约19*14mm（IMA27）
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; right middle lobe bronchial cutoff with atelectasis. The local nodule has increased in size compared to prior, now approximately 19 x 14 mm (IMA27).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段见类圆形磨玻璃密度结节同前，约10x8mm（SE307 IM21），内未见实性密度影，边缘光滑，未见索条及毛刺影
text_en: A round ground-glass opacity nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe, unchanged from previous, approximately 10x8mm (SE307 IM21), with no solid component, smooth margins, and no spiculations or linear opacities seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶贴斜裂胸膜小结节同前（Im29）
text_en: A small subpleural nodule adjacent to the oblique fissure in the right upper lobe is unchanged from prior (Im29).

source_text: 右肺癌及淋巴结转移均较前缩小
text_en: Right lung cancer and lymph node metastases are both smaller compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段纵隔旁占位较前增大，原约51x36mm（IM18），现约75x68mm（IM21），病灶与远端肺不张融合，呈多发分叶，左肺上叶支气管狭窄截断较前明显
text_en: Mass adjacent to the mediastinum in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe increased in size, previously approximately 51x36 mm (IM18), now approximately 75x68 mm (IM21). The lesion is fused with distal atelectasis, showing multiple lobulations. Left upper lobe bronchial stenosis and cutoff more obvious than before

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结同前，仍约16x8mm（IM23）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are stable, measuring approximately 16x8 mm (IM23).

source_text: 新发多发小结节
text_en: Newly developed multiple small nodules

source_text: 隆突下肿大淋巴结较前缩小，现约13x9mm（IM30），原约较大者约17x15mm（IMA31）
text_en: Enlarged subcarinal lymph nodes reduced compared to prior, now approximately 13x9 mm (IM30), previously the larger one approximately 17x15 mm (IMA31).

source_text: 右肺中叶新见模糊微小结节影（IMA35）
text_en: A new faint micronodule is seen in the right middle lobe (IMA35).

source_text: 余双肺多发小结节同前，较大约4mm（IM21）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the remainder of both lungs are unchanged; the largest measures approximately 4 mm (IM21).

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，左肺下叶背段胸膜下钙化微结节影同前，约2mm（IMA33）
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. The subpleural calcified micronodule in the left lower lobe posterior segment is stable, measuring approximately 2 mm (IMA33).

source_text: 前纵隔结节同前，追查
text_en: Nodule in the anterior mediastinum is stable compared to prior, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双肺散在微小结节灶同前，较大者约5mm（IM44）
text_en: Scattered tiny nodular foci in both lungs are unchanged, largest approximately 5 mm (IM44).

source_text: 左肺胸膜下钙化灶同前，余双肺未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: Left lung subpleural calcified focus unchanged, remainder of both lungs no new nodules or patchy opacities

source_text: 左肺上叶前段模糊小结节同前，约3mm（IM23）
text_en: An ill-defined small nodule in the left upper lobe anterior segment, approximately 3 mm, is unchanged (IM23).

source_text: 缩小
text_en: Decreased.

source_text: 右肺下叶结节同前，约5mm（IM31）
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM31).

source_text: 原双肺多发结节部分被掩盖、部分同前（IM25）
text_en: Some of the previously noted multiple nodules in both lungs are obscured, while others are unchanged (IM25).

source_text: 右肺点灶及左肺下叶小结节影同前

text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 7 x 5 mm (Figure 46).

text_en: Mass adjacent to the superior vena cava increased in size compared to prior

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R组淋巴结同前，大者仍约12x8mm（IM20），平扫密度略高同前
text_en: Lymph nodes at mediastinal stations 2R and 4R are stable, largest still approximately 12x8 mm (IM20), with slightly higher density on non-contrast scan unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺门区淋巴结大致同前，约17x11mm（Im28）
text_en: Lymph nodes in the right hilar region are essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 17 x 11 mm (Im28).

source_text: 甲状腺左叶低密度小结节同前
text_en: Low-density small nodule in the left thyroid lobe, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜见小结节同前（IM42）
text_en: A small nodule along the right interlobar pleura is unchanged (IM42).

source_text: T8椎体血管瘤同前，胸10椎体高密度灶较前无变化，余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Hemangioma in T8 vertebral body unchanged; high-density focus in T10 vertebral body stable compared to prior; no evidence of osseous destruction in the remainder of the visualized thoracic skeleton

source_text: 余双肺支气管通畅，右肺尖小磨玻璃样灶同前相仿（IM7），余肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Bronchi in both lungs are patent; the small ground-glass opacity focus at the right lung apex is similar to prior (IM7); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R、7组淋巴结较前缩小，原较大约11x10mm（IM17），现约7x4mm（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R, 4R, and 7 are decreased in size compared to prior; the largest previously measured approximately 11x10 mm (Image 17) and now measures approximately 7x4 mm (Image 21).

source_text: 左侧胸膜小结节同前（Im25），右侧未见显示
text_en: Small nodules in the left pleura are stable compared to prior (IM25); no right-sided pleural nodules are seen.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，约14x10mm（Im27）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node unchanged, measuring approximately 14 x 10 mm (Im27)

source_text: 右肺上叶癌及纵隔肿大淋巴结，大致同前
text_en: Right upper lobe carcinoma and enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes, largely unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 扫及左乳内侧象限见小结节同前（IM23），建议结合乳腺检查
text_en: A small nodule is noted in the inner quadrant of the left breast, unchanged from prior (Im23), with recommendation to correlate with breast examination.

source_text: 余两肺多个小结节同前（IM19、30等)
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the remainder of both lungs are unchanged (IM19, 30, etc.).

source_text: 双肺胸膜下微小结节同前
text_en: Subpleural micronodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶缝合线同前，索条影同前，局部可疑结节（IM25、26），密切追查
text_en: Suture line in the right lower lobe unchanged; linear opacity unchanged. A focal area of possible nodule is seen at IM25 and IM26; close follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 原双肺多发微小结节此次扫描显示欠清，未见新增结节灶
text_en: Previously noted multiple micronodules in both lungs are poorly visualized on this scan; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下浅淡小结节影同前（IMA36）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural faint small nodule unchanged (Image 36)

source_text: 扫及上腹部胃左动脉旁小淋巴结较前缩小，现约6x4mm（IMA62），原约9x6mm
text_en: A small lymph node adjacent to the left gastric artery in the upper abdomen has decreased in size compared to prior, currently approximately 6x4 mm (IMA62), previously approximately 9x6 mm

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前（IM40）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is unchanged from prior (IM40).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段结节同前，形态不规则，边缘毛糙，仍约10x7mm（IM18）
text_en: The nodule in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment is unchanged from previous, irregular in shape, spiculated margins, still approximately 10x7 mm (IM18).

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段可见一磨玻璃密度结节同前，大小约20x19mm（IM38），边界较清晰，内实性成分不明显以磨玻璃密度为主
text_en: A ground-glass opacity nodule is visible in the outer basal segment of the right lower lobe, unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 20x19 mm (IM38), with relatively well-defined boundaries and no obvious solid component, predominantly ground-glass in density.

source_text: 右肺尖不规则斑片结节并胸膜增厚、索条及右肺内钙化影大致同前
text_en: The irregular patchy nodule at the right lung apex with pleural thickening, linear opacities, and calcifications in the right lung is essentially unchanged.

source_text: 双肺上叶实性-磨玻璃结节灶较前增大，倾向恶性
text_en: Solid and ground-glass nodule in the upper lobe of both lungs is increased in size compared to prior; malignancy is favored.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管残端少许软组织密度灶范围较前缩小，未见占位征象，考虑术后改变
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; a small soft tissue density at the bronchial stump has decreased in size compared to prior. No mass is identified. Findings are consistent with postoperative change.

source_text: 纵膈7组淋巴结同前，约18x10mm（IMA27）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph node at station 7 unchanged from previous, approximately 18x10 mm (IMA27).

source_text: 右肺下叶浅淡小结节同前，约3mm（IM32），追查
text_en: The faint small nodule in the right lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM32); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶多发转移部分较前进展
text_en: Multiple metastases in the left lower lobe, some have progressed compared to previous.

source_text: 甲状腺左叶钙化及稍低密度结节影同前
text_en: Left thyroid lobe calcification and slightly low-density nodule stable.

source_text: 左肺尖微小结节同前
text_en: Tiny nodule at the left lung apex unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶、上叶及近下叶膈面小结节较前缩小模糊，较大原约7mm（IM28），现约4mm（IM27）
text_en: Small nodules in the left lower lobe, upper lobe, and near the diaphragmatic surface of the lower lobe are smaller and more indistinct compared to prior. The largest was previously approximately 7mm (IM28) and is now approximately 4mm (IM27).

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段类结节影同前，约5mm（IM26）
text_en: Nodular opacity in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged, approximately 5 mm (IM26).

source_text: 双肺小结节同前（IM11、22、31），均小于10mm
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are stable compared to prior (IM11, 22, 31), all less than 10 mm

source_text: 前纵隔低密度灶边界清，原约20x15mm（IM16），现约22x17mm（IM18）
text_en: Well-circumscribed low-density focus in the anterior mediastinum is stable compared to prior, previously approximately 20x15 mm (IM16), now approximately 22x17 mm (IM18).

source_text: 余双肺胸膜下多发小结节大致同前，较大仍约3-4mm(IM47、48)
text_en: The multiple small subpleural nodules in the remainder of both lungs are essentially stable, largest still approximately 3-4 mm (IM47, 48).

source_text: 右上叶术后，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Postoperative status of the right upper lobe; no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis are seen.

source_text: 左肺下叶癌疗后，胸部CT所见大致同前
text_en: Post-treatment for left lower lobe lung cancer, chest CT findings are similar to previous.

source_text: 双肺多发占位大致同前
text_en: Multiple space-occupying lesions in both lungs are essentially unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶钙化同前（IM49），余肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Calcification in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (IM49); no new nodules or consolidations in the remaining lung.

source_text: 右肺下叶斜裂旁小结节同前，约4mm（IM37）
text_en: The small nodule adjacent to the oblique fissure of the right lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM37).

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门淋巴结较前增大，右侧锁骨上区淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes increased in size compared to previous, right supraclavicular lymph nodes unchanged from previous.

source_text: 气管右旁转移淋巴结较前相仿
text_en: Metastatic lymph node at right paratracheal region similar to prior

source_text: 右肺下叶背段新生结节，转移
text_en: New nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe, suggestive of metastasis.

source_text: 纵隔5组淋巴结同前（IMA19）
text_en: Mediastinal station 5 lymph nodes unchanged from previous (IMA19).

source_text: 两肺散在索条小结节影大致同前
text_en: Scattered linear and small nodular opacities in both lungs, largely unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，隆突下较大者约17*10mm（IM25）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged, the largest subcarinal approximately 17x10 mm (IM25).

source_text: 双侧胸膜欠光滑，见不规则小结节样增厚同前（IM31、38、41、44）
text_en: Bilateral pleura are irregular and not smooth, showing irregular small nodular thickening, unchanged from prior (IM31, 38, 41, 44).

source_text: 周围可见新发小结节，约3mm（IM26)，考虑转移可能大，追查
text_en: New small nodules are seen in the surrounding area, approximately 3 mm (IM26), with a high possibility of metastasis; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶前基底段结节较前减小，原大小约12mm×9mm（IMA52），现大小约8mm×7mm（IM49）
text_en: Nodule in the anterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is smaller compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 12 mm × 9 mm (IMA52), now measuring approximately 8 mm × 7 mm (IM49).

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见异常软组织密度影，双肺上叶磨玻璃结节影同前，较大约5mm（IM20）
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no abnormal soft tissue density at the bronchial stump. Ground-glass nodules in the upper lobes are stable compared to prior, the largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM20).

source_text: 左肺内局限性索条影同前，余双肺未见新增结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: Localized linear opacity in left lung unchanged from previous, no new nodules or patchy opacities in remaining bilateral lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后，支气管残端及缝线周围新见软组织结节，较大约23x18mm（IM20），复发可能
text_en: Status post left lower lobectomy, new soft tissue nodule around bronchial stump and sutures, measuring approximately 23x18mm (Image 20), possible recurrence.

source_text: 扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏
text_en: No bone destruction observed in the imaged bones.

source_text: 左锁骨上、纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，短径小于10mm
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region and mediastinum are similar to previous, with short axis less than 10 mm.

source_text: 扫及上腹部胰腺上方钙化结节、胆囊结石同前
text_en: A calcified nodule superior to the pancreas and gallstones in the upper abdomen are unchanged from prior

source_text: 右肺门及纵隔2R、4R组淋巴结较前相仿，较大位于纵隔4R组，约14x9mm（IM25）
text_en: Lymph nodes at the right hilum and mediastinal stations 2R and 4R are similar to prior, the largest is located in station 4R and measures approximately 14x9 mm (IM25)

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃结节较前相仿，恶性不除外，追查或活组织检查
text_en: Left upper lobe ground-glass nodule similar to prior, malignancy cannot be excluded, follow-up or biopsy

source_text: 肺内索条小结节同前（IMA16、29、47），左上较大者仍约4mm（IM16）
text_en: Intrapulmonary linear strands and small nodules unchanged from previous (IMA16, 29, 47), with the larger one in the left upper lobe still approximately 4 mm (IM16).

source_text: 右肺上叶混杂磨玻璃结节较前相仿（IM17）
text_en: Mixed ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior (IM17).

source_text: 两肺小结节同前，较大约5*4mm（IMA10）
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior, largest measuring approximately 5x4 mm (IMA10)

source_text: 右肺钙化及上叶（IM20）、中叶（IM38）小结节灶同前，右下肺个别小结节略饱满（IM26）
text_en: Calcification in the right lung and small nodular opacities in the upper lobe (IM20) and middle lobe (IM38) are unchanged compared to prior; a few small nodules in the right lower lobe are slightly more prominent (IM26).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段微小结节同前，约2mm（IM21）
text_en: The tiny nodule in the left upper lobe anterior segment is unchanged, measuring approximately 2 mm (IM21).

source_text: 右肺尖索条结节影同前（IM8），双肺多发条片影较前增多
text_en: Linear and nodular opacity in the right lung apex is unchanged compared to prior (IM8); multifocal linear and patchy opacities in both lungs have increased compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺微小结节同前（IM31），余肺未见新生结节或实变影
text_en: Right lung tiny nodules unchanged (IM31); remainder of lungs show no new nodules or consolidation

source_text: 纵隔多发肿大淋巴结稍缩小，较大原约18×13mm，现约17x11mm(图33)
text_en: Multiple enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes slightly decreased in size; largest previously approximately 18x13 mm, now approximately 17x11 mm (Figure 33).

source_text: 双肺小结节灶同前相仿，较大约6mm（Im51）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodule foci are similar to prior, largest approximately 6 mm (Im51)

source_text: 扫及胸壁诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: Scans show no bone destruction in the bones of the chest wall.

source_text: 双肺结节较前增大，原较大约13x13mm（IM45），现较大约24x22mm（IM42）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary nodules are larger than prior. The largest was previously approximately 13x13 mm (IM45), now approximately 24x22 mm (IM42).

source_text: 右肺下叶浅淡小结节同前，约3mm（IM29），追查
text_en: The faint small nodule in the right lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM29); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节较前缩小，余同前相仿
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe has decreased in size compared to prior; the remainder is stable.

source_text: 左侧斜裂胸膜小结节及双肺多发小结节同前
text_en: Small nodule along the left major fissure pleura and multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺门淋巴结较前缩小
text_en: Left hilar lymph nodes are decreased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 右侧锁骨上区淋巴结大致同前，较大现约12x9mm（IM5），追查
text_en: The lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region are generally unchanged from prior, with the largest now measuring approximately 12 x 9 mm (IM5); follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺舌段不规则稍高密度结节大致同前，约5x6mm（IM29）
text_en: Left lung lingular segment: irregular slightly hyperdense nodule essentially unchanged, approximately 5x6 mm (Image 29)

source_text: 右肺下叶不规则微小结节同前，＜5mm（IM39）
text_en: Irregular tiny nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, less than 5 mm (IM39).

source_text: 余双肺未见明确新发结节或斑片影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no definite new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段与背段交界处磨玻璃密度结节同前，现仍约7x6mm（IM33），边缘清楚，内部见血管穿行，未见明显实性成分
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule at the junction of the outer basal and dorsal segments of the right lower lobe is unchanged from prior, currently still approximately 7x6 mm (IM33), with clear margins, internal vascular passage visible, and no obvious solid component seen.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前（IM38），约3mm
text_en: Small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM38), approximately 3 mm.

source_text: 右肺内磨玻璃小结节大致同前
text_en: The ground-glass nodules in the right lung are essentially unchanged.

source_text: 食管胸中段管壁增厚减轻，原较厚处约9mm（IM34），现较厚处约6mm（IM36）
text_en: Wall thickening of the mid-thoracic esophagus is reduced, with previously thickest portion approximately 9 mm (IM34) and currently thickest portion approximately 6 mm (IM36).

source_text: 右肺中叶结节较前增大，现约19x12mm（IM40），原约12x6mm（IM42），胸膜牵拉内陷
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe has increased in size, currently measuring approximately 19 x 12 mm (IM40), previously 12 x 6 mm (IM42), with pleural retraction.

source_text: 左侧肾上腺小结节同前，良性可能大
text_en: Small nodule in the left adrenal gland is unchanged; benign etiology is more likely.

source_text: 右肺结节同前
text_en: Right lung nodule unchanged.

source_text: 新见少许索条结节
text_en: Newly identified a few linear nodules

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，胸部CT未见复发、转移征象
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, chest CT shows no evidence of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 左肺斑片索条影同前，双肺未见结节影
text_en: Patchy linear opacities in the left lung unchanged from previous, no nodules seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见异常软组织密度灶，局部胸膜增厚同前，贴纵隔旁呈含气液腔同前（IM28），周围肺内局限性索条及索条结节灶同前
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no abnormal soft tissue density at the bronchial stump. Local pleural thickening is stable compared to prior. A gas-fluid cavity adjacent to the mediastinum is stable (IM28). Focal linear bands and linear-nodular opacities in the surrounding lung parenchyma are stable.

source_text: 右肺索条、左肺上叶舌段胸膜下小结节同前（IM35）
text_en: Linear opacities in the right lung and a small subpleural nodule in the lingular segment of the left upper lobe are unchanged compared to prior (IM35).

source_text: 左肺下叶外基底段磨玻璃密度结节同前
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段多发结节，部分较前增大，转移待排，密切观察
text_en: Left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment: multiple nodules, some increased in size compared to prior, metastasis cannot be excluded, close observation recommended.

source_text: 肺内散在微小结节同前（Im33、38、45等），右肺上叶钙化点同前，余肺未见新生灶
text_en: Scattered small pulmonary nodules unchanged (images 33, 38, 45, etc.), calcified foci in the right upper lobe unchanged, no new lesions in the remaining lung.

source_text: 双肺转移灶较前增大
text_en: Pulmonary metastases in both lungs are larger than prior.

source_text: 食管裂孔旁、胃小弯侧小淋巴结同前（IM47、57）
text_en: Small lymph nodes adjacent to the esophageal hiatus and along the lesser curvature of the stomach unchanged from previous (IM47, 57).

source_text: 左肺上叶索条影、两肺下叶小结节影同前（IM40、46）
text_en: Left upper lobe linear opacity, small nodules in both lower lobes unchanged from prior (IM40, 46).

source_text: 右肺中叶及左肺下叶少许索条影同前，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Minor linear opacities in the right middle lobe and left lower lobe are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变同前，两肺小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lobe are unchanged. The small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior. Follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺叶间胸膜下三角形结节同前相仿（IM36）
text_en: A triangular-shaped nodule is seen beneath the interlobar pleura of the right lung, similar to prior study (IM36).

source_text: 纵隔4R、6、7、8、10组多发淋巴结较前缩小，较大原约15x12mm（IM20），现约15x8mm（IM19），双侧锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R, 6, 7, 8, and 10 are smaller than previous, with the largest previously measuring approximately 15x12 mm (IM20) and now approximately 15x8 mm (IM19); no enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes bilaterally

source_text: 新见一肿大淋巴结
text_en: Newly seen enlarged lymph node

source_text: 纵隔内4L及5组多发淋巴结较前增大，较大者现约18x14mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal multiple lymph nodes at stations 4L and 5, increased in size compared to previous; largest currently approximately 18x14 mm (IM20).

source_text: 左下肺胸膜下见微小结节同前，约2mm（IM39)
text_en: A tiny subpleural nodule is seen in the left lower lobe, unchanged, measuring approximately 2 mm (IM39).

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节及斜裂胸膜结节大致同前，仍约3mm（IM27、33）
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe and the pleural nodule along the oblique fissure are stable compared to prior, remaining approximately 3 mm (IM27, 33)

source_text: 左肺下叶外侧基底段约2mm结节同前（Im54）
text_en: Left lower lobe, lateral basal segment: nodule approximately 2 mm unchanged (Image 54).

source_text: 左肺尖磨玻璃密度结节同前，约8mm（IM12）
text_en: Ground-glass density nodule at the left lung apex unchanged from prior, approximately 8 mm (IM12).

source_text: 余双肺多发转移结节较前缩小减少、密度减低，现较大约6*5mm（IM28），原约7*6mm（IM30）
text_en: Residual multiple metastatic nodules in both lungs are smaller and fewer in number with decreased density compared to prior; the largest currently measures approximately 6x5 mm (IM28), previously 7x6 mm (IM30)

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结缩小，较大原约16x12mm（IM27），现约10x6mm（IM28）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node decreased in size; the largest was previously approximately 16x12 mm (IM27), now approximately 10x6 mm (IM28)

source_text: 左肺下叶浅淡小结节影同前相仿，建议追查
text_en: Left lower lobe faint small nodule similar to prior, recommend follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门部分淋巴结切除术后，纵隔1R、2R、4R及右锁骨上区多发淋巴结部分增大，如现22x18mm（IM15）者，原约20x16mm（IM13）

text_en: Left lower lobe linear opacities and scattered indistinct small nodular opacities in both lungs, size and extent similar to prior; largest still approximately 8x6 mm (IM79).

text_en: After chemotherapy for left lung mass, the soft tissue mass in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe has slightly decreased in size, previously approximately 46x35 mm (IM14), currently approximately 41x33 mm (IM13). The lesion still involves the apical pleura and adjacent mediastinal pleura with indistinct margins. Increased fat density around the left subclavian artery main trunk appears as soft tissue density (IM16). The bifurcation of the left subclavian artery still shows mild compression and deformation with soft tissue density encircling it, and the contact surface still greater than 90 degrees.

text_en: Degenerative changes in the thoracolumbar spine, no definite evidence of bone destruction.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段见类圆形磨玻璃密度结节同前，约10x8mm（SE307 IM17），内未见实性密度影，边缘光滑，未见索条及毛刺影
text_en: A round ground-glass opacity nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe, unchanged from previous, approximately 10x8mm (SE307 IM17), with no solid component, smooth margins, and no spiculations or linear opacities seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段结节缩小，现约23x20mm（IM11），原约26*23mm（IMA12），邻近肺内小结节同前，约6mm（IM12)，右肺点状钙化同前
text_en: The nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe has decreased in size, now measuring approximately 23x20 mm (IM11), previously 26x23 mm (IMA12). The adjacent small intrapulmonary nodule is stable at approximately 6 mm (IM12). Punctate calcification in the right lung is unchanged.

source_text: 右上肺索条及索条结节灶（IM13）、右肺中叶斜裂旁小片影同前（IM38）
text_en: Linear opacities and linear nodular foci in the right upper lung (IM13), and a small patchy opacity adjacent to the oblique fissure in the right middle lobe are unchanged (IM38).

source_text: 左肾上腺结节同前相仿
text_en: Left adrenal nodule similar to previous.

source_text: 左肺内小结节灶同前
text_en: Small nodule in left lung unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺下叶斑点灶及片絮灶较前增重，局部新见斑点及结节灶（IM35-39），追查
text_en: Patchy opacities and flecks in the right lower lobe are more prominent than prior, with new flecks and nodules locally (IM35-39), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 余肺多发片絮、磨玻璃及索条灶大致同前，双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Multifocal patchy, ground-glass, and linear opacities in the remaining lung are largely unchanged. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，胸部CT未见复发征象
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, chest CT shows no evidence of recurrence.

source_text: 左肺上叶斑片灶同前，其后下方磨玻璃结节同前，约9x7mm（IM24）
text_en: Patchy opacity in the left upper lobe unchanged; ground-glass nodule posterior-inferior to it unchanged, approximately 9x7 mm (IM24).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段结节同前，大小仍约7mm（IM29），左肺、右肺中叶、右肺斜裂可见多发结节影同前（IM32、35、39），直径小于5mm，余双肺纹理走行顺畅，余肺内透亮度均匀，未见结节或实变影
text_en: Left upper lobe anterior segment nodule stable, size still approximately 7 mm (IM29). Multiple nodules in left lung, right middle lobe, and right oblique fissure stable (IM32, 35, 39), diameter less than 5 mm. Remaining bilateral lungs with normal lung markings, homogeneous lucency, no nodules or consolidations seen.

source_text: 右肺新见小结节影，约3mm（IMA34）
text_en: Newly seen small nodule in the right lung, approximately 3 mm (IMA34).

source_text: 右肺中叶贴胸膜处小结节同前，约4x3mm（IM41）
text_en: Small nodule adjacent to the pleura in the right middle lobe, unchanged, measuring approximately 4x3 mm (IM41)

source_text: 纵隔2、4、7组淋巴结同前，较大约15x8mm（Im23）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2, 4, and 7 are unchanged from previous; the largest is approximately 15x8 mm (Im23).

source_text: 右肺门及纵隔小淋巴结影同前
text_en: Small lymph node shadows in the right hilar and mediastinal regions are similar to prior findings.

source_text: 双肺磨玻璃密度结节同前，
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodules in both lungs are similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶见不规则高密度微小结节同前（IM32）
text_en: An irregular high-density micro-nodule is seen in the right lower lobe, unchanged from prior (IM32).

source_text: 胸7椎体高密度小结节同前
text_en: Dense small nodule in T7 vertebra, unchanged from previous.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结同前，约12x7mm（IM30）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes unchanged from prior, approximately 12x7 mm (IM30).

source_text: 前纵隔肿物切除术后，上纵隔多发侧枝循环血管同前相仿，未见新发占位征象
text_en: Status post resection of anterior mediastinal mass. Multiple collateral vessels in the upper mediastinum are similar to prior. No new space-occupying lesion is seen.

source_text: 两肺散在模糊小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Scattered indistinct small nodules in both lungs, unchanged from prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右侧胸膜局限性结节样增厚同前
text_en: Focal nodular thickening of the right pleura is unchanged.

source_text: 双肺多发转移结节较前增大
text_en: Multiple metastatic nodules in both lungs have increased in size.

source_text: 右上纵隔气管旁及纵隔多发转移淋巴结较前增大
text_en: Multiple metastatic lymph nodes in the right upper mediastinum and mediastinum have increased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 左锁骨上小淋巴结同前，左上纵隔颈总动脉旁结节同前（IM9）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in left supraclavicular region unchanged from previous, and nodule adjacent to left common carotid artery in upper mediastinum unchanged from previous (IM9).

source_text: 扫及肝内多发低密度结节，脂肪肝同前，建议结合腹部检查
text_en: Multiple intrahepatic low-density nodules and fatty liver are unchanged from prior; correlation with abdominal examination is recommended.

source_text: 左侧肾上腺结节同前，复查
text_en: Nodule in the left adrenal gland is unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 两肺小结节大小大致同前，部分结节内可见新发小空腔，较大约5mm（IM20）
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs generally similar in size to prior; some nodules show new small cavities within, largest approximately 5 mm (IM20)

source_text: 左肺少许索条影大致同前，余肺未见新发灶
text_en: Left lung: few linear opacities largely same as before, remainder of lungs no new lesions seen.

source_text: 左肺上叶、左斜裂胸膜及右肺中叶微小结节同前（IM25、34、36、37、47）
text_en: Tiny nodules in the left upper lobe, left oblique fissure pleura, and right middle lobe are unchanged (IM25, 34, 36, 37, 47).

source_text: 甲状腺体积弥漫增大及左侧肾上腺结节同前
text_en: Diffuse thyroid gland enlargement and left adrenal nodule stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔及双肺门淋巴结同前，较大约11x8mm（IM27）
text_en: Lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions unchanged from previous, largest approximately 11x8 mm (IM27)

source_text: 右肺陈旧病灶同前
text_en: Chronic changes in the right lung are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节较前略缩小、边缘模糊，现约4mm(图47)，原约6mm（IMA44），观察，余未见结节或实变影
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe slightly smaller than before with ill-defined margins, currently approximately 4mm (Figure 47), previously approximately 6mm (Image A44), follow-up; no other nodules or consolidation seen.

source_text: 双肺下叶多个结节同前，较大仍约6mm（IM24）
text_en: Multiple nodules in the lower lobes of both lungs are unchanged compared to prior; the largest remains approximately 6 mm (IM24).

source_text: 左肺下叶类圆形小结节同前，直径仍约3mm（IM46），边缘尚光滑
text_en: The small round nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged, with a diameter still approximately 3 mm (IM46), and smooth margins.

source_text: 两肺散在多发小结节同前（Im11、13、21、37、49等），较大者约5mm（Im13）
text_en: The scattered multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (Im11, 13, 21, 37, 49, etc.); the largest is approximately 5 mm (Im13).

source_text: 左上肺癌术后，残端周围软组织大致同前，未见明显异常强化灶，考虑术后改变
text_en: Status post left upper lobe lung cancer surgery; soft tissue around the stump is largely unchanged compared to prior, with no abnormal enhancement focus seen; postoperative change is considered.

source_text: 平扫纵隔多发淋巴结同前，较大约16*8mm（IMA25）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, the largest measuring approximately 16x8 mm on image A25.

source_text: 锁骨上、纵隔淋巴结同前
text_en: Supraclavicular and mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from previous

source_text: 左肺上叶切除术后，支气管残端周围、左肺门区及纵隔旁局部未见增厚软组织影，积液吸收，左肺纤维条索影同前，余肺内未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: After left upper lobe resection, no thickened soft tissue density around the bronchial stump, left hilar region, or paravertebral mediastinum; pleural effusion absorbed; fibrous streaks in the left lung unchanged from prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remaining lung.

source_text: 纵隔5组、双腋下多发淋巴结部分较前饱满，较大原约8x7mm（IM21），现约10x8mm（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal station 5 and bilateral axillary multiple lymph nodes partially more prominent than before, largest previously approximately 8x7 mm (IM21), now approximately 10x8 mm (IM21).

source_text: 左肺小结节及叶间胸膜结节同前（IM23、35）
text_en: Small nodules in the left lung and interlobar pleural nodules unchanged from prior (IM23, 35).

source_text: 右肺中叶内侧段不规则形小结节大致同前，仍约11x8mm（IM35）
text_en: The irregular small nodule in the medial segment of the right middle lobe remains stable, still measuring approximately 11x8 mm (IM35).

source_text: 右肺下叶多发转移结节大致同前，约5*5mm、4*4mm、15*13mm（IMA44、50、56），
text_en: Multiple metastatic nodules in the right lower lobe are approximately unchanged, measuring about 5×5 mm, 4×4 mm, and 15×13 mm (IMA44, 50, 56).

source_text: 扫及肝右叶低密度结节灶同前
text_en: CT shows a low-density nodular lesion in the right lobe of the liver unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺下叶斑片索条影较前减少，原后基底段结节较前缩小，原约13x5mm(IM64)，现约10x5mm（IM63），内见空洞形成，炎症吸收
text_en: Patchy and linear opacities in the right lower lobe are decreased compared to prior; the original nodule in the posterior basal segment has decreased in size (previously approximately 13x5 mm, IM64; now approximately 10x5 mm, IM63) with new cavity formation, consistent with resolving inflammation.

source_text: 双肺胸膜下另可见多发结节同前，较大者约5mm（IM34）
text_en: Multiple subpleural nodules are additionally seen in both lungs, stable compared to prior, the largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM34).

source_text: 双肺多发小结节，较前相仿，仍约5mm(IM21)
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior; the largest remains about 5 mm (IM21).

source_text: 双肺及叶间胸膜多发转移结节较前不同程度增大，现较大约17x12mm（IM21），原约9mm
text_en: Multiple metastatic nodules in both lungs and interlobar pleura have increased to varying degrees compared to prior; currently largest is approximately 17x12 mm (IM21), previously approximately 9 mm.

source_text: 右水平裂胸膜下结节影同前，较大者仍约14x9mm（IM30）
text_en: Subpleural nodule along the right horizontal fissure unchanged, largest still approximately 14x9 mm (IM30).

source_text: 左肺局限性索条影同前，两肺内未见明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: Localized linear opacity in the left lung unchanged from prior; no obvious new nodules or consolidations within both lungs.

source_text: 内部类圆形小结节同前，仍约8mm（Im14）
text_en: The small round nodule internally is stable, still measuring approximately 8 mm (Im14).

source_text: 左上纵隔颈总动脉旁结节同前，现仍约5x4mm（IM9）
text_en: Nodule adjacent to the left common carotid artery in the upper mediastinum is unchanged, currently measuring approximately 5x4 mm (IM9).

source_text: 两肺小结节同前（Im30、39），未见新生病灶
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior (Im30, 39), no new lesions seen

source_text: 右肺微小结节影同前（IM40、47、51）
text_en: Right lung tiny nodular opacities unchanged (IM40, 47, 51)

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，胸部CT未见明确复发及转移征象
text_en: Status post right upper lobe resection; chest CT shows no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段可见一不规则结节灶较前缩小，冠状位原较大层面约27*17mm（IMA34），现约25*14mm（冠状位 IMA31），局部胸膜凹陷同前
text_en: An irregular nodular lesion in the basal segment of the right lower lobe has decreased in size compared to prior. On the coronal view, the largest dimension was previously approximately 27 x 17 mm (IMA34), now approximately 25 x 14 mm (coronal IMA31). Localized pleural indentation remains unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔、肺门、锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结，双腋下多发小淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: No enlarged lymph nodes seen in mediastinum, hilum, or supraclavicular region; bilateral axillary multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from previous, less than 10 mm.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段胸膜下浅淡磨玻璃密度小结节同前，边缘模糊，约8x7mm（IM19）
text_en: The faint ground-glass density small nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe is unchanged, margin indistinct, approximately 8x7 mm (IM19).

source_text: 右肺中叶及左肺上叶磨玻璃小结节同前（IM34、13），较大者约3mm（IM34）
text_en: Ground-glass small nodules in the right middle lobe and left upper lobe are stable (IM34, 13), with the largest measuring approximately 3 mm (IM34).

source_text: 左肺下叶局部术后，可见胸膜增厚，少量积液积气消失气区，肺内索条影同前，未见新生结节
text_en: Postoperative change in left lower lobe with pleural thickening, small pleural effusion and resolved pneumothorax, intrapulmonary linear opacities unchanged from prior, no new nodules

source_text: 右肺上叶见斑片状肺气肿改变同前，双肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Patchy emphysematous changes are seen in the right upper lobe, unchanged from prior; no new nodules are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段实性-磨玻璃密度结节，整体范围较前略增大，现约27x21mm（IM14），原为26x20mm，实性成分略增大，现约17x13mm（IM14），原为16x12mm
text_en: Solid–ground-glass density nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe; the overall size has slightly increased to approximately 27 × 21 mm (IM14) from 26 × 20 mm, and the solid component has slightly increased to approximately 17 × 13 mm (IM14) from 16 × 12 mm.

source_text: 右上纵隔结节同前，约14x10mm（IM13）
text_en: Nodule in the right upper mediastinum is unchanged, measuring approximately 14x10 mm (IM13).

source_text: 左肺上叶索条影同前，余双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Left upper lobe linear opacity unchanged, no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remaining bilateral lungs.

source_text: 纵隔内见散在小淋巴结较前相仿，较大约10mm（IMA20）
text_en: Scattered small lymph nodes in the mediastinum, similar to previous, largest approximately 10 mm (IMA20).

source_text: 右肺下叶结节较前略增大，现约9mm(图30)，原约7mm(图29)
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is slightly larger than before, now measuring approximately 9 mm (Figure 30), previously about 7 mm (Figure 29).

source_text: 左肺新见散在小结节，约3mm（IM42）
text_en: New scattered small nodules in left lung, approximately 3mm (Image 42)

source_text: 双肺下叶少许索条影同前，右肺浅淡小结节影大致同前（IMA28、34、38、49）
text_en: Few linear opacities in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior; faint small nodules in the right lung are essentially unchanged (IMA28, 34, 38, 49).

source_text: 左乳术后，左前胸壁局限性软组织增厚同前，未见结节及肿块
text_en: Postoperative status of the left breast; localized soft tissue thickening in the left anterior chest wall is stable compared to prior, with no nodules or masses identified.

source_text: 右肺多发微小结节基本同前（IM25、44、50），大小约2-3mm
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in the right lung are essentially unchanged from prior (IM25, 44, 50), measuring approximately 2–3 mm.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，胸部CT未见复发、转移征象
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; chest CT shows no findings of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 左肺舌叶微小结节同前，仍约3mm（IM34）
text_en: Left lung lingula: small nodule unchanged, still approximately 3 mm (Image 34)

source_text: 双肺新见多发不规则灶，特殊炎性肉芽肿与转移待鉴别
text_en: Newly noted multiple irregular foci in both lungs; special inflammatory granuloma versus metastasis to be differentiated.

source_text: 左肺斜裂小结节同前，较大约6mm（IM28）
text_en: Left lung oblique fissure small nodule unchanged, approximately 6mm (Image 28)

source_text: 现约12x5mm者（IM18），原约12x8mm（IM18）
text_en: Currently approximately 12x5 mm (IM18), previously approximately 12x8 mm (IM18).

source_text: 两肺局限性索条影同前，未见新增结节及斑片影
text_en: The localized linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 食管癌疗后，管壁增厚同前
text_en: Post-treatment for esophageal cancer, wall thickening unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段新见模糊小结节，约3mm（IM38），余肺未见新生结节灶
text_en: Newly seen indistinct small nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe, approximately 3 mm (IM38); no new nodules elsewhere in the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔内多发钙化小淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple calcified small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from previous

source_text: 右侧胸膜稍厚，右侧叶间胸膜小结节同前，约为6mm（IM30）
text_en: The right pleura is slightly thickened. The small nodule along the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM30).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变，左肺尖模糊小结节同前，追查
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; indistinct small nodule at the left lung apex stable compared to prior; follow-up recommended

source_text: 双肺散在索条影同前，右肺上叶纵隔旁小结节样影同前（Im30），余肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: Scattered linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged from prior. A small nodular opacity adjacent to the mediastinum in the right upper lobe is unchanged (Im30). The remainder of the lungs show no nodules or consolidation.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃结节灶大致同前，现约17x13mm（IM24）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe posterior segment is essentially unchanged, now measuring approximately 17 x 13 mm (IM24).

source_text: 双肺少量微小结节同前，部分较致密同前相仿，左上肺新见小结节，约6mm（IM15）
text_en: Few tiny nodules in both lungs are stable; some are similarly dense as before. A new small nodule is seen in the left upper lobe, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM15).

source_text: 右肺斜裂胸膜结节同前，良性可能大，随诊
text_en: Nodule along the right oblique fissure pleura is unchanged; benign etiology is more likely, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上小淋巴结同前相仿，约12x6mm（IM4）
text_en: Small lymph node in the left supraclavicular region is stable, measuring approximately 12x6 mm (IM4).

source_text: 胸11椎体高密度结节影、双侧肩胛骨边缘硬化伴骨质内多发低密度灶同前
text_en: T11 vertebral body high-density nodule, bilateral scapular marginal sclerosis with multiple low-density foci within bone, unchanged.

source_text: 左上纵隔主动脉弓外侧不规则类结节影同前，原约2.5x1.1cm，现约2.5x1.3cm（IM17），强化不确切，考虑良性
text_en: An irregular nodular shadow in the left upper mediastinum lateral to the aortic arch is stable compared to prior, previously approximately 2.5 x 1.1 cm, now approximately 2.5 x 1.3 cm (IM17). Enhancement is not definite; benign etiology is considered.

source_text: 右肺下叶见模糊微小结节同前，约4mm（IM50）
text_en: A faint, irregular micro-nodule in the right lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM50).

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，左肺下叶基底段磨玻璃密度小结节同前，大小约5mm（IM30）
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. The small ground-glass opacity nodule in the left lower lobe basal segment is stable, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM30).

source_text: 余两肺未见明确新发异常密度灶
text_en: No definite new abnormal density foci are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 双肺上叶、右肺下叶微小结节同前，仍约2-3mm（IM10、26、28、39等）
text_en: Micronodules in the upper lobes of both lungs and the right lower lobe are stable compared to prior, still approximately 2-3 mm (IM10, 26, 28, 39, etc.).

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段结节同前相仿，仍约8mm（IM49）
text_en: Nodule in the left lower lobe basal segment similar to prior, still approximately 8 mm (IM49)

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，右侧胸腔积液较前吸收，胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; right pleural effusion has improved compared to prior imaging. No new space-occupying lesions are seen in the chest.

source_text: 右肺微小结节及磨玻璃密度影同前，随诊复查
text_en: Right lung tiny nodules and ground-glass opacities unchanged; follow-up advised

source_text: 右肺中叶索条结节灶同前
text_en: Nodular linear opacity in the right middle lobe is unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔内多发淋巴结较前增大，现约52*39mm(图23)，原约40x35mm（IM24），考虑转移可能
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes enlarged compared to previous, currently approximately 52x39 mm (Figure 23), previously approximately 40x35 mm (IM24), possible metastasis considered

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前相仿，4L组仍约13x10mm（IM22）
text_en: Mediastinal multiple lymph nodes similar to previous, station 4L still approximately 13x10mm (IM22).

source_text: 右肺上叶及左肺下叶索条结节灶同前
text_en: Linear nodular opacities in the right upper lobe and left lower lobe are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 食管胸中下段交界区管壁不规则增厚，以左侧壁为著，局部形成肿块，较前范围增大，最大截面现约36x31mm（IM26），原约29x25mm（IM25），相应管腔明显狭窄，外膜面模糊，与气管及左主支气管后壁接触距离约3.3cm，与降主动脉接触角小于90度
text_en: In the junctional region of the middle-lower thoracic esophagus, irregular wall thickening is more prominent on the left wall, with local mass formation. The extent has increased compared to prior. Current maximum cross-sectional area is approximately 36x31 mm (IM26), previously 29x25 mm (IM25). Corresponding lumen is significantly narrowed. Outer wall is indistinct. Contact distance with the posterior wall of the trachea and left main bronchus is approximately 3.3 cm. Contact angle with the descending aorta is less than 90 degrees.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段占位大致同前，追查
text_en: Space-occupying lesion in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe is roughly unchanged; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 左锁骨上、纵隔2、4、7组及右肺门可见多发淋巴结大致同前，如2L组淋巴结现约15x13mm（Im18），4组淋巴结较大约19x10mm（IM25），追查
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes are seen in the left supraclavicular region, mediastinal stations 2, 4, and 7, and the right hilar region, similar to previous; for example, the 2L station lymph node currently measures approximately 15x13 mm (Im18), and the 4 station lymph node measures approximately 19x10 mm (IM25), requiring follow-up.

source_text: 余肺未见明确新发结节灶
text_en: The remainder of the lungs shows no definite new nodules.

source_text: 纵隔2-7组及双锁骨上区小淋巴结同前，较大仍约8mm（IM23）
text_en: Mediastinal stations 2-7 and bilateral supraclavicular small lymph nodes are unchanged from previous; the larger one is still approximately 8mm (IM23).

source_text: 纵隔2R多发肿大淋巴结部分较前缩小，较大原约13x12mm(图8)，现约7x5mm（IM9）
text_en: Multiple enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes at station 2R are partially decreased in size compared to prior. The largest was approximately 13x12 mm (Figure 8), now approximately 7x5 mm (IM9).

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段浅淡磨玻璃密度灶较前相仿，范围仍约7mm（IM33），余双肺散在浅淡微小结节同前（IM13、14、30），部分伴钙化，仍小于5mm
text_en: Faint ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe lingular segment is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 7 mm (IM33). Scattered faint tiny nodules in both lungs remain unchanged (IM13, 14, 30), some with calcification, all still less than 5 mm

source_text: 右肺下叶切除术后，胸部CT平扫未见新增占位征象
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; non-contrast chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段肿块影较前缩小，现约23x20mm（IM18），原约35x28mm（IMA19）
text_en: Mass-like opacity in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe has decreased in size, currently approximately 23x20 mm (IM18), previously approximately 35x28 mm (IMA19)

source_text: 右膈下结节较前略缩小
text_en: The subdiaphragmatic nodule on the right is slightly smaller than before.

source_text: 胸2椎体低密度灶，倾向转移，请结合骨扫描
text_en: T2 vertebral body demonstrates a low-density focus, suggestive of metastasis; correlation with bone scan is recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变，胸部CT扫描未见新发占位征象
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; no new space-occupying lesions are seen on chest CT scan.

source_text: 气管右旁肿大淋巴结较前略增大，现较大约18*12mm(图15)，原约17*10mm（IMA16），考虑转移可能性大
text_en: Enlarged lymph node at right paratracheal region slightly increased compared to prior, now larger approximately 18x12mm (Figure 15), previously approximately 17x10mm (IMA16), suspicious for metastasis

source_text: 胸廓弥漫骨转移密度增高，追查
text_en: Diffuse increased density in thoracic bones suggestive of bone metastases, requires further evaluation.

source_text: 右肺多发结节大小同前，数量减少，约3-5mm（IM38），结合临床密切随诊
text_en: Multiple nodules in the right lung are stable in size and decreased in number, measuring approximately 3-5 mm (IM38); close clinical follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见占位征象，邻近胸膜增厚同前相仿，考虑术后改变
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, no mass lesion at the bronchial stump, adjacent pleural thickening unchanged, consistent with postoperative change

source_text: 右肺上叶结节及左肺下叶团片影同前，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: Nodule in the right upper lobe and patchy opacity in the left lower lobe are unchanged compared to prior; considered chronic changes

source_text: 左肺纤维条索影同前，余肺内未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Left lung fibrotic streaks unchanged, no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remaining lung parenchyma.

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段软组织密度结节较前饱满，现约17x13mm（IM50），原约15x10mm（IM50）
text_en: Left lower lobe basal segment soft tissue density nodule more prominent than prior, currently approximately 17x13 mm (IM50), previously approximately 15x10 mm (IM50)

source_text: 纵隔2R、4组多发淋巴结较前相仿，较大约15x8mm（IM17）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R and 4 are similar to prior, with the largest measuring approximately 15x8 mm (IM17)

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约11x5mm（IM18）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest measures approximately 11x5 mm (IM18).

source_text: 双肺索条及小结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: Linear opacities and small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior; findings are considered likely benign.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段类圆形小结节较前缩小，现仅见呈点状结节（IM41）
text_en: The round small nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe has decreased in size from prior, now only a punctate nodule (IM41).

source_text: 右侧第肋椎关节下关节面硬化同前，余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏
text_en: Sclerosis of the right costovertebral joint inferior articular surface is unchanged. No osseous destruction in the other bones of the thorax.

source_text: 食管术后，胸部CT增强未见新发占位
text_en: Post-esophagectomy, contrast-enhanced chest CT shows no new mass.

source_text: 胸5和胸7椎体内结节样稍高密度影同前
text_en: Nodular slightly sclerotic lesion within T5 and T7 vertebral bodies unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from previous.

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后，左侧支气管断端未见异常强化灶，双肺多发模糊结节及融合成片范围较前明显增大（IM33）
text_en: Post-left lower lobectomy, no abnormal enhancement is seen at the left bronchial stump, and the extent of bilateral pulmonary ill-defined nodules and confluent opacities has significantly increased compared to prior (IM33).

source_text: 纵隔5组淋巴结，约13mm（IMA22），大致同前，双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal station 5 lymphadenopathy, approximately 13 mm (IMA22), largely unchanged; no lymphadenopathy in bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular areas, or bilateral axillae

source_text: 双肺新发小结节，转移可能
text_en: Newly developed small nodules in both lungs. Metastasis is possible.

source_text: 左锁骨上小淋巴结同前，较大者仍约10x6mm（IM8）
text_en: Left supraclavicular small lymph node unchanged from prior. The largest remains approximately 10x6 mm (IM8)

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下小结节同前（IM39），大小仍约5mm，追查
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right middle lobe is stable (IM39), size remains approximately 5 mm, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 两肺内及胸膜下散在点状小结节灶同前，未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Scattered punctate small nodules in both lungs and subpleural regions are unchanged from prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 食管癌术后，右肺索条同前
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer, right lung linear opacities stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶外基底段类圆形小结节同前，约5mm（IM49）
text_en: The round small nodule in the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM49).

source_text: 原左肺下叶基底段模糊结节同前未见显示，左肺下叶新见片状影（IM52）
text_en: The previously noted ill-defined nodule in the basal segment of the left lower lobe is no longer clearly visible; a new patchy opacity is seen in the left lower lobe (IM52).

source_text: 右肺胸膜下微小结节同前，约2mm（Im25）
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodule in the right lung is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 2 mm (Im25).

source_text: 左肺下叶结节影大致同前，约5mm（IM40）
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is essentially unchanged, approximately 5 mm on image 40.

source_text: 右侧第6侧肋类圆形高密度结节同前（IM34），右侧第4肋多发稍高密度结节同前
text_en: Round high-density nodule in the right 6th lateral rib is unchanged (IM34). Multiple slightly hyperdense nodules in the right 4th rib are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶后基底段不规则磨玻璃密度小结节较前无明显变化，边缘毛糙，仍约9x8mm（IM37），建议继续随访观察
text_en: The irregular ground-glass opacity small nodule in the peripheral posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe shows no significant change compared to prior, with a spiculated margin, still measuring approximately 9x8 mm (IM37); continued follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 平扫见纵隔多枚小淋巴结同前，肺门淋巴结情况无法区分
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior; hilar lymph node status cannot be distinguished.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段类结节影同前，恶性不除外
text_en: The nodule-like opacity in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment is unchanged from previous; malignancy cannot be excluded.

source_text: 纵隔、锁骨上小淋巴结同前，短径小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal and supraclavicular small lymph nodes unchanged from prior; short axis diameter less than 10 mm.

source_text: 左侧肾上腺结节状稍增厚同前
text_en: Left adrenal nodular slight thickening unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，大者约15x8mm（Im22）
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, largest approximately 15x8 mm (Im22).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段胸膜下点状小结节同前（IM18）
text_en: The punctate small nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe is unchanged (IM18).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段胸膜下小结节灶大致同前，约2mm（IMA30）
text_en: Subpleural small nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is essentially unchanged, approximately 2 mm (IMA30)

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段结节较前饱满，原约12x8mm（IM38），现约14x12mm（IM37）
text_en: The nodule in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe appears more prominent compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 12x8 mm (IM38), now approximately 14x12 mm (IM37).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，气管右旁肿大转移淋巴结较前略增大
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; the enlarged metastatic lymph node adjacent to the right trachea is slightly larger than before.

source_text: 扫及多发骨质破坏灶，部分范围增大
text_en: On scan, multiple osseous destruction foci, some with increased extent

source_text: 右肺少许索条影同前，未见新发斑片及结节
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged; no new patchy opacities or nodules are seen.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，胸部CT未见明确复发及转移征象
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, chest CT shows no clear evidence of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 胸5、12局限性骨岛同前，胸骨新见骨质破坏及骨折，考虑转移及病理性骨折
text_en: Localized bone islands in T5 and T12 vertebral bodies unchanged; new bone destruction and fracture in sternum, consider metastasis and pathologic fracture.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，现较大仍约10mm（IM21）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest still approximately 10 mm (IM21).

source_text: 双肺胸膜下多发小结节较前增多增大
text_en: Multiple small subpleural nodules in both lungs have increased in number and size compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节影同前（IM59）
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged (Image 59)

source_text: 余肺未见新增灶
text_en: No new lesions are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 两肺斑片索条影同前，两肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Patchy and linear opacities in both lungs, unchanged from prior; no new nodules seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺上叶微小结节影同前（Im16）
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule unchanged from prior (Im16)

source_text: 左肺上叶结节同前，约5x4mm（IM34）
text_en: Left upper lobe nodule unchanged, approximately 5x4 mm (Image 34).

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段结节影较前略缩小
text_en: Left lower lobe basal segment nodule opacity slightly decreased compared to previous.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、双腋下淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal, bilateral hilar, and bilateral axillary lymph nodes unchanged from previous, less than 10 mm.

source_text: 右肺尖胸膜下索条结节灶同前，倾向良性
text_en: The subpleural linear nodule in the right lung apex is unchanged and is considered likely benign.

source_text: mm小结节同前（IM28、38）
text_en: Small nodule unchanged (IM28, 38)

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段胸膜下索条结节影同前，约8*4mm（IMA46），余肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: The subpleural linear and nodular opacity in the lateral basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 8 x 4 mm (IMA46); no nodules or consolidation seen elsewhere in the lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶微小结节影同前
text_en: Right upper lobe micro-nodule unchanged

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端软组织增厚较前减轻（Im35），未见异常强化结节及肿块，邻近胸膜略增厚亦较前减轻，右侧少量胸水较前减少
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; soft tissue thickening at the bronchial stump is less pronounced than prior (Im35). No abnormally enhancing nodules or masses are seen. Adjacent pleural thickening is also less prominent than before. Right-sided small pleural effusion has decreased compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶、左肺上叶尖后段胸膜下模糊小结节灶同前（IMA18、20），较大约4mm
text_en: Subpleural indistinct small nodular opacities in the right upper lobe and apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe are unchanged (IMA18, 20), largest approximately 4 mm.

source_text: 甲状腺多发结节同前
text_en: Multiple thyroid nodules stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔内4R组淋巴结同前，较大仍约11x6mm（IM23），平扫密度较高，倾向良性
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at station 4R, same as before; largest still approximately 11x6 mm (IM23), with higher density on non-contrast scan, suggestive of benign.

source_text: 右腋下多发稍大淋巴结较前缩小，较大原约12x8mm（IM16），现小于5mm
text_en: Multiple slightly enlarged lymph nodes in the right axilla are smaller than prior; the largest was previously approximately 12 x 8 mm (IM16), now less than 5 mm.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜浅淡小结节同前，约5x3mm（IMA31）
text_en: Faint small nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 5x3 mm (IMA31).

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜结节较前缩小，原约13mm，现约10*9mm（IM30），左侧胸膜光滑，双侧未见胸水征象
text_en: The nodular lesion along the right interlobar pleura is smaller compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 13 mm and now approximately 10 x 9 mm (IM30). The left pleura is smooth. No pleural effusion is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺左叶低强化结节较前增大，原约23x21mm，现约28x24mm（Im5）
text_en: A hypoenhancing nodule in the left thyroid lobe has increased in size from approximately 23 x 21 mm to 28 x 24 mm (Im5).

source_text: 右肺中叶微小结节同前，倾向良性，随访
text_en: Right middle lobe tiny nodule unchanged from prior, favoring benign etiology, follow-up recommended

source_text: 双肺小结节灶同前，陈旧灶可能，建议追查
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodule foci are stable compared to prior, likely chronic/old foci, further investigation recommended

source_text: 纵隔、肺门肿大淋巴结较前略缩小
text_en: Mediastinal and hilar enlarged lymph nodes slightly decreased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段另一磨玻璃密度结节同前，追查
text_en: Another ground-glass opacity nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 左肺小结节及两肺磨玻璃密度结节影同前（Im12、17、30、43）
text_en: Small nodules in the left lung and ground-glass density nodules in both lungs unchanged from prior (Im12, 17, 30, 43).

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，右上肺门支气管断端结构紊乱，沿纵隔旁高密度缝线影周围软组织影稍厚并部分肺膨胀欠佳较前相仿，未见占位征象
text_en: Following right upper lobectomy, disorganized architecture at the right upper lobe bronchial stump and thickened soft tissue surrounding high-density suture material along the mediastinum are similar to prior, with partial poor lung expansion; no space-occupying lesion is seen.

source_text: 新见微小致密结节
text_en: Newly identified tiny dense nodule

source_text: 右肺中叶和左肺下叶基底段胸膜下结节同前相仿（IM35、50）
text_en: Subpleural nodules in the right middle lobe and the basal segment of the left lower lobe are similar to prior (IM35, 50).

source_text: 左肺上叶新见两处混合磨玻璃密度结节（IM27、31），大者约13x10mm
text_en: Two new mixed ground-glass opacity nodules in the left upper lobe (IM27, 31); the larger measures approximately 13x10mm.

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，如7组淋巴结现仍约8x6mm（IM36）
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, such as station 7 lymph node currently still approximately 8x6 mm (IM36).

source_text: 纵隔2R多发肿大淋巴结较前缩小
text_en: Multiple enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes at station 2R are decreased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶外侧基底段见类圆形模糊小结节同前，约3mm（Im34）
text_en: Left lower lobe, lateral basal segment: round indistinct small nodule unchanged, approximately 3 mm (Image 34).

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下结节较前增大，原约20x15mm（IM22），现约23x19mm（IM21）
text_en: Subpleural nodule in the right upper lobe has increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 20 x 15 mm (IM22), now approximately 23 x 19 mm (IM21).

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门多发肿大淋巴结，考虑新发转移
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right hilum, suspicious for new metastasis.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结原约18x16mm（IM27），现约14x10mm（IM30）
text_en: The right hilar lymph node was previously approximately 18 x 16 mm (IM27), now approximately 14 x 10 mm (IM30).

source_text: 纵隔7组及贲门周围肿大淋巴结，较前缩小
text_en: Enlarged lymph nodes in mediastinal station 7 and perigastric region, smaller compared to previous.

source_text: 左肺门见不规则软组织肿块同前相仿，现仍约58x40mm（IM36），呈分叶状，增强扫描轻度强化，病变跨斜裂生长，边缘呈多发融合状结节同前，邻近血管及支气管受压
text_en: Left hilar irregular soft tissue mass similar to previous, currently still approximately 58x40 mm (IM36), lobulated, mild enhancement on contrast-enhanced scan, lesion growing across the oblique fissure, margins show multiple fused nodules unchanged from previous, adjacent vessels and bronchi compressed.

source_text: 双肺见多发小结节影同前，较大约3mm（IM25），未见新增结节及实变影
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior, the largest measuring approximately 3 mm (IM25); no new nodules or consolidations are seen.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段胸膜下微小结节同前，陈旧灶，追查
text_en: A subpleural tiny nodule in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged and represents an old lesion; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左侧胸膜结节样增厚同前（IM51），双侧胸腔未见胸水
text_en: Left pleural nodular thickening is unchanged (IM51); no pleural effusion is seen in either hemithorax

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结较前略增大，现约11*11mm(图18)，原约11*9mm(图18)
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph node is slightly enlarged compared to previous, currently approximately 11x11 mm (Image 18), previously approximately 11x9 mm (Image 18).

source_text: 双肺多发磨玻璃密度结节影同前，较大约6mm（IM28）
text_en: Multiple ground-glass density nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged; the largest measures approximately 6 mm (IM28).

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节同前，约5mm（IM19）
text_en: Right upper lobe small nodule unchanged, approximately 5 mm (IM19)

source_text: 右肺癌术后，支气管断端少许软组织密度影大致同前（IM31），考虑术后改变
text_en: Status post right lung cancer resection; a small soft tissue density at the bronchial stump is essentially unchanged (IM31), consistent with postoperative change.

source_text: 两肺叶斑点状影及浅淡微小结节影同前
text_en: Punctate opacities and faint tiny nodules in both lung lobes are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 余肺未见新发明确结节或斑片影
text_en: No new definite nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 两肺内胸膜下散在小结节灶同前（IM18、28），小于5mm，余肺未见新增结节灶及斑片影
text_en: Scattered subpleural small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM18, 28), all less than 5 mm; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段胸膜下稍高密度结节灶同前，仍约4mm（IM44）
text_en: A slightly increased density subpleural nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged from previous, still approximately 4 mm (IM44).

source_text: 右肺多发粟粒样小结节较前缩小、较少
text_en: Multiplemiliary small nodules in the right lung are smaller and fewer compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门淋巴结较前略缩小，现较大约14*14mm（IMA28），原约16*16mm（IMA27）
text_en: Mediastinal and bilateral hilar lymph nodes are slightly reduced in size compared to previous, currently the larger one approximately 14x14 mm (IMA28), previously approximately 16x16 mm (IMA27).

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门及双侧锁骨上未见新增肿大淋巴结
text_en: No new enlarged lymph nodes seen in mediastinum, right hilar region, or bilateral supraclavicular areas.

source_text: 扫描所及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Scanned thoracic skeleton bones show no evidence of osseous destruction.

source_text: 双肺未见新增结节或片絮状病灶
text_en: No new nodules or fluffy lesions are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 扫及右肾上腺结节同前(IM65)
text_en: On scan, right adrenal nodule unchanged from prior (IM65).

source_text: 左侧腋窝及纵隔见多发小淋巴结同前，食管右旁较大者仍约11x7mm（Im41）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the left axilla and mediastinum are stable compared to prior; the largest at the right paratracheal region remains approximately 11x7 mm (Im41).

source_text: 双腋区淋巴结较前饱满，如右腋区原约9mm（IM17）者，现约12mm（IM14）
text_en: Lymph nodes in bilateral axillary regions are more prominent than before; for example, the one in the right axilla previously measuring approximately 9 mm (IM17) now measures approximately 12 mm (IM14).

source_text: 右肺散在小结节部分较前略缩小，如右上肺原约4mm者，现约2mm（Im14）
text_en: Some of the scattered small nodules in the right lung are slightly smaller than prior; for example, a nodule in the right upper lobe previously measuring approximately 4 mm now measures approximately 2 mm (Im14).

source_text: 左肺叶间胸膜结节同前
text_en: Left lung interlobar pleural nodule unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，胸廓顶少许积液，支气管残端未见肿块影，两肺新见多发边界光滑结节，较大约13x10mm（IM42），考虑转移
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; small amount of fluid at the thoracic apex; no mass at the bronchial stump; multiple new well-circumscribed nodules are seen in both lungs, the largest measuring approximately 13x10mm (IM42); metastasis is considered.

source_text: 扫及肝内多发低密度结节同前，请结合腹部检查
text_en: Multiple intrahepatic low-density nodules are unchanged from prior; correlation with abdominal examination is recommended.

source_text: 肺内少许索条较前相仿，未见明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: A few linear opacities within the lung similar to previous, no obvious new nodules or consolidations

source_text: 右肺中叶结节较前缩小且密度较前变浅，请结合治疗史评价
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe is smaller than before and less dense; correlate with treatment history for interpretation.

source_text: 右肺门肿大淋巴结较前缩小，原较大约24x20mm，现约23x16mm（IM29），追查
text_en: Right hilar enlarged lymph node decreased in size compared to prior; previously measured approximately 24x20 mm, now approximately 23x16 mm (IM29); further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 胸2、11椎体致密结节同前，余扫及胸廓诸骨未见明确破坏征象
text_en: T2 and T11 vertebral bodies demonstrate dense nodules, stable compared to prior. No definite bone destruction identified in the remaining thoracic bones.

source_text: 右侧锁骨上肿大淋巴结明显缩小，现约7x3mm（IM6），原为17x13mm（IM3），腹腔干周围见多发肿大淋巴结较前亦明显缩小，较大现约13x10mm（IM57），原为20x16mm（IM52），追查
text_en: The enlarged right supraclavicular lymph node has markedly decreased in size, now measuring approximately 7x3 mm (IM6), previously 17x13 mm (IM3). Multiple enlarged lymph nodes around the celiac trunk have also significantly decreased in size compared to prior, the largest now measuring approximately 13x10 mm (IM57), previously 20x16 mm (IM52). Further evaluation is warranted.

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下微小结节同前，＜5mm（IM36）
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior, less than 5 mm (IM36).

source_text: 增粗
text_en: Increased in thickness.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，建议追查
text_en: Right hilar lymph nodes are unchanged compared to prior imaging; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门高密度淋巴结同前，右肺门较大者仍约13x11mm（IM31）
