text_en: Hyperdense lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions are unchanged from prior. The largest in the right hilar region still measures approximately 13x11 mm (IM31).

source_text: 纵隔、肺门多发淋巴结同前，较大约19x12mm（IM33)
text_en: Mediastinal and hilar multiple lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest approximately 19x12 mm (IM33).
Bilateral pulmonary small nodule shadows are stable compared to prior (IMA20, 25, 29, 30, 32, 36, 43, 46), less than 5 mm

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结所见部分大致同前
text_en: Findings of mediastinal lymph nodes are partially unchanged from prior.

source_text: 甲状腺左叶多发低密度小结节同前，请结合超声检查
text_en: Thyroid left lobe multiple small low-density nodules same as prior, please correlate with ultrasound.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段斜裂胸膜下磨玻璃结节同前，约10x9mm（IM23），界清，继续观察
text_en: A subpleural ground-glass nodule along the oblique fissure in the apical-posterior segment of the left upper lobe same as before, approximately 10x9 mm (IM23), well-defined, continue observation.

source_text: 两肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Ground-glass nodules in both upper lobes are unchanged from prior. Follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶模糊结节影稍饱满，原短径约3mm（IM43、45），现约5mm（IM47）
text_en: Left lower lobe hazy nodule shadow slightly more solid, original short axis approximately 3 mm (IM43, 45), now approximately 5 mm (IM47)

source_text: 余肺未见明显新发结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: The remainder of the lungs shows no obvious new nodules or floccular opacities.

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后改变，胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes following right upper lobectomy; no new space-occupying lesions in the chest.

source_text: 左肺透过度略减低，左肺下叶小结节同前，约6x3mm（IM35）
text_en: Left lung shows slightly decreased radiolucency; small nodule in left lower lobe unchanged from previous, approximately 6x3 mm (IM35).

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下微小结节同前
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段不规则形索条影同前，余肺野未见新发结节
text_en: Irregular linear opacity in the right upper lobe apical segment unchanged; no new nodules in the remainder of the lung fields

source_text: 胸11椎体左侧椎弓根、右侧第7肋骨骨皮质高密度结节同前
text_en: High-density nodule in left pedicle of T11 vertebra and right 7th rib cortical bone unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右上肺近水平裂一小灶同前，仍约3mm（IM31），追查，右肺下叶胸膜下微小结节同前(IM39)
text_en: Small focus near the horizontal fissure in the right upper lobe unchanged, still approximately 3 mm (IM31); follow-up recommended. Right lower lobe subpleural micro-nodule unchanged (IM39).

source_text: 纵隔内多枚淋巴结平扫密度偏高同前，短径不足10mm
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes with slightly increased density on non-contrast scan unchanged from previous, short axis less than 10 mm

source_text: 右肺小结节影同前相仿
text_en: Right lung small nodule shadow similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶实性小结节同前，与[DATE]CT比较无变化，考虑良性
text_en: Small solid nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged compared to the CT from [DATE]; benign etiology is considered.

source_text: 胸部CT未见明确转移复发征象
text_en: Chest CT shows no definite metastatic recurrence.

source_text: 扫描所及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏
text_en: Scanned thoracic skeleton bones show no evidence of osseous destruction.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，左肺上叶尖后段见短条索影同前（IMA15），左肺上叶尖后段、下舌段及下叶外、后基底段见散在多个小结节同前（IMA31、42、50），直径均约4mm
text_en: Bilateral lung markings are unremarkable in course, and pulmonary lucency is uniform. A short linear opacity in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe is stable (IMA15). Scattered multiple small nodules are stable in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe, lingular segment, and the lateral and posterior basal segments of the lower lobe (IMA31, 42, 50), each measuring approximately 4 mm.

source_text: 右肺多发磨玻璃密度小结节同前，左肺模糊小结节，结合临床追查
text_en: Multiple small ground-glass opacity nodules in the right lung are unchanged from prior; indistinct small nodules in the left lung, clinical correlation recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段见小结节同前，约4mm（IM30）.双肺见少许索条影
text_en: A small nodule is seen in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe, stable compared to prior, approximately 4 mm (IM30). Scattered linear opacities are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大仍约15x8mm（IM24）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest measures approximately 15x8 mm (IM24).

source_text: 左下肺术后，支气管断端未见占位征象，左肺不规则索条钙化同前（Im48）
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left lower lobe; no mass is seen at the bronchial stump; irregular linear calcifications in the left lung are unchanged (Im48).

source_text: 纵隔新见多发肿大淋巴结
text_en: Newly seen multiple enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见异常增厚，肺内局限性索条影同前，未见新发结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy. No abnormal wall thickening is seen at the bronchial stump. Localized linear opacities in the lung are unchanged. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 右肺散在斑片索条钙化及微小结节影同前（IMA21），右肺下叶片状模糊影消失
text_en: Scattered patchy linear calcifications and micro-nodular opacities in the right lung are stable compared to prior (IMA21); the patchy hazy opacity in the right lower lobe has resolved.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段结节大小同前，约7mm（IM34）
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe dorsal segment is stable in size, approximately 7 mm (IM34).

source_text: 右肺中叶支气管截断，肺门周围软组织密度肿块较前缩小，原约51x40mm（纵膈窗IM37），现约45x32mm（IM38），远端右肺中叶不张同前
text_en: Right middle lobe bronchus is truncated. The soft tissue density mass in the hilar region has decreased in size compared to prior, previously 51 x 40 mm (mediastinal window IM37), now 45 x 32 mm (IM38). Distal atelectasis of the right middle lobe remains unchanged.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前（IM28、30）
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior (IM28, 30)

source_text: 气管右后方结节灶同前（IM9）
text_en: Nodule in right posterior tracheal region similar to prior (IM9)

source_text: 右肺下叶背段混杂磨玻璃密度结节较前缩小，磨玻璃密度成分消失，原约6x5mm（IM31） ，现残存实性微小结节影，约2mm（IM28），其上方实性小结节消失
text_en: The mixed ground-glass density nodule in the right lower lobe dorsal segment is smaller than prior; the ground-glass component has disappeared; the residual solid micro-nodule measures approximately 2 mm (IM28), previously approximately 6x5 mm (IM31); the superior solid small nodule has disappeared.

source_text: 左肺上叶混杂磨玻璃结节同前，追查
text_en: The mixed ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged from previous, requires follow-up.

source_text: 扫及肝内多发低密度灶，左肾上腺内结节，大致同前
text_en: Multiple intrahepatic low-density lesions and a left adrenal nodule are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔4L组淋巴结同前，约10x7mm（IM26），双侧肺门及锁骨上平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal station 4L lymph nodes unchanged, approximately 10x7 mm (IM26); non-contrast imaging shows no enlarged lymph nodes in bilateral hila or supraclavicular regions

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则形结节同前相仿，约18x11mm(IM19)，近端肺内索条及片絮影大致同前
text_en: An irregular nodular lesion in the right upper lobe posterior segment is similar to prior, measuring approximately 18x11 mm (IM19); proximal intrapulmonary linear and patchy opacities are approximately stable compared to prior.

source_text: 胸2、3椎体致密结节同前
text_en: T2 and T3 vertebral bodies demonstrate dense nodules, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶大片磨玻璃影较前减少、变淡，右肺上下叶、左肺下叶及右侧斜裂多发小结节同前相仿，较大约5mm（IM41）
text_en: The large area of ground-glass opacity in the right upper lobe has decreased and become fainter compared to prior. Multiple small nodules in the right upper and lower lobes, left lower lobe, and right oblique fissure are similar to prior, the largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM41).

source_text: 右肺上叶软组织密度影较前增大，原约25x25mm，现29x23mm（IM15），内部可见少许新增支气管气相，增强扫描轻度强化，周边长索条及条片灶与胸膜相连同前，右肺上叶尖段部分亚段支气管截断
text_en: Soft tissue density in the right upper lobe has increased in size, previously measuring approximately 25x25 mm, now 29x23 mm (IM15). A few new air bronchograms are visible within. Mild enhancement is seen on contrast scan. Long linear and streaky opacities peripherally connected to the pleura remain unchanged. Partial segmental bronchial cutoff is present in the apical segment of the right upper lobe.

source_text: 右肺上叶多发树芽状模糊小结节较前增多（IM22，30等），前段多发簇状分布微小结节同前
text_en: Multiple tree-in-bud pattern indistinct small nodules in the right upper lobe have increased in number compared to prior (IM22, 30, etc.); multiple clustered tiny nodules in the anterior segment remain unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，约5mm（IM35），右肺下叶内基底段胸膜下索条小结节同前（IM40）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM35). The small subpleural linear nodule in the medial basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM40).

source_text: 纵隔内2R、4、5组多发淋巴结同前，较大仍约18x13mm(IM22)
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R, 4, and 5 are unchanged, with the largest still measuring approximately 18x13mm (IM22).

source_text: 双肺贴胸膜或邻胸膜下小结节，大致同前，不足5mm
text_en: Small subpleural or pleural-adjacent nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged from prior, measuring less than 5 mm.

source_text: 右肺中叶内侧段实性小结节较前略增大，建议6个月随访观察
text_en: Small solid nodule in the medial segment of the right middle lobe is slightly larger than before; recommend 6-month follow-up observation.

source_text: 右肺上叶支气管旁数枚软组织结节较前相仿，较大约8mm（IM24），邻近右肺上叶诸支气管未见狭窄及管壁增厚
text_en: Several soft tissue nodules adjacent to the right upper lobe bronchus are similar in size compared to prior, the largest measuring about 8 mm (IM24). The adjacent bronchi of the right upper lobe show no stenosis or wall thickening.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段斑片索条、左肺舌叶少许斑片影同前，右肺中叶微小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Patchy and linear opacities in the basal segment of the right lower lobe and minimal patchy opacities in the left lingular lobe remain unchanged. Tiny nodule in the right middle lobe remains stable. Recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节大致同前，呈点状（IM10）
text_en: Right upper lobe small nodule essentially unchanged, punctate in appearance (IM10)

source_text: 贲门左侧肿大淋巴结，较前稍缩小
text_en: The enlarged lymph node on the left side of the cardia is slightly smaller compared to previous.

source_text: 右肺中叶内侧段见类椭圆形实性小结节同前，约9x6mm（IM36），可见浅分叶
text_en: Ovoid solid small nodule in the medial segment of the right middle lobe, stable compared to prior, approximately 9x6 mm (IM36), with shallow lobulation.

source_text: 右肺小结节同前，小于5mm（IM13、27、32、34）
text_en: Right lung small nodules unchanged, less than 5 mm (IM13, 27, 32, 34)

source_text: 纵隔平扫淋巴结同前，较大约15x6mm（IM25）
text_en: Non-contrast mediastinal CT demonstrates lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest measuring approximately 15x6 mm (IM25).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端周围软组织结构尚清晰，下方结节较前略缩小，现约11x9mm（IM26），原约12x11mm
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; soft tissue structures around the bronchial stump remain well-defined. The nodule below has slightly decreased in size, currently measuring approximately 11 x 9 mm (IM26), previously 12 x 11 mm.

source_text: 余双肺未见新发结节及斑片影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后改变，左肺类结节影同前
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left lower lobe; nodular-like shadow in the left lung unchanged.

source_text: 右侧胸膜增厚，部分呈结节状同前，约为7mm（IM47），右侧胸膜光滑，双侧未见胸水征象
text_en: Right pleural thickening, partially nodular, is unchanged, measuring approximately 7 mm (IM47). The right pleura is smooth. No pleural effusion is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 左肺门小结节较前略缩小，现约15*8mm(图31)，原约17x8mm（图31），病灶远端见条索影，其旁多发结节同前相仿，结合临床
text_en: Left hilar small nodule slightly decreased in size compared to previous, now approximately 15x8 mm (Figure 31), previously approximately 17x8 mm (Figure 31). Distal to the lesion, linear opacities are seen, and multiple nodules adjacent to it are similar to previous findings. Correlated with clinical context.

source_text: 扫及右肾上腺钙化结节、肝囊肿同前
text_en: On scan, right adrenal calcified nodule and hepatic cyst unchanged from prior

source_text: 右上肺索条及索条小结节灶大致同前，余两肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Linear opacities and linear nodular foci in the right upper lung are essentially unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the rest of both lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶钙化、索条、小结节影、右肺下叶点状结节影同前（IM18、22、40）
text_en: Calcification, linear opacities, and small nodules in the right upper lobe, and punctate nodules in the right lower lobe are unchanged (IM18, 22, 40).

source_text: 余纵膈多个小淋巴结大致同前
text_en: The remaining multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes are approximately unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结大致同前，较大现短径仍约6mm（IM13）
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes essentially unchanged, largest current short axis still approximately 6 mm (IM13)

source_text: 余双肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no new nodule foci.

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段小结节显示不清，下叶胸膜下见微小结节同前，约3mm（IM43）
text_en: The small nodule in the left upper lobe lingular segment is not clearly visualized. A subpleural tiny nodule in the lower lobe is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM43).

source_text: 右肺下叶、左肺上叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见明显异常软组织密度影，右肺结节较前略饱满，约9x6mm(IM54)，左肺胸膜下微结节（IM28）同前
text_en: Status post right lower lobe and left upper lobe resection. On non-contrast imaging, no obvious abnormal soft tissue density is seen at the bronchial stump. The right lung nodule is slightly more prominent than before, measuring approximately 9x6 mm (IM54). The subpleural tiny nodule in the left lung (IM28) is unchanged.

source_text: 左侧斜裂小结节同前（IM31）
text_en: Small nodule in the left oblique fissure is unchanged (IM31).

source_text: 右肺胸膜下及斜裂下多发小结节同前（IM17、39）
text_en: Multiple small subpleural and subfissural nodules in the right lung are unchanged (IM17, 39).

source_text: 扫及左肾上腺结节样增厚同前
text_en: Nodular thickening of the left adrenal gland is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右下肺微小结节灶及片絮影同前，余双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: The tiny nodular opacities and patchy opacities in the right lower lobe are unchanged compared to prior imaging; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the bilateral lungs.

source_text: 右肺门及纵隔多发肿大淋巴结同前相仿
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the right hilar and mediastinal regions are similar to prior findings.

source_text: 食管胸中下段管壁不均匀异常增厚减轻，较厚部位原约30mm（IM31），现约17mm（IM37）
text_en: The abnormal uneven wall thickening of the mid-to-lower thoracic esophagus is reduced, with the thickest portion previously measuring approximately 30 mm (IM31) and now approximately 17 mm (IM37)

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节影同前（IMA16）
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule same as before (IMA16).

source_text: 多发骨转移同前
text_en: Multiple bone metastases are unchanged.

source_text: 双肺术后改变同前，胸部CT未见占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the lungs are unchanged; chest CT shows no mass lesion.

source_text: 右肺多发小结节显示较前清楚，大小同前（IM37、40、41）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right lung are more clearly visualized compared to prior studies; size remains unchanged (IM37, 40, 41).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节同前，追查
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 余肺散在致密结节及小片状影同前
text_en: Scattered dense nodules and small patchy opacities in the remaining lung are stable.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段、左肺上叶前段胸膜下新见结节灶（IMA19、25），右侧较大者大小约5*4mm（IMA25），建议密切追查除外转移
text_en: New nodular opacities are seen subpleurally in the dorsal segment of the right lower lobe and the anterior segment of the left upper lobe (IMA19, 25). The larger nodule on the right measures approximately 5x4 mm (IMA25). Close follow-up is recommended to exclude metastasis.

source_text: 前纵隔肿物切除术后，上纵隔见多发侧枝循环血管，未见新发占位征象
text_en: Status post resection of anterior mediastinal mass. Multiple collateral vessels are seen in the upper mediastinum. No new space-occupying lesion is identified.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区小淋巴结同前，约为4mm（IM4）
text_en: Small lymph node in the left supraclavicular region is stable, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM4).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节同前，继续追查
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged; continued follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结，部分同前相仿，约18x9mm（IM26）
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior, approximately 18x9 mm (IM26).

source_text: 纵隔4、7组淋巴结大致同前（IMA24、27）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes, stations 4 and 7, generally unchanged (IMA24, 27).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段结节同前，约14x12mm（IM24），边缘毛糙及片絮、斑片状影同前
text_en: Left upper lobe anterior segment nodule stable, approximately 14x12 mm (IM24), with irregular margins and patchy opacities stable.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段软组织密度占位较前增大，原约30x21mm（IM13），现约33x28mm（IM12），边缘多发毛刺
text_en: The soft tissue density mass in the apical segment of the right upper lobe has increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 30x21 mm (IM13), now approximately 33x28 mm (IM12), with multiple spiculations at the margin.

source_text: 双肺小结节较前缩小，原较大约7x5mm（IM15），现约5x3mm（Im15）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are smaller compared to prior, the largest was previously approximately 7x5 mm (IM15), now approximately 5x3 mm (Im15)

source_text: 右肺中叶及左肺下叶外基底段胸膜下微小结节同前（Im28、43）
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodules in the right middle lobe and the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe are unchanged (Im28, 43).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段小结节灶同前，约3mm（IMA23）
text_en: The small nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IMA23).

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结同前，约12x7mm（IM28）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes unchanged from prior, approximately 12x7 mm (IM28).

source_text: 胸骨骨质破坏伴病理骨折，局部畸形愈合
text_en: Bone destruction in the sternum with pathological fracture and local malunion

source_text: 右侧胸膜小结节同前
text_en: Small right pleural nodule is unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门及锁骨上区见散在小淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Scattered small lymph nodes less than 10mm in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, and supraclavicular areas unchanged from previous.

source_text: 左前纵隔新见肿大淋巴结，约20x16mm（IM25）
text_en: Newly observed enlarged lymph node in the left anterior mediastinum, measuring approximately 20x16 mm (IM25).

source_text: 双侧锁骨上区见散在小淋巴结同前，较大约16x6mm（IM8）
text_en: Scattered small lymph nodes in the bilateral supraclavicular regions are stable compared to prior; the largest is approximately 16x6 mm (IM8).

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结较前相仿，较大约8x6mm（IM19）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes similar to previous, largest approximately 8x6mm (IM19)

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，性质待定，追查
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior, nature to be determined; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔内右侧气管食管沟小淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Small lymph nodes within the mediastinum in the right tracheoesophageal groove are unchanged from previous, with follow-up.

source_text: 右侧第4肋骨改变同前，余诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Changes in the right 4th rib are stable. No bony destruction is seen in the remainder of the skeleton.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺右叶模糊结节同前相仿
text_en: Imaging shows an ill-defined nodule in the right lobe of the thyroid, unchanged.

source_text: 左侧胸腔积液基本消失，左肺内条片状实变灶复张，未见新发结节灶
text_en: Left pleural effusion has nearly resolved; the linear and patchy consolidation in the left lung has re-expanded; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下结节较前相仿
text_en: Subpleural nodule in the right middle lobe is similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺散在小结节同前，较大仍约3mm（IM49）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior, the largest remaining approximately 3 mm (IM49).

source_text: 左下肺少许索条同前，余双肺未见新生结节及实变影
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the left lower lobe are unchanged; the remainder of the lungs shows no new nodules or consolidation.

source_text: 右肺少许磨玻璃密度小结节较前相仿(IM21、28、36 )，较大仍约6mm（IM28）
text_en: A few ground-glass opacity nodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior (IM21, 28, 36); the largest remains approximately 6 mm (IM28).

source_text: 纵隔见多发高密度淋巴结同前，较大约13x10mm（IM33)，双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple high-density lymph nodes in mediastinum unchanged from previous, largest approximately 13x10mm (IM33), no enlarged lymph nodes seen in bilateral hilar, supraclavicular, or bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 左肺癌术后，术区结构紊乱，少许软组织密度较前减少（IM25），追查
text_en: After left lung cancer surgery, disorganized structure in the surgical area, slight soft tissue density is reduced compared to previous (IM25), follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔2、4、5、7、8组见数枚淋巴结同前，较大约13x10mm（IM30）
text_en: Several lymph nodes seen in mediastinal stations 2, 4, 5, 7, and 8 unchanged from previous, largest approximately 13x10 mm (IM30).

source_text: 纵隔4R区低密度灶较前缩小，现较大约14x13mm（IM20），原较大约27x20mm（IM21）
text_en: A low-density lesion in mediastinal station 4R has decreased in size compared to prior, now approximately 14x13 mm (IM20), previously approximately 27x20 mm (IM21).

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段微小结节灶同前，约3mm（IM37）
text_en: The tiny nodule in the basal segment of the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM37).

source_text: 纵隔4组淋巴结同前，短径约11mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal group 4 lymph nodes same as before, short axis diameter approximately 11 mm (IM20)

source_text: 左肺下叶类圆形小结节大小同前，直径仍约3mm（IM47），结节边缘尚光滑，未见毛刺影
text_en: The small round nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged in size, with a diameter still approximately 3 mm (IM47), smooth nodule margins, and no spiculation.

source_text: 左肺上叶钙化灶同前，左肺多发胸膜下微小结节同前，约2-3mm（IM8、17、40），部分钙化
text_en: Calcified focus in the left upper lobe stable; multiple subpleural micronodules in the left lung stable, approximately 2-3 mm (IM8, 17, 40), some calcified.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见明显肿块影，右肺索条影同前
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; on non-contrast imaging, no obvious mass is seen at the bronchial stump. Linear opacities in the right lung are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段小结节同前，约4x3mm（IM28）
text_en: Small nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable, approximately 4x3 mm (IM28)

source_text: 右肺上叶前段小结节同前，约4x3mm（IMA28）
text_en: Small nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable, approximately 4x3 mm (IMA28)

source_text: 双肺多发结节同前
text_en: Multiple nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺见索条影同前，左肺下叶小结节同前，仍约4mm（IM33)，倾向良性，随诊
text_en: Linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged from prior; a small nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior, still approximately 4 mm (IM33), favoring benign etiology; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺原粟粒样小结节此次未见显示，余胸部CT所见大致同前
text_en: The previously noted miliary nodules in the right lung are not seen on this examination; the remainder of the chest CT findings are essentially unchanged.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前（IM41）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is unchanged from prior (IM41).

source_text: 纵隔2-7组多个淋巴结同前相仿，较大约12x9mm（IM25）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal groups 2-7 unchanged from prior, largest approximately 12x9mm (IM25).

source_text: 新见小斑片结节
text_en: Newly identified small patchy nodule

source_text: 纵隔4L组淋巴结较前略增大，现约14*10mm(图21)，原约13x9mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4L lymph nodes slightly increased in size compared to prior, currently approximately 14x10mm (image 21), previously approximately 13x9mm (image 20).

source_text: 左肺下叶背段模糊结节同前（IM25），追查
text_en: Left lower lobe dorsal segment ground-glass nodule unchanged from prior (IM25), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则结节影同前，约28*14mm（IMA18），周围斑片结节索条状影同前
text_en: Irregular nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 28 x 14 mm (IMA18), and surrounding patchy nodular and linear opacities are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔4、5、7组淋巴结同前，较大约17x8mm（IM29），平扫呈高密度
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4, 5, and 7 unchanged, largest measuring approximately 17x8 mm (IM29), on non-contrast scan appears high density

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下、左肺下叶散在小结节同前（IM42、45），较大约4mm（IM45）
text_en: Scattered small nodules subpleurally in the right middle lobe and in the left lower lobe are unchanged (IM42, 45), with the largest measuring approximately 4 mm (IM45).

source_text: 右肺中叶结节同前，复查
text_en: Nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged; repeat examination.

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下结节伴点状钙化同前，约8mm（IM16）
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural nodule with punctate calcification unchanged from prior, approximately 8 mm (IM16).

source_text: 余双肺未见新增结节或实变影，右侧胸膜基本光滑，未见胸水
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no newly increased nodules or consolidation shadows; the right pleura is essentially smooth with no pleural effusion.

source_text: 右肺术后同前，未见新发占位
text_en: Status post right lung surgery is stable; no new mass is seen.

source_text: 左肺术后，双肺多发结节增多、增大，考虑转移进展
text_en: Post left lung surgery, multiple nodules in both lungs have increased in number and size, suggestive of metastatic progression.

source_text: 两肺少许浅淡微小结节同前相仿
text_en: The faint, tiny nodules in both lungs are similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段见不规则混杂密度软组织肿块较前缩小，内部可见气体密度影，边缘模糊见浅分叶，原约57x43mm（IM43），现约41x36mm（IM43），下叶后基底段支气管于病灶处截断，与邻近胸膜分界不清，增强扫描病灶呈边缘强化为主，内部呈稍低强化，周围可见少许片絮影，病灶远端肺不张较前减轻，余双肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: An irregular, heterogeneous soft-tissue mass in the basal segment of the right lower lobe has decreased in size compared to prior. It contains gas-density foci, with indistinct margins and shallow lobulation. Previously measured approximately 57 x 43 mm (IM43), now approximately 41 x 36 mm (IM43). The posterior basal segmental bronchus is truncated at the lesion site, and the lesion is poorly demarcated from adjacent pleura. On contrast-enhanced scans, the lesion shows predominantly peripheral enhancement with relatively lower internal enhancement. A few patchy linear opacities are seen around the lesion. Post-obstructive atelectasis distal to the lesion has improved compared to prior. No nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺内低密度结节同前
text_en: A low-density nodule is seen in the thyroid, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺透过度较前减低，原多发转移小结节缩小、显示欠清，部分呈点灶，现较大约2mm（IM23）
text_en: Lung lucency is lower than prior; the previously multiple metastatic small nodules are smaller and less distinct, some appearing as punctate foci; the largest is now approximately 2 mm (IM23).

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前（Im25）
text_en: Tiny nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior (Im25).

source_text: 双腋下多发小淋巴结大致同前，左侧胸水消失
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes at both axillae are generally unchanged from prior; left-sided pleural effusion has resolved.

source_text: 纵隔及右侧锁骨上多发肿大淋巴结大致同前（Im23、4），左膈上小淋巴结同前，约5mm（IM48）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right supraclavicular region are largely unchanged from previous (IM23, IM4). A small lymph node in the left supra-diaphragmatic region is unchanged from previous, approximately 5 mm (IM48).

source_text: 右肺门、纵隔2R、4R、7肿大淋巴结较前略缩小
text_en: Enlarged lymph nodes at the right hilum and mediastinum (stations 2R, 4R, 7) are slightly smaller than prior.

source_text: 左肺门淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Left hilar lymph nodes stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺内小结节大致同前，定期复查
text_en: Small nodules in the right lung are essentially unchanged; routine follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 平扫纵隔淋巴结影较前相仿，较大者仍约14x11mm，密度浅淡(IM22)
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows a mediastinal lymph node similar to prior, largest still approximately 14x11 mm with low density (image 22).

source_text: 左肺胸膜下小结节同前，约7mm（IM38），余左肺未见结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Left lung subpleural small nodule unchanged from previous, approximately 7mm (IM38), no nodules or patchy opacities in the remaining left lung.

source_text: 余双肺未见新发结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no new nodules or fluffy-appearing lesions.

source_text: 双肺小结节同前，考虑良性
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are stable compared to prior, considered benign

source_text: 左肺下叶背段浅淡磨玻璃密度灶较前相仿，约5mm（IM18），左肺下叶前基底段边界模糊小结节大致相仿，约9*7mm（IM37）
text_en: Left lower lobe dorsal segment faint ground-glass opacity similar to prior, approximately 5mm (IM18); left lower lobe anterior basal segment ill-defined small nodule roughly similar, approximately 9*7mm (IM37).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，考虑良性
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, considered benign.

source_text: 右肺结节较前相仿，较大约9*7mm（IMA46）
text_en: The right lung nodule is similar to prior; the larger one measures approximately 9x7 mm (IMA46).

source_text: 双肺下叶内基底段小结节同前（Im40、49），内部可见小空洞
text_en: Small nodule in the medial basal segment of both lower lobes is stable compared to prior (Im40, 49), with a small internal cavity visible

source_text: 其外侧圆形结节较前相仿，约8mm（IM19）
text_en: The round nodule lateral to it is similar to prior, measuring approximately 8 mm (IM19).

source_text: 双侧胸膜增厚，右侧部分胸膜呈结节状同前相仿，双侧胸腔内未见积液
text_en: Bilateral pleural thickening, with right-sided pleura showing nodular appearance, is unchanged. No pleural effusion is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 前纵隔占位术后，条片状低密度影及术区积液大致同前
text_en: Status post resection of an anterior mediastinal mass; linear and band-like low-density shadows and fluid collection at the surgical site are essentially unchanged.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区淋巴结同前，约为7mm（IM2）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node is unchanged, approximately 7 mm (IM2)

source_text: 左肺结节影同前，约5mm（IMA11）
text_en: Left pulmonary nodule unchanged from prior, approximately 5 mm (IMA11).

source_text: 隆突下肿大淋巴结较前缩小
text_en: Enlarged subcarinal lymph nodes reduced compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶切除术后，纵隔小淋巴结及肺内陈旧表现大致同前
text_en: Postoperative changes following right middle lobectomy. Small mediastinal lymph nodes and old pulmonary findings are essentially unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段近纵隔处结节同前，约19x16mm（IM27），强化欠均匀，边缘呈浅分叶状，相邻中间段支气管管壁尚光滑
text_en: Nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe near the mediastinum is unchanged, measuring approximately 19 x 16 mm (IM27), with heterogeneous enhancement and shallow lobulated margins; the adjacent intermediate segment bronchial wall remains smooth.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃结节同前相仿
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe similar to prior examination.

source_text: 右侧胸廓小同前，右肺上叶肿块影较前缩小，原约32x23mm（IM14），现约33x16mm（IM17）
text_en: Right thoracic cavity is slightly unchanged. The mass in the right upper lobe is smaller than before, previously measuring approximately 32x23 mm (IM14), now approximately 33x16 mm (IM17).

source_text: 右肺门多发淋巴结较前略缩小，较大原约13x9mm（IM24），现约13x8mm（IM26）
text_en: Multiple right hilar lymph nodes are slightly smaller than before; the largest was previously approximately 13x9 mm (IM24), now approximately 13x8 mm (IM26).

source_text: 纵隔多个小淋巴结，部分增大，转移
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes, some enlarged, metastatic.

source_text: 肝脏及脾脏低密度结节同前
text_en: Liver and spleen low-density nodules unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺野散在微小结节灶同前，较大约3mm（IM34），右肺上叶、下叶胸膜下少许模糊片絮影同前
text_en: Scattered tiny nodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior; the largest measures about 3 mm (IM34). Additionally, minimal indistinct linear and fluffy opacities subpleurally in the right upper and lower lobes remain unchanged.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后改变同前，胸部CT平扫未见明显新发占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left lower lobe are unchanged; non-contrast chest CT shows no obvious new mass-like lesions.

source_text: 右上肺微结节同前（IM16、24）
text_en: Micro-nodules in the right upper lung are unchanged (IM16, 24).

source_text: 纵隔5、6、10L组肿大淋巴结较前略缩小，较大原约22x15mm（IM18），现约18x16mm（IM16）
text_en: Enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 5, 6, and 10L slightly decreased in size compared to previous, previously largest approximately 22x15 mm (IM18), now approximately 18x16 mm (IM16).

source_text: 纵隔10R淋巴结略增大同前，约8*7mm(图23)
text_en: Right paratracheal (10R) mediastinal lymph node slightly enlarged, similar to prior, measuring approximately 8x7 mm (Figure 23)

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结部分较前缩小
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes have decreased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 双肺散在多发小结节数目及大小同前，较大约9mm（Im30）
text_en: Number and size of scattered multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, the largest measuring approximately 9 mm (Im30).

source_text: 纵隔、左侧锁骨上平扫小淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal and left supraclavicular small lymph nodes on non-contrast scan unchanged from previous, less than 10 mm

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前增大，较大约14x9mm（IM24），原约5mm（IM24），肺门、腋窝及锁骨上平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are enlarged compared to previous; largest approximately 14x9mm (IM24), previously approximately 5mm (IM24); no enlarged lymph nodes seen in hilar, axillary, or supraclavicular regions on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门小淋巴结同前，短径小于10mm
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right hilum are stable compared to prior, with short axes less than 10 mm.

source_text: 右下肺索条影同前，左肺透亮度均匀，双肺未见新生结节或实变影
text_en: The linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged from prior. The left lung demonstrates uniform luency. No new nodules or areas of consolidation are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左上肺微小结节同前（Im13）
text_en: The tiny nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged (Im13).

source_text: 平扫纵隔7组淋巴结同前，约12*8mm（IM23）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows the mediastinal station 7 lymph node unchanged, approximately 12x8 mm (Image 23).

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结大致同前，密切追查
text_en: Mediastinal 4R lymph node stable; close follow-up

source_text: 左肺下叶背段胸膜下浅淡小结节影同前，约3mm（IM30）
text_en: A subpleural faint small nodule shadow in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM30).

source_text: 左斜裂胸膜结节样增厚同前相仿
text_en: Nodular thickening along the left oblique fissure is similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶心缘旁模糊结节此次未见显示，余双肺未见新发结节影
text_en: Previously noted indistinct nodule adjacent to the cardiac border in the right middle lobe is no longer visible; no new nodules are seen in the remainder of both lungs

source_text: 右第8肋改变，性质待定，不除外转移，请结合骨扫描
text_en: Right 8th rib abnormality, indeterminate in nature; metastasis cannot be excluded; correlation with bone scan recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶及右肺下叶结节同前相仿
text_en: Nodules in the left upper lobe and right lower lobe are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段结节影较前相仿，边界清楚，边缘光滑，约5mm（IMA11），周围未见卫星灶
text_en: The nodular opacity in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is similar to prior, with clear boundaries and smooth margins, measuring approximately 5 mm (IMA11). No satellite lesions are seen in the surrounding lung parenchyma.

source_text: 甲状腺多发结节大致同前，请结合临床及颈部检查
text_en: Multiple thyroid nodules stable compared to prior; please correlate with clinical findings and neck examination.

source_text: 未见复发转移征象
text_en: No evidence of recurrence or metastasis

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段结节影较前增大，原约16x10mm（IM46），现为18x12mm（IM51）
text_en: Nodular opacity in the basal segment of the right lower lobe has increased in size, previously measuring approximately 16 x 10 mm (IM46), now measuring 18 x 12 mm (IM51).

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节同前（IM35），约3mm
text_en: Small nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged (IM35), measuring approximately 3 mm.

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下不规则肿物较前增大，原约26*22mm(图43)，现约30x22mm（IM42），肿块以宽基底连于胸膜，局部胸膜稍厚
text_en: Irregular subpleural mass in the right lower lobe has increased in size compared to prior (previously approximately 26 x 22 mm, Figure 43), now measuring approximately 30 x 22 mm (IM42); the mass is attached to the pleura by a broad base, with slight local pleural thickening.

source_text: 双肺气肿、间质性改变伴双肺少许索条影同前，肺内未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Pulmonary emphysema and interstitial changes with a few linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged; no new nodules or consolidation are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 右肺部分结节较前稍增大，如下叶背段结节原约6mm（IM26），现约7mm（IM26），另一结节原约2mm者现约3mm（IMA18）
text_en: Some nodules in the right lung are slightly larger than before; for example, a nodule in the dorsal segment of the lower lobe increased from approximately 6 mm (IM26) to 7 mm (IM26), and another nodule increased from 2 mm to 3 mm (IMA18).

source_text: 左肺下叶近膈面处新见多发簇状分布结节，较大约6mm（IM49），周围见絮状索条影，首先倾向炎性，请结合临床抗炎后复查谨慎除外转移
text_en: Newly observed multiple clustered nodules near the diaphragmatic surface of the left lower lobe, largest approximately 6 mm (IM49), with surrounding fluffy linear opacities. Primarily suggestive of inflammatory etiology.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，未见新增异常密度影
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no new abnormal density foci identified.

source_text: 左肺少许索条影同前，未见肺内结节
text_en: Left lung: few linear opacities same as before, no pulmonary nodules seen.

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜小结节略饱满，现约4mm（IM30），原约3mm
text_en: Small nodule in the left interlobar pleura is slightly prominent, now approximately 4 mm (IM30), previously about 3 mm.

source_text: 右肺下叶新见小结节，较大约4mm（IM56）
text_en: Newly seen small nodule in the right lower lobe, largest approximately 4 mm (IM56).

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门稍大淋巴结同前，较大者仍约13x10mm（IM28），平扫密度稍高
text_en: Slightly enlarged mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest still approximately 13x10mm (IM28), with slightly higher density on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 右肺小结节影同前，仍约3mm（IMA16）
text_en: Right lung small nodule shadows are unchanged, still approximately 3 mm (IMA16).

source_text: 纵隔4L淋巴结较前缩小，原约13*11mm(图20)，现约10*10mm(图24)，建议追查
text_en: The mediastinal 4L lymph node is decreased compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 13x11 mm (Figure 20), currently approximately 10x10 mm (Figure 24), with recommendation for follow-up.

source_text: 双肺内未见新增结节及实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 未见复发
text_en: No recurrence

source_text: 食管癌疗后较前好转
text_en: Post-treatment for esophageal cancer, improved compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔6组淋巴结同前相仿，约13x5mm（IM16）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal station 6 are similar to prior, approximately 13x5 mm (IM16).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段多发模糊点片影及多发类圆形小结节较前缩小、变淡，原较大约6mm（IM25），现小于3mm
text_en: Multiple ill-defined punctate and patchy opacities and multiple round small nodules in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe have decreased in size and become fainter compared to prior, previously up to approximately 6 mm (IM25), now less than 3 mm.

source_text: 右下肺见双发模糊结节同前（IM43、49），小于5mm
text_en: Two indistinct nodules in the right lower lobe are unchanged (IM43, 49), each less than 5 mm.

source_text: 余纵膈多发多个小淋巴结大致同前
text_en: The remaining multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes are approximately unchanged.

source_text: 肺内局限性纤维化条索同前相仿，余肺内未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Focal fibrotic streaks within the lung similar to previous; no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remaining lung parenchyma

source_text: 左肺下叶胸主动脉旁小结节影同前，约7*4mm（IM32）
text_en: A small nodule adjacent to the thoracic aorta in the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 7x4 mm (IM32).

source_text: 右下肺胸膜下模糊小结节同前，约3mm（IM23）
text_en: The subpleural indistinct small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM23).

source_text: 右肺上叶微小结节同前，约4x3mm（图13）
text_en: Tiny nodules in the right upper lobe, unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 4 × 3 mm (Figure 13).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，右肺下叶基底段结节大小同前，仍约10x8mm（IM46），边缘光整，内部见斑点状钙化，余肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Lung parenchymal lucency is uniform. A nodule in the basal segment of the right lower lobe is stable in size, still measuring approximately 10x8 mm (IM46), with smooth margins and punctate calcification within. No other nodules or consolidation are seen.

source_text: 左肱骨头高密度结节同前
text_en: High-density nodule in the left humeral head is unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，较大者约7x5mm（IM13）
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, the largest approximately 7x5mm (IM13).

source_text: 纵隔内及锁骨上小淋巴结同前，随诊观察
text_en: Small lymph nodes within the mediastinum and supraclavicular region are unchanged from previous, with follow-up observation.

source_text: 左肺上叶肿块较前稍大，左侧胸膜转移较前相仿，
text_en: Left upper lobe mass slightly larger than previous, left pleural metastasis similar to previous.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段另见微小结节灶同前，约3mm（IM26），边界模糊
text_en: Another tiny nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IM26), with indistinct margins.

source_text: 左上肺小结节同前，倾向陈旧灶，随诊观察
text_en: Small nodule in the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior, likely representing a chronic focus; follow-up observation is recommended.

source_text: 胸廓骨质未见破坏灶
text_en: No destructive lesions seen in the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段软组织密度肿块影，边界清楚，边缘不规则，现约34*27mm(图52)，原约48*46mm（IMA55），肿块远端见条片状影
text_en: Soft-tissue density mass in the basal segment of the right lower lobe, with well-defined but irregular margins. Currently measures approximately 34 x 27 mm (Figure 52), previously measured approximately 48 x 46 mm (IMA55). Linear opacities are seen distal to the mass, unchanged.

source_text: 双侧肺内多发小结节较前相仿
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the bilateral lungs are similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺尖小磨玻璃密度结节大致同前，现约6mm（IM12）
text_en: Small ground-glass nodule in the right lung apex is stable compared to prior, now approximately 6 mm (IM12).

source_text: 纵隔、膈上淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal and supra-diaphragmatic lymph nodes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下分别见3mm及4mm大小结节同前（Im52,37）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural nodules measuring 3 mm and 4 mm, unchanged from prior (Im52, 37)

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节较前略增大，现约7*6mm(图32，原约6*4mm(图30)
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is slightly larger than prior, currently measuring approximately 7x6 mm (Figure 32), previously about 6x4 mm (Figure 30).

source_text: 胸12椎体楔形变同前，余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: T12 vertebral body wedge-shaped deformity unchanged, the remaining thoracic bones show no evidence of bone destruction.

source_text: 右肺癌术后改变，右侧胸腔积液较前吸收
text_en: Postoperative change from right lung cancer; right pleural effusion has improved compared to prior.

source_text: 两肺斑片影、右肺点状结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Patchy opacities in both lungs and punctate nodules in the right lung, unchanged from prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺胸膜下微结节同前（IM31、44）
text_en: Left lung subpleural tiny nodules unchanged from previous (IM31, 44).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段胸膜下小结节灶同前，仍约2mm（IM30）
text_en: Subpleural small nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is stable, still approximately 2 mm (IM30)

source_text: 食道胸上中段管壁不均匀异常增厚较前略减轻，较厚处原约16mm，现约13mm（IM23），外膜模糊，同胸主动脉接触面小于90度，近端食管仍可见扩张
text_en: Irregular wall thickening of the upper-middle thoracic esophagus slightly decreased compared to prior, with maximum thickness reduced from approximately 16 mm to 13 mm (IM23); outer wall blurred, interface with thoracic aorta less than 90 degrees, proximal esophagus still dilated

source_text: 食管胸中下段管壁不均匀增厚较前略减轻，较厚处原约12mm（IM32），现约10mm（IM26）
text_en: The uneven wall thickening of the mid-to-lower thoracic esophagus is slightly reduced compared to prior, with the thickest portion previously measuring approximately 12 mm (IM32) and now approximately 10 mm (IM26)

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，较大仍约7mm（IM26）
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, largest still approximately 7 mm (IM26).

source_text: 双肺纹理增重紊乱并散在钙化索条影同前，两肺多发小结节同前，仍小于5mm
text_en: Increased, disorganized lung markings with scattered calcified linear opacities are similar to prior. Multiple small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior and remain less than 5 mm.

source_text: 扫及右乳内见一结节，背部见点状钙化，较前相仿，约10mm（IM31），请结合乳腺其他检查
text_en: CT shows a nodule in the right breast with punctate calcifications in the posterior aspect, similar to prior and measuring approximately 10 mm (IM31). Correlate with other breast examinations.

source_text: 右侧水平裂胸膜小结节或片状轻度增厚同前，余双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Small pleural nodule or mild patchy thickening along the right horizontal fissure is stable. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左侧斜裂胸膜小结节较前缩小，原约6x4mm（IM40），现约4x2mm（IM45）
text_en: Small nodule along the left major fissure pleura is smaller than prior, previously approximately 6x4 mm (IM40), now approximately 4x2 mm (IM45).

source_text: 左肺下叶结节大致同前，仍约13x11mm(Im38)，左肺多发索条影同前
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is essentially unchanged, still approximately 13x11 mm on image 38, and multiple linear opacities in the left lung are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段稍高密度索条小结节灶同前（IM27）
text_en: Slightly hyperdense linear small nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable compared to prior (IM27)

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右肺上叶少许索条及结节灶同前
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent; minimal linear opacities and nodular foci in the right upper lobe are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 食管旁多发肿大淋巴结较前明显缩小，较大原约37x21mm，现约17x8mm（IM28）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes adjacent to the esophagus are significantly decreased in size compared to prior. The largest node was previously approximately 37x21 mm, now approximately 17x8 mm (IM28).

source_text: 纵隔、右侧锁骨上区及右肺门淋巴结同前，较大约12x9mm（IM21）
text_en: Lymph nodes in the mediastinum, right supraclavicular region, and right hilar region are similar to prior, the largest measuring approximately 12x9 mm (IM21).

source_text: 右肺中叶内侧段及左肺下叶外基底段胸膜下模糊结节同前（IM25、52、57）
text_en: The subpleural indistinct nodules in the medial segment of the right middle lobe and the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe are unchanged from prior (IM25, 52, 57).

source_text: 左肺门淋巴结同前（IM25)，右肺门及双侧锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Left hilar lymph nodes unchanged compared to previous (Image 25). No enlarged lymph nodes seen in right hilar or bilateral supraclavicular regions.

source_text: 其后方新见软组织结节，约32x23mm（IM20）
text_en: A new soft tissue nodule is seen posterior to it, measuring approximately 32x23 mm (IM20).

source_text: 纵隔内钙化灶同前，未见明显肿大淋巴结
text_en: Calcified foci within the mediastinum same as before; no significantly enlarged lymph nodes seen

source_text: 并新发淋巴结，大小约15x10mm（IM30）
text_en: In addition, a newly developed lymph node approximately 15x10 mm in size (image 30).

source_text: 右肺钙化结节、索条影同前
text_en: Calcified nodule and fibrotic band in the right lung are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 新发结节如右肺上叶约5mm（IM30）灶
text_en: newly identified nodule in the right upper lobe approximately 5mm (IM30)

source_text: 双肺索条及斑片影较前增多，双肺未见新增结节灶
text_en: Linear opacities and patchy opacities in both lungs have increased compared to prior. No new nodules are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶点状结节影同前（IM51）
text_en: Left lower lobe punctate nodule shadow same as prior (IM51)

source_text: 双肺少量微小结节同前
text_en: Few tiny nodules in both lungs are stable.

source_text: 纵隔散在小淋巴结同前，密度较高
text_en: Scattered small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, with higher density.

source_text: 右肺上叶及中叶多发类圆形小结节同前，部分呈磨玻璃密度，较大约5mm（Im11），余双肺未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: Multiple rounded small nodules in the right upper and middle lobes remain unchanged; some have ground-glass density; the largest is approximately 5 mm (Im11); no new nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 气管左旁淋巴结同前，仍约11x8mm（IM9）
text_en: Left paratracheal lymph node unchanged, still measuring approximately 11x8 mm (IM9).

source_text: 纵隔脂肪密度较前清晰，小淋巴结同前，较大仍约15x6mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal fat density more defined than previous, small lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest still approximately 15x6mm (IM20).

source_text: 左叶间胸膜下小结节同前（IM24）
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the left interlobar region unchanged from prior (IM24).

source_text: 2R、4R、7组多发淋巴结同前相仿，较大现约12x7mm（IM18）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in stations 2R, 4R, and 7 are similar to prior; the largest is currently about 12x7 mm (IM18).

source_text: 左肺上舌段胸膜下不规则模糊小结节影大致同前，约4mm（IM30），索条影同前
text_en: Irregular blurred small subpleural nodule in the left upper lobe lingular segment essentially unchanged, approximately 4mm (IM30); linear streak shadow unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔2-7组及双肺门多发肿大淋巴结，部分同前，现约13x9mm（IM10）
text_en: Mediastinal stations 2-7 and bilateral hilar multiple enlarged lymph nodes; some are unchanged from previous, and the size is now approximately 13x9mm (IM10).

source_text: 双肺散在小结节同前，较大约4*3mm（IM17）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, largest approximately 4x3 mm (IM17).

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下区见微小结节同前，约3mm（IM9）
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural region, tiny nodule similar to previous, approximately 3 mm (IM9).

source_text: 双肺透过度较均匀，未见新发结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Lung parenchymal density is uniform; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 左肺上叶模糊小结节影同前，仍约5mm（IM19）
text_en: Left upper lobe hazy small nodule unchanged from prior, still approximately 5 mm (IM19).

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，右肺模糊浅淡结节影同前，左上肺条片状实变灶同前
text_en: Following right upper lobectomy, indistinct faint nodular opacities in the right lung are unchanged; a linear patchy consolidation in the left upper lung is unchanged.

source_text: 余肺未见新发结节斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 纵隔多发肿大淋巴结大致同前，边界模糊，现仍约24x16mm（IMA24），考虑转移可能
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes enlarged, stable compared to prior with ill-defined margins, largest still approximately 24x16 mm (IMA24), suspicion for metastasis

source_text: 右肺中叶肺癌伴中叶不张，较前好转
text_en: Right middle lobe lung cancer with middle lobe atelectasis, improved compared to prior.

source_text: 左下肺、左肺舌段散在小结节同前，较大约6mm（IM48）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the left lower lobe and left lingular segment are stable. The largest measures approximately 6 mm (IM48).

source_text: 纵隔4、7组淋巴结同前，5-8mm，平扫呈高密度同前相仿
text_en: Mediastinal stations 4 and 7 lymph nodes unchanged from prior, measuring 5-8 mm; non-contrast scan shows high density unchanged from prior

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结部分较前相仿，如5组仍约14x9mm（IM27）
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes are similar in size compared to previous; for example, station 5 remains approximately 14x9 mm (IM27).

source_text: 右肺门上三枚小结节较前略增大，较大原约5x2mm（IM17），现约7x2mm（IM18），追查
text_en: Three small nodules in the upper right hilum are slightly larger than before, previously approximately 5 x 2 mm (IM17), now about 7 x 2 mm (IM18); further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺术后改变，支气管断端未见异常，右肺上叶磨玻璃结节及左肺上叶微小结节同前（IM13、14），双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lung; no abnormality at the bronchial stump, ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe and a tiny nodule in the left upper lobe are stable compared to prior (IM13, 14), and no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶结节同前
text_en: Nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior

source_text: 支气管断端软组织结节同前、纵隔2R低密度灶较前缩小，考虑术后改变
text_en: Bronchial stump soft tissue nodule unchanged; mediastinal station 2R low-density focus decreased in size compared to prior, considered postoperative change.

source_text: 双下肺索条影较前相仿，余肺内未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: Linear opacities in the bilateral lower lungs are similar to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 双侧肺内未见新发结节灶
text_en: No new nodules are seen in the bilateral lungs.

source_text: 左肺上、下叶楔形切除术后，局部斑片、索条影及类结节影同前
text_en: Post-wedge resection of the left upper and lower lobes, the local patchy, linear, and nodular opacities are unchanged.

source_text: 左肺胸膜下散在少许3-5mm浅淡密度微小结节同前
text_en: Left lung subpleural scattered few 3-5 mm faint density tiny nodules unchanged

source_text: 纵隔4、7组多发淋巴结同前，腔静脉后较大者仍约12*8mm（IM14）
text_en: Mediastinal stations 4 and 7 multiple lymph nodes unchanged from prior; largest posterior to vena cava still approximately 12x8 mm (IM14)

source_text: 双侧叶间胸膜结节样增厚同前
text_en: Nodular thickening in the bilateral interlobar fissures is unchanged.

source_text: 甲状腺左叶低密度结节较前缩小(图6)
text_en: Left thyroid lobe low-density nodule decreased in size compared to prior (Figure 6).

source_text: 脊柱侧弯同前，扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: Scoliosis unchanged from previous; no evidence of bone destruction in the scanned bones

source_text: 左肺新见散在微小结节，转移可能大，建议追查
text_en: New scattered tiny nodules in left lung, high possibility of metastasis, recommend follow-up

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下小结节同前，良性
text_en: The subpleural small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior and is benign

source_text: 纵隔内散在数枚小淋巴结同前
text_en: Several scattered small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior

source_text: 右侧前胸壁皮下结节大致同前，约7mm（IM22）
text_en: Subcutaneous nodule in the right anterior chest wall is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 7 mm (IM22).

source_text: 左肺门淋巴结同前，约14x7mm（IM27）
text_en: Left hilar lymph node unchanged, approximately 14x7 mm (IM27).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段结节较前缩小，考虑肺癌可能性大
text_en: Nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe has decreased in size compared to prior; primary lung cancer is considered likely

source_text: 右肺下叶4mm小结节同前（Im42）
text_en: A 4 mm small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM42).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，原右肺下叶不规则团片状占位较前缩小，现仅可见稍高密度索条影，考虑炎性病变
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Lung parenchymal lucency is uniform. The previously noted irregular mass-like lesion in the right lower lobe has decreased in size compared to prior and now appears as a slightly increased density linear opacity, suggesting inflammatory change.

source_text: 食管术后改变，双肺散在索条及小结节同前，未见复发征象
text_en: Post-esophagectomy changes, scattered linear opacities and small nodules in both lungs unchanged, no signs of recurrence.

source_text: 两肺间质改变同前，未见新发结节
text_en: Interstitial changes in both lungs are stable; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见异常强化区，右肺下叶见不规则条片影，双肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no abnormal enhancement is seen at the bronchial stump. Irregular linear and patchy opacities are seen in the right lower lobe. No new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 纵隔内散在淋巴结同前，短径小于10mm
text_en: Scattered mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, with short axis less than 10mm

source_text: 右肺散在模糊斑点、结节灶部分较前相仿，现仍约4mm（IM36），右肺下叶斑片索条灶较前相仿
text_en: Scattered indistinct punctate opacities and nodules in the right lung are similar to prior, currently still approximately 4 mm (IM36); patchy linear opacities in the right lower lobe are similar to prior.

source_text: 两肺小结节影同前
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior

source_text: 右肺上叶术后同前，支气管断端未见复发征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lobe are stable compared to prior. No signs of recurrence are seen at the bronchial stump.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结同前（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph node unchanged from prior (IM19)

source_text: 两肺散在小斑片索条影同前，双肺散在微小结节影同前
text_en: The scattered small patchy linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged; scattered tiny nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 左侧第5肋见成骨性骨破坏，局部皮质略膨胀，考虑转移
text_en: Osteoblastic bone destruction in the left 5th rib with slightly expanded cortex; metastasis is considered.

source_text: 右肺中叶结节同前，仍约9*5mm（IM35）.
text_en: Nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged, still measuring approximately 9 × 5 mm (IM35).

source_text: 胸下段者原厚约17mm，较大层面约30x20mm，现约21x9mm（IM51），外膜清晰，与胸主动脉接触约90度
text_en: Esophageal wall in the lower thoracic segment, previous thickness approximately 17mm, larger dimension approximately 30x20mm; current approximately 21x9mm (IM51); outer membrane clear; contact with thoracic aorta approximately 90 degrees.

source_text: 右肺下叶见钙化结节及小条影同前（IMA37），余双肺纹理透亮度均匀，未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Calcified nodule and small linear opacities in the right lower lobe are unchanged (IMA37). The remainder of the lungs shows uniform lucency and texture, with no new nodules or consolidations.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段模糊小结节灶大致同前（IMA40）
text_en: An ill-defined small nodule in the left lower lobe posterior basal segment is approximately the same as previous (IMA40).

source_text: 双肺纹理增重，多发微结节同前相仿（IM23、29、37等）
text_en: Increased lung markings. Multiple micro-nodules are similar to prior (e.g., IM23, 29, 37).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，右肺上叶前段见一磨玻璃密度结节同前，仍约9mm（IM25），余肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Lung parenchymal lucency is uniform. A ground-glass opacity in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe is stable, still measuring approximately 9 mm (IM25). No new nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔多枚淋巴结较前增大，较大者原约12x7mm，现约20x8mm（Im21）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes have increased in size compared to previous; the largest was previously approximately 12x7 mm and is now approximately 20x8 mm (Image 21).

source_text: 右肺透亮度均匀，未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: The right lung demonstrates uniform lucency, without new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 纵隔4R区淋巴结较前稍饱满，原约10x7mm（IM18），现约11x9mm（IM17），追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are slightly prominent compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 10x7 mm (IM18), currently measuring approximately 11x9 mm (IM17), further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜见边界清楚小结节同前，仍约5mm（IM28）
text_en: Well-circumscribed small nodule in the left interlobar pleura is unchanged compared to prior, still approximately 5 mm (IM28).

source_text: 纵隔右旁低密度结节增大，原约12x6mm（IM29），现约18x9mm（IM28）
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right mediastinal region, increased in size from approximately 12x6mm (IM29) to approximately 18x9mm (IM28).

source_text: 右肺小结节同前3mm（IM36）
text_en: Small nodule in the right lung stable at 3 mm (IM36).

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜结节样增厚同前(图29)，未见胸水征象
text_en: The nodular thickening along the right interlobar pleura is unchanged (Figure 29). No pleural effusion is seen.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段模糊结节同前（IM29）
text_en: Left lower lobe dorsal segment indistinct nodule unchanged from prior (IM29).

source_text: 两肺未见新发异常密度灶
text_en: No new abnormal density foci seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左侧胸膜结节同前，追查
text_en: Left pleural nodule is stable compared to prior; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶微小结节同前，现约4mm（IM39），追查
text_en: Right lower lobe tiny nodule unchanged, now approximately 4 mm (IM39), follow-up recommended

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则形结节同前，仍约18*14mm（IM20）
text_en: An irregular nodular lesion in the right upper lobe posterior segment is stable compared to prior, remaining approximately 18x14 mm (IM20).

source_text: 右下叶术后，支气管断端未见异常软组织密度肿块影，右肺索条影、钙化灶同前
text_en: Postoperative status, right lower lobe; no abnormal soft tissue density mass at the bronchial stump; right lung linear densities and calcifications unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前（IM34）
text_en: Small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM34).

source_text: 双肺散在少许索条影及左肺类小结节影（IM30）同前相仿
text_en: Scattered few linear opacities and left lung-like small nodules (IM30) are unchanged, similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶钙化、索条、小结节影、右肺下叶点状结节影同前（IMA17、21、39）
text_en: Calcification, linear opacities, and small nodules in the right upper lobe, and punctate nodules in the right lower lobe are unchanged (IMA17, 21, 39).

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前(IM28)
text_en: Tiny nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior (IM28).

source_text: 纵隔结节状软组织密度影同前，约16x10mm（IM28）
text_en: Nodular soft tissue density shadow in mediastinum as before, approximately 16x10 mm (IM28).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见占位征象，左肺条片影同前（IMA29）
text_en: Left upper lobe postoperative status. No mass-like lesion at the bronchial stump. Left lung linear opacities stable (IMA29)

source_text: 右肺下叶背段原混杂磨玻璃密度结节较前缩小
text_en: Previously noted mixed ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe posterior segment is smaller than prior.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上淋巴结较前增大，纵隔多发淋巴结同前
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node is enlarged compared to prior; multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，约为5mm（Im49）
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 5 mm (Im49).

source_text: 双肺上叶微小结节、右肺下叶小结节同前，倾向陈旧灶，建议随诊复查
text_en: Micronodules in the upper lobes of both lungs and small nodules in the right lower lobe are stable compared to prior; likely chronic. Recommend follow-up.

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜结节状增厚同前相仿（IM32），左肺下叶散在多发片絮影同前
text_en: The nodular thickening of the left interlobar pleura is similar to prior (IM32); scattered patchy opacities in the left lower lobe are stable.

source_text: 纵隔内多发小淋巴结同前，最大19x10mm（Se2IM26）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes, stable compared to prior. Largest measuring 19x10 mm (Se2IM26).

source_text: 甲状腺右叶低密度结节同前（IM6）
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right lobe of the thyroid gland unchanged from prior (IM6).

source_text: 右肺下叶部分肺不张较前相仿，右叶间胸膜结节影同前，约5mm（IM22），追查
text_en: The partial atelectasis in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior. The nodular opacity in the right interlobar pleura is unchanged, measuring about 5 mm (IM22), and requires follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔隆突下及右肺门区新见多枚肿大淋巴结，较大者约16x12mm（Im38）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes newly seen in subcarinal and right hilar regions, largest approximately 16x12mm (Im38).

source_text: 其右侧肿大淋巴结明显缩小，原约18x13mm，现约15x7mm（Im12）
text_en: The enlarged lymph node on its right side has markedly decreased in size, from approximately 18x13 mm to approximately 15x7 mm (Im12).

source_text: 肝内低密度灶及右侧肾上腺结节同前
text_en: Hypodense lesion in liver and nodule in right adrenal gland unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下可见微小结节同前，＜5mm（IM33）
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring less than 5 mm (IM33).

source_text: 纵隔右移，纵隔小淋巴结平扫同前（IM22）
text_en: Mediastinal shift to the right, non-contrast mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged from prior (IM22).

source_text: 右肺下叶术后改变，右肺门结节同前
text_en: Postoperative change in the right lower lobe; right hilar nodule is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，局部未见复发征象
text_en: Left lower lobe postoperative, no signs of local recurrence.

source_text: 双肺散在多个圆形小结节同前（IM18、35、40），较大约5mm（IM18）
text_en: Scattered multiple round small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM18, 35, 40), the largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM18).

source_text: 双锁骨上窝、纵隔、双肺门未见明显增大淋巴结
text_en: No obvious enlarged lymph nodes are seen in bilateral supraclavicular fossae, mediastinum, or bilateral hila.

source_text: 右侧肾上腺结节同前，请结合腹部检查
text_en: Adrenal nodule on the right is unchanged. Correlation with abdominal imaging is recommended.

source_text: 食管癌术后，吻合口壁未见复发征象
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer, no evidence of recurrence at the anastomotic wall.

source_text: 双肺散在多发小结节部分较前增大、增多，如原约3mm者，现约6mm（IM40）
text_en: Some of the scattered multiple small nodules in both lungs are larger and more numerous than prior; for example, a nodule previously about 3 mm now measures approximately 6 mm (IM40).

source_text: 右肺中叶内侧段可见索条影，余肺内未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Linear strands are visible in the medial segment of the right middle lobe; otherwise, no new nodules or consolidation are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶散在小结节部分同前，较大约4x3mm（IM59），部分受邻近肺不张影响显示欠佳
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the left lower lobe, some unchanged from prior, largest approximately 4x3 mm (IM59), some poorly visualized due to adjacent atelectasis

source_text: T10椎体结节状致密影同前
text_en: Nodular dense shadow in the T10 vertebral body is unchanged.

source_text: 前纵隔结节影较前缩小，原约17x8mm（IMA20），现约7x4mm（Im21）
text_en: Nodular opacity in the anterior mediastinum has decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 17x8 mm (IMA20), now approximately 7x4 mm (Im21).

source_text: 左下肺心缘旁条片状软组织密度影较前增大，原约23x17mm（IM40），现约44x28mm（IM43），考虑恶性可能大，建议进一步检查
text_en: A linear patch-like soft tissue density adjacent to the cardiac border in the left lower lobe has increased in size, from approximately 23x17 mm (IM40) to approximately 44x28 mm (IM43); malignancy is highly suspected; further evaluation is recommended.

source_text: 左肺术后改变同前，胸部CT扫描未见新发占位征象
text_en: Left lung postoperative change unchanged, chest CT scan shows no new signs of space-occupying lesion.

source_text: 甲状腺右叶低强化结节同前
text_en: The right thyroid lobe shows a low-enhancing nodule, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左斜裂胸膜结节同前，约6mm（IM27），左侧膈胸膜多发扁平结节状增厚同前，较大约16x14mm（IM54），考虑陈旧性
text_en: Pleural nodule along the left oblique fissure is unchanged, approximately 6 mm (IM27). Multiple flat nodular thickenings of the left diaphragmatic pleura are unchanged, the largest measuring approximately 16x14 mm (IM54), considered chronic/old.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃样小结节大致同前，约11x8mm(IM20)
text_en: The small ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 11 x 8 mm (IM20).

source_text: 未见明显增大
text_en: No significant enlargement

source_text: 双肺多发磨玻璃密度结节影同前，较大约6mm（IMA29）
text_en: Multiple ground-glass density nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged; the largest measures approximately 6 mm (IMA29).

source_text: 右肺中叶肿物较前相仿，现约21*15mm(图32)，原约21*17mm（IM31），右肺膨胀不全较前相仿、双下肺索条影同前
text_en: The right middle lobe mass is similar to prior, now measuring approximately 21 x 15 mm (Figure 32), previously about 21 x 17 mm (IM31). Atelectasis of the right lung is similar to prior. Linear opacities in the bilateral lower lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔6组小淋巴结同前，仍约9x7mm（IM24）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in mediastinal station 6 are unchanged from prior, remaining approximately 9x7 mm (IM24).

source_text: 左肺下叶索条影同前，双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Left lower lobe fibrotic streak unchanged, both lungs no new nodules or patchy opacities

source_text: 左肺支气管通畅，肺内透亮度均匀，未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Left lung bronchi patent, lung parenchyma with uniform lucency, no new nodules or consolidation.

source_text: 左肾上腺及脾脏小结节同前(图55、60)，建议结合腹部CT检查
text_en: Small nodules in left adrenal gland and spleen unchanged (Figs. 55, 60), recommend correlation with abdominal CT.

source_text: 右肺中叶、左肺下叶胸膜下微小结节同前，倾向良性，追查
text_en: Subpleural micronodules in the right middle lobe and left lower lobe unchanged; likely benign, recommend follow-up

source_text: 右侧胸膜稍厚，左斜裂胸膜小结节同前，约3mm（IM38）
text_en: The right pleura is slightly thickened. The small nodule along the left oblique fissure pleura is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM38).

source_text: 组淋巴结大致同前，约9x8mm（IM20）
text_en: Group lymph node essentially unchanged, approximately 9x8 mm (IM20)

source_text: 双肺门及纵隔多组肿大淋巴结较前增大，较大原约27x22mm（IM22），现约30x25mm（IM21）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the bilateral hila and mediastinum are larger than prior; the largest was approximately 27x22 mm (IM22), now approximately 30x25 mm (IM21).

source_text: 右肺下叶磨玻璃结节较前无明显变化（IM41）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe shows no significant change compared to prior (IM41).

source_text: 左肺尖见索条影同前，余肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Linear opacity at the left lung apex unchanged from prior; no new nodules or consolidations in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺中叶肿物大致同前，约33x16mm（IM30）
text_en: The right middle lobe mass is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 33 x 16 mm (IM30).

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，较大约15x8mm（Im24）
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, largest approximately 15x8 mm (Im24).

source_text: 余肺内未见新增斑片及结节
text_en: No new patches or nodules are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下小结节同前，倾向良性，复查
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right upper lobe is stable; benign etiology favored; repeat evaluation recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段磨玻璃密度结节大小同前，定期复查
text_en: Left lower lobe dorsal segment ground-glass density nodule size unchanged, with scheduled follow-up

source_text: 余肺野未见新发结节影
text_en: The remainder of the lung fields shows no new nodules.

source_text: 左肺门、双锁骨上区及双腋下未见新发肿大淋巴结
text_en: No new enlarged lymph nodes seen in the left hilar, bilateral supraclavicular, and bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段近纵隔处见一枚结节较前增大，现约19x16mm（IMA27），原约7x6mm，边缘呈浅分叶状
text_en: Nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe near the mediastinum has increased in size compared to prior (previously approximately 7 x 6 mm), now measuring approximately 19 x 16 mm (IMA27), with shallow lobulated margins.

source_text: 右肺下叶见不规则磨玻璃密度结节同前，约22x17mm（IM24），内见血管穿行及支气管轻度扩张，边缘模糊，与斜裂关系密切，牵拉斜裂移位同前
text_en: An irregular ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 22x17 mm (IM24), with vascular passage and mild bronchial dilatation within, indistinct margins, closely related to the oblique fissure, and causing traction displacement of the fissure, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左下肺可见粗大索条影，右肺未见新增结节灶
text_en: Coarse linear opacities are visible in the left lower lobe; no new nodules are seen in the right lung.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段结节灶较前略缩小，原约14x10mm（IM12），现约14x9mm（IM11），边缘仍见毛刺，且与邻近胸膜分界不清
text_en: Nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is slightly smaller than prior, previously approximately 14x10 mm (IM12), now approximately 14x9 mm (IM11); spiculated margins persist and the lesion remains indistinct from the adjacent pleura

source_text: 右肺下叶背段胸膜下小结节同前，约7x7mm（IM31），边缘模糊，见索条影与胸膜牵拉，继续追查
text_en: The small subpleural nodule in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 7x7 mm (IM31), with blurred margins and linear opacities associated with pleural retraction; continued follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变同前，左肺下叶小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lobe are unchanged; small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable; follow-up recommended

source_text: 前纵隔小结节灶，较前未见明显变化，追查
text_en: Small nodule in the anterior mediastinum, no significant change compared to prior, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺门区见小淋巴结同前，约12x8mm（IM26）
text_en: Small lymph node seen in the right hilar region, stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 12x8 mm (IM26).

source_text: 左肺下叶及残余右肺微小结节同前，约3mm（IM21、33）
text_en: Small nodules in the left lower lobe and remaining right lung, unchanged from previous, approximately 3 mm (IM21, 33)

source_text: 纵隔2R、5组淋巴结大致同前，较大者约15x12mm（Im21）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R and 5 are similar to prior, with the largest measuring approximately 15x12 mm (Im21)

source_text: 右肺上叶支气管断端形态大致同前，局部未见占位征象
text_en: The morphology of the right upper lobe bronchial stump is largely unchanged. No space-occupying lesion is seen locally.

source_text: 右上肺陈旧灶同前，余肺未见新发异常密度灶
text_en: Right upper lobe chronic changes unchanged; remainder of lungs without new abnormal densities.

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下微小结节影显示较前清楚，大小同前，约3mm（IM37），边界清楚
text_en: Subpleural tiny nodule in the right middle lobe is more clearly visualized than prior, size unchanged at approximately 3 mm (IM37), with well-defined margins.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见异常增厚（IM22），余肺内未见新发结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy. No abnormal wall thickening is seen at the bronchial stump (IM22). No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lung.

source_text: 食道癌术后颈部吻合，吻合口左侧旁软组织密度影较前范围增大，原约12x8mm（IM12），现约20x16mm（IM12），转移可能，密切追查
text_en: Post esophageal cancer surgery with cervical anastomosis; soft tissue density shadow adjacent to the left side of the anastomosis has increased in size, previously approximately 12x8mm (IM12), now approximately 20x16mm (IM12), possible metastasis, close follow-up.

source_text: 左肺多发微小结节同前，追查
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in the left lung are similar to prior, follow-up needed

source_text: 左肺上叶前段结节灶同前（IM26）
text_en: The nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe is unchanged (IM26).

source_text: 两肺索条小结节影同前（IM13、15、24、41等），小于5mm
text_en: The linear opacities and small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM13, 15, 24, 41, etc.), less than 5 mm.

source_text: 右肺门软组织密度灶大致同前，淋巴结
text_en: Soft tissue density at the right hilum is essentially unchanged, representing lymph nodes.

source_text: 减少
text_en: Reduced.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段局限不均匀稍高密度影范围同前相仿（IM52），不除外恶性可能，随诊
text_en: A focal ill-defined slightly increased density opacity in the left lower lobe posterior basal segment is similar in extent to previous (IM52), malignancy cannot be excluded, follow-up.

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段与背段交界处磨玻璃密度结节同前，现仍约7x6mm（IM32），边缘清楚，未见明显实性成分
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule at the junction of the outer basal and dorsal segments of the right lower lobe is unchanged from prior, currently still approximately 7x6 mm (IM32), with clear margins and no obvious solid component seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶及下叶见不规则索条影及少许片絮影，余肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Irregular linear opacities and minimal patchy opacities are seen in the right upper and lower lobes; no new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺小结节同前，考虑良性可能大
text_en: Right lung small nodule unchanged; benign etiology is more likely.

source_text: 左肺下叶内基底段结节较前相仿，大小约27x20mm（IMA44），边缘较光滑，其内侧局限性肺气肿同前
text_en: The nodule in the medial basal segment of the left lower lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 27x20 mm (IMA44), with smooth margins, and the localized emphysema on its medial side is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶及左肺下叶各见一小结节灶相仿，约3-4mm（IM20、43）
text_en: One small nodule is seen in the right upper lobe and another in the left lower lobe, similar to prior, measuring approximately 3–4 mm (IM20, 43).

source_text: 左肺上叶、左斜裂胸膜及右肺中叶微小结节同前（Im24、33、35、37、45），余肺未见新增结节
text_en: Tiny nodules in the left upper lobe, left oblique fissure pleura, and right middle lobe are unchanged (Im24, 33, 35, 37, 45); no new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段点状结节同前（IM12、14），其旁见钙化及与胸膜相连索条同前，考虑为陈旧病灶
text_en: Punctate nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged (IM12, 14); adjacent calcification and pleural-based linear strands are unchanged, consistent with an old lesion.

source_text: 纵隔4L组淋巴结同前，较大约12x10mm（IM26），平扫密度仍较高
text_en: Mediastinal station 4L lymph nodes unchanged, largest approximately 12x10 mm (IM26); non-contrast density remains elevated

source_text: 左肺上叶前段结节同前，约7mm（IM30），左肺、右肺中叶、右肺斜裂可见多发结节影同前（IM23、32、36、40），小于5mm，余双肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Left upper lobe anterior segment nodule stable, approximately 7 mm (IM30). Multiple nodules in left lung, right middle lobe, and right oblique fissure stable (IM23, 32, 36, 40), less than 5 mm. Remaining bilateral lungs no new nodules or consolidations seen.

source_text: 脊柱侧弯，扫描所及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: Scoliosis; no evidence of bone destruction in the scanned bones

source_text: 右腋区多发淋巴结同前相仿，较大仍约21x12mm（IM12）
text_en: Multiple right axillary lymph nodes similar to prior, largest still measuring approximately 21x12 mm (IM12).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃样密度小灶同前，仍约7mm（IM29），余双肺未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: The small ground-glass opacity in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, still measuring approximately 7 mm (IM29); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段胸膜下新发模糊簇状微小结节
text_en: New ill-defined cluster of tiny subpleural nodules in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe.

source_text: 两肺上叶磨玻璃密度影及结节影同前，较大范围约26*22mm（IM18）
text_en: Ground-glass opacities and nodules in both upper lobes are unchanged from prior. The larger area measures approximately 26x22 mm (IM18).

source_text: 右肺多发小结节灶同前（Im13、16、18、21）
text_en: Multiple small nodular foci in the right lung are stable compared to prior studies (IM13, 16, 18, 21).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段可见磨玻璃小结节同前相仿，约9x8mm（IM14）
text_en: A small ground-glass nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 9x8 mm (IM14).

source_text: 甲状腺双侧叶低密度结节同前，甲状腺右叶钙化灶同前
text_en: Low-density nodule in bilateral thyroid lobes unchanged from prior; calcified focus in the right thyroid lobe unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺散在多发小结节数目及大小同前，较大仍约8mm（Im31）
text_en: Number and size of scattered multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, the largest still measuring approximately 8 mm (Im31).

source_text: 右肺下叶后、外基底段组织肿块较前增大，原约45x41mm，现约58x42mm（IM42），局部与胸膜相连
text_en: A tissue mass in the posterior and lateral basal segments of the right lower lobe is larger than before, previously approximately 45x41 mm, now approximately 58x42 mm (IM42), locally contiguous with the pleura.

source_text: 左肺上叶切除术后，双肺多发小结节同前，左肺下叶斑片影同前，复查
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, multiple small nodules in both lungs unchanged, patchy opacity in left lower lobe unchanged, follow-up.

source_text: 扫及T3、T11-12椎体多发斑片结节状高密度影，范围较前增大
text_en: Multiple patchy nodular high-density lesions in the T3, T11-12 vertebral bodies, with increased extent compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔、左侧锁骨上淋巴结影同前
text_en: Mediastinal and left supraclavicular lymph nodes are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右侧锁骨上淋巴结较前稍增大，密切观察
text_en: The right supraclavicular lymph node is slightly larger compared to prior imaging; close observation is recommended.

source_text: 双肺气肿透亮度增高同前，陈旧钙化同前，未见新生结节
text_en: Increased lucency of pulmonary emphysema is unchanged; old calcifications are unchanged; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 双侧锁骨上及腋下未见新发肿大淋巴结
text_en: No new enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the bilateral supraclavicular regions or axillae.

source_text: 右肺下叶模糊结节同前，约6mm（IM24）
text_en: The indistinct nodule in the right lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM24).

source_text: 右肺下叶微小结节同前，考虑良性
text_en: Right lower lobe tiny nodule unchanged, considered benign

source_text: 右肺点状结节同前（IMA25、28）
text_en: Punctate nodules in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior (IMA25, 28).

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结部分较前增大，如较大原约17x10mm(Im18)，现约23x16mm（IM20）
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes have increased in size compared to previous; the largest previously measured approximately 17x10 mm (Im18), now approximately 23x16 mm (IM20).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段模糊小结节较前缩小，原约3mm（IM38），现仅呈细小索条状改变（IM36）
text_en: The indistinct small nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 3 mm (IM38), now appearing only as a fine linear strand-like change (IM36).

source_text: 双肺内多发小结节，基本同前
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段小结节显示较前清楚，大小同前，仍约5mm（IM9）
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment small nodule more clearly visible than previous, size unchanged, still approximately 5 mm (IM9).

source_text: 双肺结节较前明显增多、增大，较大者现约19x14mm（IM27），原约12x9mm（IM26)
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary nodules are markedly more numerous and larger than prior. The largest now measures approximately 19x14 mm (IM27), previously approximately 12x9 mm (IM26).

source_text: 右肺中叶浅淡模糊小片影同前（IM30）,双肺未见新发结节或斑片影
text_en: Faint, indistinct small patchy opacity in the right middle lobe unchanged (IM30); no new nodules or patchy opacities in the lungs

source_text: 甲状腺体积弥漫增大密度不均及左侧肾上腺结节同前，大小约17*16mm（IMA60）
text_en: Diffuse thyroid gland enlargement with heterogeneous density and left adrenal nodule stable compared to prior, size approximately 17x16 mm (IMA60).

source_text: 扫及胃小弯小淋巴结显示同前（IM62）
text_en: Small lymph node along the lesser curvature of the stomach unchanged from prior (IM62).

source_text: 两肺小结节及斑片状影同前（IMA33、38）
text_en: Small nodules and patchy opacities in both lungs similar to prior (IMA33, 38)

source_text: 右叶间胸膜不规则结节同前，约7x2mm（IM28）
text_en: The irregular nodule along the right interlobar pleura is unchanged, measuring approximately 7 x 2 mm (IM28).

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no definite findings of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 右肺术后改变，积气积液较前吸收，未见新生占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lung; pneumothorax and pleural fluid have been absorbed compared to prior, no new space-occupying signs are observed.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4、5、7组多发淋巴结部分同前，较大约10x8mm（IM20）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R, 4, 5, and 7 are partially unchanged from previous, with the largest measuring approximately 10x8 mm (IM20).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结大致同前，现较大仍约14*7mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior; largest approximately 14 × 7 mm (IM20).

source_text: 双肺多发磨玻璃结节大致同前，追查
text_en: Multiple ground-glass nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 甲状腺左叶见低密度结节同前（IM6）
text_en: Left thyroid lobe low-density nodule stable (IM6).

source_text: 食管胸下段管壁不均匀增厚，较前略明显，现厚约11mm（IMA41）处，原约9mm（IM39）
