text_en: Irregular thickening of the lower thoracic esophageal wall, slightly increased compared to prior, measuring approximately 11 mm at (IMA41) versus approximately 9 mm at (IM39).

source_text: 左胸壁皮下小结节灶较前稍大，原约8mm（IM26），现约11mm（IM28）
text_en: Left chest wall subcutaneous small nodule slightly larger than before, previously approximately 8mm (IM26), now approximately 11mm (IM28).

source_text: 纵隔4组新见淋巴结，考虑转移
text_en: Newly seen lymph node in mediastinal station 4, considered suspicious for metastasis

source_text: 左肺术后，双肺小结节同前
text_en: Post left lung surgery, small nodules in both lungs stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右腋下多发小淋巴结同前（IMA13）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the right axilla, unchanged from prior (IMA13).

source_text: 左肺微小结节同前，较大约5mm（IM40）
text_en: Tiny nodule in the left lung unchanged from prior, approximately 5mm in size (IM40).

source_text: 双侧锁骨上区、纵隔2、3组及右肺门淋巴结部分较前缩小，原较大约29x16mm（IM11），现短径小于5mm，右肺门淋巴结原约14mm（IM29），现约10mm（IM29）
text_en: Several lymph nodes in the bilateral supraclavicular regions, mediastinal stations 2 and 3, and right pulmonary hilum are partially decreased in size compared to prior; the largest was previously about 29x16 mm (IM11), now short axis less than 5 mm. The right hilar lymph node was previously about 14 mm (IM29), now approximately 10 mm (IM29).

source_text: 胸7椎体致密小结节同前
text_en: Dense small nodule in T7 vertebra, unchanged from previous.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段磨玻璃结节较前相仿，约15x11mm（IM20），密切追查
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment ground-glass opacity nodule similar to previous, approximately 15x11 mm (IM20), close follow-up.

source_text: 余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏
text_en: No osseous destruction is seen in the bones imaged.

source_text: 右肺模糊结节样影同前（IMA33）
text_en: Indistinct nodular opacity in the right lung is unchanged compared to prior (IMA33).

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Right hilar lymph nodes show no significant change compared to prior study; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺尖磨玻璃密度小结节同前，约6mm（Im13）
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right apex unchanged, approximately 6 mm (Im13).

source_text: 左肺下叶结节同前
text_en: Left lower lobe nodule unchanged from previous.

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结较前相仿
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes are similar to prior.

source_text: 右上肺点状微小结节同前（IM19)，追查
text_en: Punctate micro-nodules in the right upper lung are unchanged (IM19); further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端周围未见异常软组织密度影，左肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no abnormal soft-tissue density is seen around the bronchial stump. No new nodules or consolidations are seen in the left lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，仍约6mm（IMA44），观察，余未见结节或实变影
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from prior, still approximately 6 mm (IMA44), under observation; no other nodules or consolidation seen.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段结节灶同前
text_en: The nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺尖新见一结节灶（IM10），左肺上叶微小2mm结节同前（IM32）
text_en: New nodule in the right apex (IM10); 2 mm micronodule in the left upper lobe unchanged (IM32).

source_text: 左肺下叶多发微小结节大致同前，追查
text_en: Left lower lobe multiple tiny nodules essentially unchanged, follow-up

source_text: 所及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: No signs of bone destruction seen in the thoracic bones examined.

source_text: 双肺散在高密度结节及钙化灶同前
text_en: Scattered hyperdense nodules and calcified foci in both lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 未见肺内新发结节及肿块影
text_en: No new intrapulmonary nodules or masses seen

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结较前略缩小
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes have slightly decreased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 纵隔、左肺门、左锁骨上多发淋巴结部分同前，部分略缩小，追查
text_en: Mediastinal, left hilar, and left supraclavicular multiple lymph nodes: some unchanged from prior, some slightly reduced; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 余肺内透亮度均匀，未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: The remaining lung parenchyma shows uniform lucency; no new nodules or consolidations are seen.

source_text: 右上肺及左下肺小结节较前相仿
text_en: Small nodules in the right upper lung and left lower lung are similar to prior.

source_text: 纵隔右移，纵隔小淋巴结同前（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal shift to the right, mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged from prior (IM20).

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段结节较前相仿，约17x14mm（Im46），左肺下叶两枚约5mm小结节同前（Im46、50）
text_en: The nodule in the basal segment of the right lower lobe is similar to prior, approximately 17x14 mm (Im46); two small nodules in the left lower lobe, each approximately 5 mm, are unchanged (Im46, 50).

source_text: 两肺模糊小结节灶数量及大小同前，较大仍约5mm（IM36）
text_en: The number and size of hazy small nodules in both lungs are unchanged compared to prior; the largest remains approximately 5 mm (IM36).

source_text: 余双肺多发磨玻璃密度结节部分同前（IM16），部分显示不清，双肺下叶体积缩小并可见条片影较前吸收
text_en: Residual multiple ground-glass opacity nodules in both lungs are partially unchanged (IM16), with some indistinct; volume loss in both lower lobes with linear and patchy opacities is less prominent compared to prior, showing absorption

source_text: 右肺上叶新发小结节，追查
text_en: New small nodule in the right upper lobe; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双肺多发磨玻璃样结节同前相仿，定期复查
text_en: Multiple ground-glass nodules in both lungs are similar to prior; regular follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶微小致密结节同前，2-3mm（IM41、49、50）
text_en: Left lower lobe small solid nodule unchanged, 2-3 mm (IM41, 49, 50).

source_text: 甲状腺右叶低密度结节同前（IM7）
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right lobe of the thyroid gland unchanged from prior (IM7).

source_text: 左肺微小结节同前，约2mm（IMA29），追查
text_en: Tiny nodule in the left lung unchanged from prior, approximately 2mm (IMA29); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 食管-胃胸廓入口水平吻合同前，吻合口壁未见异常增厚及强化，吻合口下方脂肪间隙内片状软组织灶略显增大，现约19mm（IMA13），原约16mm（IMA9），随诊观察
text_en: Post esophagogastrostomy at the thoracic inlet level, anastomosis unchanged, anastomotic wall without abnormal thickening or enhancement, with a slightly increased sheet-like soft tissue focus in the fat space below the anastomosis, now approximately 19mm (IMA13), previously approximately 16mm (IMA9), follow-up observation.

source_text: 左肺癌术后，支气管断端少许软组织密度影较前减少（IM26），考虑术后改变，建议复查
text_en: After left lung cancer surgery, slight soft tissue density shadow at the bronchial stump is reduced compared to previous (IM26), considered postoperative change, recommend follow-up.

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺结节同前（Im65），脾周新见少量腹水，请结合腹部检查
text_en: Left adrenal nodule unchanged from prior (Im65), new small amount of perisplenic ascites noted; please correlate with abdominal examination.

source_text: 右肺索条影，局部见小结节同前，约3mm（IM55）
text_en: Fibrotic band in the right lung; a small nodule at the local site is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM55).

source_text: 双肺多发磨玻璃密度结节影同前，较大约6mm（IMA14）
text_en: Multiple ground-glass density nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged; the largest measures approximately 6 mm (IMA14).

source_text: 右肺上叶模糊小结节同前，追查
text_en: Indistinct small nodule in the right upper lobe, stable compared to prior. Further follow-up recommended.

source_text: 余双肺散在少许微小结节同前，部分内见钙化
text_en: Residual few scattered tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged; some contain calcification

source_text: 左肺下叶多发转移，较前进展
text_en: Multiple metastases in the left lower lobe have progressed compared to previous.

source_text: 余双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Lung markings in the remainder of both lungs are smooth and unremarkable; lung parenchyma shows uniform lucency; no new nodules or consolidation shadows are seen.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段不规则磨玻璃密度结节同前，仍约15x9mm（IM32），建议隔年复查
text_en: Left lower lobe posterior segment irregular ground-glass opacity nodule unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 15x9 mm (IM32), with recommendation for biennial follow-up.

source_text: 左肺舌叶小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: The small nodule shadow in the lingula of the left lung is unchanged, recommend follow-up

source_text: 纵隔4R、5、7组淋巴结增大同前，部分并钙化，较大约17*11mm(图22)
text_en: Enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R, 5, and 7 are similar to previous, with some showing calcification; the largest measures approximately 17x11 mm (Figure 22)

source_text: 余肺散在少许2-4mm微小结节显示较前清楚，大小同前
text_en: Scattered tiny nodules measuring 2-4 mm in the remaining lung are more clearly visualized than prior, though their size remains unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门多发淋巴结同前相仿，纵隔较大灶约18x7mm（IM34）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions similar to previous, with a larger focus in the mediastinum approximately 18x7mm (IM34).

source_text: 左锁骨上区淋巴结大致同前，约11x7mm（IM4）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node roughly unchanged from prior, approximately 11 x 7 mm (IM4)

source_text: 两肺多发结节同前，较大约76mm（IM30）
text_en: Multiple nodules in both lungs similar to prior, largest measuring approximately 76 mm (IM30)

source_text: 右肺下叶内基底段磨玻璃密度结节灶大致同前，大小仍约约21*17mm（IMA40），同邻近纵隔胸膜分界不清
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the medial basal segment of the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged, still measuring approximately 21x17 mm (IMA40), with indistinct margins from the adjacent mediastinal pleura.

source_text: 双上肺胸膜下可见少许模糊小结节同前，约2-4mm（IM11、17、21）
text_en: A few indistinct small subpleural nodules are seen in both upper lungs, unchanged, measuring approximately 2-4 mm (IM11, 17, 21).

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R小淋巴结大致同前，较大约8x6mm（IM20），7组及右肺门钙化淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R and 4R are stable, largest approximately 8x6 mm (IM20). Group 7 and right hilar calcified lymph nodes are stable.

source_text: 右肺中叶模糊结节同前相仿，仍约5mm（IM34）
text_en: Faint nodule in the right middle lobe is similar to prior, still measuring approximately 5 mm (IM34).

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则浅淡结节同前相仿，边缘模糊，密度不均，仍约16*13mm(IM21)
text_en: Irregular faint nodule in the left upper lobe is similar to previous examination, with indistinct margins and heterogeneous density, still measuring approximately 16 x 13 mm (IM21).

source_text: 肝右叶高强化结节同前，请结合腹部检查
text_en: High-enhancement nodule in the right lobe of liver same as before, please correlate with abdominal examination.

source_text: 右上肺胸膜下结节同前，仍约8x6mm（IM21），中心钙化、相邻胸膜粘连同前
text_en: Right upper lobe subpleural nodule unchanged, still approximately 8x6 mm (IM21), with central calcification and adjacent pleural adhesion unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结较前饱满，原约20x19mm（IM21），现约24x22mm（IM22）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes enlarged compared to previous, previously approximately 20x19 mm (IM21), currently approximately 24x22 mm (IM22).

source_text: 双肺多发小结节较前略缩小，如右肺下叶较大结节原约10*7mm，现约9x5mm（IM56）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs have slightly decreased in size; for example, a larger nodule in the right lower lobe was previously about 10x7 mm, now about 9x5 mm (IM56).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，右肺中叶小钙化结节同前（IM35）
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, a small calcified nodule in the right middle lobe similar to prior (IM35).

source_text: 右下叶间胸膜小结节同前(IM38)
text_en: Small nodule at the right lower interlobar pleura unchanged (IM38).

source_text: 右肺上叶楔形切除术后，局部缝线影周围软组织密度增厚影较前略减轻（IMA17），右肺下叶较大结节影消失，余肺多发结节同前
text_en: Status post wedge resection of the right upper lobe; soft tissue density thickening around the local suture site is slightly less prominent than before (IMA17); the larger nodule in the right lower lobe has disappeared; remaining multiple lung nodules are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 扫及腹主动脉旁多发肿大淋巴结较前增大、增多，原较大约21x18mm（IM64），现约30x21mm（IM64）
text_en: CT shows multiple enlarged lymph nodes adjacent to the abdominal aorta, increased in size and number compared to prior. The largest was approximately 21x18 mm (IM64), now approximately 30x21 mm (IM64).

source_text: 左下叶胸膜下实性微小结节同前，考虑良性
text_en: Tiny solid subpleural nodule in the left lower lobe is stable; benign etiology is considered.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4、7、10R组淋巴结同前相仿，较大者约14x10mm（IM24、30）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R, 4, 7, and 10R are similar to previous, with the largest measuring approximately 14x10 mm (IM24, 30).

source_text: 右肺水平裂另可见一实性胸膜结节同前（IM33），直径5mm
text_en: Another solid pleural nodule is visible along the horizontal fissure of the right lung, unchanged compared to prior (IM33), with a diameter of 5 mm.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段斑片及结节灶，大致同前（IM14-16）
text_en: Patchy and nodular opacities in the left upper lobe anterior segment are essentially unchanged (IM14-16).

source_text: 右肺下叶、左肺舌叶少许索条影同前，双肺未见新发结节影
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the right lower lobe and left lingular segment are unchanged; no new nodules are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 双肺未见结节，右肺中下叶胸膜下条片状影同前
text_en: No nodules are seen in the lungs; the subpleural linear and patchy opacity in the right middle and lower lobes is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段分叶状软组织密度结节较前增大，原26x11mm（IM35），现约37x17mm（IM34），中等程度强化，边缘可见分叶及毛刺，邻近局限性胸膜凹陷
text_en: A lobulated soft tissue density nodule in the left lower lobe, apical segment, increased in size compared to prior, from 26x11 mm (IM35) to approximately 37x17 mm (IM34), with moderate enhancement, margins showing lobulation and spiculation, and adjacent localized pleural indentation.

source_text: 左肺未见新发结节及斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities in the left lung.

source_text: 右侧胸膜结节及右肺下叶结节，较前未见明显变化
text_en: The right pleural nodule and the nodule in the right lower lobe show no significant change compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4-6组及左肺门大小不等淋巴结较前缩小，原4L组较大者约11*7mm(图21)，现约7x5mm（IM20）
text_en: Lymphadenopathy in mediastinal stations 2R, 4-6, and left hilar region with nodes of varying sizes has decreased in size compared to prior, with the largest in station 4L previously measuring approximately 11x7 mm (Fig 21) and now approximately 7x5 mm (IM20)

source_text: 余双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，余肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Lung markings in the remainder of both lungs are smooth and unremarkable; lung parenchyma shows uniform lucency; the remainder of the lungs shows no new nodules or consolidation shadows.

source_text: 右肺下叶多发实性小结节同前，较大约5mm（IM35），边界较清
text_en: Multiple solid small nodules in the right lower lobe are unchanged; the largest measures approximately 5 mm (IM35) with relatively well-defined margins.

source_text: 双肺新见散在多发浅淡密度小结节，较大约5mm（IM30），边界欠请清，考虑转移可能大，密切追查除外炎性
text_en: Newly noted scattered multiple faint density small nodules in both lungs, the largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM30), poorly defined margins; metastasis likely, closely follow up to exclude inflammatory etiology.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段磨玻璃密度结节影同前，约16x11mm（IM12）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe unchanged from previous, approximately 16x11 mm (IM12)

source_text: 右肺小结节同前，较大约5mm（IM29），追查
text_en: Right lung small nodule unchanged; largest approximately 5 mm (IM29), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右下肺多发结节较前增多、增大，转移可能
text_en: Multiple nodules in the right lower lobe are increased in number and size compared to prior imaging; metastasis is possible.

source_text: 胃小弯见小淋巴结同前，约9mm（IM56）
text_en: Small lymph nodes are seen along the gastric lesser curvature, unchanged from prior; approximately 9 mm (IM56).

source_text: 甲状腺左叶见低密度结节同前（IM5）
text_en: Left thyroid lobe low-density nodule stable (IM5).

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段结节较前相仿，约3mm（IM36），追查
text_en: Nodule in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM36); further follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段模糊小结节大小同前，仍约4mm（IM8）
text_en: Stable ill-defined small nodule in left upper lobe apicoposterior segment, approximately 4 mm (IM8)

source_text: 右肺多发小结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right lung are unchanged; benign etiology is favored.

source_text: 右肺上叶见钙化结节及索条影同前，余肺未见新灶
text_en: A calcified nodule and linear opacities are seen in the right upper lobe, unchanged from prior; no new lesions are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管残端少许软组织密度同前，未见异常占位
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; minimal soft tissue density at the bronchial stump remains stable; no abnormal mass identified

source_text: 2R、2L、5、7组多发淋巴结，部分较前增大，2R组原约13x8mm（IM9），现约11x10mm（IM10），与食管壁分界不清
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in stations 2R, 2L, 5, and 7; some are larger than before. The 2R station was previously about 13x8 mm (IM9) and is now about 11x10 mm (IM10), with ill-defined margins from the esophageal wall.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段软组织密度结节略缩小，现约18*11mm（IM31），原约19x14mm（IM31），内部空洞消失，周围肺内见多发结节灶及索条影同前
text_en: A soft tissue density nodule in the left lower lobe dorsal segment is slightly smaller, measuring approximately 18 x 11 mm (IM31) compared to approximately 19 x 14 mm (IM31). The internal cavity has resolved. Multiple nodular foci and linear opacities in the surrounding lung parenchyma are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，约19x17mm（IM30）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node unchanged, measuring approximately 19 x 17 mm (IM30)

source_text: 扫及甲状腺内多发低密度结节同前
text_en: Multiple low-density nodules are seen in the thyroid, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺门淋巴结大致同前，约11x10mm（IM35）
text_en: Left hilar lymph node stable, approximately 11x10 mm (IM35).

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺结节同前（IMA64），结合腹部评价
text_en: A nodule is noted in the left adrenal gland, stable compared to prior (IMA64). Correlate with abdominal evaluation.

source_text: 右肺磨玻璃密度小结节同前，追查
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lung is unchanged compared to prior; further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 双肺下叶小斑片、小结节影同前（IMA37、42、49、52）
text_en: Small patchy opacities and small nodules in the lower lobes of both lungs are unchanged compared to prior studies (IMA37, 42, 49, 52).

source_text: 纵隔隆突下淋巴结同前，约11x9mm（IMA21）
text_en: Subcarinal lymph node unchanged, approximately 11x9mm (IMA21).

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜下小结节同前，约2mm（IM31）
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right interlobar pleura is unchanged, measuring approximately 2 mm (IM31).

source_text: 余两肺内局限性索条影同前，未见明确结节及肿块影
text_en: Focal linear opacities in the remainder of both lungs are unchanged; no definite nodules or mass-like lesions are seen.

source_text: 左肺多发小结节同前，追查
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left lung unchanged from prior; follow-up recommended

source_text: 双肺多发微小小结节同前，建议复查
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左上叶模糊小结节及磨玻璃结节同前，约9x5mm（IM34），左下肺少许片状影及囊状透亮区同前
text_en: The indistinct small nodule and ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe are unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 9x5 mm (IM34). The minor patchy opacities and cystic lucencies in the left lower lung are also unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶另见散在磨玻璃密度结节同前，较大约6x5mm（IM31）
text_en: Scattered ground-glass opacity nodules in left upper lobe unchanged, largest approximately 6x5 mm (IM31)

source_text: 两肺未见新发异常结节灶
text_en: No new abnormal nodular lesions seen in both lungs.

source_text: 胸7、9、10椎体新见高密度影，转移
text_en: Newly seen dense nodules in T7, T9, and T10 vertebrae, metastasis.

source_text: 前上纵隔囊性为主伴脂肪密度肿块影增大，现较大层面约73*63mm（IMA21），原约71x46mm（IM21）
text_en: The predominantly cystic mass with fat density in the anterior superior mediastinum has increased in size, now measuring approximately 73x63 mm on the largest slice (IMA21), previously 71x46 mm (IM21).

source_text: 纵隔平扫多发淋巴结同前，较大仍约12x10mm（IM22）
text_en: Mediastinal CT without contrast shows multiple lymph nodes unchanged, largest still approximately 12x10mm (IM22).

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结大致同前，约19*12mm（IM28）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 19x12 mm (IM28).

source_text: 纵隔右移，纵隔小淋巴结同前（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal shift to the right, mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged from prior (IM21).

source_text: 右肺散在陈旧灶同前，未见新发结节病灶
text_en: Scattered old lesions in the right lung are unchanged from prior; no new nodular lesions are seen.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段模糊结节灶同前（IM23）
text_en: Left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment: hazy nodular focus unchanged from previous (IM23).

source_text: 纵隔2R、4、7组及右肺门少许小淋巴结大致同前，均小于1cm
text_en: A few small lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R, 4, 7 and right hilar region are essentially unchanged from previous, all less than 1 cm

source_text: 右肺上叶点状结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Punctate nodular opacity in the right upper lobe unchanged; follow-up recommended

source_text: 左肺少许索条同前，双肺未见新生结节或实变影
text_en: Left lung slight linear shadows stable, both lungs no new nodules or consolidation seen

source_text: 右肺上叶及中叶多发类圆形小结节同前，部分呈磨玻璃密度，较大约5mm（Im13）
text_en: Multiple rounded small nodules in the right upper and middle lobes remain unchanged; some have ground-glass density; the largest is approximately 5 mm (Im13).

source_text: 左锁骨上区小淋巴结同前，仍约5mm（IM3）
text_en: Left supraclavicular small lymph node unchanged, still approximately 5 mm (IM3).

source_text: 右肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the right lung.

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节较前相仿，现仍约8x6mm(IM16)
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule similar to previous, currently still approximately 8x6mm (IM16).

source_text: 右肺上叶及中叶散在微小结节大致同前
text_en: Scattered tiny nodules in the right upper and middle lobes are approximately stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺结节同前
text_en: Left lung nodule unchanged.

source_text: 双肺索条影同前，双肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Linear opacities in both lungs are similar to prior. No new nodules or consolidations are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 肝内新见低强化结节(图47)，建议腹部CT检查
text_en: Newly seen low-enhancement nodule within the liver (Figure 47), recommend abdominal CT examination.

source_text: 双肺术后改变同前相仿，未见新发占位
text_en: Postoperative changes in both lungs are similar to prior; no new space-occupying lesion is seen.

source_text: 右肺中叶慢性炎症及左上叶舌段纤维化病灶同前
text_en: Chronic inflammatory changes in the right middle lobe and fibrotic changes in the lingular segment of the left upper lobe are unchanged from prior

source_text: 右肺上叶前段小结节影同前（IM21）
text_en: Small nodular opacity in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable (IM21)

source_text: 左下肺少许索条影，未见明确新发结节
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the left lower lobe; no definite new nodules are seen.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜旁微小结节同前，仍约3mm、4mm（Im50、51），建议追查
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural tiny nodule unchanged, still approximately 3mm and 4mm (Im50, 51), follow-up recommended

source_text: 双肺胸膜下少许结节同前（IM23、32、42），较大仍约5mm（IM32）
text_en: Few subpleural nodules in both lungs are stable (IM23, 32, 42), the largest still measuring approximately 5 mm (IM32).

source_text: 右肺上下叶、左肺下叶及右侧斜裂多发小结节同前相仿，较大仍约5mm（IM39）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right upper and lower lobes, left lower lobe, and right oblique fissure similar to prior; largest still approximately 5 mm (IM39).

source_text: 左肺上叶、左斜裂胸膜及右肺中叶微小结节同前（IM23、32、34、36、45）
text_en: Tiny nodules in the left upper lobe, left oblique fissure pleura, and right middle lobe are unchanged (IM23, 32, 34, 36, 45).

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃结节同前，约3mm（IM23）
text_en: Left upper lobe ground-glass nodule stable compared to prior, approximately 3 mm (IM23)

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右肺下叶致密结节影同前
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent, with a dense nodule in the right lower lobe stable compared to prior.

source_text: 食管胸中上段管壁不均匀增厚较前，原较厚处约10mm，现较厚处约7mm（IM16）
text_en: Irregular wall thickening in the upper-middle thoracic esophagus compared to previous. The thickest portion was originally approximately 10 mm and is now approximately 7 mm (IM16).

source_text: 余双肺可见少许小结节，部分模糊，较大约3mm（IM31），较前相仿
text_en: A few small nodules are visible in the remainder of both lungs; some are indistinct, the largest measuring approximately 3 mm (IM31), similar to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶支气管旁见不规则软组织密度肿物较前缩小，强化减低，仍与左肺动脉主干及近端分支关系密切，与肺门淋巴结融合，现约25x9mm（IM25），原为38x26mm（IM23）
text_en: Left upper lobe peribronchial irregular soft tissue density mass smaller than prior, decreased enhancement, still closely related to left pulmonary artery main trunk and proximal branches, fused with hilar lymph nodes, now approximately 25x9 mm (IM25), previously 38x26 mm (IM23)

source_text: 新增的肿大淋巴结
text_en: newly identified enlarged lymph node

source_text: 纵隔2、4、7组见淋巴结显示同前，较大约16x6mm（IM20）、双肺门、锁骨上区及腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2, 4, and 7 are visible and unchanged from previous; the largest is approximately 16x6 mm (IM20). No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular regions, or axillary regions.

source_text: 气管右旁可见肿大淋巴结，较大者约17*10mm（IMA16），考虑转移可能性大
text_en: Enlarged lymph node visible at right paratracheal region, larger one approximately 17x10mm (IMA16), suspicious for metastasis

source_text: 未新见
text_en: no new findings

source_text: 胸廓骨质未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: No evidence of bone destruction in the bones of the thoracic cage.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见明显软组织密度肿块影，右肺索条影及胸膜、叶间胸膜增厚同前
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; on non-contrast imaging, no obvious soft tissue density mass is seen at the bronchial stump. Linear opacities in the right lung and thickening of the pleura and interlobar pleura are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 前纵隔结节较前略小，原约15x13mm（IMA16），现约14x12mm（IM16），未见明确强化，边缘光滑锐利
text_en: The anterior mediastinal nodule is slightly smaller than before, previously approximately 15x13 mm (IMA16), now approximately 14x12 mm (IM16). No definite enhancement is seen, and the margin is smooth and well-defined.

source_text: 左肺下叶新见结节灶（IM39、49），性质待定
text_en: A nodular lesion is newly seen in the left lower lobe (IM39, 49), indeterminate in nature.

source_text: 右肺门及4R组小淋巴结同前，较大约8x5mm（IM27），追查
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the right hilar region and 4R station are stable compared to prior, the largest measuring approximately 8x5 mm (IM27); continued follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左下叶结节同前相仿（IM60），追查
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is similar to prior (IM60); further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 前纵隔椭圆形结节同前，约17x11mm（IM36），内见钙化，强化不明显
text_en: Oval nodule in the anterior mediastinum is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 17x11 mm (IM36), with calcification present and no significant enhancement.

source_text: 左肺术后，纵隔左移同前，支气管断端未见明显肿块影
text_en: Post left lung surgery, left mediastinal shift stable compared to prior, bronchial stump shows no obvious mass.

source_text: 右肺中叶肿物较前增大，原约21x13mm（IM30），现约28x17mm（IM29）
text_en: The right middle lobe mass is larger than prior, previously measuring approximately 21 x 13 mm (IM30), now approximately 28 x 17 mm (IM29).

source_text: 肺底包裹性积液胸膜亦增厚，较厚约24mm(400-图20)，考虑胸膜转移
text_en: Encapsulated pleural effusion at the lung base with pleural thickening, thickest approximately 24 mm (400-Image 20), suggestive of pleural metastasis.

source_text: 右肺中叶结节影同前，仍约21x13mm（IM29）
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged, still measuring approximately 21x13 mm (IM29).

source_text: 双锁骨上区散在淋巴结同前
text_en: Scattered lymph nodes in bilateral supraclavicular regions are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左上叶类圆形小结节同前，仍约5mm（IM29）
text_en: The round-shaped small nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, still measuring approximately 5 mm (IM29).

source_text: 右肺下叶近肺门结节较前似相仿，平扫与肺血管分界不清，远端肺内模糊片影较前相仿，两肺内多发结节较前相仿(IM20、24、28-31、36)
text_en: The nodule near the hilum of the right lower lobe appears similar to prior. On non-contrast imaging, it is indistinct from adjacent pulmonary vessels. The hazy patchy opacity in the distal lung parenchyma is similar to prior. Multiple nodules in both lungs are similar to prior (IM20, 24, 28–31, 36).

source_text: 纵隔、双锁骨上区淋巴结同前，较大约11*7mm（IM21）
text_en: Lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral supraclavicular regions are similar to prior, the largest measuring approximately 11x7 mm (IM21).

source_text: 胸胃胃壁环周增厚较前减轻，原约7mm（IM22），现约5mm（IM23）
text_en: Circumferential thickening of the stomach wall reduced compared to previous; previously approximately 7mm (IM22), now approximately 5mm (IM23).

source_text: 纵隔及锁骨上多发小淋巴结同前，短径小于10mm，密切追查
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal and supraclavicular lymph nodes unchanged, short axis diameter less than 10 mm, close follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔2-7组及右肺门数枚小淋巴结同前，短径小于10mm，部分内见钙化
text_en: Several small lymph nodes in mediastinal groups 2-7 and right hilar region unchanged from prior, short axis less than 10mm, some with calcification.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下浅淡小结节同前，复查
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural faint small nodule unchanged, follow-up

source_text: 右上肺磨玻璃密度为主混杂密度结节大致同前，约15x9mm（IM22）
text_en: Mixed ground-glass density nodule in the right upper lung is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 15x9 mm (IM22).

source_text: 双肺多发小结节增多增大，转移可能
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs have increased in number and size; metastasis is possible.

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下磨玻璃密度为主病灶范围较前相仿，边缘模糊，现约23x8mm（IM12）
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural ground-glass opacity predominant lesion similar in size to prior, ill-defined margins, currently measuring approximately 23 x 8 mm (IM12).

source_text: 右肺上叶支气管血管束旁模糊小结节同前（IM23）
text_en: The indistinct small nodule adjacent to the bronchovascular bundle in the right upper lobe is unchanged from prior (IM23).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃密度小结节灶同前相仿，约5x6mm（IM34）
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is similar to the prior study, measuring approximately 5x6 mm (IM34).

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结略饱满大致同前，约13x8mm（IM36）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is slightly prominent and essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 13x8 mm (IM36).

source_text: 右肺中叶术后改变同前，胸部CT平扫未见明显占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right middle lobe are unchanged; non-contrast chest CT shows no obvious space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下类结节影同前，倾向良性，追查
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural nodule-like opacity unchanged from previous, suggestive of benign, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶癌较前相仿，右侧胸膜增厚伴结节同前，胸腔积液同前
text_en: Right upper lobe carcinoma is similar to prior; right pleural thickening with nodules unchanged; pleural effusion unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔5、6组淋巴结较前增大，现较大约18x6mm（IM16）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 5 and 6 have increased in size compared to prior, currently larger at approximately 18x6 mm (IM16).

source_text: 右肺尖不规则类结节较前缩小
text_en: The irregular nodule-like opacity at the right lung apex has decreased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔10R略增大淋巴结较前缩小，现约13x6mm（图22），原约14x9mm（图25）
text_en: The slightly enlarged mediastinal lymph node at station 10R has decreased in size compared to previous, now approximately 13x6 mm (Figure 22), originally approximately 14x9 mm (Figure 25).

source_text: 双肺上叶胸膜下小斑点影同前（IM29、47），左肺索条影同前，右肺中叶水平裂胸膜处小结节同前，约5mm（IM35）
text_en: Small subpleural punctate opacities in the upper lobes bilaterally are stable compared to prior (IM29, 47); left lung linear bands are stable; a small nodule measuring approximately 5 mm at the pleural aspect of the horizontal fissure in the right middle lobe is stable compared to prior (IM35).

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前，左侧膈肌抬高、左侧胸膜增厚同前，两侧未见胸水
text_en: Tiny nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior. Left diaphragmatic elevation and left pleural thickening are unchanged from prior. No pleural effusion is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 双肺结节灶较前增大、增多，如现较大者约13x13mm（IM45），原约10x9mm（IM42）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary nodules are larger and more numerous than prior. The largest now measures approximately 13x13 mm (IM45), previously approximately 10x9 mm (IM42).

source_text: 新发微结节
text_en: Newly developed tiny nodules

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门淋巴结，较前缩小
text_en: Mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes decreased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 左上肺胸膜下小结节影同前（IM18）
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged from prior (IM18).

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结大致同前，较大约13x9mm（IM25）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes essentially unchanged from previous, largest approximately 13x9mm (IM25)

source_text: 左锁骨上小淋巴结同前（IM4），余纵隔、肺门、腋窝及锁骨上平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Small lymph nodes in left supraclavicular region unchanged from previous (IM4), with no enlarged lymph nodes seen in the remaining mediastinum, hilar, axillary, and supraclavicular regions on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 纵隔2、4组可见多发肿大淋巴结，较大者约28x14mm（IM23），不除外转移可能
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes are visible in mediastinal stations 2 and 4; the largest measures approximately 28x14 mm (IM23), and metastasis cannot be excluded.

source_text: 左侧胸膜转移较前相仿，
text_en: Left pleural metastases are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前增大，转移待排
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are enlarged compared to previous; metastasis to be ruled out.

source_text: 左肺下叶不规则索条影同前，未见新发占位及异常密度
text_en: Irregular linear opacity in the left lower lobe unchanged from prior; no new mass or abnormal density seen.

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段磨玻璃小结节大致同前，约5mm（IM31）
text_en: Small ground-glass nodule in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe, essentially unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM31).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，局部条片状不均匀软组织密度影较前缩小，其内伴致密金属影同前，原约62x21mm（IM20），现约62x16mm（IM21），随诊观察
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; the local ill-defined linear and patchy soft tissue density has decreased in size compared to prior, with stable dense metallic opacity within. Previously about 62 x 21 mm (IM20), now approximately 62 x 16 mm (IM21). Follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶占位，较前缩小
text_en: Mass in the right lower lobe, smaller compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺多发片絮、索条、结节影较前饱满，较大原约20x18mm（IM41），现约25x18mm（IM38），整体范围较前饱满（冠状位IM38）
text_en: Multiple patchy, linear, and nodular opacities in both lungs appear more prominent; the largest previously measured approximately 20x18 mm (IM41), now measures approximately 25x18 mm (IM38); overall extent appears more prominent (coronal view IM38).

source_text: 原纵隔3-8区多发肿大淋巴结缩小，6组较大者原约30*12mm，现约25X11mm（IMA16）
text_en: The previously enlarged lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 3-8 have decreased in size; the largest in station 6 was previously 30x12 mm, now measures 25x11 mm (IMA16).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端少量软组织密度影同前（IM29），未见增大或异常强化
text_en: Left upper lobe postoperative status. Minimal soft tissue density at the bronchial stump stable (IM29). No enlargement or abnormal enhancement

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段结节同前
text_en: Nodule in the left lower lobe basal segment unchanged from prior

source_text: 甲状腺多发结节伴粗大钙化同前
text_en: Multiple thyroid nodules with coarse calcifications stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶纯磨玻璃密度小结节同前
text_en: Small pure ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior

source_text: 右肺未见新发结节
text_en: No new nodules in the right lung.

source_text: 右肺下叶磨玻璃结节同前
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶部分切除术后改变，胸部CT平扫未见新发占位
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left lower lobe; no new mass or lesion on non-contrast chest CT.

source_text: 左下叶磨玻璃密度结节较前增大，现约15*11mm（IM36），原约9*8mm（IM37）
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the left lower lobe has increased in size compared to prior, now approximately 15 x 11 mm (IM36), previously about 9 x 8 mm (IM37).

source_text: 左主支气管腔内小结节大致同前，约5mm（IM29）
text_en: Small nodule within the left main bronchus is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM29).

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; chest shows no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 双侧未见新发结节灶
text_en: No new nodules are seen bilaterally.

source_text: 纵隔4R、6组较高密度淋巴结较前略缩小，较大者原约22x11mm（IM24），现约19x10mm（IM24）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes with higher density at stations 4R and 6 are slightly smaller than prior, with the largest previously approximately 22x11mm (IM24) and now approximately 19x10mm (IM24).

source_text: 右肺中叶结节较前略饱满，现约6x6mm（IM40），原约5x4mm（IM39）
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe appears slightly more prominent than before, currently measuring approximately 6 x 6 mm (IM40), previously 5 x 4 mm (IM39).

source_text: 右肺新见微小致密结节灶（IM34、39）
text_en: Newly seen tiny dense nodular foci in the right lung (IM34, 39).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段结节灶较前缩小，原约22x20mm，现约14x10mm（IM12），边缘仍见毛刺，且与邻近胸膜分界不清
text_en: Nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 22x20 mm, now approximately 14x10 mm (IM12); spiculated margins persist and the lesion remains indistinct from the adjacent pleura

source_text: 纵隔5组淋巴结较前相仿，较大现约15x10mm（IM30）
text_en: Mediastinal group 5 lymph nodes similar to prior, largest currently approximately 15x10 mm (Image 30)

source_text: 右肺上叶后段结节大致同前
text_en: Nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is essentially unchanged

source_text: 双侧胸膜结节样增厚大致同前，追查
text_en: Bilateral pleural nodular thickening is largely unchanged; continued follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 双肺索条及微小结节同前（如IM35）
text_en: Linear opacities and micro-nodules in both lungs are similar to prior (e.g., IM35).

source_text: 左肺上叶肺大泡并周围磨玻璃影大致同前，恶性不除外，密切追查
text_en: Bullae with surrounding ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe, similar to previous; malignancy cannot be excluded; close follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔4R组高密度淋巴结同前，约11mm（IM18），其内见点状钙化
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R high-density lymph node unchanged from prior, approximately 11 mm (IM18), with punctate calcification.

source_text: 右侧甲状腺低密度结节大致同前
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right thyroid is essentially stable.

source_text: 左肺上叶另见多发微小结节同前（IM30、39）
text_en: Multiple additional micronodules in left upper lobe unchanged (IM30, 39)

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段（IM16）、右肺中叶（IM35）小结节同前，余肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Small nodules in the apical segment of the right upper lobe (IM16) and in the right middle lobe (IM35) are stable. The remainder of the lungs shows no new nodules or consolidative opacities.

source_text: 右肺门多发钙化淋巴结同前，较大仍约13x9mm（IM24）
text_en: Multiple calcified right hilar lymph nodes are unchanged compared to prior, the largest still approximately 13x9 mm (IM24).

source_text: 右肺多发小结节灶同前（Im12、14、15、19等）
text_en: Multiple small nodular foci in the right lung are stable compared to prior studies (IM12, 14, 15, 19, etc.).

source_text: 右肺上叶见一小结节同前，约6x5mm（IM16），边界清楚，密度均匀
text_en: A small nodule is seen in the right upper lobe, stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 6x5 mm (IM16), with well-defined margins and homogeneous density.

source_text: 纵膈2组、4组、5组及右腋窝小淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal stations 2, 4, and 5 lymph nodes and right axillary small lymph nodes are stable

source_text: 左肺上叶、下叶小结节影同前（IM17、45），较大者仍约6mm（Im17），追查
text_en: Small nodules in the left upper and lower lobes are stable compared to prior (IM17, 45); the largest remains approximately 6 mm (Im17); follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶柱状改变较前减小，原较大层面约33x14mm(IM45)，现约24x9mm（IM43）
text_en: Left lower lobe tubular opacity decreased compared to prior, previously largest dimension approximately 33x14 mm (IM45), now approximately 24x9 mm (IM43).

source_text: 两肺上叶见结节影同前，较大约4mm（IMA10）
text_en: Nodules in both upper lobes are unchanged from prior. The largest measures approximately 4 mm (IMA10).

source_text: 左肺下叶膈上结节同前
text_en: Left lower lobe subdiaphragmatic nodule unchanged from previous

source_text: 右肺中叶肺癌伴中叶不张，范围较前增大
text_en: Right middle lobe lung cancer with middle lobe atelectasis, increased in extent compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见异常密度灶，右侧叶间胸膜结节状增厚范围较前缩小，边缘模糊，原约10x8mm（IM24），现约6x4mm（IM23），考虑术后改变
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no abnormal density at the bronchial stump. Nodular thickening of the right interlobar pleura has decreased in extent compared to prior, with ill-defined margins. Previously measured approximately 10x8 mm (IM24), now approximately 6x4 mm (IM23), considered postoperative change.

source_text: 新见小簇2-4mm微小结节
text_en: Newly identified small cluster of 2-4 mm tiny nodules

source_text: 锁骨上、腋下淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Supraclavicular and axillary lymph nodes essentially unchanged from previous

source_text: 两肺结节较前增大，考虑转移
text_en: Nodules in both lungs are increased in size compared to prior, suggestive of metastases.

source_text: 肺气肿及肺内陈旧小结节同前
text_en: Emphysema and intrapulmonary old small nodules unchanged from previous.

source_text: 食管癌术后，吻合口右侧纵隔及胸腔积液同前，局部积气略减少，吻合口右侧壁不连续（IM15），食管内可见置管影
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer, mediastinal and pleural effusion on the right side of the anastomosis stable compared to prior, localized air collection slightly decreased, right anastomotic wall discontinuity (IM15), esophageal tube in place visible.

source_text: 左肺散在、多发小结节较前相仿，现较大仍约10*9mm(图20)
text_en: Left lung scattered, multiple small nodules similar to previous; largest still approximately 10x9 mm (Figure 20).

source_text: 双肺微结节大致同前，追查
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary micro-nodules are roughly unchanged from prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔右侧气管食管沟小淋巴结大致同前，较大约6mm（IM9），追查
text_en: Small lymph node in the right tracheoesophageal groove of the mediastinum, stable compared to prior, largest approximately 6 mm (IM9), requires follow-up.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，约4mm（Im28）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, approximately 4 mm (Im28).

source_text: 双肺微小不规则结节灶同前（IM9、11、17等）
text_en: Tiny irregular nodular foci in both lungs are stable (IM9, 11, 17, etc.).

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上区及腋下未见新发肿大淋巴结
text_en: No new enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular areas, or axillae.

source_text: 右肺小结节部分缩小，原约5mm者（IM26），现约3mm（IM27）
text_en: Some small nodules in the right lung have partially decreased in size; a previously approximately 5 mm nodule (IM26) is now approximately 3 mm (IM27).

source_text: 右锁骨上新见肿大淋巴结，约37x21mm（IM6）
text_en: Newly enlarged right supraclavicular lymph node, measuring approximately 37x21 mm (IM6)

source_text: 双肺新发多发大小不等结节，较大约5mm（IM20）
text_en: Newly developed multiple nodules of varying sizes in both lungs. The largest measures approximately 5 mm (IM20).

source_text: 扫及颈7、胸1椎体及棘突融合，余胸廓诸骨未见明确新发破坏征象
text_en: Fusion of the C7 and T1 vertebral bodies and spinous processes; no clear new destructive signs in the remaining thoracic bones.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，局部结节影较前增大，原约10x9mm，现约13x9mm（IM18）
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; the local nodule has increased in size compared to prior, previously about 10 x 9 mm, now approximately 13 x 9 mm (IM18).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段微小结节影同前
text_en: The tiny nodule shadow in the left upper lobe anterior segment is unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度小结节同前，仍约7mm（IM33）
text_en: Small ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe unchanged from prior, still approximately 7 mm (IM33).

source_text: 双肺散在多发小结节数目及大小同前，较大约9mm（Im31）
text_en: Number and size of scattered multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, the largest measuring approximately 9 mm (Im31).

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段软组织密度占位较前相仿，原约28x21mm，现约30*21mm（Im14），边缘多发毛刺
text_en: The soft tissue density mass in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is similar to prior, previously approximately 28x21 mm, now approximately 30x21 mm (Im14), with multiple spiculations at the margin.

source_text: 前纵隔血管前间隙类椭圆形软组织密度影较前缩小，现较大层面约41*15mm(图27)，原约48*19mm（Im28），边缘清晰，其内可见点状钙化，增强扫描各期未见确切强化
text_en: An oval soft tissue density in the prevascular space of the anterior mediastinum is smaller than before, now measuring approximately 41x15 mm on the largest slice (Figure 27), previously 48x19 mm (Im28). The margin is well-defined, with punctate calcification seen within. No definite enhancement is observed on multiphase contrast-enhanced scans.

source_text: 右肺上叶结节较前缩小，余同前
text_en: The nodule in the right upper lobe has decreased in size; the remainder is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶微小结节同前，约2mm（IMA34）
text_en: Right lower lobe tiny nodule unchanged, approximately 2 mm (IMA34)

source_text: 双肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段胸膜下结节同前，约6mm（IM34）
text_en: The subpleural nodule in the left lower lobe basal segment remains unchanged, approximately 6 mm (IM34).

source_text: 右侧胸膜旁稍致密结节样增厚同前
text_en: The slightly dense nodular thickening adjacent to the right pleura is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段极浅淡影模糊不清同前（Im22），左肺未见结节
text_en: Extremely faint and indistinct opacity in the left lower lobe dorsal segment unchanged from previous (Im22), with no nodules seen in the left lung.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜结节样增厚同前，未见胸水征象
text_en: The nodular thickening along the right interlobar pleura is unchanged. No pleural effusion is seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃密度结节影同前相仿，约35x30mm（IM14 肺窗），余双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Ground-glass density nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is similar to prior, approximately 35 × 30 mm (IM14, lung window); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节灶同前（Im57）
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe, same as before (Image 57).

source_text: 左肺上叶纵隔旁不规则软组织团块较前增大，现较大层面约68x40mm（IM15），原约57x40mm（IM14)，低强化区较前增多，仍与纵隔胸膜相连、与肺门肿大淋巴结及远端不张肺组织分界不清，左肺上叶体积缩小，双肺多发结节较前增多增大，现较大约10mm（IM27）
text_en: Irregular soft tissue mass adjacent to mediastinum in left upper lobe increased in size, currently largest dimension approximately 68x40 mm (IM15), previously approximately 57x40 mm (IM14), with increased low enhancement areas, still connected to mediastinal pleura and ill-defined with hilar enlarged lymph nodes and distal atelectatic lung tissue, left upper lobe volume decreased, multiple nodules in both lungs increased in number and size, current largest approximately 10 mm (IM27).

source_text: 左膈抬高、纵膈略左移同前，纵隔、肺门、锁骨上及腋窝平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Left diaphragm elevation and slight left mediastinal shift unchanged from prior; no enlarged lymph nodes seen on non-contrast scans in the mediastinum, hilar regions, supraclavicular areas, or axillae.

source_text: 纵隔内主肺动脉窗内结节状影大致同前（Im23）
text_en: A nodular shadow within the mediastinal aortopulmonary window is roughly unchanged from previous (Im23).

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes essentially unchanged

source_text: 双下肺见索条影，双肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Linear opacities are seen in the bilateral lower lungs; no new nodules are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶（IM14、18、31）、左肺上叶前段及下叶后基底段小结节同前（IM15、48），较大约7mm（48）
text_en: Small nodules in the right upper lobe (IM14, 18, 31), anterior segment of the left upper lobe, and posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe are unchanged (IM15, 48), the largest measuring approximately 7 mm (IM48).

source_text: 纵隔散在小淋巴结同前相仿，未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Scattered small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior; no enlarged lymph nodes seen.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段胸膜下稍高密度结节灶同前，仍约4mm（IM45）

source_text: 左下肺、左肺舌段散在小结节同前，左下较大者仍约6mm（IM50）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the left lower lobe and left lingular segment are stable. The largest in the left lower lobe remains approximately 6 mm (IM50).

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，较大者小于1cm
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, largest less than 1 cm

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，支气管残段未见明确肿块征象同前
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, no definite mass lesion is seen at the bronchial stump compared to previous.

source_text: 右肺门软组织密度结节较前缩小，边缘光滑，密度较均匀，原约20x15mm，现约12x8mm（IM29）
text_en: The soft tissue density nodule at the right hilum is smaller than before, with smooth margins and relatively homogeneous density; previously about 20x15 mm, now approximately 12x8 mm (IM29).

source_text: 左肾上腺及脾脏小结节同前(图54、60)，建议结合腹部检查
text_en: Small nodules in left adrenal gland and spleen unchanged (Figs. 54, 60), recommend correlation with abdominal examination.

source_text: 未见明显新增病灶
text_en: No obvious new lesions

source_text: 原左肱骨上段骨皮质模糊此次未扫及，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: The previously noted cortical blurring of the upper left humerus is not included in the current scan; no osseous destruction is seen in the remaining imaged bones.

source_text: 两肺索条影、左肺下叶索条小结节影同前，约3mm（IM40）
text_en: The linear opacities and the linear small nodules in the left lower lobe are unchanged, about 3 mm (IM40).

source_text: 左肺下叶脊柱旁肿物，较前增大，现约53x51mm（IM41），原约43x40mm(IM39)
text_en: Left lower lobe paraspinal mass increased in size compared to previous, now approximately 53x51 mm (IM41), previously approximately 43x40 mm (IM39)

source_text: 余双肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no new nodules or consolidation shadows.

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节同前，约5mm（IM28）
text_en: The small nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged, approximately 5 mm (IM28).

source_text: 气管隆突下低密度结节同前
text_en: Subcarinal low-density nodule unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺门结构较前显示清晰，隆突下淋巴结较前稍缩小，原短径约10mm（IM33），现约6mm（M34）
text_en: Right hilar architecture is more clearly defined compared to prior; subcarinal lymph node is slightly smaller, previous short axis approximately 10 mm (IM33), now approximately 6 mm (M34)

source_text: 右肺上下叶、左肺下叶及右侧斜裂多发小结节同前相仿，较大仍约5mm（IM43）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right upper and lower lobes, left lower lobe, and right oblique fissure similar to prior; largest still approximately 5 mm (IM43).

source_text: 右肺多发结节稍增大，转移
text_en: Multiple nodules in the right lung are slightly increased in size; metastasis.

source_text: 纵隔11R淋巴结同前相仿，约11x5mm(IM36)
text_en: The mediastinal lymph node at station 11R is similar to previous, approximately 11x5 mm (Image 36).

source_text: 两肺索条影同前，双肺未见新生结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: Linear opacities in both lungs are stable; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区小淋巴结同前，纵隔、双侧腋下平扫未见明显肿大淋巴结
text_en: Small lymph node in the left supraclavicular region is stable; no enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum or bilateral axillae on non-contrast imaging.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节及斜裂胸膜结节大致同前，仍约3mm（IM27、34）
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe and the pleural nodule along the oblique fissure are stable compared to prior, remaining approximately 3 mm (IM27, 34)

source_text: 两上肺索条结节及钙化、左下叶多发索条同前
text_en: Fibrotic bands, nodules, and calcifications in both upper lungs and multiple fibrotic bands in the left lower lobe unchanged

source_text: 余纵隔多个小淋巴结大致同前
text_en: The remaining multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes are approximately unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔4、5组小淋巴结大致同前，较大现约13x7mm（Im18）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 4 and 5 are essentially stable compared to prior. The largest measures approximately 13x7 mm (Image 18).

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，均小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, all less than 10mm.

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段胸膜下小结节较前相仿，约6mm（IM42），随诊
text_en: The subpleural small nodule in the outer basal segment of the right lower lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM42); follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 双侧叶间胸膜结节同前，较大位于右侧水平裂凸向右肺中叶，仍约5mm（IMA38），未见胸水征象
text_en: Nodules in the bilateral interlobar fissures are unchanged; the largest is located in the right horizontal fissure, convex toward the right middle lobe, still measuring approximately 5 mm (IMA38); no pleural effusion is seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶新见小结节，约3mm（Im22），周围见少许磨玻璃密度增高影，炎性结节
text_en: Newly seen small nodule in the right upper lobe, approximately 3 mm (Im22), with a small area of surrounding ground-glass opacity; inflammatory nodule.

source_text: 右肺见少许索条影及肺大泡同前，下叶钙化同前，未见占位征象
text_en: Minimal reticular opacities and bullae in the right lung are stable; calcification in the lower lobe is unchanged; no space-occupying lesion is seen.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，较大约28x13mm（IM23）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are stable compared to prior, largest measuring approximately 28x13 mm (IM23)

source_text: 纵隔2R组小淋巴结同前，大小约7mm（IM14）
text_en: Small lymph node in mediastinal station 2R unchanged from previous, approximately 7 mm in size (IM14).

source_text: 右肺上叶软组织密度肿块影明显缩小，原较大层面约70*59mm，现约14*10mm（IMA26），右肺上叶见斑片索条影同前
text_en: Soft tissue mass in the right upper lobe has markedly decreased in size, previously measuring up to 70x59 mm on the largest slice, now approximately 14x10 mm (IMA26). Patchy and linear streaky opacities in the right upper lobe remain unchanged.

source_text: T9椎体许莫氏结节同前，余扫及诸骨未骨质见破坏征象
text_en: Schmorl's node in T9 vertebral body unchanged; no evidence of osseous destruction in the remainder of the visualized bones

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变同前，平扫未见明确恶性征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lobe are unchanged; no definite malignant findings on non-contrast scan

source_text: 纵隔2R组肿大淋巴结较前缩小，现约11x6mm（IM11），原为17x10mm（IM12）
text_en: Enlarged lymph node in mediastinal station 2R reduced in size compared to previous, currently approximately 11x6 mm (IM11), previously 17x10 mm (IM12).

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, no definite evidence of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 右肺多发小结节影，转移可能，请结合临床明确
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right lung; metastasis is possible—correlation with clinical findings is recommended for clarification.

source_text: 左肺下叶癌复查，较前增大
text_en: Left lower lobe cancer follow-up, increased in size compared to prior

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃结节较前相仿，仍约15x11mm（IM19），内部未见实性成分，仍见血管穿行
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is similar to prior, still measures approximately 15x11 mm (IM19), without solid component, and vascular penetration is still seen.

source_text: 右肺术后改变，左上肺转移结节较前增大
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lung; the metastatic nodule in the left upper lobe is larger than previously noted.

source_text: 纵隔4L淋巴结同前，仍约15x10mm(IM22)，追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 4L lymph nodes are unchanged from prior, still measuring approximately 15x10 mm (IM22), for follow-up.

source_text: 右肺下叶后基底段肿块进一步缩小，现约28x22mm（IM41），原约33x31mm（IM39）
text_en: Mass in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe has further decreased in size, now measuring approximately 28 x 22 mm (IM41), previously 33 x 31 mm (IM39).

source_text: 左肺下叶外基底段小结节同前，倾向良性，随诊观察
text_en: Left lower lobe, lateral basal segment: small nodule unchanged, suggestive of benign, follow-up observation.

source_text: 平扫纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约11x8mm（IM21）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest approximately 11x8 mm (image 21).

source_text: 左肺上叶结节同前
text_en: Nodule in left upper lobe unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶模糊结节同前（IM23）
text_en: The ill-defined nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior (IM23).

source_text: 双肺门见多发淋巴结同前，较大仍约15x11mm（IM28）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes at both hila are unchanged from prior, the largest still measuring approximately 15x11 mm (IM28).

source_text: 左肺上叶索条影同前，两肺胸膜下多个小结节影同前，较大约3mm（IM39）
text_en: Left upper lobe linear opacity unchanged, multiple subpleural small nodules in both lungs unchanged, largest approximately 3 mm (IM39).

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区淋巴结同前，约为7mm（IM5）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node is unchanged, approximately 7 mm (IM5)

source_text: 左侧肩胛骨低密度灶同前，边缘可见硬化缘，余扫描所及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: Low-density focus in the left scapula, unchanged from prior, with sclerotic margins; no evidence of osseous destruction in the remainder of the visualized bones.

source_text: 两肺间质纤维化大致同前，双肺散在少许小结节同前，如左肺下叶结节仍约5mm（Im36），未见新增结节灶
text_en: Pulmonary fibrosis in both lungs is stable; scattered small nodules are stable, such as a nodule in the left lower lobe still measuring approximately 5 mm (IM36); no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 纵隔4L、6组淋巴结大致同前，现较大仍约16x11mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4L and 6 largely unchanged from previous, currently largest still approximately 16x11 mm (IM20).

source_text: 锁骨上、纵隔小淋巴结同前，腔静脉后较大仍约12x8mm（IM24）
text_en: Supraclavicular and mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged from previous, with the larger one posterior to the vena cava still approximately 12x8 mm (IM24)

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大者原约12x6mm，现约11x5mm（IM26）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged, the largest previously approximately 12x6 mm, now approximately 11x5 mm (IM26).

source_text: 双侧锁骨上区小淋巴结同前，较大约8mm（IM7）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the bilateral supraclavicular regions are stable compared to prior; the largest is approximately 8 mm (IM7).

source_text: 左肺下叶模糊结节影大致同前，8*5mm（IM47）
text_en: Left lower lobe hazy nodule shadow essentially unchanged, 8x5 mm (IM47)

source_text: 双肺不规则小结节同前，约3mm（Im36、47）
text_en: Irregular small nodules in both lungs are unchanged compared to prior, approximately 3 mm (Im36, 47).

source_text: 做肺静脉下方结节同前，约13*8mm(图33)
text_en: The nodule below the pulmonary vein is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 13x8 mm (Figure 33).

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下结节状索条影同前，约12x8mm（IM41）
text_en: Subpleural nodular linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 12 x 8 mm (IM41).

source_text: 两肺小结节同前（IM41、44、52、54），较大仍约5mm（IM41）
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior (IM41, 44, 52, 54), largest still approximately 5 mm (IM41)

source_text: 右肺下叶磨玻璃密度小结节同前，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged; old focus is considered

source_text: 左肺下叶不规则结节小片灶大致同前（IM38）
text_en: Left lower lobe irregular patchy focus stable compared to previous (Image 38)

source_text: 扫及胸2椎体低密度结节同前，余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Scans show a hypodense nodule in the T2 vertebra, unchanged from prior; no signs of bone destruction in the remaining thoracic cage bones.

source_text: 食管胸上段癌，较前进展
text_en: Esophageal cancer in the upper thoracic segment, progression compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶混杂结节同前，仍约19x17mm（IM12），实性成分同前
text_en: Mixed nodule in the right middle lobe unchanged, still measuring approximately 19 x 17 mm (IM12), with solid component unchanged

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段含钙化结节同前，约16mm（Im18）
text_en: Left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment: calcified nodule stable compared to prior, approximately 16 mm (Im18).

source_text: 气管右侧旁淋巴结较前缩小，现约10x7mm（IM9），原约11x9mm（IM9）
text_en: Right paratracheal lymph node decreased compared to prior, now approximately 10x7mm (IM9), previously approximately 11x9mm (IM9)

source_text: 右肺中叶磨玻璃结节同前
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺模糊小结节同前（IM25、35），较大者约7x4mm（IMA35）
text_en: Faint small nodule in the right lung is stable compared to prior (IM25, 35), the largest measures approximately 7 x 4 mm (IMA35).

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下淋巴结同前，较大约12*11mm(图14)
text_en: Lymph nodes in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular regions, and bilateral axillary regions are unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 12x11 mm (Figure 14).

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下小结节同前，约3mm（IM57）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural small nodule unchanged from prior, approximately 3 mm (IM57)

source_text: 右肺下叶肺门旁不规则肿块较前明显缩小，仍与纵隔胸膜及叶间胸膜粘连，原约44x44mm（IM39），现约31x21mm（IM37）
text_en: The irregular mass adjacent to the hilum of the right lower lobe is significantly smaller than prior, though it remains adherent to the mediastinal and interlobar pleura. Previously measured approximately 44x44 mm (IM39), now approximately 31x21 mm (IM37).

source_text: 双肺门及纵隔少许小淋巴结同前，最大短径均小于10mm
text_en: A few small lymph nodes in the bilateral hila and mediastinum are unchanged from prior; all have a maximum short diameter less than 10 mm.

source_text: 双肺小结节同前相仿，追查
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 双肺下叶小结节同前（IM35、38、48），较大约4mm（IM35）
text_en: Small nodules in both lower lobes are stable compared to prior (IM35, 38, 48), with the largest measuring approximately 4 mm (IM35).

source_text: 两上肺索条结节灶大致同前
text_en: Fibrotic nodular foci in both upper lungs essentially unchanged

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后，支气管断端软组织密度灶较前饱满（IM26），复发不除外
text_en: Status post left lower lobectomy, soft tissue density focus at the bronchial stump more prominent compared to previous (Image 26), recurrence cannot be excluded.

source_text: 隆突下见条状软组织密度影较前减少，纵隔3p组见小淋巴结同前，约10mm（IM8）
text_en: Subcarinal linear soft tissue density shadow reduced compared to prior, mediastinal station 3p small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, approximately 10 mm (IM8).

source_text: 双肺下叶小结节同前，较大约3mm（IM52），形态欠规整
text_en: Small nodules in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior, largest approximately 3 mm (IM52), morphology irregular.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变同前，右肺索条点状结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lobe are unchanged. The linear opacities and punctate nodules in the right lung are stable. Follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双侧锁骨上多个淋巴结显示同前，小于10mm
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the bilateral supraclavicular regions are stable compared to prior, all less than 10 mm.

source_text: 两肺多发微小结节同前相仿（IM16、17、27），3-5mm
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in both lungs similar to prior (IM16, 17, 27), 3-5 mm

source_text: 右肺下叶后基底段外周近胸膜处结节同前，呈环形稍高密度，大小约10x9mm（IM66），与胸膜粘连
text_en: The nodule in the peripheral posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe near the pleura remains unchanged, showing a ring-like slightly increased density, measuring approximately 10x9 mm (IM66), and is pleurally attached.

source_text: 左肺新见少许斑点、结节及小片影（如IM37、52、53、54等）
text_en: New few spots, nodules, and small patchy opacities in left lung (e.g., Images 37, 52, 53, 54)

source_text: 左锁骨上小淋巴结较前增大，原约6mm，现约9mm（IM5）
text_en: Left supraclavicular small lymph node increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 6 mm, now approximately 9 mm (IM5)

source_text: 左下肺微小结节灶略模糊，大小同前相仿
text_en: A tiny nodule in the left lower lobe is slightly blurred, with size similar to prior.

source_text: 纵隔、肺门淋巴结同前，较大者约15x10mm（IM25）
text_en: Mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest approximately 15x10 mm (IM25).

source_text: 右侧锁骨上区见淋巴结同前，较大约为10mm（IM10）
text_en: Lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region are unchanged from prior, with the largest measuring approximately 10 mm (IM10).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段小结节大致同前，现仍约5mm(IM28)
text_en: Small nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged, currently still approximately 5 mm (IM28).

source_text: 余肺内散在浅淡斑片结节影大致同前，右肺中叶索条结节较前明显（IMA33）
text_en: The remaining scattered faint patchy and nodular opacities in the lungs are approximately unchanged; the linear and nodular opacity in the right middle lobe is more prominent than prior (IMA33).

source_text: 余双肺内未见明确新发占位征象
text_en: No definite new space-occupying lesions are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶多发高密度结节同前，部分内含钙化，最大仍约11x9mm（IM18），边缘毛糙，其内未见钙化，周边可见长索条影
text_en: Multiple high-density nodules in the right upper lobe are unchanged compared to prior; some contain calcification. The largest remains approximately 11x9 mm (IM18), with irregular margins and no calcification within. Long linear bands are visible around it.

source_text: 余胸廓诸骨未见明显骨质破坏
text_en: The remaining thoracic bones show no obvious osseous destruction.

source_text: 纵隔散在淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Scattered mediastinal lymph nodes same as before, follow-up.

source_text: 扫及左肾上腺不规则软组织结节同前，仍约27x19mm（IM60）
text_en: On imaging, an irregular soft tissue nodule measuring approximately 27 x 19 mm is seen in the left adrenal gland, unchanged from prior (IM60).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段浅淡密度小结节同前（IM21）
text_en: Faintly dense small nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable (IM21)

source_text: 左肺上叶前段磨玻璃密度结节同前
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the left upper lobe anterior segment is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下5mm以下微小结节同前（IM27）
text_en: Subpleural micronodules measuring less than 5 mm in the right upper lobe are stable compared to prior (IM27).

source_text: 纵隔向右侧移位，7组区域类圆形低密度影较前缩小，现约18*9mm(图29)，原约20x10mm（IM30）
text_en: Mediastinal shift to the right, station 7 round low-density lesion decreased in size compared to prior, currently approximately 18x9 mm (Figure 29), previously approximately 20x10 mm (IM30).

source_text: 右肺尖磨玻璃小结节灶同前，约5mm（IMA12）
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right apex unchanged, approximately 5 mm (IMA12).

source_text: 右肺下叶术后改变，未见复发、转移征象
text_en: Postoperative change in the right lower lobe; no evidence of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 右肺微小点状结节同前（Im24、26），余双肺未见新生占位
text_en: Right lung tiny punctate nodules unchanged (Im24, 26); no new pulmonary mass lesions seen in the remainder of both lungs

source_text: 左肺下叶光滑结节同前，约10x6mm（IMA451），左肺下叶胸膜下微小结节同前，＜5mm（图48）
text_en: Left lower lobe smooth nodule stable compared to previous, approximately 10x6mm (Image A451), and left lower lobe subpleural tiny nodule stable compared to previous, less than 5mm (Image 48)

source_text: 锁骨上、腋下淋巴结部分较前稍缩小，较大原约12x5mm（IM18），现约10x5mm（IM18）
text_en: Some supraclavicular and axillary lymph nodes have slightly decreased in size compared to previous, with the larger one previously approximately 12x5 mm (IM18), currently approximately 10x5 mm (IM18)

source_text: 右肺上叶及中叶多发类圆形小结节同前，部分呈磨玻璃密度，较大约5mm（Im12）
text_en: Multiple rounded small nodules in the right upper and middle lobes remain unchanged; some have ground-glass density; the largest is approximately 5 mm (Im12).

source_text: 双肺散在结节，部分同前，部分未见显示，追查
text_en: Scattered nodules in both lungs; some are unchanged, while others are no longer visible. Recommend follow-up.

source_text: 双肺胸膜下小结节同前相仿，胸部CT平扫未见新发占位
text_en: Subpleural small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior; non-contrast chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段及右肺下叶基底段结节同前
text_en: Nodules in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment and right lower lobe basal segment are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结部分较前缩小
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes are smaller compared to prior.

source_text: 中纵隔内主动脉弓及左肺动脉之间不规则肿块同前，较大平面仍约45x43mm（IM21），内大部分钙化同前，边界清
text_en: An irregular mass between the aortic arch and the left pulmonary artery in the middle mediastinum is stable; the largest dimension remains approximately 45x43 mm (IM21), with extensive calcification stable, and well-defined margins.

source_text: 右肺下叶外侧基底段模糊斑片结节影同前，约7mm（IM34）
text_en: The ill-defined patchy nodular opacity in the lateral basal segment of the right lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 7 mm (IM34).

source_text: 食管下段管壁增厚较前减轻，原较厚约25mm（IM44），现约7mm（IM44），外膜光滑，同主动脉脂肪间隙存在，近端食管轻度扩张减轻
text_en: Wall thickening of the distal esophagus reduced compared to previous, originally approximately 25mm (IM44), now approximately 7mm (IM44), with smooth serosa, fat plane with aorta present, and mild proximal esophageal dilation reduced.

source_text: 左下肺外基底段小结节灶同前，仍约3mm（Im48）
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe lateral basal segment is unchanged, still approximately 3 mm (Im48).

source_text: 双肺门淋巴结显示欠清晰，与前相仿（IM38）
text_en: Hilar lymph nodes are poorly visualized, similar to prior (IM38).

source_text: 食管癌术后改变同前相仿
text_en: Postoperative changes from esophageal cancer are similar to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度灶较前相仿，约13x6mm（IMA18），两肺微小结节影同前（IMA36、44等）
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe is similar to previous, approximately 13x6 mm (IMA18), with unchanged small nodules in both lungs (IMA36, 44, etc.).

source_text: 右肺尖及右肺下叶少许点状小结节大致同前，仍约3mm（IM18、21、44、47、56）
text_en: The few punctate small nodules at the right lung apex and right lower lobe are essentially unchanged, still measuring approximately 3 mm (IM18, 21, 44, 47, 56).

source_text: 右肺门多发淋巴结较前相仿，较大约13x8mm（IM23）
text_en: Multiple right hilar lymph nodes are similar to prior, largest approximately 13x8 mm (IM23).

source_text: 左下肺胸膜下微小结节同前（IMA40）
text_en: Subpleural micronodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged (IMA40).

source_text: 肺内小结节大致同前
text_en: Small pulmonary nodules essentially unchanged

source_text: 双侧肺内散在小结节部分同前相仿，部分显示不清，小于3mm
text_en: Some of the scattered small nodules in the bilateral lungs are similar to prior; others are not clearly visible, measuring less than 3 mm.

source_text: 右肺上叶肿物切除术后，支气管断端稍厚同前
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe with slightly thickened bronchial stump, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 前上纵隔囊性为主伴脂肪密度肿块影较前增大，原较大层面约73x63mm（IMA21），现约85x62mm（IM22）
text_en: The predominantly cystic mass with fat density in the anterior superior mediastinum has increased in size compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 73x63 mm (IMA21), now approximately 85x62 mm (IM22).

source_text: 新见多发小淋巴结
text_en: Newly identified multiple small lymph nodes

source_text: 右肺散在小结节（IM29、33、40等）同前，较大约4mm（IM33）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right lung (IM29, 33, 40, etc.) are unchanged, the largest measuring approximately 4 mm (IM33).

source_text: 余双肺未见新发结节影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no new nodule shadows.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃密度小结节范围同前，约4mm（IM27），边界欠清
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe remains unchanged in extent, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM27), with ill-defined margins.

source_text: 左肺中央型肺癌缩小，伴左肺下叶实变不张较前好转
text_en: Central lung cancer in left lung decreased in size, accompanied by improvement in consolidation and atelectasis in left lower lobe compared to previous.

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段胸膜下浅淡模糊小结节灶同前，复查
text_en: The faint, ill-defined small subpleural nodule in the lateral basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior; repeat examination recommended.

source_text: 新见两枚小结节
text_en: Newly identified two small nodules

source_text: 扫描所及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Scanned bones show no evidence of osseous destruction.

source_text: 右肺下叶散在钙化小结节同前
text_en: Scattered calcified small nodules in the right lower lobe, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 胸5附件、右侧第5后肋骨质破坏较前明显，周围软组织增厚
text_en: Bone destruction in T5 appendages and right posterior fifth rib is more obvious than before, with surrounding soft tissue thickening.

source_text: 纵隔内5、6组散在小淋巴结同前
text_en: Scattered small mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 5 and 6 are unchanged from prior

source_text: 右肺索条影同前，左肺下叶胸膜下浅淡模糊小结节同前（IM44），左肺少许索条影同前，未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: Fibrotic band in the right lung is stable compared to prior; the faint, indistinct small subpleural nodule in the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior (IM44); minimal fibrotic bands in the left lung are stable; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段结节较前缩小，形态不规则，边缘毛糙，原约15x9mm，现约10x7mm（IM19）
text_en: The nodule in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment has decreased in size compared to previous, with irregular shape and spiculated margins, from approximately 15x9 mm to approximately 10x7 mm (IM19).

source_text: 食管胸中下段管壁不均匀增厚较前减轻，原较厚约7mm（IM29），现较厚约6mm（IM27），管腔未见明显狭窄，外膜模糊，与食道旁肿大淋巴结分界不清，同胸主动脉接触面小于90度
text_en: Irregular wall thickening of the mid-to-lower thoracic esophagus reduced compared to prior, thickest portion previously approximately 7mm (IM29), now approximately 6mm (IM27), lumen shows no significant narrowing, serosa blurred, ill-defined border with enlarged periesophageal lymph nodes, contact surface with thoracic aorta less than 90 degrees.

source_text: 右上肺陈旧灶同前（IM25），双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Right upper lobe chronic changes unchanged (IM25); no new nodules or patchy opacities in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段斑片状影消失，局部见少许斑片索条影（IM29），右肺下叶小结节同前（IM49）
text_en: The patchy opacity in the right upper lobe posterior segment has resolved. A small patchy and linear opacity is now seen locally (IM29). The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM49).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端少许软组织密度灶较前相仿（IM23），未见结节及肿块，左下肺胸膜下模糊结节灶同前（IM22、44），左下肺少许索条影同前
text_en: Left upper lobe postoperative status. Soft tissue density at the bronchial stump similar to prior (IM23). No nodules or masses identified. Left lower lobe subpleural hazy nodule stable (IM22, 44). Left lower lobe minimal fibrotic bands stable

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下、双肺下叶叶间胸膜下可见微小结节大致同前，＜5mm（图36、34、30、25）
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodules in the right lower lobe and bilateral lower lobe interlobar pleura are essentially unchanged, measuring less than 5 mm (Figures 36, 34, 30, 25).

source_text: 双肺散在小斑片影、小结节影同前
text_en: Scattered small patchy opacities and small nodules in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶癌及双肺弥漫转移、右侧胸水，均较前变化不明显
text_en: Carcinoma in the right lower lobe with diffuse bilateral pulmonary metastases and right pleural effusion, all of which show no significant change compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶近肺门结节较前似相仿，平扫与肺血管分界不清，远端肺内模糊片影较前略增多，右肺下叶小结节较前略缩小，原约7x6mm(图32），现约5x4mm(图30)
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe near the hilum appears similar to prior, with indistinct margins from pulmonary vessels on non-contrast imaging. The hazy patchy opacity in the distal lung parenchyma has slightly increased compared to prior. The small nodule in the right lower lobe has slightly decreased in size, previously approximately 7x6 mm (Figure 32), now approximately 5x4 mm (Figure 30).

source_text: 双肺多发微小结节同前，约2-3mm，追查
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged, approximately 2–3 mm; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段实性小结节同前，约3mm（IM36）
text_en: Solid small nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM36).

source_text: 右肾上腺结节同前，约15mm（IM54）
text_en: Right adrenal nodule is stable, measuring approximately 15 mm (IM54).

source_text: 肝脏多发低密度小结节、胆囊结石同前
text_en: Liver multiple low-density small nodules and gallbladder stones unchanged from prior.

source_text: 甲状腺右叶体积增大伴低密度结节同前，请结合甲状腺其他检查
text_en: The right thyroid lobe is enlarged with a low-density nodule, unchanged from prior; please correlate with other thyroid examinations.

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺结节样增粗同前（IM62）
text_en: Left adrenal nodular thickening unchanged (IM62).

source_text: 余双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no newly increased nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 右肺尖结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: Nodule in the right lung apex is unchanged and is considered likely benign.

source_text: 左下肺少许条索状影同前，双肺未见新生结节斑片影
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the left lower lobe are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 左下肺条片影同前，余肺未见新发结节
text_en: Linear and patchy opacities in the left lower lobe are unchanged; no new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lung.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段浅淡结节同前(IM27)，右肺中叶约4mm结节同前（IM44）
text_en: Faint nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable (IM27); approximately 4 mm nodule in the right middle lobe, stable (IM44)

source_text: 右肺上叶模糊类结节同前（IM19,21）
text_en: The ill-defined nodular opacity in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior (IM19, 21).

source_text: 双侧甲状腺低密度结节同前
text_en: Low-density nodules in the bilateral thyroid glands are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔4R密度增高淋巴结大致同前，短径约9mm(图24)
text_en: The mediastinal station 4R lymph node with increased density is largely unchanged, short axis diameter approximately 9 mm (Fig. 24)

source_text: 甲状腺左叶低密度结节同前，请结合颈部超声检查
text_en: Left thyroid lobe low-density nodule stable compared to prior; please correlate with neck ultrasound examination.

source_text: 右侧叶间裂小结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: The small nodule along the right interlobar fissure is unchanged and is likely benign.

source_text: 余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: No osseous destruction signs are seen in the bones imaged.

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结较前增大，追查
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes increased in size compared to previous, follow-up

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约11x5mm（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest measures approximately 11x5 mm (IM19).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，平扫支气管残端未见明显异常软组织密度肿块影，左上包裹性积液同前
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, plain scan shows no significant abnormal soft tissue density mass at the bronchial stump; left upper encapsulated pleural effusion unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔内5组低密度结节同前相仿，约为30x12mm（IM22、23）
text_en: A low-density nodule at mediastinal station 5 is similar to previous, measuring approximately 30x12 mm (IM22, 23).

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见明显软组织密度肿块影，局部胸膜增厚同前（IM36）
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no obvious soft-tissue density mass is seen at the bronchial stump on non-contrast imaging. Local pleural thickening is unchanged compared to prior (IM36).

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下结节较前略饱满，原约2mm（IM37），现约3mm（IM39），性质待定，追查
text_en: Subpleural nodule in the right middle lobe is slightly more prominent than prior, previously approximately 2 mm (IM37), now approximately 3 mm (IM39); etiology indeterminate, requires follow-up.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段不规则软组织密度肿物较前缩小，原约27*26mm、56*42mm(图16、18)，现约23*20mm、52x35mm（IM17、19），病变远端絮状稍高密度影较前略减轻
text_en: The irregular soft tissue density mass in the left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment has decreased compared to prior, previously approximately 27x26 mm and 56x42 mm (Figures 16, 18), now approximately 23x20 mm and 52x35 mm (IM17, 19); the fluffy slightly higher density shadow distal to the lesion is slightly reduced compared to prior.

source_text: 胸5椎体见致密结节同前
text_en: Dense nodule in T5 vertebra, unchanged from previous.

source_text: 气管右侧旁小淋巴结同前，约9mm（IM12）
text_en: Small right paratracheal lymph node unchanged, approximately 9 mm (IM12).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段叶间裂上方片状高密度影较前缩小，原约28x23mm（IM31），现约19x8mm（IM30），边界模糊
text_en: The patchy area of increased density above the interlobar fissure in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 28x23 mm (IM31), now approximately 19x8 mm (IM30), with blurred margins.

source_text: 右肺中叶局切术后，右肺微小结节同前，右肺索条影略减轻，左肺索条影同前
text_en: Following limited resection of the right middle lobe, right pulmonary micro-nodules are unchanged; right pulmonary linear opacities are slightly improved, and left pulmonary linear opacities are unchanged.

source_text: 余结节与前相仿
text_en: The remaining nodules are similar to prior.

source_text: 甲状腺体积弥漫增大密度不均及左侧肾上腺结节同前
text_en: Diffuse thyroid gland enlargement with heterogeneous density and left adrenal nodule stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前（IMA26）
text_en: Tiny nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior (IMA26).

source_text: 纵隔及右锁骨上区散在淋巴结同前，较大约16x8mm（IM26）
text_en: Scattered lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right supraclavicular region are unchanged from prior, with the largest measuring approximately 16x8 mm (IM26).

source_text: 余双肺散在微小结节较前增大，如右肺中叶结节原约3mm（IM31），现约5mm（IM33）
text_en: Residual scattered tiny nodules in both lungs are larger than prior; for example, the nodule in the right middle lobe previously measured approximately 3 mm (IM31), now measures approximately 5 mm (IM33)

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结较前缩小，现约12x8mm（IM32），原为13x10mm（IM34）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is smaller compared to prior, now approximately 12x8 mm (IM32), previously 13x10 mm (IM34)

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，仍约11x9mm（IM25）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is unchanged from prior, still approximately 11x9 mm (IM25).

source_text: 余肺内未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 左锁骨上淋巴结较前增大，余胸部所见同前
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node increased compared to previous; other chest findings unchanged.

source_text: 隆突下淋巴结增大，原约21x10mm（IM33），现约24x15mm（IM33），转移待除外，追查
text_en: Subcarinal lymph node enlarged, previously approximately 21 × 10 mm (IM33), now approximately 24 × 15 mm (IM33), metastasis cannot be excluded, follow-up recommended

source_text: 左肺术后，断端条状软组织密度影及索条影同前，左肺上叶近心缘处新见一软组织密度结节，约14x9mm（IM21），考虑恶性可能大，请结合临床进一步检查明确
text_en: Post left lung surgery, linear soft tissue density and fibrotic strands at the stump stable compared to prior; new soft tissue density nodule in the left upper lobe near the cardiac border, approximately 14x9 mm (IM21), considered likely malignant; clinical correlation recommended for further evaluation.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区淋巴结同前，约7mm（IM6）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node is unchanged, approximately 7 mm (IM6)

source_text: 纵隔及胃周小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small mediastinal and perigastric lymph nodes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺纹理紊乱，双肺上叶、左肺下叶条片及钙化结节影同前
text_en: Disorganized bronchovascular markings in both lungs, linear and calcified nodular opacities in the upper lobes and left lower lobe similar to prior.
