source_text: 左肺上叶舌段类圆形小结节较前略增大，原约5mm（IMA36），现约6mm（IMA35）
text_en: Roundish small nodule in the left upper lobe lingular segment shows slight increase in size, previously approximately 5 mm (IMA36), now approximately 6 mm (IMA35)

source_text: 右肺上叶后段磨玻璃结节大致同前，约11x7mm（IM23），边界尚清，内见实变成分
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment is largely unchanged, approximately 11x7 mm (IM23), margins are relatively well-defined, with internal solid components present.

source_text: 减小
text_en: Decreased in size.

source_text: 原左肺散在小结节同前
text_en: The scattered small nodules in the left lung are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶局部多个簇状分布小结节同前相仿，较大约4mm（IM17），边缘模糊
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right upper lobe, clustered in distribution, similar to prior; the largest measures approximately 4 mm (IM17), with indistinct margins.

source_text: 余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: No osseous destruction foci are seen in the bones imaged.

source_text: 食管胸中段管壁不均匀增厚较前减轻，较厚横截面径原约29x22mm，现较厚处约9mm（IM27），外膜模糊，同主动脉弓脂肪间隙部分消失，近端食管无扩张
text_en: Irregular wall thickening of the mid-thoracic esophagus is reduced compared to prior, with previously thickest cross-sectional diameter approximately 29x22 mm and currently thickest portion approximately 9 mm (IM27). Outer membrane is blurred, and the periaortic fat plane with the aortic arch is partially obliterated. There is no proximal esophageal dilation.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段条形结节较前缩小，原约12x6mm（IM31），现约11x4mm(IM35)，追查
text_en: The linear nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 12 x 6 mm (IM31), now approximately 11 x 4 mm (IM35); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸主动脉旁团片结节灶同前，考虑恶性可能，密切追查
text_en: A mass-like nodule adjacent to the thoracic aorta in the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior; malignancy is considered possible; close follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶散在微小结节部分同前，＜5mm（图12、22）
text_en: Scattered tiny nodules in the left upper lobe partially unchanged, less than 5mm (Figure 12, 22)

source_text: 锁骨上、纵隔小淋巴结同前，腔静脉后较大仍约12x8mm（IM26）
text_en: Supraclavicular and mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged from previous, with the larger one posterior to the vena cava still approximately 12x8 mm (IM26)

source_text: 右下胸膜结节较前相仿
text_en: Pleural nodule in the right lower region is similar to prior examination.

source_text: 右膈下结节大致同前
text_en: The subdiaphragmatic nodule on the right is essentially unchanged.

source_text: 双肺间质性改变及微小结节影同前
text_en: Interstitial changes and tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶含钙化小结节同前（Im44）
text_en: Small calcified nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged (Im44).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见明显肿块影，右上胸膜增厚同前
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; on non-contrast imaging, no obvious mass is seen at the bronchial stump. Right upper pleural thickening is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 锁骨上小淋巴结同前相仿，小于6mm
text_en: Supraclavicular small lymph nodes similar to prior, less than 6 mm.

source_text: 纵隔内少许高密度淋巴结同前，双侧锁骨上及腋窝未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: A few high-density mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, no lymphadenopathy seen in bilateral supraclavicular and axillary regions.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节灶较前饱满，原约18x15mm（IM15），现约24x16mm（IM15）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe appears more prominent than prior, previously approximately 18x15 mm (IM15), now approximately 24x16 mm (IM15)

source_text: 双肺微结节影同前，较大约3mm（IM42）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary micro-nodular opacities are stable compared to prior; largest is approximately 3 mm (IM42).

source_text: 胸廓诸骨未见明确转移征象
text_en: No definite metastatic findings seen in the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段软组织结节较前相仿，约16x11mm（IM16)，与纵隔胸膜分界不清同前
text_en: The soft tissue nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 16x11 mm (IM16); the indistinct boundary with the mediastinal pleura remains unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔及胃周淋巴结部分同前，部分缩小
text_en: Mediastinal and perigastric lymph nodes partially unchanged, partially decreased in size.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段实性结节较前增大，原约15mm（IM58）、现约22x17mm（IM57）
text_en: The solid nodule in the basal segment of the right lower lobe has increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 15 mm (IM58), now approximately 22 x 17 mm (IM57).

source_text: T10椎体小高密度结节同前(IM44)
text_en: Small high-density nodule in the T10 vertebral body is unchanged (IM44).

source_text: 右肺上叶支气管扩张，右肺上叶胸膜旁边软组织结节较前缩小，现约20x19mm（IMA27），原约25x19mm（IM28），中心可见大片低强化区，边缘略不规则，相邻右侧水平裂增厚并见长索条影牵拉胸膜，病灶近肺门侧沿支气管束走行可见多发呈串结节影较前缩小
text_en: Right upper lobe bronchiectasis. The soft tissue nodule adjacent to the right upper lobe pleura has decreased in size, now measuring approximately 20 x 19 mm (IMA27), previously 25 x 19 mm (IM28). A large area of low enhancement is seen in the center, with slightly irregular margins. Adjacent thickening of the right horizontal fissure and long linear bands are seen pulling on the pleura. Multiple beaded nodules along the bronchovascular bundles on the hilum-adjacent side of the lesion have decreased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 脊柱侧弯同前，未见骨质破坏
text_en: Scoliosis unchanged from previous; no evidence of bone destruction

source_text: 双肺多发类圆形小结节较前略增大，原较大约6*3mm(图32)，现约6*4mm(图34)，追查
text_en: Multiple roundish small nodules in both lungs are slightly larger than prior; the largest previously measured approximately 6x3 mm (Figure 32), now measures approximately 6x4 mm (Figure 34); further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃结节同前相仿，现约9mm（IM23），原约8mm(IM28)
text_en: Left upper lobe ground-glass nodule similar to prior, currently approximately 9 mm (IM23), previously approximately 8 mm (IM28)

source_text: 双肺未见新发结节或实变
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下新见微小结节，建议追查
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural newly identified tiny nodule, recommend follow-up

source_text: 两小肺胸膜下微小结节同前
text_en: Subpleural micronodules in both lower lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔及右锁骨上肿大淋巴结，较前缩小
text_en: Enlarged lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right supraclavicular region are reduced compared to prior.

source_text: Findings document explicit comparative worsening language (e.g., 较前增大/增多).
text_en: Findings document explicit comparative worsening language (e.g., increased in size or increased in number compared to prior).

source_text: 左肺心包旁小结节此次显示欠清，左肺下叶小结节同前，约5mm（IM37）
text_en: Left lung nodule adjacent to pericardium not clearly visualized on this study; left lung lower lobe nodule unchanged from previous, approximately 5 mm (IM37).

source_text: 右肺下叶条片影消失，右下肺近膈面胸膜下小结节同前（IM49）
text_en: The linear and patchy opacity in the right lower lobe has disappeared. The small subpleural nodule near the diaphragm in the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM49).

source_text: 胸中下段食管壁偏侧性不规则增厚较前明显，管腔闭塞，现约27x22mm（IM30），原约22x20mm（IM31），病变区与邻近胸主动脉分界不清，接触面小于90度
text_en: Asymmetric irregular thickening of the mid-to-lower esophageal wall, more pronounced than prior, with luminal occlusion. Current measurement approximately 27 x 22 mm (IM30), previously approximately 22 x 20 mm (IM31). Ill-defined border with adjacent thoracic aorta, contact angle less than 90 degrees.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后改变同前，左肺下叶微小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: The postoperative change in the left upper lobe is similar to previous; the micro-nodule shadow in the left lower lobe is similar to previous; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 左肺结节同前，性质待定，追查
text_en: Left pulmonary nodule unchanged from prior, nature undetermined, further investigation.

source_text: 右肺上叶占位较前缩小
text_en: The mass in the right upper lobe has decreased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后改变同前，右肺门结节较前饱满，请结合临床酌情增强扫描明确
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lower lobe unchanged compared to prior; hilar nodule on the right is more prominent than before; consider contrast-enhanced scan in clinical context for clarification.

source_text: 右肺中叶新见少许斑片、小结节灶，建议短期复查
text_en: A few new patchy and small nodular opacities are seen in the right middle lobe; short-term follow-up is suggested.

source_text: 右上胸膜增厚同前，双肺点状结节影同前（IMA27、33）
text_en: Right upper pleural thickening unchanged; punctate nodular opacities in both lungs unchanged (IMA27, 33).

source_text: 左肺上叶结节大小同前，仍约11x7mm(Im24)
text_en: Left upper lobe nodule size unchanged, still approximately 11x7 mm (Image 24).

source_text: 纵隔及左锁骨上多发小淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and left supraclavicular region unchanged from previous.

source_text: 两肺散在磨玻璃密度小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Scattered small ground-glass opacity nodules in both lungs, unchanged from prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节影较前略增大，现约17*17mm（IMA72）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is slightly larger than prior, now approximately 17x17 mm (IMA72)

source_text: 纵隔内多个较高密度小淋巴结同前，肺门、腋窝、锁骨上平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes with higher density within the mediastinum are unchanged from previous; no enlarged lymph nodes seen in hilar, axillary, or supraclavicular regions on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 双肺下叶微结节同前，倾向良性，追查
text_en: Micronodules in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior, favored as benign; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 两肺钙化灶同前，左肺上叶结节同前相仿，约4mm（IM17）
text_en: Calcified foci in both lungs are stable; the nodule in the left upper lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM17).

source_text: 左肺下叶约8mm边界模糊稍高密度结节同前相仿（IM32），建议追查
text_en: The ill-defined slightly hyperdense nodule measuring approximately 8 mm in the left lower lobe is similar to previous (IM32), with recommendation for further evaluation.

source_text: 两肺内胸膜下散在小结节灶同前（IMA19、30），均&lt
text_en: Scattered subpleural small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IMA19, 30), all <

source_text: 纵隔4、6组淋巴结区见软组织密度灶同前，较大者约21x11mm（IM17），双侧锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal groups 4 and 6 lymph node regions show soft tissue density focus unchanged from previous, largest approximately 21x11 mm (IM17); no enlarged lymph nodes seen in bilateral supraclavicular regions.

source_text: 右肺中叶肿物大致同前，现约33*16mm(图30)，原约32x17mm（IM29）
text_en: The right middle lobe mass is essentially unchanged, currently measuring approximately 33 x 16 mm (Figure 30), previously about 32 x 17 mm (IM29).

source_text: 纵隔平扫淋巴结同前，较大约15x6mm（IM24）
text_en: Non-contrast mediastinal CT demonstrates lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest measuring approximately 15x6 mm (IM24).

source_text: 纵隔5组淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Mediastinal group 5 lymph nodes unchanged from prior, follow-up

source_text: 左上肺微小结节同前（Im16）
text_en: The tiny nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged (Im16).

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结较前增多、增大，较大原约15*5mm（IMA22），现约24x16mm（IM21），双肺门新见肿大淋巴结，较大约22x15mm(IM25)，考虑转移
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes have increased in number and size compared to previous. The largest was approximately 15x5 mm (IMA22) and is now approximately 24x16 mm (IM21). New enlarged lymph nodes are seen in both hilar regions, with the largest approximately 22x15 mm (IM25). Consider metastasis.

source_text: 未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities

source_text: 纵隔散在小淋巴结同前相仿
text_en: Scattered small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，腋窝及锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, no enlarged lymph nodes seen in axillary or supraclavicular regions.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约12mm（IMA23）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest measuring approximately 12 mm (IMA23).

source_text: 右肺胸膜下点状钙化及索条结节灶大致同前（Im10、28、29），右肺下叶少许索条影
text_en: Right lung subpleural punctate calcifications and fibrotic nodular opacities are essentially unchanged from prior (Im10, 28, 29); minimal fibrotic bands in the right lower lobe.

source_text: 双肺内未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左前胸壁皮肤小结节同前（IM13）
text_en: Small skin nodule in the left anterior chest wall unchanged from prior (IM13).

source_text: 左锁骨上区浅淡小淋巴结大致同前，原约7x4mm（IMA5），现约6x5mm（IM4）
text_en: Left supraclavicular faint small lymph node largely unchanged, previously approximately 7x4 mm (IMA5), currently approximately 6x5 mm (IM4).

source_text: 后胸膜小结节大致同前（IM24）
text_en: Small posterior pleural nodule essentially unchanged (IM24)

source_text: 右肺钙化结节同前，右肺下叶新见小片絮状模糊影(图55)，考虑炎性病变，建议结合临床
text_en: Calcified nodule in the right lung is unchanged from prior; new small patchy hazy opacity in the right lower lobe (Figure 55), likely inflammatory. Correlation with clinical findings is recommended.

source_text: 左肺舌段可见一不规则稍高密度结节大致同前，约5x6mm（IM53）
text_en: Left lung lingular segment: an irregular slightly hyperdense nodule is present, essentially unchanged, approximately 5x6 mm (Image 53)

source_text: 纵隔7组及双肺门淋巴结部分较前增大，较大现约2.0x1.1cm（Se2 Im25），原为1.5x1cm（Im27），4R-5组数枚稍大淋巴结（Im23）
text_en: Lymph nodes at mediastinal station 7 and bilateral hilar partially increased in size compared to prior, largest now approximately 2.0x1.1 cm (Se2 Im25), previously 1.5x1 cm (Im27); several slightly enlarged lymph nodes at stations 4R and 5 (Im23).

source_text: 左肺上叶类圆形结节大致同前
text_en: Left upper lobe round nodule stable compared to prior

source_text: 未见新增
text_en: No new findings

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下微小结节同前（IM15），薄层呈高密度影
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural tiny nodule stable compared to prior (IM15), high-density on thin-section imaging

source_text: 双肺下叶多发结节同前
text_en: Multiple nodules in the bilateral lower lobes are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 余双肺未见新增结节灶或实变影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no newly increased nodule foci or consolidation shadows.

source_text: 双肺多发小结节较前增多、增大，较大约4mm（IM39）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs have increased in number and size compared to prior; the largest is approximately 4 mm (IM39).

source_text: 右侧叶间裂增厚，其上见少许小结节，较大约4mm（IM41），密切追查除外转移
text_en: The right interlobar fissure is thickened with a few small nodules, the largest measuring approximately 4 mm (IM41). Close follow-up is recommended to exclude metastasis.

source_text: 左肺下叶外基底段小结节灶同前，约3mm（IMA50）
text_en: The small nodule in the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IMA50).

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段4mm小结节同前（IM33）
text_en: A 4 mm small nodule in the lateral basal segment of the right lower lobe is stable (IM33).

source_text: 纵隔4、7组淋巴结同前，较大约14mm（IM22），密度较高，倾向良性
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes, stations 4 and 7, unchanged from prior, largest approximately 14 mm (IM22), higher density, suggestive of benign.

source_text: 纵隔内5组及7组淋巴结同前，较大约11x8mm（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 5 and 7 are unchanged from previous, with the largest measuring approximately 11x8 mm (IM19).

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结部分同前，较大仍约15x14mm（IM19）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is stable compared to prior, the largest still approximately 15x14 mm (IM19)

source_text: 双肺多发磨玻璃结节大致同前，较大仍约6mm（IM35），追查
text_en: Multiple ground-glass nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged; the largest remains approximately 6 mm (IM35); further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 纵隔2R组淋巴结较前缩小，原约19x7mm（IM12），现约14x4mm（IM9）
text_en: Mediastinal station 2R lymph nodes decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 19x7 mm (IM12), now approximately 14x4 mm (IM9).

source_text: 右肺上叶多发高密度结节同前，部分内含钙化，最大仍约11x9mm（IMA16），边缘毛糙，其内未见钙化，周边可见长索条影
text_en: Multiple high-density nodules in the right upper lobe are unchanged compared to prior; some contain calcification. The largest remains approximately 11x9 mm (IMA16), with irregular margins and no calcification within. Long linear bands are visible around it.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段片状不规则混合密度结节灶范围同前，约9x6mm（IM16），密度减淡
text_en: Patchy irregular mixed-density nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged in size, approximately 9 × 6 mm (IM16), with decreased density.

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺结节同前，约22x16mm（IM54），追查
text_en: Left adrenal nodule unchanged, approximately 22x16 mm (IM54), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 余双肺多发实性小结节同前，较大约3mm（IM27）
text_en: Multiple solid small nodules in the remainder of both lungs are unchanged; the largest measures approximately 3 mm (IM27).

source_text: 左前上纵隔肿物切除术后，局部条状软组织密度影较前缩小（IM24），强化不明确
text_en: Following resection of a left anterior superior mediastinal mass, the local linear soft tissue density is smaller than before (IM24), with indeterminate enhancement.

source_text: 双肺下叶基底段片絮状磨玻璃密度影减少，双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: The patchy and fluffy ground-glass opacity in the basal segments of both lower lobes has decreased. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 甲状腺左、右叶多发低密度结节同前
text_en: Multiple low-density nodules in the left and right thyroid lobes, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双下肺散在小结节数目同前、较前增大，左下肺较大结节原约11x6mm（IM45），现约13x9mm（IM46）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the bilateral lower lungs are unchanged in number; some are larger than prior. The larger nodule in the left lower lung measured approximately 11x6 mm (IM45) previously and now measures approximately 13x9 mm (IM46).

source_text: 右肺索条及钙化影同前，右肺下叶可见小结节同前，大小约2mm（IM41）
text_en: Linear opacities and calcifications in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior; a small nodule is seen in the right lower lobe, unchanged, measuring approximately 2 mm (IM41).

source_text: 左侧锁骨上、纵隔多发淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region and mediastinum are essentially unchanged compared to prior imaging.

source_text: 两肺斑片索条小结节影、多发肺大泡同前
text_en: Patchy, linear, and small nodular opacities in both lungs and multiple pulmonary bullae, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段近叶间裂处磨玻璃样结节同前，继续追查
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe near the interlobar fissure is unchanged compared to prior; continued follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺胸膜下小结节同前，约5mm（IM18）
text_en: Left lung subpleural small nodule unchanged from previous, approximately 5mm (IM18).

source_text: 原左肺舌叶微小结节本次检查未见明确显示，余双肺未见新增结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: The previously noted tiny nodule in the left lingular segment is not clearly visible on this examination; no new nodules or fluffy lesions are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 主肺动脉窗内不规则肿块伴大部分钙化同前，考虑良性
text_en: Irregular mass with predominantly calcified components in the aortopulmonary window is unchanged; benign etiology favored.

source_text: 双肺散在肺大泡同前，未见新增结节灶及斑片影
text_en: Scattered pulmonary bullae in both lungs are unchanged from prior. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 食道术后，吻合口壁未见异常新发结节影
text_en: Post esophageal surgery, no abnormal new nodular shadows seen in the anastomotic wall.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段类圆形小结节大致同前，约7x6mm（Im19）
text_en: Small, round nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is essentially unchanged, approximately 7x6 mm (Im19).

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段结节大致同前，约12mm（IM28），密度较前增高，建议结合临床考虑，继续追查
text_en: A nodule in the left upper lobe lingular segment is roughly similar to prior, approximately 12 mm (IM28), with increased density compared to prior. Recommendation: Correlate with clinical findings and continue follow-up.

source_text: 食管癌术后，吻合口右侧少量积气较前吸收、左下少量积液减少
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer, small amount of air on the right side of the anastomosis resolved compared to prior, small amount of left lower pleural effusion decreased.

source_text: 扫及双侧肾上腺见不规则软组织占位，右侧较大约57x34mm（IM58），左侧较大约16x10mm（IM55），考虑转移
text_en: Irregular soft tissue masses in the bilateral adrenal glands, right side largest approximately 57x34 mm (IM58), left side largest approximately 16x10 mm (IM55), suspicious for metastasis

source_text: 左肺下叶磨玻璃密度小结节显示较前清楚，大小同前，仍约5mm（IM27）
text_en: A ground-glass opacity small nodule in the left lower lobe is more clearly visible compared to previous, size similar to previous, still approximately 5mm (IM27).

source_text: 左肺多发模糊微小点灶同前（Im14），余肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Multiple hazy small dot foci in the left lung are similar to prior (Im14), and no new nodules in the remaining lung

source_text: 右肺下叶外侧基底段见类圆形磨玻璃密度小结节同前，边缘模糊，仍约5mm（IMA46，薄层IM102），未见实性成分，观察
text_en: A round ground-glass density small nodule is seen in the lateral basal segment of the right lower lobe, stable, with blurred margins, still measuring approximately 5 mm (IMA46, thin-section IM102), without solid components; observation recommended.

source_text: 两肺散在含钙化结节及结节灶同前
text_en: The scattered calcified nodules and nodular foci in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右肺下叶基底段胸膜下见点状钙化灶，双肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent; punctate calcified foci are seen in the basal segment of the right lower lobe; no new nodules are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 双侧气管食管沟及右肺门增大淋巴结较前缩小，较大原约32x26mm，现约29x23mm（IM9），与气管壁及食管壁分界不清，气管壁受压
text_en: Enlarged lymph nodes in the bilateral tracheoesophageal grooves and right hilum are smaller than prior. The largest previously measured 32x26 mm and now measures 29x23 mm (IM9). The nodes remain inseparable from the tracheal and esophageal walls, with tracheal compression.

source_text: 双肺散在多发小结节影数目、大小及形态均较前相仿，小于5mm（Im11、30、44等），倾向良性，追查
text_en: Number, size, and morphology of scattered multiple small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior, all less than 5 mm (Im11, 30, 44, etc.), likely benign; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 前纵隔结节同前，约11x6mm（IM21），纵隔4组淋巴结，约19x12mm（IM22），双侧肺门、腋窝、锁骨上平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Nodule in the anterior mediastinum is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 11x6 mm (IM21); lymph node at station 4 of the mediastinum measures approximately 19x12 mm (IM22). No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the bilateral hila, axillae, or supraclavicular regions on non-contrast imaging.

source_text: 纵隔平扫多发淋巴结同前，较大约12*4mm（IMA19）
text_en: Mediastinal CT without contrast shows multiple lymph nodes unchanged, largest approximately 12x4mm (IMA19).

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段肿块大致同前，约20*14mm（IM37），病灶周围斑片索条影同前
text_en: Left lower lobe basal segment mass essentially unchanged from previous, measuring approximately 20x14 mm (IM37), with patchy and linear opacities around the lesion unchanged.

source_text: 余双肺散在多发结节影大致同前（Im13、38、40、45），追查
text_en: Residual scattered multiple nodules in both lungs are approximately unchanged (Im13, 38, 40, 45); follow-up recommended

source_text: 甲状腺左叶低密度结节同前，结合超声检查
text_en: Left thyroid lobe low-density nodule stable compared to prior; correlate with ultrasound examination.

source_text: 双肺见少许索条影，右上肺外周肺大泡同前，余双肺未见明确新发结节
text_en: A few linear opacities are seen in both lungs; a peripheral bulla in the right upper lobe is unchanged from prior; no new nodules are identified in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 左肺索条影同前，两肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Left lung linear opacities unchanged from prior, no new nodules or consolidation in both lungs

source_text: 左上叶模糊小结节及磨玻璃结节同前，现仍约9x5mm（IM34），左下肺少许片状影及囊状透亮区同前
text_en: The indistinct small nodule and ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe are unchanged compared to prior, currently measuring approximately 9x5 mm (IM34). The minor patchy opacities and cystic lucencies in the left lower lung are also unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结同前，约16x8mm（IM30），建议追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes unchanged from prior, approximately 16x8 mm (IM30). Recommend follow-up investigation.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门多发小淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions roughly unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下多个微结节影同前（IM16、19），约2-4mm
text_en: Multiple tiny nodular opacities in the right lung subpleural region are unchanged (IM16, 19), measuring approximately 2–4 mm.

source_text: 食管术后，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Post-esophagectomy, no clear evidence of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 余诸骨未见明显骨质破坏征象
text_en: The remaining bones show no obvious signs of osseous destruction.

source_text: 双肺浅淡密度小结节同前（IM27、44、46、52）
text_en: Faint density small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM27, 44, 46, 52).

source_text: 两肺微小结节影同前（IMA25、30、49）
text_en: The tiny nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged (IMA25, 30, 49).

source_text: 左肺小结节影同前（Im34）
text_en: Left lung small nodule unchanged (IM34)

source_text: 胸骨致密结节同前
text_en: Dense nodule in the sternum unchanged from previous

source_text: 其外侧圆形结节较前相仿，约8mm（IM21）
text_en: The round nodule lateral to it is similar to prior, measuring approximately 8 mm (IM21).

source_text: 右肺门及4R组淋巴结同前，右肺门较大者仍约15x12mm（Im26），密度较高
text_en: Lymph nodes in the right hilar region and 4R station are stable compared to prior; the largest in the right hilum remains approximately 15x12 mm (Im26) with relatively high density.

source_text: 右肺上叶癌复查，病灶范围较前缩小，追查
text_en: Follow-up of right upper lobe carcinoma; lesion extent is smaller than prior, further evaluation warranted.

source_text: T10椎体骨质轻度不均匀增高同前，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: Mildly and unevenly increased bone density in the T10 vertebral body is unchanged; no osseous destruction is seen in the remainder of the imaged bones.

source_text: 左锁骨上、右肺门淋巴结较前增大，如右肺门淋巴结较大原约16x8mm，现约24x12mm（IM27），转移待排，结合临床或密切随访追查
text_en: Left supraclavicular and right hilar lymph nodes enlarged compared to prior; the largest right hilar lymph node increased from approximately 16x8 mm to approximately 24x12 mm (IM27), metastasis cannot be excluded; clinical correlation or close follow-up recommended.

source_text: 扫及左肱骨骨质破坏，结合临床病史
text_en: On imaging, bone destruction is seen in the left humerus; correlate with clinical history.

source_text: 食道胸中下段管壁不均匀增厚较前减轻，较厚部位原约17mm，现约12mm（IM31）
text_en: Wall thickening of the mid-to-lower thoracic esophagus is reduced compared to prior, with the thickest portion decreasing from approximately 17 mm to 12 mm (IM31).

source_text: 右肺上叶、中叶磨玻璃密度结节影同前（IMA18、35），较大约6mm，右肺索条影同前
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodules in the right upper and middle lobes unchanged (IMA18, 35), largest approximately 6 mm; linear opacities in the right lung unchanged.

source_text: 双肺散在多发小结节数量及大小同前，边缘不规则，较大约5mm（IM36）
text_en: Number and size of scattered multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, with irregular margins, the largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM36).

source_text: 左肺下叶结节较前增大，原约5mm，现约11x10mm（IM31），远端仍见前基底段条片影
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is enlarged compared to prior, from approximately 5 mm to 11x10 mm (IM31), and linear opacities in the basal segment distally remain unchanged.

source_text: 右肺多发小结节同前，大部分呈磨玻璃密度，较大约10x7mm（IM30），结节边缘见小索条影与胸膜相连
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right lung are unchanged; most exhibit ground-glass attenuation, with the largest measuring approximately 10x7 mm (IM30); fine linear opacities connecting the nodule margins to the pleura are seen.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右肺新见小结节灶（IM30），转移
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. A new small nodule is seen in the right lung (IM30), consistent with metastasis.

source_text: 双肺散在小结节影同前（IM29、35、39），较大者仍约6x4mm（IM39），考虑良性
text_en: Scattered small nodule shadows in both lungs are unchanged (IM29, 35, 39), largest still about 6x4 mm (IM39), consider benign.

source_text: 右叶间胸膜约5mm结节同前（IM44）
text_en: Approximately 5 mm nodule along the right interlobar pleura, stable compared to prior (IM44).

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R、7组及双肺门多发肿大淋巴结部分较前缩小，较大原约26x11mm（IM32），现约24x8mm（IM31），双锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R, 4R, 7, and bilateral hilar lymph nodes are partially decreased compared to previous; the largest was previously approximately 26 x 11 mm (IM32) and is now approximately 24 x 8 mm (IM31). No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the bilateral supraclavicular regions or bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 右肺上叶类结节影缩小，原约13x10mm（IM26），现约9x5mm（IM27）
text_en: The nodular opacity in the right upper lobe has decreased in size, previously approximately 13x10 mm (IM26), now approximately 9x5 mm (IM27).

source_text: 双肺另可见不规则小结节同前相仿（IM18、26、60）
text_en: Additional irregular small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior (IM18, 26, 60).

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前（IM37），右肺下叶后基底段斑片索条影及右肺胸膜下小钙化同前
text_en: Small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM37); patchy and linear opacities in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe and small subpleural calcification in the right lung are unchanged.

source_text: 甲状腺多发结节、胆囊结石同前
text_en: Multiple thyroid nodules and gallstones stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺少许肺组织不张，右侧纵隔旁不规则索条影较前减少，左肺未见异常密度区及结节灶
text_en: There is a small amount of atelectasis in the right lung. The irregular linear opacities adjacent to the right mediastinum have decreased compared to prior. No abnormal densities or nodules are seen in the left lung.

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，如7组淋巴结现仍约8x6mm（IM31）
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, such as station 7 lymph node currently still approximately 8x6 mm (IM31).

source_text: 左上叶类圆形小结节同前，仍约5mm（IM28）
text_en: The round-shaped small nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, still measuring approximately 5 mm (IM28).

source_text: 其余双肺野未见新发结节或斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lung fields.

source_text: 双肺下叶见多个结节同前，较大约6mm（IM23）
text_en: Multiple nodules in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior, largest approximately 6 mm (IM23).

source_text: 右肺小斑片索条影、左肺点状结节灶同前（IM31、38、46）
text_en: Small patchy linear opacities in the right lung and punctate nodules in the left lung are stable compared to prior (IM31, 38, 46).

source_text: 余肺内未见新增结节
text_en: No new nodules are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 双肺下叶及右肺斜裂胸膜下结节同前（IM41、43、45）
text_en: Nodules subpleural in the lower lobes bilaterally and along the oblique fissure of the right lung are unchanged compared to prior (IM41, 43, 45).

source_text: 左肺下叶外基底段小结节同前，约5mm（Im49）
text_en: The small nodule in the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (Im49).

source_text: 纵隔2R组淋巴结较前缩小，现约9*6mm(图10)，原约11mm（Im12）
text_en: Mediastinal station 2R lymph nodes decreased in size compared to prior, now approximately 9*6 mm (Figure 10), previously approximately 11 mm (Im12).

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段多发小结节、索条影同前，右肺散在微小结节影同前
text_en: Multiple small nodules and linear opacities in the outer basal segment of the right lower lobe are unchanged from prior; scattered tiny nodules in the right lung are also stable.

source_text: 左肺胸膜下微结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: Left lung subpleural tiny nodules unchanged from previous, suggestive of benign.

source_text: 左肺未见新增结节及实变
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation in the left lung.

source_text: 右肺术后改变，未见新发占位
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lung; no new space-occupying lesions are seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶、左肺结节同前
text_en: Nodules in the right upper lobe and left lung are unchanged.

source_text: 右叶间胸膜处结节略缩小，原约7x5mm（IM31），现约5x4mm（IM29）
text_en: The nodule at the right interlobar pleura is slightly smaller, previously approximately 7x5 mm (IM31), now approximately 5x4 mm (IM29).

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段胸膜下稍高密度结节灶，边缘光滑，较前相仿，仍约4mm（IM45）
text_en: A slightly increased density subpleural nodule with smooth margins in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is similar to previous, still approximately 4 mm (IM45).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段肺癌疗后较前略缩小
text_en: Post-treatment change in the lesion in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe is slightly smaller than prior.

source_text: 双肺上叶尖段微小结节同前，约1-2mm（薄层IM37、40等），边缘清晰
text_en: Micronodules in the apical segments of the upper lobes of both lungs are stable compared to prior, approximately 1-2 mm (thin-slice IM37, 40, etc.), with well-defined margins.

source_text: 前纵隔内结节较前相仿，较大仍约8mm（IM26）
text_en: Nodule within the anterior mediastinum is similar to prior, the largest still approximately 8 mm (IM26).

source_text: 右肺中叶术后改变同前，胸部未见复发转移征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right middle lobe are unchanged; no evidence of recurrence or metastasis in the chest.

source_text: 右侧水平裂及右肺上叶小结节同前（IM19、31），双下肺少许索条影并膈胸膜轻度增厚同前，肺内未见新生结节或片絮影
text_en: Small nodules along the right horizontal fissure and in the right upper lobe are stable (IM19, 31). Minimal linear opacities in both lower lungs with mild diaphragmatic pleural thickening remain unchanged. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔4-8组可见多发淋巴结同前，较大约17x12mm（IM22），原平扫密度较高
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes visible at stations 4-8 unchanged from previous, largest approximately 17x12 mm (IM22), previously higher density on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 双肺多发小结节同前，倾向良性，追查
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior; benign etiology favored; follow-up recommended.

source_text: L1椎体水平椎管内右侧钙化结节灶同前（IM56），胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Calcified nodule in the right side of the spinal canal at the L1 vertebral level is unchanged (IM56); no osseous destruction is seen in the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 左肺下叶浅淡斑片索条影同前，小结节灶同前，约5mm（Im53）
text_en: Left lower lobe faint patchy and streaky opacities unchanged from previous, small nodule unchanged from previous, approximately 5 mm (Im53)

source_text: 右前上纵隔切除术后，前上纵隔小结节同前
text_en: Following resection of the right anterior superior mediastinum, the small nodule in the anterior superior mediastinum is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左锁骨上区淋巴结较前相仿，约为9*5mm（IM5）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node similar to prior, approximately 9 x 5 mm (IM5)

source_text: 左肺下叶术后改变，左肺类结节影较前相仿
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left lower lobe; nodular-like shadow in the left lung similar to previous.

source_text: 两肺多发<5mm小结节，现较前缩小或浅淡模糊（IM22、24、32、40）
text_en: Multiple <5 mm nodules in both lungs are now smaller or fainter and more indistinct (IM22, 24, 32, 40) than prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶新见一枚结节，大小约5x4mm（IMA39），考虑转移
text_en: A new nodule is seen in the right lower lobe, measuring approximately 5x4 mm (IMA39); metastasis is considered.

source_text: 左肺上叶微结节部分同前，部分显示不清
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule partially unchanged from prior, partially indistinct

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影同前，右肺下叶新见小结节，约8mm（IM36），转移
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged; a new small nodule is seen in the right lower lobe, approximately 8 mm (IM36), suggestive of metastasis.

source_text: 左侧胸膜结节增大，原约5mm，现约9mm（IM36)，转移待排，微量积液同前
text_en: Left pleural nodule has increased in size, previously approximately 5 mm, now approximately 9 mm (IM36); metastasis cannot be excluded; trace effusion unchanged.

source_text: 双肺胸膜下小结节较前明显增多，转移可能大
text_en: Subpleural small nodules in both lungs have significantly increased in number compared to prior, raising concern for metastasis.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下不规则类结节灶（IM44，57）同前相仿
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural irregular nodular lesion (IM44, 57) unchanged from prior

source_text: 未见异常新发
text_en: No new abnormal findings

source_text: 双肺未见新增结节
text_en: No new nodules seen in both lungs.

source_text: 纵隔多个淋巴结，部分增大，较大者原约18x12mm(图24)，现约21x13mm（IM24）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes, some enlarged, the largest previously approximately 18x12 mm (Figure 24), currently approximately 21x13 mm (IM24)

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，左肺上叶前段见不规则结节同前，边缘毛糙约6x5mm（IM20）
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. An irregular nodule is seen in the left upper lobe anterior segment, stable, with irregular margins, measuring approximately 6x5 mm (IM20).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节影同前相仿，原约17*17mm，现约17x16mm（IMA79）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior, previously approximately 17x17 mm, now approximately 17x16 mm (IMA79)

source_text: 右肺上叶前段胸膜下可疑模糊磨玻璃样小结节同前（IM23）
text_en: A suspicious, ill-defined small ground-glass opacity nodule subpleurally in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe remains unchanged (IM23).

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节同前，现仍约10x8mm(IM13)
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged, currently still approximately 10x8 mm (IM13).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，右肺上叶前段见椭圆形结节大小同前，仍约28*21mm（IM27）
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, an oval nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe is stable in size, still approximately 28x21 mm (IM27).

source_text: 多发转移淋巴结较前缩小
text_en: Multiple metastatic lymph nodes are smaller compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段模糊结节同前(图28)，建议追查
text_en: Left lower lobe dorsal segment ill-defined nodule unchanged from prior (Figure 28). Recommend follow-up.

source_text: 左肺小结节同前，较大约4mm（IM12）
text_en: Left lung small nodule unchanged, the larger approximately 4 mm (IM12)

source_text: 双肺浅淡小结节同前
text_en: Faint small nodules in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，支气管断端结节影，复发
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, nodule at bronchial stump; recurrence.

source_text: 纵隔4R区片状软组织密度较前缩小，双侧锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Patchy soft tissue density in mediastinal station 4R is reduced compared to previous; no enlarged lymph nodes seen in bilateral supraclavicular and bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 纵隔隆突下结节增大融合，与左肺支气管残端结节分界不清，原大者约20x13mm，现较大层面约64x37mm（Im29），考虑转移
text_en: Nodule in subcarinal mediastinum enlarged and fused, with ill-defined border to left lung bronchial stump nodule, previously approximately 20x13 mm, now approximately 64x37 mm on largest slice (Image 29), suggestive of metastasis

source_text: 右肺下叶近肺门结节较前略缩小，现约7x5mm（IM29），原约10x7mm
text_en: The nodule near the hilum of the right lower lobe is slightly smaller than prior, now approximately 7 x 5 mm (IM29), previously about 10 x 7 mm.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段小结节同前，约5mm（IM58）
text_en: Left lung lower lobe posterior basal segment small nodule unchanged from prior, approximately 5 mm (IM58)

source_text: 双肺未见新发结节及异常密度影
text_en: No new nodules or abnormal density shadows seen in both lungs.

source_text: 缝合线旁小结节较前相仿，原约为6mm（IM45），现约5mm（IM41）
text_en: Small nodule adjacent to suture line similar to prior, previously approximately 6 mm (IM45), now approximately 5 mm (IM41).

source_text: 右肺下叶切除、纵隔淋巴结清扫术后改变同前
text_en: Postoperative changes following right lower lobectomy and mediastinal lymph node dissection are unchanged.

source_text: 上纵隔稍大淋巴结同前，约11x10mm（IM17）
text_en: Slightly enlarged lymph nodes in the upper mediastinum unchanged, approximately 11x10 mm (IM17)

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，短径小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, short axis less than 10 mm.

source_text: 纵隔左移同前，纵隔、肺门、腋窝及锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Leftward shift of the mediastinum unchanged, no enlarged lymph nodes in the mediastinum, hila, axillae, or supraclavicular regions.

source_text: 纵隔4R组高密度淋巴结同前，约7x6mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R high-density lymph node unchanged from prior, approximately 7x6 mm (IM20).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段微小结节同前（IM14、22）
text_en: Tiny nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable (IM14, 22)

source_text: 左肺小结节部分较前增大，原约3mm（IM17），现约7mm（IM19），部分同前
text_en: Left lung small nodule partially increased in size (from approximately 3mm on IM17 to approximately 7mm on IM19), partially stable

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段新见结节灶，约6mm（IM27），考虑转移
text_en: Newly observed nodule in the left upper lobe lingular segment, approximately 6 mm (IM27), suspicious for metastasis

source_text: 右肺中叶结节较前稍增大，密切追查
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe is slightly larger than before; close follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 未见明显新发
text_en: No obvious new lesions

source_text: 左锁骨上区浅淡小淋巴结同前
text_en: Left supraclavicular faint small lymph node unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段不规则肿块同前，范围仍约25x17mm（IM24），其内仍见支气管气相
text_en: In the anterior segment of the left upper lobe, an irregular mass is stable compared to previous, with a size still approximately 25x17 mm (IM24), and an air bronchogram is still present within it.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结、扫及上腹部淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: The mediastinal lymph nodes and the scanned upper abdominal lymph nodes are unchanged; further evaluation is recommended

source_text: 胸下段食管壁环周增厚减轻，原较厚约16mm，现较厚处约12mm（IMA41），管腔狭窄同前
text_en: Circumferential thickening of esophageal wall in lower thoracic segment reduced; previous thickest approximately 16mm, current thickest approximately 12mm (IMA41); luminal narrowing unchanged from prior.

source_text: 胸部CT平扫所见同前，未见新生占位
text_en: Findings on chest CT scan unchanged from prior. No new mass lesions seen.

source_text: 右肺小结节影较前缩小，追查
text_en: Right lung small nodules are smaller than prior; further investigation recommended.

source_text: 双侧肺内见多发小结节同前（Im15、18、28、37、40、45），较大仍约4mm（Im40）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the bilateral lungs are unchanged (Im15, 18, 28, 37, 40, 45); the largest remains approximately 4 mm (Im40).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no definite findings of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 扫及右肾上腺一低密度结节同前，约18x13mm（IM62），密度较低，考虑腺瘤
text_en: On scan, right adrenal low-density nodule unchanged from prior, approximately 18x13 mm (IM62), low density, favoring adenoma.

source_text: 左肺下叶及残余右肺微小结节同前，约3mm（IM30）
text_en: Tiny nodules in the left lower lobe and residual right lung unchanged from previous, approximately 3mm (IM30)

source_text: 双肺见多发小结节影同前，较大约3mm（IM23）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior, the largest measuring approximately 3 mm (IM23).

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节较前略增大，原约4mm（IM22），现约6mm（IM23）
text_en: Right upper lobe small nodule slightly increased in size, previously approximately 4 mm (IM22), now approximately 6 mm (IM23)

source_text: 两肺微小结节灶同前，较大约3mm（IM31）
text_en: The tiny nodular foci in both lungs are unchanged; the largest is approximately 3 mm (IM31).

source_text: 右侧第6肋骨局部骨折骨痂形成中（Im23），余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Callus formation in progress at the site of right 6th rib fracture (Im23). No evidence of osseous destruction in the other bones of the thorax.

source_text: 原左肺结节基本消失，右肺上叶索条及钙化点同前相仿，双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: The previously noted nodule in the left lung has essentially disappeared; the linear strands and calcified foci in the right upper lobe are similar to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左侧斜裂胸膜小结节同前，约3mm（IM40），余双侧胸膜光滑，未见胸水征象
text_en: Small nodule along the left major fissure pleura is unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IM40); otherwise, bilateral pleura are smooth, and no signs of pleural effusion are seen.

source_text: 两肺索条、结节灶大致同前，较大约6*3mm（IMA33）
text_en: The linear opacities and nodular lesions in both lungs are approximately unchanged; the largest is about 6x3 mm (IMA33).

source_text: 左肺下叶见模糊结节同前，直径约5mm（IM36）
text_en: Left lower lobe indistinct nodule unchanged from previous, approximately 5 mm in diameter (IM36)

source_text: 双肺小结节较前相仿，右肺上叶模糊结节约5x3mm（Im16）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are similar to prior, a nodule in the right upper lobe measures approximately 5x3 mm (Im16)

source_text: 左肺上叶、右肺下叶微小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Tiny nodules in the left upper lobe and right lower lobe are stable; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶癌疗后，较前实性成分略增多
text_en: Post-treatment for left lower lobe lung cancer, the solid component is slightly increased compared to previous.

source_text: 纵隔、左肺门、左锁骨上见多发增大淋巴结部分同前，如纵隔较大约22x16mm（IM26），部分缩小，如左锁骨上淋巴结原约19x10mm（IM5），现约15x9mm(IM6)
text_en: Mediastinal, left hilar, and left supraclavicular multiple enlarged lymph nodes: some unchanged from prior, e.g., mediastinal lymph node measuring approximately 22x16 mm (IM26); some reduced, e.g., left supraclavicular lymph node previously measuring approximately 19x10 mm (IM5), now approximately 15x9 mm (IM6).

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段软组织结节密度较前明显变浅且较前缩小，原约12x9mm（IM31），现约9x6mm（IM33）
text_en: The soft tissue density of the nodule in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe is significantly less dense and smaller compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 12x9 mm (IM31), now approximately 9x6 mm (IM33).

source_text: 左下肺胸膜下小结节同前（IM41、42）
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged (IM41, 42).

source_text: 右肺下叶多发转移结节大致同前，约5*5mm、4*4mm、15*13mm（IMA43、49、54），
text_en: Multiple metastatic nodules in the right lower lobe are approximately unchanged, measuring about 5×5 mm, 4×4 mm, and 15×13 mm (IMA43, 49, 54).

source_text: 扫及双肾上腺结节同前相仿，分别约18x16mm（IM57右侧）、11x11mm（IM56左侧），追查
text_en: CT shows bilateral adrenal nodules similar to prior, measuring approximately 18x16 mm (IM57, right) and 11x11 mm (IM56, left), for follow-up.

source_text: 右上纵隔气管食管沟淋巴结较前增大，原约20x17mm（IM9），现约26x20mm（IM7），考虑转移，追查
text_en: Lymph node in the right upper mediastinal tracheoesophageal groove has increased in size compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 20x17 mm (IM9), now approximately 26x20 mm (IM7); metastasis is considered, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段胸膜下不规则结节灶较前稍增大，原约20x18mm，现约23x19mm（IM17），邻近胸膜凹陷同前
text_en: The irregular subpleural nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe is slightly increased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 20x18 mm, now approximately 23x19 mm (IM17), with adjacent pleural indentation unchanged.

source_text: 左下肺少许索条影同前，余肺野未见新增病灶
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the left lower lobe are unchanged; no new lesions are seen in the remainder of the lung fields.

source_text: 双侧肱骨头、右侧第11肋高密度灶同前，余扫及胸部诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: High-density foci in the bilateral humeral heads and the right 11th rib are unchanged; no osseous destruction is seen in the remainder of the scanned thoracic bones.

source_text: 纵隔、左肺门、左锁骨上见多发增大淋巴结同前，如纵隔较大约22x16mm（IM25）
text_en: Mediastinal, left hilar, and left supraclavicular multiple enlarged lymph nodes are unchanged from prior, e.g., mediastinal lymph node measuring approximately 22x16 mm (IM25).

source_text: 甲状腺左叶低密度结节灶同前
text_en: Left thyroid lobe low-density nodule stable compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺结节同前
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary nodules are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 扫及肝脏低密度结节同前
text_en: On scan, a low-density nodule in the liver is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下小结节较前相仿（IM15）
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior (IM15).

source_text: 右肺中叶见一混杂磨玻璃密度结节同前，边界模糊不清，范围仍约1.6x1.2cm（Im36），其内少许实性密度
text_en: A mixed ground-glass density nodule is seen in the right middle lobe, unchanged from prior, with ill-defined margins, measuring approximately 1.6x1.2 cm (Im36). It contains a small amount of solid density within.

source_text: 纵隔5、6组淋巴结同前，较大仍约14x6mm（IM16）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 5 and 6 are the same as before, larger, still approximately 14x6 mm (IM16).

source_text: 右肺下叶见浅淡模糊小结节影同前（IMA54），大小约4mm
text_en: A faint, indistinct small nodular opacity in the right lower lobe is stable (IMA54), measuring approximately 4 mm.

source_text: 双肺未见新增结节和斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶新见小片絮影，边界不清，余肺未见新见结节影
text_en: Newly seen patchy opacities in the right upper lobe, ill-defined in border; no new nodules seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，左肺上叶前段小团片灶同前相仿，原约13x12mm，现约13x11mm（IM16），边缘毛糙
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. The small patchy opacity in the left upper lobe anterior segment is similar to prior, previously measuring approximately 13x12 mm, now approximately 13x11 mm (IM16), with irregular margins.

source_text: 右肺中叶肿物较前略增大，现约33x28mm（IMA26），原约30x24mm（IMA32），右肺膨胀不全较前明显
text_en: The right middle lobe mass is slightly larger than prior, currently measuring approximately 33 x 28 mm (IMA26), previously about 30 x 24 mm (IMA32). Right lung atelectasis is significantly more pronounced than prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶贴胸膜处小结节同前，约4x3mm（IMA40）
text_en: Small nodule adjacent to the pleura in the right middle lobe, unchanged, measuring approximately 4x3 mm (IMA40)

source_text: 纵隔数枚小淋巴结同前，较大约10x6mm（IM31）
text_en: Several small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest approximately 10x6 mm (IM31).

source_text: 左乳和左肺上叶术后改变，胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left breast and left upper lobe; no new space-occupying lesions are seen in the chest.

source_text: 右下肺模糊小结节同前
text_en: The indistinct small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶浅淡小结节同前（IM33）
text_en: The faint small nodule in the right lower lobe is stable (IM33).

source_text: 右上肺近水平裂一小灶边界较前清楚，约3mm（IM31），追查，余双肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Small focus near the horizontal fissure in the right upper lobe has clearer margins than prior, approximately 3 mm (IM31); follow-up recommended. No new nodules or consolidation in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段磨玻璃结节灶同前，约9*6mm（IMA45），建议追查
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 9 x 6 mm (IMA45), recommend follow-up.

source_text: 双肺下叶浅淡密度小结节同前（IM44、45）
text_en: Faint density small nodules in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior (IM44, 45).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段混杂磨玻璃密度结节此次较前缩小且与上方小结节重叠，现磨玻璃灶约6x5mm（IM31） ，原约12x9mm（IM29），实性小结节同前，约4mm（IM29）
text_en: The mixed ground-glass density nodule in the right lower lobe dorsal segment is smaller than before and now overlaps with the superior small nodule; the current ground-glass component measures approximately 6x5 mm (IM31), previously approximately 12x9 mm (IM29); the solid small nodule remains unchanged, approximately 4 mm (IM29).

source_text: 余肺内结节同前
text_en: The remaining pulmonary nodules are unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段磨玻璃密度结节同前，仍约10x8mm（IM14）
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment ground-glass opacity nodule unchanged, still approximately 10x8 mm (IM14).

source_text: 右肺散在斑片索条影同前，右肺结节影较前浅淡，较大原约10x4mm（IM37），现仅可见稍高密度斑片影（IM37），追查
text_en: Scattered patchy linear opacities in the right lung are stable compared to prior; the right lung nodule is less prominent than before, previously measuring approximately 10 x 4 mm (IM37), now only a slightly increased density patchy opacity is visible (IM37); further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 胸11椎体致密小结节同前
text_en: Dense small nodule in T11 vertebra unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右侧胸膜结节样增厚同前（IM54），左侧胸膜光滑，双侧未见胸水征象
text_en: The nodular thickening of the right pleura is unchanged from prior (IM54). The left pleura is smooth. No pleural effusion is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 胸5、12局限性骨岛同前，胸骨见低密度骨质破坏区伴骨皮质欠连续，局部见骨痂形成
text_en: Localized bone islands in T5 and T12 vertebral bodies unchanged; lytic bone destruction area with incomplete cortical continuity and local callus formation in sternum.

source_text: 纵隔4组淋巴结较前缩小，倾向转移
text_en: Mediastinal station 4 lymph nodes are decreased in size compared to previous, suggestive of metastasis

source_text: 右上肺术后，双肺结节大致同前，追查
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lung; nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 纵隔2、4、5组小淋巴结同前，较大约12x6mm（IM19）、双肺门、锁骨上及腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Small lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2, 4, 5 unchanged from prior, largest approximately 12x6 mm (IM19); no enlarged lymph nodes in bilateral hilar, supraclavicular, or axillary regions

source_text: 纵隔5组淋巴结较前增大、模糊，现约21*17mm(图21)，原约14*10mm(图)，建议追查
text_en: Mediastinal group 5 lymph nodes increased in size and indistinct compared to prior, currently approximately 21x17 mm (Image 21), previously approximately 14x10 mm (Image), recommend follow-up

source_text: 右肺中叶切除术后改变同前，胸部CT平扫未见新生占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right middle lobe are unchanged. No new space-occupying lesions are seen on non-contrast chest CT.

source_text: 双肺微小结节及点状钙化同前，较大约4mm（IM19）
text_en: Tiny nodules and punctate calcifications in both lungs are stable, the largest measuring approximately 4 mm (IM19).

source_text: 右肺上叶索条伴类结节影同前(IM15)
text_en: The linear opacity with nodular appearance in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior (IM15).

source_text: 左肺下叶索条影及结节灶同前
text_en: Left lower lobe fibrotic streak and nodule unchanged

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜结节样增厚同前
text_en: The nodular thickening along the right interlobar pleura is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺小结节影同前
text_en: Right lung small nodule shadow unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔及右侧肺门淋巴结平扫显示同前，性质待定
text_en: Lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right hilar region on non-contrast scan are unchanged from previous, with indeterminate characteristics.

source_text: 左腋窝多发淋巴结较前增大，原约6x4mm者，现约13x10mm（IM14）
text_en: Left axillary multiple lymph nodes enlarged compared to previous, with one previously approximately 6x4 mm, currently approximately 13x10 mm (image 14).

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段结节范围同前相仿，仍约23x20mm（IM11），但空洞较前增大，实性成分减少
text_en: The extent of the nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is similar to prior, still measuring approximately 23x20 mm (IM11); however, the cavity has increased in size compared to prior, and the solid component has decreased.

source_text: 纵隔4、5、7、8组见散在高密度小淋巴结同前
text_en: Scattered small high-density lymph nodes are seen at mediastinal stations 4, 5, 7, and 8, unchanged from previous.

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，肺门、锁骨上及腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, no enlarged lymph nodes seen in hilar, supraclavicular, and axillary regions.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺见低密度结节大致同前，仍约27x20mm（IM9）
text_en: A low-density nodule in the thyroid is largely unchanged from prior, remaining approximately 27 x 20 mm (IM9).

source_text: 右侧胸腔胃，其右侧壁及左侧壁脂肪间隙内各新见一软组织结节，约26x13mm、13x13mm（IM51、50），边缘模糊，转移可能，密切追查
text_en: Right pleural effusion with gastric tube in the right hemithorax. A new soft tissue nodule is seen within the fat space along the right and left walls of the gastric tube, measuring approximately 26x13 mm and 13x13 mm (IM51, 50), respectively, with indistinct margins. Metastasis is possible; close follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶原2mm微结节同前（IMA13），右肺尖少许索条影同前
text_en: The 2 mm micro-nodule in the right upper lobe remains unchanged (IMA13); the minimal linear opacities at the right lung apex remain unchanged.

source_text: 左锁骨上淋巴结同前（IM7）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph nodes unchanged (IM7).

source_text: 右肺点状结节灶同前
text_en: Punctate nodular focus in the right lung is unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶3mm圆形小结节同前（IM36），追查
text_en: 3mm round small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (IM36), follow-up.

source_text: 余肺未见新发结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: No new nodules or fluffy opacities are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 纵隔及双肺门多发稍大淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple slightly enlarged lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions unchanged from previous

source_text: 右肺微小结节同前相仿，观察
text_en: Right lung tiny nodules similar to prior; observation advised

source_text: 右肺胸膜下小结节同前，建议追查
text_en: Subpleural small nodule in the right lung is unchanged from prior; follow-up recommended

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节较前相仿，仍约3mm（IM17）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior, still approximately 3 mm (IM17).

source_text: 右肺小结节同前，较大约6mm（IMA29），内见点状钙化同前
text_en: Right lung small nodule unchanged; largest approximately 6 mm (IMA29), punctate calcification within, unchanged.

source_text: 甲状腺左叶圆形低密度结节同前，大小约33x36mm（IM7),内部可疑壁结节
text_en: Thyroid left lobe round low-density nodule same as prior, size approximately 33x36 mm (IM7), with suspicious mural nodule internally.

source_text: 右肺微结节灶同前，左肺上叶胸膜下小结节同前，追查
text_en: Right lung micro-nodular focus unchanged; left upper lobe subpleural small nodule unchanged; follow-up recommended

source_text: 纵隔4、7组淋巴结区少许软组织密度影较前减少，余纵隔内及腋窝、锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal stations 4 and 7 lymph node regions show slight reduction in soft tissue density opacities compared to prior; remaining mediastinal, axillary, and supraclavicular regions show no enlarged lymph nodes

source_text: 右侧锁骨上区淋巴结同前
text_en: The lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下小结节同前（IM41），小于5mm
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right middle lobe is stable (IM41), less than 5 mm.

source_text: 右后肋胸膜结节状增厚较前增大，原约32x17mm，现约41x25mm（IM41)，邻近胸膜线样及结节状增厚
text_en: Nodular thickening of the right posterior rib pleura has increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 32 x 17 mm, now approximately 41 x 25 mm (IM41), with adjacent pleural linear and nodular thickening.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结同前，约13*10mm（IM23）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are stable, measuring approximately 13x10 mm (IM23).

source_text: 纵隔5组散在小淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal station 5 scattered small lymph nodes unchanged from previous.

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，随诊
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, follow-up

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下区见微小结节同前，约3mm（IM8）
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural region, tiny nodule similar to previous, approximately 3 mm (IM8).

source_text: 右侧锁骨上、纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约10mm（IM9）
text_en: The right supraclavicular and mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged from prior, with the largest measuring approximately 10 mm (IM9).

source_text: 右肺下叶结节较前相仿，复查
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is similar to prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节影同前，约6mm（IM40）
text_en: The small nodule in the right middle lobe is stable, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM40).

source_text: 右肺中叶见小结节同前（IM30）
text_en: A small nodule is seen in the right middle lobe, unchanged from prior (IM30).

source_text: 扫及双肾上腺结节同前相仿，建议腹部CT检查
text_en: CT shows bilateral adrenal nodules similar to prior, with recommendation for abdominal CT examination.

source_text: 左肺上叶结节同前，约5x4mm（IM32）
text_en: Left upper lobe nodule unchanged, approximately 5x4 mm (Image 32).

source_text: 右叶间胸膜处结节略增大，原约5x4mm，现约7x5mm（IM29）
text_en: The nodule at the right interlobar pleura is slightly increased in size, previously approximately 5x4 mm, now approximately 7x5 mm (IM29).

source_text: 食管下段管壁不规则增厚较前略减轻，较厚处现约20mm（IM43），原为22mm（IM43），外膜面毛糙同前
text_en: Irregular wall thickening of the distal esophagus slightly reduced compared to previous, thickest part now approximately 20mm (IM43), previously 22mm (IM43), with serosal surface irregularity unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶微小结节影同前（IMA9、21）
text_en: Right upper lobe micro-nodule unchanged (IMA9, 21)

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结增大，原约12*8mm，现约23*15mm（IM28）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes enlarged, previously approximately 12x8 mm, now approximately 23x15 mm (IM28)

source_text: 右肺结节较前增大
text_en: The right lung nodule is larger compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺内见数枚小结节同前相仿（IM11、17、30、37），较大者仍约6x4mm（IM30），边缘光整
text_en: Several small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior (IM11, 17, 30, 37), largest still approximately 6x4 mm (IM30), with smooth margins.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段结节同前，复查
text_en: The nodule in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment is unchanged from previous; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双肺下叶结节影同前，仍约13x9mm（IM38）、10x6mm（IM40）、2mm（IM52、56、39）
text_en: Nodular opacities in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior, still measuring approximately 13x9 mm (IM38), 10x6 mm (IM40), and 2 mm (IM52, 56, 39).

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段见分叶状软组织密度肿块缩小，原约57x51mm（IM49），现约46x41mm（IM47），边界稍模糊，周围见分叶及毛刺，邻近局限性胸膜凹陷，远端肺见不规则斑片索条影增多
text_en: A lobulated soft tissue density mass in the left lower lobe basal segment has decreased in size from approximately 57x51 mm (IM49) to 46x41 mm (IM47), with slightly ill-defined margins, surrounding lobulation and spiculation, adjacent localized pleural indentation, and increased irregular patchy streaky opacities in the distal lung.

source_text: 右肺中叶磨玻璃结节同前，追查
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged; further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左下肺门区不规则软组织密度肿物较前缩小，较大层面范围原约29x13mm（IM33），现约24x10mm（IM34），累及左肺下叶背段及前内侧基底段支气管狭窄、闭塞，远端见大片状肺不张较前减轻
text_en: An irregular soft tissue density mass in the left lower hilum is smaller than before. The largest dimension was previously approximately 29 x 13 mm (IM33), now approximately 24 x 10 mm (IM34). Involvement of the left lower lobe dorsal segment and anteromedial basal segment bronchi with stenosis and occlusion is present. A large area of distal atelectasis is improved compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶斑片影及类结节影同前
text_en: Patchy opacities and nodular-like shadows in the right upper lobe are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔数枚小淋巴结较前相仿，2R组淋巴结约12x8mm（IM14）
text_en: Several small mediastinal lymph nodes similar to prior, 2R station lymph node approximately 12x8 mm (IM14).

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节影同前，追查
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe, same as before, follow-up.

source_text: 双肺多发微小结节同前相仿，较大於右肺中叶胸膜下，＜5mm（图36）
