text_en: Small nodule in the right lower lobe is similar to prior, still approximately 6 mm (Im44).

source_text: 双腋下多发淋巴结大致同前，较大约2x1.2cm（Im14）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes at both axillae are generally unchanged from prior, the largest measuring approximately 2x1.2 cm (Im14).

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下索条小结节影同前（IM40）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural linear and small nodular opacity unchanged from previous (IM40).

source_text: 右肺中叶肺癌伴中叶不张，较前相仿
text_en: Right middle lobe lung cancer with middle lobe atelectasis, similar to prior.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，双上肺散在微小结节同前(图18-20)
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, scattered micronodules in the upper lungs similar to prior (Figure 18-20).

source_text: 纵隔5组淋巴结同前，约14x9mm（Se6Im25），右肺门淋巴结同前约14x7mm（Im34）
text_en: Mediastinal station 5 lymph nodes unchanged from previous, approximately 14x9 mm (Se6Im25). Right hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous, approximately 14x7 mm (Im34).

source_text: 双侧叶间裂呈轻微小结节样增厚同前（IM34、35）
text_en: Mild nodular thickening in the bilateral interlobar fissures is unchanged (IM34, 35).

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前，＜5mm（32-图36）
text_en: Tiny nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior, measuring less than 5 mm (32-Figure 36).

source_text: 双肺上叶胸膜下模糊小结节同前，约2-4mm（IM12、18、22、23）
text_en: Faint small subpleural nodules in the upper lobes of both lungs are unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 2-4 mm (IM12, 18, 22, 23).

source_text: 纵隔2、4、7组、右肺门及右锁骨上区多发肿大淋巴结大部分较前略增大，现较大约18*15mm(图20)，原约18*12mm（IM20），左肺门及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2, 4, 7, right hilar region, and right supraclavicular area, most slightly increased in size compared to prior; currently largest approximately 18x15 mm (Figure 20), previously approximately 18x12 mm (IM20); left hilar region and bilateral axillary regions show no enlarged lymph nodes

source_text: 余双肺未见新增结节灶及斑片影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no newly increased nodule foci or patchy opacities.

source_text: 隆突下见团状实变较前缩小，内见气体及液体影，范围原约31x28mm（IM27），现约31x20mm（IM28），边界不清，与胸腔胃分界不清
text_en: Subcarinal mass-like consolidation reduced compared to prior, containing air and fluid shadows, originally approximately 31x28 mm (IM27), now approximately 31x20 mm (IM28), ill-defined margins, poorly demarcated from intrathoracic stomach.

source_text: 右肺模糊浅淡结节影同前（Im28）
text_en: Faint, hazy nodule in the right lung is stable compared to prior (Im28).

source_text: 右肺多发索条影同前，左肺下叶外基底段结节同前相仿，约6x5mm（IM54）
text_en: Multiple linear opacities in the right lung are stable. The nodule in the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 6x5 mm (IM54).

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段胸膜下小结节较前相仿，约6mm（IM43），随诊
text_en: The small subpleural nodule in the lateral basal segment of the right lower lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM43); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，现约3mm（IM55）
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior, currently approximately 3 mm (IM55).

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结大致同前，如吻合口前方淋巴结仍约8x6mm（IM11），4L组模糊密度区约17x15mm（IM22），请结合临床
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are largely unchanged from prior, including the lymph node anterior to the anastomosis which remains approximately 8x6 mm (IM11) and the ill-defined lymph node in station 4L measuring approximately 17x15 mm (IM22). Correlate with clinical findings.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节大致同前，仍约3mm（IM20）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged, still measuring approximately 3 mm (IM20).

source_text: 余双肺内未见明显新发结节及实变影
text_en: No obvious new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 肝脏低密度占位同前，约18x18mm（IM51），边界模糊
text_en: Liver low-density mass unchanged from prior, approximately 18x18mm (IM51), ill-defined margins.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段胸膜下小结节同前（IM17）
text_en: The subpleural nodule in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment is similar to prior (IM17)

source_text: 肺癌复查：左主支气管壁增厚肿物较前相仿
text_en: Lung cancer follow-up: Left main bronchial wall thickening and mass similar to prior.

source_text: 新发结节
text_en: newly identified nodule

source_text: 右侧水平裂旁类结节灶同前
text_en: Nodule-like focus adjacent to the right horizontal fissure is stable.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段支气管较前通畅，管腔不均匀狭窄（IMA33），局部软组织肿块较前明显缩小，原较大横截面约28x18mm（IM33），现表现为管壁周围软组织影增厚（IMA33），远端肺不张消失，周围可见局限性阻塞性炎症实变影
text_en: Bronchus in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is more patent than prior; luminal irregular narrowing (IMA33); local soft tissue mass significantly smaller than prior, previously largest cross-section approximately 28 x 18 mm (IM33), now presenting as peribronchial soft tissue thickening (IMA33); distal atelectasis has resolved; focal obstructive inflammatory consolidation visible in surrounding lung.

source_text: 右肺中叶结节影较前相仿，仍约21x13mm（IM30）
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe is similar to prior, still measuring approximately 21x13 mm (IM30).

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R组淋巴结同前，短径小于10mm
text_en: Lymph nodes at mediastinal stations 2R and 4R are stable, short axis less than 10 mm.

source_text: 左肺致密小结节影同前（Im34）
text_en: The dense small nodule in the left lung is unchanged (Im34)

source_text: 上纵隔气管旁淋巴结较前增大，转移待除外，建议进一步检查
text_en: Paratracheal lymph nodes in the upper mediastinum increased in size compared to prior; metastasis cannot be excluded; further evaluation recommended

source_text: 右肺上叶、左肺下叶见磨玻璃密度结节同前，较大约5mm（IM13）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodules in the right upper lobe and left lower lobe are unchanged, largest approximately 5 mm (IM13).

source_text: 左肺上叶结节，较前略增大，原约11x7mm，现约13x9mm(Im24)
text_en: Nodule in the left upper lobe slightly increased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 11x7 mm, currently approximately 13x9 mm (Im24).

source_text: 纵隔4R、4L、3a及7组多发肿大淋巴结大致同前，较大层面现约24x12mm（IM24），边界模糊
text_en: Multiple enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R, 4L, 3a, and 7 essentially unchanged from previous, largest on current scan approximately 24x12 mm (Fig. 24), ill-defined margins

source_text: 左侧胸腔新见大量胸水，左肺下叶完全不张，原左肺下叶外基底段软组织结节明显增大，现约4.0x3.5cm（Im42），原为2.5x2.1cm（Im49）
text_en: New large amount of pleural effusion in the left hemithorax; complete atelectasis of the left lower lobe; the previously noted soft tissue nodule in the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe has significantly increased in size, now approximately 4.0 x 3.5 cm (Im42), previously 2.5 x 2.1 cm (Im49).

source_text: 左肺下叶肺门旁磨玻璃密度结节同前，仍约19x13mm（IM32）
text_en: Left lower lobe hilar ground-glass opacity nodule unchanged, still approximately 19x13 mm (IM32).

source_text: 双侧胸腔未见积液，左侧胸膜结节样增厚同前（IMA30）
text_en: No pleural effusion is seen bilaterally. Nodular pleural thickening on the left is stable (IMA30).

source_text: 左肺门淋巴结同前，大小约14*7mm（IMA27）
text_en: Left hilar lymph node unchanged, size approximately 14x7 mm (IMA27).

source_text: 甲状腺增大、多发结节及钙化灶大致同前
text_en: Thyroid enlargement, multiple nodules, and calcifications stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，左肺门软组织影较前缩小，原约25*15mm，现约15x10mm(图25)，周围可见金属夹包绕，考虑术后改变
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, left hilar soft tissue shadow decreased in size compared to prior, originally approximately 25x15 mm, now approximately 15x10 mm (Figure 25), surrounded by metal clips, considered postoperative change.

source_text: 双肺胸膜下多发微结节略缩小，约2mm（IM15、40），右肺下叶背段小结节同前，约5x4mm（IM36）
text_en: Multiple subpleural micro-nodules in both lungs are slightly smaller, measuring approximately 2 mm (IM15, 40); the small nodule in the right lower lobe dorsal segment remains unchanged, measuring approximately 5x4 mm (IM36).

source_text: 右肺尖及右肺下叶少许点状小结节大致同前，仍约3mm（IM18、21、43、46、55）
text_en: The few punctate small nodules at the right lung apex and right lower lobe are essentially unchanged, still measuring approximately 3 mm (IM18, 21, 43, 46, 55).

source_text: 右肺中叶术后改变，胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right middle lobe; no new space-occupying lesions seen in the chest.

source_text: 右肺中叶点状微小结节同前，追查
text_en: Punctate tiny nodule in the right middle lobe unchanged, for follow-up

source_text: 甲状腺多发结节大致同前
text_en: Multiple thyroid nodules stable compared to prior.

source_text: 气管右侧旁小淋巴结略增大，现约7mm（IM12），原为6mm（IM10）
text_en: Small right paratracheal lymph node slightly increased in size, now approximately 7 mm (IM12), previously 6 mm (IM10).

source_text: 余双肺未见新发增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in both lungs

source_text: 右肺少许索条影同前，右肺下叶结节较前略增大，现约5mm(图27)，原约4mm（IMA33），右肺上叶胸膜下新见微小结节，＜5mm（图20），建议追查
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged; the nodule in the right lower lobe is slightly larger than before, now approximately 5 mm (Figure 27), previously about 4 mm (IMA33); a new tiny subpleural nodule <5 mm is seen in the right upper lobe (Figure 20); follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶贴心包后方与胸主动脉左前方软组织密度结节同前，仍约18x14mm（IM37）
text_en: Left lower lobe soft tissue density nodule posterior to pericardium and anterior to left thoracic aorta unchanged from previous, still approximately 18x14 mm (IM37)

source_text: 左肺门肿块较前增大
text_en: Left hilar mass increased compared to previous.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜结节样增厚同前（Im31），右侧未见胸水征象
text_en: The nodular thickening along the right interlobar pleura is unchanged (Im31). No pleural effusion is seen on the right.

source_text: 扫及肝S7低密度小结节（IM51）同前
text_en: A low-density small nodule in liver segment S7 (IM51) is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: The nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe is unchanged; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺胸膜下浅淡密度微小结节同前（IM19、22、24、38、41、43、46）
text_en: Left lung subpleural faint density tiny nodules unchanged (IM19, 22, 24, 38, 41, 43, 46)

source_text: 前上纵隔胸骨后脂肪间隙淡片状影较前缩小，原约39*26mm，现约31x15mm(图19)，考虑良性
text_en: The faint patchy opacity in the retrosternal fat space of the anterior superior mediastinum has decreased in size, from approximately 39x26 mm to approximately 31x15 mm (Figure 19); benign etiology is considered.

source_text: 双肺小结节同前，考虑良性可能大
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are stable compared to prior, likely benign

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，胸廓顶少许积液较前吸收，支气管残端未见肿块影
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; small amount of fluid at the thoracic apex has been absorbed compared to prior; no mass is seen at the bronchial stump.

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前相仿，小于10mm
text_en: Small mediastinal lymph nodes similar to previous, less than 10 mm.

source_text: 右肺下叶切除术后，两肺微小结节同前考虑陈旧灶
text_en: Post right lower lobectomy, tiny pulmonary nodules in both lungs are unchanged and considered chronic.

source_text: 左肺上叶两3mm微小结节同前（IM15、17）
text_en: Two 3-mm small nodules in the left upper lobe are unchanged from previous (IM15, 17).

source_text: 右肺胸膜下小结节同前（IM20、44）
text_en: Subpleural small nodule in the right lung is unchanged from prior (IM20, 44)

source_text: 食管癌术后，胸腔胃，吻合口未见复发征象
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer, intrathoracic stomach, no evidence of recurrence at the anastomosis.

source_text: 纵隔数个淋巴结显示同前相仿，平扫呈较高密度
text_en: Several mediastinal lymph nodes show similar appearance to previous, on non-contrast scan show higher density.

source_text: 左上肺微结节同前，约3mm（Im21）
text_en: Left upper lobe micro-nodule unchanged, approximately 3 mm (Im21)

source_text: 纵隔、双侧锁骨区、腋下小淋巴结同前，较大者约8x7mm（IM17）
text_en: Mediastinal, bilateral supraclavicular, and axillary small lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest approximately 8x7 mm (IM17).

source_text: 诸骨骨质稀疏，强直性脊柱炎改变同前，扫描所及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: All bones show osteoporosis, with unchanged ankylosing spondylitis changes; no bone destruction is seen in all scanned bones.

source_text: 左肺门小结节同前，仍约15*8mm(图25纵隔窗)，病灶远端见条索影，其旁多发结节同前相仿，较大仍约12x10mm（IMA22），追查
text_en: Left hilar small nodule stable compared to prior, still approximately 15x8 mm (Figure 25, mediastinal window). Linear opacities distal to the lesion; adjacent multiple nodules stable compared to prior, largest still approximately 12x10 mm (IMA22), follow-up recommended

source_text: 右锁骨上、纵隔及右肺门多发淋巴结较前缩小
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region, mediastinum, and right hilum are smaller than before.

source_text: 右侧水平裂胸膜小结节或片状轻度增厚同前，右后下胸膜钙化同前
text_en: Small pleural nodule or mild patchy thickening along the right horizontal fissure is stable. Calcification in the right posterior lower pleura is stable.

source_text: 余双肺小结节大致同前
text_en: Residual multiple small nodules in both lungs are approximately unchanged

source_text: 食道胸中下段壁环周增厚较前略减轻，较厚处原约12mm，现约8mm（IM28），与主动脉接触面小于90°，与左主支气管后壁关系密切同前
text_en: Circumferential wall thickening of the mid-to-lower thoracic esophagus is slightly reduced compared to prior, with the thickest portion decreasing from approximately 12 mm to 8 mm (IM28). The contact surface with the aorta is less than 90 degrees, and the close relationship with the posterior wall of the left main bronchus remains unchanged.

source_text: 吻合口右侧旁淋巴结较前缩小，原约16x13mm，现约12x9mm（IM10）
text_en: The lymph node adjacent to the right side of the anastomosis has decreased in size compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 16x13 mm, now approximately 12x9 mm (IM10).

source_text: 纵隔、左锁骨上多发肿大淋巴结较前缩小，原较大约21x18mm（IM18），现约11x9mm（IM17）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the mediastinum and left supraclavicular region have decreased in size compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 21x18 mm (IM18), now approximately 11x9 mm (IM17)

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，平扫支气管残端未见明显异常软组织密度肿块影，左上少许包裹性积液同前
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, plain scan shows no significant abnormal soft tissue density mass at the bronchial stump; left upper small amount of encapsulated pleural effusion unchanged from prior.

source_text: 两肺多发模糊结节影较前缩小，原较大约20x14mm者，现呈条索状（IM39）
text_en: Multiple ill-defined nodular opacities in both lungs decreased in size compared to prior; the previously larger one measuring 20x14 mm now appears as a linear strand (IM39)

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前相仿
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are similar compared to previous.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结增大，原约7x4mm，现约13x12mm（IM22）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes enlarged, previously approximately 7x4 mm, currently approximately 13x12 mm (IM22).

source_text: 左肺下叶前基底段团片状影缩小，原范围约25x10mm，现约17*9mm（IMA35）
text_en: Left lower lobe anterior basal segment mass-like opacity decreased in size, original extent approximately 25x10 mm, now approximately 17x9 mm (IMA35).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段索条及微小结节灶同前（IMA15），左肺下叶胸膜下新发少许斑片状密度增高影，边界不清
text_en: The linear opacities and tiny nodules in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment are unchanged from previous (IMA15); new small patchy increased density with ill-defined margins is noted subpleurally in the left lower lobe.

source_text: 纵隔、双锁骨上区及双腋下多个小淋巴结，部分较前缩小，如原4R较大约8mm（IM20），现约6mm（IM19）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum, bilateral supraclavicular regions, and bilateral axillary regions, with some decreased in size compared to prior. For example, the largest in station 4R has decreased from approximately 8 mm (IM20) to approximately 6 mm (IM19).

source_text: 左肺下叶背段与后基底段支气管后方软组织结节较前增大，原约13x10mm（IM33），现约17x14mm（Im34），平扫前缘边界不清
text_en: A soft tissue nodule posterior to the bronchus in the left lower lobe, apical and posterior basal segments, increased in size compared to prior, from approximately 13x10 mm (IM33) to approximately 17x14 mm (Im34), with ill-defined anterior margin on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 左肺多发小结节，大致同前
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left lung are similar to prior

source_text: 右肺门区淋巴结大致同前，约17x11mm（Im25）
text_en: Lymph nodes in the right hilar region are essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 17 x 11 mm (Im25).

source_text: 双肺多发小结节较前增大，转移
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs have increased in size; metastasis.

source_text: 余双肺多发转移结节，大致同前
text_en: Residual multiple metastatic nodules in both lungs are approximately unchanged

source_text: 食道术后改变同前，胸部CT扫描未见新发占位征象
text_en: Esophageal postoperative changes unchanged from previous; chest CT scan shows no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 双肺气肿同前，未见新发结节
text_en: Pulmonary emphysema is unchanged; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 食管术后，胸部未见复发和转移征象
text_en: Post-esophagectomy, no evidence of recurrence or metastasis in the chest.

source_text: 左肺上叶后段新见小簇微小结节，小于5mm（IM32、33）
text_en: Left upper lobe posterior segment newly seen small cluster of micronodules, less than 5 mm (IM32, 33).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前相仿，较大仍约14x9mm（IM21）
text_en: The mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to previous, with the largest still approximately 14x9 mm (IM21)

source_text: 胸骨柄、胸1椎体高密度结节及右侧第3肋高密度灶同前
text_en: High-density nodule in manubrium of sternum, T1 vertebral body, and high-density lesion in right third rib unchanged from previous.

source_text: 扫及胸11椎体变扁、骨水泥填充改变同前，余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: Scans show flattening and bone cement filling in the T11 vertebra, unchanged from prior; no bone destruction seen in the remaining thoracic cage bones.

source_text: 左上肺斑片未见显示，余双肺未见新发结节
text_en: Patchy opacity in the left upper lobe is no longer visible; no new nodules seen in the remainder of both lungs

source_text: 左肺术后，胸部CT未见新发占位
text_en: Left lung postoperative, chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 双肺见多发小结节，较前增大及数目增多，现较大约6mm（IM36)，原约5mm，考虑双肺转移瘤
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs have increased in size and number compared to prior, the largest now measuring approximately 6 mm (IM36), previously about 5 mm; metastatic disease is considered.

source_text: 双肺多发索条影，右侧为主同前，未见结节影
text_en: Multiple linear opacities in both lungs, predominantly on the right, are unchanged; no nodules are seen.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，约11x7mm（IM27）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is unchanged, measuring approximately 11 x 7 mm (IM27).

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，未见明确复发征象
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no definite signs of recurrence identified

source_text: 右肺下叶模糊结节同前，其旁新发斑片灶消失
text_en: The ill-defined nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged; the newly observed patchy opacity adjacent to it has resolved.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段不规则空洞样结节较前明显缩小，现约0.9x0.7cm（Im22），原为2.4x1.7cm（Im23），其内空洞亦明显缩小，边缘模糊，远端斑片影同前
text_en: Irregular cavitary nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe has markedly decreased in size; currently about 0.9x0.7cm (Im22), previously 2.4x1.7cm (Im23); the internal cavity has also markedly decreased; margins are blurred; distal patchy opacity is unchanged.

source_text: 甲状腺左叶结节同前（IMA5）
text_en: Thyroid left lobe nodule same as prior (IMA5).

source_text: 右肺散在微结节同前（IM13、22、40）
text_en: Scattered micronodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior (IM13, 22, 40).

source_text: 左肺下叶散在小结节部分同前、部分显示欠佳，追查
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the left lower lobe, some unchanged from prior, some poorly visualized; further investigation required

source_text: 左肺胸主动脉旁小结节大致同前，约4mm（IM56）
text_en: Left lung paraaortic small nodule largely unchanged, approximately 4 mm (IM56).

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门淋巴结较前增多、增大，考虑转移
text_en: Mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes increased in number and size compared to previous, suggestive of metastasis.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下小结节同前，约3mm（IM42）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural small nodule unchanged from prior, approximately 3 mm (IM42)

source_text: 余肺内未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见明显异常软组织密度增厚影，右肺下叶索条结节影同前，约6mm（IM37）
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; non-contrast scan shows no significant abnormal soft-tissue density thickening at the bronchial stump. Linear and nodular opacities in the right lower lobe are unchanged, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM37).

source_text: 左肺下叶背段不规则磨玻璃密度结节同前，仍约15x9mm（IM33）
text_en: Left lower lobe posterior segment irregular ground-glass opacity nodule unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 15x9 mm (IM33).

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，支气管断端少许软组织密度灶较前略减少，未见异常强化结节及肿块，左侧胸腔积液较前减少
text_en: Left lower lobe postoperative, slight soft tissue density focus at the bronchial stump is slightly reduced compared to previous, no abnormally enhancing nodules or masses seen, left pleural effusion is reduced compared to previous.

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节影同前（IM10、15、17、21），较大约5mm
text_en: Right upper lobe small nodule shadow unchanged (IM10, 15, 17, 21), largest approximately 5 mm

source_text: 左残肺多发呈串珠状分布不规则高密度类结节范围同前
text_en: Multiple irregular high-density nodular opacities in the left residual lung, distributed in a string-of-pearls pattern, with extent unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔散在小淋巴结大致同前，较大仍约8x7mm（IM24）
text_en: Scattered small mediastinal lymph nodes roughly unchanged from prior; the larger node remains approximately 8x7 mm (station IM24).

source_text: 双肺小结节同前，考虑陈旧病灶
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are stable compared to prior, considered chronic/old changes

source_text: 两肺胸膜下散在小结节灶同前
text_en: Scattered small subpleural nodules in both lungs are stable.

source_text: 甲状腺左叶切除术后，右叶低密度结节较前略增大，略突出于甲状腺表面，原约8x8mm（IM7），现约8x10mm（IM6），请结合甲状腺其他检查
text_en: Post left thyroid lobectomy, right thyroid lobe low-density nodule slightly increased in size compared to prior, slightly protruding from thyroid surface, previously approximately 8x8 mm (Image 7), now approximately 8x10 mm (Image 6); please correlate with other thyroid examinations.

source_text: 新见浅淡小结节
text_en: Newly seen low-density small nodules

source_text: 纵隔2R组淋巴结同前，仍约7mm（IMA11），余未见新发肿大淋巴结
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal station 2R unchanged from previous, still approximately 7 mm (IMA11), no new enlarged lymph nodes elsewhere.

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下磨玻璃密度小结节同前，仍约7mm（IM37）
text_en: Subpleural ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior, still measuring approximately 7 mm (IM37).

source_text: 双肺散在小结节大致同前，建议追查
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged, recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右肺中叶切除术后，纵隔小淋巴结同前
text_en: Postoperative status after right middle lobectomy. Small mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段新见多发模糊小斑片及小结节
text_en: Newly seen multiple ill-defined small patchy opacities and nodules in left upper lobe apicoposterior segment

source_text: 右肺上叶后段磨玻璃密度结节同前，约12mm（IM12），未见实性成分，继续追查
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment, unchanged, approximately 12 mm (IM12), no solid component seen. Continue follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔7组肿大淋巴结较前缩小，原约35x15mm（IM31），现约20x13mm（IM32）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 enlarged lymph nodes are reduced in size compared to previous, previously approximately 35 × 15 mm (Image 31), currently approximately 20 × 13 mm (Image 32)

source_text: 右肺上叶前段小结节同前，约4x3mm（IM27）
text_en: Small nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable, approximately 4x3 mm (IM27)

source_text: 余左肺上叶及右肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation are seen in the left upper lobe or right lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶结节影大致同前，约5mm（IM41）
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is essentially unchanged, approximately 5 mm on image 41.

source_text: 右肺门多发淋巴结同前，较大者仍约12x11mm（IM29）
text_en: Multiple right hilar lymph nodes are stable compared to prior, the largest still measuring approximately 12x11 mm (IM29).

source_text: 右肺上叶模糊小结节大小同前，密度较前略增高，约5mm（IM21）
text_en: Indistinct small nodule in the right upper lobe, stable in size, with slight increase in density, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM21).

source_text: 右肺下叶新见少许模糊微小结节，小于5mm，追查
text_en: Newly seen faint micro-nodules in the right lower lobe, less than 5 mm, require follow-up.

source_text: 右肺术后改变同前，胸部CT未见明确占位征象
text_en: Findings of prior right lung surgery are unchanged; chest CT shows no definite space-occupying lesion.

source_text: 甲状腺双叶见低密度结节，大致同前，请结合颈部检查
text_en: Low-density nodules are seen in both thyroid lobes, similar to prior findings; correlate with neck examination.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节同前略增大，观察
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe is slightly larger than prior; observation recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶索条及微小结节同前（Im35、41），余肺未见新生结节
text_en: The linear opacities and tiny nodules in the right lower lobe are unchanged (Im35, 41); no new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右上肺癌疗后，病变同前
text_en: Post-treatment changes for right upper lung cancer; the lesion is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段邻近肺门处不规则结节较前明显缩小，原约10x8mm（IM20），现呈条片样，短径约4mm（IM17）
text_en: Irregular nodule near the hilum in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe has markedly decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 10x8 mm (IM20), now appears as a linear and patchy opacity with a short axis of approximately 4 mm (IM17)

source_text: 右肺下叶背段模糊结节同前，仍约5mm（IMA18）
text_en: The indistinct nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe remains stable, still measuring approximately 5 mm (IMA18).

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节同前，仍约2mm（IM31）
text_en: The small nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged, still approximately 2 mm (IM31).

source_text: 纵隔、肺门肿大淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal and hilar enlarged lymph nodes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结平扫较前相仿
text_en: Right hilar lymph node on non-contrast imaging is similar to prior.

source_text: 双肺多发模糊磨玻璃密度小结节影同前相仿，现仍约3-5mm
text_en: Multiple ill-defined ground-glass nodules in both lungs are similar to prior; currently still approximately 3-5 mm.

source_text: 余两肺散在模糊斑片、小结节影大致同前，边缘模糊
text_en: Scattered indistinct patchy opacities and small nodules in the remainder of both lungs are largely unchanged; margins are indistinct.

source_text: 右上肺占位大小同前，追查
text_en: Right upper lung mass is stable in size; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 余右肺多发类圆形小结节同前，较大约5mm（Im36）
text_en: Multiple round small nodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior, largest measuring approximately 5 mm (Im36).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变，胸部CT平扫未见新增占位征象
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; no new space-occupying lesions are seen on non-contrast chest CT.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下软组织密度结节较前形态饱满，现约15x14mm（IM17），原约17x6mm（IM18），边缘模糊不清,局部胸膜牵拉凹陷，结合临床
text_en: The subpleural soft tissue nodule in the right upper lobe appears more rounded than before, currently measuring approximately 15x14 mm (IM17), previously 17x6 mm (IM18), with indistinct margins and local pleural retraction and indentation; correlate with clinical findings.

source_text: 左肺结节灶同前，随诊观察
text_en: Left pulmonary nodule unchanged from prior, follow-up observation.

source_text: 食管中上段管壁环周增厚较前减轻，原较厚约19mm（IM21），长径约63mm（矢状位 IM38），现约11mm（IM23），长径约45mm（矢状位 IM37），边缘模糊，病灶与气管后壁分界不清
text_en: Circumferential wall thickening of the mid-to-upper esophagus is reduced compared to prior, previously approximately 19 mm (IM21) with a long axis of approximately 63 mm (sagittal plane IM38), now approximately 11 mm (IM23) with a long axis of approximately 45 mm (sagittal plane IM37). The lesion is ill-defined with blurred margins and indistinct from the posterior tracheal wall.

source_text: 双腋下、纵隔3、4组多发淋巴结同前，7组淋巴结较前饱满，原约12x8mm（Im33），现约24x13mm（IM33）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes at both axillae and mediastinal stations 3 and 4 are unchanged from prior; lymph nodes at station 7 are more prominent than prior, previously about 12x8 mm (Im33), now approximately 24x13 mm (IM33).

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段胸膜下模糊索条结节灶大致同前（IM13），右肺中叶内侧段索条影同前
text_en: The ill-defined linear and nodular opacity subpleurally in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is essentially unchanged compared to prior (IM13). The linear opacity in the medial segment of the right middle lobe remains stable.

source_text: 纵隔及肺门多发肿大淋巴结，部分同前、部分增大
text_en: Multiple enlarged mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes, some unchanged from prior and some increased in size.

source_text: 右肺小结节影较前增大增多，转移不能除外，请结合临床明确
text_en: Right lung small nodules are increased in size and number; metastasis cannot be excluded; clinical correlation is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔内不规则软组织密度灶较前缩小，原约40x10mm（IM31），现约22x8mm（IM30）
text_en: An irregular soft tissue density lesion within the mediastinum has decreased in size compared to previous, from approximately 40x10 mm (IM31) to approximately 22x8 mm (IM30).

source_text: 余纵隔多发较高密度淋巴结较前相仿，较大者仍约17x9mm（IM24）
text_en: The remaining multiple higher-attenuation mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior; the largest remains approximately 17x9 mm (IM24).

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，4L组仍约13*11mm(图21)
text_en: Mediastinal multiple lymph nodes unchanged from previous, station 4L still approximately 13x11mm (Figure 21).

source_text: 纵隔多个小淋巴结同前，较大仍约12*10mm(图26）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest still approximately 12x10 mm (Figure 26)

source_text: 右肺门旁结节同前，仍约6mm（IM23）
text_en: The nodule adjacent to the right hilum is unchanged from prior, still approximately 6 mm (IM23).

source_text: 右肺术后，支气管断端软组织肿块周围肺不张明显增多，二者分界不清，致肿块轮廓显示不清，可疑肿块较前增大（IM28），密切追查
text_en: Post right lung surgery, atelectasis surrounding the soft tissue mass at the bronchial stump has significantly increased; the boundary between the two is indistinct, obscuring the mass contour; the mass is possibly larger than before (IM28); close follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影较前减少，双肺新见散在结节，较大约13x11mm（IMA27），左肺新见斑片影
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lower lobe has decreased compared to prior; new scattered nodules are seen in both lungs, the largest measuring approximately 13 x 11 mm (IMA27); new patchy opacities are seen in the left lung.

source_text: 纵隔6组淋巴结较前略增大，现约14*11mm(图29)，原约13*9mm(图27)
text_en: Mediastinal station 6 lymph nodes are slightly enlarged compared to previous, currently approximately 14x11 mm (Image 29), previously approximately 13x9 mm (Image 27)

source_text: 余肺未见明确新发灶
text_en: The remainder of the lungs shows no definite new lesions.

source_text: 纵隔4L组淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 4L lymph nodes unchanged from prior, follow-up.

source_text: 左上肺术后，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy; no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis

source_text: 纵隔内多个较高密度小淋巴结同前，隆突下较大者约13*9mm（IMA29）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes with higher density within the mediastinum are unchanged from previous, with the largest subcarinal one approximately 13x9 mm (Image A29).

source_text: 右肺上叶近胸膜处模糊小结节同前，约5mm（IM10、22)，余肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: A hazy small nodule near the pleura in the right upper lobe is stable, approximately 5 mm (IM10, 22). No new nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶浅淡小结节同前，约4mm（Im38）
text_en: The faint small nodule in the right lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM38).

source_text: 左侧斜裂胸膜见小结节同前，约5mm（Im32）
text_en: Small nodule is seen along the left major fissure pleura, unchanged, approximately 5 mm (Im32).

source_text: 纵隔、双腋下可见多发肿大淋巴结，较前略缩小，较大原约22x14mm（IM27），现约19x12mm（IMA27）
text_en: Lymphadenopathy in the mediastinum and bilateral axillary regions is slightly smaller than prior. The largest node previously measured approximately 22x14 mm (IM27) and now measures approximately 19x12 mm (IMA27).

source_text: 食管胸中下段癌疗后，较前略好转
text_en: Post-therapy esophageal cancer in the middle-lower thoracic esophagus, slightly improved compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶另见一约5mm小结节同前（Im29）
text_en: Additional 5 mm nodule in left upper lobe unchanged (IM29)

source_text: 右下肺多发结节较前增大，追查
text_en: Multiple nodules in the right lower lobe are larger compared to prior imaging; further investigation is warranted.

source_text: 右肺上叶部分切除术后，可见金属缝线影同前，周围索条影较前增厚，右肺下叶背段结节较前增大，现约15x9mm（IM19），原约7x5mm
text_en: Status post partial resection of the right upper lobe, metallic suture clips are stable. Surrounding linear opacities are thicker than before. The nodule in the right lower lobe, dorsal segment, has increased in size, now approximately 15x9 mm (IM19), previously approximately 7x5 mm.

source_text: 右肺中叶结节较前增大、清晰，需密切追查除外转移
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe is larger and better defined compared to prior imaging; close follow-up is required to exclude metastasis.

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门及贲门旁多发淋巴结较前略显增大，如右侧下肺韧带旁淋巴结现约23x16mm（IM34），追查
text_en: Multiple mediastinal, right hilar, and paracardial lymph nodes are slightly enlarged compared to prior, such as the right inferior pulmonary ligament-adjacent lymph node currently measuring approximately 23x16 mm (IM34), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺散在小结节、纵隔淋巴结同前
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right lung and mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段混杂磨玻璃密度结节同前，边界模糊，约16x12mm（Im37），其内少许实性密度，外周肺少许索条影同前
text_en: Mixed ground-glass opacity nodule in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe, unchanged compared to prior, with indistinct margins, measuring approximately 16 x 12 mm (Im37); contains minimal solid components. Minimal peripheral pulmonary linear opacities remain unchanged.

source_text: 肺内索条、小结节及钙化灶同前
text_en: Pulmonary linear opacities, small nodules, and calcified lesions unchanged.

source_text: 余两肺多发小结节大致同前，右肺中叶较大者约5mm（IMA38）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the remainder of both lungs are largely unchanged; the largest in the right middle lobe measures approximately 5 mm (IMA38).

source_text: 余双肺散在索条及钙化结节同前
text_en: Residual scattered linear opacities and calcified nodules in both lungs are unchanged

source_text: 右上肺索条影同前，左肺下叶3mm模糊小结节同前（IM44），余肺未见结节及片絮影
text_en: Linear opacities in the right upper lung are unchanged; a 3 mm indistinct small nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged (IM44); no nodules or patchy opacities are seen elsewhere in the lungs.

source_text: 两肺少许点状结节影同前（IMA11、14、36）
text_en: The punctate nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged from prior (IMA11, 14, 36).

source_text: 纵隔略向左侧移位同前，纵隔多发小淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinum slightly shifted to the left as before, multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes as before.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，平扫支气管断端平扫未见明确占位，左肺下叶条片影同前
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, plain scan shows no clear mass at the bronchial stump; left lower lobe linear and patchy opacities unchanged from prior.

source_text: 新见团片及类结节
text_en: Newly identified patchy and nodular lesions

source_text: 纵隔多个淋巴结同前，如4L组者仍约15*9mm(图20)
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged from previous, such as those in station 4L still measuring approximately 15x9 mm (Figure 20).

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则结节伴小片状模糊影较前明显缩小，现局部仅见不规则索条影
text_en: Irregular nodule in the left upper lobe with surrounding patchy hazy opacity has markedly decreased in size compared to prior; only irregular linear strands are now seen locally.

source_text: 双肺微小结节影同前（IM22、26、33）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary micro-nodular opacities are stable compared to prior (IM22, 26, 33).

source_text: 双肺未见新增结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: No new nodules or flaky opacities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺门肿大淋巴结同前，仍约11x10mm（IM31）
text_en: The enlarged right hilar lymph node is unchanged from prior, still measuring approximately 11 x 10 mm (IM31).

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节略饱满，现约3mm（IM7），原约2mm
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule slightly prominent, currently approximately 3mm (IM7), previously approximately 2mm.

source_text: 右肺微小点状结节同前（Im26、28），余双肺未见新生占位
text_en: Right lung tiny punctate nodules unchanged (Im26, 28); no new pulmonary mass lesions seen in the remainder of both lungs

source_text: 左肺舌段索条结节大致同前
text_en: Left lung lingular segment: linear nodule essentially unchanged

source_text: 左侧第7肋、胸5椎体致密结节同前
text_en: Dense nodules in the left seventh rib and T5 vertebral body, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶支气管阻塞，结节影增大，复发
text_en: Right middle lobe bronchial obstruction with increase in size of the nodular opacity, suggestive of recurrence

source_text: 右腋下淋巴结较前缩小，最大短径小于5mm（IM13）
text_en: Right axillary lymph node decreased in size compared to prior, current maximum short diameter less than 5 mm (IM13).

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，胸部CT平扫所见大致同前，未见恶性征象
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; non-contrast chest CT findings are largely unchanged; no malignant signs identified

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结较前缩小，如原约15x13mm，现约12x10mm（IM33），追查
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is smaller compared to prior, previously approximately 15x13 mm, now approximately 12x10 mm (IM33), follow-up recommended

source_text: 左肺下叶背段支气管阻塞同前，局部肿块缩小
text_en: Bronchial obstruction in the left lower lobe dorsal segment unchanged from previous, with local mass decreased in size.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，约8mm（IM24）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node unchanged, measuring approximately 8 mm (IM24)

source_text: 右下肺叶间胸膜下结节同前，仍约10x7mm（IM36）
text_en: Right lower interlobar subpleural nodule unchanged, still approximately 10x7 mm (IM36).

source_text: 右肺上叶肺门旁见实性小结节同前，伴钙化灶，约9x6mm（IM25）
text_en: A solid small nodule adjacent to the hilum of the right upper lobe remains unchanged, accompanied by calcification, measuring approximately 9x6 mm (IM25).

source_text: 食管胸下段管壁不均匀增厚较前减轻，较厚横截面原约24x21mm（IM42），现约25x16mm（IM40），累及长度约30mm（Se602 Im34），外膜面较清晰，同主动脉接触面约45°，近端食管无扩张
text_en: The irregular wall thickening of the lower thoracic esophagus has decreased compared to prior. The maximum cross-sectional dimension was approximately 24 x 21 mm (IM42) and is now approximately 25 x 16 mm (IM40). The involved length is approximately 30 mm (Se602 Im34). The outer membrane surface is relatively clear. The contact angle with the aorta is approximately 45 degrees. The proximal esophagus shows no dilation.

source_text: 甲状腺多发低强化结节大致同前，建议颈部B超检查
text_en: Multiple low-enhancing thyroid nodules stable compared to prior; recommend neck ultrasound.

source_text: 纵隔4组淋巴结略饱满，现约18x9mm（IM21），原约16x6mm（IM20），追查
text_en: Mediastinal group 4 lymph nodes slightly enlarged, currently approximately 18x9 mm (IM21), previously approximately 16x6 mm (IM20), follow up

source_text: 双肺另多发实性小结节较前略缩小，大者位于右肺中叶外侧段，现约5*3mm(图44)，原约5*5mm(IM40)
text_en: Multiple additional solid small nodules in both lungs are slightly decreased compared to prior; largest located in the right middle lobe lateral segment, now approximately 5x3 mm (Figure 44), previously approximately 5x5 mm (IM40).

source_text: 右肺索条影同前，两肺未见新增结节及实变影
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lung is stable; no new nodules or consolidations are seen in either lung.

source_text: 胸部诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: All chest bones show no bone destruction foci.

source_text: 双肺下叶纹理增多伴少量索条同前，未见新发结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Increased bronchovascular markings in both lower lobes with few linear opacities are unchanged compared to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 左肺下叶微小结节同前，追查
text_en: Left lower lobe small nodule unchanged, follow-up.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段类结节影同前，约12x8mm（IMA23）
text_en: Nodule-like shadow in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe unchanged from previous, approximately 12x8 mm (IMA23)

source_text: 右肺上叶、左肺下叶结节同前，约4mm（IM29、45）
text_en: Nodules in the right upper lobe and left lower lobe are unchanged, approximately 4 mm (IM29, 45).

source_text: 左下肺索条及钙化点同前，双肺未见新生结节斑片影
text_en: The linear opacities and calcified foci in the left lower lobe are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左斜裂上见一扁平结节同前，约6x3mm（IM34）
text_en: Left oblique fissure flat nodule unchanged, approximately 6x3 mm (IM34).

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门见数枚淋巴结较前缩小，较大者原约22x16mm（IM28），现约13x6mm（IM30）
text_en: Several lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right hilum are reduced compared to prior, with the largest previously measuring approximately 22x16 mm (IM28) and now approximately 13x6 mm (IM30).

source_text: 纵隔内多发小淋巴结较前相仿，较大约9*7mm（IM15）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes similar to previous, largest approximately 9x7 mm (IM15)

source_text: 右肺上叶前段微结节同前，直径约3mm（IM18）
text_en: Micronodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable, diameter approximately 3 mm (IM18)

source_text: 右侧肾上腺外侧肢小结节同前，考虑良性，请结合腹部检查
text_en: Small nodule in the right adrenal lateral limb is unchanged. Benign etiology is considered. Correlation with abdominal imaging is recommended.

source_text: 扫及肝脏占位同前
text_en: On scan, a hepatic mass is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺不规则占位略增大，请结合腹部检查除外转移
text_en: A slightly enlarged irregular left adrenal mass is noted; correlation with abdominal examination is recommended to exclude metastasis.

source_text: 左肺下叶索条影同前，双肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Left lower lobe fibrotic streak unchanged, both lungs no new nodules or consolidation

source_text: 双肺上叶浅淡小结节及磨玻璃灶部分同前（IM9、15），右肺上叶磨玻璃小结节较前增大，原约6x4mm，现约8x6mm(IM14)
text_en: Faint small nodules and ground-glass opacities in the upper lobes of both lungs are partially unchanged compared to prior (IM9, 15). The ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe has increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 6x4 mm, now approximately 8x6 mm (IM14).

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结轮廓显示不清同前
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph node has ill-defined margins, unchanged from previous.

source_text: 扫及左乳内侧象限小结节同前（IM22）
text_en: A small nodule in the inner quadrant of the left breast is unchanged from prior (Im22).

source_text: 纵隔内多发淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes essentially unchanged from previous

source_text: 右肺上叶前段及左肺上叶尖后段磨玻璃密度小结节同前，分别约6x5mm（IM21）、8x7mm（IM8）
text_en: Small ground-glass density nodules in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe and apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe are unchanged, approximately 6x5mm (IM21) and 8x7mm (IM8), respectively.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，左肺下叶结节较前相仿
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lower lobe; the nodule in the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔2-7组淋巴结同前，较大约20x12mm（IM24）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal groups 2-7 unchanged from prior, largest approximately 20x12mm (IM24).

source_text: 右肺胸膜下可疑结节大致同前（IM32、47、49）
text_en: Suspicious nodules in the right lung subpleural region are roughly unchanged (IM32, 47, 49).

source_text: 右上纵隔旁肺不张加重，其外侧两枚软组织结节增大，高度可疑复发
text_en: Right upper mediastinal atelectasis has worsened; two adjacent soft tissue nodules have increased in size, highly suspicious for recurrence.

source_text: 余肺片絮、索条、钙化结节大致同前，未见明确新发结节及实变影
text_en: The fibrotic strands, nodules, and calcified nodules in the remainder of the lungs are largely unchanged; no definite new nodules or consolidation are seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变同前，右肺下叶点状影同前，右肺下叶背段浅淡小结节影，建议复查
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lobe are unchanged. The punctate opacities in the right lower lobe are stable. A faint small nodule is seen in the dorsal segment of the right lower lobe; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔4、5组多发淋巴结同前，现仍约9x5mm（IM14）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4 and 5 unchanged, still measuring approximately 9x5 mm (IM14)

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右上肺索条影同前，余两肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent; linear opacity in the right upper lobe is stable compared to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段结节同前比较变化不明显，倾向恶性，追查
text_en: Nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe shows no significant change compared to prior; malignancy is favored; further evaluation recommended

source_text: 右腋下多发小淋巴结同前（IMA17）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the right axilla, unchanged from prior (IMA17).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变，未见新发占位，追查
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; no new mass identified; follow-up recommended

source_text: 平扫纵隔淋巴结影较前略增大，现较大约14*11mm(图22)，原约10*7mm（IMA20），建议追查
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows a mediastinal lymph node slightly increased in size compared to prior, currently measuring approximately 14x11 mm (image 22), previously approximately 10x7 mm (IMA20). Recommendation: Further investigation is recommended.

source_text: 右肺散在小结节影同前，较大仍约5mm（IM38、48）
text_en: Scattered small nodular opacities in the right lung are stable compared to prior, the largest remaining approximately 5 mm (IM38, 48).

source_text: 双肺内磨玻璃密度结节部分同前，部分显示不清，右肺上叶实性结节同前，追查
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodules in both lungs are partially stable and partially indistinct; solid nodule in the right upper lobe is stable, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺门上三枚小结节同前，现较大约11*5mm(图17)，原约12*4mm（IM17），追查
text_en: Three small nodules in the upper right hilum are stable compared to prior, with the largest now measuring approximately 11 x 5 mm (Figure 17), previously about 12 x 4 mm (IM17); further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右水平裂胸膜下结节，右肺下叶磨玻璃密度小结节同前
text_en: Subpleural nodule along the right horizontal fissure unchanged; small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶上舌段胸膜下团片影较前缩小，范围原约23x16mm（Im30），现约11x8mm（IM30），边界不清同前
text_en: The subpleural patchy opacity in the superior lingular segment of the left upper lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, from approximately 23x16 mm (Im30) to 11x8 mm (IM30); the ill-defined margins remain unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段胸膜下点状小结节同前（IM19）
text_en: A punctate small subpleural nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe, unchanged from previous (IM19).

source_text: 食管-胃吻合术后，右肺门及纵隔小淋巴结影及右下肺手术缝线周围软组织影大致同前
text_en: Post-esophagogastrectomy; small lymph node shadows in the right hilum and mediastinum, and soft tissue shadow around surgical sutures in the right lower lung are largely unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺下叶高密度钙化灶同前，右肺上叶类结节灶同前（IM18）
text_en: The high-density calcified focus in the right lower lobe is unchanged; the nodular-appearing lesion in the right upper lobe is unchanged (IM18).

source_text: 食道胸下段管壁增厚较前略有减轻，原较厚约9mm(IM53)，现较厚约8mm(IM53)，轻度强化，外膜面稍模糊，与胸主动脉接触面＜90°
text_en: Wall thickening of the lower thoracic esophagus is slightly reduced compared to prior, with thickness decreasing from approximately 9 mm to 8 mm (IM53). There is mild enhancement, slight blurring of the outer membrane, and the contact surface with the thoracic aorta is less than 90 degrees.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃密度小结节同前，仍约10x6mm（IMA16），其旁散在微小结节同前，约2mm（IMA12）
text_en: Small ground-glass density nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged, still approximately 10 × 6 mm (IMA16); scattered tiny nodules nearby are unchanged, approximately 2 mm (IMA12).

source_text: 食道癌术后弓上吻合，胸部未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Post esophageal cancer surgery with supra-arch anastomosis; no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis in the chest.

source_text: 左肺下叶占位同前
text_en: Mass in the left lower lobe, unchanged from previous

source_text: 双肺下叶小钙化同前，未见新发结节
text_en: Small calcifications in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 右肺少许索条影、左肺散在陈旧点灶同前，双肺未见新发结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: A few linear opacities in the right lung and scattered old punctate foci in the left lung are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，复查
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from prior, follow-up.

source_text: 左肺下叶结节影大致同前，约5mm（IM43）
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is essentially unchanged, approximately 5 mm on image 43.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃密度结节同前，约16x8mm（IM15），内可疑斑点实性成分
text_en: Ground-glass density nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged, approximately 16 × 8 mm (IM15), with a suspicious punctate solid component within.

source_text: 右肺多发磨玻璃密度结节同前，较大约6mm（IMA24）
text_en: Multiple ground-glass opacity nodules in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior, the largest measuring approximately 6 mm (IMA24).

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节同前（IM21）
text_en: Small nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior (IM21).

source_text: 左侧肋骨见连续性中断，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: Discontinuity of the left rib, with no evidence of osseous destruction in the remainder of the visualized bones.

source_text: 左上肺见模糊小结节影同前，仍约5mm（Im18），追查
text_en: Indistinct small nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged from prior, still approximately 5 mm (Im18); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶见规则结节同前，较大截面仍约32x14mm（IM15），其内仍见含气透亮影
text_en: A regular nodule in the left upper lobe unchanged from prior, largest cross-section still approximately 32x14mm (Image 15), still containing an air-filled lucency within.

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，胸部CT平扫所见陈旧灶大致同前，未见明显新生占位
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; old findings on non-contrast chest CT are largely unchanged; no obvious new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 纵隔2L低密度结节同前，约17x11mm（IM8）
text_en: Mediastinal station 2L low-density nodule unchanged from previous, approximately 17x11 mm (IM8).

source_text: 左肺新见小结节，约4mm（IM28），内见小空泡，追查
text_en: New small nodule in left lung, approximately 4mm (Image 28), with small cavity, follow-up recommended

source_text: 余肺内透亮度均匀，未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: The remaining lung parenchyma shows uniform lucency, without new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 左肺纵隔旁小结节灶同前
text_en: Left lung parahilar small nodule unchanged.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺多发结节同前
text_en: Multiple thyroid nodules unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左前胸壁皮肤小结节同前
text_en: Small skin nodule in the left anterior chest wall unchanged from prior.

source_text: 余肺野未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: The remainder of the lung fields shows no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 右肺下叶外侧基底段见类圆形磨玻璃密度小结节同前，边缘模糊，仍约5mm（IMA46），未见实性成分
text_en: A round ground-glass density small nodule is seen in the lateral basal segment of the right lower lobe, stable, with blurred margins, still measuring approximately 5 mm (IMA46), without solid components.

source_text: 右肺上叶微小结节较前相仿，仍约为3mm（IM16），建议追查
text_en: Right upper lobe micro-nodule similar to prior, still approximately 3 mm (IM16), recommend follow-up

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区淋巴结同前，约为5mm（IM8）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node is unchanged, approximately 5 mm (IM8)

source_text: 纵隔平扫肿大淋巴结同前，较大仍约27x25mm（IMA19）
text_en: Non-contrast mediastinal CT demonstrates enlarged lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest still measuring approximately 27x25 mm (IMA19).

source_text: 左上肺门淋巴结影同前，大小约9x5mm（IM27)，追查
text_en: Left hilar lymph node shadow is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 9x5 mm (IM27), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右上叶肺癌术后改变，胸部未见明确变化
text_en: Postoperative changes following right upper lobe lung cancer resection; no definite changes are seen in the chest.

source_text: 左肺斑点索条影、右肺上叶小结节及小磨玻璃密度影同前（IMA23、26、27）
text_en: Punctate and linear opacities in the left lung, small nodules and small ground-glass opacities in the right upper lobe unchanged from previous (images 23, 26, 27).

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结同前，约9*7mm（IM22）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes unchanged, approximately 9x7 mm (IM22).

source_text: 食管胸下段管壁不均匀增厚较前减轻，较厚处原约22mm（IM42），现约10mm（IM46），外膜模糊，同胸主动脉接触面小于90度，近端食管无扩张
text_en: The lower thoracic esophageal wall demonstrates irregular thickening, reduced from prior examination; the thickest portion previously measured approximately 22 mm (IM42) and now approximately 10 mm (IM46). The adventitial layer is blurred, with an interface angle to the thoracic aorta less than 90 degrees. The proximal esophagus shows no dilation.

source_text: 余双肺散在多发微小结节同前，小于5mm，追查
text_en: Residual scattered multiple tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged, all less than 5 mm; follow-up recommended

source_text: 双肺多发小结节同前，如右肺下叶较大结节仍约9x5mm（IM52）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior, such as the larger nodule in the right lower lobe, still measuring approximately 9x5 mm (IM52).

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，仍约6mm（IM41）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, still approximately 6 mm (IM41).

source_text: 胸廓骨质未见骨质破坏
text_en: No bone destruction seen in the bones of the thoracic cage.

source_text: 左肺舌叶局部术后，两肺散在微小结节同前
text_en: Post-local resection in the lingula of the left lung, scattered tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged

source_text: 扫及右乳内下象限类结节影同前
text_en: CT shows a nodular opacity in the right breast inner lower quadrant similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺门区肿大淋巴结大致同前，约16x12mm（IM27）
text_en: Enlarged lymph node in the right hilar region is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 16x12 mm (IM27).

source_text: 左肺下叶磨玻璃小结节较前略增大，追查
text_en: Left lower lobe small ground-glass nodule slightly increased compared with prior study; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶新增结节，性质待定，追查
text_en: Newly noted nodule in the right upper lobe, indeterminate in nature; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜旁结节大致同前
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural nodule essentially unchanged

source_text: 右侧胸腔积液减少，积气消失，膨胀不全肺组织基本复张，左肺散在小结节同前（IM18、51等），较大约4mm（IM51），未见新发结节及斑片灶
text_en: Right pleural effusion has decreased; pneumothorax has resolved. The previously atelectatic lung tissue has largely re-expanded. Scattered small nodules in the left lung are unchanged (IM18, 51, etc.), the largest measuring about 4 mm (IM51). No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 两肺索条影同前，两肺未见新增结节
text_en: Linear opacities in both lungs are stable; no new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 双上叶模糊3mm结节同前（IM11、12、14、28）
text_en: The 3 mm indistinct nodules in both upper lobes are unchanged (IM11, 12, 14, 28).

source_text: 左肺下叶微小结节大致同前，约2mm（IM26）
text_en: Left lower lobe small nodule essentially unchanged, approximately 2 mm (IM26).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则软组织密度结节较前略增大，现约26*20mm(图18)，原约22*19mm（IMA19），边缘与侧胸膜牵拉同前
text_en: The irregular soft-tissue density nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe has slightly increased in size compared to prior, now measuring approximately 26x20 mm (Figure 18), previously approximately 22x19 mm (IMA19). The margin with lateral pleural retraction remains unchanged.

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节影同前，约4mm（IM36）
text_en: The small nodule in the right middle lobe is stable, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM36).

source_text: 平扫纵隔7组淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes approximately unchanged from prior.

source_text: 余双肺浅淡小结节影同前，较大约4mm(IM44)
text_en: The small faint nodules in the remainder of both lungs are stable compared to prior, largest approximately 4 mm (IM44).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段胸膜下模糊小结节同前相仿，仍约3mm（IM19）
text_en: Subpleural indistinct small nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is similar to prior, still approximately 3 mm (IM19)

source_text: 纵隔4-7组小淋巴结同前，较大约6mm（IM22）
text_en: Small mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4-7 unchanged from previous, largest approximately 6 mm (IM22).

source_text: 右肺小斑片索条钙化影同前，两肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Small patchy linear opacities and calcifications in the right lung are stable compared to prior; no new nodules or consolidations are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左肺多发小结节同前，较大约5mm（IM15）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left lung unchanged from prior, the largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM15)

source_text: 右肺下叶背段毛刺结节较前略缩小，现约9*6mm(图37)，原约10x9mm（IM37）
text_en: The spiculated nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is slightly smaller than prior, now measuring approximately 9 x 6 mm (Figure 37), previously measuring approximately 10 x 9 mm (IM37).

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前
text_en: Small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged.

source_text: 椎体高密度小结节同前
text_en: Small high-density nodule in the vertebrae unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺上叶中心型肺癌及纵膈转移淋巴结较前略缩小
text_en: Central lung cancer in the right upper lobe and mediastinal metastatic lymph nodes are slightly smaller than prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶及下叶另见多发索条影较前相仿，余肺未见结节影
text_en: Additional linear opacities are seen in the right middle and lower lobes, similar to prior. No nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下索条影同前，双肺未见新生结节灶，双侧未见胸水
text_en: Subpleural linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged; no new nodules are seen in either lung; no pleural effusion is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段模糊结节同前（IM28）
text_en: Left lower lobe dorsal segment indistinct nodule unchanged from prior (IM28).

source_text: 左锁骨上淋巴结较前增大，现约12X10mm（IM5），原约9mm
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node increased compared to previous, currently approximately 12x10 mm (IM5), previously approximately 9 mm.

source_text: 双肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation shadows seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段胸膜下结节较前缩小，原实性成分约6x5mm，现约4mm(IM34)，周围原磨玻璃密度消失，边界清楚
text_en: The subpleural nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe has decreased in size compared to prior; the previous solid component was approximately 6x5 mm, now approximately 4 mm (IM34). The surrounding ground-glass opacity has resolved, and the margins are now well-defined.

source_text: 气管右侧旁淋巴结同前，约11x9mm（IM9）
text_en: Right paratracheal lymph node unchanged, approximately 11x9 mm (IM9).

source_text: 右肺上叶类结节影同前（IM9）

Irregular margins, heterogeneous internal density, with small solid component (IM14, sagittal view IM38). Suspicious for malignancy; recommend correlation with clinical findings.
