source_text: 余双肺微小结节大致同前
text_en: Residual multiple tiny nodules in both lungs are approximately unchanged

source_text: 2R、2L、5、7组多发淋巴结，部分较前增大，2R组原约9x6mm（IM16）者，现约14x10mm（IM15）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in stations 2R, 2L, 5, and 7; some are larger than before. The 2R station, previously about 9x6 mm (IM16), is now about 14x10 mm (IM15).

source_text: 右肺中叶内侧段不规则软组织结节较前相仿，大小仍约26x15mm（IM36），与心包分界不清，矢状位示病变可见分叶及毛刺，邻近叶间胸膜增厚
text_en: The irregular soft tissue nodule in the medial segment of the right middle lobe is similar to prior, still measuring approximately 26x15 mm (IM36), with indistinct demarcation from the pericardium; sagittal images show lobulation and spiculation, with adjacent interlobar pleural thickening.

source_text: 左肺上叶混杂密度小结节大致同前，现仍约10x8mm（IM26），边缘密度略高中央呈低密度同前
text_en: The mixed density small nodule in the left upper lobe is roughly unchanged, still approximately 10x8 mm (IM26), with slightly higher density at the margins and central low density unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔内淋巴结较前稍缩小
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes slightly decreased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 左肺上叶支气管分支截断，局部软组织团块缩小，原约51x50mm（IM29），现约43x42mm（IM30），包绕肺门血管同前，远端肺内片絮影
text_en: Left upper lobe bronchial branch cutoff, local soft tissue mass reduced in size, previously approximately 51x50 mm (IM29), now approximately 43x42 mm (IM30), encasing hilar vessels unchanged, patchy opacities in distal lung

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜小结节同前，现约4mm（IM33）
text_en: Small nodule in the left interlobar pleura is stable, now approximately 4 mm (IM33).

source_text: 两肺散在胸膜下结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: Scattered subpleural nodules in both lungs, unchanged from prior; benign appearance favored.

source_text: 纵隔1R、2R、4R及右锁骨上区多发淋巴结缩小，原约13x10mm、22x13mm，现约6x4mm（IM16）、9x7mm（IM17）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal 1R, 2R, 4R stations and right supraclavicular region have decreased in size, previously approximately 13x10 mm and 22x13 mm, now approximately 6x4 mm (IM16) and 9x7 mm (IM17)

source_text: 甲状腺右叶结节同前
text_en: The right thyroid lobe shows a nodule, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，现约4mm(IM42)，余双肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior, currently approximately 4 mm (IM42); no nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 两肺内新见多发小结节较前缩小，密度减低，原较大约7x5mm（IM16），现约5mm（IMA16），较前好转
text_en: Newly seen multiple small nodules in both lungs are smaller than prior and of lower density; the previously largest was about 7x5 mm (IM16), now about 5 mm (IMA16), showing improvement compared to prior.

source_text: 未见新发结节影
text_en: No new nodules

source_text: 肝脏及双侧肾上腺多发占位同前，倾向良性，请结合腹部检查
text_en: Liver and bilateral adrenal glands multiple masses unchanged from prior, favoring benign, recommend correlation with abdominal imaging.

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结大致同前，较大约13x9mm（IM23）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes essentially unchanged from previous, largest approximately 13x9mm (IM23)

source_text: 胃小弯散在小淋巴结较前缩小，现约9x5mm者（IM63）者，原约10x7mm（IM62）
text_en: Scattered small lymph nodes along the gastric lesser curvature are smaller compared to prior; currently approximately 9x5 mm (IM63), previously approximately 10x7 mm (IM62).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端可见软组织密度影同前（IM22），平扫边界不清，右肺中叶、下叶及左肺舌叶可见索条影同前，左肺下叶基底段见小结节灶同前，直径约4mm（IM36）
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; soft tissue density adjacent to the bronchial stump is unchanged (IM22), with ill-defined margins on non-contrast imaging. Linear opacities in the right middle lobe, right lower lobe, and left lingular segment are stable. A small nodule in the basal segment of the left lower lobe remains unchanged, measuring approximately 4 mm in diameter (IM36).

source_text: 右肺斑片索条结节影同前（IMA14-16、52）
text_en: Patchy, linear, and nodular opacities in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior (IMA14-16, 52).

source_text: 右肺上叶斜裂胸膜与水平裂交界处上方分叶状软组织肿块较前缩小，原约26x20mm，现约22x15mm（Im21），邻近胸膜可见牵拉
text_en: The lobulated soft tissue mass at the upper aspect of the intersection between the oblique and horizontal fissures in the right upper lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 26x20 mm, now approximately 22x15 mm (Im21); adjacent pleural retraction is visible.

source_text: 纵隔6组肿大淋巴结缩小，现15x8mm（IM17),原17x12mm(IM17),余纵隔小淋巴结同前
text_en: Enlarged mediastinal station 6 lymph nodes reduced in size, currently 15x8 mm (Image 17), previously 17x12 mm (Image 17), other small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged

source_text: 未新增
text_en: no new lesions

source_text: 右肺中叶磨玻璃结节大致同前，建议定期追查鉴别恶性与炎性
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the right middle lobe is largely unchanged; regular follow-up is recommended to differentiate between malignant and inflammatory etiologies.

source_text: 左肺结节同前，追查
text_en: Left pulmonary nodule unchanged from prior, further investigation.

source_text: 右肺下叶后基底段不规则磨玻璃密度小结节同前，边缘毛糙，仍约9x8mm（IM34），建议继续密切随访观察
text_en: An irregular ground-glass opacity small nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged, with irregular margins, still approximately 9x8 mm (IM34); continued close follow-up observation is recommended.

source_text: 右侧水平裂旁类结节灶较前缩小，原约11x7mm（IM39），现约8x4mm（IM37）
text_en: Nodule-like focus adjacent to the right horizontal fissure is smaller than before, previously measuring approximately 11x7 mm (IM39), now approximately 8x4 mm (IM37).

source_text: 两肺索条钙化灶同前，两肺小结节影同前（IM30、47），较大约5mm
text_en: Calcified linear opacities in both lungs are stable; small nodules in both lungs are stable (IM30, 47), the largest measuring approximately 5 mm.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前（IM49）
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior (IM49)

source_text: 左肺散在磨玻璃密度小结节同前（IM21、23），较大者约6x5mm（IM19）
text_en: Scattered ground-glass nodules in the left lung unchanged from previous (IM21, 23), larger one approximately 6x5mm (IM19)

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节稍显增大，现约13x10mm（IM14），原约10x8mm(IM13)
text_en: Nodule with ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe shows slight increase in size, currently approximately 13x10 mm (IM14), previously approximately 10x8 mm (IM13).

source_text: 右肺中叶淡片结节、右肺下叶模糊浅淡片影并少许胸膜下索条影同前，复查
text_en: Faint patchy nodule in the right middle lobe and indistinct faint patchy opacity in the right lower lobe with a small subpleural linear shadow, unchanged; follow-up

source_text: 右肺中叶模糊小结节大致同前（IM28）
text_en: Faint small nodule in the right middle lobe is essentially unchanged (IM28).

source_text: 右侧胸膜结节样略厚同前，双侧胸腔未见积液
text_en: The slightly thickened nodular right pleura is unchanged from prior. No pleural effusion is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 左肺上叶钙化灶同前，左肺多发胸膜下微小结节同前，约2-3mm（IM9、18、42），部分钙化
text_en: Calcified focus in the left upper lobe stable; multiple subpleural micronodules in the left lung stable, approximately 2-3 mm (IM9, 18, 42), some calcified.

source_text: 原右肺下叶胸膜下斑片影较前相仿，双肺未见新生结节灶
text_en: The previously noted subpleural patchy opacity in the right lower lobe is similar to prior. No new nodules are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下小结节较前略增大，原约12x7mm（IM27），现约13x8mm（IM27），与胸膜粘连同前
text_en: The subpleural small nodule in the left lower lobe is slightly larger than prior, previously approximately 12 x 7 mm (IM27), now approximately 13 x 8 mm (IM27), with stable pleural adhesion

source_text: 左侧肾上腺结节样增粗大致同前
text_en: Left adrenal nodular thickening remains largely unchanged.

source_text: 双下肺微结节同前相仿
text_en: Scattered micro-nodules in the bilateral lower lungs are similar to prior.

source_text: 其上方长椭圆形淋巴结同前（Im5）
text_en: The elongated oval lymph node above it is stable (Im5).

source_text: 胃小弯侧多发小淋巴结略缩小，较大原约9x6mm（IM56），现约6x5mm(IM55)
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes at the lesser curvature of the stomach are slightly smaller than prior. The largest previously measured approximately 9x6mm (IM56), now approximately 6x5mm (IM55).

source_text: 锁骨上、腋下淋巴结部分较前稍缩小，如现约9x7mm者（IM16），原约10x10mm（IM16）
text_en: Some supraclavicular and axillary lymph nodes have slightly decreased in size compared to previous, for example, one currently approximately 9x7 mm (IM16), previously approximately 10x10 mm (IM16)

source_text: 余胸廓骨质未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: The remaining thoracic bones show no signs of osseous destruction.

source_text: 右下肺模糊小结节同前，追查
text_en: The indistinct small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior; recommended for follow-up.

source_text: 左肺下叶索条影、两肺散在模糊小结节灶大小及范围同前相仿，较大仍约8x6mm（薄层IM78）
text_en: Left lower lobe linear opacities and scattered indistinct small nodular opacities in both lungs, size and extent similar to prior; largest still approximately 8x6 mm (thin-section IM78).

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，左肺下叶背段模糊小结节灶同前，仍约8mm（IMA31）
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. The hazy small nodule in the left lower lobe posterior segment is stable, still measuring approximately 8 mm (IMA31).

source_text: 左肺下叶结节影同前，仍约5mm（IM46、47）
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged, still approximately 5mm on images 46 and 47.

source_text: 纵隔6组小淋巴结同前，仍约9x7mm（IM22）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in mediastinal station 6 are unchanged from prior, remaining approximately 9x7 mm (IM22).

source_text: 扫及双肾上腺及左肾周脂肪见占位较前略缩小，左肾上腺较大者原约49x39mm，现约39x37mm（IM59）
text_en: CT shows a mass in the bilateral adrenal glands and left perirenal fat, slightly smaller than prior. The larger left adrenal mass measures approximately 39x37 mm (IM59), previously 49x39 mm.

source_text: 右肺和左肺下叶散在小结节，同前相仿，结合临床随诊
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right lung and left lower lobe are similar to prior; correlate clinically and follow up.

source_text: 左乳结节大致同前（IM30）
text_en: The nodule in the left breast is largely unchanged compared to prior (IM30).

source_text: 左肺下叶背段支气管狭窄截断同前，局部软组织肿块较前缩小，现约23x15mm（IM31纵隔窗），原约26x24mm（IM31纵隔窗）
text_en: Bronchial stenosis and cutoff in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe, unchanged from previous, with a local soft tissue mass decreased in size, currently approximately 23x15 mm (IM31 mediastinal window), previously approximately 26x24 mm (IM31 mediastinal window).

source_text: 双肺野未见新发结节
text_en: No new nodules are seen in the lung fields.

source_text: 双肺模糊小结节影同前(IM51、106）
text_en: Faint small nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged (IM51, 106).

source_text: 双肺散在小结节同前相仿，良性可能大
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior; benign etiology is likely.

source_text: 右锁骨上区、纵隔小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region and mediastinum are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶结节影同前，仍约5mm（IM45、47），追查
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged, still approximately 5 mm (images 45 and 47), follow-up.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，右肺下叶背段见一磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，现大小约8x7mm（IMA22），边界清楚，内部可见血管穿行，未见实性成分
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Lung parenchymal lucency is uniform. A ground-glass opacity in the dorsal segment of the right lower lobe is similar to prior, now measuring approximately 8x7 mm (IMA22), with clear boundaries. Vessels are seen traversing through it, and no solid component is identified.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺右叶低密度结节同前（IM7）
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right thyroid lobe, unchanged from prior (IM7).

source_text: 余肺未见新增结节、斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 双肺散发小结节同前，较大仍约6mm（IM28）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged. The largest remains approximately 6 mm (IM28).

source_text: 左锁骨上及纵隔小淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Left supraclavicular and mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged from previous, less than 10mm.

source_text: 左肺肺内透亮度均匀，未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Left lung parenchyma uniform lucency, no new nodules or consolidation seen.

source_text: 余肺未见新增结节灶及实变影
text_en: The remainder of the lungs shows no new nodules or consolidation.

source_text: 右肺上叶及中叶散在微小结节同前
text_en: Scattered tiny nodules in the right upper and middle lobes are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 肺内局限性肺气肿及局限性索条影大致同前，未见肺内明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: Focal emphysema and focal linear opacities within the lung essentially unchanged, no obvious new nodules or consolidations within the lung

source_text: 纵隔高密度金属夹同前，纵隔内小淋巴结同前，约7mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal high-density metal clip unchanged, mediastinal small lymph node unchanged, approximately 7 mm (IM20)

source_text: 左肺下叶偏上方结节同前，现约3mm（IM41）
text_en: Left lower lobe superior aspect nodule stable compared to previous, now approximately 3mm (Image 41)

source_text: 双肺下叶小结节同前，较大约3mm（IM49），形态欠规整
text_en: Small nodules in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior, largest approximately 3 mm (IM49), morphology irregular.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段不规则小结节同前，约8mm（IM31）
text_en: Irregular small nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged, approximately 8mm (IM31).

source_text: 纵隔7组及左肺门淋巴结同前，较大约12x12mm（IM25）
text_en: Lymph nodes at mediastinal station 7 and left hilar unchanged from prior, largest approximately 12x12 mm (IM25).

source_text: 纵隔3p淋巴结消失，纵膈4R淋巴结较前略增大，现约16*12mm（IM27），原约18*9mm(图24)
text_en: Mediastinal station 3p lymph node has disappeared; mediastinal station 4R lymph node is slightly increased compared to previous, currently approximately 16x12 mm (IM27), previously approximately 18x9 mm (Figure 24).

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下不规则小结节较前同前（IM32），右肺索条同前，余肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: Irregular small subpleural nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (IM32), linear opacities in the right lung unchanged, no nodules or consolidation in the remaining lung

source_text: 右肺下叶膈上小结节同前，现约9mm（Im47）
text_en: Small nodule above the diaphragm in the right lower lobe is stable, now approximately 9 mm (Im47).

source_text: 左肺上叶斑片灶同前，其后下方磨玻璃结节较前增大，原约7x4mm（IM23）者，现约9x7mm（IM25）
text_en: Patchy opacity in the left upper lobe unchanged; ground-glass nodule posterior-inferior to it increased in size compared to previous, from approximately 7x4 mm (IM23) to approximately 9x7 mm (IM25).

source_text: 右肺上叶小斑片结节影同前（IMA8、24），双肺索条影同前，两肺未见新增结节及实变影
text_en: Small patchy nodular opacities in the right upper lobe are unchanged (IMA8, 24). Linear bands in both lungs are unchanged. No new nodules or consolidations are seen in either lung.

source_text: 右肺尖及右肺下叶少许点状小结节大致同前，仍约3mm（IM18、21、44、46、55）
text_en: The few punctate small nodules at the right lung apex and right lower lobe are essentially unchanged, still measuring approximately 3 mm (IM18, 21, 44, 46, 55).

source_text: 两肺结节同前相仿，较大者仍约15x12mm（IM55）
text_en: Nodules in both lungs are similar to prior; the largest remains approximately 15x12 mm (IM55).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，约9x7mm（IM13）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment, similar to prior, approximately 9x7 mm (IM13).

source_text: 余双肺胸膜下小结节大致同前，倾向良性，追查
text_en: The remaining small subpleural nodules in both lungs are largely unchanged, likely benign; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 胸椎多个椎体致密结节同前
text_en: Dense nodules in multiple thoracic vertebral bodies, same as before.

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节较前相仿，约6mm（IMA27），密度较前稍增高
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule similar to prior, approximately 6 mm (IMA27), density slightly increased compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R组及右肺门新见肿大淋巴结，较大者约32x20mm（IMA21）
text_en: Newly enlarged lymph nodes at mediastinal stations 2R, 4R, and right hilum, largest approximately 32x20 mm (IMA21).

source_text: 右上肺少许索条影较前相仿，余肺内散在小结节同前（IM18,28）
text_en: Few linear opacities in the right upper lobe are similar to prior; scattered small nodules elsewhere in the lungs are unchanged (IM18, 28).

source_text: 右肺下叶后基底段不规则磨玻璃密度小结节较前增大，边缘毛糙，原约9x8mm（IM37），现约11x9mm（IM36）
text_en: An irregular ground-glass opacity small nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is larger than before, with irregular margins, previously approximately 9x8 mm (IM37), now approximately 11x9 mm (IM36).

source_text: 左肺下叶外基底段胸膜下小结节同前，约5mm（IM29），密切追查
text_en: Left lower lobe lateral basal segment subpleural small nodule unchanged, approximately 5mm (IM29), close follow-up

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段胸膜下浅淡模糊小结节灶同前，约4mm（IM56）
text_en: The faint, ill-defined small subpleural nodule in the lateral basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM56).

source_text: 纵隔4R、7组淋巴结区见边界模糊稍高密度影大致同前，较大仍约22x17mm（IM31），请结合临床
text_en: In mediastinal stations 4R and 7 lymph node regions, an ill-defined slightly hyperdense opacity is present, largely unchanged from prior; the largest remains approximately 22x17 mm (IM31), please correlate with clinical findings.

source_text: 左锁骨上区浅淡小淋巴结同前，仍约6x5mm（IM3）
text_en: Left supraclavicular faint small lymph node unchanged, still approximately 6x5 mm (IM3).

source_text: 左肺癌术后，术区周围胸膜增厚同前，支气管残端周围软组织影未见增厚
text_en: After left lung cancer surgery, pleural thickening around the surgical area is similar to previous, no thickening of soft tissue shadow around the bronchial stump.

source_text: 右肺上叶癌较前略缩小
text_en: Right upper lobe carcinoma is slightly smaller than prior.

source_text: 右上叶胸膜下见混杂密度结节同前，约10*7mm（IM26）
text_en: A mixed-density nodule subpleurally in the right upper lobe is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 10x7 mm (IM26).

source_text: 右肺下叶近肺门结节较前似相仿，平扫与肺血管分界不清，远端肺内模糊片影较前相仿，两肺内多发结节较前相仿(IM21、24、28-31、42)
text_en: The nodule near the hilum of the right lower lobe appears similar to prior. On non-contrast imaging, it is indistinct from adjacent pulmonary vessels. The hazy patchy opacity in the distal lung parenchyma is similar to prior. Multiple nodules in both lungs are similar to prior (IM21, 24, 28–31, 42).

source_text: 左肺索条影同前，双肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Left lung fibrotic streaks unchanged, no new nodules or consolidation in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺尖小结节同前相仿，仍约3mm（IM7），余双肺未见新增结节和斑片影
text_en: Left apical segment: small nodule similar to previous, still approximately 3 mm (IM7), remainder of both lungs no new nodules or patchy opacities seen.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，4L组仍约13x10mm（IM25）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, with the 4L station measuring approximately 13x10 mm (IM25).

source_text: 左肺小结节影同前，左肺下叶新见斑片影，请结合临床体征考虑炎症，建议复查
text_en: Left lung small nodule stable compared to prior; new patchy opacity in left lower lobe, consider inflammation in conjunction with clinical findings, recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右肺中叶切除、上叶部分切除术后，支气管残端软组织紊乱大致同前，未见明确肿块
text_en: Status post right middle lobectomy and partial upper lobectomy; soft tissue disorganization at the bronchial stump is essentially unchanged compared to prior, without definite mass.

source_text: 左肺致密小结节影同前（Im37）
text_en: The dense small nodule in the left lung is unchanged (Im37)

source_text: 两肺模糊小结节灶同前相仿（IM38等）
text_en: The hazy small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior (IM38, etc.).

source_text: 纵隔2R、4、7组淋巴结较前相仿，隆突下者约10x6mm（IM26），平扫密度较高
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R, 4, 7 are similar to previous; the subcarinal node is approximately 10x6 mm (IM26) with higher density on non-contrast scan

source_text: 左肺下叶背段胸膜下浅淡小结节影同前
text_en: A subpleural faint small nodule shadow in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged.

source_text: 两肺结节较前缩小，原较大约23*12mm，现较大约15x12mm（IM52）
text_en: Nodules in both lungs are decreased in size compared to prior; the largest previously measured approximately 23x12 mm, now measures approximately 15x12 mm (IM52).

source_text: 右肺下叶切除术后，胸部CT未见新发占位
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; chest CT shows no newly detected space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 右肺上叶见小结节同前（IM19、20）
text_en: Small nodules are seen in the right upper lobe, unchanged (IM19, 20).

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节影同前（IMA14），左肺下叶微小结节未见明确显示
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule same as before (IMA14), left lower lobe tiny nodule not clearly visible.

source_text: 右肺下叶后基底段外周近胸膜处结节同前，呈环形稍高密度，大小约10x9mm（IM35），与胸膜粘连
text_en: The nodule in the peripheral posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe near the pleura remains unchanged, showing a ring-like slightly increased density, measuring approximately 10x9 mm (IM35), and is pleurally attached.

source_text: 左肺门结节影同前
text_en: Left hilar nodule unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺多发小结节灶同前（IM13、17）
text_en: Multiple small nodular foci in the right lung are stable compared to prior studies (IM13, 17).

source_text: 余肺散在数枚小结节影大致同前（Im25、38），左肺新见小结节（Im21）
text_en: Scattered several small nodules in the remaining lung are largely stable (Im25, 38). A new small nodule is seen in the left lung (Im21).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段贴叶间胸膜处不规则结节同前，仍约22x18mm（IM14），其内边缘小空泡影同前
text_en: An irregular nodule adjacent to the interlobar pleura in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe is unchanged from prior, still approximately 22x18 mm (IM14), with a small bubble-like opacity at the inner margin unchanged from prior

source_text: 双侧胸膜及叶间胸膜结节样增厚较前相仿，较大原约43x22mm（IM29），现约39x28mm（IM31）
text_en: Bilateral pleural and interlobar septal nodular thickening is similar to prior; the largest was previously approximately 43x22 mm (IM29), now approximately 39x28 mm (IM31).

source_text: 前纵隔结节同前，约11x6mm（IM22），余纵隔内及双侧肺门、腋窝、锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Nodule in the anterior mediastinum is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 11x6 mm (IM22). No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the remainder of the mediastinum or in the bilateral hila, axillae, or supraclavicular regions.

source_text: 左肺下叶少许索条影，另见微小结节同前（IM31）
text_en: Few linear opacities in the left lower lobe, with additional few micro nodules unchanged from prior (IM31)

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下小结节同前相仿（IM30）
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right lower lobe is similar to prior (IM30).

source_text: 左侧气管食管沟见转移淋巴结，较前相仿,大小约12x11mm（IM13）
text_en: A metastatic lymph node is seen in the left tracheoesophageal groove, similar to prior, measuring approximately 12x11 mm (IM13).

source_text: 纵隔内2R微小淋巴结同前
text_en: Tiny lymph nodes in mediastinal station 2R are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔5组淋巴结同前（IMA21）
text_en: Mediastinal station 5 lymph nodes unchanged from previous (IMA21).

source_text: 右下侧胸膜增厚较前加重，结节较前增大，现较大病变厚度约6mm（IM43），右侧见少许胸腔积液
text_en: Right lower lateral pleural thickening worsened compared to prior; nodule increased in size, with the largest lesion now approximately 6 mm in thickness (IM43); small right-sided pleural effusion present.

source_text: 右肺上叶点状浅淡结节影（IMA21）、左肺多发磨玻璃样灶同前，较大约10x8mm（IM20）
text_en: Punctate faint nodular opacity in the right upper lobe (IMA21); multiple ground-glass opacities in the left lung unchanged, largest measuring approximately 10x8 mm (IM20)

source_text: 右肺上叶结节影，双肺微小结节大致同前，建议与旧片比较或复查定性
text_en: Nodule in the right upper lobe; tiny nodules in both lungs are largely unchanged. Comparison with prior images or follow-up is recommended for characterization.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下、右肺水平胸膜新见微小结节，＜5mm（IM27、29）
text_en: Newly seen tiny nodules subpleural in the left lower lobe and at the level of the right lung pleura, less than 5mm (IM27, 29)

source_text: 双肺索条影同前，未见新发结节影
text_en: Linear opacities in both lungs are similar to prior. No new nodules are seen.

source_text: 右肺新发模糊结节，转移
text_en: Newly observed hazy nodule in the right lung, metastasis.

source_text: 胸11椎体转移范围增大，骨水泥疗后
text_en: Increased metastatic extent in T11 vertebra, post bone cement therapy.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜结节同前，现仍约10x9mm（IM30），左侧胸膜光滑，双侧未见胸水征象
text_en: The nodular lesion along the right interlobar pleura is unchanged, currently measuring approximately 10 x 9 mm (IM30). The left pleura is smooth. No pleural effusion is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 左肺上叶多发小结节较前缩小、密度变淡，较大者原约6mm（IM20），现约3mm（IM20），边缘模糊，余双肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left upper lobe have decreased in size and density compared to previous; the larger one was originally approximately 6 mm (IM20) and is now approximately 3 mm (IM20) with ill-defined margins, and no nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 余肺未见新增斑片及结节影
text_en: No new patchy opacities or nodules are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后改变同前，支气管断端未见占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left upper lobe unchanged from previous, no mass effect at the bronchial stump

source_text: 甲状腺右侧叶结节同前
text_en: Nodule in the right thyroid lobe unchanged from prior.

source_text: 扫及肝内低密度结节同前
text_en: An intrahepatic low-density nodule is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔钙化淋巴结同前，未见明显新发肿大淋巴结
text_en: Calcified mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged, no obvious new enlarged lymph nodes seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节同前，仍约5mm（IM24）
text_en: Small nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, still measures approximately 5 mm (IM24).

source_text: 右下肺混合磨玻璃密度结节影大致同前，约22x13mm（IM35）
text_en: The mixed ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged compared to prior imaging, measuring approximately 22 x 13 mm (IM35).

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节影同前（IMA12）
text_en: Right upper lobe small nodule shadow unchanged (IMA12)

source_text: 纵隔4R/4L、5、7区多发淋巴结大致同前，较大约16x8mm（IM26）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R, 4L, 5, and 7 essentially unchanged from previous, largest approximately 16x8 mm (Fig. 26)

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior

source_text: 双肺未见新发结节及片絮影
text_en: No new nodules or flaky opacities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 纵隔4-6组数枚淋巴结同前，较大约11x10mm（IM20）
text_en: Several mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4-6 are stable compared to prior, with the largest measuring approximately 11 x 10 mm (IM20).

source_text: 两肺未见新发结节及片絮影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶前基底段近膈胸膜处小结节同前，仍约4mm（IM43）
text_en: Left lower lobe anterior basal segment small nodule near diaphragmatic pleura same as prior, still approximately 4 mm (IM43).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后改变同前，支气管断端未见软组织增厚及肿块
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left upper lobe unchanged from previous, no soft tissue thickening or mass at the bronchial stump

source_text: 左下肺斑片渗出实变影减少，局部可疑结节较前缩小，原约10x10mm（IM31），现约8x4mm（IM33）
text_en: Patchy exudative consolidation in the left lower lobe has decreased; a focal suspicious nodule has decreased in size, previously approximately 10x10 mm (IM31), now approximately 8x4 mm (IM33).

source_text: 平扫纵隔2R、3A、4-7组、双锁骨上区淋巴结较前缩小，现较大约16x14mm（IM21），原较大约28x20mm（IM20）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R, 3A, 4-7 and bilateral supraclavicular regions smaller than prior; currently approximately 16x14 mm (Image 21), previously approximately 28x20 mm (Image 20).

source_text: 右下肺钙化灶同前，双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Calcified focus in the right lower lobe is unchanged. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 纵隔5-6组淋巴结同前，较大约12x10mm（IM22）
text_en: Mediastinal stations 5-6 lymph nodes are unchanged from previous, largest approximately 12x10 mm (IM22)

source_text: 右叶间裂新发结节，密切追查
text_en: New nodule in the right major fissure; close follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺水平裂结节样增厚同前，倾向良性，随诊
text_en: Nodular thickening along the horizontal fissure of the right lung is unchanged and is considered likely benign; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右上肺索条影及小结节同前，约5x3mm（IM28)，右肺下叶背段条片状灶同前
text_en: Linear opacities and small nodules in the right upper lung are unchanged, measuring approximately 5x3 mm (IM28); linear patchy opacity in the dorsal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged.

source_text: 右下肺微小结节灶同前
text_en: The tiny nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双侧斜裂胸膜小结节同前（Im29、30），追查
text_en: Small nodules in the bilateral oblique fissures are unchanged (Im29, 30); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔隆突下淋巴结较前明显增大，原约35x19mm者现约55x30mm（Im27）
text_en: Subcarinal mediastinal lymph node significantly enlarged compared to previous, previously approximately 35x19 mm, now approximately 55x30 mm (Image 27)

source_text: 双肺磨玻璃密度结节同前
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodules in both lungs are similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶结节同前，约4mm（IM34）
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM34).

source_text: 纵隔、肺门、腋窝及锁骨上多个小淋巴结同前，较大约12*9mm(图19)
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum, hilar regions, axillae, and supraclavicular regions are unchanged from prior, with the largest measuring approximately 12x9 mm (Figure 19)

source_text: 右肺上叶、下叶小结节影同前（IMA20、28、31），较大约6x4mm
text_en: Small nodules in the right upper and lower lobes unchanged (IMA20, 28, 31); largest approximately 6x4 mm.

source_text: 纵隔轻度左移、多发小淋巴结同前，较大者仍约13x8mm（IM19）
text_en: Mild leftward shift of the mediastinum; multiple small lymph nodes, same as before; the largest still approximately 13x8mm (IM19).

source_text: 双肺下叶胸膜下小结节及左侧叶间胸膜结节同前（IM28、30、46、52）
text_en: Subpleural small nodules in both lower lobes and a left interlobar pleural nodule are unchanged compared to prior (IM28, 30, 46, 52).

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结，部分较前增大，如原约14x10mm，现约18x17mm（IM19），追查
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes, some increased in size compared to prior, for example, previously approximately 14x10 mm, now approximately 18x17 mm (IM19), follow-up recommended

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜局限性小结节样增厚同前（IMA26），左侧胸膜见结节状增厚（IM45），内可见脂肪密度
text_en: Focal small nodular thickening of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior (IMA26). Nodular thickening is seen in the left pleura (IM45), containing fat density.

source_text: 食管术后改变，胸部未见复发转移征象
text_en: Post-esophagectomy changes. No evidence of recurrence or metastasis in the chest.

source_text: 右肺下叶少许小结节同前
text_en: Minimal small nodules in the right lower lobe stable compared to prior.

source_text: 余肺散在少许2-4mm微小结节同前
text_en: Scattered tiny nodules measuring 2-4 mm in the remaining lung are stable.

source_text: 右侧胸膜不均匀增厚，多发胸膜结节较前增大，右肺下叶近膈处小结节原约7x6mm（IM49），现约15x14mm（IM47），考虑胸膜转移
text_en: Irregular thickening of the right pleura and multiple pleural nodules are larger than prior. The small nodule near the diaphragm in the right lower lobe has increased from approximately 7x6 mm (IM49) to 15x14 mm (IM47). Pleural metastasis is considered.

source_text: 贲门右淋巴结同前，仍约11x7mm（IM54）
text_en: The right cardial lymph node is unchanged, still approximately 11x7 mm (IM54).

source_text: 纵隔4-7、10R组多发淋巴结大致同前，较大者仍约15x10mm（IMA29）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4-7 and 10R are largely stable compared to prior, with the largest still measuring approximately 15 x 10 mm (IMA29).

source_text: 纵隔4L、7组见淋巴结同前，较大约14x8mm（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4L and 7 are unchanged from prior, with the larger one measuring approximately 14x8 mm (IM21).

source_text: 右肺索条、结节影同前，右侧叶间胸膜略增厚同前
text_en: Linear opacities and nodular shadow in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior; slight thickening of the right interlobar pleura remains unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃结节灶较前相仿，约16x14mm（IM26）
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the right lower lobe dorsal segment is similar to prior, approximately 16x14 mm (IM26).

source_text: 肺内多发微小结节同前多数同前，部分略缩小
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules within the lung, majority unchanged from prior, some slightly decreased in size.

source_text: T12椎体下缘退行性变高密度同前，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: Degenerative high-density change at the inferior margin of the T12 vertebral body is unchanged; no osseous destruction is seen in the remainder of the imaged bones.

source_text: 纵隔2-7组及双锁骨上区小淋巴结同前，较大约8mm（IM22）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in mediastinal groups 2-7 and bilateral supraclavicular regions unchanged from prior, largest approximately 8mm (IM22).

source_text: 胸中段食管癌疗后，大致同前
text_en: Post-treatment mid-thoracic esophageal carcinoma, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶浅淡小结节同前，约3mm（IM36），追查
text_en: The faint small nodule in the right lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM36); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 胸主动脉旁软组织灶，倾向转移，追查
text_en: Paraaortic soft tissue focus, suggestive of metastasis, requires further evaluation.

source_text: 双肺多发磨玻璃密度淡片及类结节影同前，较大仍约8mm（Im16），双下肺多发小结节同前，较大仍约2mm（Im21）
text_en: Multiple ground-glass density faint patches and nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged; the largest remains approximately 8 mm (Im16); multiple small nodules in the lower lungs are unchanged, the largest still approximately 2 mm (Im21).

source_text: 右上肺术后，残端混杂密度同前，平扫未见肿块
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lung; mixed density at the stump is unchanged; no mass is seen on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 左肺散在、多发小结节较前增大，密度增高，较大原约10x9mm(IM20)，现约14x11mm（IM22）
text_en: Left lung scattered, multiple small nodules increased in size and density compared to previous; largest previously approximately 10x9 mm (IM20), now approximately 14x11 mm (IM22).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段支气管旁不规则结节较前缩小，原约31x23mm，现约21x12mm（IM24），边缘毛糙，远端肺内见片絮影同前
text_en: The irregular peribronchial nodule in the left upper lobe anterior segment has decreased in size from approximately 31x23 mm to 21x12 mm (IM24), with irregular margins; fluffy opacities in the distal lung parenchyma remain unchanged.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，右肺下叶微小结节及条片影同前相仿，小结节仍约4mm（IMA46），左肺下叶钙化结节同前
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, micronodules and linear opacities in the right lower lobe similar to prior, the micronodule still approximately 4 mm (IMA46), calcified nodule in the left lower lobe similar to prior.

source_text: 右上肺术后，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lung; no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis are seen.

source_text: 右侧第6肋骨局部骨折骨痂形成中（Im24），余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Callus formation in progress at the site of right 6th rib fracture (Im24). No evidence of osseous destruction in the other bones of the thorax.

source_text: 余扫描所及诸骨未见新发骨破坏灶
text_en: No new bone destruction foci are seen in the imaged bones.

source_text: 右下胸膜结节较前缩小
text_en: Pleural nodule in the right lower region has decreased in size compared to prior examination.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结增大同前，随访复查
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are enlarged, stable compared to prior; follow-up recommended

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段实性-磨玻璃密度结节，实性成分范围仍约13x12mm（薄层IM54），整体范围较前略显增大，原约24x19mm，现约26x20mm（薄层IM53），结合临床或密切追查
text_en: Solid–ground-glass density nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe; the solid component remains approximately 13 × 12 mm (thin-slice IM54), and the overall size has slightly increased from approximately 24 × 19 mm to 26 × 20 mm (thin-slice IM53); correlate clinically or continue close follow-up.

source_text: 左肺未见新发结节影
text_en: No new nodules in the left lung.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，肺内透亮度欠均匀，右肺上叶尖段类圆形浅淡密度结节同前，仍约6mm（IM9），右肺上叶尖段胸膜下多发索条影同前，余未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. Pulmonary lucency is somewhat heterogeneous. A round, faintly dense nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged, still measuring approximately 6 mm (IM9). Multiple linear opacities subpleurally in the apical segment of the right upper lobe are unchanged. No new nodules or consolidations are seen elsewhere.

source_text: 右侧水平裂旁可见类结节灶较前增大，原约8x3mm（IM43），现约11x7mm（IM38）
text_en: Nodule-like focus adjacent to the right horizontal fissure is larger than before, previously measuring approximately 8x3 mm (IM43), now approximately 11x7 mm (IM38).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段浅淡磨玻璃密度结节同前，约3mm（IM16）
text_en: A faint ground-glass opacity nodule in the left upper lobe anterior segment, approximately 3 mm, is unchanged (IM16).

source_text: 两肺上叶微小结节影同前（IMA20），两肺下叶索条影同前
text_en: Micronodules in both upper lobes are unchanged from prior (IMA20). Linear opacities in both lower lobes are unchanged.

source_text: 食管术后，纵隔淋巴结较前增大，考虑转移可能性大，建议进一步检查
text_en: Post-esophagectomy, mediastinal lymph nodes have increased in size compared to prior, suspicious for metastasis; further evaluation is recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶结节疗后，较前缩小
text_en: Post-treatment nodule in the left upper lobe, decreased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 双肺结节部分同前，部分较前饱满，转移待排，建议密切追查
text_en: Some bilateral pulmonary nodules are stable, while others appear more prominent. Metastasis cannot be excluded; close follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜结节同前（IM40）
text_en: The nodular lesion along the right interlobar pleura is unchanged (IM40).

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下多发微小点灶及陈旧钙化小结节同前
text_en: Multiple tiny punctate foci and old calcified small nodules subpleural in the left upper lobe, stable compared to prior

source_text: 右肺散在小结节同前，如右肺上叶者仍约4mm（矢状位IM16）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior, such as the one in the right upper lobe which remains approximately 4 mm (sagittal IM16).

source_text: 右肺微小结节及磨玻璃密度影同前，建议复查
text_en: Right lung tiny nodules and ground-glass opacities unchanged; follow-up recommended

source_text: 余双肺磨玻璃密度小结节同前
text_en: The ground-glass density small nodules in the remainder of both lungs are stable.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，未见新增结节及实变影
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. No new nodules or consolidation are seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段软组织结节较前缩小，现约16x11mm（IM18)，原约21x19mm（IM18），与纵隔胸膜分界不清同前
text_en: The soft tissue nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe has decreased in size, now measuring approximately 16x11 mm (IM18), previously 21x19 mm (IM18); the indistinct boundary with the mediastinal pleura remains unchanged.

source_text: T1、12骨质破坏，考虑转移，伴T12椎体轻度压缩性骨折可能
text_en: Osseous destruction in T1 and T12 is present, suggestive of metastasis, with possible mild compressive fracture of the T12 vertebral body.

source_text: 扫及腰1椎体楔形变并部分胸12椎体融合同前，余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: CT scan shows wedge deformity of the L1 vertebral body with partial fusion of the T12 vertebral body, stable compared to prior, with no signs of bone destruction in the remaining bones of the thorax.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段分叶状肿物较前缩小，原约41x36mm（IM8），现约35x29mm（IM8）
text_en: Lobulated mass in the right upper lobe apical segment decreased in size, previously approximately 41x36 mm (IM8), now approximately 35x29 mm (IM8)

source_text: 前纵隔占位术后，条片状低密度影及术区积液大致同前，较厚处约13mm（IMA20）
text_en: Status post resection of an anterior mediastinal mass; linear and band-like low-density shadows and fluid collection at the surgical site are essentially unchanged, with the thickest portion measuring approximately 13 mm (IMA20).

source_text: 右肺上中叶及左肺下叶索条影同前，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Linear opacities in the right upper and middle lobes and left lower lobe unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities seen.

source_text: 左侧斜裂微小结节同前（IM17），余双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Tiny nodule in the left oblique fissure is unchanged (IM17); otherwise, no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左肺舌叶见索条影，余双肺未见新发结节或斑片影
text_en: Left lung lingula: linear opacity present; no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remainder of both lungs

source_text: 左下肺散在索条影同前，余肺内未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Scattered linear opacities in the left lower lobe are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen elsewhere in the lungs.

source_text: 右肺未见新发结节影
text_en: No new nodular opacities in the right lung.

source_text: 扫及肝内多发低密度及高强化结节同前
text_en: Multiple intrahepatic low-density and hyperenhancing nodules are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 扫及廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: No evidence of bone destruction in the thoracic cage bones.

source_text: 右肺上叶3mm微小结节同前（IM12）
text_en: 3 mm tiny nodule in the right upper lobe unchanged (IM12).

source_text: 纵隔6组淋巴结同前，仍约10x7mm（IM18），追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 6 lymph nodes unchanged, still approximately 10x7 mm (IM18), requires follow-up.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，左肺下叶背段胸膜下微小结节大致同前，小于5mm（IM31）
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. The subpleural tiny nodule in the left lower lobe posterior segment is largely unchanged, measuring less than 5 mm (IM31).

source_text: 未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation

source_text: 前纵隔主动脉弓前方不规则含脂肪肿物较前增大，原约79x39mm(IM14)，现约115x80mm（IM15），内实性成分较前增大，其前方与胸骨之间软组织密度肿块亦较前略增大，原约47x34mm(IM18)，现约60x32mm（IM20）
text_en: Irregular fat-containing mass in the anterior mediastinum anterior to the aortic arch has increased in size, previously approximately 79x39 mm (IM14), now approximately 115x80 mm (IM15); the solid component within is larger than before. Additionally, a soft tissue density mass between the anterior aspect of this lesion and the sternum has also slightly increased in size, previously approximately 47x34 mm (IM18), now approximately 60x32 mm (IM20).

source_text: 双肺小结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are stable compared to prior, favoring benign etiology

source_text: 左上肺微结节同前，约3mm(IM22)
text_en: The small nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM22).

source_text: 隆突下软组织样密度影较前减少，纵隔及肺门未见明显肿大淋巴结
text_en: Subcarinal soft tissue density shadow is reduced compared to previous; no significantly enlarged lymph nodes in the mediastinum or hilar regions.

source_text: 双肺散在胸膜下浅淡斑片索条影同前相仿，未见新增结节灶
text_en: Scattered faint subpleural patchy and linear opacities in both lungs are similar to prior. No new nodules are seen.

source_text: 食管癌术后，右肺炎性病变较前好转，建议结合临床，追查
text_en: Postoperative esophageal cancer; right lung inflammatory lesion improved compared to prior; recommend clinical correlation and follow-up.

source_text: 右肺上叶类圆形小结节同前，约2mm（Im11、23）
text_en: Small, round-like nodule in the right upper lobe unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 2 mm (IM11, 23).

source_text: 两肺下叶索条影同前，双肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Linear opacities in both lower lobes are unchanged. No new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节影同前（IMA56）
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged (Image A56)

source_text: 右肺尖胸膜下结节同前，约4mm（IM14）
text_en: The subpleural nodule in the right lung apex is unchanged, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM14).

source_text: 前中纵隔结节同前相仿，考虑胸腺瘤可能大
text_en: The nodule in the anterior-middle mediastinum is similar to prior; thymoma is most likely.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R组度淋巴结同前大致同前（IM16、18）
text_en: Lymph nodes at mediastinal stations 2R and 4R are stable (IM16, 18).

source_text: 右腋下淋巴结较前缩小，现最大短径小于5mm（IM12）
text_en: Right axillary lymph node decreased in size compared to prior, current maximum short diameter less than 5 mm (IM12).

source_text: 两肺散在模糊结节、磨玻璃灶及淡片影部分多数同前，少部分略显增大，如左下肺磨玻璃结节原约7*5mm（IMA32），现约9*6mm（IMA32）
text_en: Scattered indistinct nodules, ground-glass opacities, and faint patchy opacities in both lungs, majority unchanged; a minority slightly increased in size, such as the ground-glass nodule in the left lower lobe, previously approximately 7x5 mm (IMA32), now approximately 9x6 mm (IMA32).

source_text: 左肺下叶模糊结节影同前，约3mm（IM43、45）
text_en: Left lower lobe hazy nodule shadow unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IM43, 45)

source_text: 叶间胸膜新发结节，考虑胸膜转移
text_en: New nodules along the interlobar pleura, suggestive of pleural metastasis

source_text: 右后胸膜明显不规则增厚较前减轻，原较厚处约22mm（IM22），现约28mm（IM20），内部出现空洞
text_en: The marked irregular thickening of the right posterior pleura has decreased compared to prior; the previously thickest portion was approximately 22 mm (IM22), now approximately 28 mm (IM20), with new development of an internal cavity.

source_text: 余双肺散在转移结节，较前增大、增多，如现约24x17mm（IM22），原约12x6mm
text_en: Residual scattered metastatic nodules in both lungs are larger and more numerous compared to prior; for example, one now measures approximately 24x17 mm (IM22), previously 12x6 mm

source_text: 右肺上叶结节影同前相仿（IM25），恶性难除外，密切追查
text_en: The nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior imaging (IM25); malignancy cannot be excluded; close follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 余肺内未见新发异常密度区及结节灶
text_en: No new abnormal densities or nodules are seen in the remaining lung parenchyma.

source_text: 双肺见多发小结节同前，大部分位于胸膜下，小于5mm，部分可见钙化
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable, most located subpleurally, less than 5 mm in size; some show calcification.

source_text: 甲状腺低密度结节大致同前，建议超声检查
text_en: Thyroid hypodense nodule essentially stable compared to prior. Recommend ultrasound examination.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，右肺上叶后段近斜裂胸膜处高密度斑片影及点状钙化同前（IMA22），右下肺底微小结节同前，约5x3mm（IMA51）
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Lung parenchymal lucency is uniform. A high-density patchy opacity and punctate calcification near the oblique fissure in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe are stable (IMA22). A tiny nodule in the right lower lobe base is stable, measuring approximately 5x3 mm (IMA51).

source_text: 部分增大，原约15x8mm者，现约18x13mm（IM32）
text_en: Some increased in size, previously approximately 15x8 mm, now approximately 18x13 mm (image 32).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段4mm小结节同前（IM21）
text_en: A 4 mm small nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment is stable compared to prior (IM21).

source_text: 双肺间质纤维化及散在少许小结节同前，左肺下叶结节约5mm（Im37），同前，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Pulmonary interstitial fibrosis and scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior; a nodule in the left lower lobe measures about 5 mm (Im37), unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前缩小
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are smaller compared to prior

source_text: 左侧胸膜结节状不规则增厚同前（IMA30），未见胸水征象
text_en: Left pleural nodular irregular thickening is unchanged (IMA30); no signs of pleural effusion

source_text: 左侧锁骨上淋巴结同前，不足5mm
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node unchanged, less than 5 mm

source_text: 左肺上叶斑片灶及其下方磨玻璃结节，较前增大，倾向腺癌
text_en: Patchy opacity in the left upper lobe and ground-glass nodule below it increased in size compared to previous, favoring adenocarcinoma.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前相仿，较大仍约14x9mm（IM27）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior; the largest measures approximately 14x9 mm (IM27)

source_text: 左侧第5肋骨质破坏范围较前增大（IM22）
text_en: The extent of osseous destruction at the left fifth rib is increased compared to prior (IM22).

source_text: 肝脏结节灶同前，请结合腹部CT检查
text_en: Liver nodule unchanged from prior, recommend correlation with abdominal CT.

source_text: 左肺下叶结节影同前，仍约5mm（IM45、44），追查
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged, still approximately 5 mm (IM45 and IM44), follow-up.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变，胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; no new space-occupying lesions are seen in the chest.

source_text: 胸12椎体类圆形结节样密度增高同前，余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏
text_en: T12 vertebral body demonstrates a round/oval nodular area of increased density, stable compared to prior. No bone destruction identified in the remaining thoracic bones.

source_text: 扫及肝内多发低密度结节同前
text_en: Multiple intrahepatic low-density nodules are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔及左肺门淋巴结同前，较大仍约11x6mm（IM27）
text_en: Mediastinal and left hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest still approximately 11x6 mm (IM27)

source_text: 右肺上叶结节影同前（IM26），追查
text_en: The nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior imaging (IM26); further investigation is recommended.

source_text: 右肺中叶支气管不规则变窄、中断，中叶体积缩小，楔状实变影范围较前增大，现约53x47mm（IM31），原约47x33mm（IMA34），内肿块边界不清
text_en: Irregular narrowing and interruption of the right middle lobe bronchus, with volume loss of the middle lobe. The wedge-shaped area of consolidation has increased in extent compared to prior, now measuring approximately 53 x 47 mm (IM31), previously 47 x 33 mm (IMA34). The internal mass has ill-defined margins.

source_text: 右肺上叶部分切除术后，金属缝线局部未见占位征象，少许索条影同前
text_en: Status post partial resection of the right upper lobe. No space-occupying lesion is seen at the site of metallic suture clips. Minimal linear opacities are stable.

source_text: 双肺气肿同前，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Pulmonary emphysema is unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜结节同前
text_en: Nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶微、小结节同前
text_en: Micro and small nodules in left lower lobe unchanged from prior

source_text: 右肺上叶、左肺下叶微小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Micronodules in the right upper lobe and left lower lobe are unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃样灶同前（Im12），肺内散在微小结节及浅淡模糊小片影同前（Im23、28、38等）
text_en: Left upper lobe ground-glass opacity focus unchanged from previous (image 12), scattered small nodules and faint hazy patchy shadows within the lung unchanged from previous (images 23, 28, 38, etc.).

source_text: 双肺下叶多发点状微小结节同前（IM27、42），均小于5mm
text_en: Multiple punctate tiny nodules in both lower lobes are stable compared to prior (IM27, 42), all measuring less than 5 mm.

source_text: 左侧肾上腺转移结节增大，右肾上腺略饱满，请追查
text_en: Left adrenal metastatic nodule increased in size; right adrenal gland slightly prominent; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 左上纵隔颈总动脉旁结节同前，现仍约5x4mm（IM11）
text_en: A nodule adjacent to the left common carotid artery in the left upper mediastinum is stable compared to prior, currently still approximately 5 x 4 mm (IM11).

source_text: 左肺下叶磨玻璃密度结节同前，仍约7x5mm(IM33)，性质待定，追查
text_en: Left lower lobe ground-glass density nodule unchanged, still approximately 7x5 mm (IM33), nature indeterminate, follow-up recommended

source_text: 纵隔4-7组及双肺门淋巴结同前，较大仍约13x10mm（IM33）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4-7 and bilateral hilar lymph nodes are stable compared to prior, with the largest still measuring approximately 13 x 10 mm (IM33).

source_text: 右下肺间质纤维环并感染大致同前，余肺内未见明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: Interstitial fibrosis with infection in the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged. No obvious new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺胸膜下小结节同前，约6mm（IM18）
text_en: Left lung subpleural small nodule unchanged from previous, approximately 6mm (IM18).

source_text: 左肺下叶结节同前，仍约13x11mm(IM36)，左肺多发索条影同前
text_en: Left lower lobe nodule unchanged from previous, still approximately 13x11 mm (IM36); multiple linear opacities in left lung unchanged from previous.

source_text: 双肺下叶小结节同前（IM35、40、45），较大约4mm（IM35）
text_en: Small nodules in both lower lobes are stable compared to prior (IM35, 40, 45), the largest measuring approximately 4 mm (IM35).

source_text: 双肺胸膜下多个结节同前（IM27、28、39、43、47），较大者位于右肺下叶，大小仍约6x4mm（IM39）
text_en: Multiple subpleural nodules in both lungs remain unchanged (IM27, 28, 39, 43, 47), the largest located in the right lower lobe, still measuring approximately 6x4 mm (IM39).

source_text: 右肺两枚结节此次扫描未见显示，双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Two nodules in the right lung are not visible on this scan; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 甲状腺右叶低密度结节同前相仿（IM8）
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right lobe of the thyroid gland similar to prior (IM8).

source_text: 左肺下叶胸主动脉旁微小结节同前(图31)
text_en: A tiny nodule adjacent to the thoracic aorta in the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior (Figure 31).

source_text: 腔静脉后淋巴结同前，约15*9mm（IMA21）
text_en: Posterior to the vena cava, a lymph node is unchanged, measuring approximately 15x9 mm (IMA21).

source_text: 双上叶模糊结节同前（IM12、13、17、29）
text_en: The indistinct nodules in both upper lobes are unchanged (IM12, 13, 17, 29).

source_text: 前纵隔软组织肿块略增大，原约43x23mm，现约43x31mm（IMA17）
text_en: The soft tissue mass in the anterior mediastinum is slightly larger, previously approximately 43x23 mm, now approximately 43x31 mm (IMA17).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃小结节同前，仍约7mm（IM17），邻近胸膜受牵拉，追查
text_en: The small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged, still approximately 7 mm (Image 17), with adjacent pleural retraction; further evaluation is recommended.

source_text: 左肺门见淋巴结，与[DATE]胸部CT比较，较前相仿，约9*9mm（IMA27）
text_en: Left hilar lymph node, compared with chest CT of [DATE], similar to previous, approximately 9x9 mm (IMA27).

source_text: 左肺下叶术后改变，未见新发占位
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left lower lobe; no new mass-like lesions seen.

source_text: 左肺下叶偏上方结节同前，现约3mm（IM42）
text_en: Left lower lobe superior aspect nodule stable compared to previous, now approximately 3mm (Image 42)

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，短径均小于10mm
text_en: The right hilar lymph nodes are unchanged from prior, with short diameters all less than 10 mm.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段支气管截断，局部不规则结节较前增大，原约12mm（IM26），现约18x17mm（IM26），远端肺内片絮、结节影略增多
text_en: The bronchial cutoff in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is associated with a local irregular nodule that has increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 12 mm (IM26), now approximately 18x17 mm (IM26). Patchy and nodular opacities in the distal lung have slightly increased.

source_text: 余双肺未见明确新发结节影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no definite new nodule shadows.

source_text: 扫描所及骨质未见破坏灶
text_en: No osseous destruction seen in the scanned area.

source_text: 纵隔隆突下淋巴结同前，约11x9mm（IM27）
text_en: Subcarinal lymph node unchanged, approximately 11x9mm (IM27).

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度小结节影同前
text_en: Small ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺索条同前，两肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior; no new nodules or consolidations are seen in either lung.

source_text: 双肺小结节影同前（IM42、50、57），小于5mm
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodule shadows are stable compared to prior (IM42, 50, 57), less than 5 mm

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，较大仍约12x10mm（IM21）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest still approximately 12x10 mm (IM21).

source_text: 右侧胸膜增厚并多发结节同前，增强扫描未见确切异常强化，较大现仍约22*13mm(Im23)，追查
text_en: Right pleural thickening with multiple nodules is unchanged. No definite abnormal enhancement is seen on contrast-enhanced scan. The largest remains approximately 22x13 mm (IM23); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后改变，未见明确复发及转移征象
text_en: Postoperative change in the right lower lobe; no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 食管胸中下段管壁不均匀增厚较前减轻，较厚处原约24mm，现约14mm（Im28），外膜模糊，与胸主动脉壁接触面不足90度.
text_en: Irregular wall thickening of the mid-to-lower thoracic esophagus reduced compared to prior, thickest portion previously approximately 24mm, now approximately 14mm (IM28), serosa blurred, contact surface with thoracic aorta wall less than 90 degrees.

source_text: 双肺未见新发结节及实变灶
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation foci seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左锁骨上淋巴结较前缩小，较大现约13x12mm（IM4），原19x12mm（IM7）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node decreased in size compared to previous, largest currently approximately 13x12 mm (IM4), previously 19x12 mm (IM7).

source_text: 双肺微结节同前，倾向良性，建议复查
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary micro-nodules are stable compared to prior, likely benign; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下模糊结节同前（IM41）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural hazy nodule unchanged (Image 41)

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区小淋巴结同前，纵隔小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph node in the left supraclavicular region is stable; small mediastinal lymph nodes are also stable.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段胸膜下小结节同前
text_en: A subpleural small nodule in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段磨玻璃结节同前，边界不清，仍约7x6mm（IM23）
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged, with ill-defined margins, still measuring approximately 7 x 6 mm (IM23).

source_text: 右肺下叶模糊小结节同前 ，约6mm（IM43）
text_en: The ill-defined small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, still approximately 6 mm (IM43).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段不规则混杂磨玻璃密度结节，较前缩小，原约24x14mm，现约20x10mm（IM25），密度较前变淡，牵拉相邻的斜裂胸膜
text_en: The irregular mixed ground-glass opacity nodule in the apical segment of the right lower lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 24x14 mm, now approximately 20x10 mm (IM25); the density is less intense than before, and it is pulling on the adjacent oblique fissure pleura.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结大致同前，较大4L组模糊密度区约17x15mm（IM21），请结合临床

source_text: 双侧胸膜散在结节样增厚同前，较大约5mm（IM43）

source_text: 右侧胸膜旁模糊结节同前

text_en: Small nodule in the right lung stable at 3 mm (IM39).

text_en: Left lower lobe anterior-inferior basal segment approximately 7 mm faint ground-glass density nodule similar to prior (Im43), no spiculations or linear opacities seen, clear boundaries, for re-examination.

text_en: 5mm small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (IM43).

text_en: Left adrenal nodule decreased in size, previously approximately 18x12 mm (IM56), currently approximately 14x11 mm (IM56).

text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged, still approximately 6 mm (IM37).

The boundary is indistinct, the outer membrane surface is blurred, and the demarcation from adjacent major vessels remains clear

text_en: Mixed ground-glass opacity nodule in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe, unchanged compared to prior, with indistinct margins, measuring approximately 1.6 x 1.2 cm (Im35); contains minimal solid components. Minimal peripheral pulmonary linear opacities remain unchanged.

source_text: 左肺下叶结节影大致同前，约5mm（IM46）
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is essentially unchanged, approximately 5 mm on image 46.

text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule near the pleura in the lateral basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 7 x 6 mm (IM46).

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，肺内透亮度欠均匀，右肺上叶尖段类圆形浅淡密度结节同前，约6mm（IM10），右肺上叶尖段胸膜下多发索条影同前，余未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. Pulmonary lucency is somewhat heterogeneous. A round, faintly dense nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM10). Multiple linear opacities subpleurally in the apical segment of the right upper lobe are unchanged. No new nodules or consolidations are seen elsewhere.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见异常占位，局部见楔形包裹积液较前吸收减少
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, no abnormal mass at the bronchial stump, local wedge-shaped encapsulated fluid collection decreased in size compared to prior

source_text: 纵隔内多发小淋巴结略缩小，较大原约11x7mm，现约9*7mm（IM14）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes slightly decreased in size, largest previously approximately 11x7 mm, currently approximately 9x7 mm (IM14)

source_text: 纵隔肺门未见明确肿大淋巴结，纵隔右移同前
text_en: No definite enlarged lymph nodes in mediastinal and hilar regions, mediastinum shifted to the right as before.

source_text: 纵隔轻度右移同前，右侧锁骨上及纵隔小淋巴结同前
text_en: Mild rightward shift of the mediastinum, same as before; small right supraclavicular and mediastinal lymph nodes, same as before.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段结节较前缩小，原空洞消失，余同前无明显变化
text_en: Left lower lobe posterior segment nodule decreased in size, original cavity resolved, remainder unchanged.

source_text: 余扫及胸部诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: No osseous destruction signs are seen in the chest bones imaged.

text_en: The linear opacities in both lungs, and the patchy opacity in the right upper lobe and the nodule in the lower lobe are unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 右上肺索条影同前，余两肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Linear opacities in the right upper lung are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the rest of both lungs.

source_text: 右肺微小结节影同前（Im11、16、19、29），右肺钙化索条影同前
text_en: Right lung micro-nodular opacities unchanged compared to prior (Im11, 16, 19, 29); right lung calcified linear opacities unchanged

source_text: 右肺下叶多发小结节同前
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right lower lobe are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下多发实性结节灶同前相仿，较大约5mm（IM40）
text_en: Multiple subpleural solid nodules in the right lung are similar to prior, largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM40)

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，局部缝合线及软组织增厚及包块较前明显缩小，原较大约37*30mm，现约17mm(图18)，考虑术后改变
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, suture line and soft tissue thickening and mass significantly decreased in size compared to prior, originally approximately 37x30 mm, now approximately 17 mm (Figure 18), considered postoperative change.

source_text: 纵隔散在小淋巴结同前相仿，小于10mm
text_en: Scattered small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, all less than 10 mm.

source_text: 食管中下段见壁环周增厚部分层面同前，较厚处仍约1.2cm（IM32），部分层面较前减轻，如原厚约1.2cm（IM28）处现约0.7cm（IM28），与胸主动脉壁接触角度约90度，累及上下长度约10cm，上下界限不清，近端食管腔轻度扩张
text_en: Circumferential wall thickening of the mid-to-distal esophagus is stable on some image slices, with the thickest portion still approximately 1.2 cm (IM32). On some slices, it is reduced compared to prior, such as from approximately 1.2 cm (IM28) to approximately 0.7 cm (IM28). The lesion contacts the thoracic aortic wall at an angle of approximately 90 degrees, involves a longitudinal extent of approximately 10 cm with indistinct upper and lower margins, and shows mild proximal esophageal luminal dilation.

source_text: 右肺上叶多个小结节同前相仿，较大约5mm（IM31）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right upper lobe are similar to prior, largest approximately 5 mm (IM31)

source_text: 右侧肾上腺结节样增粗同前（IMA67）
text_en: Nodular thickening of the right adrenal gland is unchanged (IMA67).

source_text: 右肺上、中叶小结节同前（IM18、38），左肺下叶小结节同前（IM49、51）
text_en: Small nodules in the right upper and middle lobes unchanged (IM18, 38); small nodules in the left lower lobe unchanged (IM49, 51).

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节同前，约3mm（IM35）
text_en: The small nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IM35).

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，约6mm（IM39），余双肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM39). No new nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶结节较前增大
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is enlarged compared to prior.

source_text: 前上纵隔胸腺密度增高同前，呈斑片、结节状影，较大者仍约10x10mm（IM25）,余纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Increased density in the thymus in the anterior superior mediastinum is stable, appearing as patchy and nodular opacities, the largest still measuring approximately 10x10 mm (IM25). No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the remainder of the mediastinum, bilateral hila, supraclavicular regions, or bilateral axillae.

source_text: 前上纵隔转移淋巴结较前缩小
text_en: The metastatic lymph node in the anterior superior mediastinum has decreased in size.

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段、右肺上叶后段各见一结节灶同前相仿（IM32、49）
text_en: Nodules in the basal segment of the left lower lobe and posterior segment of the right upper lobe are stable compared to prior (IM32, 49).

source_text: 两肺微小结节灶同前，约3mm（IM19、24、31）
text_en: The tiny nodular foci in both lungs are unchanged, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM19, 24, 31).

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段肿块影较前增大，原约35x29mm（IM13），现约48x38mm（IM16），右侧胸膜、叶间胸膜增厚较前加重，右侧胸腔新见大量胸水，右肺膨胀不全
text_en: The mass-like opacity in the apical segment of the right upper lobe has increased in size, previously measuring approximately 35x29 mm (IM13) and now approximately 48x38 mm (IM16). Thickening of the right pleura and interlobar pleura has worsened compared to prior. A new large volume of pleural fluid is seen in the right hemithorax, with associated right lung atelectasis.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段可见小结节同前，大小约4mm（IM27），建议追查除外转移
text_en: Small nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged, approximately 4mm (IM27); recommend follow-up to exclude metastasis.

source_text: 纵隔内4L、5组、左肺门见多发淋巴结，较前略减小，现较大约9x6mm（IM22），原约11x8mm（IM25）
text_en: Mediastinal multiple lymph nodes at stations 4L, 5, and left hilar, slightly decreased in size compared to previous; largest currently approximately 9x6 mm (IM22), previously approximately 11x8 mm (IM25).

source_text: 右肺上叶条索状影及结节灶大致同前（IM19)
text_en: Linear opacities and nodular opacities in the right upper lobe are essentially unchanged compared to prior (IM19).

text_en: New small nodule in the right lower lobe; close follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺复张，肺未见新发结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: Left lung re-expanded, no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 平扫纵隔未见明显增大淋巴结，右气管食管沟小淋巴结同前，仍约9x4mm（IM12）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows no significantly enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes. The small lymph node in the right tracheoesophageal groove remains stable, still measuring approximately 9x4 mm (IM12).

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，未见新发占位
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, no new space-occupying lesion is seen.

source_text: 左上肺微结节同前
text_en: The small nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段磨玻璃小结节大致同前，约5mm（IM32）
text_en: Small ground-glass nodule in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe, essentially unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM32).

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，纵隔10R淋巴结同前
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; station 10R mediastinal lymph node unchanged

source_text: 右肺下叶背段分叶状肿块较前相仿，约34x31mm（IM26），内部密度不均，含气支气管及空泡征表现无明显变化
text_en: Lobulated mass in the right lower lobe posterior segment is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 34x31 mm (IM26), with heterogeneous internal density; appearance of air bronchograms and bubble-like lucencies shows no significant change.

text_en: Newly seen 8x5mm nodule

text_en: Small pleural nodules along the right horizontal and oblique fissures are smaller than before, currently measuring approximately 5 mm (IMA32), previously about 7 mm (IM33).

text_en: Left upper lobe interlobar pleural-based nodule has increased in size compared to previous; originally punctate, now approximately 9x6 mm (IM33).

text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4, 5, and 7 are unchanged from previous, with the largest approximately 21x6 mm (Image 27).

text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes slightly enlarged compared to previous, previously approximately 10x8 mm (IM8), currently approximately 12x9 mm (IM9).

source_text: 双肺间质纤维化及散在少许小结节同前，左肺下叶结节约5mm（Im37）同前，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Pulmonary interstitial fibrosis and scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior; a nodule in the left lower lobe measures about 5 mm (Im37), unchanged from prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 左下肺斑片渗出实变影大致同前，局部可疑结节缩小，复查
text_en: Patchy exudative consolidation in the left lower lobe is essentially unchanged; the focal suspicious nodule has decreased in size; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段结节同前，追查
text_en: Left lower lobe basal segment nodule unchanged from previous, requires follow-up.

source_text: 肝多发结节同前，结合腹部检查
text_en: Multiple nodules in liver same as before, correlate with abdominal examination.

source_text: 左锁骨上、气管左旁、纵隔2、5、7组多发小淋巴结同前，较大仍约14x8mm（IM21）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region, left paratracheal area, and mediastinal stations 2, 5, and 7 unchanged from prior; the largest remains approximately 14x8 mm (IM21).

source_text: 左肺门肿大淋巴结大致同前，现较大约13*11mm(图30)，原约13x10mm（IM30）
text_en: Left hilar enlarged lymph node roughly unchanged, current size approximately 13x11 mm (Figure 30), previously approximately 13x10 mm (IM30).

source_text: 纵隔4、6、7、10组多发淋巴结增大较前相仿，较大仍约20x10mm（IM33)
text_en: Mediastinal groups 4, 6, 7, and 10 show multiple enlarged lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest still approximately 20x10 mm (IM33).

text_en: Small nodules in both lower lobes are stable compared to prior (IM40, 48), with the largest measuring approximately 6 mm (IM48).

source_text: 两肺散在斑片、小结节影同前
text_en: The scattered patchy opacities and small nodules in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶癌，较前增大
text_en: Right upper lobe carcinoma, larger than prior.

source_text: 两肺散在索条小结节影同前（IM21、32、47等）
text_en: Scattered linear and small nodular opacities in both lungs, unchanged from prior (IM21, 32, 47, etc.).

text_en: New nodule and linear opacity in the left lower lobe; recommend follow-up.

text_en: The mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged

text_en: Left lower lobe fibrotic streak unchanged, scattered indistinct small nodules in both lungs with size and number unchanged from previous, larger nodule still approximately 8x6mm (IM14)

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门多发淋巴结同前，较大仍约19x12mm（IM32)
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions unchanged from previous, largest still approximately 19x12 mm (IM32).

source_text: 胸腺瘤术后，术区少许斑片状软组织密度灶同前相仿，未见软组织结节或肿块
text_en: Post-thymoma resection, small patchy soft tissue density lesions at the surgical site similar to previous; no soft tissue nodules or masses seen.

text_en: CT scan shows multiple metastases in the thoracolumbar spine, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔4-5组淋巴结同前，较大仍约21x7mm（IM17）
text_en: Mediastinal stations 4-5 lymph nodes unchanged from previous, the larger one still approximately 21x7 mm (IM17).

text_en: Slight thickening of the left posterior internal pleura is unchanged compared to prior; nodular thickening of the right pleura (Im32); no pleural effusion is seen in either hemithorax.

source_text: 两小肺胸膜下微小结节同前，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: Subpleural micronodules in both lower lungs are unchanged from prior and are considered chronic.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度小结节较前增大，原约7mm（IM34），现约10mm（IM31）
text_en: Small ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 7 mm (IM34), now approximately 10 mm (IM31).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段和左肺下叶基底段胸膜下可见新增的小结节，大小约4x3mm(IM20、49)
text_en: New small nodules are visible subpleurally in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe and the basal segment of the left lower lobe, measuring approximately 4x3 mm (IM20, 49).

source_text: 平扫纵隔散在淋巴结较前相仿，较大约14x7mm（IM23）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows scattered mediastinal lymph nodes similar to prior, the largest measuring approximately 14x7 mm on image 23.

source_text: 左肺斑点索条影、右肺上叶小结节及小磨玻璃密度影同前（IMA23、26）
text_en: Punctate and linear opacities in the left lung, small nodules and small ground-glass opacities in the right upper lobe unchanged from previous (images 23, 26).

source_text: 左肺下叶模糊小结节同前（IM34）
text_en: Left lower lobe indistinct small nodule stable compared to prior (IM34).

source_text: 右侧肾上腺外侧肢结节同前
text_en: Nodule in the right adrenal lateral limb is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺中叶磨玻璃小结节同前，复查
text_en: Small ground-glass nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged; follow-up imaging is recommended.

source_text: 锁骨上、腋下淋巴结部分较前稍缩小
text_en: Some supraclavicular and axillary lymph nodes have slightly decreased in size compared to previous

source_text: 双肺少量微小结节同前，部分较致密同前相仿，左上肺小结节同前，仍约6mm（IM17）
text_en: Few tiny nodules in both lungs are stable; some are similarly dense as before. The small nodule in the left upper lobe is stable, still measuring approximately 6 mm (IM17).

source_text: 左锁骨上小淋巴结同前，约6mm（IM6），余纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Small lymph nodes in left supraclavicular region unchanged from previous, approximately 6mm (IM6), with no enlarged lymph nodes seen in the remaining mediastinum, bilateral hilar, supraclavicular region, and bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 两肺多发结节同前，较大约6mm（IM33）
text_en: Multiple nodules in both lungs similar to prior, largest measuring approximately 6 mm (IM33)

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下小结节同前，考虑为血管畸形
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural nodule stable compared to prior, considered vascular malformation
