text_en: The nodule on the hilar aspect of the lesion fuses with neighboring lymph nodes, with unclear structure on non-contrast imaging, and the extent has increased compared to prior (IM24-27)

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下浅淡小结节较前缩小，显示不清
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural faint small nodule decreased in size compared to previous, poorly visualized.

source_text: 右下肺局部胸膜下微结节同前，约4mm（IM15）
text_en: The small subpleural nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM15).

source_text: 扫及甲状腺左叶下极低密度结节伴钙化大致同前（IM5）
text_en: Low-density nodule with calcification in the lower pole of the left thyroid lobe, unchanged from prior (IM5).

source_text: 甲状腺右叶结节同前，结合其他检查
text_en: The right thyroid lobe shows a nodule, unchanged from prior; correlate with other examinations.

source_text: 左侧第6后肋皮质下致密灶，扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Subcortical dense focus at the left sixth posterior rib. No osseous destruction is seen in the other bones of the thorax on the current imaging.

source_text: 左锁骨上淋巴结同前，约11x10mm（IM5）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph nodes unchanged, approximately 11x10 mm (IM5).

source_text: 纵隔4组高密度淋巴结同前,余纵隔、肺门、腋窝及锁骨上平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: High-density mediastinal station 4 lymph nodes are unchanged from previous; on unenhanced scans, no enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the remaining mediastinum, hilar, axillary, and supraclavicular regions

source_text: 食管胸下段约下肺静脉水平管壁前壁局部增厚大致通勤啊，较厚外径原约36x20mm，现约35x20mm（IMA36），增强扫描可见强化，食管外膜面仍与胸主动脉接触，接触角度大于90度
text_en: Localized thickening of the anterior wall of the lower thoracic esophagus at the level of the inferior pulmonary vein, with the lumen roughly patent. The outer diameter was originally approximately 36x20 mm and is now approximately 35x20 mm (IMA36). Enhancement is seen on contrast-enhanced scan. The esophageal adventitial surface remains in contact with the thoracic aorta, with a contact angle greater than 90 degrees.

source_text: 右肺新见团片及类结节影，较大约10mm（IMA19）
text_en: Newly observed mass-like and nodular opacities in the right lung, the largest measuring approximately 10 mm (IMA19).

source_text: 右肺索条及小结节影同前（IMA21、27）
text_en: Linear opacities and small nodules in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior (IMA21, 27).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段微小结节同前（IMA30、32），较大约3mm
text_en: The tiny nodule in the left upper lobe anterior segment is unchanged (IMA30, 32), with the larger one measuring approximately 3 mm.

source_text: 右肺下叶近肺门结节平扫较前稍显增大，建议增强检查
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe near the hilum appears slightly larger on non-contrast imaging compared to prior; enhancement study is recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段肿块较前略缩小，现约34*29mm(图36)，原约38x31mm（Im37），中远端少许条片状影
text_en: The mass in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe is slightly smaller than prior, currently measuring approximately 34x29 mm (Figure 36), previously 38x31 mm (Im37). A small amount of linear and patchy opacity is seen in the middle and distal portions.

source_text: 右肺小斑片索条影、左肺下叶点状结节影同前（IMA177）
text_en: Small patchy linear opacities in the right lung and punctate nodules in the left lower lobe are stable compared to prior (IMA177).

source_text: 左肺下叶索条及小结节影同前
text_en: Left lower lobe linear opacities and small nodular opacities unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段、右肺上叶后段磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，仍约3mm、10x6mm、5x4mm（IM20、27、23），建议6月后追查
text_en: Left lower lobe posterior segment and right upper lobe posterior segment ground-glass opacity nodules unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 3 mm, 10x6 mm, and 5x4 mm (IM20, 27, 23), with recommendation for follow-up in 6 months.

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节同前，倾向陈旧灶
text_en: The small nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged and likely represents a chronic finding.

source_text: 上纵隔部分淋巴结较前缩小，例如2组原约11x5mm者现约7x3mm（Im9）
text_en: Some lymph nodes in the upper mediastinum decreased in size compared to prior; for example, a 2R node previously measuring 11x5 mm now measures 7x3 mm (Im9)

source_text: 左肺上叶浅淡小结节同前，约4mm（IM19）
text_en: The faint small nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged from previous, approximately 4 mm (IM19).

source_text: 余肺未见新发斑片及结节影
text_en: No new patchy opacities or nodules are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 纵隔及左腋窝多发小淋巴结部分较前增大
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and left axilla, some increased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 纵隔11R淋巴结同前相仿，约11x5mm(IM33)
text_en: The mediastinal lymph node at station 11R is similar to previous, approximately 11x5 mm (Image 33).

source_text: 食管术后，未见明确复发和转移
text_en: Post-esophagectomy, no clear evidence of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 右肺另见磨玻璃密度小结节同前，约6mm（IM16、20）
text_en: Another ground-glass opacity small nodule is seen in the right lung, stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM16, 20).

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下结节略浅淡，原约8mm（Im13），现约6mm（IM14），右肺下叶条状结节同前（IM33）
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural nodule slightly fainter, previously approximately 8mm (Im13), now approximately 6mm (IM14); right lower lobe linear nodule unchanged (IM33)

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段贴斜裂胸膜处结节略饱满，原约7x6mm（IM25），现约7x7mm（IM27）
text_en: A nodule adjacent to the oblique fissure pleura in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe is slightly more prominent, previously approximately 7x6 mm (IM25), now approximately 7x7 mm (IM27)

source_text: 右肺上叶后段磨玻璃密度结节较前稍增大，现约18x12mm（IMA18），原约16x12mm（IM19）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment has slightly increased in size, now approximately 18x12 mm (IMA18), previously about 16x12 mm (IM19).

source_text: 右肺结节较前相仿，追查
text_en: The right lung nodule is similar to prior; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 左肺钙化灶、左上叶胸膜下多发肺大泡、左肺下叶支气管轻度扩张同前（IMA49），左肺上叶小结节影同前（IMA33、35、37、50、53、57），小于5mm
text_en: Left lung calcifications, multiple subpleural bullae in left upper lobe, and mild bronchiectasis in left lower lobe unchanged from previous (IMA49); small nodules in left upper lobe unchanged from previous (IMA33, 35, 37, 50, 53, 57), less than 5 mm.

source_text: 余两肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: No new nodules are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 左侧腋窝淋巴结增大，现约15*13mm(图14)，原约11*8mm(图11)，转移
text_en: Left axillary lymph node enlargement, currently approximately 15*13 mm (Figure 14), previously approximately 11*8 mm (Figure 11), metastasis.

source_text: 纵隔5组淋巴结较前缩小，原约14x7mm（IM22），现约12x7mm（IM23），左肺门肿大淋巴结平扫与血管分界不清
text_en: Mediastinal station 5 lymphadenopathy decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 14 × 7 mm (IM22), now approximately 12 × 7 mm (IM23); left hilar lymphadenopathy with indistinct margins from vessels on non-contrast imaging

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段类结节影同前，约14x11mm（IMA22），内部空泡同前，边界不清同前
text_en: The nodule-like opacity in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment is unchanged from previous, approximately 14x11 mm (IMA22), with internal air bubble unchanged and ill-defined margins unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶病灶大致同前，同纵隔胸膜及上腔静脉分界欠清楚
text_en: Right upper lobe lesion is largely unchanged; the demarcation with the adjacent mediastinal pleura and superior vena cava remains indistinct

source_text: 两肺散在钙化结节、索条结节灶大致同前，倾向良性
text_en: Scattered calcified nodules and linear nodular opacities in both lungs, largely unchanged from prior; benign appearance favored.

source_text: 左肺上叶含钙化小结节影同前，约3mm（IM28）
text_en: A small calcified nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged from previous at approximately 3 mm (IM28).

source_text: 右侧锁骨上淋巴结缩小，右侧原约9x7mm，现约5x3mm（IMA5）
text_en: Right supraclavicular lymph node has decreased in size, previously measuring approximately 9 x 7 mm, now approximately 5 x 3 mm (IMA5).

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见明显软组织密度肿块影，局部胸膜增厚同前（IM35）
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lower lobe; non-contrast scan shows no obvious soft tissue density mass at the bronchial stump. Local pleural thickening is stable (IM35).

source_text: 左肺舌叶磨玻璃结节大致同前，仍约10*10mm(图33)
text_en: Left lung lingula: ground-glass nodule essentially unchanged, still approximately 10x10 mm (Figure 33)

source_text: 纵隔6组肿大淋巴结同前，约15x8mm（IM18)，余纵隔小淋巴结同前
text_en: Enlarged mediastinal station 6 lymph nodes unchanged, approximately 15x8 mm (Image 18), other small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged

source_text: 左肺胸主动脉旁小结节同前，仍约4mm（IM55）
text_en: Left lung paraaortic small nodule unchanged, still approximately 4 mm (IM55).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段不规则团片及类结节灶较前缩小，密度减低，近胸膜旁实性类结节原约13mm（IMA29），现约11mm（IM33），邻近肺内不规则淡条片影范围缩小
text_en: Irregular patch and nodular opacity in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe has decreased in size and density compared to prior; the solid-like nodule near the pleura was previously about 13mm (IMA29), now about 11mm (IM33); the area of irregular faint linear opacity in the adjacent lung has decreased in extent.

source_text: 右肺下叶膈上新见一短条状类结节影，约8x5mm（IM44），追查
text_en: A new short linear-like nodular opacity is seen above the diaphragm in the right lower lobe, measuring approximately 8x5 mm (IM44); further evaluation is recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段胸膜下小结节同前相仿，约3mm（IM14）
text_en: The subpleural nodule in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment is similar to prior, approximately 3 mm (IM14)

source_text: 右肺下叶新见小结节影，大小约3mm（IM51），转移
text_en: Newly seen small nodule in the right lower lobe, approximately 3 mm in size (IM51), metastasis.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜小结节影同前（IMA177）
text_en: Small nodular opacity of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior (IMA177).

source_text: 右肺中叶肿块较前缩小
text_en: The mass in the right middle lobe is smaller than before.

source_text: 纵隔5组小淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Mediastinal station 5 small lymph nodes largely unchanged from previous.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下新见小结节,2-4mm（IMA42、48），密切观察
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural newly identified small nodule, 2-4mm (Images 42, 48), close follow-up

source_text: 右肺下叶近肺门结节较前似相仿，平扫与肺血管分界不清，远端肺内模糊片影同前，右肺下叶小结节较前略缩小，原约5x4mm(图30)，现仅可见点状结节（IM31）
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe near the hilum appears similar to prior, with indistinct margins from pulmonary vessels on non-contrast imaging. The hazy patchy opacity in the distal lung parenchyma remains unchanged. The small nodule in the right lower lobe has slightly decreased in size, previously approximately 5x4 mm (Figure 30), now only a punctate nodule is visible (IM31).

source_text: 纵隔轻度左移同前，纵隔、肺门、腋窝及锁骨上平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mild leftward shift of the mediastinum, same as before; on non-contrast scan, no enlarged lymph nodes seen in the mediastinum, hilum, axilla, or supraclavicular regions.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，术区未见明确复发征象
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, no definite evidence of recurrence in the surgical area.

source_text: 左肺上叶见一浅淡小结节同前，约5mm（IM23），追查
text_en: A faint small nodule, approximately 5mm (Image 23), is seen in the left upper lobe unchanged from prior; follow-up.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见异常软组织肿块影，局部斑片索条影同前
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; non-contrast scan shows no abnormal soft-tissue mass at the bronchial stump. Localized patchy and linear opacities are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺点状钙化结节同前
text_en: Punctate calcified nodule in the right lung is unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 余双肺多发模糊结节同前，结合临床
text_en: Multiple indistinct nodules in the remainder of both lungs are unchanged; correlate clinically.

source_text: 纵隔2R组淋巴结同前，良性可能，追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 2R lymph nodes unchanged from prior, likely benign, recommend follow-up.

source_text: 左肺术后改变，支气管断端周围软组织略厚同前，未见明确占位征象
text_en: Left lung postoperative change, soft tissue thickening around bronchial stump unchanged, no definite signs of space-occupying lesion.

source_text: 4R组小淋巴结同前，约12x8mm（IM22），平扫密度较高，考虑良性
text_en: Small lymph node in station 4R is unchanged, measuring about 12x8 mm (IM22); on non-contrast imaging, the density is relatively high, suggestive of benign etiology.

source_text: 纵膈4、7组及双肺门多发肿大淋巴结部分略缩小，较大位于4R，原约25x21mm（IM24），现约22x18mm（IM22）
text_en: Multiple enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4, 7, and bilateral hilar regions partially slightly reduced, largest at station 4R, previously approximately 25x21 mm (IM24), now approximately 22x18 mm (IM22).

source_text: 两肺未见新发异常结节影
text_en: No new abnormal nodules seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶肺门旁肿块，左肺下叶及斜裂新发结节，考虑转移
text_en: Left lower lobe hilar mass, with new nodules in the left lower lobe and fissure; consider metastasis.

source_text: 前纵隔见水样低密度结节较前缩小，现约13x8mm（IM27），原为16x8mm（IM25），边界清
text_en: A water-density nodule in the anterior mediastinum is smaller than before, now approximately 13x8 mm (IM27), previously 16x8 mm (IM25), with clear boundaries.

source_text: 双肺气肿、肺大泡同前，未见新发结节
text_en: Pulmonary emphysema and bullae are unchanged; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见复发征象
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no signs of recurrence are seen at the bronchial stump.

source_text: 两肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: No new nodular lesions or patchy opacities are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 纵隔4、6、10R组淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal groups 4, 6, and 10R lymph nodes unchanged from previous.

source_text: 余肺内多发结节及磨玻璃密度灶同前
text_en: The remaining multiple nodules and ground-glass opacities in the lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 食管胸中段管壁增厚减轻，原较大截面约35x22mm，现较厚处约11mm（IM35），管腔狭窄同前
text_en: Decreased wall thickening in the mid-thoracic esophagus, previously largest cross-section approximately 35x22 mm, currently thickest portion approximately 11 mm (IM35), luminal narrowing unchanged from previous.

source_text: 左肺下叶陈旧小结节同前（Im37），余肺未见新生结节灶或斑片影，左侧未见胸水
text_en: Old small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (Im37); no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remaining lung; no pleural effusion on the left.

source_text: 右肺上叶癌复查，病灶范围大致同前
text_en: Follow-up of right upper lobe carcinoma; lesion extent is largely unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔4R/L、7组及双肺门多发肿大淋巴结大致同前，较大仍约27x20mm（IM22）
text_en: Multiple enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R, 4L, 7, and bilateral hilar essentially unchanged from previous, largest still approximately 27x20 mm (Fig. 22)

source_text: 右肺中叶及左肺下叶磨玻璃密度小结节同前
text_en: Small ground-glass density nodules in the right middle lobe and left lower lobe are unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶及右上肺前段小结节灶同前（IM33、39、40），余双肺散在结节及钙化灶数量、大小同前
text_en: Small nodular foci in the right middle lobe and anterior segment of the right upper lobe are stable (IM33, 39, 40). The number and size of scattered nodules and calcified foci in the remainder of the bilateral lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 两肺小斑片索条影及微小结节影同前，陈旧灶
text_en: Small patchy and reticular opacities and tiny nodules in both lungs similar to prior; old changes

source_text: 双肺下叶小结节灶同前（IM45、50），较大者约7*5mm（IMA47）
text_en: Small nodular foci in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior (IM45, 50), largest measuring approximately 7x5 mm (IMA47).

source_text: 纵隔4R/L、5、7组见多发淋巴结同前，较大者约13x12mm（IM24）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R, 4L, 5, and 7 unchanged from previous, largest approximately 13x12 mm (Fig. 24)

source_text: 纵隔2组淋巴结略饱满，原约10x5mm（IM14），现约11x8mm（IM14）
text_en: Mediastinal station 2 lymph nodes slightly prominent, previously approximately 10x5 mm (IM14), now approximately 11x8 mm (IM14)

source_text: 两肺结节灶缩小，原较大约7mm，现较大约5mm（IM42）
text_en: Nodules in both lungs are decreased in size; the largest previously measured approximately 7 mm, now measures approximately 5 mm (IM42).

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右肺新见小结节，约6x4mm（IM31），转移可能，追查
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. A new small nodule is seen in the right lung, measuring approximately 6x4 mm (IM31), possibly metastatic; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右上肺陈旧灶同前（IMA25），双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Right upper lobe chronic changes unchanged (IMA25); no new nodules or patchy opacities in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺散在模糊小结节大致同前(图29、56)
text_en: Scattered indistinct small nodules in the left lung largely unchanged (Fig. 29, 56)

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节同前，约4mm（IM12）
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM12).

source_text: 扫及左肾上腺结节同前，请结合腹部检查
text_en: A nodule in the left adrenal gland is unchanged from prior; correlation with abdominal imaging is recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶磨玻璃密度结节较前吸收
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe has partially resolved compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺胸膜/叶间胸膜下微结节同前（IM22、25）
text_en: The subpleural and interlobar pleural micronodules in the right lung are stable (IM22, 25).

source_text: 左肺钙化结节同前
text_en: Left lung calcified nodule unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺散在微小结节大致同前，陈旧灶可能大
text_en: Scattered tiny nodules in the right lung are essentially unchanged, likely representing old foci.

source_text: 胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结较前略增大，现约22*11mm(图30)，原约20*10mm(图30)
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph node slightly enlarged compared to prior, now approximately 22x11 mm (Figure 30), previously approximately 20x10 mm (Figure 30).

source_text: 扫及胸廓骨质未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: No signs of bone destruction seen in the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 余双肺散在多发微小结节同前，小于5mm
text_en: Residual scattered multiple tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged, all less than 5 mm

source_text: 双肺未见新增结节和实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation shadows seen in both lungs.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结较前缩小，原约13x9mm，现约9X7mm（IM21），随诊观察
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes decreased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 13x9 mm, currently approximately 9x7 mm (IM21), follow-up observation.

source_text: 纵隔、双侧锁骨上及腋窝多发淋巴结同前，较大仍约10x5mm（IM22）
text_en: Mediastinal, bilateral supraclavicular, and axillary multiple lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest still approximately 10x5 mm (IM22).

source_text: 食管旁、左锁骨上区、纵隔及右肺门多发肿大淋巴结较前缩小，较大者原约30x20mm，现约15x12mm（Im31）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes adjacent to the esophagus, in the left supraclavicular region, mediastinum, and right hilar region are decreased in size compared to prior. The largest node was previously approximately 30x20 mm, now approximately 15x12 mm (IM31).

source_text: 其外侧圆形小结节较前相仿，约8mm（Im20）
text_en: The small round nodule lateral to it is similar to prior, measuring approximately 8 mm (Im20).

source_text: 右侧胸膜不均匀增厚大部分同前，局部较前增厚，呈结节状突入胸腔（IM40），密切追查
text_en: Irregular thickening of the right pleura is mostly unchanged, but locally thicker than before, with nodular protrusion into the pleural cavity (IM40); close follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 双肺未见新增结节、斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶实性结节部分缩小，较大者原约13x12mm（IM35），现约10x7mm（IM37）
text_en: Solid nodules in the left lower lobe, some decreased in size; the largest previously approximately 13x12mm (IM35), now approximately 10x7mm (IM37).

source_text: 右侧胸膜增厚，右侧纵隔胸膜结节大小相仿，现约16x10mm（IM39），追查
text_en: Right pleural thickening is present. The right mediastinal pleural nodule is similar in size to prior, now measuring approximately 16x10 mm (IM39); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 余肺多发结节灶同前（IM18、26、31、50），较大者约7mm（IM18）
text_en: Multiple nodules in the remaining lung are stable (IM18, 26, 31, 50). The largest measures approximately 7 mm (IM18).

source_text: 右肺小结节影同前，仍约3mm（IMA15）
text_en: Right lung small nodule shadows are unchanged, still approximately 3 mm (IMA15).

source_text: 左肺门结节同前，约20*15mm（IMA29）
text_en: Left hilar nodule is similar to previous, approximately 20x15mm (IMA29).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段胸膜下小结节灶伴索条影同前，较大约6mm（IM20），双肺下叶小结节灶同前（IM44、49），较大约8mm
text_en: Subpleural small nodule with linear opacities in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is stable, largest approximately 6 mm (IM20); small nodules in the bilateral lower lobes are stable (IM44, 49), largest approximately 8 mm

source_text: 余双肺未见新发结节及异常密度区
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no new nodules or abnormal density areas.

source_text: 扫及骨质未见明显骨质破坏征象
text_en: Scanned bones show no obvious evidence of osseous destruction.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，肺内透亮度均匀，未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. Lung lucency is uniform. No new nodules or consolidation are seen.

source_text: 左侧胸腔占位术后，术区周围左上肺近肺门处局限性索条及结节样低密度区较前缩小
text_en: Postoperative change in the left pleural cavity; the localized linear and nodular low-density area near the left hilum in the upper lobe has decreased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节部分略显缩小，原约11mm（IMA22）者，现约9mm（IM23），边缘毛糙同前

source_text: 左肺散在小结节同前

source_text: 右肺中叶术后较前相仿，支气管断端未见复发征象

Decreased density in surrounding fat planes. Lesion contact with adjacent thoracic aorta less than 90 degrees.

text_en: Mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes decreased in size compared to previous, metastasis considered.

source_text: 纵隔2R组淋巴结钙化影同前，余纵隔、锁骨上区及双腋下平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Calcified lymph nodes in mediastinal station 2R unchanged from previous; no enlarged lymph nodes seen in the remaining mediastinum, supraclavicular regions, and bilateral axillary regions on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 余双肺少许索条影同前，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Residual few linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen

source_text: 散在小结节缩小，原较大约2mm（IM23），现约1mm（IM29）
text_en: Scattered small nodules decreased in size, previously approximately 2 mm (IM23), now approximately 1 mm (IM29).

source_text: 左肺未见新增结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities in the left lung.

source_text: 扫及C7椎体密度增高、椎体变扁，考虑转移
text_en: Increased density and flattening of the C7 vertebral body, suggestive of metastasis.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节较前稍增大，中央实性密度稍增大，考虑肺癌可能性大，请结合临床相关检查
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe has slightly increased in size, with a slight increase in the central solid component; lung cancer is highly suspected; correlate with relevant clinical findings.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结部分略饱满，如原约10x6mm（IM21），现约11x9mm（IM22）
text_en: Some multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are slightly enlarged; for example, one that was previously approximately 10x6 mm (IM21) is now approximately 11x9 mm (IM22).

source_text: 右侧锁骨上淋巴结较前略增大，现约12x7mm（IM7)，原约10×6mm(IM7）
text_en: The right supraclavicular lymph node is slightly larger than previously, now measuring approximately 12 x 7 mm (IM7), compared to prior measurement of 10 x 6 mm (IM7).

source_text: 纵隔钙化淋巴结同前
text_en: Calcified mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结同前(IM19)，余纵隔未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: The mediastinal station 4R lymph node is unchanged (Image 19), and no enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the remaining mediastinum

source_text: 左肺上叶、右肺下叶微小结节同前（Im21、51），余肺未见新生结节或实变影
text_en: Tiny nodules in the left upper lobe and right lower lobe are stable compared to prior (Im21, 51); no new nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下小结节同前，约8*5mm(图27)，邻近小肺血管增粗，似与其相连
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural nodule stable compared to prior, approximately 8x5 mm (Figure 27), with adjacent small pulmonary vessel enlargement appearing connected to it

source_text: 右肺下叶后基底段磨玻璃密度结节，较前略显缩小，原模糊渗出边界较前略清晰，中实性密度仍高，范围约12x8mm（Im36）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe, slightly smaller than before; the previously indistinct exudative margin is now slightly clearer. The central solid component remains high in density, measuring approximately 12 x 8 mm (Im36).

source_text: 左肺下叶外基底段胸膜下小结节同前，大小仍约4mm（IM44），追查
text_en: Left lower lobe lateral basal segment subpleural small nodule unchanged, size still approximately 4mm (IM44), follow-up

source_text: 右肺未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation in the right lung.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结同前，现约16*10mm（IM21），双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are stable, measuring approximately 16x10 mm (IM21). No lymphadenopathy is seen in the bilateral hila, supraclavicular regions, or bilateral axillae.

source_text: 右肺下叶近肺门结节大致同前，约14*11mm（IM29)，与右肺门血管及支气管分界不清，与右斜裂胸膜广基底粘连
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe near the hilum is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 14x11 mm (IM29), with indistinct margins from the right hilar vessels and bronchi, and broad-based adhesion to the right oblique fissure pleura.

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后同前，左肺上叶前段磨玻璃密度结节同前，追查
text_en: Postoperative changes following right upper lobectomy are unchanged; ground-glass opacity nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe is unchanged; continued surveillance recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶及上叶术后，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Status post resection in the right lower lobe and upper lobe; no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis are seen.

source_text: 左锁骨上新增肿大淋巴结，考虑转移
text_en: New enlarged left supraclavicular lymph nodes, suspicious for metastasis.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节及斜裂胸膜结节大致同前，仍约3mm（IM29、35）
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe and the pleural nodule along the oblique fissure are stable compared to prior, remaining approximately 3 mm (IM29, 35)

source_text: 双侧腋窝淋巴结同前，较大约10mm（IM13）
text_en: Lymph nodes in bilateral axillae are unchanged, the largest measuring about 10 mm (IM13).

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下模糊结节同前（IM34）
text_en: Indistinct subpleural nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged compared to prior (IM34).

source_text: 双肺小结节大致同前，随访
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are roughly stable compared to prior, follow-up recommended

source_text: 右肺尖原高密度结节及索条影同前，右肺上叶多发模糊微小结节及条片影较前减轻（IM16-24）
text_en: The original high-density nodule and linear opacities at the right lung apex are stable. The multiple indistinct tiny nodules and linear opacities in the right upper lobe have improved compared to prior (IM16-24).

source_text: 上纵隔稍大淋巴结同前，复查
text_en: Slightly enlarged lymph nodes in the upper mediastinum unchanged, repeat imaging recommended

source_text: 右肺上叶中央区磨玻璃密度结节较前饱满，原约17x12mm（IM23），现约22x14mm（IM23），中央见空泡征，大部分边界清楚
text_en: Central ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is more prominent compared to prior, previously approximately 17x12 mm (IM23), now approximately 22x14 mm (IM23), with a central air bronchogram; most margins are well-defined.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结较前增大，原约12x8mm（IM24），现约16x12mm（IM25），密切追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph node enlarged compared to prior, previously approximately 12x8 mm (IM24), now approximately 16x12 mm (IM25), close follow-up.

source_text: 右肺上叶微小结节同前，考虑良性
text_en: Tiny nodules in the right upper lobe, unchanged from prior; considered benign.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则结节同前，约14x10mm(IM23)
text_en: The irregular nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 14x10 mm (IM23).

source_text: 左肺上叶混杂毛密度小结节大致同前，现仍约10*8mm（IM25），边缘密度略高中央呈低密度同前
text_en: The mixed ground-glass density small nodule in the left upper lobe is roughly unchanged, still approximately 10x8 mm (IM25), with slightly higher density at the margins and central low density unchanged.

source_text: 肝内见多发低密度结节灶同前，请结合腹部检查
text_en: Multiple low-density nodule foci within the liver same as before, please correlate with abdominal examination.

source_text: 纵隔多组及右肺门多发淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple groups of mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous.

source_text: 两肺未见新增结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: No new nodules or patchy lesions are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶模糊类结节同前（IM18,19）
text_en: The ill-defined nodular opacity in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior (IM18, 19).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约12x7mm（IM25）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged, largest measuring approximately 12x7 mm (IM25)

source_text: 左肺上叶斑片索条影同前，两肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Patchy linear opacities in the left upper lobe unchanged; no new nodules or consolidations in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段钙化结节同前（Im14），右肺上叶后段不规则形、毛刺状结节影较前缩小（IMA31、32），较大现约15x9mm（IM32），原约15x11mm，密度较前减低
text_en: The calcified nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is stable (Im14). The irregular, spiculated nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe has decreased in size (IMA31, 32), the larger now approximately 15x9 mm (IM32), previously approximately 15x11 mm, with decreased density compared to prior.

source_text: 胸2、3椎体致密结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: T2 and T3 vertebral bodies demonstrate dense nodules, stable compared to prior; benign etiology favored.

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，仍小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, still less than 10 mm.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前相仿仍约10x5mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are similar compared to previous, still approximately 10x5mm (IM20).

source_text: 右侧第6侧肋类圆形高密度结节同前（IM35），右侧第四肋多发稍高密度结节同前，追查
text_en: Round high-density nodule in the right 6th lateral rib is unchanged (IM35). Multiple slightly hyperdense nodules in the right 4th rib are unchanged. Follow-up recommended.

source_text: 肺癌疗后，两上肺及胸膜下胸膜下散在模糊小结节灶大致同前（IM13、14、17、20、24），右肺斜裂小结节同前（IM28），右肺下叶新见片状影（IMA32），余未见新发病灶
text_en: Post-lung cancer treatment: Scattered hazy small nodules in bilateral upper lungs and subpleural regions unchanged (IM13, 14, 17, 20, 24); right oblique fissure small nodule unchanged (IM28); new patchy opacity in right lower lobe (IMA32); no other new lesions.

source_text: 右肺门片状高密度影及小结节影同前（IM22）
text_en: Right hilar patchy increased density and small nodular opacities are stable compared to prior (IM22)

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区及纵隔内淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region and mediastinum are largely unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔2、4组小淋巴结同前，4R组仍约14x8mm（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal stations 2 and 4 small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, station 4R still approximately 14x8 mm (IM21)

source_text: 左下肺索条及钙化点大致同前，双肺未见新生结节斑片影
text_en: The linear opacities and calcified foci in the left lower lobe are essentially unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左肺上叶斜裂旁条片灶同前相仿，未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: The linear and patchy lesion adjacent to the oblique fissure in the left upper lobe is similar to previous; no new nodules or consolidation are seen.

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段小结节同前，追查
text_en: The small nodule in the outer basal segment of the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 双肺下叶小结节同前，位于贴胸膜或邻胸膜下，不足5mm，形态欠规则，部分伴钙化密度，倾向良性
text_en: Small nodules in the lower lobes of both lungs are stable compared to prior imaging; they are located at or adjacent to the pleura, measure less than 5 mm, have irregular morphology, and some show calcified density, favoring benign etiology.

source_text: 右肺中叶及左肺下叶磨玻璃密度小结节同前，仍约3-5mm（IM30、55），右肺中叶可见索条同前，余肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Small ground-glass density nodules in the right middle lobe and left lower lobe are unchanged, still approximately 3–5 mm (IM30, 55); linear opacity in the right middle lobe is unchanged; no new nodules are seen elsewhere in the lungs.

source_text: 右肺中叶支气管闭塞，局部肺门区团片状软组织密度影及远端中叶肺不张较前减轻，现较宽约12mm(图18)，原约18mm(图19)
text_en: Right middle lobe bronchus is occluded. The patchy soft tissue density in the hilar region and the distal middle lobe atelectasis have improved compared to prior. The current maximum width is approximately 12 mm (Figure 18), previously 18 mm (Figure 19).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则形结节同前，现约19*12mm(图20)，原约18x13mm（IM21）
text_en: An irregular nodular lesion in the right upper lobe posterior segment is stable compared to prior, now measuring approximately 19x12 mm (Figure 20), previously 18x13 mm (IM21).

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节同前，约4mm（IM29），追查
text_en: The small nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged, approximately 4 mm (IM29); further investigation is warranted.

source_text: 右腋下淋巴结同前
text_en: Right axillary lymph nodes are unchanged compared to prior

source_text: 双锁骨上小淋巴结同前，较大仍约10x5mm（IM5）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in bilateral supraclavicular regions are unchanged from prior; the largest remains approximately 10x5 mm (IM5).

source_text: 右肺上叶结节影同前（IM25），追查
text_en: The nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior imaging (IM25); further investigation is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔多枚淋巴结大致同前，平扫密度较高，5组较大者约13x10mm（Im23）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are essentially unchanged from previous, with higher density on non-contrast scan; the largest in station 5 measures approximately 13x10 mm (Image 23).

source_text: 纵隔6组淋巴结较前略增大，建议追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 6 lymph nodes are slightly enlarged compared to previous, recommend follow-up

source_text: 右肺中叶术后，支气管残端未见软组织密度占位，双肺少许索条影同前，未见肺内新发结节或斑片影
text_en: Status post right middle lobectomy; no soft tissue density mass is seen at the bronchial remnant. Minimal linear opacities in both lungs are stable. No new pulmonary nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 右下肺少许索条影及左肺小结节同前无变化（IM25、30）
text_en: Few fibrotic bands in the right lower lobe and small nodules in the left lung are unchanged compared to prior (IM25, 30).

source_text: 余诸骨未见明确骨质破坏征象
text_en: The remaining bones show no definite signs of osseous destruction.

source_text: 右肺门肿大淋巴结同前，大小约18x16mm（IM28）
text_en: The enlarged right hilar lymph node is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 18 x 16 mm (IM28).

source_text: 右肺全切术后，支气管断端未见确切结节及肿块影，局部管壁不连续大致同前（IMA20），与右侧胸腔相通，右侧气管胸腔瘘同前相仿
text_en: Post-right pneumonectomy, no definite nodule or mass is seen at the bronchial stump. The site of discontinuous wall is stable (IMA20), communicating with the right pleural space; the right tracheobronchial fistula is unchanged.

source_text: 左肺下叶软组织密度结节大小同前相仿，边缘稍欠光滑，与胸膜粘连，现约20*13mm(图30)，原约18x14mm（IM29）
text_en: Left lower lobe soft tissue density nodule similar in size to previous, margin slightly irregular, adherent to pleura, now approximately 20x13 mm (Figure 30), previously approximately 18x14 mm (IM29)

source_text: 右肺未见新增结节灶
text_en: No new nodules are seen in the right lung.

source_text: 左侧第五后肋骨折、胸椎多发低密度灶，考虑转移，建议结合骨扫描检查
text_en: Fracture of the left fifth posterior rib and multiple low-density foci in the thoracic vertebrae, considered metastatic; correlation with bone scan is recommended.

source_text: 右肺门小淋巴结较前相仿
text_en: Small right hilar lymph nodes are similar to prior.

source_text: 纵隔内多发淋巴结大部分同前相仿，较大约14x12mm（IM19），部分略增大，原约9mm（IM12）灶现约12mm（IM14）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes mostly similar to previous, largest approximately 14x12 mm (IM19), some slightly increased in size, previously approximately 9 mm (IM12) lymph node now approximately 12 mm (IM14)

source_text: 两肺散在结节及磨玻璃密度灶同前，追查
text_en: Scattered nodules and ground-glass opacity foci in both lungs, unchanged from prior; continue monitoring.

source_text: 右肺下叶小模糊结节及钙化灶同前，双肺尖少许微小结节，肺尖胸膜增厚
text_en: Small indistinct nodule and calcified focus in the right lower lobe are unchanged; a few tiny nodules in both lung apices; apical pleural thickening.

source_text: 右肺上叶肿块较前明显增大
text_en: The mass in the right upper lobe is significantly larger than before.

source_text: 右肺多发微小结节同前相仿（IM24、43、49），追查
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in the right lung are similar to prior (IM24, 43, 49); correlation recommended.

source_text: 两肺散在微小结节大致同前，较大者仍约9*6mm（图47）
text_en: The scattered tiny nodules in both lungs are largely unchanged; the largest remains approximately 9x6 mm (Figure 47).

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结部分较前缩小，较大原约16x7mm（IM23），现约14x6mm（IM20）
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes have decreased in size compared to previous; the largest previously measured approximately 16x7 mm (IM23), now approximately 14x6 mm (IM20).

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节同前（IM22）
text_en: Small nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior (IM22).

source_text: 胃小弯侧、胃左动脉旁多发淋巴结较前略缩小，较大原约10x6mm，现约7x6mm（IM56）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes at the lesser curvature of the stomach and adjacent to the left gastric artery are slightly smaller than prior. The largest previously measured approximately 10x6mm, now approximately 7x6mm (IM56).

source_text: 左肺术后改变，胸部CT平扫未见新发占位征象
text_en: Left lung postoperative change, chest CT plain scan shows no new signs of space-occupying lesion.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节影大致同前（IM18）
text_en: Nodule with ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe is essentially unchanged from prior (IM18).

source_text: 右锁骨上区淋巴结大致同前，仍约13x8mm（Im8）
text_en: Lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region are essentially unchanged compared to prior, still measure approximately 13x8 mm (Im8).

source_text: 左肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidations in the left lung.

source_text: 双肺散在少许小结节同前，较大约9mm（IM59），部分界清，部分边缘模糊
text_en: Scattered few small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, largest about 9 mm (IM59), some with well-defined margins, some with ill-defined margins.

source_text: 右肺上叶微小结节同前，追查
text_en: Tiny nodules in the right upper lobe, unchanged from prior; recommend follow-up for further evaluation.

source_text: 双肺粟粒样结节，大致同前
text_en: Miliary nodules in both lungs are approximately similar to prior.

source_text: 余双肺上叶后段散在微结节同前，大小约3mm（IM13、15），部分边界欠清
text_en: Scattered micronodules in the posterior segments of both upper lobes are unchanged; size approximately 3 mm (IM13, 15); some have ill-defined margins.

source_text: 纵隔2R组淋巴结较前增大，原约4mm(IM9)，现约12x9mm(IM10)
text_en: Mediastinal station 2R lymph nodes increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 4 mm (IM9), now approximately 12x9 mm (IM10).

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门多发淋巴结大致同前，较大者短径仍约9mm（Im30）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right hilum are approximately stable compared to prior, with the largest short axis measuring approximately 9 mm (Im30).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段不规则混杂密度结节同前，约29x25mm（IM33），内可见小泡征，边缘清楚，并可见胸膜牵拉凹陷
text_en: Irregular mixed-density nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged, approximately 29x25mm (IM33); small bubble sign is visible within; margins are well-defined; pleural retraction is present.

source_text: 双肺上叶多发索条影，陈旧灶可能，余双肺未见新发结节及片絮灶
text_en: Multiple linear opacities in the upper lobes of both lungs, likely chronic; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen elsewhere in the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔1R、2R、4R及右锁骨上区多发淋巴结缩小，原约22x18mm（IM15）、30x21mm（IM18），现约13x10mm（IM13）、22x13mm（IM16）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal 1R, 2R, 4R stations and right supraclavicular region have decreased in size, previously approximately 22x18 mm (IM15) and 30x21 mm (IM18), now approximately 13x10 mm (IM13) and 22x13 mm (IM16)

source_text: 双肺多发转移小结节较前略缩小
text_en: Multiple metastatic small nodules in both lungs are slightly smaller than prior.

source_text: 胃小弯旁、贲门左、肝门旁多发小淋巴结显示同前
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes near the gastric lesser curvature, left cardia, and porta hepatis show no change compared to prior.

source_text: 左锁骨上区多发小结节较前相仿，较大仍约8mm（IM11）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left supraclavicular region similar to previous, largest still approximately 8 mm (IM11).

source_text: 双肺叶间胸膜下多个小结节同前，较大仍约5mm（IM50）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the interlobar pleura of both lungs are stable, largest still approximately 5 mm (IM50).

source_text: 余扫及胸廓诸骨未见明确骨质破坏征象
text_en: No definite signs of osseous destruction are seen in the thoracic bones imaged.

source_text: 左肺上叶新发小结节，余双肺小结节同前，追查
text_en: A new small nodule in the left upper lobe; the remaining small nodules in both lungs are similar to previous; follow-up.

source_text: 右肺术后改变同前，支气管断端未见占位，少许模糊斑片影同前（IM25)，左肺内散在小片灶同前相仿
text_en: Findings of prior right lung surgery are unchanged; no space-occupying lesion is seen at the bronchial stump. Slight ill-defined patchy opacities are stable compared to prior (IM25). Scattered small patchy opacities in the left lung are similar to prior.

source_text: 纵隔少量小淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal few small lymph nodes unchanged.

source_text: 双肺多发小结节大致同前，如左肺舌段结节仍约3mm（IM32）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged, such as the nodule in the lingular segment of the left lung, still measuring approximately 3 mm (IM32).

source_text: 纵隔、左锁骨上多发肿大淋巴结较前相仿，约11x9mm（IM18）
text_en: Mediastinal and left supraclavicular multiple enlarged lymph nodes similar to previous, approximately 11x9 mm (IM18).

source_text: 左肺下叶内基底段钙化灶同前（IM43），余肺未见新发结节影
text_en: The calcified focus in the medial basal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged (IM43), and no new nodules are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 右肺散在小结节影同前，较大约5mm（IM44）
text_en: Scattered small nodular opacities in the right lung are stable compared to prior, the largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM44).

source_text: 右侧锁骨上小淋巴结大致同前，约5x3mm（IM5）
text_en: The small lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region are generally unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 5 x 3 mm (IM5).

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜小结节同前，考虑良性
text_en: Small nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior, considered benign.

source_text: 双肺多发磨玻璃密度小结节及微小结节灶大致同前，建议密切追查
text_en: Multiple ground-glass density small nodules and tiny nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged; close follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右侧第6肋骨局部骨折线模糊（Im23），余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Blurred fracture line in the right 6th rib (Im23). No evidence of osseous destruction in the other bones of the thorax.

source_text: 右肺中叶不规则结节同前相仿，仍约20x13mm（IM27），相邻血管纠集，密切追查
text_en: Irregular nodule in the right middle lobe similar to prior, still measures approximately 20x13 mm (IM27), with adjacent vascular convergence; close follow-up recommended

source_text: 残余右肺内少量条片影同前，双肺胸膜下小结节大致同前，＜5mm（IM22、33），余左肺未见结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Small amount of linear and patchy opacities in the residual right lung unchanged from previous, small subpleural nodules in both lungs largely unchanged, less than 5mm (IM22, 33), no nodules or patchy opacities in the remaining left lung.

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下、左肺下叶散在小结节同前，较大仍约4mm（IM47）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the subpleural region of the right middle lobe and left lower lobe are stable compared to prior, the largest still approximately 4 mm (IM47).

source_text: 双肺新见多发结节，考虑转移
text_en: Newly noted multiple nodules in both lungs; metastasis considered.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结，原3p及4R小淋巴结较前缩小（IM11、17）
text_en: No enlarged lymph nodes seen in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular regions, and bilateral axillary regions; previous small lymph nodes at stations 3p and 4R are smaller than before (IM11, 17).

source_text: 胸10椎体高密度灶同前相仿，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: High-density focus in T10 vertebra unchanged from prior; no bone destruction seen in other scanned bones.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段小结节影同前
text_en: Small nodular opacity in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable

source_text: 左肺多发小结节同前相仿，较大灶磨玻璃密度较前减低，仍约7mm（Im11）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left lung unchanged from prior; the larger ground-glass opacity nodule demonstrates decreased density compared to prior, still measuring approximately 7 mm (Im11)

source_text: 左肺索条及近膈面区网格状间质性病变表现同前，未见肺内新生结节
text_en: Left lung linear opacities and reticular interstitial disease near the diaphragmatic surface unchanged from prior, no new pulmonary nodules seen

source_text: 左肺术后改变，胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Left lung postoperative change, chest shows no newly added signs of space-occupying lesion.

source_text: 平扫纵隔4R组淋巴结较前增大，现约1.4*1.2cm（Im21）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows the mediastinal station 4R lymph node larger than prior, currently approximately 1.4x1.2 cm (Image 21).

source_text: 右肺下叶结节同前，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged and is considered a chronic finding.

source_text: 肺内陈旧灶同前，未见新生占位
text_en: Intrapulmonary old lesions unchanged from previous, with no new space-occupying lesions seen.

source_text: 左上肺纵隔胸膜旁结节原约10x7mm，现约13x9mm（IM10），较前略增大
text_en: Nodule adjacent to the mediastinal pleura in the left upper lobe has slightly increased in size, previously measuring approximately 10 x 7 mm, now approximately 13 x 9 mm (IM10).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端周围软组织结构紊乱较前减轻（IM22），下方结节较前略缩小，现约12*11mm(图25)，原约14*13mm（IMA23）
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; disorganized soft tissue structures around the bronchial stump have improved compared to prior (IM22). The nodule below has slightly decreased in size, now measuring approximately 12 x 11 mm (Figure 25), previously 14 x 13 mm (IMA23).

source_text: 考虑转移，请结合临床
text_en: Consider metastasis.

source_text: 扫及右肾上腺旁小结节、胃左动脉旁小淋巴结同前
text_en: On scan, small nodule adjacent to right adrenal gland and small lymph node near left gastric artery unchanged from prior.

source_text: 考虑恶性可能，右肺中叶GGO大小同前，密度略高，请结合临床或密切追查
text_en: Consider possible malignancy; ground-glass opacity in the right middle lobe is stable in size with slightly increased density. Correlation with clinical findings or close follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影较前相仿，双肺未见新发结节及片絮影
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lower lobe is similar to prior; no new nodules or fluffy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 左下叶胸膜下结节较前增大，原长径约12mm（IM44），现约15mm（IMA47）
text_en: Subpleural nodule in the left lower lobe has increased in size, previously measuring approximately 12 mm (IM44), now approximately 15 mm (IMA47).

source_text: T12椎体血管瘤同前，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Hemangioma in the T12 vertebral body is unchanged; no osseous destruction is seen in the remainder of the imaged bones.

source_text: 纵隔多个小淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右侧纵隔胸膜多发结节影同前相仿，较大约11mm（IM39），左侧纵隔胸膜结节（IM47），原局部伪影干扰显示欠清，转移不除外
text_en: Multiple nodules in the right mediastinal pleura are similar to prior. The largest is approximately 11 mm (IM39). The left mediastinal pleural nodule (IM47) was previously obscured by local artifact and poorly visualized. Metastasis cannot be excluded.

source_text: 纵隔11L、6组肿大淋巴结较前缩小，原约22*7mm者，现约12x5mm(图18、24、25)
text_en: The enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 11L and 6 have decreased in size compared to previous, originally approximately 22x7 mm, now approximately 12x5 mm (Figures 18, 24, 25).

source_text: 左上肺占位，较前增大，实性成分增多
text_en: Mass in the left upper lobe has increased compared to prior, with increased solid component.

source_text: 左肺上叶良性结节同前
text_en: A benign nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右侧胸膜局限软组织密度影，伴邻近右侧第5肋骨骨质破坏，新出现，考虑转移
text_en: Focal soft tissue density in the right pleura, with adjacent osteolytic destruction of the right fifth rib, newly seen; metastasis is considered.

source_text: 左肺微小结节同前，＜5mm（图27）
text_en: Tiny nodule in the left lung unchanged from prior, less than 5mm (image 27).

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结较前相仿，大小约10x7mm（IM25）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph node similar in size compared to prior, approximately 10x7 mm (IM25).

source_text: 双肺胸膜下多发高密度结节灶及索条同前
text_en: Multiple subpleural high-density nodules and linear opacities in both lungs are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃密度结节同前，约11x9mm（IM9），边界模糊，其内见结节状实性成分，约3mm（IM9）
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent; ground-glass density nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 11x9 mm (IM9), with blurred margins; a nodular solid component within measures approximately 3 mm (IM9).

source_text: 纵隔、肺门淋巴结大，转移可能，请结合临床明确
text_en: Mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes enlarged, possible metastasis, please correlate clinically for clarification.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结增大同前，约11x9mm（IM28)，纵隔余处、锁骨上区及双腋下未见新发肿大淋巴结
text_en: Enlarged right hilar lymph node unchanged, measuring approximately 11 x 9 mm (IM28); no new enlarged lymph nodes in the remainder of the mediastinum, supraclavicular regions, or bilateral axillae

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，仍约12x7mm（Im23）
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is similar to the prior study, still measuring approximately 12x7 mm (Im23).

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，大者约15x8mm（Im24）
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, largest approximately 15x8 mm (Im24).

source_text: 纵隔、左肺门淋巴结缩小，较大原约10x6mm，现约7x5mm（IM24）
text_en: Mediastinal and left hilar lymph nodes decreased in size; the largest previously approximately 10x6 mm, now approximately 7x5 mm (IM24).

source_text: 右侧肺门淋巴结同前
text_en: Lymph nodes in the right hilum are unchanged.

source_text: 双肺多发小结节同前，左上肺较大者仍约5mm（IMA20）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior, with the largest in the left upper lung still measuring approximately 5 mm (IMA20).

source_text: 右肺下叶少许不规则索条同前，左肺上叶舌段模糊微小结节同前（Im31），余双肺未见新生结节斑片影
text_en: Minimal irregular linear opacities in the right lower lobe stable; faint micro-nodule in the left upper lobe lingular segment stable (Im31); no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右上叶微小结节同前（IM22），左下叶模糊小斑片影消失，双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent; micro-nodule in the right upper lobe is stable compared to prior (IM22); the hazy small patchy opacity in the left lower lobe has resolved; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 纵隔4-5组淋巴结同前，较大约21x7mm（IM15）
text_en: Mediastinal stations 4-5 lymph nodes unchanged from previous, the larger one approximately 21x7 mm (IM15).

source_text: 右侧心膈角小淋巴结大致同前（IM49），追查
text_en: The small lymph node in the right cardiophrenic angle is essentially unchanged (IM49). Follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔内多个较高密度小淋巴结同前，隆突下较大者约13*9mm（IMA28）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes with higher density within the mediastinum are unchanged from previous, with the largest subcarinal one approximately 13x9 mm (Image A28).

source_text: 右肺下叶切除术后，肺内陈旧灶同前，未见新生占位征象
text_en: Post right lower lobectomy, old foci in the lung are unchanged; no new mass is seen in the lung.

source_text: 双肺胸膜下微小结节影同前（IM33、38、41），直径小于5mm
text_en: Subpleural micronodular opacities in both lungs are stable (IM33, 38, 41), with diameters less than 5 mm.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段见微小结节同前，约3mm（IM21）
text_en: A tiny nodule in the left lower lobe dorsal segment is unchanged, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM21).

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结较前略增大，原约13x8mm(Im20)，现约14x9mm（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are slightly enlarged compared to previous, previously approximately 13x8 mm (IM20), currently approximately 14x9 mm (IM21).

source_text: 右上胸膜增厚同前（IMA12），右肺点状结节影同前（IMA31、35）
text_en: Right upper pleural thickening unchanged (IMA12); right lung punctate nodular opacities unchanged (IMA31, 35).

source_text: 纵隔2-7组、双侧锁骨上淋巴结较前增大，现较大约29x23mm(IM21），原约17x12mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal stations 2-7 and bilateral supraclavicular lymph nodes are increased compared to previous; the larger one is now approximately 29x23mm (IM21) and was previously approximately 17x12mm (IM20).

source_text: 纵隔2、4组小淋巴结同前，4R组现约14x8mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal stations 2 and 4 small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, station 4R now approximately 14x8 mm (IM20)

source_text: 扫及胸廓未见骨质破坏
text_en: Scans show no bone destruction in the thorax.

source_text: 纵隔4组淋巴结大小同前，短径约11mm（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal group 4 lymph nodes size same as before, short axis diameter approximately 11 mm (IM19)

source_text: 前上纵隔转移淋巴结较前缩小，原约19x15mm（IM24），现约13x3m（IM22）
text_en: The metastatic lymph node in the anterior superior mediastinum has decreased in size, from approximately 19x15 mm (IM24) to approximately 13x3 mm (IM22).

source_text: 右肺中叶近肺门三枚小结节较前略微增大，原较大约11x5mm，现约12x6mm（IM18）
text_en: Three small nodules in the right middle lobe near the hilum are slightly larger than before, previously measuring approximately 11x5 mm, now approximately 12x6 mm (IM18).

source_text: 左上肺微结节呈致密点状灶，右肺叶间胸膜下结节同前，考虑良性
text_en: Left upper lobe micro-nodule appears as a dense punctate focus; right interlobar subpleural nodule unchanged, likely benign

source_text: 左下肺索条结节灶同前相仿，倾向良性
text_en: The linear opacity and nodule in the left lower lobe are similar to prior, favoring benign etiology.

source_text: 纵隔7组高密度灶较前缩小，原约15*14mm，现约15x11mm（IM31），考虑良性，追查
text_en: The high-density focus in mediastinal station 7 has decreased in size compared to prior, from approximately 15x14 mm to 15x11 mm (IM31), considered benign, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺另可见多发小结节大致同前，较大约5mm(IM32)
text_en: Additionally, multiple small nodules are seen in the right lung, essentially unchanged; the largest measures approximately 5 mm (IM32).

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，胸部未见复发和转移征象
text_en: Left lower lobe postoperative, chest shows no signs of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，左肺上叶前段不规则结节较前略增大，现约31x23mm（IM25），原约31x21mm（IM23），边缘毛糙，远端肺内见片絮影
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, an irregular nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe is slightly larger than before, currently approximately 31x23 mm (IM25), previously approximately 31x21 mm (IM23), margin irregular, with patchy opacities in the distal lung.

source_text: 其余扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: No osseous destruction is seen in the other bones within the scanned thorax.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结部分同前，如吻合口前方淋巴结仍约8x6mm（IM9），4L组模糊密度区较前略增大，原约15x13mm（IM20），现约17x15mm（IM21），请结合临床
text_en: Some multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged from previous, such as the lymph node anterior to the anastomosis which remains approximately 8x6 mm (IM9); the indistinct density area in the 4L group is slightly increased compared to previous, from approximately 15x13 mm (IM20) to approximately 17x15 mm (IM21), please correlate with clinical.

source_text: 左肺上叶斜裂下可见微小结节同前，小于5mm（IM18）
text_en: Tiny nodule below the oblique fissure in the left upper lobe unchanged, less than 5mm (IM18).

source_text: 显左锁骨上多发小淋巴结同前
text_en: multiple small left supraclavicular lymph nodes, unchanged from prior

source_text: 右侧肾上腺见结节灶大致同前，仍约13x12mm（IM57）
text_en: Nodular lesion in the right adrenal gland is essentially unchanged compared to prior, still measuring approximately 13x12 mm (IM57).

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下小结节同前，大小约6x4mm(IM56)，形态不规则，周围见索条影
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 6 x 4 mm (IM56), with irregular morphology and surrounding linear opacities.

source_text: 右肺中叶微小结节及左肺下叶磨玻璃密度灶大致同前
text_en: Micro-nodules in the right middle lobe and a ground-glass opacity in the left lower lobe are approximately unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔6组淋巴结稍大同前，约12x10mm（IM21）、双肺门淋巴结，较大约17x9mm（IM27）余双锁骨上及腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal station 6 lymph nodes slightly enlarged unchanged, approximately 12x10 mm (IM21), bilateral hilar lymph nodes, largest approximately 17x9 mm (IM27), no enlarged lymph nodes seen in bilateral supraclavicular and axillary regions.

source_text: 右肺中叶结节较前略增大，原较大约6x5mm（Im39），现约7x6mm（Im37）
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe is slightly larger than before, previously approximately 6 x 5 mm (Im39), now approximately 7 x 6 mm (Im37).

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下微小结节同前，约2mm（Im24）
text_en: The tiny subpleural nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 2 mm (Im24).

source_text: 纵隔4组见多个淋巴结较前缩小，较大原约18x12mm，现约12x10mm（IM22），追查
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal station 4 are decreased in size compared to previous, largest from approximately 18x12 mm to approximately 12x10 mm (IM22), for further investigation

source_text: 右肺上叶微结节同前，约2mm（IMA14），右肺尖少许索条影同前
text_en: Right upper lobe micro-nodule unchanged, approximately 2 mm (IMA14); minimal fibrotic bands at the right lung apex unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前略缩小，较大原约12x6mm，现约11x5mm（IM23）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are slightly decreased compared to previous; largest previously approximately 12x6mm, currently approximately 11x5mm (IM23).

source_text: 双肺见多发结节影同前，较大仍约6*5mm（IMA20）
text_en: Multiple nodular opacities are seen in both lungs, unchanged from prior; the largest remains approximately 6x5 mm (IMA20).

source_text: 余肺野肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: The remainder of the lung fields shows normal bronchovascular markings and uniform lucency, with no new nodules or consolidation.

source_text: 纵隔隆突下淋巴结较前饱满，原约15x12mm，现约17x15mm（Im25），邻近胸膜可见不规则增厚
text_en: Subcarinal mediastinal lymph node enlarged compared to previous, previously approximately 15x12 mm, now approximately 17x15 mm (Image 25), with irregular thickening of adjacent pleura

source_text: 右肺下叶新见病变，肺内转移与炎性待鉴别，密切追查
text_en: Newly seen lesion in the right lower lobe; pulmonary metastasis versus inflammatory etiology to be differentiated, close follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右上肺术后，双肺结节同前，追查
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lung; nodules in both lungs are unchanged; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段胸膜下小结节同前，仍约6x4mm（IM48）
text_en: The subpleural small nodule in the outer basal segment of the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior, still measuring approximately 6 x 4 mm (IM48).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃样结节大致同前，继续追查
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe is essentially unchanged; continued follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左侧第5肋转移切除术后同前，近局部肌层脂肪间隙稍模糊，邻近胸膜增厚，邻近左肺上叶少量索条同前
text_en: Status post resection of metastasis at the left fifth rib, unchanged compared to prior. The fat plane adjacent to the local muscular layer is slightly indistinct. Adjacent pleural thickening is present. Minimal linear bands in the adjacent left upper lobe are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶支气管旁软组织略厚同前相仿，局部淋巴结同前，仍约13x7mm（IM29）
text_en: Slight soft tissue thickening adjacent to the right middle lobe bronchus is similar to prior. Local lymph nodes remain unchanged, still measuring approximately 13 x 7 mm (IM29).

source_text: 右肺水平裂可见小结节影较前相仿，大小仍约5mm（IM33），另一结节较扁平同前（SE401，IM26），左肺下叶少量长条索影较前相仿，右肺下叶胸膜下少量模糊条片影，局部胸膜稍增厚
text_en: Small nodular opacity along the horizontal fissure of the right lung is similar to prior, remaining approximately 5 mm in size (IM33); another nodule remains flattened as before (SE401, IM26). Minimal linear opacities in the left lower lobe are unchanged. A small indistinct linear opacity is seen subpleurally in the right lower lobe, with mild local pleural thickening.

source_text: 胸7椎体及右第2肋骨致密小结节同前
text_en: Dense small nodule in T7 vertebra and right second rib, unchanged from previous.

source_text: 胸部CT所见同前，未见恶性征象
text_en: Findings on chest CT scan unchanged from prior. No malignant findings identified.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见明显异常软组织密度增厚影，右肺下叶索条结节影同前，约6mm（IM38）
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; non-contrast scan shows no significant abnormal soft-tissue density thickening at the bronchial stump. Linear and nodular opacities in the right lower lobe are unchanged, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM38).

source_text: 左肺舌段索条结节灶大致同前，约10x7mm（IM43）
text_en: Left lung lingular segment: linear nodule focus essentially unchanged, approximately 10x7 mm (Image 43)

source_text: 余肺未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: No new nodules or areas of consolidation are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，左肺上叶上舌段见浅分叶结节灶同前，大小约9x7mm（IM31），边缘较光滑，右肺下叶背段可见结节索条灶，伴细点钙化同前，余肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. A shallow lobulated nodule is seen in the left upper lobe superior lingular segment, stable in size at approximately 9x7 mm (IM31), with relatively smooth margins. A nodular linear opacity is seen in the right lower lobe posterior segment with fine punctate calcification, stable. No nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔4L、7组及左肺门小淋巴结同前，较大约7mm（IM23）
text_en: Small mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4L and 7 and left hilar region unchanged from previous, largest approximately 7 mm (IM23).

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃样病灶较前略增大，现14*9mm(图22)，原约12x7mm（IM21），边界欠清同前，病灶内呈混杂磨玻璃密度，其内血管纹理穿行
text_en: The ground-glass opacity lesion in the apical segment of the right upper lobe has slightly increased in size compared to prior, now measuring 14x9 mm (Figure 22), previously approximately 12x7 mm (IM21); ill-defined margins remain unchanged, the lesion shows mixed ground-glass density with vascular structures traversing through it.

source_text: 甲状腺结节同前，建议超声检查
text_en: Thyroid nodule stable, correlate with ultrasound examination.

source_text: 隆突下及右肺门淋巴结较前略增大，转移
text_en: Subcarinal and right hilar lymph nodes slightly increased compared to prior, metastatic.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下浅淡模糊小结节同前（IM49）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural faint hazy small nodule unchanged from previous (IM49).

source_text: 双肺上叶小结节同前，随诊复查
text_en: Small nodules in the upper lobes of both lungs are stable compared to prior; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 左肺上叶类圆形结节大致同前，约15mm（IM23），边界清楚
text_en: Left upper lobe round nodule stable compared to prior, approximately 15 mm (IM23), well-defined margins

source_text: 左肺下叶前基底段空洞性结节大小同前相仿，现约11x10mm（IM43），原约11x11mm，密度同前，边缘光滑
text_en: Left lower lobe anterior basal segment cavitary nodule size similar to prior, now approximately 11x10 mm (IM43), original approximately 11x11 mm, density same as prior, smooth margins.

source_text: 双侧肺散在微结节（Im28、32、52）同前
text_en: Scattered micro-nodules in the bilateral lungs (Im28, 32, 52) are unchanged.

source_text: 肝内多发低密度结节，转移
text_en: Multiple low-density hepatic nodules, metastases.

source_text: 纵隔内多发小淋巴结同前，较大约9mm（IM14）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes, stable compared to prior. Largest approximately 9 mm (IM14).

source_text: 双肺多发结节较前相仿，与不张肺组织分界不清，较大约16x14mm（IM30）
text_en: Multiple nodules in both lungs are similar to prior; poorly demarcated from atelectatic lung tissue. The largest measures approximately 16x14 mm (IM30).

source_text: 右肺小结节较前相仿，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: Right lung small nodules are similar to prior, likely representing old foci.

source_text: 左肺下叶多发微结节大致同前，追查
text_en: Multiple micronodules in the left lower lobe are essentially unchanged from prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺新见多发结节，追查
text_en: Newly seen multiple nodules in the right lung; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段见类结节及索条影较前略明显，现较大约11*11mm（IM53），原约10x9mm（IM54），伴少许支气管扩张影，
text_en: Nodular and streaky opacities in the left lower lobe basal segment are slightly more prominent than prior, currently largest approximately 11x11 mm (IM53) compared to previously approximately 10x9 mm (IM54), with mild bronchiectasis.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则形结节同前相仿，约18*11mm(IMA20)，近端肺内索条及片絮影较前减少
text_en: An irregular nodular lesion in the right upper lobe posterior segment is similar to prior, measuring approximately 18x11 mm (IMA20); proximal intrapulmonary linear and patchy opacities have decreased compared to prior.

source_text: 右侧第5肋骨内见斑片状致密影（IM26），胸1、3椎体内见类圆形低密度影同前，余扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Patchy dense opacity within the right 5th rib (IM26). Round low-density foci within the T1 and T3 vertebral bodies are unchanged. No evidence of osseous destruction in the other bones of the thorax.

source_text: 纵隔内小淋巴结平扫同前
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes on non-contrast scan unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶空洞性结节较前增大
text_en: The cavitary nodule in the right lower lobe is larger than before.

source_text: 右肺中叶肿物同前，仍约21x17mm（IM32），右肺膨胀不全、双下肺索条影同前
text_en: The lesion in the right middle lobe is unchanged, still measuring approximately 21 x 17 mm (IM32); right lung volume loss and reticular opacities in both lower lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右侧第9肋骨皮质中断同前（IM60），余扫及诸骨未见明确骨质破坏征象
text_en: Cortical interruption in the right 9th rib is unchanged (IM60). No definite evidence of osseous destruction in the other bones of the thorax.

source_text: 较大结节约21*18mm（Im31），转移伴考虑炎性病变可能，建议结合临床
text_en: Large nodule measuring approximately 21*18 mm (Im31), metastasis with possible inflammatory lesion.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门多发淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions unchanged from previous.

source_text: 双肺下叶小结节同前，倾向陈旧灶
text_en: Small nodules in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior, favored as old/chronic foci.

source_text: 左肺下叶外基底段类圆形小结节同前，约5mm（IM52）
text_en: The round small nodule in the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM52).

source_text: 余两肺多个微小点灶部分较前增大，左肺新见两处结节（IM13、27），约3mm
text_en: Some of the multiple tiny foci in the remainder of both lungs have increased in size; two new nodules are seen in the left lung (IM13, 27), each approximately 3 mm.

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段软组织密度结节同前，仍约15x10mm（IM49）
text_en: Left lower lobe basal segment soft tissue density nodule unchanged from prior, still approximately 15x10 mm (IM49)

source_text: 右肺下叶背段占位较前增大，恶性可能大，请结合病理结果
text_en: Mass in the right lower lobe posterior segment is larger than prior; malignancy is likely. Correlation with pathology results is recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜旁及左肺上叶前段两枚磨玻璃密度结节同前，分别约4mm（IM31）、7mm（Im26），结节内未见确切实性成分，其边缘光滑，周围未见索条影
text_en: Two ground-glass opacity nodules adjacent to the pleura in the right upper lobe and anterior segment of the left upper lobe remain unchanged, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM31) and 7 mm (IM26), respectively; no definite solid component is seen within the nodules, their margins are smooth, and no surrounding linear opacities are present.

source_text: 左肺上叶薄壁空腔同前，左下肺小结节此次未见确切显示
text_en: A thin-walled cavity in the left upper lobe is unchanged from prior; a small nodule in the left lower lobe is not clearly demonstrated on this examination.

source_text: 双肺门、纵隔7组多发肿大淋巴结同前，较大约13x11mm（IM27）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the bilateral hila and mediastinum (group 7) are unchanged from prior; the largest is approximately 13x11 mm (IM27).

source_text: 右肺术后改变同前，支气管断端未见占位，少许模糊斑片影同前（IM19)，左肺内散在小片灶同前相仿，追查
text_en: Findings of prior right lung surgery are unchanged; no space-occupying lesion is seen at the bronchial stump. Slight ill-defined patchy opacities are stable compared to prior (IM19). Scattered small patchy opacities in the left lung are similar to prior; further investigation is recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段磨玻璃密度结节影同前，约16x11mm（IMA12）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe unchanged from previous, approximately 16x11 mm (IMA12)

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区及纵隔内2L、4、5组淋巴结大致同前，约为10x6mm（IM16）
text_en: Lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region and mediastinal stations 2L, 4, and 5 are largely unchanged, measuring approximately 10x6 mm (IM16).

source_text: 余肺野未见新增病灶
text_en: The remainder of the lung fields shows no new lesions.

source_text: 右肺小结节同前（IM9、31、37、48），右肺下叶索条影同前
text_en: Right lung small nodules unchanged (IM9, 31, 37, 48); linear opacity in the right lower lobe unchanged

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段磨玻璃结节灶同前，不除外恶性，密切追查
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment ground-glass opacity nodule unchanged, cannot exclude malignancy, close follow-up.

source_text: 食道胸下段管壁增厚较前加著，较厚部位原约6mm，现约16mm（IMA41），外膜模糊，近端食管无扩张
text_en: Wall thickening of the lower thoracic esophagus worsened compared to prior, with maximum thickness increased from approximately 6 mm to 16 mm (IMA41); outer wall blurred, no proximal esophageal dilation

source_text: 纵隔内4R组淋巴结同前，较大仍约11x6mm（IM21），平扫密度较高，倾向良性，追查
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at station 4R, same as before; largest still approximately 11x6 mm (IM21), with higher density on non-contrast scan, suggestive of benign, follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔4R、7组及右肺门淋巴结较前相仿，较大仍约11mm（IM19）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 4R and 7 and the right hilum are similar to prior, with the largest remaining approximately 11 mm (IM19).

source_text: 纵隔4-7组多发淋巴结较前缩小，现较大约17*12mm(图17)，原约25x17mm（IM17）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4-7 reduced in size compared to previous, currently largest approximately 17x12 mm (Figure 17), previously approximately 25x17 mm (IM17).

source_text: 右肺上叶及下叶胸膜下多发微小结节同前
text_en: Multiple subpleural micro-nodules in the right upper and lower lobes remain unchanged.

source_text: 左上肺术后，纵隔淋巴结部分增大同前，追查
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy; some mediastinal lymph nodes remain enlarged, unchanged from prior; recommend follow-up

source_text: 右肺上叶不规则索条结节灶同前，约10x6mm（IM25），边界不清
text_en: Irregular linear and nodular opacity in the right upper lobe is unchanged, approximately 10x6 mm (IM25), with ill-defined margins.

source_text: 甲状腺右叶低密度灶较前缩小，原约18*15mm（IM4），现约9x6mm（IM4）
text_en: Low-density lesion in the right lobe of the thyroid gland decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 18x15 mm (IM4), currently approximately 9x6 mm (IM4).

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段不规则斑片影较前稍增大，现约33x23mm（IMA15），原约32x20mm，周围长索条牵拉胸膜
text_en: Irregular patchy opacity in the right upper lobe apical segment slightly increased in size, now approximately 33x23 mm (IMA15), previously 32x20 mm; surrounded by long linear opacities causing pleural traction

source_text: 左肺下叶外侧基底段模糊小结节同前，约3mm（Im40）
text_en: Left lower lobe, lateral basal segment: indistinct small nodule unchanged, approximately 3 mm (Image 40).

source_text: 纵隔2R、4-7、10L组多发淋巴结增大同前，较大仍约21x14mm（IM22），锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Lymphadenopathy in mediastinal stations 2R, 4-7, and 10L unchanged from prior, with the largest still measuring approximately 21x14 mm (IM22). No lymphadenopathy seen in supraclavicular regions or bilateral axillae

source_text: 食管胸中、下段两处管壁增厚较前减轻，管腔略狭窄减轻，较厚处原约13mm，现约8mm（IM27）
text_en: Wall thickening in two areas of the middle and lower thoracic esophagus is reduced compared to previous. Mild luminal narrowing is also reduced. The thickest portion was originally approximately 13 mm and is now approximately 8 mm (IM27).

source_text: 椎体散在低密度结节同前，边界较清
text_en: Scattered low-density nodules in the vertebrae unchanged from previous, with well-defined borders.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段纵隔旁软组织肿块较前缩小，原约31x30mm，现约28x27mm（IM18），呈分叶状，增强扫描明显强化，尖段支气管截断，邻近脏层胸膜牵拉凹陷，内侧与纵隔胸膜分界不清，肿块前下方纵隔4R组淋巴结分界不清
text_en: The soft tissue mass adjacent to the mediastinum in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is smaller than before, previously measuring approximately 31x30 mm and now approximately 28x27 mm (IM18). It appears lobulated and shows marked enhancement on contrast-enhanced scanning. The apical segmental bronchus is truncated, and there is adjacent visceral pleural retraction with indentation. The medial margin is ill-defined relative to the mediastinal pleura. The 4R group mediastinal lymph nodes anterior and inferior to the mass are indistinct in demarcation.

source_text: 纵隔3p及4R小淋巴结同前，约6x4mm（IM19）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 3p and 4R are the same as before, approximately 6x4 mm (IM19).

source_text: 余肺多发小结节同前
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the remaining lung are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺胸膜及胸膜下多发实性结节灶同前相仿，较大约5mm（IM37）
text_en: Multiple solid nodular foci in the right pleura and subpleural region are similar to prior, the largest measuring about 5 mm (IM37).

source_text: 左上叶术后，支气管断端少许软组织密度灶较前减少，右上肺陈旧灶同前，余双肺未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy; the small soft tissue density at the bronchial stump has decreased compared to prior; the old focus in the right upper lobe is stable; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 椎体余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: No evidence of bone destruction in the vertebrae or remaining bones of the thoracic cage.

source_text: 右下肺混合磨玻璃密度结节影大致同前，约22x13mm（IM37）
text_en: The mixed ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged compared to prior imaging, measuring approximately 22 x 13 mm (IM37).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段支气管截断，局部不规则结节较前缩小，现约8x7mm（IM31），原约25x21mm（IM28），远端肺内片絮、结节影较前减少，右肺下叶背段气管旁结节较前缩小，现约18x16mm（IM35），原约26x21mm（IM33）
text_en: Right upper lobe posterior segmental bronchial cutoff; the local irregular nodule has decreased in size compared to prior, now approximately 8x7 mm (IM31), previously about 25x21 mm (IM28). The patchy and nodular opacities in the distal lung have decreased compared to before. The paratracheal nodule in the right lower lobe dorsal segment has decreased in size, now approximately 18x16 mm (IM35), previously about 26x21 mm (IM33).

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, less than 10 mm.

source_text: 左肺癌术后，支气管残端周围软组织影及左肺结节大致同前
text_en: After left lung cancer surgery, soft tissue shadow around the bronchial stump and left lung nodules are similar to previous.

source_text: 双肺未见新发增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: No new nodular or patchy opacities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左侧胸膜结节样增厚同前，右侧胸膜光滑，双侧胸腔未见胸水
text_en: Left pleural nodular thickening is unchanged; right pleura is smooth; no pleural effusion is seen in either hemithorax

source_text: 前纵隔少许软组织影同前（IM18），未见增厚或结节
text_en: Minimal soft tissue density in the anterior mediastinum is stable compared to prior (IM18), without thickening or nodules.

source_text: 双肺散在模糊小结节同前，较大约4mm（IM33）
text_en: Scattered indistinct small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, largest approximately 4 mm (IM33).

source_text: 双肺结节影部分较前增大，现较大约40x29mm（IM36），原较大约21x18mm（Im36）
text_en: Some bilateral pulmonary nodules are larger than prior. The largest now measures approximately 40x29 mm (IM36), previously approximately 21x18 mm (IM36).

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结较前相仿，约22x16mm（IM30），余纵隔小淋巴结同前
text_en: The right hilar lymph node is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 22 x 16 mm (IM30); other small mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段稍高密度索条小结节灶同前（IM26）
text_en: Slightly hyperdense linear small nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable compared to prior (IM26)

source_text: 右肺下叶近胸膜处片状影较前减少，右肺索条影减少，双肺未见结节灶
text_en: The patchy opacity near the pleura in the right lower lobe has decreased compared to prior. The linear opacities in the right lung have also decreased. No nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 纵隔4R及右肺门淋巴结同前，较大仍约12x11mm（IM13）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal station 4R and right hilar region are unchanged from previous, still approximately 12x11 mm (IM13).

source_text: 甲状腺左叶高强化结节同前，追查
text_en: Left thyroid lobe high-enhancement nodule unchanged from prior study; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 食管癌术后改变，右侧少量胸水较前减少
text_en: Postoperative changes from esophageal cancer; small right pleural effusion decreased compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔4、5、7组多发淋巴结较前略缩小，现较大约21*6mm(图28)，原约22x7mm（IM29)
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4, 5, and 7 are slightly decreased compared to previous, now largest approximately 21x6 mm (Image 28), previously approximately 22x7 mm (Image 29).

source_text: 双肺散在少许纤维索条影同前，双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Scattered few fibrotic linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged, no new nodules or patchy opacities seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区淋巴结同前，约7mm（IM7）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node is unchanged, approximately 7 mm (IM7)

source_text: 扫及T8椎体高密度结节同前（IM37）
text_en: High-density nodule in the T8 vertebral body, stable compared to prior (IM37).

source_text: 右肺点状结节影同前（IMA35）
text_en: Punctate nodular opacity in the right lung is unchanged compared to prior (IMA35).

source_text: 右肺门可见淋巴结同前，大小约11x8mm（IM32）
text_en: A lymph node is visible in the right hilum, similar to prior, measuring approximately 11x8 mm (IM32).

source_text: 左下肺小结节同前，仍约2-3mm（IM43、53、54）
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable, still approximately 2–3 mm (IM43, 53, 54).

source_text: 左肺术后改变同前，胸部未见新生占位征象
text_en: Left lung postoperative change unchanged, chest shows no newly formed signs of space-occupying lesion.

source_text: 前纵隔低密度结节同前，约13x9mm（IM19），CT值22HU
text_en: Low-density nodule in the anterior mediastinum is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 13x9 mm (IM19), with a CT value of 22 HU.

source_text: 左肺下叶多发索条、胸膜牵拉增厚同前，余双肺散发模糊小结节同前（IM18、19、27、32），胸膜下分布为主，较大约5mm（IM19）
text_en: Multiple linear opacities and pleural thickening with traction in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous; scattered indistinct small nodules in the remaining bilateral lungs unchanged from previous (IM18, 19, 27, 32), predominantly subpleural distribution, largest approximately 5mm (IM19).

source_text: 右肺中叶类圆形浅淡密度结节同前，现仍约4mm（IM44）
text_en: Round faint density nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged, currently still approximately 4 mm (IM44).

source_text: 左肾上腺结节同前，追查
text_en: Left adrenal nodule unchanged, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 两肺内多发结节大部分同前相仿
text_en: Most of the multiple nodules in both lungs are similar to prior.

source_text: 甲状腺右叶低密度结节同前，约12x12mm（IM4），建议结合超声检查
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right lobe of the thyroid gland unchanged from prior, approximately 12x12 mm (IM4); recommend correlation with ultrasound examination.

source_text: 余右肺结节大致同前
text_en: The nodules in the right lung are largely unchanged.

source_text: 病灶边界仍模糊，内未见新发实性成分
text_en: The lesion margins remain ill-defined, with no new solid components identified within

source_text: 左肺上叶前段近胸膜处浅淡密度结节同前，约7x6mm（IM32）
text_en: A faint density nodule near the pleura in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe is unchanged, approximately 7x6 mm (IM32).

source_text: 纵隔6组和左肺门肿大淋巴结部分略缩小，较原约28x13mm(IM24)，现约21x9mm（IM25）
text_en: Mediastinal station 6 and left hilar lymphadenopathy partially slightly decreased in size, largest previously approximately 28 × 13 mm (IM24), now approximately 21 × 9 mm (IM25)

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，仍约5mm（IM37）
text_en: Small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, still approximately 5 mm (IM37).

source_text: 左肺门新见肿大淋巴结，约18x15mm（Im36）
text_en: New left hilar enlarged lymph node, approximately 18x15 mm (Image 36).

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结及右锁骨上区小淋巴结同前，较大仍约17x14mm（IM30），追查
text_en: The right hilar lymph node and small lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region are unchanged from prior; the largest remains approximately 17 x 14 mm (IM30); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双侧锁骨上区及双腋下见多发小淋巴结同前，右侧较大约10*6mm（IM20）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the bilateral supraclavicular regions and bilateral axillae are stable compared to prior; the largest on the right is approximately 10x6 mm (IM20).

source_text: 肝内多发低强化结节，转移
text_en: Multiple low-enhancing hepatic nodules, metastases.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区新见淋巴结，约为10mm（IM9），转移
text_en: Newly seen lymph node in the left supraclavicular region, measuring approximately 10 mm (IM9), suggestive of metastasis.

source_text: 纵隔平扫小淋巴结影同前
text_en: Non-contrast mediastinal CT demonstrates small lymph nodes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 原约者9x7mm者（IM17），现约12x9mm（IM16）
text_en: Previously measured at 9x7 mm (IM17), now measures approximately 12x9 mm (IM16).

source_text: 左肺多发微小结节增大，考虑转移
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in the left lung have increased in size, with metastasis considered

source_text: 右肺多发钙化点及微小结节同前（Im14、15、20、29、32），余双肺未见结节斑片影
text_en: Multiple calcified foci and micronodules in the right lung are unchanged (Im14, 15, 20, 29, 32); the remainder of both lungs show no nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 左肺上叶新见3mm大小结节（IM30)
text_en: A new 3mm nodule in the left upper lobe (IM30).

source_text: 右侧第2前肋骨膨胀性骨质破坏范围同前（IM9），呈肥皂泡样，边缘骨质硬化，请结合其它检查考虑
text_en: Expansile bony destruction in the right 2nd anterior rib is stable in extent (IM9), appearing soap-bubble-like with sclerotic margins; correlate with other studies.

source_text: 双肺粟粒样小结节大致同前
text_en: Miliary nodules in both lungs are approximately similar to prior.

source_text: 纵隔肿大淋巴结同前
text_en: Enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes as before.

source_text: 纵隔4、5组少许小淋巴结同前，较大约9mm（IM16）
text_en: A few small lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 4 and 5 are stable compared to prior. The largest measures approximately 9 mm (Image 16).

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段胸膜下微结节同前，约3mm（IM36）
text_en: The subpleural micronodule in the basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IM36).

source_text: 左侧第5肋骨质破坏较前加重
text_en: Osseous destruction at the left fifth rib is worse than prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃样结节同前相仿，较大约9x8mm（IM16）
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior, measuring up to approximately 9 x 8 mm (IM16).

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节略显饱满，边缘光滑，原约16*12mm，现约18x13mm(IM36)
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe slightly prominent with smooth margins, previously approximately 16x12mm, now approximately 18x13mm (Image 36).

source_text: 左肺上叶切除术后，局部支气管截断，断端软组织密度灶较前减少，未见确切占位征象
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, local bronchial cutoff, soft tissue density at the stump decreased compared to previous, no definite mass.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前(IM27)
