text_en: Tiny nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior (IM27).

source_text: 左肺下叶外侧基底段模糊小结节同前，约3mm（Im39）
text_en: Left lower lobe, lateral basal segment: indistinct small nodule unchanged, approximately 3 mm (Image 39).

source_text: 右肺上叶楔形切除术后改变，左肺下叶磨玻璃密度结节影较前略增大，两肺小结节影较前缩小
text_en: Post wedge resection of the right upper lobe; ground-glass opacity nodule in the left lower lobe is slightly larger than before, while small nodules in both lungs are smaller than prior.

source_text: 右肺尖可微结节同前，仍约2mm（IM12）
text_en: Tiny nodule in the right lung apex remains stable, still approximately 2 mm (IM12).

source_text: 双肺胸膜下少许结节同前（IM23、32、43），较大仍约5mm（IM32）
text_en: Few subpleural nodules in both lungs are stable (IM23, 32, 43), the largest still measuring approximately 5 mm (IM32).

source_text: 右叶间胸膜不规则结节同前，约7x2mm（IM29）
text_en: Irregular nodule along the right interlobar pleura, stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 7 x 2 mm (IM29)

source_text: 右肺多发粟粒样小结节较前增多
text_en: Multiplemiliary small nodules in the right lung have increased compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺结节灶较前增多、增大，转移
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary nodules are more numerous and larger than prior; metastasis.

source_text: 纵隔及双肺门见数枚淋巴结同前，短径小于10mm
text_en: Several lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions are unchanged from previous, with short axis less than 10 mm.

source_text: 纵隔主肺动脉窗及隆突下肿大淋巴结大致同前，现较大12x8mm（IM17)
text_en: Enlarged lymph nodes in the mediastinal aortopulmonary window and subcarinal regions remain similar to previous, currently measuring 12x8mm (IM17).

source_text: 原纵隔4、5组4淋巴结较前缩小
text_en: The lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 4 and 5 are smaller than before.

source_text: 右肺门可见肿大淋巴结，约33*26mm(图28)，纵隔多个小淋巴结大致同前，较大22*12mm(IM29)
text_en: An enlarged lymph node is visible in the right hilum, measuring approximately 33x26 mm (Figure 28). Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum are largely unchanged, with the largest measuring 22x12 mm (IM29).

source_text: 右肺多发小结节同前，恶性不能完全除外，结合临床或定期随访观察
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right lung are unchanged; malignancy cannot be completely excluded; correlation with clinical findings or periodic follow-up is advised.

source_text: 右侧胸膜增厚，右侧纵隔胸膜结节大小较前相仿，现仍约16x10mm（IM40），追查
text_en: Right pleural thickening is present. The right mediastinal pleural nodule is similar in size to prior, still measuring approximately 16x10 mm (IM40); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见新发占位
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no new mass is seen at the bronchial stump.

source_text: 纵隔4、5组淋巴结同前，较大者约13x8mm（IM19）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 4 and 5 are stable compared to prior. The largest measures approximately 13x8 mm (Image 19).

source_text: 新见两处结节
text_en: Newly identified two nodules

source_text: 余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏
text_en: The remaining thoracic bones show no osseous destruction.

source_text: 两肺散在磨玻璃密度小结节较前无明显变化
text_en: Scattered small ground-glass opacity nodules in both lungs, no significant change from prior.

source_text: 余肺内另见散在浅淡斑片结节影大致同前
text_en: The remaining lungs show scattered faint patchy and nodular opacities that are approximately unchanged.

source_text: 右肺多发小结节影密度、大小同前，较大约5mm（IM34、38、49）
text_en: The density and size of multiple small nodules in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior; the largest is approximately 5 mm (IM34, 38, 49).

source_text: 纵隔4组高密度淋巴结大致同前（IM24），双侧肺门、腋窝及锁骨上平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: High-density mediastinal station 4 lymph nodes are roughly unchanged from previous (IM24); on unenhanced scans, no enlarged lymph nodes are seen in bilateral hilar, axillary, and supraclavicular regions

source_text: 左锁骨上区、纵隔及左肺门多发肿大淋巴结转移较前稍缩小
text_en: Multiple metastatic enlarged lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region, mediastinum, and left hilar region, slightly decreased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 纵隔4-7组及双肺门淋巴结同前，较大仍约13x10mm（IM34）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4-7 and bilateral hilar lymph nodes are stable compared to prior, with the largest still measuring approximately 13 x 10 mm (IM34).

source_text: 左上肺原大小约1.5mm（IMA23），现约3mm（IMA22），考虑转移较前进展
text_en: The left upper lobe nodule, previously measuring approximately 1.5 mm (IMA23), now measures approximately 3 mm (IMA22); progression of metastasis is considered compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段结节同前相仿
text_en: Left upper lobe anterior segment nodule stable.

source_text: 右肺少许结节灶及索条影大致同前（Im39、42、49等）
text_en: Minimal nodules and linear opacities in the right lung are approximately unchanged (Im39, 42, 49, etc.).

source_text: 左侧第7前肋骨质异常硬化（IMA60），考虑转移可能性大，请结合骨扫描检查
text_en: Abnormal sclerosis of the left seventh anterior rib (IMA60), with high suspicion for metastasis; correlation with bone scan is recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，胸部CT扫描未见新发占位
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, chest CT scan shows no new mass.

source_text: 右肺上叶及左肺下叶小结节同前，约3mm（IM24、48）
text_en: Small nodules in the right upper lobe and left lower lobe are stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM24, 48).

source_text: 纵隔内4、7组多发小淋巴结同前相仿
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4 and 7 are similar to prior

source_text: 左上肺及左下肺胸膜下小结节同前（IM22、30）
text_en: Small subpleural nodules in the left upper and left lower lobes are stable compared to prior (IM22, 30).

source_text: L淋巴结较前饱满，现约13*11mm（IM22），原约9*8mm（IM20）
text_en: Lymph node in station L is now fuller than before, measuring about 13x11 mm (IM22), previously about 9x8 mm (IM20).

source_text: 纵隔4L组淋巴结较前增大，双侧锁骨上新见肿大淋巴结，左侧较大约13x7mm（IM8）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4L lymph nodes increased in size compared to prior, new enlarged lymph nodes in bilateral supraclavicular regions, left larger approximately 13x7mm (image 8).

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段胸膜下多发浅淡微结节较前模糊，现显示欠清，左肺下叶多发索条影同前
text_en: Multiple faint subpleural micronodules in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe are less distinct compared to prior and now poorly visualized; multiple linear opacities in the left lower lobe are unchanged from prior

source_text: 平扫纵隔淋巴结同前，约11mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes on non-contrast CT are stable compared to prior, with the largest measuring approximately 11 mm (IM20).

source_text: 纵隔多发金属夹影同前，未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple metal clip artifacts in the mediastinum unchanged from prior; no enlarged lymph nodes seen.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下多个微结节影同前，陈旧灶可能大，建议追查
text_en: Multiple tiny nodular opacities in the right lung subpleural region are unchanged; likely represent old lesions. Recommend follow-up.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，右肺上叶胸膜旁模糊小结节同前，约3mm（IM29），边界较前清楚
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, a subpleural indistinct small nodule in the right upper lobe similar to prior, approximately 3 mm (IM29), margins clearer than before.

source_text: 左肾上腺结节同前相仿，请结合腹部检查
text_en: Left adrenal nodule similar to previous, recommend correlation with abdominal examination.

source_text: 双肺新见多发微小结节，沿支气管走行分布
text_en: Newly noted multiple tiny nodules in both lungs, distributed along the bronchial course.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段两个浅淡密度结节灶同前，边缘模糊，约3mm、5mm（IM18、28）
text_en: Two faint density nodules in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe are unchanged from prior, with blurred margins, measuring approximately 3 mm and 5 mm (IM18, 28).

source_text: 余纵隔多发小淋巴结同前相仿
text_en: The remaining multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior.

source_text: 邻近肺内小结节同前，约6mm（IM12)，右肺点状钙化同前
text_en: Small nodule in the adjacent lung parenchyma similar to prior, approximately 6 mm (image 12), and punctate calcification in the right lung similar to prior.

source_text: 纵隔4、7组见数枚淋巴结同前，仍约9x8mm（IM26）
text_en: Several lymph nodes seen in mediastinal stations 4 and 7, unchanged from prior, still approximately 9x8 mm (IM26).

source_text: 前纵隔肿物切除术后，未见新发占位征象
text_en: Status post resection of anterior mediastinal mass. No new space-occupying lesion is seen.

source_text: 纵隔内数枚小淋巴结大致同前，较大约10*9mm（图21）
text_en: Several small mediastinal lymph nodes generally unchanged from prior, with the larger one approximately 10x9mm (Figure 21)

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜旁小结节较前增大，原约3mm（IM22），现约5mm（IM19）
text_en: The small subpleural nodule in the right upper lobe is larger than before, previously measuring approximately 3 mm (IM22), now approximately 5 mm (IM19).

source_text: 双肺见散在多发类圆形结节灶（Im9、18、26、28、31、34、37、42），部分较前略缩小，多数位于胸膜或胸膜下区，较大者原约6x5mm（Im25），现约5x4mm（IM28）
text_en: Scattered multiple round nodules are seen in both lungs (Im9, 18, 26, 28, 31, 34, 37, 42); some are slightly smaller than prior, and most are located at or subpleurally; the largest was approximately 6x5 mm (Im25), now approximately 5x4 mm (IM28).

source_text: 左肺上叶切除术后，胸部陈旧病变同前，未见新生占位征象
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, chronic chest lesions are stable compared to previous, with no new mass-like lesions.

source_text: 余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: The remaining thoracic bones show no osseous destruction.

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，短径小于10mm，密度较高
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, short diameter less than 10mm, higher density.

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后改变，双肺未见新发占位
text_en: Postoperative changes following right upper lobectomy; no new space-occupying lesions in the lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶前上胸膜下新见索条结节灶，建议追查
text_en: New linear-nodular opacity subpleurally in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 左肺尖小结节较前增大，现约14*8mm(图12)，原约10*6mm，考虑恶性可能大
text_en: Left apical segment: small nodule increased compared to previous, now approximately 14x8 mm (Figure 12), previously approximately 10x6 mm, malignancy likely.

source_text: 甲状腺右叶结节，同前请结合临床及其他检查
text_en: Right thyroid lobe nodule stable; please correlate with clinical findings and other studies.

source_text: 扫及右侧肾上腺结节影同前
text_en: On scan, right adrenal nodule unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，左肺上叶胸膜下微结节同前（IMA26），约3mm，边界清
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. The subpleural micronodule in the left upper lobe is stable (IMA26), measuring approximately 3 mm, with well-defined margins.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见异常强化区，右肺下叶索条灶同前，双肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no abnormal enhancement is seen at the bronchial stump. Linear opacities in the right lower lobe are stable compared to prior. No new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 双肺浅淡模糊小结节同前（IM23）
text_en: Faint, indistinct small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM23).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段结节大致同前，建议追查
text_en: Nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is essentially unchanged; recommend follow-up

source_text: 双肺多发小结节部分缩小，较大现约3mm者（IM32），原约7mm（IM32）
text_en: Some of the multiple small nodules in both lungs have decreased in size; the largest is now about 3 mm (IM32), previously about 7 mm (IM32).

source_text: 左上肺肺不张同前，平扫无法区分肺门肿块与肺不张
text_en: Left upper lobe atelectasis is unchanged from prior; the hilar mass and atelectasis cannot be distinguished on non-contrast imaging.

source_text: 胸廓诸骨未见明显骨质破坏
text_en: No significant bone destruction seen in the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜及纵隔胸膜多发结节状增厚同前
text_en: Multiple nodular thickenings of the right interlobar pleura and mediastinal pleura are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶、左侧胸膜结节较前增多增大，现较大约8mm（IMA51），考虑转移
text_en: Nodules in the right lower lobe and left pleura have increased in number and size, the largest now measuring approximately 8 mm (IMA51), suggestive of metastasis.

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结较前相仿，4R组仍约8mm（IMA21），内可见脂肪，倾向良性，追查
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes are similar to prior; 4R group remains approximately 8 mm (IMA21), with visible fat, suggestive of benignity, follow-up.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段肿块较前增大，现约40x28mm（IM45），原为31x26mm（IM44），肿块周围斑片索条影较前增多
text_en: The mass in the basal segment of the right lower lobe has increased in size compared to prior, now approximately 40x28 mm (IM45), previously 31x26 mm (IM44); patchy and linear opacities surrounding the mass have increased compared to prior.

source_text: 胸10椎体骨质密度不均增高同前，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: Inhomogeneous bone density with increased density in T10 vertebra unchanged from prior; no bone destruction seen in other scanned bones.

source_text: 右肺术后，支气管断端周围不规则软组织灶较前减少，未见结节及肿块
text_en: Post right lung surgery, irregular soft tissue focus around the bronchial stump has decreased compared to prior; no nodules or masses seen.

source_text: 右肺未见新增异常密度及结节
text_en: No new abnormal densities or nodules are seen in the right lung.

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段、右肺中叶片索条影较前减少，余肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Linear opacities in left upper lobe lingular segment and right middle lobe decreased compared to previous; no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remainder of the lung

source_text: 左肺下叶新见小结节，大小约6x4mm（IM42），转移待排，请密切追查
text_en: New small nodule in the left lower lobe, approximately 6x4 mm (IM42), metastasis cannot be excluded; close follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺门及纵隔隆突下软组织灶大致同前，余纵隔内淋巴结较前相仿，锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: The soft tissue focus below the carina in the right hilar and mediastinal region is largely unchanged. The remaining mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior. No enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes are seen.

source_text: 胸4椎体、右侧第4后肋致密结节同前
text_en: Sclerotic nodule in T4 vertebral body and right 4th posterior rib unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下结节灶大致同前
text_en: Subpleural nodule in the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged.

source_text: 左上肺癌术后较前相仿，支气管残端周围未见异常密度区
text_en: Status post left upper lobe lung cancer surgery, similar to prior; no abnormal density area seen around the bronchial stump.

source_text: 左背部皮下见一低密度结节较前略饱满，原约20x16mm（IM4），现约24x21mm（IM4）
text_en: Left dorsal subcutaneous low-density nodule slightly increased, previously approximately 20x16mm (IM4), now approximately 24x21mm (IM4).

source_text: 扫及左侧乳腺外下象限软组织肿块缩小，原约18*13mm，现约10mm（IM36）
text_en: A soft tissue mass in the lower outer quadrant of the left breast has decreased in size from approximately 18 x 13 mm to 10 mm (Im36).

source_text: 左锁骨上多发小淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in left supraclavicular region unchanged from previous.

source_text: 扫及腹腔多发淋巴结较前增大，建议腹部检查
text_en: CT shows multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the abdomen, increased in size compared to prior; abdominal evaluation is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔2-7组及双腋区数枚淋巴结同前，较大仍约16x5mm(IM34)
text_en: Mediastinal stations 2-7 and bilateral axillary several lymph nodes are unchanged from previous; the larger one is still approximately 16x5mm (IM34).

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，肺内透亮度均匀，右肺上叶尖段胸膜下小结节同前相仿，约2mm（IM13），余肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. Lung lucency is uniform. A subpleural small nodule in the right upper lobe apical segment is similar to prior, measuring approximately 2 mm (IM13). No new nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右上肺结节同前，仍约4mm（IM27）
text_en: Nodule in the right upper lung is unchanged, still measuring approximately 4 mm (IM27).

source_text: 右肺下叶纤维索条影同前，双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Fibrotic linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 左肺可见多发小结节，较大约12*10mm(图33)，考虑转移可能大
text_en: Multiple small nodules in left lung, largest approximately 12x10 mm (Figure 33), suspicious for metastasis.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结影同前，约13*8mm（IMA28）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node shadow is unchanged, measuring approximately 13x8 mm (IMA28).

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下另可见多发点状微小结节同前（Im20、26、32）
text_en: Multiple punctate micronodules in the subpleural region of the right upper lobe remain stable (Im20, 26, 32).

source_text: 右肺下叶近肺门结节较前似相仿，平扫与肺血管分界不清，远端肺内模糊片影较前相仿，两肺内多发结节及模糊条片影较前相仿（IM19、23、26-29、33），部分结节较前模糊
text_en: The nodule near the hilum of the right lower lobe appears similar to prior. On non-contrast imaging, it is indistinct from adjacent pulmonary vessels. The hazy patchy opacity in the distal lung parenchyma is similar to prior. Multiple nodules and hazy linear-patchy opacities in both lungs are similar to prior (IM19, 23, 26–29, 33), with some nodules appearing more indistinct than before.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结同前，约24*14mm（IMA28）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes unchanged from prior, approximately 24x14 mm (IMA28)

source_text: 右肺中下叶切除术后改变，胸部未见复发和转移征象
text_en: Postoperative changes following resection of the right middle and lower lobes; no signs of recurrence or metastasis in the chest.

source_text: 左锁骨上、双腋下、纵隔3、4、7组多发淋巴结，部分较前略缩小，原约24x13mm者现约20x11mm（IM37）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region, bilateral axillae, and mediastinal stations 3, 4, and 7; some slightly decreased in size compared to prior, with the largest previously measuring approximately 24x13 mm now measuring approximately 20x11 mm (IM37).

source_text: 余扫描所及诸骨未见骨质破坏
text_en: No osseous destruction is seen in the imaged bones.

source_text: 右中下叶间淋巴结同前
text_en: Lymph node between the right middle and lower lobes is unchanged.

source_text: 左锁骨上可见新增的肿大淋巴结，大小约16x14mm（IM3）
text_en: Newly enlarged lymph node in left supraclavicular region, approximately 16x14mm (IM3).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后改变，胸部CT增强未见新发占位
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left upper lobe; contrast-enhanced chest CT shows no new mass lesions.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下淋巴结大致同前，较大约16*11mm(图16)
text_en: Mediastinal, bilateral hilar, supraclavicular, and bilateral axillary lymph nodes are largely unchanged, with the largest measuring approximately 16x11 mm (Figure 16).

source_text: 左斜裂胸膜小结节同前
text_en: Small pleural nodule along the left oblique fissure is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺门至右肺下叶肿块之间沿血管束多发淋巴结平扫显示欠清，纵隔7组淋巴结同前相仿，约11x9mm（IM28），平扫密度较高
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes along the vascular bundle between the right hilar and right lower lobe masses are poorly visualized on non-contrast imaging. The mediastinal 7-group lymph node is similar to prior, measuring approximately 11x9 mm (IM28), with relatively high density on non-contrast imaging.

source_text: 纵隔、肺门、锁骨上及腋窝多发淋巴结部分较前缩小，较大原约18x11mm（IM23），现约13x8mm（IM23）
text_en: Mediastinal, hilar, supraclavicular, and axillary multiple lymph nodes partially decreased in size compared to previous, largest previously approximately 18x11 mm (IM23), now approximately 13x8 mm (IM23).

source_text: 纵隔2、4、5、7组及右肺门多发淋巴结均较前缩小，如原约12x7mm，现约10x5mm（IM20）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal groups 2, 4, 5, 7 and right hilum are all reduced in size compared to previous, with previous size approximately 12x7mm and current size approximately 10x5mm (IM20)

source_text: 纵隔4、7及右肺门见淋巴结缩小，较大原约25x12mm（IM22），现较大约15x6mm（IM20）,双锁骨上及腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4 and 7 and right hilar lymph nodes have decreased in size, with the largest previously measuring 25x12 mm (IM22) and currently 15x6 mm (IM20). No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in bilateral supraclavicular or axillary regions.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下微小结节影同前，约3mm（IM47）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural tiny nodule unchanged, approximately 3mm (Image 47)

source_text: 右肺上叶前段磨玻璃密度结节较前稍显饱满，现约15x9mm（IM19），原为13x6mm（IM17），病变边缘毛糙、其内见肺血管及气管穿行同前
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe slightly more prominent, currently approximately 15x9 mm (IM19), previously 13x6 mm (IM17); lesion margin remains irregular, with pulmonary vessel and airway traversing through it, unchanged

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，右肺中叶胸膜旁实性软组织密度小结节大小同前相仿，约6mm（IMA28），边缘略不规则
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, a small solid soft tissue density nodule subpleural in the right middle lobe similar in size to prior, approximately 6 mm (IMA28), slightly irregular margins.

source_text: 新见多发模糊小斑片及小结节
text_en: Newly seen multiple hazy small patchy opacities and small nodules

source_text: 右肺下叶不规则结节较前缩小，原约15x10mm，现约8x4mm（IM28）
text_en: The irregular nodule in the right lower lobe has decreased in size, previously measuring approximately 15x10 mm, now approximately 8x4 mm (IM28).

source_text: 纵隔4L及右侧锁骨上淋巴结较前略缩小，原较大层面约23x11mm（Im22），现约11*4mm(图22)
text_en: Mediastinal station 4L and right supraclavicular lymph nodes are slightly decreased in size compared to prior, with the larger dimension previously measuring approximately 23x11 mm (Im22) and now approximately 11x4 mm (image 22).

source_text: 双肺新见多发结节，较大约11x9mm（IM23），考虑转移
text_en: Newly noted multiple nodules in both lungs, the largest measuring approximately 11x9 mm (IM23); metastasis considered.

source_text: 双肺散在小结节大致同前，复查
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged, recheck.

source_text: 左下肺不规则占位范围大致同前，仍约26x13mm（IM32），实性成分减少（IM32）
text_en: Irregular mass in the left lower lobe remains approximately the same in overall extent, measuring about 26x13 mm (IM32). There is a decrease in the solid component (IM32).

source_text: 左肺门淋巴结同前，现约12x10mm（IMA37）
text_en: Left hilar lymph node unchanged, currently approximately 12x10 mm (IMA37).

source_text: 左下叶磨玻璃密度结节同前，仍约6mm(IM35)
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged, still approximately 6 mm (IM35).

source_text: 左肺多发小结节同前（IM40、50、51）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left lung unchanged from prior (IM40, 50, 51)

source_text: 纵隔4R、4L组小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R and 4L are similar to previous

source_text: 纵隔、锁骨上、腋下、右侧心膈角多发淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum, supraclavicular region, axilla, and right cardiophrenic angle are unchanged from prior; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前相仿，仍约10x5mm（IM22）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior; still measuring approximately 10x5 mm (IM22)

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约14x7mm（IM26）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged, largest measuring approximately 14x7 mm (IM26)

source_text: 左肺下叶叶间胸膜多发结节同前，约7x5mm（IM29）
text_en: Multiple nodules in the interlobar pleura of the left lower lobe unchanged from previous, approximately 7x5mm (IM29)

source_text: 扫及左上腹部胃底下方淋巴结同前，约10x9mm（IMA47），建议随访复查
text_en: On scan, left upper quadrant subgastric lymph node unchanged from prior, approximately 10x9 mm (IMA47), follow-up recommended

source_text: 部分较前缩小，如4L组，原约22x14mm（Im26），现约15x9mm（IM27）
text_en: Partial reduction, e.g., in station 4L, from approximately 22x14mm (IM26) to approximately 15x9mm (IM27).

source_text: 左肺致密小结节影同前（Im38）
text_en: The dense small nodule in the left lung is unchanged (Im38)

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度影（IM21）、钙化结节及索条影同前
text_en: Ground-glass opacity (IM21), calcified nodule, and linear bands in the right upper lobe are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，右肺中叶近斜裂不规则结节同前，大小仍约8x6mm（IMA29），内见钙化
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, an irregular nodule near the oblique fissure in the right middle lobe similar to prior, size still approximately 8x6 mm (IMA29), with internal calcification.

source_text: 两肺门淋巴结大致同前，右肺门较大者仍约15*14mm（IMA25）
text_en: Hilar lymph nodes in both lungs are stable; the largest on the right side remains approximately 15x14 mm (IMA25).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段微小结节同前，约3mm（IM15）
text_en: A tiny nodule in the apical-posterior segment of the left upper lobe same as before, approximately 3 mm (IM15).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后较前相仿，平扫支气管断端未见增厚及软组织密度影，右肺模糊结节样影同前，仍约8x6mm（IM32）
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left upper lobe similar to prior; non-contrast CT shows no thickening or soft tissue density at bronchial stump, right lung hazy nodular opacity unchanged, still approximately 8x6 mm (IM32).

source_text: 右肺上叶、中叶及左肺下叶小结节数目大小同前，较大仍约6mm（IM47)
text_en: Number and size of nodules in the right upper and middle lobes and left lower lobe unchanged; largest still approximately 6 mm (IM47).

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下小结节显示不清，余肺内未见新增结节及斑片影
text_en: The subpleural small nodule in the left lower lobe is not clearly visualized; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remaining lung parenchyma

source_text: 纵隔2R,4R多发淋巴结同前，较大9x8mm（IM21)
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R and 4R unchanged from previous, largest 9x8 mm (IM21).

source_text: 左肺上叶肺门偏外侧磨玻璃密度结节大致同前，范围约29*22mm（IM24）
text_en: Left upper lobe, peripheral to the hilum, ground-glass opacity nodule similar to previous, approximately 29*22 mm (IM24).

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，大小约9x7mm（IM51）
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from prior, size approximately 9x7 mm (IM51).

source_text: 双肺弥漫大小不等结节影伴网格状影大致同前
text_en: Diffusely distributed nodules of varying sizes and reticular opacities in both lungs are largely stable.

source_text: 左肺上叶及右肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation in left upper lobe and right lung

source_text: 右肺下叶背段近叶间胸膜处模糊小结节同前相仿，约7x4mm（IM26）
text_en: A small indistinct subpleural nodule near the interlobar pleura in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is similar to prior, approximately 7x4 mm (IM26).

source_text: 余双肺结节致同前
text_en: The nodules in the remainder of both lungs remain stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺癌术后，支气管断端软组织略增厚（IM33）同前
text_en: After left lung cancer surgery, slight soft tissue thickening at the bronchial stump (IM33) is similar to previous.

source_text: 纵隔内2R、4R组见淋巴结同前，较大约10x7mm（Im12）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R and 4R are unchanged, measuring approximately 10x7mm (Im12).

source_text: 双肺小结节大致同前，随诊观察
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are roughly stable compared to prior, follow-up observation recommended

source_text: 两肺索条小结节影同前（IM11、13、15、21、37），小于5mm
text_en: The linear opacities and small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM11, 13, 15, 21, 37), less than 5 mm.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段模糊小结节大致同前，约4mm（IM10）
text_en: Stable ill-defined small nodule in left upper lobe apicoposterior segment, approximately 4 mm (IM10)

source_text: 左肺下叶索条影同前，两肺散在模糊小结节同前，较大仍约7x6mm（IM13）
text_en: Left lower lobe fibrotic streak unchanged, scattered indistinct small nodules in both lungs unchanged, larger nodule still approximately 7x6mm (IM13)

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见占位征象，左肺条片影同前（IMA36）
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, no mass lesion at the bronchial stump, left lung linear opacity stable compared to prior (IMA36)

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见异常软组织密度肿块影，右肺索条影及叶间胸膜增厚同前
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no abnormal soft tissue density mass is seen at the bronchial stump. Linear opacities and interlobar pleural thickening in the right lung are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 转移可能，追查
text_en: Possible metastasis, further workup recommended.

source_text: 主动脉弓旁及左肺门小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes adjacent to the aortic arch and left hilum are unchanged.

source_text: 右下肺索条影同前，余肺未见新生结节灶及斑片影
text_en: The linear band in the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior imaging; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶微结节同前，随诊观察
text_en: Right lower lobe micronodule stable; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺局限性索条影同前，余肺内未见新生结节及实变影
text_en: Focal linear opacity in the right lung is unchanged; no new nodules or consolidation are seen elsewhere in the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔4组淋巴结略饱满，原较大约14x10mm（IM24），现约15x11mm（IM22），双肺门、锁骨上及腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal group 4 lymph nodes slightly enlarged, previously largest approximately 14x10 mm (IM24), currently approximately 15x11 mm (IM22), no enlarged lymph nodes seen in bilateral hilar, supraclavicular, and axillary regions

source_text: 右肺上叶见多发不规则形小结节同前（IM27），较大仍约5mm，邻近叶间胸膜增厚同前
text_en: Multiple irregular small nodules are seen in the right upper lobe, unchanged (IM27); the largest remains approximately 5 mm; adjacent interlobar pleural thickening is unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔4组淋巴结同前（IMA24）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal station 4 are stable compared to prior (IMA24)

source_text: 两侧实性成分较前增多，如较大原约24x13mm，现约24x17mm(IM14)，边缘见多发毛刺及分叶，追查
text_en: Solid components on both sides have increased compared to prior. For example, a lesion previously measuring approximately 24x13 mm now measures approximately 24x17 mm (IM14), with multiple spiculations and lobulations at the margin. Further investigation is warranted.

source_text: 左肺上叶及左斜裂胸膜微小结节同前（IM24、33、35、47）
text_en: Micronodules in left upper lobe and left oblique fissure pleura unchanged (IM24, 33, 35, 47)

source_text: 甲状腺右叶多发低密度结节同前相仿
text_en: The right thyroid lobe shows multiple low-density nodules, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右侧下叶（后肋膈角区）不规则软组织密度影较前明显缩小，原病变范围约34x15mm（IM58），现约7mm（IMA59），考虑炎症，观察
text_en: Irregular soft tissue density in the right lower lobe (posterior cardiophrenic angle region) has markedly decreased in size, previously measuring approximately 34x15 mm (IM58), now approximately 7 mm (IM59). Inflammatory etiology is considered; observation is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结大致同前（IM28）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes essentially unchanged from previous (IM28)

source_text: 左肺上叶癌复查：局部不规则实变伴支气管扩张表现大致同前（IM18），追查
text_en: Follow-up of left upper lobe carcinoma: localized irregular consolidation with bronchiectasis is largely unchanged (IM18), for follow-up.

source_text: 两肺模糊小结节灶同前
text_en: The hazy small nodules in both lungs are unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 双侧锁骨上小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the bilateral supraclavicular regions are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下微小结节同前，双侧肺内未见新发结节灶
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior; no new pulmonary nodules are seen bilaterally.

source_text: 右肺上叶微小结节影同前（IMA10、22）
text_en: Right upper lobe micro-nodule unchanged (IMA10, 22)

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结部分同前，较大约17x11mm（IM24），部分较前饱满，现约15x9mm者(IMA24)，原约15x7mm
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes: some unchanged, the largest approximately 17x11mm (IM24); some appear more prominent compared to previous, now approximately 15x9mm (IMA24), previously approximately 15x7mm.

source_text: 两肺小结节影较前增大，较大约8*7mm（IMA20）
text_en: The small nodules in both lungs are larger than before; the largest is now approximately 8x7 mm (IMA20).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段小结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: Small nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged; benign etiology favored.

source_text: 纵隔4、6组淋巴结同前，较大约10x7mm（IMA24）
text_en: Mediastinal groups 4 and 6 lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest approximately 10x7 mm (IMA24).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段不规则肿块较前略缩小，现约24*14mm(图24)，原约25x17mm（IM23），其内仍见支气管气相
text_en: In the anterior segment of the left upper lobe, an irregular mass has slightly decreased compared to previous, now approximately 24x14 mm (Figure 24), previously approximately 25x17 mm (IM23), with an air bronchogram still present within it.

source_text: 左肺门新见结节样软组织灶，约13mm（IMA26），密切观察
text_en: New left hilar nodular soft tissue lesion, approximately 13 mm (Image A26), close follow-up.

source_text: 双肺少许索条影同前，未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Few linear opacities in both lungs are stable; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后同前，支气管断端未见确切复发征象
text_en: The postoperative change in the left upper lobe is similar to previous; no definite signs of recurrence at the bronchial stump.

source_text: 纵隔7组高密度灶较前缩小，现约15*14mm(图30)，原约21x15mm（IM30），术后改变可能，追查
text_en: The high-density focus in mediastinal station 7 has decreased in size compared to prior, from approximately 21x15 mm (IM30) to 15x14 mm (Figure 30), possible postoperative change, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶新见小片状模糊影，左肺内未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Newly seen small patchy hazy opacity in the right lower lobe; no new nodules or consolidations identified in the left lung.

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段点状微小结节同前，约3mm（IM29），右肺中叶内侧段钙化灶同前
text_en: Punctate tiny nodule in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe, unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM29). Calcified focus in the medial segment of the right middle lobe remains unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变同前，胸部CT平扫未见明显占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lobe are unchanged; non-contrast chest CT shows no obvious space-occupying lesion

source_text: 右肺门及4R组淋巴结部分较前缩小，右肺门较大者原约15x12mm（Im26），现约13x8mm（IM26）
text_en: Some lymph nodes in the right hilar region and 4R station have decreased in size compared to prior; the largest in the right hilum previously measured approximately 15x12 mm (Im26), now measures approximately 13x8 mm (IM26).

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下占位，较前增大，局部胸膜受累可能
text_en: Subpleural mass in the right lower lobe has increased in size compared to prior; pleural involvement is possible.

source_text: 食管癌术后，右侧胸腔胃，弓上吻合口未见异常，胸胃左旁结节较前缩小，原约20x17mm（IM24），现约17x15mm（IM24）
text_en: Postoperative esophageal cancer; right thoracic stomach, supra-arch anastomosis normal; nodule left adjacent to thoracic stomach decreased in size, previously approximately 20x17mm (IM24), currently approximately 17x15mm (IM24).

source_text: 右下叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见异常软组织密度肿块影，右肺索条影、钙化灶同前
text_en: Postoperative status, right lower lobe; no abnormal soft tissue density mass at the bronchial stump on non-contrast imaging; right lung linear densities and calcifications unchanged.

source_text: 左肺下叶支气管显示，左肺上叶仍截断，左肺门占位较前缩小，原约35x23mm（IM19），现约28x20mm（IM19），左肺下叶肺组织复张
text_en: Left lower lobe bronchus visible, left upper lobe still cutoff, left hilar mass reduced compared to previous, previously approximately 35x23 mm (IM19), now approximately 28x20 mm (IM19), re-expansion of left lower lobe lung parenchyma

source_text: 左肺门及纵隔多发小淋巴结，部分较前增大，如原约17x10mm者，现约18x13mm（IM30）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the left hilar and mediastinal regions, some increased in size compared to prior, e.g., previously approximately 17x10 mm, now approximately 18x13 mm (IM30)

source_text: 纵隔6组新见小淋巴结，约9x7mm（IM24），追查
text_en: Newly seen small lymph nodes in mediastinal station 6, approximately 9x7 mm (IM24); recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右肺下叶纤维索条影较前减少，右肺清晰，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Fibrotic linear opacity in the right lower lobe has decreased compared to prior; the right lung is clear, with no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节较前略缩小，现约6*6mm(图54)，原约8x7mm（IM55）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is slightly smaller than before, now approximately 6x6 mm (Figure 54), previously approximately 8x7 mm (IM55).

source_text: 右肺尖见模糊小结节同前（IM17），下叶背段近叶间胸膜见硬结灶同前（IM29）
text_en: A faint small nodule is seen in the right lung apex, unchanged from prior (IM17). A sclerotic focus is seen near the interlobar pleura in the posterior segment of the lower lobe, unchanged from prior (IM29).

source_text: 双肺多发转移结节影较前略缩小，较大原约12x7mm（IM28），现约11x6mm（IM34）
text_en: Multiple metastatic nodules in both lungs are slightly smaller than prior; the largest was previously about 12x7 mm (IM28), now measures approximately 11x6 mm (IM34).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段支气管狭窄截断伴不规则肿块较前相仿，现约36x26mm（IM26），增强扫描不均匀强化，病变侵犯邻近胸膜同前，远端肺组织阻塞性改变同前
text_en: Right upper lobe posterior segmental bronchial narrowing and cutoff with an irregular mass, similar to prior, now approximately 36x26 mm (IM26). The lesion shows heterogeneous enhancement on contrast-enhanced scanning. Invasion of the adjacent pleura remains unchanged. The obstructive changes in the distal lung parenchyma are unchanged.

source_text: 气管食管沟旁淋巴结同前
text_en: Lymph nodes adjacent to the tracheoesophageal groove unchanged from prior.

source_text: 腔静脉后淋巴结同前，约15*9mm（IMA24），呈高密度
text_en: Posterior to the vena cava, a lymph node is unchanged, measuring approximately 15x9 mm (IMA24), appearing high density.

source_text: 右肺中叶贴水平裂下一约3mm浅淡微小结节同前（Im26）
text_en: A faint approximately 3 mm tiny nodule adjacent to the horizontal fissure in the right middle lobe, unchanged from prior (Im26)

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后，未见复发转移征象
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, no evidence of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 纵隔内数枚小淋巴结同前，较大者仍约12x8mm（IM19）
text_en: Several small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, with the larger one still approximately 12x8mm (IM19)

source_text: 右肺门及右侧锁骨上小淋巴结同前，较大仍约12x6mm（Im29）
text_en: Small lymph nodes at the right hilum and right supraclavicular region are stable compared to prior, the largest still measures approximately 12x6 mm (Im29)

source_text: 左下肺磨玻璃密度结节大小、形态及密度特征同前，约9x6mm（Im39）
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the left lower lobe is stable in size, morphology, and density characteristics compared to prior, measuring approximately 9x6 mm (Im39).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段类圆形前段模糊小结节同前，仍约3mm（IM23）
text_en: Round, ill-defined small nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe unchanged from previous, still approximately 3 mm (IM23)

source_text: 右上肺术后，双肺小结节、纵隔及双侧锁骨上多发肿大淋巴结，均考虑转移
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lung; small nodules in both lungs, and multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral supraclavicular regions are all considered metastatic.

source_text: 双上肺多发索条影及钙化灶同前相仿，余双肺未见新发结节灶或斑片影
text_en: The multiple linear strands and calcified foci in both upper lungs are similar to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 纵隔、双锁骨上区、腋下未见新发肿大淋巴结
text_en: No new lymphadenopathy is seen in the mediastinum, bilateral supraclavicular regions, or axillary regions.

source_text: 双肺未见新发异常密度
text_en: No new abnormal densities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 膈下结节大致同前
text_en: A subdiaphragmatic nodule is essentially unchanged.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，仍约8x5mm（IM34）
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from prior, still approximately 8x5 mm (IM34).

source_text: 背部皮下脂肪内小结节较前相仿，约为13x13mm（IM6）
text_en: A small nodule within the subcutaneous fat of the back is similar to previous, approximately 13x13 mm (IM6)

source_text: 双锁骨上见多发小淋巴结同前，较大约6x3mm（IM2）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes are seen in bilateral supraclavicular regions, unchanged from prior; the largest measures approximately 6x3 mm (IM2).

source_text: 左肺上叶占位，较前明显减小
text_en: A mass in the left upper lobe is significantly decreased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 左肺小结节同前，陈旧灶可能大
text_en: Left lung small nodule unchanged, old lesion possibly larger

source_text: 纵隔内软组织增厚范围略减小，原约29x23mm（IM29），现约24x22mm（IM30）
text_en: Mediastinal soft tissue thickening slightly decreased in extent, previously approximately 29x23mm (IM29), currently approximately 24x22mm (IM30)

source_text: 右肺上叶模糊磨玻璃密度结节较前略增大，原约14x6mm（Se401 IM18），现约18x6mm（Se402 IM20）
text_en: Indistinct ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe, slightly increased in size compared to prior; previously measured approximately 14 x 6 mm (Se401 IM18), now measures approximately 18 x 6 mm (Se402 IM20).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前相仿，现较大者仍约11x10mm（IMA20），双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: The mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to previous, with the largest still approximately 11x10 mm (IMA20). No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular areas, or bilateral axillae

source_text: 右肺上叶及下叶斑片索条影同前，双肺未见新生结节
text_en: The patchy and linear opacities in the right upper and lower lobes remain unchanged; no new nodules are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 新见多发磨玻璃密度结节
text_en: Newly seen multiple ground-glass opacity nodules

source_text: 纵隔多个小肿大淋巴结较前略缩小，现较大约8*6mm(图24)，原约10*7mm(图25)
text_en: Multiple small enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes are slightly decreased in size compared to previous, currently measuring approximately 8x6 mm (Figure 24), previously measuring approximately 10x7 mm (Figure 25).

source_text: 扫及胸10椎体见结节样高密度灶同前，骨岛
text_en: Scans show a nodular hyperdense lesion in the T10 vertebra, unchanged from prior, bone island.

source_text: 左肺下叶癌疗后较前好转
text_en: Post-treatment for left lower lobe cancer improved compared to prior

source_text: 食管胸下段管壁增厚较前减轻，原较厚处约8mm（IM34），现约4mm(图35)
text_en: Wall thickening of the lower thoracic esophagus is reduced compared to prior, with the area of greatest thickness previously measuring approximately 8 mm (IM34) and now approximately 4 mm (Figure 35).

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结同前，约20x10mm（IM31）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes unchanged from prior, approximately 20x10 mm (IM31).

source_text: 左侧肾上腺类圆形低密度结节同前，约25x22mm（IM68）
text_en: Roundish hypodense nodule in the left adrenal gland is unchanged, measuring approximately 25x22 mm (IM68).

source_text: 右肺上叶及左肺下叶索条结节影同前（IMA19、41），仍约5mm（IM41）
text_en: Linear and nodular opacities in the right upper lobe and left lower lobe are stable compared to prior (IMA19, 41), remaining approximately 5 mm (IM41).

source_text: 右肺中叶新发小结节，左肺下叶小结节同前，追查
text_en: Newly developed nodule in the right middle lobe; small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged compared to prior; recommend follow-up

source_text: 左肺术后改变，左肺上叶、右肺下叶结节同前，左下肺模糊小结节，追查
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left lung. Nodules in the left upper lobe and right lower lobe are stable compared to prior examination. An ill-defined small nodule is noted in the left lower lobe. Recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右肺中叶结节较前缩小
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe is smaller than before.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段含钙化结节大致同前，现约17mm（Im19）
text_en: Left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment: calcified nodule largely stable compared to prior, currently approximately 17 mm (Im19).

source_text: 右肺上叶微结节同前，约2mm（IMA16），右肺尖少许索条影同前
text_en: Right upper lobe micro-nodule unchanged, approximately 2 mm (IMA16); minimal fibrotic bands at the right lung apex unchanged.

source_text: 左肺下叶结节较前增大，余双肺浅淡磨玻璃结节大致同前
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is enlarged compared to prior, while faint ground-glass nodules in both lungs remain stable.

source_text: 右肺另见多发小结节大致同前，追查
text_en: Additionally, multiple small nodules are seen in the right lung, essentially unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双肺散在少许索条影及左肺类小结节影（IM27）同前
text_en: Scattered few linear opacities and left lung-like small nodules (IM27) are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔内3a、4、7组淋巴结大致同前，隆突下较大仍约18x10mm（IM25），平扫密度较高
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 3a, 4, and 7 remain similar to previous, with the subcarinal largest still measuring approximately 18x10mm (IM25), showing higher density on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 两肺增重紊乱同前，两肺下叶片絮索条影同前，两肺小结节影同前
text_en: Increased lung density and disorganization are unchanged; patchy linear opacities in the lower lobes are unchanged; small nodules in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 双肺多发胸膜下多发小结节同前（Im27、31、37、43），形态不规则
text_en: Multiple subpleural small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM27, 31, 37, 43); irregular in shape.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4组、5多发淋巴结较前相仿，4R组较大者仍约13x8mm（IM18）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R, 4, and 5 are similar to previous; the largest in station 4R remains approximately 13x8 mm (IM18)

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结较前相仿，如原约12x8mm（IM22）者现同前
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are similar in size compared to previous, as exemplified by one measuring approximately 12x8 mm (IM22) which remains unchanged.

source_text: 右肺门肿大淋巴结，转移不除外，追查
text_en: Enlarged lymph nodes in the right hilum, metastasis cannot be excluded; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结大致同前，密度较高，部分伴钙化
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are largely unchanged from prior, with higher density, some with calcification.

source_text: 左侧肺见纵膈旁结节同前相仿，约11x10mm（IMA10），边缘光滑
text_en: A paravertebral nodule in the left lung is similar to prior, measuring approximately 11x10 mm (IMA10), with smooth margins.

source_text: 右肺钙化灶、左肺点状结节影同前（IMA27）
text_en: Calcified foci in the right lung and punctate nodular opacities in the left lung are unchanged (IMA27).

source_text: 余肺内未见明显新增结节或斑片影
text_en: No obvious new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 右肺多发实性微小结节、双侧胸膜多发结节样增厚大致同前，考虑良性
text_en: Multiple tiny solid nodules in the right lung and multiple nodular thickenings of the bilateral pleura are approximately stable compared to prior; favor benign etiology.

source_text: 右肺下叶钙化灶同前，两肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Calcific foci in the right lower lobe are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 双肺浅淡小结节较前相仿
text_en: Faint small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior.

source_text: 纵隔多个小淋巴结同前，较大约10x7mm（IM17），平扫密度稍高
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest approximately 10x7 mm (IM17), slightly higher density on non-contrast scan

source_text: 右肺点状结节同前（IMA25、27）
text_en: Punctate nodules in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior (IMA25, 27).

source_text: 右肺中叶微小结节及左下叶磨玻璃密度灶大致同前
text_en: Micro-nodules in the right middle lobe and a ground-glass opacity in the left lower lobe are approximately unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔、肺门、腋下未见新发肿大淋巴结
text_en: No new enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum, hilar regions, or axillae

source_text: 右肺下叶磨玻璃小结节同前，建议复查
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe is stable; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 新见两枚混合磨玻璃密度结节
text_en: Newly identified two mixed ground-glass nodules

source_text: 左肺磨玻璃密度小结节同前相仿
text_en: Left lung ground-glass opacity small nodule similar to prior.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜小结节影同前，约4mm（IM33），左侧胸膜稍增厚同前，双侧胸腔未见积液
text_en: Small nodular opacity of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM33). Left pleural slight thickening is unchanged from prior. No pleural effusion is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 双肺多发小结节此次扫描未见显示，未见新增结节灶
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are not visible on this scan; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 左肺下叶局部术后，可见胸膜增厚，肺内索条影同前，未见新生结节
text_en: Postoperative change in left lower lobe with pleural thickening, intrapulmonary linear opacities unchanged from prior, no new nodules

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则软组织密度结节较前略增大，原约26*20mm(图18)，现约27*23mm（IMA18），软组织成分饱满，边缘与侧胸膜牵拉同前
text_en: The irregular soft-tissue density nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe has slightly increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 26x20 mm (Figure 18), now approximately 27x23 mm (IMA18). The soft-tissue component appears full, and the margin with lateral pleural retraction remains unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶钙化灶同前，左肺多发胸膜下微小结节同前，约2-3mm（IM8、17、41），部分钙化
text_en: Calcified focus in the left upper lobe stable; multiple subpleural micronodules in the left lung stable, approximately 2-3 mm (IM8, 17, 41), some calcified.

source_text: 甲状腺右叶低密度结节同前（IM5）
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right lobe of the thyroid gland unchanged from prior (IM5).

source_text: 左下肺磨玻璃密度结节大小、形态同前，约9x6mm（Im37），密度略增高
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the left lower lobe is stable in size and morphology compared to prior, measuring approximately 9x6 mm (Im37), with slightly increased density.

source_text: 原右下肺近膈面磨玻璃密度结节现未见显示，余肺数个小灶同前（IM31、38、45、47）
text_en: The previously noted ground-glass opacity nodule near the diaphragm in the right lower lobe is no longer visible. The remainder of the small foci in both lungs are unchanged (IM31, 38, 45, 47).

source_text: 左肺下叶散在多发微小结节同前，较大仍约4mm（IM32）
text_en: Scattered multiple tiny nodules in the left lower lobe unchanged from prior, largest still approximately 4 mm (IM32)

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结略增大同前，较大约16x7mm（IM18、24）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are slightly enlarged, similar to prior findings, with the largest measuring approximately 16x7 mm (IM18, 24).

source_text: 转移不能除外，建议复查
text_en: Metastasis cannot be excluded; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右肺中叶微小结节同前，约3mm（IM38）
text_en: Right middle lobe tiny nodule unchanged from prior, approximately 3 mm (IM38)

source_text: 增大
text_en: Increased in size.

source_text: 右肺下叶磨玻璃结节同前，随访
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe is stable; follow-up.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段磨玻璃结节灶同前，大小约8x7mm（IM17），边界清
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment ground-glass opacity nodule unchanged, size approximately 8x7 mm (IM17), well-defined margins.

source_text: 气管右旁软组织增厚较前相仿，邻近结节稍缩小
text_en: Soft tissue thickening at right paratracheal region similar to prior, with adjacent nodule slightly decreased

source_text: 纵隔少许小淋巴结同前，较大约8x7mm（IM26）
text_en: Mediastinal few small lymph nodes unchanged, largest approximately 8x7mm (IM26).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则形结节同前，仍约18x14mm（IM21）
text_en: An irregular nodular lesion in the right upper lobe posterior segment is stable compared to prior, remaining approximately 18x14 mm (IM21).

source_text: 斜裂胸膜结节同前，仍约2mm（Im40）
text_en: Nodule on the oblique fissure pleura unchanged, still approximately 2 mm (Im40).

source_text: 前纵隔含脂肿物较前增大，考虑复发
text_en: Fat-containing mass in the anterior mediastinum has increased in size compared to prior, consider recurrence.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段胸膜下小结节灶同前，仍约2mm（IM31）
text_en: Subpleural small nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is stable, still approximately 2 mm (IM31)

source_text: 两肺见钙化灶同前，左肺上叶见结节影同前，约4mm（IMA18）
text_en: Calcified foci in both lungs are stable; a nodule in the left upper lobe is stable, measuring approximately 4 mm (IMA18).

source_text: 双肺另可见多发胸膜下小结节同前，约2-4mm（Im39、47、56），形态不规则
text_en: Additional multiple subpleural small nodules in both lungs are stable, measuring approximately 2-4 mm (Im39, 47, 56), with irregular morphology.

source_text: 纵隔右移，多组小淋巴结大致同前，右气管食管沟较大者约9*7mm（IMA11）
text_en: Mediastinal shift to the right, multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, right tracheoesophageal groove largest approximately 9x7 mm (IMA11).

source_text: 右锁骨上淋巴结较前缩小，原约11x5mm（IM4），现显示欠清
text_en: Right supraclavicular lymph node is smaller than prior, previously approximately 11x5 mm (IM4), now poorly visualized

source_text: 升主动脉旁小淋巴结同前，约4mm（IMA31），纵隔、肺门平扫未见明显肿大淋巴结
text_en: A small lymph node adjacent to the ascending aorta is unchanged from prior, approximately 4 mm (IMA31). No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum or hila on non-contrast scans.

source_text: 纵隔软组织密度增高，淋巴结增大，大致同前，较大位于右主支气管前方，约16x11mm（IM24）
text_en: Increased soft tissue density in the mediastinum with enlarged lymph nodes, roughly same as before; the largest is located anterior to the right main bronchus, approximately 16x11mm (IM24).

source_text: 余两肺内多发结节较前相仿
text_en: Multiple nodules in the remainder of both lungs are similar to prior.

source_text: 双侧胸膜增厚伴多发钙化及叶间胸膜结节样增厚同前，双侧胸腔内未见积液
text_en: Bilateral pleural thickening with multiple calcifications and interlobar septal nodular thickening is unchanged. No pleural effusion is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，平扫支气管断端软组织稍厚同前，胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; soft tissue thickening at the bronchial stump is unchanged from prior. No new space-occupying lesions are seen in the chest.

source_text: 左肺多发小结节同前相仿，较大灶呈磨玻璃密度，约7mm（Im13）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in left lung similar to prior, largest nodule with ground-glass density, approximately 7 mm (Im13).

source_text: 纵隔及左肺门多发淋巴结同前，较大仍约18x10mm（IM36）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal and left hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest still approximately 18x10 mm (IM36)

source_text: 右肺下叶斑点灶及结节、片絮灶较前稍减少减轻，追查
text_en: Patchy opacities and nodules in the right lower lobe are slightly decreased and improved compared to prior, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺内未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation in the left lung.

source_text: 纵膈、肺门小淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Small mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous, less than 10 mm.

source_text: 左上肺纵隔胸膜旁结节较前略增大，原约15x10mm，现约19x13mm（IM10）
text_en: Nodule adjacent to the mediastinal pleura in the left upper lobe is slightly larger than prior, previously approximately 15 x 10 mm, now approximately 19 x 13 mm (IM10).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段肿块影较前缩小，原约23x20mm（IM18），现约20x17mm（IM18）
text_en: Mass-like opacity in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 23x20 mm (IM18), now approximately 20x17 mm (IM18)

source_text: 余双肺多发模糊小结节同前，较大仍约5mm（IM22）
text_en: Multiple indistinct small nodules in the remainder of both lungs are unchanged; the largest remains approximately 5 mm (IM22).

source_text: 右肺散在小结节影同前，较大约5mm（IM14）
text_en: Scattered small nodular opacities in the right lung are stable compared to prior, the largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM14).

source_text: 左肺下叶索条、双肺多发肺大泡同前，余肺未见新生结节斑片影
text_en: Left lower lobe linear opacities and multiple bullae in both lungs unchanged from prior; no new nodular or patchy opacities in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶索条影较前减少，两肺未见新增结节及实变影
text_en: Left lower lobe linear opacity decreased compared to previous; no new nodules or consolidations seen in both lungs.

source_text: 双肺小结节影密度较前略增高，大小同前，较大约5mm
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodule shadows show slightly increased density compared to prior, size stable, largest approximately 5 mm

source_text: 右气管食管沟小淋巴结同前，纵隔、肺门、腋窝及锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Small right tracheoesophageal groove lymph node unchanged; no enlarged lymph nodes seen in the mediastinum, hila, axillae, or supraclavicular regions.

source_text: 右肺术后，右肺结节同前，追查
text_en: Post right lung surgery, right lung nodule unchanged; pursue further evaluation.

source_text: 左侧斜裂见小结节同前（IM29）
text_en: A small nodule is seen along the left oblique fissure, unchanged (IM29).

source_text: 食管胸中下段管壁增厚较前略减轻，原较厚处约11mm（IM34），现约9mm（IM34），上下径约64mm（IM36），与胸主动脉接触面小于90°
text_en: The wall thickening of the mid-to-lower thoracic esophagus is slightly reduced compared to prior, with the thickest portion previously measuring approximately 11 mm (IM34) and now approximately 9 mm (IM34). The longitudinal diameter measures approximately 64 mm (IM36), and the contact surface with the thoracic aorta is less than 90 degrees

source_text: 左侧胸膜及胸膜下多发结节及肿块较前增大增多，如原约15x9mm，现约31x22mm（IM28）
text_en: Multiple nodules and masses in the left pleura and subpleural region are increased in size and number compared to prior; for example, previously approximately 15x9 mm, now approximately 31x22 mm (IM28).

source_text: 右肺下叶局限实变较前减轻，余双肺未见新增结节或斑点灶影
text_en: Focal consolidation in the right lower lobe is improved compared to prior; no new nodules or punctate opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs

source_text: 甲状腺左叶及峡部较大低密度肿物同前相仿，不均匀强化（IM5），追查
text_en: Thyroid left lobe and isthmus larger low-density mass same as prior, heterogeneous enhancement (IM5), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔稍大淋巴结较前缩小，较大原约13x6mm（IM22），现约9x5mm（IM20）
text_en: Slightly enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes reduced in size compared to previous; the larger one was approximately 13x6 mm (IM22), now approximately 9x5 mm (IM20).

source_text: 左肺上叶混杂密度类结节大致同前，现仍约10x8mm（IM24），边缘密度略高中央呈低密度同前
text_en: The mixed density nodular lesion in the left upper lobe is roughly unchanged, still approximately 10x8 mm (IM24), with slightly higher density at the margins and central low density unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔4、5、7、10组淋巴结同前，较大约10x4mm（IM33）
text_en: Mediastinal stations 4, 5, 7, and 10 lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest approximately 10x4 mm (IM33).

source_text: 右肺下叶近下肺韧带处肿物较前明显增大，原约18x15mm，现约28x24mm（Im37），紧贴右下肺静脉及食管内侧壁
text_en: The mass in the right lower lobe near the inferior pulmonary ligament has increased significantly compared to prior, previously approximately 18x15 mm, now approximately 28x24 mm (Im37), closely abutting the right inferior pulmonary vein and the medial wall of the esophagus.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结较前增大
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes enlarged compared to prior

source_text: 左侧胸膜结节样增厚，转移
text_en: Left pleural nodular thickening, metastasis

source_text: 余双肺间质性改变及微小结节影同前
text_en: Interstitial changes and tiny nodular opacities in both lungs are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶微结节同前
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous

source_text: 右肺中叶及胸膜下小结节同前，追查
text_en: Small nodules in the right middle lobe and subpleural region are unchanged; further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见异常软组织增厚，余肺见散在索条影，未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no abnormal soft tissue thickening is seen at the bronchial stump. Scattered linear opacities are seen in the remaining lung. No new nodules or consolidations are identified.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment small nodule unchanged from previous, suggest follow-up.

source_text: 两肺小结节影同前，较大约4mm（IM41）
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior, largest measuring approximately 4 mm (IM41)

source_text: 纵隔及左腋窝多发淋巴结，部分较前增大，追查
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and left axilla, some increased in size compared to previous, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双肺不规则小结节同前，约3mm（Im30、43）
text_en: Irregular small nodules in both lungs are unchanged compared to prior, approximately 3 mm (Im30, 43).

source_text: 右肺部分结节稍增大，考虑转移
text_en: Some nodules in the right lung have slightly increased in size; metastasis is considered.

source_text: 纵隔7组肿大淋巴结较前稍减小，原约18x11mm（IM24）,现约17x9mm（IM25）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 enlarged lymph nodes are slightly decreased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 18 × 11 mm (Image 24), currently approximately 17 × 9 mm (Image 25)

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Right hilar lymph node essentially unchanged

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段实变影、局部胸膜增厚同前，右肺上叶斑片索条钙化及小结节影同前，较大约10x6mm（IM16）
text_en: Consolidation and localized pleural thickening in the apical segment of the right upper lobe are unchanged; patchy linear calcifications and small nodules in the right upper lobe are unchanged, largest approximately 10 × 6 mm (IM16).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段胸膜旁模糊结节密度浅淡同前（IM34）
text_en: Subpleural indistinct nodule with faint density in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is stable (IM34)

source_text: 转移可能，请结合临床
text_en: Possible metastasis.

source_text: 双肺上叶磨玻璃密度小结节同前，追查
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodules in the upper lobes of both lungs, unchanged compared to prior; recommended for follow-up.

source_text: 左肺下叶沿支气管分布小结节，较前略减少，追查
text_en: Left lower lobe small nodules distributed along bronchi, slightly decreased compared to previous; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶局限性术后，肺门区结构较前清晰，未见软组织密度结节及肿块，条形金属缝线影同前，周围软组织低密度影稍厚较前减轻
text_en: Status post limited resection of the right lower lobe; hilar architecture is clearer than prior. No soft-tissue density nodules or masses are seen. Linear metallic suture clips are stable. The surrounding soft tissue low-density shadow is slightly thickened but improved compared to prior

source_text: 右肺下叶不规则结节较前增大，原约25x15mm（IM31），现约30x20mm（IM33）
text_en: The irregular nodule in the right lower lobe has increased in size, previously measuring approximately 25x15 mm (IM31), now approximately 30x20 mm (IM33).

source_text: 左后下纵隔主动脉旁结节同前，良性
text_en: Left posterior inferior mediastinal paraaortic nodule unchanged, benign.

source_text: 右水平裂胸膜下结节影同前，约10x9mm（IM31）
text_en: Subpleural nodule along the right horizontal fissure unchanged, measuring approximately 10x9 mm (IM31).

source_text: 右肺见微小结节灶同前，现仍约3mm（IM34）
text_en: Tiny nodular foci in the right lung are stable, still measuring approximately 3 mm (IM34).

source_text: 右肺上叶少许条片影同前，余肺未见明确软组织结节肿块
text_en: Minimal linear and patchy opacities in the right upper lobe unchanged; remainder of lungs show no definite soft tissue nodules or masses

source_text: 纵隔2R、4组多发淋巴结较前饱满，较大原约12x6mm（IM18），现约13x8mm（IM19）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R and 4 are more prominent than prior, with the largest previously measuring approximately 12x6 mm (IM18) and now approximately 13x8 mm (IM19)

source_text: 肝左叶低密度结节（IM53）大致同前，请参考腹部检查
text_en: Low-density nodule in left lobe of liver (Image 53) roughly same as before, please refer to abdominal examination.

source_text: 食管术后弓上吻合，吻合口壁未见异常增厚及确切占位征象，较前相仿
text_en: Post-esophagectomy supra-aortic anastomosis, anastomotic wall shows no abnormal thickening or definite mass lesion, similar to previous.

source_text: 双侧肺门、右锁骨上区仍见多枚轻度增大淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple mildly enlarged lymph nodes are still present in the bilateral hila and right supraclavicular region, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃密度结节影同前，约15x12mm（IM28）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe posterior segment is unchanged, measuring approximately 15 x 12 mm (IM28).

source_text: 右下肺索条影同前，余双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: The linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右肺中叶结节同前，追查
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged; further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔2R组淋巴结同前，大小约8*6mm（IMA15），平扫密度较高
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal station 2R unchanged from previous, approximately 8x6 mm in size (IMA15), higher density on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段软组织密度肿块较前缩小，边缘不规则，原约34*27mm(图52)，现约29x26mm（IMA51），肿块远端见条片状影同前
text_en: Soft-tissue density mass in the basal segment of the right lower lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, with irregular margins. Previously measured approximately 34 x 27 mm (Figure 52), now approximately 29 x 26 mm (IMA51). Linear opacities distal to the mass are unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，局部条片及索条影较前减少，支气管断端未见异常强化结节及肿块
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, linear and reticular opacities decreased compared to prior, no abnormal enhancing nodules or masses at the bronchial stump.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结，部分略增大，隆突下现短径约12mm（IMA26），原约7mm（IM26），密切观察
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes; some have slightly increased in size, with the subcarinal lymph node now measuring approximately 12 mm in short axis diameter (IMA26), previously approximately 7 mm (IM26). Close observation.

source_text: 右侧肩胛骨、椎体结节样高密度灶同前
text_en: Nodular high-density foci in the right scapula and vertebrae are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔、右侧腋窝淋巴结较前相仿
text_en: Lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right axillary region are similar to prior.

source_text: 纵隔、肺门、腋窝及锁骨上未见增大淋巴结
text_en: No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum, hilar regions, axillae, or supraclavicular regions

source_text: 余肺内未见新发结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 纵隔内淋巴结较前略增大，原约12x9mm，现约14x11mm（IM10）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes slightly enlarged compared to previous, previously approximately 12x9 mm, currently approximately 14x11 mm (IM10).

source_text: 右肺下叶后基底段小结节同前，约4mm（IM75）
text_en: The small nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe remains unchanged, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM75).

source_text: 纵隔食管瘘治疗后，局部见金属致密影，局部与食管间沟通瘘口可见（IM43），后下纵隔分叶状肿物大小大致同前，约68x38mm（IM42），内部气液平消失，肿物边缘光滑，食管受推挤左移，仍与下腔静脉见脂肪间隙尚清
text_en: After treatment for mediastinal esophageal fistula, a metallic dense shadow is seen locally, and the fistula communicating between the local area and the esophagus is visible (IM43). The lobulated mass in the posterior inferior mediastinum is similar in size to previous, approximately 68x38mm (IM42), with no internal air-fluid level, smooth mass margin, esophagus displaced to the left, and still with a clear fat plane between the inferior vena cava.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门多发肿大淋巴结较前缩小，较大原约20*15mm（IMA32），现约16x7mm（IM31）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions decreased in size compared to previous; largest previously approximately 20x15 mm (IMA32), now approximately 16x7 mm (IM31).

source_text: 左下肺磨玻璃小结节同前，建议追查
text_en: The small ground-glass nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 左前胸壁皮肤小结节同前（IM15）
text_en: Small skin nodule in the left anterior chest wall unchanged from prior (IM15).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段支气管截断，局部不规则结节较前增大，原18x17mm，现约32x24mm（IM29），远端肺内片絮、结节影略增多
text_en: The bronchial cutoff in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is associated with a local irregular nodule that has increased in size compared to prior, previously 18x17 mm, now approximately 32x24 mm (IM29). Patchy and nodular opacities in the distal lung have slightly increased.

source_text: 纵隔、肺门淋巴结同前，较大约15x10mm（IM26）
text_en: Mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest approximately 15x10 mm (IM26).

source_text: 气管旁、隆突下、食管旁等处数枚小淋巴结同前
text_en: Several small lymph nodes in the paratracheal, subcarinal, and paraesophageal regions are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 两肺叶斑点状影及浅淡微小结节影同前（IM18，24、33、34），较大约9x7mm（IM18）
text_en: Punctate opacities and faint tiny nodules in both lung lobes are unchanged (IM18, 24, 33, 34); the largest is about 9x7 mm (IM18).

source_text: 食道中上段管壁不均匀增厚较前减轻，较厚部位原约9mm（IM19），现约7mm（IM23），外膜尚清晰，同胸主动脉接触面小于90度，近端食管无扩张
text_en: Uneven wall thickening in the upper-mid esophagus decreased compared to previous, thickest portion previously approximately 9 mm (IM19), currently approximately 7 mm (IM23), adventitia still clear, interface with thoracic aorta less than 90 degrees, no proximal esophageal dilation.

source_text: 食管胸下段癌疗后，管壁增厚减轻，较厚处原约13mm（IMA42），前壁为主，现未见增厚约4mm（IM41），与胸主动脉之间接触面小于45度
text_en: Post-treatment for esophageal cancer in the lower thoracic segment, wall thickening reduced; previously thickest about 13 mm (IMA42), predominantly anterior wall, now thickness approximately 4 mm without thickening (IM41), with angle of contact with thoracic aorta less than 45 degrees.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结大致同前，约9*7mm（IM20），随诊观察
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes largely unchanged, approximately 9x7 mm (IM20), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门及右锁骨上区多发淋巴结，转移
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, and right supraclavicular region, metastatic.

source_text: 左侧胸膜下微小结节及右侧胸膜旁条片影较前相仿
text_en: The tiny subpleural nodule in the left lung and the linear patchy opacity adjacent to the right pleura are similar to prior.

source_text: 双肺未见新增结节影
text_en: No new nodules seen in both lungs.

source_text: 双肺微结节、双肺气肿同前
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary micro-nodules and emphysema are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺门可见不规则肿物较前缩小，原约21*11mm，现约13*6mm（IM24）
text_en: Irregular mass in the left hilar region decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 21x11 mm, now approximately 13x6 mm (IM24)

source_text: 右肺中叶结节同前，恶性可能，追查
text_en: Nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged; malignancy possible; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双肺占位大致同前
text_en: Pulmonary masses in both lungs are largely unchanged.

source_text: 新发占位
text_en: Newly identified mass.

source_text: 双肺及叶间胸膜小结节同前
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs and interlobar pleura are stable.

source_text: 双肺未见新增结节灶及斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 胸廓各骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: No signs of bone destruction in the thoracic bones.

source_text: 左肺及右肺中叶多发索条影同前，左肺上叶胸膜下小结节略饱满，原约3mm，现约5mm（IM18）
text_en: Multiple linear opacities in the left lung and right middle lobe unchanged, small subpleural nodule in the left upper lobe slightly enlarged, from approximately 3 mm to 5 mm (IM18).

source_text: 扫及右侧肾上腺结节同前，结合腹部检查
text_en: On scan, right adrenal nodule unchanged from prior; correlate with abdominal imaging.

source_text: 未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation

source_text: 右腋下淋巴结较前增大，原约9x7mm（IM21），现约14x11mm（IM23），追查
text_en: Right axillary lymph node increased in size compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 9x7 mm (IM21), now measuring approximately 14x11 mm (IM23); further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，未见明确复发及转移征象
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis identified

source_text: 甲状腺右叶低密度结节影同前
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right lobe of the thyroid gland unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段胸膜下微结节同前
text_en: The subpleural micronodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior

source_text: 右肺中叶肿物较前相仿，现仍约23x14mm（IM30，肺窗），右肺膨胀不全较前减轻
text_en: The right middle lobe mass is similar to prior, currently measuring approximately 23 x 14 mm (IM30, lung window). Atelectasis of the right lung is improved compared to prior.

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前(图30)
text_en: Tiny nodule in the left interlobar pleura is stable (Figure 30).

source_text: 纵隔稍大淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Slightly enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes as before, follow-up.

source_text: 双肺散在网格状、索条影及右肺上叶胸膜下微小结节大致同前，两肺未见新发结节影
text_en: Scattered reticular and linear opacities and a subpleural micronodule in the right upper lobe are largely unchanged. No new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 扫及诸骨未见明显骨质破坏征象
text_en: CT shows no obvious bone destruction in the bones examined.

source_text: 左腋区淋巴结同前（如IM14）
text_en: Left axillary lymph nodes unchanged (as in image 14).

source_text: 右肺下叶斑点状影同前（Im28），右肺下叶背段浅淡小结节影同前（IMA33）
text_en: Punctate opacities in the right lower lobe are stable (Im28); the faint small nodule in the dorsal segment of the right lower lobe is stable (IMA33).

source_text: 左肺斑点索条影、右肺上叶小结节及小磨玻璃密度影同前（IMA24、27）
text_en: Punctate and linear opacities in the left lung, small nodules and small ground-glass opacities in the right upper lobe unchanged from previous (images 24, 27).

source_text: 双腋下多发淋巴结大致同前，较大约2x1.2cm（IM12）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes at both axillae are generally unchanged from prior, the largest measuring approximately 2x1.2 cm (IM12).

source_text: 右肺上叶软组织肿块较前缩小，原约85x67mm（IM13），现约55x42mm（IM14），肿块内侧边缘与纵隔胸膜分界不清，与上腔静脉及奇静脉分界不清，上腔静脉未见明显狭窄变形
text_en: The soft tissue mass in the right upper lobe is smaller than before, previously approximately 85x67 mm (IM13), now approximately 55x42 mm (IM14). The medial margin of the mass is indistinct from the mediastinal pleura and indistinct from the superior vena cava and azygos vein. The superior vena cava shows no obvious narrowing or deformation.

source_text: 右肺门旁脂肪密度结节影同前，约21x16mm（IM36）
text_en: The fat-density nodule adjacent to the right hilum is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 21 x 16 mm (IM36).

source_text: 余双肺内未见新增结节及肿块影
text_en: No new nodules or masses are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 扫及双肾上腺结节同前相仿，分别约18x16mm（IM56右侧）、11x11mm（IM54左侧）
text_en: CT shows bilateral adrenal nodules similar to prior, measuring approximately 18x16 mm (IM56, right) and 11x11 mm (IM54, left).

source_text: 双肺下叶基底段片絮状磨玻璃密度影减少，边缘模糊，余双肺未见新发结节
text_en: The patchy ground-glass opacities in the basal segments of both lower lobes have decreased and remain ill-defined; no new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔散在肿大淋巴结大致同前，较大者仍约25mm×10mm（IM24），左肺门淋巴结较前略减小，原较大者约22mm×17mm（IMA36），现约16mm×12mm（IM35）
text_en: Mediastinal scattered enlarged lymph nodes essentially unchanged, largest still approximately 25x10 mm (IM24); left hilar lymph nodes slightly decreased compared to previous, largest previously approximately 22x17 mm (IMA36), now approximately 16x12 mm (IM35).

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，大者仍约11x9mm（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, largest still approximately 11x9 mm (IM21).

source_text: 左侧斜裂上小结节同前（IM21）
text_en: Small nodule in the left oblique fissure is unchanged (IM21).

source_text: 右肺散在斑片索条影同前，右肺结节影较前增多增大，较大约11*6mm（IMA36）
text_en: Scattered patchy linear opacities in the right lung are stable compared to prior; nodular opacities in the right lung are increased in number and size, the largest measuring approximately 11 x 6 mm (IMA36).

source_text: 右肺局限性索条影同前，未见新增肺内结节或实变影
text_en: Focal linear opacity in the right lung is unchanged; no new pulmonary nodules or consolidation are seen.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段胸膜下磨玻璃密度结节同前，仍约6mm（Im22）
text_en: Subpleural ground-glass opacity nodule in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe, unchanged from prior, still approximately 6 mm (Im22).

source_text: 肺内未见新增结节灶及斑片影
text_en: No new nodular lesions or patchy opacities within the lung.

source_text: 纵隔食管瘘治疗后，局部见金属致密影，局部与食管间沟通瘘口略缩小（IM43），后下纵隔分叶状肿物大小大致同前，约68x38mm（IM43），肿物边缘光滑，食管受推挤左移，仍与下腔静脉见脂肪间隙尚清
text_en: After treatment for mediastinal esophageal fistula, a metallic dense shadow is seen locally, and the fistula communicating between the local area and the esophagus is slightly smaller (IM43). The lobulated mass in the posterior inferior mediastinum is similar in size to previous, approximately 68x38mm (IM43), with smooth mass margin, esophagus displaced to the left, and still with a clear fat plane between the inferior vena cava.

source_text: 左胸壁术后改变，术区胸膜增厚同前，未见新增软组织密度结节及肿块
text_en: Left chest wall postoperative change, pleural thickening at surgical site stable, no new soft tissue density nodules or masses.

source_text: 左肺局限性索条影同前，余双肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Localized linear opacities in the left lung unchanged from prior; no new nodules or consolidation in the remaining bilateral lung parenchyma.

source_text: 新见多发模糊结节
text_en: Newly seen multiple hazy nodules

source_text: 两肺索条小结节影同前，余肺未见新发结节影
text_en: The linear opacities and small nodules in both lungs are unchanged; no new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔高密度淋巴结同前，较大约11x7mm（IM22），双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下平扫未见明显肿大淋巴结
text_en: The mediastinal high-attenuation lymph node is similar to previous, the largest approximately 11x7mm (IM22). No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the bilateral hilar, supraclavicular, and bilateral axillary regions on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 纵隔、右侧锁骨上区及右肺门多发小淋巴结大致同前，如右侧肺门淋巴结现约12x8mm（IM33）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum, right supraclavicular region, and right hilar region are roughly similar to prior, such as the right hilar lymph node currently measuring approximately 12x8 mm (IM33).

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后，局部未见复发征象
text_en: Post-left lower lobectomy, no local recurrence is seen.

source_text: 右肺钙化索条及小结节影同前（IM23、35、38）
text_en: Calcified linear opacities and small nodular opacities in the right lung are unchanged (IM23, 35, 38).

source_text: 纵隔4L组淋巴结大致同前，追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 4L lymph nodes roughly unchanged from prior, follow-up.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段混合磨玻璃密度结节灶较前增大，考虑恶性可能性大
text_en: Mixed ground-glass opacity nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe increased in size compared to prior, malignancy is highly likely

source_text: 左肺下叶散在多发微小结节同前，较大仍约4mm（IM31）
text_en: Scattered multiple tiny nodules in the left lower lobe unchanged from prior, largest still approximately 4 mm (IM31)

source_text: 余肺内未见新发灶
text_en: No new foci are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段结节略缩小，前段结节同前
text_en: The nodule in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment has slightly decreased in size, and the nodule in the anterior segment is unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔4L组淋巴结同前，原较大约12x10mm（IM26），现约13x9mm（IM24）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4L lymph nodes unchanged, previously approximately 12x10 mm (IM26), now approximately 13x9 mm (IM24)

source_text: 左下肺结节，转移待除外，建议追查
text_en: Left lower lobe nodule, metastasis cannot be excluded; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔及腋窝多个小淋巴结同前，较大者位于纵隔4L组，仍约10x8mm（IMA17）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal and axillary lymph nodes unchanged; the largest, located in mediastinal station 4L, remains approximately 10x8 mm (IMA17).

source_text: 纵隔5组淋巴结较前相仿，较大现约15x10mm（Im28）
text_en: Mediastinal group 5 lymph nodes similar to prior, largest currently approximately 15x10 mm (Image 28)

source_text: 纵隔10R淋巴结同前相仿增大，约16x10mm（IM31）
text_en: Right paratracheal (10R) mediastinal lymph node enlarged, similar to prior, measuring approximately 16x10 mm (IM31)

source_text: 左肺尖不规则结节略缩小，原约24*16mm，现约20X13mm(图10)，边缘可见多发索条影
text_en: Left apical segment: irregular nodule slightly decreased in size, previously approximately 24x16 mm, now approximately 20x13 mm (Figure 10), with multiple linear opacities visible at the margin.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，双肺小结节大小同前
text_en: Left lower lobe postoperative, size of small nodules in both lungs is unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺上叶微小结节同前，倾向陈旧灶
text_en: Tiny nodules in the right upper lobe, unchanged from prior; likely represent old, stable findings.

source_text: 其余淋巴结部分同前、部分缩小
text_en: The remaining lymph nodes are stable in part and decreased in size in part.

source_text: 左下肺结节较前增大，现约13mm（IM51），原为4mm（IM52）
text_en: The left lower lobe nodule has increased in size, now measuring approximately 13 mm (IM51), previously 4 mm (IM52).

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段（IM18）、左肺下叶外基底段新发实性结节（IM36），直径约7mm，边界光滑清楚
text_en: New solid nodules are present in the apical segment of the right upper lobe (IM18) and in the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe (IM36), each approximately 7 mm in diameter, with smooth and well-defined margins.

source_text: 右肺多发小结节灶同前（IM12、15、16）
text_en: Multiple small nodular foci in the right lung are stable compared to prior studies (IM12, 15, 16).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，术区团片状影及钙化较前相仿，余双肺未见新发结节影
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; the patchy opacity and calcification in the surgical bed are similar to prior studies; no new nodules in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右肺门结节较前缩小
text_en: The right hilar nodule is smaller compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶上舌段见类圆形小结节灶大致同前，约7mm（Im31），可见支气管气相
text_en: A small, round nodule is seen in the upper lingular segment of the left upper lobe, approximately 7 mm (Im31), with bronchial air sign, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结增大，原约10x8mm，现约18x15mm（IM25），考虑转移可能，请结合临床相关检查
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes enlarged, previously approximately 10x8 mm, currently approximately 18x15 mm (IM25), metastasis is possible; correlate with clinical findings.

source_text: 扫及上腹，肝内多发低密度结节，脂肪肝同前
text_en: Multiple hypodense nodules within the liver and fatty liver in the upper abdomen are unchanged from prior

source_text: 右肺索条影同前，两肺未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lung is stable; no new nodules or consolidations are seen in either lung.

source_text: 双肺多发结节影部分较前相仿，较大仍位于右肺中叶，仍约16x10mm（IM40），部分消失，如原左肺尖和左肺下叶背段多发小结节
text_en: Multiple nodules in both lungs are partially similar to prior studies; the largest remains in the right middle lobe, still measuring approximately 16x10 mm (IM40). Some have disappeared, including the multiple small nodules previously seen in the left lung apex and left lower lobe dorsal segment.

source_text: 左肺上叶肿块增大，与远端肺不张分界不清，纵隔及左肺门较前增大，左锁骨上淋巴结同前
text_en: Left upper lobe mass increased in size, indistinct margin with distal atelectasis, mediastinal and left hilar lymph nodes enlarged compared to previous, left supraclavicular lymph nodes similar to previous.

source_text: 双肺散在小结节同前，较大者约3mm（IMA41）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, largest approximately 3 mm (IMA41).

source_text: 纵隔4R组数枚小淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Several small lymph nodes at mediastinal station 4R unchanged from prior, all less than 10 mm

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，定期追查
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior; regular follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 食管癌复查，壁厚较前加重
text_en: Follow-up for esophageal cancer, wall thickness increased compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺小结节大致同前，＜5mm（图25）
text_en: Left lung small nodule roughly unchanged, less than 5 mm (Figure 25)

source_text: 部分缩小，如原约11x9mm者，现约8x6mm（Im11）
text_en: Some are reduced; for example, the one that was approximately 11x9mm is now approximately 8x6mm (Im11).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结，部分较前略减小
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes are slightly smaller compared to prior.

source_text: 左上肺微结节同前，约3mm（IM21）
text_en: The small nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM21).

source_text: 纵隔6组小淋巴结同前，仍约9x7mm（IM23）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in mediastinal station 6 are unchanged from prior, remaining approximately 9x7 mm (IM23).

source_text: 左肺癌术后，胸部CT表现同前
text_en: Post-left lung cancer surgery, chest CT findings unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺门区肿大淋巴结考虑转移可能大
text_en: Enlarged lymph node in the right hilar region, metastasis is highly likely.

source_text: 右心膈角淋巴结同前，复查
text_en: Right cardiophrenic angle lymph node unchanged from prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 前纵隔胸腺区斑片状密度增高灶较前缩小，强化减低，原约16x13mm（IM26），现约11x6mm（IM21）
text_en: Patchy increased density in the thymic region of the anterior mediastinum is smaller than before, with reduced enhancement. Previously approximately 16x13 mm (IM26), now approximately 11x6 mm (IM21).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段结节，较前缩小，原约11x10mm，现约8x7mm（Im24）
