text_en: The nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe has decreased in size, previously measuring approximately 11x10 mm, now approximately 8x7 mm (Im24).

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前，观察
text_en: Tiny nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior; observation recommended.

source_text: 纵隔右侧气管食管沟小淋巴结大致同前，较大约5mm（IM7），追查
text_en: Small lymph node in the right tracheoesophageal groove of the mediastinum, roughly same as prior, largest approximately 5 mm (IM7), requires follow-up.

source_text: 左肺微小结节部分同前、部分略缩小
text_en: Left lung micronodules partially unchanged, partially slightly decreased in size.

source_text: 右肺上叶结节影同前，大小约4mm（IM25），左肺下叶索条影同前
text_en: The nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM25). The linear opacity in the left lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior imaging.

source_text: 食道癌术后，吻合口壁增厚，局部见软组织影，范围约33x30mm（IM17），边界模糊，与气管左后壁及主动脉弓分界不清，考虑复发
text_en: Post esophageal cancer surgery; anastomotic wall thickening with local soft tissue shadow approximately 33x30mm (IM17), ill-defined margins, indistinct from the left posterior wall of the trachea and the aortic arch, recurrence considered.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下及左肺下叶新见小结节，较大＜5mm（图47）
text_en: New small nodules in the subpleural region of the right upper lobe and the left lower lobe; largest less than 5 mm (Figure 47).

source_text: 左肺上叶模糊结节同前，约8x5mm（IM15）
text_en: Left upper lobe hazy nodule unchanged from prior, approximately 8x5 mm (IM15).

source_text: 双锁骨上区散在淋巴结部分缩小，如现约9x4mm者（IM7），原约13x7mm（IM7）
text_en: Some lymph nodes in bilateral supraclavicular regions are smaller than before; for example, one now measures approximately 9x4 mm (IM7), previously approximately 13x7 mm (IM7).

source_text: 纵隔多个淋巴结显示同前相仿，较大约14x8mm（IM28）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes similar to previous, the largest approximately 14x8 mm (IM28)

source_text: 左肺下叶索条影、两肺散在模糊小结节灶大小及范围部分同前相仿，较大仍约8x6mm（IMA15）
text_en: Left lower lobe linear opacities and scattered indistinct small nodular opacities in both lungs, size and extent partially similar to prior; largest still approximately 8x6 mm (IMA15).

source_text: 左下肺索条小结节灶同前
text_en: The linear opacity and small nodule in the left lower lobe are unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 左上肺小结节同前，约5mm（IM29）
text_en: Small nodule in the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM29).

source_text: 纵膈2R组肿大淋巴结较前增大，原约15x10mm（IM10），现约19x15mm（IM10）
text_en: Enlarged mediastinal station 2R lymph node has increased in size compared to prior, from approximately 15x10 mm (IM10) to approximately 19x15 mm (IM10)

source_text: 部分增大，5组现约17mm（IMA24），原约11mm（IM22）
text_en: Some increased in size, such as station 5 now approximately 17 mm (image A24), previously approximately 11 mm (image 22).

source_text: 前上纵隔小结节同前，仍约11x6mm（IM19），追查
text_en: The small nodule in the anterior superior mediastinum is stable, still measuring approximately 11x6 mm (IM19); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结较前相仿，仍约22x16mm（IM30），余纵隔小淋巴结同前
text_en: The right hilar lymph node is stable compared to prior, still measuring approximately 22 x 16 mm (IM30); other small mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶切除术后，支气管残端周围、左肺门区及纵隔旁局部未见增厚软组织影，左肺纤维条索影同前，余肺内未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: After left upper lobe resection, no thickened soft tissue density around the bronchial stump, left hilar region, or paravertebral mediastinum; fibrous streaks in the left lung unchanged from prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remaining lung.

source_text: 右肺少许索条影及钙化灶同前，两肺未见新生结节灶
text_en: A few linear opacities and calcified foci in the right lung are unchanged; no new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 余肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: The remainder of the lungs shows no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: T10椎体稍高密度结节影同前
text_en: Slightly increased density nodular shadow in the T10 vertebral body is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺索条影同前，双侧肺内未见新增结节
text_en: Fibrotic band in the right lung is stable compared to prior; no new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左肺纹理稍紊乱，散在边界模糊结节同前，大部分小灶不足3mm，较大者呈环形约8mm（Im36），支气管分支壁增厚
text_en: Left lung markings slightly disordered, scattered ill-defined nodules unchanged, most small foci less than 3mm, larger ring-shaped approximately 8mm (Im36), thickening of bronchial branch walls.

source_text: 左肺术后改变同前，未见新发占位
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left lung unchanged; no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 左前胸壁结节影同前，约13x9mm（IM18），未见明显强化
text_en: Nodular opacity in the left anterior chest wall unchanged, measuring approximately 13x9 mm (IM18), without definite enhancement.

source_text: 两肺小结节影同前，仍小于5mm
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior, still less than 5 mm

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜小结节影同前（IM49）
text_en: Small nodular opacity of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior (IM49).

source_text: 部分较前相仿，4组高密度淋巴结约18x12mm（IM20）
text_en: Partially unchanged, with high-density lymph nodes in station 4 measuring approximately 18x12mm (IM20).

source_text: 左肺门支气管旁软组织增厚较前增多，范围28x24mm（IM40），考虑恶性，不除外复发
text_en: Left hilar peribronchial soft tissue thickening increased compared to previous, measuring 28x24 mm (Image 40). Consider malignant, cannot exclude recurrence.

source_text: 纵隔2-7组及双肺门多发肿大淋巴结，部分增大，如2R组原约14*10mm，现约19*15mm（IM11）
text_en: Mediastinal stations 2-7 and bilateral hilar multiple enlarged lymph nodes; some are increased, such as station 2R which was previously approximately 14x10mm and is now approximately 19x15mm (IM11).

source_text: 左肺下叶肿物切除术后，术区见金属缝合线及不规则条片影同前
text_en: Post left lower lobe mass resection, surgical site shows metallic sutures and irregular linear opacities unchanged.

source_text: 右肺尖胸膜下可见纯磨玻璃结节同前，约7mm（IM11）
text_en: A pure ground-glass nodule is seen subpleurally in the right lung apex, unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 7 mm (IM11).

source_text: 扫及右肾上腺结节同前（IM62）
text_en: On scan, right adrenal nodule unchanged from prior (IM62)

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节影同前，约4mm（Im40）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (Im40).

source_text: 右肺微小结节，左侧胸膜结节，同前相仿，倾向良性
text_en: Right lung micro-nodule and left pleural nodule, similar to prior, favoring benign etiology

source_text: 双肺散在局限性条索影同前，余肺未见明确新增结节及实变影
text_en: Scattered focal linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged, remainder of the lungs show no definite new nodules or consolidation.

source_text: 纵隔3P组小淋巴结较前增大，现约13*12mm(图9)，原约12*10mm（IM9）
text_en: Small lymph node in mediastinal station 3P increased compared to previous, currently approximately 13x12 mm (Figure 9), previously approximately 12x10 mm (IM9).

source_text: 右肺未见新增斑片影及结节灶
text_en: No new patchy opacities or nodules are seen in the right lung.

source_text: 右下肺微小结节同前(图41)
text_en: The tiny nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged from prior (Figure 41).

source_text: 余肺野肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: The remainder of the lung fields shows normal bronchovascular markings and uniform lucency, with no new nodules or consolidation.

source_text: 左肺下叶良性微结节同前
text_en: Left lower lobe benign micronodule unchanged from previous

source_text: 扫及右侧肾上腺结节同前（IM67），请结合腹部检查
text_en: CT shows a nodule in the right adrenal gland, unchanged from previous (IM67); please correlate with abdominal imaging.

source_text: 右肺底小结节灶同前，约8x6mm（IM42）
text_en: Small nodule in the right lung base is unchanged, measuring approximately 8x6 mm (IM42).

source_text: 食管术后改变，胸部CT未见新增占位征象
text_en: Post-esophagectomy changes. Chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，多数形态扁平、平扫呈较高密度
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, with most being flat in morphology and showing higher density on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下磨玻璃密度小结节同前，大小仍约7mm（IM39）
text_en: Subpleural ground-glass opacity small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 7 mm (IM39).

source_text: 前胸壁皮下低密度结节同前，仍约25x15mm（IM22）
text_en: A subcutaneous low-density nodule in the anterior chest wall is unchanged from prior, still approximately 25x15 mm (IM22).

source_text: 纵隔2R组淋巴结同前
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal station 2R unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺条索影、双肺模糊小结节同前相仿，右肺上叶尖后段较大结节大小同前3mm（IM24）
text_en: Linear opacities in the right lung and hazy small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior; the larger nodule in the apicoposterior segment of the right upper lobe remains stable at 3 mm (IM24).

source_text: 左肺下叶类圆形小结节同前，直径约4mm(IM47)，边缘尚光滑
text_en: The small round nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged, with a diameter approximately 4 mm (IM47), and smooth margins.

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜结节样增厚同前（IM29），双侧未见胸水征象
text_en: The nodular thickening of the left interlobar pleura is unchanged compared to prior (IM29); no pleural fluid is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 肝内多发低密度灶、左侧肾上腺小结节同前相仿
text_en: Multiple low-density hepatic lesions and left adrenal small nodule similar to prior.

source_text: 双肺小结节影大致同前，建议结合临床，追查
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodule shadows are roughly stable compared to prior; clinical correlation and further investigation recommended

source_text: 食管-胃吻合术后，胸部CT未见新增占位征象
text_en: Post esophagogastrostomy, chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 双下肺微结节同前相仿，追查
text_en: Scattered micro-nodules in the bilateral lower lungs are similar to prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 余双肺未新增结节及实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidations are seen in both lungs

source_text: 倾向转移可能大，结合临床密切观察
text_en: Metastasis is highly likely; close clinical observation is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔4R及右肺门肿大淋巴结较前缩小，较大现约1.6x1.3cm（Im24），原为2.0x1.6cm（Im25）
text_en: The mediastinal station 4R and right hilar enlarged lymph nodes have decreased in size compared to previous, with the largest now approximately 1.6 x 1.3 cm (Image 24), previously 2.0 x 1.6 cm (Image 25)

source_text: 右叶间胸膜处结节同前，大小仍约7x5mm（IM31）
text_en: Nodule at the right interlobar pleura is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 7 x 5 mm (IM31).

source_text: 双侧胸膜散在结节样增厚部分较前增大，较大原约5mm（IM43），现约8mm（IM43）
text_en: Bilateral pleural scattered nodular thickening has partially increased compared to prior; the largest was previously approximately 5 mm (IM43), now approximately 8 mm (IM43).

source_text: 甲状腺左叶低密度结节同前（IM6）
text_en: Left thyroid lobe low-density nodule stable compared to prior (Image 6).

source_text: 食管-胃吻合术后，纵隔小淋巴结同前，胸部CT平扫未见明显新生占位
text_en: Post esophagogastrostomy, small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged, chest CT without contrast shows no obvious new space-occupying lesion.

source_text: 甲状腺右叶下极体积增大同前，内见低密度结节（IM7）
text_en: Volume enlargement in the inferior pole of the right thyroid lobe unchanged from prior, containing a low-density nodule (IM7).

source_text: 右上气管食管沟淋巴结缩小，原约12x10mm（Im7），现约10x6mm（IM5）
text_en: Lymph nodes in the right upper tracheoesophageal groove are smaller than before; the largest previously measured approximately 12x10 mm (Im7), now approximately 10x6 mm (IM5).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段分叶状肿块较前增大，现约30*26mm(图18)，原约27x21mm（纵隔窗IM17），远侧见阻塞性炎症
text_en: The lobulated mass in the left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment has increased compared to prior, now approximately 30x26 mm (Figure 18), previously approximately 27x21 mm on mediastinal window (IM17), with obstructive pneumonia seen distally.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺左叶低密度小结节灶同前（IM7）
text_en: Small low-density nodule in the left thyroid lobe unchanged from prior (IM7).

source_text: 左肺斑点索条影、右肺上叶小结节及小磨玻璃密度影同前（IMA24、26）
text_en: Punctate and linear opacities in the left lung, small nodules and small ground-glass opacities in the right upper lobe unchanged from previous (images 24, 26).

source_text: 右肺下叶散在磨玻璃结节同前，追查
text_en: Scattered ground-glass nodules in the right lower lobe, unchanged from prior, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左锁骨上、纵隔、双腋下多发淋巴结，部分较前略缩小
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region, mediastinum, and bilateral axillae, with some slightly decreased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则占位同前，双肺多发结节同前，追查
text_en: The irregular mass in the left upper lobe is unchanged; multiple nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior; further investigation is recommended.

source_text: 两肺可见多个微小结节灶（IMA15、16、18、35、44、48、52等），左上较大者约3mm（IMA18），考虑转移可能性大，建议密切追查
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules are seen in both lungs (IMA15, 16, 18, 35, 44, 48, 52, etc.); the largest in the left upper lobe is about 3 mm (IMA18), considered likely metastatic; close follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶不规则类结节影同前，仍约7mm（IM53）
text_en: Irregular nodule-like opacity in the left lower lobe unchanged from prior, still approximately 7mm (IM53).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段钙化结节及其前方边界清晰小结节同前相仿，密度较高，大小仍约5mm（IM22)
text_en: The calcified nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe and a small, well-defined nodule anterior to it remain unchanged, with high density, still measuring approximately 5 mm (IM22).

source_text: 右肺中叶肿物较前相仿，仍约23x14mm（IM30），右肺膨胀不全较前相仿、双下肺索条影同前
text_en: The right middle lobe mass is similar to prior, still measuring approximately 23 x 14 mm (IM30). Right lung atelectasis and bilateral lower lung fibrotic bands are similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺模糊浅淡结节影同前（Im31）
text_en: Faint, indistinct nodular opacity in the right lung is unchanged compared to prior (Im31).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段小结节影同前，约3mm（IMA10）
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment small nodule unchanged from previous, approximately 3 mm (IMA10).

source_text: 双肺多发微小结节及磨玻璃密度灶大致同前
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules and ground-glass opacities in both lungs are roughly unchanged.

source_text: 平扫纵隔7组淋巴结大致同前，约11x6mm（IM25）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes approximately unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 11x6 mm on image 25.

source_text: 左肺下叶斑片索条影、小结节影同前，约5mm（IMA53）
text_en: Patchy linear opacities and small nodules (approximately 5mm) in the left lower lobe are unchanged from previous (IMA53).

source_text: 余肺未见新发灶
text_en: No new lesions are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶5mm小结节同前（IM55）
text_en: 5mm small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (IM55).

source_text: 右肺门见多发淋巴结同前，较大约10x5mm（IM25），双锁骨上见多发小淋巴结同前，较大约6x3mm（IM5）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the right hilum are stable compared to prior, largest measuring approximately 10x5 mm (IM25). Multiple small lymph nodes in the bilateral supraclavicular regions are stable, largest measuring approximately 6x3 mm (IM5).

source_text: 扫及胸廓诸骨未见明确骨质破坏征象
text_en: No clear bone destruction seen in the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 部分较前缩小，如原约13x10mm（IM44）者，现约12x6mm（IM44）
text_en: Partial reduction, e.g., from approximately 13x10mm (IM44) to approximately 12x6mm (IM44).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段小结节同前，约4mm（IM26）
text_en: Small nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable, approximately 4 mm (IM26)

source_text: 左肺下叶结节灶同前，内见点状钙化，约为6mm（IM44）
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, with punctate calcification, approximately 6 mm in size (IM44).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段微小结节同前，约3mm（IM13）
text_en: A tiny nodule in the apical-posterior segment of the left upper lobe same as before, approximately 3 mm (IM13).

source_text: 右肺多发结节大小同前，数量减少
text_en: Multiple nodules in the right lung are stable in size and decreased in number.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺右叶低密度结节同前相仿（IM5）
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right thyroid lobe, similar to prior (IM5).

source_text: 左肺胸膜/叶间胸膜下微结节（IM15、38）同前
text_en: Left lung pleural and interlobar subpleural micronodules (IM15, 38) unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则软组织密度结节较前略饱满，现约22x19mm（IMA19），原约20x15mm（Im18），密度不均，边缘与侧胸膜牵拉同前
text_en: The irregular soft-tissue density nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe appears slightly fuller compared to prior, now measuring approximately 22x19 mm (IMA19), previously approximately 20x15 mm (Im18). The density is heterogeneous, and the margin with lateral pleural retraction remains unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后改变同前，胸部未见复发和转移征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left upper lobe unchanged from previous, no evidence of recurrence or metastasis in the chest

source_text: 纵隔14组轻度增大淋巴结同前
text_en: The mildly enlarged mediastinal lymph node at station 14 is unchanged from previous.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段胸膜下不规则软组织密度结节较前减小，原约17x13mm，现约15×12mm（IMA31），边缘见长短毛刺影
text_en: The irregular soft tissue density nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 17x13 mm, now approximately 15x12 mm (IMA31), with short and long spiculations at the margins

source_text: 右肺散在点状结节灶同前
text_en: Scattered punctate nodules in the right lung are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔4R组增大淋巴结大致同前，仍约17x12mm（IM24）
text_en: Enlarged lymph node at mediastinal station 4R unchanged from prior, currently measuring approximately 17x12 mm (IM24)

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段小簇小结节同前，考虑陈旧灶可能大
text_en: Left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment: small cluster of small nodules stable compared to prior, considered likely to be chronic lesions.

source_text: 右肺钙化结节同前，右肺下叶片絮范围较前明显减少
text_en: Calcified nodule in the right lung is unchanged from prior; the extent of patchy opacities in the right lower lobe has markedly decreased compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，较大者约7x5mm（IM14）
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, the largest approximately 7x5mm (IM14).

source_text: 右肺下叶微小结节同前
text_en: Tiny nodules in the right lower lobe are stable

source_text: 右下胸膜轻度增厚并肺内索条影同前，右肺中叶微小结节结节同前（IM23）
text_en: Mild pleural thickening in the right lower region with intrapulmonary linear opacities unchanged. Tiny nodule in the right middle lobe unchanged (IM23).

source_text: 左上腹皮下小结节灶同前，大小约10*7mm（IMA52）
text_en: Small subcutaneous nodule in the left upper abdomen is unchanged, measuring approximately 10x7 mm (IMA52).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段微小结节同前，约3mm（IM16），左肺下叶结节影约9mm（IM48）
text_en: A tiny nodule in the apical-posterior segment of the left upper lobe same as before, approximately 3 mm (IM16), and a nodule in the left lower lobe approximately 9 mm (IM48).

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结略饱满同前，随诊观察
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are slightly enlarged compared to previous, follow-up observation.

source_text: 右肺多发微小结节基本同前（IM24、42、47），大小约2-3mm
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in the right lung are essentially unchanged from prior (IM24, 42, 47), measuring approximately 2–3 mm.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见新发占位，余肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, no new space-occupying lesion at bronchial stump; remainder of lungs without nodules or consolidation.

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下微小结节同前，＜5mm（图34）
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior, less than 5 mm (Figure 34).

source_text: 双肺胸膜下多发微结节大部分同前，约3mm（IM16、42），右肺下叶背段小结节同前，约5x4mm（IM36）
text_en: Most of the multiple subpleural micro-nodules in both lungs are stable, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM16, 42); the small nodule in the right lower lobe dorsal segment remains unchanged, measuring approximately 5x4 mm (IM36).

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节影同前
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis identified

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，约5mm（IM41）
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM41).

source_text: 右肺下叶切除术后改变，胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes following right lower lobectomy; no new space-occupying lesions are seen in the chest.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段磨玻璃结节灶同前，约9x6mm（IM44）
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 9 x 6 mm (IM44).

source_text: 左腋下淋巴结增大，符合转移
text_en: Left axillary lymph nodes enlarged, consistent with metastasis.

source_text: 左下肺胸膜下见多发微小结节同前，约3-6mm（IMA49），边界清楚锐利
text_en: Multiple subpleural micronodules in the left lower lobe are unchanged, measuring approximately 3-6 mm (IMA49), with well-defined and sharp margins.

source_text: 左锁骨上淋巴结同前，较大约13x12mm（IM7）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph nodes unchanged, largest approximately 13x12 mm (IM7).

source_text: 腰1椎体上缘塌陷，局部可见骨质破坏（IM58）
text_en: Collapse of the superior margin of the L1 vertebral body with local bone destruction visible (IM58).

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区淋巴结同前
text_en: Lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region are stable.

source_text: 平扫纵隔淋巴结同前，现较大仍约13x10mm（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes on non-contrast CT are stable compared to prior, with the largest measuring approximately 13x10 mm (IM21).

source_text: 右肺下叶多发小结节，肺内转移可能
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right lower lobe; pulmonary metastasis is possible.

source_text: 左肺微小结节同前（IM21），右肺上叶贴斜裂胸膜小结节同前（Im28）
text_en: Tiny nodule in the left lung unchanged from prior (IM21); small nodule adjacent to the oblique fissure pleura in the right upper lobe unchanged from prior (Im28).

source_text: 右肺下叶微小结节同前，仍小于5mm（Im32）
text_en: Right lower lobe tiny nodule unchanged, still less than 5 mm (Im32)

source_text: 右肺微小结节影同前（IMA32、35）
text_en: Right lung tiny nodular opacities unchanged (IMA32, 35)

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段小结节大小同前，仍约5mm（IM9）
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment small nodule size unchanged from previous, still approximately 5 mm (IM9).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管残端未见新发软组织占位
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no new soft tissue mass is seen at the bronchial stump.

source_text: 食管癌术后，胸部CT未见新发占位
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer, chest CT shows no new mass lesions.

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺区域小结节同前(图58)，请结合腹部检查
text_en: A small nodule is noted in the left adrenal gland, stable compared to prior (Figure 58). Correlate with abdominal imaging.

source_text: 右肺上叶多发磨玻璃密度结节同前，追查
text_en: Multiple ground-glass opacity nodules in the right upper lobe are unchanged compared to prior; continued follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下、双肺斜裂旁可见散在结节影部分同前，部分缩小，如原较大约5x4mm（IM46），现约5x2mm(IM46)
text_en: Scattered nodular opacities subpleurally in the right middle lobe and adjacent to the oblique fissures in both lungs are partially unchanged and partially decreased in size; for example, a previously larger nodule measuring approximately 5 x 4 mm (IM46) now measures approximately 5 x 2 mm (IM46).

source_text: 双肺小结节同前，较大仍约3mm（IM33）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are stable compared to prior, the largest remains approximately 3 mm (IM33)

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下新见微小结节，＜5mm（图26）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural newly identified tiny nodule, less than 5mm (Figure 26)

source_text: 食管胸下段新发占位，考虑恶性，建议结合食道镜检查
text_en: Newly detected mass in the lower thoracic esophagus, suspicious for malignancy, recommend esophagoscopy.

source_text: 右侧心包旁及右侧心膈角区8-9mm淋巴结同前（IM33，38)，双肺门见多发小于10mm的淋巴结，追查
text_en: Lymph nodes measuring 8-9 mm adjacent to the right pericardium and in the right cardiophrenic angle are unchanged (IM33, 38). Multiple lymph nodes less than 10 mm are seen at both hila. Follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段胸膜下结节影形态、大小同前，约10x8mm（IM23），结节密度不均，可测量到脂肪密度，牵拉胸膜，胸膜外脂肪间隙清晰
text_en: Subpleural nodule in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe, morphology and size unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 10x8 mm (IM23), heterogeneous density with measurable fat density, pleural retraction present, extrapleural fat plane remains clear.

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下小结节同前，追查
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural nodule stable compared to prior, follow-up recommended

source_text: 纵隔、肺门多发淋巴结较前增大，现较大约18*16mm(图26)，原约15*14mm（IM26）
text_en: Mediastinal and hilar multiple lymph nodes enlarged compared to previous, now approximately 18*16 mm (Figure 26), previously approximately 15*14 mm (IM26).

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺结节增大，原约19x16mm（IM54），现约23x17mm（IM53），考虑转移
text_en: Left adrenal nodule enlarged, previously approximately 19x16 mm (IM54), currently approximately 23x17 mm (IM53), metastasis considered.

source_text: 纵隔内少许小淋巴结同前，未见明显增大者
text_en: A few mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, no significant lymphadenopathy seen.

source_text: 右肺索条状影同前，余肺内未见新生结节
text_en: Linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged; no new pulmonary nodules are seen.

source_text: 食管术后改变，吻合口未见复发征象
text_en: Post-esophagectomy changes. No evidence of recurrence at the anastomosis.

source_text: 右肺索条影同前，双肺未见新生结节灶
text_en: Fibrotic band in the right lung is stable compared to prior; no new nodular lesions are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 两肺索条钙化灶同前，两肺小结节影同前（IMA30、45），较大约5*4mm
text_en: Calcified linear opacities in both lungs are stable; small nodules in both lungs are stable (IMA30, 45), the largest measuring approximately 5x4 mm.

source_text: 双侧胸膜及叶间胸膜结节样增厚大致同前，较大约43x22mm（IM29），右侧胸水较前减少
text_en: Bilateral pleural and interlobar septal nodular thickening is largely stable, with the largest measuring approximately 43x22 mm (IM29). Right-sided pleural effusion is decreased compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶钙化小结节同前（IM18），双肺下叶索条影大致同前，余肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: Calcified small nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged (IM18); linear opacities in both lower lobes are essentially unchanged; no nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下及斜裂下多发小结节同前（IM18、40）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right lung subpleural region and below the oblique fissure are unchanged compared to prior (IM18, 40).

source_text: 右肺上叶周围型肺癌大致同前
text_en: Peripheral lung cancer in the right upper lobe is essentially unchanged

source_text: 余双肺多发结节较前相仿，较大者仍约11x8mm（IMA13），多数边缘仍模糊、形态不规则
text_en: Residual multiple nodules in both lungs are similar to prior; the largest remains approximately 11x8 mm (IMA13); most remain ill-defined with irregular morphology

source_text: 胸椎体高密度小结节及左第9肋局部骨质密度略增高同前.
text_en: Small high-density nodules in the thoracic vertebral bodies and slight focal increase in bone density in the left 9th rib, same as before.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下点状钙化及索条结节灶大致同前（Im13、32、33），右肺下叶少许索条影
text_en: Right lung subpleural punctate calcifications and fibrotic nodular opacities are essentially unchanged from prior (Im13, 32, 33); minimal fibrotic bands in the right lower lobe.

source_text: 纵隔7组结节同前，约14x11mm（IM33）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes unchanged from previous, approximately 14 × 11 mm (Image 33)

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影同前，两肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged; no new nodules or consolidation are seen in either lung.

source_text: 右肺门肿大淋巴结较前缩小，原较大约17x16mm（IM31），现约10*10mm（IMA30）
text_en: Right hilar enlarged lymph node decreased in size compared to prior; previously measured approximately 17x16 mm (IM31), now approximately 10x10 mm (IMA30).

source_text: 两肺斑点状影同前（IMA18、23），两肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Scattered punctate opacities in both lungs, unchanged from prior (IMA18, 23); no new nodules or consolidations seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区可见多发小淋巴结，约6x5mm（IM7），纵隔、双肺门、右锁骨上区及双腋下未见新发肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes are visible in the left supraclavicular region, measuring approximately 6x5 mm (IM7); no new enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum, bilateral hila, right supraclavicular region, or bilateral axillae.

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下模糊结节同前（IM30）
text_en: Indistinct subpleural nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged compared to prior (IM30).

source_text: 左锁骨上区淋巴结同前，仍约10x3mm（IM5）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node unchanged, still approximately 10x3 mm (IM5).

source_text: 右肺术后，右肺上叶前段及后段支气管腔变窄、肺组织不张同前（IMA25），局部结节影同前，现较大层面仍约10*9mm（IMA23）
text_en: Postoperative right lung, narrowing of the anterior and posterior segmental bronchi of the right upper lobe with associated atelectasis unchanged compared to prior (IMA25); local nodular opacity unchanged, with largest dimension still approximately 10 x 9 mm (IMA23).

source_text: 两下肺局限性索条影同前，双肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Focal fibrotic bands in both lower lungs unchanged; no new nodules in the lungs

source_text: 右肺中叶术后改变，胸部CT未见新发占位
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right middle lobe; chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区淋巴结同前，仍约7mm（IMA6）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node is unchanged, still approximately 7 mm (IMA6)

source_text: 新见多发微小结节
text_en: Newly identified multiple tiny nodules

source_text: 右肺模糊微小结节影同前（IMA37、48）
text_en: Faint tiny nodular opacity in the right lung is stable compared to prior (IMA37, 48).

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结较前缩小，左锁骨上淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes have decreased in size compared to previous, and left supraclavicular lymph nodes remain unchanged.

source_text: 左侧胸膜新见多发结节，追查
text_en: New multiple nodules are seen in the left pleura; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 两肺未见增重紊乱同前，两肺下叶片絮索条影同前，两肺小结节影同前
text_en: No increased interstitial thickening in both lungs compared to prior; patchy, linear opacities in the lower lobes of both lungs, unchanged from prior; small nodules in both lungs, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区淋巴结同前，仍约7mm（IMA4）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node is unchanged, still approximately 7 mm (IMA4)

source_text: 双肺上叶、右肺下叶微小结节同前，仍约2-3mm（IM7、25、26、35等）
text_en: Micronodules in the upper lobes of both lungs and the right lower lobe are stable compared to prior, still approximately 2-3 mm (IM7, 25, 26, 35, etc.).

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段软组织密度结节较前缩小，原约20x13mm（Im49），现约15x10mm（IM52）
text_en: Left lower lobe basal segment soft tissue density nodule smaller than prior, previously approximately 20x13 mm (Im49), currently approximately 15x10 mm (IM52)

source_text: 纵隔及肺门小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 扫及颈椎见低密度灶（IM1），胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Scanned cervical spine shows low-density focus (IM1); no evidence of osseous destruction in the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段混杂磨玻璃密度结节略饱满，原约19x15mm(IM21)，现约21x15mm（IM20），牵拉叶间胸膜凹陷同前
text_en: Mixed ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment is slightly more prominent, previously about 19x15 mm (IM21), now approximately 21x15 mm (IM20). Pleural indentation with retraction of the interlobar fissure remains unchanged.

source_text: 结合矢状位观察左斜裂胸膜上见一结节同前，直径约6mm（IMA27），左侧膈胸膜见多发扁平结节状增厚同前，较大者约16x14mm（IMA54），考虑陈旧性
text_en: In sagittal view, a nodule on the left oblique fissure pleura unchanged, diameter approximately 6 mm (IMA27); left diaphragmatic pleura shows multiple flat nodular thickenings unchanged, largest approximately 16x14 mm (IMA54), considered old

source_text: 双肺小结节显示较前清楚（IM21、22、48），大小同前，较大约4mm（IM22）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are more clearly visualized compared to prior (IM21, 22, 48), size stable, largest approximately 4 mm (IM22)

source_text: 右侧肾上腺结节样增粗同前（IMA64）
text_en: Nodular thickening of the right adrenal gland is unchanged (IMA64).

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前，不足5mm（IM33）
text_en: Tiny nodule in the left interlobar pleura is stable, less than 5 mm (IM33).

source_text: 双肺多发磨玻璃密度结节影同前，较大仍约6mm（IMA14）
text_en: Multiple ground-glass density nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged; the largest remains approximately 6 mm (IMA14).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变，胸部CT平扫所见同前，未见明确占位征象
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; findings on non-contrast chest CT unchanged from prior; no definite mass lesion identified

source_text: 左肺上叶术后改变，支气管断端周围软组织结构紊乱同前，未见占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left upper lobe; bronchial stump surrounding soft tissue disarray unchanged, no mass lesion.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，胸部CT未见新发占位
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 纵隔内5组低密度结节同前
text_en: Low-density nodule at mediastinal station 5 is unchanged from prior

source_text: 双肺上叶小结节斑片影并肺尖胸膜轻度增厚较前相仿，左肺上叶结节较多呈串状分布同前（Im11-15）
text_en: Small nodules and patchy opacities in the upper lobes of both lungs with mild pleural thickening at the apex are similar to prior; multiple nodules in the left upper lobe in a string-like distribution are stable compared to prior (IM11-15).

source_text: 食管胸下段管壁不均匀增厚较前减轻，如较厚部位原约12mm，现约10mm（IM22），外膜仍模糊同前，同胸主动脉部分分界不清，接触面大于90度
text_en: The wall of the lower thoracic esophagus shows uneven thickening, which has decreased compared to prior. The thickest portion, previously approximately 12 mm, is now approximately 10 mm (IM22). The adventitia remains blurred as before, and the boundary with the thoracic aorta remains partially indistinct, with a contact angle exceeding 90 degrees.

source_text: 纵隔2-5组淋巴结大致同前，较大约11x10mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal groups 2-5 lymph nodes are stable compared to prior, largest approximately 11x10 mm (IM20)

source_text: 余两肺散在结节大致同前，较大约7*5mm(图32)
text_en: Scattered nodules in the remainder of both lungs are largely unchanged; the largest measures approximately 7x5 mm (Figure 32).

source_text: 纵隔多发高密度淋巴结部分较前稍饱满，较大原约13x10mm（IM31)，现约15x10mm（IM33），双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple calcified mediastinal lymph nodes partially slightly increased in size; largest previously approximately 13x10 mm (IM31), now approximately 15x10 mm (IM33). No enlarged lymph nodes seen in bilateral hilar, supraclavicular, or bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 余肺未见新见结节影
text_en: The remainder of the lungs shows no newly seen nodular opacities.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段软组织密度结节较前增大，现约22*17mm（IM13），原约19x16mm（Im23），与胸膜接触面约16mm，考虑肺癌，可疑侵犯胸膜
text_en: A soft-tissue density nodule in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe has increased compared to prior, now approximately 22x17 mm (IM13), previously approximately 19x16 mm (Im23), with a pleural contact surface of approximately 16 mm, considered lung cancer, suspicious for pleural invasion

source_text: 右肺上叶索条影、左肺钙化灶同前，右肺浅淡微小结节影同前（IMA18、30）
text_en: The linear opacity in the right upper lobe and the calcified foci in the left lung are unchanged compared to prior; the faint tiny nodular opacity in the right lung is also unchanged (IMA18, 30).

source_text: 双侧肱骨头改变，骨转移
text_en: Changes in the bilateral humeral heads, consistent with bone metastases.

source_text: 双肺上叶多个结节同前
text_en: Multiple nodules in the upper lobes of both lungs are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段多发磨玻璃密度结节，较前减小或部分吸收，追查
text_en: Left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment: multiple ground-glass opacity nodules, decreased in size or partially resolved compared to prior, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔4组小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes in mediastinal station 4 are stable compared to prior

source_text: 右肺下叶磨玻璃结节同前，建议复查
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段结节同前，追查
text_en: The nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior. Recommend further investigation.

source_text: 双肺多发微结节同前
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 原左肺下叶胸膜下结节，现未见确切显示，左肺上叶微小结节大致同前（IM34）
text_en: The previously noted subpleural nodule in the left lower lobe is not clearly visible; the tiny nodules in the left upper lobe are essentially unchanged (IM34).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃密度结节影、右肺下叶基底段小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe and the small nodule in the basal segment of the right lower lobe are unchanged compared to prior; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段分叶毛刺软组织肿块大致同前，现约42*15mm(图18)，原约37x18mm（IM18），中度强化，近端支气管截断，邻近胸膜凹陷
text_en: Lobulated and spiculated soft tissue mass in the right upper lobe apical segment essentially unchanged, now approximately 42x15 mm (Figure 18), previously 37x18 mm (IM18); moderately enhancing, with proximal bronchial cutoff and adjacent pleural indentation

source_text: 左胸壁皮下小结节灶基本同前，约8mm（IMA28）
text_en: Left chest wall subcutaneous small nodule essentially stable, approximately 8mm (IMA28).

source_text: 双肺散在索条及小结节影大致同前（IM25、30）
text_en: Scattered linear and small nodular opacities in both lungs are largely unchanged (IM25, 30).

source_text: 右肺胸膜及胸膜旁散在不规则微小结节同前，较大者约3mm（IMA32）
text_en: Scattered irregular tiny nodules adjacent to the right pleura are stable compared to prior, the largest measuring about 3 mm (IMA32).

source_text: 右侧水平裂胸膜多发小结节同前
text_en: Multiple small pleural nodules along the right horizontal fissure are stable.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃样结节同前，建议追查
text_en: Left upper lobe ground-glass nodule unchanged from prior, follow-up recommended

source_text: 右侧胸膜下结节同前（IM28）
text_en: Subpleural nodule in the right lung is unchanged compared to prior (IM28).

source_text: 右肺中叶条片灶略增多，不规则小结节同前（IM17）
text_en: Right middle lobe linear and patchy opacities are slightly increased; irregular small nodule is stable (IM17).

source_text: 前纵隔结节同前，约10x5mm（IM25）
text_en: Nodule in the anterior mediastinum is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 10x5 mm (IM25).

source_text: 右肺中叶为小结节同前
text_en: The small nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶结节同前，约20x16mm（Im14），其内可见支气管气相
text_en: Left upper lobe nodule unchanged, approximately 20x16 mm (Image 14), with bronchial air sign visible within.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度灶及微小结节影同前
text_en: Ground-glass opacity and tiny nodular opacities in the right upper lobe are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺少许索条影同前，双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 纵隔3p组小淋巴结较前饱满，现约6x5mm（IM11），原约4x4mm
text_en: Small lymph node in mediastinal station 3p is enlarged compared to previous, currently approximately 6x5 mm (IM11), previously approximately 4x4 mm.

source_text: 左肺下叶病变较前稍大，现仍呈类条状，原约24x9mm（Im38），现约24x13mm（IM37），请结合临床追查
text_en: Left lower lobe lesion slightly larger than prior, currently still band-like, previously approximately 24x9mm (IM38), currently approximately 24x13mm (IM37), please correlate with clinical findings for follow-up

source_text: 纵隔6组淋巴结较前增大，原约7mm（IM23），现约10mm（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal station 6 lymph nodes increased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 7 mm (IM23), currently approximately 10 mm (IM21).

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下平扫未见明显肿大淋巴结，同前片
text_en: No enlarged lymph nodes seen in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular regions, and bilateral axillary regions on non-contrast CT, unchanged from prior study.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃密度小结节及右肺上叶前段小结节同前，约4mm（IM10）、3mm（IM24）
text_en: Small ground-glass density nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe and a small nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe are unchanged, approximately 4 mm (IM10) and 3 mm (IM24), respectively.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下微小结节同前，约2mm（Im23）
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodule in the right lung is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 2 mm (Im23).

source_text: 新见簇状多个小结节
text_en: Newly seen clustered multiple small nodules

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R见淋巴结同前，较大者约18*6mm（IMA22），形态扁平
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R and 4R are unchanged from previous, with the largest measuring approximately 18x6 mm (IMA22), flattened morphology.

source_text: 左肺下叶及残余右肺微小结节此次扫描显示不清，右肺上叶不规则索条影同前
text_en: Tiny nodules in the left lower lobe and residual right lung not clearly visualized on this scan; irregular linear opacities in the right upper lobe unchanged from previous

source_text: 双肺及叶间胸膜小结节同前，约5mm(IM31、33、40)
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs and interlobar pleura are stable, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM31, 33, 40).

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下结节同前
text_en: Subpleural nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺术后，支气管断端较前相仿，未见结节及肿块
text_en: Post left lung surgery, bronchial stump unchanged compared to prior, no nodules or masses identified.

source_text: 双肺门、纵隔2R、4、见多发小淋巴结同前，较大约19x7mm（IM26）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes are seen at the bilateral hila and mediastinum (stations 2R, 4), unchanged from prior; the largest is approximately 19x7 mm (IM26).

source_text: 左肺下叶原微小结节此次扫描未见显示，双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Original small nodule in the left lower lobe not visible on this scan, no new nodules or patchy opacities in both lungs

source_text: 左侧胸膜增厚同前，右侧斜裂胸膜结节样增厚同前
text_en: Left pleural thickening is unchanged. Nodular thickening of the right oblique fissure pleura is unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔多个小淋巴结大致同前，较大约17*8mm(图32)
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes are essentially unchanged from previous, with the largest measuring approximately 17x8 mm (Figure 32).

source_text: 右肺门及纵隔7区淋巴结大致同前，较大约16x10mm（IM37）
text_en: Lymph nodes at the right hilum and mediastinal station 7 are largely unchanged from prior, the largest measures approximately 16x10 mm (IM37)

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺占位较前缩小，请结合腹部检查
text_en: A mass in the left adrenal gland is decreased in size compared to prior. Correlate with abdominal imaging.

source_text: 左肺门、纵隔多发肿大淋巴结较前减少，追查
text_en: Multiple left hilar and mediastinal enlarged lymph nodes decreased compared to prior; further investigation required.

source_text: 左肺上叶下舌段新发类圆形结节灶，约4mm（Im37）
text_en: A new, round nodule is seen in the lower lingular segment of the left upper lobe, measuring approximately 4 mm (Im37).

source_text: 右上肺不规则索条影较前相仿，双肺小结节较前相仿（IM38、48、50、58、59）
text_en: Irregular linear opacity in the right upper lung is similar to prior; small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior (IM38, 48, 50, 58, 59).

source_text: 右肺下叶磨玻璃密度小结节影同前（IM29、36、41、51、52），小于10mm
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM29, 36, 41, 51, 52), less than 10 mm in size

source_text: 右肺上叶后段磨玻璃密度结节同前
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment, unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结较前缩小，原约20x11mm（IM29），现约18x5mm（IM29）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes are decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 20x11 mm (IM29), currently approximately 18x5 mm (IM29)

source_text: 扫及右侧肾上腺外侧肢见小结节同前，请结合腹部检查
text_en: CT shows a small nodule in the right adrenal gland lateral aspect, unchanged from previous; please correlate with abdominal imaging.

source_text: 右侧第2肋骨骨转移可能大
text_en: Bone metastasis in the right 2nd rib is highly likely.

source_text: 右肋术后改变同前，胸12椎体前下缘高密度灶同前，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: Postoperative changes of the right rib unchanged; hyperdense focus at the anterior-inferior margin of the T12 vertebral body unchanged; no osseous destruction seen in the remainder of the visualized bones.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃样病灶同前（IM11）右肺散在微小结节同前相仿，＜5mm
text_en: Left upper lobe ground-glass opacity unchanged from prior (IM11), scattered tiny nodules in the right lung similar to prior, <5 mm

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段点状结节影同前（IM15）
text_en: Left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment: punctate nodule unchanged from previous (IM15).

source_text: 左第4后肋骨质局限性密度增高同前，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: Focal increased density in the left posterior fourth rib is unchanged; no osseous destruction is seen in the remainder of the visualized bones.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段微结节同前，小于3mm（IM29）
text_en: Micro-nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe unchanged from prior, less than 3 mm (IM29).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结部分同前，较大仍约7x5mm（IM21）
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged from previous; the largest remains approximately 7x5mm (IM21).

source_text: 双侧腋窝小淋巴结同前，短径＜5mm（IM13）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in bilateral axillae are unchanged, short diameter < 5 mm (IM13).

source_text: 左肺上叶多发微结节部分同前，现较大约3mm（IM13），部分显示不清
text_en: Some of the multiple micronodules in the left upper lobe are unchanged, with the larger one now approximately 3 mm (IM13), and some are not clearly visible.

source_text: 隆突下局限性积液同前,纵隔、锁骨上区及双腋下平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Subcarinal localized fluid collection similar to prior, mediastinum, supraclavicular regions, and bilateral axillary on non-contrast scan no enlarged lymph nodes seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，右肺中叶微小结节结节及左下叶磨玻璃密度灶较前无明显变化，建议追查
text_en: Following right upper lobectomy, micro-nodules in the right middle lobe and a ground-glass opacity focus in the left lower lobe show no significant change compared to prior; continued surveillance recommended.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前无变化
text_en: The mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，约6mm（IM38），余双肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM38). No new nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右侧肺门及纵隔2R组见肿大淋巴结，较大约30x20mm（Im22），与胸腔胃关系密切，考虑转移可能大
text_en: Enlarged lymph nodes in the right hilum and mediastinal station 2R, the largest measuring approximately 30x20 mm (Im22), closely related to the intrathoracic stomach. Metastasis is highly likely.

source_text: 左肺下叶斜裂旁4mm结节较前相仿（IM31）
text_en: 4mm nodule adjacent to the oblique fissure in the left lower lobe is similar to previous (IM31).

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔及双肺门多发淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions essentially unchanged from previous

source_text: 右侧锁骨上小淋巴结大致同前，约5x3mm（IMA3）
text_en: The small lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region are generally unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 5 x 3 mm (IMA3).

source_text: 纵隔、左肺门、左锁骨上多发淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Mediastinal, left hilar, and left supraclavicular multiple lymph nodes are unchanged from prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左下肺韧带见8x6mm大小淋巴结（IM32)，较前相仿
text_en: An 8x6 mm lymph node is seen in the left lower pulmonary ligament (IM32), similar in size compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段膈肌上方多发结节较前相仿，较大约10mm（IM44），追查
text_en: Multiple nodules above the diaphragm in the basal segment of the right lower lobe are similar to prior, the largest measuring approximately 10 mm (IM44); further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 右侧肾上腺结节灶同前
text_en: Nodular focus in the right adrenal gland is unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶见一浅淡小结节同前，仍约5mm（IM28），追查
text_en: A faint small nodule, approximately 5mm (Image 28), is seen in the left upper lobe unchanged from prior; follow-up.

source_text: 左肺下叶前基底段近膈胸膜处小结节同前，约4mm（IM40）
text_en: Small nodule in the anterior basal segment of the left lower lobe near the diaphragmatic pleura, unchanged from previous, approximately 4 mm (IM40)

source_text: 新发小结节
text_en: Newly developed small nodules

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜及纵隔胸膜多发结节状增厚部分较前稍大，如原约6mm（IM26），现约8mm（IM24）
text_en: Some of the multiple nodular thickenings of the right interlobar pleura and mediastinal pleura are slightly larger than prior, such as one increasing from approximately 6 mm (IM26) to approximately 8 mm (IM24).

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜及右下肺模糊结节同前，未见新生灶
text_en: The right interlobar pleural and right lower lobe indistinct nodule are unchanged from prior; no new lesions are seen.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度灶较前相仿，约15*8mm（IMA19），两肺小结节影同前如左肺上叶舌段结节仍约3mm（IMA37），右肺下叶前基底段结节仍约9mm（IM38）
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe is similar to previous, approximately 15x8 mm (IMA19), with unchanged small nodules in both lungs including a 3 mm nodule in the lingular segment of the left upper lobe (IMA37) and a 9 mm nodule in the anterior basal segment of the right lower lobe (IM38).

source_text: 纵隔少许小淋巴结同前，较大原约7mm（IM23），现约8x7mm（IM23），密度较前增高
text_en: Mediastinal few small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest previously approximately 7mm (IM23), now approximately 8x7mm (IM23), density increased compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔5组淋巴结较前相仿，肺门淋巴结平扫显示不清
text_en: Mediastinal group 5 lymph nodes similar to prior, hilar lymph nodes not clearly visible on non-contrast scan

source_text: 右心膈角新见一小淋巴结，约5x4mm（IM38）
text_en: A new small lymph node is seen at the right cardiophrenic angle, measuring approximately 5 x 4 mm (IM38).

source_text: 扫及肝内见低密度结节同前，未见强化
text_en: CT shows a low-density nodule within the liver unchanged from previous, with no enhancement.

source_text: 右肺中叶结节同前
text_en: Nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged.

source_text: 左上叶残余肺内小结节同前，约3mm（IM13）
text_en: The small nodule within the residual lung of the left upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM13).

source_text: 左肺下叶索条影、两肺散在模糊小结节灶大小及范围同前相仿，较大仍约8x6mm（I薄层M83）
text_en: Left lower lobe linear opacities and scattered indistinct small nodular opacities in both lungs, size and extent similar to prior; largest still approximately 8x6 mm (I thin-section M83).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段磨玻璃结节影同前，约7x5mm（Im15）
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment, unchanged, approximately 7x5 mm (Im15).

source_text: 原左肺8x5mm结节较前略缩小、密度减低，边缘不清，现5*5mm（IM36)
text_en: The previously noted 8x5 mm nodule in the left lung is slightly smaller and less dense, with ill-defined margins, now measuring 5x5 mm (IM36).

source_text: R组小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph node in station R is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺斑点钙化同前，左肺未见新发结节影
text_en: Punctate calcifications in the right lung are unchanged from prior; no new nodules are seen in the left lung.

source_text: 余肺内未见新增结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段模糊结节同前（IM27），追查
text_en: Left lower lobe dorsal segment indistinct nodule unchanged from prior (IM27); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 两肺内多发模糊小结节灶大致同前，较大者约6mm（IMA26）
text_en: Multiple indistinct small nodules in both lungs are roughly unchanged; the largest is approximately 6 mm (IMA26).

source_text: 纵隔多个淋巴结同前，较大仍约12x10mm（IM20）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged from previous, with the largest still measuring approximately 12x10 mm (IM20).

source_text: 双肺另见微小结节部分较前增大，较大位于右肺中叶，原约4mm（IM35），现约7mm（IM31）
text_en: Multiple additional tiny nodules in both lungs are partially increased compared to prior; largest located in the right middle lobe, previously approximately 4 mm (IM35), now approximately 7 mm (IM31).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段不规则结节影同前，边界尚清，约9x8mm(IM17)，局部胸膜受牵拉，右肺下叶微结节同前（IM49）
text_en: The irregular nodule in the left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment is unchanged from prior, with well-defined margins, approximately 9x8 mm (IM17), with local pleural traction; the right lower lobe micronodule is unchanged (IM49).

source_text: 纵隔2-4、6、7组、右肺门及右侧锁骨上区多发肿大淋巴结较前缩小，原较大约28x21mm（Im18），现约9x6mm（IM16）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in mediastinal groups 2-4, 6, 7, right hilar region, and right supraclavicular area have decreased in size compared to prior; previously largest approximately 28x21 mm (IM18), now approximately 9x6 mm (IM16)

source_text: 余肺未见新发结节灶或斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 新见多枚肿大淋巴结
text_en: Newly seen multiple enlarged lymph nodes

source_text: 双肺未见新增的结节和斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 锁骨上、纵隔多个小淋巴结同前相仿，腔静脉后较大仍约12*8mm（IM24）
text_en: Multiple small supraclavicular and mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged, with the larger one posterior to the vena cava still measuring approximately 12x8mm (IM24).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约12x6mm（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged, largest measuring approximately 12x6 mm (IM19)

source_text: 右肺叶间胸膜微小结节及左肺下叶胸膜旁结节同前（IM32、47）
text_en: Micro-nodules beneath the interlobar pleura of the right lung and a pleural-adjacent nodule in the left lower lobe are stable compared to prior (IM32, 47).

source_text: 右肺微小结节大致同前，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: Right lung tiny nodules essentially unchanged; likely chronic

source_text: 胸10椎体致密小结节同前
text_en: Dense small nodule in thoracic vertebra 10, same as before

source_text: 余肺透亮度均匀，未见新发结节或斑片影
text_en: The remainder of the lungs shows uniform lucency, with no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 部分结节较前相仿，如右肺钙化及上叶（IM18）、中叶（IM36）小结节灶
text_en: Some nodules are similar to previous; for example, calcifications and small nodular foci in the right upper lobe (IM18) and middle lobe (IM36).

source_text: 左肺小结节及叶间胸膜结节同前（IM24、36）
text_en: Small nodules in the left lung and interlobar pleural nodules unchanged from prior (IM24, 36).

source_text: 纵隔见数枚小淋巴结，较大原约12x8mm，现约10x6mm（IM28）
text_en: Several small lymph nodes in the mediastinum; the largest previously measured approximately 12x8mm, now approximately 10x6mm (IM28).

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门多发淋巴结，考虑转移
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right hilum, suspicious for metastasis.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，胸主动脉后方软组织密度影较前缩小，原约21*15mm，现约18x11mm(图34)，左侧胸膜增厚较前减轻，左侧未见胸水征象
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, the soft tissue density posterior to the thoracic aorta has decreased in size compared to previous, from approximately 21x15 mm to 18x11 mm (Figure 34); left pleural thickening has improved compared to previous, and no pleural effusion is seen on the left.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，现约14x6mm（IM21）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, now approximately 14x6 mm (IM21).

source_text: 左肺下叶背段支气管狭窄截断同前，软组织肿块变化不大，左肺门肿大淋巴结相互融合分界不清，整体范围仍约4.3x3cm（Im26），不均匀强化
text_en: Bronchial stenosis and cutoff in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe, unchanged from previous, with a soft tissue mass unchanged; left hilar enlarged lymph nodes fused with indistinct margins, overall extent still approximately 4.3x3 cm (Im26), with heterogeneous enhancement.

source_text: 两肺未见新发异常结节或实变影
text_en: No new abnormal nodules or consolidations seen in both lungs.

source_text: 新见少许模糊微小结节
text_en: Newly identified a few indistinct tiny nodules

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，左肺上叶前段类圆形结节同前，边界清楚，约6mm（IM24）
text_en: Bilateral lung markings are unremarkable in course, and pulmonary lucency is uniform. A round nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe is stable, with clear margins, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM24).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，约9x6mm（IM21），下叶基底段胸膜下模糊小结节同前（IM36）
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to the prior study, measuring approximately 9 x 6 mm (IM21). The subpleural indistinct small nodule in the basal segment of the lower lobe is unchanged (IM36).

source_text: 右肺下叶占位较前增大
text_en: Mass in the right lower lobe is larger compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，右肺下叶背段小结节同前，仍约2mm（IMA26），邻近胸膜增厚
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Lung parenchymal lucency is uniform. A small nodule in the dorsal segment of the right lower lobe is stable, still measuring approximately 2 mm (IMA26), with adjacent pleural thickening.

source_text: 双肺少许索条影同前，未见新生结节及斑片影
text_en: Few linear opacities in both lungs are stable; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 纵隔4组肿大淋巴结同前，约19*8mm（IM25）
text_en: Enlarged mediastinal station 4 lymph nodes are unchanged from previous, approximately 19x8 mm (IM25)

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，5-10mm
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, ranging from 5 to 10 mm.

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段肿块形态较前增大，实性成分增多，现较大层面约24x15mm（IM40），对应层面约24x11mm（IM40），病灶周围斑片索条影较前增多
text_en: Left lower lobe basal segment mass increased in size compared to previous with increased solid component, currently measuring approximately 24x15 mm on the largest slice (IM40) and 24x11 mm on the corresponding slice (IM40), with increased patchy and linear opacities around the lesion compared to previous.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节影（IM17）同前相仿
text_en: Nodule with ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe (IM17) is comparable to prior findings.

source_text: 双肺多发微小结节同前相仿，追查
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged; further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 双肺纹理增重，多发微结节，大致同前
text_en: Increased bronchovascular markings in both lungs, multiple micronodules, largely unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4多发小淋巴结同前，密度混杂不均
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R and 4 are unchanged from previous, with heterogeneous density

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端壁略增厚同前相仿（IMA27），右肺小斑片索条及小结节影同前
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy. Slight wall thickening at the bronchial stump is similar to prior (IMA27). Small patchy linear opacities and small nodules in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶结节稍增大，转移可能，进一步检查或密切观察
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is slightly enlarged, suspicious for metastasis, and further evaluation or close observation is recommended.

source_text: 右肺多发磨玻璃密度结节同前
text_en: Multiple ground-glass opacity nodules in the right lung are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 前纵隔肿物切除术后，术区少许软组织密度影同前，未见强化
text_en: Status post resection of anterior mediastinal mass. A small soft tissue density in the surgical bed is unchanged from prior and shows no enhancement.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段胸膜下不规则结节较前相仿，追查
text_en: The irregular subpleural nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged from the prior study; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺中叶不规则片絮及索条影影、左肺上叶胸膜下肺大泡及右肺胸膜下小结节（IM52）同前，余肺野未见新发结节及斑片影
text_en: Irregular patchy and linear opacities in the right middle lobe, subpleural bulla in the left upper lobe, and a small subpleural nodule in the right lung (IM52) unchanged; remainder of the lung fields show no new nodules or patchy opacities

source_text: 近端食管管壁环周均匀增厚，较前减轻，原较厚约7mm（IM16），现较厚约6mm（IM13），结合相关检查
text_en: Circumferential uniform thickening of the proximal esophageal wall, improved compared to previous, previously approximately 7 mm thick (IM16), now approximately 6 mm thick (IM13).

source_text: 组淋巴结同前，约14x8mm（IM29）
text_en: Group lymph node unchanged, approximately 14x8 mm (IM29)

source_text: 余肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: No new nodules are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶模糊结节影同前，大小约3mm（IM44），追查
text_en: Left lower lobe hazy nodule shadow unchanged, size approximately 3 mm (IM44), follow-up recommended

source_text: 右肺中叶内侧段胸膜下小结节影同前，约3mm（Im35）
text_en: Small subpleural nodular opacity in the medial segment of the right middle lobe, stable compared to prior, approximately 3 mm (Im35).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段近叶间裂处结节样磨玻璃密度影大致同前，现约11x6mm(IM23)
text_en: Nodular ground-glass opacity in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe near the interlobar fissure is essentially unchanged, currently measuring approximately 11 x 6 mm (IM23).

source_text: 纵隔多发肿大淋巴结伴钙化同前，较大仍约16x13mm（IM28）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes enlarged with calcification, stable compared to prior, largest still approximately 16x13 mm (IM28)

source_text: 胸廓骨质未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: No bone destruction lesions seen in the bones of the thoracic cage.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段胸膜下磨玻璃密度结节同前，仍约6mm（Im23）
text_en: Subpleural ground-glass opacity nodule in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe, unchanged from prior, still approximately 6 mm (Im23).

source_text: 纵隔多发肿大淋巴结同前，双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下平扫未见明显肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes enlarged, stable compared to prior; bilateral hilar, supraclavicular, and bilateral axillary regions on non-contrast scan show no significant lymphadenopathy

source_text: 左肺下叶新见多发小结节，较大约12x9mm（IM55），边缘模糊
text_en: New multiple small nodules in the left lower lobe, largest approximately 12x9mm (IM55), with ill-defined margins.

source_text: 双肺多发小结节影同前相仿，不足10mm(Im20、38、40、45)
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior, all measuring less than 10 mm (Im20, 38, 40, 45).

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，左肺上叶上舌段见浅分叶结节灶同前，大小约9x7mm（IM28），边缘较光滑，右肺下叶背段可见结节索条灶，伴细点钙化同前，余肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. A shallow lobulated nodule is seen in the left upper lobe superior lingular segment, stable in size at approximately 9x7 mm (IM28), with relatively smooth margins. A nodular linear opacity is seen in the right lower lobe posterior segment with fine punctate calcification, stable. No nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺上叶结节同前，约20x15mm（Im14）
text_en: Left upper lobe nodule unchanged, approximately 20x15 mm (Image 14).

source_text: 左肺上叶切除术后改变，胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, no new space-occupying lesions in the chest.

source_text: 左肾上腺结节较前相仿
text_en: Left adrenal nodule similar to previous.

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下磨玻璃结节同前，现约9x7mm(IM14)，追查
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural ground-glass nodule unchanged from prior, currently approximately 9 x 7 mm (IM14), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶微小结节影同前（IM18）
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule unchanged (IM18).

source_text: 余肺野未见新发结节
text_en: The remainder of the lung fields shows no new nodules.

source_text: 左肺下叶前内基底段实性肿块较前略缩小，原约42x38mm（IM40），现约38x37mm（IM43），边缘呈分叶状改变，增强扫描可见不均匀强化，其内片状低强化灶同前，左肺下叶前内基底段支气管截断
text_en: In the anterior-inferior basal segment of the left lower lobe, solid mass slightly decreased in size from approximately 42x38 mm (IM40) to 38x37 mm (IM43), margins lobulated, heterogeneous enhancement on contrast scan, internal patchy low enhancement unchanged, bronchial cutoff.

source_text: 右肺中叶术后，肺内少许陈旧灶同前，胸部CT平扫未见新生占位
text_en: Status post right middle lobectomy; minimal old foci in the lung are stable. No new space-occupying lesion is seen on non-contrast chest CT.

source_text: 左肺术后改变，支气管断端未见占位征象，纵隔略左移同前
text_en: Left lung postoperative change, no space-occupying lesion signs at bronchial stump, mediastinal shift slightly to the left unchanged.

source_text: 双肺少许小结节同前（Im43、44），未见新生结节及斑片影
text_en: Few small nodules in both lungs are stable (Im43, 44); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 扫及胆囊结石，右侧肾上腺软组织结节大致同前
text_en: Gallstones, with a soft tissue nodule in the right adrenal gland largely unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结同前，约16x10mm（IMA26）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes unchanged from prior, approximately 16x10 mm (IMA26).

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，局部未见复发征象，追查
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lower lobe; no evidence of local recurrence is seen. Further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，左肺上叶前段支气管管壁略厚及管壁周围肺野模糊斑片影大致同前（IMA26），未见实性软组织密度结节或肿块
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. The slightly thickened bronchial wall and surrounding hazy patchy opacity in the left upper lobe anterior segment are largely unchanged (IMA26). No solid soft-tissue density nodule or mass is seen.

source_text: 双肺多发小斑片及小结节影同前（IM19、25、32、38、43、47），右肺索条及类结节影同前
text_en: Multiple small patchy opacities and small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior (IM19, 25, 32, 38, 43, 47). Right lung linear and nodular-like opacities are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔内见散在高密度小淋巴结同前相仿，右肺淋巴结大致同前，平扫边界不清
text_en: Scattered high-density small lymph nodes within the mediastinum similar to previous; right pulmonary lymph nodes essentially same as before, with indistinct boundaries on non-contrast scan

source_text: 右肺上叶前段椭圆形结节较前略增大，原约28x21mm（IM27），现约30x24mm（IM25）
text_en: Oval nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe slightly increased in size, previously approximately 28x21 mm (IM27), now approximately 30x24 mm (IM25)

source_text: 左侧胸背部皮下小结节同前（IM10）
text_en: Small subcutaneous nodule in the left chest and back, stable compared to prior (IM10).

source_text: 右叶间胸膜约5mm小结节同前（IM43）
text_en: A small nodule measuring approximately 5 mm in the right interlobar pleura is stable compared to prior imaging (IM43).

source_text: 右肺小斑片索条影、左肺点状结节灶同前（IM35、46）
text_en: Small patchy linear opacities in the right lung and punctate nodules in the left lung are stable compared to prior (IM35, 46).

source_text: 余纵隔散在小淋巴结同前
text_en: The remaining scattered small mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下见微小结节同前，约3mm（IM44）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural tiny nodule unchanged, approximately 3mm (IM44)

source_text: 左上叶舌段见密度较淡不规则结节灶同前，大小约9x5mm（IM33),左下肺少许片状影及囊状透亮区同前，双下肺见少量索条状病变同前，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: An irregularly shaped nodule with relatively low density in the lingular segment of the left upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 9x5 mm (IM33). The minor patchy opacities and cystic lucencies in the left lower lung are unchanged. Additionally, a small amount of linear opacities are seen in both lower lungs, unchanged, likely representing chronic changes.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结同前，约20*10mm（IM29）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes unchanged from prior, approximately 20x10 mm (IM29).

source_text: 左肺下叶索条影、两肺散在模糊小结节灶同前，较大仍约8x6mm（IM13）
text_en: Left lower lobe linear opacities and scattered indistinct small nodular opacities in both lungs unchanged from prior; largest still approximately 8x6 mm (IM13).

source_text: 左肺下叶微结节结节同前，仍约2mm、4mm（IM41、49），倾向良性
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous, still approximately 2 mm and 4 mm (IM41, 49), favors benign

source_text: 右肺中叶叶间胸膜下磨玻璃结节大致同前，约9x8mm（IM37），胸膜局部牵拉，余双肺未见新生结节或实变影
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the interlobar subpleural region of the right middle lobe is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 9x8 mm (IM37), with local pleural retraction. No new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后，支气管断端旁软组织影增厚加重，需密切观察或进一步检查以除外局部复发
text_en: Status post left lower lobectomy, soft tissue shadow adjacent to the bronchial stump thickening worsened, requiring close observation or further evaluation to exclude local recurrence.

source_text: 右肺索条影同前，双肺未见新增结节及实变影
text_en: Fibrotic band in the right lung is stable compared to prior; no new nodules or consolidations are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃样灶同前（Im11），肺内散在微小结节及浅淡模糊小片影同前（Im21、27、36等）
text_en: Left upper lobe ground-glass opacity focus unchanged from previous (image 11), scattered small nodules and faint hazy patchy shadows within the lung unchanged from previous (images 21, 27, 36, etc.).

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结同前，约14*11mm(IM25)
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are stable, measuring approximately 14x11 mm (IM25).

source_text: 双肺散发小结节大致同前，小于5mm
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged, all less than 5 mm.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结同前，约20x19mm（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are stable, measuring approximately 20x19 mm (IM21).

source_text: 左肺小结节同前（IM25、52）
text_en: Small nodules in the left lung unchanged from prior (IM25, 52).

source_text: 双肺小点状结节影同前（IM12、23、29）
text_en: Multiple small punctate nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged (IM12, 23, 29).

source_text: 右肺中叶微小结节同前，＜5mm（图40）
text_en: Right middle lobe tiny nodule unchanged from prior, <5 mm (Figure 40)

source_text: 部分结节较前增大，右下肺结节原约10x10mm者，现约12x12mm（Im42）
text_en: Some nodules are enlarged compared to previous; the right lower lobe nodule was approximately 10x10mm, now approximately 12x12mm (Im42).

source_text: 双肺散在少许索条影同前，未见新增结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: Scattered few linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged, no new nodules or patchy opacities seen.

source_text: 右下肺静脉旁淋巴结缩小，原约15x9mm（Im28），现约12x7mm（IM26），内见钙化
text_en: Lymph node adjacent to the right lower pulmonary vein has decreased in size, previously approximately 15x9 mm (Im28), now approximately 12x7 mm (IM26), with internal calcification.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段斜裂胸膜下高密度类结节大小同前，仍约11x10mm（IM19），边缘毛糙同前，其后方见点状钙化同前
text_en: Stable high-density nodule in left upper lobe apicoposterior segment, subpleural along oblique fissure, approximately 11x10 mm (IM19), irregular margins, posterior punctate calcification

source_text: 扫及左肾上腺结节同前，请结合腹部检查评价
text_en: A nodule in the left adrenal gland is unchanged from prior; correlation with abdominal imaging for evaluation is recommended.

source_text: 双侧锁骨上区散在小淋巴结同前，较大仍约16x6mm（IM4）
text_en: Scattered small lymph nodes in the bilateral supraclavicular regions are stable compared to prior; the largest remains approximately 16x6 mm (IM4).

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，肺内透亮度均匀，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. Lung lucency is uniform. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 肝内多发低密度灶、左侧肾上腺小结节，同前相仿，请结合腹部检查
text_en: Multiple low-density hepatic lesions and left adrenal small nodule similar to prior; please correlate with abdominal imaging.

source_text: 余双肺未见新发结节灶及斑片影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no new nodular foci or patchy opacities.

source_text: 左侧胸膜及叶间胸膜较前增厚，见多发结节，较厚处原约3mm（IM33），现约7mm（IM33）
text_en: The left pleura and interlobar pleura are thicker than prior, with multiple nodules present. The thickest portion was approximately 3 mm (IM33) previously and is now approximately 7 mm (IM33).

source_text: 双肺轻度间质纤维化同前，右肺中叶长索条影同前，余肺未见新发结节或斑片影
text_en: Mild interstitial fibrosis in both lungs is unchanged from prior; a long linear opacity in the right middle lobe is unchanged from prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 余两肺胸膜下散在小结节同前，较大约5mm（IM46）
text_en: Scattered small subpleural nodules in the remainder of both lungs are unchanged; the largest measures approximately 5 mm (IM46).

source_text: 右侧胸膜稍厚，叶间胸膜小结节同前（IM39），左肺下叶胸膜下新见微小结节，＜5mm（图44），建议追查
text_en: The right pleura is slightly thickened. The interlobar pleural nodule is unchanged from prior (IM39). A new tiny subpleural nodule is seen in the left lower lobe, measuring less than 5 mm (Figure 44); follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 胸10椎体骨质密度不均同前，余扫描所及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: Inhomogeneous bone density in T10 vertebra unchanged from prior; no bone destruction seen in other scanned bones.

source_text: 双肺致密索条、小结节及钙化灶同前，未见新增结节及斑片影
text_en: Dense linear opacities, small nodules, and calcified foci in both lungs are stable; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节影同前（IM40）
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged (Image 40)

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结同前（IM23)，平扫密度较高，左锁骨上小淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph node unchanged from prior (IM23), with higher density on non-contrast imaging; small left supraclavicular lymph node unchanged from prior

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，右肺中叶新见单发小结节，约12mm(图34)性质待定，建议追查
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Lung parenchymal lucency is uniform. A new solitary small nodule is seen in the right middle lobe, measuring approximately 12 mm (Figure 34), nature undetermined; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段混合磨玻璃结节灶同前，不除外恶性，密切追查
text_en: Left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment: mixed ground-glass nodule unchanged from prior examination; malignancy cannot be excluded. Close follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双肺多发索条状影较前相仿，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Multiple linear opacities in both lungs are similar to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，左肺上叶前段磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，约17x12mm（IM24），其内可见空泡征，内部未见明确实性密度
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. The ground-glass opacity nodule in the left upper lobe anterior segment is similar to prior, measuring approximately 17x12 mm (IM24), containing a bubble-like lucency. No definite solid component is seen within.

source_text: 右肺上叶多发结节同前，较大约17x12mm（IM12）
text_en: Multiple nodules in the right upper lobe are unchanged; the largest is approximately 17x12 mm (IM12).

source_text: 右肺上叶楔形切除术后，纵膈胸膜局限性增厚明显，右侧胸膜多发转移结节较前增大
text_en: Status post wedge resection of the right upper lobe; localized thickening of the mediastinal pleura is marked; multiple metastatic nodules in the right pleura are larger than prior.

source_text: 心包隐窝少量液性低密度同前相仿（IM24），纵隔及锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Small amount of fluid density in the pericardial recess, similar to prior (IM24). No enlarged lymph nodes in the mediastinum or supraclavicular region.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，局部未见复发征象
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, no evidence of local recurrence.

source_text: 左肺多个微结节同前，均小于5mm
text_en: Multiple micronodules in left lung unchanged from prior, all less than 5 mm.

source_text: 左全肺切除术后改变，支气管断端未见平扫软组织肿块影，左侧胸腔积液较前相仿，纵隔左移同前
text_en: Status post left pneumonectomy; no soft tissue mass is seen at the bronchial stump on non-contrast imaging; left pleural effusion is similar to prior; leftward mediastinal shift is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 余肺内未见新发结节结实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 两肺间质性病变同前，未见新生结节
text_en: Interstitial lung disease in both lungs is stable; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区小淋巴结较前略缩小，原约10x6mm（IM6），现约6x5mm（IM4）
text_en: Small lymph node in the left supraclavicular region is slightly decreased in size compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 10x6 mm (IM6), now approximately 6x5 mm (IM4).

source_text: 右侧胸膜结节状增厚同前，双侧胸腔未见积液征象
text_en: The nodular thickening of the right pleura is unchanged from prior. No pleural effusion is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 双肺下叶胸膜下不规则小结节部分同前，部分似略缩小（IM34、40、47）
text_en: Some irregular small subpleural nodules in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior, others appear slightly smaller (IM34, 40, 47).

source_text: 纵隔2R、4、7、8组及贲门周围、胃小弯侧见多发淋巴结较前缩小，原较大约8x7mm（IM57），现约4mm（IM56）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R, 4, 7, 8, and around the cardia and lesser curvature of the stomach are decreased in size compared to previous; the largest was previously approximately 8x7 mm (IM57), now approximately 4 mm (IM56)

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结钙化同前，平扫双侧锁骨上及纵隔内未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal lymph node calcification is unchanged from prior; on non-contrast scan, no enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the bilateral supraclavicular regions or mediastinum.

source_text: 纵隔2R、6及7组淋巴结较前稍增大，如2R者原约12x10mm，现约14x12mm（IM12），追查
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R, 6, and 7 are slightly enlarged compared to prior. For instance, the 2R node was approximately 12x10 mm, now approximately 14x12 mm (IM12). Follow-up recommended.

source_text: 平扫纵隔7组淋巴结大致同前，约11x6mm（IM26）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes approximately unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 11x6 mm on image 26.

source_text: 左肺上叶结节同前，定期复查
text_en: Left upper lobe nodule unchanged; follow-up as scheduled.

source_text: 右锁骨上扁平淋巴结同前，约10x5mm（IM1）
text_en: Right supraclavicular flattened lymph node unchanged, measuring approximately 10x5 mm (IM1)

source_text: 左肺浅淡小结节大小及密度大致同前（IM121、147），密切随访
text_en: Left lung small ground-glass opacity nodule size and density largely unchanged compared to prior (IM121, 147). Close follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右胸膜较前增厚，部分结节状改变（IM45），考虑转移，追查
text_en: Right pleura is thicker than prior, with some nodular changes (IM45); metastasis is considered, recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右肺上叶微小结节同前，随诊观察
text_en: Tiny nodules in the right upper lobe, unchanged from prior; recommend follow-up observation.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下散在实性微、小结节同前（IM42等）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural scattered solid tiny and small nodules unchanged (Images 42, etc.)

source_text: 右第8后肋高密度结节同前（IM35），余扫及胸廓诸骨未见明确破坏征象
text_en: Increased density nodule in the right 8th posterior rib unchanged (IM35); no definite destructive changes seen in the remainder of the visualized thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 纵隔4、5、7、8组及10R淋巴结同前，较大约12x9mm（IM31）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4, 5, 7, 8, and 10R are unchanged from previous, with the largest approximately 12x9 mm (Image 31).

source_text: 右肺小结节同前，观察
text_en: Right lung small nodule unchanged; observation recommended.

source_text: 气管隆突下低密度结节较前略缩小，现约20*10mm(图28)，原约20*15mm（IMA24）
text_en: Subcarinal low-density nodule slightly decreased in size compared to prior, now approximately 20x10 mm (Figure 28), previously approximately 20x15 mm (IMA24).

source_text: 纵隔7组及左侧锁骨上淋巴结同前，现仍约10x6mm(IM30）
text_en: Lymph nodes at mediastinal station 7 and left supraclavicular unchanged from prior, still approximately 10x6 mm (IM30).

source_text: 右侧第5、10肋高密度灶同前，右侧第4肋新发高密度灶，转移
text_en: High-density foci in the right 5th and 10th ribs are stable. A new high-density focus is seen in the right 4th rib, suggestive of metastasis.

source_text: 右肺上叶及双肺下叶斑点、长条形结节同前，较大仍约8x5mm（IM13）
text_en: Punctate and elongated nodules in the right upper lobe and both lower lobes are stable compared to prior; the largest remains approximately 8x5 mm (IM13).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段模糊微小结节同前，约3mm（Im19）
text_en: Indistinct micronodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment, unchanged, approximately 3 mm (Im19).

source_text: 右侧第2肋骨骨质破坏同前（IMA10）
text_en: Bony destruction in the right 2nd rib is stable (IMA10).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段胸膜下点状小结节同前（IM20）
text_en: A punctate small subpleural nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe, unchanged from previous (IM20).

source_text: 纵隔5、6组及10L可见多发肿大淋巴结较前缩小，较大现约15x9mm（IMA20），原约25*14mm(图19)
text_en: Multiple enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 5, 6, and 10L decreased in size compared to previous, largest now approximately 15x9 mm (IMA20), previously approximately 25x14 mm (Figure 19).

source_text: 左侧甲状腺低密度小结节影同前
text_en: A small low-density nodule is seen in the left thyroid, unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端软组织略增厚同前，未见异常占位
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; mild soft tissue thickening at the bronchial stump is unchanged. No abnormal mass is seen.

source_text: 双肺弥漫分布大量小结节较前明显减少、缩小、密度浅淡，均不足5mm
text_en: Diffusely distributed numerous small nodules in both lungs are markedly decreased in number, smaller in size, and less dense; all are under 5 mm.

source_text: 右上肺不规则磨玻璃密度病灶较前略增大，不除外恶性
text_en: Irregular ground-glass opacity in the right upper lung has slightly increased in size compared to prior; malignancy cannot be excluded.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，右肺尖小结节同前，左侧少量胸水较前减少
text_en: Left lower lobe postoperative, small nodule at the right lung apex is unchanged, small amount of left pleural effusion is reduced compared to previous.

source_text: 右肺未见新发结节灶及斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the right lung.

source_text: 左锁骨上、纵隔、左肺门多发淋巴结缩小，原较大约21x12mm，现较大约16*12mm（IM29）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region, mediastinum, and left hilar region have decreased in size, with the largest previously measuring approximately 21x12 mm and now approximately 16x12 mm (IM29).

source_text: 左下肺外基底段小结节灶同前，仍约3mm（Im49）
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe lateral basal segment is unchanged, still approximately 3 mm (Im49).

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结较前缩小，2R组较大者原约6x5mm（IM15），现小于5mm（IM15）
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes are smaller compared to prior; the largest in 2R group was approximately 6x5 mm (IM15) and is now less than 5 mm (IM15).

source_text: 左肺门处软组织肿物较前略大，大小原约38x34mm（IM29），现约40x38mm（IM29），左肺上叶远端沿支气管血管束见多发粟粒状小结节大致同前，远端见条片影增多
text_en: Soft tissue mass in the left hilar region slightly larger compared to prior, previously approximately 38x34 mm (IM29), now approximately 40x38 mm (IM29). Multiple miliary small nodules along the bronchovascular bundle in the distal left upper lobe are stable compared to prior; increased linear and patchy opacities distally

source_text: 左肺下叶软组织肿块较前呈不规则形态增大，现较大层面约2.7x1.8cm（Im46），原同层面约2.3x1.6cm
text_en: The soft tissue mass in the left lower lobe has irregularly increased in size compared to prior, currently measuring approximately 2.7x1.8 cm (Im46) versus previous measurement of 2.3x1.6 cm on the same slice.

source_text: 胸下段食管管壁增厚减轻，原最厚处约19mm，现较厚处约15mm（IM48），管腔狭窄
text_en: Esophageal wall thickening in lower thoracic segment reduced; previous maximum thickness approximately 19mm, current thickest approximately 15mm (IM48); luminal narrowing.

source_text: 左肺下叶4mm微小结节同前（IM34）
text_en: 4mm tiny nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (IM34).

source_text: 左肺新见微小结节，＜5mm（图25），建议追查
text_en: New tiny nodule in left lung, <5mm (Figure 25), recommend follow-up

source_text: 右肺胸膜下散在微小结节大致同前(图22、27、38等)
text_en: Scattered tiny subpleural nodules in the right lung are essentially unchanged from prior (Fig. 22, 27, 38, etc.).

source_text: 余右肺中叶及左肺下叶少许索条影同前，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the right middle lobe and left lower lobe are stable; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶见多发结节影同前，部分内含空泡，较大者约6mm（IM20），边缘模糊
text_en: Multiple nodular opacities are seen in the right upper lobe, unchanged, some containing air bronchograms; the largest measures approximately 6 mm (IM20), with blurred margins.

source_text: 双肺未见新发结节及片絮状影
text_en: No new nodules or flaky opacities seen in both lungs.
