source_text: 纵隔及双肺门淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions unchanged from previous, for follow-up

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结部分较前增大，转移不除外，建议追查
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes are enlarged compared to prior, metastasis cannot be excluded. Recommend further investigation.

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影同前，左下肺见小结节，约6mm（IM27)，转移
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged; a small nodule is seen in the left lower lobe, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM27), suspicious for metastasis.

source_text: 纵隔少许小淋巴结同前
text_en: A few small mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，约3mm（IM54），追查
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IM54), requires follow-up.

source_text: 右肺上叶点状结节影同前（IMA7）
text_en: Punctate nodular opacity in the right upper lobe unchanged (IMA7)

source_text: 右肺尖和双肺下叶散在多发小片样、小结节样磨玻璃密度影部分显示欠清，部分同前
text_en: Scattered multifocal patchy and nodular ground-glass opacities in the right lung apex and bilateral lower lobes are partially indistinct; some are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 双下肺散在微结节大致同前
text_en: Scattered micro-nodules in the bilateral lower lungs are largely unchanged.

source_text: 右肺索条影及小淡片影同前（IMA14），双肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lung and small faint patchy opacities are stable compared to prior study (IMA14); no new nodules or consolidations are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左侧胸膜结节样增厚同前
text_en: Left pleural nodular thickening is unchanged

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段不规则软组织肿块较前增大，边缘分叶，原约48x46mm，现约52x50mm（IM16），其上方多发小结节较前增大，较大现约13x10mm（IM13），原为9x8mm
text_en: Irregular soft tissue mass in the right upper lobe apical segment increased in size, with lobulated margins, previously approximately 48x46 mm, now approximately 52x50 mm (IM16); multiple small nodules above the mass also increased in size, the largest now approximately 13x10 mm (IM13), previously 9x8 mm

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节影大小同前相仿，仍约5mm（IM46），边界清楚
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe, size similar to before, still approximately 5mm (Image 46), with well-defined margins.

source_text: 纵隔散在淋巴结较前相仿，较大约11x9mm（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal scattered lymph nodes similar to previous, largest approximately 11x9 mm (IM21).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段胸膜下实性结节较前略增大，现约7mm（IM22），原约5mm（IM22），边缘见片影与胸膜粘连，性质待定，密切追查
text_en: Subpleural solid nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is slightly larger than prior, currently approximately 7 mm (IM22), previously approximately 5 mm (IM22); a patchy opacity at the margin is seen adherent to the pleura; etiology is indeterminate; close follow-up recommended

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜浅淡小结节同前，仍约5x3mm（IM31）
text_en: Faint small nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior, still measuring approximately 5x3 mm (IM31).

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下小结节同前，仍约5mm（IM35）,追查
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right middle lobe is stable, still approximately 5 mm (IM35), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右下肺叶间胸膜下结节较[DATE]片增大，原约5x4mm（IM35），现约10x7mm（IM34），恶性病变
text_en: The subpleural nodule in the right lower lobe is larger compared to the [DATE] study; previously approximately 5x4 mm (IM35), now approximately 10x7 mm (IM34), suggestive of a malignant lesion.

source_text: 累及长度原约46mm，现约40mm（矢状位IM42），外膜较前清晰，同胸主动脉脂肪间隙存在，近端食管无扩张
text_en: The involved length, previously approximately 46 mm, now approximately 40 mm (sagittal IM42). The adventitia is clearer than prior, with fat plane present between it and the thoracic aorta. No proximal esophageal dilation

source_text: 右肺上叶混合磨玻璃密度小结节同前仿，定期复查
text_en: Mixed ground-glass opacity small nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior; recommend regular follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约12x10mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest measuring approximately 12x10 mm (IM20).

source_text: 纵隔4R区低密度结节影同前（IMA13）
text_en: A low-density nodule in mediastinal station 4R is unchanged from prior (IMA13).

source_text: 右肺磨玻璃密度小结节同前
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lung is unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺多发小结节增多增大，如原较大者约10x7mm（IM26），现约15x14mm（IM29），考虑转移进展，追查
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs have increased in number and size. For example, the previously larger nodule measuring approximately 10x7 mm (IM26) now measures approximately 15x14 mm (IM29). Metastatic progression is considered; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺水平裂可见小结节影较前相仿，大小仍约5mm（IM32），另一结节较扁平同前（SE402，IM27），左肺下叶少量长条索影较前相仿，右肺下叶胸膜下少量模糊条片影，局部胸膜稍增厚
text_en: Small nodular opacity along the horizontal fissure of the right lung is similar to prior, remaining approximately 5 mm in size (IM32); another nodule remains flattened as before (SE402, IM27). Minimal linear opacities in the left lower lobe are unchanged. A small indistinct linear opacity is seen subpleurally in the right lower lobe, with mild local pleural thickening.

source_text: 右肺小结节及索条影同前（IM31、42、48）
text_en: Small nodules and linear opacities in the right lung are stable compared to prior (IM31, 42, 48).

source_text: 左上肺微结节同前，左下肺磨玻璃密度结节大小、形态同前，密度略增高
text_en: The small nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged; the ground-glass opacity nodule in the left lower lobe is stable in size and morphology, with slightly increased density.

source_text: 右肺门（IM28）、纵隔内多发小淋巴结影同前相仿，仍小于10mm
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the right hilum (IM28) and mediastinum remain similar to prior, still less than 10 mm in size.

source_text: 双肺胸膜下散在小结节同前，如较大者仍约7x5mm（IM49）
text_en: Scattered subpleural small nodules in both lungs are stable, the largest still measuring approximately 7x5 mm (IM49).

source_text: 两肺少许点状结节影同前
text_en: The punctate nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶贴斜裂胸膜处浅淡结节同前，约5x3mm（IMA45）
text_en: Faint nodule adjacent to the oblique fissure pleura in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 5 x 3 mm (IMA45).

source_text: 平扫纵隔未见明显增大淋巴结，右气管食管沟淋巴结同前，大小约9*4mm（IM10）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows no significantly enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes. The lymph node in the right tracheoesophageal groove remains stable, measuring approximately 9x4 mm (IM10).

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段胸膜下见类圆形磨玻璃密度结节，较前未见明显变化，约9mm（Im50）
text_en: A round or oval ground-glass opacity subpleural nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe shows no significant change compared to previous, approximately 9 mm (Im50).

source_text: 扫及甲状腺右叶增大并低密度结节影同前
text_en: Imaging shows enlargement of the right lobe of the thyroid with a low-density nodule, unchanged.

source_text: 余双肺多发结节大致同前，多数边缘模糊、形态不规则
text_en: Residual multiple nodules in both lungs are approximately unchanged; most remain ill-defined with irregular morphology

source_text: 前纵隔内结节较前相仿，较大仍约8mm（IM24）
text_en: Nodule within the anterior mediastinum is similar to prior, the largest still approximately 8 mm (IM24).

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影同前，余双肺未见新发结节或斑片影
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged; the remainder of both lungs shows no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 左肺多发小结节同前，较大约5mm（IM13）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left lung unchanged from prior, the largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM13)

source_text: 余双肺数枚小结节同前，较大者约4mm（Im39）
text_en: Residual several small nodules in both lungs are unchanged; the largest measures approximately 4 mm (Im39)

source_text: 左肺下叶癌较前增大
text_en: Left lower lobe lung cancer is enlarged compared to previous.

source_text: 右下肺静脉旁淋巴结同前，约15x9mm（Im28）
text_en: Lymph node adjacent to the right lower pulmonary vein is unchanged, measuring approximately 15x9 mm (Im28).

source_text: 两肺多发小结节多大致同前，个别略大（IM35），追查
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are mostly unchanged; one or two are slightly larger (IM35); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下陈旧微小点灶同前（Im14，28），左肺下叶背段微小高密度结节同前（Im26）
text_en: The old tiny punctate foci subpleural in the right lung are stable compared to prior (Im14, 28); the tiny hyperdense nodule in the posterior segment of the left lower lobe remains unchanged (Im26).

source_text: 纵隔4组多发小淋巴结大致同前，现约15*12mm(图26)，原约18*10mm(图25)
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in mediastinal station 4 are stable compared to prior, currently approximately 15 x 12 mm (Fig. 26), previously approximately 18 x 10 mm (Fig. 25)

source_text: 左肺及叶间胸膜多发小结节同前，现仍约4-5mm（Im26、30）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left lung and interlobar pleura unchanged, still approximately 4-5 mm in size (Im26, 30).

source_text: 左锁骨上小淋巴结同前（IM5）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in left supraclavicular region unchanged from previous (IM5).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，右侧胸腔积液较前明显减少，胸部CT未见新发占位征象
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; right pleural effusion has significantly decreased compared to prior. Chest CT shows no new mass-like lesions.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段及左肺舌段小结节，较前未见明显变化，建议随诊
text_en: Small nodules in the basal segment of the right lower lobe and the lingular segment of the left lung, unchanged compared to prior examination; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段磨玻璃密度结节较前增大，原约8x4mm（IM18），现约8x6mm（IM18），内新见实性成分，其上方不规则结节较前相仿，约15x8mm(IM16)
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe increased in size, previously approximately 8x4 mm (IM18), now approximately 8x6 mm (IM18), with new solid component within; irregular nodule above it, similar to prior, approximately 15x8 mm (IM16)

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段实变影吸收减少，小结节影大致同前
text_en: Consolidation in the outer basal segment of the right lower lobe has decreased in extent with absorption; small nodular opacities are largely unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔4R、6组淋巴结同前，平扫密度稍高，较大约12x10mm（IM23），考虑良性
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R and 6 are similar to prior, with slightly higher density on non-contrast scan, the largest approximately 12x10mm (IM23), considered benign.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，约4mm（IM49）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, approximately 4 mm (IM49).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变，两肺浅淡点状结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lobe; faint punctate nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged; follow-up recommended

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃结节灶较前相仿，约16x14mm（IM24）
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the right lower lobe dorsal segment is similar to prior, approximately 16x14 mm (IM24).

source_text: 双腋窝淋巴结大致同前相仿，较大者仍约10mm（IM13）
text_en: Lymph nodes in bilateral axillae are roughly similar to prior; the largest remains approximately 10 mm (IM13).

source_text: 纵隔2-7组及双腋区数枚淋巴结同前，较大仍约16*5mm(图33)
text_en: Mediastinal stations 2-7 and bilateral axillary several lymph nodes are unchanged from previous; the larger one is still approximately 16x5mm (Figure 33).

source_text: 余双肺散在小结节同前相仿，较大仍约5mm（IMA42）
text_en: Residual scattered small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior; the largest remains approximately 5 mm (IMA42)

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段胸膜下索条结节灶同前
text_en: The subpleural linear and nodular opacity in the lateral basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 新发磨玻璃结节
text_en: Newly developed ground-glass nodules

source_text: 左肺术后改变，胸部CT未见新增占位征象
text_en: Left lung postoperative change, chest CT shows no newly added signs of space-occupying lesion.

source_text: 两肺未见新增结节及实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidations are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺舌叶多发小结节部分较前饱满，原约4mm（IM39），现约5mm（IM41）
text_en: Some of the multiple small nodules in the lingula of the left lung are more prominent than before, previously approximately 4 mm (IM39), now approximately 5 mm (IM41)

source_text: 左肺点状微小结节灶同前（Im50）
text_en: Left lung punctate tiny nodules unchanged (Im50).

source_text: 右肺上叶模糊结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: The ill-defined nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, likely benign.

source_text: 纵隔4L组淋巴结同前，仍约11x8mm（IM16）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4L lymph nodes unchanged, approximately 11x8 mm (IM16)

source_text: 左上纵隔脂肪间隙多个淋巴结较前明显增大，有融合趋势，较大现约23x20mm（IM16），原为9mm（Im22）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the fat space of the left upper mediastinum are significantly larger than before with a tendency toward coalescence; the largest is now approximately 23 x 20 mm (IM16), previously 9 mm (Im22).

source_text: 双肺浅淡密度小结节同前（IM29、46、47、54）
text_en: Faint density small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM29, 46, 47, 54).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段结节同前相仿（IM19），约9x7mm，复查
text_en: Nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, similar to prior, still approximately 9x7 mm (IM19), follow-up

source_text: 两肺索条影、左肺小结节影同前，约3mm（IM42）
text_en: The linear opacities and the small nodules in the left lung are unchanged, about 3 mm (IM42).

source_text: 右肺下叶前基底段类圆形结节同前相仿，大小10x8mm，边缘模糊，有可能为低度侵袭性的肺癌
text_en: The rounded nodule in the anterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is similar to prior, measuring 10 x 8 mm with indistinct margins; low-grade invasive lung cancer is possible.

source_text: 余肺未见明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: The remainder of the lungs shows no obvious new nodules or consolidation.

source_text: 纵隔及左肺门多发肿大淋巴结较前增大，部分层面融合，大者原约36x25mm（IM38），现约50x33mm（IM37）
text_en: Multiple enlarged mediastinal and left hilar lymph nodes increased in size compared to previous, with fusion at some levels; largest previously approximately 36x25 mm (IM38), now approximately 50x33 mm (IM37)

source_text: 右侧水平裂胸膜结节同前，约5x4mm（IM37）
text_en: Pleural nodule along the right horizontal fissure is stable, measuring approximately 5x4 mm (IM37).

source_text: 右肺下叶斜裂旁小结节及右肺中叶小结节同前（Im31、34、43）
text_en: Small nodules adjacent to the oblique fissure of the right lower lobe and in the right middle lobe are stable compared to prior (Im31, 34, 43).

source_text: 双肺多发小结节较前增大，如右肺下叶较大原约6mm（IM28），现约9mm（IM27）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs have increased in size; for example, a larger nodule in the right lower lobe was previously about 6 mm (IM28), now about 9 mm (IM27).

source_text: 右肺叶间胸膜不规则增厚，左肺内钙化索条同前，右肺小结节大致同前
text_en: Irregular thickening of the interlobar pleura is seen in the right lung; calcified linear strands in the left lung are stable compared to prior; small nodules in the right lung are roughly unchanged.

source_text: 右肺结节同前，仍约21x13mm（IM35）
text_en: Right lung nodule unchanged, still measuring approximately 21 x 13 mm (IM35).

source_text: 右肺及叶间胸膜结节大致同前
text_en: The nodules in the right lung and interlobar pleura are essentially unchanged.

source_text: 扫及胸椎多发转移同前，部分椎体缘骨质塌陷同前
text_en: Multiple metastases in the thoracic vertebrae unchanged from prior, partial vertebral body margin collapse unchanged from prior.

source_text: 新见斑点及结节
text_en: Newly seen spots and nodules

source_text: 纵隔5组可见淋巴结，大小约13×9mm（Im18），较前未见明显变化
text_en: Mediastinal station 5 lymph nodes visible, size approximately 13x9 mm (Im18), no significant change compared to previous.

source_text: 肺气肿同前，肺内散在数枚小结节同前（Im32等），未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: Emphysema unchanged; scattered small nodules in the lung unchanged (Im32, etc.); no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 纵隔内散在小淋巴结同前相仿，如2R组现仍约8mm（IM14）
text_en: Scattered mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, such as station 2R still approximately 8 mm (IM14).

source_text: 双肺多发结节较前增大，原较大约18mm（Im38），现约34x12mm（IM39）
text_en: Multiple nodules in both lungs have increased in size; the largest was previously about 18 mm (IM38), now measures approximately 34x12 mm (IM39).

source_text: 左下叶磨玻璃密度结节同前，约6mm(IM36)
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged, approximately 6 mm (IM36).

source_text: 右侧胸膜增厚加重、左侧叶间胸膜增厚，考虑胸膜转移可能大
text_en: Right pleural thickening has worsened; left interlobar pleural thickening is seen. Pleural metastasis is highly likely.

source_text: 右肺下叶前基底段磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，约为13x12mm（Im45）
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the anterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 13 x 12 mm (Im45).

source_text: 双肺未见新发占位
text_en: No new space-occupying lesions seen in both lungs.

source_text: 余双肺未新增结节影
text_en: No new nodules are seen in both lungs

source_text: 右肺上叶及两下肺点状模糊微小结节灶同前（IM16、37），较大者约3mm
text_en: Punctate, ill-defined micro-nodules in the right upper lobe and both lower lungs remain unchanged (IM16, 37); the largest is approximately 3 mm.

source_text: 右肺上叶实性小结节同前，1年1次CT随诊
text_en: Small solid nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior; annual CT follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段软组织密度肿块影较前略增大，原约27x21mm（IMA40），现约29x24mm（Im40）
text_en: Soft-tissue density mass in the basal segment of the right lower lobe is slightly larger than prior. Previously measured approximately 27 x 21 mm (IMA40), now approximately 29 x 24 mm (Im40).

source_text: 右下胸膜轻度增厚并肺内索条影同前，右肺中叶结节灶同前（IM22）
text_en: Mild pleural thickening in the right lower region with intrapulmonary linear opacities unchanged. Nodular opacity in the right middle lobe unchanged (IM22).

source_text: 右下胸膜轻度增厚并肺内索条影同前，右肺中叶微小结节结节同前（IM22）
text_en: Mild pleural thickening in the right lower region with intrapulmonary linear opacities unchanged. Tiny nodule in the right middle lobe unchanged (IM22).

source_text: 双侧腋窝及纵隔内小淋巴结同前，均小于10mm
text_en: Small lymph nodes in bilateral axillae and mediastinum are unchanged, all less than 10 mm.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段见一磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，仍约12mm（Im23），密度不均，边界略模糊同前，粘连斜裂胸膜
text_en: A ground-glass opacity nodule is seen in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe, similar to prior, still approximately 12 mm (Im23), with heterogeneous density and slightly blurred margins as before, adherent to the oblique fissure pleura.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段病灶，范围同前，密度减淡
text_en: Lesion in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged in size, with decreased density.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，支气管断端旁结节影较前增大，考虑复发，请结合临床明确
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, nodule adjacent to bronchial stump increased in size compared to prior; recurrence considered; correlate clinically for confirmation.

source_text: 纵隔及左锁骨上多发小淋巴结较前相仿
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and left supraclavicular region similar to previous.

source_text: 纵隔2-7组淋巴结同前，较大约18*11mm（IM26）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal groups 2-7 unchanged from prior, largest approximately 18x11mm (IM26).

source_text: 纵隔及双肺门、扫及腹腔多发淋巴结同前，较大约21x21mm（IM59）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, and abdomen unchanged from previous, largest approximately 21x21 mm (IM59)

source_text: 纵隔内淋巴结大致同前，较大者短径约9mm（Im31）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes approximately unchanged from previous, largest with short axis approximately 9 mm (Im31).

source_text: 上纵隔多发淋巴结较前明显增大，例如4R组淋巴结短径现约1.8cm（Im24），原不足1cm
text_en: Multiple enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes in the upper mediastinum significantly increased in size compared to prior; for example, the short axis of the 4R group lymph node is now approximately 1.8 cm (Im24), previously less than 1 cm

source_text: 右叶间胸膜结节状增厚较前加重形成结节（例如Im26）
text_en: Nodular thickening of the right interlobar pleura has worsened compared to prior imaging, forming a nodule (e.g., Im26).

source_text: 右肺上叶、右肺中叶和双肺下叶胸膜下多发结节大致同前（IM12、17，30，41），较大现仍约5mm
text_en: Multiple subpleural nodules in the right upper lobe, right middle lobe, and bilateral lower lobes are essentially unchanged (IM12, 17, 30, 41), with the largest currently still approximately 5 mm.

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下微小结节影同前，约3mm（IM30）
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM30).

source_text: 右肺尖高密度小结节及斑片索条影同前（IM13、19），右下肺见索条影同前，余肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: High-density small nodule and patchy linear opacities in the right lung apex are unchanged from prior (IM13, 19). Linear opacities in the right lower lung are unchanged. The remainder of the lungs show no nodules or consolidation.

source_text: 右肺下叶点状钙化灶同前（IM32），余双肺未见新生结节斑片影
text_en: The punctate calcified focus in the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM32); otherwise, no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 左肺上叶病灶较前明显增大，实性较前增多，原大小约24x23mm，现约41*31mm（IM21），内部空洞增大同前，上叶支气管腔变细，考虑恶性
text_en: Left upper lobe lesion has significantly increased in size compared to previous, with increased solid component; previous size approximately 24x23mm, now approximately 41x31mm (IM21); internal cavity has increased similarly as before; bronchial lumen of the upper lobe is narrowed, suggestive of malignancy.

source_text: 左肺胸膜下散在小结节同前，3-5mm
text_en: Left lung subpleural scattered small nodules unchanged, 3-5 mm

source_text: 右侧第11后肋骨转移范围增大，左侧第5后肋骨折后遗改变
text_en: Range of metastasis in the right 11th posterior rib has increased. Left 5th posterior rib shows post-fracture changes.

source_text: 右肺下叶后肋膈角模糊结节样病灶同前，约9x6mm（IM91）
text_en: The ill-defined nodular lesion in the posterior costophrenic angle of the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 9 x 6 mm (IM91).

source_text: 双肺多发小结节及纵隔结节大致同前，随诊观察
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs and mediastinal nodules are essentially unchanged; follow-up observation recommended.

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下见模糊小结节同前，仍约4x3mm（IM28）
text_en: A faint subpleural small nodule is seen in the right middle lobe, unchanged from prior, still approximately 4x3 mm (IM28).

source_text: 胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏，右肩胛骨小低密度灶同前
text_en: No bone destruction seen in the thoracic skeleton; small low-density focus in the right scapula unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端处未见异常强化灶，右肺散在索条影较前减少，上叶见模糊类结节灶（IM28、33），左肺下叶基底段胸膜下见模糊类结节灶（IM40）
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no abnormal enhancing focus is seen at the bronchial stump. Scattered linear opacities in the right lung have decreased compared to prior. A hazy, nodular-appearing opacity is seen in the upper lobe (IM28, 33). A hazy, nodular-appearing opacity is seen subpleurally in the basal segment of the left lower lobe (IM40).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度小结节同前，约8mm（Im23），边界清楚
text_en: Small ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 8 mm (Im23), with well-defined margins.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺右叶结节同前
text_en: Imaging shows a nodule in the right lobe of the thyroid, unchanged.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，索条影同前，未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Bilateral lung markings are unremarkable in course, and pulmonary lucency is uniform. The linear opacity is stable. No new nodules or consolidations are seen.

source_text: 纵隔及左肺门可见多发肿大淋巴结，7组淋巴结较前缩小，现约28x14mm（IM29），原约33x16mm(IM28)
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes are visible in the mediastinum and left hilum, with station 7 lymph nodes reduced compared to prior, now measuring approximately 28x14 mm (IM29) compared to previously approximately 33x16 mm (IM28).

source_text: 双肺微小结节及点状钙化同前
text_en: Tiny nodules and punctate calcifications in both lungs are stable.

source_text: 右肺上叶高密度钙化灶同前，双肺散在微小结节同前（IM29、33），双肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: The high-density calcified focus in the right upper lobe is unchanged. Scattered tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM29, 33). No new nodules are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上淋巴结同前，＜5mm
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node unchanged, <5 mm

source_text: 左侧第6肋骨结节样高密度同前（Im44）
text_en: Nodular hyperdensity in the left sixth rib, unchanged from prior (Im44).

source_text: 纵膈2、4、5、7、10组淋巴结区域脂肪密度增高，转移
text_en: Increased fat density in mediastinal stations 2, 4, 5, 7, and 10 lymph node regions, suggestive of metastasis

source_text: 气管右侧壁较前增厚，原厚约8mm（IM16），现约12mm（IM17），建议进一步检查除外复发
text_en: Right tracheal wall thickening compared to previous, previously approximately 8 mm thick (IM16), now approximately 12 mm thick (IM17), recommendation for further examination to rule out recurrence.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，右肺上叶背段稍高密度结节较前略增大，现约16*13mm(图20)，原约16x11mm（IM21）

source_text: 双肺小结节同前，随诊观察
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are stable compared to prior, follow-up observation recommended

source_text: 右肺中叶心缘旁见模糊结节，约4mm（IM33），余双肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Indistinct nodule adjacent to the cardiac border in the right middle lobe is present, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM33); no new nodules or areas of consolidation are seen in the remainder of both lungs

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，左肺下叶背段不规则磨玻璃密度结节大小同前，仍约15x9mm（IMA31），边缘毛糙，内见小血管穿行，未见明显实性成分
text_en: Bilateral lung markings are unremarkable in course, and pulmonary lucency is uniform. An irregular ground-glass density nodule in the left lower lobe near the pleura remains stable, still measuring approximately 15x9 mm (IMA31), with irregular margins and a small vessel traversing through it. No obvious solid component is seen.

source_text: 左肺索条影及右肺中叶小结节灶同前（IM32）
text_en: Left lung linear opacities and right middle lobe small nodule unchanged from prior (IM32)

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前饱满，需密切观察除外转移
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are more prominent compared to previous; close observation is needed to exclude metastasis.

source_text: 右肺下叶膈上小结节同前，现约9mm（Im50）
text_en: Small nodule above the diaphragm in the right lower lobe is stable, now approximately 9 mm (Im50).

source_text: 左侧肾上腺结节同前相仿（IM56）
text_en: Nodule in the left adrenal gland is similar to prior (IM56).

source_text: 双腋下多发淋巴结同前相仿，较大约13x8mm（IM18）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes at both axillae are similar to prior, the largest measuring approximately 13x8 mm (IM18).

source_text: 左肺下叶结节范围大致同前，实性成分稍减少
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is stable in size, with a slight decrease in solid component.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则结节、左肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节影同前
text_en: The irregular nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe and the ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺胸膜/叶间胸膜下微结节同前（IM21、25）
text_en: The subpleural and interlobar pleural micronodules in the right lung are stable (IM21, 25).

source_text: 右肺胸膜下多个微结节影同前（IM15、18），约2-4mm，观察
text_en: Multiple tiny nodular opacities in the right lung subpleural region are unchanged (IM15, 18), measuring approximately 2–4 mm; recommend observation.

source_text: 右下肺门肿大淋巴结较前增大，原约15mm（IM32），现约20x14mm（IM34）
text_en: Enlarged lymph node in the right lower lobe hilum has increased in size compared to prior examination, previously approximately 15 mm (IM32), now approximately 20x14 mm (IM34).

source_text: 纵隔5组淋巴结同前，较大仍约15x10mm（IM28）
text_en: Mediastinal group 5 lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest still approximately 15x10 mm (Image 28)

source_text: 右肺上叶前段结节同前
text_en: Nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable

source_text: 胸11椎体高密度小结节同前，其内可疑栅栏状改变同前，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: High-density small nodule in T11 vertebra unchanged from prior, with suspicious fence-like change within unchanged; no bone destruction seen in other scanned bones.

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影较前增多，左上肺钙化灶同前，余肺内未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lower lobe has increased compared to prior; calcified focus in the left upper lobe is unchanged; no new nodules or consolidative opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 双肺间质纤维化、双肺小结节同前
text_en: Pulmonary interstitial fibrosis and scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 扫及右肾上腺见一低密度结节同前，约18x13mm（IMA59），仍密度较低，腺瘤可能
text_en: On scan, right adrenal gland shows a low-density nodule unchanged from prior, approximately 18x13 mm (IMA59), still low density, possible adenoma

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前相仿，双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior; no enlarged lymph nodes seen in bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular areas, or bilateral axillary regions

source_text: 未见骨质破坏及转移
text_en: No osseous destruction or metastases seen

source_text: 余未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation are seen.

source_text: 左肺上叶小陈旧灶同前（Im17），双肺未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: Left upper lobe small old lesion unchanged (Im17), no new nodules or patchy opacities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 余双肺透亮度均匀，未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Lung parenchyma in both lungs shows uniform lucency; no new nodules or consolidation are seen.

source_text: 前纵隔脂肪密度弥漫增高呈软组织密度同前，未见结节或肿块
text_en: Diffusely increased fat density in the anterior mediastinum, appearing as soft tissue density, is unchanged from prior. No nodules or masses are seen.

source_text: 胸10椎体许莫氏结节同前
text_en: T10 vertebral Schmorl's node unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶点状结节同前(28图)
text_en: The punctate nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged (Figure 28).

source_text: R淋巴结同前，约10x9mm（IM27）
text_en: R lymph node is unchanged, measuring about 10x9 mm (IM27).

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门多发淋巴结，大致同前，追查
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right hilum are approximately stable compared to prior, requiring follow-up.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段小结节大小同前，仍约5mm（IM18）
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment small nodule size unchanged from previous, still approximately 5 mm (IM18).

source_text: 扫及腰1椎体骨质破坏，余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: CT shows bone destruction in the L1 vertebral body; no bone destruction is seen in the other thoracic bones.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4、7、10R组淋巴结同前相仿，较大约14x10mm（IM23)
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R, 4, 7, and 10R are similar to previous, with the largest measuring approximately 14x10 mm (IM23).

source_text: 纵隔4组淋巴结较前略缩小
text_en: Mediastinal group 4 lymph nodes slightly smaller compared to before

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段软组织密度小结节同前，仍约14x13mm（IMA18），轻度强化，仍可见分叶及胸膜凹陷
text_en: A small soft-tissue density nodule in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe is unchanged from prior, still approximately 14x13 mm (IMA18), with mild enhancement, and lobulation and pleural indentation still visible

source_text: 右肺上叶新见微小结节，＜5mm（图13），建议追查
text_en: Newly seen tiny nodule in the right upper lobe, less than 5 mm (Figure 13); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃样结节大小同前，仍约21*18mm(图20)，密度浅淡，其内见血管穿行，未见实性密度
text_en: Left upper lobe ground-glass nodule size unchanged, still approximately 21x18 mm (Fig. 20), low density, with vascular passage through it, no solid component seen

source_text: 右肺上叶、右肺中叶及双肺下叶胸膜下多发结节大致同前（IM13、18、31、42），较大现仍约5mm（IM42）
text_en: Multiple subpleural nodules in the right upper lobe, right middle lobe, and bilateral lower lobes are essentially unchanged (IM13, 18, 31, 42), with the largest currently still approximately 5 mm (IM42).

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则肿物较前缩小，呈低强化，现约49x41mm（IMA10），原约76*69mm(图12)
text_en: The irregular mass in the left upper lobe has decreased in size and shows low enhancement, from approximately 76x69 mm (Figure 12) to approximately 49x41 mm (IMA10).

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜旁见小结节同前，约3mm（IM42）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural small nodule unchanged, approximately 3mm (IM42)

source_text: 两肺微小结节灶同前，约3mm（IM18、24、31）
text_en: The tiny nodular foci in both lungs are unchanged, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM18, 24, 31).

source_text: 右肺叶斜裂胸膜小结节同前，约3mm（IM38）
text_en: A small nodular lesion is seen along the oblique fissure pleura of the right lung, stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM38).

source_text: 左肺上叶结节，较前增大，倾向周围型肺癌
text_en: Nodule in the left upper lobe increased in size compared to previous, suggestive of peripheral lung cancer.

source_text: 右肺下叶浅淡小结节同前（Im31），余肺未见新生结节
text_en: The faint small nodule in the right lower lobe is stable (IM31); no new pulmonary nodules are seen elsewhere.

source_text: 纵隔、右锁骨上淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal and right supraclavicular lymph nodes unchanged from previous

source_text: 左肺门及纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，短径小于5mm
text_en: Multiple left hilar and mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, short axis less than 5mm.

source_text: 右肺下叶结节较前增大
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is larger compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段术后改变，左肺下叶基底段结节影同前，术后改变可能，复查
text_en: Postoperative change in the left lower lobe dorsal segment; nodular opacity in the left lower lobe basal segment unchanged from previous, possibly postoperative change, with recommendation for follow-up.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，支气管残端未见明确新发肿块
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, no definite new mass is seen at the bronchial stump.

source_text: 余所及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: No osseous destruction foci are seen in the bones evaluated.

source_text: 甲状腺左叶可见低密度结节同前，大小约18*11mm（IMA3），边缘可见点状钙化
text_en: Thyroid left lobe shows low-density nodule same as prior, size approximately 18x11 mm (IMA3), with punctate calcification at the margin.

source_text: 纵隔多个淋巴结显示较前相仿，较大仍约12x10mm（IM21）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes comparable to previous, the largest still approximately 12x10 mm (IM21)

source_text: 两肺索条结节及胸膜下小结节灶大致同前
text_en: Linear opacities and subpleural small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶和左肺下叶舌段微结节同前，小于3mm（IM18、28）
text_en: Micro-nodules in the right upper lobe and lingular segment of the left lower lobe are stable, less than 3 mm (IM18, 28)

source_text: 余肺少许索条影同前，未见新发斑片及结节
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the remaining lung are stable. No new patchy opacities or nodules are seen.

source_text: 纵膈4L淋巴结增大，双侧锁骨上新见肿大淋巴结，考虑转移可能大
text_en: Enlarged mediastinal station 4L lymph node, with newly enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes bilaterally; metastasis is highly suspected

source_text: 左肺下叶支气管狭窄，管壁周围见不规则软组织病灶较前缩小，增强扫描不均匀强化，与左肺门肿大淋巴结及远端肺不张分界欠清，平扫测量不准确，原约60x54mm（IM33），现约40x23mm（IM31），左肺下叶整体实变不张较前减轻，肿块累及左肺上叶舌段支气管较前减轻，远端多发索条及模糊结节影明显减少
text_en: Bronchial stenosis in the left lower lobe, with an irregular soft tissue lesion surrounding the wall that has decreased in size compared to prior, showing heterogeneous enhancement on contrast-enhanced scan and poorly demarcated from enlarged lymph nodes in the left hilum and distal atelectasis. Measurement on non-contrast scan is inaccurate; previously approximately 60x54 mm (IM33), now approximately 40x23 mm (IM31). Overall consolidation and atelectasis in the left lower lobe have improved compared to prior. Involvement of the mass in the bronchus of the lingula of the left upper lobe has decreased compared to prior, with significant reduction in distal multiple linear strands and hazy nodular shadows.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段胸膜下小结节同前，约为5mm（IM14）
text_en: A subpleural small nodule in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM14).

source_text: 右侧水平裂叶间胸膜小结节同前
text_en: Small pleural nodule along the right horizontal fissure is stable.

source_text: 纵膈侧胸膜不规则增厚较前明显，现较厚约33mm(图30)，原约14mm(图34)
text_en: Irregular pleural thickening on the mediastinal side significantly increased compared to previous, now approximately 33 mm thick (Figure 30), previously approximately 14 mm (Figure 34).

source_text: 右肺多发结节大致同前
text_en: Multiple nodules in the right lung are essentially unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 胸8椎体结节样密度增高同前
text_en: Sclerotic nodule in T8 vertebra, unchanged from previous.

source_text: 左肺野未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities in the left lung field.

source_text: 纵膈2R组新发肿大淋巴结，约15x10mm（IM10）
text_en: Newly enlarged mediastinal station 2R lymph node, approximately 15x10 mm (IM10)

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结清扫术后，纵隔内未见肿大淋巴结，原约11x7mm(IM24)者现约3mm（IM23）
text_en: Following mediastinal lymph node dissection, no enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes are seen. The lymph node previously measuring approximately 11x7 mm (IM24) now measures approximately 3 mm (IM23).

source_text: 右肺新增多发小结节，倾向转移
text_en: Newly observed multiple small nodules in the right lung; favor metastasis.

source_text: 左腋下小淋巴结同前，随诊观察
text_en: Left axillary small lymph nodes unchanged, follow-up observation.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，胸部CT平扫未见复发、转移征象
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, non-contrast chest CT shows no evidence of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 左肺斑片影较前略增大，现约31*15mm(图23)，原约31*10mm(图24），建议追查
text_en: Patchy opacity in the left lung slightly increased compared to previous, currently approximately 31x15 mm (Image 23), previously approximately 31x10 mm (Image 24). Recommend follow-up.

source_text: 胸部CT平扫未见新发占位征象
text_en: Chest CT scan shows no new mass lesion findings.

source_text: 左肺下叶不规则结节小片灶呈片絮状，范围大致同前（IM42）
text_en: Irregular small patchy lesion in the left lower lobe with patchy appearance, extent similar to prior (IM42).

source_text: 双肺上叶术后表现同前，胸部CT平扫未见新生占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the upper lobes of both lungs are stable compared to prior; no new space-occupying lesions are seen on non-contrast chest CT.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段、下叶后基底段类圆形稍高密度结节灶同前，仍约2-3mm（IM24、47）
text_en: Round, slightly hyperdense nodules in the right upper lobe posterior segment and right lower lobe posterior basal segment are stable compared to prior, remaining approximately 2–3 mm (IM24, 47).

source_text: 食道中下段癌较前略好转
text_en: Cancer in the mid-lower esophagus slightly improved compared to previous.

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结显示同前，约15x9mm（IM24），双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal 4R lymph node unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 15x9 mm (IM24); no enlarged lymph nodes in bilateral hilar, supraclavicular, or bilateral axillary regions

source_text: 扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征
text_en: No signs of bone destruction seen in the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 右腋下数枚淋巴结大致同前，较大者约18x11mm（Im19）
text_en: Several right axillary lymph nodes are essentially unchanged compared to prior, the largest measuring approximately 18x11 mm (Im19)

source_text: 双肺胸膜下散在小结节同前，如较大者仍约7x5mm（IM47）
text_en: Scattered subpleural small nodules in both lungs are stable, the largest still measuring approximately 7x5 mm (IM47).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，4R组短径仍约8mm（IM22），内部仍见钙化
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior, 4R station short axis diameter still approximately 8 mm (IM22), with persistent internal calcification

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后，平扫支气管断端未见明显软组织密度肿块影，远端斑片索条影较前相仿
text_en: Status post left lower lobectomy, non-contrast CT shows no obvious soft tissue density mass at the bronchial stump, with distal patchy linear opacities similar to previous.

source_text: 两肺上叶小结节影同前（Im10、17、21、33）
text_en: Small nodular opacities in both upper lobes are unchanged from prior (Im10, 17, 21, 33).

source_text: 左肺下叶占位较前略缩小
text_en: Mass in the left lower lobe slightly decreased in size compared to previous

source_text: 原双肺散在微小结节灶同前，左肺下叶新见小结节，性质待定，追查
text_en: Previously noted scattered micronodules in both lungs are unchanged. A new small nodule is seen in the left lower lobe, nature indeterminate; further investigation recommended.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺左叶内小结节样低密度影同前，约6mm（IM5）
text_en: A small low-density nodule in the left thyroid lobe is unchanged from prior, approximately 6 mm (IM5).

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节同前，仍约24x16mm（IM25）及23x16mm（IM26）
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged, still approximately 24x16 mm (IM25) and 23x16 mm (IM26).

source_text: 新增淋巴结
text_en: newly identified lymph node

source_text: 右肺中叶、下叶背段胸膜下及右侧叶间胸膜可见散在微小结节大致同前，＜5mm（图30、34、37、47）
text_en: Scattered tiny nodules in the posterior subpleural regions of the right middle and lower lobes and along the right interlobar pleura, approximately stable, all less than 5 mm (Fig. 30, 34, 37, 47).

source_text: 新增多发小结节
text_en: newly identified multiple small nodules

source_text: 右肺下叶见高密度钙化灶同前，余肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: High-density calcified focus in the right lower lobe is unchanged. No new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶毛刺状软组织密度结节较前缩小，原约1.8x1.4cm（Im48），现约1.4x1.2mm（Im49），周围血管支气管影纠集及长索条影较前相仿
text_en: Left lower lobe spiculated soft tissue density nodule decreased in size compared to prior, originally approximately 1.8x1.4 cm (Im48), now approximately 1.4x1.2 mm (Im49), surrounding vascular and bronchial distortion and long linear opacities similar to prior

source_text: 纵隔2R、4、5、7组多发淋巴结同前，较大约10x8mm（IM23）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R, 4, 5, and 7 are unchanged from previous, with the largest measuring approximately 10x8 mm (IM23).

source_text: 两肺多发小结节较前增大，右肺尖结节原约2mm（IM9），现约4mm（IMA29）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are larger than prior; the apical nodule in the right lung was previously about 2 mm (IM9), now about 4 mm (IMA29).

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上区多发淋巴结部分缩小，较大原约13x10mm，现约9x6mm（IM26）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, and supraclavicular areas are partially reduced in size, with the largest previously measuring approximately 13x10 mm and now approximately 9x6 mm (Image 26).

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜结节同前相仿，约5mm（IM30）
text_en: Nodule of the right interlobar pleura is similar to prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM30).

source_text: 纵隔内平扫稍高密度小淋巴结同前，双侧肺门、腋窝及锁骨上平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Slightly high-density mediastinal small lymph nodes on non-contrast scan unchanged from prior, no lymphadenopathy seen in bilateral hilar, axillary, and supraclavicular regions on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 左肺下叶索条影、两肺散在模糊小结节灶大小及范围同前相仿，较大仍约8x6mm（薄层IM68）
text_en: Left lower lobe linear opacities and scattered indistinct small nodular opacities in both lungs, size and extent similar to prior; largest still approximately 8x6 mm (thin-section IM68).

source_text: 右肺少许索条影同前，双肺未见新生结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged; no new nodules or fluffy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左肺上叶结节同前，考虑良性
text_en: Left upper lobe nodule unchanged, considered benign.

source_text: 纵隔2、4、5组及右肺门、右侧锁骨上散在淋巴结较前缩小，现较大原约19x11mm（IM28），现约15x8mm（IM28）
text_en: Scattered lymph nodes in mediastinal groups 2, 4, 5, right hilum, and right supraclavicular are reduced in size compared to previous; the largest was previously approximately 19x11mm (IM28) and is now approximately 15x8mm (IM28)

source_text: 纵隔左移，散在小于10mm淋巴结同前，未见肿大
text_en: Mediastinal shift to the left, scattered lymph nodes less than 10mm unchanged, no enlargement.

source_text: 左肺下叶癌术后改变同前相仿
text_en: Postoperative changes from left lower lobe cancer similar to prior

source_text: 余淋巴结同前
text_en: Remaining lymph nodes are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结略饱满大致同前，约13x8mm（IM36），追查
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is slightly prominent and essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 13x8 mm (IM36); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双肺散在小结节大致同前，随诊观察
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged, follow-up observation.

source_text: 扫及左肾上腺小结节及胆囊结石同前
text_en: A small nodule in the left adrenal gland and gallstones are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶及右肺下叶小结节同前，追查
text_en: Small nodules in the left upper lobe and right lower lobe are unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右肺中叶点状钙化影、左肺上叶舌段索条影同前，余肺内未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. A punctate calcified opacity in the right middle lobe and a linear opacity in the left upper lobe lingular segment are stable. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节，约2mm（IMA30），同前相仿，观察
text_en: Small nodule in the right lower lobe, approximately 2 mm (IMA30), stable compared to prior; observation recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下类结节影较前缩小、变淡(图30）
text_en: Nodular opacity in the right lower lobe subpleural region is smaller and less dense compared to prior (Figure 30).

source_text: 双肺微结节大致同前
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary micro-nodules are roughly unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺术后，支气管断端未见异常软组织密度影，两肺未见新增结节灶及斑片影
text_en: Post right lung surgery, no abnormal soft tissue density at the bronchial stump; no new nodules or patchy opacities in either lung.

source_text: 胸11椎体致密小结节同前，考虑良性
text_en: Dense small nodule in T11 vertebra unchanged from prior, considered benign.

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段结节同前略饱满，原约8mm（IM49），现约9mm（IM48）
text_en: Nodule in the left lower lobe basal segment slightly enlarged compared to prior, previously approximately 8 mm (IM49), now approximately 9 mm (IM48)

source_text: 食管癌术后较前相仿，食管-胃吻合口壁未见增厚征象
text_en: Postoperative esophageal cancer similar to prior; esophagogastric anastomotic wall shows no thickening.

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节同前，仍约5mm（IM22）
text_en: Small nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, still measures approximately 5 mm (IM22).

source_text: 右肺上叶及左肺下叶各见一浅淡密度点状结节同前，约3mm（IM15、41）
text_en: One faintly dense punctate nodule is seen in the right upper lobe and another in the left lower lobe, stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM15, 41).

source_text: 右肺门旁结节同前，仍约6mm（IM24）
text_en: The nodule adjacent to the right hilum is unchanged from prior, still approximately 6 mm (IM24).

source_text: 双肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见增厚软组织密度影，左肺索条、模糊小结节影同前（IM23)
text_en: Postoperative changes in the upper lobes of both lungs; no thickened soft tissue density is seen at the bronchial stump. Linear opacities and indistinct small nodules in the left lung are stable compared to prior (IM23).

source_text: 右肺小叶后基底段微小结节灶同前，约3x2mm（IMA38）
text_en: Tiny nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lung is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 3x2 mm (IMA38).

source_text: 余双肺未见新发结节灶或斑片影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no new nodular foci or patchy opacities.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段肿块较前增大
text_en: The mass in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is larger than before.

source_text: 左下肺混合磨玻璃病变范围大致同前，考虑恶性可能性大
text_en: Mixed ground-glass lesion in the left lower lobe is essentially unchanged in extent; malignancy is considered likely.

source_text: 食管-胃弓上吻合术后，吻合口右侧壁不连续并与右侧胸腔相通，其外侧形成混杂密度区较前范围缩小，原约42x35mm，现约32x23mm（IM15），中间含气低密度区明显缩小，周围软组织环绕增厚，其下方沿右后胸壁内侧仍见引流管穿行
text_en: Post supra-aortic esophagogastrostomy, discontinuity of the right wall of the anastomosis communicating with the right pleural cavity, with a mixed-density area lateral to it reduced in size compared to previous, originally approximately 42x35mm, now approximately 32x23mm (IM15). The central air-containing low-density area significantly reduced, with surrounding soft tissue thickening, and a drainage tube still traversing along the inner aspect of the right posterior chest wall below it.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区淋巴结较前相仿，约为3mm、5mm（IM5）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph nodes are stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm and 5 mm (IM5).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前相仿，较大仍约15x4mm（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior; the largest measures approximately 15x4 mm (IM21)

source_text: 右上肺近水平裂一小灶较前模糊，约3mm（IM30），追查，右肺下叶胸膜下微小结节同前(图35)
text_en: Small focus near the horizontal fissure in the right upper lobe less distinct than prior, approximately 3 mm (IM30); follow-up recommended. Right lower lobe subpleural micro-nodule unchanged (Fig. 35).

source_text: 双肺散在索条影同前，右肺上叶纵隔旁小结节样影同前（IMA31）
text_en: Scattered linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged from prior. A small nodular opacity adjacent to the mediastinum in the right upper lobe is unchanged (IMA31).

source_text: 右肺下叶术后改变，左肺上叶结节同前
text_en: Postoperative change in the right lower lobe; left upper lobe nodule is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 其外侧圆形小结节较前相仿，约8mm（Im19）
text_en: The small round nodule lateral to it is similar to prior, measuring approximately 8 mm (Im19).

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃密度结节略增大，原约37*34mm，现约42X34mm（IM14）
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe has slightly increased in size, previously approximately 37x34 mm, now approximately 42x34 mm (IM14).

source_text: 左肺下叶及右肺下叶胸膜旁不规则小结节灶同前，约3mm（IM46、47），追查
text_en: Irregular small nodules adjacent to the pleura in the left lower lobe and right lower lobe, stable compared to prior examination, approximately 3 mm (IM46, 47), recommend follow-up.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，右肺多发索条同前，右肺上叶前段磨玻璃小结节较前略缩小，大小现约6x5mm（IM21），原约8x7mm（IM20），追查
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, multiple linear opacities in the right lung similar to prior, a ground-glass small nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe is slightly smaller than before, currently approximately 6x5 mm (IM21), previously approximately 8x7 mm (IM20), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺点状结节同前（Im11、25、29）
text_en: Punctate nodules in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior (Im11, 25, 29).

source_text: 扫及左侧腹膜后见低强化结节，约21x15mm（IMA70），不除外淋巴结转移，请结合腹部检查，追查
text_en: Imaging shows a low-enhancing nodule measuring approximately 21 x 15 mm in the left retroperitoneum (IMA70), cannot exclude lymph node metastasis. Please correlate with abdominal imaging for further evaluation.

source_text: 右肺下叶前基底段结节较前缩小，原约8x7mm，现约7x5mm（IM48、49）
text_en: Nodule in the anterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is smaller compared to prior, previously approximately 8 × 7 mm, now approximately 7 × 5 mm (IM48, 49).

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门多发淋巴结，大致同前，11R较大现约21x18mm(IM35)
text_en: Multiple mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes, essentially unchanged, station 11R largest currently approximately 21x18 mm (IM35).

source_text: 右肺下叶5mm小结节同前（Im52）
text_en: A 5 mm small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM52).

source_text: 右肺下叶结节同前，肺内未见新生占位
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged; no new intrapulmonary space-occupying lesion is seen.

source_text: 两肺多发结节灶同前相仿，部分伴钙化
text_en: Multiple nodular foci in both lungs similar to prior, some with calcification

source_text: 右肺中叶癌术后大致同前，未见新生占位征象
text_en: Postoperative status of right middle lobe carcinoma, essentially unchanged; no new space-occupying lesions

source_text: 右肺上叶支气管狭窄减轻，局部右肺门旁不规则形态的软组织密度肿较前缩小，现约18*17mm（IM25），密度减低，原约29x25mm（IMA27）
text_en: The stenosis of the right upper lobe bronchus has improved. The irregular soft tissue density mass adjacent to the right hilum has decreased in size compared to prior, now measuring approximately 18 x 17 mm (IM25), with reduced density; previously measured about 29 x 25 mm (IMA27).

source_text: 余双肺支气管通畅，肺内透亮度均匀，未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Bronchi in both lungs are patent; lung parenchyma shows uniform lucency; no new nodules or consolidations are seen

source_text: 扫及肝左叶低密度结节同前
text_en: On scan, a low-density nodule in the left hepatic lobe is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔内4、7、10R组多发淋巴结，部分较前增大，原较大约15x11mm，现约20x14mm（Im22）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4, 7, and 10R, with some increased in size; the largest previously measured approximately 15x11 mm and now measures approximately 20x14 mm (Im22)

source_text: 右肺胸膜下可疑结节同前（IM32、46、47、54）
text_en: Suspicious nodules in the right lung subpleural region remain unchanged (IM32, 46, 47, 54).

source_text: 右肺上叶点状结节影同前（IMA8）
text_en: Punctate nodular opacity in the right upper lobe unchanged (IMA8)

source_text: 双肺胸膜下多发微小结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: Multiple subpleural micronodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior, likely benign.

source_text: 扫及肝S1低密度结节同前
text_en: A low-density nodule in liver segment S1 is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 食管胸中段癌，较前缩小
text_en: Mid-thoracic esophageal cancer is reduced in size compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶见簇状分布小结节及钙化灶同前，较大现仍约14x8mm（IM15），考虑为陈旧灶
text_en: A cluster of small nodules and calcified foci are seen in the right upper lobe, unchanged from prior; the largest remains approximately 14 x 8 mm (IM15), considered chronic/old changes.

source_text: 余双肺未见新发病灶
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no new pathological foci.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结同前，仍约13x8mm（IM27）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes unchanged from previous, still approximately 13x8 mm (IM27).

source_text: 右肺下叶不规则小结节及磨玻璃密度小灶等均同前（Im36、38）
text_en: Irregular small nodule and ground-glass opacity in the right lower lobe remain unchanged (Im36, 38).

source_text: 右肺上叶近胸膜处模糊小结节影同前，仍约5mm（IM10、22)，余肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: A hazy small nodule near the pleura in the right upper lobe is stable, still approximately 5 mm (IM10, 22). No nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 双肺转移结节明显增大，如左肺上叶舌段结节灶现约35x28mm（IM25），周围新增多发斑点灶，结节原约13mm（IM26）
text_en: Pulmonary metastatic nodules in both lungs are markedly increased in size; for example, a nodule in the lingular segment of the left upper lobe is now approximately 35x28 mm (IM25), with newly developed multiple punctate opacities in the surrounding area; the nodule was previously approximately 13 mm (IM26).

source_text: T10椎体致密小结节同前
text_en: Dense small nodule in the T10 vertebral body is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺结节同前相仿，约3-5mm（IM34、37），结合临床密切随诊
text_en: Right lung nodule similar to prior, measuring approximately 3-5 mm (IM34, 37); close clinical follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺内结节同前
text_en: The nodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节同前，仍约7mm(Im26)，后方贴近斜裂胸膜，追查
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule stable compared to prior, still approximately 7 mm (Im26), posteriorly adjacent to the oblique fissure pleura, follow-up recommended

source_text: 右肺胸膜下小结节同前相仿（IM19、44）
text_en: Subpleural small nodule in the right lung is similar to prior (IM19, 44)

source_text: 纵隔多枚淋巴结伴钙化同前，双肺门、锁骨上区及腋下平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes with calcification unchanged from prior; on non-contrast scan, no enlarged lymph nodes seen in bilateral hilar, supraclavicular, or axillary regions.

source_text: 右肺中叶结节影同前，仍约21x13mm（IM32）
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged, still measuring approximately 21x13 mm (IM32).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结缩小，原较大约12*10mm（IMA18），现约8mm（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are reduced in size, with the largest previously measuring approximately 12x10 mm (IMA18) and currently approximately 8 mm (IM19).

source_text: 右上肺和左下肺结节同前，仍约4mm（IM22、38）
text_en: Nodules in the right upper lung and left lower lung are unchanged, still measuring approximately 4 mm (IM22, 38).

source_text: 双肺间质性改变较前明显，左肺见点状钙化结节同前
text_en: Interstitial changes in both lungs are more prominent than prior; left lung shows punctate calcified nodules, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔2R组局部少量积液同前（IM15），纵隔小淋巴结影同前
text_en: Small amount of localized fluid in mediastinal station 2R unchanged from previous (IM15), small mediastinal lymph node shadow unchanged from previous.

source_text: 肝内低密度灶及右侧肾上腺结节同前，右侧肾上腺结节大小约21*18mm（IMA53）
text_en: Low-density hepatic lesion(s) and right adrenal nodule unchanged from prior; right adrenal nodule measures approximately 21 x 18 mm (IMA53).

source_text: 双肺散在索条及胸膜下致密结节灶同前，不足3mm
text_en: Scattered linear opacities and dense subpleural nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior, measuring less than 3 mm.

source_text: 右肺上叶混合磨玻璃密度分叶状小结节灶同前相仿，约8x7mm（IM31、32）
text_en: Mixed ground-glass opacity, lobulated small nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 8x7 mm (IM31, 32).

source_text: T4椎体高密度小结节及左第9肋局部骨质密度略增高同前（IM46）
text_en: High-density small nodule in T4 vertebral body and slightly increased bone density in the left ninth rib locally unchanged (IM46)

source_text: 前纵隔淋巴结同前，约10mm（IMA24）
text_en: Anterior mediastinal lymph node is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 10 mm (IMA24).

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区淋巴结缩同前，现约7x3mm（IM4）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node is unchanged compared to prior, now approximately 7x3 mm (IM4)

source_text: 双肺散在斑片和小结节影同前（IM28、29、32、56）
text_en: Scattered patchy and small nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged (IM28, 29, 32, 56).

source_text: 右侧锁骨上、纵隔多发淋巴结大致同前，较大仍约21x16mm（IM25）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular and mediastinal regions are generally unchanged from prior, with the largest still measuring approximately 21 x 16 mm (IM25).

source_text: 右侧胸膜增厚及右肺下叶索条影同前，两肺未见新生结节灶及斑片影
text_en: Right pleural thickening and right lower lobe linear bands are unchanged. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 双肺小结节及钙化结节同前
text_en: Multiple small nodules and calcified nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺索条及小结节影同前（IMA22、25），较大约4mm（IM25）
text_en: Linear opacities and small nodules in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior (IMA22, 25), the largest measuring approximately 4 mm (IM25).

source_text: 双肺散在小结节同前（IM24、27、31、45），部分伴钙化
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM24, 27, 31, 45), some with calcification.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下点状结节影同前（IM22），双肺未见新发结节或斑片影
text_en: Subpleural punctate nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior (IM22); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺结节较前增大、增多，转移
text_en: Left pulmonary nodules increased in size and number compared to prior, suggestive of metastasis.

source_text: 胰腺周围异常密度影较前缩小，范围原约23*18mm（IMA62），现约12x8mm（IM64），术后改变
text_en: Peripancreatic abnormal density shadow has decreased in size, previously approximately 23*18 mm (IMA62), now approximately 12x8 mm (IM64), postoperative change

source_text: 右下肺局部胸膜下微结节同前，约4mm（IM13）
text_en: The subpleural micronodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior imaging, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM13).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变，胸膜小结节同前
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; small pleural nodule stable compared to prior

source_text: 双肺少许小结节同前（IM42）
text_en: Few small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior (IM42).

source_text: 扫及甲状腺左叶低密度结节较前相仿，约16mm（IM4）
text_en: A low-density nodule in the left thyroid lobe is unchanged from prior, approximately 16 mm (IM4).

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结较前大致同前，仍约14x10mm（Im30）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is similar to prior, still approximately 14x10 mm (Im30)

source_text: 左侧第3、8肋骨见低密度灶，第8肋骨可见膨胀性骨质破坏
text_en: Low-density foci seen in the left 3rd and 8th ribs; expansile osseous destruction is visible in the 8th rib.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4组多发淋巴结较前相仿，4R组较大者仍约13x8mm（IM19）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R and 4 are similar to prior, with the largest in station 4R still measuring approximately 13x8 mm (IM19)

source_text: 纵隔内数个较高密度小淋巴结同前相仿，腋窝、锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Several higher density small mediastinal lymph nodes similar to prior, with no enlarged lymph nodes in axillary or supraclavicular regions

source_text: 双肺多发小结节影数目、大小均同前，部分为硬结灶，部分呈软组织密度
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged in number and size compared to prior; some are calcified foci, others show soft tissue density.

source_text: 右侧高位食管旁多发异常增大淋巴结同前，较大约9x8mm（IM11)
text_en: Multiple abnormally enlarged lymph nodes along the right upper esophagus are stable compared to prior examination, the largest measuring approximately 9 x 8 mm (IM11).

source_text: 余未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation are seen.

source_text: 纵隔内及贲门区少许小淋巴结同前
text_en: A few small lymph nodes within the mediastinum and cardiac region are unchanged from previous.

source_text: 食管旁肿大淋巴结同前，短径约14mm（IM31）
text_en: Paraesophageal enlarged lymph node unchanged, short axis approximately 14 mm (image 31).

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段软组织密度结节较前缩小，原约26x18mm，现约20x13mm（Im49）
text_en: Left lower lobe basal segment soft tissue density nodule smaller than prior, previously approximately 26x18 mm, currently approximately 20x13 mm (Im49)

source_text: 双肺下叶少量条索影同前，余双肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Few linear opacities in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior; no new nodules are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 左肺舌段索条结节、两肺索条影同前相仿
text_en: Left lung lingular segment: linear nodule; linear opacities in both lungs unchanged from previous

source_text: 双肺下叶胸膜下微小结节灶同前，约6mm、2mm（IM42、46），右肺中叶少许条索影同前
text_en: Subpleural micronodules in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 6 mm and 2 mm (IM42, 46); few linear opacities in the right middle lobe are unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶外侧基底段模糊小结节同前，仍约3mm（IM36）
text_en: Left lower lobe lateral basal segment hazy small nodule unchanged from prior, still approximately 3 mm (IM36)

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下小结节同前，约5mm（IM47）
text_en: The subpleural small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, approximately 5 mm (IM47)

source_text: 右肺下叶近胸膜下索条小结节较前相仿（IM34、53）
text_en: The small nodular linear opacity subpleural in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior (IM34, 53).

source_text: 纵隔3p小淋巴结同前，约6mm（IM10）
text_en: Small lymph node in mediastinal station 3p is the same as before, approximately 6 mm (IM10).

source_text: 纵隔5组淋巴结较前增大，现较大约14*11mm(图27)，原约16*8mm（IM27）
text_en: Mediastinal group 5 lymph nodes increased in size compared to prior, largest currently approximately 14x11 mm (Image 27), previously approximately 16x8 mm (Image 27)

source_text: 右肺下叶内基底段结节大致同前，仍约19x15mm（IM41），边缘仍见多发索条影
text_en: The nodule in the medial basal segment of the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged, still measuring approximately 19x15 mm (IM41), with multiple linear opacities still seen at the margin.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前，＜5mm（图26）
text_en: Tiny nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior, measuring less than 5 mm (Figure 26).

source_text: 左侧斜裂胸膜下微小结节同前
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodule in the left oblique fissure is unchanged.

source_text: 两肺内散在钙化结节及索条结节灶大致同前（IMA26、29、31、37），较大者约6mm（IMA31）
text_en: Scattered calcified nodules and linear nodules in both lungs are roughly unchanged (IMA26, 29, 31, 37); the largest is about 6 mm (IMA31).

source_text: 右下胸膜轻度增厚并肺内索条影同前，右肺中叶结节灶同前（IM21）
text_en: Mild pleural thickening in the right lower region with intrapulmonary linear opacities unchanged. Nodular opacity in the right middle lobe unchanged (IM21).

source_text: 左上肺癌术后较前相仿，支气管断端未见确切复发征象
text_en: Status post left upper lobe cancer surgery, similar to prior; no definite recurrence at the bronchial stump

source_text: 左肺上叶前段见不规则磨玻璃密度病灶同前，约26x24mm（IM19），密度不均
text_en: An irregular ground-glass opacity lesion in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe, unchanged from previous, approximately 26x24mm (IM19), with heterogeneous density.

source_text: 新见少许斑片、小结节
text_en: Newly identified a few patchy opacities and small nodules

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下小磨玻璃结节同前，约5mm（IM36）
text_en: Small ground-glass nodule in the subpleural region of the right middle lobe is stable compared to prior, approximately 5 mm (IM36).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段小结节同前，倾向良性，必要时追查
text_en: Small nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged; benign etiology favored; follow-up as needed.

source_text: 左肺下叶类圆形小结节同前，直径约3mm（IM46），结节边缘尚光滑，未见毛刺影
text_en: The small round nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged, with a diameter approximately 3 mm (IM46), smooth nodule margins, and no spiculation.

source_text: 双肺散在点状结节及钙化灶同前
text_en: Scattered punctate nodules and calcified foci in both lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，考虑良性
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged and is considered benign.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上小淋巴结同前相仿，约12x6mm（IM2）
text_en: Small lymph node in the left supraclavicular region is stable, measuring approximately 12x6 mm (IM2).

source_text: 双肺胸膜见多发条片影大致同前，余肺未见新增结节灶
text_en: Multiple linear and patchy opacities adjacent to the pleura in both lungs are approximately stable; no new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左锁骨上区多发小结节较前相仿，较大约8mm（IM9）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left supraclavicular region similar to previous, largest approximately 8 mm (IM9).

source_text: 余双肺未见新发结节或斑片影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 纵隔内见少许小淋巴结同前，均不足10mm
text_en: A few small lymph nodes in the mediastinum, similar to previous, all less than 10 mm.

source_text: 双肺多发小结节灶数目、大小及形态均同前相仿，3-6mm
text_en: Number, size, and morphology of multiple small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior; 3–6 mm in size.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端支气管扩张，管壁增厚（IMA14-18），范围较前增大，不除外复发，建议进一步检查
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy. Bronchiectasis and wall thickening at the bronchial stump (IMA14-18) have increased in extent compared to prior. Recurrence cannot be excluded; further evaluation is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔内淋巴结同前，建议追查
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from previous, recommend follow-up.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，约6mm（IMA44），观察，余未见结节或实变影
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 6 mm (IMA44), observation recommended; no other nodules or consolidation noted.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节较前略增大，大小约8x7mm（IM55），原大小约6x5mm（IM52）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is slightly larger than prior, now measuring approximately 8x7 mm (IM55), previously about 6x5 mm (IM52).

source_text: 纵隔内淋巴结大致同前，建议追查
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes approximately unchanged from previous, recommend follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔内多发转移淋巴结较前增大
text_en: Multiple metastatic mediastinal lymph nodes enlarged compared to previous

source_text: 两肺索条影同前，左肺上叶舌段胸膜下类小结节灶大致同前，约4mm（IM49）
text_en: Linear opacities in both lungs are stable; a small subpleural nodule in the lingular segment of the left upper lobe is stable, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM49).

source_text: 纵隔4R、7、9组淋巴结同前，较大约15x9mm（IM27）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R, 7, and 9 are similar to prior, with the largest approximately 15x9mm (IM27).

source_text: 纵隔1R、2R、4R及右锁骨上区多发淋巴结大致同前，较大位于4R组，短径约9mm（IM18）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 1R, 2R, 4R, and the right supraclavicular region are essentially unchanged from previous, with the largest at station 4R having a short axis diameter of approximately 9 mm (Image 18).

source_text: mm浅淡小结节同前（IM27、38）
text_en: Faint small nodule unchanged (IM27, 38)

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节同前，较大仍约9mm（IM20），边缘毛糙同前，平扫密度稍高
text_en: The small nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged, larger at approximately 9 mm (IM20), with irregular margin as before and slightly higher density on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4-7组及左肺门、左锁骨上多发肿大淋巴结增大，较大原约25x14mm（IM17），现约32x20mm（IM23）
text_en: Lymphadenopathy in mediastinal stations 2R, 4-7, left hilar, and left supraclavicular regions has increased in size, with the largest previously measuring approximately 25x14 mm (IM17) and now approximately 32x20 mm (IM23)

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区及纵隔淋巴结同前
text_en: Lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region and mediastinum are unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段胸膜下索条小结节灶同前，约3mm（IM29）
text_en: A linear small subpleural nodule in the left lower lobe dorsal segment is unchanged, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM29).

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段可见片状不规则混合密度结节灶，范围较前明显减小，原大小约26mm×19mm（IMA17），现大小约20mm×13mm（IM15），边界不清，其周围可见支气管气相及索条
text_en: An irregular patchy mixed-density nodule is visible in the apical segment of the right upper lobe, with a marked reduction in size compared to prior: previously approximately 26 mm × 19 mm (IMA17), now approximately 20 mm × 13 mm (IM15), with ill-defined margins; bronchiolar air trapping and linear strands are visible around it.

source_text: 两肺索条影同前，未见新发结节灶
text_en: Linear opacities in both lungs are stable; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段多发小结节，部分较前增大，较大者约6mm（IM29），原约2mm（IM32）
text_en: Left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment: multiple small nodules, some increased in size compared to prior, larger one approximately 6 mm (IM29), previously approximately 2 mm (IM32).

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前，＜5mm（2-图37）
text_en: Tiny nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior, measuring less than 5 mm (2-Figure 37).

source_text: 纵隔4、7、10组多发淋巴结，部分较前增大，如现大小约7x7mm（IM19），原约3x4mm（IM19）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4, 7, and 10, with some increased in size compared to prior, currently measuring approximately 7x7 mm (IM19) versus previously 3x4 mm (IM19).

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺结节同前（IM54）
text_en: A nodule is noted in the left adrenal gland, stable compared to prior (IM54).

source_text: 双肺下叶小索条影同前，双肺未见新发结节
text_en: Small linear opacities in the bilateral lower lobes are stable compared to prior imaging; no new nodules are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 右侧肾上腺结节同前
text_en: Adrenal nodule on the right is unchanged.

source_text: 气管左侧主肺窗间低密度结节现约26*25mm（IM23），较前略缩小，分隔显示不清，食管腔受压较前减轻
text_en: A low-density nodule in the left tracheal aortopulmonary window measures approximately 26x25 mm (IM23), slightly smaller than prior, with unclear septations and reduced esophageal lumen compression compared to previous.

source_text: 双侧腋窝小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes in bilateral axillae are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结区软组织密度灶同前
text_en: Soft tissue density focus in mediastinal station 7 lymph node region unchanged from previous.

source_text: 左侧胸膜小结节同前
text_en: Small nodules in the left pleura are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段术后，术区未见复发征象
text_en: Postoperative status in the left upper lobe lingular segment; no evidence of recurrence in the surgical bed

source_text: 纵隔4、7组多发高密度淋巴结同前，腔静脉后较大者仍约12x8mm（IM16）
text_en: Mediastinal stations 4 and 7 multiple high-density lymph nodes unchanged from prior; largest posterior to vena cava still approximately 12x8 mm (IM16)

source_text: 右肺下叶背段结节形态、大小同前，约12x8mm（Im25），边界较清
text_en: The nodule in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe is stable in morphology and size, measuring approximately 12x8 mm (Im25), with relatively clear margins.

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门淋巴结同前，较大仍约12x7mm（IM24）
text_en: Mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous, the largest still approximately 12x7 mm (IM24).

source_text: 纵隔、左肺门淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal and left hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous.

source_text: 原贲门旁淋巴结消失，纵膈4R淋巴结较前略增大，约20*8mm(图24)，建议追查
text_en: The previously noted lymph node adjacent to the cardia has disappeared; the 4R mediastinal lymph node is slightly larger than before, measuring approximately 20x8 mm (Image 24). Recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右肺点状结节同前（IMA24、26）
text_en: Punctate nodules in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior (IMA24, 26).

source_text: 左肺上叶微小结节同前（IM11），余两肺未见新发结节影
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule unchanged (IM11), no new nodules seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，局部结节平扫显示不清，平扫未见新增异常密度影
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; the local nodule is not clearly visualized on non-contrast imaging. No new abnormal densities are seen on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 双侧肺内多发小结节同前，复查
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the bilateral lungs are unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔2、4组多发肿大淋巴结明显缩小，原较大者约28x14mm，现约22x11mm（IM20）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2 and 4 have significantly decreased in size; the largest previously measured approximately 28x14 mm is now approximately 22x11 mm (IM20).

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区淋巴结同前，仍约为12x8mm（Im7）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node is unchanged, still approximately 12x8 mm (Im7)

source_text: 右侧前胸壁皮下结节缩小，原约7mm（IM22），现约5mm(IM25)
text_en: Subcutaneous nodule in the right anterior chest wall has decreased in size, previously measuring approximately 7 mm (IM22), now approximately 5 mm (IM25).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后改变，双肺未见新发占位
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left upper lobe, no new masses in both lungs

source_text: 右侧第四肋骨头皮质变薄、不连续，呈膨胀性骨质破坏（IM15），考虑转移，请结合骨扫描检查
text_en: Cortical thinning and discontinuity in the right 4th rib head, showing expansile osseous destruction (IM15). Metastasis is considered. Correlation with bone scan is recommended.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上淋巴结稍增大，原约8x8mm，现约10x9mm（IMA6）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node slightly enlarged, previously approximately 8x8 mm, now approximately 10x9 mm (IMA6)

source_text: 胃小弯淋巴结同前，较大约10x5mm（IM67）
text_en: Lymph nodes along the gastric lesser curvature are unchanged from prior; the largest is approximately 10x5 mm (IM67).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃密度小结节同前
text_en: The small ground-glass density nodule in the right lower lobe dorsal segment is unchanged.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺左叶低密度小结节灶同前（IM6）
text_en: Small low-density nodule in the left thyroid lobe unchanged from prior (IM6).

source_text: 左上叶残余肺内小结节同前，约3mm（IM12）
text_en: The small nodule within the residual lung of the left upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM12).

source_text: 右下肺少许索条影大致同前，余肺，未见新发结节及片絮影
text_en: The minimal linear opacities in the right lower lobe are essentially unchanged compared to prior. The remainder of the lungs shows no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 纵隔少许小淋巴结大致同前，较大约8*5mm（IM22）
text_en: Mediastinal few small lymph nodes roughly unchanged, largest approximately 8x5mm (IM22).

source_text: 左上叶小结节同前（IM10），余两肺未见新发结节影
text_en: Small nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged (IM10); no new nodules are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右肺肺尖胸膜下局限性磨玻璃密度结节灶大致同前（IM11、20），较大者约7mm（IM11）
text_en: The focal ground-glass opacity nodule subpleurally at the right lung apex is largely unchanged (IM11, 20); the larger one measures approximately 7 mm (IM11).

source_text: 纵隔4、7组多发淋巴结同前，腔静脉后较大者仍约12x8mm（IM16）
text_en: Mediastinal stations 4 and 7 multiple lymph nodes unchanged from prior; largest posterior to vena cava still approximately 12x8 mm (IM16)

source_text: 右肺中叶及左肺下叶外基底段胸膜下微小结节同前
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodules in the right middle lobe and the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe are unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶后肋膈角模糊结节样病灶同前，约9x6mm（IM46）
text_en: The ill-defined nodular lesion in the posterior costophrenic angle of the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 9 x 6 mm (IM46).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变同前，胸部CT扫描未见新生占位
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lobe are unchanged; chest CT scan shows no new space-occupying lesion

source_text: 右肺下叶背段见磨玻璃结节同前，大小约6mm（IM21），内部可见实性成分
text_en: A ground-glass nodule is seen in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe, stable compared to prior, approximately 6 mm (IM21), with an internal solid component visible.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见新发强化占位
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, no new enhancing space-occupying lesion at bronchial stump.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变同前，胸部CT未见新生占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lobe are unchanged; chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesion

source_text: 双下肺胸膜下小结节及左侧叶间胸膜结节较前相仿（IM25、28、44、50）
text_en: Subpleural small nodules in the bilateral lower lungs and a nodule in the left interlobar fissure are similar to prior (IM25, 28, 44, 50).

source_text: 纵隔内主肺动脉窗淋巴结同前（IMA21）
text_en: A lymph node in the mediastinal aortopulmonary window is unchanged from previous (IMA21).

source_text: 双肺多发小结节较前略缩小，如左上肺结节原约5mm者，现约2mm（Im17）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs have slightly decreased in size; for example, a nodule in the left upper lobe was previously about 5 mm, now about 2 mm (Im17).

source_text: 双肺微结节影同前，较大约3mm（IM73）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary micro-nodular opacities are stable compared to prior; largest is approximately 3 mm (IM73).

source_text: 左肺舌叶磨玻璃结节同前，仍约10x10mm(Im30)
text_en: Left lung lingula: ground-glass nodule unchanged, still approximately 10x10 mm (Image 30)

source_text: 右肺下叶背段实性小结节同前，直径约3mm（IM31）
text_en: Solid small nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM31).

source_text: 纵隔4R区淋巴结较前相仿，约10x7mm（IM18）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are similar to previous, approximately 10x7 mm (IM18).

source_text: 右肺中叶及左肺下叶外基底段胸膜下小结节同前，仍约3mm（IM30、41）
text_en: Small subpleural nodules in the right middle lobe and the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe are unchanged, still approximately 3 mm (IM30, 41).

source_text: 右肺多发微小结节同前，约3mm（IM30、31）
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in the right lung are unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM30, 31).

source_text: 右肺门旁结节同前相仿，仍约9mm（IM35)
text_en: The nodule adjacent to the right hilum is similar to prior, still approximately 9 mm (IM35).

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R小淋巴结同前，较大仍约6x4mm（IM19）
text_en: Small mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R and 4R are unchanged from prior, with the largest still measuring approximately 6x4 mm (Image 19).

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上及腋窝多发淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular areas, and axillae are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段支气管截断，局部不规则结节较前相仿，现仍约8x7mm（IM28），远端肺内片絮、结节影较前相仿
text_en: The bronchial cutoff in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is associated with a local irregular nodule that is similar to prior, still measuring approximately 8x7 mm (IM28). Patchy and nodular opacities in the distal lung are similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃小结节较前略增大，恶性不除外，追查
text_en: The small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe has slightly increased in size; malignancy cannot be excluded; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右锁骨上区淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region are essentially unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔内2R组淋巴结较前缩小，原约12x10mm，现约9x8mm（IM14）
text_en: Mediastinal station 2R lymph nodes are reduced in size compared to previous, from approximately 12x10mm to approximately 9x8mm (IM14).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端不规则等低混杂密度灶较前缩小，边缘模糊，原约23x16mm（IM18），现约21x14mm（IM19）
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, irregular isodense to hypodense mixed density focus at the bronchial stump is smaller than prior with blurred margins, previously approximately 23x16 mm (IM18), now approximately 21x14 mm (IM19).

source_text: 左肺下叶微、小结节同前，追查
text_en: Micro and small nodules in left lower lobe unchanged from prior, follow-up

source_text: 甲状腺右叶低密度结节灶同前，大小约11mm（IMA2）
text_en: The right thyroid lobe shows a low-density nodule, unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 11 mm (IMA2).

source_text: 平扫纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约13x7mm（IM24）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest approximately 13x7 mm (image 24).

source_text: 两肺散在模糊小结节同前
text_en: Scattered indistinct small nodules in both lungs, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左上肺点状钙化结节同前（Im16）
text_en: Punctate calcified nodule in the left upper lobe unchanged (Im16)

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段浅淡模糊小结节灶大致同前（Im36）
text_en: A faint and ill-defined small nodule in the left lower lobe posterior basal segment is approximately the same as previous (Im36).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，右肺中叶内侧段结节此次未见明确显示，左肺上叶尖后段、左肺下叶外基底段散在小结节灶大致同前（IM18、49）追查
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, the nodule in the medial segment of the right middle lobe is not seen on this study, scattered small nodules in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe and the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe are largely unchanged (IM18, 49), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶模糊结节同前，约5mm（IM36），双肺未见新增结节
text_en: Left upper lobe hazy nodule unchanged from prior, approximately 5 mm (IM36), no new nodules bilaterally.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段术后，支气管断端周围软组织影，考虑复发可能
text_en: Postoperative status in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe; soft tissue density around the bronchial stump, with possible recurrence.

source_text: 左肺下叶多发索条影，局部见结节同前，约7x6mm（Im44）
text_en: Multiple linear opacities in the left lower lobe with nodules locally unchanged from previous, approximately 7x6mm (Im44).

source_text: 纵隔右侧气管食管沟淋巴结大致同前，较大仍约7mm（IM8），追查
text_en: Mediastinal right tracheoesophageal groove lymph node, roughly same as prior, largest measures approximately 7 mm (IM8), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后改变同前，胸部CT扫描未见恶性征象
text_en: Postoperative change in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior; chest CT scan shows no malignant findings.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，右肺胸膜下可见多个小结节影同前（IMA15、17），大小约2-4mm，观察
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, multiple subpleural small nodules in the right lung similar to prior (IMA15, 17), size approximately 2-4 mm, under observation.

source_text: 平扫纵隔1R组淋巴结同前，约8*6mm（IM6），双肺门、左锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows the mediastinal station 1R lymph node unchanged, approximately 8x6 mm (Image 6). No enlarged lymph nodes seen in the bilateral hilar regions, left supraclavicular region, or bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上、左腋下淋巴结较前增大，现较大约12X8mm（IM18），纵隔、双肺门、右锁骨上区及右腋下平扫未见明显肿大淋巴结
text_en: The left supraclavicular and left axillary lymph nodes are larger than previously, now measuring approximately 12 x 8 mm (IM18). No enlarged lymph nodes are seen on non-contrast imaging in the mediastinum, bilateral hila, right supraclavicular region, or right axilla.

source_text: 扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏
text_en: No bone destruction seen in the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 右肺门肿大淋巴结同前，仍约11x10mm（IM30）
