text_en: The enlarged right hilar lymph node is unchanged from prior, still measuring approximately 11 x 10 mm (IM30).

source_text: 右肺下叶切除术后改变大致同前，支气管断端结构基本清晰，局部未见占位征象及异常强化灶
text_en: Postoperative changes following right lower lobectomy are essentially unchanged; the bronchial stump appears well-defined, with no evidence of a space-occupying lesion or abnormal enhancement at the local site.

source_text: 双肺弥漫多发磨玻璃结节同前，右肺中叶结节密度较高，为主要病灶，需密切追查
text_en: Diffusely distributed multiple ground-glass nodules in both lungs are stable. The nodule in the right middle lobe has higher density and is the dominant lesion, requiring close follow-up.

source_text: 左肺索条同前，纵隔旁小结节灶同前，约5mm（IM42）
text_en: Left lung linear opacities unchanged from prior, small mediastinal-adjacent nodule unchanged, approximately 5 mm (IM42)

source_text: 左肺下叶偏上方结节缩小，原约4mm（IM39），现约3mm（IM40）
text_en: Left lower lobe superior aspect nodule decreased in size, previously approximately 4mm (Image 39), now approximately 3mm (Image 40)

source_text: 纵隔6组小淋巴结同前（IM24）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in mediastinal station 6 are unchanged from prior (IM24).

source_text: 双肺少许索条影同前，余双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Few linear opacities in both lungs are stable; otherwise, no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 双肺新见多发结节，较大者约16x8mm（IM15），形态不规则，伴毛刺索条影
text_en: Newly noted multiple nodules in both lungs, the largest measuring approximately 16x8 mm (IM15), irregular in shape, associated with spiculated linear opacities.

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜小结节同前
text_en: The small nodule in the left interlobar pleura is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右下肺少许索条影及左肺小结节同前（IM25、31）
text_en: Few fibrotic bands in the right lower lobe and a small nodule in the left lung are unchanged compared to prior (IM25, 31).

source_text: 扫描所及胸11椎体见骨质破坏灶，边缘硬化
text_en: Scanned T11 vertebral body shows osseous destruction focus with sclerotic margins.

source_text: 双肺弥漫多发粟粒结节较前减少，约1-2mm
text_en: Diffusely distributed miliary nodules in both lungs are decreased compared to prior, measuring approximately 1-2 mm.

source_text: 扫及腰1椎体楔形变、塌陷且与胸12椎间隙变窄同前，间隙内见结节状高密度灶
text_en: CT scan shows wedge deformity and collapse of the L1 vertebral body with narrowing of the disc space between T12 and L1, stable compared to prior, with a nodular high-density lesion within the disc space.

source_text: 纵隔7组肿大淋巴结缩小，原约22x13mm（IM 24），现约11x8mm（IM25）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 enlarged lymph nodes are reduced in size, previously approximately 22 × 13 mm (Image 24), currently approximately 11 × 8 mm (Image 25)

source_text: 缓解
text_en: Remission

source_text: 左肺下叶磨玻璃密度小结节较前略增大，原约5mm（IM27），现约6mm（IM56）
text_en: A ground-glass opacity small nodule in the left lower lobe is slightly enlarged compared to previous, previously approximately 5mm (IM27), now approximately 6mm (IM56).

source_text: 未见肺内新增
text_en: No new intrapulmonary findings seen

source_text: 右肺下叶结节较前稍大，原约14x7mm（IM35），现约16x9mm（IM36），边缘分叶
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is slightly larger than before, previously measuring approximately 14x7 mm (IM35), now approximately 16x9 mm (IM36), with lobulated margins.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃结节同前，仍约15x11mm（IM19），内部未见实性成分，仍见血管穿行
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe remains stable, still measuring approximately 15x11 mm (IM19); no solid component is seen within, and vascular structures are still traversing the nodule.

source_text: 扫及左肋局限密度增高同前，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: On imaging, localized increased density in the left rib is unchanged from prior; no bone destruction is seen in the other imaged bones.

source_text: 双肺弥漫转移结节部分较前增大
text_en: Some of the diffusely distributed metastatic nodules in both lungs are larger than prior.

source_text: 余骨质未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: No osseous destruction is seen in the remaining bones.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段结节较前增大，原约现约17*15mm（IM20），现约22*15mm（IM20），周围不规则索条同前
text_en: The nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe has increased in size, previously measuring approximately 17x15 mm (IM20), now approximately 22x15 mm (IM20); the surrounding irregular linear opacities remain unchanged.

source_text: 右肺中叶切除术后，肺内陈旧灶同前，未见新生占位
text_en: Postoperative status after right middle lobectomy. Old pulmonary foci are unchanged. No new space-occupying lesions are seen.

source_text: 双肺多发结节大部分同前、部分略缩小
text_en: Most multiple nodules in both lungs are unchanged, some are slightly smaller.

source_text: 余两肺多发结节较前缩小、减少，均不超过5mm
text_en: Multiple nodules in the remainder of both lungs are smaller and fewer in number compared to prior; all are less than 5 mm.

source_text: 双肺浅淡密度小结节同前，倾向良性，追查
text_en: Faint density small nodules in both lungs are unchanged; likely benign, recommend follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R/L、7组及右侧锁骨上淋巴结同前，如原约14x10mm者现仍约14x10mm（IM7），如4R原约13x10mm者同前（IM25），右肺门淋巴结平扫显示不清
text_en: Lymphadenopathy in mediastinal stations 2R, 4R, 4L, 7, and right supraclavicular region unchanged from prior, with a node previously measuring approximately 14x10 mm still measuring approximately 14x10 mm (IM7), and a station 4R node previously approximately 13x10 mm unchanged (IM25). Right hilar lymph nodes not clearly visualized on non-contrast imaging

source_text: 双肺多发结节较前稍增大，左肺上叶原约6mm（IM20），现约8x6mm（IM18）
text_en: Multiple nodules in both lungs are slightly larger than prior; the left upper lobe nodule was previously about 6 mm (IM20), now measures approximately 8x6 mm (IM18).

source_text: 左肺门淋巴结未见显示，右肺门小淋巴结同前，较大约9x9mm（Im34）
text_en: Left hilar lymph node not visualized; right hilar small lymph node unchanged, largest approximately 9x9 mm (Im34).

source_text: 食管癌术后，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer, no definite evidence of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 左侧胸膜下散在实性微、小结节同前（IM39等）
text_en: Scattered tiny and small solid nodules subpleurally in the left lung are unchanged compared to prior (IM39, etc.).

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，现约3mm（IM53、56）
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior, currently approximately 3 mm (IM53, 56).

source_text: 双肺多发微小结节同前，＜5mm
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged; <5 mm.

source_text: 左肺上叶微小结节、左肺下叶小结节同前，追查
text_en: A subcentimeter nodule in the left upper lobe and a small nodule in the left lower lobe are unchanged from prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶类结节影同前（IM11）
text_en: Nodule-like opacity in the right upper lobe unchanged from prior (IM11).

source_text: 纵隔4组淋巴结略大同前，现仍约15x10mm（IM17）
text_en: Mediastinal group 4 lymph nodes slightly enlarged same as before, currently still approximately 15x10 mm (IM17)

source_text: 两肺小结节影同前，两肺新发小结节影，建议复查
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior; new small nodules seen in both lungs; follow-up recommended

source_text: 纵隔、肺门淋巴结缩小，现较大约15x9mm（IMA26），原较大约20x12mm（IMA19）
text_en: Mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes decreased in size, now largest approximately 15x9 mm (IMA26), previously largest approximately 20x12 mm (IMA19).

source_text: 双肺多发胸膜下多发小结节，部分增大，左肺下叶结节原约2mm（IM29），现约4mm（IM31）
text_en: Multiple subpleural small nodules in both lungs; some have increased in size. The left lower lobe nodule was previously about 2 mm (IM29), now measures approximately 4 mm (IM31).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段少许硬结索条影伴钙化灶、双下肺胸膜下少许条片影、右下肺钙化灶同前，双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: A few fibrotic streaks with calcified foci in the apical-posterior segment of the left upper lobe, a few linear and patchy opacities subpleurally in both lower lobes, and calcified foci in the right lower lobe same as before; no new nodules or patchy opacities in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶前基底段支气管旁新见微小结节影，约2mm（IM32），追查
text_en: A new tiny nodule is seen adjacent to the bronchus in the anterior basal segment of the right lower lobe, measuring approximately 2 mm (IM32); recommend follow-up.

source_text: 双肺散在多发肺大泡，肺内未见新发结节影
text_en: Scattered pulmonary bullae are seen in both lungs. No new nodules are identified.

source_text: 右肺中叶磨玻璃结节同前（IM34）
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged (IM34).

source_text: 左肺上叶下舌段支气管截断同前，周围软组织结节较前略饱满，原约24x20mm（IM24），现约28x23mm（IM25）
text_en: The bronchial cutoff in the lower lingular segment of the left upper lobe remains unchanged; the surrounding soft tissue nodule is slightly more prominent, previously measuring approximately 24 x 20 mm (IM24), now approximately 28 x 23 mm (IM25).

source_text: 食管术后改变，双肺散在索条及小结节同前，未见下肺结节影
text_en: Post-esophagectomy changes, scattered linear opacities and small nodules in both lungs unchanged, no nodules in the lower lobes.

source_text: 扫及部分胸椎骨质密度欠均匀同前，余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Bone density is uneven in some thoracic vertebrae, unchanged from prior; no signs of bone destruction in the remaining thoracic bones.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段不规则团片及类结节灶，较前缩小，密度减低
text_en: Irregular patch and nodular opacity in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe has decreased in size and density compared to prior.

source_text: 扫及左乳内侧象限小结节同前（IM24）
text_en: A small nodule in the inner quadrant of the left breast is unchanged from prior (Im24).

source_text: 纵隔2R、4、5、7见淋巴结大致同前，均小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R, 4, 5, and 7 are essentially unchanged from previous, all less than 10 mm.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段、右肺上叶后段磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，仍约3mm、10x6mm、5x4mm（IM19、21、27），建议6月后追查
text_en: Left lower lobe posterior segment and right upper lobe posterior segment ground-glass opacity nodules unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 3 mm, 10x6 mm, and 5x4 mm (IM19, 21, 27), with recommendation for follow-up in 6 months.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段磨玻璃小结节同前，右肺上叶后段实性微结节同前，追查
text_en: Ground-glass small nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment, unchanged. Solid micronodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment, unchanged. Follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺尖及左下肺叶横隔旁微小结节同前，约3mm（IMA12、63）
text_en: Tiny nodules near the right lung apex and left lower lobe adjacent to the diaphragm are stable compared to prior, approximately 3 mm (IMA12, 63).

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下小结节较前相仿（IM17），左下肺少许索条影同前
text_en: The small subpleural nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior (IM17); minimal linear opacities in the left lower lobe are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔少许小淋巴结同前，较大约7mm（IM23）
text_en: Mediastinal few small lymph nodes unchanged, largest approximately 7mm (IM23).

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段软组织密度占位较前相仿，仍约30x21mm（Im13），边缘多发毛刺
text_en: The soft tissue density mass in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is similar to prior, still approximately 30x21 mm (Im13), with multiple spiculations at the margin.

source_text: 右肺门、隆突下小淋巴结同前，约10mm（IM29）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the right hilum and subcarinal region are stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 10 mm (IM29).

source_text: 未见新发淋巴结
text_en: No new lymphadenopathy

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜结节状增厚加重，胸膜转移可能大
text_en: The nodular thickening along the right interlobar pleura has increased, raising concern for pleural metastasis.

source_text: 双肺散在多发磨玻璃密度及实性结节显示同前，如右肺中叶实性病灶仍约3mm（IM25）
text_en: Scattered multiple ground-glass and solid nodules in both lungs are unchanged, such as the solid lesion in the right middle lobe, which remains approximately 3 mm (IM25).

source_text: 甲状腺多发结节及胆囊结石同前
text_en: Multiple thyroid nodules and gallstones stable compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺未见新发结节灶及斑片影
text_en: No new nodular foci or patchy opacities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后，左肺上叶不规则占位同前，双肺多发结节同前，追查
text_en: Post-left lower lobectomy, the irregular mass in the left upper lobe is unchanged, bilateral pulmonary nodules are unchanged, and follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 双肺散在磨玻璃密度结节同前，复查
text_en: Scattered ground-glass nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior. Recommend follow-up.

source_text: 双锁骨上小淋巴结同前相仿，右侧较大者现约10*9mm（IM3），纵隔、双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Small lymph nodes in bilateral supraclavicular regions are similar to prior; the largest on the right now measures approximately 10x9 mm (IM3); no enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum or bilateral axillae.

source_text: 双肺透过度增高，双肺弥漫粟粒样微小结节较前减少
text_en: Increased lung lucency; diffuse miliary tiny nodules in both lungs are reduced compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶支气管不规则变窄、中断，中叶膨胀不全较前减轻，楔状实变影范围较前缩小，原约53x47mm（IM31），现约38x28mm（IMA34），其肿块边界不清
text_en: Irregular narrowing and interruption of the right middle lobe bronchus. Atelectasis of the middle lobe has improved compared to prior. The wedge-shaped area of consolidation has decreased in extent, previously 53 x 47 mm (IM31), now approximately 38 x 28 mm (IMA34). The mass has ill-defined margins.

source_text: 右下肺空泡性结节较前缩小，原约18x15mm，现约13x9mm（IM33）
text_en: The bubble-like nodule in the right lower lobe has decreased in size compared to prior imaging, previously measuring approximately 18 x 15 mm, now approximately 13 x 9 mm (IM33).

source_text: 纵隔多个小淋巴结同前（IM21、22）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior (IM21, 22)

source_text: 胸主动脉旁淋巴结大致同前（IM48）
text_en: Paraaortic lymph nodes are essentially unchanged from previous (IM48).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段结节影缩小，原约6mm（IM27），现约4mm（IM27），边界清楚，周围未见卫星灶
text_en: The nodule in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment has decreased in size from approximately 6 mm (IM27) to approximately 4 mm (IM27), with well-defined margins and no satellite nodules seen.

source_text: 左肺小结节影同前（Im33、38）
text_en: Left lung small nodule unchanged (IM33, 38)

source_text: 右肺上叶后段邻近肺门处不规则结节较前缩小，原约25x17mm（IM20），现约10x8mm（IM20）
text_en: Irregular nodule near the hilum in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 25x17 mm (IM20), now approximately 10x8 mm (IM20)

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见明显异常软组织密度影，左肺胸膜下浅淡小结节影同前，约4mm（IM25），左肺索条影同前
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, plain scan shows no significant abnormal soft tissue density at the bronchial stump; left lung subpleural faint small nodule unchanged from prior, approximately 4 mm (IM25); left lung linear opacities unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔4、5组淋巴结同前，较大者约13x8mm（IMA21）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 4 and 5 are stable compared to prior. The largest measures approximately 13x8 mm (Image A21).

source_text: 左肺下叶背段小结节影同前，倾向陈旧灶，复查
text_en: A small nodule-like opacity in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe, unchanged from previous, likely a chronic lesion, for follow-up.

source_text: 扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象、
text_en: No signs of bone destruction observed in the imaged bones.

source_text: 右肺模糊小结节同前，约5mm（IM20、26）
text_en: Faint small nodule in the right lung is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM20, 26).

source_text: 左肺下叶背段结节大小同前，结合临床密切追查
text_en: Left lower lobe posterior segment nodule size unchanged; clinical correlation and close follow-up advised.

source_text: 纵隔2R组淋巴结较前缩小，余肺多发病变大致同前
text_en: Mediastinal station 2R lymph nodes decreased in size compared to prior, other multiple pulmonary lesions largely unchanged.

source_text: 左肺结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Left pulmonary nodule unchanged from prior, recommendation for follow-up.

source_text: 扫描范围内未见明显骨质破坏灶
text_en: No significant osseous destruction seen within the scan range.

source_text: 右肺少量索条结节、钙化及小结节灶同前，未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: The small linear opacities, nodules, calcifications, and tiny nodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior. No new nodules or consolidations are identified.

source_text: 右肺中叶术后，右肺门旁稍低密度包块较前缩小，现约23*14mm(图35)，原约26*21mm(图35)
text_en: Postoperative status of the right middle lobe; a slightly hypodense mass adjacent to the right hilum has decreased in size compared to prior, now approximately 23*14 mm (Figure 35), previously about 26*21 mm (Figure 35).

source_text: 纵隔2组淋巴结较前相仿，约10x7mm（IM15）
text_en: Mediastinal station 2 lymph nodes similar to prior, approximately 10x7 mm (IM15)

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段及左肺上叶尖后段磨玻璃密度结节灶同前，较大约8mm（IM12）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodules in the apical segment of the right upper lobe and apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe are unchanged, largest approximately 8 mm (IM12).

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结较前相仿
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are similar in size compared to previous.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段见类椭圆形磨玻璃密度小结节同前，仍约14x11mm（Im21），病变部分边缘与邻近胸膜分界欠清
text_en: Oval ground-glass density small nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is stable, still approximately 14x11 mm (Im21); part of the lesion margin remains indistinct from the adjacent pleura

source_text: 右侧甲状腺结节同前，建议颈部B超检查
text_en: Nodule in the right thyroid is stable; neck ultrasound is recommended.

source_text: 右肺中叶体积缩小并索条、小结节影同前
text_en: The right middle lobe shows volume loss with linear strands and small nodules, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺散在模糊结节影同前（IMA21、32），左肺下叶新见斑片状影
text_en: Scattered indistinct nodules in the left lung unchanged from previous (IMA21, 32), new patchy opacities in the left lower lobe

source_text: 右心膈角处结节增大，原约15*11mm，现约22x18mm（IMA38），主体位于肺内
text_en: The nodule at the right cardiophrenic angle has increased in size, previously approximately 15 x 11 mm, now approximately 22 x 18 mm (IMA38), with the main body located within the lung parenchyma.

source_text: 纵隔4、6、7、10组多发淋巴结增大较前相仿，较大仍约20x10mm（IM31)
text_en: Mediastinal groups 4, 6, 7, and 10 show multiple enlarged lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest still approximately 20x10 mm (IM31).

source_text: 肝内多发低密度灶、左侧肾上腺小结节同前
text_en: Multiple low-density hepatic lesions and left adrenal small nodule unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右上肺少许索条影较前相仿，余肺内散在小结节同前
text_en: Minimal linear opacity in the right upper lung is similar to prior; scattered small nodules in the remainder of the lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 转移可能大，追查
text_en: Probable metastasis; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 纵隔、双锁骨上散在小淋巴结大致同前，短径仍小于10mm
text_en: Scattered small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral supraclavicular regions are roughly similar to prior, with short axes still less than 10 mm.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结较前相仿，如原约12x8mm（IM24）者现同前
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are similar in size compared to previous, as exemplified by one measuring approximately 12x8 mm (IM24) which remains unchanged.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段支气管壁略显增厚同前， 支气管周片絮影较前范围增大，密度增高，边界较前清晰，现范围约17x12mm（IM26），原约13x7mm（IM28）
text_en: Mild thickening of the bronchial wall in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe, unchanged from previous, with peribronchial patchy opacities increased in extent and density, with sharper borders compared to previous; current extent approximately 17x12 mm (IM26), previously approximately 13x7 mm (IM28).

source_text: 左肺上叶下舌段支气管截断，局部软组织结节明显缩小，原约28x23mm，现短径约11mm（IM25），长径与肺不张无法区分，远端肺组织膨胀不全范围缩小
text_en: The bronchial cutoff in the lower lingular segment of the left upper lobe persists; the local soft tissue nodule has markedly decreased in size, previously measuring approximately 28 x 23 mm, now with a short axis of approximately 11 mm (IM25); the long axis cannot be distinguished from atelectasis, and the extent of distal lung underexpansion has decreased.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见异常，双肺少许索条影、左肺下叶类结节影（IM35）同前，双肺未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no abnormality is seen at the bronchial stump. Minimal linear bands in both lungs and a nodule-like opacity in the left lower lobe (IM35) remain unchanged. No new nodules or consolidations are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶、右肺中叶和双肺下叶胸膜下多发结节大致同前（IM21，33，43、44），较大约5mm
text_en: Multiple subpleural nodules in the right upper lobe, right middle lobe, and bilateral lower lobes are essentially unchanged (IM21, 33, 43, 44), largest approximately 5 mm.

source_text: 右下肺索条影同前，左下肺少许稍高密度模糊片絮影稍多，余双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: The linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior. There is a slight increase in the number of faintly increased-density, ill-defined patchy opacities in the left lower lobe. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 新见分叶状软组织
text_en: Newly identified lobulated soft tissue mass

source_text: 肝内多发低密度无强化结节同前，结合腹部检查
text_en: Multiple non-enhancing low-density hepatic nodules unchanged from prior; correlate with abdominal imaging.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上淋巴结同前，仍约10x9mm（IMA5）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node unchanged, still approximately 10x9 mm (IMA5)

source_text: 右肺下叶后基底段近胸膜处结节同前，现仍约21x12mm（IM37），邻近局局限性肺气肿同前
text_en: Nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe near the pleura is unchanged, currently measuring approximately 21 x 12 mm (IM37); adjacent focal emphysema remains unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段新见小簇2-4mm微小结节（IM35-37），炎性
text_en: Newly detected small cluster of 2-4 mm micronodules in the right upper lobe posterior segment (IM35-37); inflammatory in nature.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段孤立小结节同前，追查
text_en: Solitary small nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 左肺内局限性纤维化条索影同前相仿，余双肺未见新生结节及实变影
text_en: Localized fibrotic linear opacity in left lung unchanged from previous, no new nodules or consolidation in remaining bilateral lungs.

source_text: 纵隔右侧气管食管沟小淋巴结同前（IM11），双侧肺门见淋巴结，较大约16x11mm（Im34）
text_en: Small lymph node in the right paratracheal groove of the mediastinum, same as before (IM11); lymph nodes seen in bilateral hila, largest approximately 16x11mm (Im34).

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节同前相仿
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule similar to prior

source_text: 右肺索条同前，余肺未见新生结节或实变影
text_en: Linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior; no new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺磨玻璃小结节同前
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lung is unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 右上肺和左下肺结节同前，仍约4mm（IM28、45）
text_en: Nodules in the right upper lung and left lower lung are unchanged, still measuring approximately 4 mm (IM28, 45).

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，较大短径约10mm（IM12）
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, largest short axis approximately 10 mm (IM12).

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段软组织密度结节同前，仍约15x10mm（IM52）
text_en: Left lower lobe basal segment soft tissue density nodule unchanged from prior, still approximately 15x10 mm (IM52)

source_text: 纵隔内小淋巴结大致同前，未见明显异常肿大者
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes essentially unchanged from prior, no significant lymphadenopathy seen.

source_text: 右肺部分结节较前增大，如下叶背段结节现约4mm（IM26），原约2mm
text_en: Some nodules in the right lung are slightly larger than before; for example, a nodule in the dorsal segment of the lower lobe now measures approximately 4 mm (IM26), previously about 2 mm.

source_text: 纵隔及左锁骨上小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and left supraclavicular region unchanged from previous.

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后，未见复发征象
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, no evidence of recurrence.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见新发肿大淋巴结
text_en: No new enlarged lymph nodes seen in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular regions, and bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 右肺叶间胸膜下小结节大致同前，约8mm（IM28）
text_en: A small nodule beneath the interlobar pleura of the right lung is roughly unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 8 mm (IM28).

source_text: 前纵隔结节同前，淋巴结可能
text_en: Nodule in the anterior mediastinum is stable compared to prior; lymph node origin is possible.

source_text: 右膈下小结节灶较前略缩小，原约15x8mm（IM67），现约15x5mm（IM62）
text_en: The small subdiaphragmatic nodule on the right is slightly smaller than before, previously measuring approximately 15x8 mm (IM67), now approximately 15x5 mm (IM62).

source_text: 右肺上叶微小结节同前，＜5mm（图14）
text_en: Right upper lobe micro-nodule unchanged, <5 mm (Figure 14)

source_text: 双肺散在结节灶大致同前
text_en: Scattered nodules in both lungs are largely unchanged from prior.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺双叶多发结节影同前（IM5）
text_en: Multiple nodules are seen in bilateral thyroid lobes, stable compared to prior (IM5).

source_text: 右肺散在小结节同前（Im16、34、42等）同前，双肺未见新生结节或及斑片影
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right lung are unchanged (Im16, 34, 42, etc.) compared to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 余肺未见新增结节灶或实变影
text_en: The remainder of the lungs shows no new nodules or consolidation.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后改变同前，右肺下叶支气管后方结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lower lobe unchanged compared to prior; nodule posterior to the right lower lobe bronchus unchanged, recommend follow-up.

source_text: 上纵隔气管旁、食管旁、纵隔6区、右肺门可见多发增大淋巴结同前相仿，较大约11x8mm（IM33）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the upper mediastinal paratracheal, esophageal, mediastinal zone 6, and right hilar regions similar to prior; largest approximately 11x8 mm (IM33)

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端周围软组织影增厚，左侧纵隔旁、胸膜及胸膜下多发结节及肿块较前缩小，原较大约40x38mm，现约24x20mm（IMA13），左侧极少量胸水基本消失
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, soft tissue thickening around the bronchial stump; multiple nodules and masses adjacent to the left mediastinum, pleura, and subpleura are smaller than prior, previously approximately 40x38 mm, now approximately 24x20 mm (IMA13); left minimal pleural effusion nearly resolved.

source_text: 双肺散在多发小结节大致同前，较大者仍约6mm（IM16）
text_en: Scattered multiple small nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged, the largest still measuring approximately 6 mm (IM16).

source_text: 左肺上叶结节较前稍增大且密度变实，倾向恶性，请结合临床
text_en: Nodule in the left upper lobe slightly increased in size and density became solid, suggestive of malignancy.

source_text: 右肺微结节同前（IMA75）
text_en: Right lung micro-nodule unchanged compared to prior (IMA75)

source_text: 双肺多发小结节灶大致同前
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are roughly unchanged.

source_text: 左上胸膜结节样增厚较前同前，现约18x10mm（IM8），邻近肺内见少许类结节影（IM8-10）
text_en: Nodular pleural thickening in the left upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, currently measuring approximately 18x10 mm (IM8); a few small nodular opacities are seen in the adjacent lung parenchyma (IM8-10).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，右肺中叶小结节影同前，仍约7mm（IM39），边缘模糊，密度欠均匀同前，内部可疑点状钙化同前
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, a small nodule in the right middle lobe similar to prior, still approximately 7 mm (IM39), ill-defined margins, inhomogeneous density similar to prior, suspicious punctate calcification similar to prior.

source_text: 纵隔、锁骨上、腋下、右侧心膈角多发淋巴结同前，较大仍约14x11mm（IM23）
text_en: Mediastinal, supraclavicular, axillary, and right cardiophrenic angle multiple lymph nodes unchanged from prior; largest still approximately 14x11 mm (IM23).

source_text: 左肺下叶模糊小结节影同前（IM38、39）
text_en: Left lower lobe indistinct small nodule stable compared to prior (IM38, 39).

source_text: 左肺下叶背段术后，左肺下叶基底段结节影同前，倾向术后改变，复查
text_en: Postoperative status in the left lower lobe dorsal segment; nodular opacity in the left lower lobe basal segment unchanged from previous, favored to be postoperative change, with recommendation for follow-up.

source_text: 左肺癌术后，左肺门淋巴结略显饱满大致同前，建议追查
text_en: After left lung cancer surgery, left hilar lymph nodes are slightly prominent, similar to previous, recommend follow-up.

source_text: 部分结节较前相仿，如右肺钙化及上叶（IM19）、中叶（IM38）小结节灶
text_en: Some nodules are similar to previous; for example, calcifications and small nodular foci in the right upper lobe (IM19) and middle lobe (IM38).

source_text: 右肺下叶后基底段椭圆形结节大致同前，约33x25mm(IM42)
text_en: The oval-shaped nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 33x25 mm (IM42).

source_text: 脾脏多发低密度结节同前
text_en: Multiple low-density nodules within the spleen unchanged from previous

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结稍缩小，原约11x9mm，现约9x7mm（IM25）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes slightly reduced in size, previously approximately 11x9 mm, now approximately 9x7 mm (IM25)

source_text: 左肺下叶肺门旁磨玻璃密度结节同前，仍倾向恶性，建议结合临床
text_en: Left lower lobe hilar ground-glass opacity nodule unchanged, still suggestive of malignancy; recommend correlation with clinical findings.

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门淋巴结较前缩小，7组较大原约21x16mm（IMA27），现约19x15mm（IM27），追查
text_en: Mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes are decreased in size compared to previous, with station 7 largest previously measuring approximately 21x16 mm (IMA27) and now measuring approximately 19x15 mm (IM27), follow-up

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约20x11mm（IM22）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged, the largest approximately 20x11 mm (IM22).

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜模糊结节样增厚同前（IM19）
text_en: Indistinct nodular thickening of the left interlobar pleura is stable (IM19).

source_text: 食管胸中下段交界区管壁不均匀增厚及强化较前明显，现较厚处约12mm(图32)，原约8mm（IM37），部分层面与主动脉间脂肪间隙消失，接触面小于90°
text_en: In the junctional region of the middle-lower thoracic esophagus, the wall demonstrates uneven thickening and enhancement, more prominent than prior. Current maximum thickness is approximately 12 mm (Fig 32), previously 8 mm (IM37). In some sections, the fat plane between the esophagus and aorta is absent, with contact surface less than 90 degrees.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜小结节同前（IM36）
text_en: Small nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior (IM36).

source_text: 左肺下叶散在结节影同前，较大约5mm（IM48）
text_en: Scattered nodular shadows in the left lower lobe unchanged from prior, largest approximately 5 mm (IM48)

source_text: 右肺门及纵隔多发淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes at the right hilum and mediastinum are unchanged from prior, all less than 10 mm

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，约5mm（IM49）
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM49).

source_text: 甲状腺左右叶多发低密度结节同前
text_en: Multiple low-density nodules in the left and right thyroid lobes, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段及右肺下叶前基底段病灶较前缩小
text_en: Lesions in the right upper lobe apical segment and right lower lobe anterior basal segment decreased in size compared to prior

source_text: 纵隔隆突下新见肿大淋巴结，与食管病变融合分界不清，短径约18mm（IMA30）
text_en: Enlarged lymph node newly seen in subcarinal region, fused with esophageal lesion with indistinct margins, short axis diameter approximately 18mm (IMA30).

source_text: 纵隔多个小淋巴结同前相仿，平扫密度较高，较大约17x6mm（IM27），良性可能大，随诊观察
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes similar to prior, higher density on non-contrast scan, largest approximately 17x6 mm (IM27), likely benign, follow-up observation

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，仍约12mm（Im23），建议12月后复查
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is similar to the prior study, still measuring approximately 12 mm (Im23); follow-up in 12 months is recommended.

source_text: 未见新增结节灶及斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities

source_text: 右上纵隔内见数枚圆形淋巴结同前，大者约11x10mm（Im11），双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Several round lymph nodes in the right upper mediastinum are unchanged, the largest measuring approximately 11x10 mm (Im11); no enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the bilateral hila, supraclavicular regions, or axillae.

source_text: 食管癌术后颈部吻合，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Postoperative esophageal cancer with cervical anastomosis; no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 甲状腺左叶圆形低密度结节同前相仿
text_en: Thyroid left lobe round low-density nodule same as prior.

source_text: 余双肺多发结节部分同前，部分较前密度增高，现较大者如左肺上叶结节，现约9*9mm实性结节（IM23），原呈磨玻璃样改变，约12x10mm（IM23）
text_en: Residual multiple nodules in both lungs are partially unchanged; some show increased density; the largest currently is a solid nodule in the left upper lobe measuring approximately 9x9 mm (IM23), previously ground-glass in appearance and measuring approximately 12x10 mm (IM23)

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，较大约9mm（IM23），平扫密度略高
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, the largest approximately 9mm (IM23), on non-contrast scan density slightly increased.

source_text: 左肺上叶周围型肺癌较前增大
text_en: Peripheral lung cancer in the left upper lobe has increased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 右肺上叶索条影、左肺钙化灶同前，右肺浅淡微小结节影同前（IMA19、31）
text_en: Linear opacities in the right upper lobe and calcifications in the left lung are unchanged compared to prior; faint, tiny nodules in the right lung are also unchanged (IMA19, 31)

source_text: 右肺下叶结节大致同前，大小约12x10mm（IM36）
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is approximately unchanged, measuring about 12x10 mm (IM36).

source_text: 右肺胸膜下微小结节同前(IM28)
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior (IM28).

source_text: 右上肺、左下肺微结节同前相仿（IM45、87）
text_en: Micronodules in the right upper lung and left lower lung are similar to prior (IM45, 87).

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺结节大致同前
text_en: Left adrenal nodule essentially unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶结节灶消失，索条同前
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe has disappeared; the linear opacity is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺中叶、左肺下叶小结节同前（IM31、38、58），较大约6mm
text_en: Small nodules in the right middle lobe and left lower lobe unchanged (IM31, 38, 58), largest measuring approximately 6 mm

source_text: 前纵隔少许软组织影同前（IM20），未见增厚或结节
text_en: Minimal soft tissue density in the anterior mediastinum is stable compared to prior (IM20), without thickening or nodules.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，约3mm（IM54）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IM54).

source_text: 纵隔、双锁骨上区及双腋下多个小淋巴结同前，较大短径仍约7mm(IM20)
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum, bilateral supraclavicular regions, and bilateral axillary regions are unchanged from prior. The largest short axis still measures approximately 7 mm (IM20).

source_text: 左肺上叶模糊结节同前相仿
text_en: Left upper lobe hazy nodule similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段分叶状肿块较前相仿，约34x31mm（IM23），内部密度不均，含气支气管及空泡征表现大致同前
text_en: Lobulated mass in the right lower lobe posterior segment is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 34x31 mm (IM23), with heterogeneous internal density; air bronchograms and bubble-like lucencies are essentially unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，较大约16x7mm(IM19)
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, largest approximately 16x7 mm (IM19)

source_text: 右腋窝淋巴结同前，现仍约16x15mm（IM13）
text_en: Right axillary lymph node unchanged from prior, currently still measuring approximately 16x15 mm (IM13).

source_text: 新见散在小结节
text_en: Newly seen scattered small nodules

source_text: 左锁骨上区见散在小淋巴结同前相仿，较大仍约12x7mm（IM7）
text_en: Left supraclavicular scattered small lymph nodes similar to prior, largest still approximately 12 x 7 mm (IM7)

source_text: 两肺索条影同前，未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Linear opacities in both lungs are stable; no new nodules or consolidations are seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶钙化同前，余双肺未见新发结节及片絮影
text_en: Calcification in the right upper lobe is unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 甲状腺左叶结节及钙化灶同前
text_en: Thyroid left lobe nodule and calcification same as prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶占位较前略缩小
text_en: The mass in the right upper lobe is slightly smaller than prior.

source_text: 纵隔内5组低密度结节同前，约为30x12mm（IM21）
text_en: A low-density nodule at mediastinal station 5 is unchanged from previous, measuring approximately 30x12 mm (IM21).

source_text: 扫及肝右叶顶部见低密度小结节同前(图42)
text_en: CT shows a small low-density nodule at the superior aspect of the right lobe of the liver unchanged from previous (Figure 42).

source_text: 肺内陈旧病变同前，CT平扫未见新生占位
text_en: Intrapulmonary old lesions unchanged from previous, non-contrast CT shows no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 肺门及纵隔多组淋巴结区不规则钙化灶同前
text_en: Irregular calcifications in multiple hilar and mediastinal lymph node groups unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺术后改变，局部索条影同前，支气管残端未见异常增厚及肿物，双肺支气管通畅，肺内透亮度均匀，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Findings of prior right lung surgery; local linear opacities are unchanged, and the bronchial stump shows no abnormal thickening or mass. Bilateral bronchi are patent, lung parenchyma shows uniform lucency, and no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 双肺下叶小斑片、小结节影同前（IMA37、42、48、52）
text_en: Small patchy opacities and small nodules in the lower lobes of both lungs are unchanged compared to prior (IMA37, 42, 48, 52).

source_text: 右上肺见结节，约18mm，考虑转移
text_en: Nodule in the right upper lobe, approximately 18 mm, suggestive of metastasis.

source_text: 双肺下叶小结节同前，考虑良性
text_en: Small nodules in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior, considered benign.

source_text: 纵隔、左锁骨上散在小淋巴结同前，短径仍小于10mm
text_en: Scattered small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and left supraclavicular region are unchanged from prior, with short axes still less than 10 mm

source_text: 余纵隔淋巴结较前相仿
text_en: The remaining mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，平扫支气管断端未见确切复发征象
text_en: Following right upper lobectomy, no definite recurrence is seen at the bronchial stump on non-contrast imaging.

source_text: 余肺内未见新发结节及异常密度区
text_en: No new nodules or abnormal densities are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段微小结节同前（Im24）
text_en: The micro-nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged from prior (Im24).

source_text: 余双肺未见新发异常密度区及结节灶
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no new abnormal density or nodules.

source_text: 右肺下叶切除术后，支气管断端未见软组织密度增厚，左肺下叶多发微结节同前，较大现仍约5mm（IM26），余双肺内未见结节或实变影
text_en: Post right lower lobectomy, no soft tissue thickening is seen at the bronchial stump; multiple tiny nodules in the left lower lobe are unchanged, the largest still approximately 5 mm (IM26); no nodules or consolidation are seen elsewhere in the lungs.

source_text: 余肺未见新发结节或实变
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 新见肿大淋巴结
text_en: newly identified enlarged lymph node

source_text: 纵隔7组高密度灶较前缩小，原约25x17mm（IM27），现约21x15mm（IM30），术后改变可能，追查
text_en: The high-density focus in mediastinal station 7 has decreased in size compared to prior, from approximately 25x17 mm (IM27) to 21x15 mm (IM30), possible postoperative change, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 甲状腺内多发低密度结节大致同前，边界欠清
text_en: Multiple low-density nodules within the thyroid gland essentially unchanged from prior, with ill-defined margins.

source_text: 扫及胸11椎体斑片致密灶同前，余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Scans show a patchy dense lesion in the T11 vertebra, unchanged from prior; no signs of bone destruction in the remaining thoracic cage bones.

source_text: 两肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: No new nodules seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶及左肺下叶多发类圆形微小结节同前，仍约2mm（IM18、21、22、44）
text_en: Multiple small, round micro-nodules in the right upper lobe and left lower lobe are stable compared to prior, remaining approximately 2 mm (IM18, 21, 22, 44).

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节影同前（IMA14），余肺未见新发结节影
text_en: The small nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged (IMA14), with no new nodules in the remainder of the lung.

source_text: 纵隔4、7组小淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal stations 4 and 7 small lymph nodes unchanged from prior

source_text: 两肺多发微小结节同前（IM41）
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in both lungs unchanged from prior (IM41)

source_text: 右肺下叶背段结节影缩小，大小原约25x23mm(IM29)，现约23x17mm（IM27），增强扫描强化，病灶与叶间裂分界不清
text_en: The nodular opacity in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe has decreased in size, previously measuring approximately 25x23 mm (IM29), now approximately 23x17 mm (IM27). Enhancement is observed on contrast-enhanced scanning. The lesion has indistinct demarcation from the interlobar fissure.

source_text: 余肺散在索条及致密小结节同前，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Scattered linear opacities and dense small nodules in the remaining lung are stable. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 甲状腺右侧叶结节同前，性质待定
text_en: Nodule in the right thyroid lobe unchanged from prior, nature indeterminate.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下微小结节影同前（4-IMA58）
text_en: The tiny subpleural nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged (4-IMA58).

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，短径小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, short diameter less than 10mm.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结饱满同前相仿，追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes enlarged similar to previous, further investigation.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段气管旁结节较前相仿，现仍约18x16mm（IM33）
text_en: The paratracheal nodule in the right lower lobe dorsal segment is similar to prior, still approximately 18x16 mm (IM33).

source_text: 左肺下叶微小致密结节同前，2-3mm（IM47、49、57）
text_en: Left lower lobe small solid nodule unchanged, 2-3 mm (IM47, 49, 57).

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结同前，仍现约12x7mm(IM27)
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes unchanged from previous, still approximately 12x7 mm (IM27).

source_text: 两肺下叶索条影同前，两肺点状结节影同前（IM24）
text_en: Linear opacities in both lower lobes are unchanged. Punctate nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged from prior (IM24).

source_text: 双下肺胸膜下小结节及左侧叶间胸膜结节较前相仿（IM26、27、43、49）
text_en: Subpleural small nodules in the bilateral lower lungs and a nodule in the left interlobar fissure are similar to prior (IM26, 27, 43, 49).

source_text: 扫及胸部诸骨未见骨质破坏
text_en: CT scan shows no evidence of bone destruction in the bones of the chest.

source_text: 左叶裂膜小结节、左肺下叶、右肺下叶结节同前，约2mm（IM30、44、48）
text_en: Small nodules in the left interlobar pleura, left lower lobe, and right lower lobe unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 2 mm (IM30, 44, 48).

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结较前相仿，仍约16*8mm（IM24）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are similar to previous, still approximately 16x8 mm (IM24).

source_text: 左侧甲状腺低密度结节同前，请结合超声检查
text_en: Left thyroid low-density nodule unchanged; correlate with ultrasound examination.

source_text: 左肺下叶斜裂旁4mm结节较前相仿（IM33）
text_en: 4mm nodule adjacent to the oblique fissure in the left lower lobe is similar to previous (IM33).

source_text: 右肺中叶切除术后，肺内少许陈旧灶同前，胸部CT平扫未见新生占位
text_en: Postoperative changes after right middle lobectomy. A few old pulmonary foci are unchanged. No new space-occupying lesions are seen on non-contrast chest CT.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下结节较前增大，较大者现约8x6mm（IM24），原约7x3mm（IM19）
text_en: The subpleural nodule in the right lung is larger than before, with the largest now measuring approximately 8x6 mm (IM24), previously about 7x3 mm (IM19).

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节灶同前（Im53）
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe, same as before (Image 53).

source_text: 右肺上叶部分切除术后，局部金属缝线、斑片索条影同前，未见明显肿块影
text_en: Status post partial resection of the right upper lobe. Local metallic suture clips and patchy linear opacities are stable. No obvious mass is seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，约9x6mm（IM23），下叶基底段胸膜下模糊小结节同前（IM38）
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to the prior study, measuring approximately 9 x 6 mm (IM23). The subpleural indistinct small nodule in the basal segment of the lower lobe is unchanged (IM38).

source_text: 右肾上腺结节同前，约15x10mm（IM60），密切追查
text_en: Right adrenal nodule is stable, measuring approximately 15x10 mm (IM60); close follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶4mm结节同前（IM15）
text_en: 4 mm nodule in the right upper lobe unchanged (IM15).

source_text: 纵隔2R小淋巴结同前，仍约8x6mm（IM13）
text_en: A small mediastinal lymph node at station 2R is unchanged compared to prior, still approximately 8x6 mm (IM13).

source_text: 两肺小结节影大致同前
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs generally similar to prior

source_text: 左肺上叶前段及右肺上叶后段不规则软组织密度结节大致同前，仍约24x18mm、23x17mm（Im18、22），周围斑片状磨玻璃密度大致同前
text_en: Irregular soft tissue density nodules in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe and posterior segment of the right upper lobe are stable compared to prior, still measuring approximately 24x18 mm and 23x17 mm (Im18, 22), with surrounding patchy ground-glass density stable.

source_text: 双肺透亮度减低，左肺新见微小结节（IM17，33)，右下肺见6mm大小不规则结节（IM33)，邻近见索条影，追查
text_en: Decreased lucency in both lungs; a new tiny nodule is seen in the left lung (IM17, 33); a 6 mm irregular nodule is seen in the right lower lobe (IM33), with adjacent linear opacities; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 纵隔6组淋巴结较前缩小，原约13*9mm(IM24)，现约6x5mm（IM24）
text_en: Mediastinal station 6 lymph nodes are reduced in size compared to previous, previously approximately 13x9 mm (Image 24), currently approximately 6x5 mm (Image 24)

source_text: 右肺上叶浅淡小结节影、右肺下叶斑片影同前（IMA27、41）双肺未见新增结节影
text_en: Faint small nodule in the right upper lobe and patchy opacity in the right lower lobe are unchanged compared to prior (IMA27, 41). No new nodules are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 双侧锁骨上、纵隔多组淋巴结部分较前缩小，现约10x5mm（IM12）灶原约16x12mm（IM12）
text_en: Several lymph nodes in the bilateral supraclavicular and mediastinal regions are partially decreased in size compared to prior; the largest is now approximately 10x5 mm (IM12), previously about 16x12 mm (IM12).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段结节影同前，仍约13x12mm（IM16），边界清晰
text_en: The nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe is unchanged, still measuring approximately 13x12 mm (IM16), with well-defined margins.

source_text: 两肺索条影及左肺下叶小结节影同前，约6mm（IM53）
text_en: Linear opacities in both lungs and a small nodule in the left lower lobe are stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM53).

source_text: 食管胸中下段管壁不均匀增厚较前略进展，原较厚约6mm（IM27），现较厚约9mm（IM24），管腔未见明显狭窄，外膜模糊，与食道旁肿大淋巴结分界不清，同胸主动脉接触面小于90度
text_en: The uneven wall thickening of the mid-to-lower thoracic esophagus shows slight progression compared to prior, with the thickest portion previously measuring approximately 6 mm (IM27) and now approximately 9 mm (IM24). The lumen shows no significant narrowing, the outer membrane is blurred, the boundary with adjacent enlarged lymph nodes is indistinct, and the contact surface with the thoracic aorta is less than 90 degrees

source_text: 平扫甲状腺低密度结节影同前
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows a low-density nodule in the thyroid, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 甲状腺左叶圆形低密度结节同前，大小约33x36mm（IM9)
text_en: Thyroid left lobe round low-density nodule same as prior, size approximately 33x36 mm (IM9).

source_text: 右肺中叶浅淡小结节同前，约4mm（IM32）
text_en: Faint small nodule in the right middle lobe unchanged, approximately 4 mm (IM32)

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右肺尖少许索条斑片灶，右肺结节基本同前（IM19、21、29、36），左肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. Minor linear and patchy opacities are seen at the right lung apex. The right lung nodules are essentially unchanged (IM19, 21, 29, 36). No nodules or consolidation are seen in the left lung.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4组及右肺门多发淋巴结同前，较大约22x11mm（IM22）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R and 4 and right hilar region are unchanged from previous; the largest is approximately 22x11 mm (IM22)

source_text: 双肺病变及纵隔、肺门淋巴结同前相仿
text_en: Pulmonary abnormalities and mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes are similar to prior.

source_text: 双下肺散在小结节数目同前，部分大小同前，如左下肺结节现约17x14mm（IM48）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the bilateral lower lungs are unchanged in number; some are similar in size to prior. The nodule in the left lower lung now measures approximately 17x14 mm (IM48).

source_text: 双肺弥漫结节部分较前稍大，如原约5mm空洞结节（IM36），现约7mm（IM34）
text_en: Some of the diffusely distributed nodules in both lungs are slightly larger than prior; for example, a cavitary nodule previously measuring about 5 mm (IM36) now measures about 7 mm (IM34).

source_text: 食管术后，右侧锁骨上小淋巴结同前
text_en: Post-esophagectomy. Small right supraclavicular lymph node unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右侧第1肋及胸3椎体新见骨质破坏灶，考虑骨转移
text_en: New bony destruction foci are seen in the right 1st rib and thoracic 3 vertebra, suggestive of bone metastasis.

source_text: 左下肺膨胀不全较前稍减轻，左肺未见新发结节
text_en: Atelectasis in the left lower lobe is slightly improved compared to prior. No new nodules are seen in the left lung.

source_text: 双肺多发微小点灶结节大致同前（IM9、14、22、29、35）
text_en: Multiple tiny punctate nodules in both lungs are roughly unchanged (IM9, 14, 22, 29, 35).

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R、右肺门多发肿大淋巴结较前略缩小，现较大约20*15mm(图23)，原约25x15mm（IM24）
text_en: Multiple enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R and 4R and right hilar lymph nodes are slightly decreased in size compared to prior; the largest currently measures approximately 20x15 mm (Fig. 23) versus 25x15 mm (Image 24) previously.

source_text: 右肺上叶模糊小结节影同前，大小约4mm（IM24），余肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: Indistinct small nodule in the right upper lobe, stable, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM24). No nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃结节较前增大，建议追查
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe has increased in size compared to prior; further investigation is recommended.

source_text: 双肺未见新发结节灶或斑片影
text_en: No new nodular foci or patchy opacities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结较前相仿，现约13x9mm（IM21），随诊观察
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are similar to previous, currently approximately 13x9 mm (IM21), follow-up observation.

source_text: 双肺下叶基底段新见多发片絮状磨玻璃密度影，边缘模糊，倾向炎症，建议抗炎后复查，余双肺未见新发结节
text_en: Newly noted multiple patchy ground-glass opacities in the basal segments of both lower lobes, with blurred margins, likely inflammatory; follow-up after anti-inflammatory treatment is recommended. No new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶微结节同前，直径约3mm（IM22）
text_en: Right upper lobe micro-nodule unchanged, approximately 3 mm in diameter (IM22).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段浅淡索条影较前模糊（IM34），余双肺索条及模糊斑点状结节影大致同前
text_en: Faint linear opacities in the right upper lobe posterior segment are more indistinct (IM34). The remainder of the bilateral lung linear opacities and indistinct punctate nodular opacities are largely unchanged.

source_text: 双肺小结节灶同前，建议随访复查
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodule foci are stable compared to prior, follow-up recommended

source_text: 左肺下叶背段结节较前相仿
text_en: Left lower lobe posterior segment nodule similar to prior.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结部分较前略减小，原较大者约12x10mm，现较大约8x8mm（IM22）
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes have slightly decreased in size compared to previous; the largest previously measured approximately 12x10 mm, now approximately 8x8 mm (IM22).

source_text: 纵隔4R、7、9组淋巴结同前，较大约15x9mm（IM29）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R, 7, and 9 are similar to prior, with the largest approximately 15x9mm (IM29).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段气管旁结节较前相仿，现仍约18x15mm（IM32）
text_en: The paratracheal nodule in the right lower lobe dorsal segment is similar to prior, still approximately 18x15 mm (IM32).

source_text: 纵隔及左锁骨上多发小淋巴结较前相仿，较大者位于4L组，现约11x7mm（IM20），原约10x8mm
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and left supraclavicular region similar to previous, the largest located in station 4L, currently approximately 11x7mm (IM20), previously approximately 10x8mm.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺右叶低密度结节大致同前
text_en: Imaging shows a low-density nodule in the right lobe of the thyroid, essentially unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔6组淋巴结较前增大，现约13*9mm(图24)，原约7*6mm(图24)，转移
text_en: Mediastinal station 6 lymph nodes increased in size compared to previous, currently approximately 13x9 mm (Figure 24), previously approximately 7x6 mm (Figure 24), metastasis.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段模玻璃密度类结节影（IM14）及前段胸膜下微小结节（IM15）同前，两肺未见新生结节影
text_en: Ground-glass density nodular-like shadow in the apical segment of the right upper lobe (IM14) and a subpleural tiny nodule in the anterior segment (IM15) are unchanged; no new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 双肺新见多发结节，较大者约24x19mm（IM48），右肺可见散在条片状影较前减少
text_en: Newly noted multiple nodules in both lungs, the largest measuring approximately 24x19 mm (IM48); scattered linear and patchy opacities in the right lung are decreased compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺散在模糊小结节大致同前(图28、39)
text_en: Scattered indistinct small nodules in the left lung largely unchanged (Fig. 28, 39)

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，短径＜10mm
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, short axis < 10 mm.

source_text: 纵隔4R肿大淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R enlarged lymph node unchanged from prior, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前（Im21、28）
text_en: Tiny nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior (Im21, 28).

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段、左肺结节部分增大，现较大约12x8mm（IM38）者，原约10x5mm（IM36）
text_en: Some nodules in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe and the left lung have increased in size; the largest now measures approximately 12x8 mm (IM38), previously approximately 10x5 mm (IM36).

source_text: 未见骨转移
text_en: No bone metastases seen

source_text: 左肺下叶5mm小结节同前（IM56）
text_en: 5mm small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (IM56).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段结节同前，约18x13mm（IM23）
text_en: The nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 18x13 mm (IM23).

source_text: 食管癌术后，纵隔未见积气，右侧胸腔上部少量胸水较前减少
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer, no pneumomediastinum in the mediastinum, small amount of pleural effusion in the upper right pleural cavity decreased compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶、右肺中叶及下叶仍见少许索条影，左肺下叶钙化灶同前，余肺未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: Minimal linear opacities persist in the left upper lobe, right middle lobe, and right lower lobe. Calcified foci in the left lower lobe are unchanged. No new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜旁及左肺上叶前段两枚磨玻璃密度结节同前，分别约4mm（IM36）、7mm（Im31），结节内未见确切实性成分，其边缘光滑，周围未见索条影
text_en: Two ground-glass opacity nodules adjacent to the pleura in the right upper lobe and anterior segment of the left upper lobe remain unchanged, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM36) and 7 mm (IM31), respectively; no definite solid component is seen within the nodules, their margins are smooth, and no surrounding linear opacities are present.

source_text: 右肺门、左侧锁骨上区淋巴结同前，较大仍约12x8mm（IMA26）
text_en: Lymph nodes at the right hilum and left supraclavicular region are unchanged from prior; the largest remains approximately 12 x 8 mm (IMA26).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段软组织肿物较前略缩小，现约23x18mm（IM23），原为25x20mm（IM22），累及前纵隔胸膜同前
text_en: A soft tissue mass in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe is slightly decreased in size compared to previous, currently approximately 23x18 mm (IM23) versus previously 25x20 mm (IM22), with unchanged involvement of the anterior mediastinal pleura.

source_text: 余肺内未见明显新增异常结节及实变影
text_en: No obvious new abnormal nodules or consolidations are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下模糊小结节同前，大小约4mm（IM26）
text_en: Indistinct small subpleural nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM26).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变同前，胸部CT未见新增占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lobe are unchanged; chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesion

source_text: 双肺下叶小结节消失，余肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Small nodules in both lower lobes have disappeared; no new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔、双侧锁骨上及腋窝多发淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal, bilateral supraclavicular, and axillary multiple lymph nodes unchanged from previous.

source_text: 双肺索条影同前，未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Linear opacities in both lungs are similar to prior. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶及中叶多发类圆形小结节同前，部分呈磨玻璃密度，较大约5mm（Im13），未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: Multiple small, round nodules in the right upper and middle lobes are stable compared to prior, some with ground-glass density; the largest measures approximately 5 mm (Im13). No new nodules or consolidation are seen.

source_text: 余肺内未见新增结节灶及斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 纵隔4、5组见小淋巴结同前，大者约17x9mm（IM21），中心脂肪密度，双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal groups 4 and 5 show small lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest approximately 17x9 mm (IM21) with central fatty density; no enlarged lymph nodes seen in bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular regions, or bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前增大
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are enlarged compared to previous.

source_text: 纵隔隆突下软组织密度区范围同前，纵隔及左锁骨上区内淋巴结同前，如气管右前方淋巴结仍约13x11mm（IM18）
text_en: Soft tissue density area in subcarinal mediastinum unchanged in size from previous; lymph nodes in mediastinum and left supraclavicular region unchanged, such as right anterior tracheal lymph node still approximately 13x11 mm (Image 18)

source_text: 左肺门淋巴结显示同前
text_en: Left hilar lymph node appears unchanged.

source_text: 右肺中下叶切除术后较前相仿，原右肺门软组织结节此次平扫边界不清，大致范围同前，仍约27x10mm（IM27），余肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Status post right middle and lower lobe resection, similar to prior. The previously noted soft tissue nodule at the right hilum is ill-defined on this non-contrast scan, with approximate dimensions unchanged at about 27x10 mm (IM27). No new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶支气管旁软组织结节较前相仿
text_en: The soft tissue nodule adjacent to the right upper lobe bronchus is similar in size compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺尖陈旧灶同前，余肺未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: Chronic foci at both lung apices are stable; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下微小结节影同前，约3mm（IM42）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural tiny nodule unchanged, approximately 3mm (Image 42)

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Right upper lobe small nodule shadow unchanged, recommend follow-up

source_text: 左腋区淋巴结较前饱满，如原约9x6mm，现约10x8mm（IM12）
text_en: Left axillary lymph node more prominent compared to previous, previously approximately 9x6 mm, currently approximately 10x8 mm (image 12).

source_text: 右下肺前侧胸壁胸膜增厚及胸膜下结节影同前（IM30）
text_en: Right lower lung anterior lateral chest wall pleural thickening and subpleural nodular opacities unchanged (IM30).

source_text: 气管左旁淋巴结同前，约11x8mm（IM10）
text_en: Left paratracheal lymph node unchanged, measuring approximately 11x8 mm (IM10).

source_text: 余肺清晰，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: The remainder of the lungs is clear, with no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 扫及肝占位大致同前，请结合腹部检查
text_en: CT shows a hepatic mass essentially unchanged from previous; please correlate with abdominal imaging.

source_text: 余双肺散在小结节同前，3-5mm，部分致密钙化
text_en: Residual scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, 3-5 mm in size; some show dense calcification

source_text: 右肺下叶不规则模糊小结节大致同前，较大约5mm（IM33）
text_en: Irregular, ill-defined small nodule in the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM33).

source_text: 双肺少许小结节同前（Im47），未见新生结节及斑片影
text_en: Few small nodules in both lungs are stable (Im47); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 右锁骨上见多个小淋巴结同前（IM4）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region, stable compared to prior (IM4)

source_text: 左肺下叶结节同前，约13x11mm(IM39)，左肺多发索条影同前
text_en: Left lower lobe nodule unchanged from previous, approximately 13x11 mm (IM39); multiple linear opacities in left lung unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右上肺术后，支气管残端少许软组织密度改变同前，未见明确肿块
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lung; slight soft tissue density change at the bronchial stump is unchanged; no definite mass is seen.

source_text: 双肺散在磨玻璃样结节及左肺下叶小结节同前性质待定，建议追查
text_en: Scattered ground-glass nodules in both lungs and a small nodule in the left lower lobe are unchanged in nature. Indeterminate. Recommend follow-up.

source_text: 左锁骨上及纵隔见多发小淋巴结大致同前，左锁骨上大者约6x4mm（IM5）
text_en: Left supraclavicular and mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes essentially unchanged from previous, largest in left supraclavicular approximately 6x4mm (IM5).

source_text: 左侧斜裂胸膜小结节同前
text_en: Small nodule along the left major fissure pleura is unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺陈旧结核灶同前，未见新生结节
text_en: Chronic tuberculous foci in both lungs are unchanged from prior; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 左肺上叶、右肺中叶微小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Tiny nodules in the left upper lobe and right middle lobe are stable compared to prior; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段多发小结节呈树芽状分布较前相仿
text_en: Left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment: multiple small nodules with tree-in-bud distribution similar to prior.

source_text: 纵隔及右侧锁骨上区多发淋巴结，大致同前
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right supraclavicular region are largely unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺尖及右肺下叶结节大致同前，仍约3mm（IM20、22、43、47、56）
text_en: The nodules at the right lung apex and right lower lobe are stable compared to prior, still measuring approximately 3 mm (IM20, 22, 43, 47, 56).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖段索条小结节同前，约4mm（IM15）
text_en: A small linear nodule in the apical segment of the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior, approximately 4 mm (IM15)

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段4mm结节同前（IM9），余双肺未见新生结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: 4 mm nodule in the right upper lobe apical segment unchanged (IM9); remainder of both lungs show no new nodules or fluffy opacities

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段小结节同前，约为6mm（IM36）
text_en: The small nodule in the outer basal segment of the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM36).

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前(IM34)，右肺下叶小硬结灶同前（IM47），左肺下叶索条影同前
text_en: Tiny nodule in the left interlobar pleura is stable (IM34); small calcified focus in the right lower lobe is stable (IM47); linear opacity in the left lower lobe is stable.

source_text: 左肺下叶微小结节同前，约3mm（IM26）
text_en: Left lower lobe small nodule unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IM26).

source_text: 肺内散在微小结节部分缩小，如右肺下叶基底段者原约3mm（IM33），现约1mm（IM34），余肺多发微小结节同前（Im35-37、39、42、44等），右肺上叶钙化点同前，余肺未见新生灶
text_en: Scattered small pulmonary nodules partially decreased in size, for example, in the basal segment of the right lower lobe, originally approximately 3 mm (image 33), now approximately 1 mm (image 34); remaining multiple small nodules unchanged (images 35-37, 39, 42, 44, etc.); calcified foci in the right upper lobe unchanged; no new lesions in the remaining lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶索条影、局部结节影同前，约7x6mm（IMA45），左侧胸膜增厚、少量胸水同前
text_en: Left lower lobe fibrotic streak unchanged, local nodule unchanged approximately 7x6mm (IMA45), left pleural thickening and small pleural effusion unchanged

source_text: 纵隔平扫6组淋巴结同前相仿，约10x10mm（IM22）
text_en: Mediastinal CT without contrast shows group 6 lymph nodes similar to prior, approximately 10x10mm (IM22).

source_text: 双肺小结节较前缩小，较大原约3mm（IM24），现仅可见点状结节（IM28）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are smaller compared to prior, the largest was previously approximately 3 mm (IM24), now only a punctate nodule is visible (IM28)

source_text: 左肺下叶模糊结节大小同前，约5mm（IM19），较前变淡
text_en: Left lower lobe hazy nodule size unchanged, approximately 5 mm (IM19), less prominent than prior

source_text: 纵隔4L组淋巴结较前相仿，约14x10mm(IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4L lymph nodes similar to prior, approximately 14x10mm (image 21).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段结节同前，约7mm（IM21）
text_en: The nodule in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment is unchanged from previous, approximately 7 mm (IM21).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结大致同前，观察
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior; observation.

source_text: 右肺上叶癌术后，左下肺小结节同前，胸部未见新生占位征象
text_en: Postoperative status of right upper lobe carcinoma; small nodule in the left lower lung is unchanged; no new space-occupying lesions in the chest.

source_text: 斜裂胸膜散在小结节较前饱满，考虑转移
text_en: Scattered small nodules on the oblique fissure pleura more prominent compared to prior, suggestive of metastasis.

source_text: 右肺上叶模糊磨玻璃密度结节同前
text_en: Indistinct ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 食管癌切除术后，吻合口漏好转，右侧胸腔脓肿较前减轻，结合临床追查
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer, anastomotic leak has improved and right pleural empyema has decreased compared to prior; clinical correlation is recommended.

source_text: 左下较大者约3mm（IMA47），考虑转移，建议密切追查
text_en: Largest lesion in the left lower lobe measures approximately 3 mm (IMA47), considered likely metastatic; close follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔散在淋巴结同前，未见肿大者
text_en: Scattered mediastinal lymph nodes same as before, no enlarged ones seen.

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜结节样增厚同前（IM32）
text_en: The nodular thickening of the left interlobar pleura is unchanged compared to prior (IM32).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前略缩小，较大者原约25*10mm（IMA35），现约21x9mm（IM33）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are slightly decreased compared to previous; largest previously approximately 25x10mm (IMA35), currently approximately 21x9mm (IM33).

source_text: 余肺未见新发结节或斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 左锁骨上区新发肿大淋巴结，腹膜后肿大淋巴结增多、增大，考虑转移
text_en: Newly enlarged lymph node in left supraclavicular region, increased number and size of retroperitoneal enlarged lymph nodes, metastasis considered.

source_text: 食管胸上段壁增厚较前减轻，较厚处原约10mm（IM13），现约5mm（IM13），浆膜面较前清晰，累及上下径范围缩小
text_en: Wall thickening in the upper thoracic esophagus reduced compared to prior; previously thickest area approximately 10mm (IM13), currently approximately 5mm (IM13), serosal surface clearer than prior, involved craniocaudal extent reduced.

source_text: 右上肺可见一不规则混杂磨玻璃密度结节同前，约12mm（Im21），边缘毛刺，与相邻血管、叶间胸膜纠集
text_en: An irregular mixed ground-glass nodule in the right upper lung is unchanged, measuring approximately 12 mm (Im21), with spiculated margins and associated vascular and interlobar pleural convergence.

source_text: 右肺微结节同前（IMA21）
text_en: Right lung micro-nodule unchanged compared to prior (IMA21)

source_text: 右肺散在磨玻璃密度灶同前，较大仍约7mm（IMA25），左肺下叶结节影同前，约5mm（IMA41）
text_en: Scattered ground-glass opacities in the right lung are similar to prior, the largest still approximately 7 mm (IMA25); nodular opacities in the left lower lobe are similar to prior, approximately 5 mm (IMA41).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段结节较前稍大，原约18x15mm（Im24），现约22x14mm（IM24），边缘仍模糊
text_en: The nodule in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment is slightly larger than previous, from approximately 18x15 mm (Im24) to approximately 22x14 mm (IM24), with margins remaining indistinct.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下多发实性结节灶同前，较大约5mm（IM38）
text_en: Multiple subpleural solid nodules in the right lung are unchanged from prior, largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM38)

source_text: 左锁骨上区浅淡小淋巴结同前，仍约6x5mm（IM5）
text_en: Left supraclavicular faint small lymph node unchanged, still approximately 6x5 mm (IM5).

source_text: 右肺不规则高密度小结节同前（Im14、20、32、45）
text_en: The irregular high-density small nodule in the right lung is unchanged (Im14, 20, 32, 45).

source_text: 膈下结节影大致同前，现约23x17mm（IM45）
text_en: A subdiaphragmatic nodule is essentially unchanged, now measuring approximately 23x17 mm (IM45).

source_text: 右下肺叶结节同前
text_en: Right lower lobe nodule unchanged.

source_text: 扫及胃小弯及腹腔干旁转移淋巴结较前明显增大，请结合腹部检查
text_en: Metastatic lymph nodes along the lesser curvature of the stomach and near the celiac trunk significantly increased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 右前纵隔内肿物切除术后改变，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Postoperative changes following resection of a mass in the right anterior mediastinum; no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis are seen.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，现仍13*8mm(图36)
text_en: The right hilar lymph node is unchanged and remains 13 x 8 mm (Figure 36).

source_text: 前纵膈圆形淋巴结较前略饱满、密度增高，现约9mm（IM18），原约8mm，随诊
text_en: The round lymph node in the anterior mediastinum is slightly more prominent and increased in density compared to prior, now measuring approximately 9 mm (IM18), previously 8 mm; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃样病灶较前略增大
text_en: The ground-glass opacity lesion in the apical segment of the right upper lobe has slightly increased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前，＜5mm（IM33）
text_en: Tiny nodule in the left interlobar pleura is stable, <5 mm (IM33).

source_text: 胸部未见复发转移征象
text_en: Chest CT shows no recurrent metastatic signs.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜模糊结节同前(IM26)
text_en: Indistinct nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior (IM26).

source_text: 双肺少许微结节同前，均小于5mm
text_en: Few tiny nodules in both lungs are stable, all measuring less than 5 mm.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段小结节灶同前，约3mm（IM22）
text_en: The small nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM22).

source_text: 右肺中叶斜裂胸膜下模糊小结节同前（Im34）
text_en: Indistinct small nodule subpleural at the oblique fissure in the right middle lobe, unchanged compared to prior (Im34)

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前相仿，4组高密度淋巴结约18x12mm（IM20），7组淋巴结约23x12mm（IM25）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior; Group 4 hyperdense lymph node measures approximately 18x12 mm (IM20), Group 7 lymph node measures approximately 23x12 mm (IM25)

source_text: 左侧腋下淋巴结较前缩小，原约11x7mm，现约8x3mm（IM11），追查
text_en: Left axillary lymph node is decreased in size compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 11x7 mm, now measuring approximately 8x3 mm (IM11); further follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双肺散在多发类圆形小结节大致同前，约2-4mm，考虑肺内转移可能大，追查
text_en: Scattered multiple round small nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 2-4 mm; pulmonary metastasis is likely. Follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 双肺散在微结节同前，倾向良性，追查
text_en: Scattered micronodules in both lungs are unchanged, favoring benign, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段不规则团片影范围大致同前，现约24*12mm(图17)，原约26x9mm（IM18）
text_en: Irregular patch in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe is roughly unchanged in extent; currently about 24x12mm (Figure 17), previously about 26x9mm (IM18).

source_text: 腔静脉后淋巴结同前，约15x9mm（IMA21），呈高密度
text_en: Posterior to the vena cava, a lymph node is unchanged, measuring approximately 15x9 mm (IMA21), appearing high density.

source_text: 左锁骨上区小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺上叶结节缩小，左肺下叶结节同前
text_en: The nodule in the right upper lobe has decreased in size; the nodule in the left lower lobe remains stable.

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下小结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged and likely benign.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，倾向良性，追查
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from prior, likely benign; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右下肺索条同前，左肺未见新生结节
text_en: The linear band in the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior. No new nodules are seen in the left lung.

source_text: 双腋区淋巴结较前缩小，如右腋区原约12mm者，现约9mm（IM14）
text_en: Lymph nodes in bilateral axillary regions are smaller than before; for example, the one in the right axilla previously measuring approximately 12 mm is now approximately 9 mm (IM14).

source_text: 两侧腋窝区多发大小不一结节同前
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes of varying sizes in both axillary regions are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔2R、3P、4R及左侧锁骨上多发肿大淋巴结较前缩小，较大原约12x10mm（IM7、19），现约11x9mm（IM21）
text_en: Lymphadenopathy in mediastinal stations 2R, 3P, 4R, and left supraclavicular region has decreased in size compared to prior, with the largest previously measuring approximately 12x10 mm (IM7, 19) and now approximately 11x9 mm (IM21)

source_text: 双肺3-4mm微结节（IM30、42)，较前相仿
text_en: 3-4 mm micronodules in both lungs (IM30, 42) are similar to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下4mm浅淡密度小结节同前（IM53）
text_en: 4mm subpleural nodule with faint density in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (IM53)

source_text: 左肺模糊结节同前，约5mm（IM17）
text_en: Left lung hazy nodule unchanged, approximately 5 mm (IM17).

source_text: 右叶间胸膜及右侧侧胸膜增厚同前，仍见小结节（IM40）
text_en: The thickening of the right interlobar pleura and right lateral pleura remains unchanged compared to prior imaging, with small nodules still present (IM40).

source_text: 左侧锁骨上淋巴结同前，约10mm（IM8）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node unchanged, approximately 10 mm (IM8)

source_text: 纵隔、肺门、锁骨上及腋窝多发淋巴结部分较前稍减小，较大原约12x6mm（IM23），现约10x5mm（IM22）
text_en: Mediastinal, hilar, supraclavicular, and axillary multiple lymph nodes partially decreased in size compared to previous, largest previously approximately 12x6 mm (IM23), now approximately 10x5 mm (IM22).

source_text: 纵隔隆突下片状软组织密度灶范围较前缩小，原约25x18mm，现约15x15mm（IM33）
text_en: Patchy soft tissue density lesion in subcarinal mediastinum reduced in size compared to previous, previously approximately 25x18 mm, now approximately 15x15 mm (Image 33)

source_text: 两肺散在小结节同前，较大约2mm（IM37）
text_en: The scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged; the largest is approximately 2 mm (IM37).

source_text: 右侧心膈角小淋巴结大致同前（IM50）
text_en: The small lymph node in the right cardiophrenic angle is essentially unchanged (IM50).

source_text: 左肺门淋巴结略显饱满大致同前（IM26)，随诊观察
text_en: Left hilar lymph nodes are slightly prominent, similar to previous (IM26), for follow-up observation.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后改变，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Postoperative change in the right lower lobe; no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段可见实性微结节同前相仿，约4mm（IM25）
text_en: A solid micro-nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM25).

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜结节同前（IM29），左侧胸膜光滑，双侧未见胸水征象
text_en: The nodular lesion along the right interlobar pleura is unchanged (IM29). The left pleura is smooth. No pleural effusion is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 新见一短条状类结节
text_en: Newly seen short linear nodule-like lesion

source_text: 前纵隔类圆形软组织密度小结节大致同前，边界清晰，直径约9mm（IM25）
text_en: Small, well-circumscribed, round soft tissue density nodule in the anterior mediastinum is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 9 mm in diameter (IM25).

source_text: 扫及左肾上腺结节、胆囊结石同前，脂肪肝
text_en: A nodule in the left adrenal gland and gallstones are unchanged from prior, with fatty liver.

source_text: 胸中下段食管壁不规则增厚较前略明显，管腔闭塞，原约20x15mm（IM30），现约22x20mm（IM31），病变区与邻近胸主动脉分界不清，接触面小于90度
text_en: Irregular thickening of esophageal wall in mid to lower thoracic segment slightly more prominent than prior; luminal occlusion; previous size approximately 20x15mm (IM30), current size approximately 22x20mm (IM31); lesion indistinct from adjacent thoracic aorta with contact surface less than 90 degrees.

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节影同前，约3mm（IMA28）
text_en: Right upper lobe small nodule shadow unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IMA28)

source_text: 两下肺条索影大致同前，未见新生结节肿块征象
text_en: Linear opacities in both lower lungs are essentially unchanged from prior. No new nodules or masses are seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶模糊类结节同前（IM19、21）
text_en: The ill-defined nodular opacity in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior (IM19, 21).

source_text: 右肺小结节同前，仍约3mm（IMA20）
text_en: Right lung small nodule unchanged, still approximately 3 mm (IMA20)

source_text: 左上肺微结节同前，约3mm（Im30）
text_en: Left upper lobe micro-nodule unchanged, approximately 3 mm (Im30)

source_text: 扫及肝内见多发低密度结节，胆囊内结石，同前相仿，结合腹部检查
text_en: CT shows multiple low-density nodules within the liver and gallstones within the gallbladder, similar to previous; correlate with abdominal imaging.

source_text: 左侧胸膜不规则增厚（IM36)，左侧胸腔积液，考虑转移
text_en: Irregular thickening of the left pleura (IM36), left pleural effusion; metastasis is considered.

source_text: 右肺局部术后，右肺下叶基底段团块影较前略增大，平扫与邻近大血管分界不清，现较大短径约19mm(图38)，原约17mm(图42)
text_en: Postoperative change in the right lung; the mass-like opacity in the basal segment of the right lower lobe is slightly larger than before. On non-contrast imaging, it is indistinct from adjacent major vessels. The largest short diameter is now approximately 19 mm (Figure 38), previously about 17 mm (Figure 42).

source_text: 双肺多发小结节大致同前
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged.

source_text: 左上肺术后，未见复发转移征象
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy; no evidence of recurrence or metastasis

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结较前略饱满，现约13x10mm(IM25)，原约11x7mm(IM24)，双侧锁骨上区及双腋下平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are slightly enlarged compared to previous, currently approximately 13x10 mm (IM25), previously approximately 11x7 mm (IM24); no enlarged lymph nodes seen on non-contrast scan in bilateral supraclavicular and bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 吻合口右侧旁淋巴结同前，仍约9x6mm（IM12），现见钙化密度
text_en: Lymph node adjacent to the right side of the anastomosis unchanged from prior, still measuring approximately 9x6 mm (IM12), now showing calcified density

source_text: 纵隔散在淋巴结同前，未见肿大
text_en: Scattered mediastinal lymph nodes same as before, no enlargement seen.

source_text: 纵隔胸胃旁及肺门结节部分同前，约25x17mm（IM30）
text_en: Mediastinal nodules near gastric conduit and hilar region partially unchanged from previous, approximately 25x17mm (IM30).

source_text: 右肺术后，右肺条片影大致同前(IM23)，缝合线旁软组织结节较前增大、密度增高，现约12*9mm（IM23），追查
text_en: Postoperative right lung, linear and patchy opacities in the right lung generally unchanged (IM23); soft tissue nodule adjacent to the suture line has increased in size and density compared to prior, now measuring approximately 12 x 9 mm (IM23); further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下多个小结节同前，陈旧灶可能大
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right lung subpleural region are unchanged; likely represent old lesions.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段小结节影较前明显吸收，现局部仅余浅淡索条影（IM33）,余双肺索条结节影大致同前
text_en: The small nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe has markedly resolved, with only a faint linear strand remaining locally (IM33). The remaining linear and nodular opacities in both lungs are essentially unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见软组织密度结节及肿块，双肺散在少许索条影同前，未见结节灶及斑片影
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, no soft tissue density nodules or masses at the bronchial stump, scattered minimal linear opacities in both lungs unchanged from prior, no nodular or patchy opacities.

source_text: 扫及诸骨未见破坏灶
text_en: CT shows no destruction lesions in the bones examined.

source_text: 双肺微结节灶及磨玻璃灶同前
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary micro-nodular foci and ground-glass opacities are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左下肺小结节同前（IM52），右肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable (IM52); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the right lung.

source_text: 新见微小结节
text_en: Newly identified tiny nodule

source_text: 纵隔内多发小淋巴结同前，主肺动脉窗内较大者约18x10mm（IM25）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes, stable compared to prior. Largest in the aortopulmonary window measuring approximately 18x10 mm (IM25).

source_text: 余纵隔和双肺门多发小淋巴结同前
text_en: The remaining multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and both hila are unchanged.

source_text: 右侧胸膜下结节同前（IM24）
text_en: Subpleural nodule in the right lung is unchanged compared to prior (IM24).

source_text: 双肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: No new nodules seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见明显新发肿块
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, no significant new mass at the bronchial stump

source_text: 气管前淋巴结较前缩小，原约8x6mm，现约6x4mm（IM15)，追查
text_en: Pretracheal lymph nodes are decreased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 8x6 mm, now approximately 6x4 mm (IM15), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔2-8组及贲门旁多发小淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in mediastinal groups 2-8 and paraesophageal region unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺门肿大淋巴结，转移
text_en: Left hilar enlarged lymph node, metastasis.

source_text: 左侧第6肋骨结节样高密度同前（IM43）
text_en: Nodular hyperdensity at the left sixth rib, unchanged compared to prior (IM43).

source_text: 双肺纹理清晰，部分模糊小结节同前（Im26）
text_en: Clear bronchovascular markings in both lungs, some indistinct small nodules similar to prior (IM26).

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，支气管断端周围见软组织密度结节，约18x14mm（IM30），复发
text_en: Following right upper lobectomy, a soft tissue density nodule measuring approximately 18x14 mm (IM30) is seen adjacent to the bronchial stump; recurrence.

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段见分叶状软组织密度肿块缩小，原约46x41mm，现约37x31mm（IM48），边界稍模糊，周围见分叶及毛刺，邻近局限性胸膜凹陷，远端肺见不规则斑片实变范围缩小
text_en: A lobulated soft tissue density mass in the left lower lobe basal segment has decreased in size from approximately 46x41 mm to 37x31 mm (IM48), with slightly ill-defined margins, surrounding lobulation and spiculation, adjacent localized pleural indentation, and decreased extent of irregular patchy consolidation in the distal lung.

source_text: 纵隔及肺门多发小淋巴结大致同前，如右肺门较大者现仍约11x7mm（IM33）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes essentially unchanged from prior, such as the larger one in the right hilum still approximately 11x7mm (IM33).

source_text: 右肺上叶微小结节影及索条影同前，约3mm（IM14）
text_en: Right upper lobe micro-nodule and linear opacity unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IM14)

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结平扫同前，较大者中心可见脂肪密度（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes on non-contrast CT unchanged from prior; largest demonstrates central fat density (IM21).

source_text: 右肺多发胸膜下微小结节大致同前，＜5mm（Im36、30、32、38）
text_en: Multiple subpleural micronodules in the right lung are essentially unchanged, <5 mm (Im36, 30, 32, 38).

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则形混杂磨玻璃密度结节大致同前，边界不清，现仍约20x13mm（IMA15），内见小空泡
