text_en: Irregular nodule in the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior, with ill-defined margins, currently measuring approximately 20 x 13 mm (IMA15), containing a small air bubble.

source_text: 左肺下叶新见实性结节，约8x6mm（IM47）
text_en: New solid nodule in the left lower lobe, approximately 8x6mm (IM47).

source_text: 两肺转移灶较前缩小
text_en: Metastatic lesions in both lungs are decreased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 气管食管沟旁淋巴结较前缩小
text_en: Lymph nodes adjacent to the tracheoesophageal groove reduced in size compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段结节影较前缩小，现约16x10mm（IM46），原为19x12mm（IM53），追查
text_en: The nodule in the basal segment of the right lower lobe is smaller compared to prior, now approximately 16x10 mm (IM46), previously 19x12 mm (IM53); further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃样密度小灶同前，约7mm（IM27），余双肺未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: The small ground-glass opacity in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 7 mm (IM27); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右锁骨上较大者原约17x9mm（IM6），现约15x7mm（IM5）
text_en: The largest right supraclavicular lymph node was previously approximately 17x9 mm (IM6), now approximately 15x7 mm (IM5)

source_text: 纵隔3组淋巴结较前增大，原约15x9mm（IM15），现约18x15mm（IM14），追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 3 lymph nodes are enlarged compared to prior, previously approximately 15x9 mm (IM15), currently approximately 18x15 mm (IM14). Recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右肺多发小结节灶同前（Im13、14、16）
text_en: Multiple small nodular foci in the right lung are stable compared to prior studies (IM13, 14, 16).

source_text: 远端肺内模糊片影及两肺内多发结节较前缩小(IM21、22、25)
text_en: Hazy patchy opacity in the distal lung parenchyma and multiple nodules in both lungs, smaller than prior (images 21, 22, 25).

source_text: 纵隔、左锁骨上、膈上多发淋巴结，较前较前增大、增多，较大现约31x15mm（IM27）
text_en: Mediastinal, left supraclavicular, and supradiaphragmatic multiple lymph nodes increased in size and number compared to previous; the largest now approximately 31x15 mm (IM27).

source_text: 纵隔5、6组淋巴结同前，较大仍约14x6mm（IM15）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 5 and 6 are the same as before, larger, still approximately 14x6 mm (IM15).

source_text: 左肺下叶外侧基底段约2mm结节同前（Im52）
text_en: Left lower lobe, lateral basal segment: nodule approximately 2 mm unchanged (Image 52).

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，约5mm（IM32）
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM32).

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门少许淋巴结、部分伴钙化同前
text_en: Mediastinal and bilateral hilar few lymph nodes, some with calcification, unchanged from previous.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结缩小，较大原约15x12mm（IM10），现约9*6mm（IM11）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are reduced in size, with the largest previously measuring approximately 15x12 mm (IM10) and currently approximately 9x6 mm (IM11).

source_text: 双肺术后，胸部CT未见新增占位征象
text_en: Postoperative lungs; chest CT shows no new mass lesion.

source_text: 左肺下叶外基底段小结节同前，大小仍约5x4mm（IM34），边界清，与相邻的前后两个小血管相延续
text_en: The small nodule in the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 5x4 mm (IM34), with clear margins and continuity with adjacent anterior and posterior small vessels.

source_text: 右下肺索条及高密度金属缝线影同前，余双肺未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: The linear opacity and high-density metallic suture material in the right lower lobe are unchanged compared to prior. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the bilateral lungs.

source_text: 右侧斜裂胸膜小结节同前（Im33）
text_en: The small nodule along the right oblique fissure pleura is unchanged (Im33).

source_text: 左肺下叶新增结节、肺门淋巴结增大较前缩小
text_en: New nodule in the left lower lobe and enlarged hilar lymph nodes that are smaller than before.

source_text: 纵隔、双侧锁骨上区多发淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral supraclavicular regions are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule same as before, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节较前略饱满，原约7mm（IM23），现约8mm（IM24）
text_en: Right upper lobe small nodule slightly more prominent, previously approximately 7 mm (IM23), now approximately 8 mm (IM24)

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段结节灶增大，原约6mm（IM27），现约13mm（IM26），考虑转移
text_en: A nodule in the left upper lobe lingular segment has increased in size, previously approximately 6 mm (IM27), now approximately 13 mm (IM26), consider metastasis.

source_text: 扫及肝右叶边缘见结节状高强化灶同前
text_en: CT shows a nodular highly enhancing lesion at the margin of the right lobe of the liver unchanged from previous.

source_text: 双侧锁骨上区、纵隔2-10组、双肺门多发肿大淋巴结较前缩小，较大原约38x14mm（IM31），现约35x14mm（IM35）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the bilateral supraclavicular regions, mediastinal stations 2-10, and bilateral pulmonary hila are decreased in size compared to prior; the largest was previously about 38x14 mm (IM31), now approximately 35x14 mm (IM35).

source_text: 双肺弥漫转移结节较前增多、增大
text_en: Diffusely distributed metastatic nodules in both lungs are increased in number and larger than prior.

source_text: 纵隔6组淋巴结稍增大同前，双肺门淋巴结，追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 6 lymph nodes slightly enlarged unchanged, bilateral hilar lymph nodes, requires follow-up.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸主动脉旁小结节影同前，约7*4mm（IM31）
text_en: A small nodule adjacent to the thoracic aorta in the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 7x4 mm (IM31).

source_text: 左肺磨玻璃密度及多发小结节同前
text_en: Left lung ground-glass opacity and multiple small nodules unchanged from prior.

source_text: 另左肺下叶及右肺下叶胸膜旁不规则小结节灶同前，约为3mm（IM46）
text_en: Additionally, irregular small nodular foci adjacent to the pleura in the left lower lobe and right lower lobe are unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM46).

source_text: 扫及甲状腺右侧叶低密度结节同前
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right thyroid lobe, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右侧锁骨上淋巴结缩小，右侧原约15x10mm，现约9x7mm（IMA7）
text_en: Right supraclavicular lymph node has decreased in size, previously measuring approximately 15 x 10 mm, now approximately 9 x 7 mm (IMA7).

source_text: 扫及甲状腺双叶低密度结节同前
text_en: Low-density nodules are seen in bilateral thyroid lobes, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜结节状增厚同前相仿（IM32），左肺下叶散在多发片絮影减少
text_en: The nodular thickening of the left interlobar pleura is similar to prior (IM32); scattered patchy opacities in the left lower lobe have decreased.

source_text: 其上方长椭圆形淋巴结同前（Im9）
text_en: The elongated oval lymph node above it is stable (Im9).

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段结节同前，现约9x7mm（IM55）
text_en: The nodule in the outer basal segment of the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior, now measuring approximately 9 x 7 mm (IM55).

source_text: 未见明确变化
text_en: No definite change

source_text: 双肺多发小结节部分同前，部分略增大，原约4mm（IM39）灶现约5mm（IM40）
text_en: Some of the multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, while others have slightly increased in size; a focus previously about 4 mm (IM39) is now about 5 mm (IM40).

source_text: 右侧胸膜弥漫增厚及多发胸膜结节，叶间胸膜串珠状改变，右侧胸腔新见胸水，考虑胸膜转移可能大
text_en: Diffuse thickening of the right pleura with multiple pleural nodules and beaded changes in the interlobar pleura. New right pleural effusion is seen. Pleural metastasis is highly likely.

source_text: 右下肺斑片、索条影同前相仿，余双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: The patchy and linear opacities in the right lower lobe are similar to those previously noted; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the bilateral lungs.

source_text: 右上肺胸膜下索条及含钙化结节同前（IM36）,右下肺野胸膜下小结节同前（IM39）
text_en: Right upper lobe subpleural linear density and calcified nodule unchanged compared to prior (IM36); right lower lobe subpleural small nodule unchanged (IM39).

source_text: 两肺上叶多发磨玻璃样结节及小结节较前略缩小，现较大约11*8mm、22*16mm(图12、16)，原约18*8mm、26*21mm(图10、14)
text_en: Multiple ground-glass nodules and small nodules in both upper lobes are slightly smaller than prior. The largest now measures approximately 11x8 mm and 22x16 mm (Figures 12, 16), previously measuring 18x8 mm and 26x21 mm (Figures 10, 14).

source_text: 右肺小结节影同前，与既往检查比较，均无显著变化，考虑良性
text_en: Right lung small nodule shadows are unchanged compared to prior examination, with no significant change, likely benign.

source_text: 甲状腺右叶7x5mm大小低密度结节灶同前
text_en: 7x5 mm low-density nodule in the right thyroid lobe unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则混杂密度结节，较前相仿，现约17x13mm（IM18)，原17x15mm（Im18），边缘较清晰，相邻血管纠集、叶间胸膜凹陷同前，其内少量实性成分同前
text_en: The irregular mixed-density nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is similar to prior, currently measuring approximately 17x13 mm (IM18), previously 17x15 mm (Im18), with relatively well-defined margins. Adjacent vascular convergence and interlobar pleural indentation remain unchanged. The small solid component within the nodule remains stable.

source_text: 纵隔4组及右肺门数枚小淋巴结较前相仿，短径小于10mm（Im18）
text_en: Several small lymph nodes in mediastinal station 4 and the right hilum are similar to prior, with short axes less than 10 mm (Im18)

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端软组织较前缩小，原约18*10mm，现约13x10mm(IM29)，术后改变可能大，建议追查
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; soft tissue at the bronchial stump is smaller compared to prior, previously approximately 18x10 mm, now approximately 13x10 mm (IM29), likely representing postoperative change; follow-up recommended

source_text: 纵隔、肺门、腋窝及锁骨上淋巴结同前，较大约12*9mm（IMA19）
text_en: Lymph nodes in the mediastinum, hilar regions, supraclavicular, and axillary regions are unchanged from prior, with the largest measuring approximately 12x9 mm (IMA19)

source_text: 右肺小结节同前，约3mm（IMA20、25）
text_en: Right lung small nodule unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IMA20, 25)

source_text: 右肺下叶后基底段近胸膜处见一不规则结节同前相仿，原约22x12mm（IMA44），现约21*12mm（IMA42），邻近局局限性肺气肿同前
text_en: An irregular nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe near the pleura is similar to prior, previously measured approximately 22 x 12 mm (IMA44), now approximately 21 x 12 mm (IMA42); adjacent focal emphysema remains unchanged.

source_text: 扫及右侧第3、4肋骨质不连续同前，余扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: CT shows fracture of the right 3rd and 4th ribs, unchanged from previous; no bone destruction seen in the other scanned thoracic bones.

source_text: 右肺散在小结节同前（Im16、34、42、45等）同前，双肺未见新生结节或及斑片影
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right lung are unchanged (Im16, 34, 42, 45, etc.) compared to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 右肺门肿大淋巴结同前相仿，大小约20x16mm（IM26）
text_en: The enlarged right hilar lymph node is similar to prior, measuring approximately 20 x 16 mm (IM26).

source_text: 右肺散在磨玻璃密度灶同前，较大约7mm（IMA28），左肺下叶结节影同前，约5mm（IMA40）
text_en: Scattered ground-glass opacities in the right lung are similar to prior, largest approximately 7 mm (IMA28); nodular opacities in the left lower lobe are similar to prior, approximately 5 mm (IMA40).

source_text: 扫及甲状腺右叶结节灶大致同前
text_en: Imaging shows a nodule in the right lobe of the thyroid, essentially unchanged.

source_text: 扫及胃小弯侧小淋巴结较前饱满（IM57）、肝内多发低密度灶大致同前
text_en: Small lymph node along the lesser curvature of the stomach more prominent compared to prior (IM57), with multiple low-density foci within the liver largely unchanged.

source_text: 右肺中叶模糊小结节同前，约3mm（IM39、41）
text_en: Faint small nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM39, 41).

source_text: 右肺门及纵隔7组小淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes at the right hilum and mediastinal station 7 are largely unchanged from prior

source_text: 双肺散在少许索条影及左肺类小结节影（IM28）同前相仿
text_en: Scattered few linear opacities and left lung-like small nodules (IM28) are unchanged, similar to prior.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Bilateral lung markings are unremarkable in course, and pulmonary lucency is uniform. No new nodules or consolidations are seen.

source_text: 双肺多发小结节转移结节大致同前，较大约15x14mm（IM27）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs, likely metastatic, are stable; the largest is approximately 15x14 mm (IM27).

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜小结节同前（IM37）
text_en: Small nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior (IM37).

source_text: 右肺微小结节影大致同前（IMA32、35）
text_en: Right lung micro-nodular opacities essentially unchanged (IMA32, 35)

source_text: 右肺上叶浅淡小结节影同前（IM31）
text_en: Faint small nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior (IM31).

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影、左肺上叶结节灶（Im22）同前
text_en: The linear opacities in the right lower lobe and the nodule in the left upper lobe (Im22) are unchanged.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，左上叶舌段小结节同前相仿，约8x6mm（IM34）
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. The small nodule in the left upper lobe lingular segment is similar to prior, measuring approximately 8x6 mm (IM34).

source_text: 扫及胰腺尾部稍低密度结节影同前（IMA55）
text_en: Scans show a slightly hypodense nodule in the tail of the pancreas, unchanged from prior (IMA55).

source_text: 右肺微小结节影大致同前（IM34、37）
text_en: Right lung micro-nodular opacities essentially unchanged (IM34, 37)

source_text: 右肺下叶内基底段磨玻璃密度结节灶大致同前，倾向恶性
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the medial basal segment of the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged and is considered suspicious for malignancy.

source_text: 左肺上叶高密度结节同前（IM14）
text_en: High-density nodule in the left upper lobe unchanged from previous (IM14).

source_text: 右肺多发结节大小同前相仿，复查
text_en: The size of the multiple nodules in the right lung is similar to prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺中下叶少许索条影同前，余肺未见结节
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the right middle and lower lobes, stable compared to prior. No nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节同前（IMA13、18），较大约7mm（IM13）
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule stable compared to prior (IMA13, 18), larger approximately 7 mm (IM13)

source_text: 双肺多发小结节同前
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约12x7mm（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged, largest measuring approximately 12x7 mm (IM21)

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段结节较前相仿，约3mm（IM38），追查
text_en: The nodule in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM38); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶癌疗后，肺内及纵隔病变大致同前
text_en: Post-treatment status of carcinoma in the right lower lobe; the pulmonary and mediastinal lesions are essentially unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 右下肺结节、左下肺索条同前，倾向炎性病变
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe and the linear opacity in the left lower lobe are unchanged compared to prior imaging, favoring inflammatory etiology.

source_text: 右肺上叶微结节同前，约3mm（IM20）
text_en: Right upper lobe micro-nodule unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IM20).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前相仿，较大约15x4mm（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior; the largest measures approximately 15x4 mm (IM21)

source_text: 双侧胸膜未见增厚或结节，右侧胸腔少量积液，较前减少，左侧胸腔未见积液
text_en: No pleural thickening or nodules are seen bilaterally. Right-sided pleural effusion is small and decreased compared to prior. No effusion is seen on the left.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上淋巴结同前，约10x7mm（IM5）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node unchanged, approximately 10x7 mm (IM5)

source_text: 纵隔4、7组及双肺门多发肿大淋巴结部分增大，较大位于4R，原约22x18mm，现约24x18mm（IM27）
text_en: Multiple enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4 and 7 and bilateral hilar lymph nodes, with some increased in size; the largest is at station 4R, previously measuring 22x18 mm and currently 24x18 mm (IM27).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变，支气管断端未见新发占位
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; no new mass seen at the bronchial stump

source_text: 左肺门淋巴结同前，约9mm（IM30)，纵隔、右肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Left hilar lymph node unchanged, approximately 9 mm (IM30); no enlarged lymph nodes seen in the mediastinum, right hilum, supraclavicular regions, or bilateral axillae.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，胸膜下见散在多发索条影，左肺下叶胸膜下微小结节同前（IM45、48）
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. Scattered subpleural linear opacities are seen. A tiny subpleural nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged (IM45, 48).

source_text: 右肺下叶切除术后较前相仿，右肺门支气管断端金属密度影前方、中间段支气管后壁低密度影范围较前略增大，现约20*15mm（IM33），原约14*12mm（IM31），建议密切追查除外
text_en: Findings after right lower lobectomy are similar to prior; the low-density lesion anterior to the metallic density at the bronchial stump and along the posterior wall of the intermediate bronchus has slightly increased in size, now approximately 20x15 mm (IM33), previously about 14x12 mm (IM31); close follow-up is recommended to exclude progression.

source_text: 上下径原约47mm，现约35mm（SE401 IM34），外膜模糊，同主动脉弓脂肪间隙尚存在，近端食管扩张
text_en: Cranio-caudal dimension previously approximately 47 mm, now approximately 35 mm (SE401 IM34); outer membrane blurred; fat plane with aortic arch still present; proximal esophageal dilation

source_text: 原左肺下叶背段软组织密度结节较前明显缩小，左肺门多发增大淋巴结较前缩小，平扫与肺门血管分界不清
text_en: The previously noted soft-tissue density nodule in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe is markedly smaller; multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the left hilum are smaller than before, with unclear demarcation from hilar vessels on non-contrast imaging.

source_text: 纵隔4R组高密度淋巴结同前，约11mm（IM19），其内见点状钙化
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R high-density lymph node unchanged from prior, approximately 11 mm (IM19), with punctate calcification.

source_text: 两肺结节同前
text_en: Nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶少许索条影，右肺下叶肺组织透光度增高同前，双肺未见新发结节
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the right middle lobe and increased lucency in the right lower lobe lung parenchyma are unchanged; no new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结部分缩小，原较大约23x13mm，现约17x10mm（IM29）
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes have decreased in size; the largest previously measured approximately 23x13 mm, now approximately 17x10 mm (IM29).

source_text: 扫及诸骨未见新发骨质破坏征象
text_en: CT shows no new bone destruction in the bones examined.

source_text: 左锁骨上、纵隔见小淋巴结显示同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes are seen in the left supraclavicular region and mediastinum, similar to previous.

source_text: 纵隔内见散在小淋巴结同前，较大约23x6mm（IM35），呈长椭圆形
text_en: Scattered small lymph nodes in the mediastinum, similar to previous, largest approximately 23x6 mm (IM35), elliptical in shape.

source_text: 右肺少许索条影同前，双肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: A few linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged; no new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段肿块大致同前，范围约29x27mm（IM31），密度减低，背段支气管通畅，包绕左下肺动脉
text_en: Left lower lobe posterior segment mass stable, approximately 29x27 mm (IM31), decreased density, posterior segment bronchus patent, encasing left lower pulmonary artery.

source_text: 右肺上叶见局部多个小结节呈簇状同前，较大仍约4mm（IM16），边缘模糊
text_en: A cluster of multiple small nodules is seen locally in the right upper lobe, unchanged; the largest remains approximately 4 mm (IM16), with blurred margins.

source_text: 肺气肿同前，两肺未见新生结节或实变影，左侧未见胸水
text_en: Emphysema unchanged; no new nodules or consolidation in either lung; no left pleural effusion.

source_text: 右下肺术后及局部金属线、少许索条影同前，双肺微小结节状影较前相仿，较大约6mm（Im34）
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lower lobe with local metallic sutures and a few linear opacities are unchanged from prior examination. Tiny nodular opacities in both lungs are stable compared to previous imaging, with the largest measuring approximately 6 mm (Im34).

source_text: 平扫左肺门淋巴结同前，约14x14mm（Im32）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows the left hilar lymph node unchanged, approximately 14x14 mm (Image 32).

source_text: 两下肺见结节，较大约12mm（IM26)，考虑转移可能大
text_en: Nodules are seen in both lower lungs, the largest measuring approximately 12 mm (IM26), with a high possibility of metastasis.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端少量软组织密度影同前（IM27），未见增大或异常强化
text_en: Left upper lobe postoperative status. Minimal soft tissue density at the bronchial stump stable (IM27). No enlargement or abnormal enhancement

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前相仿，较大约12mm（IM15）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior, largest approximately 12 mm (IM15)

source_text: 右肺下叶部分实性磨玻璃结节较前相仿
text_en: The part-solid ground-glass nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右下叶两处磨玻璃微结节大致同前（Im41、50），不足3mm
text_en: Two ground-glass micro-nodules in the right lower lobe largely unchanged (Im41, 50), less than 3 mm.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门小淋巴结影较前缩小，现约18x7mm（IM29）者，原约22x10mm，双侧锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal and bilateral hilar small lymph nodes are reduced in size compared to previous, currently approximately 18x7 mm (IM29), previously approximately 22x10 mm. No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the bilateral supraclavicular regions or bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺略呈结节状增厚同前
text_en: Mild nodular thickening is noted in the left adrenal gland, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔内及右肺门多发小淋巴结伴钙化同前
text_en: Multiple small calcified lymph nodes within the mediastinum and right hilar region are unchanged from previous.

source_text: 两肺片絮、实变影减少消失，两肺未见新发结节影
text_en: The patchy and consolidative opacities in both lungs have decreased or resolved; no new nodules are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 扫及T8椎体高密度结节同前（IM38）
text_en: High-density nodule in the T8 vertebral body, stable compared to prior (IM38).

source_text: T10椎体致密小结节同前（Im41），余胸廓诸骨未见明确破坏征象
text_en: Dense small nodule in the T10 vertebral body is unchanged (Im41); no definite destructive changes are seen in the remainder of the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 纵隔多枚淋巴结大致同前，平扫密度较高
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are essentially unchanged from previous, with higher density on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 纵隔4R组长条形淋巴结同前，约16x7mm（IM27），平扫密度较高，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R elongated lymph node similar to previous, approximately 16x7 mm (IM27), higher density on non-contrast scan, considered old lesion.

source_text: 左肺索条影及左侧胸膜轻度增厚同前相仿，右肺未见新增斑片及结节影
text_en: Left lung linear opacities and mild left pleural thickening similar to prior, no new patchy or nodular opacities in the right lung

source_text: 纵隔7组钙化淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 calcified lymph nodes unchanged from previous

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节同前，约5mm（IM25）
text_en: The small nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged, approximately 5 mm (IM25).

source_text: 双肺散在索条影较前同前，未见新发结节或斑片影
text_en: Scattered linear opacities in both lungs are similar to prior. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 双肺下叶小结节同前
text_en: Small nodules in both lower lobes are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺叶间胸膜下多个小结节影同前，较大约5mm（IM50）
text_en: Multiple small nodular opacities in the interlobar pleura of both lungs are stable, largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM50).

source_text: 食管癌术后改变同前
text_en: Postoperative changes from esophageal cancer are unchanged.

source_text: 双肺下叶散在点状微小结节同前（IM26、28、37、39），均小于5mm
text_en: Scattered punctate micronodules in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior (IM26, 28, 37, 39), all less than 5 mm.

source_text: 右叶间胸膜约5mm小结节同前（IM40）
text_en: A approximately 5 mm nodule at the right interlobar pleura is stable compared to prior (IM40).

source_text: 两肺下叶胸膜下微小结节同前，考虑陈旧灶可能大
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodules in both lower lobes are unchanged from prior, with old foci being more likely.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，右肺下叶微小结节较前增大，原约4mm（IMA46），现约15x10mm（IM43）
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, a micronodule in the right lower lobe is larger than before, previously approximately 4 mm (IMA46), now approximately 15x10 mm (IM43).

source_text: 右下肺门结构扭曲，小淋巴结同前（Im23）
text_en: Distortion of the right lower lobe hilar architecture with small lymph nodes unchanged (Im23).

source_text: 扫及肝脏密度减低较前明显，肝内见低密度结节大致同前
text_en: Decreased liver density more pronounced than prior, with low-density nodules within the liver largely unchanged.

source_text: 新发小片结节
text_en: Newly developed small nodules

source_text: 左肺上叶前段内侧分支支气管截断较前好转，纵隔旁团片状软组织密度影较前缩小，现仅可见左肺门处软组织结节影约20x15mm（IM22），原此处病灶约25x18mm，远端肺阻塞性实变明显减轻
text_en: The bronchial cutoff of the medial branch in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe has improved compared to prior. The mediastinal-adjacent mass-like soft tissue density shadow has decreased in size, now only a soft tissue nodule shadow measuring approximately 20x15 mm (IM22) is visible at the left hilum, previously the lesion was approximately 25x18 mm. The distal obstructive pulmonary consolidation has significantly improved.

source_text: 双侧叶间胸膜小结节同前，观察
text_en: Small nodules in the bilateral interlobar fissures are unchanged; observation recommended.

source_text: 双肺小结节同前（IM20、21、42、47），较大仍约4mm（IM21）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are stable compared to prior (IM20, 21, 42, 47), the largest remains approximately 4 mm (IM21)

source_text: 右肺上叶及中叶结节同前相仿，追查
text_en: Nodules in the right upper and middle lobes are similar to prior; further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶癌疗后，大致同前
text_en: Post-treatment for left lower lobe lung cancer, findings are similar to previous.

source_text: 左肺未见新发斑片及结节影
text_en: No new patchy opacities or nodules in the left lung.

source_text: 右肺模糊浅淡结节影同前（IMA28）
text_en: Faint, hazy nodule in the right lung is stable compared to prior (IMA28).

source_text: 左肺上叶切除术后，肺门支气管断端周围形态同前，未见新发软组织密度肿块
text_en: After left upper lobe resection, morphology around the hilar bronchial stump unchanged from prior; no new soft tissue density mass.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见明显异常软组织密度增厚影，右肺下叶索条结节影同前，约6mm（IM36）
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; non-contrast scan shows no significant abnormal soft-tissue density thickening at the bronchial stump. Linear and nodular opacities in the right lower lobe are unchanged, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM36).

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，肺内陈旧表现同前，胸部CT平扫未见明显新生占位
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; old findings remain unchanged; non-contrast chest CT shows no obvious new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4多组发小淋巴结同前，锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R and 4 are unchanged from previous; no enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前（IM40），约3mm
text_en: Small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM40), approximately 3 mm.

source_text: 右肺上叶陈旧灶同前，双肺未见新生结节及斑片影
text_en: Chronic findings in the right upper lobe are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 双肺内新见多发结节，较大者约7x6mm（IMA36）
text_en: Newly noted multiple nodules in both lungs, largest measuring approximately 7x6 mm (IMA36).

source_text: 扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: No signs of bone destruction seen in the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 食管胸上段管壁增厚减轻，原较厚横截面短径约30mm（IM15），现较厚处约18mm（IMA17）
text_en: Wall thickening of the upper thoracic esophagus reduced; previously, the thickest cross-sectional short diameter was approximately 30 mm (IM15), now approximately 18 mm (IMA17).

source_text: 左肺下叶少许模糊结节大致同前，约4mm（IM46、47）
text_en: Few ill-defined nodules in the left lower lobe essentially unchanged from prior, approximately 4mm (IM46, 47)

source_text: 扫及胃小弯侧小淋巴结较前增大（IM58），现约16x10mm（IM58），原约9x6mm（IM57）
text_en: A small lymph node along the lesser curvature of the stomach is noted to have increased in size compared to prior, from approximately 9x6 mm (IM57) to approximately 16x10 mm (IM58).

source_text: 右肺术后，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Postoperative right lung, no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis are identified.

source_text: 右腋下淋巴结略增大，原较大约15x9mm，现较大约17*12mm（IM12）
text_en: Right axillary lymph node slightly enlarged, previously measuring approximately 15x9 mm, now measuring approximately 17x12 mm (IM12).

source_text: 隆突下局限性积液同前,纵隔、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Subcarinal localized fluid collection similar to prior, mediastinum, supraclavicular regions, and bilateral axillary no enlarged lymph nodes seen.

source_text: 左侧胸腔术后改变，胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Postoperative change in the left pleural cavity; no new space-occupying lesions seen in the chest.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上小淋巴结同前，约6mm（IM2）
text_en: Left supraclavicular small lymph node unchanged, approximately 6 mm (IM2)

source_text: 锁骨上小淋巴结同前相仿
text_en: Supraclavicular small lymph nodes similar to prior.

source_text: 右侧锁骨上区可疑肿大淋巴结同前，约25x22mm（IM1）
text_en: A suspicious enlarged lymph node in the right supraclavicular region is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 25 x 22 mm (IM1).

source_text: 左肺下叶外侧基底段见类圆形模糊小结节同前，约3mm（Im33）
text_en: Left lower lobe, lateral basal segment: round indistinct small nodule unchanged, approximately 3 mm (Image 33).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段不规则团片影范围较前缩小，横断面原约18x9mm（Im17），现约15x5mm（IM19）
text_en: Irregular patch in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe has decreased in extent; previously about 18x9mm (Im17), now about 15x5mm (IM19).

source_text: 余双肺未见新增结节及实变影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no newly increased nodules or consolidation shadows.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段微小结节同前，约2mm（IM24）
text_en: Tiny nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable, approximately 2 mm (IM24)

source_text: 右肺上叶点状浅淡结节影（IMA20）、左肺多发磨玻璃样灶同前，较大约10x8mm（IM19）
text_en: Punctate faint nodular opacity in the right upper lobe (IMA20); multiple ground-glass opacities in the left lung unchanged, largest measuring approximately 10x8 mm (IM19)

source_text: 左上肺不规则形结节及小片状模糊影同前（Im14、20）
text_en: Irregular nodule and small patchy hazy opacity in the left upper lobe are unchanged (Im14, 20).

source_text: 右肺上叶贴水平裂处结节同前，约6x5mm（IM26）
text_en: A nodule adjacent to the horizontal fissure in the right upper lobe is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 6 x 5 mm (IM26).

source_text: 气管右旁肿大淋巴结较前相仿，现较大约18x12mm（IM15）
text_en: Enlarged lymph node at right paratracheal region similar to prior, now larger approximately 18x12mm (IM15)

source_text: 右肺术后，支气管断端未见异常增厚及占位征象，右肺中下叶少许索条影同前
text_en: Post right lung surgery, no abnormal thickening or space-occupying lesion at the bronchial stump; minimal linear opacities in the right middle and lower lobes unchanged.

source_text: 胸10椎体下缘结节样高密度影同前相仿
text_en: Nodular high-density shadow at the inferior margin of thoracic vertebra 10, similar to previous

source_text: 余两肺多个小结节同前（IM21、32、43等)
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the remainder of both lungs are unchanged (IM21, 32, 43, etc.).

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结略饱满同前，较大约11x10mm（Im30）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is slightly prominent, unchanged from prior, with the largest measuring approximately 11x10 mm (Im30).

source_text: 左肺术后改变同前，胸部CT平扫未见新发占位
text_en: Left lung postoperative change unchanged, chest CT plain scan shows no new space-occupying lesion.

source_text: 余双肺内多发小结节灶同前
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the remainder of both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前相仿，较大约15x4mm（IM24）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior; the largest measures approximately 15x4 mm (IM24)

source_text: 右肺下叶浅淡小结节同前（IM31）
text_en: The faint small nodule in the right lower lobe is stable (IM31).

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下结节条索同前（IM13）
text_en: Subpleural nodule and linear opacity in the right upper lobe are unchanged compared to prior (IM13).

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺结节同前（IMA63），结合腹部评价
text_en: A nodule is noted in the left adrenal gland, stable compared to prior (IMA63). Correlate with abdominal evaluation.

source_text: 扫及肝内低密度占位较前增大
text_en: An intrahepatic low-density mass has increased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶实性密度结节同前，约5mm（IM17）
text_en: Solid density nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM17).

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下索条小结节灶大致同前，大小约3mm（IMA51）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural small linear nodule essentially unchanged, approximately 3mm (IMA51)

source_text: 两肺未见新发结节或实变影，
text_en: No new nodules or consolidations seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左下肺模糊小结节灶同前，大小约3mm（IMA46）
text_en: Faint small nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IMA46).

source_text: 右肺条索影、双肺模糊小结节同前相仿，右肺上叶尖后段较大结节大小同前3mm（IM23）
text_en: Linear opacities in the right lung and hazy small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior; the larger nodule in the apicoposterior segment of the right upper lobe remains stable at 3 mm (IM23).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后改变同前，左肺胸膜下浅淡小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left upper lobe unchanged from previous, subpleural subtle small nodule in the left lung unchanged from previous, recommend follow-up

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下3mm小结节影同前（IM39）
text_en: 3mm subpleural nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (IM39)

source_text: 右肺上叶索条及钙化点同前相仿，未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: The linear opacity and calcified foci in the right upper lobe are similar to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 双下肺少许索条（Im55）及结节（Im16）影同前
text_en: Minimal linear opacities (Im55) and nodules (Im16) in the bilateral lower lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 甲状腺低密度结节同前
text_en: Thyroid hypodense nodule stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶两处结节大致同前
text_en: Two nodules in the right upper lobe are essentially unchanged.

source_text: 双腋下淋巴结较前增大，追查
text_en: Axillary lymph nodes are larger than prior; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶不规则磨玻璃密度结节大致同前，仍约16x10mm（IM11），其内未见明显实性成分，局部轮廓内陷，局部与侧胸膜牵拉粘连
text_en: Irregular ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is essentially unchanged, still approximately 16x10 mm (IM11), without definite solid component; local contour retraction and focal adhesion/tethering to the lateral pleura are present.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结较前增大，原约16x12mm（IM25），现约20x14mm（IM23）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph node enlarged compared to prior, previously approximately 16x12 mm (IM25), now approximately 20x14 mm (IM23).

source_text: 左上肺门淋巴结影同前，大小约9x5mm（IM29)，追查
text_en: Left hilar lymph node shadow is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 9x5 mm (IM29), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, no enlarged lymph nodes seen in bilateral hilar, supraclavicular, and bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 右肺中叶实性结节同前，约12x10mm（SE307 IM24）
text_en: Solid nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 12x10 mm (SE307 IM24).

source_text: 双肺结节影增大，原较大约17x14mm（IM48），现较大约21x18mm（Im36）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary nodules have increased in size. The largest was previously approximately 17x14 mm (IM48), now approximately 21x18 mm (IM36).

source_text: 双肺陈旧灶及纵隔淋巴结同前
text_en: Chronic pulmonary foci and mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段胸膜下不规则结节同前相仿，约8x5mm（IM28）
text_en: The irregular subpleural nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe is similar to previous, approximately 8x5 mm (IM28).

source_text: 左肺上叶肿块大致同前
text_en: Left upper lobe mass similar to previous.

source_text: 食管术后改变同前，未见新生占位征象
text_en: Post-esophagectomy changes unchanged, no new mass lesion signs.

source_text: 双肺条索影、多发小结节同前，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Linear opacities and multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 纵隔内4L组淋巴结较前相仿，仍约13x6mm（IMA23）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at station 4L, similar to previous; still approximately 13x6 mm (IMA23).

source_text: 纵隔4R、7、9组淋巴结同前，较大约16x8mm（IM27）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R, 7, and 9 are similar to prior, with the largest approximately 16x8mm (IM27).

source_text: 胸中段食管癌疗后较前好转
text_en: Post-treatment mid-thoracic esophageal carcinoma, improvement compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺中、下叶多发磨玻璃密度结节大小大致同前（IM18、27、37），较大约19x13mm（IM27）
text_en: Multiple ground-glass opacity nodules in the right middle and lower lobes are approximately unchanged in size (IM18, 27, 37); the largest measures approximately 19 x 13 mm (IM27).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段不规则结节较前增大，原约14x8mm，现约28x21mm（IM37），其下方梭形条片影同前，病变牵拉叶间裂
text_en: The irregular nodule in the apical segment of the right lower lobe has increased in size compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 14x8 mm, now approximately 28x21 mm (IM37); the fusiform patchy shadow below the lesion remains unchanged, and the lesion is pulling on the interlobar fissure.

source_text: 左肺下叶5mm小结节同前（IM57）
text_en: 5mm small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (IM57).

source_text: 左锁骨上淋巴结同前，约11x6mm（IM4），追查
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph nodes unchanged, approximately 11x6 mm (IM4), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左上纵隔胸膜及胸膜多发结节较前增大，原较大约25x21mm（IMA10），现约31x18（IM12），左侧胸水同前，左肺下叶肺组织膨胀不全同前
text_en: Multiple nodules in the left upper mediastinal pleura and pleura are larger than before, the largest previously approximately 25 x 21 mm (IMA10), now approximately 31 x 18 mm (IM12). Left-sided pleural effusion is stable compared to prior. Atelectasis of the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior.

source_text: T12椎体楔形变同前，上缘见许莫氏结节
text_en: Wedge-shaped deformity of the T12 vertebral body is unchanged; a Schmorl's node is seen at the superior margin.

source_text: 右肺中叶占位较前略增大，实性成分增多
text_en: Right middle lobe mass has slightly increased in size compared to prior, with an increase in the solid component.

source_text: 肺内新见数枚小结节，需定期观察
text_en: Newly seen several small pulmonary nodules, require regular follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4组、5多发淋巴结较前相仿，4R组较大约13x8mm（IM18）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R, 4, and 5 are similar to previous; the largest in station 4R is approximately 13x8 mm (IM18)

source_text: 右肺上叶、左肺野中外带可见多发新增的结节影，呈簇状分布，较大约6x5mm（IM14），边界清晰
text_en: Newly developed multiple nodules in the right upper lobe and left lung periphery, distributed in clusters, largest approximately 6x5 mm (IM14), with clear margins.

source_text: 右上肺及左下肺小结节灶大致同前（IMA30、33），较大者仍约4mm（IM30）
text_en: Small nodules in the right upper lung and left lower lung are roughly unchanged (IMA30, 33), the largest still measuring approximately 4 mm (IM30).

source_text: 右肺下背段磨玻璃密度小结节同前，追查
text_en: The small ground-glass opacity nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 甲状腺右叶结节同前，大小约23mm（IMA4）
text_en: The right thyroid lobe shows a nodule, unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 23 mm (IMA4).

source_text: 左侧锁骨上淋巴结较前增大，原约9x7mm（IM5），现约12x10mm（IM5）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 9x7 mm (IM5), now approximately 12x10 mm (IM5)

source_text: 其外侧圆形结节同前，约6mm（IM20
text_en: The round nodule lateral to it is stable, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM20).

source_text: 扫及胸10椎体见结节样高密度灶同前
text_en: Scans show a nodular hyperdense lesion in the T10 vertebra, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃结节同前，内可疑实性成分，恶性可能性存在，建议外科会诊
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe unchanged from prior; a suspicious solid component is noted within, and malignancy remains possible. Surgical consultation is recommended.

source_text: 未见明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: No obvious new nodules or consolidation

source_text: 平扫纵隔淋巴结同前相仿，现较大仍约13*10mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes on non-contrast CT are stable compared to prior, with the largest measuring approximately 13x10 mm (IM20).

source_text: 余双肺胸膜下少许模糊小结节同前相仿（IM20、31、33等）
text_en: A few indistinct small subpleural nodules in both lungs are similar to prior (IM20, 31, 33, etc.).

source_text: 右肺中叶癌术后，支气管断端未见异常增厚，右肺上叶索条同前，右肺上、下叶多发局灶性磨玻璃影较前大致相仿
text_en: Postoperative status of right middle lobe carcinoma; no abnormal thickening at the bronchial stump; linear opacities in the right upper lobe unchanged; multiple focal ground-glass opacities in the right upper and lower lobes are similar to prior

source_text: 纵隔散在钙化淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal scattered calcified lymph nodes unchanged.

source_text: 双肺散在多发模糊结节影及小结节灶大小、数量同前，右肺上叶前段结节仍约16x10mm（IM26）
text_en: Size and number of scattered multiple indistinct nodules and small nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged. The nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe remains approximately 16x10 mm (IM26).

source_text: 右肺门结节影同前（IM37），平扫与肺门血管分界不清
text_en: Right hilar nodular opacity is stable compared to prior (IM37), poorly demarcated from hilar vessels on non-contrast imaging

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段实性结节大致同前，分叶状边缘见多发毛刺，大小约20x14mm（IM35），增强扫描呈明显强化，边缘可见长索条牵拉胸膜内陷
text_en: The solid nodule in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 20x14 mm (IM35), with a lobulated margin and multiple spiculations. It shows marked enhancement on contrast-enhanced scanning, and long linear strands are seen pulling the pleura inward at the margin.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结钙化同前
text_en: Mediastinal lymph node calcification is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺多发小结节同前，较大现仍约3mm者（IM31）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior, with the largest still measuring approximately 3 mm (IM31).

source_text: 食管术后改变，吻合口壁未见异常增厚，未见肿块征象，邻近肺内条片影，右侧胸水较前减少，纵隔内不规则软组织灶密度减低，均考虑术后改变
text_en: Post-esophagectomy changes. Anastomotic wall without abnormal thickening, no mass lesion. Linear and patchy opacities in adjacent lung. Right pleural effusion decreased compared to prior. Irregular mediastinal soft tissue focus with decreased density, all considered postoperative changes.

source_text: 右肺门肿大淋巴结较前缩小（IM27）
text_en: The enlarged right hilar lymph node is smaller than prior (IM27).

source_text: 左锁骨上区、纵隔及左肺门多发肿大淋巴结，较前增多、增大，如原约8x7mm（IM19）者，现约22x16mm（IM17）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region, mediastinum, and left hilar region, increased in number and size compared to previous, for example, original approximately 8x7 mm (IM19) now approximately 22x16 mm (IM17).

source_text: 扫及腹腔淋巴结增大，较大原约13x11mm（IM59），现约18x11mm（IM60）
text_en: CT shows enlarged lymph nodes in the abdomen; the largest was approximately 13x11 mm (IM59), now approximately 18x11 mm (IM60).

source_text: 气管隆突下低密度结节同前，约16*8mm（IM24）
text_en: Subcarinal low-density nodule unchanged from prior, approximately 16x8 mm (IM24).

source_text: 肺内陈旧小结节同前
text_en: Intrapulmonary old small nodules unchanged from previous.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结同前，仍约10x8mm（Im22）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are stable, measuring approximately 10x8 mm (Im22).

source_text: 食道胸中下段管壁不均匀异常增厚大致同前，如原厚约15mm处，现约16mm（前后径IM40），累及长度约95mm（矢状位IM36），局部管腔狭窄同前，外膜模糊，同胸主动脉接触面小于90度，近端食管轻度扩张
text_en: Wall thickening of the mid-to-lower thoracic esophagus is stable compared to prior, with the thickness at the previously noted 15 mm site now measuring approximately 16 mm in the anteroposterior dimension (IM40). The involved length remains approximately 95 mm (sagittal view IM36). Local luminal narrowing is unchanged, the outer membrane is blurred, the contact surface with the thoracic aorta is less than 90 degrees, and there is mild proximal esophageal dilation.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前相仿（IM34、47），边缘模糊，较大约5mm（IM47）
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is similar to prior (IM34, 47), with ill-defined margins, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM47)

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段局限性索条影及多发小结节及钙化等陈旧表现大致同前，右肺中叶少许3-4mm微小结节、左肺上叶钙化灶同前
text_en: The localized linear opacity and multiple small nodules with calcifications in the outer basal segment of the right lower lobe, representing chronic changes, are essentially unchanged. The few 3-4 mm tiny nodules in the right middle lobe and the calcified focus in the left upper lobe are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右心膈角淋巴结同前，约14x9mm（IM37）
text_en: Right cardiophrenic angle lymph node unchanged, measuring approximately 14x9 mm (IM37).

source_text: 右肺小斑片索条影较前减少、变淡，钙化影同前，两肺未见新增结节灶或实变影
text_en: Small patchy linear opacities in the right lung are decreased in extent and less prominent compared to prior; calcifications are stable; no new nodules or consolidations are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左肺上叶斑点状钙化同前，右肺上叶斑片影范围较前无变化，余肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Punctate calcifications in the left upper lobe unchanged; patchy opacities in the right upper lobe with no change in extent; no new nodular opacities in the remaining lung.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺双叶多发结节影同前（IM7）
text_en: Multiple nodules in both thyroid lobes, unchanged from prior (IM7).

source_text: 双肺未见新发结节及异常密度区
text_en: No new nodules or abnormal density areas seen in both lungs.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal multiple lymph nodes unchanged from previous.

source_text: 余肺少许斑片索条影同前，模糊斑点影同前，未见新发斑片影及结节灶
text_en: Minimal patchy linear opacities in the remaining lung are stable. Indistinct punctate opacities are stable. No new patchy opacities or nodules are seen.

source_text: 双肺下叶索条影同前，两肺未见新生结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Linear opacities in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺中叶（IM39）、左肺舌叶（IMA43）、左肺下叶（IM46）见类圆形小结节同前，边界清楚
text_en: Round small nodules are seen in the right middle lobe (IM39), left lingular segment (IMA43), and left lower lobe (IM46), stable compared to prior, with well-defined margins.

source_text: 组及右肺门钙化淋巴结同前
text_en: Group and right hilar calcified lymph nodes unchanged

source_text: 右肺中叶磨玻璃密度影增大，现约19x17mm（IM13），原约18x12mm（SE3 Im12），内部实性成分较前增多
text_en: Ground-glass density in the right middle lobe has increased in size, currently measuring approximately 19 x 17 mm (IM13), previously 18 x 12 mm (SE3 Im12). The solid component within the lesion has increased compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前（IM38），纵隔、锁骨区、腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is unchanged from prior (IM38); no enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum, supraclavicular region, or axillae.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段4mm小结节同前（IM23）
text_en: A 4 mm small nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment is stable compared to prior (IM23).

source_text: 双肺轻度间质性改变，左肺见点状钙化结节同前
text_en: Mild interstitial changes in both lungs; a punctate calcified nodule in the left lung is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左锁骨上区淋巴结同前，约8mm（IM9）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node unchanged from prior, approximately 8 mm (IM9)

source_text: 双肺及右侧叶间胸膜散在微结节同前，直径仍小于2mm（IM31、41）
text_en: Scattered micro-nodules in both lungs and right interlobar pleura are stable, diameters still less than 2 mm (IM31, 41).

source_text: 新见多发结节
text_en: Newly seen multiple nodules

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则形结节影、周围斑片索条小结节影大致同前
text_en: Irregular nodule in the left upper lobe and surrounding patchy linear and nodular opacities are essentially unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔2R组淋巴结同前，长径约9mm（Im12）
text_en: Mediastinal station 2R lymph nodes unchanged from prior, long axis approximately 9 mm (Im12).

source_text: 右肺下叶微小结节灶同前
text_en: Right lower lobe tiny nodular focus unchanged

source_text: 双肺索条影及钙化灶大致同前，余肺未见新生结节及斑片影
text_en: Linear opacities and calcifications in both lungs are approximately similar to prior. The remainder of the lungs show no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 右肺术后改变，支气管断端未见异常，右肺上叶磨玻璃结节及左肺上叶微小结节同前（IM14），双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lung; no abnormality at the bronchial stump, ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe and a tiny nodule in the left upper lobe are stable compared to prior (IM14), and no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 两肺多发小结节同前，2-5mm（IM25、35、53）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, 2-5 mm (IM25, 35, 53).

source_text: 右肺中叶近水平裂处结节样磨玻璃密度影同前，大小仍约7x5mm（IM25）
text_en: Nodule-like ground-glass opacity near the horizontal fissure in the right middle lobe, unchanged, still measuring approximately 7x5 mm (IM25)

source_text: 双肺小结节（IM19、20、46）大小同前，较大约4mm（IM20）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules (IM19, 20, 46) are stable in size, the largest measuring approximately 4 mm (IM20).

source_text: 余双肺内散在3mm大小结节灶同前相仿（IM38，41)
text_en: Scattered 3 mm nodules in the remainder of both lungs are similar to prior (IM38, 41).

source_text: 纵隔4组淋巴结减小，原约8mm（IM26），现约5mm（IM26），双肺门未见确切肿大淋巴结
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal station 4 have decreased in size, previously approximately 8 mm (IM26), currently approximately 5 mm (IM26), with no definite enlargement of lymph nodes in the bilateral hila

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段胸膜下肿块较前缩小，左肺门及纵膈9组淋巴结较前缩小
text_en: A subpleural mass in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is decreased in size compared to previous, and left hilar and mediastinal station 9 lymph nodes are decreased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 甲状腺体积弥漫增大强化不均及左侧肾上腺结节同前，大小约17*16mm（IMA58）
text_en: Diffuse thyroid gland enlargement with heterogeneous enhancement and left adrenal nodule stable compared to prior, size approximately 17x16 mm (IMA58).

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结显示不清，右锁骨上、余纵隔余处多发小淋巴结大致同前，较大者约10x6mm（IMA25）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes not clearly visualized; right supraclavicular and other mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest approximately 10x6 mm (IMA25)

source_text: 甲状腺右叶增大并低密度结节影同前
text_en: The right thyroid lobe is enlarged with a low-density nodule, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 所及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏
text_en: No bone destruction seen in the thoracic bones examined.

source_text: 左肺上叶浅淡密度结节同前，约4mm（IM31），界清
text_en: The faint density nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged from previous, approximately 4 mm (IM31), with well-defined margins.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则结节较前增大
text_en: The irregular nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe has increased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 前纵隔结节较前缩小，原约19x14mm（IM23），现约15x9mm（IM22）
text_en: The anterior mediastinal nodule is smaller than before, previously approximately 19x14 mm (IM23), now approximately 15x9 mm (IM22).

source_text: 下纵隔偏左侧巨大软组织占位大致同前，仍约7.7x6.6mm（IM48），仍呈低强化
text_en: Large soft tissue mass in the left paravertebral lower mediastinum essentially unchanged, still approximately 7.7x6.6 mm (IM48), remains hypoenhancing

source_text: 右肺术后，右肺支气管截断，肺组织不张，两肺多发结节肿块较前增大增多，原较大约69x60mm（IM24），现较大约9.0x8.4cm（IM14）
text_en: Postoperative right lung, bronchial cutoff and pulmonary atelectasis; multiple nodules and masses in both lungs have increased in size and number compared to prior, with the largest previously measuring approximately 69 x 60 mm (IM24), now approximately 9.0 x 8.4 cm (IM14).

source_text: 右肺钙化及上叶（IM22）、中叶（IM40）小结节灶同前相仿，双侧胸膜散在结节样增厚同前，未见确切新发灶
text_en: Calcification in the right lung and small nodular opacities in the upper lobe (IM22) and middle lobe (IM40) are similar to prior; scattered nodular pleural thickening bilaterally is unchanged; no definite new lesions are seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段软组织肿块较前略缩小，现约55*48mm(图22)，原约62x54mm（IM22），不均匀强化，与右肺门肿大淋巴结融合，与邻近胸膜关系密切
text_en: The soft tissue mass in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe has slightly decreased in size, now measuring approximately 55x48 mm (Figure 22), previously 62x54 mm (IM22); it shows heterogeneous enhancement, is fused with an enlarged right hilar lymph node, and is closely related to the adjacent pleura.

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段胸膜下浅淡模糊小结节灶同前，约4mm（IMA58）
text_en: The faint, ill-defined small subpleural nodule in the lateral basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (IMA58).

source_text: 余纵隔淋巴结同前
text_en: The remaining mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged.

source_text: 隆突下肿大淋巴结较前缩小，原约20*12mm（IM28），现约14*11mm（IMA28）
text_en: Enlarged subcarinal lymph nodes reduced compared to prior, originally approximately 20x12 mm (IM28), now approximately 14x11 mm (IMA28).

source_text: 双肺小结节较前增大，原约3mm（IM30）灶现约7mm（IM31）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are larger compared to prior, a prior focus of approximately 3 mm (IM30) is now approximately 7 mm (IM31)

source_text: 左肺下叶背段不规则磨玻璃密度结节同前，仍约15x9mm（IM34），定期复查
text_en: Left lower lobe posterior segment irregular ground-glass opacity nodule unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 15x9 mm (IM34), with recommendation for routine follow-up.

source_text: 余扫及诸骨未见破坏灶
text_en: No destructive foci are seen in the bones imaged.

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下模糊小结节同前，约3mm（IM33）
text_en: Indistinct subpleural nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM33).

source_text: 双肺索条影同前，双肺未见明确肺内结节影
text_en: Linear opacities in both lungs are similar to prior. No definite pulmonary nodules are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 纵膈多发淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes stable compared to prior study, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右侧肾上腺结节同前，约12x12mm（IM60），平扫密度较前增高
text_en: Adrenal nodule on the right is unchanged, measuring approximately 12x12 mm (IM60). Unenhanced density is higher than before.

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结同前相仿，双侧锁骨上及腋窝未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: The mediastinal station 4R lymph node is similar to previous, and no enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the bilateral supraclavicular and axillary regions

source_text: 右肺上叶多发结节较前增大，较大原约11x9mm（IM18），现约16x11mm（IM17），右肺上叶近纵隔处新见结节，约20x12mm（IM12），转移
text_en: Multiple nodules in the right upper lobe are larger than before; the largest was previously approximately 11x9 mm (IM18), now approximately 16x11 mm (IM17). A new nodule is seen near the mediastinum in the right upper lobe, measuring approximately 20x12 mm (IM12); metastasis is suspected.

source_text: 右肺下叶不规则结节同前，约8mm（Im41）
text_en: The irregular nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 8 mm (Im41).

source_text: 双肺多发小结节同前，追查
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔6组淋巴结同前，仍约10x7mm（IM17），追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 6 lymph nodes unchanged, still approximately 10x7 mm (IM17), requires follow-up.

source_text: 双肺纹理增多紊乱伴胸膜下散在小斑片影大致同前，双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Increased and disorganized lung markings with scattered subpleural patchy opacities are approximately similar to prior. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶钙化、索条、小结节影、右肺下叶点状结节影同前（IMA16、21、38）
text_en: Calcification, linear opacities, and small nodules in the right upper lobe, and punctate nodules in the right lower lobe are unchanged (IMA16, 21, 38).

source_text: 右肺下叶较前新见多发小结节，较大者大小约9x6mm（IM33）
text_en: Multiple new small nodules are seen in the right lower lobe, with the largest measuring approximately 9 x 6 mm (IM33).

source_text: 左肺上叶微小结节同前（IM36、42）
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule unchanged (IM36, 42).

source_text: 纵隔4组高密度淋巴结同前，考虑良性
text_en: High-density mediastinal station 4 lymph nodes are unchanged from previous and considered benign

source_text: 右肺下叶结节影较前略增大，建议复查
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is slightly larger than prior; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 甲状腺左叶低密度结节同前（IM5）
text_en: Left thyroid lobe low-density nodule stable compared to prior (Image 5).

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，左肺上叶微小结节同前，追查
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lower lobe; tiny nodules in the left upper lobe are stable compared to prior. Further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 胸上段至中段食管壁增厚较前减轻，现较厚处约8mm（IM19）,原较厚处约为16mm，食管外膜面较前清晰
text_en: Esophageal wall thickening from upper to mid thoracic segment reduced compared to prior; current thickest portion approximately 8mm (IM19), previously approximately 16mm; esophageal outer membrane surface clearer than prior.

source_text: 纵隔2R组淋巴结略缩小，原约9x7mm（IM9），现约8x7mm（IM10）
text_en: Mediastinal station 2R lymph nodes slightly decreased in size, previously approximately 9x7 mm (IM9), now approximately 8x7 mm (IM10).

source_text: 纵膈4,5,7组及双肺门多发高密度淋巴结同前，4R较大原约24*18mm，现约24x18mm（IM33），边界模糊
text_en: Multiple high-density lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 4, 5, 7 and bilateral hilar regions are stable compared to prior; the largest 4R was previously approximately 24x18 mm and currently measures approximately 24x18 mm (IM33), with blurred margins

source_text: 右肺下叶微小结节同前，＜5mm（图36）
text_en: Right lower lobe tiny nodule unchanged, <5 mm (Figure 36)

source_text: 右侧胸膜弥漫多发结节较前增大，如原4mm（IM20），现约6mm（IM21），考虑胸膜转移
text_en: Multiple diffuse nodules in the right pleura are larger than prior; for example, a nodule previously 4 mm (IM20) now measures approximately 6 mm (IM21). Pleural metastasis is considered.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结清扫术后，纵隔5组淋巴结增大，较大约11x7mm(IM24),考虑转移
text_en: Following mediastinal lymph node dissection, the station 5 mediastinal lymph node is enlarged, measuring approximately 11x7 mm (IM24), suspicious for metastasis.

source_text: 甲状腺左叶占位同前同前，请结合超声检查
text_en: Thyroid left lobe space-occupying lesion same as prior, please correlate with ultrasound.

source_text: 未见明显复发
text_en: No significant recurrence

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下、两肺斜裂旁小结节同前，追查
text_en: Small subpleural nodules in the right middle lobe and adjacent to the oblique fissures in both lungs are unchanged; recommended for follow-up.

source_text: 左肺下叶斜裂旁4mm结节较前相仿（IM30）
text_en: 4mm nodule adjacent to the oblique fissure in the left lower lobe is similar to previous (IM30).

source_text: 双肺胸膜下见多发高密度结节灶及索条同前（IM17、44、55等）
text_en: Multiple subpleural high-density nodules and linear opacities in both lungs are stable (IM17, 44, 55, etc.).

source_text: 右肺小结节同前，约3mm（IMA21）
text_en: Right lung small nodule unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IMA21)

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则实性-磨玻璃密度结节影大致同前，整体范围约21x15mm（IM23），实性成分范围仍约10x7mm（IM23肺窗）
text_en: An irregular solid–ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment is approximately stable compared to prior, with an overall size of approximately 21x15 mm (IM23); the solid component remains approximately 10x7 mm (IM23, lung window).

source_text: 右肺斑片索条结节影同前（IMA13-15、51）
text_en: Patchy, linear, and nodular opacities in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior (IMA13-15, 51).

source_text: 纵隔4L区软组织密度灶同前，淋巴结
text_en: Lymph nodes at mediastinal station 4L show a soft tissue density lesion unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右侧甲状腺低密度结节影同前
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right thyroid is stable.

source_text: 转移
text_en: Metastasis.

source_text: 胸中段食道癌疗后，较前好转
text_en: Post-treatment mid-thoracic esophageal carcinoma, improvement compared to prior.

source_text: 左侧肾上腺结节样增粗同前，未见明显异常强化
text_en: Left adrenal nodular thickening unchanged; no abnormal enhancement is seen.

source_text: 左锁骨上区淋巴结较前缩小，现约4*3mm(图5)，原约10x3mm（IM5）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node decreased in size compared to prior, now approximately 4 x 3 mm (Figure 5), previously approximately 10 x 3 mm (IM5)

source_text: 右肺少许索条影同前，双肺未见新增结节灶及斑片影
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下软组织灶形态较前饱满，转移可能，追查
text_en: The subpleural soft tissue focus in the right upper lobe appears more rounded than before; metastasis is possible; further evaluation is warranted.

source_text: 左上肺磨玻璃结节灶大致同前，约9mm(IMA32)，余双肺未见新发异常密度区及结节灶
text_en: Ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe is largely stable, measuring approximately 9 mm (IMA32); no new abnormal density or nodules are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 余扫及诸骨未见新生破坏灶
text_en: No new destructive foci are seen in the bones imaged.

source_text: 右肺浅淡点状结节影同前（IMA19）
text_en: Faint punctate nodular opacity in the right lung is unchanged compared to prior (IMA19).

source_text: 纵隔4、5、7组及双肺门淋巴结较前增大，现较大约35x20mm（IM23），原较大21x14mm（IM22)
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4, 5, and 7 and bilateral hilar lymph nodes have increased compared to previous, now largest approximately 35x20 mm (Image 23), previously largest 21x14 mm (Image 22).

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节同前，约3mm（IM9）
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule stable compared to prior, approximately 3 mm (IM9)

source_text: 双肺散在少许钙化结节同前，左下肺近膈面小结节同前（IM50）
text_en: Scattered few calcified nodules in both lungs are unchanged, small nodule near the diaphragmatic surface of the left lower lobe unchanged (IM50).

source_text: 双肺多个小结节影部分同前（IM44），大部分较前缩小（IM24、37、40、47），如左肺上叶舌段，原约8x5mm者，现约7x4mm（IM37），密度较前减低
text_en: Some of the multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable (IM44), while most are smaller than before (IM24, 37, 40, 47). For example, in the lingular segment of the left upper lobe, a nodule previously measuring approximately 8x5 mm now measures approximately 7x4 mm (IM37), with decreased density compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔食管旁淋巴结缩小，原约14x9mm，现约8x6mm（IM10）
text_en: The mediastinal paraesophageal lymph node has decreased in size, previously approximately 14x9mm, currently approximately 8x6mm (IM10).

source_text: 双肺新见散在多发类圆形小结节，约2-4mm，考虑肺内转移可能大，追查
text_en: Newly noted scattered multiple round small nodules in both lungs, approximately 2-4 mm; pulmonary metastasis likely, follow up.

source_text: 左肺上叶切除术后，支气管断端下方软组织影较前增大，现约25*19mm(图28)，原约23*15mm(图29)，建议增强CT检查
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, soft tissue shadow below bronchial stump increased compared to previous, currently approximately 25*19 mm (Figure 28), previously approximately 23*15 mm (Figure 29), recommend contrast-enhanced CT.

source_text: 双肺散在多发小结节数量及大小同前，边缘不规则，较大仍约5mm（IM46）
text_en: Number and size of scattered multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, with irregular margins, the largest still measuring approximately 5 mm (IM46).

source_text: 右肺下叶微小结节同前，追查
text_en: Right lower lobe tiny nodule unchanged, follow-up recommended

source_text: 肝左叶低密度结节大致同前
text_en: Low-density nodule in left lobe of liver roughly same as before.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R组度淋巴结同前大致同前（IM15、18）
text_en: Lymph nodes at mediastinal stations 2R and 4R are stable (IM15, 18).

source_text: 左肺门小结节较前增大，现约19x10mm(图23 纵隔窗)，原约15*8mm(图25 纵隔窗)，病灶远端见条索影，其旁多发结节较前增大，现约15x12mm（IMA21），原约12x10mm（IMA22），追查
text_en: Left hilar small nodule increased in size compared to prior, now approximately 19x10 mm (Figure 23, mediastinal window), previously approximately 15x8 mm (Figure 25, mediastinal window). Linear opacities distal to the lesion; adjacent multiple nodules increased in size compared to prior, now approximately 15x12 mm (IMA21), previously approximately 12x10 mm (IMA22), follow-up recommended

source_text: 余肺内散在小结节同前，如右肺中叶结节仍约2mm（IM39）
text_en: The remaining scattered small nodules in the lungs are unchanged; for example, the nodule in the right middle lobe remains approximately 2 mm (IM39).

source_text: 右肺结节增大，左肺下叶新生结节，考虑转移可能大，追查
text_en: Right lung nodule has increased in size; new nodule in the left lower lobe, metastasis likely; further investigation recommended.

source_text: 纵隔散在淋巴结较前相仿，较大约11x9mm（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal scattered lymph nodes similar to previous, largest approximately 11x9 mm (IM19).

source_text: 右肺下叶结节略增大，现约10x10mm（IM37），原约10x7mm
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is slightly larger, now measuring approximately 10x10 mm (IM37), previously about 10x7 mm.

source_text: 纵隔4R组长条形淋巴结同前，约16x7mm（IM26），平扫密度较高，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R elongated lymph node similar to previous, approximately 16x7 mm (IM26), higher density on non-contrast scan, considered old lesion.

source_text: 左上肺结节大小同前相仿，内部密度减低
text_en: The left upper lobe nodule is similar in size compared to prior, with decreased internal density.

source_text: 两肺上叶术后改变同前，两肺斑片索条影、左肺小结节影同前
text_en: Postoperative changes in both upper lobes are unchanged. Patchy and linear opacities in both lungs and a small nodule in the left lung are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左侧胸腔多量积液，左侧胸膜下新发结节，转移待排，结合临床密切观察
text_en: Large amount of pleural effusion in the left hemithorax; new subpleural nodule in the left lung, metastasis cannot be excluded; close observation with clinical correlation recommended.

source_text: 左下肺粗大索条影同前，右肺未见新增结节灶
text_en: The coarse linear opacity in the left lower lobe is unchanged; no new nodules are seen in the right lung.

source_text: 右肺门肿大淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: The enlarged right hilar lymph node is unchanged from prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双肺纹理增多，双肺散在小结节大致同前，较大约5mm（IM38）
text_en: Increased lung markings. Scattered small nodules in both lungs are approximately similar to prior. The largest is about 5 mm (IM38).

source_text: 左肺小结节同前（IM37），余双未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Small nodules in the left lung unchanged from prior (IM37), no new nodules or consolidation in the remaining bilateral lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶后外侧基底段肿块切除术后，左肺上叶尖后段小结节大小同前（IMA16），左肺未见新发病变，左肺上叶下舌段原血管迂曲走行现不明显
text_en: Post-mass resection in the posterior lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe. The small nodule in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior (IMA16). No new lesions in the left lung. The previously noted tortuous vascular course in the inferior lingular segment of the left upper lobe is no longer apparent.

source_text: 双肺多发磨玻璃密度结节灶大致同前，较大者位于左肺上叶尖后段，仍约14x8mm（IM18），边界模糊
text_en: Multiple ground-glass density nodular opacities in both lungs are essentially unchanged; the largest is located in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe, still measuring approximately 14x8 mm (IM18), with indistinct margins.

source_text: 双肺小结节影，右肺下叶结节被遮蔽，余结节大致同前，现较大约5mm（IM34）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules; the nodule in the right lower lobe is obscured, the remainder are roughly stable, current largest approximately 5 mm (IM34)

source_text: 左肺上叶片状磨玻璃密度灶较前减轻，小结节较前减少
text_en: The patchy ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe has improved compared to previous, with a decrease in small nodules.

source_text: 近肺门侧见上叶后段支气管截断性闭塞同前，肿物远端仍可见少许斑片影
text_en: Truncative occlusion of the posterior segmental bronchus of the upper lobe at the hilar side unchanged, a few patchy opacities still visible distal to the mass.

source_text: 双肺下叶少许条索、小片状影同前，双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Few linear and patchy opacities in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺胸膜下微小结节影大致同前
text_en: Left lung subpleural tiny nodules unchanged from previous.

source_text: 左肺下叶前内基底段不规则结节范围大致同前，仍约12x10mm（IM42），实性成分较前稍减少，周围未见明显索条牵拉
text_en: In the anterior-inferior basal segment of the left lower lobe, irregular nodule approximately unchanged in size at 12x10 mm (IM42), solid component slightly decreased, no obvious traction bands.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段近膈肌上方扁平样结节影同前，大小约8x3mm（IM65）
text_en: The flat-appearing nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe near the diaphragm is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 8x3 mm (IM65).

source_text: 纵隔多个小淋巴结同前，较大约10x7mm（IM18），平扫密度稍高
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest approximately 10x7 mm (IM18), slightly higher density on non-contrast scan

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段空洞性占位，较前缩小
text_en: Cavitary mass in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is smaller than prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，左肺小结节同前，胸部CT未见新生占位征象
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; small nodules in the left lung are stable; chest CT shows no new mass lesions.

source_text: 右肺中叶少许微小结节及钙化灶同前
text_en: Minimal tiny nodules and calcific foci in the right middle lobe are unchanged.

source_text: 余双肺未见新发结节及片絮影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no new nodules or fluffy opacities.

source_text: 左肺上叶支气管旁新发一实性小结节，约4mm（IM19）
text_en: Left upper lobe peribronchial new solid small nodule, approximately 4 mm (IM19)

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段混杂磨玻璃密度结节大致同前，约13x11mm（IMA17），可见胸膜凹陷
text_en: Mixed ground-glass density nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is essentially unchanged, approximately 13 × 11 mm (IMA17), with visible pleural indentation.

source_text: 左肺下叶沿支气管分布小结节同前，考虑炎性病变
text_en: Left lower lobe small nodules distributed along bronchi unchanged, considered inflammatory

source_text: 两肺可见多个微小点灶（IM15、16、18、35、44、48、52等），较前相仿，部分层面微小结节较前显示欠清
text_en: Multiple tiny foci are seen in both lungs (IM15, 16, 18, 35, 44, 48, 52, etc.), similar to prior; some tiny nodules are less clearly seen on some sections than prior.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结平扫大小较前相仿
text_en: Right hilar lymph node size is similar to prior on non-contrast imaging.

source_text: 左上叶微小结节同前（IM11），余两肺未见新发结节影
text_en: The tiny nodule in the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior (IM11); the remainder of both lungs shows no new nodules.

source_text: 双肺上叶胸膜下模糊小结节同前，约2-4mm（IM10、16、20）
text_en: Faint small subpleural nodules in the upper lobes of both lungs are unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 2-4 mm (IM10, 16, 20).

source_text: 左锁骨上区淋巴结同前，仍约8mm（IM9）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node unchanged, still approximately 8 mm (IM9).

source_text: 双肺上叶斑片索条影同前，两肺散在点状高密度小结节影同前，两肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Patchy and linear opacities in the upper lobes of both lungs are stable compared to prior; scattered punctate high-density small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior; no new nodules or consolidations are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔、左腋下散在小淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal and left axillary scattered small lymph nodes unchanged from previous.

source_text: 未见明显异常增大
text_en: No significant abnormal enlargement

source_text: 右侧水平裂旁可见类结节灶同前，现约11x7mm（IM36）
text_en: Nodule-like focus adjacent to the right horizontal fissure is stable, currently measuring approximately 11x7 mm (IM36).

source_text: 左肺上叶下舌段小结节同前，仍约8x7mm（IM46）

text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no newly increased nodules or patchy opacities.

text_en: On scan, right adrenal nodule unchanged from prior (IM68).

text_en: Scattered hazy small nodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior, the largest measuring approximately 4 mm (IMA27).

text_en: A small nodule adjacent to the thoracic aorta in the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 6x4 mm (IM31).

No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the remainder of the mediastinum, bilateral hila, supraclavicular regions, or bilateral axillae.

source_text: 纵隔4R组、左肺门淋巴结同前，较大约13x9mm（IM26）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R group and left hilar lymph nodes are unchanged from previous, larger approximately 13x9 mm (Image 26).

source_text: 右乳新见软组织密度类结节影，约17x15mm（IM29），建议进一步检查明确性质
text_en: New soft tissue density nodular opacity in the right breast, measuring approximately 17x15 mm (IM29). Further evaluation is recommended to clarify the nature.

source_text: 双肺模糊小结节灶大致同前，复查
text_en: Faint small nodules in both lungs are roughly unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔2、4、6、7组散在淋巴结较前变化不明显，原较大约12x9mm（IM25），现约14x6mm（IM28）
text_en: Scattered lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2, 4, 6, 7 with no significant change compared to prior; previously largest approximately 12x9 mm (IM25), now approximately 14x6 mm (IM28)

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后，支气管断端旁条形软组织影较前增厚，原约5mm现约8mm（Im32）且向下范围亦增大
text_en: Status post left lower lobectomy, linear soft tissue shadow adjacent to the bronchial stump thickened compared to previous, from approximately 5 mm to 8 mm (Image 32), with increased inferior extent.

source_text: 纵隔4-6组小淋巴结同前相仿，未见肿大
text_en: Small mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4-6 are similar to prior, with no enlargement noted.

source_text: 双侧腋窝、两肺门及纵隔散在小淋巴结同前，短径小于10mm
text_en: Scattered small lymph nodes in bilateral axillae, bilateral hila, and mediastinum are unchanged, short diameter less than 10 mm.

source_text: 纵隔5组淋巴结同前，较大仍约15x10mm（Im27）
text_en: Mediastinal group 5 lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest still approximately 15x10 mm (Image 27)

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，肺内透亮度均匀，右肺下叶背段小结节同前，约2mm（IM27），邻近胸膜增厚
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. Lung lucency is uniform. The small nodule in the right lower lobe posterior segment is stable, measuring approximately 2 mm (IM27), with adjacent pleural thickening.

source_text: 纵隔、肺门淋巴结同前，较大者约15x10mm（IM27）
text_en: Mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest approximately 15x10 mm (IM27).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，右肺下叶基底段支气管截断，局部见软组织团块较前缩小，原约50x36mm，现约45*33mm（IM33），远端肺内见片絮影较前缩小，右肺中叶见索条影同前，右肺上中叶小结节同前，双肺未见新发结节
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, bronchial cutoff in the basal segment of the right lower lobe, with a soft tissue mass locally that is smaller than before, previously approximately 50x36 mm, now approximately 45x33 mm (IM33), patchy opacities in the distal lung are smaller than before, linear opacities in the right middle lobe similar to prior, small nodules in the right upper and middle lobes similar to prior, no new nodules seen in both lungs.

source_text: 余纵隔多发较高密度淋巴结较前相仿，较大者仍约17x9mm（IM22）
text_en: The remaining multiple higher-attenuation mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior; the largest remains approximately 17x9 mm (IM22).

source_text: 左肺浅淡小结节大小及密度大致同前（IM32、38）
text_en: Left lung faint small nodule size and density largely unchanged (IM32, 38).

source_text: 余肺未见新发结节及斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 左下叶结节同前
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶及中叶散在索条影及小结节同前(图19)，余双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，未见结节或实变影
text_en: Scattered linear opacities and small nodules in the right upper and middle lobes are stable compared to prior (Figure 19). The remainder of the lungs shows unremarkable bronchovascular markings and uniform lucency. No nodules or consolidation are seen.

source_text: 双肺新见多发条片影，双肺内多发实性小结节部分同前（IM23、47等），较大约4mm（IM47），部分遮蔽未见显示
text_en: Newly noted multiple linear and patchy opacities in both lungs; multiple pre-existing solid small nodules in the lungs remain (IM23, 47, etc.), the largest measuring approximately 4 mm (IM47); some are obscured and not visible.

source_text: 食管术后改变，右上肺索条结节灶同前
text_en: Post-esophagectomy changes, linear and nodular opacities in the right upper lobe unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段索条及微小结节灶同前（IMA16），余双肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: The linear opacities and tiny nodules in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment are unchanged from previous (IMA16); no new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右肺多发索条小结节影同前，双肺未见新增结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: Multiple linear and small nodular opacities in the right lung are stable. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 两肺未见新增结节灶
text_en: No new nodular lesions are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 扫及左肾上腺结节状增粗同前（IM56）
text_en: Nodular thickening of the left adrenal gland is unchanged from prior (IM56).

source_text: 双肺多发小结节同前（Im21、41、44、51等）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior (Im21, 41, 44, 51, etc.).

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影同前，左侧叶间胸膜旁小结节同前，约为5mm（IM40）
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged; a small nodule adjacent to the left interlobar pleura is unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM40).

source_text: 前纵隔结节较前缩小，现约11x6mm(IM21)，余纵隔未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: The anterior mediastinal nodule is smaller than before, now approximately 11x6 mm (IM21). The remainder of the mediastinum shows no enlarged lymph nodes.

source_text: 双肺散在索条影同前，未见新生结节影
text_en: Scattered linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged from prior. No new nodules are seen.

source_text: 右肺肺内透亮度均匀，未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: The right lung demonstrates uniform lucency; no new nodules or consolidation are seen.

source_text: 左肺少许索条影同前，两肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Left lung slight linear shadows stable, both lungs no new nodules or consolidation seen

source_text: 双侧肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: No new nodules are seen in the bilateral lungs.

source_text: 右上纵隔见新发小淋巴结（IMA11),纵隔、肺门、腋窝及锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: A new small lymph node is seen in the right upper mediastinum (IMA11); no enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum, hila, axillae, or supraclavicular regions.

source_text: 左侧第5肋骨折，扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Fracture of the left fifth rib. No osseous destruction is seen in the other bones of the thorax on the current imaging.

source_text: 并右上肺胸膜下多发微结节大致同前
text_en: In addition, multiple subpleural micronodules in the right upper lobe largely unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺未见新发结节影
text_en: No new nodules seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶类结节影同前，倾向良性，追查
text_en: The nodular opacity in the left lower lobe is unchanged, suggestive of benign, follow-up.

source_text: 右肺小结节同前，约3mm（IM37）
text_en: Right lung small nodule unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IM37)

source_text: 左肺下叶磨玻璃样病灶伴中心软组织密度结节范围及密度较前相仿，磨玻璃密度范围仍约30x25mm（IMA39），软组织密度范围仍约9x8mm（IMA38）
text_en: Left lower lobe ground-glass opacity lesion with central soft tissue density nodule, size and density similar to previous; ground-glass density extent still approximately 30x25 mm (IMA39), soft tissue density extent still approximately 9x8 mm (IMA38)

source_text: 右侧甲状腺低密度结节同前
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right thyroid is stable.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, no definite evidence of recurrence or metastasis is seen.

source_text: 右肺中叶新发一实性小结节，约4mm（IM40）
text_en: Newly developed small solid nodule in the right middle lobe, approximately 4 mm (IM40)

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节影同前（IMA25）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior (IMA25).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段及下叶前基底段分别磨玻璃密度结节较前变化不明显（IM17），左肺另多发点状小结节同前，较大约3mm（Im51）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodules in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment and left lower lobe anterior basal segment, respectively, show no significant change compared to prior (IM17). Multiple punctate small nodules in the left lung are stable compared to prior, with the largest measuring approximately 3 mm (Im51).

source_text: 食管胸中下段管壁不均匀增厚较前明显减轻（Im31），原较厚处约20mm，现不足10mm，外膜模糊，近端食管无扩张
text_en: Irregular wall thickening of the mid-to-lower thoracic esophagus significantly reduced compared to prior (IM31), thickest portion previously approximately 20mm, now less than 10mm, serosa blurred, proximal esophagus without dilation.

source_text: 右肺上叶及左肺下叶斑点、长条形结节同前，较大仍约8x5mm（IM13），继续追查
text_en: Punctate and elongated nodules in the right upper lobe and left lower lobe are stable compared to prior; the largest remains approximately 8x5 mm (IM13); continued follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 双肺微结节及胸膜陈旧病变等同前
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary micro-nodules and pleural old lesions, etc., are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶局部术后，术区高密度缝线影周围条片软组织密度影较前缩小，原约45x26mm（肺窗IM11），现约38x20mm（肺窗IM12），左肺上叶小斑片影同前（IM21）
text_en: Following local resection of the left upper lobe, a linear soft tissue density opacity surrounding the high-density suture shadow at the surgical site is reduced compared to prior, previously approximately 45x26 mm (lung window IM11), now approximately 38x20 mm (lung window IM12), and a small patchy opacity in the left upper lobe is stable (IM21)

source_text: 右侧顶后壁胸膜增厚伴胸水，转移可能
text_en: Right apicoposterior pleural thickening with pleural effusion, metastasis possible

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约14x7mm（IM25）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged, largest measuring approximately 14x7 mm (IM25)

source_text: 左斜裂扁平结节同前，仍约6x3mm（IM32）
text_en: Left oblique fissure flat nodule unchanged, still approximately 6x3 mm (IM32).

source_text: 肝脏占位大致同前，建议结合腹部检查
text_en: Liver mass largely unchanged from prior, recommend correlation with abdominal imaging.

source_text: 两肺间质纤维化改变、双肺小结节同前
text_en: Findings of interstitial fibrosis and small nodules in both lungs are stable.

source_text: 右肺上叶微结节同前，直径约3mm（IM21）
text_en: Right upper lobe micro-nodule unchanged, approximately 3 mm in diameter (IM21).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，术区见条片影，未见新发肿块
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; linear and patchy opacity is seen in the surgical bed; no new mass identified.

source_text: 右肺下叶环形磨玻璃密度结节同前，约为6mm（IM35）
text_en: The ring-shaped ground-glass nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM35).

source_text: 右肺上叶癌较前缩小
text_en: Right upper lobe carcinoma is smaller than prior.

source_text: 胸4椎体内见稍高密度模糊结节同前
text_en: Slightly sclerotic fuzzy nodule within T4 vertebral body unchanged.

source_text: 双肺另少许浅淡密度小结节大致同前（IM12、17、30、33），不超过5mm
text_en: A few additional faint density small nodules in both lungs are largely unchanged (IM12, 17, 30, 33), not exceeding 5 mm.

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下磨玻璃结节较前相仿，现约9x7mm(IM13)，追查
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural ground-glass nodule similar in size to prior, currently approximately 9 x 7 mm (IM13), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶条索灶同前，胸膜下新发小结节，较大约4mm（IM53）
text_en: Left lower lobe linear opacity stable compared to prior, new subpleural small nodule, largest approximately 4 mm (IM53).

source_text: 右肺见少许索条影同前，余肺未见结节灶
text_en: Minimal reticular opacities in the right lung are stable; no nodules are seen in the left lung.
