source_text: 左侧斜裂上小结节同前（IM22）
text_en: Small nodule in the left oblique fissure is unchanged (IM22).

source_text: 左肺下叶沿支气管分布小结节较前减少（IM47）
text_en: Left lower lobe small nodules distributed along bronchi decreased compared to prior (IM47)

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段新发少许模糊小结节，较大约4mm（IM44）
text_en: A few new indistinct small nodules are noted in the outer basal segment of the right lower lobe, the largest measuring approximately 4 mm (IM44).

source_text: 纵隔4、5组多发小淋巴结同前相仿，较大约11x6mm（IM23）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4 and 5 similar to prior, largest measuring approximately 11x6 mm (IM23)

source_text: 扫及门腔间隙可见淋巴结大致同前，仍约10x8mm（IM53）
text_en: Lymph nodes visible in the portocaval space are roughly unchanged from prior, size still approximately 10x8mm (IM53).

source_text: 两下肺胸膜下微小结节影同前（IM33、43），直径小于5mm
text_en: Subpleural micronodules in both lower lungs are unchanged from prior (IM33, 43), with diameters less than 5 mm.

source_text: 余肺未见新发结节灶及斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 左肺未见新发占位
text_en: No new mass lesion in left lung

source_text: 右肺下叶背段不规则混杂磨玻璃密度结节大致同前，原约20x10mm，现约19x11mm（IM25），牵拉相邻的斜裂胸膜
text_en: The irregular mixed ground-glass opacity nodule in the apical segment of the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged, previously measuring approximately 20x10 mm, now approximately 19x11 mm (IM25), and it is pulling on the adjacent oblique fissure pleura.

source_text: 左肺上叶癌复查，较前明显缩小
text_en: Follow-up of left upper lobe carcinoma shows significant reduction in size compared to previous.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下环形结节灶同前（IM31）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural ring-shaped nodule unchanged from previous (IM31).

source_text: 左肺上叶3mm点状结节同前相仿（IM15）
text_en: A 3 mm punctate nodule in the left upper lobe is similar to prior (IM15).

source_text: 右侧纵隔胸膜多发结节较前增大，现较大13x8mm（IM17),双侧未见胸水
text_en: Multiple nodules in the right mediastinal pleura are larger than before. The largest is now 13x8 mm (IM17). No pleural effusion bilaterally.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节、双肺斑片影同前
text_en: Small nodule in the right lower lobe and patchy opacities in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前略缩小，较大原约11x5mm（IM23），现＜5mm(图22)
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are slightly decreased compared to previous; largest previously approximately 11x5mm (IM23), currently less than 5mm (Figure 22).

source_text: 甲状腺多发结节同前，结合超声检查
text_en: Multiple thyroid nodules stable compared to prior; correlate with ultrasound.

source_text: 纵隔内散在小淋巴结较前相仿，2R组现仍约8mm（IM13）
text_en: Scattered small mediastinal lymph nodes similar to prior, with station 2R still approximately 8mm (IM13)

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，双侧锁骨上、腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, with no enlarged supraclavicular or axillary lymph nodes seen bilaterally.

source_text: 原左肺上叶新发小片结节影较前减
text_en: The newly noted small patchy opacity in the left upper lobe is decreased compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节同前，仍约2mm（IM15）
text_en: Small nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, still measures approximately 2 mm (IM15).

source_text: 尖段支气管进入肿物后截断，肿物与胸膜顶、第一肋骨及右锁骨下动脉分界不清同前，肿块周边不规则浅淡片絮影减少
text_en: The apical segmental bronchus is truncated after entering the mass; the mass remains indistinct from the apex of the pleura, the first rib, and the right subclavian artery as before; irregular, faint patchy opacities around the mass have decreased.

source_text: 左第6肋异常高密度区同前，骨转移
text_en: Abnormal area of increased density in the left sixth rib is unchanged; bone metastasis.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段小结节较前缩小，建议复查
text_en: A small nodule in the left lower lobe posterior basal segment has decreased in size compared to previous; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右侧水平裂见小结节样增厚同前（Im30）
text_en: Small nodular thickening seen along the right horizontal fissure is stable (Im30).

source_text: 余双肺未见新增结节或实变影，
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no newly increased nodules or consolidation shadows,

source_text: 左肺上叶微小结节影同前
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule unchanged.

source_text: 双肺多发磨玻璃密度结节同前，随诊
text_en: Multiple ground-glass density nodules in both lungs are unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔4、7组、左锁骨上多发淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4 and 7 and left supraclavicular lymph nodes are essentially unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段及中叶内侧段分别可见磨玻璃密度结节同前，大小仍约10x7mm、5mm（薄层IM62、116），右肺上叶病灶其内可见纹理穿行，边缘毛糙
text_en: Ground-glass density nodules in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe and medial segment of the right middle lobe are unchanged, still approximately 10x7mm and 5mm (thin-slice IM62, 116), respectively; the right upper lobe lesion shows internal linear structures and irregular margins.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度小结节、左上叶微小实性结节同前，追查
text_en: Small ground-glass nodule and tiny solid nodule in the left upper lobe unchanged from prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶新见多发条片及结节灶，可见强化，较大约17mm（IMA41），转移待排，建议进一步检查
text_en: Multiple new linear and nodular opacities are seen in the right lower lobe, with enhancement observed. The largest measures approximately 17 mm (IMA41). Metastasis cannot be excluded; further evaluation is recommended.

source_text: 左肺胸主动脉旁小结节大致同前，约4mm（IM58）
text_en: Left lung paraaortic small nodule largely unchanged, approximately 4 mm (IM58).

source_text: 右叶间胸膜不规则结节同前，随诊
text_en: Irregular nodule along the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶支气管旁软组织结节较前缩小
text_en: The soft tissue nodule adjacent to the right upper lobe bronchus has decreased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺散在多发钙化结节及索条影同前，余肺内未见新增结节或肿块影
text_en: Scattered calcified nodules and linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged; no new nodules or mass-like lesions are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺钙化、两肺索条影同前，两肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Calcification in the right lung and linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged compared to prior; no new nodules or consolidations are seen in either lung.

source_text: 纵隔散在淋巴结同前
text_en: Scattered mediastinal lymph nodes same as before.

source_text: 锁骨上窝、纵隔间隙、双肺门散在淋巴结影大致同前
text_en: Scattered lymph node shadows in supraclavicular fossa, mediastinal spaces, and bilateral hilar regions roughly similar to prior.

source_text: 甲状腺右叶结节大致同前
text_en: Right thyroid lobe nodule stable compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃密度结节影，较前稍增大，现约20x15mm（IMA45），原约19x12mm，边界清晰，密度不均，中央条索状实性密度较前稍增大且密度增高，原约3mm，现约5mm（IMA47），余肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Lung parenchymal lucency is uniform. A ground-glass opacity in the apical segment of the right upper lobe has slightly increased in size, now measuring approximately 20x15 mm (IMA45), previously 19x12 mm, with clear margins and heterogeneous density. The central linear solid component has slightly increased in size and density compared to prior, previously about 3 mm, now about 5 mm (IMA47). No other nodules or consolidation are seen.

source_text: 左肺少许斑片索条影同前，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Left lung slight patchy and linear shadows stable, no new nodules or patchy opacities seen

source_text: 右肺结节同前，倾向陈旧灶
text_en: Right lung nodule unchanged, likely representing an old focus.

source_text: 右侧胸膜增厚较前加重，考虑转移，右侧胸水，右肺膨胀不全
text_en: Right pleural thickening is worse than prior; metastasis is considered. Right pleural effusion and right lung atelectasis are present.

source_text: 右肺下叶后基底段肿块较前大致相仿，仍约28x22mm（IM41）
text_en: Mass in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is approximately unchanged compared to prior, still measuring about 28 x 22 mm (IM41).

source_text: 纵隔余数枚小淋巴结同前
text_en: The remaining small mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺术后，胸部CT所见大致同前，未见新增占位征象
text_en: Postoperative right lung, chest CT findings are largely unchanged compared to prior, with no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 左侧胸膜结节影同前（IM27）
text_en: Left pleural nodular opacity is unchanged (IM27)

source_text: 左肺下叶浅淡斑片索条影同前，小结节灶同前，约5mm（Im55）
text_en: Left lower lobe faint patchy and streaky opacities unchanged from previous, small nodule unchanged from previous, approximately 5 mm (Im55)

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门淋巴结同前，较大仍约11x8mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal and bilateral hilar lymph nodes, unchanged from previous, the larger one still approximately 11x8 mm (IM20).

source_text: 双肺多发小结节同前，部分位于胸膜下，较大者约6mm（IM51）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior, some located subpleurally, largest measuring approximately 6 mm (IM51).

source_text: 双腋下散在小淋巴结同前
text_en: Scattered small lymph nodes at both axillae are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左侧斜裂胸膜小结节同前，随诊观察
text_en: Small nodule along the left major fissure pleura is unchanged; follow-up observation is recommended.

source_text: 不能除外转移，建议复查
text_en: Metastasis cannot be excluded; follow-up recommended

source_text: 右腋下小淋巴结同前，约7mm（IM19），纵隔、双肺门及锁骨上未见淋巴结肿大
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the right axilla are unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 7 mm (IM19). No lymphadenopathy in the mediastinum, bilateral hila, or supraclavicular regions.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，断端未见复发征象
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no findings of recurrence at the stump.

source_text: 原左肺下叶较大结节大致同前，仍约8mm（IM35)
text_en: The larger nodule in the left lower lobe is essentially unchanged, still measuring approximately 8 mm (IM35).

source_text: 左肺小结节影同前
text_en: Left lung small nodule unchanged

source_text: 左下肺可见索条影，考虑陈旧灶，余肺未见新发结节灶及斑片影
text_en: Linear opacities are visible in the left lower lobe, likely representing chronic changes; the remainder of the lungs shows no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 左下肺模糊小结节灶同前，追查
text_en: Faint small nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged; further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔2R及6组淋巴结较前稍缩小，如2R者原约13x12mm（IM11），现约12x10mm（IM12），追查
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R and 6 are slightly decreased in size compared to prior. For example, the 2R node was approximately 13x12 mm (IM11), now approximately 12x10 mm (IM12). Follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门小淋巴结同前，双侧锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions unchanged from previous; no enlarged lymph nodes seen in bilateral supraclavicular and bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 扫及腰1椎体、右侧第四肋骨高密度结节同前，余胸廓诸骨未见明确破坏征象
text_en: CT scan shows a high-density nodule in the L1 vertebral body and right fourth rib, stable compared to prior, with no clear signs of destruction in the remaining bones of the thorax.

source_text: 贲门周围及胃小弯肿大淋巴结较前缩小，原约36*27mm（IMA58），现约26x21mm（IM58）
text_en: Enlarged lymph nodes around the cardia and along the lesser curvature of the stomach have decreased in size, from approximately 36x27 mm (IMA58) to approximately 26x21 mm (IM58).

source_text: 右侧锁骨上区淋巴结较前稍大，原约5mm（IM6），现约8mm（IM6）
text_en: The lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region are slightly larger than prior, previously approximately 5 mm (IM6), now approximately 8 mm (IM6).

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节影同前，约7x5mm（IM47）
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe, same as before, approximately 7x5mm (Image 47).

source_text: 右肺多发GGO大致同前，倾向恶性可能，建议追查
text_en: Multiple ground-glass opacities in the right lung are approximately stable compared to prior imaging, with malignancy favored; recommend further investigation.

source_text: 两肺索条钙化灶同前，两肺小结节影大致同前（IM31、48），较大现约7x5mm（IM48），原约7x4mm（IM47）
text_en: Calcified linear opacities in both lungs are stable; small nodules in both lungs are stable (IM31, 48), the largest now measures approximately 7x5 mm (IM48), previously measured 7x4 mm (IM47).

source_text: 右肺中叶内侧段分叶状混杂密度结节略增大，原约19x15mm，现约19x16mm（IM28），实性成分略增多
text_en: The lobulated mixed-density nodule in the medial segment of the right middle lobe is slightly increased in size, previously approximately 19x15 mm, now approximately 19x16 mm (IM28), with a slight increase in solid component.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，未见明确转移征象
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no definite signs of metastasis identified

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下小结节部分略增大，如原约4mm（IM33），现约6mm（IM32），转移可能
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural nodule partially slightly enlarged, previously approximately 4 mm (IM33), now approximately 6 mm (IM32), possible metastasis

source_text: 左肺下叶结节同前，追查
text_en: Left lower lobe nodule unchanged from previous; follow up.

source_text: 双肺及右侧叶间胸膜散发小结节同前，较大者位于右肺下叶，约8x4mm（IM41）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs and right interlobar pleura are stable, largest located in the right lower lobe, measuring approximately 8x4 mm (IM41).

source_text: 左肺门及纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，较大约16x8mm
text_en: Multiple left hilar and mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest approximately 16x8mm.

source_text: 右肺下叶癌，病变较前缩小
text_en: Carcinoma in the right lower lobe; the lesion is smaller compared to prior.

source_text: 下叶脊柱旁胸膜小结节同前，约7mm（Im42）
text_en: Small pleural nodule adjacent to the spine in the lower lobe unchanged, approximately 7 mm (Im42)

source_text: 纵隔5、6组多发淋巴结较前相仿，较大约8mm（IM24）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 5 and 6 similar to previous, largest approximately 8 mm (IM24).

source_text: 食管胸中段管壁偏心性低密度灶较前略缩小，密度略增高，现较大层面约19*12mm（IM29），原约33*20mm（IM25），未见明显强化
text_en: Eccentric low-density lesion within the wall of the mid-thoracic esophagus is slightly reduced in size compared to prior, with density slightly increased. Current largest cross-sectional area is approximately 19x12 mm (IM29), previously approximately 33x20 mm (IM25). No significant enhancement is seen.

source_text: 右肺浅淡点状结节影同前（IMA21）
text_en: Faint punctate nodular opacity in the right lung is unchanged compared to prior (IMA21).

source_text: 双肺下叶多发小磨玻璃结节同前，追查
text_en: Multiple small ground-glass nodules in both lower lobes, unchanged compared to prior; recommended for follow-up.

source_text: 右肺上叶索条影较前局限性增多、右肺下叶结节较前略增大，建议追查
text_en: Linear opacities in the right upper lobe show focal increase compared to prior; the nodule in the right lower lobe is slightly larger than before; follow-up is recommended

source_text: 左侧斜裂胸膜见模糊小结节同前，仍约4mm（IM29）
text_en: A small indistinct nodule is seen along the left oblique fissure pleura, unchanged, still approximately 4 mm (IM29).

source_text: 纵隔及左肺门多发肿大淋巴结，倾向转移
text_en: Multiple enlarged mediastinal and left hilar lymph nodes, suggestive of metastasis

source_text: 纵隔内多枚金属夹同前相仿，未见明显肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal metallic clips unchanged from prior, no significant lymphadenopathy seen.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，现约4mm(IM43)，余双肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior, currently approximately 4 mm (IM43); no nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右上肺模糊小结节灶大致同前，大小约7mm（IMA10）、4mm（IMA12）
text_en: Indistinct small nodular foci in the right upper lung are essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 7 mm (IMA10) and 4 mm (IMA12).

source_text: 双肺及叶间胸膜多发转移结节较前不同程度增大，原较大约7mm（IM18），现约9mm(图18)
text_en: Multiple metastatic nodules in both lungs and interlobar pleura have increased to varying degrees compared to prior; previously largest was approximately 7 mm (IM18), now approximately 9 mm (Figure 18).

source_text: 纵隔4-5组多发淋巴结部分同前，部分较前增大，现较大约13x12mm（Im23）
text_en: Mediastinal stations 4-5 show multiple lymph nodes, some unchanged, some increased in size compared to previous, the largest currently approximately 13x12 mm (Im23).

source_text: 右肺内局限性索条影同前，双肺未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: Focal linear opacities in the right lung are stable compared to prior; no new nodules or consolidations are seen in either lung.

source_text: 扫及双侧甲状腺多发低密度结节同前，较大约35x31mm（IM3）
text_en: Bilateral thyroid multiple hypodense nodules unchanged from prior, the largest approximately 35x31 mm (IM3)

source_text: 扫及肝内低密度结节，肝门部淋巴结较前增大，建议结合腹部检查
text_en: An intrahepatic low-density nodule and porta hepatis lymphadenopathy compared to prior; correlation with abdominal examination is recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶结节术后，术区见楔条状高密度影，余双肺未见新发结节
text_en: Postoperative status in the right lower lobe; a wedge-shaped area of increased density is seen at the surgical site. No new nodules are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右肺胸胃旁实变影同前，双肺下叶多发索条影同前，双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: The consolidation adjacent to the intrathoracic stomach in the right lung is unchanged; multiple linear opacities in the lower lobes bilaterally are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 肺内微小结节同前
text_en: Pulmonary small nodules unchanged.

source_text: 双肺浅淡磨玻璃结节影同前（Im19、29、30）
text_en: Faint ground-glass nodules in both lungs are unchanged (Im19, 29, 30).

source_text: 纵隔轻度右移，纵隔多发淋巴结显示，部分增大，较大约16x12mm（IM43），原约9mm，考虑转移可能大，追查
text_en: Mild rightward shift of the mediastinum; multiple mediastinal lymph nodes visible, some enlarged; the largest approximately 16x12mm (IM43), previously approximately 9mm; metastasis is considered likely; further investigation recommended.

source_text: 纵隔4R组高密度淋巴结同前相仿（IM17）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R high-density lymph node similar to prior (IM17).

source_text: 左侧胸膜结节较前减小，现较大约7x7mm（IM9），原较大约14x10mm（IM8）
text_en: Left pleural nodule is smaller than before, currently measuring approximately 7x7 mm (IM9), previously measuring approximately 14x10 mm (IM8)

source_text: 纵隔气管周围、隆突下脂肪间隙密度增高同前，纵隔、锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Increased density in the fat planes surrounding the mediastinal trachea and subcarinal region is unchanged. No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum or supraclavicular regions

source_text: 右肺小结节部分同前，部分较前消失
text_en: Some right lung small nodules are unchanged, while others have disappeared compared to prior.

source_text: 两肺微小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: The tiny nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜结节同前，约5mm（IM35），右下肺少许索条影，左上肺小硬结灶基本同前，余肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: The nodular lesion along the right interlobar pleura is unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM35). There are minimal reticular opacities in the right lower lobe. The small calcified focus in the left upper lobe is essentially unchanged. No additional nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，两肺胸膜下散在小结节灶同前
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; scattered small subpleural nodules in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 双肺多发实性小结节较前缩小，大者位于右肺中叶外侧段，现呈点状（IM41），原约5*3mm(图44)
text_en: Multiple small solid nodules in both lungs are smaller than before. The largest is now punctate in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe (IM41), previously measuring approximately 5x3 mm (Figure 44).

source_text: 两肺微小结节灶同前（IMA20、26、32），约3mm
text_en: The tiny nodular foci in both lungs are unchanged (IMA20, 26, 32), measuring approximately 3 mm.

source_text: 纵隔多个淋巴结同前，较大者仍约13x9mm（IMA23）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from previous, the largest still approximately 13x9 mm (IMA23)

source_text: 左肺下叶受胸胃压迫致膨胀不良，余两肺局限性肺气肿同前，未见新生结节
text_en: Left lower lobe compressed by thoracic stomach resulting in poor expansion; focal emphysema in the remaining bilateral lungs unchanged from previous; no new nodules seen

source_text: 左肺下叶外基底段胸膜下小结节同前，大小仍约4mm（IM45），追查
text_en: Left lower lobe lateral basal segment subpleural small nodule unchanged, size still approximately 4mm (IM45), follow-up

source_text: 两肺结节较前略增大，较大现约22x18mm（IM50），原为19x17mm（IM49）
text_en: Nodules in both lungs are slightly increased in size compared to prior; the largest now measures approximately 22x18 mm (IM50), previously measured 19x17 mm (IM49).

source_text: 左肺下叶近膈面新发小结节，约5x3mm（IM50）
text_en: New small nodule near the diaphragmatic surface of the left lower lobe, approximately 5x3 mm (IM50).

source_text: 扫及肝右叶结节同前
text_en: CT shows a nodule in the right lobe of the liver unchanged from previous.

source_text: 左肺下叶及残余右肺微小结节同前，约3mm（IM33）
text_en: Tiny nodules in the left lower lobe and residual right lung unchanged from previous, approximately 3mm (IM33)

source_text: 左侧胸膜不规则增厚较前减轻，考虑左侧胸膜转移，左侧胸腔积液较前减少，左肺膨胀不全较前减轻
text_en: Irregular thickening of the left pleura has improved compared to prior; metastatic pleural disease is considered. Left pleural effusion has decreased, and left lung atelectasis has improved compared to prior.

source_text: 右上肺及左下肺小结节灶大致同前（IMA32、33），较大者仍约4mm（IM32）
text_en: Small nodules in the right upper lung and left lower lung are roughly unchanged (IMA32, 33), the largest still measuring approximately 4 mm (IM32).

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区小淋巴结较前相仿，约为4mm（IM8）
text_en: Small lymph node in the left supraclavicular region is similar to prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM8).

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下见多发肿大淋巴结，较前缩小，如原约43x30mm，现约21x13mm（IM32）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular areas, and bilateral axillae, which are smaller than previously, for example, from approximately 43x30 mm to approximately 21x13 mm (Image 32).

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，左肺上叶下舌段小结节同前，约5x4mm（IM35），边界清楚
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. The small nodule in the left upper lobe inferior lingular segment is stable, measuring approximately 5x4 mm (IM35), with well-defined margins.

source_text: 右肺下叶贴斜裂胸膜处浅淡小结节同前（Im46）
text_en: Faint small nodule adjacent to the oblique fissure pleura in the right lower lobe is unchanged (Im46).

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门散在小淋巴结同前，最大短径均小于10mm
text_en: Scattered mediastinal and right hilar small lymph nodes unchanged from previous, with largest short axis less than 10 mm.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, less than 10 mm.

source_text: 右肺肿物切除术后，周围索条影较前减少
text_en: Post right lung mass resection; surrounding linear opacities are decreased compared to prior.

source_text: 右下肺局部胸膜下微结节同前，约4mm（IM16）
text_en: The subpleural micronodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior imaging, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM16).

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下小结节同前，约5mm（IM32）,追查
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right middle lobe is stable, approximately 5 mm (IM32), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔多枚淋巴结同前，未见明显肿大
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior; no significant enlargement seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃结节较前相仿
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is similar to prior study.

source_text: 纵隔多发高密度小淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple small calcified mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段结节略缩小，原约9x5mm（IM21），现约6x5mm（IM21），前段支气管血管束旁小结节大致同前，约5x4mm（IM23），肺气肿同前
text_en: The nodule in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment has slightly decreased in size from approximately 9x5 mm (IM21) to approximately 6x5 mm (IM21). The small nodule adjacent to the bronchovascular bundle in the anterior segment remains approximately the same at 5x4 mm (IM23), and emphysema is unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖段索条小结节同前，约4mm（IM14）
text_en: A small linear nodule in the apical segment of the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior, approximately 4 mm (IM14)

source_text: 纵隔及贲门下方转移淋巴结较前进展
text_en: Metastatic lymph nodes in the mediastinum and below the cardia progressed compared to previous.

source_text: 左肺上叶结节大小同前，仍约11*7mm(Im22)
text_en: Left upper lobe nodule size unchanged, still approximately 11x7 mm (Image 22).

source_text: 右上肺术后，双肺结节大致同前
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lung; nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段术后，支气管断端未见增厚软组织密度影，左肺下叶基底段见结节影同前（IMA46），边缘见粗条状影，边缘见高密度影
text_en: Postoperative status in the left lower lobe dorsal segment; no thickened soft tissue density at the bronchial stump, with a nodular opacity in the left lower lobe basal segment unchanged from previous (IMA46), showing coarse linear opacities at the margin and high-density shadow at the margin.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段胸膜下结节同前，仍约5mm（IM30），左肺见散在微小结节
text_en: A subpleural nodule in the left lower lobe dorsal segment is unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM30). Scattered tiny nodules are present in the left lung.

source_text: 左侧斜裂胸膜小结节同前，仍约3mm（IM36），余双侧胸膜光滑，未见胸水征象
text_en: Small nodule along the left major fissure pleura is unchanged, still approximately 3 mm (IM36); otherwise, bilateral pleura are smooth, and no signs of pleural effusion are seen.

source_text: 食管胸中下段管壁不均匀增厚较前减轻，较厚部原约22mm，现约4mm（IM32），外膜清晰，同胸主动脉脂肪间隙存在
text_en: Irregular wall thickening of the mid-to-lower thoracic esophagus reduced compared to prior, thickest portion previously approximately 22mm, now approximately 4mm (IM32), serosa clear, fat plane with thoracic aorta present.

source_text: 左肺多发磨玻璃结节同前，较大仍约8x6mm（IM11），部分边界模糊
text_en: Multiple ground-glass nodules in the left lung unchanged from prior, largest still approximately 8x6 mm (IM11), some with ill-defined margins.

source_text: 余诸骨未见新发骨质破坏征象
text_en: The remaining bones show no new signs of osseous destruction.

source_text: 纵隔4L淋巴结较前相仿，较大仍约10x10mm(IM21)
text_en: The mediastinal 4L lymph node is similar to prior, the larger one still measuring approximately 10x10 mm (IM21).

source_text: 右上肺片絮影、右下肺模糊小结节同前
text_en: Patchy opacities in the right upper lung and indistinct small nodules in the right lower lung are unchanged.

source_text: 扫及肝脏S7稍低密度结节同前相仿，请结合腹部检查
text_en: On scan, a slightly low-density nodule in hepatic segment S7 is similar to prior; correlate with abdominal examination.

source_text: 双肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节，较前增大，均考虑周围型肺癌
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodules in both upper lobes, increased in size compared to prior, both considered peripheral lung cancer.

source_text: 前纵隔结节较前缩小，原约21*10mm，现约20X8mm(图23)
text_en: The anterior mediastinal nodule is smaller than before, previously approximately 21x10 mm, now approximately 20x8 mm (Figure 23).

source_text: 右肺上叶见一环状小斑片灶同前，约4mm（IMA14），其余右肺未见结节及异常密度区
text_en: A small ring-like patch is seen in the right upper lobe, unchanged, measuring approximately 4 mm (IMA14); no nodules or abnormal densities are seen elsewhere in the right lung.

source_text: 两肺小结节影同前（IMA40、43、50、52），较大仍约5mm（IMA40）
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior (IMA40, 43, 50, 52), largest still approximately 5 mm (IMA40)

source_text: 纵隔结节状软组织密度影同前相仿，约16x10mm（IM28）
text_en: Nodular soft tissue density shadow in mediastinum similar to previous, approximately 16x10 mm (IM28).

source_text: 纵隔4、7组数个淋巴结同前相仿，较大约13x5mm（IM25），肺门、腋窝及锁骨上平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal stations 4 and 7 several lymph nodes unchanged from prior; largest approximately 13x5 mm (IM25). Hilar, axillary, and supraclavicular regions on non-contrast scan show no enlarged lymph nodes

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结同前相仿（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph node unchanged from prior (IM19)

source_text: 余扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏
text_en: No osseous destruction is seen in the thoracic bones imaged.

source_text: 右肺门软组织增厚较前相仿，右肺门淋巴结可疑缩小，较大原约25x17mm（IM25），现约21x15mm（IM26），平扫边界欠清
text_en: Soft tissue thickening at the right hilum is similar to prior. A right hilar lymph node is suspiciously smaller, previously measuring about 25x17 mm (IM25), now approximately 21x15 mm (IM26), with ill-defined margins on non-contrast imaging.

source_text: 两肺未见新发结节及斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 双肺索条影同前，未见新发结节或实变灶
text_en: Linear opacities in both lungs are similar to prior. No new nodules or consolidation foci are seen.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，倾向良性
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, suggestive of benign etiology.

source_text: 未见明确新发灶
text_en: No definite new lesion

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段小结节大小同前，仍约5mm（IM10）
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment small nodule size unchanged from previous, still approximately 5 mm (IM10).

source_text: 双肺见多发小结节同前 ，约为3mm、5mm、5mm（Im29、44、45）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable, measuring approximately 3 mm, 5 mm, and 5 mm (IM29, 44, 45).

source_text: 前纵隔肿物切除术后，术区少许软组织密度影同前
text_en: Status post resection of anterior mediastinal mass. A small soft tissue density in the surgical bed is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔2L低密度结节同前
text_en: Mediastinal station 2L low-density nodule unchanged from previous.

source_text: 余双肺未见明显新增结节或实变影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no obvious newly increased nodules or consolidation shadows.

source_text: 扫及胃小弯小淋巴结显示同前（IM64）
text_en: Small lymph node along the lesser curvature of the stomach unchanged from prior (IM64).

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前(IM29)
text_en: Tiny nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior (IM29).

source_text: 肺气肿及间质性病变、散在小结节等陈旧灶同前
text_en: Emphysema and interstitial lung disease, scattered small nodules, and other old lesions unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段磨玻璃结节同前，仍约7x6mm（IM22）
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged, still measuring approximately 7 x 6 mm (IM22).

source_text: 左锁骨上淋巴结增大，较大现约17x14mm（IM5），原为13x12mm（IM6）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node increased in size, largest currently approximately 17x14 mm (IM5), previously 13x12 mm (IM6).

source_text: 左肺多发小结节同前，较大者约6mm（IM50），部分伴钙化同前
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left lung unchanged from prior, the largest measuring approximately 6 mm (IM50), some with calcification unchanged from prior

source_text: 右肺上叶微小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Right upper lobe micro-nodule unchanged, follow-up recommended

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前相仿，肺门淋巴结平扫显示不清
text_en: Mediastinal multiple lymph nodes similar to previous, hilar lymph nodes not clearly visible on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 左肺尖不规则微小结节同前（IM8）
text_en: Left apical segment: irregular tiny nodule same as before (IM8).

source_text: 左肺散在结节影同前，较大约6mm（IM50）
text_en: Scattered nodules in the left lung unchanged from previous, largest approximately 6mm (image 50).

source_text: 余肺野未见新发结节及斑片影
text_en: The remainder of the lung fields shows no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 右肺小结节同前相仿（IM14、24），双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Small nodules in the right lung are stable (IM14, 24); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶模糊不规则小斑点影同前（Im28），余肺未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: The ill-defined, irregular small punctate opacities in the right lower lobe are unchanged (Im28). No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 两肺弥漫转移同前
text_en: Diffuse metastases in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端少量软组织密度影同前（IM32），未见增大或异常强化
text_en: Left upper lobe postoperative status. Minimal soft tissue density at the bronchial stump stable (IM32). No enlargement or abnormal enhancement

source_text: 左全肺切除术后改变同前，支气管断段未见软组织肿块影，左侧胸腔积液、纵隔左移同前
text_en: Findings post left pneumonectomy are stable compared to prior; no soft tissue mass is seen at the bronchial stump; left pleural effusion and leftward mediastinal shift are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺门小淋巴结较前相仿
text_en: Left hilar small lymph nodes similar in size compared to prior

source_text: 右肺下叶斜裂后方结节大小同前，约25x20mm（IM23），呈分叶状，未见明确毛刺及索条，增强轻度强化，邻近支气管壁未见增厚，管腔未见狭窄，肺门淋巴结增大
text_en: The nodule in the posterior aspect of the oblique fissure of the right lower lobe is stable in size, measuring approximately 25x20 mm (IM23), with a lobulated appearance. No definite spiculation or linear opacities are seen. It shows mild enhancement. The adjacent bronchial wall shows no thickening, and the lumen is not narrowed. There is lymphadenopathy in the hilar region.

source_text: 余双肺散在小结节同前，部分钙化
text_en: Residual scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged; some are calcified

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃结节同前，恶性待排，追查
text_en: Left upper lobe ground-glass nodule stable compared to prior, malignancy to be ruled out, follow-up

source_text: 左肺胸膜下小结节同前（IM40）
text_en: Left lung subpleural small nodule unchanged from previous (IM40).

source_text: 纵隔多个小淋巴结大致同前，较大16*9mm(图30)
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes are essentially unchanged from previous, with the largest measuring 16x9 mm (Figure 30).

source_text: 新见结节
text_en: newly identified nodule

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，右肺模糊浅淡结节影同前
text_en: Following right upper lobectomy, indistinct faint nodular opacities in the right lung are unchanged.

source_text: 右下肺6mm大小不规则结节大致同前（IM40)，邻近见索条影，追查
text_en: Irregular 6 mm nodule in the right lower lung largely unchanged (IM40), with adjacent linear densities; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段模玻璃密度灶同前（IM15），右肺上叶前段胸膜下微小结节（IM16）同前，两肺未见新生结节影
text_en: Ground-glass density focus in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged (IM15); a subpleural tiny nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe (IM16) is unchanged; no new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 右上肺内多发小结节同前，较大者仍约5x4mm（IM13）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right upper lung are unchanged; the largest remains approximately 5x4 mm (IM13).

source_text: 右肺下叶混杂密度灶较前缩小，邻近结节消失
text_en: The mixed-density lesion in the right lower lobe is smaller compared to prior; the adjacent nodule has disappeared.

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后，右下肺混合磨玻璃密度结节影大致同前
text_en: Post-left lower lobectomy, the mixed ground-glass nodule in the right lower lobe is largely unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔4R组增大淋巴结大致同前（IM23）
text_en: Enlarged lymph node at mediastinal station 4R unchanged from prior (IM23)

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约10mm（IMA17）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest measures approximately 10 mm (IMA17).

source_text: 纵隔3组淋巴结较前缩小，原约18x15mm，现约13x10mm（IM15），追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 3 lymph nodes decreased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 18x15 mm, currently approximately 13x10 mm (IM15). Follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔多发肿大淋巴结伴钙化同前，较大仍约16x13mm（IM30）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes enlarged with calcification, stable compared to prior, largest still approximately 16x13 mm (IM30)

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段软组织密度小结节同前，仍约14x13mm（IMA18），密度较前稍减低，轻度强化，仍可见分叶及胸膜凹陷
text_en: A small soft-tissue density nodule in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe is unchanged from prior, still approximately 14x13 mm (IMA18), with slightly decreased density compared to prior, mild enhancement, and lobulation and pleural indentation still visible

source_text: 左肱骨头高密度结节同前，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: High-density nodule in the left humeral head is unchanged; no osseous destruction is seen in the other scanned bones.

source_text: 右叶间胸膜及右侧侧胸膜增厚同前，仍见小结节（IM36）
text_en: Right interlobar and right lateral pleural thickening is unchanged from prior; small nodules are still present (IM36).

source_text: 左肺下叶索条影同，左肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Left lower lobe linear opacity unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities seen in the left lung.

source_text: 右上肺近水平裂一小灶同前，仍约3mm（IM29），右肺下叶胸膜下微小结节同前(IM37)
text_en: Small focus near the horizontal fissure in the right upper lobe unchanged, still approximately 3 mm (IM29); right lower lobe subpleural micro-nodule unchanged (IM37).

source_text: 右侧水平裂胸膜结节同前，约5x4mm（IM36）
text_en: Pleural nodule along the right horizontal fissure is stable, measuring approximately 5x4 mm (IM36).

source_text: 右肺上叶小片絮影较前吸收，余肺未见新见结节影
text_en: The small patchy opacities in the right upper lobe have improved compared to prior. No new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔3组淋巴结较前缩小，原约13x8mm（IM13），现约9x4mm（IM12）
text_en: Mediastinal station 3 lymph nodes decreased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 13x8 mm (IM13), currently approximately 9x4 mm (IM12).

source_text: 右肺上叶条索、斑片钙化及小结节影同前
text_en: Linear opacities, patchy calcifications, and small nodules in the right upper lobe are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左上肺及近膈面微小结节均增大，原约1-2mm，现约3mm（IM22、44）
text_en: Tiny nodules in the left upper lobe and near the diaphragmatic surface have increased in size, previously measuring approximately 1–2 mm, now approximately 3 mm (IM22, 44).

source_text: 甲状腺低密度灶结节同前
text_en: Thyroid hypodense nodule stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶及下叶胸膜下多发微小结节同前，约5mm（IMA13）
text_en: Multiple subpleural micro-nodules in the right upper and lower lobes remain unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (IMA13).

source_text: 双肺下叶小结节同前（IM37、41、49），较大约4mm（IM37）
text_en: Small nodules in both lower lobes are stable compared to prior (IM37, 41, 49), the largest measuring approximately 4 mm (IM37).

source_text: 食管癌术后，吻合口壁环周增厚，局部形成肿块较前缩小，原约61x50mm（IM42），现约55x41mm（IM39）
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer, circumferential thickening of the anastomotic wall with a local mass, decreased in size from approximately 61x50 mm (IM42) to 55x41 mm (IM39).

source_text: 左肺胸膜下浅淡密度微小结节同前（IM16、21、23、37、39、42、44）
text_en: Left lung subpleural faint density tiny nodules unchanged (IM16, 21, 23, 37, 39, 42, 44)

source_text: 2R组淋巴结现约12x6mm（IM13),原6x4mm（IM11)，左锁骨上多发小淋巴结显示，较大6mm，密切观察
text_en: 2R lymph node is now about 12x6 mm (IM13), previously 6x4 mm (IM11). Multiple small lymph nodes are visible in the left supraclavicular region, the largest measuring 6 mm; close observation is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔及左肺门多发淋巴结同前，较大仍约15x8mm（IM19）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal and left hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest still approximately 15x8 mm (IM19)

source_text: 右肺门可见肿大淋巴结同前，约12x11mm(Im30)
text_en: An enlarged lymph node is visible in the right hilum, similar to prior, measuring approximately 12x11 mm (Im30).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，平扫支气管断端软组织形态同前，未见明确占位
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; soft tissue morphology at the bronchial stump is unchanged from prior, with no definite mass identified.

source_text: 左肺上叶切除术后，支气管断端未见异常密度灶，左肺下叶少许索条影同前，右肺中叶外侧段多发结节灶较前缩小，仅余少许絮状影（IM27）
text_en: After left upper lobe resection, no abnormal density focus at the bronchial stump, a few fibrous streaks in the left lower lobe unchanged from prior, multiple nodules in the right middle lobe lateral segment decreased in size compared to prior, only a few fluffy opacities remain (IM27).

source_text: 纵隔5区淋巴结同前，约22x18mm（IM17）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at station 5 are the same as before, approximately 22x18 mm (IM17).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节较前增大，原约22*12mm，现约27x17mm(图22)，密度不均，考虑恶性可能大
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe has increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 22 x 12 mm, now approximately 27 x 17 mm (Figure 22), with heterogeneous density; malignancy is highly suspected.

source_text: 余肺未见明显新发病灶
text_en: The remainder of the lungs shows no obvious new lesions.

source_text: 两肺纹理增粗，左下肺稍高密度结节同前，约4mm（IM36），观察
text_en: Increased bronchovascular markings in both lungs; a slightly hyperdense nodule in the left lower lung is stable, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM36), under observation.

source_text: 食道胸下段管壁增厚较前明显减轻，较厚部位原约25mm，现约6mm（IMA44），外膜模糊，近端食管无扩张
text_en: Wall thickening of the distal thoracic esophagus is significantly reduced compared to prior, with the thickest portion decreasing from approximately 25 mm to 6 mm (IMA44). The outer membrane remains blurred, and there is no proximal esophageal dilation.

source_text: 右肺中叶内侧段、下叶基底段及左肺上叶舌段、下叶基底段见多发索条影同前，双肺未见新发结节
text_en: Multiple linear strands are seen in the medial segment of the right middle lobe, basal segments of the right lower lobe, lingular segment of the left upper lobe, and basal segments of the left lower lobe, unchanged from prior; no new nodules are seen in the lungs bilaterally.

source_text: 肝内低密度灶及右侧肾上腺结节同前，请结合腹部检查
text_en: Low-density hepatic lesion(s) and right adrenal nodule similar to prior; please correlate with abdominal imaging.

source_text: 两肺未见新增斑片影及结节灶
text_en: No new patchy opacities or nodular lesions are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结，部分较前缩小，如7组淋巴结原约23x12mm（IM25），现约18x9mm（IM24）
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes are smaller compared to prior, such as station 7 lymph node previously approximately 23x12 mm (IM25), now approximately 18x9 mm (IM24).

source_text: 双肺见多发磨玻璃密度结节及点状微小结节同前相仿（薄层IM46、90、118、132等），较大约9x7mm（Im132），内部见少许实性成分同前
text_en: Multiple ground-glass opacity nodules and punctate tiny nodules are seen in both lungs, similar to prior (thin-slice IM46, 90, 118, 132, etc.); the largest is approximately 9x7 mm (Im132), with a small solid component unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大仍约18x6mm（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest measures approximately 18x6 mm (IM19).

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R、7、右肺门淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R, 4R, 7, and right hilar lymph nodes are similar to previous, all less than 10 mm.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见异常软组织影增厚，双肺未见新增结节及斑片影
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, no abnormal soft tissue thickening at bronchial stump; no new nodules or patchy opacities in both lungs.

source_text: 食道术后，食管-胃主动脉弓水平吻合，吻合口壁增厚较前明显，原较厚处约9mm（IM20），现约12mm（IMA19）
text_en: Post esophageal surgery, esophagogastric anastomosis at the level of the aortic arch; anastomotic wall thickening is more prominent than before, previously approximately 9mm thick (IM20), now approximately 12mm (IMA19).

source_text: 左肺下叶结节较前增多、增大，现较大约17x16mm（IM41）,右肺上叶条索状影大致同前（IM17)
text_en: Nodules in the left lower lobe have increased in number and size compared to prior, with the largest now approximately 17x16 mm (IM41); linear opacities in the right upper lobe are stable (IM17).

source_text: 食管中段管壁环周增厚较前减轻，原较厚约9mm（IM20），现约4mm（IM21），周围脂肪间隙索条影略减轻，病灶与气管分界不清
text_en: Circumferential wall thickening of the mid-esophagus is reduced compared to prior, previously approximately 9 mm (IM20), now approximately 4 mm (IM21). Perilesional fat stranding is slightly decreased. The lesion is indistinct from the trachea.

source_text: 右肺上叶不规则索条、结节状灶，较前稍增大，例如原短径约11mm者现约13mm（Im18）
text_en: Irregular linear and nodular opacities in the right upper lobe are slightly larger than prior; for example, a lesion with a previous short axis of approximately 11 mm now measures approximately 13 mm (Im18).

source_text: 两肺未见明确新发结节及肿块
text_en: No definite new nodules or masses are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右腋下淋巴结同前，约15x13mm（Im23）
text_en: Right axillary lymph nodes are unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 15x13 mm (Im23)

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见异常，双肺少许索条影同前，双肺未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no abnormality is seen at the bronchial stump. Minimal linear bands in both lungs are unchanged. No new nodules or consolidations are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门高密度淋巴结同前，右肺门较大仍约13x11mm（IM33），追查
text_en: Mediastinal and bilateral hilar high-density lymph nodes, unchanged from previous, the larger one in the right hilar region still approximately 13x11 mm (IM33), follow-up.

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则形混杂磨玻璃密度小结节大致同前，边界不清，现仍约20x13mm（IMA16），内见小空泡
text_en: Irregular mixed ground-glass density nodule in the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior, with ill-defined margins, currently measuring approximately 20 x 13 mm (IMA16), containing a small air bubble.

source_text: 右侧心膈角见淋巴结（IM48），转移可能，追查
text_en: A lymph node is seen in the right cardiophrenic angle (IM48), raising concern for metastasis. Follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺多发模糊结节（IM9、35、41）、钙化灶同前
text_en: Multiple indistinct nodules (IM9, 35, 41) and calcified foci in the right lung are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶3mm点状结节同前相仿（IM17）
text_en: A 3 mm punctate nodule in the left upper lobe is similar to prior (IM17).

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结大致同前，大小约11x8mm(图24)
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes largely unchanged, size approximately 11x8 mm (Figure 24).

source_text: 右肺尖胸膜下微小结节灶同前，倾向良性
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodular focus in the right lung apex is unchanged and is considered likely benign.

source_text: 右侧胸膜稍厚，双侧叶间胸膜小结节同前（IM27、31），较大约6mm（IM27）
text_en: The right pleura is slightly thickened. Small nodules along the bilateral interlobar pleura are unchanged from prior (IM27, 31), with the largest measuring approximately 6 mm (IM27).

source_text: 右前胸壁术后改变同前，未见软组织结节及肿块
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right anterior chest wall are unchanged compared to prior; no soft tissue nodules or masses are seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶癌，较前增大，空洞形成
text_en: Right upper lobe carcinoma, larger than prior, with cavity formation.

source_text: 扫及右侧肾上腺结节影同前，考虑腺瘤
text_en: On scan, right adrenal nodule unchanged from prior, favoring adenoma.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度小结节同前，约7mm（IM34）
text_en: Small ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe unchanged from prior, approximately 7 mm (IM34).

source_text: 甲状腺右叶下极结节同前（IM2）
text_en: Nodule in the inferior pole of the right thyroid lobe unchanged from prior (IM2).

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区淋巴结同前，约7mm（IM9）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node is unchanged, approximately 7 mm (IM9)

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结较前增大、胃小弯侧淋巴结略缩小，追查
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes have increased in size compared to previous, and lymph nodes along the lesser curvature of the stomach have slightly decreased in size. Follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺门区淋巴结稍增大，原约15x7mm，现约17x9mm（Im29）
text_en: Lymph nodes in the right hilar region are slightly enlarged, previously approximately 15 x 7 mm, now about 17 x 9 mm (Im29).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内散在少许索条及胸膜下小结节同前，约4*3mm（IMA10）
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Scattered minimal linear opacities and subpleural small nodules are stable, measuring approximately 4x3 mm (IMA10).

source_text: 右肺尖胸膜下微小结节较前相仿，约3mm（IM14），其内上方结节灶缩小，大小原约7x6mm（IM11），现约3x3mm（IM13）
text_en: The tiny subpleural nodule in the right lung apex is similar to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM14). The nodule located superior and internal to it has decreased in size, previously measuring about 7x6 mm (IM11), now approximately 3x3 mm (IM13).

source_text: 两肺模糊小结节灶同前相仿（IM35等）
text_en: The hazy small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior (IM35, etc.).

source_text: 右肺上叶见磨玻璃密度结节同前，仍约13x10mm（IM20），未见明确实性成分，边缘尚清
text_en: A ground-glass opacity nodule is seen in the right upper lobe, unchanged from prior, still measuring approximately 13 x 10 mm (IM20), without definite solid component, with relatively clear margins.

source_text: 甲状腺左侧叶结节同前
text_en: Thyroid left lobe nodule unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶切除术后，纵隔4R及右肺门淋巴结同前，未见新灶
text_en: After left upper lobe resection, mediastinal station 4R and right hilar lymph nodes unchanged from prior, no new lesions.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜结节样增厚同前(图31)，未见胸水征象
text_en: The nodular thickening along the right interlobar pleura is unchanged (Figure 31). No pleural effusion is seen.

source_text: 右肺孤立小结节同前
text_en: Solitary small nodule in the right lung is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，右肺下叶背段见一磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，现大小约8x7mm（IMA24），边界清楚，内部可见血管穿行，未见实性成分
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Lung parenchymal lucency is uniform. A ground-glass opacity in the dorsal segment of the right lower lobe is similar to prior, now measuring approximately 8x7 mm (IMA24), with clear boundaries. Vessels are seen traversing through it, and no solid component is identified.

source_text: 左侧斜裂胸膜小结节显示较前清楚，大小同前（IM18）
text_en: Small nodule along the left major fissure pleura is more clearly visualized than prior, but size remains unchanged (IM18).

source_text: 双肺小结节同前相仿，建议定期观察
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior; regular observation recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶多发模糊结节较前增大、增多，部分病灶见晕征（IM13）
text_en: Multiple indistinct nodules in the right upper lobe have increased in size and number compared to prior; some lesions show a halo sign (IM13).

source_text: 双肺多发小结节同前，余双肺未见新生灶
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior; no new lesions are seen elsewhere in the lungs.

source_text: 右肺叶间胸膜小结节状增厚同前（IM31），余肺未见新发异常密度灶
text_en: Nodular thickening of the interlobar pleura in the right lung is stable compared to prior (IM31); no new abnormal density foci are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 肺内索条结节灶大致同前
text_en: Intrapulmonary linear strands and nodules essentially unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右锁骨上散在淋巴结同前，平扫与血管分辨不清
text_en: Scattered right supraclavicular lymph nodes unchanged, indistinct from vessels on non-contrast imaging

source_text: 左第6肋新见异常高密度区，骨转移
text_en: New abnormal area of increased density in the left sixth rib; bone metastasis.

source_text: 双肺门小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes at both hila are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 两肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidations are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右下肺结节较前增大，考虑周围型肺癌可能性大
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is larger compared to prior imaging; peripheral lung cancer is considered highly likely.

source_text: 双肺多发实性结节较前增多增大，现较大者约11x10mm（IM18）,原约3mm（IM21）
text_en: Multiple solid nodules in both lungs have increased in number and size compared to prior. The largest now measures approximately 11x10 mm (IM18), previously about 3 mm (IM21).

source_text: 扫描所及胸部诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: Scanned thoracic bones show no osseous destruction focus.

source_text: 双肺微小结节同前（IM14、34、39）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary micro-nodules are stable compared to prior (IM14, 34, 39).

source_text: 左上肺纵隔胸膜旁结节较前略增大，现约15*10mm(图)，原约13x9mm（IM10），
text_en: Nodule adjacent to the mediastinal pleura in the left upper lobe is slightly larger than prior, now measuring approximately 15 x 10 mm (Figure), previously 13 x 9 mm (IM10).

source_text: 左肺下叶背段小结节同前，约4mm（IM32）
text_en: A small nodule in the left lower lobe, apical segment, unchanged from prior, approximately 4 mm (IM32).

source_text: 左肺下叶背段结节减小，余钙化灶同前
text_en: Left lower lobe dorsal segment nodule decreased in size, with remaining calcified foci unchanged

source_text: 食管胸中下段交界区管壁稍增厚较前稍减轻，较厚处原约8mm（IM28），现约6mm（IM31），外膜光滑，同主动脉弓脂肪间隙存在，近端食管无扩张
text_en: In the junctional region of the middle-lower thoracic esophagus, mild wall thickening has slightly decreased compared to prior. Current maximum thickness is approximately 6 mm (IM31), previously 8 mm (IM28). Outer wall is smooth. Fat plane with the aortic arch is present. Proximal esophagus shows no dilation.

source_text: 左侧肾上腺新见肿块，大小约27x26mm（IM59），考虑转移
text_en: Newly seen mass in the left adrenal gland, measuring approximately 27x26 mm (IM59); metastasis is considered.

source_text: 胸5附件、右第5后肋骨质破坏较前明显
text_en: Bone destruction in T5 appendages and right posterior fifth rib is more obvious than before.

source_text: 右侧气管食管沟小淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: The small lymph node in the right tracheoesophageal groove is unchanged. Follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔2、4、7组可见多发淋巴结较前缩小，较大者原约12x7mm（IM11），现约9*5mm（IMA15）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2, 4, and 7 are visible and have decreased in size compared to previous; the largest previously measured approximately 12x7 mm (IM11) is now approximately 9x5 mm (IMA15).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后缺如，支气管残端未见明确异常软组织密度影，右肺多发索条影大致同前，余双肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Right upper lobe is absent post-surgery; no definite abnormal soft tissue density is seen at the bronchial stump. Multiple linear opacities in the right lung are essentially unchanged. No new nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: mm小结节，部分同前（IM20、24、38），部分未见显示
text_en: Small nodule, some unchanged (IM20, 24, 38), some not visualized

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段椭圆形软组织密度结节大小同前，约11x7mm(IM18)，边缘基本光滑清楚
text_en: Stable oval soft-tissue density nodule in left upper lobe apicoposterior segment, approximately 11x7 mm (IM18), margins essentially smooth and well-defined

source_text: 左肺下叶点状结节影同前（IM53）
text_en: Left lower lobe punctate nodule shadow same as prior (IM53)

source_text: 胸膜增厚较前明显，叶间胸膜结节较前增大，原约4mm（IM44），现约6mm（IM43），考虑左肺癌进展，左侧胸膜转移
text_en: Pleural thickening more prominent than prior. Interlobar pleural nodule increased from approximately 4 mm (IM44) to 6 mm (IM43). Suspected progression of left lung cancer with left pleural metastasis.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节灶同前，约18x15mm（IM15）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged from prior, approximately 18x15 mm (IM15)

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段小结节同前，直径约5mm（IM41）
text_en: The small nodule in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe remains stable, with a diameter of approximately 5 mm (IM41).

source_text: 右肺下叶钙化灶同前，右肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Calcific foci in the right lower lobe are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the right lung.

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下原钙化结节现呈软组织密度为主、较前增大，原约4mm，现约13x11mm(IM25)
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural, originally calcified nodule now predominantly soft tissue density, increased in size compared to previous, originally approximately 4 mm, now approximately 13x11 mm (IM25).

source_text: 双侧腋窝多发小淋巴结同前，最大短径均小于5mm
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in bilateral axillae are unchanged, maximum short diameter less than 5 mm.

source_text: 右肺门旁低密度结节影同前，约21*16mm（IMA36）
text_en: Low-density nodular opacity adjacent to the right hilum is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 21x16 mm (IMA36).

source_text: 纵隔右侧气管食管沟小淋巴结同前（IM8）
text_en: Small lymph node in the right paratracheal groove of the mediastinum, same as before (IM8).

source_text: 右肺下叶微小结节同前，仍小于5mm（Im34）
text_en: Right lower lobe tiny nodule unchanged, still less than 5 mm (Im34)

source_text: 右肺上叶近水平裂小灶同前，约3mm（IM31），右肺下叶胸膜下微小结节同前(IM37)
text_en: A small focus near the horizontal fissure in the right upper lobe is stable compared to prior, approximately 3 mm (IM31). A subpleural micronodule in the right lower lobe is stable (IM37).

source_text: 双肺散发模糊小结节同前，追查
text_en: Scattered indistinct small nodules in both lungs are unchanged; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左锁骨上淋巴结同前，较大约8x6mm（IM8）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node unchanged, largest approximately 8x6 mm (IM8).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段磨玻璃密度结节影同前，边界不清，边缘不规则，较大层面仍约21x21mm（IMA22），局部胸膜凹陷同前
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment ground-glass opacity nodule unchanged, ill-defined margins, irregular edges, largest dimension still approximately 21x21 mm (IMA22), local pleural indentation unchanged.

source_text: 双肺多发磨玻璃密度结节影同前，较大约5mm（IMA24）
text_en: Multiple ground-glass density nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged; the largest measures approximately 5 mm (IMA24).

source_text: 左锁骨上区淋巴结同前，仍约9mm（IM8）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node unchanged from prior, still approximately 9 mm (IM8)

source_text: 平扫左肺门淋巴结同前，约17x14mm（Im34）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows the left hilar lymph node unchanged, approximately 17x14 mm (Image 34).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则结节同前，约14x10mm（IM22）
text_en: The irregular nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 14x10 mm (IM22).

source_text: 左肺下叶沿支气管分布小结节较前相仿（IM46）
text_en: Left lower lobe small nodules distributed along bronchi similar to previous (IM46)

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门小淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right hilum are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段胸膜下模糊小结节同前，仍小于3mm（IM26）
text_en: Ill-defined small subpleural nodule in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe, unchanged from prior, still less than 3 mm (IM26).

source_text: 右肺上叶多发不规则结节部分较前缩小，原约9x7mm（IM14）者，现约7x5mm（IM16）
text_en: Some of the multiple irregular nodules in the right upper lobe have decreased in size compared to prior; the one previously measuring approximately 9x7 mm (IM14) now measures approximately 7x5 mm (IM16).

source_text: 右肺中叶结节较前稍缩小，原约6x4mm（IM43），现约4x3mm（IM43）
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe is slightly smaller than before, previously measuring approximately 6 x 4 mm (IM43), now approximately 4 x 3 mm (IM43).

source_text: 胸2椎体高密度灶同前，余扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Sclerotic focus in T2 vertebral body unchanged; no evidence of bone destruction in the remaining scanned thoracic bones.

source_text: 扫及左肾上腺低密度结节同前，约9mm（IM60），追查
text_en: On imaging, a low-density nodule measuring approximately 9 mm is seen in the left adrenal gland, unchanged from prior (IM60). Follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶微结节同前，直径约3mm（IM20）
text_en: Right upper lobe micro-nodule unchanged, approximately 3 mm in diameter (IM20).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃结节影同前，仍倾向恶性可能大
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe unchanged from prior; malignancy is still considered more likely.

source_text: 余肺内未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 左肺上叶癌较前明显缩小
text_en: Left upper lobe carcinoma has significantly reduced in size compared to previous.

source_text: 右下肺背段不规则肿块大小同前，仍约35x33mm（IM25），轻度强化，与相邻叶间裂关系密切，其周围可见多发微结节同前，伴树芽征
text_en: The irregular mass in the right lower lobe dorsal segment remains stable in size, still measuring approximately 35x33 mm (IM25), with mild enhancement. It is closely related to the adjacent interlobar fissure. Multiple surrounding micro-nodules remain unchanged, accompanied by tree-in-bud opacities.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段及下叶后基底段磨玻璃密度结节大致同前，现分别仍约6x5mm、5x4mm（IM23、42）
text_en: The ground-glass nodules in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe and the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe are essentially unchanged, currently measuring approximately 6x5 mm and 5x4 mm (IM23, 42), respectively.

source_text: 余双肺多发小结节较前增大、增多，较大者原约5x4mm（IM28），现约7x6mm（IM30），考虑转移
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the remainder of both lungs have increased in size and number; the largest previously measured approximately 5x4 mm (IM28), and now measures approximately 7x6 mm (IM30); metastasis is considered.

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则软组织肿块较前增大，原约35x27mm（IM23），现约38x29mm（IM21），增强扫描轻度强化，肿块累及左上肺动静脉，并与左肺动脉干分界不清同前相仿，左肺上叶远端斑片状影较前增多
text_en: The irregular soft tissue mass in the left upper lobe has increased in size, from approximately 35x27 mm (IM23) to approximately 38x29 mm (IM21), with mild enhancement on contrast-enhanced scan. The mass involves the left upper pulmonary artery and vein and has an ill-defined border with the left pulmonary artery trunk, similar to previous. Patchy opacities in the distal left upper lobe have increased compared to previous.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结同前，约18x5mm（IM30）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes unchanged from prior, approximately 18x5 mm (IM30).

source_text: 纵隔4R组高密度淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R high-density lymph node unchanged from prior.

source_text: 新见可疑小结节
text_en: Newly identified suspicious small nodule

source_text: 左肺上叶及右肺中叶微结节同前相仿
text_en: Micronodules in left upper lobe and right middle lobe unchanged

source_text: 右肺中叶结节大小同前，密度较前增高，约8x6mm（IM32）
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe is stable in size but shows increased density, measuring approximately 8x6 mm (IM32).

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影同前，余肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged; the remainder of the lungs show no new nodules.

source_text: 左肺下叶索条影同前，双肺未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: Left lower lobe linear opacity unchanged from previous; no new nodules or patchy opacities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺中叶新发结节，不除外转移，追查
text_en: Newly developed nodule in the right middle lobe, metastasis cannot be excluded; recommend follow-up

source_text: 胸骨柄内可见多发高密度影，考虑转移
text_en: Multiple high-density shadows within the manubrium of sternum, suggestive of metastasis.

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节较前略增大
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule slightly increased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 未见明确新增
text_en: No definite new lesions

source_text: 双肺及胸膜散在多发不规则小结节影大部分同前相仿，较大仍约8x5mm（IM36），边缘模糊，以双上肺为主
text_en: Multiple scattered irregular small nodules in both lungs and pleura are largely similar to prior, largest still approximately 8x5 mm (IM36), with blurred margins, predominantly in the upper lungs.

source_text: 纵隔10R淋巴结较前相仿，原约16x13mm，现约17x11mm(IM30)，追查
text_en: The mediastinal lymph node at station 10R is similar to previous, originally approximately 16x13 mm, now approximately 17x11 mm (Image 30), follow-up.

source_text: 双肺散在磨玻璃密度小结节较前相仿（IM9、22、29、34、40），较大仍约8mm（IM9）
text_en: Scattered small ground-glass nodules in both lungs are similar to prior (IM9, 22, 29, 34, 40). The largest remains approximately 8 mm (IM9).

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结同前（IM24)，平扫密度较高，左锁骨上小淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph node unchanged from prior (IM24), with higher density on non-contrast imaging; small left supraclavicular lymph node unchanged from prior

source_text: 双肺实性微小结节同前（IM16、29）
text_en: Multiple solid micronodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM16, 29).

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节，转移可能，追查
text_en: Small nodule in the right lower lobe, metastasis possible, recommend follow-up.

source_text: 新增肿大淋巴结
text_en: Newly seen enlarged lymph node

source_text: 左肺下叶前基底段不规则结节灶较前相仿，轴位大小现约16x11mm（IM37），边缘见分叶、毛刺同前，其内可见泡状气体密度
text_en: Left lower lobe anterior basal segment irregular nodule similar to prior, axial size now approximately 16x11 mm (IM37), lobulation and spiculation same as prior, bubble-like gas density visible within.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段及右肺上叶后段不规则软组织密度结节大致同前，仍约24x18mm、23x17mm（Im16、21），周围斑片状磨玻璃密度大致同前
text_en: Irregular soft tissue density nodules in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe and posterior segment of the right upper lobe are stable compared to prior, still measuring approximately 24x18 mm and 23x17 mm (Im16, 21), with surrounding patchy ground-glass density stable.

source_text: 左前胸壁皮肤小结节同前（IM18）
text_en: Small skin nodule in the left anterior chest wall unchanged from prior (IM18).

source_text: 右肺中叶、下叶可见多发结节影大致同前（IM33、37、38），3-5mm
text_en: Multiple nodules in the right middle and lower lobes, approximately unchanged (IM33, 37, 38), measuring 3-5 mm.

source_text: 余双肺结节同前
text_en: The nodules in the remainder of both lungs are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 扫及肝脏右叶见低强化占位，转移
text_en: On scan, a hypoenhancing metastatic mass in the right hepatic lobe.

source_text: 左侧胸腔积液明显减少，左肺内条片状实变灶复张，未见新发结节
text_en: Left pleural effusion has significantly decreased; the linear and patchy consolidation in the left lung has re-expanded; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 纵隔4L组淋巴结同前，仍约11x8mm（IM17）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4L lymph nodes unchanged, approximately 11x8 mm (IM17)

source_text: 左肺上叶肺门偏外侧混杂磨玻璃密度灶，范围较前增大（IM21），原约29x23mm（IM23），现约34x25mm（IM21），其外侧实性结节较前变实，考虑恶性可能，进一步检查
text_en: Mixed ground-glass opacity lateral to the hilum in the left upper lobe, extent increased compared to previous (IM21), previously approximately 29x23 mm (IM23), currently approximately 34x25 mm (IM21); the peripheral solid nodule became solid compared to previous, malignancy possible.

source_text: 左肺下叶小片影较前略缩小，现呈类结节状，约5mm（IM24）
text_en: The small opacity in the left lower lobe is slightly smaller than prior and now appears nodular, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM24)

source_text: 平扫纵隔小淋巴结同前
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 两肺未见明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: No obvious new nodules or consolidations are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端见软组织密度区较前增大，平扫与血管分界不清，建议增强扫描，余肺野未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; the soft tissue density at the bronchial stump is larger than previously noted. On non-contrast imaging, it is indistinct from adjacent vessels. Contrast-enhanced scanning is recommended. No new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lung fields.

source_text: 右肺索条及钙化影同前，右肺下叶可见小结节，大小约4mm（IM41），追查
text_en: Linear opacities and calcifications in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior; a small nodule is seen in the right lower lobe, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM41), requiring follow-up.

source_text: 双肺多发胸膜下小结节同前，陈旧性可能大，建议随诊复查
text_en: Multiple subpleural small nodules in both lungs are unchanged; likely chronic; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 余双肺未见新增结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no newly increased nodules or fluffy-appearing lesions.

source_text: 右锁骨上淋巴结肿大，转移
text_en: Right supraclavicular lymph node is enlarged, metastatic

source_text: 左肺胸膜/叶间胸膜下微结节（IM16、41）同前
text_en: Left lung pleural and interlobar subpleural micronodules (IM16, 41) unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端不规则软组织密度影范围较前稍大，原约24x13mm（IM36），现约35x27mm（IM37），其与纵隔内7组淋巴结分界不清
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; the irregular soft-tissue density at the bronchial stump has slightly increased in size, from approximately 24x13 mm (IM36) to 35x27 mm (IM37). It is indistinct from the group 7 mediastinal lymph nodes.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，原约12*9mm(IM34)，现约15*7mm(图36)
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is unchanged from prior, previously approximately 12x9 mm (IM34), now approximately 15x7 mm (Figure 36).

source_text: 左肺胸膜下见部分小结节同前（IM27)，部分消失，追查
text_en: Left lung subpleural some small nodules unchanged (IM27), some resolved, follow-up recommended

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段模玻璃密度类结节（IM14）及前段胸膜下微小结节（IM16）同前，两肺未见新生结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Ground-glass density nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe (IM14) and a subpleural tiny nodule in the anterior segment (IM16) are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段模糊结节同前，仍约5mm（IMA16）
text_en: The indistinct nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe remains stable, still measuring approximately 5 mm (IMA16).

source_text: 余肺未见新发肿块及结节灶
text_en: No new masses or nodules are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 扫及肝脏多发低密度占位同前
text_en: Multiple low-density hepatic lesions unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段类圆形小结节同前，边缘清晰、锐利，仍约12x10mm（Im28），内可见多发点状钙化及斑片状脂肪密度区（IM28）
text_en: Round small nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable, still approximately 12x10 mm (Im28), with multiple punctate calcifications and patchy fat density areas within (IM28)

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，仍约10mm（Im26）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is unchanged from prior, still approximately 10 mm (Im26).

source_text: 肺内少许胸膜下斑点影同前，未见新生结节或片絮状病灶
text_en: A few subpleural punctate opacities within the lung unchanged from previous, no evidence of new nodules or patchy opacities

source_text: 食管术后改变同前，胸部CT未见新增占位征象
text_en: Post-esophagectomy changes unchanged, chest CT shows no newly added mass lesion signs.

source_text: 两肺小结节同前（IM39、42、49、52），较大仍约5mm（IM39）
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior (IM39, 42, 49, 52), largest still approximately 5 mm (IM39)

source_text: 扫及脂肪肝，右侧肾上腺小结节同前，请结合腹部相关检查
text_en: CT scan shows fatty liver and a small nodule in the right adrenal gland, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺斑片索条影同前，两肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Patchy and linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged from prior; no new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 两肺上叶及右肺下叶多发磨玻璃样结节影同前（IMA12、14、23、28、32、51），其中较大者位于右肺尖，仍约17mm（IMA12），中央见实性密度影同前
text_en: Multiple ground-glass nodules in both upper lobes and the right lower lobe are unchanged from prior (IMA12, 14, 23, 28, 32, 51). The largest, located in the right apex, remains approximately 17 mm (IMA12), with a central solid density unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下小结节同前，倾向良性，追查
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right upper lobe is stable; benign etiology favored; requires follow-up.

source_text: 右肺术后，右肺条片影大致同前(IM23)，缝合线旁软组织结节较前增大，原约17*10mm，现约18x14mm（IM26）
text_en: Postoperative right lung, linear and patchy opacities in the right lung generally unchanged (IM23); soft tissue nodule adjacent to the suture line has increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 17 x 10 mm, now approximately 18 x 14 mm (IM26).

source_text: 右肺下叶局部术后，右肺索条影、右侧胸膜、叶间胸膜结节样增厚较前相仿
text_en: Status post partial resection of the right lower lobe; linear opacities in the right lung and nodular thickening of the right pleura and interlobar pleura are similar to prior

source_text: 纵隔3p组见小淋巴结同前，约10mm（IM8）
text_en: Mediastinal station 3p shows small lymph nodes unchanged from previous, approximately 10 mm (IM8).

source_text: 双腋下多发淋巴结大致同前，较大约2x1.2cm（IM13）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes at both axillae are generally unchanged from prior, the largest measuring approximately 2x1.2 cm (IM13).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段及后基底段磨玻璃密度小结节大致同前，约7x5mm、7x4mm（IM28、46），边缘模糊
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodules in the right lower lobe posterior segment and posterior basal segment are stable, measuring approximately 7x5 mm and 7x4 mm (IM28, 46), with indistinct margins.

source_text: 纵隔及左肺门淋巴结同前，较大约11*6mm（IMA26）
text_en: Mediastinal and left hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest approximately 11x6 mm (IMA26)

source_text: 双肺内多发磨玻璃密度结节同前，约15mm（IM9），密度同前
text_en: Multiple ground-glass opacity nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 15 mm (IM9), with density unchanged.

source_text: 双肺弥漫散在多发小结节部分较前略增大，较大者现约7mm（IM34），原约5mm（IM35），边缘较前清楚
text_en: Diffusely distributed multiple small nodules in both lungs are partially slightly larger than prior; the largest now measures approximately 7 mm (IM34), previously about 5 mm (IM35), with margins clearer than before.

source_text: 双侧叶间胸膜结节样增厚及双侧胸膜增厚同前，双侧未见胸腔积液
text_en: Nodular thickening in the bilateral interlobar fissures and bilateral pleural thickening are unchanged; no pleural effusion is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 食管裂孔附近同前，较大仍约16x13mm（IM45），纵隔淋巴结部分较前略增大，如原约8x5mm（IM19），现约11x7mm（IM18）
text_en: Lymph nodes near the esophageal hiatus unchanged from previous, largest still approximately 16x13 mm (IM45), some mediastinal lymph nodes slightly increased in size compared to previous, e.g., previously approximately 8x5 mm (IM19), currently approximately 11x7 mm (IM18).

source_text: 双肺索条及钙化灶同前，未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Linear opacities and calcifications in both lungs are similar to prior. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶中央区磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，约17*12mm，中央见空泡征，大部分边界清楚
text_en: Central ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior, approximately 17x12 mm, with a central air bronchogram; most margins are well-defined.

source_text: 扫及肝右叶血管瘤样高强化结节同前
text_en: CT shows a hemangioma-like highly enhancing nodule in the right lobe of the liver unchanged from previous.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结大小同前，约11x8mm（IM18）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes size unchanged, the largest approximately 11x8 mm (IM18).

source_text: 纵隔4R及右侧腋窝小淋巴结同前，未见肿大
text_en: Small lymph nodes in mediastinal station 4R and right axilla are unchanged from previous; no enlarged lymph nodes seen.

source_text: 右腋下淋巴结同前，约16x13mm（Im22）
text_en: Right axillary lymph nodes are unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 16x13 mm (Im22)

source_text: 左肺上叶术后较前相仿，平扫支气管断端未见增厚及软组织密度影，右肺模糊结节样影同前，仍约8x6mm（IM33）
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left upper lobe similar to prior; non-contrast CT shows no thickening or soft tissue density at bronchial stump, right lung hazy nodular opacity unchanged, still approximately 8x6 mm (IM33).

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜结节状增厚同前（IM34），左肺下叶散在多发片絮影同前
text_en: Nodular thickening of the left interlobar pleura is unchanged compared to prior (IM34); scattered multiple patchy opacities in the left lower lobe are also unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则肿物较前明显缩小，原约53x52mm，现约26x21mm（IM21），与纵隔胸膜关系密切
text_en: The irregular mass in the left upper lobe has significantly decreased in size, from approximately 53x52 mm to approximately 26x21 mm (IM21), and is closely related to the mediastinal pleura.

source_text: 右肺下叶近下肺韧带处不规则软组织密度肿物较前略缩小，原约25x18mm，现约18*15mm（IMA36纵隔窗），呈分叶状，增强扫描轻度强化，中央见片状低强化区
text_en: Irregular soft tissue density mass near the inferior pulmonary ligament in the right lower lobe is slightly smaller than prior, previously measuring approximately 25 x 18 mm, now measuring approximately 18 x 15 mm (IMA36, mediastinal window). The mass is lobulated and shows mild enhancement on contrast-enhanced scanning, with a central area of lower enhancement.

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜结节样增厚同前（IMA36、41）
text_en: The nodular thickening of the left interlobar pleura is unchanged compared to prior (IMA36, 41).

source_text: 双肺多发结节，部分增大，部分同前相仿
text_en: Multiple nodules in both lungs; some have increased in size, others are similar to prior.

source_text: 双肺多发磨玻璃结节（IM9、11-13、17、22、35）大致同前，以两肺上叶为主，呈纯磨玻璃密度，较大直径约6mm（IM22）
text_en: Multiple ground-glass nodules (IM9, 11-13, 17, 22, 35) in both lungs are essentially unchanged, predominantly in the upper lobes, appearing as pure ground-glass opacities; the largest diameter is approximately 6 mm (IM22).

source_text: 左肺上叶癌复查：左肺门区及上叶远端肺内病变均较前缩小
text_en: Follow-up of left upper lobe carcinoma: lesions in the left hilar region and distal lung parenchyma of the upper lobe have both reduced in size compared to previous.

source_text: 左肺下叶癌疗后及双肺多发结节大致同前
text_en: Post-treatment for left lower lobe cancer and multiple nodules in both lungs largely same as prior

source_text: 右肺中叶内侧段见类圆形小结节较前增大，现约7mm（IM31），原约约5mm
text_en: Round small nodule in the medial segment of the right middle lobe is larger than before, now approximately 7 mm (IM31), previously approximately 5 mm.

source_text: 右肺模糊小结节影同前，较大约3mm（IM39）
text_en: Faint small nodular opacity in the right lung is stable compared to prior, the largest measuring approximately 3 mm (IM39).

source_text: 诸骨未见骨转移征象
text_en: No signs of bone metastasis are seen in all bones.

source_text: 右肺中叶多个磨玻璃样结节灶大致同前，较大现约11x8mm（IM100），边缘模糊
text_en: Multiple ground-glass nodules in the right middle lobe are essentially unchanged; the largest is currently approximately 11x8 mm (IM100), with indistinct margins.

source_text: 余肺内透亮度均匀，未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: The remaining lung parenchyma shows uniform lucency, without new nodules or areas of consolidation.

source_text: 纵隔及上腹部多发淋巴结较前稍缩小
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and upper abdomen slightly decreased compared to previous

source_text: 纵隔数枚小淋巴结同前，短径小于10mm
text_en: Several small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, short axis diameter less than 10 mm.

source_text: T9椎体结节灶同前，余扫及诸骨未骨质见破坏征象
text_en: Nodular lesion in T9 vertebral body unchanged; no evidence of osseous destruction in the remainder of the visualized bones

source_text: 纵隔4、7组及双侧锁骨上小淋巴结较前缩小，较大原约11x5mm（IM19），现约8x4mm（IM19），肺门及腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Small mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4 and 7 and bilateral supraclavicular lymph nodes have decreased in size compared to prior, with the largest previously measuring 11x5 mm (IM19) and currently 8x4 mm (IM19). No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in hilar or axillary regions.

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，未见肿大
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, no enlargement seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶肺门旁结节同前，考虑良性
text_en: The nodule adjacent to the hilum of the right upper lobe remains stable and is considered benign.

source_text: 右肾上腺低强化结节同前
text_en: Hypoenhancing nodule in the right adrenal gland is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺结节较前明显减少、缩小、密度减低，较大者原约19x14mm（IM27），现约17x12mm（IM27）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary nodules are markedly decreased in number and size, with reduced density. The largest was previously approximately 19x14 mm (IM27), now approximately 17x12 mm (IM27).

source_text: 右侧胸壁肌间隙、纵隔及双肺门多发钙化淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple calcified lymph nodes in the right chest wall intermuscular spaces, mediastinum, and bilateral pulmonary hila are unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 双侧胸膜结节样增厚同前，未见胸水
text_en: Bilateral pleural nodular thickening is unchanged. No pleural effusion is seen.

source_text: 食管-胃弓上吻合术后，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Post supra-aortic esophagogastrostomy, no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 右肺多发结节及钙化灶同前
text_en: Multiple nodules and calcifications in the right lung are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段小结节影同前，约4mm（IM18）
text_en: The small nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM18).

source_text: 扫及甲状腺右叶结节灶同前
text_en: Imaging shows a nodule in the right lobe of the thyroid, unchanged.

source_text: 平扫纵隔淋巴结同前，较大现仍约13x7mm（IM23）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest still approximately 13x7 mm (image 23).

source_text: 右肺中叶水平裂下方结节影同前，大小仍约6x4mm（IM34），边界清晰
text_en: Nodular opacity below the horizontal fissure in the right middle lobe is unchanged, still measuring approximately 6x4 mm (IM34), with well-defined margins.

source_text: 右锁骨上区可疑淋巴结，较前缩小，现约8x5mm（IM2），追查
text_en: Suspicious lymph node in the right supraclavicular region, decreased in size compared to prior, now approximately 8x5 mm (IM2); recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右侧纵膈多发小淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the right mediastinum are unchanged.

source_text: 双肺多发小结节较前明显缩小、减少，右下肺较大者原约6mm（IM36)，现约3mm（IMA36），多发转移较前明显好转
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs have markedly decreased in size and number; for example, the largest in the right lower lobe was previously about 6 mm (IM36), now about 3 mm (IMA36); multiple metastases have significantly improved.

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段小结节同前
text_en: Small nodule in the outer basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶纯磨玻璃密度结节大小同前，仍约4mm（IM31），追查
text_en: Pure ground-glass density nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged in size, still approximately 4 mm (IM31); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后改变，未见复发征象
text_en: Post-left lower lobectomy changes, with no evidence of recurrence.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管残端未见新发占位
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no new mass is seen at the bronchial stump.

source_text: 右肺模糊微小结节影同前（IMA38、50）
text_en: Faint tiny nodular opacity in the right lung is stable compared to prior (IMA38, 50).

source_text: 右肺下叶斜裂旁小结节同前，约4mm（IM35）
text_en: The small nodule adjacent to the oblique fissure of the right lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM35).

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则形混杂磨玻璃密度小结节大致同前，边界不清，现仍约20*13mm（IMA16），内见小空泡
text_en: Irregular mixed ground-glass density nodule in the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior, with ill-defined margins, currently measuring approximately 20 x 13 mm (IMA16), containing a small air bubble.

source_text: 转移瘤
text_en: Metastatic tumor.

source_text: 右肺尖新见微小结节，追查
text_en: New tiny nodule in the right apex; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段肿块较前增大
text_en: Left lower lobe basal segment mass increased compared to previous.

source_text: 右叶间胸膜约5mm小结节同前（IM42）
text_en: A small nodule measuring approximately 5 mm along the right interlobar pleura is stable compared to prior (IM42).

source_text: 双下肺少许条索、微结节同前（IM35），双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: A few linear strands and micro-nodules in both lower lungs are unchanged (IM35); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 纵隔4、5组少许小淋巴结同前，较大约9mm（IM17），平扫密度较高
text_en: A few small lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 4 and 5 are stable compared to prior. The largest measures approximately 9 mm (Image 17) and demonstrates higher density on non-contrast imaging.

source_text: 右肺叶间胸膜微小结节同前(图32)
text_en: Tiny nodule along the right interlobar pleura is stable compared to prior (Figure 32).

source_text: 上叶后段新见多发类结节影（IM27）及多发浅淡磨玻璃密度影（IM44）
text_en: New multiple nodular opacities in the upper lobe posterior segment (IM27) and multiple faint ground-glass opacities (IM44)

source_text: 右肺下叶背段条形结节大致同前，约12x6mm（IMA31），追查
text_en: The linear nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 12 x 6 mm (IMA31); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段实性结节大小同前无变化，建议3个月后随诊
text_en: A solid nodule in the left lower lobe, posterior segment, size unchanged from prior. Recommend follow-up in 3 months.

source_text: 双肺弥漫结节较前相仿
text_en: Diffusely distributed nodules in both lungs are similar to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶近膈面处多发簇状分布结节较前缩小减淡，较大原约6mm，现约3mm（IM49），倾向炎性，追查
text_en: Multiple clustered nodules near the diaphragmatic surface of the left lower lobe have decreased in size and density compared to prior, with the largest previously measuring approximately 6 mm and now approximately 3 mm (IM49). Findings are suggestive of inflammatory etiology. Follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双肺小结节部分同前，较大者约5mm（Im47）
text_en: Some bilateral pulmonary small nodules are stable compared to prior, the largest measures approximately 5 mm (Im47)

source_text: 右下肺磨玻璃结节同前相仿，倾向恶性，追查或或活检
