text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the right lower lobe is similar to the prior study; malignancy is favored. Further investigation or biopsy is recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段不规则形壁稍厚大泡病灶同前，建议复查
text_en: Irregularly shaped bulla with slightly thickened wall in the basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺结节同前（IM13、45、50），较大约7*6mm
text_en: Left lung nodule unchanged (IM13, 45, 50), approximately 7*6mm.

source_text: 双肺小点状结节影同前（IM12、23、31）
text_en: Multiple small punctate nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged (IM12, 23, 31).

source_text: 肺内局限性索条影同前，右肺肺尖小结节灶同前，约3mm（IMA12）
text_en: Focal linear opacities within the lung unchanged from previous; small nodule focus at the apex of the right lung unchanged, approximately 3 mm (image 12)

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R、5、6组多发淋巴结同前相仿，较大仍约19x18mm（IM29）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R, 4R, 5, and 6 are multiple and similar to previous, with the largest still approximately 19 x 18 mm (IM29).

source_text: 右第6肋局限高密度影仍可见（Im29），余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: Focal area of increased density in the right 6th posterior rib still visible (Im29); no osseous destruction seen in the remainder of the visualized bones.

source_text: 胸骨柄及胸5椎体上缘稍高密度灶，密切追查，请结合骨扫描检查除外转移
text_en: Slightly high-density lesion in the manubrium of the sternum and superior aspect of the T5 vertebral body; close follow-up recommended. Please correlate with bone scan to exclude metastasis.

source_text: 右肺散在微小结节同前，较大仍约3mm（IM24）
text_en: Scattered tiny nodules in the right lung are unchanged, the largest still measuring approximately 3 mm (IM24).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，左肺上叶后段胸膜下磨玻璃密度小结节大小同前，约4mm（IM18），边缘稍高实性密度同前
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, a small subpleural ground-glass density nodule in the posterior segment of the left upper lobe similar in size to prior, approximately 4 mm (IM18), with slightly higher solid density periphery similar to prior.

source_text: 纵隔多个小淋巴结同前相仿，平扫密度较高，较大约17x6mm（IM23）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes similar to prior, higher density on non-contrast scan, largest approximately 17x6 mm (IM23)

source_text: 扫及甲状腺左叶小结节同前
text_en: A small nodule in the left thyroid lobe is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺术后表现同前，胸部未见确切新生占位
text_en: Postoperative appearance in the right lung is unchanged from prior; no definite new space-occupying lesions are seen in the chest.

source_text: 左上叶小结节同前（IM11），两肺未见新发结节影
text_en: The small nodule in the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior (IM11); no new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段胸膜下结节同前，约6mm（IM39）
text_en: The subpleural nodule in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM39).

source_text: 左侧肋骨致密灶同前，余扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Dense foci in the left ribs, unchanged from prior; no evidence of osseous destruction in the remainder of the visualized thoracic bones.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃密度小结节大致同前，约7x4mm（IM14）
text_en: Small ground-glass density nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is essentially unchanged, approximately 7 × 4 mm (IM14).

source_text: 右肺多发小结节同前，建议复查
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right lung are unchanged; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶索条、两肺微小结节同前，双肺未见新发结节结及实变影
text_en: The linear opacities in the right upper lobe and the tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged; no new nodules or consolidations are seen in either lung.

source_text: 右锁骨上、纵隔及右肺门多发淋巴结，较前相仿，追查
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region, mediastinum, and right hilum are similar to prior; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔4、7组见小淋巴结同前，较大仍约16x8mm（IM27），余双肺门、锁骨上区及腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Small lymph nodes seen in mediastinal stations 4 and 7, unchanged from prior, largest still approximately 16x8 mm (IM27). No enlarged lymph nodes seen in the remaining bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular regions, or axillary regions.

source_text: 右肺下叶切除术后，支气管断端未见异常软组织密度影，肺内局限性索条影及右下肺近膈面胸膜类结节影同前（IM46）
text_en: Post right lower lobectomy, no abnormal soft tissue density is seen at the bronchial stump; focal linear densities in the lung and a nodular-appearing lesion near the diaphragmatic pleura in the right lower lobe are unchanged (IM46).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段不规则软组织肿块较前缩小，现约25*17mm(图18)，原约33x31mm（IM16）
text_en: The irregular soft tissue mass in the left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment has decreased compared to prior, now approximately 25x17 mm (Figure 18), previously approximately 33x31 mm (IM16).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段微小结节同前，追查
text_en: A tiny nodule in the apical-posterior segment of the left upper lobe same as before, follow-up.

source_text: 右肺癌术后改变同前相仿
text_en: Postoperative change from right lung cancer is similar to prior.

source_text: 双肺多发小结节同前，如右肺下叶较大结节仍约9x5mm（IM53）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior, such as the larger nodule in the right lower lobe, still measuring approximately 9x5 mm (IM53).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管残端未见新增占位征象
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no new mass-like findings are seen at the bronchial stump.

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门、锁骨上淋巴结较前略增大，右肺门现约19x16mm（IMA28）原约14x12mm（Im29）
text_en: Mediastinal, right hilar, and supraclavicular lymph nodes are slightly increased compared to previous. The right hilar node is currently approximately 19x16 mm (IMA28), previously approximately 14x12 mm (Im29).

source_text: 左肺下叶各见一浅淡密度结节较前相仿，约3mm（IM43），追查
text_en: One faint density nodule in the left lower lobe similar to previous, approximately 3mm (IM43), follow-up recommended

source_text: 左肺癌术后，支气管断端未见确切复发征象
text_en: After left lung cancer surgery, no definite signs of recurrence at the bronchial stump.

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下、左肺下叶散在小结节同前，较大仍约4mm（IM41）
text_en: Scattered small nodules subpleurally in the right middle lobe and in the left lower lobe are unchanged, with the largest still measuring approximately 4 mm (IM41).

source_text: 右肺下叶近膈处小结节同前，仍约7mm（IM44）
text_en: The small nodule near the diaphragm in the right lower lobe is stable, still measuring approximately 7 mm (IM44).

source_text: 两肺小结节同前
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior

source_text: 左肺未见新增结节灶及斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities in the left lung.

source_text: 双肺转移结节增大
text_en: Pulmonary metastatic nodules in both lungs are increased in size.

source_text: 左肺上叶及右肺中叶不规则小结节同前，较大约4mm（IM25）
text_en: Irregular small nodules in the left upper lobe and right middle lobe are unchanged, largest approximately 4 mm (IM25).

source_text: 甲状腺体积增大同前，平扫内部呈多结节状，部分伸入纵隔内
text_en: Thyroid gland enlargement stable compared to prior, non-contrast scan shows multinodular appearance with partial extension into the mediastinum.

source_text: 右肺上叶见微结节较前相仿，约3mm（IM15）
text_en: A tiny nodule is seen in the right upper lobe, stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM15).

source_text: 扫及右侧肾上腺结节同前
text_en: CT shows a nodule in the right adrenal gland, unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段软组织肿块较前缩小
text_en: The soft tissue mass in the basal segment of the right lower lobe is smaller compared to prior imaging.

source_text: 余肺野未见新发结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: The remainder of the lung fields shows no new nodules or floccular opacities.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后改变，胸部CT未见新发病变
text_en: Postoperative change in the right lower lobe; chest CT shows no new lesions.

source_text: 两肺未见明显新发结节影
text_en: No obvious new nodules are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结较前稍减小
text_en: The right hilar lymph node is slightly decreased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶微小结节影同前（IM43）
text_en: Right lower lobe tiny nodular opacity unchanged (IM43)

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下不规则小结节同前，仍约4mm（IM30）
text_en: Irregular small subpleural nodule in the right middle lobe is stable compared to prior, still approximately 4 mm (IM30).

source_text: 左侧锁骨上小淋巴结同前相仿，约14x7mm（IM4）
text_en: Small lymph node in the left supraclavicular region is stable, measuring approximately 14x7 mm (IM4).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段少量小结节同前相仿，较大约5mm（IM28），追查
text_en: Few small nodules in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe, similar to prior; largest approximately 5 mm (IM28); recommended for follow-up.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见异常软组织密度灶，局部胸膜增厚同前，周围肺内局限性索条及索条结节灶同前，隆突下局限性包裹性液气胸同前
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no abnormal soft tissue density at the bronchial stump. Local pleural thickening is stable compared to prior. Focal linear bands and linear-nodular opacities in the adjacent lung parenchyma are stable. Focal, localized loculated pneumatocele under the carina is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔4、5组小淋巴结大致同前，较大者仍约13x7mm（Im19）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 4 and 5 are essentially stable compared to prior. The largest remains approximately 13x7 mm (Image 19).

source_text: 右肺中叶索条影同前，右肺上中叶小结节同前，双肺未见新发结节
text_en: Linear opacity in the right middle lobe is unchanged; small nodules in the right upper and middle lobes are unchanged; no new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节及斜裂胸膜结节大致同前，仍约3mm（IM22、28、34）
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe and the pleural nodule along the oblique fissure are stable compared to prior, remaining approximately 3 mm (IM22, 28, 34)

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, follow-up.

source_text: 腔静脉后小淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes posterior to the vena cava essentially unchanged from previous

source_text: 右肺中叶占位大致同前
text_en: Right middle lobe mass is essentially unchanged.

source_text: 双肺转移部分较前增大
text_en: Some pulmonary metastatic nodules in both lungs are larger than prior.

source_text: 扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏及转移征象
text_en: No bone destruction or metastatic signs observed in the imaged bones.

source_text: 左锁骨上小淋巴结略增大，原约2mm，现约4mm（IM4）
text_en: Left supraclavicular small lymph node slightly enlarged, previously approximately 2 mm, now approximately 4 mm (IM4)

source_text: 平扫纵隔淋巴结同前，较大仍约20x12mm（IM29）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes on non-contrast CT are stable compared to prior, with the largest measuring approximately 20x12 mm (IM29).

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结同前，仍约12x8mm（IM21）
text_en: The mediastinal station 4R lymph node is unchanged, still approximately 12 x 8 mm (Image 21)

source_text: 纵隔7组肿大淋巴结较前稍增大，原约18x12mm（IM34），现约22x15mm(IM30)，贲门左侧肿大淋巴结较前稍缩小，原约21x16mm（IM59），现约18x14mm（IM57）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 enlarged lymph nodes are slightly increased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 18 × 12 mm (Image 34), currently approximately 22 × 15 mm (Image 30); left gastric cardia enlarged lymph nodes are slightly decreased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 21 × 16 mm (Image 59), currently approximately 18 × 14 mm (Image 57)

source_text: 左侧锁骨上小淋巴结同前，约为7mm（IM5）
text_en: Left supraclavicular small lymph node unchanged, approximately 7 mm (IM5)

source_text: 纵隔少许小淋巴结同前，未见异常肿大淋巴结
text_en: A few small mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged from prior; no abnormally enlarged lymph nodes observed.

source_text: 双肺间质纤维化大致同前，双肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Pulmonary interstitial fibrosis is generally unchanged from prior; no new nodules are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺内多发低密度结节影同前
text_en: Multiple low-density nodules are seen in the thyroid, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影及模糊小结节同前(图60)，左肺尖点状小结节同前，大小3mm（IM7）
text_en: The linear opacities and indistinct small nodules in the right lower lobe are unchanged (Figure 60); the punctate nodule at the left lung apex is unchanged, measuring 3 mm (IM7).

source_text: 左肺中叶肿物较前增大，现约28*27mm(图30)，原约20*13mm(图11)
text_en: Mass in left middle lobe increased compared to previous, currently approximately 28x27mm (image 30), previously approximately 20x13mm (image 11).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，左肺上叶纵隔旁新发结节，考虑转移可能性大
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; new-onset nodule adjacent to the mediastinum in the left upper lobe, with high suspicion for metastasis.

source_text: 破坏灶
text_en: Destructive focus

source_text: 左侧胸膜结节较前增多增大，较大约14x10mm（IM8）
text_en: Left pleural nodules are increased in number and size compared to prior, the largest measuring approximately 14x10 mm (IM8).

source_text: 前纵隔结节影同前，现约17*8mm（IMA20）
text_en: Nodular opacity in the anterior mediastinum is stable compared to prior, now measuring approximately 17x8 mm (IMA20).

source_text: 局部肿大淋巴结较前缩小，追查
text_en: Locally enlarged lymph nodes are smaller than before; continue follow-up.

source_text: 右侧第5后肋术后改变同前，左侧3-6侧肋骨质连续性中断，断端见骨痂形成，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right 5th posterior rib are stable. The left 3rd to 6th lateral ribs show discontinuity with callus formation at the fracture ends. No bony destruction is seen in the remainder of the scanned bones.

source_text: 右肺散在小结节影同前，较大约5mm（IMA17）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right lung are unchanged from prior, the largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IMA17).

source_text: 左肺陈旧灶同前，胸部CT平扫未见新生占位
text_en: Left lung chronic lesion unchanged; non-contrast chest CT shows no new nodule or mass.

source_text: 原左肺舌叶微小结节未见显示，余双肺未见新增结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: The previously noted tiny nodule in the left lingular segment is no longer visible; no new nodules or fluffy lesions are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 病变与其下方残胃壁分界不清，局部软组织密度结节较前减小，原约36x32mm（IM15），现约32x29mm（IM15）
text_en: The lesion has ill-defined margins with the residual gastric wall below. The local soft tissue density nodule has decreased in size, previously measuring approximately 36x32 mm (IM15), now approximately 32x29 mm (IM15)

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管残端未见确切复发征象
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, no definite evidence of recurrence at the bronchial stump.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段磨玻璃结节灶同前，约9x6mm（IM46）
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 9 x 6 mm (IM46).

source_text: 扫及甲状腺右叶低密度结节同前
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right thyroid lobe, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶钙化结节同前
text_en: Calcified nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖后段混杂磨玻璃密度结节大小同前，约6*4mm（IMA21）
text_en: Right upper lobe apical and posterior segment mixed ground-glass density nodule size unchanged, approximately 6x4 mm (IMA21)

source_text: 左肺门淋巴结，较前略减小
text_en: Left hilar lymph nodes are slightly decreased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 右上肺不规则磨玻璃密度病灶较前略增大，恶性
text_en: Irregular ground-glass opacity in the right upper lung has slightly increased in size compared to prior; malignant.

source_text: 右肺上叶微小结节同前，约2-3mm（IM29）
text_en: Tiny nodules in the right upper lobe, unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 2–3 mm (IM29).

source_text: 右腋下淋巴结同前，仍约14x12mm（Im22）
text_en: Right axillary lymph nodes are unchanged compared to prior, remaining approximately 14x12 mm (Im22)

source_text: 左肺下叶陈旧小结节同前（Im40），余肺未见新生结节灶或斑片影，左侧未见胸水
text_en: Old small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (Im40); no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remaining lung; no pleural effusion on the left.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段点状结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Punctate nodular opacity in the basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 双肺多个小结节同前，追查
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺结节同前，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: Right lung nodule unchanged, considered an old focus.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃小结节同前
text_en: Left upper lobe small ground-glass nodule unchanged from previous.

source_text: 左上叶术后，支气管断端少许软组织密度灶大致同前，右上肺陈旧灶同前，余双肺未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy; the small soft tissue density at the bronchial stump is essentially unchanged; the old focus in the right upper lobe is stable; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 余肺多发小结节及磨玻璃密度结节灶同前
text_en: Multiple small nodules and ground-glass nodules in the remaining lung are stable compared to prior.

text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, scattered micronodules in the upper lungs similar to prior (Figure 16-18).

source_text: 肺内多发小结节及胸膜陈旧病变等同前
text_en: Multiple small nodules within the lung and chronic pleural changes unchanged from prior.

text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities

text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are largely unchanged from prior, with the larger one now measuring approximately 12x9 mm (IM20).

source_text: 右肺肺尖胸膜下局限性磨玻璃密度结节灶大致同前（IMA9、18），较大者约7mm（IMA9）
text_en: The focal ground-glass opacity nodule subpleurally at the right lung apex is largely unchanged (IMA9, 18); the larger one measures approximately 7 mm (IMA9).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，纵隔及右肺门淋巴结部分切除术后，余纵隔及右侧锁骨上淋巴结，部分同前，部分增大
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy with partial resection of mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes; some of the remaining mediastinal and right supraclavicular lymph nodes are unchanged, while others have increased in size.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前相仿，较大约23x15mm（IMA20）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior, largest approximately 23x15 mm (IMA20)

source_text: 扫及右侧肾上腺结节影、肝内低密度结节影同前，请结合腹部检查评价
text_en: On scan, right adrenal nodule and intrahepatic low-density nodule unchanged from prior; correlate with abdominal imaging.

source_text: 甲状腺内低密度结节同前，请结合临床及超声检查
text_en: Low-density nodule within the thyroid gland unchanged from prior; please correlate with clinical and ultrasound findings.

source_text: 左肺未见新发结节
text_en: No new nodules in the left lung.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，左肺上叶结节较前增大，恶性可能大，建议追查
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lower lobe; the nodule in the left upper lobe has increased in size compared to prior, with high suspicion for malignancy. Further evaluation is recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶肿块较前缩小，边缘仍可见毛刺及分叶，邻近胸膜牵拉同前，不均匀强化同前相仿，现约34x28mm（IM17），原为50x46mm（IM17）
text_en: The mass in the right upper lobe has decreased in size compared to prior imaging. Marginal spiculation and lobulation remain visible, and adjacent pleural retraction is unchanged. Heterogeneous enhancement is similar to prior studies; now measuring approximately 34x28 mm (IM17), previously 50x46 mm (IM17).

text_en: Newly seen ill-defined small nodules

source_text: 左肺下叶背段、右肺上叶后段磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，仍约3mm、10x6mm、5x4mm（IM20、24、27）
text_en: Left lower lobe posterior segment and right upper lobe posterior segment ground-glass opacity nodules unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 3 mm, 10x6 mm, and 5x4 mm (IM20, 24, 27).

text_en: No definite new findings seen

text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, small amount of soft tissue density at the bronchial stump, scattered small subpleural nodules on the distal side stable compared to prior (IM43).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段薄壁空腔同前，仍约21x20mm（IMA17），壁厚度均匀，未见壁结节，其周围环周模糊磨玻璃密度同前，范围仍约10x8mm（IMA17），未见明显实性成分，追查
text_en: A thin-walled cavity in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe, unchanged from previous, still approximately 21x20mm (IMA17), with uniform wall thickness and no wall nodules seen. Surrounding circumferential hazy ground-glass opacity unchanged, extent still approximately 10x8mm (IMA17), no obvious solid component seen, follow-up.

text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe slightly more prominent, currently approximately 6 mm (IM20), previously approximately 4 mm (IM20)

text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs have increased in number; some appear more prominent; for example, a focus previously about 2 mm is now about 4 mm (IM28).

source_text: 前纵隔片状软组织影同前（Im18），未见增厚或结节
text_en: Patchy soft tissue density in the anterior mediastinum is stable compared to prior (Im18), without thickening or nodules.

text_en: The small nodules in both lungs are largely unchanged compared to prior; the largest remains approximately 7 mm (IM33).

source_text: 右肺门及纵隔多发淋巴结同前相仿，较大约15x14mm（IM27），追查

source_text: 新见数枚小结节
text_en: Newly seen several small nodules

source_text: 左肺上叶前段及右肺下叶基底段散在小结节同前（IM15、33、37），较大仍约7x3mm（IM15）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe and basal segment of the right lower lobe are stable compared to prior (IM15, 33, 37), the larger one still measuring approximately 7x3 mm (IM15).

text_en: Small lymph nodes in mediastinal station 6 are unchanged from prior, approximately 5 mm (IM14).

source_text: 左下叶背段软组织肿块较前明显增大，原约46x44mm（IM30)，现约56x54mm（IM31），左下叶背段支气管截断同前
text_en: The soft tissue mass in the left lower lobe dorsal segment has significantly increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 46 x 44 mm (IM30), now approximately 56 x 54 mm (IM31). The truncated appearance of the left lower lobe dorsal segmental bronchus remains unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、双腋下淋巴结同前相仿，小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal, bilateral hilar, and bilateral axillary lymph nodes unchanged from previous, less than 10 mm.

source_text: 右肺上叶及左肺下叶散在小结节同前，较大仍约6mm（IM15）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right upper lobe and left lower lobe are stable compared to prior; the largest remains approximately 6 mm (IM15).

source_text: 双肺多发微小结节同前
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 两肺小结节影部分较前饱满，如右肺上叶原约4mm者，现约6mm（Im20），双肺结节较大约9mm（IM37）
text_en: Some of the small nodules in both lungs appear more prominent than prior; for example, a previously approximately 4 mm nodule in the right upper lobe is now approximately 6 mm (Im20). The largest nodules in both lungs are now approximately 9 mm (IM37).

source_text: 食管下段管壁增厚较前减轻，纵隔、贲门周围、胃小弯多发淋巴结较前缩小，考虑好转
text_en: Wall thickening of the distal esophagus is reduced compared to prior. Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum, around the cardia, and along the gastric lesser curvature are decreased in size compared to prior, suggesting improvement.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段小结节同前，约5x4mm（IM34）
text_en: Small nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 5x4 mm (IM34).

source_text: 双肺门、纵隔7组多发肿大淋巴结同前，较大约14x11mm（IM28）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the bilateral hila and mediastinum (group 7) are unchanged from prior; the largest is approximately 14x11 mm (IM28).

source_text: 未见肺内明显新增
text_en: No significant new intrapulmonary findings seen

source_text: 右腋下淋巴结同前，仍约14x12mm（Im21）
text_en: Right axillary lymph nodes are unchanged compared to prior, remaining approximately 14x12 mm (Im21)

source_text: 双侧锁骨上区未见肿大淋巴结，纵隔4、5组淋巴结同前，较大仍约17x8mm（IM21）
text_en: No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the bilateral supraclavicular regions. Lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 4 and 5 are stable compared to prior; the largest remains approximately 17x8 mm (IM21).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃密度结节同前，约7mm（IMA38），右肺下叶外基底段小结节同前，约4x2mm（IMA43）
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 7 mm (IMA38); the small nodule in the lateral basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 4x2 mm (IMA43).

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区小淋巴结同前，约为10x6mm（IM6）
text_en: Small lymph node in the left supraclavicular region is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 10x6 mm (IM6).

source_text: 胸10椎体下缘结节样高密度影同前相仿，边界清晰
text_en: Nodular high-density shadow at the inferior margin of thoracic vertebra 10, similar to previous, with clear margins

source_text: 前纵隔淋巴结同前，约10mm（IMA22）
text_en: Anterior mediastinal lymph node is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 10 mm (IMA22).

source_text: 双肺小结节、右肺门淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs and right hilar lymph node are unchanged; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 双侧锁骨上区及纵隔散在小淋巴结同前
text_en: Scattered small lymph nodes in the bilateral supraclavicular regions and mediastinum are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔2、4、7、10R肿大淋巴结同前，较大约16x10mm（IMA25），密度均匀
text_en: Enlarged lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2, 4, 7, 10R unchanged from prior, largest approximately 16x10 mm (IMA25), uniform density

source_text: 纵隔4R/4L、5、7区多发淋巴结大致同前，较大约16x8mm（IM30）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R, 4L, 5, and 7 essentially unchanged from previous, largest approximately 16x8 mm (Fig. 30)

source_text: 甲状腺低密度结节部分显示同前
text_en: Thyroid hypodense nodule partially demonstrated as prior.

source_text: 双肺未见新发结节斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，仍约6mm（IM36）
text_en: Small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, still approximately 6 mm (IM36).

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节较前相仿，仍约3mm（IMA17）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior, still approximately 3 mm (IMA17).

source_text: 左肺小结节同前，仍约3mm（IM43）
text_en: Left lung small nodule unchanged, still approximately 3 mm (IM43)

source_text: 病灶边缘多发毛刺、与邻近斜裂胸膜牵拉粘连同前
text_en: Multiple spiculations at the lesion margins and traction adhesions to the adjacent oblique fissure pleura, unchanged from prior

source_text: 左下叶见新发小结节约2mm（IM37），追查
text_en: New small nodule measuring approximately 2 mm is identified in the left lower lobe (IM37); follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: No bone destruction lesions observed in the imaged bones.

source_text: 左侧膈肌胸膜结节同前相仿（IM48），未见胸水征象
text_en: The nodular pleural thickening along the left hemidiaphragm is similar to prior (IM48); no evidence of pleural effusion is seen.

source_text: 右肺中叶内侧段微小结节同前，约2mm（IM32）
text_en: Tiny nodule in the medial segment of the right middle lobe, stable compared to prior, approximately 2 mm (IM32).

source_text: 左上叶尖后段陈旧结核灶同前（Im25），余肺未见新发结节及片絮影
text_en: The old tuberculosis focus in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior (Im25); the remainder of the lungs shows no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 胸4椎体、右侧第4后肋致密结节同前，余扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Sclerotic nodule in T4 vertebral body and right 4th posterior rib unchanged; no evidence of bone destruction in the remaining scanned thoracic bones.

source_text: 纵隔散在小淋巴结同前
text_en: Scattered small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见异常软组织密度肿块影，右肺索条影同前，右肺下叶斑片状影缩小（IMA42）
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no abnormal soft tissue density mass is seen at the bronchial stump. Linear opacities in the right lung are stable. Patchy opacities in the right lower lobe have decreased in size (IMA42).

source_text: 右肺上叶肿物切除术后改变同前
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe is stable compared to prior imaging.

source_text: 左肺上叶索条影同前，余肺未见新发结节
text_en: Left upper lobe linear opacity unchanged, no new nodules in the remaining lung.

source_text: 两肺多发小结节部分较前增大，现较大约13*8mm（IM49）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs, some increased in size compared to prior, now measuring up to approximately 13x8 mm (IM49)

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段不规则结节同前，仍约18x14mm（IM33），边缘光整，轻度强化
text_en: The irregular nodule in the basal segment of the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, remaining approximately 18x14 mm (IM33), with smooth margins and mild enhancement.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，左叶间胸膜下小结节同前，约6x4mm（IM38）
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. The subpleural small nodule in the left fissure is stable, measuring approximately 6x4 mm (IM38).

source_text: 左上肺新见小结节，追查
text_en: New small nodule seen in the left upper lobe; recommend follow-up

source_text: 右肺门软组织影较前略增厚，现较厚约8mm(图24)，原约5mm(图25)
text_en: Soft tissue opacity at the right hilum is slightly thicker than prior, now measuring about 8 mm in thickness (Figure 24), previously about 5 mm (Figure 25).

source_text: 右肺下叶见不规则高密度微小结节同前（IM34），余肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: An irregular high-density micro-nodule is seen in the right lower lobe, unchanged from prior (IM34); no new nodules or consolidation are seen elsewhere in the lungs.

source_text: 右腋下淋巴结同前，仍约14x12mm（Im18）
text_en: Right axillary lymph nodes are unchanged compared to prior, remaining approximately 14x12 mm (Im18)

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下类结节影及索条影较前增大增多
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural nodule-like opacity and linear opacity increased in size and number compared to previous.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段见一磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，仍约9mm（IM25），建议12月后复查
text_en: A ground-glass density nodule is seen in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, similar to prior, still measuring approximately 9 mm (IM25); follow-up in 12 months is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔2R、3P、4R、5、7、8区多发肿大淋巴结较前缩小，较大原约24x16mm（IM33），现约20x15mm（IM31），扫及膈下见多发小淋巴结显示
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R, 3P, 4R, 5, 7, and 8 decreased compared to previous; largest previously approximately 24x16 mm (IM33), now approximately 20x15 mm (IM31). Scan also shows multiple small subdiaphragmatic lymph nodes.

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下小结节影同前，约3mm（IM41）
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM41).

source_text: 双肺散在稍高密度微小结节同前，双下肺为主，多数钙化
text_en: Scattered slightly hyperdense micronodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior, predominantly in the lower lungs. Most are calcified.

source_text: 右肺门肿大淋巴结，考虑转移
text_en: Enlarged lymph nodes in the right hilum, considered metastatic.

source_text: 右肺中叶占位同前，追查
text_en: Right middle lobe mass is unchanged. Further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 右肺中叶条片灶同前，不规则小结节同前（IM16）
text_en: Right middle lobe linear and patchy opacities are stable; irregular small nodule is stable (IM16).

source_text: 纵隔4R、7组及右肺门淋巴结较前相仿，较大仍约11mm（IM16）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 4R and 7 and the right hilum are similar to prior, with the largest remaining approximately 11 mm (IM16).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃结节影同前，大小约16x10mm（IM13），内部可见少许实性成分
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 16x10 mm (IM13), with a few solid components visible within.

source_text: 右侧少量胸水及右侧叶间积液基本吸收，右肺下叶膨胀不前同前，右上肺索条影同前，左肺内未见明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: The small right pleural effusion and right interlobar fluid collection have essentially resolved. Poor expansion of the right lower lobe is unchanged. The linear opacities in the right upper lobe are unchanged. No new nodules or consolidations are seen in the left lung.

source_text: 在一个多发小淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes are generally stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结较前缩小，原约22x11mm，现约20x11mm（IM29）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes are decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 22x11 mm, currently approximately 20x11 mm (IM29)

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous, less than 10mm.

source_text: 双肺间质纤维化及散在少许小结节同前，左肺下叶结节约5mm（Im38）同前，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Pulmonary interstitial fibrosis and scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior; a nodule in the left lower lobe measures about 5 mm (Im38), unchanged from prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 扫及左乳内侧象限小结节同前（IM27）
text_en: A small nodule in the inner quadrant of the left breast is unchanged from prior (Im27).

source_text: 余肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: The remainder of the lungs shows no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 纵隔8组新见一肿大淋巴结，约25x20mm（IM34），边缘模糊，与邻近结构分界不清
text_en: A newly observed enlarged lymph node in mediastinal station 8, approximately 25x20 mm (IM34), with blurred margins and indistinct borders from adjacent structures.

source_text: 两肺索条小结节影同前（IM15、24、41等），小于5mm
text_en: The linear opacities and small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM15, 24, 41, etc.), less than 5 mm.

source_text: 右肺门肿大淋巴结同前，约13x11mm（Im29），建议追查
text_en: The enlarged right hilar lymph node is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 13 x 11 mm (Im29); follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔4、7组数个淋巴结同前相仿，较大约13x5mm（IM25），肺门、腋窝及锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal stations 4 and 7 several lymph nodes unchanged from prior; largest approximately 13x5 mm (IM25). Hilar, axillary, and supraclavicular regions show no enlarged lymph nodes

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes essentially unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双下肺小结节同前，倾向转移
text_en: The small nodules in both lower lungs are unchanged, suggestive of metastases.

source_text: 纵隔4、7组及双侧锁骨上小淋巴结较前相仿，较大仍约8x4mm（IM20），肺门及腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Small mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4 and 7 and bilateral supraclavicular lymph nodes are similar to prior, with the largest still measuring approximately 8x4 mm (IM20). No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in hilar or axillary regions.

source_text: 纵隔、双锁骨上区及双腋下多个小淋巴结，较前相仿，如原4R较大仍约6mm（IM22）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum, bilateral supraclavicular regions, and bilateral axillary regions are similar to prior, with the largest in station 4R still measuring approximately 6 mm (IM22).

source_text: 左肺上叶索条结节灶同前（IMA32），余肺未见新发结节及斑片影
text_en: Left upper lobe linear nodular opacity unchanged (IMA32), no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remaining lung.

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门小淋巴结同前，部分内仍见钙化
text_en: Small mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous, some still show calcification.

source_text: 左锁骨上小淋巴结同前，纵隔多发淋巴结较前相仿，较大约7x4mm（IM15）
text_en: Left supraclavicular small lymph node unchanged from prior. Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes similar to prior. The largest measures approximately 7x4 mm (IM15)

source_text: 纵隔及左锁骨上多发淋巴结较前相仿，较大仍约11x8mm（IM21）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and left supraclavicular region similar to previous, the largest still approximately 11x8mm (IM21).

source_text: 两肺下叶索条影及右肺散在小结节、钙化灶大致同前
text_en: Linear opacities in both lower lobes are unchanged. Scattered small nodules and calcified foci in the right lung are essentially unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺磨玻璃密度小结节同前
text_en: Left lung ground-glass opacity small nodule unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺叶间胸膜结节影同前，大小约8x4mm（IM38）
text_en: Left lung interlobar pleural nodule unchanged from prior, size approximately 8x4 mm (IM38).

source_text: 右肺中叶斜裂旁不规则磨玻璃结节同前，仍约9x6mm（IM44），斜裂胸膜受牵拉
text_en: Irregular ground-glass nodule adjacent to the oblique fissure in the right middle lobe, stable compared to prior, still approximately 9x6 mm (IM44), with pleural retraction at the fissure

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下小结节同前，约4mm（IM29）
text_en: The subpleural small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, approximately 4 mm (IM29)

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前，＜5mm（图24）
text_en: Tiny nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior, measuring less than 5 mm (Figure 24).

source_text: 右肺门及右侧锁骨上小淋巴结同前，较大仍约12x6mm（Im28）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the right hilar region and right supraclavicular area are stable compared to prior; the largest remains approximately 12x6 mm (Im28).

source_text: 右肺散在斑片索条钙化及微小结节影同前（IMA20），双肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Scattered patchy linear calcifications and micro-nodular opacities in the right lung are stable compared to prior (IMA20); no new nodules or consolidations are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺门不规则肿块较前略增大，原约40x27mm（IM29），现约44x31mm（IM28），其远侧结节、斑片影增大，范围扩大
text_en: Left hilar irregular mass slightly increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 40x27mm (IM29), currently approximately 44x31mm (IM28); distal nodules and patchy opacities increased with expanded extent.

source_text: 双肺内未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺门见片状高密度影及小结节影同前（IM21、22）
text_en: Patchy areas of increased density and small nodular opacities in the right hilum are stable compared to prior (IM21, 22).

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门多发淋巴结同前，较大约20x12mm（IM35）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous, the largest approximately 20x12 mm (IM35).

source_text: 两肺散在索条小结节灶同前，陈旧病灶可能，追查
text_en: Scattered linear and small nodular opacities in both lungs, unchanged from prior; likely old lesions, continue monitoring.

source_text: 双肺浅淡密度微小结节同前（IM19、23、24、39、41、44、46），较大仍约5mm（IM23）
text_en: Faint density tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM19, 23, 24, 39, 41, 44, 46); the largest remains approximately 5 mm (IM23).

source_text: 隆突下见软组织密度片影较前缩小，原范围约20x14mm，现约11x8mm（IM24）
text_en: Subcarinal soft tissue density patch is reduced compared to previous, with original size approximately 20x14 mm and current size approximately 11x8 mm (IM24).

source_text: 平扫纵隔、左侧锁骨上小淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows mediastinal and left supraclavicular small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, all less than 10 mm.

source_text: 胸椎椎体多发稍高密度结节（矢状位 IM35、38）同前相仿，余扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Multiple slightly high-density nodules in the thoracic vertebral bodies (sagittal view IM35, 38) similar to previous, no evidence of bone destruction seen in the remaining scanned bones of the thoracic cage.

source_text: 左肺下叶结节部分较前增多、增大，如左下肺新发结节约11x9mm（Im34）
text_en: Some left lower lobe nodules have increased in number and size compared to previous, such as a new nodule in the left lower lobe approximately 11x9 mm (Im34).

source_text: 双上肺术后，肺内索条影，局部高密度缝合钉影同前相仿，局部软组织略增厚同前，双下肺多发条片影同前，未见新发结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Status post-surgery in both upper lungs; the intrapulmonary linear strands and localized high-density suture clips are similar to prior; localized soft tissue thickening is unchanged; the multiple linear and patchy opacities in both lower lungs are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 扫描所及胸部诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Scanned thoracic bones show no evidence of osseous destruction.

source_text: 右下肺背段癌复查，同前相仿
text_en: Follow-up of right lower lobe carcinoma is comparable to prior examination.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R、7组可见多发淋巴结较前稍小，较大原约14x11mm（IM33），现约12x10mm（IM32）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R, 4R, 7 are visible and slightly smaller than previous; the largest was previously approximately 14 x 11 mm (IM33) and is now approximately 12 x 10 mm (IM32).

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节同前，仍约9*7mm(图19)
text_en: Small nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, still measures approximately 9 x 7 mm (Figure 19).

source_text: 纵隔及肺门淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes unchanged from prior, less than 10mm in size.

source_text: 双肺胸膜下散在多发小结节影大致同前，较大约5mm（IM48），部分界清，部分边缘模糊，周围见磨玻璃密度同前（薄层IM55）
text_en: Scattered multiple small subpleural nodules in both lungs are approximately stable, the largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM48); some have well-defined margins, others have indistinct margins, with surrounding ground-glass opacity stable compared to prior (thin-section IM55).

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见明显异常肿块影，左侧胸膜增厚同前，左侧胸水减少
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, no significant abnormal mass at bronchial stump; left pleural thickening unchanged from prior; left pleural effusion decreased.

source_text: 左肺透过度略减低，左肺下叶小结节同前，约6x3mm（IM38）
text_en: Left lung shows slightly decreased radiolucency; small nodule in left lower lobe unchanged from previous, approximately 6x3 mm (IM38).

source_text: 右下肺及左上肺模糊结节灶大致同前
text_en: Indistinct nodules in the right lower lung and left upper lung largely unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结，原3p及4R小淋巴结较前缩小（IM11、18）
text_en: No enlarged lymph nodes seen in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular regions, and bilateral axillary regions; previous small lymph nodes at stations 3p and 4R are smaller than before (IM11, 18).

source_text: 右肺术后，下叶支气管断端结构紊乱同前，手术缝线周围软组织影较前增厚，较厚处原约15mm（IMA21），现约31mm（IM22），考虑复发，结合临床床
text_en: Postoperative right lung, disorganized architecture at the distal end of the lower lobe bronchus unchanged compared to prior; soft tissue density surrounding the surgical suture has thickened compared to before, with maximum thickness previously approximately 15 mm (IMA21), now approximately 31 mm (IM22). Recurrence is considered; correlate clinically.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段斜裂胸膜下高密度类结节大小同前，仍约11x10mm（IM21），边缘毛糙同前，其后方见点状钙化同前
text_en: Stable high-density nodule in left upper lobe apicoposterior segment, subpleural along oblique fissure, approximately 11x10 mm (IM21), irregular margins, posterior punctate calcification

source_text: 双肺未见明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: No obvious new nodules or consolidation are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 左侧膈肌新见结节，大小约13x8mm（IM48），考虑转移
text_en: Newly noted nodule in the left hemidiaphragm, measuring approximately 13 x 8 mm (IM48), considered likely metastatic.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜及双侧胸膜多发结节状增厚大部分同前，个别结节略增大
text_en: Multiple nodular thickenings of the right interlobar pleura and bilateral pleura are mostly unchanged from prior, with individual nodules slightly increased in size.

source_text: 右上叶钙化灶及索条影较前相仿，余肺未见新发结节影
text_en: Calcified foci and linear opacities in the right upper lobe are similar to prior; no new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 食道胸中段癌同前比较未见明显变化
text_en: Mid-thoracic esophageal cancer shows no significant change compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶多发微小结节同前（IM19、24）
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in the right upper lobe are stable compared to prior (IM19, 24).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段4mm小结节同前（IM20）
text_en: A 4 mm small nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment is stable compared to prior (IM20).

source_text: 胸2椎体、左侧第7肋骨高密度结节同前
text_en: T2 vertebral body and left seventh rib demonstrate hyperdense nodules, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区、右上纵隔气管旁数枚淋巴结较前相仿（Im6、13、17等），约8-10mm
text_en: Several lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region and right upper paratracheal mediastinum are stable compared to prior (Im6, 13, 17, etc.), measuring approximately 8-10 mm.

source_text: 左下肺门区不规则软组织密度肿物较前略增大，较大层面范围原约20x10mm（IM29），现约25*12mm（IM30），累及左肺下叶背段及前内侧基底段支气管狭窄、闭塞同前，远端肺不张较前增大
text_en: An irregular soft tissue density mass in the left lower hilum is slightly larger than before. The largest dimension was previously approximately 20 x 10 mm (IM29), now approximately 25 x 12 mm (IM30). Involvement of the left lower lobe dorsal segment and anteromedial basal segment bronchi with stenosis and occlusion remains unchanged. The distal atelectasis is increased compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段结节较前相仿，大小约12x7mm（IM35），左肺下叶少许斑片状影大致同前
text_en: Left lower lobe basal segment nodule essentially unchanged from previous, measuring approximately 12x7 mm (IM35), with minimal patchy opacity in the left lower lobe essentially unchanged.

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段微小结节灶同前，约3mm（IM39）
text_en: Tiny nodule in the left lower lobe basal segment unchanged from prior, approximately 3 mm (IM39)

source_text: 双肺散在微小结节同前，较大约4mm（IM42）
text_en: Scattered tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged, largest approximately 4 mm (IM42).

source_text: 右肺索条影、右肺胸膜下多发小结节同前，较大约6mm（IM42）
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lung and multiple small subpleural nodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior study (IM42); the largest is approximately 6 mm.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结大致同前，较大约19x10mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior; largest approximately 19 × 10 mm (IM20).

source_text: 右肺多发微小结节基本同前（IM27、44、50），大小约2-3mm
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in the right lung are essentially unchanged from prior (IM27, 44, 50), measuring approximately 2–3 mm.

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结大致同前，仍约8x5mm(IM22)
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes essentially unchanged, still approximately 8x5 mm (IM22)

source_text: 余双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no newly increased nodule foci or patchy opacities.

source_text: 左肺下叶近膈面小结节同前（IM49）
text_en: Small nodule near the diaphragmatic surface of the left lower lobe remains unchanged (IM49).

source_text: 双肺门、纵隔多发淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the bilateral hila and mediastinum are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺散在磨玻璃密度结节同前，较大约6x5mm（IM15）
text_en: Scattered ground-glass nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior. The largest measures approximately 6x5 mm (IM15).

source_text: 右上气管食管沟淋巴结增多增大，现较大约16x11mm（Im7），原约10x6mm（IM5）
text_en: Lymph nodes in the right upper tracheoesophageal groove have increased in number and size; the largest now measures approximately 16x11 mm (Im7), previously approximately 10x6 mm (IM5).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段、右肺中叶见斑片影同前（IMA20、41），右肺下叶见小结节影同前（IMA43），左肺见钙化灶同前
text_en: Patchy opacities in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe and right middle lobe are unchanged (IMA20, 41); small nodules in the right lower lobe are unchanged (IMA43); calcifications in the left lung are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔少许小淋巴结同前，平扫密度略高
text_en: A few small mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged from prior; non-contrast scan shows slightly higher density.

source_text: 新见散在微小结节
text_en: Newly seen scattered micronodules

source_text: 双上肺多发小结节同前
text_en: The multiple small nodules in both upper lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶见高密度钙化灶，余肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: High-density calcified focus is seen in the right lower lobe. No new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺多发钙化点及微小结节同前（Im12、13、18、27、31），余双肺未见结节斑片影
text_en: Multiple calcified foci and micronodules in the right lung are unchanged (Im12, 13, 18, 27, 31); the remainder of both lungs show no nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则软组织密度结节较前相仿，，仍约20x15mm（Im17），密度不均，边缘仍与侧胸膜牵拉
text_en: The irregular soft-tissue density nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is similar to prior, still measuring approximately 20x15 mm (Im17). The density is heterogeneous, and the margin continues to show lateral pleural retraction.

source_text: 纵隔内2R、4R组见淋巴结同前，较大约10x7mm（Im11）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R and 4R are unchanged, measuring approximately 10x7mm (Im11).

source_text: 前纵膈术区局部结节同前，约10x8mm（IM16)，追查
text_en: Focal nodule in the anterior mediastinum at the surgical site is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 10x8 mm (IM16), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶不规则形结节及索条影同前
text_en: Irregular nodule and linear opacities in the right lower lobe are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺索条同前，小斑片影吸收，两肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior; small patchy opacities have resolved; no new nodules or consolidations are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段肿块大致同前，范围约29x27mm（IM32），实性成分略饱满
text_en: A mass in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe is largely unchanged, measuring approximately 29x27 mm (IM32), with a slightly bulging solid component.

source_text: 扫及双侧肾上腺区结节大致同前
text_en: Nodules in the bilateral adrenal regions are roughly unchanged from prior

source_text: 右肺中叶肺癌伴中叶不张，较前略缩小
text_en: Right middle lobe lung cancer with middle lobe atelectasis, slightly smaller than prior.

source_text: 甲状腺双侧叶饱满，不均匀强化结节同前，约27x22mm（IM5）
text_en: Bilateral thyroid lobes appear full, with a heterogeneously enhancing nodule unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 27x22 mm (IM5).

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下4mm浅淡密度小结节同前（IM50）
text_en: 4mm subpleural nodule with faint density in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (IM50)

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结较前缩小，较大原约10x7mm（IM23），现均小于5mm
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes decreased in size compared to previous; the largest previously approximately 10x7mm (IM23), now all less than 5mm.

source_text: 纵隔、肺门多发小淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Mediastinal and hilar multiple small lymph nodes essentially unchanged from previous.

source_text: 纵隔见多发小淋巴结同前，平扫密度较高，多数淋巴结内可见钙化灶
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in mediastinum unchanged from previous, higher density on non-contrast scan, calcifications visible in most lymph nodes.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段新见一模糊类结节影，约7mm（IM28），性质待定，首先倾向炎性，追查除外其它
text_en: Newly observed indistinct nodular opacity in the left lower lobe dorsal segment, approximately 7 mm (IM28), nature undetermined, first consideration is inflammatory, further investigation to exclude other causes.

source_text: 肝占位同前，请结合腹部检查
text_en: Liver mass same as before, please correlate with abdominal examination.

source_text: 双肺多发小结节同前相仿，类风湿结节可能，复查除外其它
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior; rheumatoid nodules are possible; re-evaluate to exclude other causes.

source_text: T10椎体高密度结节同前
text_en: High-density nodule in the T10 vertebral body is unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段肿块较前相仿，较大层面约21x16mm（IM17），内见钙化灶，边界不清
text_en: The mass in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment is similar to prior, with a maximum dimension of approximately 21x16 mm (IM17), containing a calcification, and ill-defined margins

source_text: 扫及左肾上腺结节同前
text_en: A nodule in the left adrenal gland is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 食管胸上段管壁环周增厚较前明显，管腔闭塞，原较厚约11mm（IM19），现较大截面约30x24mm（IM18），外膜模糊，同主动脉弓、气管后壁局部脂肪间隙消失
text_en: Circumferential wall thickening of the upper thoracic esophagus significantly increased compared to prior, with luminal occlusion; previously thickest about 11 mm (IM19), now larger cross-section approximately 30x24 mm (IM18); outer membrane blurred, loss of fat plane with aortic arch and posterior tracheal wall.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段模糊类结节较前吸收，余肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Left lower lobe dorsal segment indistinct nodular-like lesion absorbed compared to prior; no new nodules or consolidation in the remaining lung.

source_text: 主动脉弓旁、膈上及胸主动脉旁小淋巴结多数同前，部分略有变化，原约14x8mm（IM20）者，现约10x7mm（IMA20），追查
text_en: Most small lymph nodes adjacent to the aortic arch, above the diaphragm, and paravertebral to the thoracic aorta are unchanged, with some minor changes; the one previously measuring approximately 14x8 mm (IM20) now measures approximately 10x7 mm (IMA20); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双肺术后改变同前相仿，未见新发结节、斑片灶
text_en: Postoperative changes in the lungs are similar to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 右肺上中叶斑片结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Patchy nodular opacities in the right upper and middle lobes unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔4、5、7组淋巴结较前略增大，现较大约21x6mm（IM28）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4, 5, and 7 slightly increased compared to prior, currently largest measuring approximately 21x6 mm (IM28)

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺见软组织结节同前，约9mm（IM64）
text_en: On imaging, a soft tissue nodule measuring approximately 9 mm is seen in the left adrenal gland, unchanged from prior (IM64).

source_text: 右侧第11后肋骨质破坏较前明显，范围扩大，周围软组织肿块范围增大
text_en: Bony destruction in the right 11th posterior rib is significantly more pronounced than before, with increased extent. The surrounding soft tissue mass has also increased in size.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端壁略增厚较前减轻（IMA27），右肺条片影消失，右肺小斑片索条及小结节影同前
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy. Slight wall thickening at the bronchial stump has improved compared to prior (IMA27). Linear and patchy opacities in the right lung have resolved. Small patchy linear opacities and small nodules in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段实性-磨玻璃密度结节，实性成分范围仍约13x12mm（IM13），整体范围较前略显增大，原约22x18mm（IM14），现约24x19mm（IM13），建议继续密切观察
text_en: Solid–ground-glass density nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe; the solid component remains approximately 13 × 12 mm (IM13), and the overall size has slightly increased from approximately 22 × 18 mm (IM14) to 24 × 19 mm (IM13); close follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，胸部CT平扫未见新发占位
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, non-contrast chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesion.

source_text: 左肺门不规则团片灶较前灶增大（IM26），病灶旁肺内左侧斜裂胸膜前方新见多发类圆形小结节，较大约6mm（Im26-28），肺内转移
text_en: Left hilar irregular mass-like lesion increased in size compared to prior (IM26); multiple new round small nodules in the lung parenchyma anterior to the left oblique fissure pleura adjacent to the lesion, largest approximately 6mm (IM26-28); pulmonary metastases.

source_text: 左侧第5肋转移切除术后，局部见片状低密度灶基本消失（IM32），近局部肌层脂肪间隙稍模糊，增强扫描未见异常强化，邻近胸膜增厚，邻近左肺上叶少量索条减少
text_en: Status post resection of metastasis at the left fifth rib. The previously seen focal area of low density at the site has essentially resolved (IM32). The fat plane adjacent to the local muscular layer remains slightly indistinct. No abnormal enhancement is seen on contrast-enhanced scans. Adjacent pleural thickening persists. Minimal linear bands in the adjacent left upper lobe have decreased compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔2-6组及双侧锁骨上淋巴结较前明显增大，现较大约18x13mm（IM25）
text_en: Mediastinal groups 2-6 and bilateral supraclavicular lymph nodes have increased in size compared to prior, largest now approximately 18x13 mm (IM25)

source_text: 余双肺内未见新发条片结节影
text_en: No new linear, patchy, or nodular opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，右肺索条及小结节影同前，追查
text_en: Following right upper lobectomy, linear opacities and small nodules in the right lung are unchanged; continued surveillance recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见明显异常软组织密度增厚影，右肺下叶索条结节影同前，约6mm（IM43）
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; on non-contrast imaging, no significant abnormal soft tissue thickening is seen at the bronchial stump. Linear and nodular opacities in the right lower lobe are stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM43).

source_text: 右肺胸膜下点状钙化及索条结节灶大致同前（Im11、29、30），右肺下叶少许索条影
text_en: Right lung subpleural punctate calcifications and fibrotic nodular opacities are essentially unchanged from prior (Im11, 29, 30); minimal fibrotic bands in the right lower lobe.

source_text: 双侧肾上腺区结节大小大致同前
text_en: Bilateral adrenal nodules are stable in size compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约12x7mm（IM27）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged, largest measuring approximately 12x7 mm (IM27)

source_text: 食管术后，未见明确复发及转移征象
text_en: Post-esophagectomy, no clear evidence of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 甲状腺右侧叶低密度结节同前相仿，因平扫边界显示不清
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right thyroid lobe similar to prior; boundaries not well visualized on non-contrast imaging.

source_text: 左侧第5肋术后改变同前，第6肋骨质密度不均同前，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Postoperative change in the left 5th rib unchanged; inhomogeneous bone density in the 6th rib unchanged; no osseous destruction seen in the remainder of the visualized bones.

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下结节较前略缩小，原约8x6mm（IM54），现约5mm（IM54）
text_en: Subpleural nodule in the right lower lobe is slightly smaller than prior, previously approximately 8 x 6 mm (IM54), now approximately 5 mm (IM54).

source_text: 双肺多发结节较前增多，部分大小同前，部分略增大，较大原约18x17mm（IM28），现约21x17mm（IM30纵隔窗）
text_en: Multiple nodules in both lungs have increased in number; some are unchanged in size, while others are slightly larger. The largest was previously about 18x17 mm (IM28), now measures approximately 21x17 mm (IM30, mediastinal window).

source_text: 纵隔4R及右肺门淋巴结同前，较大仍约12x11mm（IM12）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal station 4R and right hilar region are unchanged from previous, still approximately 12x11 mm (IM12).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，双肺肺尖少许稍高密度结节影同前，较大约6mm（IM12），左肺上叶纵隔旁条片状软组织密度灶同前，较大截面约13x8mm（IM26），内部可见支气管气相，牵拉纵隔胸膜
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Lung parenchymal lucency is uniform. Slightly increased density nodules at both lung apices are stable, the largest measuring approximately 6 mm (IM12). A linear soft-tissue density adjacent to the mediastinum in the left upper lobe is stable, with a maximum cross-section of approximately 13x8 mm (IM26), containing air bronchograms and causing traction of the mediastinal pleura.

source_text: 左肺下叶结节部分缩小，原约12x11mm（IM40），现约10x8mm（IM38，部分同前，仍约6mm（IMA46），追查
text_en: Some left lower lobe nodules have decreased in size; one was approximately 12x11 mm (IM40), now approximately 10x8 mm (IM38). Some remain unchanged at approximately 6 mm (IMA46). Follow-up.

source_text: 左锁骨上少许淋巴结同前，较大约10x6mm（IM10）
text_en: A few left supraclavicular lymph nodes unchanged, largest approximately 10x6 mm (IM10).

source_text: 左肺上叶模糊结节同前
text_en: Left upper lobe hazy nodule unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右锁骨上淋巴结同前，仍约10x6mm（IM5），密度较高同前
text_en: Right supraclavicular lymph node unchanged, still measuring approximately 10x6 mm (IM5), with higher density as before

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，左肺上叶类圆形磨玻璃结节同前，仍约6mm（IM30），余肺内未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. A round ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe remains unchanged, still measuring approximately 6 mm (IM30). No new nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺散在小结节影较前相仿，较大仍约5mm（IMA50）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right lung are similar to prior, the largest still measuring approximately 5 mm (IMA50).

source_text: 气管左旁小淋巴结较同前，约10x8mm（IM9）
text_en: Left paratracheal small lymph node similar to prior, measuring approximately 10x8 mm (IM9).

source_text: 扫及甲状腺双侧叶低密度结节同前，右侧伴钙化
text_en: Low-density nodules are seen in bilateral thyroid lobes, stable compared to prior, with calcification on the right.

source_text: 右上肺索条及索条结节灶（IMA14）、右肺中叶斜裂旁小片影同前（IM39）
text_en: Linear opacities and linear nodular foci in the right upper lung (IMA14), and a small patchy opacity adjacent to the oblique fissure in the right middle lobe are unchanged (IM39).

source_text: 左下肺结节同前，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: The left lower lobe nodule is unchanged and is considered a chronic finding.

source_text: 右肺下叶多发不规则索条影、左上肺模糊小结节（IM17）、左下肺点状钙化同前
text_en: Multiple irregular linear opacities in the right lower lobe, an ill-defined small nodule in the left upper lung (IM17), and punctate calcification in the left lower lung are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结较前略缩小，现约20*10mm(图30)，原约22*11mm(图30)
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph node slightly decreased in size compared to prior, now approximately 20x10 mm (Figure 30), previously approximately 22x11 mm (Figure 30).

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，约6mm（IM37、38）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM37, 38).

source_text: 左乳下象限可见肿块影，较前略增大，原大小约26*16mm（IMA34），现约26x20mm（IM34）
text_en: A mass is visible in the lower quadrant of the left breast, slightly increased in size compared to prior; previously approximately 26 x 16 mm (IMA34), now approximately 26 x 20 mm (IM34).

source_text: 双肺小结节较前缩小
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are smaller compared to prior

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜微小结节（IM34），大致同前
text_en: Tiny nodule of the right interlobar pleura (IM34) is roughly unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺小结节同前考虑良性灶，左肺上叶陈旧灶
text_en: Small nodules in the right lung are stable and likely benign; old lesion in the left upper lobe.

source_text: 左侧斜裂胸膜小结节同前，追查
text_en: Small nodule along the left major fissure pleura is unchanged; further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺左右叶多发低密度结节并粗大钙化同前
text_en: Multiple low-density thyroid nodules with coarse calcification in bilateral lobes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶结节及右侧锁骨上区、纵隔、右肺门多发肿大淋巴结较前略增大
text_en: Nodule in the right upper lobe and multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region, mediastinum, and right hilum are slightly larger than before

source_text: 胸椎椎体高密度结节同前，胸12椎体楔形变较前相仿，余诸骨未见破坏征象
text_en: High-density nodules in the thoracic vertebral bodies unchanged from previous; T12 vertebral body wedge deformity similar to previous; no evidence of destruction in the remaining bones.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段不规则结节较前相仿，原约8x8mm（IM39），现约8x7mm（IM40），密度较前增高，考虑纤维硬结形成可能大
text_en: Left lung lower lobe posterior basal segment irregular nodule stable compared to prior, previously approximately 8x8 mm (IM39), now approximately 8x7 mm (IM40), with increased density, favoring fibrotic scar formation

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区数枚小淋巴结同前
text_en: Several small lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region are stable.

source_text: 右肺尖高密度小结节及斑片索条影同前（IMA11、20），右下肺见索条影，余肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: High-density small nodule and patchy linear opacities in the right lung apex are unchanged from prior (IMA11, 20). Linear opacities are seen in the right lower lung. The remainder of the lungs show no nodules or consolidation.

source_text: 右肺癌术后，双肺散在多发小结节多数同前
text_en: Status post right lung cancer resection; the majority of scattered multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段术后，局部金属密度及条片状影同前，局部未见软组织肿块
text_en: Postoperative status in the left upper lobe lingular segment with unchanged local metallic density and linear opacities; no soft tissue mass is observed locally

source_text: 余所及诸骨未见骨质破坏
text_en: No osseous destruction is seen in the bones evaluated.

source_text: 纵隔、扫及腹腔多发淋巴结较前增大，请结合临床
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and abdomen have increased in size compared to prior

source_text: 右锁骨上淋巴结同前，仍约11x9mm（IM2）
text_en: Right supraclavicular lymph node unchanged, still measuring approximately 11x9 mm (IM2)

source_text: 右上纵隔内数枚圆形淋巴结同前，大者仍约8x6mm（IM113）
text_en: Several round lymph nodes in the right upper mediastinum are unchanged from prior; the largest remains approximately 8x6 mm (IM113).

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段胸膜下浅淡模糊小结节灶同前，建议复查
text_en: The faint, ill-defined small subpleural nodule in the lateral basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺中叶内侧段模糊结节影较前稍大，原约9x7mm（IM31），现约11x7mm（IM31），密度较前增高，同纵隔胸膜分界不清
text_en: Slightly larger indistinct nodular opacity in the medial segment of the right middle lobe compared to prior, previously approximately 9x7 mm (IM31), now approximately 11x7 mm (IM31), with increased density and ill-defined margin from the mediastinal pleura.

source_text: 右肺散在结节影同前（IMA25、39、40），较大约6x6mm（IM25）
text_en: Scattered nodular opacities in the right lung are similar to prior (IMA25, 39, 40), the largest measuring approximately 6x6 mm (IM25).

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门淋巴结较前缩小，如现约11x8mm者（IM18），原约16*15mm（IMA20）
text_en: Mediastinal and bilateral hilar lymph nodes are reduced in size compared to previous, for example, currently approximately 11x8 mm (IM18), previously approximately 16x15 mm (IMA20).

source_text: 纵隔右移，多组小淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Mediastinal shift to the right, multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺散在小结节同前，较大5mm（IM49）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, largest still about 5 mm (IM49).

source_text: 双肺散在磨玻璃密度结节影较前增大，较大原约7mm（IM17），现约9mm（IM17）
text_en: Scattered ground-glass nodules in both lungs are larger than prior. The largest was previously approximately 7 mm (IM17), now approximately 9 mm (IM17).

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下小结节同前，约5mm（IM42）
text_en: The subpleural small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, approximately 5 mm (IM42)

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，右肺下叶结节较前缩小，原约15x10mm（IM43），现约11x7mm（IM42）
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, a nodule in the right lower lobe is smaller than before, previously approximately 15x10 mm (IM43), now approximately 11x7 mm (IM42).

source_text: 双肺可见多发软组织结节及肿块较前相仿，边界欠清，部分形态不规则，较大者仍约31x26mm（IM31）
text_en: Multiple soft tissue nodules and masses in both lungs are similar to prior, with ill-defined margins, some irregular in shape, largest still approximately 31x26 mm (IM31).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，右肺下叶背段类圆形小结节灶同前，仍约13x11mm（IM25），边界清晰
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, a round small nodule in the dorsal segment of the right lower lobe similar to prior, still approximately 13x11 mm (IM25), well-defined margins.

source_text: 余肺索条结节影大致同前，较大者如右肺中叶约3mm结节(IM34），双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: The linear strands and nodular opacities in the remainder of the lungs are largely unchanged; the largest, such as the approximately 3 mm nodule in the right middle lobe (IM34), remains stable; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 两肺结节部分同前，部分未显示
text_en: Some nodules in both lungs are stable, while others are no longer visible.

source_text: 右下叶肺癌术后，支气管残端未见异常软组织密度影，双侧胸膜下微小结节及索条影同前
text_en: Postoperative status following right lower lobe lung cancer resection; no abnormal soft tissue density at the bronchial stump; bilateral subpleural micro-nodules and linear densities unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，较大约10x7mm（IM17）
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, the largest approximately 10x7mm (IM17).

source_text: 纵隔4组淋巴结较前略缩小，原约13x9mm（IM21），现约12x8mm（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4 lymph nodes are slightly decreased in size compared to previous, from approximately 13x9 mm (IM21) to approximately 12x8 mm (IM19)

source_text: 扫及门静脉周围条状淋巴结同前
text_en: Linear lymph nodes around the portal vein are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺癌术后，支气管断端少许软组织密度影大致同前（IM34），考虑术后改变
text_en: Status post right lung cancer resection; a small soft tissue density at the bronchial stump is essentially unchanged (IM34), consistent with postoperative change.

source_text: 右肺上叶见一类圆形磨玻璃密度结节同前，约11x8mm（IM16），边缘欠清
text_en: A round ground-glass opacity nodule is seen in the right upper lobe, unchanged, measuring approximately 11 x 8 mm (IM16), with indistinct margins.

source_text: 胸1椎体模糊高密度结节同前，追查
text_en: T1 vertebral body demonstrates an ill-defined hyperdense nodule, stable compared to prior; further investigation is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门多发淋巴结较前相仿，如纵隔较大现仍约18*7mm（IM32）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions similar to previous, largest in mediastinum still approximately 18x7 mm (IM32).

source_text: 右下肺索条影同前，余双肺未见新生结节或实变影
text_en: The linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior imaging; no new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下小结节同前，约4mm（Im10、34），左下肺索条影同前
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right lung is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (Im10, 34); left lower lobe linear band-like opacity is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 食管病变周围多发淋巴结较前缩小，原约8mm者（IMA32），现不足3mm
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes surrounding the esophageal lesion have decreased in size compared to prior; a node previously measuring approximately 8 mm (IMA32) now measures less than 3 mm.

source_text: 右上叶前段不规则小结节同前，约7mm（IM31）
text_en: Irregular small nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 7 mm (IM31).

source_text: 左上肺微小结节同前（Im15）
text_en: The tiny nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged (Im15).

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，较大仍约12x10mm（IM20）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest still approximately 12x10 mm (IM20).

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous.

source_text: 双肺散在少许钙化结节同前，左下肺近膈面小结节同前（IM46）
text_en: Scattered few calcified nodules in both lungs are unchanged, small nodule near the diaphragmatic surface of the left lower lobe unchanged (IM46).

source_text: 两肺未见新发结节或斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺叶间胸膜下实性小结节大小同前，仍约8mm（IM27），呈球形边缘清楚光滑
text_en: A small solid nodule beneath the interlobar pleura of the right lung remains stable in size, still measuring approximately 8 mm (IM27), spherical in shape with well-defined, smooth margins.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结略饱满同前，约13x11mm（IM22），余纵隔、肺门、腋窝及锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes slightly prominent but unchanged, approximately 13x11 mm (IM22), no enlarged lymph nodes seen in the remaining mediastinum, hilar, axillary, and supraclavicular regions.

source_text: 右肺中叶肿物较前相仿，仍约23x14mm（IM29），右肺膨胀不全较前相仿、双下肺索条影同前
text_en: The right middle lobe mass is similar to prior, still measuring approximately 23 x 14 mm (IM29). Right lung atelectasis and bilateral lower lung fibrotic bands are similar to prior.

source_text: 左肺两处磨玻璃密度结节影同前（Im15、17），较大约11x8mm（IM17），追查
text_en: Two ground-glass opacity nodules in left lung unchanged from previous (images 15, 17), larger approximately 11x8mm (image 17), follow-up.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜结节影较前缩小
text_en: The nodular lesion along the right interlobar pleura is smaller compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段及左肺下叶前基底段小结节缩小，较大原约6mm（IM18），现约3mm（IM16）
text_en: Small nodules in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe and the anterior basal segment of the left lower lobe have decreased in size, with the largest previously measuring approximately 6 mm (IM18) and now approximately 3 mm (IM16).

source_text: 左肺下叶点状结节影同前（IMA51）
text_en: Left lower lobe punctate nodule shadow same as prior (IMA51)

source_text: 甲状腺左叶低密度结节灶同前，约19mm（IM4），边界清楚
text_en: Left thyroid lobe low-density nodule stable compared to prior, approximately 19 mm (Image 4), well-defined margins.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结较前略饱满，现约15x13mm（IM22），原约14x10mm（IMA23）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are slightly enlarged compared to previous, currently approximately 15x13 mm (IM22), previously approximately 14x10 mm (IMA23).

source_text: 双肺浅淡小结节影同前，较大约4mm（IM45）
text_en: Faint small nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged; the largest is approximately 4 mm (IM45).

source_text: 余肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or areas of consolidation are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结部分增大，原较大者约10x6mm，现较大约12X10mm（IM20）
text_en: Some multiple mediastinal lymph nodes have increased in size; the largest was previously approximately 10x6 mm and is now approximately 12x10 mm (IM20).

source_text: 余扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: No osseous destruction signs are seen in the thoracic bones imaged.

source_text: 两肺索条、结节灶大致同前，较大约6*3mm（IM33）
text_en: The linear opacities and nodular lesions in both lungs are approximately unchanged; the largest is about 6x3 mm (IM33).

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节较前相仿，仍约3mm（IMA19）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior, still approximately 3 mm (IMA19).

source_text: 纵隔8组新见多发肿大淋巴结，与食管壁分界不清，较大者约48x38mm（IM43），考虑转移，结合临床
text_en: Multiple newly observed enlarged lymph nodes in mediastinal station 8, indistinct from the esophageal wall, the largest measuring approximately 48x38 mm (IM43), considered metastatic, correlate with clinical findings.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，约5mm（IM47），追查
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM47), follow-up required.

source_text: 左肺上叶微小结节同前（IM39、42）
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule unchanged (IM39, 42).

source_text: 双肺上叶小结节斑片影并肺尖胸膜轻度增厚同前，左肺上叶串状分布多发结节同前
text_en: Small nodules and patchy opacities in the upper lobes of both lungs with mild pleural thickening at the apex are stable compared to prior; multiple nodules in the left upper lobe in a string-like distribution are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔、肺门淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous.

source_text: 双肺新见小结节灶以右肺尤著，较大约6mm（IM29）
text_en: Newly noted small nodules in both lungs, more prominent in the right lung, the largest measuring approximately 6 mm (IM29).

source_text: 扫及诸骨未见明确骨质破坏征象
text_en: CT shows no definite bone destruction in the bones examined.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃结节灶大致同前，仍约17x13mm（IM25）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe posterior segment is essentially unchanged, still measuring approximately 17 x 13 mm (IM25).

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下3mm小结节影同前（IM41）
text_en: 3mm subpleural nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (IM41)

source_text: 双肺下叶胸膜下不规则小结节较前同前（IM35、43、46），密切追查
text_en: Irregular small subpleural nodules in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior (IM35, 43, 46); close follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段磨玻璃密度结节较前相仿，仍约17x12mm（IM38），追查
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the left lower lobe basal segment similar to prior, still approximately 17x12 mm (IM38), follow-up

source_text: 左肺上叶实性结节同前，现仍约8mm（IM15）
text_en: A solid nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged and still approximately 8 mm (IM15).

source_text: 未见新发
text_en: No new findings

source_text: 右肺胸膜下点状钙化及索条结节灶大致同前（Im11、30、31），右肺下叶少许索条影
text_en: Right lung subpleural punctate calcifications and fibrotic nodular opacities are essentially unchanged from prior (Im11, 30, 31); minimal fibrotic bands in the right lower lobe.

source_text: 双肺微小结节同前，追查
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary micro-nodules are stable compared to prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺术后改变，局部未见复发征象
text_en: Findings of prior right lung surgery; no evidence of local recurrence.

source_text: 纵隔4、7组及双肺门高密度淋巴结部分较前略缩小，较大者原约20x12mm，现约17x9mm（IM26），部分伴钙化
text_en: Mediastinal stations 4 and 7 and bilateral hilar high-density lymph nodes show partial slight reduction in size compared to prior; the largest previously measured approximately 20x12 mm now approximately 17x9 mm (IM26), some with calcification

source_text: 双侧胸膜弥漫结节样增厚伴钙化同前，双侧胸腔未见积液
text_en: Bilateral pleural diffuse nodular thickening with calcification is unchanged. No pleural effusion is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 纵隔多发肿大淋巴结较前相仿，约11x9mm（IM18）
text_en: Multiple enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes similar to prior, approximately 11x9 mm (IM18).

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门见发小淋巴结较前相仿，如隆突下淋巴结短径现仍约7mm（Im23）
text_en: Small mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes are seen similar to previous, such as subcarinal lymph node with short axis still approximately 7mm (Im23).

source_text: 纵隔内多发小淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes within the mediastinum are unchanged from previous.

source_text: L组淋巴结较前略缩小，现约8x5mm（IM33），原约8x6mm（IM31)
text_en: Lymph nodes in station L are slightly smaller than before, now measuring about 8x5 mm (IM33), previously about 8x6 mm (IM31).

source_text: 原双肺散在胸膜下微小结节同前相仿，小于5mm
text_en: Previously noted scattered subpleural micronodules in both lungs are similar to prior, all less than 5 mm.

source_text: 前纵隔结节较前略增大，原约20x8mm，现约21x12mm(Im20)，追查
text_en: Nodule in the anterior mediastinum is slightly larger than prior, previously approximately 20x8 mm, now approximately 21x12 mm (Im20), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下微小结节同前
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺结节较前模糊，仍约7mm（Im14），索条影较前减少
text_en: Left pulmonary nodule blurred compared to prior, still approximately 7 mm (Im14), linear opacities decreased compared to prior.

source_text: 右上肺术后，右肺下叶背段磨玻璃微小结节同前
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lung; ground-glass micro-nodule in the dorsal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节同前，建议随诊复查
text_en: The small nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged; follow-up imaging is recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶实性微结节同前，仍约3mm（IM33）
text_en: Solid micronodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous, still approximately 3mm (IM33).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端软组织密度影、左肺索条影及小结节影、左侧胸膜增厚并少量胸水同前
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, soft tissue density at the bronchial stump, left lung linear opacities and small nodules, left pleural thickening with minimal pleural effusion unchanged from prior.

source_text: 新见一小淋巴结
text_en: Newly seen small lymph node

source_text: 左肾上腺及脾脏小结节同前
text_en: Small nodules in left adrenal gland and spleen unchanged.

source_text: 右叶间胸膜多发结节状增厚，转移不除外
text_en: Multiple nodular thickenings of the right interlobar pleura, metastasis cannot be excluded

source_text: 右肺钙化及上叶（IM19）、中叶小结节灶同前相仿，未见新发灶
text_en: Calcification in the right lung and small nodular opacities in the upper lobe (IM19) and middle lobe are similar to prior; no new lesions are seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃密度小结节大致同前，仍约10x6mm（IM16），呈纯磨玻璃密度，其旁散在微小结节大致同前，约2mm（IM14）
text_en: Small ground-glass density nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is essentially unchanged, still approximately 10 × 6 mm (IM16), appearing as pure ground-glass opacity; scattered tiny nodules nearby are essentially unchanged, approximately 2 mm (IM14).

source_text: 余两肺多发结节较前相仿，均不超过5mm
text_en: Multiple nodules in the remainder of both lungs are similar to prior; all are less than 5 mm.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下见微小结节影同前，边界尚清，直径约4mm（IM16），局部胸膜轻度牵拉
text_en: A tiny subpleural nodule is seen in the right upper lobe, stable compared to prior, with well-defined margins, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM16); mild local pleural retraction is present.

source_text: 右肺模糊小结节同前（IM36）
text_en: Faint small nodule in the right lung is stable compared to prior (IM36).

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，不足10mm，双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, less than 10mm, no enlarged lymph nodes seen in bilateral hilar, supraclavicular, and bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 左上叶残余肺内小结节同前约3mm（IM12）
text_en: The small nodule within the residual lung of the left upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM12).

source_text: 隆突下淋巴结较前相仿，现约10x7mm（IM27）
text_en: Subcarinal lymph node similar to previous, now approximately 10 × 7 mm (IM27)

source_text: 纵隔及双肺门多发稍高密度淋巴结同前，较大约24x12mm（IM21）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes with slightly higher density in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions unchanged from previous, largest approximately 24x12 mm (IM21)

source_text: 肺内少许微小陈旧灶同前，胸部CT平扫未见新生占位
text_en: A few tiny chronic lesions within the lung unchanged from previous; non-contrast chest CT shows no evidence of new space-occupying lesions

source_text: 扫及右侧甲状腺结节、左侧甲状腺钙化灶同前
text_en: CT shows a nodule in the right thyroid and calcification in the left thyroid, unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下、左肺下叶散在小结节同前，较大仍约4mm（IM46）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the subpleural region of the right middle lobe and left lower lobe are stable compared to prior, the largest still approximately 4 mm (IM46).

source_text: 双肺内多发小结节同前相仿，较大约5mm（IM26），追查
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior, largest approximately 5 mm (IM26); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺未见新增结节影
text_en: No new nodules in the left lung.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段不规则软组织密度结节同前，约13x10mm（IM19），边界清晰，边缘可见分叶，邻近局限性胸膜凹陷
text_en: Irregular soft tissue density nodule in the right upper lobe apical segment unchanged, approximately 13x10 mm (IM19), with well-defined margins and visible lobulation; adjacent focal pleural indentation

source_text: 余双肺多发小结节影同前，约3-4mm（IM21、30、47、52）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the remainder of both lungs are unchanged, measuring approximately 3-4 mm (IM21, 30, 47, 52).

source_text: 病灶整体矢状位原较大层面约14*13mm（矢状位 IMA23），现约16*15mm（IMA22）
text_en: The largest cross-sectional area of the lesion in the sagittal plane, previously measuring approximately 14x13 mm (sagittal IMA23), now approximately 16x15 mm (IMA22)

source_text: 纵隔、右侧锁骨上小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right supraclavicular region are similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段、左肺上叶各新见一结节，约6mm、4mm（IM22、32），考虑转移
text_en: A new nodule is seen in the apical segment of the right lower lobe and another in the left upper lobe, measuring approximately 6 mm and 4 mm (IM22, 32), respectively; metastasis is considered.

source_text: 右肺上叶、左肺下叶结节同前
text_en: Nodules in the right upper lobe and left lower lobe are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺叶间胸膜小结节状增厚同前（IM30），余肺未见新发异常密度灶
text_en: Nodular thickening of the interlobar pleura in the right lung is stable compared to prior (IM30); no new abnormal density foci are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区淋巴结同前，仍约7mm（IMA5）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node is unchanged, still approximately 7 mm (IMA5)

source_text: 余双肺散在少许索条影，未见新增结节灶及斑片影
text_en: Residual few scattered linear opacities in both lungs; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影同前，余双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged; the remainder of both lungs shows no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 两肺内多发索条影同前，原左肺下叶多发小结节灶，现未见显示
text_en: Multiple linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged from prior; the previously noted multiple small nodules in the left lower lobe are no longer visible.

source_text: 右肺多发小结节影较前减小减少
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right lung are smaller compared to prior studies.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上、纵隔内小淋巴结大致同前，未见确切肿大淋巴结
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region and mediastinum are essentially unchanged compared to prior imaging; no definitively enlarged lymph nodes are seen.

source_text: 胸骨前软组织小结节同前（IM14）
text_en: Small soft tissue nodule anterior to sternum, unchanged from previous (IM14)

source_text: 左侧肾上腺结节样增粗同前，追查
text_en: Left adrenal nodular thickening unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 未见明显新增
text_en: No obvious new lesions

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右肺上叶磨模糊结节同前相仿，约5mm（Im14-16），余双肺透亮度不均匀伴散在条片及网状影大致同前，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
