text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent; hazy nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (Im14-16); the remainder of both lungs shows uneven lucency with scattered linear, patchy, and reticular opacities, which are roughly unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 两肺内小结节灶大致同前
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs are roughly unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺胸膜下多发小结节同前，追查
text_en: Multiple small subpleural nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 两肺胸膜下小结节同前，较大仍约2mm（IM24、30），随诊观察
text_en: Small subpleural nodules in both lungs are stable; the largest remains approximately 2 mm (IM24, 30), under follow-up observation.

source_text: 扫及肝脏内多个边缘结节状强化灶同前
text_en: On scan, multiple peripheral nodular enhancing lesions within the liver are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺门原14x11mm结节较前缩小，现不明显
text_en: Left hilar nodule, previously 14x11mm, decreased in size compared to prior; currently not prominent.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结同前相仿
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph node unchanged from prior

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R、7组多发淋巴结较前略缩小，较大者原约10x8mm（IM6），现约6x6mm（IM6），左锁骨上可见小淋巴结，约4x3mm（IM3）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R, 4R, and 7 are slightly decreased in size compared to prior; the largest previously measured approximately 10x8 mm (Image 6) and now measures approximately 6x6 mm (Image 6). A small lymph node is seen in the left supraclavicular region, measuring approximately 4x3 mm (Image 3).

source_text: 左上纵膈胸膜及胸膜多发结节较前增大，考虑转移
text_en: Multiple nodules in the left upper mediastinal pleura and pleura are larger than before; metastasis is considered.

source_text: 左肺下叶外基底段不规则团片状占位较前缩小，现约29x10mm（IM52），原为35x20mm，仍以实变为主，边缘较前清晰，内部仍可见空气支气管征，空洞消失，强化较均匀，周围索条影减少
text_en: Left lower lobe, lateral basal segment: irregular patchy mass reduced in size compared to previous; now approximately 29x10 mm (Image 52), previously 35x20 mm. Still predominantly consolidation, margins clearer than before, air bronchogram still visible internally, cavity disappeared, enhancement more uniform, peripheral linear shadows reduced.

source_text: 两肺微小结节影及肺大泡同前
text_en: The tiny nodules and bullae in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段结节同前相仿，仍约9x7mm（IM28），上叶纵隔旁另一小结节灶同前，约7x6mm（IM16）
text_en: Nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, similar to prior, still approximately 9x7 mm (IM28); another small nodular focus adjacent to the mediastinum in the upper lobe, stable, approximately 7x6 mm (IM16)

source_text: 右肺散在多发结节灶同前，考虑大部分为良性，随诊观察
text_en: Scattered multifocal nodules in the right lung are unchanged; most are considered benign, with follow-up observation recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段胸膜下结节同前，约6mm（IM40）
text_en: The subpleural nodule in the lateral basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM40).

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段磨玻璃结节灶同前，约9x6mm（IM45）
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 9 x 6 mm (IM45).

source_text: 余扫描范围内未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: No osseous destruction signs are seen within the scanned range.

source_text: 扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: No bone destruction foci seen in the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺汇合部结节样增粗同前
text_en: Nodular thickening is noted in the left adrenal gland confluence area, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右上肺术后，双肺结节较前增大，考虑转移
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lung; nodules in both lungs are larger than prior; metastasis is considered.

source_text: 纵隔4R、6及7组多发淋巴结部分较前缩小，如较大原约12x6mm，现约8x5mm（IM20）
text_en: Some multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R, 6, and 7 are smaller than previous, with the largest previously measuring approximately 12x6 mm and now approximately 8x5 mm (IM20)

source_text: 右肺中叶叶间胸膜下磨玻璃样结节同前，仍约8x7mm(图26)
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the interlobar subpleural region of the right middle lobe is unchanged, still measuring approximately 8x7 mm (Figure 26).

source_text: 右肺上叶支气管旁数枚软组织结节较前缩小，原较大约11x11mm（IM23），现约8mm（IM23），邻近右肺上叶诸支气管未见狭窄及管壁增厚
text_en: Several soft tissue nodules adjacent to the right upper lobe bronchus have decreased in size, previously measuring up to 11 x 11 mm (IM23), now approximately 8 mm (IM23). The adjacent bronchi of the right upper lobe show no stenosis or wall thickening.

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段心缘旁类结节影同前，仍约11x8mm（IM38），与相邻胸膜粘连
text_en: A nodule-like opacity adjacent to the cardiac border in the left upper lobe lingular segment is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 11 x 8 mm (IM38), with adhesion to the adjacent pleura.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R组淋巴结较前增大，较大者约19x7mm（IM12），原约12x3mm（IM11）
text_en: Lymph nodes at mediastinal stations 2R and 4R are larger compared to prior; largest approximately 19x7 mm (IM12), previously approximately 12x3 mm (IM11).

source_text: 右肺中叶结节同前，右肺下叶片状影同前，追查
text_en: Nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged; patchy opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段胸膜下小结节同前相仿，约3mm（IM13）
text_en: The subpleural nodule in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment is similar to prior, approximately 3 mm (IM13)

source_text: 左肺上叶前段团块影增大，原约22x21mm（IM16），现约28x21mm（IM18）
text_en: The mass in the left upper lobe anterior segment has increased in size, from approximately 22x21 mm (IM16) to approximately 28x21 mm (IM18).

source_text: 右肺中叶结节同前，考虑陈旧病灶
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged; old lesion is considered.

source_text: 双肺见多发小结节同前，复查
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 两肺门淋巴结同前，现较大仍约11*10mm（IM28）
text_en: Hilar lymph nodes in both lungs are stable; the largest currently measures 11x10 mm (IM28).

source_text: 右肺上叶、左肺上叶尖后段胸膜下模糊小结节灶同前，较大约4mm（IM20）
text_en: Subpleural indistinct small nodular opacities in the right upper lobe and apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe are unchanged, largest approximately 4 mm (IM20).

source_text: 扫及肝左叶低密度结节大致同前
text_en: On scan, a low-density nodule in the left hepatic lobe is largely unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左上肺切除术后改变同前，胸部CT未见新增占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes following left upper lobectomy are unchanged; chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后缺如，支气管残端未见明确异常软组织密度影，右肺多发索条影大致同前，双肺纹理走行顺畅，余双肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Right upper lobe is absent post-surgery; no definite abnormal soft tissue density is seen at the bronchial stump. Multiple linear opacities in the right lung are essentially unchanged. Pulmonary markings in both lungs are smooth and unremarkable. No new nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 两肺多发小结节大致同前，较大者仍约5mm（IM38）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are roughly unchanged; the largest remains about 5 mm (IM38).

source_text: 右肺癌术后，支气管断端软组织稍厚同前相仿
text_en: Status post right lung cancer resection; soft tissue thickening at the bronchial stump is similar to prior.

source_text: 双肺小结节灶同前，较大约8*6mm（IM50）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodule foci are stable compared to prior, largest approximately 8x6 mm (IM50)

source_text: 双侧胸膜少许小结节同前，较大仍约4mm（IM13），部分伴钙化，双侧未见胸水征象
text_en: Bilateral pleural few small nodules are unchanged, the largest still measuring approximately 4 mm (IM13), some with calcification. No pleural effusion is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 余肺少许斑片索条影及模糊斑点影同前，未见新发斑片影及结节灶
text_en: Minimal patchy linear opacities and indistinct punctate opacities in the remaining lung are stable. No new patchy opacities or nodules are seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段及左肺上叶前段微结节较前相仿，仍约5mm（IM11）
text_en: Micronodules in the right upper lobe apical segment and left upper lobe anterior segment similar to prior, still approximately 5 mm (IM11)

source_text: 右肺斑片索条影同前，双肺未见新增结节灶及斑片影
text_en: Patchy and linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged from prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 双肺多发结节灶同前，追查
text_en: Multiple nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 左肺多发模糊微小点灶及钙化大致同前（Im26等），右肺索条影，双肺未见新生结节
text_en: Multiple hazy small dot foci and calcifications in the left lung are similar to prior (Im26, etc.), linear opacity in the right lung, and no new nodules in both lungs

source_text: 纵隔及双肺门散在多发钙化淋巴结同前
text_en: Scattered multiple calcified lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions unchanged from previous

source_text: 左腋下肿大淋巴结较前缩小，原较大约16x12mm（IM8），现约10*8mm(图13)，密度减低
text_en: Left axillary enlarged lymph node decreased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 16x12 mm (image 8), currently approximately 10x8 mm (image 13), with decreased density.

source_text: 右肺尖小磨玻璃样灶同前相仿（IM7），余肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity in the right lung apex is similar to prior (IM7); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶叶间胸膜结节同前
text_en: Nodule in the interlobar pleura of the left lower lobe unchanged from previous

source_text: 左下肺索条影同前，考虑陈旧灶，余肺未见新发结节灶及斑片影
text_en: The linear opacity in the left lower lobe is unchanged, considered chronic; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 双侧胸膜散在结节样增厚，右肺下叶胸膜结节较前增大，现约5mm（IM44）,原约3mm
text_en: Bilateral pleural scattered nodular thickening is present. The right lower lobe pleural nodule has increased compared to prior, now measuring approximately 5 mm (IM44), previously about 3 mm.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段见不规则小结节同前（IM28），边缘可见索条影
text_en: An irregular small nodule is seen in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, unchanged (IM28); linear opacities are visible at the margin.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃样结节同前，追查
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior; comparison with previous studies is recommended.

source_text: 双肺及叶间裂小结节同前，追查
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs and interlobar fissures are stable, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔略向左侧移位同前，4、7组淋巴结区不规则软组织密度范围缩小，考虑术后改变
text_en: Mediastinum slightly shifted to the left as before, irregular soft tissue density in group 4 and 7 lymph node regions reduced in size, considered postoperative change.

source_text: 两肺多发小结节大致同前，较大者仍约5mm（IM39）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are roughly unchanged; the largest remains about 5 mm (IM39).

source_text: 胸1椎体模糊高密度结节同前
text_en: T1 vertebral body demonstrates an ill-defined hyperdense nodule, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结范围较前缩小，原约28x13mm，现约22x11mm（IM32）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes extent reduced compared to prior, previously approximately 28x13 mm, now approximately 22x11 mm (IM32)

source_text: 两肺索条影及左肺下叶小结节影同前，仍约6mm（IM53）
text_en: The linear opacities and the small nodule in the left lower lobe are unchanged, still about 6 mm (IM53).

source_text: 右肺下叶见散在微结节，右肺少许索条影同前，余肺野未见新发结节及片絮影
text_en: Scattered micro-nodules are seen in the right lower lobe; minimal linear opacities in the right lung are stable; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lung fields.

source_text: 右肺中叶术后，右肺门结构紊乱同前，平扫局部未见明显软组织肿块影
text_en: Postoperative status of the right middle lobe; disorganized hilar structures are unchanged; no obvious soft tissue mass seen on non-contrast scan at the local site.

source_text: 左肺下叶类结节影同前相仿，约5mm（IM26、41）
text_en: The nodular opacity in the left lower lobe is similar to prior, approximately 5 mm (IM26, 41).

source_text: 左上肺点状钙化结节同前
text_en: Punctate calcified nodule in the left upper lobe unchanged

source_text: 双肺下叶及右肺斜裂胸膜下结节同前（Im42、44、45），余肺未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: Nodules subpleural in the lower lobes bilaterally and along the right oblique fissure are stable compared to prior (Im42, 44, 45); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结同前，较大约18x16mm（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal 4R lymph node unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 18x16 mm (IM19)

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下结节同前
text_en: Subpleural nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺散在多发点状微结节大致同前，追查
text_en: Left lung scattered, multiple punctate micronodules approximately unchanged from previous, requiring follow-up investigation.

source_text: 余肺未见新增结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: No new nodules or fluffy opacities are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 右上胸膜增厚同前，右肺点状结节影同前（IM27、33）
text_en: Right upper pleural thickening unchanged; right lung punctate nodular opacities unchanged (IM27, 33).

source_text: 两肺微小结节灶同前，较大约3mm（IM32）
text_en: The tiny nodular foci in both lungs are unchanged; the largest is approximately 3 mm (IM32).

source_text: 双锁骨上区散在淋巴结同前，现仍约9x4mm（IM5），纵隔、双肺门、双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Scattered lymph nodes in bilateral supraclavicular regions are unchanged from prior; one measures approximately 9x4 mm (IM5); no enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum, bilateral hila, or bilateral axillae.

source_text: 原双肺微小结节同前，左肺下叶新见小结节，约5mm（IM35）
text_en: Previously noted multiple micronodules in both lungs are unchanged. A new small nodule, approximately 5 mm, is seen in the right lower lobe (IM35).

source_text: 右肺下叶切除术后，支气管断端未见异常软组织密度影，肺内局限性索条影及右下肺近膈面胸膜类结节影同前（IM43）
text_en: Post right lower lobectomy, no abnormal soft tissue density is seen at the bronchial stump; focal linear densities in the lung and a nodular-appearing lesion near the diaphragmatic pleura in the right lower lobe are unchanged (IM43).

source_text: 右肺中叶软组织密度结节影同前，约21x13mm（IM30）
text_en: Soft tissue density nodule in the right middle lobe, unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 21x13 mm (IM30)

source_text: 纵隔2R组淋巴结同前，仍约7mm（IMA12），余未见新发肿大淋巴结
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal station 2R unchanged from previous, still approximately 7 mm (IMA12), no new enlarged lymph nodes elsewhere.

source_text: 左肺散在模糊小结节大致同前(图31、42)
text_en: Scattered indistinct small nodules in the left lung largely unchanged (Fig. 31, 42)

source_text: 纵隔内2R组淋巴结较前相仿，现约9x8mm（IM11）
text_en: Mediastinal station 2R lymph nodes are similar to previous, currently measuring approximately 9x8mm (IM11).

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见异常密度灶，右侧叶间胸膜结节状增厚范围较前缩小，边缘模糊，原约14x10mm，现约10x8mm（IM24），考虑术后改变
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no abnormal density at the bronchial stump. Nodular thickening of the right interlobar pleura has decreased in extent compared to prior, with ill-defined margins. Previously measured approximately 14x10 mm, now approximately 10x8 mm (IM24), considered postoperative change.

source_text: 左肺小结节大致同前
text_en: Left lung small nodule roughly unchanged

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下结节较前略增大，定期复查
text_en: The subpleural nodule in the right upper lobe is slightly larger than before; regular follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 扫及右侧前下腹壁肌层肿块影较前增大，原较大层面约62x46mm（IM57），现较大层面约70*48mm（IMA56）
text_en: CT shows a mass in the right anterior inferior abdominal wall muscle layer, increased in size compared to prior. Previously on the largest slice it measured approximately 62x46 mm (IM57), now approximately 70x48 mm (IMA56).

source_text: 两肺下叶斑片索条与前相仿，两肺肺气肿同前，未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Linear and patchy opacities in both lower lobes are similar to prior. Pulmonary emphysema in both lungs is unchanged. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 双肺下叶多发小结节大致同前（Im38、41、45、49），较大者仍约7*4mm（IMA45）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the lower lobes of both lungs are essentially unchanged compared to prior (Im38, 41, 45, 49); the largest remains approximately 7 x 4 mm (IMA45).

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段模玻璃密度类结节影（IM13）及前段胸膜下微小结节（IM15）同前，两肺未见新生结节影
text_en: Ground-glass density nodular-like shadow in the apical segment of the right upper lobe (IM13) and a subpleural tiny nodule in the anterior segment (IM15) are unchanged; no new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 两下肺索条影及小结节影大致同前，较大者约6x4mm（IM39）
text_en: Linear opacities and small nodules in both lower lungs are essentially unchanged from prior. The largest measures approximately 6x4 mm (IM39).

source_text: 纵隔5、6组淋巴结同前相仿，现较大约18x6mm（IM17）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 5 and 6 are similar to prior, currently larger at approximately 18x6 mm (IM17).

source_text: 食管术后改变，胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Post-esophagectomy changes. No new space-occupying lesions in the chest.

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下小结节同前，约4mm（IM45），右肺下叶条片影消失
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM45); the linear patchy opacity in the right lower lobe has resolved.

source_text: 两肺散在模糊结节影部分缩小，现较大约6*5mm（IMA31），原较大约9*6mm（IMA32）
text_en: Scattered indistinct nodules in both lungs, some decreased in size; currently the largest is approximately 6x5 mm (IMA31), previously the largest was approximately 9x6 mm (IMA32).

source_text: 右肺索条影同前，余肺未见新发结节影
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lung is stable; no new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右下胸膜轻度增厚并肺内索条影同前，右肺中叶结节灶同前（IM23）
text_en: Mild pleural thickening in the right lower region with intrapulmonary linear opacities unchanged. Nodular opacity in the right middle lobe unchanged (IM23).

source_text: 余两肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段肿块较前相仿，较大层面约21x16mm（IM19），内见钙化灶，边界不清
text_en: The mass in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment is similar to prior, with a maximum dimension of approximately 21x16 mm (IM19), containing a calcification, and ill-defined margins

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则结节实性成分最大层面同前，仍约14x10mm(IM21)，周围磨玻璃成分范围稍显增大（IM20）
text_en: The solid component of the irregular nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe remains unchanged on its largest cross-section, still measuring approximately 14x10 mm (IM21). The surrounding ground-glass component appears slightly increased in extent (IM20).

source_text: 右下肺软组织肿块较前增大
text_en: Soft tissue mass in the right lower lobe has increased in size compared to prior examination.

source_text: 左肺下叶索条结节影大致同前，结节仍约3x1mm（IM40）
text_en: Left lower lobe streaky nodule opacity largely unchanged; the nodule remains approximately 3x1 mm (IM40).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，平扫支气管断端软组织未见明确增大
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; soft tissue at the bronchial stump shows no definite enlargement.

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节原约5mm者，现约4mm（Im23）
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule previously approximately 5 mm, now approximately 4 mm (Im23)

source_text: 两肺小结节影同前（IM13、15、25）
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior (IM13, 15, 25)

source_text: 左肺门新发结节，约14x11mm（IM29），与周围血管分界不清，远端沿下肺动脉分支走行，局部血管未见充盈
text_en: New left hilar nodule, approximately 14x11 mm (Image 29), ill-defined margins with surrounding vessels, extending distally along branches of the inferior pulmonary artery, with no vascular enhancement in the local area.

source_text: 左肺上叶切除术后，纵隔及肺门淋巴结大致同前
text_en: After left upper lobe resection, mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes essentially unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺模糊小结节影同前（IMA36）
text_en: Faint small nodular opacity in the right lung is stable compared to prior (IMA36).

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节影同前（IM13）
text_en: The small nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged (IM13).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，右肺中叶胸膜下索条结节同前，约3mm（IM41），界清
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, a subpleural linear nodule in the right middle lobe similar to prior, approximately 3 mm (IM41), well-defined.

source_text: 右肺上叶不规则实性病灶较前缩小，原约25x14mm（IM19），现约20x9mm（IM22）
text_en: Irregular solid lesion in the right upper lobe is smaller compared to prior, previously approximately 25x14 mm (IM19), now approximately 20x9 mm (IM22).

source_text: 右肺微小结节影同前（Im12、20、30），右肺钙化索条影同前
text_en: Right lung micro-nodular opacities unchanged compared to prior (Im12, 20, 30); right lung calcified linear opacities unchanged

source_text: 扫及胸腰椎多发骨质破坏灶同前
text_en: CT scan shows multiple bone destruction lesions in the thoracolumbar spine, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺尖钙化结节及索条影同前
text_en: Calcified nodule and linear opacity at the left lung apex unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左上肺小结节同前，约5mm（IM28）
text_en: Small nodule in the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM28).

source_text: 纵隔2、4、5、7及右肺门多发肿大淋巴结大致同前，较大现约20x14mm（IM21）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2, 4, 5, 7 and right hilar region essentially unchanged from previous, largest currently approximately 20x14 mm (IM21).

source_text: 右肺小结节同前（IM10、31、37、48），右肺下叶索条影同前
text_en: Small nodules in the right lung are stable (IM10, 31, 37, 48); linear opacity in the right lower lobe is stable.

source_text: 右锁骨上淋巴结同前
text_en: Right supraclavicular lymph node unchanged

source_text: 双肺结节较前相仿
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary nodules are similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶占位较前增大
text_en: Right middle lobe mass has increased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结较前缩小，原约15x9mm（IM32），现约11x6mm（Im34）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is smaller compared to prior, previously approximately 15x9 mm (IM32), now approximately 11x6 mm (IM34)

source_text: 右肺下叶后基底段胸膜下软组织结节较前缩小，原约19x14mm（IM44），现约14x11mm（IM45），边缘分叶毛刺，牵拉胸膜，轻-中度强化
text_en: Subpleural soft tissue nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is smaller than prior, previously measuring approximately 19 x 14 mm (IM44), now approximately 14 x 11 mm (IM45). The lesion shows lobulated and spiculated margins with pleural retraction and mild to moderate enhancement.

source_text: 右肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: No new nodules are seen in the right lung.

source_text: 左肺小结节影同前（IM48）
text_en: Left lung small nodule unchanged (IM48)

source_text: 右肺上叶斑片及小结节影较前略增多
text_en: Patchy opacities and small nodules in the right upper lobe are slightly increased compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺不规则小结节同前，约3mm（Im32、45）
text_en: Irregular small nodules in both lungs are unchanged compared to prior, approximately 3 mm (Im32, 45).

source_text: 纵隔及双腋下淋巴结同前相仿，5区淋巴结较大原约16x9mm（IM19），现约15x10mm（IM22），追查
text_en: Lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral axillary regions are similar to previous. The station 5 lymph node, previously approximately 16x9 mm (IM19), is now approximately 15x10 mm (IM22), requiring follow-up.

source_text: 左侧斜裂小结节同前（IM30）
text_en: Small nodule in the left oblique fissure is unchanged (IM30).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段新见索条结节灶，约4*2mm（IMA25）
text_en: Newly seen linear-nodular opacity in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, approximately 4x2 mm (IMA25)

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段结节较前相仿，约3mm（IM40），追查
text_en: The nodule in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM40); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, no definite evidence of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，较大仍约17x11mm(IM31)
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest still approximately 17x11 mm (IM31).

source_text: 纵隔4、5组小淋巴结同前，余纵隔及双侧肺门、腋窝、锁骨上平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Small lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 4 and 5 are stable compared to prior. No enlarged lymph nodes are seen on non-contrast imaging in the remaining mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, axillae, or supraclavicular areas.

source_text: 右肺肿物均较前缩小
text_en: The right lung masses are smaller compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶及左肺下叶散在小结节同前，较大仍约6mm（IM14）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right upper lobe and left lower lobe are stable compared to prior; the largest remains approximately 6 mm (IM14).

source_text: 扫及肝内模糊小结节较前增大（IM45），请结合腹部相关检查
text_en: CT shows an ill-defined small nodule within the liver that has increased in size compared to previous (IM45); please correlate with relevant abdominal imaging.

source_text: 左肺上叶钙化灶同前，左肺多发胸膜下微小结节同前，仍约3mm（IM9、18、42、53），部分钙化，倾向良性
text_en: Calcified focus in the left upper lobe stable; multiple subpleural micronodules in the left lung stable, still approximately 3 mm (IM9, 18, 42, 53), some calcified, benign-appearing.

source_text: 纵隔、左侧锁骨上淋巴结同前，较大约14x8mm（IM23）
text_en: Mediastinal and left supraclavicular lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest approximately 14x8 mm (IM23)

source_text: 右肺下叶背段分叶状肿块较前相仿，约34x31mm（IM26），内部密度不均，见含气支气管及小泡征
text_en: Lobulated mass in the right lower lobe posterior segment is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 34x31 mm (IM26), with heterogeneous internal density; air bronchograms and small bubble-like lucencies are present.

source_text: 左肺清晰，未见新增结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: Left lung clear, no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 双肺少许陈旧灶同前，双肺未见新发结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: Few chronic foci in both lungs are stable; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 双肺纹理增重，左肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Increased bronchovascular markings in both lungs, no new nodules seen in the left lung.

source_text: 双肺散在少许小结节同前，如左肺下叶结节仍约5mm（Im37），未见新增结节灶
text_en: Scattered few small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, such as the nodule in the left lower lobe still about 5 mm (Im37), no new nodules seen.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜结节影同前
text_en: The nodular opacity along the right interlobar pleura is unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，如5组者仍约17*15mm(图24)，前纵隔者大小仍约20x14mm（IMA27）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, with the 5 station measuring approximately 17x15 mm (Figure 24), and the anterior mediastinal node measuring approximately 20x14 mm (IMA27).

source_text: 左腋下小淋巴结同前，现仍约9mm（IM24）
text_en: Left axillary small lymph node unchanged, still approximately 9 mm (image 24).

source_text: 左肺结节大致同前
text_en: Left pulmonary nodule approximately unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶可见磨玻璃密度小结节同前，约5mm（IM15），左肺上叶尖段见实性微结节同前（IM15）
text_en: Left upper lobe shows a small ground-glass opacity nodule, same as before, approximately 5 mm (IM15). Left upper lobe apical segment shows a solid micronodule, same as before (IM15).

source_text: 右肺中叶浅淡小结节同前，约4mm（IM31）
text_en: Faint small nodule in the right middle lobe unchanged, approximately 4 mm (IM31)

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结区未见明确占位征象，金属影同前，考虑术后改变
text_en: No definite space-occupying lesion seen in mediastinal station 7 lymph node region, metallic shadow unchanged, considered postoperative change.

source_text: 食管癌术后，弓上吻合，胸腔胃，吻合口左侧壁软组织结节，约31x24mm（IMA15），考虑复发或转移
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer with cervical anastomosis and intrathoracic stomach, soft tissue nodule on the left anastomotic wall measuring approximately 31x24 mm (IMA15), suspicious for recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 胸骨后小结节同前，约10x6mm（IM43）
text_en: Small nodule posterior to sternum, unchanged from previous, approximately 10x6 mm (IM43)

source_text: 两肺点状小结节大致同前，约4mm（IM13、16、23）
text_en: The punctate small nodules in both lungs are approximately unchanged, about 4 mm (IM13, 16, 23).

source_text: 纵隔4R、4L、5组多发淋巴结同前相仿，较大约10x8mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R, 4L, and 5 are similar to previous, with the largest measuring approximately 10x8 mm (IM20)

source_text: 扫及左乳内侧象限小结节同前（IM26）
text_en: A small nodule in the inner quadrant of the left breast is unchanged from prior (Im26).

source_text: 左上叶尖后段陈旧结核灶同前（Im23），余肺未见新发结节及片絮影
text_en: The old tuberculosis focus in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior (Im23); the remainder of the lungs shows no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃样病灶同前（IM11）右肺散在微小结节同前相仿，＜5mm（IM32）
text_en: Left upper lobe ground-glass opacity unchanged from prior (IM11), scattered tiny nodules in the right lung similar to prior, <5 mm (IM32)

source_text: 左肺上叶术后改变，胸部CT平扫较前未见新发占位
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left upper lobe; non-contrast chest CT unchanged from prior, no new mass lesions.

source_text: 右肺索条及小斑片影同前（IMA35），两肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Linear opacities and small patchy opacities in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior (IMA35); no new nodules or consolidations are seen in either lung.

source_text: 两肺模糊小结节灶同前相仿（IM5等）
text_en: The hazy small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior (IM5, etc.).

source_text: 新见两处混合磨玻璃密度结节
text_en: Newly identified two mixed ground-glass nodules

source_text: 左肺下叶结节及纵隔内淋巴结同前，随诊
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe and mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged from previous, with follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜小结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: Small nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior, favoring benign etiology.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段小结节略增大，原4mm，现5mm（IM8）
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment small nodule slightly increased, originally 4 mm, now 5 mm (IM8).

source_text: 胸2椎体骨转移略增大
text_en: Slight increase in size of bone metastasis in T2 vertebral body.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前相仿，较大约23x15mm（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior, largest approximately 23x15 mm (IM19)

source_text: 纵隔内淋巴结较前相仿，现仍约10x8mm（IM8）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes similar to previous, still approximately 10x8 mm (IM8).

source_text: 左肺上叶钙化灶同前，左肺多发胸膜下微小结节同前，仍约3mm（IM11、20、44、55），倾向良性
text_en: Calcified focus in the left upper lobe stable; multiple subpleural micronodules in the left lung stable, still approximately 3 mm (IM11, 20, 44, 55), benign-appearing.

source_text: 纵隔及双肺门淋巴结同前相仿，较大约14mm（IM34）
text_en: Lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions similar to previous, largest approximately 14 mm (IM34)

source_text: 两肺上叶磨玻璃密度影及结节影同前（IM10、20），较大范围约26*22mm（IM20）
text_en: Ground-glass opacities and nodules in both upper lobes are unchanged from prior (IM10, 20). The larger area measures approximately 26x22 mm (IM20).

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结较前增大，如原约10x8mm，现约15x13mm（IM31），密切追查
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is larger compared to prior; previously approximately 10x8 mm, now approximately 15x13 mm (IM31); close follow-up is recommended

source_text: 未见明显转移
text_en: No obvious metastasis

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节、双肺实性小结节同前，复查
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe and solid small nodules in both lungs are unchanged; repeat examination is recommended.

source_text: 双肺上叶见不规则实性-磨玻璃结节灶较前增大，原约17x14mm（IM17 ）、18x12mm（IM21），现约24x17mm（IM18）、20x12mm（IM22），实性成分较前增多，边缘模糊，局部伴胸膜凹陷
text_en: Irregular solid-ground glass nodules in the upper lobes of both lungs are larger than before, previously measuring approximately 17x14 mm (IM17) and 18x12 mm (IM21), now measuring approximately 24x17 mm (IM18) and 20x12 mm (IM22). The solid components have increased compared to prior, margins are blurred, and local pleural indentation is present.

source_text: 纵隔、左肺门多发大小不等淋巴结较前缩小，追查
text_en: Mediastinal and left hilar multiple lymph nodes of varying sizes are reduced compared to prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 扫及胸部诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: CT scan shows no signs of bone destruction in the bones of the chest.

source_text: 新见散在多发浅淡密度小结节
text_en: Newly identified scattered multiple low-density small nodules

source_text: 食管胸中段壁环周增厚较前减轻，管腔不清，横断面整体径线现约18x14mm（IM23），原约28x20mm，外膜面模糊，与胸主动脉间隙模糊，接触面小于90°
text_en: Circumferential wall thickening of the mid-thoracic esophagus is reduced compared to prior, with poorly defined lumen. Current cross-sectional diameter is approximately 18x14 mm (IM23), previously approximately 28x20 mm. Outer membrane is blurred, and the interface with the thoracic aorta is blurred, with contact surface less than 90 degrees.

source_text: 食管胸下段癌疗后，大致同前
text_en: Post-treatment for esophageal cancer in the lower thoracic segment, essentially unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔2、4、7组及右肺门淋巴结同前，较大仍约16x14mm（IM22）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2, 4, and 7 and the right hilar region are unchanged from previous; the largest remains approximately 16x14 mm (IM22).

source_text: 两肺未见新增结节及片絮影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 原有两肺小结节影同前，较大约12x8mm（IM48）
text_en: The previously noted small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, the largest measuring approximately 12x8 mm (IM48).

source_text: 纵隔及双侧锁骨上小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral supraclavicular regions same as before

source_text: 左上肺见模糊小结节影同前，仍约5mm（Im20）
text_en: Indistinct small nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged from prior, still approximately 5 mm (Im20).

source_text: 左肺下叶微小结节灶同前，追查
text_en: Left lower lobe small nodule unchanged, follow-up.

source_text: 增多
text_en: Increased in number.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段斜裂胸膜下部分实性结节同前，边界尚清，较大层面大小原约21x17mm（IM26），现约22x15mm（IM25），右侧斜裂牵拉上抬
text_en: The subpleural part-solid nodule along the oblique fissure in the right upper lobe posterior segment is unchanged. The margins are relatively well-defined. The size on the largest slice was previously about 21x17 mm (IM26), now approximately 22x15 mm (IM25). The right oblique fissure is retracted and elevated.

source_text: 双锁骨上小淋巴结同前，较大仍约10x5mm（IM6）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in bilateral supraclavicular regions are unchanged from prior; the largest remains approximately 10x5 mm (IM6).

source_text: 左侧腋窝及纵隔见多发小淋巴结同前，食管右旁较大者仍约11x7mm（Im40），追查
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the left axilla and mediastinum are stable compared to prior; the largest at the right paratracheal region remains approximately 11x7 mm (Im40); further follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结较前增大，原较大约13x4mm（IM27），现约15x7mm（IM26）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes increased in size compared to previous, previously largest approximately 13x4mm (IM27), now approximately 15x7mm (IM26)

source_text: 复发
text_en: Recurrence.

source_text: 余胸廓骨质未见明显骨质破坏灶
text_en: The remaining thoracic bones show no obvious osseous destruction.

source_text: 同前
text_en: Stable compared to prior

source_text: 肝左叶低密度小灶大致同前，左侧肾上腺结节样增粗，右肾萎缩，请结合腹部检查
text_en: Small low-density focus in left lobe of liver roughly same as before, left adrenal gland nodular thickening, right renal atrophy, please correlate with abdominal examination.

source_text: 纵隔10R淋巴结较前略增大，原约13x11mm，现约16X13mm(IM32)，追查
text_en: Right paratracheal (10R) mediastinal lymph node slightly increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 13x11 mm, now approximately 16x13 mm (IM32), requires follow-up.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段含钙化结节同前，仍约16x15mm（IMA19），右肺中叶外侧段胸膜下见一不规则实性结节，约16x10mm（IM25），考虑转移可能大，邻近胸膜较前轻度增厚，建议密切随诊
text_en: A calcified nodule in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment is stable compared to prior, still measuring approximately 16 x 15 mm (IMA19). An irregular solid nodule is seen subpleural in the right middle lobe lateral segment, measuring approximately 16 x 10 mm (IM25), suspicious for metastasis. Adjacent pleura is slightly thickened compared to prior, and close follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 胸5、胸7椎体内结节样稍高密度影同前
text_en: Nodular slightly sclerotic lesion within T5 and T7 vertebral bodies unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔多个小淋巴结大致同前，较大16*9mm(IM28)
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes are essentially unchanged from previous, with the largest measuring 16x9 mm (IM28).

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前（Im34）
text_en: Tiny nodule in the left interlobar pleura is stable (Im34).

source_text: 气管右侧旁、隆突下及双肺门淋巴结部分同前，部分缩小，较大原约11x10mm（IM8），现约7x7mm（IM8）
text_en: Right paratracheal, subcarinal, and bilateral hilar lymph nodes: some unchanged, some decreased in size; the largest previously approximately 11x10 mm (IM8), now approximately 7x7 mm (IM8).

source_text: 新见一模糊类结节
text_en: Newly seen ill-defined nodule-like lesion

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，未见新发占位
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no new space-occupying lesions identified.

source_text: 左肺胸膜下小结节同前，约6mm（IM20）
text_en: Left lung subpleural small nodule unchanged from previous, approximately 6mm (IM20).

source_text: 双肺多发小结节灶同前，约3-5mm（IM18、28、41）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 3–5 mm (IM18, 28, 41).

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则结节影大致同前，现约29*16mm（IMA16），周围斑片结节索条状影同前
text_en: Irregular nodule in the left upper lobe is essentially unchanged, now measuring approximately 29 x 16 mm (IMA16), and surrounding patchy nodular and linear opacities are unchanged.

source_text: 右侧锁骨上区淋巴结大致同前，现较大约12*8mm(图4)，原约10*10mm（IM10）
text_en: The lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region are generally unchanged from prior, with the largest currently measuring approximately 12 x 8 mm (Figure 4), previously about 10 x 10 mm (IM10).

source_text: 右肺上叶结节较前缩小，现约4x2mm（IM28），原约9x9mm（IM27）
text_en: The nodule in the right upper lobe is smaller than before, now measuring approximately 4x2 mm (IM28), previously about 9x9 mm (IM27).

source_text: 左锁骨高密度结节同前
text_en: Left supraclavicular high-density nodule unchanged.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结较前相仿，仍约22x16mm（IM29），余纵隔小淋巴结同前
text_en: The right hilar lymph node is stable compared to prior, still measuring approximately 22 x 16 mm (IM29); other small mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶不规则微小结节同前，＜5mm（IM38）
text_en: Irregular tiny nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, less than 5 mm (IM38).

source_text: 右侧胸膜旁模糊结节同前，约为5mm（Im28）
text_en: The indistinct nodule adjacent to the right pleura is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (Im28).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端软组织密度影较前吸收，未见明确占位征象，考虑术后改变，原右侧胸腔积液吸收
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; soft tissue density at the bronchial stump has improved compared to prior. No definite mass is identified. Findings are consistent with postoperative change. The previously noted right pleural effusion has resolved.

source_text: 双肺新发多发结节影，较大约17*15mm（IM35），考虑转移
text_en: Newly developed multiple nodules in both lungs. The largest measures approximately 17x15 mm (IM35). Consider metastasis.

source_text: 右肺内多发索条及条片灶较前缩小，左肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Multiple linear and patchy opacities in the right lung are smaller compared to prior imaging; no new nodules are seen in the left lung.

source_text: 双肺下叶纹理增多并见少量索条，未见新发结节影
text_en: Increased bronchovascular markings in both lower lobes with few linear opacities; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 新见实性结节
text_en: Newly seen solid nodule

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段点状结节影同前（IM11）
text_en: Left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment: punctate nodule unchanged from previous (IM11).

source_text: 左肺多发小结节同前，较大约5mm（IM14）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left lung unchanged from prior, the largest measuring approximately 5 mm (IM14)

source_text: 新见高密度结节
text_en: newly identified high-density nodule

source_text: 双肺下叶胸膜下小结节及左侧叶间胸膜结节同前（IM25、26、41、47）
text_en: Subpleural small nodules in both lower lobes and a left interlobar pleural nodule are unchanged compared to prior (IM25, 26, 41, 47).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段混杂磨玻璃密度结节整体范围同前，仍约19*16mm(图21)
text_en: Mixed ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment, overall extent unchanged, still approximately 19x16 mm (Figure 21).

source_text: 双侧胸膜增厚、胸膜下多发结节状钙化灶同前相仿
text_en: Bilateral pleural thickening with multiple calcified nodules and left lower lobe calcification is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4、7、10R组淋巴结同前相仿，较大约14x10mm（IM25、31）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R, 4, 7, and 10R are similar to previous, with the largest measuring approximately 14x10 mm (IM25, 31).

source_text: 双肺散在钙化结节较前无变化，右肺上叶纤维索条影同前，双肺下叶见散在长索条影，双下肺小范围膨胀不全
text_en: Scattered calcified nodules in both lungs show no change from prior. Fibrotic linear opacities in the right upper lobe are unchanged. Long linear opacities are seen in the lower lungs bilaterally. Small areas of volume loss are present in the lower lungs.

source_text: 双肺散在多发小结节部分同前，追查
text_en: Some of the scattered multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺门、左侧锁骨上区淋巴结同前，较大仍约12*8mm（IMA25）
text_en: Lymph nodes at the right hilum and left supraclavicular region are unchanged from prior; the largest remains approximately 12 x 8 mm (IMA25).

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结同前，仍约10x5mm（IMA27）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes unchanged from previous, still approximately 10x5 mm (IMA27).

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，仍约16x8mm（IM30）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is unchanged from prior, still approximately 16x8 mm (IM30).

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结较前相仿，现仍约12x8mm（IM32）
text_en: The right hilar lymph node is stable compared to prior, still measuring approximately 12 x 8 mm (IM32).

source_text: 右肺上叶见磨玻璃密度结节同前，约5mm（IM17）
text_en: A ground-glass opacity nodule is seen in the right upper lobe, unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM17).

source_text: 扫及左上腹部胃底下方见一淋巴结同前，约10x9mm（IMA50），建议随访复查
text_en: On scan, left upper quadrant subgastric lymph node unchanged from prior, approximately 10x9 mm (IMA50), follow-up recommended

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段磨玻璃灶及双肺散在微小结节大致同前（IMA15、24、30、47），未见新发结节或实变灶
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment ground-glass opacity focus and scattered tiny nodules in both lungs roughly unchanged (IMA15, 24, 30, 47), no new nodules or consolidation.

source_text: 纵隔内淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from previous.

source_text: 左肺下叶支气管截断，局部见软组织肿块较前缩小，较大层面原约49x42mm（IM30），现平扫大致测量约33x18mm（IM31）
text_en: Bronchial cutoff in the left lower lobe with local soft tissue mass reduced compared to previous, previously approximately 49x42 mm on largest cross-section (IM30), now approximately 33x18 mm on non-contrast scan (IM31)

source_text: 右上肺结节同前，随诊观察
text_en: Nodule in the right upper lung is unchanged; follow-up observation recommended.

source_text: 纵隔左移较前相仿，纵隔内多发淋巴结普遍较前增大，现较大约11x8mm（IM7）、12x7mm（IM11）
text_en: Mediastinal shift to the left similar to prior, multiple mediastinal lymph nodes generally enlarged compared to prior, largest approximately 11x8mm (IM7) and 12x7mm (IM11).

source_text: 两肺转移结节影较前缩小，原较大约14*11mm，现较大约12x7mm（IMA28）
text_en: Metastatic nodules in both lungs are decreased in size compared to prior; the largest previously measured approximately 14x11 mm, now measures approximately 12x7 mm (IMA28).

source_text: 右肺胸膜下簇集小结节（IMA30）同前
text_en: Clustered small subpleural nodules in the right lung (IMA30) unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶间质改变及炎症大致同前，余肺内未见明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: Interstitial changes and inflammation in the right lower lobe are essentially unchanged; no significant new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺条索影、双肺模糊小结节同前相仿，右肺上叶尖后段较大结节大小同前3mm（IM22）
text_en: Linear opacities in the right lung and hazy small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior; the larger nodule in the apicoposterior segment of the right upper lobe remains stable at 3 mm (IM22).

source_text: 右肺上叶见点状及左肺上叶及右下肺少许索条影同前，肺内未见转移结节
text_en: Punctate opacities in the right upper lobe and a few linear opacities in the left upper lobe and right lower lobe are unchanged from prior; no metastatic nodules are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 余肺未见新增结节灶
text_en: The remainder of the lungs shows no new nodules.

source_text: 左肺下叶微小结节同前，约2-3mm（IM43、44），双下肺见少许索条影同前
text_en: Left lower lobe small nodule unchanged, approximately 2-3 mm (IM43, 44), bilateral lower lungs show a few linear opacities unchanged.

source_text: 左下肺小结节同前（IM48），右肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable (IM48); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the right lung.

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下新见少许索条结节影（IM39）
text_en: Newly noted faint linear and nodular opacities are seen subpleurally in the right middle lobe (IM39).

source_text: 右肺中叶近水平裂处结节样磨玻璃密度影同前，约10x7mm（IM30），边缘模糊
text_en: Nodule-like ground-glass opacity near the horizontal fissure in the right middle lobe, unchanged, measuring approximately 10x7 mm (IM30), with indistinct margins

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段心缘旁类结节影，较前缩小，原约16x10mm，现约11x8mm（IM39），与相邻胸膜粘连
text_en: A nodule-like opacity adjacent to the cardiac border in the left upper lobe lingular segment has decreased in size compared to prior, measuring approximately 16 x 10 mm previously and 11 x 8 mm currently (IM39), with adhesion to the adjacent pleura.

source_text: 纵隔7、8组及上腹部胃小弯多发肿大淋巴结部分同前，隆突下仍约33x16mm（IM30）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes at mediastinal stations 7 and 8 and upper abdominal gastric lesser curvature partially unchanged from prior, subcarinal still approximately 33x16 mm (IM30).

source_text: 左后胸壁皮下结节较前缩小，原约17mm（IM39），现约13mm（IM39）
text_en: Left subcutaneous posterior chest wall nodule decreased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 17 mm (IM39), now approximately 13 mm (IM39).

source_text: 左上叶微小结节同前（IM12），余两肺未见新发结节影
text_en: The tiny nodule in the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior (IM12); the remainder of both lungs shows no new nodules.

source_text: 双肺多发结节同前，追查
text_en: Multiple nodules in both lungs are unchanged; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 两肺结节较前增大增多，考虑转移
text_en: Nodules in both lungs are increased in size and number compared to prior, suggestive of metastases.

source_text: 左肺下叶磨玻璃密度结节同前，仍约7x5mm(IM34)，性质待定，追查
text_en: Left lower lobe ground-glass density nodule unchanged, still approximately 7x5 mm (IM34), nature indeterminate, follow-up recommended

source_text: 扫及甲状腺右侧叶低强化结节同前
text_en: Hypoenhancing nodule in the right thyroid lobe, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 胸廓诸骨骨质未见破坏灶
text_en: No destructive lesions seen in the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段浅淡结节影同前，仍约3mm（IMA21）
text_en: Faint nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment, unchanged, still approximately 3 mm (IMA21).

source_text: 左肺下叶背段磨玻璃密度结节较前略缩小，现约6mm（IM38），原约8mm（IM36)，追查
text_en: Left lower lobe dorsal segment ground-glass density nodule slightly decreased in size compared to previous, currently approximately 6 mm (IM38), previously approximately 8 mm (IM36), with follow-up

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结同前，约15x6mm（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are stable, measuring approximately 15x6 mm (IM19).

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，支气管断端及纵隔旁少许软组织影同前，未见明确软组织肿块征象
text_en: Following right upper lobectomy, minimal soft tissue at the bronchial stump and adjacent to the mediastinum is unchanged; no definite soft tissue mass is identified.

source_text: 右肺钙化及上叶（IM20）、中叶（IM38）小结节灶同前
text_en: Calcification in the right lung and small nodular opacities in the upper lobe (IM20) and middle lobe (IM38) are unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺数枚小结节较前相仿，较大者约5mm（Im45）
text_en: Several small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior. The largest measures approximately 5 mm (Im45).

source_text: 双肺及叶间胸膜多发微小结节较前不同程度增大，原较大者仍约5mm（IM46），现较大约7mm（IM18），考虑转移
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in both lungs and interlobar pleura have increased to varying degrees compared to prior; previously largest was approximately 5 mm (IM46), now largest is approximately 7 mm (IM18), suggestive of metastases.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺右叶占位呈低密度大致同前（IM1）
text_en: Imaging shows a low-density mass in the right lobe of the thyroid, essentially unchanged (IM1).

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，约5mm（IM36），右肺下叶新见可疑小结节，约为5mm（IM40）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM36). A new suspicious small nodule is seen in the right lower lobe, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM40).

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结平扫与血管分界不清，整体较前增大，较大原约44x24mm（IM27），现约44x28mm（IM28）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is poorly demarcated from adjacent vessels on non-contrast imaging and is overall larger compared to prior; the largest was previously approximately 44x24 mm (IM27) and is now approximately 44x28 mm (IM28).

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节同前，约5mm（IM28）
text_en: The small nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged, approximately 5 mm (IM28).

source_text: 右侧胸膜、叶间胸膜结节状增厚同前
text_en: Nodular thickening of the right pleura and interlobar pleura is unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段多发模糊点片影及多发类圆形小结节较前增多、模糊(IM23)
text_en: Multiple ill-defined punctate and patchy opacities and multiple round small nodules in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe have increased in number and are more blurred compared to prior (IM23).

source_text: 右肺索条及小结节影同前（IMA21、25）
text_en: Linear opacities and nodular shadow in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior (IMA21, 25).

source_text: 左肺类结节影同前，约7mm（IMA）（IM46）
text_en: Left lung nodule-like shadow unchanged from prior, approximately 7 mm (IMA) (IM46).

source_text: 右肺中叶术后，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Status post right middle lobectomy; no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis are seen.

source_text: 左下肺新见小结节，约4mm（IM52），转移待排，密切观察
text_en: A new small nodule, approximately 4 mm (IM52), is seen in the left lower lobe; metastasis cannot be excluded; close observation recommended.

source_text: 两肺小结节影同前，约2-3mm（IM33、40），两肺新见微小结节影（IMA35、39）
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior, approximately 2-3 mm (IM33, 40); new tiny nodules seen in both lungs (IMA35, 39)

source_text: 右肺中叶软组织密度结节影同前，约21x13mm（IM29）
text_en: Soft tissue density nodule in the right middle lobe, unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 21x13 mm (IM29)

source_text: 左肺上叶癌较前略缩小，追查
text_en: Left upper lobe carcinoma has slightly reduced in size compared to previous, for follow-up.

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节同前相仿，追查
text_en: Small nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior; further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 双肺下叶胸膜下不规则小结节同前（IM33、39、42），密切追查
text_en: Irregular small subpleural nodules in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior (IM33, 39, 42); close follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔2R组气管旁多发小淋巴结较前饱满，较大原约11x6mm，现约11x9mm（Im7）
text_en: Multiple small paratracheal lymph nodes in mediastinal station 2R are more prominent than before, the larger one was approximately 11x6 mm, now approximately 11x9 mm (Im7).

source_text: 右上肺微小结节及索条影大致同前
text_en: Micro-nodules and linear opacities in the right upper lung are essentially unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔6组淋巴结略饱满，如原约18x8mm（IM20）者，现约2x09mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal station 6 lymph nodes are slightly prominent, previously approximately 18 x 8 mm (IM20), now approximately 2 x 09 mm (as documented; IM20).

source_text: 左肺动脉干旁及纵隔6区多发增大淋巴结部分较前缩小，例如原约10x5mm者现约8x4mm（IM20），双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes adjacent to the left pulmonary artery trunk and in mediastinal station 6 partially reduced in size compared to prior, e.g., from approximately 10x5 mm to 8x4 mm (IM20). No enlarged lymph nodes in bilateral hilar, supraclavicular, or axillary regions.

source_text: 左叶裂膜小结节、左肺下叶、右肺下叶结节同前，约2mm（IM33、47、56）
text_en: Small nodules in the left interlobar pleura, left lower lobe, and right lower lobe unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 2 mm (IM33, 47, 56).

source_text: 左肺下叶软组织肿块较前增大，原较大层面约30x28mm（IM43），现约48x36mm（IM44），其外侧肺内多发索条纠集同前
text_en: The soft tissue mass in the left lower lobe has increased in size compared to prior, previously measured approximately 30x28 mm (IM43), currently measures approximately 48x36 mm (IM44). Multiple linear opacities with traction in the adjacent lung parenchyma remain unchanged.

source_text: 双下肺微小结节同前（IM53、59），较大约6mm(IM 53)
text_en: Scattered micro-nodules in the bilateral lower lungs are unchanged (IM53, 59), the largest measuring approximately 6 mm (IM53).

source_text: 左肺下叶类圆形结节同前，约12x9mm（Im33），边缘清晰光滑，内为软组织密度夹杂多枚钙化同前，符合良性
text_en: The round nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged, approximately 12x9 mm (Im33), with clear and smooth margins, containing soft tissue density with multiple calcifications as before, consistent with benign.

source_text: 左肺上叶肺门偏外侧混杂磨玻璃密度结节大致同前，范围约29*23mm（IM23），建议短期随访观察
text_en: Left upper lobe, peripheral to the hilum, mixed ground-glass opacity nodule similar to previous, approximately 29*23 mm (IM23), suggest short-term follow-up observation.

source_text: 胃小弯侧及腹腔干旁淋巴结同前，较大仍约9x6mm（IM52）
text_en: Lymph nodes at the lesser curvature of the stomach and adjacent to the celiac trunk remain unchanged from prior, with the largest still measuring approximately 9x6mm (IM52).

source_text: 双肺气肿不均伴肺大泡同前，未见新发结节影
text_en: Pulmonary emphysema with bullae is unchanged; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节较前相仿，现仍约8x6mm(IM18)
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule similar to previous, currently still approximately 8x6mm (IM18).

source_text: 右肺小叶后基底段微小结节灶同前，约3*2mm（IMA37）
text_en: Tiny nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lung is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 3x2 mm (IMA37).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，右肺内多个小结节影大致同前（IMA19、41），较大约5mm，两下肺新见片絮、索条影，追查
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, multiple small nodules in the right lung largely unchanged (IMA19, 41), largest about 5 mm, new patchy and linear opacities in both lower lungs, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 食管-胃弓上吻合术后，吻合口右侧壁不连续并与右侧胸腔相通，其外侧形成混杂密度区较前范围同前，原约32x23mm（IM15），现约31x20mm（IM14），中间含气低密度区略缩小，周围软组织环绕同前，其下方沿右后胸壁内侧仍见引流管穿行
text_en: Post supra-aortic esophagogastrostomy, discontinuity of the right wall of the anastomosis communicating with the right pleural cavity, with a mixed-density area lateral to it unchanged in size compared to previous, originally approximately 32x23mm (IM15), now approximately 31x20mm (IM14). The central air-containing low-density area slightly reduced, surrounded by soft tissue unchanged, with a drainage tube still traversing along the inner aspect of the right posterior chest wall below it.

source_text: 左肺上叶浅淡密度结节同前，约4mm（IM32），界清
text_en: The faint density nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged from previous, approximately 4 mm (IM32), with well-defined margins.

source_text: 右肺尖胸膜微小结节较前相仿，约3mm（IM12），其内上方新见一结节灶，大小约7x6mm（IM11）
text_en: The tiny subpleural nodule in the right lung apex is similar to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM12). A new nodule is now seen superior and internal to it, measuring approximately 7x6 mm (IM11).

source_text: 左侧肾上腺结节较前相仿，请结合腹部检查
text_en: Left adrenal nodule similar to prior; correlate with abdominal evaluation.

source_text: 左肺未见新发结节或斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities in the left lung.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上淋巴结较前缩小，原约10x9mm（IMA5），现＜5mm(图8)
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node is decreased in size compared to prior; previously approximately 10x9 mm (IMA5), now less than 5 mm (Figure 8).

source_text: 两肺小结节影同前（IMA40、43、50、53），较大约5mm
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior (IMA40, 43, 50, 53), largest approximately 5 mm

source_text: 扫及肝内多发点状低密度影，左侧肾上腺内小结节样低密度影同前（IM56）
text_en: Multiple punctate low-density foci within the liver and a small nodular low-density lesion within the left adrenal gland are stable compared to prior (IM56).

source_text: 肺气肿及间质性病变，散在小结节同前
text_en: Emphysema and interstitial lung disease with scattered small nodules unchanged from prior.

source_text: 前纵隔胸腺区密度稍高较前相仿，其内小结节大小同前（Im17、26）
text_en: Slightly increased density in the thymic region of the anterior mediastinum is similar to prior, with the internal small nodule unchanged in size (Im17, 26).

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，约5mm（IM34），右肺下叶内基底段胸膜下索条小结节同前（IM38）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM34). The small subpleural linear nodule in the medial basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM38).

source_text: 纵隔2R组淋巴结同前，大小约8*6mm（IMA15）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal station 2R unchanged from previous, approximately 8x6 mm in size (IMA15).

source_text: 左锁骨上、纵隔小淋巴结同前，仍小于10mm
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region and mediastinum are similar to previous and still less than 10 mm in size.

source_text: 左肺舌叶局部术后，两肺散在微小结节大致同前
text_en: Post-local resection in the lingula of the left lung, scattered tiny nodules in both lungs are largely unchanged

source_text: 右肺上叶后段磨玻璃密度结节较前稍增大，轴位原约16x13mm，现约16x15mm（IM19），矢状位上下径原约21mm，现约23mm，倾向恶性
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment has slightly increased in size; axial dimension was previously about 16x13 mm, now approximately 16x15 mm (IM19); sagittal craniocaudal dimension was previously about 21 mm, now approximately 23 mm. Malignancy is favored.

source_text: 右侧肺门肿物较前略缩小，原约40x28mm，现约35x26mm（IM31），与邻近肺门肿大淋巴结融合分界不清同前
text_en: Right hilar mass is slightly smaller than before, previously approximately 40x28 mm, now approximately 35x26 mm (IM31). Fusion with enlarged right hilar lymph nodes remains indistinct, as before.

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段软组织密度结节较前相仿，约15x10mm（IM53）
text_en: Left lower lobe basal segment soft tissue density nodule similar to prior, approximately 15x10 mm (IM53)

source_text: 右肺中叶微小结节同前（IMA40）
text_en: Right middle lobe tiny nodule unchanged from prior (IMA40)

source_text: 右肺上叶支气管狭窄中断，支气管分布不规则软组织肿物较前增大，现约5.5x4.7cm（Im18），原为4.7x3.2cm（Im23），包绕右上肺动脉消失同前相仿，外周肺见大片实变影及少量积液
text_en: Narrowing and interruption of the right upper lobe bronchus. The irregularly distributed soft tissue mass in the bronchial region has increased in size, now measuring approximately 5.5 x 4.7 cm (Im18), previously 4.7 x 3.2 cm (Im23). Encasement of the right upper pulmonary artery with its disappearance is similar to prior. Peripheral lung shows a large area of consolidation and a small amount of fluid.

source_text: 双肺多发小结节同前相仿，较大约7mm（IM31）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior, largest measuring approximately 7 mm (IM31).

source_text: 右肺下叶近肺门结节较前相仿，现仍约7x5mm（IM30），远端肺内模糊片影及两肺内多发结节较前相仿(IM19、23、26-30、39)
text_en: The nodule near the hilum of the right lower lobe is similar to prior, still measuring approximately 7 x 5 mm (IM30). The hazy patchy opacity in the distal lung and multiple nodules in both lungs are similar to prior (IM19, 23, 26–30, 39).

source_text: 右肺下叶前基底段模糊小结节同前，直径约5mm（IM32）
text_en: The indistinct small nodule in the anterior basal segment of the right lower lobe remains unchanged, with a diameter of approximately 5 mm (IM32).

source_text: 甲状腺左叶低密度结节及钙化灶同前
text_en: Left thyroid lobe low-density nodule and calcification unchanged from prior

source_text: 两肺微小结节同前
text_en: The tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 新见多发簇状分布微小结节
text_en: Newly seen multiple tiny nodules with clustered distribution

source_text: 余肺斑片索条影、钙化结节大致同前，未见新发结节及斑片影
text_en: Patchy linear opacities and calcified nodules in the remaining lung are stable. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 纵隔11L淋巴结同前，仍约12x7mm(IM34)
text_en: The mediastinal lymph node at station 11L is unchanged from previous, still approximately 12x7 mm (Image 34).

source_text: 两肺散在模糊小结节灶同前
text_en: Scattered indistinct small nodular opacities in both lungs, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 气管后方结节影同前
text_en: Nodule shadow posterior to trachea similar to prior

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段肿块影缩小，原约54x40mm，现约40*36mm（IMA41），基底段肺组织不张范围增大
text_en: Left lower lobe basal segment mass opacity decreased in size, originally approximately 54x40 mm, now approximately 40x36 mm (IMA41), with increased extent of atelectasis in the basal segment lung tissue.

source_text: 右肺胸胃旁实变影较前减少，双肺下叶多发索条影较前明显减少，双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: The consolidation adjacent to the intrathoracic stomach in the right lung has decreased; multiple linear opacities in the lower lobes bilaterally have markedly decreased; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 纵隔内见散在小淋巴结同前，较大仍约12x9mm（IM23）
text_en: Scattered small lymph nodes in the mediastinum, similar to previous, largest still approximately 12x9 mm (IM23).

source_text: 左肺下叶短条状实性小结节较前饱满，原约4mm（[DATE]胸部CT IM57），现约6x4mm（IM50）
text_en: A short linear solid small nodule in the left lower lobe is more prominent compared to previous, previously approximately 4mm (chest CT IM57 on [DATE]), now approximately 6x4mm (IM50).

source_text: 胸12椎体上缘退变许莫氏结节形成同前，余扫及胸廓诸骨未见明确破坏征象
text_en: T12 vertebral body superior margin degenerative Schmorl's node formation unchanged, the remaining scanned thoracic bones show no clear evidence of destruction.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节影同前，约4mm（IMA13）
text_en: Nodule with ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe is unchanged from prior, approximately 4 mm (IMA13).

source_text: 加重
text_en: Worsening.

source_text: 左上肺磨玻璃结节灶大致同前，大小约9mm(IMA31)，余双肺未见新发异常密度区及结节灶
text_en: Ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe is largely stable, measuring approximately 9 mm (IMA31); no new abnormal density or nodules are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右腋下淋巴结同前，约15x13mm（Im21）
text_en: Right axillary lymph nodes are unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 15x13 mm (Im21)

source_text: 右侧肩胛骨及胸12椎体骨岛同前，余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Enostosis in the right scapula and T12 vertebra is unchanged. No evidence of osseous destruction in the other bones of the thorax.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结密度较高同前，双侧锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes with higher density, unchanged from prior; no enlarged lymph nodes in the bilateral supraclavicular regions or bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 肝内低密度灶及右侧肾上腺结节同前相仿，请结合腹部检查
text_en: Low-density hepatic lesion(s) and right adrenal nodule similar to prior; please correlate with abdominal imaging.

source_text: 两肺结节影较前增大增多，较大约10*9mm（IMA46）
text_en: Nodules in both lungs are increased in size and number compared to prior, the largest measuring approximately 10x9 mm (IMA46).

source_text: 两肺间质改变同前，两肺小结节影同前
text_en: Interstitial changes in both lungs are stable; small nodules in both lungs are stable.

source_text: 左肺下叶结节较前增大，较大者原约14*9mm(图34)，现约23x20mm（IM33）
text_en: Left lower lobe nodule increased in size compared to previous. The larger one was approximately 14x9 mm (Figure 34), now approximately 23x20 mm (IM33).

source_text: 双肺少许小结节同前（Im44、45），未见新生结节及斑片影
text_en: Few small nodules in both lungs are stable (Im44, 45); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 右肺斑片影较前相仿，余肺未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: Patchy opacities in the right lung are similar to prior; no new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺中叶斜裂胸膜下模糊小结节同前（Im33）
text_en: Indistinct small nodule subpleural at the oblique fissure in the right middle lobe, unchanged compared to prior (Im33)

source_text: 甲状腺右叶小结节影同前
text_en: The right thyroid lobe shows a small nodule, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶前基底段叶间胸膜及肋胸膜下混杂磨玻璃密度结节同前，约12x7mm（IM28），薄层可见高密度索条影牵拉胸膜
text_en: Mixed ground-glass opacity nodule along the interlobar and costal pleura in the anterior basal segment of the right lower lobe remains stable, measuring approximately 12 x 7 mm (IM28); thin-section images show a high-density linear opacity tethering the pleura.

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前相仿，腔静脉后淋巴结仍约12x7mm（IM20），气管憩室同前
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes similar to prior, retrocaval lymph node still approximately 12x7 mm (IM20), tracheal diverticulum unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔多组、双肺门多发肿大淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple groups of mediastinal and bilateral hilar enlarged lymph nodes unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右侧胸膜下软组织密度结节略增大，右侧壁层胸膜新发结节，追查
text_en: Right subpleural soft tissue density nodule is slightly larger; a new nodule is seen in the right parietal pleura; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔4、7组见小淋巴结同前，较大约16x8mm（IM27），余双肺门、锁骨上区及腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Small lymph nodes seen in mediastinal stations 4 and 7, unchanged from prior, largest approximately 16x8 mm (IM27). No enlarged lymph nodes seen in the remaining bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular regions, or axillary regions.

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜结节状增厚同前相仿（IM30），左肺下叶散在多发片絮影减少
text_en: The nodular thickening of the left interlobar pleura is similar to prior (IM30); scattered patchy opacities in the left lower lobe have decreased.

source_text: 双侧胸膜不均匀结节样增厚，部分结节样钙化同前
text_en: Bilateral pleural thickening is nodular and irregular, with nodular calcification, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，双上肺可见散在小的透亮区，右肺上叶后段近胸膜处不规则团片状灶变化不大，原约24x17mm，现约25x15mm（IMA16），边缘毛糙，其内部可见多个微小气体密度影，远端与胸膜分界不清
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, scattered small lucencies in the upper lungs, the irregular patchy lesion near the pleura in the right upper lobe posterior segment is unchanged, previously approximately 24x17 mm, now approximately 25x15 mm (IMA16), margin irregular, with multiple tiny air-density foci within, poorly demarcated from the pleura distally.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段小结节伴钙化灶同前，约7x5mm(Im9)，局部索条影略明显
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment small nodule with calcification unchanged from previous, approximately 7x5 mm (IM9), local linear opacities slightly prominent.

source_text: 气管隆突下低密度结节缩小，原约20x13mm，现约16*8mm（IM26）
text_en: Subcarinal low-density nodule decreased in size, previously approximately 20x13 mm, now approximately 16x8 mm (IM26).

source_text: 平扫纵隔未见明显增大淋巴结，右气管食管沟淋巴结同前，大小约9*4mm（IMA12）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows no significantly enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes. The lymph node in the right tracheoesophageal groove remains stable, measuring approximately 9x4 mm (IMA12).

source_text: 右肺散在斑片索条影同前，右肺结节影较前缩小，部分密度较前浅淡，较大原约11x6mm（IM36），现约10x4mm（IM37），追查
text_en: Scattered patchy linear opacities in the right lung are stable compared to prior; the right lung nodule is smaller than before, with some areas less dense, previously measuring approximately 11 x 6 mm (IM36), now measuring approximately 10 x 4 mm (IM37); further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 纵隔及贲门旁多发淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple mediastinal and lymph nodes adjacent to the cardia unchanged.

source_text: 双肺胸膜下新见多发结节灶，较大约13x10mm（IM33），转移可能大，追查
text_en: Newly seen multiple subpleural nodules in both lungs, the largest measuring approximately 13x10 mm (IM33), raising concern for metastasis; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔、肺门、腋窝及锁骨上未见新发肿大淋巴结
text_en: No new enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum, hilar regions, axillae, or supraclavicular regions

source_text: 左肺上叶片絮影及结节影减少、缩小，较大原约12mm（IM26），现小于3mm（IM25）
text_en: Left upper lobe patchy opacities and nodular opacities have decreased and reduced in size; the larger one was approximately 12mm (IM26), now less than 3mm (IM25).

source_text: 膈下结节较前缩小
text_en: The subdiaphragmatic nodule is smaller compared to previous.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，较大仍约10mm（IM24）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest still approximately 10 mm (IM24).

source_text: 纵隔隆突下软组织密度，约25*13mm（IM31）.4组小淋巴结同前
text_en: Soft tissue density in subcarinal mediastinum, approximately 25x13 mm (Image 31); small lymph nodes in station 4 unchanged from previous

source_text: 纵隔3P组淋巴结较前相仿，约14x10mm(IM10)
text_en: Lymph node in mediastinal station 3P is similar to previous, approximately 14x10 mm (IM10).

source_text: 两肺索条影、左肺下叶索条小结节影同前，约3mm（IM41）
text_en: The linear opacities and the linear small nodules in the left lower lobe are unchanged, about 3 mm (IM41).

source_text: 双肺门淋巴结同前，较大仍约11x6mm（IM32）
text_en: Hilar lymph nodes are unchanged from prior, the largest still measuring approximately 11x6 mm (IM32).

source_text: 两肺多发小结节同前，较大灶仍分别为7x5mm（IM60）、9x5mm（IM54），部分结节内钙化同前
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged; the larger lesions remain 7x5 mm (IM60) and 9x5 mm (IM54), respectively; calcification within some nodules is unchanged.

source_text: 双肺结节同前，继续观察
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary nodules are stable. Continue observation.

source_text: 右肺下叶高密度钙化灶同前，右肺上叶类结节灶同前（IM17）
text_en: The high-density calcified focus in the right lower lobe is unchanged; the nodular-appearing lesion in the right upper lobe is unchanged (IM17).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段与前段之间见软组织肿块，较前明显减小，最大层面现约40x27mm（IM21），原约68x49mm（IM23），不均匀强化，边界欠清同前
text_en: A soft tissue mass is seen between the apicoposterior and anterior segments of the left upper lobe, significantly decreased compared to prior, now approximately 40x27 mm on maximum dimension (IM21), previously approximately 68x49 mm (IM23), with heterogeneous enhancement and ill-defined margins unchanged from prior.

source_text: 两肺散在微小结节影同前
text_en: The scattered tiny nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段小结节灶较前缩小，原约为9x8mm（IM13），现约8x5mm（IM13），结节边缘较前清晰
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment small nodule decreased compared to previous, originally approximately 9x8 mm (IM13), now approximately 8x5 mm (IM13), nodule margins clearer than previous.

source_text: 右肺下叶散在小结节，双侧叶间胸膜结节，同前相仿，观察
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right lower lobe and nodules along bilateral interlobar pleura, similar to prior, under observation.

source_text: 食管胸中段壁环周增厚较前略减轻，原较厚部位约13mm，现约11mm（IM29），同胸主动脉接触面小于90度，近端食管无扩张
text_en: Circumferential wall thickening of the mid-thoracic esophagus is slightly reduced compared to prior, with previously thickest portion approximately 13 mm and currently approximately 11 mm (IM29). Contact surface with the thoracic aorta is less than 90 degrees, and there is no proximal esophageal dilation.

source_text: 双肺浅淡密度微小结节同前（IM17、23、24、38、40、43、45），较大仍约5mm（IM23）
text_en: Faint density tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM17, 23, 24, 38, 40, 43, 45); the largest remains approximately 5 mm (IM23).

source_text: 右肺局部术后，右肺内未见新发肿块及结节影
text_en: Postoperative change in the right lung; no new masses or nodules are seen within the right lung.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺右叶卵圆形低密度结节同前
text_en: Imaging shows an oval low-density nodule in the right lobe of the thyroid, unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段类结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Nodule-like shadow in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe unchanged from prior examination; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节同前，约5mm（IM34）
text_en: The small nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged, approximately 5 mm (IM34).

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，较大仍约7mm（IM25）
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, largest still approximately 7 mm (IM25).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，胸部扫描未见新发占位征象
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, chest scan shows no new mass.

source_text: 新发转移
text_en: newly identified metastatic lesion

source_text: 两肺散在索条小结节影同前
text_en: Scattered linear and small nodular opacities in both lungs, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺胸膜下见散在少许3-5mm浅淡密度微小结节同前
text_en: Left lung subpleural scattered few 3-5 mm faint density tiny nodules unchanged

source_text: 左肺未见明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: No obvious new nodules or consolidation in the left lung.

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结大致同前（IM24）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes essentially unchanged from previous (IM24)

source_text: 胸部CT平扫未见新生占位征象，少许陈旧灶同前
text_en: Chest CT scan shows no new mass lesion findings. A few old lesions unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见异常软组织密度肿块影，右肺索条影及叶间胸膜增厚同前
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; non-contrast scan shows no abnormal soft-tissue mass at the bronchial stump. Linear opacities and interlobar pleural thickening in the right lung are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔4L淋巴结较前略增大，现约13*11mm(图20)，原约10*10mm(图20)
text_en: The mediastinal 4L lymph node is slightly enlarged compared to prior, currently measuring approximately 13x11 mm (Figure 20), previously approximately 10x10 mm (Figure 20).

source_text: 双肺纹理增重，两肺散在陈旧钙化、索条同前，未见新生结节或实变影
text_en: Increased lung markings. Scattered old calcifications and linear opacities in both lungs are similar to prior. No new nodules or consolidations are seen.

source_text: 前纵隔肿物切除术后，局部未见复发征象
text_en: Status post resection of anterior mediastinal mass. No signs of local recurrence are seen.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段胸膜下小结节同前，仍约4mm（IM43）
text_en: The subpleural small nodule in the basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged, still approximately 4 mm (IM43).

source_text: 双肺叶间胸膜下微结节同前（IM32、34、35、44），较大仍约5mm，大小及形态均较前相仿，考虑炎性结节或陈旧灶可能大
text_en: Multiple subpleural micronodules at the interlobar fissures are stable compared to prior (IM32, 34, 35, 44), largest still approximately 5 mm, with similar size and morphology as before; inflammatory nodules or sequelae are most likely.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段结节影较前略增大，原约12*10mm（IMA16），现约13*12mm（IMA18），边界清晰
text_en: The nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe is slightly increased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 12x10 mm (IMA16), now approximately 13x12 mm (IMA18), with well-defined margins.

source_text: 两肺索条影、双肺小结节影同前，较大约5mm（Im49）
text_en: The linear opacities and small nodules in both lungs are unchanged; the largest is about 5 mm (Im49).

source_text: 双肺3-4mm微结节（IM32，41)，较前相仿
text_en: 3-4 mm micronodules in both lungs (IM32, 41) are similar to prior.

source_text: 纵隔2、4、7组、右肺门及右锁骨上区多发肿大淋巴结缩小，较大原约25x18mm（IM19)，现约15x14mm（IM17），左肺门及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2, 4, and 7, right hilar region, and right supraclavicular region have decreased in size; the largest previously measured approximately 25x18 mm (IM19) is now approximately 15x14 mm (IM17). No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the left hilar region or bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 右肺下叶磨玻璃小结节同前（IM26），余双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe is stable (IM26); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度同前相仿，左肺上叶胸膜下磨玻璃密度结节，追查
text_en: Ground-glass opacity in the right upper lobe is similar to prior. Subpleural ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下多发磨玻璃密度小结节同前，约2-5mm（Im37、41、44、54）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural multiple ground-glass opacity nodules unchanged from prior, approximately 2-5 mm (Im37, 41, 44, 54)

source_text: 左肺下叶GGO同前相仿，右肺中叶模糊小结节，随诊复查
text_en: Ground-glass opacity in the left lower lobe is similar to prior. Indistinct small nodule in the right middle lobe; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔肿物术后，局部见小片状软组织灶较前缩小，原约20x6mm（IM26），现约9x6mm（IM22）
text_en: Postoperative for mediastinal mass, local small patch of soft tissue focus reduced in size compared to previous, previously approximately 20x6mm (IM26), currently approximately 9x6mm (IM22).

source_text: 双肺内多发小结节同前，较大约5mm（IM26、50）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged compared to prior, largest approximately 5 mm (IM26, 50).

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段近膈肌上方扁平样结节影同前，大小约8x3mm（IM66）
text_en: The flat-appearing nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe near the diaphragm is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 8x3 mm (IM66).

source_text: 两肺索条影同前，两肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Linear opacities in both lungs are stable; no new nodules or consolidations are seen in either lung.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段模糊小片影同前（IM24），余肺内未见新发结节或斑片影
text_en: The indistinct small patchy opacity in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe remains stable (IM24); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen elsewhere in the lungs.

source_text: 右下肺及左上肺小结节及磨玻璃密度影大致同前
text_en: Small nodules and ground-glass opacities in the right lower lung and left upper lung largely unchanged.

source_text: 双肺散在微结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: Scattered micronodules in both lungs are unchanged, favoring benign.

source_text: 左肺上叶上舌段可见磨玻璃结节同前，大小约9x5mm（IM27），边界清，内见少许偏实性成分同前
text_en: A ground-glass nodule in the superior lingular segment of the left upper lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 9x5 mm (IM27), with well-defined margins and a small amount of partial solid component, as previously noted.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约22x11mm（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged, the largest approximately 22x11 mm (IM19).

source_text: 前纵隔模糊低密度影较前缩小，现约19x16mm（IMA22）原约36*17mm（IM20），建议随诊观察
text_en: Indistinct low-density shadow in the anterior mediastinum has decreased in size compared to prior, now approximately 19x16 mm (IMA22), previously approximately 36x17 mm (IM20); follow-up observation recommended.

source_text: 右肺中叶及左肺下叶胸膜下少许2-3mm点状小结节同前
text_en: A few 2–3 mm punctate subpleural nodules in the right middle lobe and left lower lobe are unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺尖微结节同前，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: Right apical micronodule unchanged; old focus favored.

source_text: 纵隔2、4、5、7组及双肺门散在淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Scattered lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2, 4, 5, 7 and bilateral hilar regions essentially unchanged from previous.

source_text: 左下肺胸主动脉旁肿物较前略增大，仍考虑良性病变
text_en: The mass adjacent to the descending aorta in the left lower lobe is slightly larger than prior; benign lesion is still considered.

source_text: 考虑骨转移较前略进展，结合临床
text_en: Consider osseous metastasis with slight progression compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺胸膜下陈旧灶同前，双肺未见新生结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Chronic findings in the subpleural regions of both lungs are stable; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶钙化灶及索条影同前相仿，余肺内未见新发结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Calcific foci and linear opacities in the right lower lobe are similar to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺舌叶微小结节同前，约3mm（IM32），追查
text_en: Left lung lingula: small nodule unchanged, approximately 3 mm (Image 32), follow-up recommended

source_text: 右肺下叶多发钙化灶同前，余肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Multiple calcified foci in the right lower lobe are unchanged; no new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 双肺散在少许3-4mm微小结节同前（IM24-25、36）
text_en: Scattered few 3-4 mm tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM24-25, 36).

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结大致同前，小于5mm
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes essentially unchanged from previous, less than 5mm

source_text: 吻合口旁类圆形小结节较前略显增大，原约12x8mm，现约15x10mm（Im5），性质待定，转移待排，建议密切追查
text_en: A round nodule adjacent to the anastomosis is slightly larger than before, previously measuring approximately 12x8 mm, now approximately 15x10 mm (Im5); the nature is undetermined, metastasis cannot be excluded, and close follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上及纵隔小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular and mediastinal regions are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段与背段交界处磨玻璃密度结节同前，现仍约7x6mm（IM35），边缘清楚，内部见血管穿行，未见明显实性成分，追查
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule at the junction of the outer basal and dorsal segments of the right lower lobe is unchanged from prior, currently still approximately 7x6 mm (IM35), with clear margins, internal vascular passage visible, no obvious solid component seen, and requires follow-up.

source_text: 双侧锁骨上及纵隔散在小淋巴结同前
text_en: Scattered small lymph nodes in the bilateral supraclavicular regions and mediastinum are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 胸骨体骨质密度增高较前新发，转移可能，建议核医学骨扫描检查
text_en: Newly developed increased bone density in the sternal body, possible metastasis. Recommend nuclear medicine bone scan examination.

source_text: 气管隆突下低密度结节较前相仿
text_en: Subcarinal low-density nodule unchanged from prior.

source_text: 部分大小同前，如右肺上叶玻璃样结节，现仍约17x14mm(IM14)
text_en: Some similar in size to prior, such as the ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe, now still approximately 17x14 mm (image 14).

source_text: 右肺散在微小结节同前，观察
text_en: Scattered tiny nodules in the right lung are unchanged; observation recommended.

source_text: 右肺中叶见实性结节同前，约3mm（IM33）
text_en: A solid nodule is seen in the right middle lobe, unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM33).

source_text: 扫及右侧肾上腺软组织结节大致同前
text_en: On scan, right adrenal soft-tissue nodule stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段与尖后段交界区近纵隔旁肿块较前明显缩小，现约24*19mm(图17)，原约38x32mm（IM15）
text_en: Adjacent to the mediastinum at the junction of the anterior and apicoposterior segments of the left upper lobe, a mass has significantly decreased compared to previous, now approximately 24x19 mm (Figure 17), previously approximately 38x32 mm (IM15).

source_text: 右锁骨上淋巴结较前增大，追查
text_en: Right supraclavicular lymph node is increased in size compared to prior, follow-up recommended

source_text: 右下肺结节同前
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior imaging.

source_text: 右肺底小结节灶同前，约8x6mm（IM41）
text_en: Small nodule in the right lung base is unchanged, measuring approximately 8x6 mm (IM41).

source_text: 双肺清晰，原左肺下叶基底段不规则结节较前完全吸收，现局部未见异常密度灶
text_en: Lungs are clear bilaterally. The previously noted irregular nodule in the left lower lobe basal segment has completely resolved and no abnormal density is currently seen at this location.

source_text: 右肺内散在钙化结节及索条影同前
text_en: Scattered calcified nodules and linear opacities in the right lung are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 两肺新见微小结节，较大约4mm（IMA46），不除外转移，密切观察
text_en: New micro-nodules in both lungs, the largest approximately 4 mm (IMA46); metastasis not excluded; close observation advised.

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下钙化结节同前
