text_en: Calcified subpleural nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔4、5组多发小淋巴结同前相仿，较大约11x6mm（IM25）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4 and 5 similar to prior, largest measuring approximately 11x6 mm (IM25)

source_text: 左肺下叶结节增大，左肺上叶尖段新发磨玻璃结节，右肺上叶结节密度增高，不除外恶性可能，密切追查
text_en: Left lower lobe nodule increased in size; new ground-glass nodule in the apical segment of the left upper lobe; increased density of nodule in the right upper lobe, malignancy cannot be excluded; close follow-up.

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段、下叶基底段少许索条影较前吸收，未见新发结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Slight linear opacities in left upper lobe lingular segment and lower lobe basal segments absorbed compared to previous; no new nodules or patchy opacities

source_text: 余肺少许索条影同前，未见新发斑片影及结节灶
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the remaining lung are stable. No new patchy opacities or nodules are seen.

source_text: 甲状腺右叶下极结节同前（IM3）
text_en: Nodule in the inferior pole of the right thyroid lobe unchanged from prior (IM3).

source_text: 右肺中间干支气管内侧肺韧带内软组织结节较前缩小，原约20x8mm（IM31），现约11x7mm（IM30）
text_en: The soft-tissue nodule within the pulmonary ligament medial to the right intermediate bronchus has further decreased in size, previously measuring approximately 20x8 mm (IM31), now approximately 11x7 mm (IM30).

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜旁结节大致同前，约10*6mm(图31)
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural nodule essentially unchanged, approximately 10x6mm (Figure 31)

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结较前增大，原约11x7mm（IM30），现约16x8mm，建议追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes enlarged compared to prior, previously approximately 11x7 mm (IM30), now approximately 16x8 mm, recommend follow-up

source_text: 左肺及叶间胸膜多发小结节同前，现仍约4-5mm（Im25、29）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left lung and interlobar pleura unchanged, still approximately 4-5 mm in size (Im25, 29).

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段结节较前相仿，约3mm（IM39），追查
text_en: The nodule in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM39); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺点条灶同前，未见新发结节
text_en: Left lung punctate and linear opacities unchanged, no new nodules.

source_text: 两肺散在斑片状影、小结节影同前
text_en: The scattered patchy opacities and small nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 右侧肋骨术后改变及T11椎体低密度灶较前相仿，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right rib and low-density focus in the T11 vertebral body are similar to prior. No evidence of osseous destruction in the other bones of the thorax.

source_text: 纵隔多个小淋巴结同前，较大约10*8mm(图20)
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest approximately 10x8 mm (Figure 20)

source_text: 左肺未见新发结节病灶
text_en: No new nodules in the left lung.

source_text: 余双肺散在模糊小结节同前，左肺尖较大约7*4mm（IM10）
text_en: Residual scattered indistinct small nodules in both lungs are unchanged; the largest in the left lung apex measures approximately 7x4 mm (IM10)

source_text: 双肺弥漫多发磨玻璃密度结节同前，右侧为著，右肺中叶较实者约9x7mm（IMA32），边缘可见细毛刺，周围肺野清晰
text_en: Diffusely distributed multiple ground-glass nodules in both lungs are stable, more prominent on the right. The more solid nodule in the right middle lobe measures approximately 9x7 mm (IMA32), with fine spiculated margins and clear surrounding lung parenchyma.

source_text: 左肱骨头结节状致密影同前，考虑骨岛（Im5），胸廓诸骨未见明确破坏征象
text_en: Nodular dense opacity in the left humeral head is unchanged, considered enostosis (Im5); no definite osseous destruction is seen in the visualized bones of the thorax.

source_text: 右肺门及下叶血管束旁多发淋巴结大致同前，追查
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes adjacent to the right hilum and lower lobe vascular bundles are stable compared to prior; continued follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔多枚淋巴结同前，较大者约15x7mm（IMA22）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior; largest approximately 15x7 mm (IMA22).

source_text: 胸骨前软组织小结节同前（IM13）
text_en: Small soft tissue nodule anterior to sternum, unchanged from previous (IM13)

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，右肺下叶背段支气管闭塞，软组织密度肿块缩小，原约43x29mm，现约34x20mm（IM36），增强扫描可见强化，部分包绕右下肺动脉，部分层面斜裂牵拉改变，远侧可见多发斑片影减少
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Lung parenchymal lucency is uniform. The bronchus in the dorsal segment of the right lower lobe is obstructed. The soft-tissue density mass has decreased in size, previously measuring approximately 43x29 mm, now measuring approximately 34x20 mm (IM36). Enhancement is seen on contrast scanning, with partial encasement of the right lower pulmonary artery and traction changes of the oblique fissure in some sections. Distal patchy opacities have decreased.

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门淋巴结同前，较大约10mm（IMA18）
text_en: Mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous, the largest approximately 10 mm (IMA18).

source_text: T1椎板、T11椎体高密度小结节同前
text_en: Small high-density nodule in T1 lamina and T11 vertebral body unchanged

source_text: 左下叶胸膜下实性小结节同前，约5x4mm（IM47），余肺内透亮度均匀，未见结节或实变影
text_en: Small solid subpleural nodule in the left lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 5x4 mm (IM47). The remainder of the lung parenchyma shows uniform lucency without nodules or consolidation.

source_text: 双肺门多发淋巴结较前相仿，因平扫与血管分界不清，较大约15x11mm（IM32）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes at both hila are similar to prior; due to non-contrast imaging, boundaries with vessels are unclear, the largest measuring approximately 15x11 mm (IM32).

source_text: 双肺结节灶大致同前
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary nodules are roughly stable.

source_text: 左肺门见淋巴结同前，约17x12mm（IM28）
text_en: Left hilar lymph node unchanged from previous, approximately 17x12 mm (IM28).

source_text: 胸8椎体高密度结节同前
text_en: Dense nodule in T8 vertebra, unchanged from previous.

source_text: 均考虑转移可能，追查
text_en: All are considered possibly metastatic; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双肺结节增多、增大，均考虑转移
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary nodules have increased in number and size; all are considered metastatic.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸主动脉旁小结节影同前，约6x4mm（IM32）
text_en: A small nodule adjacent to the thoracic aorta in the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 6x4 mm (IM32).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段模糊小结节大小同前，仍约4mm（IM10）
text_en: Stable ill-defined small nodule in left upper lobe apicoposterior segment, approximately 4 mm (IM10)

source_text: 右肺下叶斑点状影同前（Im28），右肺下叶背段新见浅淡小结节影（IMA33）
text_en: Punctate opacities in the right lower lobe are stable (Im28); a new faint small nodule is seen in the dorsal segment of the right lower lobe (IMA33).

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结较前缩小，现约11x5mm（IM35），原为13x9mm（IM35）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is smaller compared to prior, now approximately 11x5 mm (IM35), previously 13x9 mm (IM35)

source_text: 肺气肿同前，肺内散在数枚小结节同前（Im31等），未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: Emphysema unchanged; scattered small nodules in the lung unchanged (Im31, etc.); no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端周围软组织结构紊乱较前减轻（IM22），下方结节约12x10mm（IMA23），同前相仿
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; disorganized soft tissue structures around the bronchial stump have improved compared to prior (IM22). The nodule below measures approximately 12 x 10 mm (IMA23), similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段不规则软组织肿块大致同前，仍约35x25mm（IM24），分叶状，与水平裂广基接触可见叶间胸膜凹陷牵拉，考虑肺癌可能大，肿瘤可能侵犯叶间胸膜
text_en: Irregular soft tissue mass in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe is roughly unchanged, still approximately 35x25mm (IM24); lobulated; broad-based contact with the horizontal fissure with pleural indentation and traction; lung cancer is highly likely; tumor may invade the interlobar pleura.

source_text: 右肺尖结节同前，约4mm（IM26）
text_en: Nodule in the right lung apex is unchanged, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM26).

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下结节较前相仿，现仍约8mm（Im14），右肺下叶条状结节同前（IM32）
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural nodule similar to previous, now still approximately 8mm (Im14); right lower lobe linear nodule unchanged (IM32)

source_text: 右肺内微小结节、点状钙化及索条影同前（IMA17、22），双肺内未见新发结节灶
text_en: Micro-nodules, punctate calcifications, and linear opacities in the right lung are stable compared to prior (IMA17, 22); no new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜结节同前，现仍约10*9mm（IM30），左侧胸膜光滑，双侧未见胸水征象
text_en: The nodular lesion along the right interlobar pleura is unchanged, currently measuring approximately 10 x 9 mm (IM30). The left pleura is smooth. No pleural effusion is seen bilaterally.

source_text: 左肺下叶类结节影同前，追查
text_en: The nodular opacity in the left lower lobe is unchanged, follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔稍大淋巴结同前
text_en: Slightly enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes as before.

source_text: 扫及左肩胛骨高密度结节灶同前，余胸廓诸骨未见明确破坏征象
text_en: On imaging, a high-density nodular lesion in the left scapula is unchanged from prior; no definite bone destruction is seen in the other thoracic bones.

source_text: 余纵隔多发较高密度淋巴结较前相仿，较大者仍约17x9mm（IM23）
text_en: The remaining multiple higher-attenuation mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior; the largest remains approximately 17x9 mm (IM23).

source_text: 左肺多发小结节较前增大，密度增高，考虑转移
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left lung have increased in size and density compared to prior, with metastasis considered

source_text: 纵隔2组淋巴结较前稍小，原约10x7mm，现约10x5mm（IM16）
text_en: Mediastinal station 2 lymph nodes slightly decreased compared to previous, previously approximately 10x7 mm, currently approximately 10x5 mm (IM16).

source_text: 右肺上叶见多发结节影同前，部分内含空泡，较大者约6mm（IM17），边缘模糊
text_en: Multiple nodular opacities are seen in the right upper lobe, unchanged, some containing air bronchograms; the largest measures approximately 6 mm (IM17), with blurred margins.

source_text: 诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: No bone destruction is seen in all bones.

source_text: 双肺散在实性结节部分同前、部分遮蔽未见显示，追查
text_en: Some of the scattered solid nodules in both lungs are unchanged, while others are obscured and not visible. Follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 6组可见多个小淋巴结同前，较大仍约12x7mm（IM16）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes are visible in station 6, similar to prior; the largest remains about 12x7 mm (IM16).

source_text: 右肺门、纵隔2R、4R、7肿大淋巴结较前略缩小，现较大约20*12mm(图24)，原约24x12mm（IM25）
text_en: Enlarged lymph nodes at the right hilum and mediastinum (stations 2R, 4R, 7) are slightly smaller than prior; the largest now measures approximately 20 x 12 mm (Figure 24), previously about 24 x 12 mm (IM25).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则结节较前略增大，建议追查
text_en: The irregular nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe has slightly increased in size compared to prior; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 新见少许斑点、结节
text_en: Newly identified a few spots and nodules

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结较前缩小，较大原约13x10mm，现约9x8mm（IM23）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes have decreased in size compared to previous; the largest was previously approximately 13x10 mm and is now approximately 9x8 mm (IM23).

source_text: 左肺下叶背段与后基底段支气管后方软组织结节较前增大，原约10mm，现约13mm（Im33），平扫前缘边界不清
text_en: A soft tissue nodule posterior to the bronchus in the left lower lobe, apical and posterior basal segments, increased in size compared to prior, from approximately 10 mm to approximately 13 mm (Im33), with ill-defined anterior margin on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 右肺下叶后基底段片状影基本吸收，右肺中叶及左肺下叶少许索条影同前，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: The patchy opacity in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is nearly resolved; a few fibrotic bands in the right middle lobe and left lower lobe remain unchanged, and no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 左乳结节大致同前（IM32）
text_en: The nodule in the left breast is largely unchanged compared to prior (IM32).

source_text: 右肺术后改变，双肺陈旧病灶同前
text_en: Findings of prior right lung surgery; chronic parenchymal changes in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 气管右侧旁淋巴结较前略增大，原约10x7mm（IM9），现约10x10mm（IM13），左锁骨上小淋巴结同前（IM9）
text_en: Right paratracheal lymph node slightly increased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 10x7 mm (IM9), now approximately 10x10 mm (IM13); small left supraclavicular lymph node unchanged (IM9).

source_text: 组淋巴结同前，约14x8mm（IM31）
text_en: Group lymph node unchanged, approximately 14x8 mm (IM31)

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，胸部未见明确转移复发征象
text_en: Status post right upper lobe resection; no definite signs of metastatic recurrence in the chest.

source_text: 左肺下叶不规则实性结节略饱满，呈条带状，边缘模糊，见索条影与胸膜牵拉，轴位较大层面原约7x5mm（IM32），现约8x7mm（IM31）
text_en: Irregular solid nodule in the left lower lobe, slightly prominent, band-like, with ill-defined margins, showing linear opacities and pleural traction. Largest dimension on axial view was previously approximately 7x5mm (IM32) and is now approximately 8x7mm (IM31).

source_text: 纵隔、锁骨上小淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal and supraclavicular small lymph nodes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 余双肺散在多发结节影大致同前（Im11、32、37、39），追查
text_en: Residual scattered multiple nodules in both lungs are approximately unchanged (Im11, 32, 37, 39); follow-up recommended

source_text: 右侧胸膜稍厚，左斜裂胸膜小结节同前，约3mm（IM36）
text_en: The right pleura is slightly thickened. The small nodule along the left oblique fissure pleura is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM36).

source_text: 余双肺胸膜下散在少许小结节同前，较大约6mm（IM29）
text_en: Scattered small subpleural nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior, largest measuring approximately 6 mm (IM29).

source_text: 右肺下叶钙化及局部索条影同前，余肺未见新生结节及异常密度区
text_en: Calcification and focal linear opacities in the right lower lobe are unchanged compared to prior; no new nodules or abnormal density areas are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 双肺多发肺大泡及索条影同前，未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Multiple bullae and linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged from prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 两肺3-4mm微结节（IM30，40)，较前相仿
text_en: 3-4 mm micronodules in both lungs (IM30, 40) are similar to prior.

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前，现较大约8*5mm(IM23).
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, largest approximately 8x5 mm (IM23).

source_text: 纵隔4L-7组、9R组见多发淋巴结同前，较大约17x9mm（IM27）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes visible at stations 4L-7 and 9R unchanged from previous, largest approximately 17x9 mm (IM27).

source_text: 右肺下叶支气管复现，管壁增厚减轻，周围肿块较前明显缩小，原约51x40mm（IM44），现呈条片影，范围约38x27mm（IM40），远端肺组织大部分复张
text_en: Reappearance of the right lower lobe bronchus with reduced wall thickening; the surrounding mass has markedly decreased in size, previously approximately 51x40 mm (IM44), now appearing as a linear and patchy opacity measuring approximately 38x27 mm (IM40). Most of the distal lung parenchyma has re-expanded.

source_text: 未见新发结节灶及斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜浅淡小结节同前，较大仍约5x3mm（IM31）
text_en: Faint small nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior; the largest remains approximately 5x3 mm (IM31).

source_text: 双肺少许索条影同前，右肺下叶见一微小结节影（IM22），约2mm，边界清楚
text_en: Few linear opacities in both lungs are stable; a tiny nodule is seen in the right lower lobe (IM22), measuring approximately 2 mm with well-defined margins.

source_text: 左肺尖陈旧灶同前，双肺未见新生结节
text_en: Old lesion at the left lung apex unchanged from prior; no new nodules in both lungs.

source_text: 未见明确新发
text_en: No definite new lesions

source_text: 左下叶肺癌术后改变，胸部CT较前无明显变化
text_en: Postoperative changes from prior left lower lobectomy for lung cancer; chest CT shows no significant change compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶及双肺下叶散在磨玻璃密度微结节大致同前，均小于5mm
text_en: Scattered ground-glass density micro-nodules in the right middle lobe and bilateral lower lobes are essentially unchanged, all measuring less than 5 mm.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜及双侧胸膜多发结节状增厚稍增大，右肺尖胸膜结节较前稍大，如较厚原约5mm，现约8mm（IM15）
text_en: Multiple nodular thickenings of the right interlobar pleura and bilateral pleura are slightly increased in size. The pleural nodule at the right lung apex is slightly larger than before, increasing from approximately 5 mm to approximately 8 mm (IM15).

source_text: 左肺门及9组肿大淋巴结较前缩小，原约20x15mm（IMA29），现约11x9mm（IM30）
text_en: Left hilar and station 9 enlarged lymph nodes decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 20x15mm (IMA29), currently approximately 11x9mm (IM30).

source_text: 右肺门肿大淋巴结同前，仍约11x10mm（IM28）
text_en: The enlarged right hilar lymph node is unchanged from prior, still measuring approximately 11 x 10 mm (IM28).

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段混杂磨玻璃密度结节大致同前，约13x11mm（IMA16），可见胸膜凹陷
text_en: Mixed ground-glass density nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is essentially unchanged, approximately 13 × 11 mm (IMA16), with visible pleural indentation.

source_text: 双肺下叶后基底段可见磨玻璃密度影同前，双侧肺内未见新发结节灶
text_en: Ground-glass opacity is seen in the posterior basal segments of both lower lobes, unchanged from prior. No new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 双肺未见明确新发结节影
text_en: No definite new nodules are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 双肺纹理增重，右肺上叶尖段，左肺上叶舌段见少量小结节同前，较大约3mm（IM9），形态不规则
text_en: Increased lung markings. A few small nodules in the right upper lobe apical segment and left upper lobe lingular segment are similar to prior. The largest is about 3 mm (IM9), with irregular morphology.

source_text: 右侧第2前肋骨膨胀性骨质破坏范围同前（Im13），呈肥皂泡样，边缘骨质硬化
text_en: Expansile bony destruction in the right 2nd anterior rib is stable (Im13), appearing soap-bubble-like with sclerotic margins.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺左叶下极低密度结节伴钙化大致同前（IM7）
text_en: Low-density nodule with calcification in the lower pole of the left thyroid lobe, unchanged from prior (IM7).

source_text: 右上肺术后，未见复发及转移征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lung; no signs of recurrence or metastasis are seen.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上区多发肿大淋巴结大致同前，现较大仍约19x9mm(IM19)
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, and supraclavicular areas are largely unchanged, with the largest still measuring approximately 19x9 mm (Image 19).

source_text: 两肺点状小结节大致同前，约4mm（IM13、16、26、43）
text_en: The punctate small nodules in both lungs are approximately unchanged, about 4 mm (IM13, 16, 26, 43).

source_text: 余纵膈多发小淋巴结大致同前
text_en: The remaining multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes are approximately unchanged.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段胸膜下肿块略缩小，现约17x17mm（IMA32），原约20*16mm（IM32）
text_en: A subpleural mass in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is slightly decreased in size, currently approximately 17x17 mm (IMA32), previously approximately 20x16 mm (IM32).

source_text: 食管癌术后，纵隔多发积气较前减少，右侧胸腔上部包裹性液气胸较前缩小，气液平缩小
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer, multiple pneumomediastinum decreased compared to prior, encapsulated hydropneumothorax in the upper right pleural cavity decreased compared to prior, air-fluid level decreased.

source_text: 双肺胸膜下多发微结节同前，约2mm（IM15、43）
text_en: Multiple subpleural micro-nodules in both lungs are stable, measuring approximately 2 mm (IM15, 43).

source_text: 左肺上叶斑片灶及其下方磨玻璃结节大致同前，建议追查
text_en: Patchy opacity in the left upper lobe and ground-glass nodule below it largely unchanged; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 双肺下叶小结节同前（IM35、43、48），较大约4mm（IM35）
text_en: Small nodules in both lower lobes are stable compared to prior (IM35, 43, 48), the largest measuring approximately 4 mm (IM35).

source_text: 左肺下叶背段模糊结节同前（IM29），追查
text_en: Left lower lobe dorsal segment indistinct nodule unchanged from prior (IM29). Recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后大致同前，胸部CT未见新生占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lobe are essentially unchanged. Chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 两肺微小结节影同前
text_en: The tiny nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 6组多个小淋巴结同前，较大仍约12x7mm（IM17）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in station 6 are unchanged; the largest remains about 12x7 mm (IM17).

source_text: 左肺下叶长椭圆形结节同前，约9x4mm（IM44）
text_en: Oval nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous, approximately 9x4 mm (IM44).

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结较前缩小，现约10x8mm(IM26)，原约16x9mm（IM24），平扫高密度影
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes are decreased in size compared to prior, currently approximately 10x8 mm (IM26), previously approximately 16x9 mm (IM24), with high-density opacity on non-contrast scan

source_text: 左肺下叶散在多发微小结节同前，较大仍约4mm（IM34）
text_en: Scattered multiple tiny nodules in the left lower lobe unchanged from prior, largest still approximately 4 mm (IM34)

source_text: 双肺小结节部分同前，现较大仍约5mm（IM48）
text_en: Some bilateral pulmonary small nodules are stable compared to prior, the largest remains approximately 5 mm (IM48)

source_text: 左下肺磨玻璃密度结节大小、形态及密度特征同前，约9x6mm（Im37）
text_en: Ground-glass density nodule in the left lower lobe shows no change in size, morphology, or density characteristics, measuring approximately 9x6 mm (Im37).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃灶，原约9*9mm(图13)，现约12x8mm（IM15），并少许索条影及局部远端支气管略扩张同前
text_en: Ground-glass opacity in the right upper lobe, previously approximately 9x9 mm (Figure 13), now approximately 12x8 mm (IM15), with a few linear strands and mild distal bronchial dilatation unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺散在小结节较前相仿，较大约6mm（IM42）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right lung are similar to prior, the largest measuring approximately 6 mm (IM42).

source_text: 左肺未见新增结节
text_en: No new nodules in the left lung.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下结节同前，仍约6mm（IM23）
text_en: Subpleural nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, still approximately 6 mm (IM23).

source_text: 右肺中叶钙化结节同前
text_en: Calcified nodule in the right middle lobe is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结较前相仿，大小约10x7mm（IM28）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph node similar in size compared to prior, approximately 10x7 mm (IM28).

source_text: 食管胸中下段癌，较前明显缩小
text_en: Esophageal carcinoma in the mid-to-lower thoracic esophagus, significantly reduced compared to prior.

source_text: 余双肺未见新发结节和斑片影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no new nodules and patchy opacities.

source_text: 右肺上叶结节影大致同前，约14x10mm（IM20）
text_en: The nodule in the right upper lobe is largely unchanged, measuring approximately 14x10 mm (IM20).

source_text: 余两肺散在模糊斑片、小结节影同前
text_en: Scattered indistinct patchy opacities and small nodules in the remainder of both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 双肺未见新增结节及片絮灶
text_en: No new nodules or flaky opacities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下小结节灶大致同前，约4mm（IM26），余肺内未见新增结节及实变影
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural nodule approximately stable compared to prior, approximately 4 mm (IM26), no new nodules or consolidation in the remaining lung

source_text: 扫及右侧甲状腺低密度结节影同前
text_en: CT shows a low-density nodular shadow in the right thyroid gland similar to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节影同前，约4mm（IMA14）
text_en: Nodule with ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe is unchanged from prior, approximately 4 mm (IMA14).

source_text: 左上胸膜下小结节影同前（IM16）
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged (IM16).

source_text: 隆突下淋巴结较前缩小，短径约1cm
text_en: Subcarinal lymph nodes reduced compared to prior, short axis diameter approximately 1 cm.

source_text: 右肺门及纵隔淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Right hilar and mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior findings; continued follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 新见簇状分布模糊结节
text_en: Newly seen clustered ill-defined nodules

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影同前，右肺下叶结节增大，现约12mm（IM39），原为8mm（IM36），左肺下叶3mm圆形小结节同前（IM44），余肺未见新增结节灶
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged; the nodule in the right lower lobe has increased in size, now approximately 12 mm (IM39), previously 8 mm (IM36); a 3 mm round nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged (IM44); no new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见占位征象，左侧少量胸水较前减少，左肺上叶局部膨胀不全较前减轻
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, no space-occupying lesion at bronchial stump; left small pleural effusion decreased compared to prior; left upper lobe focal atelectasis improved compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4、7、10R组淋巴结同前相仿，较大者约14x10mm（IM24、31）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R, 4, 7, and 10R are similar to previous, with the largest measuring approximately 14x10 mm (IM24, 31).

source_text: 右下肺结节较前略缩小，原约15X10mm，现约15x7mm（IM44)，右肺散在索条影同前，余肺野未见肺内结节或斑片影
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is slightly smaller compared to prior examination, previously approximately 15x10 mm, now approximately 15x7 mm (IM44). Scattered linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged. No pulmonary nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节，较前略增大，追查
text_en: The small nodule in the right middle lobe is slightly larger than before; further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺及右肺中叶多发索条影同前，左肺上叶胸膜下小结节同前，大小约3mm（IM17）
text_en: Multiple linear opacities in the left lung and right middle lobe unchanged, small subpleural nodule in the left upper lobe unchanged, approximately 3 mm in size (IM17).

source_text: 两肺局限性纤维化条索影同前，未见新增结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: The localized fibrotic linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged; no new nodules or fluffy opacities are seen.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段磨玻璃密度结节同前，约9x6mm（IM31），边缘模糊，未见明显实性成分
text_en: Left lower lobe dorsal segment ground-glass density nodule unchanged, approximately 9x6 mm (IM31), with blurred margins, no obvious solid component seen

source_text: 左肺上叶散在微小结节部分同前，＜5mm（图12）
text_en: Scattered tiny nodules in the left upper lobe partially unchanged, less than 5mm (Figure 12)

source_text: 右上肺不规则索条影较前相仿，双肺小结节较前相仿（IM36、47、57、59）
text_en: Irregular linear opacity in the right upper lung is similar to prior; small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior (IM36, 47, 57, 59).

source_text: 前纵隔结节较前缩小
text_en: The anterior mediastinal nodule is smaller compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔5组高密度淋巴结较前相仿，4L及6组淋巴结同前，锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal station 5 hyperdense lymph nodes similar to prior, stations 4L and 6 lymph nodes unchanged, no lymphadenopathy in supraclavicular regions

source_text: 双肺散在索条影较前减少、变淡，未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Scattered linear opacities in both lungs are decreased in number and less prominent than prior. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 右上纵隔内数枚圆形淋巴结同前，较大者约9mm（Im14）
text_en: Several round lymph nodes in the right upper mediastinum are unchanged, the largest measuring approximately 9 mm (Im14).

source_text: 两肺内及胸膜下散在点状致密小结节灶同前，两肺不规则条索同前
text_en: Scattered punctate dense small nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior; irregular linear opacities in both lungs are also unchanged.

source_text: 右肺中叶及下叶支气管壁增厚、邻近肺门不规则软组织密度灶较前相仿（IMA32），局部结节较前缩小，原约19mm（IM36），现约15mm（IM33）
text_en: Bronchial wall thickening in the right middle and lower lobes and the adjacent irregular soft tissue density focus are similar to prior (IMA32). The local nodule has decreased in size, measuring approximately 19 mm previously (IM36) and now approximately 15 mm (IM33).

source_text: 背部皮下结节较前增大，追查
text_en: Subcutaneous nodule on the back is larger compared to prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 甲状腺右叶低密度结节同前，约12x12mm（IM5）
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right lobe of the thyroid gland unchanged from prior, approximately 12x12 mm (IM5).

source_text: 右肺内未见新增结节及实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation are seen in the right lung.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内可见多发钙化小结节同前
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Multiple calcified small nodules are seen in the lungs, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺叶间胸膜结节及左肺下叶结节同前
text_en: Nodules along the right interlobar pleura and in the left lower lobe are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左侧第3肋骨局限性低密度灶并边缘硬化同前（Im17），余诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Focal low-density lesion in the left 3rd rib with sclerotic margins unchanged (Im17); no osseous destruction seen in the remainder of the visualized bones.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结较前略缩小，原约14x13mm，现约14x10mm（Im31）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is slightly smaller compared to prior, previously approximately 14x13 mm, now approximately 14x10 mm (Im31)

source_text: 部分淋巴结肿大，原小于6mm，现较大约22x14mm（IM13），追查，除外恶性
text_en: Some lymph nodes are enlarged, previously less than 6mm, now approximately 22x14mm (IM13), with further investigation to exclude malignancy.

source_text: 胸椎椎体多发骨质增生同前，扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Multiple osteophytes in the thoracic vertebral bodies unchanged from previous; no evidence of bone destruction in all scanned bones.

source_text: 相仿
text_en: Unchanged

source_text: 扫及右肾上腺结节同前（Im53）
text_en: On scan, right adrenal nodule unchanged from prior (Im53)

source_text: 左下叶磨玻璃密度结节同前，仍约6mm(IM36)
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged, still approximately 6 mm (IM36).

source_text: 余双肺未见新发异常密度灶
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no new abnormal density.

source_text: 右肺中叶、胸膜下条索影同前，左肺未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: Subpleural linear opacities in the right middle lobe unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities seen in the left lung

source_text: 两肺小结节影同前（IMA28、30、33、46）
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior (IMA28, 30, 33, 46)

source_text: 右上纵隔内圆形淋巴结同前，较大者约9mm（Im10）
text_en: Round lymph nodes in the right upper mediastinum are unchanged from prior; the largest measures approximately 9 mm (Im10).

source_text: 食管胸下段管壁环周增厚较前明显，现较大外径约47*34mm(图43)，原约37*27mm（IMA44），增强扫描明显强化，累及管壁全层，外膜面稍欠光滑，与胸主动脉之间脂肪间隙存在
text_en: Circumferential wall thickening of the lower thoracic esophagus is significantly increased compared to prior, with current larger outer diameter approximately 47*34 mm (Figure 43), previously approximately 37*27 mm (IMA44). On contrast-enhanced scan, it shows marked enhancement, involves the full thickness of the wall, the adventitial surface is slightly irregular, and the fat plane between the esophagus and thoracic aorta is preserved.

source_text: 右肺中叶新见多发结节索条灶，较大约8x6mm（IM40）
text_en: Multiple new nodular and linear opacities are seen in the right middle lobe, with the largest measuring approximately 8x6 mm (IM40).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大仍约12x10mm（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest measures approximately 12x10 mm (IM19).

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下浅淡结节同前（IM19）
text_en: Subpleural faint nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior (IM19).

source_text: 食管癌术后改变，局部未见复发征象
text_en: Postoperative changes from esophageal cancer; no signs of local recurrence.

source_text: 余扫及诸骨未见新发骨质破坏征象
text_en: No new osseous destruction signs are seen in the bones imaged.

source_text: 原左肺上叶尖后段磨玻璃密度结节，现较前密度减低，体积减小，边缘模糊，约2-3mm（IM13、25、28）
text_en: The previously noted ground-glass opacity nodule in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe now shows decreased density and reduced volume, with blurred margins, approximately 2-3 mm (IM13, 25, 28).

source_text: 余双肺未见新发结节及异常强化区
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no new nodules or areas of abnormal enhancement.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见异常软组织影，远端肺膨胀不全同前，右侧胸膜局限性增厚、少量胸水同前，余肺未见新增结节灶及斑片影
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no abnormal soft tissue density is seen at the bronchial stump. Distal lung atelectasis remains unchanged compared to prior. Localized right pleural thickening and small amount of pleural effusion are stable. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 双肺多发实性小结节部分同前（IM33等），部分被遮挡显示不清
text_en: Some of the multiple small solid nodules in both lungs are stable (IM33, etc.), while others are obscured and not clearly visible.

source_text: 纵隔稍大淋巴结较前相仿，如仍约9x5mm（IM20）
text_en: Slightly enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes similar to previous, still approximately 9x5 mm (IM20).

source_text: 左肺下叶背段磨玻璃结节大致同前，约10x7mm（（IM34），周围边界不清，可疑少许实性成分
text_en: Left lower lobe dorsal segment ground-glass nodule essentially unchanged, approximately 10x7 mm (IM34), with indistinct margins, suspected small solid component

source_text: 纵隔及膈上多发淋巴结，部分肿大，较前缩小，大者原约25x16mm（IM23），现约22x13mm（IM23）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal and supra-diaphragmatic lymph nodes, some enlarged, decreased in size compared to previous; the largest previously approximately 25x16 mm (IM23), now approximately 22x13 mm (IM23).

source_text: 纵隔9组淋巴结影平扫仍未见明显变化
text_en: The lymph node shadow in mediastinal station 9 on non-contrast CT shows no significant change.

source_text: 双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，双肺未见新发占位
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no new space-occupying lesions are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上淋巴结同前相仿，约10mm（IM7）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph node similar to prior, approximately 10 mm (IM7)

source_text: 余肺索条结节影大致同前，较大者如右肺中叶小结节仍约3mm(IM34）
text_en: The linear strands and nodular opacities in the remainder of the lungs are largely unchanged; the largest, such as the small nodule in the right middle lobe, remains approximately 3 mm (IM34).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管残端少许软组织密度影同前，平扫未见新发结节灶
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, minimal soft tissue density at the bronchial stump unchanged from prior, no new nodular lesions on non-contrast imaging.

source_text: 右下肺少许索条影及左肺小结节同前无变化（IM30、35）
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the right lower lobe and a small nodule in the left lung are unchanged compared to prior (IM30, 35).

source_text: 胸廓扫及各骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: No evidence of bone destruction in the thoracic bones on scan.

source_text: 双侧锁骨上区可见多发淋巴结同前，较大者约6mm（IM7），双肺门、双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the bilateral supraclavicular regions are stable compared to prior; the largest is about 6 mm (IM7). No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the bilateral pulmonary hila or axillae.

source_text: 两肺弥漫转移较前好转
text_en: Diffuse metastases in both lungs have improved compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺散在小结节同前（Im17、35、43、47等）同前，双肺未见新生结节或及斑片影
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right lung are unchanged (Im17, 35, 43, 47, etc.) compared to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 新见一小结节
text_en: Newly seen small nodule

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结区软组织密度灶同前，追查
text_en: Soft tissue density focus in mediastinal station 7 lymph node region unchanged from previous, follow-up.

source_text: 右肺上叶及左肺下叶斑点、长条形结节同前，较大仍约8x5mm（IM13）
text_en: Punctate and elongated nodules in the right upper lobe and left lower lobe are stable compared to prior; the largest remains approximately 8x5 mm (IM13).

source_text: 右心膈角处结节增大，转移可能
text_en: Nodule at the right cardiophrenic angle has increased in size; metastasis is possible.

source_text: 原纵隔内淋巴结较前缩小，如2R组原约14x9mm（IM24），现约9x5mm（IM23）
text_en: The mediastinal lymph nodes are smaller than prior; for example, the 2R group was previously 14x9 mm (IM24), now measures 9x5 mm (IM23).

source_text: 肺内散在稍大结节灶同前（29、37、43、45、46），较大者同前，约7*6mm（Im44）
text_en: Scattered slightly larger nodules unchanged (images 29, 37, 43, 45, 46); the largest nodule unchanged, approximately 7x6 mm (Image 44).

source_text: 两肺内多发结节较前不同程度增大，原较大约14mm，现约15mm（IM25)，另如右上肺原直径3mm结节现约5mm（IMA16），考虑转移
text_en: Multiple nodules in both lungs are larger to varying degrees than prior; the previously largest was about 14 mm, now about 15 mm (IM25); additionally, a nodule in the right upper lobe previously measuring 3 mm now measures about 5 mm (IMA16), considered likely metastatic.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺右叶低密度结节同前相仿
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right thyroid lobe, similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺支气管及分支闭塞，周围软组织肿块增大，肿块与肺门肿大淋巴结融合分界不清，原约89x66mm（IMA26），现约100x63mm（IM23），不均匀强化，右肺各叶不张
text_en: Right main bronchus and branches occluded; surrounding soft tissue mass increased in size, fused with enlarged hilar lymph nodes with indistinct margins; previously approximately 89x66 mm (IMA26), now approximately 100x63 mm (IM23), showing heterogeneous enhancement; atelectasis in all right lung lobes

source_text: 左肺下叶背段胸膜下结节同前，仍约5mm（IM28），追查
text_en: A subpleural nodule in the left lower lobe dorsal segment is unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM28), with follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔、右锁骨上淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Mediastinal and right supraclavicular lymph nodes unchanged from previous, follow-up

source_text: 双侧胸膜稍厚，双侧叶间裂上小结节同前
text_en: Bilateral pleura are slightly thickened. Small nodules on bilateral interlobar fissures are unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段实性小结节较前稍增大，现约7mm（IM10），原约5*4mm（IMA10）
text_en: Left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment: solid small nodule slightly increased in size compared to prior, currently approximately 7 mm (IM10), previously approximately 5x4 mm (IMA10).

source_text: 食管癌术后，吻合口漏同前，吻合口旁积气较前增多（引流管植入），纵隔内积液范围缩小
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer, anastomotic leak stable compared to prior, perianastomotic air collection increased (with drainage tube in place), mediastinal fluid collection decreased in extent.

source_text: 右肺上叶片絮结节影及右肺下叶小斑片索条影较前相仿
text_en: Patchy nodular opacity in the right upper lobe and small patchy linear opacity in the right lower lobe are similar to prior

source_text: 右肺下叶模糊小结节同前，约3mm（IM39），余肺未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: The ill-defined small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IM39). No new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见异常软组织密度肿块影，右肺散在背段索条影同前，右肺上叶可疑浅淡小片状影（IMA33）
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no abnormal soft tissue density mass at the bronchial stump. Scattered linear bands in the dorsal segment of the right lung are stable. A faint, questionable patchy opacity in the right upper lobe is noted (IMA33).

source_text: 左胸壁皮下小结节灶同前，约11mm（IM30）
text_en: Left chest wall subcutaneous small nodule stable, approximately 11mm (IM30).

source_text: 左锁骨上小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes in left supraclavicular region unchanged from previous.

source_text: 双肺胸膜旁小结节同前，复查
text_en: Subpleural small nodules in both lungs are stable; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 甲状腺双叶多发结节影同前
text_en: Multiple nodules in bilateral thyroid lobes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下浅淡小结节同前，约3mm（IM39）
text_en: Faint subpleural small nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM39).

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段点状微小结节同前，约3mm（IM28），右肺中叶内侧段钙化灶同前
text_en: Punctate tiny nodule in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe, unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM28). Calcified focus in the medial segment of the right middle lobe remains unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段混杂磨玻璃密度结节整体范围较前略增大，现约19*16mm(图18)，原约17x14mm（Im18）
text_en: Mixed ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment, overall extent slightly increased compared to prior, now approximately 19x16 mm (Figure 18), previously about 17x14 mm (Im18).

source_text: 右上肺癌放射性粒子植入术后，粒子周围结节灶较前增大，原约19x16mm（IM20），现约25x21mm（IM19）
text_en: Post-radiation seed implantation for right upper lung cancer; the nodular focus around the seeds has increased in size, from approximately 19x16 mm (IM20) to 25x21 mm (IM19).

source_text: 纵隔2R及6组淋巴结较前增大，如2R者原约9x8mm，现约13x12mm（IM11），强化均匀，转移不除外，需密切追查
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R and 6 are enlarged compared to prior. For example, the 2R node was approximately 9x8 mm, now approximately 13x12 mm (IM11), with homogeneous enhancement. Metastasis cannot be excluded; close follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔2R淋巴结缩小，原约17x9mm，现约8x4mm（IMA15）
text_en: Lymph node at mediastinal station 2R decreased in size, previously approximately 17x9mm, currently approximately 8x4mm (IMA15)

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，约3mm（IM56）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IM56).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段实性小结节同前，追查
text_en: Small nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged; further follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺结节灶同前相仿，追查
text_en: The right lung nodule is similar to prior; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 胃小弯淋巴结亦较前缩小，原约12x9mm，现约9x5mm（Im57）
text_en: Lymph nodes along the gastric lesser curvature are also smaller compared to prior; previously approximately 12x9 mm, currently approximately 9x5 mm (Im57).

source_text: 纵隔2、4、5、7组散在小淋巴结同前，短径小于10mm，密度较高，部分伴点状钙化
text_en: Scattered small lymph nodes in mediastinal groups 2, 4, 5, 7 are unchanged from previous, with short axis less than 10mm, higher density, and some with punctate calcification

source_text: 右肺上叶原有点状结节大小同前（IM23），前段新见多发簇状分布微小结节，小于5mm，密度浅淡，炎性
text_en: The punctate nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged in size (IM23); new multiple clustered micro-nodules, less than 5 mm with faint density, are seen in the anterior segment, likely inflammatory.

source_text: 右肺上叶索条影、左肺钙化灶同前，右肺浅淡微小结节影同前（IMA19、32）
text_en: Linear opacities in the right upper lobe and calcifications in the left lung are unchanged compared to prior; faint, tiny nodules in the right lung are also unchanged (IMA19, 32)

source_text: 右肺下叶背段小结节稍显缩小，现约2mm(SE402 IM21)，原约3mm（SE402 IM17），密度减低
text_en: Small nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is slightly smaller, now approximately 2 mm (SE402 IM21), previously approximately 3 mm (SE402 IM17), with decreased density.

source_text: 双肺散在多发小结节大致同前，较大者约6mm（IM18）
text_en: Scattered multiple small nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged, the largest measuring approximately 6 mm (IM18).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，左肺下叶后基底段软组织结节较前缩小变淡，原约10x6mm（IM51），现仅余5mm淡片影（IMA46）
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. A soft-tissue nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe has decreased in size and density compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 10x6 mm (IM51), now only a faint 5 mm opacity (IMA46).

source_text: 左肺上叶纵隔旁肺癌较前缩小
text_en: Lung cancer adjacent to mediastinum in left upper lobe decreased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 气管左旁小淋巴结同前，约10x8mm（IM9）
text_en: Left paratracheal small lymph node unchanged, measuring approximately 10x8 mm (IM9).

source_text: 纵隔内14组淋巴结同前（IMA50）
text_en: Mediastinal station 14 lymph nodes are unchanged (IMA50).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃结节灶大致同前，仍约17x13mm（IM26）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe posterior segment is essentially unchanged, still measuring approximately 17 x 13 mm (IM26).

source_text: 纵隔内高密度影同前，数个淋巴结同前，短径小于10mm
text_en: High-density shadow within the mediastinum same as before; several lymph nodes same as before, short axis less than 10mm

source_text: 左侧肾上腺结节同前，请结合腹部评价
text_en: Left adrenal nodule unchanged; correlate with abdominal evaluation.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R、10R组多发增大淋巴结均较前缩小，现较大约12*8mm(图21)，原约18x14mm（IM24)
text_en: Lymphadenopathy in mediastinal stations 2R, 4R, and 10R has decreased in size compared to prior, with the largest now measuring approximately 12x8 mm (Fig 21), previously approximately 18x14 mm (IM24)

source_text: 食管癌术后，胸腔胃，右肺多发索条影较前增多，右肺新见模糊斑片影，渗出灶可能大
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer, intrathoracic stomach, multiple linear opacities in the right lung increased compared to prior, new ill-defined patchy opacities in the right lung, likely representing exudative foci.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下结节较前增大，追查
text_en: The subpleural nodule in the right upper lobe is larger than previously noted; further evaluation is warranted.

source_text: 右肺散在小结节同前
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right lung are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔4、7组数个淋巴结同前相仿，较大仍约13x5mm（IM26），肺门、腋窝及锁骨上平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal stations 4 and 7 several lymph nodes unchanged from prior; largest still approximately 13x5 mm (IM26). Hilar, axillary, and supraclavicular regions on non-contrast scan show no enlarged lymph nodes

source_text: 右肺上叶前段磨玻璃密度小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable; follow-up recommended

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃样结节大致同前，建议追查
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe is essentially unchanged; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 双肺多发小结节较前相仿，追查
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior; further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺新见多发索条影，左肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Newly seen multiple linear opacities in the right lung; no new nodules or consolidation in the left lung.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段不规则团片类结节灶较前相仿，现约14x13mm（IMA32），内见多发不规则小空泡及实性成分，牵拉邻近胸膜
text_en: The irregular patch-like nodular lesion in the apical segment of the right lower lobe is similar to prior, now measuring approximately 14x13 mm (IMA32), with multiple irregular small air bubbles and solid components internally, and it is pulling on the adjacent pleura.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门多发淋巴结较前相仿，如纵隔较大现仍约18*7mm（IM33）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions similar to previous, largest in mediastinum still approximately 18x7 mm (IM33).

source_text: 右肺索条影，局部见小结节同前，约3mm（Im52）
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lung, with a small nodule stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (Im52).

source_text: 左肺上叶结节影同前（IMA32、35），密度较前增高，较大约4mm（IM32）
text_en: Left upper lobe nodule unchanged (Images A32, A35), density increased compared to previous, approximately 4 mm larger (Image 32).

source_text: 左侧胸膜较前增厚，左侧胸膜上结节增多、增大，如原约11x10mm（IM18）者，现约16x11mm（IM18），左侧胸水增多
text_en: Left pleura is thicker than prior; pleural nodules are increased in number and size, such as the one previously measuring approximately 11x10 mm (IM18), now measuring approximately 16x11 mm (IM18); left pleural effusion is increased.

source_text: 两下肺胸膜下索条小结节灶及左上肺陈旧灶同前
text_en: Subpleural linear and nodular opacities in both lower lungs and a chronic lesion in the left upper lung are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔2、4R、4L、5组多发淋巴结大致同前，较大约10x8mm（IM22）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2, 4R, 4L, and 5 essentially unchanged from previous, largest approximately 10x8 mm (IM22).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段不规则混杂磨玻璃密度结节大致同前，仍约20x10mm（IM28），牵拉相邻的斜裂胸膜
text_en: The irregular mixed ground-glass opacity nodule in the apical segment of the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged, still measuring approximately 20x10 mm (IM28), and it is pulling on the adjacent oblique fissure pleura.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段模糊结节大致同前，仍约8x6mm（IM19）
text_en: An ill-defined nodule in the left upper lobe anterior segment, approximately 8x6 mm, is essentially unchanged (IM19).

source_text: 右肺中叶见索条影同前，余肺未见结节灶
text_en: Linear opacities are seen in the right middle lobe, unchanged from prior. No nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔2、4、5组淋巴结同前，较大约12x6mm（IM19）双侧锁骨上及腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2, 4, 5 unchanged from prior, largest approximately 12x6 mm (IM19); bilateral supraclavicular and axillary regions show no enlarged lymph nodes

source_text: 未见新发结节灶
text_en: No new nodular lesions

source_text: T7椎体局限性高密度灶同前，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Focal high-density lesion in T7 vertebral body unchanged; no evidence of osseous destruction in the remainder of the visualized bones

source_text: 右侧胸膜增厚同前，如右侧胸膜结节现约8mm（IM27）
text_en: Right pleural thickening is unchanged. The right pleural nodule now measures approximately 8 mm (IM27).

source_text: 右肺水平裂不规则结节样增厚同前，大小约6mm（IM24）
text_en: Irregular nodular thickening along the horizontal fissure of the right lung is unchanged, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM24).

source_text: 左下肺少许索条影大致同前，左肺下叶小结节同前相仿（IM33）
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the left lower lobe are essentially unchanged; a small nodule in the left lower lobe is similar to prior (IM33).

source_text: 前纵隔6组淋巴结同前，约10mm（IM18）
text_en: Anterior mediastinal lymph node at station 6 is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 10 mm (IM18).

source_text: 双肺下叶浅淡密度小结节同前（IM46、47）
text_en: Faint density small nodules in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior (IM46, 47).

source_text: 余纵隔2-7组数枚小淋巴结同前，部分内见钙化，追查
text_en: Several small lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2-7 are unchanged from prior; some contain calcification. Follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下微小结节影同前，约3mm（IM28）
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM28).

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下索条微小结节影同前（IM36）
text_en: Subpleural linear micro-nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged from prior (IM36).

source_text: 两肺浅淡小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: The faint small nodules in both lungs are unchanged; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左侧胸膜结节较前略缩小，追查
text_en: Left pleural nodules are slightly decreased in size compared to prior; further follow-up recommended.

source_text: 余纵隔小淋巴结同前
text_en: The remaining small mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔内4、5、7、10组多发淋巴结同前，较大约为14x7mm（IM28）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4, 5, 7, and 10 are unchanged from prior, the largest measuring approximately 14x7 mm (IM28)

source_text: 右肺上叶两处结节大小同前，随访复查
text_en: Two nodules in the right upper lobe are unchanged in size; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔、左锁骨上淋巴结同前
text_en: Lymph nodes in the mediastinum and left supraclavicular region are unchanged from prior

source_text: 新见多发胸膜下小结节
text_en: Newly seen multiple subpleural small nodules

source_text: 右肺上叶多发结节同前，较大仍约17x12mm（IM12）
text_en: Multiple nodules in the right upper lobe are unchanged; the largest remains approximately 17x12 mm (IM12).

source_text: 多个椎体边缘硬化灶同前，扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Multiple vertebral body endplate sclerosis foci are unchanged; no osseous destruction is seen in the bones surveyed.

source_text: 右肺多发模糊结节（IM11、39、45）、钙化灶同前
text_en: Multiple indistinct nodules (IM11, 39, 45) and calcified foci in the right lung are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左下肺不规则小结节同前，约3mm（Im46）
text_en: Small irregular nodule in the left lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 3 mm (Im46).

source_text: 右肺散在小结节同前（Im17、33、41等）同前，双肺未见新生结节或及斑片影
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right lung are unchanged (Im17, 33, 41, etc.) compared to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in either lung.

source_text: 扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶，右侧第5、6肋骨质改变同前
text_en: No bone destruction lesions observed in the imaged bones; bone changes in the right 5th and 6th ribs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺索条影同前，余肺野未见新生结节
text_en: Linear opacities in both lungs are similar to prior. The lung fields show no new nodules.

source_text: 两肺未见新增斑片及结节影
text_en: No new patchy opacities or nodules are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 双侧气管食管沟及右肺门淋巴结较前缩小，追查
text_en: Lymph nodes in the bilateral tracheoesophageal grooves and right hilum are smaller than prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左侧胸腔积液，左肺内见条片状实变灶，未见新发结节
text_en: Left pleural effusion present; linear and patchy consolidation seen in the left lung; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 右肺下叶及中叶点状小结节同前（Im26、27、33）
text_en: Small punctate nodules in the right lower lobe and middle lobe are unchanged (Im26, 27, 33).

source_text: 左下肺外基底段胸膜下微小结节同前，约2mm（IMA35、39），余肺未见结节及斑片
text_en: Subpleural micronodule in the left lower lobe lateral basal segment is stable, approximately 2 mm (IMA35, 39); the remainder of the lungs shows no nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 纵隔内小淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes essentially unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左全肺切除术后改变，支气管断端未见平扫软组织肿块影，左侧少量胸腔积液较前减少，纵隔左移同前
text_en: Status post left pneumonectomy; no soft tissue mass is seen at the bronchial stump on non-contrast imaging; left small pleural effusion is decreased compared to prior; leftward mediastinal shift is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见异常肿块影，右肺索条影同前
text_en: Postoperative status of the right middle lobe; no abnormal mass seen at the bronchial stump on non-contrast scan; linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下小结节同前，约4mm（Im11、34），左下肺索条影同前
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right lung is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (Im11, 34); left lower lobe linear band-like opacity is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左锁骨上、纵隔2、5、7组多发小淋巴结同前，较大约14x8mm（IM22）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region and mediastinal stations 2, 5, and 7 are similar to previous, with the largest measuring approximately 14x8 mm (IM22).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段局限性小片状影同前（IM30），余肺未见新生结节及实变影
text_en: A localized small patchy opacity in the apical-posterior segment of the left upper lobe same as before (IM30); no new nodules or consolidations in the remaining lung.

source_text: 右肺见多发实性结节.双肺多发囊泡状透亮区大致同前
text_en: Multiple solid nodules are seen in the right lung. Multiple cystic lucencies in both lungs are essentially unchanged.

source_text: 左下肺小结节较前增大，原约5mm，现约7mm（IM28）
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe has increased in size, previously approximately 5 mm, now approximately 7 mm (IM28).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段胸膜下见点状小结节同前，仍约4mm（Im19），形态不规则
text_en: A small punctate subpleural nodule is seen in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe, stable compared to prior, still approximately 4 mm (Im19), with irregular morphology.

source_text: 纵隔及左锁骨上多发淋巴结较前相仿，较大约11x8mm（IM24）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and left supraclavicular region similar to previous, the largest approximately 11x8mm (IM24).

source_text: 两肺小结节影同前（IM18、29、31、32）
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior (IM18, 29, 31, 32)

source_text: 纵隔2R、8组数枚淋巴结部分缩小，原较大约7mm（IM35），现约5mm（IM36）
text_en: Several mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R and 8 are partially decreased in size compared to prior. The largest was approximately 7 mm (IM35), now approximately 5 mm (IM36).

source_text: 右肺中叶癌及双肺小结节大致同前
text_en: Right middle lobe carcinoma and multiple small nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged

source_text: 胸中下段食管管壁不规则增厚减轻，较厚处原约为17mm（IM32），现约14mm(IM30)，可见不均匀强化，病变外膜面模糊，周围脂肪间隙密度增高，其与胸主动脉接触面小于90度，病变压迫左心房轻度变形减轻
text_en: Irregular thickening of the mid-to-lower esophageal wall has decreased, with maximum thickness previously approximately 17 mm (IM32), now approximately 14 mm (IM30). Heterogeneous enhancement is present. Ill-defined outer margin. Increased density in surrounding fat planes. Lesion contact with thoracic aorta less than 90 degrees. Reduction in mild left atrial deformation caused by the lesion.

source_text: 右肺多发小结节同前（IM18、45、50），较大现约7mm（IM50）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior (IM18, 45, 50); the largest is currently approximately 7 mm (IM50).

source_text: 纵隔4、5、7组淋巴结同前，密度较高，较大仍约21*9mm（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4, 5, and 7 are unchanged from previous, with higher density, and the largest still approximately 21x9 mm (Image 21).

source_text: 左肺下叶背段支气管内类结节影同前，追查
text_en: An endobronchial nodule-like opacity in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe, unchanged from previous, for further investigation.

source_text: 双肺多发微小结节灶同前(IM12，18，22，30，32)，较大约5mm（IM30）
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM12, 18, 22, 30, 32); the largest is about 5 mm (IM30).

source_text: 双肺散在多发模糊结节影及小结节灶大小、数量同前，右肺上叶前段结节约16x10mm（IM26）
text_en: Size and number of scattered multiple indistinct nodules and small nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged. The nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe measures approximately 16x10 mm (IM26).

source_text: 右肺中叶内侧段实性小结节同前，追查
text_en: Small solid nodule in the medial segment of the right middle lobe, stable compared to prior; recommended for follow-up.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段点状结节影同前（IMA43）
text_en: Punctate nodular opacity in the basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged (IMA43).

source_text: 双上肺肺气肿同前，右肺上叶软组织占位较前缩小，原约43x37mm（IM21），现约26x25mm（IM22），边缘呈分叶状，可见多发毛刺，内见不规则空洞
text_en: Pulmonary emphysema in both upper lungs is unchanged; the soft tissue mass in the right upper lobe is smaller than before, previously measuring 43x37 mm (IM21), now 26x25 mm (IM22), with a lobulated margin, multiple spiculations, and an irregular cavity within.

source_text: 余双肺清晰，未见新发结节灶及斑片影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs is clear with no new nodular foci or patchy opacities.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，术区见索条影，术区偏下方见一高密度小结节灶同前相仿，约6x4mm（IMA27），建议随访
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, linear opacities in the surgical area, a small high-density nodule in the inferior aspect of the surgical area similar to prior, approximately 6x4mm (IMA27), recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下可见微小结节影较前相仿（IM28），小于5mm
text_en: Tiny nodular opacities in the subpleural region of the right middle lobe are similar to prior (IM28), less than 5 mm.

source_text: 双肺门小淋巴结同前，较大短径约8mm(IM32)
text_en: Small lymph nodes at both hila are unchanged from prior, the largest short diameter measuring approximately 8 mm (IM32).

source_text: 纵隔部分小淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Some small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged, less than 10mm in size.

source_text: 5组多发小淋巴结同前相仿，较大约10x6mm（IM22）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in station 5 are similar to prior; the largest measures about 10x6 mm (IM22).

source_text: 右肺上叶类结节影同前（IM8）
text_en: Nodule-like opacity in the right upper lobe unchanged from prior (IM8).

source_text: 胸中下段食管癌疗后，较前进展
text_en: Post-treatment mid-to-lower esophageal carcinoma, progression compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺胸膜下微小结节及钙化影同前（IM20、25、46等），两肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Left lung subpleural tiny nodules and calcified foci unchanged from previous (IM20, 25, 46, etc.), no new nodules or patchy opacities in both lungs.

source_text: 两肺未见明确新发异常密度灶
text_en: No definite new abnormal density foci are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 两下肺胸膜下微小结节影同前（IM34、43），直径小于5mm
text_en: Subpleural micronodules in both lower lungs are unchanged from prior (IM34, 43), with diameters less than 5 mm.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结较前相仿，约15x10mm（IM29）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes are similar to prior, approximately 15x10 mm (IM29)

source_text: 左侧少量胸水基本消失，后纵隔包裹性液性密度区范围较前减小，原较大层面约71*33mm（IMA27），现约53*25mm（IMA27）
text_en: The small amount of left pleural effusion has nearly resolved. The extent of the encapsulated fluid-density area in the posterior mediastinum has decreased compared to prior. It measured approximately 71 x 33 mm at the largest slice previously (IMA27), and now measures approximately 53 x 25 mm (IMA27).

source_text: 右肺斑点影同前，双肺未见新生占位
text_en: Punctate opacities in the right lung are unchanged from prior; no new space-occupying lesions are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶斜裂下小结节同前（IM39）
text_en: Small nodule below the oblique fissure in the left lower lobe is unchanged from previous (IM39).

source_text: 纵隔多发高密度淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple calcified mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 余双肺未见明确新发结节灶
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no definite new nodule foci.

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节大致同前（IM35）
text_en: The small nodule in the left upper lobe is essentially unchanged (IM35).

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜结节样增厚同前（IM35），未见胸水征象
text_en: The nodular thickening along the right interlobar pleura is unchanged (IM35). No pleural effusion is seen.

source_text: 肿物内缘与纵隔胸膜分界不清同前，内缘紧贴下肺静脉及内基底段支气管同前
text_en: The inner margin of the mass remains ill-defined with the mediastinal pleura and abuts the inferior pulmonary vein and medial basal segmental bronchus, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺多发类圆形结节灶部分同前、部分略增大，如现约9x9mm者（IM36），原约7x6mm
text_en: Multiple roundish nodular opacities in both lungs are partially unchanged and partially slightly larger; for example, one now measures approximately 9x9 mm (IM36), previously measured approximately 7x6 mm.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段支气管旁不规则结节大致同前，仍约21x12mm（IM24），边缘毛糙，远端肺内见片絮影同前
text_en: The irregular nodule adjacent to the bronchus in the left upper lobe anterior segment is largely unchanged, still measuring approximately 21x12 mm (IM24), with spiculated margins, and patchy opacities in the distal lung parenchyma are unchanged.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，双肺胸膜下小结节大致同前，较大仍约4mm（IMA41），余未见结节或实变影
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Lung parenchymal lucency is uniform. Subpleural small nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged, the largest still measuring approximately 4 mm (IMA41). No other nodules or consolidation are seen.

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节同前（IM36），仍约3mm
text_en: Small nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged (IM36), still measuring approximately 3 mm.

source_text: 右肺下叶结节同前（IMA43），约9mm
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged from prior (IMA43), measuring approximately 9 mm.

source_text: 纵隔向左侧移位同前，纵隔、锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal shift to the left unchanged from prior, no enlarged lymph nodes in mediastinum or supraclavicular region.

source_text: 双肺索条影同前，两肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Linear opacities in both lungs are similar to prior. No new nodules or consolidations are seen in either lung.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右侧胸膜弥漫增厚，胸腔新见胸水，肺膨胀不全，原右肺下叶背段结节此次扫描显示欠清，可疑较前增大（Se400 Im23）
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent; diffuse pleural thickening on the right, new pleural effusion in the thoracic cavity, and lung atelectasis are noted; the previously seen nodule in the right lower lobe dorsal segment is poorly visualized on this scan and is suspicious for increase in size compared to prior (Se400 Im23).

source_text: 左肺下叶外基底段小结节同前，约5mm（Im48）
text_en: The small nodule in the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (Im48).

source_text: 右上肺胸膜下不规则软组织占位较前缩小，大小原约39x23mm（IM24），现约27x22mm（IM25），边缘模糊，跨水平裂生长，与胸膜分界不清
text_en: Irregular soft tissue mass subpleurally in the right upper lung is smaller than prior, measuring previously approximately 39x23 mm (IM24), now 27x22 mm (IM25); margins are blurred, it crosses the horizontal fissure, and the boundary with the pleura is indistinct.

source_text: 左肺下叶不规则结节略饱满，左肺下叶新见模糊小结节，追查
text_en: Left lower lobe irregular nodule slightly prominent, and a newly seen ill-defined small nodule in left lower lobe, requiring follow-up.

source_text: 两肺内多发小结节部分较前缩小，右上斜裂旁肺内磨玻璃结节变淡消失
text_en: Some of the multiple small nodules in both lungs are smaller than prior; the ground-glass nodule near the right upper fissure has faded and disappeared.

source_text: 双肺门淋巴结较前略缩小，右侧现约20x17mm（IMA32），原约22x20mm（IM30）
text_en: Hilar lymph nodes are slightly smaller than prior; the right now measures approximately 20x17 mm (IMA32), previously about 22x20 mm (IM30).

source_text: 右肺多发小结节大致同前，较大约5mm(IM34)
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right lung are roughly unchanged; the largest is approximately 5 mm (IM34).

source_text: 部分斑片结节影较前略缩小，现右肺上叶条索状影大致同前（IM17)
text_en: Some patchy nodular shadows are slightly reduced compared to previous; the linear shadow in the right upper lobe remains roughly unchanged (IM17).

source_text: 左侧气管旁小淋巴结较前稍饱满，原约9x6mm（IM9），现约11x8mm（IM9），追查
text_en: The small lymph node adjacent to the left paratracheal region is slightly more prominent than before, previously measuring approximately 9x6 mm (IM9), now approximately 11x8 mm (IM9); recommend follow-up.

source_text: 余肺内未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段混合磨玻璃结节范围大致同前，仍约13x10mm（IM27），密度较前相仿
text_en: The mixed ground-glass nodule in the right lower lobe dorsal segment is roughly unchanged in extent, still approximately 13x10 mm (IM27), with density similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃密度结节较前缩小，现呈点状（IMA11），原约5*5mm（IMA10）
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, now appearing as a punctate focus (IMA11), previously measuring approximately 5x5 mm (IMA10).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段软组织密度小结节形态、大小大致相仿，边界欠清，似可见毛刺，仍约18x14mm（IM31，肺窗），远端见索条影与胸膜粘连
text_en: The small soft-tissue density nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is similar in morphology and size to prior, approximately 18x14 mm (IM31, lung window), with ill-defined margins and possible spiculation. A linear opacity extending to the pleura is seen distally, suggesting pleural tethering.

source_text: 右肺小结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: Right lung small nodule unchanged, likely benign

source_text: 右肺下叶少许不规则索条同前，左肺上叶舌段模糊微小结节同前（IM33），余双肺未见新生结节斑片影
text_en: Minimal irregular linear opacities in the right lower lobe stable; faint micro-nodule in the left upper lobe lingular segment stable (IM33); no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 左肺近膈处少许条片状灶同前相仿，余肺内未见明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: Left lung near diaphragm shows a few linear and patchy opacities similar to previous; no new nodules or consolidations evident in the remaining lung parenchyma.

source_text: 两肺局限性索条影同前，右肺上叶新见一小结节，约4x2mm（IM32）
text_en: The localized linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged; a new small nodule is seen in the right upper lobe, measuring approximately 4x2 mm (IM32).

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下小结节同前，约4mm（IM37）
text_en: The subpleural small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, approximately 4 mm (IM37)

source_text: 右肺下叶混杂磨玻璃密度灶同前，考虑恶性
text_en: The mixed ground-glass opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior imaging and is considered malignant.

source_text: 纵膈4R淋巴结较前相仿，约22x11mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph node at station 4R similar to previous, approximately 22x11 mm (IM20).

source_text: 双肺门多发增大淋巴结大致同前，较大约15x10mm（IM28）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes at the bilateral hila are essentially unchanged from prior; the largest is approximately 15x10 mm (IM28).

source_text: 左下肺胸膜下见微小结节同前，约2mm（IM36)
text_en: Subpleural micronodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 2 mm (IM36).

source_text: 右肺下叶癌疗后，较前稍缩小
text_en: Post-treatment status of carcinoma in the right lower lobe; the lesion is slightly smaller compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见明显肿块影，左肺索条影同前
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, plain scan shows no significant mass at the bronchial stump; left lung linear opacities unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶贴斜裂胸膜小结节同前（Im28）
text_en: A small subpleural nodule adjacent to the oblique fissure in the right upper lobe is unchanged from prior (Im28).

source_text: 纵隔内多发小淋巴结大致同前，较大约10mm（IM22）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes essentially unchanged from previous, largest approximately 10 mm (IM22)

source_text: 右肺上叶后段、下叶后基底段类圆形稍高密度结节灶同前，仍约2-3mm（IM25、47）
text_en: Round, slightly hyperdense nodules in the right upper lobe posterior segment and right lower lobe posterior basal segment are stable compared to prior, remaining approximately 2–3 mm (IM25, 47).

source_text: 双肺多发转移结节部分较前稍增大，较大原约20x16mm(IM33)，现约21x17mm（IM37）
text_en: Some of the multiple metastatic nodules in both lungs are slightly larger than prior; the largest was previously about 20x16 mm (IM33), now measures approximately 21x17 mm (IM37).

source_text: 左肺小结节同前，约4mm、6mm（IM40、48）
text_en: Left lung small nodules unchanged, approximately 4 mm and 6 mm (IM40, 48)

source_text: 双肺散在片絮及索条影大致同前，未见明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: Scattered patchy and linear opacities in both lungs are largely unchanged. No significant new nodules or consolidation are seen.

source_text: 右肺中叶及胸膜下小结节同前相仿（Im23、32、34）
text_en: Small subpleural nodules in the right middle lobe are similar to prior (Im23, 32, 34).

source_text: 右肺磨玻璃小结节同前，较大仍约6mm（Im28）
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lung is unchanged compared to prior; the largest remains approximately 6 mm (Im28).

source_text: 胸膜增厚同前，叶间胸膜结节较前增大，原约6mm，现约10mm（IM45），考虑左肺癌进展，左侧胸膜转移增大
text_en: Pleural thickening unchanged from prior. Interlobar pleural nodule increased in size from approximately 6 mm to 10 mm (IM45). Suspected progression of left lung cancer with enlargement of left pleural metastasis.

source_text: 右侧锁骨上淋巴结较前缩小，现约5x4mm（IM9），原约12x7mm（IM7)
text_en: The right supraclavicular lymph node is smaller compared to prior, now approximately 5x4 mm (IM9), previously approximately 12x7 mm (IM7).

source_text: 两肺斑点及结节影较前明显增多，部分增大，仍小于5mm
text_en: Scattered punctate and nodular opacities in both lungs, significantly increased in number compared to prior, some increased in size; still less than 5 mm.

source_text: 胸廓各骨未见明显骨质破坏征象
text_en: No obvious signs of bone destruction in the thoracic bones.

source_text: 双肺多发陈旧病灶同前
text_en: Multiple chronic lesions in both lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段磨玻璃密度结节大致同前，约15x10mm（IM18），倾向恶性，密切追查
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, largely unchanged, approximately 15x10 mm (IM18), favoring malignancy; close follow-up recommended

source_text: 扫及双侧肾上腺结节样增粗同前，请结合腹部检查评价
text_en: Nodular thickening of the bilateral adrenal glands unchanged from prior; evaluate in conjunction with abdominal imaging

source_text: 双肺索条、小结节影（IM21、29等）同前相仿
text_en: Linear opacities and small nodules in both lungs (e.g., IM21, 29) are similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变同前，胸部CT平扫未见明显新发占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right upper lobe are unchanged; non-contrast chest CT shows no obvious newly developed space-occupying lesion

source_text: 左下肺散在索条影同前，余肺内未见新发结节影
text_en: Scattered linear opacities in the left lower lobe are unchanged; no new nodules are seen elsewhere in the lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶环形灶同前，左肺上叶前段结节，复查
text_en: Left lower lobe ring-shaped lesion same as prior, left upper lobe anterior segment nodule, follow-up

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下浅淡结节同前相仿（IM19）
text_en: Subpleural faint nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior (IM19).

source_text: 双肺见多发模糊结节影同前相仿（IM11、16、22、30），左肺尖胸膜下较大者约10*6mm（IMA11）
text_en: Multiple indistinct nodules in both lungs are similar to prior (IM11, 16, 22, 30); the largest in the left apical subpleural region measures approximately 10x6 mm (IM11).

source_text: 左肺门淋巴结同前，较大约12x8mm（IMA25）
text_en: Left hilar lymph node unchanged, largest approximately 12x8 mm (IMA25).

source_text: 新见小结节
text_en: Newly identified small nodule

source_text: 两肺散在多发稍高密度微小结节及钙化灶等大致同前，均不足10mm
text_en: The scattered multiple slightly hyperdense tiny nodules and calcified foci in both lungs are largely unchanged; all are less than 10 mm.

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右侧胸膜、叶间胸膜结节状增厚同前，追查
text_en: Nodular thickening of the right pleura and interlobar pleura is unchanged compared to prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺中叶微小结节及左下叶磨玻璃密度灶同前
text_en: Micro-nodules in the right middle lobe and a ground-glass opacity in the left lower lobe are unchanged.

source_text: 双肺多发磨玻璃及实性结节，部分较前增大，如原左肺上叶者约8mm（IM15）者，现约12x9mm（IM13）
text_en: Multiple ground-glass and solid nodules in both lungs; some have increased in size, such as the one in the left upper lobe previously measuring approximately 8 mm (IM15), now measuring approximately 12x9 mm (IM13).

source_text: 食管胸中段管壁不均匀增厚，较前减轻，较厚处原约17mm，现约9mm（IM35），上下边界不清，外膜欠清，与胸主动脉间隙可见，近端食管局部扩张较前减轻
text_en: Irregular wall thickening of the mid-thoracic esophagus is reduced compared to prior, with previously thickest portion approximately 17 mm and currently approximately 9 mm (IM35). Superior and inferior margins are not well defined, and outer membrane is not well defined. Interface with the thoracic aorta is visible, and proximal esophageal focal dilation is reduced compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶微小结节同前（IMA41）
text_en: Right middle lobe tiny nodule unchanged from prior (IMA41)

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门多发钙化淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple calcified lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right hilum are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 扫及右侧第5、6骨皮质断裂，邻近肌肉增厚模糊，余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: CT shows cortical fracture of the right 5th and 6th ribs with adjacent muscle thickening and blurring; no bone destruction seen in the other thoracic bones.

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节同前，考虑良性
text_en: Right upper lobe small nodule unchanged, considered benign

source_text: 扫及甲状腺低密度结节同前
text_en: A low-density nodule is seen in the thyroid, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶实性结节同前，追查
text_en: Solid nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged; further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 胸10椎体骨转移
text_en: T10 vertebral bone metastasis.

source_text: 双肺微小结节影同前（IM12、21、29）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary micro-nodular opacities are stable compared to prior (IM12, 21, 29).

source_text: 左肺尖及下叶背段小结节大致同前（IMA14、29），较大仍约5mm（IM29）
text_en: Left apical segment and posterior segment of lower lobe: small nodules largely same as before (IMA14, 29), larger one still approximately 5 mm (IM29).

source_text: 余未见新发结节影
text_en: No new nodules are seen.

source_text: 双肺门及纵隔少许小淋巴结同前，最大短径均小于10mm，部分钙化同前
text_en: A few small lymph nodes in the bilateral hila and mediastinum are unchanged from prior; all have a maximum short diameter less than 10 mm; some calcification unchanged from prior.

source_text: 两肺内散在多发浅淡斑片影及模糊结节影大致同前
text_en: Scattered multiple faint patchy opacities and indistinct nodules in both lungs are roughly unchanged.

source_text: 双肺多发实性结节较前增大，原较大者约11x10mm（IM18）,现约14x13mm（IM19）
text_en: Multiple solid nodules in both lungs are larger than before. The largest previously measured approximately 11x10 mm (IM18) and now measures approximately 14x13 mm (IM19).

source_text: 右肺中叶术后，支气管断端未见新发异常强化灶
text_en: Status post right middle lobectomy; no new abnormal enhancing focus is seen at the bronchial stump.

source_text: 食管-胃吻合术后，双肺索条及小结节同前
text_en: Post-esophagogastrectomy; bilateral pulmonary fibrotic strands and small nodules are unchanged from previous.

source_text: 扫及肝右叶高强化结节灶同前（IM57），血管瘤可能
text_en: CT shows a highly enhancing nodular lesion in the right lobe of the liver unchanged from previous (IM57), possible hemangioma.

source_text: 双腋窝多发肿大淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in bilateral axillae are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下微小结节同前（Im18），余右肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: The tiny subpleural nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged (Im18); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the right lung.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节影（IMA18）同前相仿
text_en: Nodule with ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe (IMA18) is comparable to prior findings.

source_text: 脾内结节同前
text_en: Nodule within the spleen unchanged from previous

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结同前（IMA18）
text_en: The mediastinal station 4R lymph node is unchanged (IMA18)

source_text: 肺内多发微小结节同前，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules within the lung unchanged from prior, considered chronic lesions.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，左肺门处软组织肿物较前增大，大小原约36x26mm（IM28），现约38x34mm（IM29），左肺上叶远端沿支气管血管束见多发粟粒状小结节，考虑肿瘤播散转移
text_en: Bilateral lung markings are unremarkable in course, and pulmonary lucency is uniform. A soft tissue mass at the left hilum is larger than prior, previously measuring approximately 36x26 mm (IM28), now approximately 38x34 mm (IM29). Multiple miliary nodules are seen along the bronchovascular bundles in the distal left upper lobe, considered to represent tumor dissemination and metastasis.

source_text: 双肺散在少许小结节数量及大小同前，较大者仍约7mm（IM41）
text_en: Scattered few small nodules in both lungs, number and size unchanged, largest still about 7 mm (IM41).

source_text: 右肺癌术后，双肺散在多发小结节同前，考虑转移可能大，追查
text_en: Status post right lung cancer resection; scattered multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable, but metastasis is highly likely—further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶微结节同前，约3mm（IM21）
text_en: Right upper lobe micro-nodule unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IM21).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，右肺下叶后基底段小结节同前，约6x4mm（IMA47），左肺上叶微小结节同前（IMA20）
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Lung parenchymal lucency is uniform. A small nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 6x4 mm (IMA47). Microscopic nodules in the left upper lobe are stable (IMA20).

source_text: 右侧水平裂旁类结节灶同前，约11x7mm（IM39）
text_en: Nodule-like focus adjacent to the right horizontal fissure is stable, measuring approximately 11x7 mm (IM39).

source_text: 胸中下段食管壁偏侧性不规则增厚较前明显，管腔闭塞，现约41x27mm（IM30），原约27x22mm（IM30），病变区与邻近胸主动脉分界不清，接触面接近90度
text_en: Asymmetric irregular thickening of the mid-to-lower esophageal wall, more pronounced than prior, with luminal occlusion. Current measurement approximately 41 x 27 mm (IM30), previously approximately 27 x 22 mm (IM30). Ill-defined border with adjacent thoracic aorta, contact angle approaching 90 degrees.

source_text: 右锁骨上7x5mm淋巴结同前相仿（IM6），纵隔、肺门未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: The 7x5 mm right supraclavicular lymph node is similar to prior (IM6); no enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum or hila.

source_text: 左肺上叶斑片索条钙化灶同前，左肺散在浅淡结节影消失
text_en: Patchy linear calcified opacities in the left upper lobe unchanged; scattered faint nodular opacities in the left lung have disappeared.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结缩小，原较大约17×10mm，现较大约14*7mm（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are reduced in size, with the largest previously measuring approximately 17x10 mm and currently approximately 14x7 mm (IM19).

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，双肺陈旧灶同前，胸部CT未见新增占位征象
text_en: Following right upper lobectomy, chronic pulmonary changes are unchanged; chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 纵隔2组淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal station 2 lymph nodes unchanged from prior

source_text: 左上叶见钙化灶，左下叶胸膜下见微小结节同前，现仍约3mm（IM43），左下叶胸膜下微小结节显示不清
text_en: Calcification is seen in the left upper lobe. Subpleural micronodules in the left lower lobe are stable compared to prior, currently still approximately 3 mm (IM43). The subpleural micronodules in the left lower lobe are not clearly visualized.

source_text: 左肺类结节影同前（IM45）
text_en: Left lung nodule-like shadow unchanged from prior (IM45).

source_text: 右肺上叶癌较前增大
text_en: Right upper lobe carcinoma is larger than prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段3mm小结节同前（IM16）
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment 3 mm small nodule unchanged (IM16).

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术术后，支气管截断，局部少许索条同前，未见明确占位及异常强化灶
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; bronchial cutoff is present; local fibrotic strands are unchanged; no definite mass or abnormal enhancement focus is seen.

source_text: T7椎体新见骨破坏，考虑骨转移可能大，建议核素检查
text_en: New bone destruction in T7 vertebral body, metastasis likely; nuclear medicine study recommended

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下微小磨玻璃小结节（IM14）同前
text_en: Tiny subpleural ground-glass nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior (IM14).

source_text: 右肺下叶膈上小结节同前，现约9mm（Im49）
text_en: Small nodule above the diaphragm in the right lower lobe is stable, now approximately 9 mm (Im49).

source_text: 左后胸壁皮下结节同前，仍约17mm（IM43）
text_en: Left subcutaneous posterior chest wall nodule unchanged, still approximately 17 mm (IM43).

source_text: 左肺下叶浅淡结节影同前相仿，约4mm（IM29）
text_en: Left lower lobe faint nodule similar to previous, approximately 4 mm (IM29)

source_text: 右肺多发小结节灶同前（Im12、14、15）
text_en: Multiple small nodular foci in the right lung are stable compared to prior studies (IM12, 14, 15).

source_text: 双肺多发小结节部分同前，部分被遮挡显示不清，倾向良性
text_en: Some of the multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, while others are obscured and not clearly visible; benign etiology is favored.

source_text: 左肺下叶占位，体积较前增大，实性成分较前增多，倾向恶性
text_en: Mass in the left lower lobe, volume increased compared to previous, solid component increased compared to previous, suggestive of malignancy

source_text: 两下肺局限性索条影同前，未见明显新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Focal linear opacities in both lower lungs are unchanged from prior. No obvious new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 未见明显变化
text_en: No significant change

source_text: p组淋巴结同前，建议追查
text_en: Lymph nodes in p group unchanged, follow-up recommended

source_text: 左肺斑片索条及小结节影同前（IM32、52）
text_en: Patchy linear and small nodular opacities in the left lung unchanged from previous (images 32, 52).

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结大致同前，现较大约8*5mm(IM21).
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes essentially unchanged, currently largest approximately 8x5 mm (IM21)

source_text: 右肺下叶背段结节影较前增大，现约24x20mm（IMA27），原约23x17mm（IM27）
text_en: The nodular opacity in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe has increased compared to prior, now measuring approximately 24x20 mm (IMA27), previously approximately 23x17 mm (IM27).

source_text: 右肺上叶水平裂胸膜下结节同前相仿，约4mm（IM32）
text_en: The subpleural nodule along the horizontal fissure of the right upper lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM32).

source_text: 余左肺未见新发结节斑片影，左侧胸膜光滑，未见胸水
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the left lung; the left pleura is smooth, and no pleural effusion is present.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段斑片索条影同前（IMA57），右肺中叶微小结节影同前（IMA34）
