text_en: Patchy linear opacities in the basal segment of the right lower lobe are unchanged compared to prior (IMA57); tiny nodular opacity in the right middle lobe is unchanged (IMA34).

source_text: 转移不除外，追查
text_en: Metastasis cannot be excluded; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 右叶间胸膜新见结节影，约5mm（IM24），追查
text_en: Newly seen nodule adjacent to the right interlobar pleura, approximately 5 mm (IM24), requires follow-up.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺内低密度结节及钙化同前相仿
text_en: A low-density nodule with calcification is seen in the thyroid, similar to prior.

source_text: 4R组小淋巴结同前，约12x8mm（IM24），平扫密度较高，考虑良性
text_en: Small lymph node in station 4R is unchanged, measuring about 12x8 mm (IM24); on non-contrast imaging, the density is relatively high, suggestive of benign etiology.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后改变同前，右肺上叶小斑片索条影及浅淡微小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lower lobe unchanged compared to prior; small patchy linear opacities and faint micro-nodules in the right upper lobe unchanged, recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右肺术后改变，支气管断端周围软组织略增厚，平扫未见明确结节肿块，邻近胸腔少量包裹积液同前
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lung; mild soft tissue thickening around the bronchial stump, no definite nodules or masses seen on non-contrast imaging, and a small amount of encapsulated pleural effusion in the adjacent thoracic cavity remains unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右肺上叶尖段小结节同前，约5mm（IM14）
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent; small nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM14).

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端周围软组织结构紊乱，邻近肺门软组织结节较前缩小，原约14x9mm（IMA30），现约12x8mm（IM29）
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; soft-tissue architecture is disorganized around the bronchial stump. A soft-tissue nodule near the hilum has decreased in size, from approximately 14x9 mm (IMA30) to 12x8 mm (IM29).

source_text: 双锁骨上、纵隔2、4、5组小淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Small lymph nodes in bilateral supraclavicular regions and stations 2, 4, and 5 of the mediastinum are unchanged from prior, all less than 10 mm.

source_text: 右肺上叶多发树芽状模糊小结节同前（IM23），前段多发簇状分布微小结节同前
text_en: Multiple tree-in-bud pattern indistinct small nodules in the right upper lobe are stable compared to prior (IM23); multiple clustered tiny nodules in the anterior segment remain unchanged.

source_text: 右侧肋骨术后、胸9右侧横突局限性骨岛、胸4椎体低密度结节同前，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right rib, focal enostosis in the right transverse process of T9, and low-density nodule in the T4 vertebral body are unchanged. No osseous destructive lesions in the other bones of the thorax.

source_text: 左上肺见斑点状钙化同前，右肺上叶斑片影范围较前无变化，余肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Punctate calcification is seen in the left upper lobe, unchanged from prior. The patchy opacity in the right upper lobe shows no change in extent. No new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 食道癌术后，纵隔新发肿大淋巴结，考虑转移
text_en: Post-esophageal cancer surgery, new enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes, suspicious for metastasis

source_text: 纵隔内多发小淋巴结大致同前，较大约10mm（IM21）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes, largely unchanged from prior. Largest approximately 10 mm (IM21).

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜小结节影同前（IM46）
text_en: Small nodular opacity of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior (IM46).

source_text: 右肺门见淋巴结略增大，现约7mm（IM21）原约6mm，纵隔余处、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Slightly enlarged lymph node in the right hilum, currently measuring approximately 7 mm (IM21), previously 6 mm. No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the remainder of the mediastinum, supraclavicular regions, or bilateral axillae.

source_text: 食道癌术后，吻合口稍厚同前（IM5），增强后未见异常强化区，术后改变可能，追查
text_en: Post esophageal cancer surgery; anastomosis slightly thickened unchanged from previous (IM5), no abnormal enhancement seen on contrast-enhanced imaging, postoperative changes possible, follow-up.

source_text: 左肺多发小结节，部分缩小，如较大原约5mm，现约3mm（IM43）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left lung are partially decreased in size; the largest was approximately 5 mm (previously), now approximately 3 mm (IM43)

source_text: 双侧胸膜结节状增厚同前相仿，右肺上叶胸膜小少许条索影同前
text_en: Bilateral pleural nodular thickening is unchanged. Small linear opacities on the right upper lobe pleura are unchanged.

source_text: 食管术后改变，未见明确复发转移征象
text_en: Post-esophagectomy changes. No definite evidence of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 左肺上叶纵隔旁新见结节灶，大小约12x11mm（IM24）
text_en: Newly seen nodular focus adjacent to mediastinum in left upper lobe, size approximately 12x11 mm (IM24).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后改变，胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left upper lobe; no new mass lesion findings in the chest.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段结节较前增大，倾向恶性
text_en: Nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe has increased in size compared to prior; malignancy is favored

source_text: 余扫及诸骨未见明确骨质破坏征象
text_en: No definite signs of osseous destruction are seen in the bones imaged.

source_text: 甲状腺双侧叶低密度结节同前，甲状腺右侧叶钙化灶同前
text_en: Low-density nodule in bilateral thyroid lobes unchanged from prior; calcified focus in the right thyroid lobe unchanged from prior.

source_text: 2R、2L、5、7组多发淋巴结，部分缩小，如2R组原约19*11mm，现约13*8mm（IM9）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in stations 2R, 2L, 5, and 7; some have decreased in size, such as the 2R station which was previously about 19x11 mm and is now about 13x8 mm (IM9).

source_text: 左肺小结节部分同前、部分缩小
text_en: Left lung small nodule partially stable, partially decreased

source_text: 右肺上叶及左肺下叶微小结节同前
text_en: Micro-nodules in the right upper lobe and left lower lobe are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左上肺大泡同前（IM15），右肺下叶近肺门处可见斑片影，右肺叶间裂及胸膜结节样增厚大致同前
text_en: Left upper lobe bulla is stable compared to prior (IM15); patchy opacity near the right lower lobe hilum is visible; nodular thickening along the right interlobar fissure and pleura is essentially unchanged.

source_text: 右侧水平裂结节样密度增高影同前（IM32）
text_en: Nodule-like density increase along the right horizontal fissure is stable (IM32).

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结同前，仍约10mm（IMA26）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes unchanged from previous, still approximately 10 mm (IMA26).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，如4L组仍约15x10mm（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior, such as 4L station still approximately 15x10 mm (IM19)

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节显示较前清楚，大小同前，仍约4mm（IM38）
text_en: The small nodule in the right middle lobe is more clearly visualized compared to prior imaging, but its size remains unchanged at approximately 4 mm (IM38).

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结部分同前，部分缩小
text_en: Some multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged from previous, while some have decreased in size.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下小结节较前相仿（IM19），左下肺少许索条影同前
text_en: The small subpleural nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior (IM19); minimal linear opacities in the left lower lobe are unchanged.

source_text: 双肺散在多发小结节大致同前，小于10mm，追查
text_en: Scattered multiple small nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged, all less than 10 mm; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结较前增大、纵隔新增多发肿大淋巴结，考虑转移
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is larger compared to prior, and new multiple enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes are present; metastasis is considered

source_text: 双肺多发结节部分遮蔽，大部分同前，追查
text_en: Some of the multiple nodules in both lungs are obscured; the majority are unchanged from prior; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下结节灶（IM55），较大原约16x11mm，现约9x4mm（IM59）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural nodule (IM55), previously approximately 16x11mm, now approximately 9x4mm (IM59)

source_text: 右肺下叶结节同前，仍约5mm（IM29），追查
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, still measuring approximately 5 mm (IM29); further investigation recommended.

source_text: 右下叶肺癌术后，右肺门平扫未见异常软组织密度影，双侧胸膜下微小结节及索条影同前
text_en: Postoperative status following right lower lobe lung cancer resection; no abnormal soft tissue density at the right hilum on non-contrast imaging; bilateral subpleural micro-nodules and linear densities unchanged.

source_text: 右肺多发微小结节同前
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in the right lung are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段模糊小结节灶同前，约4*3mm（IMA19），右肺局限性纤维化索条及右肺下叶钙化灶同前
text_en: Indistinct small nodular focus in the right upper lobe posterior segment, unchanged, approximately 4x3 mm (IMA19). The localized fibrotic linear opacities in the right lung and the calcified focus in the right lower lobe are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶钙化结节同前(IM44)
text_en: Calcified nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM44).

source_text: 肺内多处局限性索条影同前，未见新生结节
text_en: Multiple focal linear opacities within the lung unchanged from previous, no evidence of new nodules

source_text: 双侧锁骨上区小淋巴结同前，较大约9x5mm（IM4）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the bilateral supraclavicular regions are stable compared to prior; the largest is approximately 9x5 mm (IM4).

source_text: 右肺上叶微小结节影及索条影同前，约3mm（IM13）
text_en: Right upper lobe micro-nodule and linear opacity unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IM13)

source_text: 左上叶散在微小结节同前，小于5mm（IM23）
text_en: Scattered tiny nodules in the left upper lobe are stable compared to prior, all less than 5 mm (IM23).

source_text: 右肺中叶术后改变，右肺微小结节同前相仿，观察
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right middle lobe; tiny nodules in the right lung are similar to prior, under observation.

source_text: 扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: No signs of bone destruction observed in the imaged bones.

source_text: 左锁骨上区、纵隔及左肺门多发肿大淋巴结稍缩小，较大者原约28x27mm（IM17），现约26x25mm（IM21）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region, mediastinum, and left hilar region are slightly decreased in size, with the largest previously measuring approximately 28x27 mm (IM17) and now approximately 26x25 mm (IM21).

source_text: 左下肺门肿大淋巴结，约19x16mm（IMA32），考虑转移可能大
text_en: Enlarged lymph node in the left lower hilum, measuring approximately 19x16 mm (IMA32), with a high possibility of metastasis.

source_text: 右下胸膜腔内软组织肿物大致同前，部分位于膈胸膜下，肿物跨膈胸膜呈哑铃状形态，原较大范围约132*66mm(图)，现约129*68mm(图50)
text_en: Soft tissue mass in the right lower pleural cavity is essentially unchanged, with part located subdiaphragmatically. The lesion has a dumbbell shape across the diaphragmatic pleura, previously measuring approximately 132x66 mm (image), now approximately 129x68 mm (image 50).

source_text: 双肺下叶基底段微结节同前相仿，约3-4mm（IM37、55）
text_en: The small nodules in the basal segments of both lower lobes are similar to prior, measuring approximately 3-4 mm (IM37, 55).

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影同前，两肺未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged; no new nodules or consolidation are seen in either lung.

source_text: 右肺结节影同前（IM20）
text_en: Nodule in the right lung unchanged (IM20).

source_text: 右肺中下叶切除术后较前相仿，原右肺门软组织结节此次平扫边界不清，大致范围同前，仍约27x10mm（IM24），余肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Status post right middle and lower lobe resection, similar to prior. The previously noted soft tissue nodule at the right hilum is ill-defined on this non-contrast scan, with approximate dimensions unchanged at about 27x10 mm (IM24). No new nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 扫及颈7椎体骨质密度不均匀同前，余诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Scanned C7 vertebral body shows inhomogeneous bone density unchanged from prior; remaining bones show no evidence of osseous destruction.

source_text: 右肺尖索条结节影同前（IM9），双肺多发索条影同前
text_en: Linear and nodular opacity in the right lung apex is unchanged compared to prior (IM9); multifocal linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺门稍高密度淋巴结同前，仍约16x9mm（IM22）
text_en: Slightly increased density right hilar lymph node is stable compared to prior, still approximately 16x9 mm (IM22)

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，胸部CT平扫未见新发占位征象
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, non-contrast chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesion.

source_text: 右肺上叶病变表现同前，纵隔淋巴结同前
text_en: Findings of the right upper lobe lesion unchanged; mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged

source_text: 双肺见多发片絮、索条、结节影较前增大，较大原约5mm（IM41），现约8mm（IM41）
text_en: Multiple patchy, linear, and nodular opacities are seen in both lungs, larger than prior; the largest was approximately 5 mm (IM41), now approximately 8 mm (IM41).

source_text: 左肺下叶术后改变，右肺上叶和中叶磨玻璃结节同前，性质待定，追查
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left lower lobe; ground-glass nodules in the right upper and middle lobes unchanged, indeterminate in nature, for follow-up.

source_text: 右侧锁骨上小淋巴结较前饱满，原约5x3mm，现约7x5mm（IM6）
text_en: The small right supraclavicular lymph node is more prominent compared to prior, previously measuring approximately 5 x 3 mm, now approximately 7 x 5 mm (IM6).

source_text: 甲状腺右叶结节同前、
text_en: The right thyroid lobe shows a nodule, unchanged from prior,

source_text: 右肺尖结节同前，约4mm（IMA11）
text_en: Nodule in the right lung apex is unchanged, measuring approximately 4 mm (IMA11).

source_text: 右肺下叶后基底段胸膜下类小结节影同前（IM58），约4mm
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior (IM58), measuring approximately 4 mm.

source_text: 纵隔多发增大淋巴结大致同前，较大仍约18x9mm（IM24）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal enlarged lymph nodes essentially unchanged from previous, the largest still approximately 18x9 mm (IM24)

source_text: 左肺下叶点状微小结节灶同前（IM55）
text_en: Left lower lobe punctate tiny nodule unchanged from previous (IM55)

source_text: 左肺上叶前段支气管旁不规则结节较前相仿，仍约31x23mm（IM26），边缘毛糙，远端肺内见片絮影同前
text_en: The irregular nodule adjacent to the bronchus in the left upper lobe anterior segment is similar to before, still measuring approximately 31x23 mm (IM26), with spiculated margins, and patchy opacities in the distal lung parenchyma are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺中叶少许索条影同前，余双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the right middle lobe are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 左上叶见钙化灶同前，左肺多发胸膜下微小结节同前，现仍约3mm（IM14、18、42、53）
text_en: The calcified focus in the left upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior. Multiple tiny subpleural nodules in the left lung are also unchanged, currently measuring approximately 3 mm (IM14, 18, 42, 53).

source_text: 右肺尖胸膜下索条结节及下叶索条影同前，余双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: The subpleural linear nodule in the right lung apex and the linear opacities in the lower lobe are unchanged. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 肺内索条小结节灶同前，倾向良性
text_en: Intrapulmonary linear strands and small nodules unchanged from previous, suggestive of benign.

source_text: 右肺门见类圆形淋巴结略缩小，现约14x10mm（IM32)，原约15x15mm（Im31 ）
text_en: A rounded lymph node is seen at the right hilum, slightly decreased in size, now measuring approximately 14x10 mm (IM32), previously about 15x15 mm (IM31).

source_text: 左肺索条、结节及支气管扩张同前
text_en: Left lung linear opacities, nodules, and bronchiectasis unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，右上叶钙化灶及索条影段增强，余左肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, calcified foci and linear opacities in the right upper lobe show increased enhancement, no new nodules or consolidation seen in the remainder of the left lung.

source_text: 纵隔及双侧锁骨上多发淋巴结大致同前（Im22等）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral supraclavicular regions essentially same as before (Im22, etc.)

source_text: 右肺门及右侧锁骨上小淋巴结同前，较大约12x6mm（IM29）
text_en: Small lymph nodes at the right hilum and right supraclavicular region are stable compared to prior, the largest measures approximately 12x6 mm (IM29)

source_text: 双肺散在网格状及索条影大致同前，两肺未见新发结节影
text_en: Scattered reticular and linear opacities in both lungs are largely unchanged. No new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 扫及右侧甲状腺增大，内部低密度结节影同前（IMA4）
text_en: CT shows enlargement of the right thyroid gland with an internal low-density nodule, unchanged from previous (IMA4).

source_text: 左肺上叶结节较前稍增大，病变下部层面原约8x6mm，现约10x8mm，上部层面原约11x9mm，现约13x10mm（IM20及薄层IMA78)，密度较前稍增高
text_en: Nodule in the left upper lobe slightly increased in size compared to previous; inferior aspect previously approximately 8x6 mm, currently approximately 10x8 mm; superior aspect previously approximately 11x9 mm, currently approximately 13x10 mm (IM20 and thin-section IMA78); density slightly increased compared to previous.

source_text: 纵隔散在小淋巴结平扫大致同前
text_en: Scattered small mediastinal lymph nodes roughly unchanged from prior on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺左叶下极低密度结节伴钙化大致同前（IM6）
text_en: Low-density nodule with calcification in the lower pole of the left thyroid lobe, unchanged from prior (IM6).

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门淋巴结较前缩小，7组较大原约19x15mm（IM27），现约11x9mm（IM30），追查
text_en: Mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes are decreased in size compared to previous, with station 7 largest previously measuring approximately 19x15 mm (IM27) and now measuring approximately 11x9 mm (IM30), follow-up

source_text: 纵隔2、4、7及双肺门多发肿大淋巴结部分较前缩小，平扫密度较高、部分含钙化同前，较大现约24x11mm（IM31），原为36x11mm（IM30）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2, 4, 7 and bilateral hilar regions, some decreased in size compared to prior; on non-contrast CT, higher density and some with calcification unchanged from prior; largest currently approximately 24x11 mm (IM31), previously 36x11 mm (IM30)

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，右肺中叶微小结节结节及左下叶磨玻璃密度灶同前相仿，建议追查
text_en: Following right upper lobectomy, micro-nodules in the right middle lobe and a ground-glass opacity focus in the left lower lobe are similar to prior; continued surveillance recommended.

source_text: 纵隔5组肿大淋巴结同前，较大约16*7mm（IM23）
text_en: Mediastinal station 5 lymphadenopathy unchanged, largest approximately 16 × 7 mm (IM23)

source_text: 右肺下叶不规则形结节及索条影及右肺上叶不规则斑片索条影同前
text_en: Irregular nodule, linear opacities in the right lower lobe, and irregular patchy linear opacities in the right upper lobe are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶微小结节同前，＜5mm（图41）
text_en: Right middle lobe tiny nodule unchanged from prior, <5 mm (Figure 41)

source_text: 纵隔及锁骨上多发小淋巴结同前，短径小于10mm
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal and supraclavicular lymph nodes unchanged, short axis diameter less than 10 mm.

source_text: 右下肺肿块较前增大，原约42x40mm（IM26），现约48x43mm（IM27），肿物与远端不张肺组织及胸腔积液分界不清
text_en: The mass in the right lower lobe has increased in size compared to prior examination, previously approximately 42x40 mm (IM26), now approximately 48x43 mm (IM27). The lesion has indistinct margins with the distal atelectatic lung tissue and pleural effusion.

source_text: 纵隔平扫肿大淋巴结同前，较大仍约27x25mm（IM20）
text_en: Non-contrast mediastinal CT demonstrates enlarged lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest still measuring approximately 27x25 mm (IM20).

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端少许软组织密度灶大致同前，右上肺陈旧灶同前，余双肺未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: Left upper lobe postoperative status. Soft tissue density at the bronchial stump stable compared to prior. Right upper lobe old lesion stable. Remainder of both lungs without new nodules or patchy opacities

source_text: 新见占位
text_en: Newly identified mass

source_text: 右肺下叶结节同前相仿
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔4、5、7组见小淋巴结同前，较大约13*9mm（IM26）
text_en: Small mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4, 5, and 7 seen unchanged, largest measuring approximately 13x9 mm (IM26)

source_text: 气管食管沟旁淋巴结同前，仍约14x8mm（IM8），双侧腋下多发靶环状淋巴结同前，仍小于10mm
text_en: Lymph nodes adjacent to the tracheoesophageal groove unchanged from prior, still approximately 14x8 mm (IM8); bilateral axillary multiple target-like lymph nodes unchanged, still less than 10 mm.

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下磨玻璃密度小结节同前，大小仍约7mm（IM38）
text_en: Subpleural ground-glass opacity small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 7 mm (IM38).

source_text: 双肺微小结节同前相仿，倾向良性，追查
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary micro-nodules are similar to prior studies, likely benign; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔4、5、7组及左肺门多发淋巴结较前略缩小，现较大约22x7mm（IM29），原约24*9mm(28)
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4, 5, and 7 and left hilar lymph nodes are slightly decreased compared to previous, now largest approximately 22x7 mm (IM29), previously approximately 24x9 mm (28).

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃灶及双肺多发结节同前，追查
text_en: Left upper lobe ground-glass opacity and multiple nodules in both lungs unchanged from prior, follow-up recommended

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下稍厚壁空洞性结节影增大，原约10*7mm（IMA51），现约12x8mm（IM51）
text_en: Subpleural nodular opacity with slightly thickened wall in the right lower lobe has increased in size, previously approximately 10 x 7 mm (IMA51), now approximately 12 x 8 mm (IM51).

source_text: 纵隔数枚小淋巴结同前，较大约10x6mm（IM22）
text_en: Several small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest approximately 10x6 mm (IM22).

source_text: 纵隔内多发淋巴结部分同前
text_en: Some multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from previous

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，右肺索条影同前，余肺未见新增结节及斑片影
text_en: Bilateral lung markings are unremarkable in course, and pulmonary lucency is uniform. The linear opacity in the right lung is stable compared to prior. No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段胸膜下磨玻璃密度小结节大致同前，建议定期随访观察
text_en: Subpleural ground-glass opacity nodule in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe, largely unchanged from prior; recommend periodic follow-up observation.

source_text: 后胸膜小结节大致同前（IM25）
text_en: Small posterior pleural nodule essentially unchanged (IM25)

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约12x10mm（IM17）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest measuring approximately 12x10 mm (IM17).

source_text: 双肺散在小结节同前，倾向偏良性，随诊
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, favoring a benign etiology, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶外基底段胸膜下小结节同前，大小仍约4mm（IM41），追查
text_en: The subpleural small nodule in the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM41), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、腹部小淋巴结较前增大，追查
text_en: Mediastinal, bilateral hilar, and abdominal small lymph nodes have increased in size compared to prior imaging; further evaluation is recommended.

source_text: 右肺内微小结节、点状钙化及索条影同前（IMA14、19），双肺内未见新发结节灶
text_en: Micro-nodules, punctate calcifications, and linear opacities in the right lung are stable compared to prior (IMA14, 19); no new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 纵隔4组肿大淋巴结同前，约19*8mm（IM26）
text_en: Enlarged mediastinal station 4 lymph nodes are unchanged from previous, approximately 19x8 mm (IM26)

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节同前，较大约5mm（IM18），与胸膜线状相连
text_en: The small nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged, larger at approximately 5 mm (IM18), linearly connected to the pleura.

source_text: 左肺上叶微小结节同前（IM25）
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule unchanged (IM25).

source_text: 双锁骨上区散在淋巴结同前，现仍约9x4mm者（IM7），纵隔、双肺门、双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Scattered lymph nodes in bilateral supraclavicular regions are unchanged from prior; one measures approximately 9x4 mm (IM7); no enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum, bilateral hila, or bilateral axillae.

source_text: 双锁骨上小淋巴结同前，纵隔、双腋下平扫未见明显肿大淋巴结
text_en: Small lymph nodes in bilateral supraclavicular regions are unchanged from prior; no obvious enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum or bilateral axillae on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 前纵隔结节灶同前相仿，约25x15mm（IM16），未见确切强化，考虑良性，追随
text_en: Nodular lesion in the anterior mediastinum is similar to prior, measuring approximately 25x15 mm (IM16), without definite enhancement; consider benign etiology, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 沿右侧叶间胸膜及侧后胸膜小结节较前减少、缩小
text_en: Small nodules along the right interlobar and lateral posterior pleura decreased in number and size compared to prior.

source_text: 右侧腋窝淋巴结缩小，原约12x9mm(IM17)，现约8x7mm（IM14），追查

text_en: Nodule in the left upper lobe increased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 13x11 mm (IM13), currently approximately 15x13 mm (IM14).

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段结节同前，约11x10mm（IM24）

text_en: Multiple tree-in-bud pattern indistinct small nodules in the right upper lobe are stable compared to prior; multiple clustered tiny nodules in the anterior segment remain unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶散在磨玻璃结节同前，约4mm（IM43）
text_en: Scattered ground-glass nodules in the right lower lobe, stable compared to prior, approximately 4 mm (IM43).

text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes reduced in size, previously approximately 19x15 mm (IM32), now approximately 17x12 mm (IM34)

text_en: The previously noted ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe has increased in density, becoming a solid nodule, with increased craniocaudal dimension, now measuring approximately 11x10 mm (400-IM23), previously 10x6 mm (400-Image 34).

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，约12*9mm(IM34)
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 12 x 9 mm (IM34).

text_en: Multiple target-like lymph nodes in bilateral axillae are unchanged, all less than 10 mm.

text_en: Mediastinal stations 2-7 and bilateral supraclavicular small lymph nodes are unchanged from previous.

text_en: Left hilar small nodule decreased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 22x15 mm (Figure 24), now approximately 17x8 mm (Figure 31). Distal to the lesion, linear opacities are seen, and multiple nodules adjacent to it are similar to previous findings. Correlated with clinical context.

text_en: The nodule in the right subclavian region is stable in size compared to prior, measuring approximately 27 x 24 mm (IMA5). It shows no significant enhancement on contrast-enhanced scanning, with a well-defined margin and smooth edge.

text_en: A faint subpleural small nodule is seen in the right middle lobe, unchanged from prior, still approximately 4x3 mm (IM29).

source_text: 左下肺门淋巴结相仿，约为10x7mm（IMA32）

text_en: Left adrenal nodular thickening unchanged.

text_en: High-density small nodule and patchy linear opacities in the right lung apex are unchanged from prior (IMA11, 17). Linear opacities in the right lower lung are unchanged. The remainder of the lungs show no nodules or consolidation.

text_en: Left upper lobe small old lesion unchanged (Im18), no new nodules or mass opacities seen in both lungs.

text_en: The anterior mediastinal mass is slightly larger than before.

source_text: 平扫左肺门淋巴结同前，约17x14mm（Im31）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows the left hilar lymph node unchanged, approximately 17x14 mm (Image 31).

text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, the largest approximately 9mm (IM25).

text_en: The smaller nodule in the left lower lobe is less distinct compared to prior (IM39), while the larger nodule remains stable at approximately 8 mm (IM49), and follow-up is recommended.

text_en: Nodule with ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe (IM19) is essentially unchanged from prior.

text_en: The ground-glass opacity lesion in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 12x7 mm (IM21); ill-defined margins remain unchanged, the lesion shows mixed ground-glass density with vascular structures traversing through it.

text_en: Small low-density nodule in the left thyroid lobe unchanged from prior (IMA6).

text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the left interlobar region unchanged from prior, favoring benign etiology.

text_en: Left chest wall postoperative change, chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesions.

text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. The small nodule in the left upper lobe lingular segment is similar to prior, currently measuring approximately 8x7 mm (IM36).

source_text: 左肺下叶微小结节影同前（Im33、39）
text_en: Left lower lobe small nodule unchanged (Im33, 39).

source_text: 纵隔甲状腺肿术后，现未见新发占位
text_en: Postoperative status from mediastinal thyroid swelling, no new mass is seen currently.

text_en: Linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged; multiple small punctate opacities in the posterior basal segment have resolved; new multiple ill-defined nodules are seen in the dorsal segment of the lower lobe (IM26-32).

source_text: 远端肺内模糊片影及两肺内多发结节大部分较前相仿(图21、22、25)，建议追查
text_en: Hazy patchy opacity in the distal lung parenchyma and multiple nodules in both lungs, most similar to prior findings (images 21, 22, 25), recommend follow-up.

text_en: Nodule with ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe is essentially unchanged from prior (IM19).

text_en: The subpleural small nodule in the basal segment of the right lower lobe is largely unchanged (IM35).

text_en: Left upper lobe postoperative status. Soft tissue density at the bronchial stump stable compared to prior. Old lesions in both lungs stable. Remainder of both lungs without new nodules or patchy opacities

source_text: 其外侧圆形小结节较前相仿，仍约8mm（Im21）
text_en: The small round nodule lateral to it is similar to prior, still measuring approximately 8 mm (Im21).

text_en: Scattered faint nodules in both lungs are largely unchanged (IM24, 25, 27, 29, 34, 37). The largest remains approximately 6 mm (IM29), likely benign. Recommend follow-up.

text_en: Right supraclavicular lymph node unchanged, measuring approximately 14x8 mm (IM6)

text_en: The nodule adjacent to the right hilum is unchanged from prior, still approximately 6 mm (IM25).

text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe is slightly increased compared to previous, currently approximately 10x9 mm (IM25) versus previously approximately 10x6 mm (IM24), highly suspicious for malignancy; follow-up is recommended.

text_en: Lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right hilar region, including calcified ones, are unchanged from previous.

text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged, size approximately 11x9 mm (IM18).

text_en: Left lung patchy opacities and small nodules are further reduced compared to previous, no obvious new nodules or consolidation in the remaining lung.

text_en: Left lower lobe indistinct nodule increased in size, previously approximately 12x9 mm (IM43), now approximately 20x11 mm (IM52).

text_en: Tiny nodule along the right interlobar pleura is stable compared to prior (IM30).

text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; non-contrast scan shows a localized irregular soft-tissue density with patchy and linear opacities that has decreased in size compared to prior—previously approximately 62 x 16 mm (IM21), now approximately 59 x 9 mm (IM21). Dense metallic foci within remain unchanged.

text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right upper lobe are stable compared to prior, the largest measuring approximately 5 mm (Im30).

text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. Lung lucency is uniform. Multiple hazy patchy opacities and irregular nodules are similar to prior (IM17, 33, 34, 41). No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

text_en: Newly detected nodule posterior to the right nipple, significance uncertain, requires follow-up.

text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right lung are unchanged (IMA25, 29, 30, 43, 46, 55); the largest measures approximately 5 mm (IMA46).

source_text: 双肺多发微小结节灶同前(IM12，17，22，31，33，34)，较大约5mm（IM30）
