text_en: Right pleural thickening is present. The right mediastinal pleural nodule is smaller than prior, previously measuring 16x10 mm, now approximately 15x7 mm (IM41).

source_text: 左肺上叶下舌段胸膜下小结节同前，约2mm（IM36）
text_en: The subpleural small nodule in the lower lingular segment of the left upper lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 2 mm (IM36).

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，胃底小弯侧淋巴结显示欠清
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, gastric fundus lesser curvature lymph nodes not clearly visualized.

source_text: 右肺中叶支气管不规则变窄、中断，楔状实变影范围较前略缩小，原约38x28mm，现约38x22mm（IM34），边界不清
text_en: Irregular narrowing and interruption of the right middle lobe bronchus. The wedge-shaped area of consolidation has slightly decreased in extent compared to prior, previously 38 x 28 mm, now approximately 38 x 22 mm (IM34). The margins are ill-defined.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are stable compared to prior; follow-up recommended

source_text: 胸部CT平扫未见明确转移征象
text_en: Chest CT scan shows no definite metastatic findings.

source_text: 纵隔、左肺门多发淋巴结同前，复查
text_en: Mediastinal and left hilar multiple lymph nodes are unchanged from prior; repeat examination.

source_text: 右肺小结节及双侧胸膜下结节或结节样增厚，部分较前稍增大、部分同前
text_en: Small nodules in the right lung and nodules or nodular thickening in the bilateral subpleural regions show partial slight increase in size compared to prior, while others remain unchanged.

source_text: 左肺下叶稍高密度结节同前
text_en: Left lower lobe slightly high-density nodule unchanged

source_text: 右肺多发小结节，部分较前增大，转移不除外，结合临床或密切追查
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right lung; some are larger than before—metastasis cannot be excluded; clinical correlation or close follow-up is advised.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门及双侧锁骨上区平扫未见新发肿大淋巴结
text_en: No new enlarged lymph nodes seen on non-contrast scan in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, and bilateral supraclavicular regions.

source_text: 双肺小结节同前，较大仍约6x5mm（IM50）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are stable compared to prior, the largest remains approximately 6x5 mm (IM50)

source_text: 右肺新见团片及类结节影，转移待排，结合临床进一步检查
text_en: Newly observed mass-like and nodular opacities in the right lung; metastasis cannot be excluded, recommend further evaluation in clinical context.

source_text: 右下肺术后及局部金属线、少许索条影同前，双肺微小结节状影大小同前，较大约6mm（Im34），贴近胸膜
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lower lobe with retained local metallic suture material and a few linear opacities are unchanged. Multiple tiny pulmonary nodules are stable in size compared to prior imaging, the largest measuring approximately 6 mm (Im34), located adjacent to the pleura.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结，大致同前
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are essentially unchanged from previous.

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则结节同前相仿，较大截面约28x18mm（IM16），内部见不规则空洞
text_en: Irregular nodule in the left upper lobe is similar to prior, with largest cross-section measuring approximately 28 x 18 mm (IM16), and an irregular cavity is seen within.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见软组织占位，右肺多发索条影同前，右侧少量胸水同前
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no soft tissue mass is seen at the bronchial stump. Multiple linear opacities in the right lung are stable. Trace right pleural effusion is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 未见明确复发
text_en: No definite recurrence

source_text: 双肺见多发磨玻璃密度结节（IM19、27）同前，较大约6mm（Im27），原IM12磨玻璃结节消失
text_en: Multiple ground-glass opacity nodules are seen in both lungs (IM19, 27), unchanged from prior; the largest is approximately 6 mm (Im27); the ground-glass nodule previously seen at IM12 has disappeared.

source_text: 左肺上叶多发小结节部分增大，现约3mm者（IM34），原显示不清，右肺上叶后段模糊结节略缩小（IM31），余肺内多小结节灶及斑片索条影大致同前
text_en: Some of the multiple small nodules in the left upper lobe have increased in size, with one now approximately 3 mm (IM34) that was previously not clearly visible; a vague nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is slightly decreased in size (IM31), and multiple small nodules and patchy linear opacities in the remainder of the lung are largely unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节同前，复查
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule stable compared to prior, follow-up

source_text: 两肺胸膜下多个小结节影同前（IM15、29、44），约3-5mm，边界清
text_en: Multiple small subpleural nodules in both lungs are stable (IM15, 29, 44), measuring 3-5 mm, with well-defined margins.

source_text: T9椎体下缘许莫氏结节同前，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Schmorl's node at the inferior margin of T9 vertebral body unchanged; no evidence of osseous destruction in the remainder of the visualized bones

source_text: 左肺上叶前段直径约5mm圆形密度较浅淡小结节同前（Se3 Im24），边界不清
text_en: A round small nodule with faint density, approximately 5 mm in diameter, in the left upper lobe anterior segment is unchanged (Se3 Im24), with ill-defined borders.

source_text: 右肺尖索条伴结节团片状密度增高表现同前（IM8）
text_en: Linear strands with nodular and patchy increased density in the right apex unchanged (IM8).

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段磨玻璃结节灶同前，约9*6mm（IM46）
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 9 x 6 mm (IM46).

source_text: 左肺下叶微结节同前，良性可能，追查
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous, benign possibility, follow-up

source_text: 纵隔4R区淋巴结较前相仿，约10x7mm（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are similar to previous, approximately 10x7 mm (IM19).

source_text: 右肺下叶后基底段见一4mm小结节（IM37），原显示不清，倾向转移可能，密切追查
text_en: A 4 mm small nodule is seen in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe (IM37), previously not clearly visualized; metastasis is considered possible. Close follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左侧肾上腺结节同前相仿，约25x19mm（IM55）
text_en: Nodule in the left adrenal gland is similar to prior, measuring approximately 25x19 mm (IM55).

source_text: 右肺中叶及下叶散在小结节大致同前
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right middle and lower lobes are essentially unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔3P组小淋巴结较前相仿，约14x10mm(IM11)
text_en: Small lymph node in mediastinal station 3P is similar to previous, approximately 14x10 mm (IM11).

source_text: 左下叶模糊的磨玻璃灶同前（IM27），余双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Indistinct ground-glass opacity in the left lower lobe is unchanged (IM27); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右肺点状结节影同前，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: Punctate nodular opacity in the right lung is unchanged compared to prior; findings are considered chronic.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结缩小，纵隔、双侧锁骨上区多发小淋巴同前相仿
text_en: Right hilar lymph node decreased in size. Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral supraclavicular regions are similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段小结节同前，定期复查
text_en: Small nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged; periodic follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶斜裂旁小结节及右肺中叶小结节同前（Im28、36）
text_en: Small nodules adjacent to the oblique fissure of the right lower lobe and in the right middle lobe are stable compared to prior (Im28, 36).

source_text: 右肺上叶结节同前，观察
text_en: The nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged; observation is recommended.

source_text: 结合矢状位观察左斜裂胸膜上见一结节同前，直径约6mm（IMA24），左侧膈胸膜见多发扁平结节状增厚同前，较大者约16x14mm（IMA50），陈旧性可能
text_en: In sagittal view, a nodule on the left oblique fissure pleura unchanged, diameter approximately 6 mm (IMA24); left diaphragmatic pleura shows multiple flat nodular thickenings unchanged, largest approximately 16x14 mm (IMA50), possibly old

source_text: 左肺上叶见椭圆形结节，边缘较光滑，大小同前，仍约11x9mm（IM19），密度不均同前，内部见不规则偏心性空洞
text_en: An oval nodule with smooth margins in the left upper lobe, size unchanged from prior at approximately 11x9mm (Image 19), heterogeneous density unchanged from prior, with an irregular eccentric cavity.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结部分增大，如原约10x6mm（IM24）者，现约21x17mm（IM20），术后反应性增大
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes are enlarged, such as one that was previously approximately 10x6mm (IM24) and is now approximately 21x17mm (IM20), which is reactive enlargement post-surgery.

source_text: 纵隔4R、右肺门淋巴结较前增大，原约16x13mm，现约20x16mm（IM28）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal station 4R and the right hilum have increased in size compared to prior, from approximately 16x13 mm to approximately 20x16 mm (IM28).

source_text: 右肺少许索条影同前，未见新生结节
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 右上肺纵隔旁片絮状软组织密度较前略增大，现约27*16mm(图16)，原约27*11mm(13图)，建议追查
text_en: The soft tissue density of the patchy opacity adjacent to the mediastinum in the right upper lung is slightly larger than prior, now measuring approximately 27x16 mm (Figure 16), previously 27x11 mm (Figure 13); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 颈7椎体内高密度结节高密度灶同前（Im2）
text_en: High density nodule within the C7 vertebral body is unchanged from previous (Im2).

source_text: 右肺上叶结节同前，追查
text_en: The nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged; further investigation is recommended.

source_text: 扫描扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: No osseous destruction seen in all scanned bones.

source_text: 左锁骨上肿大淋巴结同前，大小仍约16x14mm（IM5）
text_en: Left supraclavicular enlarged lymph node unchanged, size still approximately 16x14 mm (IM5).

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则形粗条状及结节状病变较前发展，范围增大，内部及周围新增多发斑点、片絮及不规则结节灶，多发支气管扩张及少量点状钙化，原病灶内部结节表现出硬化改变，考虑慢性感染、支扩可能大，建议随诊观察
text_en: Irregular coarse linear and nodular lesion in the left upper lobe has progressed compared to prior, with increased extent; multiple new punctate, patchy, and irregular nodular opacities are seen within and around the lesion. Multiple bronchiectatic changes and a small amount of punctate calcification are present. The internal nodule within the original lesion shows sclerotic change. Chronic infection with bronchiectasis is most likely; follow-up observation is recommended.

source_text: 气管隆突下低密度结节较前略缩小
text_en: Subcarinal low-density nodule slightly decreased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 两肺散在结节及磨玻璃密度灶同前，较大仍约13x10mm（IMA22）
text_en: Scattered nodules and ground-glass opacity foci in both lungs, unchanged from prior; the largest remains approximately 13x10 mm (IMA22).

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜下小结节影同前（IMA40）
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged compared to prior (IMA40).

source_text: 右上肺模糊小结节灶大致同前，考虑炎性病变可能，建议结合临床
text_en: Indistinct small nodular foci in the right upper lung are essentially unchanged; inflammatory lesion is possible; correlation with clinical findings is recommended.

source_text: 右肺点状结节影同前（IMA29、31）
text_en: Punctate nodular opacities in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior (IMA29, 31).

source_text: 右肺下叶、左肺微小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Tiny nodules in the right lower lobe and left lung are unchanged from prior; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 胃小弯散在小淋巴结较前缩小
text_en: Scattered small lymph nodes along the gastric lesser curvature are smaller compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺多发粟粒样小结节较前减少
text_en: Multiplemiliary small nodules in the right lung have decreased compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔多发肿大淋巴结大致同前（Im22），左膈上小淋巴结同前，约5mm（IM47）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes enlarged, stable compared to prior (Im22); small lymph node above the left diaphragm, stable, approximately 5 mm (IM47)

source_text: 新见一微小结节
text_en: Newly seen tiny nodule

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下结节灶，转移不除外，追查
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural nodule, metastasis cannot be excluded, follow-up recommended

source_text: 双肺微小结节同前，小于3mm
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary micro-nodules are stable compared to prior, less than 3 mm.

source_text: 右肺门、左侧锁骨上区淋巴结大同前，较大仍约12*8mm（IMA25）
text_en: Lymph nodes at the right hilum and left supraclavicular region are unchanged from prior; the largest remains approximately 12 x 8 mm (IMA25).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见异常密度灶及占位征象，右肺少许索条影同前
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy. No abnormal density or space-occupying lesion is seen at the bronchial stump. Minimal linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、腹部小淋巴结较前增大，原约25x6mm（IM25），现约28x9mm（IM23）
text_en: Mediastinal, bilateral hilar, and abdominal small lymph nodes increased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 25x6 mm (IM25), currently approximately 28x9 mm (IM23).

source_text: 纵隔多发肿大淋巴结平扫部分同前
text_en: Multiple enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes on non-contrast scan, partially unchanged from prior.

source_text: 扫及右侧第3、4肋骨质不连续，余扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: CT shows fracture of the right 3rd and 4th ribs; no bone destruction seen in the other scanned thoracic bones.

source_text: 左上肺微结节同前，倾向良性，追查
text_en: The small nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged, likely benign; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺多发模糊微小点灶同前（Im15），余肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Multiple hazy small dot foci in the left lung are similar to prior (Im15), and no new nodules in the remaining lung

source_text: 双肺散在胸膜下小结节较前相仿（IM12、20、36、51等）
text_en: Scattered subpleural small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior (IM12, 20, 36, 51, etc.).

source_text: 双侧多发肋骨骨折，余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Multiple rib fractures are seen bilaterally; no osseous destruction is seen in the remainder of the thoracic bones.

source_text: 右肺多发小结节灶同前（Im13、15、16、21）
text_en: Multiple small nodular foci in the right lung are stable compared to prior studies (IM13, 15, 16, 21).

source_text: 左肺下叶见索条影，两肺未见新发结节影
text_en: Left lower lobe linear opacities; both lungs show no new nodules

source_text: 纵隔钙化淋巴结同前，未见明显新生肿大淋巴结
text_en: Calcified mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged, no obvious new enlarged lymph nodes seen.

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段小结节较前增大，形态欠规则，原约14x9mm，现约19x10mm（IM28）
text_en: The small nodule in the left upper lobe lingular segment has increased in size compared to prior with irregular morphology, measuring approximately 14 x 9 mm previously and 19 x 10 mm currently (IM28).

source_text: 双肺微小结节同前
text_en: Tiny nodules in both lungs are stable.

source_text: 左肺上叶微小结节影大致同前（Im14）
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule similar to prior (Im14)

source_text: 两肺小结节同前（IMA17、25、26），＜5mm
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior (IMA17, 25, 26), <5 mm

source_text: 扫及甲状腺多发结节、胆囊结石同前
text_en: Imaging shows multiple thyroid nodules and gallbladder stones, unchanged.

source_text: 右肺多发结节同前，追查
text_en: Multiple nodules in the right lung are stable compared to prior; further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔4L、7组及左肺门小淋巴结同前，较大约7mm（IM22）
text_en: Small mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4L and 7 and left hilar region unchanged from previous, largest approximately 7 mm (IM22).

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，左肺上叶前段见不规则结节同前，边缘毛糙约6x5mm（IM18）
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. An irregular nodule is seen in the left upper lobe anterior segment, stable, with irregular margins, measuring approximately 6x5 mm (IM18).

source_text: 纵隔2R、4组多发淋巴结较前略缩小，较大原约15x8mm（IM17），现约12x6mm（IM18）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R and 4 are slightly smaller than prior, with the largest previously measuring approximately 15x8 mm (IM17) and now approximately 12x6 mm (IM18)

source_text: 左侧锁骨上多发小淋巴结同前，建议追查
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region are unchanged from prior; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶软组织肿块较前缩小，原约60x42mm（IMA30），现约38x36mm（IM29），轻度不均匀强化，可见分叶及毛刺，内部可见空洞，邻近胸膜及纵隔胸膜凹陷
text_en: The soft tissue mass in the left upper lobe has decreased in size compared to previous, from approximately 60x42 mm (IMA30) to approximately 38x36 mm (IM29). It demonstrates mild heterogeneous enhancement, lobulation, spiculation, an internal cavity, and adjacent pleural and mediastinal pleural indentation.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃密度结节影同前相仿，范围仍约34x30mm（IM15 肺窗），建议12月后复查
text_en: Ground-glass density nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged, still approximately 34 × 30 mm (IM15, lung window); follow-up in 12 months is recommended.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右肺下叶见索条影，余肺内透亮度均匀，未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. A linear opacity is seen in the right lower lobe. The remainder of the lungs demonstrates uniform lucency without new nodules or consolidation.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4多发小淋巴结同前，锁骨上未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R and 4 are unchanged from previous; no enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes

source_text: 左肺癌较前相仿
text_en: Left lung cancer similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺门旁脂肪密度结节影同前，约21x16mm（IM34）
text_en: The fat-density nodule adjacent to the right hilum is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 21 x 16 mm (IM34).

source_text: 食道术后改变同前，右肺下叶点状结节影同前
text_en: Postoperative changes in the esophagus unchanged from previous, punctate nodular shadow in the right lower lobe unchanged from previous.

source_text: 左肺下叶外侧基底段模糊小结节同前，仍约3mm（IM38）
text_en: Left lower lobe lateral basal segment hazy small nodule unchanged from prior, still approximately 3 mm (IM38)

source_text: 其上方长椭圆形淋巴结同前（Im7）
text_en: The elongated oval lymph node above it is stable (Im7).

source_text: 右肺上叶新见占位、左肺小结节、右锁骨上区及纵隔多发肿大淋巴结，考虑肺癌肺内转移（右肺上叶原发与转移待鉴别），伴多发淋巴结转移
text_en: Newly seen mass in the right upper lobe, small nodule in the left lung, and multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region and mediastinum; findings suggest lung cancer with intrapulmonary metastasis (primary versus metastatic in the right upper lobe cannot be excluded), accompanied by multiple lymph node metastases.

source_text: 右肺门、纵隔小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the right hilum and mediastinum are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 新见骨破坏
text_en: newly identified bone destruction

source_text: 左肺上叶前段与尖后段交界区近纵隔旁肿块较前明显缩小，现约17x15mm（IM17），原约24*19mm(图17)
text_en: Adjacent to the mediastinum at the junction of the anterior and apicoposterior segments of the left upper lobe, a mass has significantly decreased compared to previous, now approximately 17x15 mm (IM17), previously approximately 24x19 mm (Figure 17).

source_text: p组淋巴结同前，现约10*8mm（IM9）
text_en: Lymph nodes in p group unchanged, currently approximately 10x8 mm (IM9)

source_text: 两肺未见新增结节或片絮状病灶
text_en: No new nodules or patchy lesions are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见异常密度及强化灶，右肺少许索条影同前相仿，余双肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no abnormal density or enhancement at the bronchial stump. Few linear bands in the right lung are stable compared to prior. No new nodules or consolidations in the remainder of the bilateral lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段不规则结节大小同前相仿，约9x8mm（IM43），密度略增高，周围见长索条牵拉胸膜
text_en: Irregular nodule in the outer basal segment of the right lower lobe is stable in size compared to prior, measuring approximately 9x8 mm (IM43), with slightly increased density and surrounded by long linear pleural traction.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约12x6mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged, largest measuring approximately 12x6 mm (IM20)

source_text: 双肺陈旧条索影同前，未见新生结节或斑片影
text_en: Chronic linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged from prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R小淋巴结大致同前，较大约8x6mm（IM19），7组及右肺门钙化淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R and 4R are stable, largest approximately 8x6 mm (IM19). Group 7 and right hilar calcified lymph nodes are stable.

source_text: 左侧肾上腺结节同前（IM62）
text_en: Nodule in the left adrenal gland is unchanged (IM62).

source_text: 左肺下叶多发微结节，部分较前缩小、减少，如原约5mm，现约3mm（IM26）
text_en: Multiple micronodules in the left lower lobe, some decreased in size and number compared to previous, e.g., previously approximately 5mm, now approximately 3mm (IM26).

source_text: 余纵膈、左肺门多发淋巴结大致同前，追查
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and left hilum are largely unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶局部术后，术区见不规则条片状软组织密度影较前明显减轻，原较厚处约13mm（IM21），现约10mm(图22)
text_en: Following local resection of the left upper lobe, an irregular linear opacity of soft tissue density at the surgical site is significantly reduced compared to prior, previously approximately 13 mm thick (IM21), now approximately 10 mm (Figure 22)

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段胸膜下不规则软组织密度结节同前，约17x15mm（IM32），边缘见长短毛刺影
text_en: The irregular soft tissue density nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 17x15 mm (IM32), with short and long spiculations at the margins

source_text: 右肺中叶肿物较前缩小，现约20x11mm（IM29），原为22x14mm（IM31），右肺膨胀不全较前减轻
text_en: The right middle lobe mass has decreased in size compared to prior, currently measuring approximately 20 x 11 mm (IM29), previously 22 x 14 mm (IM31). Atelectasis of the right lung is improved compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变，未见新发占位
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; no new mass identified

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下多发小结节大致同前，现较大仍约6*4mm(IM45)
text_en: Multiple small subpleural nodules in the right lower lobe are essentially unchanged; the largest remains approximately 6 x 4 mm (IM45).

source_text: 右肾上腺结节同前，追查
text_en: Right adrenal nodule is stable; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双肺未见新发结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: No new nodules or flaky opacities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 纵隔所见淋巴结大致同前，隆突下较大者约17*14mm（IMA25），平扫部分显示不清
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are roughly unchanged from prior. The larger node below the carina measures approximately 17x14 mm (station IMA25), partially not well visualized on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 纵隔内多发小淋巴结较前相仿
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes similar to previous

source_text: 左肺下叶索条结节影较前缩小，结节原约4mm，现约3x1mm（IM38）
text_en: Left lower lobe streaky nodule opacity decreased in size compared to previous; the nodule was originally approximately 4 mm, now approximately 3x1 mm (IM38).

source_text: 右肺中叶肿物较前增大，原约21x17mm（IM32），现约31x19mm（IM29）
text_en: The right middle lobe mass is larger than prior, previously measuring approximately 21 x 17 mm (IM32), now approximately 31 x 19 mm (IM29).

source_text: 右肋局限骨质密度异常同前，其余扫描所及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: Focal abnormal bone density in the right rib unchanged; no osseous destruction seen in the remainder of the visualized bones.

source_text: 远端肺内模糊片影及两肺内多发结节大部分同前相仿
text_en: Hazy patchy opacity in the distal lung parenchyma and multiple nodules in both lungs, most similar to prior findings.

source_text: 左肺下叶内基底段钙化灶同前（IM44），余肺未见新发结节影
text_en: The calcified focus in the medial basal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged (IM44), and no new nodules are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段含空泡结节影及小淡片状影同前（IM19、24）
text_en: Nodular opacities with air bubbles and faint patchy shadows in the apical segment of the right upper lobe are unchanged (IM19, 24).

source_text: 甲状腺右叶低密度结节大致同前，平扫边界不清
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right lobe of the thyroid gland largely unchanged from prior, ill-defined margins on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 左腋下多发淋巴结增大，考虑转移
text_en: Left axillary multiple lymph nodes enlarged, consider metastasis.

source_text: 双肺多发索条同前，未见新生结节或实变影
text_en: Multiple linear opacities in both lungs are unchanged; no new nodules or consolidations are seen.

source_text: 新见多发类圆形小结节
text_en: Newly seen multiple round small nodules

source_text: 双下肺胸膜下类圆形微结节同前，约5x2mm、5x3mm、2mm（IM41、47、51）
text_en: Round-shaped micro-nodules subpleurally in the bilateral lower lungs are unchanged, measuring approximately 5x2 mm, 5x3 mm, and 2 mm (IM41, 47, 51).

source_text: 右肺术后，未见明显新增占位征象
text_en: Postoperative right lung, no obvious new space-occupying lesions are seen.

source_text: 双腋下小淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Small lymph nodes at both axillae are unchanged from prior, all less than 10 mm.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段点状结节影同前（IM18、26、27）
text_en: Punctate nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment, unchanged (IM18, 26, 27).

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，较大约9mm（IM20），平扫密度略高
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, the largest approximately 9mm (IM20), on non-contrast scan density slightly increased.

source_text: 纵隔内4、5、7组多发淋巴结同前，较大者仍约15x10mm（Im22）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4, 5, and 7 are unchanged from prior, the largest remaining approximately 15x10 mm (Im22)

source_text: 右上肺金属夹周围不规则磨玻璃密度灶较前略增大，原约49*27mm(图21)，现约52x28mm（IMA20）
text_en: Irregular ground-glass opacity adjacent to metallic clips in the right upper lobe slightly increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 49x27 mm (Fig. 21), now approximately 52x28 mm (IMA20).

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段胸膜下模糊结节较前缩小，现约2mm（IMA27），原约4mm（IM31），追查
text_en: The indistinct nodule subpleurally in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, now measuring approximately 2 mm (IMA27), previously approximately 4 mm (IM31); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左上叶模糊小结节及磨玻璃结节同前，现仍约9x5mm（IM35），左下肺少许片状影及囊状透亮区同前
text_en: The indistinct small nodule and ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe are unchanged compared to prior, currently measuring approximately 9x5 mm (IM35). The minor patchy opacities and cystic lucencies in the left lower lung are also unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔右移，纵隔小淋巴结平扫同前（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal shift to the right, non-contrast mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged from prior (IM20).

source_text: 两肺结节较前增大，较大原约14x8mm（IM30），现较大约18x10mm（IM29）
text_en: Nodules in both lungs are increased in size compared to prior; the largest previously measured approximately 14x8 mm (IM30), now measures approximately 18x10 mm (IM29).

source_text: 甲状腺多发结节大致同前，结合颈部检查
text_en: Multiple thyroid nodules stable compared to prior; correlate with neck examination.

source_text: 双肺散在小结节同前，较大仍约3mm（IM50），形态不规则，密度不均，陈旧灶可能
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, largest still about 3 mm (IM50), irregular in shape, heterogeneous in density, likely an old lesion.

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影、左肺上叶钙化灶同前，双肺内未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: The linear opacities in the right lower lobe and the calcified focus in the left upper lobe are unchanged; no new nodules or consolidations are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔4、5、7组多发淋巴结同前，较大仍约21x6mm(IM28)
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4, 5, and 7 are unchanged from previous, with the largest still approximately 21x6 mm (Image 28).

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门淋巴结较前增大，较大原约13x10mm（IM28），现约19x15mm（IM27）
text_en: Mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes are enlarged compared to previous, with the largest previously measuring approximately 13x10 mm (IM28) and now measuring approximately 19x15 mm (IM27)

source_text: 新见多发肿大淋巴结
text_en: Newly seen multiple enlarged lymph nodes

source_text: 右肺下叶近肺门结节大致同前，约14*11mm（IM28)，与右肺门血管及支气管分界不清，与右斜裂胸膜广基底粘连
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe near the hilum is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 14x11 mm (IM28), with indistinct margins from the right hilar vessels and bronchi, and broad-based adhesion to the right oblique fissure pleura.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结较前缩小，原较大约18x12mm（IMA25），现约12*7mm(图25)
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes are decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 18x12 mm (IMA25), currently approximately 12x7 mm (Figure 25)

source_text: 两肺散在微小结节同前
text_en: The scattered tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前相仿
text_en: The mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to previous

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节同前（IM17、19）
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule stable compared to prior (IM17, 19)

source_text: 左肺上叶后段胸膜下磨玻璃密度小结节大小同前，约4mm（IM21），密度略增高
text_en: A small subpleural ground-glass density nodule in the posterior segment of the left upper lobe is unchanged in size at approximately 4 mm (IM21), with slightly increased density.

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段占位大致同前，仍约32x15mm（IM28）
text_en: Mass in left upper lobe lingular segment roughly unchanged, still approximately 32x15mm (IM28)

source_text: 双肺散在小结节影基本同前，较大约6mm（IMA48、50），随诊观察
text_en: Scattered small nodule shadows in both lungs are essentially unchanged, largest approximately 6 mm (IMA48, 50), follow-up observation.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结缩小，原约17x16mm，现约11x9mm（IM25）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node decreased in size, previously approximately 17x16 mm, now approximately 11x9 mm (IM25)

source_text: 双肺间质纤维化及散在少许小结节同前，左肺下叶结节约5mm同前相仿（Im38），未见确切新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Pulmonary interstitial fibrosis and scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior; a nodule in the left lower lobe measures about 5 mm, similar to prior (Im38); no definite new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 左肺局限性肺不张同前（MA44），双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Localized atelectasis in the left lung unchanged from prior (MA44); no new nodules or patchy opacities in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺上叶微小结节影同前（Im14）
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule unchanged from prior (Im14)

source_text: 右下胸膜轻度增厚并肺内索条影同前，未见结节灶
text_en: Mild pleural thickening in the right lower region with intrapulmonary linear opacities unchanged. No nodules are seen.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4组及右肺门淋巴结同前，较大约11x7mm（IM22）
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R and 4 and right hilar region are unchanged from previous; the largest is approximately 11x7 mm (IM22)

source_text: 右肺尖脊柱旁不规则类结节影较前缩小，现约8*2mm(图12)，原约10x8mm（IM11），邻近胸膜增厚
text_en: The irregular nodular opacity adjacent to the spine in the right lung apex has decreased in size, now measuring approximately 8x2 mm (Figure 12), previously about 10x8 mm (IM11). Adjacent pleural thickening remains.

source_text: 纵隔10R淋巴结较前缩小，原约18x14mm，现约13x11mm(IM30)，追查
text_en: The mediastinal lymph node at station 10R has decreased in size compared to previous, originally approximately 18x14 mm, now approximately 13x11 mm (Image 30), follow-up.

source_text: 新见一软组织
text_en: Newly seen soft tissue lesion

source_text: 纵膈2R淋巴结大致同前，约11mm(图16)
text_en: Mediastinal station 2R lymph node is stable, approximately 11 mm (Figure 16)

source_text: 扫及肝内多发低密度结节灶同前
text_en: Multiple intrahepatic low-density nodules are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺钙化及上叶（IM20）、中叶小结节灶同前相仿，未见新发灶
text_en: Calcification in the right lung and small nodular opacities in the upper lobe (IM20) and middle lobe are similar to prior; no new lesions are seen.

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下小结节同前相仿，约2-3mm（IM45）
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right lower lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 2–3 mm (IM45).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见明显软组织密度肿块影，右肺索条影、右上胸膜增厚同前
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; on non-contrast imaging, no obvious soft tissue density mass is seen at the bronchial stump. Linear opacities in the right lung and right upper pleural thickening are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔2-7组多发淋巴结较前增大，较大原约17x11mm(IM28)，现约25x17mm（IM29）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal groups 2-7 increased in size compared to prior, largest previously approximately 17x11mm (IM28), now approximately 25x17mm (IM29).

source_text: 右肺下叶模糊小结节同前 ，约6mm（IM39）
text_en: The ill-defined small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, still approximately 6 mm (IM39).

source_text: 纵隔、双侧锁骨上淋巴结部分较前缩小
text_en: Mediastinal and bilateral supraclavicular lymph nodes partially decreased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 左肺下叶磨玻璃结节同前，可疑少许实性成分，恶性不能除外，建议进一步检查
text_en: Left lower lobe ground-glass nodule unchanged, suspicious for small solid component, malignancy cannot be excluded, recommend further evaluation.

source_text: 4L、6、7组及双肺门增大淋巴结大致同前，较大仍约25x18mm（IM27）
text_en: Enlarged lymph nodes in stations 4L, 6, 7, and bilateral hila are largely unchanged; the largest remains about 25x18 mm (IM27).

source_text: 左肺上叶浅淡小结节同前，约4mm（IM20）
text_en: The faint small nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged from previous, approximately 4 mm (IM20).

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结大致同前，约17x14mm（Im18）
text_en: Mediastinal 4R lymph node stable, measuring approximately 17x14 mm (Im18)

source_text: 双肺多发小结节数目、大小同前，较大约5mm（IM46）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged in number and size; the largest is approximately 5 mm (IM46).

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节同前（IM14），左肺索条影同前，双肺未见明确新发结节灶
text_en: Small nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged (IM14); linear opacities in the left lung are unchanged; no definite new nodules are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔数枚小淋巴结较前相仿，2R组淋巴结约12x8mm（IM18）
text_en: Several small mediastinal lymph nodes similar to prior, 2R station lymph node approximately 12x8 mm (IM18).

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段软组织密度结节同前，仍约15x10mm（IM51）
text_en: Left lower lobe basal segment soft tissue density nodule unchanged from prior, still approximately 15x10 mm (IM51)

source_text: 左锁骨上区小淋巴结同前，约12x7mm（IM7），纵隔、双肺门、及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Left supraclavicular small lymph node unchanged, approximately 12x7 mm (IM7), no enlarged lymph nodes seen in mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, and bilateral axillae.

source_text: 右水平裂胸膜下结节影同前，约10x9mm（IM29）
text_en: Subpleural nodule along the right horizontal fissure unchanged, measuring approximately 10x9 mm (IM29).

source_text: 扫及肝门区小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the porta hepatis region unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶多发不规则类结节影同前（IM17、19、29），边缘毛糙
text_en: Multiple irregular nodular opacities in the right upper lobe are stable compared to prior (IM17, 19, 29), with ill-defined margins.

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结大致同前，现仍约16x14mm（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal 4R lymph node stable, currently measuring approximately 16x14 mm (IM21)

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节同前（IM19）
text_en: Small nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior (IM19).

source_text: 双肺下叶少许索条影同前，未见新增结节
text_en: Few linear opacities in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 纵隔多个小淋巴结同前相仿，平扫密度较高，较大约17x6mm（IM28），良性可能大，随诊观察
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes similar to prior, higher density on non-contrast scan, largest approximately 17x6 mm (IM28), likely benign, follow-up observation

source_text: 左肺上叶局限斑片索条影并周围肺大泡同前（Im32）,恶性不除外，密切追查
text_en: A localized patchy and linear opacity with surrounding bullae in the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior (Im32), malignancy cannot be excluded, and close follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔3A组淋巴结缩小，原约14x9mm（IM18），现约12x8mm（IM13）
text_en: Mediastinal station 3A lymph nodes decreased, previously approximately 14x9 mm (IM18), currently approximately 12x8 mm (IM13).
Multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM10, 17, 21, 27, 28).

source_text: 扫及甲状腺多发低密度结节大致同前，结合超声检查
text_en: Imaging shows multiple low-density nodules in the thyroid, essentially unchanged, with correlation to prior ultrasound.

source_text: 右肺胸膜/叶间胸膜下微结节较前略缩小（IM22、26），均小于5mm
text_en: The subpleural and interlobar pleural micronodules in the right lung are slightly smaller compared to prior (IM22, 26), all measuring less than 5 mm.

source_text: 右锁骨上区小淋巴结同前，仍约5mm（IM4）
text_en: Small lymph node in the right supraclavicular region is stable compared to prior, still measures approximately 5 mm (IM4).

source_text: 右肺胸膜下散在小结节及钙化灶同前（IMA28、34、43）
text_en: Scattered small nodules and calcifications in the right lung subpleural region unchanged from prior (IMA28, 34, 43).

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节较前略小，现约27x21mm（IM28），原约27x23mm（IM28），密度较前增高，周围新见散在点状致密影及索条影
text_en: Left upper lobe ground-glass opacity nodule slightly decreased in size compared to previous, currently approximately 27x21 mm (image 28), previously approximately 27x23 mm (image 28), density increased compared to previous, with new scattered punctate dense shadows and linear opacities around it.

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门平扫小淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal and right hilar small lymph nodes unchanged from previous on non-contrast CT.

source_text: 纵隔4L组、9L组肿大淋巴结较前缩小，较大现约17x5mm（IM24），原为25x9mm（IM22）
text_en: The enlarged mediastinal 4L and 9L group lymph nodes are decreased compared to prior; the larger one currently measures approximately 17x5 mm (IM24), previously 25x9 mm (IM22).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，短径均小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior, all short axis diameters less than 10 mm

source_text: 右肺下叶高密度钙化灶同前，右肺上叶及中叶类结节灶同前（IM17、33）
text_en: High-density calcified focus in the right lower lobe is unchanged; nodular opacities in the right upper and middle lobes are unchanged (IM17, 33).

source_text: 右肺中叶模糊微小结节同前（IM22、27）
text_en: Faint tiny nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged (IM22, 27).

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前相仿，较大仍约20x13mm(IM28)，内见钙化灶
text_en: Mediastinal multiple lymph nodes similar to previous, the largest still approximately 20x13mm (IM28), with calcification seen within.

source_text: 右肺上叶结节较前缩小、密度增高，现约6*6mm(图29)，原约8x6mm（IMA28），余两肺散在模糊结节影同前相仿，双肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: The nodule in the right upper lobe has decreased in size and increased in density, now measuring approximately 6x6 mm (Figure 29), previously approximately 8x6 mm (IMA28). The scattered indistinct nodules in the rest of both lungs are similar to prior. No new nodules or consolidation are seen in either lung.

source_text: 隆突下局限性积液较前减少,纵隔、锁骨上区及双腋下平扫未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Subcarinal localized fluid collection decreased compared to prior, mediastinum, supraclavicular regions, and bilateral axillary on non-contrast scan no enlarged lymph nodes seen.

source_text: 双下肺多发结节大致同前，追查
text_en: The multiple nodules in both lower lungs are essentially unchanged; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶及下叶支气管周围软组织影显示增厚并钙化及结节灶大致同前（IMA20、33），平扫边界显示不清，所示较大者结节仍约10*6mm（IMA34）
text_en: The peribronchial soft tissue thickening with calcification and nodular foci in the right upper and lower lobes are largely unchanged (IMA20, 33); the borders are poorly defined on non-contrast imaging; the largest nodule remains approximately 10x6 mm (IMA34).

source_text: 纵隔、肺门、锁骨上及腋窝多发淋巴结同前，较大约10x5mm（IM22）
text_en: Mediastinal, hilar, supraclavicular, and axillary multiple lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest approximately 10x5 mm (IM22).

source_text: 右肺下叶前基底段类圆形结节灶同前，约5mm（Im39）
text_en: The rounded nodule in the anterior basal segment of the right lower lobe remains unchanged, measuring approximately 5 mm (Im39).

source_text: 双肺未见结节，右肺下叶条片状影同前
text_en: No nodules are seen in the lungs; the linear and patchy opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺内索条影同前，双肺未见新增结节及片絮影
text_en: Linear opacities in the left lung unchanged, no new nodules or patchy opacities in both lungs.

source_text: 纵隔左移同前，纵隔、双侧锁骨区、腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Leftward shift of the mediastinum unchanged, no enlarged lymph nodes in the mediastinum, bilateral supraclavicular regions, or axillae.

source_text: 原双肺片絮状渗出实变影基本吸收，余双肺未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: The previously noted patchy exudative consolidation in both lungs has been largely absorbed. No new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺未见新增结节实变影
text_en: No new nodular consolidation is seen in the right lung.

source_text: 原左肺下叶胸膜下结节，现未见确切显示，左肺上叶微小结节大致同前（IM33）
text_en: The previously noted subpleural nodule in the left lower lobe is not clearly visible; the tiny nodules in the left upper lobe are essentially unchanged (IM33).

source_text: 残右肺仍见少许索条影，左肺近膈面不规则小结节同前（IM47），右肺胸膜下小片影同前
text_en: Small amount of linear opacities still seen in the residual right lung, irregular small nodule near the diaphragm in the left lung unchanged from previous (IM47), small subpleural patchy opacity in the right lung unchanged from previous.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，左肺舌叶少许磨玻璃密度影大致同前（IM36），余肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Bilateral lung markings are unremarkable in course, and pulmonary lucency is uniform. A small area of ground-glass opacity in the lingula of the left lung is roughly stable (IM36). No new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段小结节同前（Im42）
text_en: Left lung lower lobe posterior basal segment small nodule unchanged from prior (Im42)

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见明显异常增厚软组织密度影，右肺上叶小斑片索条影及浅淡微小结节影同前（IMA26）
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lower lobe; non-contrast scan shows no obvious abnormal soft tissue thickening at the bronchial stump. Small patchy linear opacities and faint tiny nodular opacities in the right upper lobe are stable (IMA26).

source_text: 扫及左肾上腺结节同前（IM63），追查
text_en: A nodule in the left adrenal gland is unchanged from prior (IM63), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双肺多发小结节数目、大小同前，较大约5mm（IM44）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged in number and size; the largest is approximately 5 mm (IM44).

source_text: 左全肺切除术后改变，支气管断端未见平扫软组织肿块影，左侧胸腔积液较前稍减少，纵隔左移同前
text_en: Status post left pneumonectomy; no soft tissue mass is seen at the bronchial stump on non-contrast imaging; left pleural effusion is slightly decreased compared to prior; leftward mediastinal shift is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶结节增大，原约10x8mm（IM26），现约15x12mm（IM27），考虑转移，密切追查
text_en: Left lower lobe nodule increased in size, previously approximately 10x8 mm (IM26), currently approximately 15x12 mm (IM27); consider metastasis, close follow-up.

source_text: 部分略缩小，如较大原约30x19mm（IM54），现约28x16mm（IM55）
text_en: Some are slightly reduced, for example, the larger one was approximately 30x19mm (IM54), now approximately 28x16mm (IM55).

source_text: 右肺中叶微小结节、左侧斜裂胸膜小结节同前，考虑良性
text_en: Micro-nodules in the right middle lobe and a small pleural nodule along the left oblique fissure are unchanged, likely benign.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上区多发淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, and supraclavicular areas are largely unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管残端软组织密度改变较前缩小，现约17x10mm（IM22），原约23x14mm（IM21）
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; soft tissue density at the bronchial stump has decreased compared to prior, now measuring approximately 17x10 mm (IM22), previously 23x14 mm (IM21).

source_text: 右腋下数枚淋巴结大致同前，较大者约18x11mm（Im20）
text_en: Several right axillary lymph nodes are essentially unchanged compared to prior, the largest measuring approximately 18x11 mm (Im20)

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则结节同前
text_en: The irregular nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺术后，胸部CT未见明显新增恶性征象
text_en: Postoperative right lung, chest CT shows no obvious new malignant findings.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段小结节同前，仍约5mm（IM22），边缘光整，界清
text_en: Small nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged, still approximately 5mm (IM22); margins are smooth and well-defined.

source_text: 新增的小结节
text_en: newly identified small nodule

source_text: 左全肺切除术后，左肺新见多发软组织密度灶，较大约66x54mm（IMA35），复发
text_en: Status post left pneumonectomy; new multiple soft tissue density foci are seen in the left hemithorax, the largest measuring approximately 66x54 mm (IMA35); findings are consistent with recurrence.

source_text: 左肺多发小结节同前相仿，现较大仍约16*13mm（Im31），未见明确新发结节灶
text_en: Multiple small nodules in left lung similar to prior, largest still approximately 16x13 mm (Im31), no definite new nodules.

source_text: 双肺散在小结节同前，追查
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段磨玻璃密度结节，较前未见明显变化，追查
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe shows no significant change from prior, recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节大致同前，仍约3mm（IM19）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is essentially unchanged, still measuring approximately 3 mm (IM19).

source_text: 两肺3-4mm微结节（IM31，41)，较前相仿
text_en: 3-4 mm micronodules in both lungs (IM31, 41) are similar to prior.

source_text: 余肺未见新增肺内结节或斑片影
text_en: The remainder of the lungs shows no new intrapulmonary nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃样灶同前（Im13），肺内散在微小结节及浅淡模糊小片影同前（Im23、30、38等）
text_en: Left upper lobe ground-glass opacity focus unchanged from previous (image 13), scattered small nodules and faint hazy patchy shadows within the lung unchanged from previous (images 23, 30, 38, etc.).

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，较大仍约12x7mm（IMA22）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest still approximately 12x7 mm (IMA22).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段见高密度钙化结节同前
text_en: A high-density calcified nodule in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe is unchanged from prior

source_text: 纵隔内多处金属夹影同前，未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Multiple metallic clip shadows in mediastinum unchanged from previous, no enlarged lymph nodes seen

source_text: 左肺索条影同前，双肺未见新增结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: Left lung fibrotic streaks unchanged, no new nodules or patchy opacities in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: The small nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged compared to prior imaging; follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段胸膜下微小结节同前，小于2mm（IM24）
text_en: The subpleural micro-nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe remains unchanged, measuring less than 2 mm (IM24).

source_text: 纵隔4、5组多发小淋巴结大致同前，较大现约13x7mm（Im21）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4 and 5 roughly unchanged, largest currently measuring approximately 13x7 mm (IM21)

source_text: 食管中段粘膜下囊性低密度肿物较前缩小
text_en: Submucosal cystic low-density mass in the mid-esophagus is decreased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 右下肺结节大小同前，倾向良性病变，建议定期复查
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is stable in size compared to prior imaging, favoring a benign lesion; periodic follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔内气管隆突右前方软组织密度灶较前减轻，原约20x10mm（IMA19），现厚约5mm(图20)
text_en: A soft tissue density lesion right anterior to the carinal bifurcation within the mediastinum is reduced compared to previous, previously approximately 20x10 mm (IMA19), now approximately 5 mm thick (Figure 20).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段结节同前，约14x12mm（IM23），边缘毛糙及片絮、斑片状影同前
text_en: Left upper lobe anterior segment nodule stable, approximately 14x12 mm (IM23), with irregular margins and patchy opacities stable.

source_text: 右肺门及右锁骨上区小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes at the right hilum and right supraclavicular region are stable compared to prior

source_text: 双肺陈旧灶，纵隔、左肺门多发淋巴结同前
text_en: Chronic pulmonary foci; multiple lymph nodes at mediastinum and left hilum are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔4R组长条形淋巴结同前，仍约16x7mm（IM27），平扫密度较高，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R elongated lymph node similar to previous, still approximately 16x7 mm (IM27), higher density on non-contrast scan, considered old lesion.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段小结节灶较前缩小，追查
text_en: Left upper lobe apicoposterior segment small nodule decreased compared to previous, follow-up.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，双肺小结节灶同前（IM32、33），转移
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent; small nodular foci in both lungs are stable compared to prior (IM32, 33); metastases.

source_text: 两下肺索条影及小结节影大致同前，较大者约6x4mm（IM38）
text_en: Linear opacities and small nodules in both lower lungs are essentially unchanged from prior. The largest measures approximately 6x4 mm (IM38).

source_text: 右下肺结节原约6x5mm者，现约8x6mm（Im42）
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe, previously measuring approximately 6x5 mm, now measures approximately 8x6 mm (Im42).

source_text: 左肺多发小结节同前相仿，左上肺较大磨玻璃密度灶仍约7mm（IM12），追查
text_en: Multiple small nodules in left lung similar to prior, larger ground-glass opacity in left upper lobe still approximately 7 mm (IM12), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，左肺上叶胸膜下见两枚小结节同前（IMA14、35），直径小于5mm，边缘清楚，建议随访
text_en: Bilateral lung markings are unremarkable in course, and pulmonary lucency is uniform. Two small nodules subpleurally in the left upper lobe are stable (IMA14, 35), each less than 5 mm in diameter with clear margins. Follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 胸扫及廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: No signs of bone destruction seen on chest CT scan in the bones of the thoracic cage.

source_text: 双肺多发实性微结节同前
text_en: Multiple solid micronodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后表现同前，左肺小结节同前
text_en: Findings in the right upper lobe are stable post-surgery; small nodules in the left lung are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔、双锁骨上区小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral supraclavicular regions are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结较前相仿，较大仍约19x18mm（IM20）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph node is similar to previous, larger still approximately 19x18 mm (Image 20).

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，较大约9mm（IM21），平扫密度略高
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, the largest approximately 9mm (IM21), on non-contrast scan density slightly increased.

source_text: 右肺底小结节灶同前，约8x6mm（IM40）
text_en: Small nodule in the right lung base is unchanged, measuring approximately 8x6 mm (IM40).

source_text: 双肺结节较前略增大，较大约9x9mm（IM25），原较大约8x6mm（IM26）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary nodules are slightly larger than prior. The largest now measures approximately 9x9 mm (IM25), previously approximately 8x6 mm (IM26).

source_text: 右肺上叶局部及右肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见占位征象，局部术区见索条影同前
text_en: Partial right upper lobe and right lower lobe postoperative changes; no space-occupying lesion seen at the bronchial stump; linear opacities in the local surgical bed are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺新见散在微小结节，＜5mm（图14、33）
text_en: New scattered tiny nodules in left lung, <5mm (Figures 14, 33)

source_text: 食道术后改变，胸部CT未见新增占位征象
text_en: Esophageal postoperative changes; chest CT shows no new space-occupying lesions.

source_text: 双肺多发模糊小结节同前，较大仍约5mm（IM28）
text_en: Multiple ill-defined small nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior; the largest remains approximately 5 mm (IM28).

source_text: 新发类圆形结节
text_en: newly identified round nodule

source_text: 肺内索条结节大致同前（IMA39），未见明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: Intrapulmonary linear strands and nodules essentially unchanged from previous (IMA39), with no new nodules or consolidation seen.

source_text: 食管癌术后，未见明确复发征象
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer, no definite evidence of recurrence.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段磨玻璃密度结节大致同前，约8*4mm（IM18），其上方不规则结节同前，约15*8mm(图16)，追查
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, largely unchanged, approximately 8x4 mm (IM18); irregular nodule above it, stable, approximately 15x8 mm (Figure 16), follow-up recommended

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则结节同前相仿，较大截面仍约32x14mm（IM15），其内仍见含气透亮影
text_en: Irregular nodule in the left upper lobe is similar to prior, with largest cross-section still measuring approximately 32 x 14 mm (IM15), and an air-containing lucency remains visible within it.

source_text: 新见模糊微小结节
text_en: Newly seen ill-defined micronodules

source_text: 右肺术后改变同前，支气管断端未见占位，少许模糊斑片影同前（IM24)，左肺内散在小片灶同前相仿，追查
text_en: Findings of prior right lung surgery are unchanged; no space-occupying lesion is seen at the bronchial stump. Slight ill-defined patchy opacities are stable compared to prior (IM24). Scattered small patchy opacities in the left lung are similar to prior; further investigation is recommended.

source_text: 双肺下叶及左肺上叶舌段胸膜下见散在多发磨玻璃样微小结节同前，均小于5mm
text_en: Scattered multiple subpleural ground-glass micronodules measuring less than 5 mm are seen in the lower lobes of both lungs and the lingular segment of the left upper lobe, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺术后改变，支气管断端未见异常，右肺上叶磨玻璃结节及左肺上叶微小结节同前（IM12），双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lung; no abnormality at the bronchial stump, ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe and a tiny nodule in the left upper lobe are stable compared to prior (IM12), and no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 双腋下多发小淋巴结大致同前，较大约8*6mm(图16)
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes at both axillae are generally unchanged from prior, the largest measuring approximately 8x6 mm (Figure 16).

source_text: 左肺上叶不见规则结节同前，较大截面约32x14mm（IM15），其内仍见含气透亮影
text_en: The irregular nodule in the left upper lobe remains unchanged, with a largest cross-section measuring approximately 32 x 14 mm (IM15); an air-containing lucency is still visible within it.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段浅淡结节影同前，仍约3mm（IMA23）
text_en: Faint nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment, unchanged, still approximately 3 mm (IMA23).

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结大致同前，约9*7mm（IM21），随诊观察
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes largely unchanged, approximately 9x7 mm (IM21), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶结节增大，转移进展
text_en: Left lower lobe nodule increased in size; metastatic progression.

source_text: 余肺内未见明显新增结节结及实变影
text_en: No obvious new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下少许点状模糊结节同前（IM27），左肺下叶胸膜下点状结节同前（IM32），倾向良性，随诊观察
text_en: Minimal punctate hazy nodules in the right upper lobe subpleural region are unchanged (IM27); punctate nodules in the left lower lobe subpleural region are unchanged (IM32), likely benign; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺中叶叶间胸膜下磨玻璃结节大小同前，约10x9mm（IM38），密度似较前略增高，其后外方浅淡磨玻璃密度区显示同前，整体范围约15x11mm
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the interlobar subpleural region of the right middle lobe is stable in size, measuring approximately 10x9 mm (IM38), with density appearing slightly increased compared to prior. The faint ground-glass density area posterior-laterally remains unchanged, with overall extent measuring approximately 15x11 mm.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结及双肺门淋巴结，数目大小较前相仿
text_en: Mediastinal multiple lymph nodes and bilateral hilar lymph nodes, number and size similar to previous.

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门小淋巴结部分较前饱满，如右上纵隔原约6x5mm者，现约8x6mm（IM12）
text_en: Mediastinal and right hilar small lymph nodes are partially more prominent than before, for example, the right upper mediastinal node previously approximately 6x5 mm is now approximately 8x6 mm (IM12).

source_text: 原食道胸中段管壁增厚较前减轻，原较厚处约22mm，现约8mm（IMA18），周围脂肪间隙较前清楚，同胸主动脉接触面较前缩小
text_en: The wall thickening in the mid-thoracic esophagus is less pronounced than before; the previously thickest portion was approximately 22 mm, now measures approximately 8 mm (IMA18); the surrounding fat planes are clearer than before, and the contact surface with the thoracic aorta is reduced.

source_text: 气管食管沟旁淋巴结较前缩小，原约19x10mm（IM7），现约14x8mm（IM6），双侧腋下多发靶环状淋巴结同前，仍小于10mm
text_en: Lymph nodes adjacent to the tracheoesophageal groove reduced in size compared to prior, previously approximately 19x10 mm (IM7), currently approximately 14x8 mm (IM6); bilateral axillary multiple target-like lymph nodes unchanged, still less than 10 mm.

source_text: 右肺斜裂胸膜下小结节同前，边界清晰，约5mm（IM22）
text_en: Small subpleural nodule along the right oblique fissure is unchanged, with clear margins, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM22).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端壁略增厚同前相仿（IM27），右肺下叶背段新见小斑片状模糊影（IM27），余右肺小斑片索条及小结节影同前
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; slight thickening of the bronchial stump wall is unchanged (IM27). A new small patchy hazy opacity is seen in the dorsal segment of the right lower lobe (IM27). The remaining small patchy, linear, and nodular opacities in the right lung are stable.

source_text: 左乳内上象限一枚小结节同前，约7mm（Im26）
text_en: A small nodule in the upper inner quadrant of the left breast is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 7 mm (Im26).

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，随诊观察
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged, follow-up observation

source_text: 右肺上叶纵隔旁另一小结节灶同前，约7x6mm（IMA18）
text_en: Another small nodule adjacent to the mediastinum in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior, measuring approximately 7x6 mm (IMA18)

source_text: 双肺散在多发类圆形小结节大致同前，约2-4mm，追查
text_en: Scattered multiple round small nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 2-4 mm. Follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶切除术后，支气管断端平扫未见明显肿块影，左侧胸膜稍厚同前，未见胸水征象
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, no obvious mass on non-contrast scan at bronchial stump, left pleural thickening unchanged, no pleural effusion.

source_text: 纵隔4R高密度淋巴结略饱满，原约9mm（IM18），现约11mm（IM18），追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R high-density lymph node slightly prominent, previously approximately 9 mm (IM18), now approximately 11 mm (IM18), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左侧肾上腺结节略缩小，腹腔钙化灶同前，请结合腹部检查
text_en: Left adrenal nodule slightly smaller; abdominal calcifications unchanged; correlate with abdominal findings.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变，左下肺小结节部分较前饱满，建议密切追查除外转移
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; some small nodules in the left lower lobe are more prominent than before, suggesting close follow-up to exclude metastasis

source_text: 右肺上叶后段支气管截断，局部不规则结节较前增大，原约8x7mm，现约12mm（IM26），远端肺内片絮、结节影略增多
text_en: The bronchial cutoff in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is associated with a local irregular nodule that has increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 8x7 mm, now approximately 12 mm (IM26). Patchy and nodular opacities in the distal lung have slightly increased.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结较前缩小，原约12*10mm，现约9*7mm(IM22)
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes decreased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 12x10 mm, currently approximately 9x7 mm (IM22).

source_text: 纵隔隆突下淋巴结略增大，原约18x11mm，现约21x15mm（IM32）
text_en: Subcarinal lymph node slightly increased in size, previously approximately 18x11mm, now approximately 21x15mm (IM32).

source_text: 右侧胸膜不均匀增厚较前减轻，多发胸膜结节缩小或消失，右肺下叶近膈处原15x14mm结节现已不明显，现较大者约13x10mm（IMA47），原局部范围约25x15mm，考虑胸膜转移好转
text_en: Irregular thickening of the right pleura is less than prior. Multiple pleural nodules have decreased in size or disappeared. The previously 15x14 mm nodule near the diaphragm in the right lower lobe is no longer evident; the largest now measures approximately 13x10 mm (IMA47). The prior area measured about 25x15 mm. Improvement in pleural metastasis is considered.

source_text: 双肺下叶模糊小结节同前，追查
text_en: Faint small nodules in both lower lobes are unchanged compared to prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜及双侧胸膜多发结节状增厚大部分同前相仿，右肺尖胸膜结节较前稍大，如较厚原约2mm（IM13），现约5mm（IM12）
text_en: Multiple nodular thickenings of the right interlobar pleura and bilateral pleura are mostly similar to prior. The pleural nodule at the right lung apex is slightly larger than before, increasing from approximately 2 mm (IM13) to approximately 5 mm (IM12).

source_text: 两肺内局限性纤维化条索影大致同前，未见肺内明显新增结节及肿块征象
text_en: Focal fibrotic linear opacities in both lungs are roughly unchanged; no new obvious nodules or mass lesions are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段结节同前，追查
text_en: Left upper lobe anterior segment nodule stable, for follow-up.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段不规则结节大致同前，但对比[DATE]胸部CT可见内部实性成分增多，需警惕恶性可能
text_en: Irregular nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe is roughly unchanged in morphology and size; however, compared to [DATE] chest CT, solid components have increased; malignant potential should be considered.

source_text: 左肺上叶不规则形混杂磨玻璃密度小结节大致同前，边界不清，现仍约20*13mm（IMA12），内见小空泡
text_en: Irregular mixed ground-glass density nodule in the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior, with ill-defined margins, currently measuring approximately 20 x 13 mm (IMA12), containing a small air bubble.

source_text: 纵隔6组小淋巴结同前，约8x5mm（IM14）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in mediastinal station 6 are unchanged from prior, approximately 8x5 mm (IM14).

source_text: 右肺上叶浅淡小结节影同前（IM32）
text_en: Faint small nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior (IM32).

source_text: 甲状腺双侧叶稍低密度结节灶同前
text_en: Slightly low-density nodule in bilateral thyroid lobes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶类圆形结节大致同前，约15*13mm（IM23），边界清楚
text_en: Left upper lobe round nodule stable compared to prior, approximately 15x13 mm (IM23), well-defined margins

source_text: 部分增大，如左肺上叶尖后段原小于2mm（IM21），现约5mm（IM22）
text_en: Some increased in size, such as in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe, previously less than 2 mm (image 21), now approximately 5 mm (image 22).

source_text: 纵隔4R、5组小淋巴结影同前
text_en: Small mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R and 5 are similar to previous

source_text: 右肺尖及右肺下叶结节大致同前，约3mm（IM20、23、45、48、56）
text_en: Nodules in the right lung apex and right lower lobe are stable compared to prior, approximately 3 mm (IM20, 23, 45, 48, 56).

source_text: 扫及右侧肾上腺可疑结节同前，约9mm（Im60）
text_en: CT shows a suspicious nodule in the right adrenal gland, unchanged from previous, approximately 9 mm (Im60).

source_text: 均考虑转移
text_en: All are considered to represent metastasis.

source_text: 右肺下叶及左肺点状微小结节同前，＜5mm（Im33）
text_en: Punctate tiny nodules in the right lower lobe and left lung are unchanged, <5 mm (Im33).

source_text: 纵隔3P、4R、8组、右侧锁骨上可见多发肿大淋巴结，较大原约25x15mm（IM4），现约17x10mm（IMA6），原胃小弯肿大淋巴结，约18x16mm（IM55），现边界不清，结合腹部检查
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes visible in mediastinal stations 3P, 4R, 8, and right supraclavicular region, larger one previously approximately 25x15 mm (IM4), currently approximately 17x10 mm (IMA6), previously enlarged lymph node at gastric lesser curvature approximately 18x16 mm (IM55), currently ill-defined borders, in conjunction with abdominal examination.

source_text: 右肺下叶多发小结节同前，性质待定，追查
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right lower lobe are unchanged; etiology indeterminate; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺斑片状透过度降低好转，左肺胸膜下小结节同前，约5mm（IM22）
text_en: Patchy opacity in the left lung improved, small subpleural nodules in the left lung unchanged from previous, approximately 5mm (image 22).

source_text: 右肺部分结节较前稍增大，如下叶背段结节原约4mm，现约6mm（IM26），另一结节原约3mm者现约5mm（IMA26）
text_en: Some nodules in the right lung are slightly larger than before; for example, a nodule in the dorsal segment of the lower lobe increased from approximately 4 mm to 6 mm (IM26), and another nodule increased from 3 mm to 5 mm (IMA26).

source_text: 左肺下叶陈旧小结节同前（Im41），余肺未见新生结节灶或斑片影，左侧未见胸水
text_en: Old small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (Im41); no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remaining lung; no pleural effusion on the left.

source_text: 两下肺胸膜下见微小结节影同前（IM33、42），直径小于5mm
text_en: Subpleural micronodules in both lower lungs are unchanged from prior (IM33, 42), with diameters less than 5 mm.

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段胸膜下肿块较前缩小，原约17x17mm（IMA32），现约12x11mm（Im33），邻近片絮影与肿物分界不清
text_en: A subpleural mass in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is decreased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 17x17 mm (IMA32), currently approximately 12x11 mm (Im33), with adjacent patchy opacities having ill-defined borders with the mass.

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺结节同前，约22x16mm（IM55），追查
text_en: Left adrenal nodule unchanged, approximately 22x16 mm (IM55), follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段结节灶同前相仿，仍约16x16mm（IM20），边缘多发毛刺，与胸膜粘连，内部可见钙化，外周肺见不规则气肿同前，恶性不除外
text_en: The nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe is similar to previous, still measuring approximately 16x16 mm (IM20), with multiple spiculations at the margin, pleural adhesion, calcification within, irregular emphysema in the surrounding lung unchanged, malignancy cannot be excluded.

source_text: 右肺多发小结节同前，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the right lung are unchanged; old/inactive foci are considered.

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下结节缩小，现约8x6mm（IM54），原为12x9mm（IM50），追查
text_en: Subpleural nodule in the right lower lobe measures 8 x 6 mm (IM54), decreased from 12 x 9 mm (IM50); recommend follow-up.

source_text: 左肺上叶及右肺下叶小结节同前，约4mm（IM22、39、25），左肺下叶前基底段结节较前显示模糊（IM41）
text_en: Small nodules in the left upper lobe and right lower lobe are unchanged, approximately 4 mm (IM22, 39, 25), and the nodule in the anterior basal segment of the left lower lobe appears more indistinct compared to previous (IM41).

source_text: 左肺微小结节同前（Im36、41），追查
text_en: Tiny nodule in the left lung unchanged from prior (Im36, 41); recommend follow-up.

source_text: 左肺胸膜下结节影、右肺上叶前段浅淡结节同前(图25)
text_en: Left lung subpleural nodule shadow, right upper lobe anterior segment faint nodule unchanged (Figure 25)

source_text: 右肺中叶局限性膨胀不全同前，余双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Focal atelectasis in the right middle lobe is unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺尖及右肺下叶结节大致同前，约3mm（IM20、23、45、48、57）
text_en: Nodules in the right lung apex and right lower lobe are stable compared to prior, approximately 3 mm (IM20, 23, 45, 48, 57).

source_text: 纵隔隆突下转移淋巴结明显增大
text_en: Subcarinal mediastinal lymph nodes suspicious for metastasis significantly enlarged

source_text: 右下肺见微小结节同前，约2mm（IM20)，左肺上叶舌段见索条影，余肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: Tiny nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 2 mm (IM20). Linear opacity is seen in the lingular segment of the left upper lobe. No nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结大部分同前相仿，腔静脉后淋巴结仍约12x7mm（IM20），个别略增大，如原约8x6mm（IM14），现约9x7mm（IM12）
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes mostly unchanged, postcaval lymph node still approximately 12x7 mm (IM20), some slightly enlarged, e.g., previously approximately 8x6 mm (IM14), now approximately 9x7 mm (IM12)

source_text: 左主支气管开口处局部壁不均匀增厚同前，局部肿物仍向支气管腔内、腔外生长，较厚处约18mm（IM26），病变致局部管腔狭窄同前，左肺下叶肺不张较前减轻
text_en: Focal irregular wall thickening at the origin of the left main bronchus remains unchanged; the local mass continues to grow into and beyond the bronchial lumen, with a maximum thickness of approximately 18 mm (IM26). Luminal narrowing due to the lesion remains unchanged; atelectasis of the left lower lobe has improved compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶结节较前增大、清晰，约4mm（IM34）、3mm（IM36）
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe is larger and more distinct, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM34) and 3 mm (IM36).

source_text: 右侧第3后肋致密灶同前，余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏
text_en: Dense focus in the right 3rd posterior rib is stable. No bony destruction is seen in the remainder of the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 胸12椎体许莫氏结节同前
text_en: T12 vertebral body Schmorl's node, stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度灶稍缩小，较大原约11*11mm，现约11x9mm（IMA16）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe slightly decreased in size, previously approximately 11 x 11 mm, now approximately 11 x 9 mm (IMA16).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段不规则团片结节灶大致同前，实性部分仍约19x18mm（IM14），远端斑片影同前
text_en: In the anterior segment of the left upper lobe, an irregular patchy nodule is stable compared to previous, with the solid component still approximately 19x18 mm (IM14), and the distal patchy shadow remains stable.

source_text: 左背部小结节同前，倾向良性，追查
text_en: Left dorsal small nodule stable, favoring benign, follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结，部分略大，如原约10x6mm，现约12x8mm（IM22）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes, some slightly enlarged, for example, previously approximately 10x6 mm, now approximately 12x8 mm (IM22)

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜及纵隔胸膜多发结节状增厚大致同前
text_en: Multiple nodular thickenings of the right interlobar pleura and mediastinal pleura are roughly unchanged from prior.

source_text: 食管-胃吻合术后，左侧气管沟肿块，考虑淋巴结转移可能大，请结合临床
text_en: Post-esophagogastrectomy; a mass in the left tracheoesophageal groove is seen, with lymph node metastasis considered likely; clinical correlation is recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段新见结节，约8x6mm（IM20）
text_en: Newly seen nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe, approximately 8 x 6 mm (IM20).

source_text: 右上肺门区结构紊乱，局部未见异常增厚，右肺中叶结节同前相仿，仍约5x5mm（IM21），胸膜下结节同前（IM24、27、36），右肺内索条影大致同前
text_en: Disorganized architecture in the right hilar region without abnormal thickening; right middle lobe nodule similar to prior, still approximately 5x5 mm (IM21); subpleural nodules unchanged (IM24, 27, 36); right lung linear densities largely unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结显示同前，约15x9mm（IM25），双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal 4R lymph node unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 15x9 mm (IM25); no enlarged lymph nodes in bilateral hilar, supraclavicular, or bilateral axillary regions

source_text: 右肺散在模糊小结节部分显示较前清，部分呈树丫状改变同前
text_en: Some of the scattered hazy small nodules in the right lung are more clearly defined than prior; some show tree-in-bud pattern, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段小结节同前，约4mm（IM27）
text_en: Small nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable, approximately 4 mm (IM27)

source_text: 纵隔4L小淋巴结较前缩小相仿，约7mm（IM24），贲门旁及胃小弯淋巴结同前，现较大约16x15mm（IM57）
text_en: Small lymph nodes at mediastinal station 4L are slightly decreased in size compared to prior, measuring approximately 7 mm (IM24). Lymph nodes adjacent to the cardia and along the lesser curvature of the stomach are unchanged from prior, with the larger one now measuring approximately 16x15 mm (IM57).

source_text: 左肺上叶两3mm微小结节同前（IM19、21）
text_en: Two 3-mm small nodules in the left upper lobe are unchanged from previous (IM19, 21).

source_text: 双侧胸膜散在结节样增厚并微小钙化同前
text_en: Bilateral pleural scattered nodular thickening with micro-calcification is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左锁骨上区多发小结节较前相仿，较大仍约11x9mm（IM11）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left supraclavicular region similar to previous, largest still approximately 11x9 mm (IM11).

source_text: 右肺下叶索条及类结节影同前
text_en: The linear opacities and nodular-like shadows in the right lower lobe are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结影同前，仍约7mm（IMA24）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior; largest approximately 7 mm (IMA24).

source_text: 食管胸上中段管壁增厚较前明显减轻，较厚处原约35mm（IM23），现约11mm（IM22），与胸主动脉接触面小于90°
text_en: Wall thickening in the upper to mid thoracic esophagus significantly reduced compared to prior; previously thickest area approximately 35mm (IM23), currently approximately 11mm (IM22), with contact surface to thoracic aorta less than 90 degrees.

source_text: 双肺纹理增多，左肺胸膜下小结节同前，约3mm（IMA32），观察
text_en: Increased lung markings. A small subpleural nodule in the left lung is similar to prior, measuring about 3 mm (IMA32). Observation recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段类圆形小结节同前，现约4mm（Im36）
text_en: Roundish small nodule in the left upper lobe lingular segment is stable, currently measuring approximately 4 mm (IM36)

source_text: 右肺中叶索条及微小结节影同前
text_en: Linear opacity and tiny nodules in the right middle lobe are unchanged.

source_text: 左肺钙化同前，未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Left lung calcifications unchanged from previous; no new nodules or consolidations.

source_text: 纵隔内淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from previous, follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结部分同前，较大者约12x10mm（IM10），部分缩小，如原约8x8mm（IM14）者，现约8x4mm（IM15）
text_en: Some multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are unchanged from previous, with the largest approximately 12x10 mm (IM10); some have decreased in size, such as one that was previously approximately 8x8 mm (IM14) and is now approximately 8x4 mm (IM15).

source_text: 右肺中叶不规则结节同前，仍约20x13mm（IM29）
text_en: Irregular nodule in the right middle lobe unchanged, still measures approximately 20x13 mm (IM29)

source_text: 新见小簇微小结节
text_en: Newly identified small cluster of tiny nodules

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段小结节影，转移
text_en: Small nodule in the basal segment of the right lower lobe, metastatic.

source_text: 两肺下叶微小结节影同前（IM20、36），较大约3mm（IM36）
text_en: Micronodules in both lower lobes are unchanged from prior (IM20, 36). The largest measures approximately 3 mm (IM36).

source_text: 扫及右侧肾上腺脂肪密度结节同前
text_en: On scan, right adrenal fat-density nodule unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，建议随诊复查
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, recommend follow-up imaging.

source_text: 右肺中叶见磨玻璃小结节同前，约7mm（IM34）
text_en: A ground-glass small nodule is seen in the right middle lobe, unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 7 mm (IM34).

source_text: 左侧肾上腺新见结节，考虑转移
text_en: Newly seen nodule in the left adrenal gland; metastasis is considered.

source_text: 左锁骨上区、纵隔及左肺门多发淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region, mediastinum, and left hilar region are similar to previous.

source_text: 纵隔6组小淋巴结同前，约5mm（IM16)
text_en: Small lymph nodes in mediastinal station 6 are unchanged from prior, approximately 5 mm (IM16).

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，考虑良性
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable and considered benign.

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段结节同前，约11x10mm（IM26）
text_en: A nodule in the left upper lobe lingular segment is similar to previous, approximately 11x10 mm (IM26).

source_text: 左肺胸膜下小结节同前（IM41）
text_en: Left lung subpleural small nodule unchanged from previous (IM41).

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节大致同前，性质待定，追查
text_en: Right upper lobe small nodule essentially unchanged, etiology indeterminate, recommend follow-up

source_text: 纵隔2、4、6组、右锁骨上及双腋下小淋巴结同前，未见肿大
text_en: Small lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2, 4, 6, right supraclavicular, and bilateral axillary regions unchanged from prior; no enlarged lymph nodes

source_text: 右肺上叶见不规则索条影、小结节及高密度钙化灶（IM19）同前
text_en: Irregular linear bands, small nodules, and high-density calcified foci are seen in the right upper lobe (IM19), unchanged.

source_text: 右下肺门结构扭曲，小淋巴结同前（Im24）
text_en: Distortion of the right lower lobe hilar architecture with small lymph nodes unchanged (Im24).

source_text: 纵隔5组淋巴结同前，较大仍约15x10mm（IM27）
text_en: Mediastinal group 5 lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest still approximately 15x10 mm (Image 27)

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下纯磨玻璃影结节同前，约9x8mm(IM11)
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural pure ground-glass opacity nodule unchanged from prior, approximately 9 x 8 mm (IM11).

source_text: 双肺散在模糊小结节影较前相仿，右上肺较大者仍约7mm（IMA20）
text_en: Scattered indistinct small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior. The largest in the right upper lung remains approximately 7 mm (IMA20).

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下磨玻璃结节同前，大小约9x7mm（IM29），邻近胸膜似牵拉增厚
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural ground-glass nodule unchanged from prior, size approximately 9 x 7 mm (IM29), with adjacent pleural thickening suggestive of traction.

source_text: 扫及胸11椎体许莫氏结节，余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Scans show a Schmorl's node in the T11 vertebra; no signs of bone destruction in the remaining thoracic cage bones.

source_text: 平扫纵隔淋巴结略增大，原较大约11x8mm，现较大约13*10mm（IM20）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows mediastinal lymph nodes slightly enlarged, previously largest approximately 11x8 mm, currently largest approximately 13x10 mm (image 20).

source_text: 左侧锁骨上小淋巴结同前，约7x4mm（IM2）
text_en: Left supraclavicular small lymph node unchanged, approximately 7x4 mm (IM2)

source_text: 双肺多发小结节，较前增多、部分增大，考虑转移可能
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs have increased in number and some have increased in size; metastasis is possible.

source_text: 左肺未见新发结节，双侧未见胸水
text_en: No new nodules in the left lung, and no pleural effusion bilaterally.

source_text: 左肺下叶结节及钙化灶同前，余多发模糊结节同前相仿
text_en: The nodule and calcified focus in the left lower lobe are unchanged from previous; multiple ill-defined nodules in the remaining lung are similar to previous.

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节大致同前
text_en: Right upper lobe small nodule essentially unchanged

source_text: 左肺舌叶索条影同前，余双肺未见新发结节或斑片影
text_en: Left lung lingula: linear opacity unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remainder of both lungs

source_text: 双肺模糊小结节较前相仿
text_en: Faint small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior.

source_text: 双肺散在索条及钙化结节同前
text_en: Scattered linear opacities and calcified nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶占位较前增大，
text_en: A mass in the left upper lobe is increased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 右上肺少许索条影较前相仿，余肺内散在小结节同前（IM14、17、26），左肺尖较大者仍约6mm（IMA14）
text_en: Minimal linear opacity in the right upper lung is similar to prior; scattered small nodules in the remainder of the lungs are unchanged (IM14, 17, 26), with the largest in the left lung apex still measuring approximately 6 mm (IMA14).

source_text: 纵隔4R、7、9组淋巴结大致同前，较大约15x9mm（IM27）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R, 7, and 9 are roughly similar to prior, with the largest approximately 15x9mm (IM27).

source_text: 右肺下叶结节、磨玻璃密度灶较前相仿，复查
text_en: The nodule and ground-glass opacity in the right lower lobe are similar to prior examination; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜局限性结节样增厚同前（IMA28）

text_en: Some nodules are similar to previous; for example, calcifications and small nodular foci in the right upper lobe (IM20) and middle lobe (IM36).

text_en: Linear opacities in both lungs are stable; no new nodules are seen in both lungs.

text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is slightly smaller than before, now approximately 4 mm (IM32), previously 5 mm (IM32).

text_en: Mediastinal station 4L lymph nodes similar to prior, approximately 14x10mm (image 20).
