source_text: 与[DATE]胸部CT比较，左肺上叶尖后段磨玻璃结节较前略饱满，原约12x8mm（IM21），现约15x11mm（IM20），边缘尚清，倾向恶性，密切追查
text_en: Compared to [DATE] chest CT, the ground-glass nodule in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe is slightly more prominent, previously approximately 12x8 mm (IM21), now approximately 15x11 mm (IM20), margins still well-defined; malignancy favored; close follow-up recommended

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结较前缩小，较大者原约24*12mm(图25)，此次未见明确显示
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes have decreased in size compared to previous; the largest was previously approximately 24x12 mm (Figure 25), and is not definitively visible this time.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph node in the left supraclavicular region is stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度小结节较前增大，原约10mm，现约31x10mm（IM34）呈实性
text_en: Small ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 10 mm, now approximately 31 x 10 mm (IM34), solid.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段胸膜下小结节影同前，约4mm（IM13）
text_en: The subpleural nodule in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment is similar to prior, approximately 4 mm (IM13)

source_text: 左肺上叶见一浅淡小结节同前，约5mm（IM29），追查
text_en: A faint small nodule, approximately 5mm (Image 29), is seen in the left upper lobe unchanged from prior; follow-up.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结大致同前，约14x12mm（Im29）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 14x12 mm (Im29).

source_text: 右肺微结节同前（IM22）
text_en: Right lung micro-nodule unchanged compared to prior (IM22)

source_text: 纵隔肿大淋巴结同前，较大者短径仍8mm（IM17），密切观察
text_en: Mediastinal enlarged lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest short axis still 8mm (IM17), close follow-up.

source_text: 右肺新见两枚小结节，约3mm（IM27、35）
text_en: Two new small nodules observed in the right lung, approximately 3 mm in size (IM27, 35).

source_text: 左肺小结节同前
text_en: Small nodules in the left lung unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺术区后方片絮索条影大致同前（Im25），左肺索条、模糊小结节影同前（Im25）
text_en: The linear and reticular opacities posterior to the right lung surgical site are stable compared to prior (Im25); the linear opacities and indistinct small nodules in the left lung are also stable compared to prior (Im25).

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜结节样增厚同前（IMA35、41）
text_en: The nodular thickening of the left interlobar pleura is unchanged compared to prior (IMA35, 41).

source_text: 左肺下叶、右肺上叶小结节同前（IMA25、34），较大约3mm
text_en: Small nodules in the left lower lobe and right upper lobe are unchanged from prior (IMA25, 34). The largest is approximately 3mm.

source_text: 纵隔2L、4L、5组多发淋巴结大致同前，较大仍约10x7mm（IM24）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal groups 2L, 4L, and 5 largely unchanged from prior, largest still approximately 10x7mm (IM24).

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前（IM50、52），较大内见小空洞同前
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from prior (IM50, 52), with a small cavity within the larger dimension unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左上叶小结节同前（IM13），两肺未见新发结节影
text_en: The small nodule in the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior (IM13); no new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 两肺散在小结节影大致同前，仍小于5mm
text_en: The scattered small nodular opacities in both lungs are largely unchanged and remain less than 5 mm.

source_text: 纵隔4R组淋巴结较前增大，原小簇淋巴结整体约14x9mm（IM22），现整体约20x15mm（IM21）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph nodes are enlarged compared to previous; previously, the cluster of small lymph nodes measured approximately 14x9 mm (IM22), currently approximately 20x15 mm (IM21).

source_text: 右肺尖结节同前（IM10），左肺上叶微小2mm结节同前（IM30）
text_en: Nodule in the right lung apex is unchanged (IM10); a 2 mm tiny nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged (IM30).

source_text: 颈段食管与气管间见不规则软组织灶，约40x29mm（IM7），考虑肿大淋巴结可能性大，考虑转移，与气管食管及甲状腺双叶分界不清
text_en: An irregular soft tissue focus measuring approximately 40x29 mm (IM7) is seen between the cervical esophagus and trachea, with ill-defined borders to the trachea, esophagus, and bilateral thyroid lobes; likely represents an enlarged lymph node, and metastasis is considered.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，追查
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged, follow-up

source_text: 右肺上叶散在小结节同前（IM19、21），约2-4mm
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the right upper lobe are unchanged from prior (IM19, 21), measuring approximately 2–4 mm.

source_text: 左上肺不规则软组织影大致同前，约28*13mm（IM10），周围索条、小结节及胸膜粘连同前
text_en: Irregular soft tissue opacity in the left upper lobe is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 28x13 mm (IM10); surrounding linear opacities, small nodules, and pleural adhesions are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见异常软组织密度肿块影，右肺索条影同前，右肺下叶斑片索条状影同前（IM44）
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no abnormal soft tissue density mass is seen at the bronchial stump. Linear opacities in the right lung are stable. Patchy and linear opacities in the right lower lobe are stable compared to prior (IM44).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段胸膜下磨玻璃结节同前，大小约8x6mm（IM25），边界清
text_en: Subpleural ground-glass nodule in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe, unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 8x6 mm (IM25), with well-defined margins.

source_text: 余两肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: No additional nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜结节样增厚同前(图35)
text_en: The nodular thickening along the right interlobar pleura is unchanged (Figure 35).

source_text: 左肺下叶外基底段微结节同前，约3mm（IM49）
text_en: The micronodule in the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM49).

source_text: 左肺下叶钙化结节同前
text_en: Calcified nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺中叶、左肺下叶小结节同前（Im31、38、58），未见新生结节
text_en: Small nodules in the right middle lobe and left lower lobe unchanged (Im31, 38, 58); no new nodules seen

source_text: 双侧少量胸膜下索条影同前，肺尖胸膜下小结节灶同前，约2mm（IMA12），双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Minimal subpleural linear opacities bilaterally are unchanged; a small subpleural nodule at the lung apex is unchanged, measuring approximately 2 mm (IMA12); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 扫及贲门区、纵隔内及食管旁淋巴结较前缩小，如原约16*12mm者，现约13x7mm（IMA53）
text_en: Lymph nodes in the cardiac region, mediastinum, and paraesophageal area are smaller than before, for example, previously approximately 16x12mm, now approximately 13x7mm (IMA53).

source_text: 其外侧圆形小结节较前相仿，仍约8mm（Im20）
text_en: The small round nodule lateral to it is similar to prior, still measuring approximately 8 mm (Im20).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变，胸部CT未见新增占位征象
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; no new space-occupying lesions are seen on chest CT.

source_text: T7椎体局限性高密度灶同前，胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Focal high-density lesion in T7 vertebral body unchanged; no evidence of osseous destruction in the thoracic skeleton

source_text: 右肺中叶结节影同前，仍约21x13mm（IM31）
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged, still measuring approximately 21x13 mm (IM31).

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前
text_en: The right hilar lymph node is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双侧少量胸膜下索条影同前，双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Minimal subpleural linear opacities bilaterally are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔及左锁骨上多发小淋巴结基本同前，较大者短径小于8mm
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and left supraclavicular region essentially unchanged from previous, the largest with short axis less than 8mm.

source_text: 双肺多发点状微小结节显示欠清，双肺未见新发结节
text_en: Multiple punctate tiny nodules in both lungs are poorly visualized; no new nodules are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 右肺中叶胸膜旁见两枚结节同前，分别约4mm、6mm（IM34）,其中较大结节与邻近胸膜分界不清
text_en: Two subpleural nodules are seen in the right middle lobe, unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 4 mm and 6 mm (IM34), respectively; the larger nodule has indistinct margins with adjacent pleura.

source_text: 左肺上叶癌同前相仿，追查
text_en: Left upper lobe carcinoma is stable compared to previous, for follow-up.

source_text: 胸部CT未见转移征象
text_en: Chest CT shows no metastatic signs.

source_text: 纵隔散在肿大淋巴结同前，较大者约25x10mm（IM26）
text_en: Mediastinal scattered enlarged lymph nodes unchanged, largest approximately 25x10 mm (IM26).

source_text: 右肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation in the right lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，左侧胸膜增厚加重，考虑胸膜转移
text_en: Left lower lobe postoperative, left pleural thickening is worsened, suggestive of pleural metastasis.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃密度结节影同前，约15x12mm（IM29）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe posterior segment is unchanged, measuring approximately 15 x 12 mm (IM29).

source_text: 左上肺不规则软组织影大致同前，约28*13mm（IM11），周围索条、小结节及胸膜粘连同前
text_en: Irregular soft tissue opacity in the left upper lobe is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 28x13 mm (IM11); surrounding linear opacities, small nodules, and pleural adhesions are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺多发微结节大致同前，追查
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in the right lung are largely unchanged from prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段多发模糊点片影及多发类圆形小结节同前（IM26）
text_en: Multiple ill-defined punctate and patchy opacities and multiple round small nodules in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe are unchanged from prior (IM26).

source_text: 左肺下叶背段支气管壁略增厚同前，周围片絮影较前范围增大，密度增高，考虑恶性
text_en: Mild thickening of the bronchial wall in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe, unchanged from previous, with surrounding patchy opacities increased in extent and density compared to previous, suspicious for malignancy.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上、纵隔多发淋巴结，部分缩小，部分同前
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region and mediastinum; some have decreased in size, others are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶及左肺下叶微小结节同前，约2-3mm（IM28、45）
text_en: Micro-nodules in the right upper lobe and left lower lobe are stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 2–3 mm (IM28, 45).

source_text: 右上肺及右肺中叶小结节同前（IM15、22），双侧肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: Small nodules in the right upper lung and right middle lobe are unchanged (IM15, 22); no new nodules are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶索条影同前，余双肺未见新发结节或斑片影
text_en: Left lower lobe fibrotic streak unchanged, rest of both lungs no new nodules or patchy opacities

source_text: 左肺上叶微小结节影大致同前，复查
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule similar to prior, follow-up

source_text: 右肺索条及小斑片影较前缩小（IMA35），两肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Linear opacities and small patchy opacities in the right lung are smaller than prior (IMA35); no new nodules or consolidations are seen in either lung.

source_text: 右肺少许小结节同前，较大约5mm（IM20），余肺未见结节或实变影
text_en: A few small nodules in the right lung are unchanged; the largest measures approximately 5 mm (IM20); no nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段结节，较前缩小，建议继续抗炎后复查
text_en: The nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe has decreased in size; continued anti-inflammatory treatment and follow-up are recommended.

source_text: 余双肺胸膜下新见少许模糊小结节（IM17、37等）
text_en: Newly noted few indistinct small subpleural nodules in both lungs (IM17, 37, etc.).

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，随诊复查
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are stable compared to prior; follow-up recommended

source_text: 食管旁肿大淋巴结较前缩小，短径原约24mm（IM31），现约14mm（IM30）
text_en: Paraesophageal enlarged lymph node reduced in size compared to previous, short axis previously approximately 24 mm (image 31), now approximately 14 mm (image 30).

source_text: 右肺下叶结节同前（IMA45），约9mm
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged from prior (IMA45), measuring approximately 9 mm.

source_text: 两肺上叶微小结节影同前，建议复查
text_en: Micronodules in both upper lobes are unchanged from prior. Follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 左侧斜裂胸膜下微小结节同前，约2mm（IM31）
text_en: Tiny subpleural nodule in the left oblique fissure is unchanged, measuring approximately 2 mm (IM31).

source_text: 食管胸中下段管壁不均匀增厚较前加重，较厚现约14mm（IM32），原约11mm（IM31），外膜模糊
text_en: Irregular wall thickening of the mid-to-lower thoracic esophagus increased compared to prior, thickest portion now approximately 14mm (IM32), previously approximately 11mm (IM31), serosa blurred.

source_text: 右下叶实性为主软组织密度结节灶同前相仿，约12x9mm（Im38），斜裂胸膜牵拉凹陷同前
text_en: Solid-predominant soft tissue density nodule in the right lower lobe similar to prior, approximately 12x9 mm (Im38), with persistent pleural retraction and indentation along the oblique fissure.

source_text: 纵隔2L气管食管沟内多发淋巴较前增大，现约8mm（IM16)，原5mm
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal station 2L tracheoesophageal groove increased compared to previous, now approximately 8 mm (IM16), previously 5 mm.

source_text: 胃小弯小淋巴结较前略小，原约11x9mm(图55)者，现约9x7mm（IM52）
text_en: Small lymph nodes at the lesser curvature of the stomach are slightly smaller than prior. The one previously measuring approximately 11x9mm (Figure 55) now measures approximately 9x7mm (IM52).

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端近胸膜下见结节影较前增大，现约6mm（IM32），原约3mm，密切追查
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; a nodule near the bronchial stump subpleurally has increased in size compared to prior, now approximately 6 mm (IM32), previously about 3 mm; close follow-up recommended

source_text: 纵隔2R淋巴结同前相仿，现约8x4mm（IMA16），纵隔4R\L及右肺门淋巴结平扫范围大致同前
text_en: Lymph node at mediastinal station 2R similar to previous, currently approximately 8x4mm (IMA16); mediastinal stations 4R and L and right hilar lymph nodes non-contrast scan range similar to previous

source_text: 双肺微小结节影同前（IM12、22、35等）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary micro-nodular opacities are stable compared to prior (IM12, 22, 35, etc.).

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结较前增大前，较大原短径仍约6mm（IM13），现约10mm（IM13）
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes are enlarged compared to prior; the largest short axis was approximately 6 mm (IM13) and is now approximately 10 mm (IM13).

source_text: 右肺上叶软组织肿块较前增大，原约44x33mm（IM25），现约77x54mm（IM20），边缘不规则，病变坏死明显，内见空洞形成，及液平面，后缘紧贴右侧水平裂，周围见多发不规则条片影
text_en: Soft tissue mass in the right upper lobe has increased in size, previously measuring approximately 44x33 mm (IM25), now approximately 77x54 mm (IM20). The margin is irregular. Necrosis is prominent, with cavity formation and an air-fluid level visible. The posterior margin abuts the right horizontal fissure. Multiple irregular linear and patchy opacities are seen in the surrounding area.

source_text: 右肺下叶磨玻璃密度小结节影同前（IM29、34、39、49、50），小于10mm
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM29, 34, 39, 49, 50), less than 10 mm in size

source_text: 纵隔7组肿大淋巴结，较前稍增大
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 enlarged lymph nodes are slightly increased in size compared to previous

source_text: 两肺小结节同前相仿（IM31、43、59）
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs similar to prior (IM31, 43, 59)

source_text: 双肺下叶小磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿（IM35、43)，较大仍约5mm，倾向AAH或癌前病变可能
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodules in both lower lobes are similar to prior (IM35, 43); the largest remains approximately 5 mm, with findings favoring atypical adenomatous hyperplasia (AAH) or a precancerous lesion.

source_text: 两肺模糊结节同前，较大约5mm（IM32）
text_en: The hazy nodules in both lungs are unchanged compared to prior; the largest is approximately 5 mm (IM32).

source_text: 右肺中叶见不规则形小结节同前，仍约5mm（Im40），周围见少许索条影
text_en: An irregularly shaped small nodule is seen in the right middle lobe, unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (Im40). A small amount of linear opacity is seen around it.

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节较前略增大，密切追查
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule slightly increased in size compared to previous, close follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右侧第5侧肋见连续性中断，扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Discontinuity is seen in the right 5th lateral rib. No bony destruction is seen in the remainder of the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 纵膈、双侧锁骨上区未见明显新发肿大淋巴结
text_en: No obvious new enlarged lymph nodes in the mediastinum or bilateral supraclavicular regions.

source_text: 纵隔、左腋下小淋巴结显示同前，小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal and left axillary small lymph nodes unchanged from previous, less than 10 mm.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段可见一分叶状软组织密度结节同前，仍约19x15mm（Im26），内可见支气管气相
text_en: A lobulated soft tissue density nodule in the left lower lobe, apical segment, unchanged from prior, still approximately 19x15 mm (Im26), with bronchial air sign present.

source_text: 未见新发结节或索条影
text_en: No new nodules or linear opacities

source_text: 右肺上叶微小结节较前缩小呈条状，空洞消失（图9），建议追查
text_en: Right upper lobe micro-nodule smaller than prior, now linear in appearance, with resolution of cavity (Figure 9), recommend follow-up

source_text: 右腋下小淋巴结同前，仍约7mm（IM20），纵隔、双肺门及锁骨上未见新发淋巴结肿大
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the right axilla are unchanged from prior, still measuring approximately 7 mm (IM20). No new lymphadenopathy in the mediastinum, bilateral hila, or supraclavicular regions.

source_text: 纵隔5组高密度淋巴结较前增大，大小原约14*11mm，现约22x15mm（Im29）
text_en: Mediastinal station 5 hyperdense lymph nodes increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 14 × 11 mm, now approximately 22 × 15 mm (Im29)

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后，平扫支气管断端未见明显软组织密度肿块影，远端斑片索条影较前略增多
text_en: Status post left lower lobectomy, non-contrast CT shows no obvious soft tissue density mass at the bronchial stump, with distal patchy linear opacities slightly increased compared to previous.

source_text: 左肺门小淋巴结较前缩小，原约9x6mm（IM24），现约8*4mm(图24)
text_en: Left hilar small lymph nodes decreased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 9x6 mm (IM24), now approximately 8x4 mm (Figure 24)

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节较前相仿，约9x6mm（IM22），下叶基底段胸膜下模糊小结节同前，约3mm（IM36）
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe remains similar in size, approximately 9 x 6 mm (Image 22); the small subpleural nodule in the basal segment of the lower lobe is unchanged, approximately 3 mm (Image 36).

source_text: 余肺散在微小结节大致同前，部分位于胸膜下，小于5mm
text_en: Scattered micro-nodules in the remaining lung are largely stable, some subpleural, all less than 5 mm.

source_text: 重度脂肪肝，肝内强化结节影大致同前，请结合腹部检查
text_en: Severe fatty liver, hepatic enhancing nodules largely unchanged, correlate with abdominal findings.

source_text: 两肺内散在结节灶大致同前，追查
text_en: Scattered nodules in both lungs are roughly unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 双肺多发模糊小结节同前
text_en: Multiple ill-defined small nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 后纵隔肿物大致同前，约33x27mm（IMA40）
text_en: Posterior mediastinal mass essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 33x27 mm (IMA40)

source_text: 右上叶术后，平扫支气管断端未见明确复发征象
text_en: Postoperative status of the right upper lobe; no definite signs of recurrence are seen at the bronchial stump on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段不规则形态软组织密度肿物较前略缩小，大小原约30x21mm，现约26x18mm（IMA31），边缘见毛刺，可见胸膜凹陷征，增强扫描可见强化
text_en: Left lower lobe posterior segment irregular soft tissue density mass slightly decreased in size compared to prior, from approximately 30x21 mm to 26x18 mm (IMA31), with spiculated margins, pleural indentation sign, and enhancement on contrast-enhanced scan.

source_text: 原长度范围约74mm（SE501 IM44），现约50mm（SE401 IM45），边界不清，局部外膜略模糊，同胸主动脉接触面小于90度
text_en: Previously measured at approximately 74 mm in length (SE501 IM44), now measures approximately 50 mm (SE401 IM45), with ill-defined margins and slightly blurred outer membrane; the contact surface with the thoracic aorta is less than 90 degrees.

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结较前相仿，约22x11mm（IM31），建议密切追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes are similar to prior, approximately 22x11 mm (IM31), recommend close follow-up

source_text: 右肺下叶磨玻璃密度片状灶略显增大（IMA24、41），较大原约14x10mm（IMA42），现约16x11mm（IMA41），随诊观察
text_en: Patchy ground-glass opacity in the right lower lobe is slightly larger than prior (IMA24, 41); previously measured approximately 14 x 10 mm (IMA42), now approximately 16 x 11 mm (IMA41); follow-up observation is recommended

source_text: 左肺下叶不规则结节小片灶大致同前（IM41）
text_en: Left lower lobe irregular patchy focus stable compared to previous (Image 41)

source_text: 右肺散在斑片索条及小片絮影部分较前相仿，双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Scattered patchy linear and small fluffy opacities in the right lung are partially similar to prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 食管胸中段管壁不均匀异常增厚局部层面较前略饱满，原较大层面约21x19mm(IM32)，现约23x20mm（IM33），请结合其它检查评价
text_en: Irregular abnormal wall thickening of the mid-thoracic esophagus is locally slightly more prominent compared to prior, with previously largest cross-sectional area approximately 21x19 mm (IM32) and currently approximately 23x20 mm (IM33). Correlation with other studies is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔5-6组肿大淋巴结缩小，原较大约26x19mm，现较大约21x19mm（IM19）
text_en: Enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 5-6 decreased in size, previously largest approximately 26x19 mm, now largest approximately 21x19 mm (IM19).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前相仿，仍约10x5mm（IM23）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are similar to prior; still measuring approximately 10x5 mm (IM23)

source_text: 纵隔4L组淋巴结较前相仿，约14x10mm(图21）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4L lymph nodes similar to prior, approximately 14x10mm (image 21).

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结及钙化同前
text_en: Small mediastinal lymph nodes and calcification unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺尖及右肺下叶结节大致同前，约3mm（IM18、21、23、42、46、54）
text_en: Nodules in the right lung apex and right lower lobe are stable compared to prior, approximately 3 mm (IM18, 21, 23, 42, 46, 54).

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下多发小结节大致同前，现较大仍约6*4mm(IM42)
text_en: Multiple small subpleural nodules in the right lower lobe are essentially unchanged; the largest remains approximately 6 x 4 mm (IM42).

source_text: 右肺下叶支气管截断、肺门肿物稍缩小，现范围约25x18mm（IM29），原约28x25mm(IM30)，远端肺不张大致同前
text_en: Right lower lobe bronchial cutoff and hilar mass slightly smaller, currently measuring approximately 25x18 mm (IM29), previously about 28x25 mm (IM30). Distal atelectasis remains essentially unchanged.

source_text: 右侧水平裂小结节同前，倾向良性，对比前片或随诊
text_en: Small nodule along the right horizontal fissure is stable, likely benign; comparison with prior study or follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 余左侧下叶及右肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation are seen in the left lower lobe or right lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶外基底段胸膜下微小结节同前，约3mm（IM29）
text_en: Left lower lobe lateral basal segment subpleural tiny nodule unchanged, approximately 3mm (IM29)

source_text: 右侧胸膜结节及右肺下叶模糊结节，较前未见明显变化
text_en: The right pleural nodule and the indistinct nodule in the right lower lobe show no significant change compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶外基底段胸膜下小结节较前相仿，约6mm（IM39），追查
text_en: The subpleural small nodule in the outer basal segment of the right lower lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM39); follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 纵隔6组小淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal station 6 small lymph nodes unchanged

source_text: 右肺上叶楔形切除术后，局部缝线旁纵膈胸膜较前略增厚，现约10mm（IMA23），原厚约5mm（IMA21），右侧胸膜弥漫多发大小不等结节较前增大，大者现约10mm（IMA28），原约6mm（IMA27）
text_en: Status post wedge resection of the right upper lobe; localized thickening of the mediastinal pleura adjacent to the suture site is slightly increased compared to prior, now approximately 10 mm (IMA23), previously about 5 mm (IMA21); multiple pleural nodules on the right side are larger than before, with the largest now approximately 10 mm (IMA28), previously about 6 mm (IMA27).

source_text: 双肺多发小结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior; benign etiology favored.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，较大者约14*8mm（IMA24）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node unchanged, largest approximately 14 x 8 mm (IMA24)

source_text: T12椎体小高密度结节同前(图55)
text_en: Small high-density nodule in the T12 vertebral body is unchanged (Figure 55).

source_text: 左肺上叶胸膜下小结节及右侧叶间胸膜结节样增厚同前
text_en: Left upper lobe subpleural nodule and right interlobar pleural nodular thickening, stable compared to prior

source_text: 左肺上叶切除、左肺下叶楔形切除术后，支气管断端未见异常肿块影，左侧少量胸水同前
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy and left lower lobe wedge resection, no abnormal mass at the bronchial stump, and a small amount of left pleural effusion unchanged from previous.

source_text: 左肺下叶一不规则小结节，较前稍缩小，原约4mm，现约3mm（IM42），追查
text_en: One irregular small nodule in the left lower lobe is slightly smaller compared to prior, previously approximately 4mm, now approximately 3mm (IM42); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 余双肺支气管通畅，肺内透亮度均匀，未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: Bronchi in both lungs are patent; lung parenchyma shows uniform lucency; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen

source_text: 右肺上叶前段及中叶内侧段磨玻璃结节同前无明显变化
text_en: Ground-glass nodules in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe and medial segment of the right middle lobe are unchanged without significant variation.

source_text: 右肺下叶模糊不规则结节较前稍缩小，原约6x5mm，现约5x4mm（IM31）
text_en: The ill-defined, irregular nodule in the right lower lobe is slightly smaller than before, previously approximately 6x5 mm, now approximately 5x4 mm (IM31).

source_text: 纵隔4组及7组淋巴结部分较前略饱满，原约14*8mm(图26)，现约16x12mm（IM26）
text_en: Some mediastinal lymph nodes, stations 4 and 7, slightly more prominent compared to prior; previously approximately 14x8 mm (Figure 26), now approximately 16x12 mm (IM26).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节影同前，仍约6x5mm（IM28）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged from prior, still approximately 6x5 mm (IM28)

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，左肺上叶前段胸膜下浅淡磨玻璃密度小结节同前，边缘模糊，约8x7mm（IM18）
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. A faint subpleural ground-glass opacity small nodule is seen in the left upper lobe anterior segment, stable, with indistinct margins, measuring approximately 8x7 mm (IM18).

source_text: 纵隔5组高密度淋巴结同前（Im21），纵隔内钙化及金属夹影同前
text_en: Mediastinal station 5 hyperdense lymph nodes unchanged (Im21); mediastinal calcifications and metallic clip artifacts unchanged

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃结节灶同前，追查
text_en: Ground-glass nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结较前缩小
text_en: The right hilar lymph node has decreased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶磨玻璃小结节同前（IM27），余双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe is stable (IM27); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 纵隔左移，纵隔及左侧锁骨上多发小淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal shift to the left, multiple small mediastinal and left supraclavicular lymph nodes unchanged.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下索条小结节灶大致同前，大小约3mm（IMA）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural small linear nodule essentially unchanged, approximately 3mm (IMA)

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous.

source_text: 右肺多发索条同前，右肺上叶前段及左肺下叶前内基底段磨玻璃结节同前（IM20、32），较大约6x5mm（IM20）
text_en: Multiple linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged. Ground-glass nodules in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe and the anteromedial basal segment of the left lower lobe are unchanged (IM20, 32), the largest measuring approximately 6x5 mm (IM20).

source_text: 纵膈小淋巴结，部分较前缩小，如原约10x9mm，现约8x6mm（IM38）
text_en: Small mediastinal lymph nodes, some decreased in size compared to prior; for example, previously approximately 10x9 mm, now approximately 8x6 mm (IM38)

source_text: 左锁骨上淋巴结同前，约11x10mm（IM4）
text_en: Left supraclavicular lymph nodes unchanged, approximately 11x10 mm (IM4).

source_text: 左主支气管截断缓解，肺组织复张，局部肿块缩小，原约44x31mm（IMA25），约25x22mm（IMA25）
text_en: Obliteration of the left main bronchus has improved, with re-expansion of the lung parenchyma; the local mass has decreased in size from a prior measurement of approximately 44x31 mm (IMA25) to approximately 25x22 mm (IMA25).

source_text: 左下肺见结节，约12mm（IM35），不除外转移
text_en: A nodule is seen in the left lower lobe, measuring approximately 12 mm (IM35), metastasis cannot be excluded.

source_text: 纵膈淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior

source_text: 右肺下叶模糊不规则结节较前缩小，现约6x5mm（IM29），原约8x4mm（IM28）
text_en: The ill-defined, irregular nodule in the right lower lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, now approximately 6x5 mm (IM29), previously approximately 8x4 mm (IM28).

source_text: 纵隔2R新见多发肿大淋巴结，边界模糊，4R淋巴结较前明显饱满、增大增多，现较大约19*11mm（IM22），考虑淋巴结转移可能大
text_en: Newly seen multiple enlarged lymph nodes at mediastinal station 2R with ill-defined margins; station 4R lymph nodes significantly enlarged and increased in number compared to previous, largest currently approximately 19x11mm (IM22), suspicious for lymph node metastasis

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则实性-磨玻璃密度结节影大致同前，仍约21x15mm（IM22），实性成分范围仍约10x7mm（IM23纵隔窗）
text_en: An irregular solid–ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment is approximately stable compared to prior, remaining approximately 21x15 mm (IM22); the solid component remains approximately 10x7 mm (IM23, mediastinal window).

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段见磨玻璃样病灶同前（IM45、54）
text_en: Ground-glass opacity in the basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged from prior (IM45, 54).

source_text: 双肺及叶间胸膜多发转移结节较前略增大
text_en: Multiple metastatic nodules in both lungs and interlobar pleura are slightly increased compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶切除术后，支气管残端平扫未见复发征象
text_en: After left upper lobe resection, no signs of recurrence at the bronchial stump on non-contrast CT.

source_text: 左肺肺大泡增大，原约2.8cm（Im35），现约5.4x4.3cm（IM37），偏后壁上见少许壁上结节影，周围肺野见片状磨玻璃密度影
text_en: Left lung bulla enlargement, previously approximately 2.8 cm (Im35), currently approximately 5.4x4.3 cm (IM37), with a few nodular opacities on the posterior wall and patchy ground-glass opacity in the surrounding lung parenchyma.

source_text: 扫及左乳内上象限见一枚小结节同前，约7mm（Im25），结合临床或超声检查
text_en: A small nodule measuring approximately 7 mm is noted in the upper inner quadrant of the left breast, unchanged from prior (Im25); correlation with clinical or ultrasound findings is recommended.

source_text: 左肺下叶占位较前缩小
text_en: Mass in the left lower lobe decreased in size compared to previous

source_text: 胸骨局限性致密结节灶同前，余扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Localized dense nodular lesion in sternum unchanged from previous; no bone destruction seen in other scanned bones of the thoracic cage.

source_text: 左肺下叶切除术后，双肺微小点灶同前，考虑陈旧灶，未见新生占位
text_en: Post-left lower lobectomy, bilateral pulmonary micronodules are unchanged from prior and likely represent old lesions; no new mass is seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶小结节及左肺上叶前段胸膜下小结节同前（IM16、26），较大约6mm，余肺未见结节
text_en: Small nodule in the right upper lobe and a subpleural small nodule in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe are unchanged compared to prior (IM16, 26), measuring up to approximately 6 mm; no other pulmonary nodules are seen.

source_text: 右肺上叶可见不规则肿物较前略缩小，现约33x20mm（图19），原约35x22mm（图21），边缘欠光滑
text_en: An irregular mass in the right upper lobe is slightly smaller than prior, now measuring approximately 33x20 mm (Figure 19), previously 35x22 mm (Figure 21); margins remain irregular.

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下稍厚壁空洞性结节影同前，约10*7mm（IMA51）
text_en: Subpleural nodular opacity with slightly thickened wall in the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 10 x 7 mm (IMA51).

source_text: 双肺门小淋巴结同前相仿
text_en: Small lymph nodes at both hila are similar to prior.

source_text: 左肺术后，双肺微结节同前
text_en: Post left lung surgery, bilateral pulmonary micronodules stable compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段见类圆形小结节，约3mm（Im34），转移待排，追查
text_en: A roundish small nodule, approximately 3mm (Image 34), is seen in the left upper lobe lingular segment; metastasis to be ruled out, follow-up.

source_text: 左肺上叶新见小片类结节影（IMA24），左肺尖稍高密度模糊片絮影较前相仿
text_en: A new small patch-like nodule shadow in the left upper lobe (IMA24); the slightly high-density fuzzy patchy shadow in the left lung apex is similar to previous.

source_text: 双肺小结节较前缩小，追查
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodules are smaller compared to prior, further investigation recommended

source_text: 双肺多发转移增大
text_en: Multiple metastatic nodules in both lungs have increased in size.

source_text: 纵隔4-7组及双肺门淋巴结同前
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4-7 and bilateral hilar lymph nodes are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，仍约13x9mm（IM26）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is unchanged from prior, still approximately 13x9 mm (IM26).

source_text: 右肺下叶结节同前，陈旧灶可能
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged; old focus is possible.

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门数枚小淋巴结较前相仿，短径小于10mm
text_en: Several small mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes are similar to previous, with short axis less than 10mm.

source_text: 双侧腋下淋巴结可见多发小淋巴结同前，最大者约9mm(IM13）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes are visible in bilateral axillae, unchanged; the largest measures about 9 mm (IM13).

source_text: 左肺上叶前段支气管旁不规则结节大致同前，仍约21x12mm（IM25），边缘毛糙，远端肺内见片絮影同前
text_en: The irregular nodule adjacent to the bronchus in the left upper lobe anterior segment is largely unchanged, still measuring approximately 21x12 mm (IM25), with spiculated margins, and patchy opacities in the distal lung parenchyma are unchanged.

source_text: 左肺门淋巴结较前增多、增大，现较大者约18x14mm（IMA34），原小于10mm，转移
text_en: Left hilar lymph nodes are increased in number and size compared to previous; the largest is now approximately 18x14mm (IMA34), previously less than 10mm, metastasis.

source_text: 左肺点状小结节同前
text_en: Left lung punctate small nodules unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔内多发小淋巴结大致同前，较大约1cm（IM22）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes essentially unchanged from previous, largest approximately 1 cm (IM22)

source_text: 纵隔2、4R-7组、右肺门、食管旁多发淋巴结显示较前清楚，大致同前
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2, 4R, 5, 6, and 7, right hilar, and paraesophageal regions more clearly visible than before but essentially unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶模糊小结节同前
text_en: Left upper lobe hazy small nodule unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右侧胸膜不均匀增厚同前相仿，考虑胸膜转移
text_en: Irregular thickening of the right pleura is similar to prior; pleural metastasis is considered.

source_text: 右侧肾上腺结节样增粗同前，追查
text_en: Nodular thickening of the right adrenal gland is unchanged. Follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃小结节影同前，仍约5mm（IM18）
text_en: Left upper lobe small ground-glass nodule unchanged from previous, still approximately 5 mm (image 18).

source_text: 纵隔2R组、7组及食管旁多发肿大淋巴结缩小，较大原约13x10mm（IM6），现约10x9mm（IM5）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes at mediastinal stations 2R, 7, and paraesophageal decreased in size, largest previously approximately 13x10mm (IM6), currently approximately 10x9mm (IM5)

source_text: 左上肺胸膜下小结节影同前（IM17）
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged from prior (IM17).

source_text: 双肺术后改变，胸部CT平扫未见新增占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the lungs; non-contrast chest CT shows no new mass lesion.

source_text: 纵隔2R/L、4R/L、5、7、10R多发肿大淋巴结较前缩小，原较大约31*20mm(图23）者现19x15mm（IM22）
text_en: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R/L, 4R/L, 5, 7, and 10R decreased compared to previous; previously largest approximately 31x20 mm (Figure 23), now 19x15 mm (IM22).

source_text: 左肺钙化灶、左上叶胸膜下多发肺大泡、左肺下叶支气管轻度扩张同前（IMA50），左肺上叶小结节影同前（IMA34、37、50、53、57），小于5mm
text_en: Left lung calcifications, multiple subpleural bullae in left upper lobe, and mild bronchiectasis in left lower lobe unchanged from previous (IMA50); small nodules in left upper lobe unchanged from previous (IMA34, 37, 50, 53, 57), less than 5 mm.

source_text: 右肺上叶及下叶小斑片索条影同前，双肺未见新生结节
text_en: The small patchy and linear opacities in the right upper and lower lobes remain unchanged; no new nodules are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段磨玻璃密度小结节同前，约10x6mm（IM15），内见血管穿行，边缘分叶
text_en: Left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment: small ground-glass opacity nodule unchanged from previous, approximately 10x6 mm (IM15), with vessels traversing through it and lobulated margins.

source_text: 双侧胸膜结节样增厚表现大致同前，余未见新生占位
text_en: Bilateral pleural nodular thickening is largely unchanged. No new space-occupying lesions are seen elsewhere.

source_text: 左侧第6肋骨结节样高密度同前（Im40）
text_en: Nodular hyperdensity at the left sixth rib, unchanged compared to prior (IM40).

source_text: 局部胸腔胃壁稍厚稍减轻，原约11mm，现约9mm（IM46），追查
text_en: Slight thickening of the wall of the intrathoracic stomach is somewhat reduced, from approximately 11 mm previously to approximately 9 mm currently (IM46); continue follow-up.

source_text: 右肺少许索条影同前，未见新增结节灶及斑片影
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结大致同前，隆突下淋巴结同前相仿，现仍约28*13mm（IM22）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are largely unchanged from prior, with the subcarinal lymph node similar to prior and remaining approximately 28x13 mm (IM22).

source_text: 右侧锁骨上、纵隔多发淋巴结较前增多、大部增大，如现约21x16mm者（IM23），原约20x10mm（IM20）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular and mediastinal regions have increased in number and most are larger than prior, such as the one now measuring approximately 21 x 16 mm (IM23), previously about 20 x 10 mm (IM20).

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段新见结节影，约10*7mm（IMA47）
text_en: Newly observed nodule in the basal segment of the right lower lobe, measuring approximately 10 x 7 mm (IMA47).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则软组织密度结节较前相仿，约20x15mm（Im18），密度不均，边缘与侧胸膜牵拉同前
text_en: The irregular soft-tissue density nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 20x15 mm (Im18). The density is heterogeneous, and the margin with lateral pleural retraction remains unchanged.

source_text: 左侧叶间胸膜结节样增厚同前（IM28），双侧胸腔未见胸水征象

source_text: 右锁骨上淋巴结同前，仍约11*9mm（IM4）
text_en: Right supraclavicular lymph node unchanged, still measuring approximately 11x9 mm (IM4)

source_text: 胸1椎体高密度结节同前
text_en: T1 vertebral body demonstrates a hyperdense nodule, stable compared to prior.

text_en: Multiple metastatic small nodules in both lungs have decreased in size and number; the one previously measuring 4 mm (IM27) now measures approximately 3 mm (IM26).

text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged (IM61); further follow-up is recommended.

text_en: Status post wedge resection of the right upper lobe and resection of the right lower lobe; soft tissue density in the right hilar region is less prominent than before, with the largest short diameter now approximately 8 mm (Figure 27), previously about 10 mm (Im25); distal irregular linear opacities are also less prominent than prior.

source_text: 右膈下小结节灶大致同前，仍约15x5mm（IM60）
text_en: The small subdiaphragmatic nodule on the right is essentially unchanged, still measuring approximately 15x5 mm (IM60).

source_text: 双肺尖胸膜不规则增厚同前，形成小结节及肺内索条牵拉

text_en: Scattered nodules in the right upper and middle lobes unchanged (IM24, 30, 34, 39); largest short diameter still approximately 6 mm (IM39).

text_en: Hilar lymph nodes are unchanged from prior, the largest measuring approximately 11x6 mm (IM32).

text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, observation.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下多发小结节同前，较大约6mm（IM41）

text_en: The ill-defined nodular opacity in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior (IM18, 19).

text_en: No nodules are seen in the lungs; the linear and patchy opacity in the right middle and lower lobes is unchanged from prior.

text_en: Pretracheal lymph nodes are similar to previous, approximately 6x4 mm (IM15).

text_en: Left subcutaneous posterior chest wall nodule unchanged, still approximately 17 mm (IM39).

text_en: Left lower lobe, lateral basal segment: irregular patchy mass reduced in size compared to previous; previously approximately 29x10 mm (Image 52), now only residual linear shadow (Images 51-53).

text_en: Subcarinal low-density nodule unchanged from prior, approximately 20x10 mm (IM24).

text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are stable compared to prior, largest measuring approximately 17x15 mm (IM23)

text_en: Multiple space-occupying lesions in both lungs are larger and show progression compared to prior.

text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and bilateral hilar regions similar to previous, with a larger one approximately 10mm (IM34), and no enlarged lymph nodes seen in bilateral supraclavicular and axillary regions.

text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IMA17).

text_en: Chest CT shows no significant new space-occupying lesions.

text_en: Ground-glass opacities and nodules in both upper lobes are unchanged from prior.

text_en: Suspicious nodule in the left lower lobe increased in size compared to previous, currently approximately 16x17mm (IM45), previously approximately 13x9mm (IM41), with internal air-containing cavity, nature undetermined, follow-up recommended

text_en: Left upper lobe anterior segment nodule stable.

text_en: Nodular opacity in the basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 8 mm (IM38).

text_en: A new nodule is noted in the left adrenal gland, measuring approximately 20x16 mm (IMA57).

text_en: On imaging, a small nodule in the left posterior thorax is unchanged from prior (IM65).

text_en: Some small lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region are smaller than prior, such as one previously measuring 9 x 6 mm (IMA5), now approximately 6 x 4 mm (IMA5). Lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2R and 4R are unchanged from prior, with the largest measuring approximately 13 x 7 mm (IMA23).

text_en: The nodular lesion along the right interlobar pleura is unchanged, measuring approximately 6 x 3 mm (IM32).

text_en: The patchy and nodule-like opacities in both upper lungs are slightly larger than before (IMA14-17, 21, 22), with increased density, consistent with active tuberculosis.
