source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，双上肺散在微小结节同前(IM15-18)
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, scattered micronodules in the upper lungs similar to prior (IM15-18).

source_text: 右锁骨上区多发淋巴结部分较前饱满，现约12*10mm（IM7），原约10*9mm（IM7），建议追查
text_en: Several lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region are partially more prominent than prior; currently measure approximately 12x10 mm (IM7), previously 10x9 mm (IM7); recommend follow-up.

source_text: 余双肺纹理走行顺畅，未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: Lung markings in the remainder of both lungs are smooth and unremarkable with no new nodules or consolidation shadows.

source_text: 双肺散在良性小结节同前
text_en: Scattered benign small nodules in both lungs are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶癌复查，较前增大
text_en: Follow-up of carcinoma in the right lower lobe, which has increased in size compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺多发结节，部分较前增大，倾向转移，追查
text_en: Multiple nodules in both lungs; some are larger than prior, suggestive of metastasis; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 右肺新见小斑片结节影同前（IMA27-31）
text_en: Newly seen small patchy nodular opacities in the right lung, unchanged (IMA27-31).

source_text: 纵隔、肺门、锁骨上及腋下未见肿大淋巴结，多发钙化同前
text_en: No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum, hilar regions, supraclavicular, or axillary regions; multiple calcifications are unchanged from prior

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段微结节同前，大小约3mm（IM23）
text_en: A small nodule in the apical-posterior segment of the left upper lobe same as before, size approximately 3 mm (IM23).

source_text: 右肺中叶及左肺上叶磨玻璃小结节同前，随诊复查
text_en: Ground-glass small nodules in the right middle lobe and left upper lobe are unchanged compared to prior; follow-up imaging recommended.

source_text: 余未见肺内新发结节或斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段多发片状影，较前范围增大，较大者现约22x15mm（IM54），原约10x10mm（IM56）
text_en: Multiple patchy opacities in the basal segment of the right lower lobe have increased in extent compared to prior. The largest measures approximately 22 x 15 mm (IM54), previously about 10 x 10 mm (IM56).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段及下叶后基底段小结节灶同前（IM10、44），较大仍约5mm（IM44）
text_en: Small nodules in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment and left lower lobe posterior basal segment are stable compared to prior (IM10, 44), with the largest still measuring approximately 5 mm (IM44).

source_text: 纵隔2、4、5、7、8组、双肺门多发淋巴结同前，较大者仍约16x11mm（IM32）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2, 4, 5, 7, and 8 and bilateral hilar regions unchanged from previous, largest still approximately 16x11 mm (IM32).

source_text: 右肺中叶肿物同前，仍约21x17mm（IM33），右肺膨胀不全、双下肺索条影同前
text_en: The right middle lobe mass is unchanged, still measuring approximately 21 x 17 mm (IM33). Right lung atelectasis and bilateral lower lung fibrotic bands remain unchanged.

source_text: 双肺散在多发小结节数目及大小同前，较大仍约8mm（Im32）
text_en: Number and size of scattered multiple small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, the largest still measuring approximately 8 mm (Im32).

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段结节同前，考虑陈旧灶可能大，追查
text_en: Nodule in the left lower lobe basal segment unchanged from prior, considered likely an old lesion, follow-up

source_text: 双肺小结节灶同前，较大约8*6mm（IM51）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodule foci are stable compared to prior, largest approximately 8x6 mm (IM51)

source_text: 右侧水平裂点状微小结节同前（Im28）
text_en: Punctate tiny nodule along the right horizontal fissure is stable (Im28).

source_text: 纵隔10R淋巴结同前，仍约17x13mm(IM30)
text_en: Right paratracheal (10R) mediastinal lymph node unchanged from prior, still measuring approximately 17x13 mm (IM30)

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段结节同前，约9x8mm（IM50），左肺上叶钙化灶同前
text_en: Nodule in the left lower lobe basal segment unchanged from prior, approximately 9x8 mm (IM50); calcified focus in the left upper lobe unchanged from prior

source_text: 左肺上叶下舌段小结节大致同前
text_en: The small nodule in the lower lingular segment of the left upper lobe is essentially unchanged.

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，约5mm（IM44）
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM44).

source_text: 右肺下叶术后改变，胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right lower lobe; no new space-occupying lesions are seen in the chest.

source_text: 部分纵隔小淋巴结稍增大，如气管分叉前方淋巴结原约13x5mm，现约16x7mm（IM25），密切随访追查
text_en: Some small mediastinal lymph nodes are slightly enlarged, for example, the lymph node anterior to the tracheal bifurcation was approximately 13x5mm, now approximately 16x7mm (IM25), with close follow-up and further investigation.

source_text: 后下纵隔分叶状肿物大小同前，气液平面消失
text_en: Lobulated mass in the posterior inferior mediastinum, size unchanged from prior; air-fluid level no longer visible

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结较前缩小，隆突下短径原约12mm，现约8mm（IMA26），密切观察
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes have decreased in size compared to previous; the short axis of the subcarinal lymph node was previously approximately 12 mm and is now approximately 8 mm (IMA26), with close observation.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见复发征象
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, no evidence of recurrence at the bronchial stump

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门多发小淋巴结较前相仿，如隆突下淋巴结短径现仍约7mm（IM22）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right hilar region are similar to previous, such as the subcarinal lymph node with short axis still approximately 7 mm (IM22).

source_text: 两肺上叶见浅淡小结节影同前（IMA18、31、32），左下肺胸膜下小结节灶同前，较大者约4mm（IMA55）
text_en: Faint small nodules in both upper lobes are unchanged from prior (IMA18, 31, 32). A subpleural small nodule in the left lower lung is unchanged, with the largest measuring approximately 4 mm (IMA55).

source_text: 右肺尖微小结节同前，大小约3mm（IM11），边界清
text_en: Tiny nodule in the right lung apex is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM11), with well-defined margins.

source_text: 扫及胸8椎体结节样密度增高同前
text_en: Scans show nodular density increase in the T8 vertebra, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔、肺门淋巴结明显缩小，如原较大约15x11mm（IM27），现约约6x5mm（IM22）
text_en: Mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes significantly decreased in size, e.g., previously largest approximately 15x11 mm (IM27), now approximately 6x5 mm (IM22).

source_text: 右肺上叶后段稍高密度索条小结节灶同前（IM25）
text_en: Slightly higher density linear small nodular focus in the right upper lobe posterior segment, unchanged (IM25).

source_text: 右肺叶间裂及胸膜结节样增厚大致同前
text_en: Nodular thickening along the right interlobar fissure and pleura is approximately stable compared to prior.

source_text: 甲状腺双侧叶饱满，不均匀强化结节同前，约27x22mm（IM4）
text_en: Bilateral thyroid lobes appear full, with a heterogeneously enhancing nodule unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 27x22 mm (IM4).

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约12x10mm（IMA16）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest measuring approximately 12x10 mm (IMA16).

source_text: 左肺下叶、斜裂新见多发结节，较大约20x10mm（IM34），形态不规则
text_en: Newly seen multiple nodules in the left lower lobe and oblique fissure, largest approximately 20x10mm (IM34), irregular in shape.

source_text: 双肺及叶间胸膜下微小结节同前，考虑陈旧病灶
text_en: Multiple tiny nodules in both lungs and subpleural regions are stable, considered chronic/old changes.

source_text: 右肺转移瘤切除术后，剩余右肺现未见异常密度灶
text_en: Following right lung metastasectomy, no abnormal density foci are currently seen in the remaining right lung.

source_text: 平扫甲状腺低密度结节同前
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows a low-density nodule in the thyroid, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶切除术后，双肺小结节同前
text_en: Post right lower lobectomy, small nodules in both lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，双肺散在少许小结节大致同前，边界清楚，较大仍约6mm（IM37）
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Lung parenchymal lucency is uniform. Scattered minimal small nodules are stable, with clear margins. The largest remains approximately 6 mm (IM37).

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段胸膜下微小结节同前，约2mm（IM46）
text_en: A subpleural micronodule in the left upper lobe lingular segment is similar to previous, approximately 2 mm (IM46).

source_text: 左肺索条影较前减少，左肺下叶胸膜下小结节影同前（IMA41）、左肺上叶轻度肺气肿同前
text_en: Left lung fibrotic streaks decreased compared to previous, left lower lobe subpleural small nodule unchanged (IMA41), left upper lobe mild emphysema unchanged.

source_text: 左锁骨上区多发小结节较前相仿，较大仍约11x9mm（IM7）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left supraclavicular region similar to previous, largest still approximately 11x9 mm (IM7).

source_text: 左上纵隔主动脉弓外侧不规则类结节较前增大，原约2.5x1.3cm（IM17），现约3.3x1.5cm（IM16），呈低强化，强化不明确
text_en: An irregular nodular lesion in the left upper mediastinum lateral to the aortic arch is larger than before, previously approximately 2.5 x 1.3 cm (IM17), now approximately 3.3 x 1.5 cm (IM16), showing low enhancement; enhancement is not clearly defined.

source_text: 右肺中叶术后，支气管断端见不规则软组织灶（IM37），复发可能
text_en: Status post right middle lobectomy; an irregular soft tissue focus is seen at the bronchial stump (IM37), with possible recurrence.

source_text: 余双肺散在小结节同前，较大约4x3mm（IM18）
text_en: Residual scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged; the largest measures approximately 4x3 mm (IM18)

source_text: 纵隔2R、7组淋巴结较前增大，现较大约16x12mm（IM30），原约9x6mm（IM31）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 2R and 7 are enlarged compared to prior. The largest is now approximately 16x12 mm (IM30), previously approximately 9x6 mm (IM31).

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前相仿，较大於10R,约11*8mm(图30)
text_en: Multiple mediastinal small lymph nodes similar to previous, larger than 10R, approximately 11x8 mm (Figure 30)

source_text: 右上肺微结节同前，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: Micro-nodules in the right upper lung are unchanged; old changes are considered.

source_text: 扫及肝右叶见模糊低密度结节同前（IM49、51）
text_en: CT shows an ill-defined low-density nodule in the right lobe of the liver unchanged from previous (IM49, 51).

source_text: 右肺上叶局限术后，术区局部结节增大，考虑复发可能性大
text_en: Localized postoperative change in the right upper lobe; the local nodule in the surgical bed has increased in size, raising concern for recurrence.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段胸膜下磨玻璃密度结节大致同前满，约13x12mm（IM76），形态及内部实性成分基本同前
text_en: Subpleural ground-glass density nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is essentially stable, approximately 13x12 mm (IM76); morphology and internal solid component are essentially unchanged

source_text: 右肺上叶术后，支气管断端未见异常增厚（IM23），余肺内未见新发结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy. No abnormal wall thickening is seen at the bronchial stump (IM23). No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of the lung.

source_text: 右侧胸膜下结节同前（IM23）
text_en: Subpleural nodule in the right lung is unchanged compared to prior (IM23).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃密度结节同前（IM26），余双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM26); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 胸9椎体类圆形边缘硬化低密度灶大小同前，内部密度增高，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: Round low-density focus with sclerotic margins in the T9 vertebral body, size unchanged from prior, with increased internal density; no bone destruction seen in the remaining scanned bones.

source_text: 右肺中叶及胸膜下小结节同前（Im22、31、33）
text_en: Small nodules in the right middle lobe and subpleural region are unchanged compared to prior (Im22, 31, 33).

source_text: 双侧肺内散在微结节同前相仿，小于3mm
text_en: Scattered micro-nodules in the bilateral lungs are similar to prior, measuring less than 3 mm.

source_text: 未见肺内新发
text_en: No new intrapulmonary lesions seen

source_text: 双肺上叶浅淡小结节及磨玻璃灶部分同前（IM9、14），右肺上叶磨玻璃小结节同前，约8x6mm(IM14)
text_en: Faint small nodules and ground-glass opacities in both upper lobes are partially unchanged compared to prior (IM9, 14); a small ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe is stable, measuring approximately 8x6 mm (IM14).

source_text: 右上肺小结节同前，考虑良性，陈旧病变可能大
text_en: Small nodule in the right upper lung is unchanged, considered benign, likely representing an old lesion.

source_text: 右肺下叶磨玻璃密度小结节影同前（IM23、27、34、40、49），小于10mm，边界模糊
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged (IM23, 27, 34, 40, 49), less than 10 mm in size, with indistinct margins

source_text: 双下肺多发索条影同前，未见新增结节灶及斑片影
text_en: The multiple linear strands in both lower lungs are unchanged; no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen.

source_text: 食管术后，双肺索条、小结节及片絮影同前
text_en: Post-esophagectomy. Linear opacities, small nodules, and patchy opacities in both lungs unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，支气管断端软组织增厚较前减轻，原较大层面约26x14mm（IM24），现约14x10mm（IM24），平扫与左肺门血管分界不清
text_en: Status post left upper lobectomy, soft tissue thickening at the bronchial stump decreased compared to prior, previously measured approximately 26x14 mm (IM24), now approximately 14x10 mm (IM24), on non-contrast imaging indistinct from left hilar vessels.

source_text: 两肺小结节略增大，现较大约6mm（IM28），不除外转移
text_en: The small nodules in both lungs are slightly larger, with the largest now approximately 6 mm (IM28); metastasis cannot be excluded.

source_text: 纵隔、左肺门多发淋巴结较前增大，如原约7x6mm（IM13），现约12x11mm（IM13）
text_en: Mediastinal and left hilar multiple lymph nodes are increased compared to prior, e.g., previously measuring approximately 7x6 mm (IM13), now approximately 12x11 mm (IM13).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨模糊结节同前相仿，考虑陈旧灶可能大
text_en: Indistinct nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to prior; old lesion is most likely.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，左肺上叶尖后段小簇小结节同前，较大约7mm（IM15），内见高密度灶，界清
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. A small cluster of nodules in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior, with the largest measuring approximately 7 mm (IM15), containing a high-density focus and well-defined margins.

source_text: 考虑转移，追查
text_en: Consider metastasis; further investigation recommended.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结同前，约13x9mm（IM28）
text_en: Right hilar lymph node is unchanged, measuring approximately 13 x 9 mm (IM28).

source_text: 纵隔4L、7组见淋巴结同前，较大仍约14x8mm（IM22）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4L and 7 are unchanged from prior, with the larger one still measuring approximately 14x8 mm (IM22).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段占位较前略增大，追查
text_en: Space-occupying lesion in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe is slightly larger than prior; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下点状钙化灶同前，余双肺未见新增结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: Right lung subpleural punctate calcifications unchanged from prior; no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节较前增大，原约23x16mm（IM26），现约27x23mm（IM28）
text_en: Left upper lobe ground-glass opacity nodule increased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 23x16 mm (image 26), currently approximately 27x23 mm (image 28).

source_text: 双肺未见新增结节斑片影
text_en: No new nodular or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔右移同前，纵隔、肺门未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal shift to the right, same as before; no enlarged lymph nodes seen in mediastinum and hila.

source_text: 右上纵隔结节同前同前，追查
text_en: Nodule in the right upper mediastinum is unchanged, unchanged; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 两肺浅淡小结节影同前（IM20、21、27、35、37、56），小于5mm
text_en: The faint small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM20, 21, 27, 35, 37, 56), less than 5 mm.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段不规则结节较前增大，原约10x7mm（IM23），现约14x10mm（IM25）
text_en: The irregular nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe has increased in size compared to prior, previously approximately 10x7 mm (IM23), now approximately 14x10 mm (IM25).

source_text: 甲状腺左叶低密度结节同前（IM13）
text_en: Left thyroid lobe low-density nodule stable compared to prior (Image 13).

source_text: 左肺下叶微小结节同前，仍约2mm（IM41），余肺内未见明显结节及实变影
text_en: Left lower lobe small nodule unchanged, still approximately 2 mm (IM41), no obvious nodules or consolidation in the remainder of the lung.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段结节灶同前，追查
text_en: The nodule in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged; further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右侧胸膜局限增厚同前，少量胸水较前相仿，余肺未见新发斑片结节或实变影
text_en: Focal right pleural thickening is unchanged. Small pleural effusion is similar to prior. The remainder of the lungs shows no new patchy opacities, nodules, or consolidations.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段点状结节影同前（IM13）
text_en: Left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment: punctate nodule unchanged from previous (IM13).

source_text: 双肺多发磨玻璃密度结节及斑片灶大致同前
text_en: Multiple ground-glass density nodules and patchy opacities in both lungs are essentially unchanged.

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下片状影较前略增大，原约13x8mm（IM27），现约22x9mm（IM25），与胸膜粘连同前
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural patchy opacity slightly increased in size compared to previous, previously approximately 13x8 mm (IM27), currently approximately 22x9 mm (IM25), pleural adhesion unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔7组及左肺门肿大淋巴结同前（IM30、31），追查
text_en: Enlarged lymph nodes at mediastinal station 7 and left hilar unchanged from prior (IM30, 31), follow-up.

source_text: 左肺类结节影较前相仿，原约12*7mm（IMA46），现约13*7mm（IM45）
text_en: Left lung nodule-like shadow similar to prior, previously approximately 12x7 mm (IMA46), currently approximately 13x7 mm (IM45).

source_text: 前纵隔椭圆形较高密度结节同前，约17x11mm（Im37）
text_en: Oval higher-density nodule in the anterior mediastinum is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 17x11 mm (Im37).

source_text: 左锁骨上区多发小结节较前相仿，较大仍约11*9mm（IM9）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left supraclavicular region similar to previous, largest still approximately 11x9 mm (IM9).

source_text: 左肺下叶新发小结节，右侧叶间胸膜小结节，追查
text_en: New small nodule in the left lower lobe and a small nodule in the right interlobar pleura; recommend follow-up.

source_text: 扫及左肾上腺不规则软组织结节同前，仍约27x19mm（IM57）
text_en: On imaging, an irregular soft tissue nodule measuring approximately 27 x 19 mm is seen in the left adrenal gland, unchanged from prior (IM57).

source_text: 左肺下叶微结节同前，考虑陈旧灶
text_en: Small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous, considered old lesion

source_text: 纵隔小淋巴结同前相仿
text_en: Small mediastinal lymph nodes similar to previous.

source_text: 右肺下叶近肺门结节较前略缩小，现约10*7mm(图29)，原约11*8mm（IM29），与右肺门血管及支气管分界不清，与右斜裂胸膜广基底粘连
text_en: The nodule near the hilum of the right lower lobe is slightly smaller than prior, now approximately 10 x 7 mm (Figure 29), previously about 11 x 8 mm (IM29). It remains indistinct from the vessels and bronchi of the right hilum and shows broad-based adhesion to the right oblique fissure pleura.

source_text: 两肺浅淡小结节影同前（IM22、23、28、35、39、57），小于5mm
text_en: The faint small nodules in both lungs are unchanged (IM22, 23, 28, 35, 39, 57), less than 5 mm.

source_text: 双肺上叶微小结节灶同前，约3mm（IM17）
text_en: Micronodules in the upper lobes of both lungs are stable compared to prior, approximately 3 mm (IM17).

source_text: 纵隔2R淋巴结同前，约15x12mm（IM9）
text_en: Lymph node at mediastinal station 2R same as previous, approximately 15x12mm (IM9)

source_text: 纵隔内淋巴结，较前相仿，如7组仍约12mm（IM31）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes, similar to previous, such as station 7 still approximately 12 mm (IM31).

source_text: 纵隔5、6组淋巴结同前相仿，现较大仍约18x6mm（IM17）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 5 and 6 are similar to prior, currently larger, still approximately 18x6 mm (IM17).

source_text: 右肺中叶条片灶略增多，不规则小结节范围较前缩小（IM15）
text_en: Right middle lobe linear and patchy opacities are slightly increased; the extent of the irregular small nodule is decreased compared to prior (IM15).

source_text: 纵隔及左肺门肿大淋巴结较前增大，考虑转移
text_en: Enlarged mediastinal and left hilar lymph nodes increased in size compared to previous, suggests metastasis

source_text: 左肺下叶前基底段近膈胸膜处小结节同前，约4mm（IM47）
text_en: Small nodule in the anterior basal segment of the left lower lobe near the diaphragmatic pleura, unchanged from previous, approximately 4 mm (IM47)

source_text: 肾转移瘤
text_en: Renal metastatic tumor.

source_text: 右肺上叶结节较前稍饱满，现约8x6mm（IMA30），余两肺散在模糊结节影同前相仿，双肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: The nodule in the right upper lobe appears slightly more prominent, now measuring approximately 8x6 mm (IMA30). The scattered indistinct nodules in the rest of both lungs are similar to prior. No new nodules or consolidation are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节影（IM16）同前相仿
text_en: Nodule with ground-glass opacity in the left upper lobe (IM16) is comparable to prior findings.

source_text: 右肺索条影、两肺微小结节较前相仿
text_en: Linear opacities in the right lung and tiny nodules in both lungs are similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶微小结节影同前，直径约5mm（IM15），右肺中叶及左肺下叶见微小结节灶，直径约0.3cm（IM27、37）
text_en: Right upper lobe micro-nodule unchanged, approximately 5 mm in diameter (IM15); micro-nodules noted in the right middle lobe and left lower lobe, approximately 0.3 cm in diameter (IM27, 37)

source_text: 右侧第10后肋见不规则骨质破坏，扫及胸3、12椎体血管瘤同前
text_en: Irregular bony destruction is seen in the right 10th posterior rib. Hemangiomas in the thoracic 3 and 12 vertebrae are stable.

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃样小结节大致同前，约11x8mm（IM20）
text_en: The small ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 11 x 8 mm (IM20).

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下小结节此次扫描未见显示，余肺内透亮度均匀，未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: The subpleural small nodule in the left lower lobe is not visualized on this scan; the remaining lung parenchyma shows uniform lucency without new nodules or patchy opacities

source_text: 两肺上叶未见新发结节影
text_en: No new nodules are seen in both upper lobes.

source_text: 左侧胸水吸收，双腋下多发淋巴结大致同前，随诊
text_en: Left pleural effusion has resolved; multiple lymph nodes in both axillae are stable compared to prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 左肺未见新发结节，左侧未见胸水
text_en: No new nodules in the left lung; no pleural effusion on the left.

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺结节大致同前，请结合腹部检查
text_en: Left adrenal nodule essentially unchanged; please correlate with abdominal examination.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，左肺上叶尖后段见短条索影同前（IMA11），左肺上叶尖后段、下舌段及下叶外、后基底段见散在多个小结节同前（IMA28、38、46），直径均约4mm
text_en: Bilateral lung markings are unremarkable in course, and pulmonary lucency is uniform. A short linear opacity in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe is stable (IMA11). Scattered multiple small nodules are stable in the apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe, lingular segment, and the lateral and posterior basal segments of the lower lobe (IMA28, 38, 46), each measuring approximately 4 mm.

source_text: 双肺小结节灶同前，较大约8x6mm（IM56）
text_en: Bilateral pulmonary small nodule foci are stable compared to prior, largest approximately 8x6 mm (IM56)

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，较大者约14x9mm（IM21）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are stable compared to prior, largest measuring approximately 14x9 mm (IM21)

source_text: 右肺上叶及下叶磨玻璃密度结节同前，恶性不除外，定期追查
text_en: The ground-glass density nodules in the right upper and lower lobes remain unchanged; malignancy cannot be excluded; regular follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 扫及右肾上腺旁钙化结节、肝囊肿同前
text_en: On scan, calcified nodule adjacent to right adrenal gland and hepatic cyst unchanged from prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下结节较前增大，考虑转移
text_en: Subpleural nodule in the right upper lobe has increased in size compared to prior; metastasis is considered.

source_text: 两肺下叶结节灶较前增大，如左肺者原约9x7mm，现约13x11mm（IMA36），右肺结节原约18x10mm，现约21x13mm（IMA32），均考虑恶性可能，需结合临床进一步检查
text_en: Nodules in both lower lobes are larger than prior. For example, the left lung nodule has increased from approximately 9x7 mm to 13x11 mm (IMA36), and the right lung nodule has increased from approximately 18x10 mm to 21x13 mm (IMA32). Malignancy is considered likely. Further clinical evaluation is required.

source_text: 右肺多发磨玻璃结节影基本同前，定期观察
text_en: Multiple ground-glass nodules in the right lung are essentially unchanged; recommend regular follow-up observation.

source_text: 双肺见多发磨玻璃密度微小结节同前相仿，较大仍约5mm（Im19），追随
text_en: Multiple tiny ground-glass opacity nodules are seen in both lungs, similar to prior; the largest remains approximately 5 mm (Im19); follow-up recommended.

source_text: 纵隔、右肺门淋巴结大致同前，较大约13x9mm（IM30）
text_en: Mediastinal and right hilar lymph nodes essentially unchanged from previous, the largest approximately 13x9 mm (IM30).

source_text: 右肺散在钙化结节及索条影同前，余肺内未见新发结节灶
text_en: Scattered calcified nodules and linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged from prior; no new nodules are seen elsewhere in the lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段可见一分叶状实性软组织密度结节同前，仍约19x15mm（Im27），内可见支气管气相
text_en: A lobulated solid soft tissue density nodule in the left lower lobe, apical segment, unchanged from prior, still approximately 19x15 mm (Im27), with bronchial air sign present.

source_text: 右肺下叶近肺门结节大致同前，约11*8mm（IM29），与右肺门血管及支气管分界不清，与右斜裂胸膜广基底粘连
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe near the hilum is essentially unchanged, measuring approximately 11x8 mm (IM29), with indistinct margins from the right hilar vessels and bronchi, and broad-based adhesion to the right oblique fissure pleura.

source_text: 右肺上叶软组织结节较前增大，原约20x19mm，现约33x25mm（IM25），中心可见大片低强化区，边缘略不规则，相邻右侧水平裂增厚并见长索条影牵拉胸膜
text_en: Soft tissue nodule in the right upper lobe has increased in size, previously measuring approximately 20x19 mm, now approximately 33x25 mm (IM25). A large area of low enhancement is visible in the center. The margin is slightly irregular. Adjacent thickening of the right horizontal fissure is present, with long linear bands tethering the pleura.

source_text: 双肺多发模糊斑片及不规则结节影大致同前，双下肺长索条影同前
text_en: Multiple ill-defined patchy and irregular nodular opacities in both lungs are essentially unchanged; long linear opacities in the lower lungs are unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，未见复发征象
text_en: Status post right upper lobectomy; no findings of recurrence.

source_text: 纵隔4-7组及双肺门淋巴结同前，较大约13x10mm（IM36）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4-7 and bilateral hilar lymph nodes unchanged from previous, largest approximately 13x10 mm (IM36).

source_text: 食管胸下段癌疗后，病变较前好转
text_en: Post-treatment for esophageal cancer in the lower thoracic segment, lesion improved compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶结节同前，约5x4mm（IM35）
text_en: Left upper lobe nodule unchanged, approximately 5x4 mm (Image 35).

source_text: 隆突下淋巴结消失，余纵隔及肺门淋巴结同前，小于10mm
text_en: Subcarinal lymph node disappeared, remaining mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes unchanged, less than 10 mm

source_text: 左肺上叶新见小结节，约3mm（Im29），追查
text_en: A new small nodule in the left upper lobe, approximately 3mm (Im29), follow-up.

source_text: 甲状腺体积弥漫增大强化不均及左侧肾上腺结节同前，大小约17*16mm（IMA60）
text_en: Diffuse thyroid gland enlargement with heterogeneous enhancement and left adrenal nodule stable compared to prior, size approximately 17x16 mm (IMA60).

source_text: 右肋术后、多发肋骨骨折较前愈合，右侧第6后肋高密度结节同前，胸8椎体略变扁同前
text_en: Postoperative changes of the right rib and multiple rib fractures show healing compared to prior; right 6th posterior rib hyperdense nodule unchanged; mild compression of the T8 vertebral body unchanged.

source_text: 新见少许模糊小结节
text_en: Newly identified a few indistinct small nodules

source_text: 双肺散在少许小结节同前，左肺下叶结节约5mm（Im37），未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Scattered few small nodules in both lungs are unchanged, left lower lobe nodule about 5 mm (Im37), no new nodules or patchy opacities seen.

source_text: 双肺未见明确新发病灶
text_en: No definite new lesions are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 左侧后内胸膜稍增厚同前，右侧叶间胸膜局部结节样增厚同前（IM33），双侧胸腔未见胸水
text_en: Slight thickening of the left posterior internal pleura is unchanged compared to prior; focal nodular thickening of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged (IM33); no pleural effusion is seen in either hemithorax.

source_text: 右肺中叶外侧段及左肺下叶前基底段新见小结节，较大约6mm（IM18）
text_en: New small nodules are seen in the lateral segment of the right middle lobe and the anterior basal segment of the left lower lobe, with the largest measuring approximately 6 mm (IM18).

source_text: 右肺下叶新见结节，约15x11mm（IM35），边清，可见分叶，考虑转移
text_en: Newly seen nodule in the right lower lobe, approximately 15 x 11 mm (IM35), well-defined, with lobulation, considered metastatic.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段胸膜下极浅淡片影此次未见显示，右肺下叶外基底段小结节同前，约为6mm（IM35）
text_en: The very faint subpleural patch in the dorsal segment of the left lower lobe is not visible on this examination. A small nodule in the lateral basal segment of the right lower lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 6 mm (IM35).

source_text: 双腋窝多发小淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in bilateral axillae are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺及胸膜小结节同前
text_en: Small nodules in both lungs and pleura are stable.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段椭圆形结节大致同前，现约30*25mm(图27)，原约30x24mm（IM25）
text_en: Oval nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, largely unchanged, currently approximately 30x25 mm (Figure 27), previously approximately 30x24 mm (IM25)

source_text: 双肺未见新增结节或斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs.

source_text: 双腋下多发淋巴结大致同前，较大约2x1.2cm（Im12）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes at both axillae are generally unchanged from prior, the largest measuring approximately 2x1.2 cm (Im12).

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前（Im20、27）
text_en: Tiny nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior (Im20, 27).

source_text: 右肺下叶多个不规则模糊小结节同前，较大仍约5mm（IM34），追查
text_en: Multiple irregular and ill-defined small nodules in the right lower lobe are unchanged; the largest remains approximately 5 mm (IM34); further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 左肺结节灶同前
text_en: Left pulmonary nodule unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶后段新发结节，约3mm（IM18）
text_en: Left upper lobe posterior segment newly developed nodule, approximately 3 mm (IM18).

source_text: 双肺见多发磨玻璃密度小结节同前（薄层Im60、78、79、90），较大者约5mm（Im78）
text_en: Multiple small ground-glass opacity nodules are seen in both lungs, unchanged from prior (thin-slice Im60, 78, 79, 90); the largest is approximately 5 mm (Im78).

source_text: 余双肺未见明确新发结节及实变影
text_en: The remainder of both lungs shows no definite new nodules or consolidation shadows.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节影同前，约4mm（Im41）
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 4 mm (Im41).

source_text: 左肺见索条影，纵隔旁小结节灶同前，约5mm（IMA43）
text_en: Left lung shows linear opacities; small nodule adjacent to mediastinum unchanged from previous, approximately 5 mm (IMA43).

source_text: 右肺上叶及下叶小结节同前
text_en: The small nodules in the right upper and lower lobes remain unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段（IM30，31）、右肺中叶（IM36）及左肺下叶（IM46）数枚胸膜下小结节同前，均小于5mm
text_en: Several subpleural small nodules in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe (IM30, 31), right middle lobe (IM36), and left lower lobe (IM46) are unchanged compared to prior; all are less than 5 mm in size.

source_text: 左第3、8肋骨骨质破坏同前
text_en: Osseous destruction of the left third and eighth ribs is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变，胸部未见复发和转移征象
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; no signs of recurrence or metastasis are seen in the chest.

source_text: 纵隔右移，多发小淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Mediastinal shift to the right; multiple small lymph nodes, roughly same as before.

source_text: 纵隔4、5、7组多发淋巴结同前，较大仍约21x6mm(IM27)
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4, 5, and 7 are unchanged from previous, with the largest still approximately 21x6 mm (Image 27).

source_text: 双肺多发结节大致同前
text_en: Multiple nodules in both lungs are essentially unchanged.

source_text: 两肺未见明确新发结节或实变影
text_en: No definite new nodules or consolidations are seen in both lungs.

source_text: 左肺上叶舌段新见模糊小结节灶（IM27），转移
text_en: A new ill-defined small nodule is seen in the left upper lobe lingular segment (IM27), metastasis.

source_text: 双肺支气管通畅，右肺中下叶条片影大致同前，余双肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Bilateral bronchi are patent. The linear and patchy opacities in the right middle and lower lobes are largely unchanged. No new nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 两肺小结节影、左肺下叶小斑片状影同前
text_en: Small nodules and a small patchy opacity in the left lower lobe similar to prior

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影及模糊小结节同前(图61)，左肺尖点状小结节同前，大小3mm（IM7）
text_en: The linear opacities and indistinct small nodules in the right lower lobe are unchanged (Figure 61); the punctate nodule at the left lung apex is unchanged, measuring 3 mm (IM7).

source_text: 左肺术后，纵隔左移同前，支气管断端未见结节及肿块影
text_en: Left lung postoperative, mediastinal shift to the left unchanged, no nodules or mass at the bronchial stump.

source_text: 右侧叶间胸膜微小结节同前（Im27）
text_en: Tiny nodule of the right interlobar pleura is unchanged from prior (Im27).

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结显示同前，建议复查
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes appear unchanged from prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下小结节较前缩小，现约2mm（IM17），原约3mm
text_en: The small subpleural nodule in the right upper lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, now approximately 2 mm (IM17), previously approximately 3 mm.

source_text: 纵隔4、5组淋巴结同前
text_en: Lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 4 and 5 are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右侧肋骨术后改变同前，胸廓骨质未见转移征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the right rib are unchanged. No evidence of metastatic disease in the thoracic bones.

source_text: 双肺散发小结节同前，右侧胸膜小结节，追查
text_en: Scattered small nodules in both lungs are unchanged. A small nodule is seen in the right pleura; further evaluation is recommended.

source_text: 双肺内少许微结节同前结节，较大约4mm（IM31、37），倾向良性
text_en: A few small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior (IM31, 37), largest measuring approximately 4 mm, favoring benign etiology.

source_text: 双肺透亮度较前减低，模糊小结节影部分同前(IM102），部分显示不清
text_en: Lung lucency is lower than prior; some of the hazy small nodules are unchanged (IM102), while others are not clearly visible.

source_text: 左肺术后改变同前，未见复发、转移征象
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left lung unchanged; no signs of recurrence or metastasis.

source_text: 右肺多发实性结节,转移?追查.
text_en: Multiple solid nodules in the right lung; metastasis? Pursue further evaluation.

source_text: 双肺索条影同前，余肺未见结节
text_en: Linear opacities in both lungs are similar to prior. No nodules are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶外基底段稍高密度结节灶同前，约3mm（IM39）
text_en: The slightly hyperdense nodule in the lateral basal segment of the left lower lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM39).

source_text: 右腋下淋巴结同前，仍约14x12mm（Im19）
text_en: Right axillary lymph nodes are unchanged compared to prior, remaining approximately 14x12 mm (Im19)

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见增厚软组织密度影，双肺未见新增结节或实变影
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no thickened soft-tissue density is seen at the bronchial stump. No new nodules or consolidations are seen in either lung.

source_text: 左肺上叶后段胸膜下磨玻璃密度小结节大小同前，约4mm（IM18），密度略降低
text_en: Left upper lobe posterior segment pleural-based small ground-glass opacity nodule, size same as before, approximately 4 mm (IM18), density slightly decreased.

source_text: 余肺内未见明显新增病灶
text_en: No obvious new foci are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下多个微结节影同前（IM13、16），约2-4mm，观察
text_en: Multiple tiny nodular opacities in the right lung subpleural region are unchanged (IM13, 16), measuring approximately 2–4 mm; recommend observation.

source_text: 右侧膈胸膜结节样增厚同前（IM49)，未见胸水征象
text_en: The nodular thickening of the right diaphragmatic pleura is unchanged from prior (IM49); no pleural effusion is seen.

source_text: 纵隔、双肺门、锁骨上区及腋下未见肿大淋巴结，多发高密度淋巴结同前
text_en: No enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum, bilateral hilar regions, supraclavicular areas, or axillae; multiple high-density lymph nodes remain unchanged.

source_text: 左肺下叶索条影、两肺散在模糊小结节灶大小及范围部分同前相仿，较大仍约8x6mm（Se3,IM15）
text_en: Left lower lobe fibrotic streak, scattered indistinct small nodules in both lungs with size and extent partially similar to previous, larger nodule still approximately 8x6mm (Se3,IM15)

source_text: 扫及肝S4肿块同前
text_en: A mass in liver segment S4 is unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左肺下叶3mm圆形小结节同前（IM40），追查
text_en: 3mm round small nodule in the left lower lobe unchanged from previous (IM40), follow-up.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段磨玻璃结节影同前，约5x5mm（IM14）
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the apical segment of the right upper lobe is stable, measuring approximately 5x5 mm (IM14).

source_text: 纵隔散在小淋巴结较前相仿，现仍约8*5mm(图28)
text_en: Scattered small mediastinal lymph nodes similar to previous, still approximately 8x5 mm (Figure 28).

source_text: 右上肺尖多个高密度结节同前
text_en: Multiple high-density nodules in the right upper lung apex are unchanged.

source_text: 食管癌术后，胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Post-esophagectomy for esophageal cancer, no new mass lesions in the chest.

source_text: 纵隔5、7组、双肺门见肿大淋巴结同前相仿，较大者约18x14mm（IMA26）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 5 and 7, and bilateral hilar enlarged lymph nodes are similar to prior, largest approximately 18x14 mm (IMA26).

source_text: 扫及甲状腺左叶内小结节样低密度影同前，大小约6mm（IM6）
text_en: A small low-density nodule in the left thyroid lobe is unchanged from prior, approximately 6 mm (IM6).

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段少许硬结索条影伴钙化灶、双下肺胸膜下少许条片影、右下肺钙化灶同前相仿，双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: A few fibrotic streaks with calcified foci in the apical-posterior segment of the left upper lobe, a few linear and patchy opacities subpleurally in both lower lobes, and calcified foci in the right lower lobe similar to previous; no new nodules or patchy opacities in both lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段胸膜下小结节灶伴索条影同前，较大约6mm（IM20），其内可见钙化影，考虑结核硬结灶可能性大
text_en: Subpleural small nodule with linear opacities in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe is stable; largest measures approximately 6 mm (IM20); calcification is visible within; tuberculous scar is likely

source_text: 纵隔2-4R淋巴结较前缩小，现约13*8mm(14图)，原约17*10mm(图14)
text_en: Mediastinal 2-4R lymph nodes have decreased in size compared to prior, now approximately 13x8 mm (IM14), previously approximately 17x10 mm (IM14)

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段模糊点状结节同前，倾向良性可能，追查
text_en: Stable ill-defined punctate nodule in left upper lobe apicoposterior segment, suggestive of benign possibility, follow-up

source_text: 左肺上叶、右肺下叶微小结节同前（Im24、52），余肺未见新生结节或实变影
text_en: Tiny nodules in the left upper lobe and right lower lobe are stable compared to prior (Im24, 52); no new nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 右肋术后、多发肋骨陈旧骨折同前，右侧第6后肋高密度结节同前，胸8椎体略变扁同前
text_en: Postoperative changes of the right rib and multiple old rib fractures unchanged; right 6th posterior rib hyperdense nodule unchanged; mild compression of the T8 vertebral body unchanged.

source_text: 扫及胸椎局限性低密度灶（IM54）同前，余扫及胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Localized low-density focus in the thoracic vertebrae (IM54) unchanged from prior, no signs of bone destruction seen in the remaining thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 右肺下叶浅淡小结节同前，约4mm（Im43）
text_en: The faint small nodule in the right lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM43).

source_text: 锁骨上、腋下淋巴结大致同前，较大现仍约10x5mm（IM15）
text_en: Supraclavicular and axillary lymph nodes essentially unchanged from previous, with the larger one currently still approximately 10x5 mm (IM15)

source_text: 纵隔、左肺门淋巴结减少缩小，原较大约21x18mm，现较大约17*11mm（IM25）
text_en: Mediastinal and left hilar lymph nodes are decreased in number and reduced in size; largest previously measuring approximately 21x18 mm, now approximately 17x11 mm (IM25).

source_text: 右上肺癌术后，术区缝线周围未见明显软组织影异常增较前略增大，现约23*12mm(图53)，原约19x13mm（IM54）
text_en: Postoperative changes after right upper lung cancer resection; no significant abnormal soft tissue around the suture site is seen; the area is slightly larger than prior, now measuring approximately 23x12 mm (Figure 53), previously 19x13 mm (IM54).

source_text: 未见明确转移
text_en: No definite metastasis

source_text: 左肺上叶磨玻璃密度灶较前相仿，约13*6mm（IMA19），两肺微小结节影同前（IMA37、43等）
text_en: The ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe is similar to previous, approximately 13x6 mm (IMA19), with unchanged small nodules in both lungs (IMA37, 43, etc.).

source_text: 平扫纵隔未见明显增大淋巴结，右气管食管沟小淋巴结同前，仍约9x4mm（IM11）
text_en: Non-contrast CT shows no significantly enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes, and the small lymph node in the right tracheoesophageal groove unchanged from prior, still measuring approximately 9x4 mm on image 11.

source_text: 右肺下叶小结节同前，追查
text_en: The small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged; further follow-up is recommended.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段4mm结节同前（IM10），余双肺未见新生结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: 4 mm nodule in the right upper lobe apical segment unchanged (IM10); remainder of both lungs show no new nodules or fluffy opacities

source_text: 左下肺混合磨玻璃病变范围较前略增大，考虑恶性可能性大
text_en: Mixed ground-glass lesion in the left lower lobe is slightly increased in extent compared to prior; malignancy is considered likely.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下微小结节同前，约2mm（Im23）
text_en: The tiny subpleural nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 2 mm (Im23).

source_text: T4胸椎体致密结节同前
text_en: Dense nodule in T4 thoracic vertebra unchanged

source_text: 余双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，未见新发结节影
text_en: Lung markings in the remainder of both lungs are smooth and unremarkable; lung parenchyma shows uniform lucency; no new nodule shadows are seen.

source_text: 右肺叶间胸膜下小结节同前，仍约8mm（IM28）
text_en: A small nodule beneath the interlobar pleura of the right lung is stable compared to prior, still measuring approximately 8 mm (IM28).

source_text: 左肺上叶散在小片絮及微小结节影同前（IMA26、27）
text_en: Scattered small patchy opacities and tiny nodular opacities in the left upper lobe unchanged from previous (IMA26, 27)

source_text: 右肺门旁结节同前，仍约9mm（IM37)
text_en: The nodule adjacent to the right hilum is similar to prior, still approximately 9 mm (IM37).

source_text: 右肺上叶前段浅淡结节同前(IM26)，右肺中叶约4mm结节同前（IM43）
text_en: Faint nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable (IM26); approximately 4 mm nodule in the right middle lobe, stable (IM43)

source_text: 纵膈2、4、5、7组多发淋巴结较前变化不明显，较大原约19*8mm，现约18x7mm（IM23）
text_en: Mediastinal stations 2, 4, 5, and 7 lymph nodes show no significant change compared to prior; the largest was approximately 19x8 mm, now approximately 18x7 mm (IM23)

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段胸膜下微小结节同前，较大约4mm（IM38）
text_en: The subpleural tiny nodule in the left lower lobe basal segment remains unchanged, largest approximately 4 mm (IM38).

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管残端少许软组织密度灶较前减少，未见异常强化结节及肿块
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; minimal soft tissue density focus at the bronchial stump has decreased compared to prior; no abnormally enhancing nodule or mass identified

source_text: 新见散在结节
text_en: Newly seen scattered nodules

source_text: 胸10椎体上缘塌陷伴骨质硬化同前，余扫及诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Superior margin collapse of thoracic vertebra 10 with sclerosis, same as before; no evidence of bone destruction in the remaining scanned bones

source_text: 右肺中叶及左肺下叶胸膜下见少许2-3mm点状小结节同前
text_en: A few 2–3 mm punctate subpleural nodules are seen in the right middle lobe and left lower lobe, unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段支气管截断同前，局部软组织肿块较前略缩小，原约36x25mm，现约30x25mm（IM29），其内可见空洞同前，与斜裂胸膜关系密切
text_en: Bronchial cutoff in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe unchanged from prior; local soft tissue mass slightly smaller than prior, previously approximately 36 x 25 mm, now approximately 30 x 25 mm (IM29); cavity within the mass unchanged; closely related to the oblique fissure pleura.

source_text: 右肺下叶钙化小结节同前，部分微结节显示不清
text_en: Calcified small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged; some micronodules are not clearly visualized.

source_text: 纵隔平扫多发淋巴结显示同前，小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal CT without contrast shows multiple lymph nodes unchanged, all less than 10mm.

source_text: T10椎体小高密度结节同前(IM45)，建议追查
text_en: Small high-density nodule in the T10 vertebral body is unchanged (IM45); further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 右肺下叶后肋膈角模糊结节样病灶同前相仿，约11x8mm（IM40）
text_en: The ill-defined nodular lesion in the posterior costophrenic angle of the right lower lobe is similar to prior, measuring approximately 11 x 8 mm (IM40).

source_text: 扫及右肾上腺结节同前（IM64）
text_en: On scan, right adrenal nodule unchanged from prior (IM64)

source_text: 纵隔新见淋巴结影，约7mm（IMA24）
text_en: Newly seen mediastinal lymph node approximately 7 mm (IMA24).

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下浅淡模糊小结节同前（IM47）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural faint hazy small nodule unchanged from previous (IM47).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段结节同前，仍倾向恶性，实性成分较少
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe dorsal segment is unchanged and remains favored to be malignant, with minimal solid component.

source_text: 右肺小结节影同前（IM11、40），右肺上叶索条影同前
text_en: Right lung small nodule shadows unchanged (IM11, 40); right upper lobe linear opacity unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖段小结节同前相仿，约5mm（IM15）
text_en: A small nodule in the apical segment of the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior, approximately 5 mm (IM15)

source_text: 原右肺索条影较前相仿，余双肺未见新发结节灶
text_en: The previously noted linear opacity in the right lung is similar to prior. No new nodules are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶斑片影钙化及肺内小结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: Calcified patchy opacity in the right upper lobe and small pulmonary nodules are unchanged from prior, likely benign.

source_text: 右肺中下叶散在微结节同前，较大者约4mm（IM32）
text_en: Scattered micro-nodules in the right middle and lower lobes, stable compared to prior; the largest measures approximately 4 mm (IM32).

source_text: 右肺多发絮状密度增高影较前大部吸收，现局部仅见少许结节灶及索条影（Im38、41、47等）
text_en: The multifocal fluffy increased density opacities in the right lung have largely resolved compared to prior. Only a few small nodular foci and linear opacities remain (Im38, 41, 47, etc.).

source_text: 右肺下叶背段磨玻璃微小结节同前（IM27），余双肺未见新增结节灶或斑片影
text_en: Tiny ground-glass nodule in the right lower lobe posterior segment is unchanged (IM27); no new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 左上肺微小结节同前（Im14）
text_en: The tiny nodule in the left upper lobe is unchanged (Im14).

source_text: 左肺内未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation in left lung.

source_text: 纵隔2R小淋巴结较前缩小，现约8mm（IM11），原约10mm（IM11）
text_en: Small lymph node at mediastinal station 2R decreased in size compared to previous, currently approximately 8mm (IM11), previously approximately 10mm (IM11)

source_text: 右肺内散在微小结节同前，较大者约3mm（IM42）
text_en: Scattered micro-nodules in the right lung are stable; the largest measures approximately 3 mm (IM42).

source_text: 双肺未见新发结节影，双肺下叶条片影部分范围缩小
text_en: No new nodules seen in both lungs; partial reduction in the extent of linear opacities in the lower lobes bilaterally.

source_text: 右肺新见多发小结节，较大约6mm（IM44），考虑转移
text_en: Newly observed multiple small nodules in the right lung, the largest measuring approximately 6 mm (IM44); metastasis is considered.

source_text: 右叶间胸膜处结节同前，约7x5mm（IM29）
text_en: Nodule at the right interlobar pleura is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 7 x 5 mm (IM29).

source_text: 右肺门及纵隔隆突下软组织密度区范围较前缩小，余纵隔内淋巴结较前缩小，原约16x12mm（IM18），现约13x11mm（IM18）
text_en: The soft tissue density area below the carina in the right hilar and mediastinal region has decreased in size compared to prior. The remaining mediastinal lymph nodes are smaller than before, previously measuring approximately 16x12 mm (IM18), now approximately 13x11 mm (IM18).

source_text: 纵隔7组淋巴结较前缩小，现约13*7mm(图29)，原约13x10mm（IM28）
text_en: Mediastinal station 7 lymph nodes are reduced in size compared to previous, currently approximately 13 × 7 mm (Image 29), previously approximately 13 × 10 mm (Image 28)

source_text: 右肺上叶斑片及小结节影较前相仿
text_en: Patchy opacities and small nodules in the right upper lobe are similar to prior.

source_text: 左肺未见明显新发结节影
text_en: No obvious new nodules in the left lung.

source_text: 双肺上叶小斑片索条影、右肺上叶点状结节影同前（IMA31）
text_en: Small patchy and linear opacities in the upper lobes of both lungs and a punctate nodule in the right upper lobe are stable compared to prior (IMA31).

source_text: 右肺模糊小结节同前（IM23、31）
text_en: Hazy small nodules in the right lung are unchanged (IM23, 31).

source_text: 纵隔6组小淋巴结同前（IM23）
text_en: Small lymph nodes in mediastinal station 6 are unchanged from prior (IM23).

source_text: 扫及甲状腺右侧叶低强化结节同前相仿
text_en: Hypoenhancing nodule in the right thyroid lobe, similar to prior.

source_text: 左肺癌治疗后，较前好转
text_en: After left lung cancer treatment, improved compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶结节较前稍缩小
text_en: The nodule in the right middle lobe is slightly smaller than before.

source_text: 右肺胸膜/叶间胸膜下微结节同前（IM23、27），均小于5mm
text_en: The subpleural and interlobar pleural micronodules in the right lung are stable (IM23, 27), all measuring less than 5 mm.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段肿块影缩小，原约42x30mm，现约31x28mm（IM14）
text_en: The mass in the left upper lobe apicoposterior segment has decreased in size, previously approximately 42x30 mm, now approximately 31x28 mm (IM14)

source_text: 双肺余微小结节同前（Im31、42）
text_en: Remaining micronodules in both lungs are unchanged compared to prior (Im31, 42).

source_text: 右肺上叶磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，现仍约14x12mm（Im21），密度稍增高
text_en: The ground-glass opacity nodule in the right upper lobe is similar to the prior study, currently measuring approximately 14 x 12 mm (Im21), with slightly increased density.

source_text: 左肺内未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation in left lung.

source_text: 右肺上叶及右肺下叶磨玻璃密度小结节较前相仿(IM21、28、36 )，较大仍约6mm（Im28）
text_en: Small ground-glass opacity nodules in the right upper and right lower lobes are similar to prior (IM21, 28, 36); the largest remains approximately 6 mm (Im28).

source_text: 左肺下叶小结节同前，现约3mm（IM52、55）
text_en: The small nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior, currently approximately 3 mm (IM52, 55).

source_text: 右肺多发磨玻璃密度结节较前相仿
text_en: Multiple ground-glass opacity nodules in the right lung are similar to prior.

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺内透亮度均匀，右肺中叶模糊小结节较前缩小，现约4x2mm（IM 36），原约5x4mm（IMA36）
text_en: Pulmonary markings are unremarkable. Lung parenchymal lucency is uniform. A poorly defined small nodule in the right middle lobe has decreased in size compared to prior, now measuring approximately 4x2 mm (IM36), previously 5x4 mm (IMA36).

source_text: 气管左旁小淋巴结同前（IM13）
text_en: Left paratracheal small lymph node unchanged from prior (IM13).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，左肺上叶前段可见条片状磨玻璃密度影同前，较大层面范围约21*13mm（IMA20），其内可见小结节灶，矢状位重建图像呈扁平片状形态同前，周围局限性胸膜粘连
text_en: Smooth bronchovascular markings in both lungs, a linear ground-glass density in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe similar to prior, largest dimension approximately 21x13 mm (IMA20), containing a small nodular focus, sagittal reconstruction shows a flat, plate-like morphology similar to prior, with localized pleural adhesion.

source_text: 双肺门淋巴结饱满，大致同前，随诊观察
text_en: Hilar lymph nodes are prominent, generally unchanged from prior; follow-up recommended.

source_text: 余双肺内未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 左肺散在小结节同前（IMA29、44）
text_en: Scattered small nodules in the left lung unchanged from previous (IMA29, 44)

source_text: 右上肺胸膜下模糊小结节影同前，小于5mm（IM21）
text_en: Indistinct small nodular opacity subpleurally in the right upper lung is unchanged, less than 5 mm (IM21).

source_text: 左肺上叶小结节影同前，密度较前增高，建议复查
text_en: Left upper lobe small nodule same as before, increased density compared to previous, follow-up recommended.

source_text: 胸廓诸骨密度欠均匀同前，未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: Thoracic bones show inhomogeneous density unchanged from previous, with no signs of bone destruction.

source_text: 右肺上叶及中叶结节同前相仿，未见新发结节
text_en: Nodules in the right upper and middle lobes are similar to prior; no new nodules are seen.

source_text: 左肺上叶、右肺下叶索条影、右肺上叶浅淡小结节影同前（IMA28）
text_en: Linear opacities in the left upper lobe and right lower lobe, and faint small nodules in the right upper lobe are stable compared to prior (IMA28).

source_text: 左肾上腺结节同前，请结合腹部检查
text_en: Left adrenal nodule unchanged, recommend correlation with abdominal examination.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结同前，较大约12*10mm（IMA18）
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior, largest measuring approximately 12x10 mm (IMA18).

source_text: 右肺散在小结节影同前，较大仍约5mm（IM45）
text_en: Scattered small nodular opacities in the right lung are stable compared to prior, the largest remaining approximately 5 mm (IM45).

source_text: 左肺尖斑片影同前（IM8），余双肺未见新增结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: Patchy opacity at the left lung apex unchanged from prior (IM8); no new nodules or patchy opacities in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 食道胸中段管壁不均匀异常增厚较前减轻，较厚部位原约12mm（IMA22），现约8mm（IM21），外膜模糊，同胸主动脉接触面约90度，近端食管稍扩张
text_en: Irregular abnormal thickening of the mid-thoracic esophageal wall, reduced compared to previous; thickened area previously approximately 12 mm (IMA22), now approximately 8 mm (IM21); outer membrane blurred; contact surface with thoracic aorta approximately 90 degrees; proximal esophagus slightly dilated.

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结较前略增大，建议追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 4R lymph node is slightly enlarged compared to previous, with recommendation for further evaluation.

source_text: 纵隔4R、6组及7组淋巴结多数较前相仿，如较大现约15x10mm（IM23），平扫密度较高
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes at stations 4R, 6, and 7 are mostly similar to prior, with the largest now approximately 15x10mm (IM23) and higher density on non-contrast scan.

source_text: 其余双肺未见新发结节或实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidation are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右肺下叶背段结节同前，大小约10x7mm和7x5mm（IMA33、29）
text_en: The nodule in the right lower lobe dorsal segment is unchanged, measuring approximately 10x7 mm and 7x5 mm (IMA33, 29).

source_text: 双肺纹理走行顺畅，肺纹理增多，左上叶见微小结节同前，2mm（IM25）
text_en: Bilateral lung markings are unremarkable in course, but increased in number. A tiny nodule in the left upper lobe is stable, measuring 2 mm (IM25).

source_text: 另左肺下叶胸膜旁及右肺下叶胸膜旁小结节灶同前，约为3mm（IM47）
text_en: Additionally, small nodular foci adjacent to the pleura in the left lower lobe and right lower lobe are unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM47).

source_text: 隆突下淋巴结缩小，原约20x13mm(Im24)，现约11x5mm（IM30）
text_en: Subcarinal lymph node decreased in size, previously approximately 20 × 13 mm (Im24), now approximately 11 × 5 mm (IM30)

source_text: 纵隔散在小淋巴结较前相仿，现仍约8*5mm(图26)
text_en: Scattered small mediastinal lymph nodes similar to previous, still approximately 8x5 mm (Figure 26).

source_text: 右下叶模糊小结节同前，约3mm（IM35），余肺未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: Indistinct small nodule in the right lower lobe unchanged, approximately 3 mm (IM35); remainder of lungs without new nodules or consolidation.

source_text: 左肺肺大泡增大，原约5.4x4.3cm，现约5.8x4.6cm（Im34），后下壁及腔内结节较前增大，周围肺野片状磨玻璃密度影范围较前增多
text_en: Left lung bulla enlargement, previously approximately 5.4x4.3 cm, currently approximately 5.8x4.6 cm (Im34), with nodules on the posterior-inferior wall and within the cavity increased in size, and increased extent of patchy ground-glass opacity in the surrounding lung parenchyma compared to previous.

source_text: 纵隔4L淋巴结同前，现仍约15x11mm（IM26）
text_en: Mediastinal station 4L lymph nodes are unchanged from prior, now still measuring approximately 15x11 mm (IM26).

source_text: 双肺索条、小结节影同前
text_en: Linear opacities and small nodules in both lungs are similar to prior.

source_text: 纵隔右移，纵隔小淋巴结同前（IM19）
text_en: Mediastinal shift to the right, mediastinal small lymph nodes unchanged from prior (IM19).

source_text: 左肺下叶后基底段磨玻璃密度小结节较前相仿，大小仍约5mm（IM46），建议追踪观察
text_en: The small ground-glass nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe is unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM46), recommend follow-up.

source_text: 余肺内未见明显新增结节及实变影
text_en: No obvious new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 左侧第6肋骨新见增高影，骨质毛糙（IM39），转移待排，请结合病史或骨扫描
text_en: New area of increased density at the left sixth rib with cortical irregularity (IM39). Metastasis is to be ruled out. Correlation with clinical history or bone scan is recommended.

source_text: T5椎体高密度结节同前
text_en: High-density nodule in T5 vertebral body unchanged

source_text: 气管右侧胸廓入口处、3A、7组、食管旁、胸主动脉后、右肺门多发淋巴结大致同前，如较大仍约21x5mm（IM28）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes at right paratracheal, thoracic inlet, station 3A, station 7, paraesophageal, posterior to thoracic aorta, and right hilum generally similar to prior, with larger one remaining approximately 21x5mm (IM28)

source_text: 双肺内、叶间胸膜散在微小结节，较前相仿，良性可能
text_en: Scattered micronodules in the lung parenchyma and interlobar pleura are similar to prior, likely benign.

source_text: 右肺胸膜下多个微结节影同前（IM15、18），约2-4mm
text_en: Multiple tiny nodular opacities in the right lung subpleural region are unchanged (IM15, 18), measuring approximately 2–4 mm.

source_text: 纵隔内多发小淋巴结大致同前，未见明显肿大者
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes, largely unchanged from prior. No significantly enlarged lymph nodes seen.

source_text: 新发小淋巴结
text_en: Newly developed small lymph nodes

source_text: 纵隔7、10R见多发淋巴结平扫显示同前，较大约13x10mm（IM28）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes at mediastinal stations 7 and 10R on non-contrast scan unchanged from prior, largest approximately 13x10 mm (IM28).

source_text: 右肺见磨玻璃密度结节部分同前（IM16），部分显示不清（原IM31、41），边缘光滑
text_en: Partially stable ground-glass density nodules in the right lung (IM16); some are no longer clearly visible (previously IM31, 41), with smooth margins.

source_text: 右肺上叶尖段及左肺上叶尖后段磨玻璃密度结节同前，追查
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodules in the apical segment of the right upper lobe and apicoposterior segment of the left upper lobe are unchanged; further evaluation recommended.

source_text: 左肺多发小结节同前（IM38、49、50）
text_en: Multiple small nodules in the left lung unchanged from prior (IM38, 49, 50)

source_text: 双肺门、纵隔多发小淋巴结同前
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the bilateral hila and mediastinum are unchanged from prior.

source_text: 余肺野未见新增结节
text_en: The remainder of the lung fields shows no new nodules.

source_text: 右肺上叶见多发结节影同前，部分内含空泡，较大者约6mm（IM19），边缘模糊
text_en: Multiple nodular opacities are seen in the right upper lobe, unchanged, some containing air bronchograms; the largest measures approximately 6 mm (IM19), with blurred margins.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段见磨玻璃密度结节影同前，约4mm（IMA24）
text_en: A ground-glass density nodule is seen in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe, unchanged, measuring approximately 4 mm (IMA24).

source_text: 甲状腺右叶低密度结节同前
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right lobe of the thyroid gland unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上多发小淋巴结同前，较大约7mm（IM5）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region are unchanged from prior, the largest measuring approximately 7 mm (IM5).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变，未见明确复发及转移征象
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; no definite signs of recurrence or metastasis

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门多发小淋巴结部分同前，部分略饱满，如隆突下原约13x7mm（IM36）者，现约19x11mm（IM32）
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right hilar region are partially unchanged from previous and partially slightly enlarged, such as the subcarinal lymph node that was previously approximately 13x7 mm (IM36) and is now approximately 19x11 mm (IM32).

source_text: 右下肺模糊结节较前增多，追查
text_en: The indistinct nodules in the right lower lobe have increased in number compared to prior imaging; further evaluation is warranted.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段新发模糊片絮影，右肺下叶钙化及局部索条影同前，余肺未见新生结节及异常密度区
text_en: Newly developed indistinct patchy opacities are seen in the right upper lobe posterior segment. The calcification and local linear opacities in the right lower lobe are unchanged. No new nodules or abnormal density areas are seen elsewhere in the lungs.

source_text: 右上叶肺癌术后改变，较前相仿
text_en: Postoperative changes following right upper lobe lung cancer resection are similar to prior.

source_text: 右肺尖脊柱旁不规则类结节影同前，约8*2mm(图10)，邻近胸膜增厚同前
text_en: The irregular nodular opacity adjacent to the spine in the right lung apex is unchanged, measuring approximately 8x2 mm (Figure 10). Adjacent pleural thickening is also unchanged.

source_text: 右水平裂胸膜下结节影，右肺下叶磨玻璃密度小结节影同前
text_en: Subpleural nodule along the right horizontal fissure unchanged; small ground-glass opacity nodule in the right lower lobe unchanged.

source_text: 余两肺未见新发结节及实变影
text_en: No new nodules or consolidations are seen in the remainder of both lungs.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段血管旁小结节同前，大小约3*2mm（IMA20）
text_en: The small perivascular nodule in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe remains unchanged, measuring approximately 3x2 mm (IMA20).

source_text: 纵隔内小淋巴结平扫同前，未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal small lymph nodes on non-contrast scan unchanged from prior, no lymphadenopathy seen.

source_text: 余肺未见新增结节及实变影
text_en: No new nodules or areas of consolidation are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 右肺中叶浅淡小结节同前，约4mm（IM25）
text_en: Faint small nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged, measuring approximately 4 mm (IM25).

source_text: 胸椎体高密度小结节及左第9肋局部骨质密度略增高同前
text_en: Small high-density nodules in the thoracic vertebral bodies and slight focal increase in bone density in the left 9th rib, same as before.

source_text: 右肺上叶胸膜下小结节同前，约3mm（IM14）
text_en: Small subpleural nodule in the right upper lobe is stable, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM14).

source_text: 右肺中叶血管旁见模糊磨玻璃密度片絮影同前，约8x5mm（IM34），中叶胸膜下5mm小结节（IM37）同前
text_en: A hazy ground-glass opacity is seen adjacent to vessels in the right middle lobe, unchanged from prior, measuring approximately 8x5 mm (IM34). A 5-mm small nodule subpleural in the middle lobe (IM37) remains unchanged.

source_text: 左肺上叶后段支气管狭窄，斜裂前方不规则软组织肿块较前稍缩小，与肺门淋巴结分界欠清，较大层面原约39x22mm（IM32），现约38x19mm（IM37），后方累及斜裂胸膜，肿瘤内可见不规则形偏心性厚壁空洞及点状钙化，实性成分见强化，远端阻塞性肺不张同前
text_en: Left upper lobe posterior segment bronchial stenosis. Irregular soft tissue mass anterior to the oblique fissure has slightly decreased in size compared to previous; ill-defined margins with hilar lymph nodes. Largest dimension originally approximately 39x22 mm (IM32), now approximately 38x19 mm (IM37). Posteriorly involves the oblique fissure pleura. The mass shows irregular eccentric thick-walled cavity and punctate calcification; solid component demonstrates enhancement. Distal obstructive atelectasis same as before.

source_text: 左肺术后改变同前，胸部未见新增占位征象
text_en: Left lung postoperative change unchanged, chest shows no newly added signs of space-occupying lesion.

source_text: 原右肺中叶微小结节较前缩小呈点状（IMA34）
text_en: The previously noted micronodule in the right middle lobe is smaller than before and now appears punctate (IMA34).

source_text: 扫描范围内未见骨质破坏灶
text_en: No osseous destruction seen within the scan range.

source_text: 右前胸膜小结节同前，追查
text_en: Small nodule in the right anterior pleura, unchanged compared to prior; recommended for follow-up.

source_text: 双肺尖模糊小灶大致同前（IM15、18），余肺未见明确新发结节及片絮状病灶
text_en: Indistinct small foci at both lung apices are largely stable (IM15, 18); no definite new nodules or patchy opacities are seen elsewhere in the lungs.

source_text: 纵隔2组淋巴结较前略饱满，如原约7mm者，现约9mm（IM15），追查
text_en: Mediastinal station 2 lymph nodes are noted to be slightly prominent compared to prior, previously approximately 7 mm, now approximately 9 mm (IM15); recommend follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔4R淋巴结同前，追查
text_en: Mediastinal 4R lymph node unchanged from prior; follow-up
