text_en: Multiple new small nodules seen in both lungs, diameter <

source_text: 两肺弥漫斑点及模糊小结节影较前增多，部分增大，考虑转移可能，建议结合临床，密切追查
text_en: The diffuse punctate opacities and indistinct small nodules in both lungs are increased in number and some are larger than prior; metastasis is considered possible. Correlation with clinical findings and close follow-up are recommended.

source_text: 纵隔隆突下等处小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes in subcarinal mediastinum and other areas unchanged from previous

source_text: 胸11椎体上缘许莫氏结节同前，胸9椎体上缘许莫氏结节较前清楚
text_en: Schmorl's node at superior margin of T11 vertebra unchanged from prior; Schmorl's node at superior margin of T9 vertebra more distinct than prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段稍高密度索条小结节灶同前（IM28）
text_en: Slightly hyperdense linear small nodule in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe, stable compared to prior (IM28)

source_text: 左上肺小结节同前，约5mm（IM26）
text_en: Small nodule in the left upper lobe is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM26).

source_text: 两肺下叶索条影同前，两肺点状结节影同前（IMA26）
text_en: Linear opacities in both lower lobes are unchanged. Punctate nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged from prior (IMA26).

source_text: 甲状腺右侧叶低密度结节同前，约3mm（IM4）
text_en: Low-density nodule in the right thyroid lobe unchanged from prior, approximately 3 mm (IM4).

source_text: 右肺下叶索条影同前，左侧叶间胸膜旁小结节较前无变化，约为5mm（IM38）
text_en: Linear opacity in the right lower lobe is unchanged; a small nodule adjacent to the left interlobar pleura shows no change compared to prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM38).

source_text: 双肺磨玻璃密度同前，恶性不除外
text_en: Ground-glass opacities in both lungs are similar to prior. Malignancy cannot be excluded.

source_text: 右肺上叶后段、中叶、左肺下叶基底段新见类圆形稍高密度结节灶，边缘模糊，约3mm（IM26、34、51），左肺舌段新见少许片絮影（IM38）
text_en: Newly seen round, slightly hyperdense nodules are present in the right upper lobe posterior segment, right middle lobe, and left lower lobe basal segment, measuring approximately 3 mm (IM26, 34, 51), with indistinct margins. A small patchy opacity is newly seen in the left lingular segment (IM38).

source_text: 纵隔右侧气管食管沟小淋巴结同前（IM11）
text_en: Small lymph node in the right paratracheal groove of the mediastinum, same as before (IM11).

source_text: 右肺中叶局切术后，右肺微小结节、双肺索条影同前
text_en: Following limited resection of the right middle lobe, right pulmonary micro-nodules and bilateral pulmonary linear opacities are unchanged.

source_text: 余所及骨质未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: No signs of osseous destruction are seen in the bones evaluated.

source_text: 左下肺模糊小结节同前（IM30)，余肺内未见新灶
text_en: Indistinct small nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged (IM30); no new foci are seen in the remainder of the lungs.

source_text: 左肺下叶背段模糊小结节灶同前，建议密切追查
text_en: Left lower lobe dorsal segment indistinct small nodule unchanged from prior. Recommend close follow-up.

source_text: 左肺舌叶小结节同前，较大约4mm（IM39），追查
text_en: The small nodule in the lingula of the left lung is unchanged, the larger approximately 4 mm (IM39), follow-up

source_text: 左肺下叶胸膜下小结节同前，约3mm（IM55）
text_en: Left lower lobe subpleural small nodule unchanged from prior, approximately 3 mm (IM55)

source_text: 纵隔散在淋巴结同前，5-8mm
text_en: Scattered mediastinal lymph nodes same as before, 5-8 mm.

source_text: 左肺上叶前段纵隔旁模糊结节灶大致同前，约11mm（IMA20），边界不清，邻近局限性胸膜粘连
text_en: Left upper lobe anterior segment mediastinal-adjacent ill-defined nodule stable, approximately 11 mm (IMA20), ill-defined margins, with adjacent localized pleural adhesion.

source_text: 双肺多发磨玻璃密度结节影同前，左肺较大约6mm（IM28）
text_en: Multiple ground-glass density nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged; the largest in the left lung measures approximately 6 mm (IM28).

source_text: 纵隔内腔静脉后方高密度线影旁异常密度灶较前缩小，范围原约21x18mm，现约16x13mm（IM21），考虑术后改变，追查
text_en: Abnormal density focus adjacent to a high-density linear shadow posterior to the vena cava in the mediastinum, decreased in size compared to previous, previous extent approximately 21x18 mm, current extent approximately 16x13 mm (IM21), considered postoperative change, follow-up.

source_text: 右肺下叶术后，支气管断端未见异常密度灶，右侧叶间胸膜结节状增厚范围较前相仿，边缘模糊，约14x10mm（IM24），考虑术后改变
text_en: Status post right lower lobectomy; no abnormal density at the bronchial stump. Nodular thickening of the right interlobar pleura is stable compared to prior, with ill-defined margins, measuring approximately 14x10 mm (IM24), considered postoperative change.

source_text: 左侧锁骨上区、纵隔内2R、4、10R组小淋巴结同前
text_en: Small lymph nodes in the left supraclavicular region and mediastinal stations 2R, 4, and 10R are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 双肺未见新发结节及斑片影
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities seen in both lungs.

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门多发淋巴结同前，较大仍约15x9mm（Im24）
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right hilum are stable compared to prior, with the largest measuring approximately 15x9 mm (Im24).

source_text: 纵隔内多发小淋巴结同前，较大仍约9mm（IM15）
text_en: Multiple small mediastinal lymph nodes, stable compared to prior. Largest still approximately 9 mm (IM15).

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节同前（IM33）
text_en: Small nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged (IM33).

source_text: 左侧肾上腺结节同前
text_en: Nodule in the left adrenal gland is unchanged.

source_text: 右肺上叶斜裂胸膜与水平裂交界处上方分叶状软组织肿块较前增大，原约22x15mm（IM21），现约35x31mm（IM17），邻近胸膜可见牵拉
text_en: A lobulated soft tissue mass located above the junction of the oblique fissure and horizontal fissure in the right upper lobe has increased in size compared to prior, previously measuring about 22 x 15 mm (IM21), now measuring approximately 35 x 31 mm (IM17); adjacent pleural retraction is visible.

source_text: 左肺下叶模糊微小结节较前相仿
text_en: Left lower lobe indistinct tiny nodule stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺上叶多发结节大致同前，较大仍约17x12mm（IM13）
text_en: Multiple nodules in the right upper lobe are essentially unchanged; the largest remains approximately 17x12 mm (IM13).

source_text: 双肺新发多发结节，考虑肺内转移，密切追查
text_en: Newly developed multiple nodules in both lungs. Consider pulmonary metastases. Recommend close follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔2、4、5、7组及双肺门散在淋巴结大致同前，较大约16*9mm(图24)
text_en: Scattered lymph nodes in mediastinal stations 2, 4, 5, 7 and bilateral hilar regions essentially unchanged from previous, largest approximately 16x9 mm (Figure 24).

source_text: 左肺上叶后段及左肺下叶前基底段小结节同前，约4mm（IMA21、39）
text_en: Left upper lobe posterior segment and left lower lobe anterior basal segment show small nodules, same as before, approximately 4 mm (IMA21, 39).

source_text: 右上纵隔内数枚圆形淋巴结同前，大者约11x10mm（Im11），双肺门、锁骨上区及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Several round lymph nodes in the right upper mediastinum are unchanged, the largest measuring approximately 11x10 mm (Im11); no enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the bilateral hila, supraclavicular regions, or axillae.

source_text: 右肺上叶模糊结节同前
text_en: The ill-defined nodule in the right upper lobe is unchanged compared to prior.

source_text: 余双肺少量微小结节同前
text_en: Residual few tiny nodules in both lungs are unchanged

source_text: 两肺少许点状结节影同前，未见明显新增病灶
text_en: The punctate nodular opacities in both lungs are unchanged from prior; no significant new lesions are seen.

source_text: 隆突下淋巴结增大，原约8x7mm（IM25），现约15x11mm（IM28），密切追查
text_en: Subcarinal lymph node enlarged, previously approximately 8 × 7 mm (IM25), now approximately 15 × 11 mm (IM28), close follow-up recommended

source_text: 双肺散在多发结节灶大致同前（如IM17、26、39、41、45），左下肺胸膜下较大者仍约7mm（IM45）
text_en: Scattered multiple nodular opacities in both lungs are essentially unchanged (e.g., IM17, 26, 39, 41, 45). The largest, located subpleurally in the left lower lobe, remains approximately 7 mm (IM45).

source_text: 左肺上叶多发团片及类结节样磨玻璃密度灶大致同前，较大仍约6mm（IM27），未见明确实性成分
text_en: Multiple patchy and nodular ground-glass density opacities in the left upper lobe are largely unchanged, with the larger one still approximately 6 mm (IM27), and no definite solid component is seen.

source_text: 右肺门淋巴结较前相仿，约16x10mm（IM24）
text_en: The right hilar lymph node is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 16 x 10 mm (IM24).

source_text: 左肺下叶结节同前性质待定，请结合临床追查
text_en: Left lower lobe nodule unchanged from previous, nature undetermined; please correlate clinically and follow up.

source_text: 两肺散在结节及磨玻璃密度灶同前，较大仍约13x10mm（IMA24）
text_en: Scattered nodules and ground-glass opacity foci in both lungs, unchanged from prior; the largest remains approximately 13x10 mm (IMA24).

source_text: 左侧胸膜结节影较前略缩小（IM26）
text_en: Left pleural nodular opacity is slightly decreased compared to prior (IM26)

source_text: 纵隔数枚小淋巴结同前
text_en: Several small mediastinal lymph nodes unchanged from prior.

source_text: 左侧胸膜及叶间胸膜改变，倾向转移
text_en: Changes in the left pleura and interlobar pleura favor metastasis.

source_text: 左侧胸膜多发结节样增厚较前明显，较大约14*9mm（IM14），左侧胸腔新见少量胸水，考虑胸膜多发转移
text_en: Multiple nodular thickening of the left pleura is more prominent than prior, with the largest measuring approximately 14 x 9 mm (IM14). A new small amount of left pleural effusion is seen. Multiple pleural metastases are considered.

source_text: 左肺上叶尖后段磨玻璃密度结节同前相仿，约13x12mm（IM13），境界稍模糊
text_en: Left upper lobe, apicoposterior segment: ground-glass opacity nodule similar to previous, approximately 13x12 mm (IM13), with slightly ill-defined margins.

source_text: 扫描所及部分胸椎低密度结节同前
text_en: Scanned portions of the thoracic vertebrae show low-density nodules unchanged from prior.

source_text: 双肺现未见新发结节斑片影，双侧未见胸水
text_en: No new nodules or patchy opacities are seen in the lungs bilaterally. No pleural effusion is seen on either side.

source_text: 肺内磨玻璃密度结节及右肺上叶实性结节部分同前、部分显示不清，追查
text_en: Ground-glass opacity nodules and solid nodules in the right upper lobe partially unchanged, partially not clearly visible; further investigation required.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后改变，双肺小结节较前相仿
text_en: Postoperative changes in the left lower lobe; small nodules in both lungs are similar to previous.

source_text: 纵隔淋巴结较前略缩小，原较大约11x5mm（IM25），现约8*4mm(图25)
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes are slightly decreased compared to previous; largest previously approximately 11x5mm (IM25), currently approximately 8x4mm (Figure 25).

source_text: 右肺下叶胸膜下微小磨玻璃小结节（IM16）同前
text_en: Tiny subpleural ground-glass nodule in the right lower lobe is stable compared to prior (IM16).

source_text: 左腋窝多发小淋巴结同前
text_en: Left axillary multiple small lymph nodes unchanged.

source_text: 余胸廓诸骨未见骨质破坏征象
text_en: The remaining thoracic bones show no signs of osseous destruction.

source_text: 纵隔多发淋巴结同前，较大约15*5mm（IMA22）
text_en: Multiple mediastinal lymph nodes are stable compared to prior, largest measuring approximately 15x5 mm (IMA22)

source_text: 纵隔内7组见淋巴结同前相仿，约为12x7mm（Im27）
text_en: A lymph node at mediastinal station 7 is similar to previous, measuring approximately 12x7 mm (Im27).

source_text: 右肺结节、斑片索条影同前（IM35、50）
text_en: Nodule and patchy linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged (IM35, 50).

source_text: 左肺下叶结节大致同前，仍约13x11mm(IM38)，左肺多发索条影同前
text_en: The nodule in the left lower lobe is essentially unchanged, still approximately 13x11 mm on image 38, and multiple linear opacities in the left lung are unchanged.

source_text: 左肺下叶术后，支气管断端近肺门侧软组织影平扫显示欠清，局部未见确切新增软组织密度影，远端肺组织部分实变同前
text_en: Post left lower lobectomy, the soft tissue density at the bronchial stump near the hilum is not clearly visualized on non-contrast CT; no definite new soft tissue density is seen locally, and partial consolidation in the distal lung parenchyma is stable compared to previous.

source_text: 扫及甲状腺右叶模糊结节同前
text_en: Imaging shows an ill-defined nodule in the right lobe of the thyroid, unchanged.

source_text: 右肺下叶外侧基底段不规则小结节同前，约7x4mm（IM114），密度较高，边界清晰
text_en: An irregular small nodule in the lateral basal segment of the right lower lobe is stable, measuring approximately 7x4 mm (IM114), with relatively high density and well-defined margins.

source_text: 左肺下叶基底段类结节及索条影同前，较大约21x13mm（IM53），伴少许支气管扩张影，
text_en: Nodule and linear opacities in the left lower lobe basal segment unchanged from prior, largest approximately 21x13 mm (IM53), with mild bronchiectasis

source_text: 右肺下叶陈旧性病灶同前
text_en: Chronic findings in the right lower lobe are unchanged.

source_text: 纵隔2R、4R、5、6组多发淋巴结同前相仿，较大仍约17x16mm（IM29）
text_en: Lymphadenopathy in mediastinal stations 2R, 4R, 5, and 6 similar to prior, with the largest still measuring approximately 17x16 mm (IM29)

source_text: 左肺上叶前段近胸膜处浅淡环状稍高密度结节同前，约7x6mm（IM17）
text_en: A faint ring-shaped nodule with slightly higher density near the pleura in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe is unchanged, approximately 7x6 mm (IM17).

source_text: 双肺叶间胸膜下微结节同前（IM30、32、33、42），较大仍约5mm，大小及形态均较前相仿，考虑炎性结节或陈旧灶可能大
text_en: Multiple subpleural micronodules at the interlobar fissures are stable compared to prior (IM30, 32, 33, 42), largest still approximately 5 mm, with similar size and morphology as before; inflammatory nodules or sequelae are most likely.

source_text: 右肺上叶切除术后，左肺小结节及淡片影同前
text_en: Following right upper lobectomy, small nodules and faint patchy opacities in the left lung are unchanged.

source_text: 腰1椎体高密度结节同前，倾向骨岛，余扫及胸廓诸骨未见明确破坏征象
text_en: A high-density nodule in the L1 vertebral body is unchanged, suggestive of a bone island; no clear evidence of destruction in the remaining scanned thoracic bones.

source_text: 右肺下叶基底段实性结节，约15mm（IMA58），考虑转移，结合临床
text_en: Solid nodule in the basal segment of the right lower lobe, approximately 15 mm (IMA58), considered metastatic; correlate with clinical findings.

source_text: 右侧胸膜结节较前缩小
text_en: The right pleural nodule is smaller compared to prior.

source_text: 纵隔及右肺门小淋巴结大致同前
text_en: Multiple small lymph nodes in the mediastinum and right hilum are approximately stable compared to prior.

source_text: 甲状腺左侧叶增厚伴低密度结节同前
text_en: Thickening of the left thyroid lobe with a low-density nodule, unchanged from prior.

source_text: 纵隔8组淋巴结较前相仿，现约25x14mm（IM38）
text_en: The lymph node in mediastinal station 8 is similar in size compared to prior, currently approximately 25x14 mm (IM38).

source_text: 双肺多发小结节影同前
text_en: Multiple small nodules in both lungs are stable compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节灶较前略增大，现约4mm（IMA33），原约3mm（IM33）
text_en: The small nodule in the right middle lobe is slightly larger than before, now measuring approximately 4 mm (IMA33), previously approximately 3 mm (IM33).

source_text: 左肺索条影及右肺中叶小结节灶同前（IM33）
text_en: Left lung linear opacities and right middle lobe small nodule unchanged from prior (IM33)

source_text: 右肺小斑片结节影较前范围缩小，密度减低
text_en: The small patchy nodular opacity in the right lung has decreased in extent and density compared to prior.

source_text: 左肺上叶术后，右肺下叶模糊小结节较前缩小，余双肺小结节同前，追查
text_en: Post left upper lobectomy, hazy small nodule in right lower lobe decreased in size compared to prior, remaining small nodules in both lungs unchanged, with follow-up.

source_text: 原左肺下叶较大结节大致同前，仍约8mm（IM34)
text_en: The larger nodule in the left lower lobe is essentially unchanged, still measuring approximately 8 mm (IM34).

source_text: 右肺小结节影同前，仍约3mm（IMA18）
text_en: Right lung small nodule shadows are unchanged, still approximately 3 mm (IMA18).

source_text: 双肺散在少许钙化结节同前，左下肺近膈面小结节同前（IM48）
text_en: Scattered few calcified nodules in both lungs are unchanged, small nodule near the diaphragmatic surface of the left lower lobe unchanged (IM48).

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，均小于10mm，左肺门、双侧锁骨上及双腋下未见肿大淋巴结
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, all less than 10mm, no enlarged lymph nodes seen in left hilar, bilateral supraclavicular, and bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 左肺下叶索条影、两肺散在模糊小结节灶大小及范围部分同前相仿，较大仍约8x6mm（IMA14）
text_en: Left lower lobe linear opacities and scattered indistinct small nodular opacities in both lungs, size and extent partially similar to prior; largest still approximately 8x6 mm (IMA14).

source_text: 右肺上叶术后改变，纵隔淋巴结较前饱满，余大致同前
text_en: Postoperative change in the right upper lobe; mediastinal lymph nodes more prominent than before; remainder largely unchanged

source_text: 纵隔、锁骨上区及双腋下平扫未见新发肿大淋巴结
text_en: Non-contrast scan shows no new enlarged lymph nodes in mediastinal, supraclavicular, or bilateral axillary regions.

source_text: 新见单发小结节
text_en: Newly identified solitary small nodule

source_text: 右侧锁骨区、纵隔多发淋巴结，转移待排
text_en: Multiple lymph nodes in the right supraclavicular region and mediastinum; metastasis cannot be excluded.

source_text: 纵隔多发小淋巴结同前，最大短径均小于10mm
text_en: Mediastinal multiple small lymph nodes unchanged from prior, maximum short diameter all less than 10mm.

source_text: 余肺未见新发结节
text_en: No new nodules are seen in the remaining lung.

source_text: 左肺下叶结节较前缩小，余多发模糊结节同前相仿
text_en: Left lower lobe nodule decreased in size compared to previous. The remaining multiple indistinct nodules are similar to previous.

source_text: 右肺下叶后段微小结节较前略明显，余肺多发小结节较前略缩小
text_en: The tiny nodule in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe is slightly more prominent than before; the remaining multiple small nodules in the lungs are slightly smaller than prior.

source_text: 双肺上叶微结节同前，倾向良性
text_en: Micronodules in the upper lobes of both lungs are stable compared to prior; likely benign.

source_text: 右肺少许索条影同前，右肺下叶结节，约4mm（IMA33），转移
text_en: Minimal linear opacities in the right lung are unchanged; a nodule in the right lower lobe measures approximately 4 mm (IMA33); metastasis.

source_text: 左侧腋下淋巴结同前，约11x7mm（IM8），追查
text_en: Left axillary lymph node is stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 11x7 mm (IM8); further follow-up recommended.

source_text: 余右肺散在微小结节影同前，大小约5mm（IM21、45）
text_en: Scattered tiny nodular opacities in the right lung are stable compared to prior, measuring approximately 5 mm (IM21, 45).

source_text: 右上肺多发索条结节较前略增多
text_en: Multiple linear and nodular opacities in the right upper lung have slightly increased in number compared to prior.

source_text: 扫及左侧肾上腺结节缩小，原约20x16mm（IM57），现约18x12mm（IM56）
text_en: Left adrenal nodule decreased in size, previously approximately 20x16 mm (IM57), currently approximately 18x12 mm (IM56).

source_text: 胸5椎体左侧椎弓根、胸6椎体、腰1椎体内小结节样高密度影同前
text_en: Small dense nodule in the left pedicle of T5, T6, and L1 vertebrae, unchanged from previous.

source_text: 余大小同前，未见确切新发灶
text_en: Size is stable; no definite new lesions are seen.

source_text: 右肺中叶及下叶支气管壁仍增厚，邻近肺门不规则软组织密度灶局部较前稍增大，原约15x11mm（IM33），现约18x14mm（IM35），邻近右肺下叶近肺门区支气管周围片状实变影较前范围增大
text_en: Wall thickening of the bronchi in the right middle and lower lobes persists. The irregular soft tissue density focus adjacent to the hilum is slightly larger than before, measuring approximately 15x11 mm (IM33) previously and now approximately 18x14 mm (IM35). The patchy consolidation surrounding the bronchi near the right lower lobe hilum has increased in extent compared to prior.

source_text: 右肺下叶不规则模糊小结节同前，较大仍约5mm（IM36）
text_en: Irregular, ill-defined small nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged; the largest remains approximately 5 mm (IM36).

source_text: 右肺上叶近水平裂新见一微小结节，约2mm（IM31），性质待定，追查
text_en: A new tiny nodule is seen near the horizontal fissure in the right upper lobe, approximately 2 mm (IM31), indeterminate in nature, requires follow-up.

source_text: 纵隔内淋巴结较前缩小
text_en: Mediastinal lymph nodes decreased in size compared to previous.

source_text: 右肺尖钙化灶及索条影同前，余双肺未见新发结节灶及斑片影
text_en: Calcified foci and linear opacities in the right lung apex are unchanged from prior. The remainder of both lungs shows no new nodules or patchy opacities.

source_text: 右肺中叶小结节影同前（IM31）
text_en: The small nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged (IM31).

source_text: 左肺下叶支气管开口处腔内结节略缩小，原约11mm（IM28），现约8mm（IMA25），远端肺不张较前略减轻
text_en: Intraluminal nodule at the bronchial orifice of the left lower lobe slightly reduced, previously approximately 11 mm (IM28), now approximately 8 mm (IMA25), distal atelectasis slightly improved compared to previous

source_text: 右肺下叶条片影较前增多，左肺下叶钙化结节同前
text_en: The linear and patchy opacity in the right lower lobe has increased compared to prior. The calcified nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged.

source_text: T10椎体致密小结节同前（Im42），余胸廓诸骨未见明确破坏征象
text_en: Dense small nodule in the T10 vertebral body is unchanged (Im42); no definite destructive changes are seen in the remainder of the thoracic skeleton.

source_text: 右肺上叶前段及左肺下叶前内基底段磨玻璃结节同前相仿，追查
text_en: Ground-glass nodules in the anterior segment of the right upper lobe and anteromedial basal segment of the left lower lobe are similar to prior; recommend follow-up.
